title: Humanoid robot football game machine
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and in particular discloses a humanoid robot football game machine. The humanoid robot football game machine comprises a humanoid football robot, an automatic football game platform and a remote control operation module, wherein the humanoid football robot is powered by a lithium battery, the height of the humanoid football robot is 340mm, 17 joints are designed on the whole body of the humanoid football robot, each arm is provided with three joints, the torque born by the joints of each arm can not exceed 9kg/cm, each leg is provided with 5 joints, the walking speed can not exceed 50mm/s, the torque born by the joints of each leg can not exceed 15kg/cm, the working voltage is DC 6V, and a lithium battery is used for providing electricity; the automatic football game platform is taken as a football playing field; the remote control operation module is a smart phone. The humanoid football robot in the humanoid robot football game machine can simulate a human being to kick the football towards any direction, and an automatic device is arranged on the football game platform, so that the game operation is flexible and simple, and the use is safe and convenient.

title: Intelligent partner robot for children
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent partner robot for children. The intelligent partner robot comprises a base, wherein rolling wheels are arranged at the lower part of the base; a robot body is fixed on the base; a rotatable head is connected with the upper part of the robot body; two rotatable arms are arranged on the left and right sides of the robot body; a cover body is arranged at the upper part of the head, and connected with a telescopic rod arranged in the head; a plurality of LED light sources are arranged on the lower surface of the cover body; a light sensor is arranged on the robot body; the robot body, the head and the arms are coated with a soft material which has a carbon crystal heating sheet; a temperature sensor is arranged inside the robot body and has sensing elements; the sensing elements are uniformly distributed on the surface of the robot body; the temperature sensor is connected with the carbon crystal heating sheet; when the ambient temperature is lower than a preset low-temperature value, the heating function of the carbon crystal heating sheet is enabled; and when the ambient temperature is higher than a preset high-temperature value, the heating function of the carbon crystal heating sheet is disabled.

title: Leg mechanism for serial-parallel hybrid human-simulated soccer robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg mechanism for a serial-parallel hybrid human-simulated soccer robot. The leg mechanism comprises a hip joint, two thigh connecting rods, a knee joint, two shank connecting rods, an ankle joint and a sole which are successively hinged, wherein the hip joint is arranged in a traditional serial form but the short span design of a hip joint U-shaped frame can strengthen the rigidity of the hip joint; a four-connecting-rod mechanism is arranged at the knee joint; the four-connecting-rod mechanism of the knee joint can promote the rigidity of the knee joint and can increase the walking stability; an arranging space for the knee joint tension spring is further supplied by the four-connecting-rod mechanism; the ankle joint has a parallel structure; the parallel structure of the ankle joint can realize the simultaneous power output of two driving units of the ankle joint; the rigidity is promoted while the inertia of shank is greatly reduced and the loads of the driving unit of the knee joint and the driving unit of the hip joint are relieved; the target of being light, quick, powerful and stable is achieved; the tension spring on the rear part of the knee joint has the functions of compensating for gravity and storing energy.

title: Robotic leg parallel to a ball screw
abstract: Disclosed are robotic systems, methods, bipedal robot devices, and computer-readable mediums. For example, a robotic system may include a robotic body, a robotic hip connected to the robotic body, and a ball screw connected to the robotic hip. Further, the robotic system may include a robotic leg connected to the robotic hip parallel to the ball screw. Yet further, the robotic hip includes a motor that is linearly movable to one or more positions along the ball screw between one end of the robotic leg and an opposite end of the robotic leg.

title: Device for vending ice-cream

title: Calculation method of kinetic model of 3D under-actuated biped robot
abstract: The invention, which relates to the technical field of the robot, provides a calculation method of a kinetic model of a 3D under-actuated biped robot. For a 3D under-actuated biped robot, kinetic model calculation is carried out on a one-foot supporting phase and a biped supporting phase, wherein the biped supporting phase of the robot is formed by a collision process and a coordinate switching process. Compared with the previous kinetic model calculation method, the provided method enables the programming calculation process of the kinetic model of the 3D under-actuated biped robot to become simple and clear, so that programming application can be realized conveniently.

title: Coordinate system establishment method of 3D biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a coordinate system establishment method of a 3D biped robot. The method comprises the steps of establishment of a robot inertial coordinate system, a reference coordinate system and coordinate systems of all connecting rods. The inertial coordinate system is fixed on a foot for a support leg when the robot takes its first step. The x-axis direction of the foot is aligned with the forward direction of the foot for the support leg. The y-axis direction points to the outside of a robot body. The z-axis direction is vertical to a foot panel. The reference coordinate system varies with the walking of the robot. In the single-leg support period of an ith step, the reference coordinate system is fixed on the foot of the support leg. The x-axis direction of the foot is aligned with the forward direction of the foot for the support leg. The y-axis direction points to the outside of a robot body. The z-axis direction is vertical to the foot panel. The coordinate systems of all connecting rods are established according to an HD method. The coordinate system establishment method cannot only describe the 3D spatial movement of the 3D biped robot in a complicated road condition but also conveniently demonstrate the kinematic characteristics of the walking state of the robot.

title: WEARABLE ROBOT
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a wearable robot comprises: an upper leg structure corresponding to a femoral region of a wearer; a lower leg structure provided on a lower portion of the upper leg structure, corresponding to a shin region of the wearer; a foot structure provided on a lower portion of the lower leg structure, corresponding to the foot region of the wearer; and a knee joint structure capable of rotating the lower leg structure backwards about a connection region with the upper leg structure as a multi-joint link structure connecting a gap between the upper leg structure and the lower leg structure.

title: Flexible human shoulder joint imitation mechanism and movement method
abstract: The invention relates to a flexible human shoulder joint imitation mechanism and a movement method thereof and belongs to the field of bio-robots. The flexible human shoulder joint imitation mechanism comprises a fixed platform, a spherical hinge I, a primary movement platform, a spherical hinge II, a secondary movement platform, pneumatic muscle actuators and the like, wherein the primary movement platform is connected with the fixed platform through the spherical hinge I and four pneumatic muscle actuators to form a primary parallel mechanism; the secondary movement platform is connected with the primary movement platform through the spherical hinge II and six pneumatic muscle actuators to form a secondary parallel mechanism; and the primary parallel mechanism and the secondary parallel mechanism form a parallel structure. The flexible human shoulder joint imitation mechanism is in two joint movements, namely, three-degree-of-freedom rotation of the primary movement platform by four four pneumatic muscle actuators relative to the fixed platform, and the three-degree-of-freedom rotation of the secondary movement platform by six the pneumatic muscle actuators relative to the primary movement platform. The flexible human shoulder joint imitation mechanism is close to actual situations of a human body, has relatively good flexibility, can be used for the design of various human-simulated robot shoulder joints, and therefore, has a wide application prospect.

title: Robot arm and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot arm and a robot. The robot arm comprises an upper arm and a forearm connected with the far end part of the upper arm through a movable joint. The forearm can make folding motion relative to the upper arm and make rotation motion along the longitudinal axis of the forearm. The robot arm can achieve a function more similar to that of a human arm, so that the experience effect of a humanoid robot using the robot arm can be improved.

title: Upper limb structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an upper limb structure of a humanoid robot and a humanoid robot. The upper limb structure comprises shoulders and arms, upper forearms and elbows for connecting the shoulders and arms and the upper forearms, wherein the shoulders and arms are provided with pivots; the upper forearms can be rotatably connected to the pivots; and the pivots and the x-axis direction form an angle alpha, and the pivots and the y-axis direction form an angle beta, wherein beta is an acute angle, and beta=90 DEG-alpha. According to the upper limb structure of the humanoid robot provided by the invention, upper limbs of the humanoid robot can be enabled to simulate various postures of a human through only changing the elbows, namely changing the directions of the pivots between the shoulders and arms, and the upper forearms, while no complex structures are needed to be arranged, so that not only is the upper limb structure simple and easy to produce and assemble, but also the product cost can be greatly reduced, and furthermore, the upper limb structure can be more popular with consumers.

title: Humanoid pneumatic flexible manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to a pneumatically-driven humanoid five-finger manipulator, comprising a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger, with ten joints, the thumb is arranged above the plane of the palm, the axis of the thumb and the plane of the palm form an included angle of 60 DEG, the four fingers other than the thumb are distributed along with the palm in the same plane, the axes of the adjacent fingers form an included angle of 13.5 DEG, the axial plane o the thumb and middle finger in the free state forms an included angle of 50 DEG C with the plane of the palm, the axes of the five fingers extend and intersect at a point, the thumb has a maximum bending angle of 210 DEG C for forward flexion, the thumb can rock by using the axial plane of the thumb and middle finger as a symmetric plane, with a maximum bending angle of +/- 30 DEG for rocking action, the index finger has a maximum bending angle of 290 DEG for forward flexion and maximum bending angles of 15 DEG for reverse flexion and side rocking, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are identical in structure, a maximum bending angle of 290 DEG for forward flexion toward the palm, and the fingers are driven in a pneumatic manner.

title: Humanoid robot gait control method based on model correlated reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait control method based on model correlated reinforcement learning. The method comprises steps of 1) defining a reinforcement learning framework for a stable control task in forward and backward movements of a humanoid robot; 2) carrying out gait control of the humanoid robot with a model correlated reinforcement learning method based on the sparse online Gaussian process; and 3) improving a motion selection method of a reinforcement learning humanoid robot controller by a PID controller, and taking the improved operation as an optimizing initial point for the PID controller obtaining the motion selection operation of the reinforcement learning controller. The invention utilizes reinforcement learning to control gaits of the humanoid robot in movement, and thus the movement control of the humanoid robot can be automatically adjusted via interaction with the environment, a better control effect is achieved, and the humanoid robot is enabled to be stable in forward and backward directions.

title: HAND INTENDED TO EQUIP A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The invention concerns a hand intended to equip a humanoid robot, the hand comprising a palm and at least one finger (20) extending along a first axis (21), the hand being capable of picking up an object, the finger (20) comprising a first phalanx (31) linked to the palm by a first motorised pivot link (41) and a second phalanx (32) consecutive to the first phalanx (31) linked to the first phalanx (31) by a second pivot link (42). According to the invention, the finger (20) comprises a first mechanism (51) linking the palm to the second phalanx (32) configured such that the rotation of the first phalanx (31) about the second axis (22) causes the second phalanx (32) to rotate about the third axis (23), and a second mechanism (52) linking the palm to each of the phalanxes (31, 32) configured to actuate the finger (20) in such a way that the finger (20) wraps around the object to be picked up, and the second mechanism (52) is configured to deform the first mechanism (51).

title: ROBOT BEHAVIOR GENERATION METHOD
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a robot behavior generation method that more accurately reproduces human behavior. To accomplish this purpose, there is provided a robot behavior generation method for the purpose of reproducing human behavior with a robot, wherein the robot behavior generation method has: a step S1 for generating a human body model by modeling the configuration of the human body; a step S2 for generating a robot model by modeling a configuration of a robot; a step S3 for creating associations between the human body model generated in step S1 and the robot model generated in step S2; a step S4 for acquiring first movement data indicating displacement of a human body model corresponding to behavior of the human body; a step S5 for selectively choosing movement feature indicators having first unknown movement data that indicates displacement of the human body model generated in step S1, and formulating evaluation criteria pertaining to reproduction error, for normative movement data acquired in step S4; a step S6 for selecting a constraint necessary for the purpose of movement by a robot which has second unknown movement data that indicates displacement of the robot model generated in step S2; a step S7 for calculating first unknown movement data and second unknown movement data such that reproduction error based on the evaluation criteria of step S5 is minimized under the constraint selected in step S6 and the association obtained in step S3; and a step S8 for using the second unknown movement data calculated in step S7 to control the robot.

title: Kinect-based human behavior imitation method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a Kinect-based human behavior imitation method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following step: 1) extracting human skeleton information from an RGB-D image acquired by Kinect, and building a motion model of a human body; 2) building a motion model of the humanoid robot according to structural features of the limbs of the humanoid robot; 3) converting acquired human motion into motion of the motion model of the humanoid robot by means of model mapping; 4) adjusting the joint angles of the humanoid robot by a balance control technology to keep the humanoid robot stale during an imitation process; and 5) after self-collision avoidance treatment of the state of the humanoid robot, sending final joint configuration data to the humanoid robot so that the humanoid robot complete imitated motion. According to the method, a mapping technology with eight kinematic chains is employed, so that the humanoid robot can imitate as many human joint positions as possible, the motion of the humanoid robot is similar to that of the human body, and the humanoid robot can execute the motion online. The method can be used in human motion learning, remote control and the like of the humanoid robot.

title: Home teaching robot with adjustable walking device
abstract: The invention discloses a home teaching robot with an adjustable walking device. The home teaching robot comprises a teaching robot body. The teaching robot body comprises a teaching robot body shell and a teaching robot body control system. The teaching robot body shell comprises wheel installation bodies and articulated arms. The wheel installation bodies are connected with the articulated arms. The teaching robot body control system comprises a driving device, a control device and a camera device. The driving device is connected with the control device. The control device is connected with the camera device. The camera device is used for shooting various postures, states and motions of a user. The control device automatically adjust telescopic or turnover or rotation or moving motions of the wheel installation bodies and/or the articulated arms and/or the teaching robot body according to pictures shot by the camera device. The home teaching robot is simple in structure and convenient to operate. Greater humanization and intellectualization are achieved. The home teaching robot adapts to sitting or prostrating or lying or standing or exercising postures and states of the user by adjusting the postures and motions of the teaching robot body, and thus studying of the user is convenient.

title: Community correction robot
abstract: The invention discloses a community correction robot. The community correction robot comprises a robot head shell, a robot trunk shell, a head assembly arranged in the robot head shell, and a trunk skeleton arranged in the robot trunk shell. title: Mechanically-timed footsteps for a robotic device
abstract: An example implementation for determining mechanically-timed footsteps may involve a robot having a first foot in contact with a ground surface and a second foot not in contact with the ground surface. The robot may determine a position of its center of mass and center of mass velocity, and based on these, determine a capture point for the robot. The robot may also determine a threshold position for the capture point, where the threshold position is based on a target trajectory for the capture point after the second foot contacts the ground surface. The robot may determine that the capture point has reached this threshold position and based on this determination, cause the second foot to contact the ground surface.

title: INTEGRATION OF WHOLE BODY CONTROLLERS WITH ROBOTS
abstract: A method, system and computer program product for controlling a humanoid robot. A compound task that defines operational space objectives and lower priority goal postures that a whole body controller should achieve is defined. Furthermore, a constraint set that specifies natural physical constraints of a robot is defined. Additionally, a robot model that computes kinematic and dynamic properties of the robot is defined. Furthermore, controller parameters to be utilized by the whole body controller are bound to a set of transport layers which enables the controller parameters to be accessed by external processes. The whole body controller is instantiated utilizing the compound task, constraint set, robot model and parameter bindings. In this manner, whole body controllers are effectively integrated with robots and their applications.

title: Humanoid robot joint mechanism with zero position detection function
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint mechanism with a zero position detection function. A humanoid robot comprises a hip joint mechanism and an ankle joint mechanism. title: Three-motor companion robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a three-motor companion robot. Each foot device comprises a shell, a power supply structure which is arranged inside the shell, a first driving structure which is arranged inside the shell and connected with the power supply structure, and a first obstacle avoidance structure which is arranged inside the shell. title: A METHOD AND A SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING MOTION RETARGETING BETWEEN HETEROGENEOUS SPACES

According to a method and a system for re-targeting a motion of a humanoid object between heterogeneous spaces of the present invention, when a heterogeneous space is given, space similarity information based on a target object of a motion in each space may be calculated through computation geometry such that a space corresponding map is constructed and the motion is applied and changed in heterogeneous spaces by using the space corresponding map. The miniature LED projector is placed inside the head part and located behind the light-transmitting mask, and is used for projecting role images generated by a computer in a simulation mode onto the light-transmitting mask. The telephone receivers are located at the two sides of the head part. abstract: The invention discloses a steering mechanism for a humanoid robot hip joint, and belongs to the technical field of robots. title: Joint connection structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a joint connection structure for a humanoid robot and belongs to the technical field of robots. title: Reinforcement learning humanoid robot gait planning method based on big data mode
abstract: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning humanoid robot gait planning method based on a big data mode, comprising the steps as follows: first, acquiring state information through a sensor assembled on a humanoid robot; then, calculating an action using a Q learning algorithm, correcting offline gait, and getting an immediate return value; storing the information in a file in the form of tetrad using a big data storage method; and finally, randomly extracting a tetrad, and updating a Q function based on the tetrad and a RBF neural network. Through the method, the walking of a humanoid robot in an uneven environment can be smoothly adjusted and controlled. Compared with a method of guiding a robot to walk using offline gait, the method is more efficient and advantageous. Experiments prove that the method is feasible and effective.

title: Humanoid-robot automatic vending machine
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid-robot automatic vending machine, comprising a shelf, a smart outgoing warehouse, a humanoid robot that rotates to capture goods on the shelf and putting in smart outgoing warehouse, a touch-screen computer connected with shelf, and a cashier system connected with touch-screen computer, wherein the humanoid robot comprises humanoid shell, moving parts under the humanoid shell, rotary waist arranged on the humanoid shell, mechanical arms on the humanoid shell, and control box connected with mechanical arms. The invention provides a multi-functional humanoid-robot automatic vending machine that prevents products from falling and getting damage. The vending form is novel, reducing chances of product breakage; the computer with touch screen is used to enable operators to select products by touch screen. In idle time, touch screen becomes an advertisement board. Meanwhile, payment by mobile phone is supported; remote information release device may make remote information content release at one or a plurality of vending machines simultaneously.

title: Underactuated humanoid dexterous robotic hand device
abstract: The invention relates to an underactuated humanoid dexterous robotic hand device, which is provided with five independently controlled modular fingers and has 16 freedom degrees. The whole hand is driven by 11 motors; the dimension and the shape are similar to those of the hand of an adult. Except for a thumb, the other four fingers have the completely identical structures; the thumb has one freedom degree of doing longitudinal rotation around the palm base; through the arrangement of a rotating shaft, when the whole hand grasps objects, the grasping force of the forefinger, the ring finger and the small finger on the objects can be in symmetrical distribution at the two sides of the middle finger; the grasping stability is improved. Modular fingers are used; the two motors are respectively used for driving a finger base part joint, a middle joint and a tail end joint; the middle joint and the tail end joint are coupled by a structure-variable connecting mechanism; through a connecting rod mechanism, the relative positions of the two coupled finger joints after the contact with the objects can be actively regulated, so that the fingers can wrap the objects according to the shape of the grasped objects; the self adaptability to the appearance of the objects is high; the grasping action better conforms to the human hand. The structure of the whole hand is simple; the grasping force is great; the grasping rigidity is high; the control is simple; the grasping self adaptability is high; the underactuated humanoid dexterous robotic hand device is applicable to the fields of disabled people artificial hands, explosive handling, nuclear equipment detection and humanoid robots.

title: Human walking simulated plate carrying robot
abstract: The invention discloses a human walking simulated plate carrying robot, comprising an upper body structure, a waist board, a lower body structure and a double-stable meal delivery device. The upper body structure is a frame type structure, and comprises a main frame. The main frame comprises a head portion, a shoulder portion and a thoracico-abdominal portion. The double-stable meal delivery device comprises a meal delivery bottom plate. A main container having an arched vertical section is arranged on the meal delivery bottom plate. A lead block is fixedly connected to the bottom of an inner cavity of the main container, and the center of gravity of the lead block is located right above a first ball. A water holding plate is arranged in the inner cavity of the main container above the lead block, and hermetically connected to the inner wall of the main container. The center of the water holding plate is upwardly connected with an elastic expansion link, and the top end of the elastic expansion link is fixedly connected to a second ball. The water holding plate and the main container define a water tank. The water tank is filled with water, and a tableware tray floats on the water, and comprises a disc-shaped tray bottom plate. The human walking simulated plate carrying robot is capable of simulating human walking, and also capable of avoiding unstable meal delivery, and is simple in structure and relatively low in manufacturing cost.

abstract: The invention relates to a lower limb movement-assisting machine skeleton with a barycenter self-adjustment balance function. The lower limb movement-assisting machine skeleton comprises a base, hip brackets, crus brackets, foot fixing plates and drivers, wherein a waist rotation base is hinged to the base; the waist rotation base is provided with a barycenter adjusting device; the barycenter adjusting device comprises a support block, a first motor, a lead screw, counterweight slide blocks and buffering springs; the upper ends of the hip brackets are hinged to the lower surface of the base through second spherical hinges; the lower ends of the hip brackets are hinged to the upper ends of the crus brackets; the lower ends of the crus brackets are connected with the foot fixing plates. The lower limb movement-assisting machine skeleton with the barycenter self-adjustment balance function is reasonable in structure, and has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in use, high intelligence degree and the like; the problem that the conventional lower limb movement-assisting machine skeleton cannot well stabilize the barycenter of a human body is solved effectively.

The biped-walking dining car pushing robot can simulate the human body to push the dining car and walk, simulate the knee bending action of the human body as well as simulate the action that the leg with a bent knee walks forward and the other leg does not walk temporarily, and is stable in dining delivery. The biped-walking dining car pushing robot has a relatively simple structure, is convenient to process and manufacture, has relatively low cost, and is suitable for restaurants for saving labor force and attracting more diners.

title: Autonomous robot using data captured from a living subject
abstract: Using various embodiments, an autonomous robot using data captured from a living subject are disclosed. In one embodiment, an autonomous robot is described comprising a robotic skeleton designed similar to that of a human skeleton to simulate similar movements as performed by living subjects. The movements of the robotic skeleton are resultant due to control signals received by effectors present near or on the robotic skeleton. The robot can be configured to receive sensor data transmitted from a sensor apparatus that periodically gathers the sensor data from a living subject. The robot can then process the sensor data to transmit control signals to the effectors to simulate the actions performed by the living subject and perform a predictive analysis to learn the capability of generating spontaneous and adaptive actions, resulting in an autonomous robot that can adapt to its surroundings.

title: Humanoid robot trunk structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot trunk structure. The humanoid robot trunk structure is characterized in that the trunk structure is formed by connecting subunits in series; each subunit is provided with a cylindrical shell, the top face and the bottom face of each cylindrical shell are symmetrical slopes, and as for the two symmetrical side edges of each cylindrical shell, one side edge is short while the other side edge is long; a motor, an encoder and a driver are arranged in the cylindrical shell of each subunit; as for series connection of the subunits, the bottom face of each upper unit and the top face of the corresponding lower unit are connected through the upper surface and the lower surface of a speed reducer; and motors arranged in the lower units can drive the cylindrical shells of the upper units to rotate through the speed reducers so that the short edges of the subunits can be located on the same side and a trunk can be bent, or the short edges of every two adjacent subunits can be located on different sides and the trunk can be upright. The humanoid robot trunk structure is simple in structure, easy to control and good in bearing capacity, and can achieve three kinds of typical postures including leftward and rightward lateral swinging, forward and backward pitching and waist rotation like the trunk of a human being.

abstract: The invention discloses a hip connection device of a humanoid robot. The hip connection device of the humanoid robot comprises a hip rack. title: System for Estimating the Center of Pressure in Gait Rehabilitation Robots and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for estimating the center of gravity and a method thereof, which can estimate a position of the center of gravity with a sensor module to estimate the center of gravity in a gait rehabilitation robot, and comprises: a sensor module having a detection unit which is mounted on a foothold to detect pressure when a pedestrian walks; an output means outputting a voltage value corresponding to a predetermined condition in accordance with a pressure signal detected in the sensor module; and an estimation means calculating an angle value by corresponding to the voltage value outputted in the output means, and estimating the center of gravity. title: Self-adaptive motion multi-joint walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive motion multi-joint walking robot. The self-adaptive motion multi-joint walking robot comprises a drive unit, an ultrasonic sensor, a triaxial accelerometer, a photoconductive resistance sensor, a main control chip and a servo steering engine controller. The drive unit comprises a plurality of servo steering engines, and four limbs of the robot are each provided with at least two servo steering engines. The ultrasonic sensor is used for feedback for the robot distance. The triaxial accelerometer is used for feedback for the stationary value of the robot. The photoconductive resistance sensor is used for feedback for the offset of the robot. The main control chip is connected with the drive unit, the ultrasonic sensor, the triaxial accelerometer and the photoconductive resistance sensor and is used for controlling the operating state of the robot. The servo steering engine controller is used for numbering the servo steering engines so as to control the states of the servo steering engines. The robot is simple in structure, easy to assemble, relatively free under walking limitation, good in motion speed and stable in operation, and when the robot is in instable motion, self-repair can be achieved through instant development.

title: Head structure of humanoid service robot
abstract: The invention provides a head structure of a humanoid service robot. title: Control device and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control device and method for a humanoid robot. The control device comprises a robot controller arranged in the robot. The robot controller comprises an upper computer and a lower computer in communication connection with the upper computer. The lower computer is connected with all movement parts of the robot. The control device is further provided with a signal collector which is in communication connection with the upper computer. The upper computer sends signals to the lower computer according to information collected by the signal collector so as to achieve movement control over all the movement parts of the robot. Due to the arrangement of the upper computer, the signal collector and the lower computer, the upper computer conducts comprehensive analysis according to position, audio and image information collected by the signal collector and sends control signals to the lower computer, and the lower computer then sends the movement control signals to all the movement parts of the robot to achieve the expected movement of all the movement parts of the robot. The control device and method for the humanoid robot are simple in line and low in cost, and the control device and method are used for the field of humanoid robots.

title: Auto-height swing adjustment
abstract: An example implementation includes (i) receiving sensor data that indicates topographical features of an environment in which a robotic device is operating, (ii) processing the sensor data into a topographical map that includes a two-dimensional matrix of discrete cells, the discrete cells indicating sample heights of respective portions of the environment, (iii) determining, for a first foot of the robotic device, a first step path extending from a first lift-off location to a first touch-down location, (iv) identifying, within the topographical map, a first scan patch of cells that encompass the first step path, (v) determining a first high point among the first scan patch of cells; and (vi) during the first step, directing the robotic device to lift the first foot to a first swing height that is higher than the determined first high point.

title: Double-leg walking humanoid educational robot for infant teaching assistance
abstract: The invention discloses a double-leg walking humanoid educational robot for infant teaching assistance. The double-leg walking humanoid educational robot for infant teaching assistance comprises an upper body structure, a waist board and a lower body structure. The upper body structure is a framework structure and comprises a main framework with the profile simulating the shape of the upper half body of a human body. The main framework comprises a head portion, shoulder portions and a chest-belly portion. The waist board is arranged horizontally, and the chest-belly portion in the upper body structure is connected with the waist board. The lower body structure is arranged in a bilateral symmetry mode, and comprises a thigh structure, a shank structure and a leg structure. The double-leg walking humanoid educational robot for infant teaching assistance can simulate human beings to walk, simulate the knee bending action in the walking process, and further simulate the action that the leg with the knee bent moves forwards while the other leg does not move forwards temporarily, the two legs can move forwards alternately, the humanoid degree is significantly improved compared with the prior art, the robot can more strongly attract the attention of infants for a longer time, a user can make related interpretation for the infants more conveniently, the interest of the infants in technologies is improved, and the scientific literacy of the infants is enhanced.

title: Vibration suppression method in walking of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention a vibration suppression method in walking of a humanoid robot based on an input shaper. The method comprises the following steps: firstly collecting ZMP position step response signals by using a pelma six-dimensional force/moment sensor; then building a model of a process from a ZMP reference value to a ZMP practical value according to the ZMP position step response signals, constructing the input shaper according to the obtained model, and calculating time advance of a reference ZMP track according to the obtained model; and finally putting the obtained input shaper and the time advance link in a reference ZMP track generator, and applying the reference ZMP track generator to walking of the humanoid robot. Through the vibration suppression method, the vibration caused by a non-rigid connection rod system in walking is suppressed in a feedforward manner by modifying the reference ZMP track sent to a centroid track generator, so that the walking is more stable; compared with a method for suppressing vibration by feedback, the method can suppress the vibration after the vibration occurs and is free of risk of oscillation caused by overhigh closed-loop gain.

title: Method for optimizing inverse kinematic humanoid-arm configuration of 7-freedom-degree humanoid mechanical arm under multi-constraint condition
abstract: A method for optimizing inverse kinematic humanoid-arm configuration of a 7-freedom-degree humanoid mechanical arm under a multi-constraint condition belongs to the field of mechanical arm control. By the method, the problems the usable arm configuration of the humanoid mechanical arm cannot be completely described, the tail end reachable positions are reduced, motion is susceptible to jumping change and the humanoid arm configuration meeting the multi-constraint condition cannot be obtained in the existing position-based inverse kinematic method are solved. The method comprises the steps: calculating all the useable arm configuration sets avoiding joint limiting and collusion under the given track; performing operating ellipsoid optimization on all the useable arm configuration sets to obtain humanoid arm configuration; introducing transition between a mechanical arm self-motion processing unusable optimizing arm angle and an arm angle area; and transforming a problem of searching optimized joints from a seven-dimensional joint space constrained by six equations and a plurality of inequations into a one-dimensional optimizing problem. The method is used for optimizing the humanoid arm configuration of the 7-freedom-degree humanoid mechanical arm.

title: Method for controlling anthropomorphic robot to imitate motions of upper part of human body in real time
abstract: The invention provides a method for controlling an anthropomorphic robot to imitate motions of the upper part of a human body in real time. The method for controlling the anthropomorphic robot to imitate the motions of the upper part of the human body in real time comprises the steps that (1) human body skeleton information, color information and depth information are obtained through Kinect sensors; (2) three-dimensional coordinates of all joints of upper limbs are extracted from the skeleton information, and the joint angles of the left and right arms of the upper limbs of the human body are worked out through a geometrical analysis method; (3) with the color information and the depth information as input, the face rotating angle of the human body is obtained through a face tracking algorithm in Kinect SDK; (4) hands are segmented out from a depth image, and the open-close states of palms are judged; and (5) the robot is driven to complete motions identical with the motions of the human body according to the angles, worked out in the step (1), of the left and right arms of the upper limbs of the human body, the head rotating angle, worked out in the step (2), of the human body, and the hand states, judged in the step (4), of the human body. According to the method for controlling the anthropomorphic robot to imitate the motions of the upper part of the human body in real time, the joint angles of the left and right arms of the upper limbs can be worked out without modeling, and imitation of head rotation of the human body by the robot is achieved through the angles obtained based on face recognition, and the hand states of the human body are judged easily and conveniently by segmenting out the palms through the depth information.

The humanoid mechanical head comprises a first steering engine, a second steering engine, a first swing arm, a second swing arm, a base plate, a biaxial universal joint and a base; two ends of the biaxial universal joint are fixedly connected with the base plate and the base respectively; the first steering engine and the second steering engine are mounted on the base plate and located at two sides of the biaxial universal joint; the first steering engine is hinged with the first swing arm, and one end of the first swing arm far away from the first steering engine is hinged with the base; the second steering engine is hinged with the second swing arm, and one end of the second steering arm far away from the second steering engine is hinged with the base; the first steering engine and the first swing arm are matched with each other, and the second steering engine and the second swing arm are matched each other, thereby realizing the front-back nodding action and left-right snaking action of the humanoid mechanical head. The humanoid mechanical head and the humanoid robot provided by the invention can realize precise control.

title: Humanoid type mechanical finger with perceptive functions of temperature and touch force
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid type mechanical finger with perceptive functions of temperature and touch force. The humanoid mechanical finger is formed by hinge of three sections of finger metal phalanges which have controllable bending ranges in sequence, and complexion silica gel is utilized to encapsulate the external surface of the humanoid mechanical finger; each section of the finger is hollow, the third section of the finger metal phalanges is internally provided with a micro motor and a minitype circuit, both the first section of the finger metal phalanges and the finger pulp of the second section of the finger metal are provided with plane grooves on the surface and are internally provided with three-dimensional force sensors, the semicircular face of the top end of the first section of the finger metal phalanges is provided with a gap, an cambered heat conductor and a temperature sensor are fixed through snap joints, and the temperature sensor is closely attached to the inner surface of the heat conductor. According to the humanoid type mechanical finger with perceptive functions of temperature and touch force, the temperature of an object touched by the mechanical finger and the three-dimensional force applied to the object can be sensitively measured and be timely transmitted to a control system, slipping, moving, deformation of the object and the like are recognized through the change of the three-dimensional force, the purpose of integrating the artificial touch to the mechanical finger is achieved, and convenience is brought to closed-loop control over the mechanical finger in grabbing the object more intelligently, cleverly and stably.

title: Self-locking joint parallel connection elastic actuator
abstract: The invention relates to a self-locking joint parallel connection elastic actuator. A motor is arranged in a vertical-axis mode. A speed reducer shell is a part of the actuator rather than common sleeve connection of the motor and a speed reducer. A second-stage speed reduction mechanism uses a worm and gear mechanism, the transverse size is reduced, and the mechanical self-locking requirement is met. The transverse size of the joint of an upper shell and a lower shell is small so as to install a worm wheel, and other parts are provided with a worm and a first-stage speed reduction mechanism respectively. The first-stage speed reduction mechanism uses common cylindrical gear transmission so as to adjust the center distance according to different requirements under the condition that the models of the worm wheel, the worm and the motor are determined, and the rotation range of the joint actuator is widened as much as possible. The largest bending angle and the largest stretching angle are limited by the size of the shell to protect safety of an exoskeleton user. A torsion spring is used as an energy storage mechanism, arranged at the joint of the upper shell and the lower shell and positioned by a mechanical boss. A worm shaft serves as an output shaft so that the upper shell and the lower shell can be connected, and the lower shell and the upper shell are connected with lower limbs and upper limbs of a power exoskeleton or a humanoid robot respectively.

title: Entertainment humanoid intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses an entertainment humanoid intelligent robot. The robot is characterized by comprising a head, a neck, a trunk, two arms, two legs and two feet, the lower end of the head is fixed to the center of the upper end of the neck, the neck is installed at the center of the trunk, the two arms are symmetrically installed on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the trunk, the two legs are installed at the left end and the right end of the bottom of the trunk respectively, and the feet are installed at the bottoms of the legs respectively. By the adoption of the technical scheme, the robot has the advantages that the whole robot is manufactured through machining and plates, machining cost and time cost are reduced, and later detail finishing of parts is convenient; an up-down buckle type battery bin is used, the whole robot is easy to machine, and assembly and later maintenance are easy.

title: Control system and method of multifunctional man-machine interaction humanoid teaching robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control system of a multifunctional man-machine interaction humanoid teaching robot. The system comprises a remote monitoring module, real-time protective modules, a speech module, a mobile phone APP module, a robot movement module, a wireless communication module, a steering engine integration module and a control module, the modules are connected with an embedded controller through wires for real-time data exchange, the remote monitoring module is located on the head of the robot, the real-time protective modules are located on the shoulders of the robot, the wireless communication module is located on the chest of the robot and composed of three communication module bodies, robot palms are arranged at the tail ends of robot arms, the chest of the robot is supported on robot feet through robot legs, and the robot movement module and the steering engine integration module receive control instructions sent by the control module. The biological humanoid teaching robot is multifunctional, richer in man-machine interaction and high in environment adaptability, and the adaptability range to people of different ages is wide.

title: Robot for traffic guidance
abstract: The invention provides a robot for traffic guidance. A rotating motor is arranged on a base of the robot; an engine body is arranged on the rotating motor; two arm steering motors are respectively arranged at the two sides of the upper part of the engine body and are connected to arm main rotating motor bases; each arm main rotating motor corresponds to one arm auxiliary rotating motor; each arm auxiliary rotating motor corresponds to one guidance rod rotating motor; the two sides of the arm main rotating motors and the arm auxiliary rotating motors and the two sides of the arm auxiliary rotating motors and the guidance rod rotating motors correspond to a pair of arm supports respectively; the arm supports are connected to the corresponding motors; the arm auxiliary rotating motors and the guidance rod rotating motors are fixed between the two corresponding arm supports; electronic guidance rods are inserted on the guidance rod rotating motors; the engine body is provided with a head which is provided with a work indicating lamp; and a top is arranged above the head; and each side of the top is provided with three traffic lights. The main body of the robot is an anthropomorphic robot and can simulate each posture of a traffic police to achieve the effect of traffic guidance.

title: Humanoid robot with ultrasonic wave eyes
abstract: The present invention provides a humanoid robot with ultrasonic wave eyes. Through matching with a head motion mechanism, a set of ultrasonic sensors are arranged at the eye portions of the humanoid robot to allow the detection angle of the humanoid robot to be wider and have more directivity, reduce the hardware cost and the program complexity of the robot and improve the ornamental value of the humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a humanoid robot head, an ultrasonic ranging module is fixed at the eye portions of the humanoid robot head and comprises two ultrasonic sensors taken as the robot eyes, the robot head has a steering engine capable of driving the head to move, and the steering engine and the ultrasonic ranging module are both connected with a robot main control board which emits control signals to control the synchronous movement of the ultrasonic ranging module and the robot head and emit detection signals to allow the robot to realize the multidirectional ultrasonic scanning detection through the head motion.

title: Robot model
abstract: The invention discloses a robot model. title: Robot expression control method and device
abstract: The invention provides a robot expression control method and device. The method comprises the steps of receiving user behavior signals collected by a robot, wherein the user behavior signals comprise one or multiple of face reflection signals, limb reflection signals and voice signals; extracting user emotion characteristics from the user behavior signals, wherein the user emotion characteristics comprise one or multiple of expression characteristics, action characteristics and voice characteristics; seeking expression parameters corresponding to the user emotion characteristics from an expression parameter database built in advance; sending the expression parameters to the robot so as to enable the robot to seek expression presentation data corresponding to the expression parameters from the expression parameter database built in advance; according to the expression presentation data, controlling the face of the robot to perform expression showing, wherein the expression presentation data comprise action control data of the five facial sense organs of the face. According to the method and device, interactivity and practicability of the robot and a user are enhanced, and the user experience degree of the user is improved.

title: Knee ankle rigidity matching method of humanoid lower limb
abstract: The invention discloses a knee ankle rigidity matching method of a humanoid lower limb. The knee ankle rigidity matching method comprises steps that a Solidworks model data is designed according to a robot, and an Adams and Matlab combined simulation platform is established; the control rates of the robot at a flying attitude and a standing attitude are designed, and the robot can complete a capriole motion, the foothold of which is zero; according to a human body jumping exercise rule, an evaluation function of a PSO algorithm is proposed, and knee ankle joint spring rigidity capable of satisfying evaluation indexes is searched according to the PSO algorithm; the spring rigidity suitable for the robot is selected from real objects according to the searching results of the PSO algorithm. The continuous stable high energy effect jumping exercise of the robot is realized, and energy efficiency can reach 55.8%.

title: Multifunctional intelligent robot capable of moving independently
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional intelligent robot capable of moving independently. The multifunctional intelligent robot comprises a base, a trunk assembly and a head assembly. The base comprises laser radar and a collision detection sensor. The trunk assembly is located above the base, and a projector is arranged in front of the trunk assembly. Multiple ultrasonic sensors and a control unit are arranged in the trunk assembly. The head assembly is located above the trunk assembly and comprises a camera and a display screen. The display screen is used for displaying state information of the multifunctional intelligent robot. A microphone and a loudspeaker are arranged on the left side and the right side of the head assembly correspondingly. The multifunctional intelligent robot is simple in structure and can independently move without the aid of any external sensor, the independent thinking ability and the intelligence level of the robot are improved, functions are rich, and the robot can provide guiding services or be used for family services, medical services, children entertainment, study assisting, education study, intelligent monitoring and the like.

title: Infant intelligent nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses an infant intelligent nursing robot. The infant intelligent nursing robot comprises a head, a body, a roller, telescopic arms, sucking discs and a signal collecting line. The head is arranged on the upper end portion of the body, the roller is arranged on the lower end portion of the body and is connected to the head through a rotating shaft, the telescopic arms are separately arranged on the left and right sides of the upper portion of the body, the sucking discs are separately arranged at free ends of the telescopic arms, and the signal collecting line is arranged on the head. By virtue of the mode, the infant intelligent nursing robot is applied to nursing preschoolers, can execute corresponding commands through a remote controller, an intelligent mobile phone and voices, and takes articles to the infants and prevents the infants from being hurt so as to provide a user with good using experience. The using interest of an accompanied target can be improved, can the robot can monitor in real time to realizing the accompany function of the children accompanying robot.

title: Anti-falling self-locking mechanism for exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-falling self-locking mechanism for an exoskeleton robot. The robot comprises a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod; the anti-falling self-locking mechanism comprises an electromagnet, a pawl, a ratchet, and a spring, wherein the ratchet is fixedly arranged on the upper end of the second connecting rod, the electromagnet is fixedly arranged on the first connecting rod; a downward telescopic rod is arranged at the bottom of the electromagnet, the telescopic rod is connected with a contact terminal of the electromagnet, the lower end of the telescopic rod is rotatably connected with the pawl; a first pin shaft is fixedly arranged on the first connecting rod, the tail end of the pawl is rotatably connected with the first pin shaft, the front end of the pawl is matched with the ratchet; the upper end and the lower end of the spring are respectively connected with the pawl and the ratchet; and the pawl and the ratchet are laminated with each other under the pulling function of the spring; the stretching of the telescopic rod can be realized through the power-on/off of the electromagnet, thereby driving the pawl to break away from or fit to the ratchet. The anti-falling self-locking mechanism has the advantages that the mechanism can realize the one-way self-locking by use of the self-locking mode of the pawl and the ratchet, so that the human leg can move to the upright direction, the security and the reliability are high.

title: Large robot swing part convenient to dismount and with rotatable body
abstract: The invention provides a large robot swing part convenient to dismount and with a rotatable body. The large robot swing part is characterized in that the head (2) is movably connected to the top of the body (1), the lower portion of the body (1) is movably connected to the lower body (3) through a rotary shaft (9), the lower portion of the lower body (3) is connected with two legs (4), the upper portions of two sides of the body (1) are movably connected with arms (5) through shoulders (8), the arms (5) are connected with front arms through movable elbow joints (6), and the front arms are connected with hands through movable wrists (7). The large robot swing part has the advantages that by the adoption of the technical scheme, a robot can be convenient to dismount and move and easy to install and can be formed only by mutually inserting the head, the body, the lower body, the legs and the arms. In addition, the head, the body, the arms and the like of the robot are rotatable, and the robot is life-like and cool in appearance and is attractive for children.

title: Video projection early-education robot
abstract: The invention discloses a video projection early-education robot. The video projection early-education robot comprises a head, a body, arms, legs and feet, a projection light unit head, an infrared sensor, voice receiving and sending devices and a VCD loading device. The projection light unit head is arranged above the head, the infrared sensor is arranged on the head and located below the projection light unit head, and the voice receiving and sending devices are arranged on the left side and the right side of the head correspondingly. The VCD loading device is arranged in the middle of the obverse side of the body. In this way, the video projection early-education robot is applied to education of preschool children, and voice conversation and video projection can be achieved; video contents are transmitted through the VCD loading device, an SD card slot and a USB port; the projection light unit head is adopted for projection, the projection image quality is soft, and the color is vivid; images are formed through diffuse reflection of projection light of the light unit head on a wall face or a ceiling, damage to infant visions is avoided, the visions of immature children can be effectively protected, and curiosity of the children can be aroused.

title: Biped robot travelling mechanism containing linear joint
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot travelling mechanism containing a linear joint. The biped robot travelling mechanism containing the linear joint comprises a waist mechanism, wherein one leg mechanism is arranged at each of the two sides of the waist mechanism, the two leg mechanisms are respectively connected with the waist mechanism by virtue of a hip joint, and the bottom of each leg mechanism is connected with a foot mechanism; each leg mechanism comprises a leg body, the linear joint is cooperatively arranged in the leg body, the linear joint comprises a driving part and a driven part, the driven part is connected with a lateral rotary power device by virtue of a connecting piece, the driving part operates to drive the driven part to do linear vertical motion, then the leg body moves up and down and lifts a leg, the lateral rotary power device operates to drive the leg body to swing forward and backward, the lateral rotary power devices of the two leg mechanisms alternately operate to drive the leg body to realize an alternate leg striding action. Thighs, knee joints and shanks of a biped robot are integrated into one complete linear joint, and the biped robot travelling mechanism containing the linear joint has the characteristics of simple mechanism, easy maintenance, low energy consumption and strong weight bearing capability.

title: Humanoid mechanical leg joint module, humanoid mechanical leg and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical leg joint module, a humanoid mechanical leg and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. The humanoid mechanical leg joint module comprises a first body, a second body, a controller, a motor and a speed reducer, wherein the motor is installed on the first body, the controller is connected with the motor and controls the motor, and the motor is rotationally connected with the speed reducer to drive the speed reducer; the speed reducer is installed in the first body and is connected with the second body to drive the second body to rotate relative to the first body; the humanoid mechanical leg comprises the humanoid mechanical leg joint module; and the humanoid robot comprises the humanoid mechanical leg. The humanoid mechanical leg joint module, the humanoid mechanical leg and the humanoid robot provided by the invention are simple in structures and flexible in movement.

title: Manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator which comprises a left claw (10), a left median claw (20), a right median claw (30), a right claw (40), a rocking arm (50), a horizontal rod (60) and a support plate (70), wherein the horizontal rod (60) is provided with the left claw (10), the left median claw (20), the right median claw (30), the right claw (40) and the support plate (70); a rocking arm (50) drives the horizontal rod (60) to perform rotating motion; the left claw (10) is pushed to reciprocate along a right claw guide rail (42) by virtue of a right claw driver (41); after moving, the left claw (10) clamps an arm of a human body together with the left middle claw (20); after moving, the right claw (40) clamps the arm of the human body together with the right middle claw (30). The manipulator is simple and compact in structure, is capable of controlling the sitting angle of the human body, clamping the arm so as to ensure human body position fixation and ensuring the reliability during posture change of the human body, and can be regulated according to different body types.

title: Service robot
abstract: The invention provides a service robot. The service robot comprises a head part (1), arms (2), a trunk (3) and a chassis (4), wherein the head part (1) is connected to a head part fixing bearing seat (12) on the trunk (3) through a head part fixing shaft, the arms (2) are connected to the two sides of the trunk (3), and the bottom end of the trunk (3) is arranged on the chassis (4); the arms (2) comprise an upper arm I (21), an upper arm II (22) and a lower arm (23), and the trunk (3) sequentially comprises an upper computer control circuit cavity (31), a lower computer control circuit cavity (32) and a driver and power supply control chamber (33) from top to bottom; and the chassis (4) comprises a chassis body, two oppositely-arranged drive wheels (46) arranged on the chassis body and two oppositely-arranged universal wheels (44). The robot provided by the invention has a movable arm structure, and each arm has four degrees of freedom and can simulate the movement of a human limb.

title: Temperature control escort service robot
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature control escort service robot. The temperature control escort service robot comprises a robot body, a main viewing window, a display screen, capacitance palm print sensors, capacitance film pressure sensing arrays, polyimide heating films, temperature sensors, and RGBLED prompt lamps; the capacitance palm print sensors are arranged on two sides of a shell of the robot body; the capacitance film pressure sensing arrays are uniformly embedded between the capacitance palm print sensors; the RGBLED prompt lamps are embedded around the capacitance palm print sensors; the polyimide heating films are bonded on the back surfaces of the capacitance palm print sensors; and the temperature sensors are integrated in the capacitance film pressure sensing arrays. Through the mode, the invention provides the temperature control escort service robot; users press the capacitance palm print sensors to start a hand warming function of the robot, and adjust the hand warming temperature according to double-hand pressing strength, so that the intimacy between the robot and the users is effectively improved; and in particular, aiming at the cold weather, the temperature control escort service robot can effectively prevent the users from disgusting a cold shell.

title: Bionic intelligent robot for toddler education
abstract: The invention discloses a robot, and particularly discloses a bionic intelligent robot for toddler education. The robot comprises a head part, a trunk, double arms, lower limbs and a base, and is characterized in that an electric quantity display indication device and a low-electric quantity warning device are mounted at the forehead part of the robot; a liquid crystal display panel used for displaying facial expressions is mounted at the face part; field depth cameras are mounted at the connection part, of the chest and head and neck, of the trunk; obstacle avoiding sensors are mounted at the connection part of the base and the lower limbs of cone-shaped structures and the connection part of the base and the trunk; and sound acquisition devices used for collecting external sound are arranged on ears of the head part. The bionic intelligent robot has the beneficial effects that basic functions like information input, self-help navigation and obstacle avoidance, man-machine interaction and intelligent housekeeping are achieved, safety guard and children education are achieved, remote communication with robots and remote control can be achieved by virtue of a communication platform, and the bionic intelligent robot has better utilization value in housekeeping industry service.

title: Steering engine wire arrangement structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a steering engine wire arrangement structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the technical field of robots, and is designed to solve the problem of easy wear of electric conducting wires in a traditional device. The steering engine wire arrangement structure of the humanoid robot comprises a steering engine main body; the steering engine main body is provided with an upper cover on one side and a lower cover on the other side; a driving rudder disc is arranged on the upper cover; a driven rudder disc is arranged on the lower cover, and is provided with an U-shaped sheet metal part; and an electric conducting cable penetrates through a through hole in the middle part of the driven rudder disc and a through hole in the rotating center of the U-shaped sheet metal part to connect to a control unit in the steering engine main body. The humanoid robot comprises the steering engine wire arrangement structure of the humanoid robot. The steering engine wire arrangement structure of the humanoid robot and the electric conducting cable of the humanoid robot cannot generate friction with an adjacent front chest and a chest back shell in rotation of the U-shaped sheet metal part to prevent wear of the electric conducting cable so as to prevent short circuit or power failure of a steering engine; and the whole machine is more stable in work.

title: Humanoid robot based on hollow drivers and micro drivers
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on hollow drivers and micro drivers. The humanoid robot comprises a robot chest assembly, a robot head assembly, a robot waist and crotch assembly, a robot left leg assembly, a robot right leg assembly, a robot left arm assembly and a robot right arm assembly. The robot chest assembly comprises a chest shell and a robot controller. The robot head assembly comprises a head body, the head shaking micro driver and the nodding micro driver. The robot waist and crotch assembly comprises a waist installation shell, a crotch installation shell, the waist rotating hollow driver, the left leg hollow driver, the right leg hollow driver and the stooping hollow driver. Each of the robot left leg assembly and the robot right leg assembly comprises a thigh, a crus, a foot, the crotch joint hollow driver, the knee joint hollow driver and the angle joint hollow driver. Each of the robot left arm assembly and the robot right arm assembly comprises a large arm, a forearm, a hand, the shoulder joint hollow driver, the elbow joint micro driver and the wrist joint micro driver. The humanoid robot has the beneficial effects that the humanoid simulation effect is good, and design is novel.

title: Waist structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and provides a waist structure and a humanoid robot. The waist structure is used for connecting a torso structure with leg structures of the humanoid robot. The waist structure comprises a support assembly located between the torso structure and the leg structures, a waist steering engine mounted on the support assembly, a pair of first-stage leg steering engines and a driving part. The waist steering engine is used for connecting the torso structure with the support assembly. The first-stage leg steering engines are used for connecting the support assembly with the leg structures to enable the support assembly to rotate relative to the leg structures. According to the waist structure, the waist steering engine used for being connected with the torso structure and the first-stage leg steering engines used for being connected with the leg structures are arranged, the first-stage leg steering engines are connected with the support assembly and the leg structures to enable the support assembly to rotate relative to the leg structures, accordingly connecting parts of the waist structure and the leg structures can rotate, thus the waist structure has the freedom degree of rotating relative to the leg structures, and the flexibility of the waist structure is improved.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The leg structure is used for connecting a waist structure and two foot structures of the humanoid robot and comprises a first-grade leg steering engine, a second-grade leg steering engine and a connecting assembly, and the connecting assembly comprises a connecting piece, a first end cap and a second end cap, wherein the first end cap and the second end cap are fixedly connected with the connecting piece. According to the leg structure, by oppositely arranging the first-grade leg steering engine and the second-grade leg steering engine and connecting the first-grade leg steering engine and second-grade leg steering engine through the connecting assembly, the connecting portion of the leg structure and the waist structure can automatically rotate; and the first-grade leg steering engine is installed on the connecting piece and the first end cap to enable the connecting piece and the first end cap to rotate relative to the first-grade leg steering engine, and the second-grade leg steering engine is installed on the connecting piece and the second end cap to enable the connecting piece and the second end cap to rotate relative to the second-grade leg steering engine. The degree of freedom of the leg structure is increased, and flexibility of rotation of the leg structure is improved accordingly.

title: Bidirectional-drive variable-speed-ratio output rotary joint provided with steel wires
abstract: The invention provides a bidirectional-drive variable-speed-ratio output rotary joint provided with steel wires, and relates to a variable-speed rotary joint. By adoption of the bidirectional-drive variable-speed-ratio output rotary joint provided with the steel wires, the problems that in the prior art, a motor is used for regulating speed to achieve movement of outer bone joints, the output torque of the motor is large, and the movement precision of the joints is low are solved. The bidirectional-drive variable-speed-ratio output rotary joint provided with the steel wires comprises an input shaft, a first steel wire rope, a cam, a second steel wire rope and a joint shaft, wherein the joint shaft is mounted on a support, and the input shaft is rotatably mounted on the support and the joint shaft; one end of the first steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the end, away from the joint shaft, of the cam, the first steel wire rope is wound on the input shaft after being laid in an arc-shaped rope groove, and the other end of the first steel wire rope is fixed to the input shaft; and one end of the second steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the end, adjacent to the joint shaft, of the cam, the second steel wire rope is wound on the input shaft after being laid in the arc-shaped rope groove, and the other end of the second steel wire rope is fixed to the input shaft. The bidirectional-drive variable-speed-ratio output rotary joint is used as an outer bone robot joint.

title: Bio-robot capable of switching motion mode
abstract: The invention discloses a bio-robot capable of switching a motion mode. The bio-robot comprises a control system and a mechanical system, wherein the mechanical system has a body trunk and a plurality of pairs of foot motion mechanisms connected with the body trunk, and further has a motion switching mechanism; the motion mechanism has rocking arm plates connected with at least one pair of foot motion mechanisms and motion switching motors driving the rocking arm plates to rotate, and further has a tail balancing motions of the robot; and the tail is arranged on the tail part of the body trunk. Multi-foot synchronization movements can be achieved via the arrangements of the motion switching mechanism and the tail; when operation is required, the plurality of pairs of foot motion mechanisms can be lifted up and the foot movements of the part can be stopped or a hand operation is switched via the motion switching mechanism, so foot utilization rate of the robot can be increased and work capacity can be enhanced; power loss can be reduced; the balancing capacity of the robot can be increased via the tail, so robot motion stability can be increased; and the bio-robot capable of switching motion mode can be applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped semi-passive bipartition upper body walking robot which comprises a hip and two legs. The hip comprises a hip support and two lateral swinging parts, the lateral swinging parts are rotatably mounted on the hip support in a matched manner, a lateral swinging drive mechanism is arranged on the hip support, rotating parts are arranged on the lower portions of the lateral swinging parts respectively, a first rotating shaft is arranged on each rotating part and matched with the corresponding lateral swinging part, leg expansion drive mechanisms are arranged among the hip and the rotating parts, each leg comprises a thigh, a shank and an imitation foot plate, second rotating shafts are arranged on the rotating parts, thigh connectors are arranged at the upper end of the thighs and rotatably sleeve the second rotating shafts in a matched manner, front and back swinging drive mechanisms are arranged on the rotating parts, the shanks are hinged to the thighs, a knee joint drive mechanism is arranged between each thigh and the corresponding shank, the imitation foot plates are rotatably mounted at the bottoms of the shanks through ankle joint rotating shafts in a matched manner, the ankle joint rotating shafts are parallel to the second rotating shafts, and ankle joint drive mechanisms are arranged among the imitation foot plates and the hip or the legs.

title: Man-machine interactive intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses a man-machine interactive intelligent robot. The man-machine interactive intelligent robot is mainly composed of a head assembly, a middle assembly and a chassis assembly. The middle assembly is movably connected with the head assembly through an electric slide rail structure. The chassis assembly is connected with the middle assembly through a multi-dimensional movement mechanism of a gear and rack structure. An inverted-pyramid-shaped structure for forming a three-dimensional holographic animated image is installed in the head assembly. According to the man-machine interactive intelligent robot, the three-dimensional holographic animated image is formed on the robot through the simple mechanical structure, a cartoon image of a three-dimensional holographic animated elf serves as a man-machine interactive medium, a traditional mode that interaction and two-dimensional flat panel displaying of a traditional commercial advertisement robot mainly depend on voice conversation is changed, and a breakthrough is made on the experience that the robot has the thinking ability imitating human.
