title: Intelligent robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and particularly relates to an intelligent robot. The following solution is hereby proposed to solve the problems that the existing robot is unable to adjust the height automatically according to the height of a person, unable to identify the expressions and gestures of the person accurately, or automatically match with proper expressions and gestures to achieve the purpose of interaction, and the intelligent level is low. The intelligent robot comprises a base and a lower trunk welded on the top of the base, wherein an upper trunk is arranged right above the lower trunk fixedly provided with a body induction unit with bolts, and a first storage cavity is formed in the lower trunk; the bottom inner wall of the first storage cavity is fixedly provided with a first push rod motor with the bolts. The intelligent robot provided by the invention is able to adjust the height automatically according to the height of the person so as to accurately identify the expressions and gestures of the person and automatically match with proper expressions and gestures to achieve the purpose of interaction, with high intelligent level, simple structure and easy use.

title: Security protection robot
abstract: The invention discloses a security protection robot and relates to the field of intelligent robots. The security protection robot comprises a movable base and a humanoid robot body arranged on the movable base. A controller used for dispatching and controlling the humanoid robot body is arranged in the movable base. The humanoid robot body comprises a lower trunk fixed to the movable base. The lower trunk is connected with an upper trunk. The top of the upper trunk is connected with a head through a rotary shaft. A left mechanical arm and a right mechanical arm are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper trunk correspondingly. Fire fighting equipment is arranged on the right mechanical arm. Anti-terrorism and anti-theft equipment is arranged on the left mechanical arm. The upper trunk is provided with a fire fighting inductor and an anti-terrorism and anti-theft inductor. An obstacle avoidance inductor is arranged on the movable base. A camera, a sound detecting device, a smell detecting device and a broadcaster are arranged on the head. A material box is further arranged on the movable base. The security protection robot is complete in function and has multiple functions including fire fighting, anti-theft and anti-terrorism.

title: Power-down anti-falling method and device of robot and power-down anti-falling robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power-down anti-falling method of a robot. The power-down anti-falling method comprises the following steps of judging whether power-down conditions are satisfied, and if the power-down conditions are satisfied, controlling a first leg and a second leg, so that the robot returns to stand; controlling the first leg and/or the second leg of the robot, so that a first foot and a second foot of the robot are respectively located on both sides of the ground projection point of the center of gravity of the robot; controlling the first leg and/or the second leg of the robot, so that the center of gravity of the robot approaches to the ground; and if stop conditions are satisfied, enabling a first leg action mechanism and a second leg action mechanism to stop moving. When the power-down conditions are satisfied, the first leg and/or the second leg of the robot is controlled, so that the first foot and the second foot of the robot are respectively located on the both sides of the ground projection point of the center of gravity of the robot, a large support area is provided, and the center of gravity of the robot is lowered, so that the stable performance of the robot is improved, and the robot is prevented from falling down due to unstable center of gravity.

title: Motion control of anthropomorphic robotic systems with many degrees of freedom based on principles of independent motion control in the direction of characteristic vectors of the linearized dynamic Lagrange equation and the anthropomorphic robotic system
abstract: A method for controlling the movement of anthropomorphic robotic systems with many degrees of freedom based on the principles of independent movement control in the direction of characteristic vectors of the linearized dynamic Lagrange equation and a device for carrying out this control method is characterized in that during long delays in the feedback control loop, the region of stability of control parameters is much larger, and thus the possibility of stable control is possible at a much higher latency. abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure are directed to the ability of being able to create complex robotic humanoid movements, actions, and interactions with tools and the instrumented environment by automatically building movements for the humanoid; actions and behaviors of the humanoid based on a set of computer-encoded robotic movement and action primitives. These motion-primitives are termed to be minimanipulations and each has a clear time-indexed command input-structure and output behavior/performance profile that is intended to achieve a certain function. Minimanipulations comprise a new way of creating a general programmable-by-example platform for humanoid robots. title: Nonlinear model predictive control-based trust region-SQP method for gait optimization of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of the gait optimization control for a biped robot and particularly relates to a model predictive control-based trust region-SQP method for the gait optimization of the biped robot. Based on the nonlinear model predictive control technology, the trust region-SQP method is adopted to realize the superlinear convergence rate and the global convergence fast-solving optimal control, so that the optimal movement gait of the biped robot is realized. Since the nature of an objective function is poor, a significant amount of time is spent in determining a searching step length. Therefore, the real-time performance is invalid. According to the technical scheme of the invention, based on the nonlinear model predictive control technology, a robot dynamics model is converted into a non-linear optimization model, and the trust region-SQP method having fast convergence characteristics is provided. In this way, the optimal control, which realizes the real-time performance, is solved. The method overcomes the defect that the real-time performance cannot be realized during the solving process of a traditional controller. The method can be applied to multi-degree-of-freedom biped robots and provides references for the real-time control solutions of multi-degree-of-freedom biped robots.

title: Dual-cam-disk output speed changing joint driven by steel wire
abstract: The invention discloses a dual-cam-disk output speed changing joint driven by a steel wire, and relates to a speed changing joint; the dual-cam-disk output speed changing joint solves the problems of big output torque of a motor, relatively low movement precision of the joint and high cost when an exoskeleton joint movement is realized by the motor speed regulation. The dual-cam-disk output speed changing joint comprises an input shaft, a supporting bracket, a joint shaft, a lower cam, an upper cam, a 1# wire rope and a 2# wire rope; the joint shaft is rotationally installed on the supporting bracket, and the input shaft is rotationally installed on the supporting bracket and the joint shaft; the lower cam and the upper cam are arranged at both sides of the input shaft and fixedly mounted on the joint shaft; the lower cam and the upper cam are formed to be a closed eccentric circle; the 1# wire rope is paved on an upper arc rope groove and then coiled on the input shaft; the 2# wire rope is paved on a lower arc rope groove and then coiled on the input shaft. The dual-cam-disk output speed changing joint is applied to the exoskeleton or a humanoid robot joint.

title: Wearable human body exoskeleton robot

title: Two-stage vibration reducing ankle-foot integrated parallel low-impact walking foot mechanism and controlling method
abstract: The invention discloses a two-stage vibration reducing ankle-foot integrated parallel low-impact walking foot mechanism and a controlling method, which can be used for effectively reducing foot-ground impact force and are capable of performing active control. The walking foot mechanism comprises a foot-leg connecting platform, a food end bottom connecting platform, three groups of moving pairs, three groups of revolute pairs and three groups of ball pairs, a lower platform simulates the foot end of a robot, the moving pairs are driving pairs, and are used for simulating legs of the robot, an anti-vibration pad, with frictional force, is inlaid in the lower surface of the food end bottom connecting platform, and is used as first-stage vibration reduction, the three groups of moving pairs are arranged in a mirror symmetry manner, and each group of moving pair comprise a hydraulic cylinder, a spring damper, a servo valve and a controller, wherein the spring damper sleeves a cylinder piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, and is used as second-stage vibration reduction, so that the whole mechanism forms a lower-mobility parallel mechanism with a three freedom degree structure, and two rotational freedom along the directions of x and y and a translational freedom degree along the direction of z are realized. The mechanism and method provided by the invention have the advantages that the plan and control of the robot are flexible and reliable, and the stability is high.

title: Exoskeleton-type walking machine
abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton-type walking machine. title: Humanoid mechanical finger structure based on shaft drive transmission
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical finger structure based on shaft drive transmission. The structure comprises a first knuckle, a second knuckle 28, a third knuckle and a base, each knuckle achieves linkage with the prior knuckle through the corresponding coordination of different crown gears and different straight gears, power driving the knuckles to rotate is transmitted forwards step by step from a direct current motor in a shaft drive transmission mode, and bending and stretching of a mechanical finger are achieved. title: Three-dimensional gait self-synchronizing and self-stabilizing method based on control strategy
abstract: A three-dimensional gait self-synchronizing and self-stabilizing method based on a control strategy presented by the invention mainly comprises a simple inverted pendulum model, defining virtual constraints, using a control strategy in periodic walking gait, stabilizing periodic walking gait through vertical oscillation, and extending the attributes to a real model of a humanoid robot. Firstly, virtual constraints are defined for the vertical position of a component object model in a simple inverted pendulum model; secondly, a control strategy for guiding self-synchronization is used in the constant-height periodic walking gait of the component object model; thirdly, the periodic walking gait is stabilized asymptotically through vertical oscillation of the component object model of the pendulum model; and finally, the attributes are extended to a real model of a humanoid robot. By using a self-synchronization control strategy, the walking speed, efficiency and adaptability to environment are improved. Moreover, the coordination is stronger, the stability is higher, and the method can be put into application more easily.

title: Flexible driving hip joint for semi-passive biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible driving hip joint for a semi-passive biped robot. The flexible driving hip joint comprises an angular bisector mechanism and a hip joint flexible driving mechanism; and a hip bracket is fixedly arranged at the middle part of a shaft through a locating pin, thus forming a rack main body part of the flexible driving hip joint. The angular bisector mechanism comprises first connecting pieces, first connecting rods, a second connecting rod and sleeves, is a connecting rod mechanism, is simple in structure and works reliably. The hip joint flexible driving mechanism is distributed in a bilaterally symmetric manner, and is powered by a right side steering engine and a left side steering engine; during working, the right side steering engine and the left side steering engine rotate at equal speeds and in the opposite directions all the time, and with the combination of the use of the angular bisector mechanism, a gait of biped walking can be simulated very well; and the driving of the right side steering engine and the driving the left side steering engine are transferred by tension springs, so that the problems like inertia impact arising from rigid driving are solved, the stability is brought to a system, and the natural mechanical properties of the flexible driving hip joint can be reflected better.

title: Commercial service robot based on visual navigation
abstract: A commercial service robot based on visual navigation comprises a trunk body. A head body is arranged on the upper portion of the trunk body. title: Robot charging device and achieving method thereof

title: Modularized humanoid hand based on SMA drive
abstract: The invention discloses a modularized humanoid hand based on SMA drive. The modularized humanoid hand comprises a plurality of finger modules. Each finger module is connected with a cuboid palm. Each finger module comprises a far finger joint, a middle finger joint and a near finger joint which are coupled in sequence. The front end of each steel wire rope is fixed to the corresponding far finger joint. The rear end of each steel wire rope winds across a steel wire rope guide shaft of the corresponding middle finger joint and then passes through a steel wire rope guide shaft of the corresponding near finger joint and a guide shaft of the corresponding cuboid palm to enter a palm, and the steel wire rope is fixedly connected with the output end of an SMA driver ultimately. The front end of each reset pulling rope is fixed to the corresponding far finger joint, and the rear end of each reset pulling rope winds across a guide shaft inside the corresponding near finger joint to enter the corresponding cuboid palm and is fixedly connected with a slippage magnet of a magnet reset device. The modularized humanoid hand based on SMA drive has the advantages that the humanoid hand uses SMA fibers as a driving material, a magnet resetting mode is adopted to provide prestretching force for the SMA fibers and finger resetting force for the SMA drivers after power failure, and the modularized mode is used for assembling; and the characteristics of being low in price, low in weight and easy to control are achieved.

title: Four-claw type humanoid pipe climbing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a four-claw type humanoid pipe climbing robot. The four-claw type humanoid pipe climbing robot comprises four arms arranged symmetrically, an upper part trunk and a lower part trunk, wherein the upper trunk and the lower trunk connect the four arms into one; the four arms are all movable mechanical arms with mechanical claws at the tail ends, and are a left upper arm, a right upper arm, a left lower arm and a right lower arm respectively, the left upper arm and the right upper arm are connected to the left and right ends of the upper part trunk respectively, and the left lower arm and the right lower arm are connected to the left and right ends of the lower part trunk respectively; the four arms are connected to the two ends of the upper part trunk and the lower part trunk respectively through an extruding slide block and extruding spring mechanism, the lower part trunk and the upper part trunk are connected through a waist mechanism, the waist mechanism is a mechanism which is composed of an upper part driving steering engine, a first waist connecting frame, a middle driving steering engine, a second waist connecting frame and a lower part driving steering engine and can conduct multi-degree-of-freedom motion, and under the action of the waist mechanism and the motion of the four arms, the four-claw type humanoid pipe climbing robot can simulate the four arms of a person to achieve the requirement of pipe climbing of different types. title: A humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot comprising soles, shoes, shanks, thighs, a balance device, a battery, a main board, a body, an operation display screen, a robot head, a helmet, arms, wrists and hands. Each part is provided with a motor and a rapid assembly clamping opening. The main board comprises a processor, a display system, a signal processing system, motor operation drivers and an operation keyboard, wherein the display system, the signal processing system, the motor operation drivers and the operation keyboard are connected with the processor; the signal processing system comprises a wireless receiving module used for receiving external commands and information, a wireless transmitting module used for transmitting information, an infrared receiving and transmitting module used for enhancing recognition ability, and a wireless remote control module used for remote control of the main board; the motor in each part is connected with the motor operation drivers. The humanoid robot can work stably and flexibly via the main board and can fulfill multiple functions; the robot can operate independently; the robot can also transmit signals to adjacent robots for wake-up call, so that multiple robots can form a group to complete movement and commands cooperatively.

title: Stair climbing method for robot
abstract: The invention discloses a stair climbing method for a robot. The stair climbing method comprises the steps that 1, the robot elevates a front leg; 2, the front leg of the robot moves forwards; 3, a front step detector is turned on; 4, if a step is detected in front of the robot, the front leg is elevated; 5, the step 3 is repeated till the front leg of the robot is higher than the step; 6, the front leg of the robot is shifted forwards; 7, the step in front of the front leg of the robot is detected; 8, when the front leg of the robot gets close to the front step, the front leg is put down till the front leg of the robot is put onto the step surface; 9, the front leg of the robot is elevated, so that the gravity center of the whole robot is elevated; and 10, a rear leg of the robot is elevated, the actions of the front leg of the robot are repeated, after the step climbing action of the rear leg of the robot is completed, the step 1 is repeated, and the robot climbs the next step continuously. By elevating the legs of the robot, the steps that may be collided are avoided, and the stair climbing action of the robot is completed.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm control method based on Kinect sensor
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical arm control method based on a Kinect sensor. The method comprises the first step of collecting data through the Kinect sensor; the second step of preprocessing the collected data, and then using relevant algorithms to conduct gesture segmentation; the third step of using a DBN neural network to conduct gesture recognition; the fourth step of converting recognized gestures into instructions in a fixed format; the fifth step of using a TCP protocol to conduct telecommunication, and then sending the instructions to a server side; the sixth step of making the server side receive and recognize the instructions, and obtaining a control parameter through kinematics calculation; the seventh step of making the server side control motions of a mechanical arm according to the control parameter. According to the humanoid mechanical arm control method based on the Kinect sensor, the requirements in the aspects of cost and accuracy in actual operation, response speed and the like are considered, the problems that a data glove is high in control cost, and the traditional human-computer interactive modes based on keyboards and the like have certain requirements on specialized knowledge are solved, and the humanoid mechanical arm control method has the advantages that the operation is humanized, the response speed is high, the accuracy is high, and the humanoid mechanical arm control method has very good robustness.

title: Walking robot with gyroscopic stabilizers
abstract: A walking robot with gyroscopic stabilizers comprises a double-foot walking mechanism, gyroscopic stabilizer mechanisms and a foot driving mechanism. The two sides of the lower end of a body are each internally provided with one gyroscopic stabilizer mechanism, and the gyroscopic stabilizer mechanisms can balance the gravity center of the body in walking. The double-foot walking mechanism comprises shanks, thighs, driving shafts, straight-tooth bevel gears, bearings and motors, wherein upper joints of the thighs are hinged to the body, and lower joints of the thighs are hinged to upper joints of the corresponding shanks; lower joints of the shanks are hinged to upper foot covers, and the upper foot covers and foot bases are mounted in cooperation; and the shanks and the thighs can walk like a person through cooperative movement of the driving shafts, the straight-tooth bevel gears, the bearings, the motors and other parts mounted in the thighs. The foot driving mechanism comprises the upper foot covers, the foot bases, universal ball wheels, driving wheels and motors, and thus turning or curved walking of the robot can be achieved. The walking robot with the gyroscopic stabilizers can straightly walk with wheels and can also walk on foot.

title: Human skeleton point parameter acquisition device applied to humanoid motion mimicry and recognition method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a human skeleton point parameter acquisition device applied to humanoid motion mimicry and a recognition method thereof. The method is characterized by acquiring a depth image, recognizing human joint points by using the depth image by an OpenNI bone recognition algorithm library, extracting spatial coordinates, and providing control data for a robot controller by means of filtering, spatial vector calculation, and leg posture recognition. In view of a problem that posture recognition is influenced by environment so as to be low in recognition accuracy and poor in real-time performance, a new action recognition method based on human skeleton predefining is provided for human-machine interaction posture classification. The method give full scope to an advantage that the Kinect can obtain a depth image feature, organically combines 2bitBP characteristics, constitutes a skeleton predefined posture type, performs posture classification by using an improved support vector machine, and is good in real-time performance, high in recognition accuracy, and good in robustness in the case of illumination variation. The recognition efficiency and accuracy can meet a natural human-machine interaction system requirement.

title: Intelligent biped walking robot

A steering engine is mounted on the neck of the robot and can control the robot to node for communication. The vision sensing system which can achieve face recognition and has a memory function is mounted in eyes on a head. The infrared induction system which can achieve imaging recognition is mounted above the curved-surface display screen. The eyes are connected with the corresponding steering engine and can be driven by the steering engine to rotate for eye contact.

title: Human body motion capture data-based humanoid robot gait planning method
abstract: The invention relates to a human body motion capture data-based humanoid robot gait planning method. The method includes the following steps that: human body gait modes are extracted, angle curves of the six degrees of freedom of a single leg are obtained, wherein the human body gait modes include hip joint roll, hip joint pitch, hip joint yaw, knee joint pitch, ankle joint pitch and ankle joint roll; format conversion and mathematical optimization are performed on the human body gait mode data, so that the data can be applied to a human simulating robot; and a ZMP control algorithm is introduced to finely adjust the joint angles of a humanoid robot to improve the robustness of the humanoid robot. With the human body motion capture data-based humanoid robot gait planning method of the invention adopted, the gait planning difficulty of the humanoid robot can be simplified, the humanoid property and stability of the gait of the humanoid robot can be improved, and a foundation can be provided for the complex action planning of the humanoid robot. Compared with a traditional humanoid robot gait planning method, the human body motion capture data-based humanoid robot gait planning method has outstanding advantages and has a bright prospect.

title: Six-freedom-degree walking robot single-leg structure capable of carrying out leg-arm fusion operation
abstract: The invention discloses a six-freedom-degree walking robot single-leg structure capable of carrying out leg-arm fusion operation, designed with the first three joints, namely a hip joint, a shank joint and a thigh joint, for walking, and the first three joints are respectively driven by a steering engine. Meanwhile, an execution module with three degrees of freedom is added on the basis of the first three joints, and the execution module comprises a task-switching joint, a manipulator-rotating joint, and a manipulator-drive-rotating joint, which are also driven by a steering engine respectively. Therefore, the output-freedom-degree of the single-leg structure is six. When the single-leg structure moves in a walking mode, a task-switching steering engine controls a walking foot end to rotate to the front end of a shank rod, and a manipulator is retracted into the shank. When the robot works in an operation mode, the task-executing steering engine controls the walking foot end to be retracted into the shank, and the manipulator rotates to the front end of the shank rod. According to the six-freedom-degree walking robot single-leg structure capable of carrying out leg-arm fusion operation, the single-leg structure is high in output-freedom-degree and flexibility, and wide in working range, so that more complex task operation can be carried out, no interference exists between the walking mode and the operation mode, and switching is rapid and smooth.

title: Method for grabbing object based on NAO robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for grabbing an object based on a NAO robot. title: Brimless wheel mechanism used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a brimless wheel mechanism capable of being used for traveling simulation and automatic testing of a biped robot. The brimless wheel mechanism is composed of a center shaft module, a sliding sleeve module, a leg module, a control circuit module, a center shaft connection module and an additional function module, and can move in various modes under cooperation of the modules. As for the spatial bilateral brimless wheel movement mode of the brimless wheel mechanism, through intermittent impact contact between the tail end of a spoke of the brimless wheel mechanism and the topographical slope, sole rhythmic movement of a steady foot walking gait is simulated, and testing is conducted. title: Robot awakening method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot awakening method. The robot awakening method comprises the following steps that (1) the bottom zones 1, 2, 3 and 4 of a robot are each internally provided with a pyroelectric infrared sensor, and if a life body approaches the monitoring range of the robot, the robot judges that a user approaches for the first time and determines that the position of the zone receiving an infrared signal; (2) after a robot master control unit judges that the user approaches for the first time, the position and direction of the zone receiving the infrared signal are determined, the head of the robot swings up and down at the same time, and a face recognition unit conducts recognition; (3) movement of the robot and steering of the body and the head of the robot are achieved finally by driving a direct current motor through a PID algorithm; and (4) after it is successfully judged that the user approaches the robot, a robot voice output unit conducts voice broadcast. Through the method, the user position can be effectively judged, user information is actively received, the robot does not need to be awakened by the user passively, and intelligent man-machine interaction is achieved.

title: Three-freedom-degree waist device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a three-freedom-degree waist device for a humanoid robot. The three-freedom-degree waist device comprises a worm and gear assembly mechanism, a ball joint mechanism, a sliding screw mechanism and a universal joint mechanism. Through the connection of a worm gear, a worm and a direct current motor, the mechanism rotating power and movement ability are provided; and then through matching of the sliding screw mechanism and a universal joint, the power provided by the direct current motor converts linear movement into the waist rotating power under matching of the ball joint mechanism. Under driving of the direct current motor, the sliding screw mechanism and the universal joint mechanism complete waist bending movement and waist edging movement. Through mutual matching of the mechanisms, the flexibility problem of humanoid robot waist movement can be solved. Therefore, the three-freedom-degree waist device for the humanoid robot has the advantages of being simple in structure, stable in operation, economical, practical, environmentally friendly, small in space structure, convenient to produce and assemble, and the like.

title: Zero calibration method for humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a zero calibration method for humanoid robot joints. The method includes the steps that PC upper computer software and mobile phone APPs are adopted to be connected to a humanoid robot through wired connection or wireless connection, or a voice control mode is used for sending out a joint zero calibration instruction to the humanoid robot, a humanoid robot control center can enter into a zero calibration mode, and accordingly each joint begins to be calibrated; during zero calibration, the humanoid robot control center sends rotating instructions to the joints to be calibrated; and the humanoid robot control center inquires the angles of the joints to be calibrated once after some interval of time, it is regarded that the joints to be calibrated have already rotated to joint limitation surfaces when the joints to be calibrated cannot be rotated any more, the humanoid robot control center figures out the error value of one zero position and further stores the error value, and then the zero position of the next joint begins to be calibrated. By the adoption of the zero calibration method, development cost and device cost are reduced, and there is no need to additionally develop a zero calibration device independently.

title: Bionic human elbow joint
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robot joints and particularly relates to a bionic human elbow joint. The bionic human elbow joint comprises a forearm, a big arm and an elbow joint rotating component, wherein one end of the forearm is sleeved with one end of the big arm through a central shaft; the elbow joint rotating component comprises a sliding rod, a spring leaf, a sliding groove frame, a connection rod, a first screw rod and a first driving motor; two ends of the sliding rod are clamped in avoiding sliding grooves which are formed in two sides of the front end of the forearm; the middle part of the sliding rod is fixedly connected with one end of the spring leaf; the other end of the spring leaf is fixedly connected onto the surface near the front end of the sliding groove frame; the sliding groove frame is arranged in a cavity which is formed in a junction between the forearm and the big arm; the middle part of the sliding groove frame sleeves the central shaft through a bearing; the tail end of the sliding groove frame is connected with one end of the connection rod; the other end of the connection rod is connected with a sliding block; the sliding block is fixed to the tail end of the first screw rod; the first screw rod is fixedly connected with the first driving motor; the first driving motor is fixed on the inner side of the other end of the big arm. The bionic human elbow joint is simple in structure, convenient and flexible to mount, small in size, light in weight and convenient to use; the production cost is greatly reduced.

title: Assembly type humanoid robot applying helical gear steering engine
abstract: The invention discloses an assembly type humanoid robot applying a helical gear steering engine, and belongs to the field of robot equipment. The robot comprises a chest, a neck assembled on the chest, a waist movably connected on the lower part of the chest, arms, legs, and a control circuit board. Two sides of the chest and two sides of the waist are respectively provided with steering engine modules X. The steering engine modules X are connected with joint steering engine boxes and can drive the joint steering engine boxes to rotate along front and back directions. The joint steering engine box is internally provided with a steering engine module Y which drives the arm and the leg to rotate along left and right directions. Middle joints of the arms and the legs are provided with helical gear steering engines which drive the joints to bend. The lower end of the arm is provided with a rotatable wrist. The lower end of the leg is provided with a foot which can rotate along front and back directions. The control circuit board is electrically connected with the steering engine modules X, a driving motor, the steering engine module Y, and the helical gear steering engines. The assembly type humanoid robot solves problems that joint movement fidelity of an existing robot is relatively low, and robot homogenization is serious.

title: Human simulation dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy (SMA) flexible body intelligent digital composite structures
abstract: The invention discloses a human simulation dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy (SMA) flexible body intelligent digital composite structures. The human simulation dexterous hand is composed of the five different sizes of SMA flexible intelligent digital composite structures and flexible wrapping materials. The size of each SMA-flexible body intelligent digital composite structure corresponds to one finger and a metacarpal bone of the finger of a human hand. Each SMA flexible body intelligent composite structure is composed of two sections, one section is of a rigid structure simulating a metacarpal bone structure of the human hand, and the other section is of a flexible deformation structure simulating the finger part of the human hand. The SMA flexible body intelligent digital composite structures are composed of 3D metacarpal bones, intelligent digital driving skeletons, elastic sheets and the flexible wrapping materials. The SMA flexible body intelligent digital composite structures are composed of the intelligent digital driving skeletons, the sheets and the flexible wrapping materials, so that self-feedback control and digital bending motion can be realized. The dexterous hand has the advantages that the simulation degree of shapes and motion is high, cost is low, safety and compatibility are good, and controllability is high.

title: Robot trajectory planning method based on fourth-order cubic B-spline function and humanoid robot platform
abstract: The invention provides a robot trajectory planning method based on a fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and a humanoid robot platform. Through the method, specific movements required by various joints are planned, a complete trajectory generation control system is established, and stable control on a humanoid robot under a ZMP stable condition is ensured. The trajectory planning part of the method comprises the steps of construction of a B-spline function, mathematical model deduction of the B-spline function, solution of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function, and densification of a joint trajectory. After an expected trajectory is derived, corresponding movement functions are edited to a raspberry Pi system according to to-be-solved data points, corresponding instructions are sent through smartphone application software to call the corresponding movement functions to complete the expected planning trajectory. With the adoption of the fourth-order cubic B-spline function for planning the movement trajectory, no sharp corner problem is caused at places between adjacent joints, vibration of a joint mechanical arm is avoided, and the stability of the humanoid robot in a movement process is improved.

title: Multi-joint leg structure of biped walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-joint leg structure of a biped walking robot. The multi-joint leg structure comprises a foot sole movement mechanism, an ankle joint movement mechanism and a leg joint movement mechanism; toe joints are hinged with a foot sole by shafts; a shank lower joint support is hinged with an inner support by a shaft; the inner support is hinged with an ankle joint support plate; the foot sole movement mechanism can be used for controlling the toe joints to make a movement of lifting toes around the shafts through which the toe joints are hinged with the foot sole, so that the movement of lifting the toes is realized; the ankle joint movement mechanism can be used for controlling the foot sole to make a foot swing movement to the left or to the right, and also can be used for controlling the foot sole to move forwards or backwards, so that a foot sole joint of the robot can move in multiple degrees of freedom; the leg joint movement mechanism can be used for controlling the joints of the shank to realize a clockwise or anticlockwise leg raising movement, and also can be used for controlling the shank to make a rotational motion around the thigh. Therefore, after the multi-joint leg structure of the biped walking robot is adopted, the robot can make a biped walking movement since the leg raising movement is realized in the multiple degrees of freedom by the joints of the leg of the robot, and the biped walking of the humanoid robot is more flexible.

title: Leg-track composite humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a leg-track composite humanoid robot. The leg-track composite humanoid robot is characterized by comprising an upper body, a head, an interactive sensor, a space positioning sensor, an environment detection sensor, arm assemblies, a waist, a crotch, leg assemblies, an energy supply system and a control system, wherein a hollow cavity for placing the space positioning sensor, the environment detection sensor, the energy supply system and the control system is formed in the upper body; the top of the upper body is rotationally connected with the head; the head is provided with the interactive sensor; the upper part of the upper body is rotationally connected with the arm assemblies, the bottom of the upper body is rotationally connected with the top of the waist, the bottom of the waist is fixedly connected with the top of the crotch, and the bottom of the crotch is fixedly connected with the leg assemblies capable of carrying out translational action and striding action; and the interactive sensor, the space positioning sensor, the environment detection sensor, the arm assemblies, the waist, the crotch, the leg assemblies and the energy supply system are electrically connected with the control system separately. The leg-track composite humanoid robot can be widely applied to the military field and the civil field.

title: SPEED REDUCER
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a speed reducer of this invention having a buffer mechanism for reducing trouble found and acting as an important technical element for realizing actions of a humanoid robot in which a wave motion gear type speed reducer is applied in particular as a speed reducer scarcely generating any backlash and some troubles such as loss of synchronism or damage at the teeth that are easily produced by this speed reducer.SOLUTION: In order to resolve the problem described above, this invention provides a speed reducer and the like comprising a speed reducing mechanism for reducing an output number of revolution in respect to an input between an input rotary shaft and an output rotary shaft; a housing fixed to either the input rotary shaft or the output rotary shaft to store the speed reducing mechanism; and an elastic body; and buffer means in which a major direction of acting cushion force is a substantial rotational tangential line direction where rotary shaft is rotated and generated between the housing and a shaft side where the housing is not fixed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Pose calibrating device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a pose calibrating device for a humanoid robot. The pose calibrating device comprises a base; a humanoid robot fixing device is arranged on the base; a support is arranged on the base; a top camera assembly is arranged in the center of the upper part of the support; a left-side camera assembly and a right-side camera assembly are arranged on the left side and the right side of the support separately; a front camera assembly in the moving direction is arranged at the back part of the support; a controller is arranged in the base and comprises an industrial computer, a motor driver and an electrical control board; and the controller is connected with a displayer, the top camera assembly, the left-side camera assembly, the right-side camera assembly and the front camera assembly. title: Real estate selling robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real estate selling robot. The real estate selling robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms and a base; the head is provided with a visual system, a voice acquisition module, a voice processing module, a voice recognition module, a main-control module and a voice playing module; the head is installed on a head fixing bearing seat at the top end of the trunk, shoulder bearing seats on the two sides of the trunk are provided with the arms, the chest of the trunk is fixedly provided with a touch screen, the bottom of the trunk is provided with the base, the bottom of the base is provided with two drive wheels and a universal wheel, and the base is internally provided with a navigation system; and the visual system, the voice acquisition module, the voice processing module, the voice recognition module, the voice playing module, a display screen, a data processing module and the navigation system are all electrically connected with the main-control module. title: System for grabbing object based on NAO robot
abstract: The invention discloses a system for grabbing an object based on an NAO robot. The system comprises a first acquisition module, a second acquisition module, a third acquisition module, a first obtaining module, a fourth acquisition module, a fifth acquisition module and a second obtaining module. The first acquisition module is used for acquiring first center point pixel coordinates. The second acquisition module is used for acquiring the first function relation between the head height change value of the NAO robot and the pitch angle. The third acquisition module is used for acquiring the second function relation between the distance between the target object and the NAO robot and the pitch angle. The first obtaining module is used for obtaining second center point pixel coordinates of an image. The fourth acquisition module is used for acquiring the horizontal deflection angle and the vertical deflection angle of the target object relative to the NAO robot. The fifth acquisition module is used for acquiring the distance between the target object and the NAO robot. The second obtaining module is used for obtaining the walking path of the NAO robot. The technical problem that a system for grabbing an object in the prior art is not high in locating precision and poor in real-time performance is solved.

title: Differential bevel gear type robot head and neck control mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a differential bevel gear type robot head and neck control mechanism. The differential bevel gear type robot head and neck control mechanism comprises a base used for being fixed to a robot body, a head support frame fixed to the robot head, a neck located between the head support frame and the base and a neck control mechanism used for controlling the neck to move; the neck control mechanism comprises a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a third bevel gear and a fourth bevel gear, the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are coaxially and oppositely arranged on the base, and the third bevel gear and the fourth bevel gear are coaxially and oppositely arranged on the neck; and the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are driven by a first motor and a second motor correspondingly to rotate, and the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are meshed between the third bevel gear and the fourth bevel gear simultaneously to enable the first bevel gear, the second bevel gear, the third bevel gear and the fourth bevel gear to jointly form a differential bevel gear set. By means of the control mechanism, the head and neck motion of a child can be flexibly and truly simulated, and a robot can be easily accepted by the olds.

title: Wearable robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable robot. The wearable robot is provided with a chest support device, hip joints and leg support devices; the chest support device is provided with an integral chest support, shoulder support parts and hip transmission rod pieces; two ends of the shoulder support parts are respectively connected with the integral chest support and user hip parts for supporting user shoulders; two ends of the hip transmission rod piece are respectively connected with the integral chest support and the user hip parts for realizing the acting force transfer between the integral chest support and the user hip parts; the hip joints are connected with the chest support device and the leg support devices for providing the support assistance to a user upper body; and the leg support devices are supported on user legs in a bonding manner, and are provided with upper connecting ends connected with the hip joints. The wearable robot is prominent in structure simplicity, movement flexibility and self-adapting capacity.

title: Robot imitating head and neck of human
abstract: The invention provides a robot imitating the head and the neck of a human. The robot can achieve multiple-degree-of-freedom actions of a head and is simple in structure and small in size. The robot imitating the head and the neck of the human comprises the head and a base. The base comprises a shell body and a head motion mechanism located in the shell body. The head motion mechanism drives the head to make multiple-degree-of-freedom motion and comprises a head rotating mechanism and at least two head lifting mechanisms. Each head lifting mechanism comprises a lifting driving part and a lifting part. Joint ball heads are arranged at the top ends of the lifting parts. The head is fixedly provided with a joint connector. The joint ball heads are in matched connection with the joint connector. The head rotating mechanism comprises a rotating driving part and a rotating support. The head lifting mechanisms are mounted on the rotating support. The robot can complete the multiple-degree-of-freedom actions, such as rising and falling of the head, nodding, look-up, shaking and turning, of the head and is simple and compact in structure, small in whole unit size and smooth and flexible in motion.

title: Multifunctional self-service robot system
abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional self-service robot system. The multifunctional self-service robot system is characterized by comprising an anthropomorphic robot, sound equipment, a robot vision system, a control table, a speech processing system and a server unit; the control table, the service unit and a multi-robot system are in wireless connection, and information interaction is carried out in a wireless manner; the server unit is internally provided with the visual system, is used for providing vision serve information for the control table and the multi-robot system and is meanwhile matched with the speech processing system for making a decision; and a vision unit of the server unit transmits image information to a server of the server unit in a wireless manner for processing. title: Wireless-control steering engine interaction humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wireless-control steering engine interaction humanoid robot. The wireless-control steering engine interaction humanoid robot comprises a host module, a subordinate machine module and an independent power source; the host module comprises an STM32 steering engine control panel which is used for being installed in a master robot; an IO pin of the STM32 steering engine control panel is connected with a host unibus connector which works according to the bus communication protocol, and outputs a control signal to a host steering engine set; the host steering engine set is used for executing a host action instruction; a communication interface of the STM32 steering engine control panel is connected with a master Bluetooth module; the subordinate machine module comprises a serial port-to-unibus steering engine control panel; a bus port of a unibus steering engine control panel is connected with a subordinate machine steering engine set through a unibus; the subordinate machine steering engine set is used for controlling a steering engine to act; a communication port of the unibus steering engine control panel is connected with a slave Bluetooth module; and the slave Bluetooth module and the master Bluetooth module perform data transmission communication according to the Bluetooth protocol. The wireless-control steering engine interaction humanoid robot saves IO resources, a plurality of systems can be controlled, cost is low, and stability is high.

title: Gait planning device of similarity movement of humanoid robot and planning method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a gait planning device of similarity movement of a humanoid robot and a planning method thereof. The device and the method are characterized in that through a humanoid robot gait planning method based on the key frame similarity, through the similarity measurement of the gait key frame, the planning of hip joints, and real-time correction of zero moment points, online adjustment of curved gaits of the humanoid robot is achieved; and the adjusted gaits are capable of well getting close to the actual zero moment point curve. According to the invention, when the operand is reduced, problems in gait stability and movement planning of the humanoid robot are well solved; and time consumption during undesirable selection of the gaits can be reduced.

title: ARM-based intelligent induction child toy robot
abstract: The invention discloses an ARM-based intelligent induction child toy robot. The ARM-based intelligent induction child toy robot comprises a robot shell, wherein the robot shell comprises a head and a robot body, wherein a traveling mechanism is mounted at the bottom of the robot body, an image acquisition system is arranged on the front of the head, a main control module is arranged inside the head, manipulators are also arranged at the two sides of the upper end of the robot body respectively, and a touch induction module is arranged on each manipulator; and the main control module comprises a core controller, the power supply terminal of the core controller is connected with a power supply board, the power supply board is used for supplying power to each small module, the data terminal of the core controller is connected with a signal acquisition and processing module and a voice interaction module, the data communication terminal of a core processor is also connected with a data communication module, and a motor driver is connected between the traveling mechanism and the core controller. title: Proximity sense sensing network for self-adaptive pre-grabbing of five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to a proximity sense sensing network for self-adaptive pre-grabbing of a five-finger dexterous hand. According to the envelope characteristic of the structure of the humanoid dexterous hand, a sensing network is formed by arranging angle sensors at all joints and embedding distance sensors into the inner side surfaces of all knuckles, and two novel functions for the pre-grabbing task of the dexterous hand are realized. On one hand, a three-dimensional model of an object in a palm can be established, the data of the two kinds of sensors are processed in real time on the basis of theory of a link mechanism, point cloud data of the object are obtained, and a novel method is provided for identifying a target to be grabbed; and on the other hand, the side swing movement of each finger is controlled through the proximity sense sensing network, the sensing network can reduce the fingertip accessible domain to a two-dimensional plane from a three-dimensional space during force planning, the problem that the calculation amount of an expected pose of a fingertip is large is solved, the real-time planning speed of the pre-grabbing stage is increased, meanwhile, the knuckles can make contact with the target to be grabbed as much as possible, and a better foundation is laid for achieving stable grabbing.

title: Small humanoid robot capable of realizing omni-directional walking and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a small humanoid robot capable of realizing omni-directional walking and a control method thereof and is used for solving the technical problem that an existing small humanoid robot cannot realize the purpose of walking to the arbitrary direction. The invention adopts the technical scheme that the robot comprises a steering engine and a steering engine connecting piece which form a whole main body; three connecting pieces are arranged on each arm, that is, each arm has three degrees of freedom. Six connecting pieces are arranged on each leg, that is, each leg has six degrees of freedom; two connecting pieces are arranged on the head, that is, the head has two degrees of freedom. A gait algorithm adopted by the control method is an approximation of a real-time zero moment point algorithm; compensation and correction are performed through outputting a coupling oscillation curve and combining with an inverted pendulum system control algorithm; model parameters are adjusted through computer simulation, so that a stable humanoid robot gait simulation model capable of real-time generation is obtained. Finally, an experiment is performed on a physical robot to achieve a final robot gait effect.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: Provided is a humanoid robot in which the possibility of falling over, which occurs when the power is shut off or when a centrifugal force, an external force, or the like is generated, is reduced, thus achieving high continuous operation probability. A humanoid robot (1) includes a body part (11), a head part (10), a left arm (12L) and a right arm (12R) that are attached at one end to the left and right of an upper section of the body part (11), a left foot (13L) and a right foot (13R) that are attached at one end to the left and right of a lower section of the body part (11), and a left travelling part (14L) and a right travelling part (14R) that are provided at the other ends of the left foot (13L) and the right foot (13R). The left travelling part (14L) includes a left driving wheel (101L) at the front side in the travelling direction and a left driven wheel (102L) at the rear side in the travelling direction, and the right travelling part (14R) includes a right driving wheel (101R) at the front side in the travelling direction and a right driven wheel (102R) at the rear side in the travelling direction. The left driving wheel (101L), the right driving wheel (101R), the left driven wheel (102L), and the right driven wheel (102R) move while touching the ground.

title: Waist joint for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a waist joint for a humanoid robot. According to the waist joint for the humanoid robot, two lifting mechanisms and a rotation mechanism are arranged between a movable platform and a fixed platform, and the connection positions of the two lifting mechanism and the connection position of the rotation mechanism with the movable platform are in a triangle shape. Power sources of the three mechanisms are independent, so that the three mechanisms integrally form a linkage structure which has a good carrying capacity; meanwhile, the pitching and rolling motion of the movable platform are completed through the two lifting mechanisms cooperatively, rotation of the movable platform is completed through the two lifting mechanisms and the rotation mechanism cooperatively, three-degree-of-freedom motion of the movable platform relative to the fixed platform is achieved, the motion space is similar to that of a waist joint of a human body, and the motion range requirement is met; and in addition, pitching, rolling and rotation of the movable platform are completed through the two or three mechanisms cooperatively, the three mechanism bear loads, and thus the overall carrying capacity is improved.

title: Home self-adaptation physical examination robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a home self-adaptation physical examination robot. The robot comprises a robot body. The robot body comprises a trunk. A head is arranged at the top end of the trunk. A camera used for shooting images of arms of physical examinees is arranged on the head. A left arm is hinged to the left side of the trunk. A sphere end used for measuring the heart rate is arranged at the end of the left arm. A right arm is hinged to the right side of the trunk and comprises a telescopic rear arm hinged to the trunk, and a front arm hinged to the rear arm. A bandage used for measuring the blood pressure is fixed to the rear arm, and the position of the bandage can be adjusted along with telescoping of the rear arm. A display screen used for displaying the placement position of front arms of the physical examinees is arranged on the front arm. When the robot is used for measuring the blood pressure of the physical examinees, the front arm and the rear arm are adjusted so that the arm bent shape for blood pressure measuring can be formed, the arms of the physical examinees can be placed in an accurate posture, and thus blood pressure measuring is more accurate.

title: Exoskeleton robot control system
abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot control system. The exoskeleton robot control system comprises a robot main body. The robot main body comprises a mechanical structure and a control system. The mechanical structure comprises a back component, a hip joint connecting component, thigh connecting components, shank connecting components, power devices and feet, wherein the thigh connecting components, the shank connecting components and the feet are sequentially hinged from top to bottom and symmetrically hinged to the two sides of the hip joint connecting component, and the back component is mounted on the hip joint connecting component. Each power device comprises a servo motor and a transmission structure, wherein the servo motor is in transmission connection with the transmission structure. The power devices are mounted in the positions where the thigh connecting components and the shank connecting components are hinged together and the positions where the thigh connecting components and the hip joint connecting component are hinged together. The back component and the hip joint connecting component are connected through a connecting piece arranged between the back component and the hip joint connecting component. The connecting piece comprises a connecting nose on the lower portion and a connecting rod on the upper portion. The exoskeleton robot control system can assist people in working, and the labor intensity is relieved.

title: Exoskeleton robot and hip joint thereof
abstract: The invention provides an exoskeleton robot and a hip joint thereof. title: Humanoid upper limb based on pneumatic muscle
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid upper limb based on pneumatic muscle. The pneumatic muscle simulates human muscle for driving a shoulder joint, an elbow joint and a wrist joint to move, and the function of completely simulating the motion of the upper limb of a person is achieved. The humanoid upper limb is composed of a rib, a vertebra, a shoulder blade, a humerus, a fibula, an ulna, a spherical hinge, the pneumatic muscle and a pneumatic muscle fixing plate; the pneumatic muscle of a humanoid upper limb girdle muscle drives the shoulder joint to retract and stretch, bend and extend, inwards rotate and outwards rotate; arm muscle drives the elbow joint to bend and extend, inwards rotate and outwards rotate, and meanwhile the arm muscle and the upper limb girdle muscle cooperatively drive the shoulder joint to inwards retract, outwards stretch, inwards rotate and outwards rotate; and forearm muscle drives the wrist joint to bend and extend and retract and stretch and drives the elbow joint to bend and extend, inwards rotate and outwards rotate. The humanoid upper limb is driven by the pneumatic muscle, has the beneficial effects of being compact in structure, clean and good in anti-explosion performance, and can be used for teaching demonstration, medicinal diagnosis and scientific research.

title: Robot for adjuvant therapy of infantile autism
abstract: The invention discloses a robot for adjuvant therapy of infantile autism. title: PARTICLE SWARM OPTIMIZATION AND REINFORCEMENT LEARNING ALGORITHM-BASED DYNAMIC WALKING CONTROL SYSTEM FOR BIOMIMETIC BIPED ROBOT
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biomimetic humanoid robot walking control. Provided is a particle swarm optimization and reinforcement learning algorithm-based dynamic walking control system for a biomimetic biped robot. The dynamic walking control system comprises: a motion mode control center; a central mode control center; an action stage control center; a postural reflex control center; and a joint unit. A modulation signal output terminal of the motion mode control center is connected to a modulation signal input terminal of the joint unit. A stimulus signal output terminal of the motion mode control center is connected to a stimulus signal input terminal of the central mode control center. An excitation signal output terminal of the central mode control center is respectively connected to an excitation signal input terminal of the action stage control center and an excitation signal input terminal of the joint unit. An action signal output terminal of the action stage control center is connected to an action signal input terminal of the postural reflex control center. The control system has a high stability, high efficiency and high adaptivity.

title: A traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot and a diagnosis and treatment method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot and a diagnosis and treatment method thereof. The traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot comprises a human shape robot; the front portion of the robot is provided with an interactive touch screen, an identity card information reader, a camera, a speech recognition unit and a face recognition unit. The rear portion of the robot is provided with an electronic acupuncture therapeutic instrument; the robot is inside provided with a central controller storing a traditional Chinese medicine database; the central controller is in signal connection with the electronic acupuncture therapeutic instrument, the interactive touch screen, the identity card information reader, the camera, the speech recognition unit and the face recognition unit. The traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot can perform accurate diagnosis for patients, provide ideal traditional Chinese medicine prescriptions and acupuncture prescriptions and greatly shorten clinic time of patients; the traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot is suitable for communities, sub-districts or villages; the traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment robot meets the urgent requirements of patients for diagnosis and treatment and improves the life quality of people, thereby being of great social importance.

title: Humanoid robot device, control system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot device and a control system thereof. The device comprises a communication circuit, a containing space, a microprocessor and a steering engine assembly, wherein the communication circuit is used for being connected with peripheral equipment, so that the humanoid robot device is operated by the peripheral equipment by virtue of the communication circuit; the containing space is formed in the device and is used for containing the peripheral equipment, and the peripheral equipment is connected with the communication circuit; the microprocessor is respectively connected with the communication circuit and the steering engine assembly and is used for processing first data which are received by the communication circuit from the peripheral equipment and generating control instructions; and the steering engine assembly is used for receiving the control instructions from the microprocessor and executing the control instructions. In the mode, the performance of a controller of the humanoid robot device can be improved, and the research and development cost of the controller of the humanoid robot device can be reduced.

title: CPG (Central Pattern Generator) model-based humanoid robot gait planning method
abstract: The present invention belongs to the humanoid robot technical field and relates to a CPG (Central Pattern Generator) model-based humanoid robot gait planning method. The method includes the following steps that: (1) a corresponding coupled oscillator model is established according to specific hardware parameters of a robot; (2) the model is improved by adding a centroid offset control item, so that an improved oscillator model can be obtained; and (3) with velocity adopted as an input condition, genetic algorithm optimization is used to obtain the optimal values of parameters in step (2), and the obtained optimal values of the parameters are substituted into the model in step (2). With the planning method adopted, the robot is not prone to vibrating forwards and backwards and tumble when the robot rapidly accelerates to move or moves rapidly.

title: Controlling method of bionic eyeball mechanism capable of enabling a robot to express human feelings with the emotional feedback through the eyes
abstract: The present invention provides a controlling method of a bionic eyeball mechanism, which is applied to a bionic eyeball mechanism. In the controlling method of the bionic eyeball mechanism, the eyeball returns to the original point when powering on the eyeball mechanism, and a posture detection module detects the displacement of an object and then transfers the information to a motion controlling module. The motion controlling module controls the movement of a relevant motor after calculation so as to achieve the action of rotating the eyeball element to track the object. When the object has been out of the detection range for a period of time, the eyeball element will be automatically adjusted back to the heading position. The pupil zooming dimension of the eyeball is controlled according to the ambient light detected by an ambient light detection module so that the eyeball element can conduct the object tracking, the pupil zooming and other actions more accurately. Thus, a robot can express human feelings with the emotional feedback through the eyes so as to achieve a more realistic humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid rod-climbing robot based on pneumatic muscles
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid rod-climbing robot based on pneumatic muscles and a control system thereof. The pneumatic muscles are used for simulating four limbs of a person to drive movement of joints, and the function of climbing a rod by completely simulating the person is achieved. The humanoid rod-climbing robot is composed of the pneumatic muscles, an upper end grasping mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a multi-rod telescopic mechanism and a lower end grasping mechanism. The humanoid rod-climbing robot is driven through the pneumatic muscles and has the characteristics of compact structure, good cleaning performance and good explosion-proof performance and can be used for paint spraying, cleaning and maintenance work of high-rise buildings and high-altitude rod-shaped urban buildings such as wire poles, wires and cables, natural gas pipelines, light poles and bridge cables.

title: Home care robot
abstract: The invention discloses a home care robot. The home care robot comprises an outer shell, a head part, a door body and an intelligent bracelet. The outer side of the upper end of the base is connected with the outer shell through a fence. A dispensing apparatus is installed on the left side of the exterior of the outer shell. The right side of the dispensing apparatus is provided with a heating pipe. A water-out button is installed on the right side of the heating pipe. Mechanical arms are installed at the left end and the right end of the back side of the outer shell. An armrest is arranged on the left side of the outer shell. Pickups are connected with the left side and the right side of the head part. The head part is located above the outer shell. According to the home care robot, the dispensing apparatus is arranged, timely and reasonable dose distribution according to the needed dose of the old can be achieved, and the condition of excessive medicine using or forgetting to take medicine cannot happen.

title: Bionic shoulder joint based on dielectric elastomer actuators
abstract: A bionic shoulder joint based on dielectric elastomer actuators comprises a shoulder joint connector, a shoulder joint support, an upper arm support, two upper-arm connecting rods and the two dielectric elastomer actuators, wherein the shoulder joint connector is provided with a rotation sleeve, and the front end of the shoulder joint support is installed at the rotation sleeve so that the shoulder joint support can rotate in the shoulder joint connector; and an intermediate shaft of the upper arm support is installed in two sleeves and can rotate in the sleeves. Two symmetrically arranged hemispherical grooves extend out from the front end of the upper arm support and are used for being connected with round heads of the two connecting rods. The tail end of each connecting rod and the output end of the corresponding dielectric elastomer actuator are installed together. The two actuators act at the same time and can control the movement direction and movement angle of the shoulder joint. The bionic shoulder joint is similar to true conditions of a human body on the aspects of structure, movement and functions, and has good flexibility. Besides, the bionic shoulder joint is simple in structure, reasonable in design and convenient to install and can be applied to the shoulder joint design of various humanoid robots, and the application prospects are quite extensive.

title: Drive circuit board based on humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a drive circuit board which is arranged on a circuit board mounting end surface, opposite to an adjacent lifting arm joint, of a rotary arm joint according to the shape of a humanoid mechanical arm. When the humanoid mechanical arm is in a stretching state, the drive circuit board is just arranged between the adjacent rotary arm joint and the lifting arm joint, so that mounting space of the drive circuit board is saved, length of the rotary arm joint and the lifting arm joint can be greatly shortened, and integral flexibility of the humanoid mechanical arm is improved. The drive circuit board is simultaneously adjacent to the rotary arm joint and the lifting arm joint, so that the drive circuit board is favorably arranged towards a connecting line of the rotary arm joint and the lifting arm joint. The drive circuit board adopts a slide slot way to mount, and is electrically connected with other parts through connectors, so that mounting and debugging are easy. The drive circuit board adopts a high-speed real-time bus EtherCAT to transmit a control signal, and has the advantages of being high in real-time response, low in cost and the like.

title: Robot ankle structure and robot

title: Anthropomorphic system of elder nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic system of an elder nursing robot. The anthropomorphic system comprises a central processor, a sound pickup, a camera, a first storage module, a second storage module and a third storage module, wherein the sound pickup, the camera, the first storage module, the second storage module and the third storage module are in communication connection with the central processor. The central processor is internally provided with an information extracting module, a time screening module and a counting module. The central processor extracts user input information within a second time period from the third storage module according to the second time period which is set in the time screening module, and the central processor enables the counting module to carry out counting and mark the most-frequent user input information in the second time period. The central processor enables the counting module to carry out counting and mark the most-frequent user input information in a first time period. The central processor stores the marked user input information to the first storage module. The elder nursing robot can gradually grow according to the behavioral habit of an elder, and the robot is personalized and meets the living needs of each elder better.

title: Man-robot virtual reality interaction control system based on inertia motion capture
abstract: The invention discloses a man-robot virtual reality interaction control system based on inertia motion capture. The man-robot virtual reality interaction control system comprises a motion measuring method based on MSP430 and a nine-axis sensor, and a virtual reality technology robot interactive interface module. According to the motion measuring method based on the MSP430 and the nine-axis sensor, a wearable inertia action capture node is designed so that a real-time posture of a human body can be collected, posture information is calculated with a kalman filter, then, the posture is converted into a data package and fed back to a host system through a wireless transceiver, a host analyses and processes data, generates a command to control a built three-dimensional human body model to respond and meanwhile generates a command to control a humanoid entity robot to move, and the robot feeds back the response condition of the robot to the host. According to the virtual reality technology robot interactive interface module, a set of virtual human parts are designed through SolidWorks mainly, then, a virtual environment is built through Labview to conduct action restoring, and interaction is achieved.

abstract: Provided is a walking control method enabling stable walking operation to be realized, a walking control program and a biped walking robot. A walking control method includes, during walking operation of a biped walking robot having a position of center of gravity being adjusted at a predetermined reference angle that enables the robot to be upright, a step of acquiring information indicative of an inclination angle of an upper body relative to the reference angle, and a step of operating, with one of a first leg and a second leg not being grounded due to the walking operation, the first leg and the second leg such that the upper body is maintained within a predetermined angle range relative to the reference angle according to the inclination angle.

title: SUBACTUATED MECHANIZED RECONFIGURATION APPARATUS FOR BIPEDAL WALK.
abstract: The invention relates to a bipedal walking apparatus which characterizes by allowing reconfiguring a variety of paths to its walk. Each limb is a complex subactuated mechanism formed by the combination of the Jansen and Hopkins bar mechanisms and an actuator drives each limb. Also, it possesses a device that allows synchronization and adequately offset the movement of the limbs. The presented invention maintains a manual calibration and adjustment mechanism for reconfiguring a variety of walks at both limbs. The limbs are attached to a double hip that laterally dampens the oscillations by a spring system, and that stability combines with the vertical damping of the feet by other pairs of springs.

title: a hoisting apparatus of wearable robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a lifting device for a wearable robot, and more particularly, to a lifting device for a wearable robot that minimizes the occurrence of load and reduces fatigue by including a rotating frame that easily and smoothly lifts or transports heavy objects with little force in conjunction with the wearer's movement on one side of the wearable robot. title: TRANSFORMABLE ROBOT
abstract: This transformable robot is capable of switching between a vehicle mode and a humanoid mode. In the vehicle mode, this transformable robot has: front lateral side portions which are located to the sides of a front central portion; a cabin where a seat is disposed; door portions which are located to the sides of the cabin; and a rear upper portion and a rear lower portion which are respectively located above and below the rear of the cabin. In the humanoid mode, the front central portion forms a head portion, the front lateral side portions form a chest portion, the door portions form arm portions, the rear upper portion forms a lumbar portion, and the rear lower portions form left and right leg portions. In both the vehicle mode and the humanoid mode, the surface of the seat of the cabin has the same inclination angle. Thus, this transformable robot is capable of switching between the vehicle mode and the humanoid mode without changing the orientation of the pilot's seat.
