title: Robot joint with flexible and stable movement and robot with joint
abstract: The invention discloses a robot joint with flexible and stable movement. The robot joint comprises a first component and a second component, wherein the first component and the second component can relatively rotate. A motor is fixedly arranged on the first component and is connected with a speed reducer, and the speed reducer is arranged on an output shaft. A connecting column is fixedly arranged on the second component and is connected with the output shaft through a transmission device. The joint further comprises a control device and a sensor used for detecting the position of the first component or the second component, and the control device is electrically connected with the motor and the sensor. The output shaft is connected with the connecting column through the transmission device, and the motor can be arranged at the position far away from the joint, so that regulation is more flexible. The transmission device connection is adopted to replace the current direct meshing transmission, and the rotational speed of the output shaft is controlled through the speed reducer, so that transmission is more stable. The invention further provides a robot with the joint, the hip joint, the knee joints and the ankle joints of the joint adopt the structure, and thus the robot walks more flexibly and stably.

title: Intelligent partner robot capable of simulating human body actions in real time
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent partner robot capable of simulating human body actions in real time, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The intelligent partner robot comprises a central processing unit, a camera shooting unit, a voice interaction unit and an action drive unit. An action mapping module is arranged inside the central processing unit. The camera shooting unit acquires a human body image sequence with depth information. The central processing unit processes the human body image sequence and further classifies the human body actions according to a preset training model to form recognition actions. The human body actions are mapped into information streams of the action drive unit through the action mapping module, so that the action drive unit drives the robot to make expected actions. The voice interaction unit plays action names and receives voice instructions input from the outside. By the adoption of the intelligent partner robot, the simple human body actions can be recognized, real-time simulation is conducted, face recognition is performed, and a larger space is provided for the playability and interestingness of the robot based on depth cameras and voice interaction.

title: Regeneration power mechanical skeleton system
abstract: The invention relates to a regeneration power mechanical skeleton system. The regeneration power mechanical skeleton system comprises a mechanical system and a data collection system. The mechanical system comprises a lower limb servo mechanism and a connection mechanism. title: Ducted push-aiding device and method making biped robot step over obstacles
abstract: The invention discloses a ducted push-aiding device and method making a biped robot step over obstacles. A controller calculates out theoretical thrust needing to be provided by a ducted fan to ensure that the robot steps over obstacles in a balance mode according to the step-over trajectory of the step-over sole of the robot, and sends the theoretical thrust to a processor; the processor identifies the instruction, generates a corresponding PWM signal and sends the PWM signal to an electronic speed regulator of the ducted fan, and the electronic speed regulator controls the ducted fan according to the PWM signal and generates corresponding thrust. title: Bipedal isotropic lattice locomoting explorer: robotic platform for locomotion and manipulation of discrete lattice structures and lightweight space structures
abstract: A robotic platform for traversing and manipulating a modular 3D lattice structure is described. The robot is designed specifically for its tasks within a structured environment, and is simplified in terms of its numbers of degrees of freedom (DOF). This allows for simpler controls and a reduction of mass and cost. Designing the robot relative to the environment in which it operates results in a specific type of robot called a “relative robot”. Depending on the task and environment, there can be a number of relative robots. This invention describes a bipedal robot which can locomote across a periodic lattice structure made of building block parts. The robot is able to handle, manipulate, and transport these blocks when there is more than one robot. Based on a general inchworm design, the robot has added functionality while retaining minimal complexity, and can perform numerous maneuvers for increased speed, reach, and placement.

title: Action training method of human-like multi-degree-of-freedom robot
abstract: The invention discloses an action training method of a human-like multi-degree-of-freedom robot. The action training method comprises the following steps: 1, using optical equipment to recognize the bone data of a person whose action is captured; 2, mapping bone joint coordinates to a mathematic coordinate system, and calculating the included angle of each joint according to coordinate data; and 3, sending the angle data to corresponding motor controllers on the robot, which control rotating motors to restore the action of the person. The action training method has the beneficial effects that the action accuracy and completeness of the multi-degree-of-freedom robot are improved, and the action training method can be widely applied to the fields of intelligent robots, logistic robots, warehouse management robots, cargo handling robots, bar code robots, children robots, tourist guide manner robots, housekeeping robots, acting entertainment robots, humanoid robots, construction robots and the like.

title: WHOLE BODY MANIPULATION ON A LEGGED ROBOT USING DYNAMIC BALANCE
abstract: A robot system (400) includes: an upper body section (408b) including one or more end-effectors (422, 424); a lower body section (408a) including one or more legs (404, 406); and an intermediate body section (408c) coupling the upper and lower body sections. An upper body control system (417b) operates at least one of the end-effectors. The intermediate body section experiences a first intermediate body linear force and/or moment based on an end-effector force acting on the at least one end-effector. A lower body control system operates (417a) the one or more legs. The legs experience respective surface reaction forces. The intermediate body section experiences a second intermediate body linear force and/or moment based on the surface reaction forces. The one or more legs operate so that the second intermediate body linear force balances the first intermediate linear force and the second intermediate body moment balances the first intermediate body moment.

title: BIPEDAL ISOTROPIC LATTICE LOCOMOTING EXPLORER: ROBOTIC PLATFORM FOR LOCOMOTION AND MANIPULATION OF DISCRETE LATTICE STRUCTURES AND LIGHTWEIGHT SPACE STRUCTURES
abstract: A robotic platform for traversing and manipulating a modular 3D lattice structure is described. The robot is designed specifically for its tasks within a structured environment, and is simplified in terms of its numbers of degrees of freedom (DOF). This allows for simpler controls and a reduction of mass and cost. Designing the robot relative to the environment in which it operates results in a specific type of robot called a 'relative robot'. Depending on the task and environment, there can be a number of relative robots. This invention describes a bipedal robot which can locomote across a periodic lattice structure made of building block parts. The robot is able to handle, manipulate, and transport these blocks when there is more than one robot. Based on a general inchworm design, the robot has added functionality while retaining minimal complexity, and can perform numerous maneuvers for increased speed, reach, and placement.

title: FRONT WEARING STAND-UP ASSISTANCE ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to a front-wearing stand-up assistance robot and, more specifically, relates to a front-wearing stand-up assistance robot capable of being worn on the front; capable of automatically being balanced against an external force; and capable of being predicting and assisting a next motion by determining a users intention. The front-wearing stand-up assistance robot comprises: a plurality of assistance leg portions which include leg joint drivers formed along the outside of the users legs, and providing a freedom of motion in a first direction in correspondence with leg joints of the user, and links connecting the leg joint drivers; and a body portion which includes a plurality of support bars connected to the first pelvic joint drivers of the leg joint drivers at a first stage, surrounding the front surface of the body of the user, and bent to open a rear surface of the body, and second pelvic joint drivers connected to second stages of the plurality of support bars providing freedom of motion in a second direction.

title: AGED-CARE SERVICE ROBOT
abstract: An aged-care service robot, comprising a humanoid shell (100), a sensing module (200), a motion module (300), a control module (400), and a power supply module (500). The humanoid shell (100) comprises a head portion (110) and a torso portion (120). The sensing module (200) is arranged on an outer surface of the humanoid shell (100), and is used to sense a motion position of a service target. The motion module (300) is provided on a bottom portion of the humanoid shell (100), and is used to drive the aged-care service robot to move. The control module (400) is communicatively connected to the sensing module (200) and the motion module (300). The power supply module (500) supplies power to the sensing module (200), the motion module (300), and the control module (400). The aged-care service robot of the present invention is not affected by ambient light, has high accuracy, and does not require the elderly to wear a tag, thus providing simple operation and convenience.

title: Pneumatic-muscle-based multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing robot and control system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic-muscle-based multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing robot and a control system thereof. The pneumatic-muscle-based multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing robot drives joints to move through pneumatic muscles and has the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing function. The multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing robot is mainly composed of an upper end Y-direction clamping system, an upper end X-direction clamping system, a climbing system, a climbing pole and a lower end clamping system. The upper end Y-direction clamping system, the upper end X-direction clamping system and the lower end clamping system are used for firmly grasping the climbing pole. The climbing system is composed of two pairs of support legs used for realizing vertical crawling in the X-direction and the Y-direction. The pneumatic-muscle-based multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid pole-climbing robot conducts driving through the pneumatic muscles, has thecharacteristics of being compact in structure, clean and good in explosion-proof performance and can be used for paint spraying, cleaning and maintaining of high-rise irregular rod-like urban buildings.

title: WALKING ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING BALANCING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention proposes a walking robot and a posture control method thereof for controlling a stable posture of the walking robot of which each joint operates using a torque servo. Using the center of gravity of the robot and the inclination and direction of an upper body and a pelvis, the present invention is able to stably maintain the upright posture and a desired angle of the upper body regardless of an external change including any force applied from the outside, an inclination degree of the ground, and the like. Further, even when information about the inclination direction and the inclination degree of the ground is not given to the robot, the present invention is able to maintain the upright posture with respect to the direction of gravity, and even when a standing surface is tilted slowly, an angle of an ankle joint is changed accordingly, such that the upper body and legs can maintain the constant posture.

title: Cervical joint driving mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a cervical joint driving mechanism of a humanoid robot to solve the problem that the humanoid robot is low in integration and the head motion performance cannot meet the actualusage demand. The cervical joint driving mechanism comprises a neck pitching mechanism, a neck rotation mechanism, a hydraulic pitching driving device and a hydraulic rotation driving device which arelocated in the neck area of the humanoid robot. The neck pitching mechanism is used for being fixedly connected with a head shell, when the neck pitching mechanism is driven to move through the hydraulic pitching driving device, the neck pitching mechanism drives the head shell to complete pitching action; and the neck rotation mechanism is fixedly connected with the neck pitching mechanism, whenthe hydraulic rotation driving device drives the neck rotation mechanism, the neck rotation mechanism drives the head shell to complete rotation action through the neck pitching mechanism.

title: Rigidity-flexibility-softy coupled humanoid robot spine structure
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and particularly discloses a rigidity-flexibility-softy coupled humanoid robot spine structure. The spine structure comprises a plurality of vertebra bodies made from rigid materials; the vertebra bodies are sequentially stacked to form a spine body; an elastic soft body is arranged between every two adjacent vertebra bodies; the surface, making contact with the corresponding vertebra body, of each elastic soft body is sunken inwards to form a cavity; the surface, making contact with the corresponding elastic soft body, of each vertebra body is provided with a protrusion corresponding to the cavity; each elastic soft body comprises an intermediate body and a ring body arranged on the outer side of the intermediate body in an annular sleeving manner; and the fluidity of each ring body is higher than that of the corresponding intermediate body. According to the spine structure, the elastic soft bodies and the vertebra bodies are limited through the cavities and the protrusions, and the risk that the elastic soft bodies are extruded out when the vertebra bodies are bent is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot gait planning method based on human body teaching
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait planning method based on human body teaching. Human body movement information is used for gait planning of a humanoid robot. The joint driving angle of the robot is obtained through inverse operation of skeleton information during human body movement. The mass center track information of the robot is estimated through human body teaching data in orderto meet the stability during movement of the humanoid robot. Compensation control is conducted on the driving angle of the robot by combining a ZMP criterion and a robot mass center-angle jacobi matrix. In selection of supporting feet, switching of the supporting feet during human body teaching is judged through a hysteretic curve, so that selection of the supporting feet of the robot is determined. The humanoid robot gait planning method based on human body teaching greatly simplifies the complexity of humanoid robot gait planning, and the movement process of the robot is more personified through the gait planning based on human body teaching.

title: Humanoid robot self-service cash register and unattended convenience store operation system
abstract: A humanoid robot self-service cash register comprises a humanoid shell which is internally provided with a voice recognizing module, a voice synthesizing module, a face recognizing module, a commodityinformation recognizing module, a payment module, a storage module, an Ethernet interface module and a main control module connected with all the above mentioned modules. The Ethernet interface module is connected with the Internet or a cloud server. The surface of the humanoid shell is provided with a display screen, a loudspeaker, a camera and slots corresponding to the payment module, the commodity information recognizing module, the voice recognizing module and the Ethernet interface module. The commodity information recognizing module collects commodity bar codes or radio frequency identification information. The main control module calls prestored commodity unit price from the storage module of the cloud server and accumulates a total price. The main control module converts the accumulated total price into a control command to be sent to the payment module for collecting the corresponding money. A humanoid robot realizes the conversation with customers and provides consultationand shopping guidance with the aid of the voice recognizing module and the voice synthesizing module.

title: Head-eye coordinated movement device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a head-eye coordinated movement device for a humanoid robot. The head-eye coordinated movement device is composed of two eye movement mechanisms, a head-shaped shell and a neckmovement mechanism. The two eye movement mechanisms are installed on the positions of two eyes of the head-shaped shell, and the neck movement mechanism is installed below the head-shaped shell. title: Humanoid machine shank having take-off buffering function
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid machine shank having a take-off buffering function and belongs to the field of humanoid robots and the field of impact vibration isolation. The humanoid machine shank comprises a tibia cylinder, an upper end cap, a lower end cap, a fibula porous piston module and a compression-resistant spring, one end of a tibia is fixed on the porous piston module which dividesthe inside of the tibia cylinder into a cylinder area A and a cylinder area B, and the inside of each of the cylinder area A and the cylinder area B is filled with viscous fluid; the porous piston module comprises a piston body, multiple equal-section one-way holes, a one-way flowing cover A, multiple gradually-changing-section one-way holes, a one-way flowing cover B, a locking spring A and a locking spring B, the lower end of the compression-resistant spring is connected with the lower end cap while the upper end of the same is free, and the gradually-changing-section one-way holes and theequal-section one-way holes are in spaced arrangement. The humanoid machine shank is a shank buffer capable of extending and contracting a shank and absorbing impact energy and having a jumping function.

title: 2D walking stabilizing structure of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a 2D walking stabilizing structure of a biped robot. The 2D walking stabilizing structure includes a biped robot body. The surface of the biped robot body is provided with an obstacle-avoidance sensor. One end of the obstacle-avoidance sensor is provided with an infrared sensing transmitter. The other end of the obstacle-avoidance sensor is provided with an infrared sensingreceiver. The biped robot body comprises a head part and a walking part. The head part is provided with a rotating shaft through a connecting rod. The walking part comprises upper joints and lower joints. A bent transmission shaft is arranged between each upper joint and the corresponding lower joint. Each lower joint is connected with a foot of the robot. The surface of each foot is provided with a pressure sensor. The pressure sensors are connected with a main control box through a signal conveyor. The interior of the main control box comprises a central processing unit. One end of the central processing unit is provided with an operating chip which controls the robot to walk stably, and the other end of the central processing unit is provided with an ultrasonic sensor. The stability inthe process of walking of the robot is improved, and connection of all parts is more coordinated.

title: Robot with adjustable chassis
abstract: The invention provides a robot with an adjustable chassis. The robot comprises first mechanical leg modules, second mechanical leg modules, a body module, an interaction module, a manipulator module and a box module, wherein the first mechanical leg modules and the second mechanical leg modules are mounted at both sides of the body module; the interaction module is mounted at the front end of thetop of the body module; the manipulator module is mounted at the rear end of the top of the body module; the box module is mounted at the middle of the body module; each first mechanical leg module and each second mechanical leg module are respectively provided with three rotary joints comprising an upper joint, a middle joint and a bottom joint driven by a corresponding independent motor and respectively provided with a corresponding hub motor; the second mechanical leg modules are symmetrical structures of the first mechanical leg modules; and the robot can adjust the supporting area and theheight of gravity center of the entire chassis of the robot by virtue of the middle joints during the operation process. The robot with the adjustable chassis improves the stability of the robot in various environments by independently adjusting the supporting area, the height of gravity center and the overall height of the entire chassis of the robot.

title: Spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot is usedfor assisting people in walking to reduce people's energy consumption in the long-time walking process and can also be used for a lower limb rehabilitation training. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot comprises a thigh drive spherical mechanism, a calf drive spherical mechanism, a leg drive spherical mechanism, a hip structure, a power source anda drive controller. According to the spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot, a magnetoelectric angular displacement sensor is used for detecting space swinging angles among the thigh, the calf and the foot. An electromagnet is used for pushing a permanent magnet motor rotor to make the spherical rotor suspend. A spherical stator is used for driving a permanent magnet rotor to rotate. The lengths of the thigh and the calf can be adjusted by the adjustment of set bolts on the thigh and the calf, and therefore the spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot is suitable for different groups. The spherical joint magnetic levitation permanent magnet motor bipedal walking robot can be used for the lower limb rehabilitation training and reducing people's energy consumption in walking.

title: Variable topology spoke walking biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a variable topology spoke walking biped robot. The variable topology spoke walking biped robot includes a left wheel foot assembly, a right wheel foot assembly, a left shank assembly, a right shank assembly, a left thigh assembly, a right thigh assembly and hip joint assemblies. The left wheel foot assembly and the right wheel foot assembly are connected with the lower endsof the left shank assembly and the right shank assembly correspondingly. The left shank assembly and the right shank assembly are connected with the lower parts of the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly. The upper ends of the left thigh assembly and the right thigh assembly are connected with the hip joint assemblies. Rotatable main bodies are correspondingly arranged in the left wheel foot assembly and the right wheel foot assembly. Three spokes which are distributed at 60 degree at intervals are arranged in each main body in a penetrating mode. Each spoke can reciprocate in the length direction of the corresponding spoke. Each main body is used for extending and contracting the corresponding spoke according to needs of road conditions of a landing place before landing. According to the variable topology spoke walking biped robot, because every three spokes which are distributed at 60 degree at intervals and can reciprocate in the length direction of the spokes are used, the unique mobility is formed by combining with leg parts of the biped robot, the adaptability to complicated terrains such as potholes, mountain, flat ground and obstacle crossing of the biped robot is improved, the energy consumption is low, and the walking efficiency is high.

title: Biped robot and leg damping and energy recycling device thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot and a leg damping and energy recycling device thereof. Four-bar linkage mechanisms are arranged at a left knee-joint assembly and a right knee-joint assembly correspondingly, each four-bar linkage mechanism is internally provided with four pulling lines, a permanent magnet block and a magnetic wire coil, the permanent magnet blocks are located in the magneticwire coils, the inner side ends of each four pulling lines are connected with the corresponding permanent magnet block, the outer side ends of every four pulling lines a are connected with four connecting points of the corresponding four-bar linkage mechanism correspondingly, an electric energy storage device is further arranged in a hip-joint assembly, and the magnetic wire coils are electricallyconnected with the electric energy storage device through connecting lines. title: Walking-aid robot chest supporting structure
abstract: The invention relates to a walking-aid robot chest supporting structure. The invention aims at solving the problems that an existing walking-aid robot chest supporting structure is high in cost, complex in structure, poor in comfort level and poor in practicability. The walking-aid robot chest supporting structure is composed of a supporting rod, a handle, a control mechanism and a chest protection mechanism, wherein the supporting rod is hinged to the control mechanism through a rotating shaft, and the handle penetrates through the control mechanism to be fixedly connected to the front ends of a chest protection plate through threads. The walking-aid robot chest supporting structure is used for chest supporting of a walking-aid robot.

title: Shock absorbers for biped robots
abstract: The invention discloses shock absorbers for biped robots. The shock absorbers for the biped robots include an actuator arm, a power mechanism, a transmission mechanism, and an actuator. The actuator arm includes a telescopic arm rod. One end of the telescopic arm rod is provided with a coupling shaft, while the other end of the telescopic arm rod is provided with a gripping plate. The power mechanism includes a motor. The motor is connected with an output shaft. The output shaft is in driving connection with the actuator through the transmission mechanism to drive the actuator to move. The actuator includes a central processing unit. A signal processor is mounted in the central processing unit. The actuator arm, the power mechanism, the transmission mechanism and the actuator are respectively provided with the shock absorbers. The shock absorbers comprise a shock absorbing shell, a buffer core and a reinforcing layer. Positioning holes are formed in the inner wall of the shock absorbing shell, therefore the shock absorbers have greater torsion resistance. The shock absorbers for the biped robots have novel design and are a very good innovative program.

title: Dragging teaching instrument for humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: A dragging teaching instrument for a humanoid mechanical arm comprises a six-dimensional force sensor, a power source module and a teaching controller. The teaching controller comprises physical keys,an IO module, a DSP chip and a CAN bus controller. The six-dimensional force sensor is used for measuring space six-dimensional force exerted on an end executor of the humanoid mechanical arm. The physical keys are used for sending dragging signals to the IO module. The DSP chip receives measurement data of the six-dimensional force sensor and collecting the dragging signals of the IO module at the same time, and after calculating the position and posture variations, the DSP chip sends the position and posture variations to the CAN bus controller. The CAN bus controller sends the position andposture variations to a control system of a robot. By the adoption of a dragging teaching method, teaching of position dragging and posture dragging of the humanoid mechanical arm of the robot is achieved.

title: Robot facial expression control structure
abstract: The invention discloses a robot facial expression control structure. The robot facial expression control structure comprises a robot face, a face skin coating the robot face and multiple connecting parts arranged on the inner side of the face skin. Each connecting part comprises a drive connecting frame and a face connecting frame located at one end of the drive connecting frame. The other end ofeach drive connecting frame is connected with a control unit. The connecting parts are connected with the face skin through the face connecting frames. According to the robot facial expression controlstructure, the multiple connecting parts are arranged on the inner side of the face skin, all the connecting parts are designed to be provided with the face connecting frames with holes, the face skin can be embedded into the face connecting frames through the holes, and therefore the face skin is closely connected with the connecting parts; and motion of the connecting parts is controlled through the control units to achieve accurate control over the facial expression changes of a robot. According to the robot facial expression control structure, the defects that the face skin of the robot and the connecting parts are prone to falling off, facial expressions are stiff, and even the robot has no facial expression are overcome, and the robot facial expression control structure can be widely applied to the technical field of robot facial expression control.

title: Leg structure of walking robot
abstract: The present invention provides a leg structure of a walking robot. The leg structure comprises a thigh portion, a shank portion, a quasi-foot plate, a telescopic mechanism and a linkage mechanism. Thethigh portion comprises a connecting plate connected to the walking robot body, and a support plate arranged corresponding to the connecting plate. The shank portion comprises a connecting end and afree end, and the connecting end is telescopically connected with the thigh portion. The quasi-foot plate is provided with a connecting portion, a first connecting end and a second connecting end, andthe connecting portion is rotatably connected with the free end. The telescopic mechanism is arranged on the support plate. The telescopic mechanism is provided with a power part used for driving theshank portion to telescope. The linkage mechanism comprises an elastic connecting piece and a rigid connecting piece. The first connecting end is connected to the position, close to the free end, ofthe shank portion through the elastic connecting piece. The second connecting end is connected to the thigh portion through the rigid connecting piece. The leg structure has the advantages of light overall weight, simple structure, sensitiveness in control and high load capacity; the quantity of driving motors is small, the cost is low, and the reliability is high.

title: WEARABLE ASSISTANCE ROBOT DEVICE
abstract: There is provided a wearable assist robot apparatus configured to assist a walking action or the like with a least drive source, allow a body trunk to bent obliquely to the left and right, and detect landing of a foot without a floor reaction force switch for a foot. Upper arms (70) are fixed to drive shafts (62) of a pair of drive sources (60) at or near respective left and right hip joints. The upper arms (70) are coupled to an upper body trunk harness (20) by first passive rotary shafts (91) via third passive rotary shafts (73), and are mounted to a lower body trunk harness 30 by mounting means (94). Lower arms (80) are fixed to drive source bodies (63), and are coupled to thigh harnesses (40) by second passive rotary shafts (92) via fourth passive rotary shafts (83). The first and second passive rotary shafts (91, 92) and third and fourth passive rotary shafts (73, 83) are angularly displaceable about axial lines in a lateral direction of the wearer and axial lines in an anteroposterior direction of the wearer, respectively. An acceleration/angular speed sensor (103) fixed to the lower body trunk harness (30) detects an acceleration ±1 of the body trunk (11) in a vertical direction by landing of a foot.

title: ROBOT AND CONTROL METHOD AND DEVICE THEREOF
abstract: Provided are a robot and a control method and device thereof. The method comprises: determining whether any of multiple limb members (100) is separated from a torso portion (200) and falls to a location beyond a preset distance from the torso portion; if so, determining a location relationship between the torso portion and the separated limb member, wherein the separated limb member is one of the multiple limb members which is separated from the torso portion and falls to the location beyond the preset distance from the torso portion; controlling, according to the location relationship between the torso portion and the separated limb member, the robot to walk to the location of the separated limb member; and controlling the torso portion to control, by means of a magnetic force, the separated limb member to move within the preset distance from the torso portion. Also provided are a control device implementing the control method and a robot. The method and device solve a problem in which when a limb member is separated from a robot, the robot is unable to automatically reattach the separated limb member.

title: ATTITUDE CONTROL APPARATUS FOR AN WEARABLE TYPE ROBOT AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a posture control apparatus of a wearable type robot and a control method of the apparatus. The posture control apparatus controlling a posture of a wearable type robot comprises: a sensor portion detecting a walking state of a user wearing the robot; at least one driving portion generating moment of a specific direction in a roll direction; and a control portion for determining whether the user is supporting a body with one leg based on a detection result of the walking state of the user, and controlling the driving portion to generate moment in a direction corresponding to the one leg supporting the body by the user when the user is supporting the body with the one leg, thereby capable of maintaining a stable posture while moving at a high speed with a heavy load.

title: Teaching control method for humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a teaching control method for a humanoid manipulator. The teaching control method for the humanoid manipulator comprises the steps that after a teaching mode is started, the humanoid manipulator is dragged to a preset target position; in the whole dragging process, the position information of each joint is collected and fed back to a controller of the humanoid manipulator;after the controller receives the position information, median filtering is conducted on the position information, and expected position information data are obtained; after the expected position information data are converted into a code command, the code command is directly issued to a driver of the humanoid manipulator; the humanoid manipulator is driven to complete the corresponding motion according to the code command; and whether the motion meets the preset requirement or not is judged, and the humanoid manipulator is controlled according to the judgment result. By means of the teachingcontrol method for the humanoid manipulator, the purposes of simplifying the teaching process of the manipulator and reducing the teaching cost of the manipulator are realized.

title: Improved transmission structure of biped robot hip joint
abstract: The invention discloses an improved transmission structure of a biped robot hip joint. The improved transmission structure comprises a hip joint seat. A driving motor is installed in the hip joint seat. A coupling is arranged at one end of the driving motor. A bearing screw rod is arranged at the other end of the driving motor. A front-back swing arm part is arranged on one side of the coupling. An up-down swing arm part is arranged on the other side of the coupling. Angle sensors are installed between the front-back swing arm part and the up-down swing arm part. A damping piece is installed on a stress part of the angle sensor. An elastic compressed spring serves as the damping piece. A pressure sensor is installed at the bottom of the hip joint seat. The angle sensor and the pressure sensor are connected with a hip joint driving controller through a signal transmitting circuit. A filter filtering a digital signal is arranged in the hip joint driving controller. A power controller isarranged on one side of the filter. A PLC control chip is arranged on the other side of the filter. Stability of robot operation is improved, and thus connection of all parts is more coordinated.

title: Shoulder joint of robot

title: Humaniod robot based on air cylinder
abstract: The invention discloses a humaniod robot based on an air cylinder. The air cylinder is adopted as a driving element for simulating the motion of the waist joint and four limbs of the human body, and the function of completely simulating human motion is achieved. The humaniod robot is mainly composed of the air cylinder, fixing plates, thighbones, fibulas and humeri and has 44 freedom degrees. Thesimulated waist joint has 12 freedom degrees, and the hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints of the simulated lower limbs have three freedom degrees, two freedom degrees and 2 freedom degrees correspondingly. The shoulder joints, elbow joints and wrist joints of simulated upper limbs have three freedom degrees, one freedom degree and four freedom degrees correspondingly, and a freedom degree isadded between the shoulder joints and the elbow joints. The humaniod robot is driven by the air cylinder, has the beneficial effects of having multiple freedom degrees and being good in cleaning and anti-explosion performance, and can be used for the fields of teaching demonstration, exhibitions, guest greeting, work position part grabbing and carrying and the like.

title: High-simulation robot head structure and motion control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-simulation robot head structure and a motion control method thereof. The high-simulation robot head structure comprises a shell assembly, a face motion assembly and an internal control assembly. The face motion assembly comprises an eye assembly, a mouth assembly and a neck assembly. An eyeball assembly is connected with the internal control assembly through a firstmotor. An eyelid assembly is connected with the internal control assembly through a second motor and a third motor. The mouth assembly is connected with the internal control assembly through a fourthmotor. An expression control and management module, independently researched and developed by our company, for realizing expression actions can be added to the internal control assembly. The expression control and management module works in cooperation with the face assembly under the external silica gel skin to realize the changes of expressions. With the high-simulation robot head structure andthe motion control method thereof, it is solved that in the prior art, when a robot for the service industry simulates the facial expressions of a real human being, the facial expressions are stiff because a traditional actuator is adopted for providing kinetic energy, the robot is in lack of the function of interacting with real human beings, and the robot cannot provide new and interesting consumption experience for consumers in the service industry.

title: ROBOTIZED HUMANOID HAND
abstract: The invention relates to a robotized humanoid hand having independently controlled motors driving the fingers. The hand can be used on its own or as part of a robot - a humanoid. It can find application in the creation of robotized structured games for the purposes of social therapy for children with development problems or for teaching the language of gestures in people with hearing disabilities. The robotized humanoid hand comprises a base (1) to which are mounted servomotors (2) which drive rollers (3) to which are connected the first ends of threads (4), which pass through holes in identical fingers (5) and the second ends of the threads are fixed to the last units (6) of the fingers. The identical fingers (5) are attached to the base (1) by means of a detachable screw connection (7) and the shape of the joints of each of the fingers has two cylindrical sections (8) and one spherical part (9) in the middle as one of the finger parts is connected to the spherical section stationary and the next one is housed in the two cylindrical sections (8) and partly in the sphere (9). An elastic flat corrugated element (10) is fixed at one of its ends stationary to the outermost section (6) of the finger (5) and its other end is stationary connected by means of the screws (9) to the base (1).

title: Anti-interference control system for biped robots
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-interference control system for biped robots, including a biped robot control system which is arranged inside an actuator. The control system contains a master controlsingle chip microcomputer. A signal filter is arranged at one end of the master control single chip microcomputer. A signal centralized transceiver is arranged at the other end of the master control single chip microcomputer. The signal filter is connected with a detector. The signal centralized transceiver is connected with an energy efficiency detection unit. A signal storage memory unit, a noise signal elimination unit and an intelligent anti-interference processor are arranged inside the master control single chip microcomputer. The intelligent anti-interference processor includes a signalamplification module. The transmission order of signals can be adjusted through a programmable digital signal processor. Therefore, the operation error of robots is greatly reduced, equipment can obtain a real low-distortion signal, and the operation stability of biped robots is greatly improved. The anti-interference control system for biped robots is a very good innovative scheme.

abstract: The invention provides a space station repair and maintenance method using a humanoid robot. title: Integrated ankle joint drive mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an integrated ankle joint drive mechanism for a humanoid robot. The integrated ankle joint drive mechanism comprises an ankle joint control unit, a shank assembly, ankle joint pitching/side-turning mechanism and detection units and a foot portion. The ankle joint control unit is connected with the ankle joint pitching/side-turning and detection units through the shank assembly. The foot portion is connected with the shank assembly and the ankle joint pitching/side-turning and detection units at the same time. The ankle joint control unit comprises a first hydraulic servovalve, a second hydraulic servo valve, a first end cover and a pressure sensor. The first hydraulic servo valve and the second hydraulic servo valve are mounted at the upper end of the first end cover. The pressure sensor is mounted at the lower end of the first end cover. The first end cover is connected with the shank assembly.

abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot having a hydraulic cylinder mechanism, which comprises: a main body part; a femoral link rotationally coupled to the main body part; a calf link coupled to be relatively moved with respect to the femoral link; a knee joint part positioned between the femoral link and the calf link; a calf link cylinder mechanism having one side connected to the femoral link and the other side connected to the calf link to allow the calf link to be relatively moved with respect to the femoral link; a fixing support part positioned on the calf link to support the calf link cylinder mechanism; a variable support part positioned on the calf link to support the calf link cylinder mechanism and capable of moving between the first support position arranged on one side of the knee joint part and a second support position arranged to be further away from the knee joint part; and a variable support part driving part moving the variable support part to the first support position or the second support position. title: Simple exoskeleton of human body
abstract: The invention discloses a simple exoskeleton of a human body. The simple exoskeleton comprises a body assembly, arm assemblies, leg assemblies, foot assemblies, connection joint assemblies, active joint assemblies, shaft joint assemblies and precise electric push rods. The left and right sides of the top end of the body assembly are connected with the arm assemblies through the connection joint assemblies. The left and right sides of the bottom end of the body assembly are connected with the leg assemblies through the connection joint assemblies. The foot assemblies are arranged below the legassemblies. The active joint assemblies, the shaft joint assemblies and the precise electric push rods are arranged at joints of all assemblies. The simple exoskeleton of the human body has the following beneficial effects: the exoskeleton has a simple structure; major joint parts are connected through flexible joint assemblies such that four limbs of the exoskeleton have a broader movement range;the human body does not feel constrained by the exoskeleton so that the human body can perform more movements; additionally, an outer push rod can freely perform telescopic motion without influence of an inner push rod when the exoskeleton is out of power; and a user does not have to take off the exoskeleton due to failure of movement.

title: Humanoid robot simulation similarity evaluation method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot simulation similarity evaluation method. The method comprises the steps that 1) the three-dimensional position information of a human skeleton node is acquired; 2) a human skeleton vector is constructed, and a human virtual joint is established according to the human skeleton vector and a robot joint structure to form a human skeleton model; 3) a link reference coordinate system based on each link of the human skeleton model is established; 4) the link skeleton vector of the human skeleton model is converted to the parent link reference coordinate system thereof; 5) the vector coordinate of each link of a robot in the parent link coordinate system thereof is calculated; and 6) the similarity between the humanoid robot and the human pose is calculated according to the skeleton vector coordinate of each link of the human skeleton model in the parent link coordinate system thereof and the vector coordinate of each link of the robot in the parent link coordinate system thereof. According to the invention, the pose similarity is quantitatively evaluated by using the vector of each link in the parent link coordinate system thereof, and the methodhas the characteristics of sufficient representation, partial emphasis and accurate evaluation.

title: Ladder data acquisition method and apparatus based on laser radar
abstract: Embodiments of the invention disclose a ladder data acquisition method and apparatus based on a laser radar, and are applied to a biped robot on which a laser radar is installed. The method includes the steps of acquiring and storing several frames of sampling data collected by a laser radar, wherein each frame of sample data includes N sampling points of the laser radar, where N is a natural number; classifying the sampling points to extract valid sampling points; and calculating ladder data according to the sampling data corresponding to the valid sampling points. title: High-flexibility and low-energy bionic tension and compression ankle joint for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-flexibility and low-energy bionic tension and compression ankle joint for a biped robot. In the high-flexibility and low-energy bionic tension and compression ankle joint, the interaction between a passive flexible member and an antagonistically-arranged active drive flexible member achieves the back extension and plantar flexion the bionic tension and compression ankle joint for the biped robot. A curved sole plate design makes the movement gait of the biped robot closer to human walking. The passive flexible member itself has preloading force and flexibility and enhances the smoothness and flexibility of the ankle joint movement during transmission movement. In addition, a three-dimensional topological structure formed by the active drive flexible member and the passive flexible member can not only maintain the stability of the ankle joint but also contribute to the transmission and management of energy. Thus, the passive flexible member, the active flexible member and a hard member constitute a bionic tension and compression structure, which contributes to improving the flexibility and energy efficiency of the biped robot.

title: Leg joint compensation angle automatic obtaining method for biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg joint compensation angle automatic obtaining method for a biped robot to stably walk. According to the method, a calculable general evaluation index for measuring the effectiveness of a leg joint compensation angle is provided, and errors among actual ZMP and planned ZMP and trunk posture errors are comprehensively considered. The biped robot walks and moves to the spot, the leg joint periodic compensation angle is automatically adjusted, and an evaluation index value corresponding to the current compensation angle is calculated; after all compensation angles within a preset compensation angle amplitude limiting range are traversed, several groups of obtained evaluation index values are compared, and the leg joint compensation angle corresponding to the minimumevaluation index value is regarded as the optimal leg joint compensation angle. By means of the leg joint compensation angle automatic obtaining method for the biped robot to stably walk, a large number of repeated walking experiments are avoided, the interference of external uncertain disturbance factors on obtaining the optimal compensation angle in a walking process is excluded, the experimentcost is lowered, the debugging time is saved, the leg joint compensation precision is improved, and finally a basis is laid for stable walking of a humanoid robot.

title: Self-adaptive stair-climbing control system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive stair-climbing control system and a self-adaptive stair-climbing control method. The self-adaptive stair-climbing control method comprises the steps of: establishing an exoskeleton or biped robot model according to lengths and overall weight of joints and connecting rods; acquiring obstacle distance information, and detecting whether an obstacle exists in the front is detected by means of an obstacle detection module; if so, detecting size information of the obstacle, and judging whether the obstacle is an obstacle that can be crossed by means of an obstacle classification module; if the obstacle is an obstacle that cannot be crossed, controlling a robot to move into a safety range through planning a motion trajectory by means of a safety judgment module; and if the obstacle is an obstacle that can be crossed, completing the crossing of the obstacle by means of the stair-climbing control module. The self-adaptive stair-climbing control system andthe self-adaptive stair-climbing control method solve the problem of identifying environments with unfixed height of stairs, improve the adaptability of the robot to the external environment, realizethe anthropomorphic gait of the robot, improve the overall intelligence of a machine, and have high transportability and stability.

title: NAO robot system based on action collection
abstract: The invention discloses an NAO robot system based on action collection. The NAO robot system based on action collection comprises an NAO robot, an action collector and a converter. The NAO robot is used for simulating and re-displaying human body actions, the action collector is used for collecting images relevant to the human body actions, and the converter converts image data collected by the action collector into control instructions for controlling the angle of a steering gear of the NAO robot and sends the instructions to the NAO robot in real time and can also store the instructions as files. The NAO robot sets the angle of the steering gear according to the control instructions sent by the converter to simulate the human body actions in the collected images. The instruction files can also be called through a voice interface to re-display the human body actions collected by the collector. The NAO robot system has the beneficial effects that non-specialized persons can rapidly andconveniently control and conducts custom setting on robot actions.

title: Robot capable of automatically controlling human face posture
abstract: The invention relates to the field of human face posture controlling of robots, and discloses a robot capable of automatically controlling the human face posture. The robot capable of automatically controlling the human face posture includes a body, a head, a rotation shaft, an orientation sensor module, a controlling center, and a rotation module, wherein the head is connected with a driving through the rotation shaft; the rotation module is connected with the rotation shaft to drive the rotation shaft to rotate; an orientation sensor is arranged on the head to sense the orientation of the human body relative to the face of the head, and transmit the sensed orientation information to the controlling center. The controlling center drives the rotation module according to the orientation information to control the rotation of the rotation shaft, and to make the face of the head face the human body. The robot capable of automatically controlling the human face posture can change the faceorientation according to the position of the face, so that the function of sheering off can be achieved, and the fact that the face turns along with sound is achieved.

title: Human body posture mapping method applied to action imitation of anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a human body posture mapping method applied to action imitation of an anthropomorphic robot. The method comprises the following steps that 1) the three-dimensional position information of notes of human skeleton series is acquired through a depth camera; 2) vectors of the human skeleton series are constructed according to the notes of the human skeleton series, virtual human joints are established according to the vectors of the human skeleton series and the robot joint structure so as to form a human skeleton model; 3) a connecting rod reference coordinate system basedon connecting rods of the human skeleton model is established; 4) the human body mapping joint angles are calculated by utilizing the human body connecting rod skeleton vectors according to the structure characteristics of robot joints; and 5) the human body mapping joint angles are applied to robot joints according to the limit of each joint angle of the robot. title: Multi-objective particle swarm algorithm-based humanoid robot gait planning method
abstract: The invention provides a multi-objective particle swarm algorithm-based humanoid robot gait planning method. The method comprises the following steps of S1, by applying a cubic spline interpolation function, generating motion tracks of hip joints and ankle joints; S2, according to the generated motion tracks of the hip joints and the ankle joints, calculating out motion situations of joints of both legs, and further calculating out a track of a zero moment point and moments of the hip joints of the both legs; S3, according to an optimized objective function and a task constraint condition, determining fitness functions of the joints of the both legs; S4, according to the fitness functions, obtaining a Pareto optimal solution set corresponding to the optimized objective function by utilizing a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm; and S5, selecting a solution as an optimal solution from the Pareto optimal solution set, and substituting the optimal solution into plannedgaits, thereby guiding a humanoid robot to walk.

title: Monitoring device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a monitoring device of a humanoid robot. abstract: The invention provides a biped walking simulation evaluation system and method of a robot based on six-degree-of-freedom legs. title: Patella impedance-changing bionic driving unit for biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of hydraulic servo control and discloses a patella impedance-changing bionic driving unit for a biped robot. The unit comprises a thigh plate, a damper, a rotation shaft, a clutch disc A, a damping rope A, a steering engine, a pawl, a ratchet, a hydraulic cylinder, a kevlar transmission belt, a clutch disc B and a nonlinear spring. The damping rope A is arrangedat the top of the damper; one end of the pawl is rotatably arranged on the thigh plate, and the other end of the pawl swings through driving of the steering engine; one end of the kevlar transmissionbelt is fixedly connected to a piston rod of the hydraulic cylinder, the other end of the kevlar transmission belt is fixedly connected to the clutch disc B, and the kevlar transmission belt is arranged at the top of the nonlinear spring. According to the patella impedance-changing bionic driving unit for the biped robot, through application of a variable damping structure, the functions of vibration reduction and kinetic energy absorption of the crus ligament to elastic impact are achieved, a variable elastic device is used for conducting torque compensation at the same time, and the torque requirement of a hydraulic elastic driver to the knee joint is met.

title: Humanoid household service robot construction method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid household service robot construction method. title: Robot foot plate structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot foot plate structure and a humanoid robot, wherein the robot foot plate structure is used for being used cooperatively with a humanoid robot main body structure and is connected to the bottom of the humanoid robot main body structure. The robot foot plate structure includes a foot plate body and a buffer mechanism which is arranged on the foot plate body and is connected with the foot plate body and the humanoid robot main body structure to buffer a load generated by the gravity of the humanoid robot main body structure applied to the robot foot plate structure during walking. The robot foot plate structure and the humanoid robot main body structure are used cooperatively. When the robot foot plate structure walks, the load generated by the gravity of the humanoid robot main body structure acts on the buffer mechanism, the buffer mechanism absorbs the impact of the load on the robot foot plate structure generated when the robot foot plate structure walksand is in touch with the ground, and thus the service life of the robot foot plate structure can be prolonged.

title: Humanoid hand finger tip slide tactile sensor
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid hand finger tip slide tactile sensor. A rubber finger tip is a hemispherical cavity; a PVDF film is attached to the outer surface of the rubber finger tip; and a sealing plug seals the rubber finger tip, and the bottom portion of the sealing plug is equipped with a liquid pressure sensor. A housing main body is in a rigid barrel structure; and the top portion of the housing main body is provided with a circular opening, and the bottom portion thereof is a flange disc structure, which is provided with four circular through holes in symmetric distribution in theform of a cross. An inner skeleton comprises a cylinder head, a vertical strain rod and a base. All sides of the strain rod close to the base are respectively attached by a strain foil. The base is provided with four round threaded through holes in symmetric distribution in the form of a cross. Connecting bolts pass through the through holes in the bottom portion of the housing and are cooperatedwith the threaded through holes in the base respectively to enable the inner skeleton to be connected with the housing. The PVDF film and the rubber finger tip, and the rubber finger tip and the inner skeleton and the housing are respectively fixedly connected through binders. The sensor can be mounted at the finger tip of a bionical artificial hand or a mechanical arm, and is used for obtaininginformation of texture, material and form and the like of an object and contact information between the finger and the contact object.

title: Automatic dust-collection robot foot relevant to beer production robot
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic dust-collection robot foot relevant to a beer production robot. The automatic dust-collection robot foot relevant to the beer production robot comprises a storagebattery, a second fan, a robot foot shell and a driven belt pulley. A rotary brush is arranged on the left side in the robot foot shell; a dust retention chamber is arranged on the right side of the robot foot shell; a control panel is embedded into a front surface of the dust retention chamber; a gravity sensor is arranged under the dust retention chamber; and a drive belt pulley is arranged in front of a servo motor. title: Optimization method of minimum acceleration trajectory of 7-DOF humanoid-arm-provided flying object in operation
abstract: The invention discloses an optimization method of a minimum acceleration trajectory of a 7-DOF humanoid-arm-provided flying object in operation. The optimization method comprises the following steps:step (S1) building a mathematic model, adopting Joint trajectories of a quartic polynomial interpolation operation process and a return process, and taking a joint angular acceleration norm minimum asa target function for algorithm optimization; step (S2) setting the running parameters of a particle swarm optimization algorithm; step (S3) running the particle swarm optimization algorithm, and obtaining a group of optimal redundant variable parameters by optimizing and minimizing the target function; and step (S4) substituting the optimal redundant variable parameter into operation action trajectory parameterization of the humanoid-arm-provided flying object to obtain the action trajectory of which the joint angular acceleration norm is minimum. The optimization method disclosed by the invention can be used for obtaining an operation action trajectory of the humanoid-arm-provided flying object, wherein the angular acceleration is continuous, and the joint angular acceleration norm is also minimum, so hidden vibration caused by an incontinuous angular acceleration trajectory in an action process of a humanoid arm, disturbance on the posture of a robot body is reduced, and the execution precision of the humanoid arm is improved.

title: Pneumatic humanoid bionic mechanical arm control system
abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic humanoid bionic mechanical arm control system. title: Walking motion planning method for biped walking robot
abstract: The invention provides a walking motion planning method for a biped walking robot. The walking motion planning method takes an omnidirectional moving trolley as a model, takes a condition that the trolley does not overturn as a dynamics constraint condition, considers the dynamics constraints in footprint transform, uses a three-dimensional linear inverted pendulum model between partial discrete footprints, generates a hip trajectory online, and obtains driving joint trajectories through inverse kinematics; and finally, the walking motion planning method adopts a multi-rigid-body dynamics model, adopts a ZMP theory to determine stability, verifies the effectiveness of the joint trajectories, optimizes parameters of the omnidirectional moving trolley and the three-dimensional linear inverted pendulum model, and finally realizes biped walking robot walking motion planning constrained by dynamics under a fast walking condition.

title: Robot head structure with tongue expression
abstract: The invention discloses a robot head structure with a tongue expression. The robot head structure comprises a head formed by a head shell, a scalp and a head fixing base. The tongue assembly comprises a tongue extensible assembly, a tongue vertical-tilting assembly and a tongue left-right-swing assembly. The mouth assembly is used for completing a mouth opening-closing action expression and/or a mouthcorner smile action expression. The eye assembly is used for completing eyeball left-right-moving action expression and/or an eyelid blinking action expression. title: METHOD FOR MODELING ROBOT SIMPLIFIED FOR STABLE WALKING CONTROL OF BIPEDAL ROBOT
abstract: A method for modeling a robot simplified for stable walking control of a bipedal robot provides a robot model that is simplified as a virtual pendulum model including a virtual body, two virtual legs connected to the body at a virtual pivot point (VPP) that is set at a position higher than the center of mass (CoM) of the body, and virtual feet connected to the two legs, respectively, to step on the ground. A ground reaction force, which acts on the two legs, acts towards the VPP, thereby providing a restoring moment with respect to the CoM such that stabilization of the posture of the body naturally occurs.

title: Novel robot-based noisy speech recognition device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a novel robot-based noisy speech recognition device and method. The device comprises a piece of Kinect equipment and a humanoid robot. The Kinect equipment is used for capturing and processing 3D lip information and visual information. The humanoid robot is used for acquiring and processing audio information and fusing a variety of strategies. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring a video source; S2, collecting lip area information through a 3D projection method, and acquiring audio information; S3, reconstructing the side lip by using 3D data, and extracting audio features; S4, fusing multiple stream features; and S5, carrying out modeling by using an HMM model, and obtaining a result.

title: Novel walking control device and method for biped robot

The method comprises the following steps: S1, the voice sensor module acquires and recognizes a voice signal and matches the voice signal with a previously-stored voice instruction and sends a specific instruction; S2, the core controller STM 32 module receives, converts and sends a corresponding instruction; S3, the steering engine controller module controls the robot to perform corresponding motions according to a received instruction; S4, the acceleration sensor module carries out an angle test ona sports robot; S5, the core controller STM 32 module collects, analyzes and processes angle testing data and sends the angle testing data to the liquid crystal display module and the steering enginecontroller module; S6, the steering engine controller module timely adjusts the running state of a steering engine according to a centric track so as to ensure that the steering engine runs smoothlyand monitors postures of the robot in a real-time manner.

title: Novel humanoid movement system of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a novel humanoid movement system of a robot. The humanoid system is composed of a human body motion capture part, a man-machine motion mapping part and a multi-joint robot part. The human body motion capture part is connected with the man-machine motion mapping part. The man-machine motion mapping part is connected with the multi-joint robot part through a wireless local area network communication manner. With the scheme, a Kinect sensor is utilized for collecting images and depth information of human body motions and obtaining human body motion information. Postures ofhuman body motions are recognized by utilizing corresponding technology in order to set up a man-machine motion mapping relationship. Ultimately, motion control is utilized for achieving humanoid movement of the robot. Therefore, the rigid requirement of a traditional robot for efficiency and precision of movement control is effectively degraded. As a result, a man-machine communication process is simpler and more natural.

title: Exoskeleton robot auxiliary device and method based on novel perception
abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot auxiliary device and method based on novel perception. The device comprises a left-leg sensor module, a right-leg sensor module, a data processing mainboard, an upper computer and an exoskeleton controller. The method comprises the following steps: S1, the left-leg sensor module and the right-leg sensor module collects data simultaneously; S2, data of included angle between knees and ankles of left and right legs is calculated according to collected data; S3, rotary angles of joints are predicted according to calculation results and predication datais sent; S4, sent left and right leg data are integrated in order to achieve time synchronization; S5, data is sent to the exoskeleton controller or the upper computer. With the scheme, sensors, a microcontroller and a wireless communication module are utilized to achieve a human gait perception system. Therefore, movement conditions of lower limb joints of human bodies in the future are predicted. Exoskeletons and movement of wearers cooperate with each other.

title: Assistant education robot for children with autism
abstract: The invention relates to the field of assistant rehabilitation of children with autism, in particular to a designing method and education content of an assistant education robot. The autism rate is higher and higher, the pathogenesis is unclear, the curative effect of drugs is not apparent, the robot assisted education can effectively alleviate the autism symptom, so that children with autism canbe better suitable for the society. A humanoid robot for assisting the education of the children with autism is designed, the assistant education robot is remotely controlled by a supervisor to send out a sound instruction and make actions, the children with the autism can imitate the action, and then the performance of the children can be evaluated. The humanoid robot is similar with the body structure of people, so that the action imitation done by the children with the autism can be facilitated. The action imitation games remotely controlled by the supervisor can effectively arouse the interest of the children with autism and can improve the communication capability of the children with autism with people. title: Robotic knee joint based on line contact magnetic attraction
abstract: The invention discloses a robotic knee joint based on line contact magnetic attraction, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The knee joint comprises an upper joint module arranged at the front end of a thighbone, lower joint modules arranged at the front ends of a fibula and a tibia, a joint fastening belt used for connecting the upper joint module and the lower joint modules, a patellarligament used for connecting the thighbone and the tibia, and a fibular lateral ligament used for simultaneously connecting the thighbone, the fibula and the tibia; the upper joint module comprises anupper joint body, an upper articular cartilage and an upper joint magnetic shaft; the lower joint module comprises a lower joint body, a lower articular cartilage and a lower joint magnetic shaft; the upper joint magnetic shaft is attracted by the lower joint magnetic shaft through magnetism, and relative rotation between the the upper joint magnetic shaft and the lower joint magnetic shaft can be achieved. The robotic knee joint based on the line contact magnetic attraction is a novel knee joint without a fixed rotation center, capable of achieving attraction through the magnetism, achievingslightly sliding at a joint position and being applied in robots.

title: Humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators and discloses a humanoid manipulator. The humanoid manipulator comprises a palm component, a first finger component and a plurality of second finger components. The first finger component and the second finger components are movably connected to the palm component through connectors, the second finger components are in abreast arrangement, and the first finger component is opposite to one of the second finger components. Each of the first finger component and the second finger components is provided with two knuckles, and each knuckle is independently driven through a driving unit. The first finger component and the second finger components are driven by the driving units to realize grasping. The humanoid manipulator is capable of realizing actions of grasping, pinching, lifting and the like to meet daily utilization requirements. Each knuckle of the manipulator is independently driven by one motor, sufficient driving force can be provided in operation of the manipulator, grasping force and bending degree of the knuckles are increased, and the grasping performance of the manipulator is improved.

title: Three-DOF (degree of freedom) flexible joint structure
abstract: The invention discloses a three-DOF (degree of freedom) flexible joint structure and belongs to the field of flexible robots. The three-DOF flexible joint structure comprises a first connector connected with a robot head, a second connector connected with a robot body, composite joint body A capable of rotating relative to the first connector, and composite joint body B capable of turning relativethe second connector; the composite joint body A and the composite joint body B can rotate relatively; each rotating portion is mounted by magnetic attraction and is provided with a deformable elastic pad that may compressively deform such that a 3-DOF joint generates minor compressive deformation when rotating, the center of rotation is changed, and joint flexibility is improved. The three-DOF flexible joint is a no-stability rotation center with three orthogonal degrees of rotation and has flexible vibration-isolating and protecting functions.

title: Dexterous hand based on myoelectric control
abstract: The invention discloses a dexterous hand based on myoelectric control. The dexterous hand has the advantages that the FPA serves as a driving core, the two bending joints ofdifferent structures are mutually combined, the electromyographic signals are introduced into a control strategy of the dexterous hand, and the dexterous hand is controlled in a myoelectric control mode, so that the motion mode of a human hand can be better simulated.

title: Leg fixing device for lower limb exoskeleton robot

The fixed end is fixed to the leg exoskeleton, the fixed end is in sliding connection with the sliding end,and the sliding end can slide relative to the fixed end in the axial direction of the leg. The rotating shell is detachably arranged on one side of the sliding end, the rotating shell can rotate relative to the sliding end in the direction perpendicular to the axial direction of the leg, the fixed shell is fixedly arranged on the other side of the sliding end, and the outer side of the fixed shell and the outer side of the rotating shell are provided with the bandages. The fixed shell, the rotating shell and the bandage coordinate to fix the leg. The fixing device has the beneficial effects of being convenient to demount and being matched with different human leg shapes better.

title: ' ' 2 omitted
abstract: One of the biggest problems in the development of a two-legged humanoid robot is not only to walk or run faster, but also to prevent the robot from easily falling down when the robot performs various asymmetric actions or external impact is applied to the robot. Until now, in order to solve the problem, we have relied on the computation of a computer that controls a servo motor installed on each joint of a robot by using a gyroscope sensor or the like. However, the robot easily falls down or it is impossible to walk or run with a big step due to the limitation of computation. In particular, the robot easily falls down when external impact is applied thereto. title: High-pressure heating process for simulated humanoid robot
abstract: Provided is a high-pressure heating process for a simulated humanoid robot. The simulated humanoid robot comprises left and arms, double legs, a front chest and a back. title: Method for controlling chest vibration amplitude of humanoid robot
abstract: Provided is a method for controlling chest vibration amplitude of a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a left chest, a right chest and a back. The method comprises the following operation steps that (A) three sets of sensors are embedded in the left chest, the right chest and the back, and correspond to the four grades of 0-3 according to different shaking degrees, and the sensor on theback serves as a reference in the detection process; (B) the robot is connected with a power supply; (C) the robot is started and powered on; (D) the sensors are initialized; (E) the chests are shaken; (F) data of the three sets of sensors are read, and the shaking grades are determined; (G) the shaking grades are compared; (H) absolute values are compared, and a sound of the corresponding area isplayed according to the maximum value; (I) the steps (E)-(H) are conducted repeatedly till stopping; and (J) the robot is shut down. The method is reasonable, a sound feedback can be provided for external touch to the chests, different voices are played according to the degree of touch intensity, and user experience is good.
