title: Deflect moment control method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a deflect moment control method of a humanoid robot, and relates to a deflect moment compensation control method, in a double-foot walking manner, of the humanoid robot. The deflect moment control method is characterized in that influence of the deflect moment on the walking stability is controlled, an optimizing equation is established by minimizing an equivalent force F<A> of the ankle joint, and a compensation offset of the ankle joint is obtained via an online iteration algorithm. title: Humanoid robot movable joint stress testing device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid robot movable joint stress testing device. In the humanoid robot movable joint stress testing device, the joint module is used for transmitting torque to drive the upper connecting rod, the lower connecting rod and the upper fixing block to move on the guide rail, and the bending and stretching movement of a humanoid robot movable joint is simulated. In the motion process, the data processing system receives signals fed back by the joint module and conducts conversion, and then stress data of the movable joint can be obtained. The whole testing device is simple in structure, high in biofidelity, accurate and reliable in testing data and easy to operate.

title: EXOSKELETON ROBOT AND CONTROLLING METHOD FOR EXOSKELETON ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a method for controlling an exoskeleton robot. The method comprises checking that a first signal is triggered by a first button, checking a tilt angle after the first signal is triggered, setting an action based on the tilt angle, and executing the action to move the exoskeleton robot. The first signal indicates to change the exoskeleton robot from a standing posture to another posture, and the tilt angle is a leaning-forward angle of a waist assembly of the exoskeleton robot relative to a line vertical to ground. The method utilizes the tilt angle to judge the intent of the user, and thus can simplify the controlling buttons to one or two buttons. Further, the controlling method also monitors the tilt angle to choose a suitable action.

title: Human body interaction robot teaching method and system
abstract: The invention provides a human body interaction robot teaching method. title: Humanoid robot ball grabbing method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot ball grabbing method. title: Humanoid dexterous hand finger based on SMA wire drive
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid dexterous hand finger based on SMA wire drive, and belongs to the field of robots. An SMA wire driver, a base joint, a near-end finger bone shell, a near-finger joint, a middle-finger bone shell, a far-finger joint and a far-end finger bone shell are sequentially and fixedly connected. Four pulley shafts are all provided with four pulleys in a rotating mode. Oneends of four of six SMA wires are connected with four drive tendon ropes through four SMA wire connecting blocks, and the other ends of the four of the six SMA wires wind across the corresponding pulleys and then are fixedly connected with an SMA wire fixing plate. The remaining two SMA wires are fixedly connected with a second base joint connecting plate of the base joint and the SMA wire fixingplate. The other ends of two of the four drive tendon ropes are fixedly connected with a near-finger joint drive chain wheel, and the other ends of the other two drive tendon ropes are fixedly connected with two base joint drive chain wheels. One ends of two coupling tendon ropes are fixedly connected with a far-finger joint coupling chain wheel. The other end of one of the coupling tendon ropes is fixedly connected with a near-finger joint coupling chain wheel, and the other end of the other coupling tendon rope is fixedly connected with a pre-tightening block. The humanoid dexterous hand finger based on SMA wire drive is used for driving robot fingers to move.

title: Biped robot and walking control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot and a walking control method thereof. The biped robot comprises a body and double legs; a gyroscope assembly is arranged in the body of the robot and comprises at least one pair of gyroscopes, a swinging motor for controlling the gyroscopes to actively deflect, and a reverse synchronizing mechanism for controlling the pairs of gyroscopes to be the same in swinging speed and opposite in swinging direction. The gyroscope assembly is used for achieving the situation that when one of the legs is lifted, the biped robot generates the gyroscope torque with thesame magnitude and the opposite direction as the gravity torque born by the biped robot, and thus the robot keeps balance. In the whole walking process, the gravity center of the robot in the left-right direction does not need to be controlled, double feet are directly controlled to forwards step and move, the control process is simplified, the control difficulty is reduced, and the walking speedis also greatly increased.

title: Linkage device suitable for controlling and limiting degree of freedom of humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention discloses a linkage device suitable for controlling and limiting the degree of freedom of humanoid robot joints. The linkage device is characterized in that a parallelogram in the two-dimensional space rotates in the three-dimensional space through spherical hinged connection, but the degree of freedom and the rotating amplitude in the three-dimensional space are limited by a self geometric structure, so that the control over the twisting and the degree of freedom of robot or mechanical exoskeleton joints is realized, and stable and reliable connection is realized. For example, when the linkage is used for controlling a hip joint, a robot main body or exoskeleton back frame 100 is connected with a hip connecting block 101, a hip first connecting rod 102 is connected with thehip connecting block 101 and a hip parallelogram structure 103 at the same time, and then the hip parallelogram structure 103 is connected to a hip 104.Through the linkage, the hip joint can rotate ina Y-axis direction, so that the robot or exoskeleton walking movement is realized. Additionally, the rotating angle of the Y axis is limited by the structure. According to the linkage device, the twisting of the robot or exoskeleton joints can be realized, additionally, the rotating degree of freedom of the joints can be limited, the stable and reliable connection is realized, and the effects ofvibration reduction and vibration isolation are achieved.

The method includes that a first NAO robot plays voice for communication; a second NAO robot acquires voice played by the first NAO robot through a channel of an equipped audio device and converting the voice to an audio file in a wav format; a terminal device connected with the second NAO robot calls Baidu voice recognition REST API to perform voice recognition on the audio file collected by the second NAO robot, performs treatment on the voice recognition result and sends the treatment result to the second NAO robot; the second NAO robot performs voice feedback on the treatment result so as to realize interaction. According to the invention, a control platform Choregraphe software ofthe NAO robot calls the Baidu voice recognition REST API to perform voice recognition on a remote server, so that voice recognition becomes more effective, quick and accurate; and conversation treatment is performed on a computer connected with the anthropomorphic robots aiming at the recognized voice, so that voice communication employing the two anthropomorphic robots is realized.

title: Robust detection and classification of body parts in a depth map
abstract: A method for processing data includes receiving a depth map of a scene containing at least a part of a body of a humanoid form. The depth map includes a matrix of pixels having respective pixel depth values. A digital processor extracts from the depth map a curvature map of the scene. The curvature map includes respective curvature values and curvature orientations of at least some of the pixels in the matrix. The depth map is segmented using the curvature values and curvature orientations in the curvature map so as to extract three-dimensional (3D) coordinates of one or more limbs of the humanoid form.

title: Method for realizing self-adaptive walking framework of anthropomorphic robot based on CPG (central pattern generator) model
abstract: The invention discloses a method for realizing a self-adaptive walking framework of an anthropomorphic robot based on a CPG (Central Pattern Generator) model. The method comprises the following stepsof firstly, enabling a CPG network to output a reasonable rhythm control signal, so as to enable the anthropomorphic robot to walk on flat ground; designing a learning module based on a neural network, wherein the learning module is used for learning and outputting an expected rhythm compensation signal to act on the output of original CPG; finally, designing the reasonable robot feedback, so as to enable the whole control framework to output the expected rhythm control signal according to environments, thereby being suitable for various ramp environments. The method has the advantages that the problem of difficulty in production of precise and diversified rhythm signals by the CPG model in the field of bionic control of robots is solved; the practicality of the CPG model in the field of robot control is improved; the important meaning is realized for the designing of the more self-adaptive anthropomorphic robot system.

title: Adaptive control method for multiple humanoid robots in case of immeasurable speed
abstract: The invention discloses an adaptive control method for multiple humanoid robots in the case of an immeasurable speed, which comprises the steps of first, building a mathematical model of the multiplehumanoid robots for cooperatively grasping an object; second, designing a state observer; and third, designing a neural network adaptive controller to control the humanoid robots. According to the invention, influences of driving saturation are eliminated through constructing an auxiliary system in allusion to a humanoid robot system with input saturation; the input of the neural network is enabled to be maintained within a bounded compact set range through introducing an obstacle Lyapunov function, and the normal running of the neural network is ensured; and the state observer is introduced to estimate the speed, the controller design is performed in the case that the speed of the object is immeasurable, and an unknown constant matrix W2 is converted into an unknown scalar virtual parameter c, so that only one adaptive parameter needs to be adjusted online, and the computational burden is greatly reduced.

title: Biped robot kinematic analysis method based on toddler gait extraction
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot kinematic analysis method based on toddler gait extraction. The method comprises the following steps: (1) walking videos of a toddler in different months are acquired, and corresponding supporting phases, oscillating phases, uniped or biped supporting phases, a gait cycle and a step frequency are extracted; (2) based on a D-H pose conversion method, a human lower limb coordinate system is built, skeletons of thighs, lower legs and soles are regarded as connecting rods, parts driving the skeletons to move are regarded as joints connecting the connecting rods, and a corresponding D-H parameter table is solved; (3) a forward kinematic model and an inverse kinematic model of the lower limb are solved; and (4) change values of joint angles are subjected tocurve fitting to analyze the spatial characteristics of a toddler walking gait. On the basis of acquiring the toddler walking data and extracting the gait time parameters, the forward kinematic modeland the inverse kinematic model of the lower limb are deduced based on the D-H pose conversion method, a toddler gait development space parameter change law is thus acquired, and a theoretical supportcan be provided for gait planning for the biped robot.

title: Waist joint of humanoid robot based on 3-RRR spherical parallel mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to a waist joint of a humanoid robot based on a 3-RRR spherical parallel mechanism. The waist joint of the humanoid robot based on the 3-RRR spherical parallel mechanism is formed by symmetrically coupling the odd number of parallel mechanism units with the same structures. Each parallel mechanism unit comprises a fixed platform, a common platform, a tail end platform, and three RRR series connection branch chains which are used for connecting each two platforms, have the same structures and are uniformly distributed along a circumferential direction. Each branch chain comprises a drive rod, a driven rod and a straight bevel gear; a movable platform of a front-stage parallel mechanism unit and a fixed platform of a back-stage parallel mechanism unit in each two adjacent parallel mechanism units share one platform; all components of each front-stage mechanism unit and all components of each back-stage mechanism unit are symmetrical regarding to the common platformat any time; and by additionally arranging a single-degree-of-freedom transmission mechanism, an angular variation of a driven rod of each front-stage mechanism unit is equivalently transformed into an angular variation of a drive rod of each back-stage mechanism unit. The waist joint of the humanoid robot based on the 3-RRR spherical parallel mechanism provided by the invention can realize multiple superposition, work space enlargement and movement flexibility, and is almost completely consistent to movement features of multi-segment linkage of a lumbar vertebra of a human body.

title: Humanoid robot-based method of recognizing object shape and color
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot-based method of recognizing an object shape and color. title: Control of robotic devices with non-constant body pitch
abstract: An example implementation involves controlling robots with non-constant body pitch and height. The implementation involves obtaining a model of the robot that represents the robot as a first point mass rigidly coupled with a second point mass along a longitudinal axis. The implementation also involves determining a state of a first pair of legs, and determining a height of the first point mass based on the model and the state of the first pair of legs. The implementation further involves determining a first amount of vertical force for at least one leg of the first pair of legs to apply along a vertical axis against a surface while the at least one leg is in contact with the surface. Additionally, the implementation involves causing the at least one leg of the first pair of legs to begin applying the amount of vertical force against the surface.

title: CONTROLLED-CLUTCH ACTUATOR DEVICE AND METHOD, IN PARTICULAR FOR ROBOTIC APPLICATIONS
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a related device for the actuation of a follower member (30) in a robotic apparatus, such as a humanoid robot, a gripping arm for industrial applications, and the like. The method envisages a clutch (20) interposed between an electric drive (10) and the follower member (30), which, in addition to allowing limiting the resistant torque (Tl) transmitted by the follower member (30) in case of sudden overloads, is also used for connecting and/or disconnecting the drive (10) and the follower member (30) to/from each other for controlled time intervals during the operation of the robotic apparatus. In this way it is possible to attain energy savings and exploit regenerative energy in order to recharge the batteries or supercapacitors associated with the apparatus.

title: DMP-based robot workspace adaptive walking control system and method
abstract: The invention relates to a DMP-based robot workspace adaptive walking control system and method. The control system comprises: a DMP centroid track generator which generates a centroid track of a humanoid robot based on DMP training according to a planning target and feedback information; a DMP foot sole track generator which generates a foot sole track of the humanoid robot based on DMP trainingaccording to the planning target and the feedback information; and a joint mapping module which performs inverse kinematic calculation on the centroid track and the foot sole track, and uses a motionengine to map the adaptability of the workspace to a joint space, so as to achieve the adaptive walking control of the humanoid robot. The DMP centroid track generator and the DMP foot sole track generator are obtained based on the example track training study of the robot working space. Compared with the prior art, the system and the method have the advantages of adjusting the gait and body posture in real time, and enhancing the environmental adaptability of the humanoid robot walking.

title: Biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot
abstract: The invention provides a biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot. The biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot comprises a first adsorption foot assembly, a waist turning joint assembly, afirst pitching joint assembly, a second pitching joint assembly, a third pitching joint assembly, a connecting rod III, a second adsorption foot assembly, a control system, a wireless module and a power supply device and can be used for detecting iron wall surfaces such as large-sized tank bodies, ship surface bodies and steel framed bridge towers. By controlling coordinated motion of each joint assembly and alternate adsorptions between the two adsorption foot assemblies and the wall surface, the circumferential motion, creeping, turnover and crossed surface transition of the robot are realized. The robot can detect the characteristics of the wall surface by using a camera and transmit images to a user. The robot can also execute different types of operations by mounting different terminal devices. The biped magnetic adsorption wall-climbing robot has the advantages of compact structure, multiple functions and crossed surface transition capacity. A solution is provided to assist people or replace people to carry out operations such as overhauling under dangerous environments such as vertical wall surfaces or high altitude wall surfaces.

The synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm comprises a supporting device and two arms which are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the supporting device, each arm comprises an upper arm, a forearm and a transmission device, each upper arm is hinged to the corresponding forearm, each transmission device comprises an upper arm sleeve connected to a human arm in a sleeving mode, a transmission shaft installed on the corresponding upper arm and a transmission mechanism installed on the corresponding forearm, each upper arm sleeve is rotatably connected with the corresponding transmission shaft, and one end of each transmission shaft is connected with the correspondingtransmission mechanism. According to the synchronous exoskeleton mechanical arm, the human arm is taken as a power source, power is transmitted to the upper arms and the forearms through the transmission shafts and the transmission mechanisms, therefore, human arc actions are synchronously completed, supporting and moving assistance is provided for a human body, few materials are consumed, and operation is easy.

title: Bullet train emergency service robot with fire detection function
abstract: The present invention discloses a bullet train emergency service robot with a fire detection function. The robot comprises a robot body and a processing terminal located in the robot body, the robot body is mainly formed by a block-shaped head portion, a block-shaped body and rod-shaped arm portions which form a human-like shape, the block-shaped body is internally provided with a fixed clamping seat configured to install each part, the bottom portion of the robot body is provided with a travel mechanism configured to drive the robot body to move, the travel mechanism is formed by a fixed pedestal, a track and a drive device, a fire detection mechanism electrically connected with the processing terminal and configured to collect fire signals are fixedly arranged at the block-shaped head portion, the processing terminal is electrically connected with an acousto-optic alarm unit configured for alarm, the fire detection mechanism sends the collected signals to the processing terminal, andthe processing terminal determines whether the fire happens or not through adoption of a neural algorithm. The bullet train emergency service robot detects various parameters of an environment to reduce misinformation and report missing probability and achieve the purpose of accurately distinguishing the fire.

title: Previewing control humanoid robot gait planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a previewing control humanoid robot gait planning method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises steps of 1) acquiring state information through a sensor assembled on a humanoid robot; 2) improving a current deep reinforcement learning network, and defining totally new states, action vectors and awarding functions; 3) using the defined action vectors to correct output of a previewing controller, calculating the angle of each steering engine of the feet of the humanoid robot and guiding the humanoid robot to walk; and 4) during walking processes of thehumanoid robot, using values of the states, the action vectors and the awarding functions to update the improved deep reinforcement learning network. According to the invention, the walking problem of the humanoid robot under a complex environment can be effectively solved; and a test is carried out on a simulation platform and a real robot to verify the validity of the method.

title: Humanoid robot system based on pneumatic muscle

The humanoid robot mainly consists of a fixed plate, a support piece, thighbone, fibula, feet, humerus, ulna and the pneumatic muscle. title: Piezoelectric-driven humanoid mechanical finger and driving method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a piezoelectric-driven humanoid mechanical finger and a driving method thereof, and relates to the field of the piezoelectric driving technique and robots. The piezoelectric-driven humanoid mechanical finger is small in size and high in humanoid degree, wherein no additional driver is required. The piezoelectric-driven humanoid mechanical finger comprises a tail-end knuckle, a middle knuckle, a base knuckle, a first clamping component and a second clamping component. The tail-end knuckle, the middle knuckle and the base knuckle are both rectangular. The left and right sides of the tail-end knuckle, the middle knuckle and the base knuckle are sequentially connected through the first clamping component and the second clamping component. After being connected together,the tail-end knuckle, the middle knuckle and the base knuckle are fixed in the horizontal direction and can rotate in the vertical direction. The upper side and the lower side of the tail-end knuckleare respectively provided with a first piezoelectric ceramic piece. The upper side and the lower side of the middle knuckle are respectively provided with a second piezoelectric ceramic piece. The upper side and the lower side of the base knuckle are respectively provided with a third piezoelectric ceramic piece. The piezoelectric-driven humanoid mechanical finger is simple and compact in structure, and easy in miniaturization. The requirement that the humanoid degree of the humanoid mechanical finger is high can be met.

title: Flexible anti-impact bionic pulled and pressed body knee joint
abstract: The invention provides a flexible anti-impact bionic pulled and pressed body knee joint, belonging to the technical field of robots. The flexible anti-impact bionic pulled and pressed body knee jointcomprises pressed bodies (the bionic femur and the bionic tibia) and pulled bodies (the bionic flexible ligaments), wherein the pulled bodies are connected with the pressed bodies, so that a bionic knee joint structure is formed; the prestrain and the material attribute of the pulled bodies are adjustable, so that various speeds and loading states of a bipedal robot can be adapted. The appearancessimulating the human skeleton curve of the bionic femur condyle and the bionic tibia condyle enable the knee joint to be capable of generating the rotation with three degrees of freedom, in the faceof the high speed or large load, the rotation in the frontal plane and the cross section can effectively alleviate the impact of the external force or the moment of force. The pulled bodies and the pressed bodies are connected to form a space three-dimensional topological structure, when disturbance of the external load is applied, the force is transmitted to the other pressed bodies and pulled bodies through the topological structure, finally, a passive self-stabilizing structure without the need of energy input is formed, the multi-dimension mechanical impedance can be resisted, the controlis simplified, and the energy consumption is reduced.

title: Motion planning of humanoid soccer robot
abstract: The invention relates to a motion planning of a humanoid soccer robot. The motion planning of the humanoid soccer robot comprises a target recognition module, a target positioning module and an omnidirectional walking method. The specific steps of the target recognition module include: reading pixel information of a template image, reading characteristic points of a template, and performing real-time image matching and object recognition. Specific steps of the target positioning module include initialization of a particle set, prediction of updating, perception of updating, positionability estimation, prediction of covariance estimation, dynamic correction, and expansion of resampling. Specifically, the omnidirectional walking method is a gait planning method based on CMAC closed loop control. In the motion planning of a humanoid soccer robot, the target recognition module analyzes and processes the images collected by the robot, extracts effective targets, uses the positionability matrix and the prediction model covariance matrix, and can improve the positioning accuracy and robustness in the dynamic environment. The motion planning of a humanoid soccer robot introduces a gait planning method based on CMAC closed loop control, on the premise that the robot is accurate in positioning, and can realize the omnidirectional walking mode with predictive control.

abstract: A convenient-to-mount type self-locking bionic mechanical leg with autonomous distributed power comprises a thigh, a shank and a foot and is further provided with a connecting frame, self-locking joints, a power battery pack and a control device. title: Three-joint bionic mechanical leg capable of being assembled conveniently with autonomous distribution power

title: Layered CPG and application of layered CPG in walking control of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to layered CPG and application of the layered CPG in walking control of a humanoid robot. The layered CPG is passively motivated by an external sensing information to generate amotion time sequence signal loaded with a motion mode, the layered CPG comprises a rhythm generator layer and a pattern generator layer, different sensing information are transmitted to a corresponding layer through different feedback paths, the rhythm generator layer generates a fundamental rhythm signal according to the sensing information, and the pattern generator layer generates a motion mode control signal according to the sensing information; the application of the layered CPG in walking control of the humanoid robot is as follows, a center of gravity trajectory and a foot sole trajectory are planned in the working space of the robot; a double-leg time sequence signal loaded with the motion mode are output through the layered CPG, and a mass center track and a foot sole track are modulated; and inverse kinematics calculation is carried out on the modulated working space, and the adaptability of the working space is mapped to a joint space by utilizing a motion engine. Comparedwith the prior art, the layered CPG and application of the layered CPG in walking control of the humanoid robot has the advantages of being high in regulation and control instantaneity, low in engineering complexity and the like.

title: Biped walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped walking robot. The biped walking robot comprises a quadrilateral frame. A power transmission mechanism is arranged in the quadrilateral frame. A power output shaft of a rotating motor is fixedly connected with a fourth belt pulley. The fourth belt pulley is connected with a third belt pulley through a belt, wherein the third belt pulley is fixedly connected to an intermediate rotary shaft. Two second belt pulleys are coaxially and fixedly connected to the intermediate rotary shaft and arranged on the two sides ofthe third belt pulley. Each connecting board is rotationally connected with a vertically-arranged supporting board. The bottom end of each supporting board is fixedly connected with a supporting foot.The rotating motor is connected with a PLC connected with an automatic obstacle avoidance module, a voice broadcasting module and a wireless control module. The biped walking robot is simple in structure, convenient to use and low in manufacturing cost, whether a front road is smooth or not can be judged through the automatic obstacle avoidance module in the moving process, then voice broadcasting is conducted, and people can remotely control the robot.

title: Taiji push hand robot based on depth camera
abstract: The invention provides a Taiji push hand robot based on a depth camera. The Taiji push hand robot comprises a humanoid robot body, the depth camera, an inertial navigation module, an upper computer and an embedded controller. The four limbs and the trunk of the humanoid robot body are provided with a plurality of rotation devices, and the rotation devices are provided with steering engines for controlling the rotation angle. The depth camera is used for collecting the human body skeleton graph and transmitting information to the robot body through the upper computer. The inertial navigation module is used for collecting the human body fine action and actions hard to recognize. The embedded controller processes data of the inertial navigation module. A depth camera sensor can be used for collecting the human body action information and transmitting the human body action information to the humanoid robot body, and the humanoid robot body makes the proper response. The inertial navigationmodule collects the pose of human body arms, the recognition accuracy of the human body complex action is improved, and the intelligent action of Taiji push hands is achieved. The Taiji push hand robot based on the depth camera is provided, and a path is provided for a Taiji fan to practice the Taiji.

title: Double-arm motion planning method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm motion planning method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps that according to a kinematic model of a left arm and a right arm of the humanoid robot, forward kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly, and on the basis of the forward kinematic equations, inverse kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; according to the inverse kinematic equations, the quadratic programming problem expressions of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; and then quadratic programming indexes of the left arm and the right arm are combined with a constraint to obtain a standard quadratic programming problem expression of the humanoid robot; three motion planning judgment methods of the humanoid robot are set according to the standard quadratic programming problem expression; and thethree motion planning judgment methods are combined to resolve the standard quadratic programming problem expression, and the optimal solution is output. According to the method, the left arm and theright arm of the humanoid robot which can be controlled is well completed; and the double-arm motion planning method of the humanoid robot has the characteristics of being clear in mind, strong in logicality, simple and clear, effective, and the like.

title: Posture decision dynamic planning method
abstract: The invention discloses a posture decision dynamic planning method. The method comprises the following steps that firstly, a model is established, forward kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly; then model analysis is carried out, inverse kinematic equations of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot is written correspondingly, and quadratic programming problem expressions of the left arm and the right arm of the humanoid robot are written correspondingly according to the inverse kinematic equations; and then the quadratic programming indexes of the left arm and the right arm are combined with a constraint to obtain a standard quadratic programming problem expression of the humanoid robot; then based on the standard quadratic programming problem expression, the posture decision dynamic equation is designed and the posture decision dynamic planning method is established; and finally, a solver is designed to perform resolving on the posture decision dynamic planning method. According to the method, compared with a traditional method, the posture decision dynamic planning method can well complete the postureplanning and the control of the double-arm of the humanoid robot, and higher control precision is achieved.

title: Device and control method for improving balance and walking speed of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a device and control method for improving balance and walking speed of a biped robot. Most biped robots are controlled by using a ZMP(such as ASIMO in Japan). However, the biped robots controlled by the ZMP have the disadvantages that soles are large in size and the walking speed is slow. The device and control method for improving the balance and the walking speed of the biped robot fully utilizes the advantages of the ZMP and overcomes the disadvantages as much as possible. The device for improving the balance and the walking speed of the biped robot mainly comprisesa mechanical structure and a controller. For the existing biped robots, it is only necessary to replace original feet with the device for improving the balance and the walking speed of the biped robot, and it is not necessary to modify remaining structural parts, so higher practicability is achieved in real life. The mechanical structure of the soles dynamically adjusts the center of gravity of the biped robot under the action of the controller, so that the biped robot has good balance in motion and the motion speed of the biped robot is obviously improved. The biped robot adopting the deviceand control method for improving the balance and the walking speed of the biped robot can be widely applied in the fields of industry, rescue, family, medical care and like.

title: Flexible humanoid mechanical finger
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible humanoid mechanical finger. The flexible humanoid mechanical finger comprises a body and an attached body, wherein the body consists of a plurality of finger jointsand a plurality of finger rods; the finger joints and the finger rods are alternatively arranged in a spaced mode in the length direction; comb-like or bow-like continuous sealing gas cavities and airvents which communicate with an external drive gas source are arranged inside the finger joints of the body; the finger rod parts of the body are equipped with gasbags; high-pressure gas is pre-filled into the gasbags through one-way vent valves; a layered substance which cannot extend is arranged inside the attached body; and during work, the drive gas source charges gas or discharges gas for the sealed gas cavities inside the body, so that the body bends and extends under limit of the attached body. According to the flexible humanoid mechanical finger disclosed by the invention, the fingerjoints and the finger rods are arranged in the spaced mode, and high-pressure gas is pre-charged into the gasbags of the finger rods for partially stiffening the finger rods, so that finger movement of human can be simulated to a great extent, and therefore, quick grabbing for objects of different shapes and different sizes can be adapted.

title: Interaction robot
abstract: The invention discloses an interaction robot. A head is vertically and movably arranged at the upper end of a body; a transparent plate, coaxial with a shell, is arranged on the side wall of the shell; a rotating shaft capable of rotating is arranged between an upper shaft base and a lower shaft base; the side wall of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with at least one extension rod perpendicular to the rotating shaft; the end, far from the rotating shaft, of the extension rod is fixedly connected with a camera; the shooting direction of the camera is towards the transparent plate; a microphone array is arranged at the bottom of the outer wall of the shell, and is electrically connected with a voice processing module arranged in the shell; the voice processing module identifies a voice output position according to voice information strength obtained by the microphone array; and a 3D motion sensing camera for capturing user limb actions is arranged on the outer wall of the shell.The interaction robot can point by 360 degrees, can widen the viewing angle, and identifies user voice and limbs to improve the interaction experience.

title: Humanoid robot based on air cylinders
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on air cylinders. The humanoid robot is used for driving the movement of hip joints, knee joints, ankle joints, waist joints, shoulder joints, elbow joints and wrist joints of the robot and has the function of completely simulating the movement of human. The humanoid robot mainly comprises humeri, ulnae, thigh fixing parts, the air cylinders, shank fixing parts, waist joint connecting parts, feet, bevel gears, bearings, connecting plates, supporting plates and connecting shafts, the air cylinders of the lower limb knee joints, the ankle joints, the upper limb elbow joints and the wrist joints are combined in a plurality of modes to drive the joints to achieve the bending and stretching, folding and unfolding and annular rotating functions, thehip joints have the bending and stretching movement functions, the rotating air cylinders drive the bevel gears to mesh so that the shoulder joints can achieve the annular rotating movement function,the air cylinders of the waist joints drive the joints to achieve the front-and-back and left-and-right swinging, bending and stretching, folding and unfolding and annular rotating functions, and meanwhile, upper limbs and lower limbs are driven to swing front and back and swing left and right. The humanoid robot is driven by the air cylinders and has the advantages of being compact in structure,clean, good in anti-explosion performance and capable of being used for teaching, explosive ordnance disposal and exhibition.

title: Robot motion control system and method based on learnable central pattern generators
abstract: The invention discloses a robot motion control system and method based on learnable central pattern generators. The robot motion control system based on the learnable central pattern generators comprises a robot; the robot comprises a left hip joint, a right hip joint, a left knee joint, a right knee joint, a left ankle joint and a right ankle joint; a corresponding steering engine is arranged onthe internal side of each joint; each steering engine is driven by a control signal generated by the corresponding learnable central pattern generator; each learnable central pattern generator performs training by using history motion data of the corresponding joint; after the training is finished, each learnable central pattern generator is arranged on the controller; each learnable central pattern generator outputs a corresponding control signal according to an input signal; the controller transmits the control signal output by each learnable central pattern generator to the steering engineso as to drive the steering engine of each joint; and therefore, the motion of the robot is controlled.

title: Control method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a control method for a humanoid robot. The control method comprises the following steps that step 1, whole body joint motion data characteristics of the humanoid robot are extracted by using principal component analysis, and dimension reduction processing is carried out on the data; step 2, an action model of the robot is established in low-dimensional space through Gaussian process dynamic model; and step 3, the humanoid robot is controlled to move through the action model of the robot. By adopting the Gaussian process dynamic model to directly learn actions of the robot and effectively establishing the action model, the problem that the dimension of the action data of the robot is too high can be effectively solved, the actions of the robot can be effectively learned and trained through dimension reduction processing, and the characteristics of the robot action in low-dimensional space are shown.

title: ROBOT PROVIDED WITH SOFT OUTER SKIN
abstract: A robot according to an embodiment of the present invention is provided with a flexible outer skin 314 which is provided so as to cover a first part (such as a head) and a second part (such as a body). The outer skin 314 includes a stretchable base material 520. Stretchability improving regions 550-554 are provided between (a head contact region 550 and a stomach contact region 552, and the head contact region 550 and a back contact region 554) regions of the base material 520 which are respectively in contact with the first part and the second part. The stretchability improving regions have a higher stretchability than the contact regions.

title: Guest greeting robot small arm control device
abstract: The invention relates to a guest greeting robot small arm control device. The guest greeting robot small arm control device comprises a body and a head, wherein the head is mounted on the body. The left side and the right side of the body are each fixedly provided with a large arm. A small arm is hinged to the front end of each large arm. The middle and the upper end of each small arm are providedwith a protruding block and a palm correspondingly. A motor is mounted in the middle of the body and connected with a straight gear. The straight gear is engaged with an outer gear ring. A round roller is fixedly mounted on the inner side wall of the outer gear ring. The left end and the right end of the body are each provided with an inclined face. A transmission rod bracket is in abutting fit with the eccentric position of each inclined face. The guest greeting robot small arm control device is high in intelligentization level; the two transmission rod brackets are driven by rotation of theround roller to maintain opposite reciprocating type sliding, and furthermore, the two palms can be driven to maintain waving continuously in opposite gestures; the effect that hand waving for greeting is conducted in a highly-human-simulating manner is achieved; and the good greeting effect is achieved.

title: Elderly care service robot
abstract: The invention relates to an elderly care service robot. The elderly care service robot is of a human-like structure composed of a robot head, a robot body, robot arms, robot legs and robot feet. The robot head is provided with a wireless communication module, colored cameras, a loudspeaker and microphones. A voice interaction module is arranged inside the robot head. The robot body is provided with a power switch, infrared sensors, a main control panel, a touch display screen, a charging interface and a data storage socket. A third-party sensor interface is arranged at the end of each robot arm. An air quality sensor and a temperature and humidity sensor are arranged on the robot legs. Rolling wheels are mounted at the bottoms of the robot feet. The robot feet are each provided with an anti-collision and anti-falling sensor. The elderly care service robot helps in tracing the daily life of an old person, detecting basic health information of the old person and transmitting informationof the old person to children through the website; and the children can know about the condition of the old person, and aid is provided under emergency.

title: Biped robot and slope angle measurement method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot and a slope angle measurement method. The method comprises steps that original data corresponding to each scanning point collected by a radar device is acquired,n sets of quantized data are generated for each frame of the original data, each set of the quantized data includes values of a first variable, a second variable and a third variable, the value of thefirst variable is equal to the distance between the current scanning point and the radar device, the value of the second variable is equal to the inclination angle of the current scanning point relative to the radar device, and the value of the third variable is equal to the vertical distance between the current scanning point and the radar device; according to the n sets of quantified data, whenthe biped robot is determined to be in an uphill state, the n sets of quantized data are sorted, and largest m sets of data through sorting are extracted from the n sets of quantized data; the inclination angle of the slope where the biped robot is located is calculated according to the largest m sets of data. Compared with the prior art, the method is advantaged in that the road surface situation of the biped robot can be efficiently identified in real time.

title: Device for metering running mileage of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a device for metering the running mileage of a biped robot. title: Robot leg
abstract: The invention discloses a robot leg, which aims at solving the problems that the existing heavy-loaded large-scale six-foot robot generally uses a hydraulic cylinder for driving, and the obstacle passing capability of the six-foot robot is limited. The robot leg comprises a blade type swinging hydraulic motor, a robot calf, a robot thigh and a robot base section, wherein the blade type swinging hydraulic rotor comprises a motor casing, a first hydraulic oil inlet and outlet opening, a second hydraulic oil inlet and outlet opening, a flange installing hole and two output shafts. title: Integrated hydraulic system robot leg
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated hydraulic system robot leg to solve the problems that an existing six-feet robot commonly adopts motor driving, and therefore twisting moment is low, bearing capacity is low, and during traditional transmission hydraulic system driving, the weight of the machine body is high, and load can be increased. The integrated hydraulic system robot leg comprises a shank, a thigh, a base pitch and an integrated hydraulic system. Two ends of the thigh are correspondingly hinged to the shank and the base pitch. A buffering piece is arranged at the lower end of the shank. Through the integrated hydraulic system, independent high-accurate leg control of the robot can be conducted, and a heavy oil tank in a traditional hydraulic system can be effectively omitted based on the improved structure, and therefore load of the legs of the robot can be alleviated, and load bearing capacity is improved. The problem of high torque requirements needed by high load bearing is effectively solved. The robot body is lighter, the beating capacity is improved, and accurate robot leg control is achieved. The concept is ingenious, the design is reasonable, the structure is simple, and high application value is achieved.

title: Three-layer distributed control system for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a three-layer distributed control system for a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The system comprises an interaction decision-making layer, a motion planning layer and a hardware driver layer; the interaction decision-making layer for man-machine interaction sends a control instruction to the motion planning layer, the motion planning layer receives and parses the control instruction sent by the interaction decision-making layer and issues the control instruction to the hardware driver layer, and the hardware driver layer receives the control instruction of the motion planning layer, collects hardware data and transmits the hardware data to the motion planning layer. The three layers of the three-layer distributed control system run on two computers and a driver chip respectively and cooperate with one another without mutual dependence. The three layers of the system are independently implemented and are low in coupling degree andconvenient to develop; ambient environment data can be collected in real time to control the robot to make corresponding actions, there is no need to make a lot of programming preparation, and the system efficiency is greatly improved to some extent.

abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a method, device and system for self-adaption balance control of a humanoid robot in a complex terrain. The method comprises the following steps of establishing a connecting rod model of a robot; calculating a corresponding foothold; adjusting the joint angle value of the robot; monitoring the mass center curve of the robot, receiving gyroscope sensor data, and judging whether the robot is in a balanced state; receiving a joint angle feedback value and the gyroscope sensor data when the robot is in an unbalanced state, and optimizing and adjusting the foot movement curve of the robot; enabling the robot to be self-adaptively subjected to balance control in the movement process; optimizing the joint angle value and relevant parameters of the robot. The robot can be applied to movement balance control of biped and quadruped robots and the like, the application range is wide, the self-adaptive capacity of the robot to an application environment can be greatly enhanced, and the hardware loss can be effectively reduced in the actual application process.

title: Human body rotating and displacement mapping method applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a human body rotating and displacement mapping method applied to a humanoid robot. The human body rotating and displacement mapping method comprises the following steps that (1) three-dimensional position information of skeletal joints of a human body is obtained through a depth camera; (2) the skeletal vector from a left hip to a right hip is constructed according to the skeletal joints of the human body; (3) the constructed skeletal vector is projected to the horizontal plane; (4) the rotating angle and direction of the human body are calculated according to the skeletal vector projected to the horizontal plane; (5) the displacement in a human body base coordinate system is calculated according to skeletal joints at the bottom of a spine and the skeletal vector projected to the horizontal plane; and (6) the calculated rotating angle and direction and the calculated displacement in the human body base coordinate system are applied to the humanoid robot. According to the human body rotating and displacement mapping method, human body rotating and displacement are mapped to the humanoid robot through the skeletal joints of the human body and the skeletal vector, and the human body rotating and displacement mapping method has the characteristics of easy and convenient operation and high real-time performance.

title: Self-adaptive stable equilibrium control method, self-adaptive stable equilibrium control system and biped humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a self-adaptive stable equilibrium control method, a self-adaptive stable equilibrium control system and a biped humanoid robot capable of being equilibrated adaptively and stably. The self-adaptive stable equilibrium control method includes the following steps: (1) establishing a state space model of the biped humanoid robot, =A*X+B*U, wherein Y=C*X, X is a state functionof the biped humanoid robot, Y is an output function, U is an input function, A is a state matrix, B is a coefficient matrix of the input function, and C is a coefficient matrix of the output function; (2) determining an optimal control algorithm, wherein the state model of the biped humanoid robot can be converted into =(A-BK)X, the selection of the controller parameter K shall allow the characteristic value of the matrix (A-BK) to meet the set conditions, and state convergence and stable equilibrium of the biped humanoid robot can be realized. The biped humanoid robot is equilibrated adaptively by the self-adaptive stable equilibrium control system according to the self-adaptive stable equilibrium control method. The biped humanoid robot comprising the self-adaptive stable equilibrium control system can achieve stable equilibrium by itself.

title: Robot head movement mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a robot head movement mechanism. title: Humanoid shoulder joint system based on rope
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid shoulder joint system based on a rope. A motor and the rope are adopted to simulate muscles of a human body to drive a shoulder joint to move, and the function of completely simulating human body shoulder joint movement is achieved. A humanoid shoulder joint is mainly composed of a shoulder blade, a humerus, an ulna, a supraspinatus, a teres minor, an infraspinatus, a deltoid, a latissimus dorsi, a triceps brachii, a coracoid brachialis, a biceps brachii, a motor and a rope guider. The supraspinatus, the teres minor, the infraspinatus,the deltoid, the latissimus dorsi, the triceps brachii and the coracoid brachialis jointly drive the humerus to do bending, stretching, adduction, abduction and circumduction motion around the shoulder blade, and the tricepsbrachii and the biceps brachii drive the humerus to do bending, stretching, adduction, abduction and circumduction motion around the shoulder blade together with the supraspinatus, the teres minor, the infraspinatus, the deltoid, the latissimus dorsi, the triceps brachii and the coracoid brachialis while driving the ulna to do bending, stretching, adduction and abduction motion around the humerus. abstract: The invention discloses a gait planning method for a biped robot based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method utilizes the stability and flexibility of human gait and combines deep reinforcement learning to effectively control the gait of the biped robot. The method includes the following steps: 1), establishing a passive biped robot model; 2), acquiring and processing human gait data andtarget gait data; 3), extracting the implicit features of the gait data of the biped robot and human gait data through using a noise reduction auto-encoder; 4), learning the gait characteristics of ahuman body through using deep reinforcement learning, and then planning the gait of the biped robot. The method combines deep reinforcement learning with human gait data to control the biped robot towalk as stable and compliant as a human.

title: ROBOTS WITH DYNAMICALLY CONTROLLED POSITION OF CENTER OF MASS
abstract: Dynamic control of a center of mass position is based on replacement of discrete motion of macro body (counterweighing solid or counterbalancing mechanisms) for continuous molecular flow of counterweighing liquid. Redistributing liquid counterweight between chambers attached to independently moving parts of robot allows its motion to new stable position without disruption in static stability and dynamic balance. Various embodiments include bipods/humanoids, wheeled locomotion robots and hybrid wheeled/multi-pod bio-like robotic systems; some embodiments allow reversible mutual reconfiguration between various structural arrangements. In humanoid embodiments, method allows moving on uneven terrain or ascending staircases while maintaining static stability; method also decreases the probability of fall and secures self-rising if a fall occurred. In some embodiments liquid counterweight may be transferred upon high barriers exceeding the height of robot by a few folds, such as walls of the building or ledge or steep slope in mountains, thus providing robots with capability principally not available to prior art.

title: Biped robot design containing waist structure and feedback control method
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot design containing a waist structure and a feedback control method. title: SMA-based facial expression bionic mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the field of bionic robots, in particular to an SMA-based facial expression bionic mechanism. The biomimetic mechanism comprises an eye mechanism, an eyebrow mechanism, an eyelid mechanism, a mouth mechanism and a cheek mechanism. The mouth mechanism is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a lower connecting plate through a mouth supporting plate of the mouth mechanism. The lower connecting plate is fixedly connected with the lower surface of an upper connecting plate. The eye mechanism is connected with the upper surface of the upper connecting plate through eye bearing supports of the eye mechanism. Eyes of the eye mechanism move left and right on the horizontal plane and move up and down on the vertical plane. Compared with traditional motor driven modes,shape memory alloy springs are used as driving components, so that the whole structure is simpler and lighter; and the multiple mechanisms are adopted for combination motion to complete basic facialexpressions, thus, each mechanism can be independently designed, the overall structure is rapid and simple to implement and convenient to install.

title: Method for generating robot anthropomorphic fuzzy emotion
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a robot anthropomorphic fuzzy emotion generation method. A method for generating humanoid fuzzy emotion of robot comprises the follow steps: step 1, defining a set of emotion factors; 2, numeralizing emotional factors; 3, performing linear sequencing; 4, constructing a multi-dimensional array space of emotional factors; 5, collecting the emotion factor value in real time and calculating the current emotion range according to the emotion factor data; 6, performing convolution operation and obtaining a numerical value, and generating fuzzy emotion according to the numerical value definition. The invention simulates the basic process of human emotion generation through the design, so that the emotion generation of the robot is unpredictable and linear, accords with the cognitive understanding of the human emotion, and enables the robot to have more natural emotion expression.

title: Chess playing method based on humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a chess playing method based on a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. title: Method for phonetic summon intelligent home health-care robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for voice calling intelligent home health-care robot, wherein an RGB-D camera is installed on the upper body of the robot; a plurality of voice sensors are mounted onthe head; The method comprises: getting RGB-D camera depth image and color image; identifying whether there is human contour in depth image and color image of the RGB-D camera; obtaining the center position of the human contour relative to the RGB-D camera position relation; the position of human contour center in map coordinate system being calculated; publishing the position of the human body contour center in the map coordinate system to a robot navigation module, wherein the navigation module judges whether the position is valid, navigates to the point if the position is valid, searches anoptimal path to navigate the point in the navigation process, and exits the voice sensor calling state when the robot reaches the navigation point; If not, the navigation is judged to be unsuccessfuland a voice sensor call is made again. The invention does not need the aid of a third-party device for calling, and is convenient to operate and carry. The robot can be summoned to the user accurately, and the positioning accuracy is high.

title: A hip joint mechanism for walking robot
abstract: A hip joint mechanism for walking robot comprises a frame, a thigh rod and a rotating mechanism, wherein one end of the thigh rod is articulated with the frame, one end of the rotating mechanism is connected with the frame, and the other end of the rotating mechanism is articulated with the middle part of the thigh rod. The technical effect of the invention is that: the invention provides a two-degree-of-freedom rotary joint mechanism, which converts a planar two-degree-of-freedom mechanism into a two-degree-of-freedom rotary output, so that the machine frame has larger range of motion and flexibility, and better rigidity and dynamic performance. The driving device sequentially drives the thigh rod to move through the driving rod, the driving rod and the thigh connecting rod, so that the torque is large and the load capacity is strong. As that drive part such as the electric motor and the like are arranged on the machine frame in the application, the mechanism doe not act as a moving load, the inertia of the mechanism is small, the moving speed is fast, and the dynamic response is good.

title: Method for evaluating posture similarity between humanoid robot and human body
abstract: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the posture similarity between a humanoid robot and a human body, which comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring three-dimensional position information of a human body skeleton node through a depth camera; (2) a connecting rod vector of human skeleton model being constructed according to human skeleton node; (3) transforming the coordinates of the connecting rod vectors of the human skeleton model in the coordinate system of the depth camera into the coordinate system of the human observation; 4) calculating that coordinates of the link vector of the humanoid robot in the observation coordinate system of the robot according to the joint angles of the humanoid robot and the posture of the supporting feet; (5) according to the coordinates of the human skeleton model connecting rod vector in the human observation coordinate system and the coordinates of the humanoid robot connecting rod vector in the robot observation coordinate system,the similarity between the humanoid robot and the human body being calculated. The invention utilizes the vector quantization of the human skeleton model and the humanoid robot connecting rod in the world coordinate system to evaluate the posture similarity, and has the characteristics of sufficient representation, focusing on the whole and accurate evaluation.

title: Hybrid reality interactive system based on passive tactile feedback
abstract: The present invention provides a low cost solution for a hybrid reality interaction system with passive haptic feedback, using a humanoid robot as the trunk of virtual human, using realistic facial models to create virtual images, and the virtual image is superposed on the head of the humanoid robot accurately. The virtual image enhances the facial details of the humanoid robot, enhances the appearance of the robot, and interacts with the user by such a virtual and real image. Compared with the virtual image of the trunk-less human, the virtual image provides the user with passive tactile force feedback, greatly enhances the reality of the virtual human, and enhances the interactive experience of the virtual human system. At the same time, compared with the virtual human 'U-Tsu-Shi-O-Mi' with power feedback, the invention does not use the special hardware tracking device, uses the tracking mode based on three-dimensional marker points to track the position of the registered virtual image, and utilizes the RGB camera to realize the fusion of the virtual image and the real image, thus saving the tracking cost.

title: Kinematics joint simulation method of one-leg multi-axis biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a single-leg multi-axis biped robot kinematics joint simulation method. The method comprises the following steps: S1, a single-leg multi-degree-of-freedom biped mechanism modelis constructed in Matlab; S2, a single-leg multi-degree-of-freedom biped mechanism model is constructed in Matlab; S2, on the basis of the simulation module sl_rrmc2 of the six-degree-of-freedom single manipulator puma560, two Simulink simulation modules corresponding to the left and right legs are designed according to the characteristics of the biped legs; S3, the biped mechanism model established in the step S1 and the Simulink simulation module developed in the step S2 are interacted to realize the kinematics joint simulation of walking. title: Human body posture following-based robot control and demonstration method
abstract: The invention discloses a human body posture following-based robot control and demonstration method, which comprises the following steps: marking a serial number for each joint of a robot, recording arobot balance posture, a robot joint angle and the serial numbers of the moving joints of the robot after the joints of the robot move, calculating positions of the gravity center of the robot underthe various postures, classifying the postures according to the number of the moving joints, building a database comprising the postures of the robot, information of the moving joints of the robot andthe positions of the gravity center of the robot, acquiring position information of joint points of a human body in an image by building a network model to complete acquisition of posture informationof the human body, acquiring an optimal matching angle from the database by using an angle matching model and combining a path search method, outputting the optimal matching angle serving as a corresponding human body action posture, converting the optimal matching angle into a robot control instruction, and sending the robot control instruction to the robot to realize motion control and demonstration of the robot. title: Robust control method of dynamic biped walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robust control method aiming at gait optimization control of a dynamic biped walking robot, and specifically relates to a robust control method of the dynamic biped walkingrobot. Aiming at a dynamic biped walking robot optimal robust control problem, in combination of a fast exponential stability control Lyapunov function and hybrid zero dynamics, a kind of projection Dai-Yuan equality constraint optimization algorithm with sufficient descent characteristics is provided through full consideration of a control torque saturation condition. In the method, a numerical simulation experiment is executed for a 3-bar dynamic biped walking robot model with nonlinear, under-actuated and pulse mixed characteristics, a numerical result shows that an optimal robust controller solved by the projection Dai-Yuan equality constraint optimization algorithm still can realize high-efficiency and steady walking gait of the dynamic biped walking robot although parameters of a dynamical model of the dynamic biped walking robot are perturbed trebly. The method provided by the invention improves stability and robustness of dynamic walking of the dynamic biped robot.

title: Humanoid robot route planning method and device
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot route planning method and device. The method comprises the following steps: sequencing evaluation function values at different dots of a target grid map in a list to be retrieved in route planning, and taking a dot corresponding to a smallest evaluation function value as a present dot; according to coordinates of adjacent dots and preset final dots, acquiring connecting lines of the adjacent dots and the preset final dots; if a connecting line has no preset obstacle dot, taking the connecting line as a first section route between the adjacent dots and the preset final dots, and taking the first section route and a second section route acquired on the basis of an A* algorithm in advance as a total route from a preset start dot to the preset final dot.Through overall judgment on the target grid map, the confirmed connecting line is adopted as the route from adjacent dots to the preset final dots directly, and thus the route planning efficiency canbe greatly improved.

title: Biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and a robot. The biped robot climbing stair gait planning method comprises the steps that in the stair climbing process, a variable-length first-order inverted pendulum model is adopted to carry out trajectory planning on a forward gait, the motion trajectory of an ankle joint is constrained according to preset constraint conditions, and a first-order linear inverted pendulum model is adopted to carry out trajectory planning on a lateral gait to realize stair climbing of a biped robot; the process is that whenfacing the first stair, the center of gravity of a body is controlled to move to the left; a right foot of a swing leg is lifted to drop the right foot onto the stair; the center of gravity of the body is moved to the right foot, and the left foot of the swing leg is lifted so that the left foot falls onto the stair; the steps are repeated until the first stair is the last stair; whether the center of gravity falls within a stable region or not is judged; if yes, the walking is finished; and if not, the two legs are controlled to close and return to the starting state. Based on the biped robot climbing stair gait planning method and device and a robot, an effective application of a robot walking mode can be realized, so that the robot can walk on the stairs as freely as a human.

abstract: The invention relates to a rotating theater system for robot performance, which specifically refers to a theater and equipment therein for humanoid and bionic robots to perform stage performance by combining scene equipment. Meanwhile, the rotating theater can also combine auxiliary equipment in the theater toimprove the viewing experience and the operation efficiency of the flow, thereby being a complete set of robot performance theater system.

title: Humanoid intelligent controlled obstacle avoidance control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid intelligent controlled obstacle avoidance control method based on reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: S1, judging the distance from anobstacle to the vehicle, and determining the relation between the distance d and the safety distance S when the obstacle appears in the sensing area in front of the vehicle; if d < S, the vehicle cannot realize effective obstacle avoidance and would stop; if d >= S, and a relative speed exists between the vehicle and the obstacle, performing obstacle avoidance; if d >= S, and the relative speed is zero, the vehicle travels on the original route; S2, obstacle avoidance learning of the vehicle: calculating the turning radius and the accelerated speed of the vehicle when performing obstacle avoidance; S3, autonomous obstacle avoidance of the vehicle: after online learning of the vehicle, calling a driving experience to perform an autonomous obstacle avoidance by utilizing a memory function.For roads of various conditions, the obstacle avoidance control method provided by the invention has a relatively high obstacle avoidance rate, a good practicability and a good development potential.

title: METHOD FOR THE EDUCATION OF ANTHROPOID ROBOTS
abstract: Novelty: method for the electronic programming of anthropoid robots via auto-visual paradigms established by specialized operators having no special knowledge in robot programming is disclosed. title: SERIES ELASTIC LINEAR ACTUATOR
abstract: To provide a series elastic linear actuator which can be specifically applied to a field such as a humanoid robot and a rehabilitation support mechanism.SOLUTION: A series elastic linear actuator A includes: a liner driving mechanism 1A; a power output member 2A; and an elastic member 3A. The liner driving mechanism 1A comprises: a stepping motor 10A; a screw rod member 12A; and a linearly moving member 13A. The screw rod member is communicated with the stepping motor, and the linearly moving member is provided at the stepping motor side so as to be connected with the screw rod member, and performs linear reciprocating-motion along a power input direction by the driving of the screw rod member. The power output member 2A is installed on one side of an axial direction in the linearly moving member, and performs the liner reciprocating-motion along a power output direction matching the power input direction. title: Foot-type robot anti-disturbance balancing device and a control method thereof

title: Biped walking robot without using degree of freedom of roll direction and its biped walking method
abstract: The present invention relates to a bipedal walking robot capable of performing a stable bipedal walking without using degrees of freedom of a roll direction during the bipedal walking of a robot having degrees of freedom of multi-joint, and a bipedal walking method thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the bipedal walking robot comprises: at least left and right pitch joint units forming left and right legs of the robot with left/right symmetricity, and having degrees of freedom of a pitch direction; left and right foot housings connected to the lowermost pitch joint unit among the pitch joint units in the left and right legs of the robot, and coming in contact with the ground; left and right roll joint replacing members installed in the left and right foot housings, respectively, and protruding to the inside of the left and right foot housings by a control signal; and a control unit to control operation of the left and right pitch joint units, and the left and right roll joint replacing member for bipedal walking of the robot. During the bipedal walking of the robot, the control unit controls the operation of the pitch joint unit of the left and right legs of the robot, and at the same time, controls the operation of the right and left roll joint replacing member corresponding to the operation of the pitch joint unit.

title: End actuator
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an end actuator. The end actuator comprises a main body mechanism, an actuator body, a drive device and a cooling device. The main body mechanism is movably connected with the actuator body. The drive device is arranged in the main body mechanism and connected with the actuator body. The cooling device is arranged on the periphery of the drive device and used for cooling the drive device. The drive device comprises at least one shape memory alloy (SMA) driver. According to the end actuator, the SMA driver is adopted to take the place of a micro motor toserve as a core power component, the cost of a humanoid hand is greatly reduced, noiseless driving can be achieved, and the requirement of an inpatient ward needing silence is met. Due to the fact that a screw type heat dissipation water pipe is arranged outside the SMA driver to be used in cooperation with a cooling fan and heat dissipation fins, the purpose of rapid cooling is achieved throughcirculation of condensate, and therefore the operation frequency of the SMA driver is greatly increased; and the end actuator can be flexibly and noiselessly used in the executing process.

title: Routing inspection robot control method based on human-computer coordination system
abstract: The invention discloses a routing inspection robot control method based on a human-computer coordination system. The control method comprises task-level control and instruction-level control, and themethod comprises the following specific steps that a user performs task description to the robot system at the task level, and the target state of the robot system is obtained based on the task description amount through an inference mechanism; the current characteristic parameters of the robot are obtained from the target state, and the current characteristic parameters serve as target instructions to be stored in the background; and at the instruction level, the user performs automatic planning on a task executing process according to a feedback result in the task level planning, and the system judges user planning rationality on the background and gives out a prompt and recommended task path. According to the method, human planning and decision-making capability is combined with autonomous planning of a humanoid robot, so that the robot has the capability of adapting to environment change; and by virtue of combined use of the task-level parameters and instruction-level parameters, the movement track of the robot is more accurate, and the completion of the intelligent task is more accurate and reliable.

title: Buffering and stability improving humanoid robot foot mechanism
abstract: The invention provides a buffering and stability improving humanoid robot foot mechanism. title: Hydraulic drive robot hip joint cantilever structure
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic drive robot hip joint cantilever structure, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The structure comprises servo hydraulic cylinders, a robot waist, hydraulic rods, hip joints, thigh shells, shank shells and foot shells, the upper ends of the servo hydraulic cylinders are fixed to the robot waist, and the lower ends of the servo hydraulic cylinders are connected with the hydraulic rods; the hydraulic rods are connected with the hip joints, the hip joints are connected with the thigh shells, the thigh shells are connected with the shank shells, and theshank shells are connected with the foot shells. By means of the cantilever structure, linear driving of the hydraulic servo cylinders is converted into rotation of the hip joints, and the flexibility of the hip joints is improved. Meanwhile, the cantilever structure also greatly improves the lateral swing range of legs, and the lateral stepping capability and external disturbance resistance of the robots are improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a robot gait planning method based on individual characteristics.
