title: AUTOMATIC BALANCING FOOT STRESS DEVICE FOR INTELLIGENT ROBOT
abstract: An automatic balancing foot stress device for an intelligent robot, comprising an ankle (1) and a sole (2). Foot plates (3) are connected to two sides of the sole; a foot plate connecting shaft (4) is embedded in one end of each foot plate; the middle of each foot plate is tightly welded to a support rod (5); the support rod is fixedly connected to one end of a support rod connecting block (6), and the other end of the support rod connecting block is tightly welded to one end of each of sub support rods (7); the other end of each sub support rod is fixedly connected to one side of a slide block (9); the top of the slide block is tightly welded to the bottom ends of main springs (10); and the top ends of the main springs are tightly welded to the upper end of the inner portion of the ankle. When the robot tilts, one end of the foot plate is pressed; the pressure enables, by means of the support rod and the support rod connecting block, the sub support rod to push the slide block to move upwards so that the main springs are pushed to compress upwards; moreover, the springs have shock absorbing and damping functions, so that the turnover speed of the foot plate is decreased, and the smoothness is improved.
abstract_en: An automatic balancing foot stress device for an intelligent robot, comprising an ankle (1) and a sole (2). Foot plates (3) are connected to two sides of the sole; a foot plate connecting shaft (4) is embedded in one end of each foot plate; the middle of each foot plate is tightly welded to a support rod (5); the support rod is fixedly connected to one end of a support rod connecting block (6), and the other end of the support rod connecting block is tightly welded to one end of each of sub support rods (7); the other end of each sub support rod is fixedly connected to one side of a slide block (9); the top of the slide block is tightly welded to the bottom ends of main springs (10); and the top ends of the main springs are tightly welded to the upper end of the inner portion of the ankle. When the robot tilts, one end of the foot plate is pressed; the pressure enables, by means of the support rod and the support rod connecting block, the sub support rod to push the slide block to move upwards so that the main springs are pushed to compress upwards; moreover, the springs have shock absorbing and damping functions, so that the turnover speed of the foot plate is decreased, and the smoothness is improved.

title: Anti-falling biped bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-falling biped bionic robot. By the arrangement of a driving motor, when the height of a robot body changes, the barycenter of the robot body is deflected, a main conical gear is driven to rotate by the driving motor through a rotary shaft, a threaded column is driven to rotate by the main conicalgear through a driven conical gear, a threaded connecting rod is driven to move left and right by the threaded column, a hinged installing column is driven to rotate by the threaded connecting rod, telescopic springs are arranged, so that auxiliary supporting rods always fit the ground to achieve the effect of adjusting the supporting angles of the auxiliary supporting rods according to the position of the barycenter, and the purpose of falling preventing is achieved.

title: MOBILE ROBOT AND METHOD FOR PERFORMING A RUNNING/WALKING MOVEMENT
abstract: The invention relates to a mobile robot, which is suitable for performing running/walking movements known from nature and comprises two leg assemblies, each having a leg (02) and a trunk part (01). The upper leg segment (03) is mounted in a trunk joint on the trunk part (01) and can be swung relative to the trunk part (01) in a running/walking direction by means of a leg swing drive (08, 09, 11). title: Multi-DOF trunk mechanism for biped robots
abstract: The invention belongs to the relative technical field of machine body structure, and discloses a multi-DOF trunk mechanism for biped robots. The trunk mechanism includes an upper part, a pelvis, hip component and two hip pitch directional drive assemblies. The pelvis and the hip component are connected with the upper part. The two hip pitch directional drive assemblies are connected with the pelvis and the hip component. The upper part and the hip pitch directional drive assemblies are driven by an oil cylinder. The pelvis and the hip component are driven by a motor. The upper part achieves bending forward and backward, rolling left and right and the movement in vertical direction through three oil cylinders. The pelvis, the hip component are matched with the hip pitch directional drive assemblies to achieve the movement of the pelvis and the hip component of the robots in yaw direction, roll direction and pitch direction. The multi-DOF trunk mechanism for the biped robots improves therate of space utilization, and is simple in structure and good in sports performance.

title: Miniature six-dimensional force/torque sensor
abstract: The invention relates to a miniature six-dimensional force/torque sensor, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent control. The miniature six-dimensional force/torque sensor structurally comprises a double-Z-shaped arc surface elastomer and a signal processing circuit. The elastomer is formed by connecting two Z-shaped thin-wall beam structures in series, and the middle of the elastomer is a contact force area. Compared with other cylindrical elastomer structures, the structure is designed to be an arch-shaped thin-wall structure and is easy to install on the outer surface of a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanism, for example, finger joints of humanoid dexterous robotic hand fingers, and the sensor can serve as a part of a finger joint body structure.

title: Optimization method of hierarchical kicking optimization model of humanoid robot based on Gaussian punishment
abstract: The invention discloses an optimization method of a hierarchical kicking optimization model of a humanoid robot based on Gaussian punishment. The optimization method comprises the steps that kicking seed motions of the humanoid robot is designed based on keyframe method; a hierarchical kicking training model of the humanoid robot is built, and single kicking motions of the humanoid robot is decomposed into a presetting number of optimization layers by adopting optimization decomposition; an optimal parameter set of hierarchical kicking optimization model of the humanoid robot is obtained by adopting an assignment algorithm; in the process of optimizing of the optimization layers of the kicking speed and distance of the humanoid robot and on the basis of linear evaluation and optimization of the kicking speed of the humanoid robot, and the kicking distance can be optimized by Gaussian punishment. According to the optimization method of the hierarchical kicking optimization model of thehumanoid robot based on Gaussian punishment, the offset of the kicking motions in the process of kicking of the humanoid robot is smaller, and the accuracy and the steadily of kicking are effectivelyimproved.

title: HUMAN ASSISTIVE DEVICE COMPRISING A SENSING MODULE CAPABLE OF REDUCING NOISE
abstract: A sensing module (4, 4', 4') is disclosed in the present invention and includes a body attaching member (40, 40'), a base module (41, 41'), a transmission member (42, 42') and a first sensor (43). The body attaching member (40, 40') is attached to a human limb and disposed on the base module (41, 41'). The transmission member (42, 42') is coupled to and moved with the body attaching member (40, 40'). The first sensor (43) is disposed on a side of the body attaching member (40, 40') and separate from the body attaching member (40, 40'). When the body attaching member (40, 40') is driven to move along a direction by the human limb, the body attaching member (40, 40') drives the transmission member (42, 42') to activate the first sensor (43) to generate a first signal (α1). Since the first sensor (43) is separate from the human limb, the first sensor (43) is not affected by muscle swelling and skin friction during movement. Accordingly, the actuating module (44) is able to drive an exoskeleton member more precisely.

title: Leg joint driving mechanism for foot-type walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg joint driving mechanism for a foot-type walking robot. The leg joint driving mechanism is characterized by mainly comprising a left pull arm (1), a left motor (3), a first push-and-pull soft shaft (4), a first soft shaft support (5), a mechanism body frame (6), a second soft shaft support (7), a first soft shaft mandrel (8), thighs (9), middle leg joints (10), middlelegs (11), a second push-and-pull soft shaft (12), a third push-and-pull soft shaft (13), shanks (14), a second soft shaft mandrel (15), shank joints (16), a right pull arm (17), a right motor (19) and a fourth soft shaft support (20). title: Computing method for transient response of flexible humanoid manipulator finger frictional collision
abstract: The invention discloses a computing method for transient response of flexible humanoid manipulator finger frictional collision. The computing method is characterized in that inertial fields and displacement fields of a flexible humanoid manipulator finger are discretized by an absolute node coordinate method, a kinetic equation at a non-contact stage is obtained by a Boolean matrix and lagrangianmultiplier method, a kinetic equation at a frictional collision stage is obtained by combining an event-driven method with a local flexible contact model, and the corresponding kinetic equation is solved by utilizing a generalized alpha method. The computing method solves the description problem for large-range motion and large structural deformation of the flexible humanoid manipulator finger, and also solves the problem that current analysing and computing efficiency for flexible humanoid manipulator finger frictional collision is low.

abstract: The invention discloses an eyeball control structure applied to a bionic robot. The eyeball control structure comprises an upper eyelid, an upper eyelid pull rod, a lower eyelid and a lower eyelid pull rod, wherein the upper eyelid pull rod is arranged at one side of the upper eyelid; the lower eyelid is arranged under the upper eyelid; one side of the lower eyelid is equipped with the lower eyelid pull rod; an eyeball is arranged on the lower eyelid; one side of the eyeball is equipped with a rotary connecting head; one side of the rotary connecting head is equipped with a supporting framework; an eyelid steering engine is arranged on the supporting framework; a steering engine lifting lever is arranged on the eyelid steering engine; a universal ball head is arranged on the steering engine lifting lever; and an eyeball steering engine is arranged on the supporting framework. The eyeball control structure has the beneficial effects that: firstly, the device is simple and compact in structure, the whole control device is small in size, and the device can be completely suitable for a mechanism which is as big as a simulated person; and secondly, through transmission of the mechanicalstructure, up-down and horizontal rotation of a simulated eyeball and rotation of upper and lower eyelids are realized, so that the simulating effect is very high.

title: Humanoid robot falling-over detection and stability control method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot falling-over detection and stability control method. The humanoid robot falling-over detection and stability control method comprises the steps of 1, calculating a ZMP expected track, formed in the moving process, of a humanoid robot, measuring a ZMP actual track, and calculating the error between the ZMP expected track and the ZMP actual track; 2, calculating an expected body posture, formed in the moving process, of the humanoid robot, measuring an actual body posture, formed in the moving process, of the humanoid robot, and calculating the error between the expected body posture and the actual body posture; and 3, setting a ZMP track error threshold value of the humanoid robot as D1, a threshold value formed when the body posture of the humanoid robot topples forwards as D2 and a threshold value formed when the body posture of the humanoid robot topples backwards as D3, and judging the current stable state of the robot through the set threshold value range. According to the humanoid robot falling-over detection and stability control method, stable states of the robot are rapidly classified into the stable state, the anti-disturbance state,the falling-over state and the like, and the robot can select corresponding movement control strategies according to the different stable states; and the environment adaption capacity of the humanoidrobot is enhanced.

title: Humanoid robot and walking acceleration compensation method and device thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a walking acceleration compensation method and device thereof. The method comprises that when the humanoid rod in a single-leg supporting state, angular accelerations of different joints are calculated according to angular velocity of the same, and a six-dimension acceleration of the centroid of a connecting rod in an absolute world coordinate system iscalculated according to the angular velocities, the angular accelerations as well as a Jacobian matrix of the joints relative to a landing point; moments needed by the angular acceleration of each joint of the humanoid robot is calculated according to the six-dimensional acceleration; and a feedforward current value corresponding to the moment is determined according to preset correspondence; andthe feedforward current value is added to a control signal of the corresponding joint, so that the humanoid robot is controlled accorded to the control signal after addition. Thus, influence of the acceleration can be inhibited effectively, the rigidity of a PID controller is reduced, and the whole humanoid robot is more stable.

title: Biped robot impedance control method and device
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot impedance control method and device, and relates to the technical field of design of impedance control methods. The method includes the steps of modifying the hitting force borne by landing legs of a biped robot through a natural attenuation function so as to serve as the input of impedance control, obtaining an impedance model of the biped robot, determining an impedance control transmission function according to the impedance model, calculating the impedance control output mode according to the input of impedance control and the impedance control transmission function, and modifying the external force input in the impedance control through the natural attenuation function. The aim of adjusting the impedance control over the two legs of the robot is realized, then it is avoided that the robot deformation caused by the impedance control influences the balance the robot during walking, and the walking process of the robot is more stable and natural.

title: Waterproof humanoid robot with projection and drainage structure
abstract: The invention relates to a waterproof humanoid robot with a projection and drainage structure. The waterproof humanoid robot comprises a head, a body and a base which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; a groove is formed in the top of the head; an antenna is fixed in the groove; a first drainage groove of a closed structure is arranged in the groove; the edge of front projection of theantenna from top to bottom is overlapped with the first drainage groove; and the first drainage groove is used for draining water falling into the groove to the outside of the groove. The groove is convenient for accommodation and fixing of the antenna. Water flowing from the top of the antenna to the groove and the water directly falling into the groove can be drained away through the first drainage groove. Thus, water accumulation is effectively prevented, and the drainage function of the waterproof humanoid robot is improved.

title: Hydraulic biped robot without external power source
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic biped robot without an external power source. The hydraulic biped robot comprises a small-scale hydraulic power station, a hip platform, an oil division group, a left leg and a right leg. The small-scale hydraulic power station is integrated to the hydraulic biped robot, so that the robot is not restricted during the outdoor activities, the advantages of the hydraulic biped robot can be well realized during the field operation; an experiment verification result shows that the pump station is capable of supply sufficient pressure to the normal walking of therobot, the robot can work for 30 minutes under a full-loading condition and can meet the demands on the basic debugging and operation; meanwhile, hydraulic oil of the small-scale hydraulic power station is mainly in a pipeline of the pump station, an oil storage mechanism is mainly used for injecting hydraulic oil, and only a small amount of hydraulic oil is stored, so that the volume and mass ofthe pump station are relatively small, and the pump station can be conveniently integrated to the biped robot. Besides, after the pump station is integrated to the robot, a complete closed-loop systemis formed, and the situation that the robot is disturbed by an external pump station connecting pipeline during the operation can be avoided.

title: Mechanical legs of football shooting robot
abstract: The invention discloses mechanical legs of a football shooting robot. Each of the mechanical legs comprises a thigh part and a shank part, wherein the thigh part comprises a first thigh, a second thigh, a third thigh and a support chassis; the support chassis can be installed on a walking carrier in front and back translation through a lead screw nut mechanism; the first thigh is installed on thesupport chassis through a first joint; the second thigh is installed on the front end of the first thigh through a first telescopic device; the third thigh is installed on the front end of the secondthigh through a second joint; the shank part includes a shank bracket and a foot; the shank bracket is installed on the front end of the third thigh through a third joint; the foot is mounted at the bottom of the shank bracket through a movement joint; the second joint and the third joint are pitch joints which adjust a pitch angle of the shank part; the angle and azimuth adjustment of the shank part is completed through the first joint, the second joint, the third joint and the first telescopic device. The mechanical legs of the football shooting robot can simulate actions of human legs so that playing football becomes possible through the robot.

title: Active fault tolerant control method of active biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an active fault tolerant control method of an active biped robot. There exists no biped robot control system which can always work perfectly, the safety performance of the robot and more reliable control are added under systematic faults to stabilize the faults and maintain the performance of the robot, which becomes a key point. The method is characterized in that the method is a model based on a fault detection and isolation technology, a constraint Kalman filter (linear system state equation) is utilized to perform optimal estimation on the state of the system through systematically input and output observation data, effective factors of a fault executing device-sensor are estimated under the situation that there exist interference and random noise in systematicobserving data, and a controller which can be reconstructed is designed by combining a singular value decomposition (SVD) principal and an eigenstructure assignment technology. The method is applied to the active fault tolerant control method of the active biped robot.

title: Bionic foot mechanism of robot and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic foot mechanism of a robot and a biped robot. The technical scheme is that the bionic foot mechanism comprises a forefoot and a back foot which are separated from each other; a buffering assembly is arranged between the forefoot and the back foot; and one side of thebuffering assembly is connected with the forefoot by a first link mechanism, and the other side of the buffering assembly is connected with the back foot by a second link mechanism, wherein a piston mechanism for controlling a walking amplitude is mounted between the forefoot and the first link mechanism.

title: Robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot. title: Children habit culture method and system and intelligent robot

title: Robustness test system for joints of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robustness test system for joints of a humanoid robot. According to the robustness test system disclosed by the invention, a humanoid joint is loaded by using cylinders as power elements, and the robustness test system has the function of completely testing the robustness of the joints of the humanoid robot. The robustness test system for the joints of the humanoid robotmainly consists of cylinders, a bracket, a humanoid joint, pressure sensors, tension sensors, displacement sensors and connecting pieces, wherein through the movement displacement or the magnitude ofoutput force of the cylinders which are arranged up and down are independently or simultaneously controlled, so that loading of various complex shapes can be realized. The robustness test system disclosed by the invention is driven by the cylinder, has the characteristics of being simple and compact in structure, capable of performing multi-direction loading, and convenient to perform quantitativeanalysis, and can be used for performing robustness test on mechanisms which need to perform multi-direction quantitative analysis, including humanoid joints, robots and others.

title: Humanoid robot expression recognition method based on dense convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot expression recognition method based on a dense convolutional neural network. The method comprises the steps of positioning a face position in a single frame image according to a directional gradient histogram feature and a support vector machine algorithm, and matching the face reference points of the face image by using the regression tree set, correctingand recording the face image according to a matching result, identifying the corrected face image by using the dense convolutional neural network, obtaining expression classification according to an identification result, and transmitting an expression classification result to the humanoid robot. The technical scheme provided by the invention is based on face positioning and face correction. The dense convolutional neural network is used to combine the flow of face feature extraction and expression classification so as to realize the expression recognition of the face, and finally the classification result is provided for the humanoid robot in real time, so that the effect of human-computer interaction is achieved, the accuracy is ensured, the real-time performance is high, and the safetyof pedestrians is effectively ensured.

title: Flexible humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible humanoid manipulator. title: Seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm based on improved flexible cable transmission
abstract: The invention relates to a seven-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, in particular to a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm based on improved flexible cable transmission. The seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm comprises a motor box, a big arm, a small arm and a dexterous hand, wherein shells are arranged outside the big arm and the small arm. The shape and degree-of-freedomlayout of the mechanical arm are similar to that of a human arm, and seven degrees of freedom are available. In particular, one ends of two steel wire ropes are fixed to a driving wheel II 28, the twosteel wire ropes pass through force bearing hoses, and the other ends of the two steel wire ropes are fixed to a driven wheel II 30 or a driven wheel III 33, so that a transmission relation is formed. The transmission is applied to the mechanical arm. The limitation of the space to a tail joint is broken through improved flexible cable transmission, a driving motor can be arranged in the back, and a multi-joint series-connection system is lighter. The seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm has the advantages of being simple in structure, flexible in layout and low in cost.

title: Multi-rate sampling coordination control method for rigid humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-rate sampling coordination control method for a rigid humanoid manipulator. The multi-rate sampling coordination control method for the rigid humanoid manipulator comprises the following steps of building a humanoid manipulator motion system, and using a neutral II type T-S fuzzy method to establish a non-linear dynamic system of the rigid humanoid manipulator. Considering that sampling speeds of humanoid manipulator fingers are different, a response speed of a drive motor of each humanoid manipulator fingers is different from the corresponding sampling speed,and sampling information of adjacent sampling time sequences does not have obvious changes, unnecessary calculation is caused to cause waste of hardware resources. A multi-rate sampling event triggering fuzzy controller is designed aiming to the three problems, so that coordinated grabbing of the humanoid manipulator fingers and stable work are realized. The invention designs a rigid humanoid manipulator structure design and the multi-rate sampling coordination control method, the method takes the three real working conditions into consideration, the designed multi-rate sampling event triggering fuzzy controller enables the humanoid manipulator motion system to realize stable work, and the rigid humanoid manipulator structure design and the multi-rate sampling coordination control method have a wide market application prospect.

title: Small biped robot driven by brushless direct current motor and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a small biped robot driven by brushless direct current motors and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of biped robot devices. The robot includes a machine frame, two drive devices are arranged on the machine frame, and a controller used for controlling the drive devices is arranged between the two drive devices. Each drive device includes two long connection rods, one ends of the two long connection rods are connected through a fixed screw, and the other ends of the two long connection rods are connected with one ends of short connection rods through fixed bolts respectively. The other end of each short connection rod is connected with the corresponding brushless direct current motor, and the outer end face of each brushless direct current motor is fixedly provided with a motor driver, and a connection rod is arranged between the two brushless direct current motors. The robot has the advantages of being simple in structure, high in integration degree and convenient to install and saves the cost.

title: Wearable Manned Robot Having Sound Effect Operating function with Motion Link
abstract: Disclosed is a wearable inducing robot including: an outer cover unit having a humanlike shape and including a boarding space formed therein and a door part formed on a side to open the boarding space; a frame unit supporting the shape and forming the boarding space in the outer cover unit, and having at least one part connected to the outer cover unit to control motion; an opening and closing control unit installed on the frame unit, and having at least one part connected to the door part to selectively control the opening and closing of the door part; at least one lower sensing unit installed in the lower part of the outer cover unit to sense whether a contact surface and the floor touch or not through a step; and a control unit installed on the outer cover unit, and outputting at least one sound effect set in response to an electric signal delivered from the lower sensing unit. According to the present invention, the wearable inducing robot is capable of enabling users to enjoy an entertaining component outputting a sound corresponding to a motion.

title: Humanoid biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid biped robot. The humanoid biped robot comprises thigh structures and two-degree-of-freedom quasi-man hip joint structures, wherein each thigh structure comprises a lightweight knee joint having large torque output, and each hip joint structure has large torque output. The lightweight knee joints are designed in the thigh structures, alternating-current servo electric push rods are designed and mounted in the thigh structures, large-torque-output single-degree-of-freedom movement of the lightweight knee joints is realized through transmission of crank-link mechanisms, the mass, centroid and rotational inertia of the thigh structures can be adjusted through adjustment of thigh counterweight units, and corresponding artificial shanks can be selected to be connected with the knee joints of the thigh structures according to experiment needs; the two-degree-of-freedom movement of the hip joint structures is realized through large-torque alternating-currentservo motors, the synchronous belt drive and parallel two-degree-of-freedom structures, and counterweights can be added to the hip joint structures to adjust the mass, centroid and rotational inertiaof the humanoid biped robot. The humanoid biped robot can be applied to relevant human gait research, detection and development of electromechanical lower limb products, and the like.

title: Biped robot gait stability control method based on inertial navigation system
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait stability control method based on an inertial navigation system, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. A biped robot is a hydraulic biped robot and comprises a body, thighs and shanks. The body and the thighs are controlled by hydraulic cylinders, and the thighs and the shanks are controlled by hydraulic cylinders. Motion of joints and legsis controlled through the elongation of hydraulic cylinder shafts. The inertial navigation system is arranged in the body of the robot and is horizontally placed on the waist of the body of the robotand used for collecting posture data of the robot, the posture of the robot is adjusted through data fed back by the inertial navigation system so as to keep the upper body of the body upright, gaitstability of the robot is ensured, and the robot is prevented from toppling over. The biped robot gait stability control method is based on a position control strategy of body posture information, andthe body posture information comprises the pitching angle, the roll angle and the course angle. The method is used for avoiding defects in the prior art so as to provide a simplified control processand improve the walking speed.

title: A system for realizing autonomous aesthetic understanding and judgment of dance postures of a robot
abstract: The invention relates to a system for realizing autonomous aesthetic understanding and judgment of dance postures of a robot, wherein the system comprises a visual signal capturing module used for capturing dance posture mirror images of the robot; a visual perception module used for primary processing of visual elements, a neural processing decision module used for processing unified representation of aesthetic objects, accumulating aesthetic experience and carrying out aesthetic judgment, and a behavior extension module used for reporting or applying aesthetic judgment results. title: Magnetic attraction walking robot used for vacuum pipeline inspection and maintenance
abstract: A magnetic attraction walking robot used for vacuum pipeline inspection and maintenance comprises pipelines supported on pipe piers, rails are arranged in the pipelines, vehicles are arranged on the rails, isolation doors are arranged in the pipelines, shelter waiting rooms are arranged on the side walls of the pipelines, and the inside and outside of each pipe are inspected and maintained by morethan one robot. The pipelines are ferromagnetic pipelines or composite structure pipelines, the robots are humanoid robots, two soles of each robot are provided with electromagnets, and under the action of electromagnetic attraction, the robots can stand on the outer walls of the pipelines or the inner wall surfaces of the pipelines. The electromagnets on the two soles of each robot can be alternately electrified and powered down, so that the robot can walk step by step like a human being, bend over or extend arms to carry out various inspection and maintenance operations, and at the same time, the robot can stand on the side or stand upside down of the pipeline wall, which cannot be done by a natural person. The vacuum pipelines can be inspected and maintained efficiently, rapidly and conveniently through the robots in a time and labor saving manner.

abstract: The utility model discloses a self-stabilizing device of a walking type robot. The device comprises a base and a guide rail, a weight box is mounted at the top of the base through screws; wherein theweight box is installed in the middle of the top of the base, a plurality of weight grooves are formed in the weight box, a left wing plate, a reinforcing plate and a right wing plate are arranged onthe lower surface of the base, the reinforcing plate is arranged between the left wing plate and the right wing plate, and the reinforcing plate, the left wing plate and the right wing plate are parallel to one another. According to the utility model, the weight box is divided into a plurality of weight grooves; the weight ratio can be adjusted according to the actual condition of the robot; The weight box is made of metal, the weight box is high in quality stability and simple in overall structure, the gravity center of the biped walking robot can be adjusted through a simple structure, stable walking of the robot is guaranteed accordingly, the position of the reinforcing plate can be adjusted through the guide rail, the gravity center of the robot can be adjusted in the left-right direction, and the practicability is high.

title: Joint of biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a joint of a biped robot. wherein the upper arm and the lower arm are used for connecting the biped robot; the joint comprises: a joint body; the device comprises a joint bracket (1), a gas spring (2), a reduction gearbox (3), an encoder (4) and a motor (5), wherein the air spring is fixedly connected with one side of the joint bracket; the reduction gearbox (3), the encoder (4) and the motor (5) are fixedly connected with the other side of the joint support, and a rotating shaft of the air spring is fixedly connected with the lower arm, so that the air spring is used for storing and releasing energy, and a basis is provided for the biped robot to learn the walking characteristics of human beings, especially for efficient utilization of energy and natural motioncontrol.

title: Head and neck structure for guest greeting robot in science and technology museum
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot. The head and neck structure is used for a guest greeting robot in a science and technology museum. The utility model aims to solve the problems that the head andneck postures of the guest greeting robot in the science and technology museum are stiff; the mouth opening and closing actions cannot be realized. The head and neck structure comprises a main frame,an occlusion mechanism, a head and neck mechanism and a controller. The main frame comprises a human body infrared induction module, a main supporting plate and an auxiliary supporting plate. The meshing mechanism comprises a first steering engine, a first steering engine support, a transmission mechanism, a plastic package steel wire rope, a jaw component, a pull rope guide connector and a rotating shaft. The head and neck structure comprises a double-shaft steering engine, a first metal steering wheel, a second steering engine support, a main support, a second steering engine, a third steering engine support, a double-shaft steering engine support and a second metal steering wheel. and the controller is in control connection with the main frame, the occlusion mechanism and the head and neck mechanism. According to the utility model, vivid mouth opening and closing actions and humanoid head swinging (pitching and rotating) actions can be realized.

title: Electric linear driving device and humanoid robot joint driving mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to an electric linear driving device and a humanoid robot joint driving mechanism. According to the main technical scheme, the electric linear driving device comprises a motor, a push rod assembly, a magnetic part and a Hall device. The push rod assembly comprises a push rod and a transmission mechanism; wherein the motor is in driving connection with the transmission mechanism, and the transmission mechanism is in driving connection with the push rod so as to convert rotary motion of the motor into linear motion of the push rod; the magnetic part is connected with the motor and rotates along with a rotor shaft of the motor; the Hall device sleeves the magnetic part, and a set gap exists between the Hall device and the magnetic part; the Hall device feeds back thenumber of revolutions of the motor by sensing the change of the magnetic field of the magnetic part. The utility model provides an electric linear driving device adopting a Hall device as position feedback, so that a controller can accurately control the position, the speed and the acceleration of a push rod, and the electric linear driving device can be applied to a large humanoid robot joint driving technology.

title: Humanoid tea frying robot
abstract: The utility model provides an anthropomorphic tea frying robot. The tea frying machine comprises a control cabinet, a tea frying main body device, a frying pan arranged below the tea frying main bodydevice and a fixing frame used for fixing the tea frying main body device, wherein the tea frying main body device comprises a shoulder part and mechanical arms arranged at the two ends of the shoulder part respectively, the tail end of each mechanical arm is provided with a gripper used for frying tea, the grippers are arranged in the frying pan, and the shoulder part is provided with an image acquisition device used for acquiring images of the frying pan; a first driving device used for controlling the shoulder part to rotate is arranged at the joint of the shoulder part and the fixing frame, and the first driving device is controlled by the control cabinet. The humanoid tea frying robot imitates a human fixation process in a tea frying fixation process, so that tea leaves can be uniformly heated, mechanical damage of the tea leaves in the fixation process is avoided, and the quality of the tea leaves is improved.

title: Mechanical arm joint for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a mechanical arm joint for a humanoid robot. The mechanical arm joint comprises an encoder fixing base (1), a motor (2), a motor fixing base (3), a coupler (4), a damper (5), a transmission connecting shaft (6), a damper fixing base (7), a fixing frame (8), a transmission rotating shaft (9), a rotating plate (10), an inductor (11) and a mechanical limiter (12). The mechanical limiter and the sensor are arranged on the joint, the sensor is used for sensing the moving range of the mechanical arm, when the rotating angle of the mechanical arm exceeds the rated range, the mechanical limiter can stop the rotating plate from continuously rotating, and therefore it is guaranteed that rotation of the mechanical arm is kept within the rated range; and by arranging the damper, the return difference of the mechanical arm is reduced, and the control precision is improved.

title: Humanoid finger mechanism and humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid finger mechanism and a humanoid manipulator, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The humanoid finger mechanism comprises a plurality of finger joints and a traction mechanism, every two adjacent finger joints are rotationally connected through a rotating structure, and a limiting element is arranged in each rotating structure. One of adjacent knuckles is provided with a first rotating part; according to the humanoid finger mechanism, the first rotating part and the second rotating part are matched to form a rotating structure, and the traction mechanism is in transmission connection with the finger joints to drive the adjacent finger joints to rotate, so that the whole humanoid finger mechanism is simple and compact in structure, high in profiling precision and low in control difficulty. Besides, a limiting element is arranged in the rotating structure, so that the rotating angle between every two adjacent finger joints can be limited, and the accuracy of the humanoid finger mechanism during operation can be improved.

title: KINEMATIC JOINT BLOCK, ROBOT CAPABLE OF EXPRESSING EMOTIONS, AND METHOD FOR CONTROLLING SAME
abstract: A kinematic joint block for constructing a robot, a robot capable of expressing emotions, and a method for controlling the robot are disclosed. The kinematic joint block includes a base (201) and a ball joint. The ball joint includes three joint units. The first joint unit (202) of the ball joint is mounted on the base (201) having a degree of freedom of rotation in the first direction. The second joint unit (203) is mounted on the first joint unit (202) having a degree of freedom of rotation in the second direction. The third joint unit (204) is mounted on the second joint unit (203) having a degree of freedom of rotation in the third direction. Rotation axes in the first direction, in the second direction, and in the third direction are perpendicular to each other and intersect at a same central point. A robot is constructed by the kinematic joint block of the present invention. The robot can simulate actions and gestures of human body, a database of a series of target gestures is planned in advance for expressing different emotions, and an action and a gesture of the robot body are controlled according to the emotion expressed by the robot, so as to express the emotion similar to that of the human.

title: Method for measuring finger tip stress of humanoid dexterous finger
abstract: The invention discloses a method for measuring finger tip stress of a humanoid dexterous finger. An under-actuated humanoid finger of a linkage mechanism symmetric structure is adopted, an upper knuckle, a left knuckle, a right knuckle and a knuckle connecting rod are arranged on the under-actuated humanoid finger, the left knuckle, the right knuckle and the knuckle connecting rod are correspondingly connected with the upper knuckle through rotary pairs, and the left knuckle and the right knuckle are symmetrically arranged with respect to the knuckle connecting rod. A strain gage sensor is installed on the knuckle connecting rod or the left knuckle or the right knuckle, and the strain gage sensor is connected with a signal receptor. According to the method for measuring the finger tip stress of the humanoid dexterous finger, based on a contra-parallelogram mechanism, the change of stress of the positive and negative sides of a robot dexterous finger tip can be changed into the change of a certain connecting rod in a linkage mechanism, and the two kinds of strains of stretching and retracting of parts can be measured by the strain gage sensor and correspond to the finger tip force in the forward direction and the reverse direction of the robot dexterous finger tip. Meanwhile, the symmetric structure is adopted by the linkage mechanism of the finger, the strain produced by the transverse shear stress borne by the middle knuckle connecting rod when the front side and the back side of the finger are pressed, and the measuring accuracy is improved.

title: Biped-quadruped attitude transform control method of foot-type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped-quadruped attitude transform control method of a foot-type robot. The foot-type robot can be conveniently transformed into a biped robot or a quadruped robot accordingto needs, and has the advantages and functions of both the biped robot and the quadruped robot. In the transformation process of the biped robot and the quadruped robot, the sliding mode variable structure control is used for determining the rotation speed of a robot body according to the characteristics of uncertain factors existing in the modeling process, the robustness of a system is improved,and the foot-type robot is enabled to be kept in balance in the attitude transformation process.

title: Method and device for controlling robot to stand up after falling down
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for controlling a robot to stand up after falling down. The method comprises the steps that when it is detected that the robot falls down, a first control signal is sent to a first arm motion mechanism and a second arm motion mechanism of the robot to control a first arm and a second arm to support the body of the robot so that the upper part of the bodyof the robot can get away from the ground surface; and a second control signal is sent to a first foot motion mechanism and a second foot motion mechanism of the robot to control the bottom of a firstfoot and the bottom of a second foot to make contact with the ground surface; and a third control signal is sent to a first leg motion mechanism and a second leg motion mechanism of the robot to control a first leg and a second leg of the robot to carry out bending motion according to the preset actions, so that the gravity center of the robot is located in the standing supporting area of the robot, and the robot is controlled to stand up. With the embodiment of the invention, namely the method and device for controlling the robot to stand up after falling down, it can be achieved that the humanoid robot automatically stands up, and robot intellectualization is improved.

title: Control system for gait walking planning of small biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control system for gait walking planning of a small biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of automatic controlling. A CPU is connected with a USB, a Bluetooth, a power supply module, an SD card, a serial driving servo, and a power amplifier driving loudspeaker. The control system for gait walking planning of the small biped robot is simple in structure, and is applied to all control systems of bipedal robots. The control system of the biped robot is convenient to port and can be directly ported into a suitable mechanical structure as a set of soft hardware system, and an upper computer software facilitates gait motions or dance actions of the robots, secondary designing for general users is convenient, fast, stable and reliable.

title: Intelligent interactive humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, in particular to an intelligent interactive humanoid robot. The intelligent interactive humanoid robot comprises a robot main body device, an adjusting device, an energy supply device and an auxiliary supporting device, wherein the adjusting device is fixedly connected to the inner side of the top end of the robot main body device, the lower side of the adjusting device is provided with the energy supply device, the energy supply device is fixedly connected with the robot main body device, the auxiliary supporting device is arranged on the lower side of the energy supply device, and the auxiliary supporting device is fixedly connected with the robot main body device. According to the intelligent interactive humanoid robot,a second motor, a sliding block and a second screw rod are arranged, most intelligent robots are supported and walk through two wheels, and are not prone to incline during normal walking, but when the intelligent robots carry heavy goods, the intelligent robots are prone to incline, when the goods are carried, the whole humanoid robot can be supported through second rolling wheels, so that the whole humanoid robot is guaranteed not to incline during walking.

title: Museum guiding robot based on Raspberry Pi and use method of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a museum guiding robot based on the Raspberry Pi and a use method of the robot. The museum guiding robot based on the Raspberry Pi comprises a master control robot base, a visual sensor, sound equipment, the Raspberry Pi, an LCD and a humanoid casing. The use method of the museum guiding robot based on the Raspberry Pi includes the following steps that a system is started;initialization is performed; the robot is controlled to walk, and a museum indoor environment map is built; the built 2D map is uploaded to a 3D visual tool RVIZ, and multiple destinations are set inthe LCD; navigation is performed in combination with global path planning and local path planning, and the navigation guiding task is fulfilled; the Raspberry Pi plays related audio frequency throughthe sound equipment after the robot arrives at the destinations, and the explaining task for visitors is fulfilled. By the aid of the robot and the use method, autonomous navigation of the robot is realized, the human-computer interaction function is enhanced, the coping capacity for emergencies is improved, and the guiding function is realized during navigation.

title: Variable-rigidity joint based on symmetric crank-slider mechanisms
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of mechanical engineering, and particularly relates to a variable-rigidity joint based on symmetric crank-slider mechanisms. A joint driving motor, a connecting frame, a speed reducer, a connecting flange, an input disc, a fixing ring, an output disc, an output rod and a plate spring jointly form a joint position adjusting device, the center of the plate spring is fixedly connected with the input disc, the two ends of the plate spring are in contact with arc surface groove holes in the two sides of the output disc, the fixing ring is fixedly connected with the input disc, so that the output disc can be axially fixed; the rigidity adjusting motor is fixedly connected with the input disc, the crank-slider mechanism is formed by a cylindrical gear, a short connecting rod, a long connecting rod and a plate spring clamp assembly together, and is used for adjusting the joint rigidity, and one pair of the crank-slider mechanisms are in symmetrical movement relative to the center of the plate spring through the gear transmission. The variable-rigidity joint has the advantages that the structural design is simple, the size of the variable-rigidity joint issmaller, the joint position and the joint rigidity can be independently adjusted; the output rigidity has the characteristic of large-scale continuous change, and the flexible requirement of the humanoid mechanical arm can be met.

title: Coupled self-adaptive under-actuated humanoid dexterous finger
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a coupled self-adaptive under-actuated humanoid dexterous finger. The finger is composed of three knuckles and a base, wherein a motor and a bevel gear train are adopted for transmission, and the finger can be rotated by only one motor; firstly, the motor drives a first bevel gear through a speed reducer, and then the second bevel gear meshed with the first bevel gear is driven to realize the rotation of knuckles; then, the transmission is transmitted to a middle knuckle under the connection action of the multi-connecting-rod mechanism to realize the rotation of the middle knuckle body; the transmission mode of the far knuckle and the middle knuckle is similar to the transmission mode of the middle knuckle. The finger realizes integration of coupling movement and self-adaptive movement, and kneading and self-adaptive enveloping of objects can be realized through cooperation between fingers. In addition, the finger iscompact in structure, high in transmission precision and small in size, the transmission ratio between the two bevel gears can be adjusted according to needs to achieve deflection at different anglesand is suitable for being used as a humanoid dexterous hand.

title: Humanoid robot system

title: A conditional generative adversarial network three-dimensional facial expression motion unit synthesis method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of man-machine emotion interaction, intelligent robots and the like, and aims to provide a corresponding solution way for researching generation and control problemsof natural facial expressions of a humanoid robot by taking a three-dimensional face model oriented to a virtual or entity humanoid robot as a carrier. Therefore, the conditional generative adversarial network three-dimensional facial expression motion unit synthesis method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing effective mapping between facial motion unit labels with different intensities and different combinations and facial expression parameter distribution; (2) carrying out game optimization on the generation result of the expression motion parameter generation model; And (3) applying the generated target expression parameters to the three-dimensional face model facing the humanoid robot to realize generation and control of the three-dimensional face complex expression of thehumanoid robot. The method is mainly applied to intelligent robot design and manufacturing occasions.

title: Biped robot equivalent trajectory generating method and biped robot using the same
abstract: The present disclosure provides an equivalent trajectory generating method for a biped robot and a biped robot using the same. The method includes: obtaining a motion state of the biped robot by a position sensor; determining switching moments in an advancing direction of the biped robot, based on the motion state of the biped robot; finding the mass center position of the biped robot at each switching moment; connecting the mass center positions at the switching moments as an equivalent trajectory of the biped robot; and performing a closed loop control on the biped robot according to the equivalent trajectory. title: Seven-freedom-degree bionic humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention provides a seven-freedom-degree bionic humanoid mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The technical problem that the motion inertia of existing mechanical arms islarge is solved. The seven-freedom-degree bionic humanoid mechanical arm comprises a shoulder joint, a big arm, a forearm and a wrist joint. The shoulder joint comprises a first rotating frame and asecond rotating frame. The inner end of the second rotating frame is fixedly connected with the outer end of the big arm. The outer end of the second rotating frame is hinged to the inner end of the first rotating frame. The inner end of the big arm is hinged to the outer end of the forearm. The wrist joint comprises a first hinged seat, a second hinged seat and a supporting frame. title: Biped robot and walking control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot which comprises a body, a left leg and a right leg, and further comprises a balance control system, a pressure module group and a balance fine adjusting system. The pressure module group comprises a left leg pressure module and a right leg pressure module. The balance fine adjusting system comprises a main liquid storage tank, electromagnetic valves, an electric pump, a connecting ring and an adjusting pipe. A telescopic motor is arranged on the connecting ring. A telescopic rod is arranged on the telescopic motor. A guide pipe is arranged between the main liquid storage tank and the electric pump. A branch pipe is arranged between the electric pump and the adjusting pipe. The electromagnetic valves are arranged on the guide pipe and the branch pipe respectively. The invention further discloses a walking control method of the biped robot. By adjusting the volume of liquid in the adjusting pipe and adjusting the distance between the adjusting pipe and the left leg or the right leg, the gravity center of the robot is adjusted, the inclination direction of the robot can be sensed in time, the cost of controlling parts is low, the control process is simple, and the robot can effectively reach the dynamic balance.

title: Nursing robot for the elderly
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a nursing robot for the elderly. The robot comprises a robot head, a body portion and a chassis. The body portion comprises a shell and an interior. A blood pressure measuring device, a heart rate measuring device, a temperature measuring device and an object holding table are mounted in the accommodating cavity. The interior of the body portion comprises a master control module, a detection module, a recognition module, a communication module, a help seeking module and a driving module. title: Robot and human face following method of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a human face following method of the robot. The method includes the steps that picture images are initiatively collected by the robot in a periodical or event trigger mode and detected, and whether a human face exists in the picture images or not is judged; if the human face exists in the picture images, position information of the human face relative to robot head part specified points or toward directions can be obtained; whether the position information is in a preset range or not is judged, and if the position information is not in the preset range, needed rotating information that the head part of the robot turns to the preset range can be determined; and the head part of the robot is driven to rotate according to the rotating information to followthe human face. Through the human face following method, the head part of the robot can be adjusted in real time to follow movement changes of the human face, thus the head part of the robot faces towards the human face all the time, and the robot can be more vivid when interacting with users and is more intelligent.

title: Gait control method, device, and terminal device for biped robot
abstract: The present disclosure relates to robot technology, which provides a gait control method, device, and terminal device for a biped robot. The method includes: planning an initial position of an ankle joint of the biped robot and a rotation angle of a sole of the biped robot to rotate around one of a toe and a heel of the biped robot; planning a body pose of the biped robot; calculating a target position of the ankle joint based on the initial position of the ankle joint and the rotation angle of the sole; obtaining a joint angle of each of a plurality of joints of the biped robot by performing an operation on the body pose and the target position of the ankle joint utilizing an inverse kinematics algorithm; and adjusting a gait of the biped robot based on the joint angle of each of the joints.

title: Humanoid robot gait balance model building method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot gait planning method combining human teaching with robot learning, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and robot control. Human teaching and the support vector regression learning algorithm are combined and applied to gait planning of a humanoid robot, a humanoid robot gait balance generalization model is built based on the support vector regression algorithm, the joint angle and ZMP information of a human body when walking action is completed are input into the gait balance generalization model, and the joint angle subjected to stability compensation can be directly obtained. Parameters of a WOA optimization model are quoted so that the optimal generalization effect of the model can be obtained, and the performance of the gait balance model is improved. The NAO humanoid robot can be driven to complete stable walking action through the joint angle obtained through the gait balance generalization model. According to the humanoidrobot gait planning method, the complexity of the humanoid robot gait imitation algorithm is reduced, the real-time performance is improved, and in addition, the stability and personification of walking action of the humanoid robot are maintained.

title: Complex environment-oriented lower limb robot gait planning method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and specifically discloses a complex environment-oriented lower limb robot gait planning method. The method comprises the steps of: setting mark points onthe lower limbs of a human body, and obtaining static posture data and moving posture data of the human body through a motion capture system; carrying out inverse kinematic calculation on a human body model according to the moving posture data so as to obtain angle data of each joint in the moving process; and establishing a fitting function according to a relationship between the angle data of each joint and a period, and carrying out lower limb robot gait planning according to the fitting function. According to the method, the discrete joint angle data is serialized, so that the change of the joint angle data in the gait period can be basically restored; experiences prove that the method has relatively fitting results, is capable of enabling the lower limb robots to restore the motionsof the human bodies to the greatest extent, and can be suitable for complex walking environments such as walking, climbing hills and climbing stairs.

title: Cylinder-based humanoid robot lower limb device
abstract: The invention relates to a cylinder-based humanoid robot lower limb device. title: Overload slipping mechanism for lower limb external skeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides an overload slipping mechanism for a lower limb external skeleton robot. The slipping mechanism comprises a bead screw, a slipping connection ring, an inner bearing and an outerbearing; the bead screw is fixed to an external skeleton support; a groove is formed in the surface of the slipping connection ring, the groove is designed to be provided with a higher edge and a lower edge, and an elastic bead corresponding to the bead screw is arranged at the groove; when a rotation motor of a rotation power component normally works, the elastic bead is clamped to the groove, so that the bead screw is connected with the slipping connection ring; the bead screw drives the slipping connection ring to conduct circular motion around a rotation shaft of the human body hip jointcorresponding to the external skeleton support, and assistance force during walking is provided; when the rotation motor of the rotation power component is overloaded, a spring of the bead screw is subjected to retractable deformation, and the elastic bead of the bead screw is stored in a cavity of the bead screw, so that the external skeleton support and the rotation power component are in a slipped state; an inner ring of the slipping connection ring is connected with an outer ring of the inner bearing, and an outer ring of the slipping connection ring is connected with an inner ring of theouter bearing.

title: Method for controlling walking of robot and robot
abstract: A method for controlling walking of a robot includes: determining a stance of the robot, in response to the robot being in a single-leg stance, determining a rotational angle of each of the joints, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints; in response to the robot being in a double-leg stance, calculating a position of a projection of a center of mass of the robot on a surface where the robot stands, and calculating a value of a torque produced by a force of gravity acting on the robot about each of the joints according to the position of the projection; obtaining a feed-forward current of each of the joints; and applying the feed-forward current of each of the joints to a corresponding actuator of this joints.

title: Robot joint driving mechanism, robot lower limb and foot type humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot joint driving mechanism, a robot lower limb and a foot type humanoid robot. According to the main scheme, the robot joint driving mechanism comprises a first jointpiece, a second joint piece and at least one linear driver; the second joint piece is connected with the first joint piece to form a joint of the robot; each linear driver is provided with a first end and a second end which are oppositely arranged; the first end of the linear driver is connected with the first joint piece, and the second end of the linear driver is connected with the second jointpiece so as to adjust the angle of the joint under the driving of the linear driver; and a triangular driving structure is formed among the first joint piece, the second joint piece and each linear driver. The robot lower limb comprises the robot joint driving mechanism. The foot type humanoid robot comprises the robot lower limb. The energy efficiency ratio of the robot joint driving mechanism is improved, the manufacturing cost of the foot-type robot is reduced, and industrialization and large-scale application of the large foot-type robot are achieved.

title: Labyrinth feature recognition and walking method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a labyrinth feature recognition and walking method of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the specific steps that step 1, a camera at the head of the humanoid robot collectsan image; step 2, the humanoid robot performs image processing and image feature extraction on collected image information, wherein the processes include edge detection, circle detection, straight line detection and line splicing to identify the features of the labyrinth; step 3, the humanoid robot identifies intersection types according to the features of the labyrinth; and step 4, the humanoidrobot passes through the current intersection according to the intersection types and walking strategies. The method uses vision, sonar and information of fewer markers, obtains the relative positioninformation of the robot in the labyrinth, identifies the intersection types in the labyrinth and develops corresponding walking strategies according to different intersection types to make the humanoid robot successfully pass the intersections, realize the labyrinth navigation and realize the direction calibration when deviation occurs during the walking.

title: Humanoid fast walking and tracking obstacle avoidance robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid fast walking and tracking obstacle avoidance robot. title: Humanoid robot quick walking tracking obstacle avoidance implement method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot quick walking tracking obstacle avoidance implement method which relates to a humanoid robot quick walking tracking obstacle avoidance robot. The robot includes an Arduino main control chip, wherein the Arduino main control chip is connected with a two-axial steering engine to drive mechanical legs to move, and three actions of straight going, left turningand right turning are set. According to the humanoid robot quick walking tracking obstacle avoidance implement method, a camera is used for sampling, firstly a lab color space is mapped, an identification threshold value is set, then pigment blocks are calculated, the biggest block is selected to be a target area, coordination values are passed back, the angle of the steering engine are calculatedthrough the coordination values and compared with a preset angle to judge whether the angle is in a preset tracking angle or not, and if so, straight going is conducted; and if not, whether the angleis less than the preset angle or not is judged, if so, left turning is conducted, if not, right turning is conducted, finally the robot is returned to the camera to sample until the angle is in the preset angle, and circulation is conducted until the whole journey is completed in a walking mode. According to the humanoid robot quick walking tracking obstacle avoidance implement method, quick walking can be achieved, the function of obstacle avoidance is provided, and the robot is suitable for the quick stable walking environment.

title: Education system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides an education system based on a humanoid robot. title: Assistant management robot head device for community hospital department query and control
abstract: The invention relates to an assistant management robot head device for community hospital department query and control, and solves the problem that a community hospital lacks professional leading examining personnel due to the large medical staff turnover. The head device comprises a facial device, a neck device and a control system; the facial device comprises a facial support, a speech module and a mouth device; the neck device comprises a neck support and a neck movement device. title: Humanoid soccer robot gait plan based on cubic spline interpolation
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid soccer robot gait plan based on cubic spline interpolation. The humanoid soccer robot gait plan comprises the following steps of (1) establishing a kinematic modelaccording to the structure of a robot; (2) planning the gait of the robot on the basis of the kinematic model by using the space cubic spline interpolation method; and (3) optimizing the gait of the robot according to a stability control algorithm for vibration suppression. According to the humanoid soccer robot gait plan, the defect of instability in walking of the robot is improved, so that therobot has good robustness so as to implement behaviors such as walking and kicking the ball; the cubic spline interpolation planning method is adopted, so that the geometrical relationship between alljoints can be preferably guaranteed in the NAO robot soccer gait plan, and the later stability is conveniently optimized; and the angle of deviation and the distance of deviation during walking are greatly reduced through new gait planning and algorithm optimization, and the walking accuracy and stability of the robot are greatly increased.

title: Humanoid football robot path planning method based on dynamic window method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid football robot path planning method based on a dynamic window method. The method comprises the steps that 1, a barrier is recognized through a camera of a robot, andthe distance and relative position between the robot and the barrier are quickly obtained by the adoption of monocular vision positioning and ranging of the robot; 2, a motion model of the robot is obtained through calculation; 3, multiple groups of velocity parameters are sampled, and velocity value limiting conditions are obtained considering hardware conditions of the robot itself; 4, a motiontrack of the robot is calculated through the motion model of the robot and the motion velocity of the robot; and 5, an evaluation function is set and used for evaluating multiple groups of sampled velocities and multiple segments of simulated running tracks in the running process of the robot, and the optimal track is selected. Through the method, the distance between the robot and the barrier can be quickly obtained; and by adopting the dynamic window method to derive the optimal track of barrier-avoiding motion of the robot, the processing speed is high, efficiency is high, and the track derivation effect is good.

title: Biped step competition robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped racing robot which comprises a device steering engine, an asymmetric concave part, a gasket, a steering engine fixing piece, a symmetric concave part, a vertical plate, a control panel, a control panel supporting piece, a right-angle connecting piece, a large plate, a battery and a foot part. title: (Rehabilitation) robot based on human lower extremity exoskeletons
abstract: The invention relates to a (rehabilitation) robot based on human lower extremity exoskeletons. The robot comprises a power storage device, the lower extremity exoskeletons and load-bearing shoes. Thepower storage device is fixed in a back basket provided with multiple stages of fixed holes. The lower extremity exoskeletons comprise a lumbar adjustment and anti-roll device, a hip exoskeleton, a thigh exoskeleton, a knee exoskeleton, a calf exoskeleton and an ankle exoskeleton. The lumbar adjustment and anti-roll device is provided with holes and sliding grooves and connected with a hip exoskeleton bearing. The hip exoskeleton and the thigh exoskeleton are compressed by an expansion sleeve and a nut. When subjected to load, the friction force generated by the expansion sleeve and the thightransmits torque or axial force for compression. The thigh exoskeleton and the knee exoskeleton are compressed by an expansion sleeve and a nut. The knee exoskeleton and the calf exoskeleton are compressed by an expansion sleeve and a nut. The calf exoskeleton and the ankle exoskeleton are compressed by an expansion sleeve and a nut. The ankle exoskeleton is connected with the bearing shoes through screws. Step or stepless adjustment can be conducted at multiple portions.

title: Medical companion robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a medical companion robot which comprises a single chip microcomputer, a walking system, a voice system, a monitoring system, an alarm system, a video system and a reminding system. A power supply is in circuit connection with a charging system, the single chip microcomputer is connected with a wireless network transmission module, the wireless network transmission module is connected with a cloud server network, the cloud server network is connected with a mobile phone client-side and a third party network respectively,and the mobile phone client-side is connected with the third party network. By means of the cooperation of the walking system, the monitoring system and the single chip microcomputer, various physicalsign data are automatically and regularly monitored for a required guardian, and the physical sign data are automatically uploaded to a medical information management platform for providing a reference basis for a doctor to carry out health management on the guardian, so that the medical monitoring is simpler and more efficient, and precious time is saved for the treatment of the required guardian.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom multi-mode humanoid mechanical hand
abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom multi-mode humanoid mechanical hand. The two-degree-of-freedom multi-mode humanoid mechanical hand comprises a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger,a ring finger, a little finger, a synergistic driving mechanism, a palm supporting frame, a flange and a palm motor, the synergistic driving mechanism is fixedly connected to an output shaft of the palm motor, the palm supporting frame is provided with finger installing holes, first sliding grooves, thumb connecting holes, a second sliding groove, a palm motor installing hole and flange installingholes, the palm motor is fixed on the palm supporting frame through the palm motor installing hole, the flange is fixedly connected to the palm supporting frame through the flange installing holes, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are fixed on the palm supporting frame, and the thumb is arranged on the palm supporting frame in a sleeving mode. The two-degree-of-freedom multi-mode humanoid mechanical hand is simple and reliable in structure, easy to control and particularly suitable for being used as a humanoid artificial limb hand; and two driving motors are adopted so that multiple kinds of action modes of a natural state, lateral turning of the thumb, lateral pinching, pinching by the two fingers, grabbing and the like can be achieved, the weight and the manufacturing cost of the mechanical hand are greatly reduced while the human hand movement function is achieved.

title: Self-powered rotary detection and interactive control device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a self-powered rotary detection and interactive control device and method. The device comprises a knuckle (3), an elbow joint (4) and a shoulder joint (5), wherein the knuckle(3) is connected with the elbow joint (4) through a first connecting rod (1), and the elbow joint (4) is connected with the shoulder joint (5) through a second connecting rod (2). Angle sensors are installed in the knuckle (3), the elbow joint (4) and the shoulder joint (5), and the rotation angle of each joint is detected by the corresponding angle sensor. The device and the method have the advantages that when a user teaches a humanoid robot, the user only needs to wear the humanoid robot on the arm to teach various complex actions of the robot arm through the human arm, and thus the efficiency of robot programming is greatly improved.

title: Device for controlling complex robot through arduino
abstract: The utility model discloses a device for controlling a complex robot through arduino. The system comprises an arduino controller, a robot module, a sensor, a bus interface and a steering engine controller, wherein the arduino controller is provided with a plurality of sensor interfaces, the sensor interfaces are connected with a sensor, the sensor is installed on a robot module, the arduino controller is provided with a steering engine controller connected through a serial port bus, and the steering engine controller is connected with the robot module through the serial port bus. According tothe utility model, the arduino controller is connected with the steering engine controller through the bus interface; the robot is connected to the steering engine controller, the sensor is connectedto the arduino controller, and by means of the design, sensor data can be collected through the arduino controller, and the humanoid robot is indirectly controlled by communicating with the steering engine controller.
