title: Biped robot with self-adaptive balance capacity
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped robot with self-adaptive balance capacity. According to the utility model, the high-quality driving ball is used for driving the springs which are arranged aroundalong the radial direction; therefore, the sensors around are triggered to drive the corresponding electric telescopic rods to work; the biped robot is supported; therefore, overturning is prevented,meanwhile, the driving device is added to drive the driving ball; the driving device drives the supporting table to vertically move through the end face cam. When the driving ball does not work, the driving device moves the driving ball into the vertical channel, so that the driving ball does not work, the balance adjusting device does not work at the moment, and the balance adjusting device is simple in structure, convenient to operate and capable of greatly improving the balance capacity of the biped robot, preventing the biped robot from overturning and reducing the probability of danger.

title: Humanoid intelligent control system
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid intelligent control system. The circuit comprises an input filter circuit, an instruction amplification adjusting circuit and an output filter circuit. The inputfilter circuit carries out RC filtering on an instruction output by a server and then outputs the instruction to the instruction amplification adjusting circuit. The instruction amplification adjusting circuit comprises an operational amplifier AR1 and an operational amplifier AR2. The operational amplifier AR1 amplifies an output signal input into the filter circuit and then sends the amplifiedoutput signal into the MOS transistor Q1 and the triode T1 for further amplification; one part of an output signal of the triode T1 is sent into the operational amplifier AR2 and fed back to the inputend of the operational amplifier AR1; finally, the output filter circuit performs LC filtering on an output signal of the instruction amplification adjusting circuit; the control system is driven towork as a control instruction, the transmission speed of an instruction signal is effectively increased, meanwhile, the stability and accuracy of the instruction signal are well kept in the processingprocess of the instruction signal, the humanoid robot can execute the instruction in time and effectively, and good practical value and development value are achieved.

title: Self-engaging gearbox-coupling unit
abstract: The subject of the application is a self-engaging gear-clutch assembly intended for use in all solutions dynamically transmitting rotational energy and subsequently utilizing the inertia of the system for further movement, in particular in electric vehicles, humanoid robots, exoskeletons and limb prostheses. The assembly has a drive shaft (1) driven by a drive system, preferably a motor, mounted on which is a gear (2) reversing the direction of rotation and a clutch, which on the side of the gear (2) has a raceway (3) provided with a cage (5) with wedging elements (6), and behind the raceway (3) a ring (4a) with recesses is mounted, wherein friction elements (4b) pressed against the cage (5) by springs are mounted in the recesses of the ring (4a), furthermore the wedging elements (6) are mounted between an output sleeve (7) and the raceway (3).

title: System and method for balance control of humanoid
abstract: A system for balance control of a humanoid includes a control input generation unit which determines Zero Momentum Position (ZMP) of the humanoid with respect to ground, and a control output generation unit which determines Center of Mass (CoM) position and velocity of the humanoid, wherein the control input generation unit and the control output generation unit determine the ZMP and the CoM position and velocity, respectively, by applying a discrete-time dynamics equation sampled by applying a non-pathological sampling frequency.

title: Four-steering-engine biped robot and method for attitude simulation of four-steering-engine biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a four-steering-engine biped robot and a method for attitude simulation of the four-steering-engine biped robot. The four-steering-engine biped robot comprises a host shell andtwo feet mounted at the lower end of the host shell; the feet are constituted by leg parts and foot parts correspondingly; the leg parts and the foot parts are each internally provided with a steering engine room; a first steering engine and a second steering engine are mounted in the steering engine rooms of the left part and the foot part on the left side correspondingly, and a third steering engine and a fourth steering engine are mounted in the steering engine rooms of the left part and the foot part on the right side correspondingly; and the first steering engine is arranged at the upperend of the second steering engine, and the third steering engine is arranged at the upper end of the fourth steering engine. According to the four-steering-engine biped robot and the method for attitude simulation of the four-steering-engine biped robot, the structure is simple, the method can be used for virtual computing simulation of actions before the robot is designed, thus verification is conducted without waiting for a made real mold, the time is shortened, the cost is lowered, stability is improved, and jamming of all the parts and tumbling of the robot can be avoided.

title: Variable-topology multi-joint cooperative follow-up robot
abstract: The invention relates to a variable-topology multi-joint cooperative follow-up robot, belongs to the field of robots. The problems that mechanical arms of a robot in the prior art cannot realize synchronous motions with people and real-time control, flexibility and operability are low, and a humanoid robot can only simulate partial motions of people and cannot carry heavy objects. A humanoid bionic execution mechanism has 16 joints and 2 mechanical claws, and is provided with a head part, a waist part, a left arm, a right arm, a left hand and a right hand, wherein a camera installed at the head part is provided with a humanoid visual angle, and the robot can accurately copy the motions of people to complete operation tasks. According to the humanoid bionic execution mechanism, the motion and the gesture of a human body can be accurately executed under the follow-up control condition, so that cooperative following-up between the robot and people as well as synchronous operation on the robot by the people under remote control are realized, so that the robot can replace people in the case of operation in dangerous environments.

title: Humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration method based on hybrid mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration method based on a hybrid mechanism. The method comprising the operating steps that (1) based on the human anatomy and the anthropomorphic configuration design idea, and free configuration is conducted on the lower limb exoskeleton;(2) according to the humanoid lower limb exoskeleton freedom-degree configuration, a humanoid lower limb exoskeleton configuration based on the hybrid mechanism is designed, specifically 6SPS+3SPS+1SPS+3SPS, and a single leg is composed of a hybrid mechanism 3SPS+1SPS+3SPS; and (3) Taking a hip joint as an example, the kinematic simulation is conducted on a 6SPS parallel mechanism, and the human movement matching effect at the hip joint is verified by being combined with the human gait data measured by the experiment. The method has the innovative, the simulation and the experimental basis, and meanwhile, has the outstanding advantages of being high in human-machine movement matching accuracy, high in carrying capacity and high in stability, the problem that active driving of the movement of each direction of a lower limb joint of a wearer cannot be achieved through an existing lowerlimb exoskeleton configuration can be solved, and the significant guiding significance is achieved for the lower limb exoskeleton configuration design.

title: Intelligent monitoring robot with clock assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent monitoring robot with a clock assembly. The humanoid intelligent monitoring robot comprises a humanoid intelligent monitoring robot body, a charging socket is formed in the afterbrain of the robot body; a dustproof plate and a positioning shaft are arranged on the robot body; a rubber plug is arranged at one end of the plate surface on one side of the dustproof plate; an iron sheet is arranged on the plate face of the other side of the dustproof plate, the end, away from the plug, of the dustproof plate is hinged to the top of the afterbrain of the robot body, one end of the positioning shaft is connected with the top of the robot body, the other end of the positioning shaft is bent around the hinged axis, and a magnet is arranged on the side, away from the head of the robot body, of the positioning shaft. According to the intelligent monitoring robot, the plug is connected with the robot, so that the plug cannot be lost during charging, and the use convenience of the intelligent monitoring robot is improved.

title: Bionic human-shaped underwater detection device
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic human-shaped underwater detection device. A human body-like structure is adopted and the device comprises mechanisms of a body, a head, a neck, arm parts, a back and legs. Various sensors, an underwater binocular vision camera and an underwater lighting device are mounted at the head. A multipurpose backpack is arranged on the back of the body. A self-adaptive manipulator platform is arranged at the tail end of each of the arm parts. Quick switching between a walking mode and a swimming mode of the legs can be achieved through cooperation of multiple mechanisms. The arms and the legs are cooperatively operated, the underwater environment is detected or underwater objects are grabbed, meanwhile, the underwater detection device can carry additional equipmentto conduct underwater operation together with divers, and a good man-machine cooperative operation function is achieved. The underwater detection device has the advantages of being rich in function, wide in application range, high in adaptability and high in flexibility, and the functions of omni-directional movement, shooting, grabbing, water quality monitoring, man-machine cooperative operationand the like of the underwater detection device in a shallow water area can be achieved.

title: Bipedal walking robot based on parallel mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a bipedal walking robot based on a parallel mechanism. The bipedal walking robot comprises a waist platform and two leg part mechanisms symmetrically arranged and connected tothe lower side of the waist platform. Each leg part mechanism comprises an upper platform, a lower platform and three telescopic cylinders hinged between the upper platform and the lower platform through universal joints, and the bipedal walking robot further comprises a steering mechanism installed on the waist platform and a sole mechanism installed at the bottom of each leg part mechanism. According to the bipedal walking robot based on the parallel mechanism, a single-degree-of-freedom waist part is used for driving a motor to drive two three-degree-of-freedom leg part mechanisms based ona parallel structure, so that under the situation that two legs are only provided with four degrees of freedom in total, the robot can realize the functions of straight running, turning, obstacle-crossing and walking up and down stairs stably; and compared with existing six-degree-of-freedom robots, the design structure of the robot is simpler, a workspace is large, and the payload to deadweight ratio is high.

title: Robot intelligent vending machine and unmanned supermarket
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot intelligent vending machine. The system comprises a control cabinet and two containers, the control cabinet comprises a first cabinet body and a control system arranged in the first cabinet body. A humanoid robot, a bill printer and a shipment platform are further arranged in the first cabinet body, and openings are formed in the positions, corresponding to thebill printer and the shipment platform, of the front door of the first cabinet body; a transparent window is arranged at the corresponding position of the humanoid robot; the front door is further provided with a camera system and a voice system which are connected with the control module. The two containers are arranged on the two sides of the control cabinet, a goods passing opening corresponding to the goods shelf is formed in the connecting position of the first cabinet body and the second cabinet body so that goods can enter the control cabinet through the goods passing opening, and thecontrol system comprises a goods display module, a payment module, a goods outlet control module and a communication module. The utility model further relates to an unmanned supermarket. The self-service vending machine can sell more goods, is safe in delivery, and can realize remote goods taking in unmanned supermarkets.

title: Multi-information fusion human exoskeleton robot control protection system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-information fusion human exoskeleton robot control protection system. title: Human arm stiffness identification method and system based on surface electromyographic signals
abstract: The invention provides a human arm stiffness identification method and system based on surface electromyographic signals. The method mainly comprises five parts of data acquisition, data processing, feature extraction, classifier training and real-time stiffness identification. According to the method, extra heavy auxiliary equipment is not needed. A mathematical model between the electromyographic signals and the rigidity does not need to be established, and the rigidity of the arm is directly identified through a sensor and a mathematical analysis method. The inaccuracy of modeling can be avoided, the rigidity state of the human arm can be effectively identified without the assistance of additional mechanical equipment, and thei nvention has an actual application value in the field of robot humanoid control.

title: Child learning robot

title: Hip joint enhanced six-degree-of-freedom leg structure of small humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a hip joint enhanced six-degree-of-freedom leg structure of a small humanoid robot. title: Three-degree-of-freedom hip joint of anthropomorphic robot and anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The three-degree-of-freedom hip joint of the anthropomorphic robot comprises a hip joint supporting frame which is connected with a Z-direction rotation driving mechanism. The hip joint supporting frame is fixedly connected with the support part of the Y-direction tail end gear piece, and the connecting hole of the hip joint supporting frame and the gear part of the Y-direction tail end gear pieceare coaxially arranged in the Y direction. The Y-direction tail end gear piece is connected with a Y-direction rotation driving mechanism; the hip joint supporting frame is movably connected with thefront end of the Y-direction gear box body through the connecting hole, and the Y-direction tail end gear piece is movably connected with the rear end of the Y-direction gear box body through the gear part. And the Y-direction gear box body is connected with an X-direction rotation driving mechanism. The hip joint has three rotational degrees of freedom, and the rotating shafts of the three rotational degrees of freedom are intersected at one point, so that the walking stability of the robot can be ensured, the vertical walking action of human beings can be truly simulated, and the work of the human beings can be completed. title: Joint rotation limiting mechanism of anthropomorphic robot

title: Arrangement and system for wearable balance meter
abstract: The invention relates to an arrangement (10) and a system for determining the ability of an object to remain in balance. The object is constituted by a bipedal animal, a bipedal bird or a bipedal robot, and it has an anterior- posterior extent and a medio-lateral extent. The arrangement comprises a monitor unit (30) monitoring the anterior-posterior and mediolateral acceleration of the object, and a computing unit (50) computing the displacement and movement of the object’s centre element. It integrates the anterior-posterior acceleration and the medio-lateral acceleration and performs an adjustment so that low acceleration and small displacement coincide in time. The invention also relates to a garment comprising such a system.

title: System and method for cognitive customer interaction

title: AGV autonomous positioning and navigating method based on topological map of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an AGV autonomous positioning and navigating method based on a topological map of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a topological map based on a given robot activity area, wherein the topological map comprises an end point representing a key point in the active area, and a side which is connected with the end point for representing a walking path, wherein the end point comprises characteristic information which can be detected by a robot through a self sensor; and S2, carrying out positioning and navigation of the robot on the basis of the topological map, so that the robot can move from the current position to the target point. The AGV autonomous positioning and navigating method can overcome the problems that traditional robot autonomous positioning navigation technology has problems in graphs and positioning navigation, the difficulty and the complexity of the modeling and positioning navigation are effectively reduced, and the navigation reliability is improved.

title: Mouth part mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, in particular to a mouth part mechanism of a humanoid robot. The mouth part mechanism of the humanoid robot comprises a lip model, an upper jaw support plate and a chin model, wherein the lip model and the upper jaw support plate are arranged above the chin model; the lip model comprises an upper lip, a lower lip and mouth corners; the upper lip is arranged above the lower lip; the mouth corners are connected between the upper lip and the lower lip; the upper lip is connected with an upper lip driving mechanism; the lower lipis connected with a lower lip driving mechanism; the mouth corners are connected with a mouth corner driving mechanism; and the chin model is connected with a chin driving mechanism for driving the chin model to be rotated. According to the mouth part mechanism of the humanoid robot disclosed by the invention, the lip model is driven by adopting a connecting rod structure, and under a common effect of the upper lip driving mechanism, the lower lip driving mechanism, the mouth corner driving mechanism and the chin driving mechanism, the mouth corner driving mechanism can interfere with upper and lower lip driving points, the chin driving mechanism can interfere with mouth corner driving points, the six driving points for driving the lip model can realize mouth-shape movement that speaking and the like are more complicated, and the mouth part mechanism has higher mouth-shape change frequency.

title: Steering control method of biped robot capable of running and jumping
abstract: The invention discloses a steering control method of a biped robot capable of running and jumping. The steering control method comprises an ankle joint moment control method and a leg length adjustingcontrol method; according to the ankle joint moment control method, different moments are exerted during different supporting phases through left and right ankle pitching joints, so that a deflectioneffect is applied on a trunk of the robot, and a deflection angle is generated under the integral effect of time, so that the steering control of the robot is completed; and the leg length adjustingcontrol method refers to achieving direction adjustment by modifying left leg length and right leg length in the running gait of the robot. According to the method, the robot is able to resist the steering disturbance caused by the external disturbance as well as achieve autonomous steering control, and is simpler and more practical in the whole mechanism design, and the development cost is reduced.

title: Movable arm support for upper human body exoskeleton and upper human body exoskeleton
abstract: The invention discloses a movable arm support for an upper human body exoskeleton and the upper human body exoskeleton. The movable arm support comprises shoulder swing arms, first rotating shafts andhand swing arms, wherein the first rotating shafts are installed on a back support located behind the back, the shoulder swing arms are rotatably installed on the first rotating shafts and connectedwith the hand swing arms, the hand swing arms are installed on arms, and the hand swing arms are raised or lowered on the trunk side to drive the shoulder swing arms to rotate around the first rotating shafts. The back support forms a support for the shoulder swinging arms and the hand swinging arms, the arms drive the hand swinging arms to rotate when moving, and the hand swinging arms drive theshoulder swinging arms to rotate. The first rotating shafts are perpendicular to or approximately perpendicular to the back under the upright state, so the upward rotation of the arms on the trunk side is converted into the rotation of the shoulder swing arms around the first rotating shafts. The higher perpendicularity of the rotation plane of the arms and the first rotating shafts is, the less resistance the arms suffer as the arms rotate. Therefore, the first rotating shafts provide the freedom of upward rotation for the movable arm support on the side of the human body.

title: Breaststroke teaching demonstration robot based on speech recognition, and control method of breaststroke teaching demonstration robot
abstract: The invention relates to an education robot and a control method thereof, in particular to a breaststroke teaching demonstration robot based on speech recognition, and a control method of the breaststroke teaching demonstration robot. The robot is a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot, is provided with robot kinematic joints consistent with human body kinematic joints, and comprises robot leg systems, a robot body system, robot hand systems, a robot head system, a robot power system and a control system. The control method comprises the steps: after the robot is started, situations of all the parts of the robot are detected, whether all surrounding obstacles are larger than safe threshold values or not is detected, and the left leg system, the right leg system, the left hand system, theright hand system, the robot head system and the robot body system are controlled along with speech to move in a coordinated mode according to breaststroke teaching actions. The learning efficiency and the teaching quality can be improved, the urban-rural teaching gap is narrowed, and the breaststroke teaching demonstration robot can overall and flexibly cooperate with teaching demonstration, hasthe characteristics of being good in flexibility, high in intelligent degree, simple in structure and low in cost, and is easy to use and popularize.

title: Humanoid robot copying hand
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot copying hand. The humanoid robot copying hand comprises a palm and a finger assembly, wherein a palm part of the palm is fixedly connected with a palm part ofthe finger assembly; finger fingertips of the finger assembly are connected with an upper pulling plate through upper fingertip traction ropes; the finger fingertips of the finger assembly are connected with a lower pulling plate through lower fingertip traction ropes; and the upper pulling plate is positioned above the lower pulling plate; a first motor is connected with an input end of a first speed reducing mechanism; a traction rope is wound on an output gear shaft of the first speed reducing mechanism; one end of the traction rope serves as a feeding rope, and the other end of the traction rope serves as a discharging rope; the upper pulling ropes are connected with the upper pulling plate, and the lower pulling ropes are connected with the lower pulling plate; and the first motor candrive the output gear shaft to rotate, so that the traction force is transmitted to the fingertips through the upper pulling plate or the lower pulling plate so as to achieve the finger grabbing degree of freedom. According to the humanoid robot copying hand, synchronous straightening and bending actions of five fingers can be achieved, so that the five-finger linkage grabbing is completed.

title: Disturbance recovery humanoid robot space compliance control model construction method
abstract: The invention discloses a disturbance recovery humanoid robot space compliance control model construction method. The method comprises posture compliance control and height compliance control. The attitude compliance control method includes the steps of acquiring an angle theta of the upper body of the robot relative to feet; calculating a target moment tauref according to the elastic damping model of legs, compensating the deviation between the actually measured moment taumeasure and the tauref by adjusting the ankle joint rotation angle delta qankle through admittance control, tracking the target moment tauref, and realizing attitude compliance control. The height compliance control method comprises the steps that the height of the upper body relative to the supporting legs is obtained,the force in the target vertical direction is calculated, then the actual acting force of the force sensor on the shanks is calculated, admittance control is conducted, a centroid height adjusting instruction delta H is controlled in each control period, and the centroid height is made to return to Href. According to the invention, the combination of robot posture compliance and high compliance isrealized, so that when the robot is subjected to external impact (including the pulse acting force of the uneven ground on the sole of the feet), the posture of the body can deviate to a certain extent, the impact force is reduced, and the instability of the robot is prevented.

title: Humanoid manipulator control system based on in-depth learning and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid manipulator control system based on in-depth learning and a control method thereof. The system comprises an image acquisition module, an object detection and recognition module and a humanoid manipulator control and decision-making module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for achieving an image acquisition and image pretreatment function for a workingscene; the object detection and recognition module is used for detecting target objects in acquired images and recognizing corresponding categories; and the humanoid manipulator control and decision-making module is used for planning a humanoid manipulator motion locus, performing motion decision-making on positions where the target objects are located according to treatment results of the two above modules, and achieving motion locus self-learning. According to the humanoid manipulator control system, an automatic control system is established, self-actuated working can be achieved under conditions without human intervention, the intelligence of machines is improved, the system can be widely applied to environments including factories, workshops, logistics and the like where object sorting and other operation are needed, and the market prospects and the potential value are good.

title: Anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet. The anthropomorphic robot capable of walking uprightly on two feet comprises a trunk skeleton, a waist, a right leg and a left leg; the waist is connected with the trunk skeleton through a waist rotating platform; the left side and the right side of the waist are connected with the left leg and the right legthrough double-degree-of-freedom hip joints; the lower part of the trunk skeleton is fixedly connected with the waist rotating platform of the waist; a waist rotating mechanism drives the waist rotating platform to rotate so as to drive the trunk skeleton to rotate around a Z axis and realize Z-axis rotation freedom degree of the waist; an X-axis driving motor of the hip joint drives a hip jointball through a hip joint straight gear group to rotate around the X axis to realize the X-axis rotation freedom degree of the hip joint; a Y-axis driving motor realizes vertical reversing from X-axisrotation to Y-axis rotation through a bevel gear pair; and a planetary wheel speed-reducing mechanism drives a tail end connecting flange to rotate around the Y axis to realize Y-axis rotation freedomdegree of the hip joint. The 13 degrees of freedom enable the upright walking posture of the robot to imitate the action of human beings.

title: CONTROL METHOD FOR BIPED ROBOT TPYE TOY
abstract: The present invention relates to a biped robotic toy and a control method thereof. Provided is a biped robotic toy comprising: a lower body part having a first leg module and a second leg module on both sides; an upper body part corresponding to an upper body of the biped robotic and having a first arm module and a second arm module at both sides; and a center-of-gravity moving part disposed at a position connecting the upper body and the lower body for walking motion, and moving a center of gravity of the biped robotic toy toward the first leg module or the second leg module side by adjusting the position of upper body part prior to driving the first leg module or the second leg module. In addition, provided is a control method of the biped robotic toy comprising the steps of: moving a position of an upper body part toward the first leg module; advancing the second leg module; moving the position of the upper body part toward the second leg module; and backward driving the second leg module.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent robot analysis control system based on big data. The system comprises a data acquiring module, a signal transfer module, a controller, an action execution module, a database, an image acquiring module, an analysis processing module, a touch induction module and a search updating module; the data acquiring module is used for acquiring human body induction information and voice element information of users in real time and transmitting the information to the signal transfer module; the human body induction information comprises head mobile data, hand mobiledata and foot mobile data; and the voice element information comprises pitch data, loudness data, length data and tone data. Different touch points of an intelligent robot liked by the users can be associated with different priorities of actions and music combinations, and the contents are continuously updated according to data analysis in a self-adaption mode, so that the intelligence degree ofthe intelligent robot and the fit degree liked by the users are improved.

title: Wheel leg type humanoid robot with internal oil flowing
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel leg type humanoid robot with internal oil flowing, relates to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems that when a hydraulic driving unit and a power unit are connected by adopting a rubber hose, the hose is long, the pipe arrangement is complex, and the movement flexibility of a conventional hydraulically-driven robot is influenced. The humanoid robot comprises a head, shoulders, a body, a hip pelvic bone, a first hydraulic connecting rod assembly, a second hydraulic connecting rod assembly, a third hydraulic connecting rod assembly, a hydraulic cylinder, two mechanical arms, two thighs, two shanks and two driving wheels. The head, the shoulders and the body are sequentially and fixedly connected together from top to bottom; the body ishinged to the hip pelvic bone and driven by the hydraulic cylinder, each mechanical arm is hinged to the corresponding shoulder and driven by the first hydraulic connecting rod assembly to swing leftwards and rightwards, and each thigh is hinged to the hip pelvic bone and driven by the second hydraulic connecting rod assembly to swing forwards and backwards. Each joint adopts a hose-free oil way,so that the pipeline abrasion fault is greatly reduced, and the safety and the reliability of the whole machine are improved.

title: Humanoid soccer robot image segmentation method based on an improved region growth algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid soccer robot image segmentation method based on an improved region growth algorithm. The method specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, setting a threshold value of a gray difference as zero; step 2, performing line-by-line scanning on the image, and finding out pixels to which the image does not belong; step 3, by taking the pixel as a center, checking the adjacent pixels, namely comparing the pixels in the neighborhood with the pixel one by one, and if the gray difference is smaller than a predetermined threshold value, merging the pixels; step4, taking the newly combined pixels as the center, and carrying out detection in the step 3 until the area cannot be further expanded; step 5, returning to the step 2 again and scanning continuously until pixels which do not belong to cannot be found; step 6, calculating the average gray difference among all adjacent areas, and combining the adjacent areas with the minimum gray difference; and step 7, setting a termination criterion, and merging the regions in sequence by repeatedly performing the operation in the previous step until the termination criterion is met, and ending the growth process. The target recognition effect of the robot can be remarkably improved.

title: MOTION ASSIST DEVICE
abstract: A motion assist device (1) comprises: a first mount member (10) that is mounted to a torso; second and third mount members (20, 30) that are respectively mounted to both legs; and a power generation mechanism (40) that has one end connected to the first mount member (10) and the other end connected to the second and third mount members (20, 30) and that generates a tensile force between the one end and the other end. title: Robot interaction method realized by multiple technologies
abstract: The invention discloses a robot interaction method realized by multiple technologies. The method comprises the following steps that 1, obtaining the position of a center point of a picture presented under a robot face recognition camera, recording the position of the center point as a fixed point A, wherein the position is fixed and unchanged all the time along with fixation of the position of the camera, and a rectangular coordinate system is established on the picture with the fixed point A as an original point; 2, detecting whether a human face exists or not by utilizing a human face recognition technology, if the human face exists, acquiring a human face image, then processing the acquired human face image, and positioning a coordinate position (x, y) of a position B on the central line of the human face of the client in a rectangular coordinate system at the moment; and step 3, transmitting the coordinate position (x, y) of the point B to a robot head movement system, analyzing and positioning the coordinate by the robot head movement system, and rotating the robot head to enable the fixed point A and the point B to coincide. According to the invention, the interest of the client is caused by actively facing the client, so that the robot looks more intelligent, and the client has better interaction experience and interaction opportunities.

title: Biped robot arm with shoulder rotation function
abstract: The invention belongs to the field o robot body structures, and particularly discloses a biped robot arm with a shoulder rotation function. The biped robot arm with the shoulder rotation function comprises a shoulder rotation module, an upper arm module and a lower arm module, which are connected in sequence, wherein the should rotation module comprises a first connecting part, a chest plate and a hydraulic cylinder; the first connecting part comprises a first connecting base, a shoulder rotation torque motor and a first connecting plate, which are connected in sequence; the upper arm module comprises a second connecting part, an upper arm supporting part and a third connecting part; the second connecting part comprises a second connecting base and a shoulder hand-raising torque motor; and the lower arm module comprises a parallel triangular bar mechanism, a fourth connecting base and a steering engine. The biped robot arm with the shoulder rotation function can effectively realize the action of shoulder rotation, arm rotation, arm lifting, elbow rotation, wrist horizontal and vertical twisting, and wrist rotation of the robot arm synchronously, realizes the multi-degree of freedom movement of the robot arm, and effectively improves the movement performance of the robot.

title: Foot force and moment following control method of bipedal robot
abstract: The invention discloses a foot force and moment following control method of a bipedal robot. According to the method, a double-spring damping model is designed, a force following controller is designed by using an LQR optimization method, and the following of the foot force and moment of the bipedal robot is realized; and the foot expected force and the foot expected moment are calculated by a planned ZMP (Zero Moment Point) distribution method, and finally, the ZMP following of the bipedal robot is better, and can adapt to a certain uneven ground. According to the foot force and moment following control method of the bipedal robot provided by the invention, the traditional ZMP following is abandoned, so that a control mode adaptive to the stable walking and the uneven ground of the bipedal robot can be realized, the foot expected force and the force moment that enable the robot to stably work are directly calculated, and the following of the foot force and the force moment is realized by directly controlling the foot expected force and the force moment, so that stable control is carried out in a more intrinsic and easier implementation manner, the control response is faster, the capability of adapting to the uneven ground is stronger, and the ZMP following effect is very ideal.

title: Elderly service robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an elderly service robot. The elderly service robot comprises a main body, wherein a mechanical arm is arranged at the top of the main body, the mechanical arm is connected with a mechanical hand through a joint, a waist tray is arranged on the position above the middle part of the main body, a lifting mechanism is arranged below the waist tray, a four-bar mechanical arm is arranged in the middle of the main body, one end of the four-bar mechanical arm is arranged on the main body, and the other end of the four-bar mechanical arm is provided with a leg tray, a pressure sensor is arranged on the leg tray, a chassis is arranged at the bottom of the main body, a walking system is arranged on the chassis, a power transmission system and a control system are arranged in the main body, and the power transmission system comprises a driving mechanism and a speed reducing mechanism. According to the elderly service robot, six-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is used, so that the robot has great flexibility and can move and rotate in x-axis, y-axis and z-axis directions; and the robot is used for assisting elderly people in walking.

title: Full-hydraulic humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention provides a full-hydraulic humanoid manipulator which comprises a control module and a gripper module. The full-hydraulic humanoid manipulator is characterized in that the control module comprises a control motor, a threaded shaft, a bearing, a valve, a valve body and a pipe joint; the control motor is connected with the threaded shaft; a bearing is arranged between the threaded shaft and the valve; the valve is fixedly arranged at the other end of the threaded shaft and is arranged in the valve body; the pipe joint is arranged under the valve body; through a precise liquid flow control device, a finger knuckle liquid flow can be controlled, so that the requirement on adjusting each finger according to the needs can be met; and fingers are driven through a precise special micro oil cylinder and are automatically controlled through a computer, so that opening, closing and grasping of any finger at different degrees can be realized. The strength magnitude can be adjusted through a control pressure valve according to the feedback.

title: Human body posture robot demonstration method and device based on in-demonstration-garment video
abstract: The invention discloses a human body posture robot demonstration method and device based on a in-demonstration-garment video. A video of the demonstration process preformed by a demonstrator is obtained, by means of video target identification and video image synchronous fusion algorithms, a space-time point location evolution sequence and multi-dimensional dynamics parameters of bone joints of the human body are obtained, and then the robot locally operates the parameters or executes codes; in this way, by means of simple demonstration of a real person, the robot can acquire the motion process and main points and repeat personalized job task of the user, so that the purpose that the user can conduct personalized operation and use on the service robot without the need for grasping complicated programming is achieved.

title: Novel bionic human front-arm twisting mechanism and robot comprising the same
abstract: The invention provides a novel bionic human front-arm twisting mechanism and a robot comprising the same. The novel bionic human front-arm twisting mechanism comprises flexible bars and six front-arm shells, wherein the four flexible bars 14 are tightly matched with the front-arm shells and all penetrate through the six front-arm shells, and two ends of each flexible bar are fixed; the six front-arm shells are limited sequentially and mutually two by two, and the limiting angles between the shells change linearly.

title: Humanoid robot centroid trajectory planning method for reducing walking energy consumption
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot centroid trajectory planning method for reducing walking energy consumption. According to the knee joint pitch angle theta knee, the ankle joint pitch angle theta ankle and the hip joint pitch angle theta hip, the centroid height is calculated when the speed and the angular acceleration of the knee joint, the ankle joint and the hip joint are minimalized under the constraint of the centroid. The calculated centroid height is weighted to acquire the optimized centroid height. According to the technical scheme of the invention, the problem of high energy consumption of a walking robot is solved by optimizing the centroid trajectory of the walking robot.

title: Waist joint mechanism and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a waist joint mechanism and a robot and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The waist joint mechanism comprises a waist ball seat, a waist ball cap and a waist ball. A containing cavity is formed jointly by the waist ball seat and the waist ball cap. The inner sidewall of the containing cavity is provided with a first sunken part and a second sunken part which are symmetric. The waist ball is arranged in the containing cavity. The sidewall of the waist ball is provided with a first limiting protrusion and a second limiting protrusion which are symmetric. The first limiting protrusion is inlaid in the first sunken part. The second sunken part is inlaid in the second sunken part. Gaps are formed between the upper end face and the lower end face of the first limiting protrusion and the wall face of the first sunken part. Gaps are formed between the upper end face and the lower end face of the second limiting protrusion and the wall face of the second sunken part. The waist joint mechanism can have high impact resistance when the robot makes contact with the ground, can enable the waist of the robot to bend down in multiple directions in the moving process of the robot. The waist joint mechanism has low requirements for manufacturing and installation precision and is convenient to produce, simple in structure and light in weight.

title: Humanoid robot waist joint and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot waist joint and a humanoid robot. The waist joint comprises a first tile structure, a second tile structure, a first transition structure, a second transition structure, a first substrate and a second substrate. A first end of the first transition structure is slidingly connected with a first end of the first tile structure, and a first end of the second transition structure is slidingly connected with a second end of the first tile structure to limit swinging of the first tile structure along a first arc line; one side surface of the first substrate is slidingly connected with a first end of the second tile structure, and one side surface of the second substrate is slidingly connected with a second end of the second tile structure to limit swinging of the second tile structure along a second arc line; a second end of the first transition structure is fixedly connected with a third end of the second tile structure; and a second end of the second transition structure is fixedly connected with a fourth end of the second tile structure. Through the scheme, the robot achieves higher impact resistance, and is lower on manufacturing and mounting precision requirements.

title: Biped robot adaptive walking control method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot adaptive walking control method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps that 1) a simulation platform is established; 2) a network model based on a deep reinforcement learning method introducing an attention mechanism is constructed; 3) the network model is trained according to the interaction information of a biped robot in the environment of the simulation platform, and the interaction information is stored in a playback pool; and 4) the network model which completes training is used to realize adaptive control of walking of the biped robot. Compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention has the advantages of fast convergence speed, good fitting effect, high walking stability and the like.

title: ROBOTICALLY NEGOTIATING STAIRS
abstract: A method (500) for negotiating stairs (20) includes receiving image data (164) about a robot (100) maneuvering in an environment (10) with stairs. Here, the robot includes two or more legs (104). Prior to the robot traversing the stairs, for each stair, the method further includes determining a corresponding step region (220) based on the received image data. The step region identifies a safe placement area on a corresponding stair for a distal end (106) of a corresponding swing leg of the robot. Also prior to the robot traversing the stairs, the method includes shifting a weight distribution of the robot towards a front portion of the robot. The method further includes, for each stair, moving the distal end of the corresponding swing leg of the robot to a target step location where the target step location is within the corresponding step region of the stair.

title: The AI robot and control method thereof
abstract: Provided is an artificial intelligence home robot including: a body forming an internal storage space; a support part placed under the body to support the body; a display displaying an image; a head located on the body with the display placed on the front side; a voice input part including a plurality of microphones (MIC) receiving a voice signal; and a control part requesting the utterance of a security when receiving a payment command from a user, and then, receiving the utterance of the security code from the user, comparing the utterance to the security code, and comparing the utterance to a pre-stored voice of the user to authenticate the user. Therefore, the artificial intelligence home robot is capable of improving user convenience by performing security authentication through voice input.

title: WALKING CONTROL SYSTEM AND CONTROL METHOD OF ROBOT
abstract: A walking control method of a robot is provided. The method includes receiving a walking command of the robot including a link device having a plurality of links that correspond to both lower limbs. In response to receiving the walking command, implementing walking of the robot by providing torque to the link device to move a first lower limb is moved. In a double stance state where foot ends of the both lower limbs are simultaneously in contact with ground while the lower limb to be moved is changed, a driving force is generated in the double stance by adjusted the torque of the drive device to virtually move the foot ends of the both lower limbs by a predetermined stable distance in an opposite direction to a walking direction.

title: Method for achieving teaching function of mechanical arm based on instruction of PLC humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for achieving the teaching function of a mechanical arm based on an instruction of a PLC humanoid robot. A code compiler is constructed through a basic instruction of a PLC, and subprograms correspondingly meeting a motion control requirement and an industrial application requirement are set up through a system subprogram and sequentially controlled functions, and an arithmetic unit is constructed in the PLC in the manner of defining internal storage and calling a basic operation instruction to complete data operation; and the constructed main program and an edited PLC pulse output program cooperate to complete a recognition function of the system on a code, a parameter loading function and the function of finally achieving a teaching process. Compared with a current application, the method achieves the function of modifying the technological process and motion parameters by inputting control instruction stream under the condition that an underlying code is not changed, the system has higher flexibility and easy operation performance, and the technical requirements of the system are reduced.

title: Hose-free internal oil circuit for hydraulic wheel-legged humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hose-free internal oil circuit for a hydraulic wheel-legged humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and aims at solving the problems of easy wear, redundant pipeline and inconvenient disassembly and assembly of an existing external hydraulic oil circuit. The head and shoulders, mechanical arms, a body, hip pelvic pone, thighs and shanks of the hydraulic wheel-legged humanoid robot are all of framework structures with hydraulic oil circuit cavity assemblies; an oil inlet and an oil return port are formed in the rear side back of the body; the oil inlet end of the oil inlet is connected with an external hydraulic power system through a hydraulic oil circuit; the oil outlet end of the oil return port is connected with the external hydraulic power system through the hydraulic oil circuit. The hose-free internal oil circuit disclosed by the invention is used for the humanoid robot.

title: Robot device

title: Humanoid robot arm structure
abstract: The utility model discloses an arm structure of a humanoid robot. INCLUDING A FIRST DRIVE MOTOR, the right end of the first driving motor is in transmission connection with a shoulder part; a second driving motor is movably mounted in the shoulder part; a fourth driving motor is movably mounted in the first arm; an input shaft is movably mounted at the transmission end of the fourth driving motor; and an output shaft is movably mounted at the lower end of the input shaft, the output shaft is movably mounted at the upper end of a second arm, a fifth driving motor is movably mounted in the second arm, a third arm is movably mounted at the transmission end of the fifth driving motor, and an electronic telescopic rod is movably mounted in the third arm. title: Linear inverted pendulum model-based robot gait planning method
abstract: The invention discloses a linear inverted pendulum model-based robot gait planning method. The linear inverted pendulum model-based robot gait planning method comprises the following steps of building a linear inverted pendulum model, in which a proportion factor Gamma is introduced on the basis of a dual-connection rod inverted pendulum model (DLIPM) to build a new linear inverted pendulum model; and performing robot gait planning, in which zero-torque point track, trunk mass center motion track and free foot planning track are generated on the basis of the linear inverted pendulum model, and each joint gait motion curve is solved by inverse kinematics. The linear inverted pendulum model built by the method more conforms to actual mass distribution condition of a humanoid robot, the zero-torque point track, the trunk mass center motion track and the feet foot planning track which are generated on the basis of the model and the each solved joint gait motion curve linear are more reasonable and more conform to the gait process of a natural person dual-foot robot, and the gait planning accuracy is high.

title: Planning control method for crossing vertical wall barrier by humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a planning control method for crossing a vertical wall barrier by a humanoid robot. A target object needing to be crossed is formulated for the humanoid robot; the motion track pre-planning of the humanoid robot is carried out according to the target object; the expected jump speed of the humanoid robot is calculated according to the pre-planned movement track; the hip joint of the humanoid robot is calculated according to the expected jump speed, the knee joint and the ankle joint are respectively subjected to motor characteristic curve restraint, joint limiting restraint and ground friction force constraint, and the actual takeoff speed is obtained, and then the motion trail of the jumping stage is optimized; the air posture is stably adjusted in the air stage, and the stability of the upper body of the humanoid robot is kept; and the landing stage is stably adjusted through the landing posture, so that the landing impact is relieved, and the whole task spanning the vertical wall barrier is completed. According to the method, the joint force moment is optimized, a large jump distance is achieved without an energy storage element, crossing the vertical wall barrier, and keeping the stability of the humanoid robot in the process.

title: Humanoid five-finger manipulator claw
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid five-finger manipulator claw. title: Controllable humanoid dancing robot utilizing mobile communication

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of police service robot case reporting, in particular to a self-service case receiving and reporting recording robot and a system thereof. title: Gait generation and optimization method for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a gait generation and optimization method for a biped robot. The method is characterized in that a gait library of the biped robot is constructed in a finite state machine according to a target pose of the state of the biped robot; mutual switching conditions among all states of the robot are set and triggered; in each state switching process, a joint cubic interpolation method is used for planning the movement track of support legs, and a gauss pseudo-spectral method is used for optimizing the movement track of swing legs; and finally, the gait of the biped robot in different motion modes is generated by the finite state machine. According to the gait generation and optimization method for the biped robot, the constraint of ZMP is not considered, and all the bipedrobots with or without the sole edges of the feet can generate the walking track by the method; and the planning process is simple and operable and is more suitable for online generation, and the biped walking robot can stably walk and finish walking, running, jumping and other actions by matching with a simple control strategy.

title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot. The lower limb exoskeleton robot comprises a chest and abdomen leaning plate, a left portion and a right portion, the left portion and the rightportion are identical in structure, and the left portion and the right portion each comprise a hip joint portion, an ankle joint portion, a knee joint locking portion, a foot sole auxiliary supporting portion, a thigh depending plate, a shank leaning plate and a knee joint shaft. According to the lower limb exoskeleton robot, the exoskeleton applies three-branched-chain parallel spherical connecting rod mechanisms to the design of a hip joint and an ankle joint, so that the exoskeleton hip joint and ankle joint each have three degrees of freedom to match with the degree of freedom of movementof each joint of a human body to be sufficiently adaptive to various complicated actions of lower limbs of the human body, and the flexibility of the exoskeleton is effectively improved; the variable-optimized three-branched-chain parallel spherical connecting rod mechanisms are combined with a planar four rod mechanism, so that the seven degree of freedoms of the single branched chain are completely locked at one position at one time, stable support of arbitrary postures of the lower limbs is realized, meanwhile, the number of complex components and the overall weight are greatly reduced, the control cost is saved, and the operation difficulty is simplified.

title: Small biped robot driven by brushless direct current motor
abstract: The utility model discloses a small biped robot driven by a brushless direct current motor, and relates to the technical field of biped robot devices. The device comprises a rack, two sets of drivingdevices are arranged on the rack, and a controller used for controlling the driving devices is arranged between the two sets of driving devices. Each group of driving device comprises two long connecting rods; one ends of the two long connecting rods are connected through a fixing screw, the other ends of the two long connecting rods are connected with one ends of the short connecting rods throughfixing bolts respectively, the other end of each short connecting rod is connected with one brushless direct current motor, a motor driver is fixed to the outer end face of each brushless direct current motor, and a connecting rod is arranged between the two brushless direct current motors. According to the utility model, the purposes of simple structure, high integration level, convenient installation and cost saving are realized.

title: Foreground humanoid robot

title: Biped bionic robot based on connecting rod mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a biped bionic robot based on a connecting rod mechanism and belongs to the field of bionic robots. The biped bionic robot based on the connecting rod mechanismhas the advantages that the loads on leg structures are small, the robot is lighter, the motion energy consumption is low, and the robot is driven to advance by using the connecting rod mechanism.

title: Humanoid mechanical foot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical foot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The humanoid mechanical foot with high flexibility and sufficient stability is provided. A push rod connecting piece is horizontally and rotatably mounted on the connecting shaft, and the upper end of the connecting shaft is coaxially fixed on the bottom surface of a leg fixing cylinder. The telescopic outer end of a telescopic push rod is connected with one end of the push rod connecting piece, and the fixed end of the telescopic push rod is fixed on the leg fixing cylinder through a fixing connecting piece. The rear end of a heel plate is rotationally connected with the push rod connecting piece, the rear end of a back plate is rotatably connected with the front end of the heel plate, and the rear end of a toe plate is rotatably connected with the front end of the back plate. The leg fixing cylinder is provided with three first bearings, and the heel plate, the back plate, and the toe plate are connected with the corresponding first bearings by telescopic pull rods. The humanoid mechanical foot has the advantages that horizontal rotation and up-and-down rotation can be realized, thesimulation of the foot movement of the human body can be realized, stability is high, and vibration absorption can be realized through the vibration absorption rubber and the stability is enhanced.

title: Bionic mechanical arm with humanized features

The right am of anadult man is used as a design model; and the structural features of the arm and hand are fully considered for comprehensive design. title: Elbow joint of humanoid doll
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid dolls. The utility model discloses an elbow joint of a simulated human-shaped doll. title: Humanoid robot path planning method based on 3D point cloud
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot path planning method based on 3D point cloud. The humanoid robot path planning method comprises the steps of: 1) using a laser radar to sense terrain and establishing a point cloud map; 2) calculating terrain environmental information based on the point cloud map; 3) designing an adaptive gait set; 4) and adaptively selecting different adaptive gait set searching paths according to different terrain environments. The humanoid robot path planning method can effectively solve the path planning problem of a humanoid robot in a complex environment, and theeffectiveness of the humanoid robot path planning method is verified through conducting tests on the simulation platform and the physical robot.

title: Biped robot walking planning and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking planning and control method, which comprises the following steps of acquiring a control instruction, wherein the control instruction comprises target place information; establishing a coordinate system for a robot by adopting a D-H method according to a composition mechanism of the biped robot; generating a footprint according to the control instruction and the coordinate system; establishing a forward dynamics model of the biped robot, and deriving a dynamics equation of the robot; analyzing an on-line synchronized planning mass center orbit and azero moment point track according to the dynamics equation; and controlling the biped robot to reach a target place according to the footprint, the mass center orbit and the zero moment point track.According to the method, the technical problem of poor maneuverability of the existing biped robot can be solved, the stability is higher, and any footprint of the biped robot can be stably changed ina walking process.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot leg structure which comprises a leg structure unit, the leg structure unit comprises a first steering engine, a second steering engine and a third steeringengine, and the first steering engine is connected with the second steering engine through a first connecting piece to form a first walking mechanism; the second steering engine is connected with thethird steering engine through a second connecting piece; travelling mechanism forming second group, the bottom of the third steering engine is connected with a foot structure of the robot, the firststeering engine drives the leg structure to swing on the horizontal plane and simulate the human straddle structure, the first walking mechanism provides front-back movement of the leg structure and simulates the thigh part of a person, and the second walking mechanism provides left-right swing of the leg structure and simulates the shank part of the person. The whole leg mechanism simulates the structure of a human skeleton to the maximum extent, the stability and flexibility of the humanoid robot in the gait walking process are improved, and compared with a traditional leg structure, the number of steering engines is small, and the cost is saved.

title: Humanoid robot thoracic cavity device
abstract: The utility model discloses a thoracic cavity device of a humanoid robot. Thoracic cavity shell, a control panel is fixedly mounted on the front end surface of the thoracic cavity shell; buttons are installed on the front end face of the control panel. Upper arm preformed holes are formed in the left end and the right end of the thoracic cavity shell. Connecting movable plates are fixedly installed at the left end and the right end of the lower portion of the clamping tooth column, convex buttons are movably installed at the ends, away from the lower portion of the clamping tooth column, of the connecting movable plates, movable push buttons are movably installed on the outer sides of the convex buttons, and leg connecting holes are reserved in the left side and the right side of the lowerend of the thoracic cavity shell. The thoracic cavity shell of the humanoid robot thoracic cavity device is integrally designed; meanwhile, the outer portion of the thoracic cavity shell is made of the copper alloy material, the copper alloy material has good firmness and is beneficial to prolonging the service life of the device, and the movable push button is of a conical design, so that the mechanical leg is convenient to disassemble and assemble and can adapt to fixation of leg parts with different widths.

title: Robot simulating human arm intelligent system
abstract: The invention discloses a robot simulating human arm intelligent system. The intelligent system comprises a bionics robot arm and further comprises a processor connected with the robot arm, and the processor is further connected with a human arm sensing module and a signal input module; and the robot arm is used for receiving a control signal sent through the processor and does action according tothe control signal, the processor is used for receiving a control signal input through the signal input module and sending the control signal to the robot arm after processing the control signal, andis used for receiving motion parameters sent through the human arm sensing module, generating a control signal after processing the motion parameters and then sending the control signal to the robotarm, the signal input module is used for receiving a control signal input from the outside and sending the control signal to the processor, and the human arm sensing module is used for acquiring the motion parameters of all the parts of a human arm and sending the motion parameters to the processor. The system has the advantages that work is done by simulating the actions of the human arm, and thebionic degree is high; and the simulation control is sequentially carried out starting from an elbow joint, and a control method is simple.

abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a robot and a waist structure thereof. A degree of freedom is set between the chest and the waist of the robot, a waist steering engine is arranged on a fixing frame of the chest of the robot, the waist steering engine controls an adapter plate located on the waist of the robot to rotate, relative rotation of the chest andthe waist of the robot, namely humanoid rotation action, is achieved, and the structure is simple and practical.

title: Robot
abstract: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of electronics, and provides a robot which is a humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot comprises a robot body, a pickup module and a main controlmodule; the pickup module comprises a microphone array, and the microphone array comprises a first microphone array and a second microphone array; wherein the first microphone array comprises N microphones, and the N microphones are arranged around the neck of the humanoid robot and are uniformly distributed; wherein the second microphone array comprises M microphones, and the M microphones are arranged on the neck of the humanoid robot and located on a connecting line of any two microphones in the first microphone array; the main control module acquires N paths of audio data through the firstmicrophone array, acquires M paths of audio data through the second microphone array, and performs sound source localization and sound pickup based on the N paths of audio data, the M paths of audiodata and the reference audio data. 360-degree awakening and sound source positioning of the robot can be supported, formation of directional beams can also be supported, and the noise reduction effectis good.

title: Shank composite structure and humanoid robot comprising shank composite structure
abstract: The invention provides a shank composite structure and a humanoid robot comprising the shank composite structure. The shank composite structure comprises supporting side plates, an embedded filling structure clamped between the supporting side plates and a shell wrapping the outer periphery of the supporting side plates and the embedded filling structure. The supporting side plates comprises the shank outer plate and the shank inner plate which are fixedly installed at intervals on the left side and the right side at a preset distance, the upper ends of the shank outer plate and the shank inner plate are provided with upper end connecting support parts used for supporting and connecting knee joint assemblies, and the lower ends of the shank outer plate and the shank inner side plate are provided with lower end connecting support parts. The embedded filling structure comprises upper plugs located below the upper end connecting support parts and fixedly connected to the support side plates, lower plugs located above the lower end connected support parts and inner cavity structures fixed between the upper plugs and the lower plugs and fixedly connected to the support side plates, wherein each inner cavity structure is provided with an accommodating cavity. The structure has good strength and rigidity in all directions, and the internal space of the shank can be fully utilized.

title: Intelligent juvenile learning robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent juvenile learning robot. The structure of the intelligent juvenile learning robot comprises a monitoring head, a touch screen, a human-shape robot body, a soundcollecting support, supporting handrailing, a lifting cleaning support and a movable support. The intelligent juvenile learning robot has the effects that the sound collecting support can expand the range of sound wave reception through a sound absorbing ring wall structure enclosed by blades on a support, the sound absorption efficiency of a sound absorbing cover is improved, then the receiving range of voice receiver on user voice messages is improved, so that a user can send a voice control instruction to the robot in a long distance in a bedroom; and the lifting cleaning support uses lifting power provided by an electric lifting rod to enable a dust removal ring and a disinfection ring to enclose a ring wall structure along the human-shape robot body, and dust removal, disinfection andmoisture absorption work can be performed on the surface of the human-shape robot body from top to bottom, so that the robot can keep clean and tidy before and after use.

title: Crotch structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a crotch structure of a humanoid robot. The crotch structure comprises waist-crotch connecting plates, large gears, servo rotary arms, thigh outer skeletons and first motors, output shafts of the first motors are connected to speed reducers, output shafts of the speed reducers penetrate through the waist-crotch connecting plates which are horizontally arranged to be connected to pinions and drives the pinions to rotate, the pinions mesh with the large gears, the large gears rotate to drive the thigh outer skeletons to rotate together with turbine frames, worm wheel frames are fixedly arranged at the lower ends of the large gears, rotating shafts are arranged in the worm wheel frames and are connected to the worm wheel frames through second bearings, the lower ends of the worm wheel frames and the rotating shafts are distributed perpendicular to each other, worms are arranged in the lower ends of the worm wheel frames, the outer walls of the two ends of the wormsare sleeved with first bearings and are connected to the worm wheel frames in a rotating mode, worm wheels are arranged on the rear sides of the worm wheel frames and sleeve the outer sides of the rotating shafts, and the bottom ends of the worm wheels mesh with the worms. The crotch structure of the humanoid robot have the advantages of being reasonable in structure, high in simulation performance, multiple in running direction and large in power.

title: Face structure of simulation robot

title: Biped stepping robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of robots, aims to solve the problem of low frequency state fitting degree of a biped robot in the prior art, and provides a biped stepping robot, which comprises a main frame group, a plurality of auxiliary frame groups, a plurality of auxiliary frame groups and a plurality of auxiliary frame groups, the outer frame foot group comprises a left frame foot anda right frame foot; the left frame foot and the right frame foot are located on the left side and the right side of the main frame set correspondingly and serve as two walking feet of the robot. Theconnecting mechanism comprises a left connecting mechanism and a right connecting mechanism; the left frame foot is movably connected to the left frame piece through a left connecting mechanism, and the right frame foot is movably connected to the right frame piece through a right connecting mechanism. And the driving mechanism is installed on the main frame set and is in transmission connection with the left connecting mechanism and the right connecting mechanism at the same time so as to drive the left frame foot to move through the left connecting mechanism and drive the right frame foot tomove through the right connecting mechanism. The beneficial effects of the utility model are that the device is low in operation inertia, can improve the performance of a climbing frequency state during the propelling and landing operation, and improves the fitting degree.

title: Bionic viscoelasticity control method of robot joint
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic viscoelasticity control method of a robot joint. A robot suffers from unknown disturbance, joint angle deviation and joint angular velocity deviation between the current posture of the robot and the reference posture are acquired according to a posture sensor and joint coded disk data, and virtual moment which the robot suffers from is calculated according to a viscoelasticity model, so that expected joint angle track generated by the virtual moment is acquired and the robot is controlled by the track. By the bionic viscoelasticity control method of the robot joint, the flexibility of the robot joint can be improved, and the stability of the robot is maintained while joint movement maintains flexibility under the unknown additional disturbance. By the method, the operability of the robot can be enhanced and the application occasions of the humanoid robot are increased.

title: Gesture control method for biped robot based on spatial second-order inverted pendulum model
abstract: The invention discloses a gesture control method for a biped robot based on a spatial second order inverted pendulum model and belongs to the technical field of movement control of biped robots. The method maps control on an upper body gesture of the biped robot to control of four joints of the spatial second-order inverted pendulum model to achieve coupling non-linear control of the gesture of the biped robot, so that the coupling and non-linear characteristics of the gesture angle are reserved while a kinetic model of the robot is simplified. The calculating speed and the control precision are considered, the balanced capacity and the dynamic characteristic of the biped robot are improved, and the utilization efficiency of energy is improved.

title: Planning method for multi-joint cooperative explosive jump of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a planning method for multi-joint cooperative explosive jump of a humanoid robot. The planning method for the multi-joint cooperative explosive jump of the humanoid robot comprises the following steps: reading the current rotational speed of a joint motor and calculating peak value torques capable of being generated by joints at first; then calculating the angular accelerations of the joints under the action of the peak value torques of the joints according to the kinetic equation of the robot; then obtaining the position of ZMP point of the robot by the angular accelerations of the joints, and then judging the stability of the robot in a jump state; if the robot is instable, adjusting the joint torques of the robot; and reaching the explosive jump state of the robot while meeting the stability of the robot, so that jump movement can be realized. According to the planning method for the multi-joint cooperative explosive jump of the humanoid robot, planning of the jump movement is carried out on the robot, the multi-joint cooperative explosive jump is realized, and high stability is achieved.
