title: Heuristic type humanoid robot falling protection method
abstract: The invention discloses a heuristic humanoid robot falling protection method. A self state of a robot is monitored by an industrial personal computer through information acquired by a sensor and compared with a state expected value; and if the difference value between the self state of the robot and the expected value is monitored to be larger than a threshold value, the robot is in an unbalancedstate, the industrial personal computer implements a falling protection strategy, the falling impact of the robot is reduced to minimum, and the robot is gradually stable under the control of the industrial personal computer and finally stops moving. According to the heuristic type humanoid robot falling protection method, each joint track of the robot during falling is obtained so that the impactof the robot during falling can be reduced, and the robot can be protected; adjustment is performed according to different falling states of the robot to obtain the protection strategy which is mostsuitable for the current falling situation, and the falling protection has the adaptability of the different situations.

title: Method and device for robot to reproduce human body demonstration actions
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for a robot to reproduce human body demonstration actions. The method comprises the steps of processing a demonstration video to be reproduced by a robot;generating a corresponding operation instruction to control the robot to reproduce the human body demonstration action in the demonstration video to be reproduced by the robot. Therefore, an operatordoes not need to wear hardware equipment for collecting human body joint information. The technical problem that the operator needs to wear the hardware equipment for collecting the human body jointinformation when a sensor is used for capturing the state of a human body joint in the prior art is solved.

title: Hugging robot for children and control method for hugging robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hugging robot for children and a control method for the hugging robot. The hugging robot is child-centered and actively comforts for accompanying and comprises a main body, wherein the main body comprises a head, a robot body, a chassis and mechanical arms; the mechanical arms are provided with clamping plates for applying the pressure to children; all the clamping platesare respectively provided with pressure sensors; the main body is provided with an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared sensor and a sound transducer; the ultrasonic sensor is used for detecting the ambient environment; the infrared sensor is used for detecting the positions of the children; the sound transducer is used for detecting the sound given by the children and further analyzing the emotions ofthe children; the head is provided with a camera and a mini PC; the camera is used for acquiring images and is in communication connection with the mini PC; the mini PC is provided with OpenCV; the OpenCV is used for analyzing the motions of the children through graphs; the bottom of the chassis is provided with a walking mechanism; and the mechanical arms, the pressure sensor, the ultrasonic sensor, the infrared sensor, the sound transducer, the walking mechanism and the mini PC are connected with a main control chip respectively.

title: Foot structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a foot structure of a humanoid robot. Bottom shell, a butt joint groove is formed in the upper end of the bottom shell. An auxiliary wheel clamping groove is formed in themiddle position of one end of the bottom surface in the bottom shell; a fixed placement groove is reserved in the middle position of the other end of the bottom surface in the bottom shell; a drivingbutt joint thread is formed in the middle of the outer part of the driving shaft; a connecting clamping block is movably installed at the upper end of the spherical connecting block, an external connecting piece is fixedly installed at the upper end of the connecting clamping block, a matching groove is formed in the middle of the bottom of the connecting clamping block, a butt joint clamping block is fixedly installed on the outer ring of the bottom of the shell, and a connecting groove is formed in the tail end of the upper end face of the shell. According to the humanoid robot foot structure, the overall moving mode is simplified, the moving speed is increased, the working functionality is improved, the spherical connecting block is arranged, the humanoid robot foot structure can meet the requirement for multi-angle direction change, and the overall application range is enlarged.

title: Tracing obstacle-avoiding humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a tracing and obstacle avoiding humanoid robot. Humanoid robot body, wherein the humanoid robot body sequentially comprises a trunk part, arms, legs and feet from top to bottom; the lower end of the trunk part is rotationally connected with a rotating shaft; steering engines are arranged at the joints of the arms and the legs. The front end of the body part is fixedly connected with an infrared tracing sensor; the infrared tracking sensor is located at the lower end of the electronic display screen, the front end of the foot is fixedly connected with an ultrasonic obstacle avoidance sensor, a second electric telescopic rod is fixedly connected into the mounting groove, the output end of the motor is fixedly connected with a driving wheel, and the outer side of the transverse shaft is fixedly connected with a rolling wheel. According to the tracing and obstacle avoiding humanoid robot, the humanoid robot can advance according to a set route, meanwhile, obstacles in front of the humanoid robot can be detected, unnecessary losses caused by collision between the humanoid robot and the obstacles are prevented, and meanwhile the safety of the humanoid robot isimproved.

title: HIGHLY FLEXIBLE, PIEZORESISTIVE, WIRE-BASED, AND SHAPE-VARIABLE SENSOR, METHOD FOR MANUFACTURING SAME, AND SHAPE-VARIABLE SENSOR APPLICATION
abstract: The present invention pertains to a method for manufacturing a flexible sensor for three-dimensional curved surfaces of human or humanoid robot systems, wherein the flexible sensor is a highly flexible, piezoresistive, wire-based, and shape-variable sensor that can provide artificial skin having a spatial resolution of less than 300 micron texel for telepathological/telediagnostic medical applications, and can be applied to the prosthetic feet or the like of humanoid robots for postural stability. The highly flexible, piezoresistive, wire-based, and shape-variable sensor according to the present invention is characterized by being configured in the form of a sheet by arranging a plurality of piezoresistive wires including: a conductive core made of a mixture of a silicone polymer (platinum-catalyzed silicone), multiwall carbon nanotubes (MWCNT), and anhydrous toluene; and an insulation layer coated on the outer surface of the conductive core.

title: Humanoid cashier robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid cashier robot. Box body, cash register mechanism arranged on surface, a head is fixedly mounted on an upper panel of the box body through mounting screws; connecting pieces are fixedly connected to the two sides of the box body through mounting screws; the connecting piece is fixedly connected with a mechanical big arm; a small mechanical arm is arranged below the large mechanical arm; the large mechanical arm and the small mechanical arm are connected with each other through a circular connecting piece; mechanical fingers are fixedly mounted at one end,away from the mechanical big arm, of the mechanical small arm through mounting screws; mechanical thighs are fixedly mounted on the two sides of the lower surface of the box body through small mounting bolts; the cashier robot can be conveniently moved through the arranged walking wheels; meanwhile, the damping springs and the connecting columns are arranged above the walking wheels, and the damping springs can play a good role in damping, buffering and protecting when the cashier robot moves, so that the impact force borne by the box body is reduced, the robot is prevented from breaking down,the cashier accuracy is improved, and meanwhile, the service life of the robot is prolonged.

title: Compact bionic eye device based on two-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic driving rotating mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a compact bionic eye device based on a two-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic driving rotating mechanism. The device can be used as a visual sensor of a bionic robot such as a humanoid robot and mainly comprises a rotor, a stator core, a winding, an angular displacement camera, a spherical hinge pressing block, a stator connecting piece, a camera, a spherical hinge, a cameraconnecting piece, a rotor connecting piece and an outer spherical shell. According to the device, by adjusting the winding currents of the four stators, the rotor is driven to realize limited rotation of pitching and yaw freedom; and the two-degree-of-freedom electromagnetic rotating mechanism is compact in structure, and the bionic eye device capable of realizing the human eye scale provides animportant foundation for truly applying bionic eyes to the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot system based on pneumatic movement
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot system based on pneumatic movement. A lower limb device is connected with a waist device, and the waist device is connected with an upper limb device; a firsttransverse air cylinder of the lower limb device is connected with a third transverse air cylinder through a second transverse air cylinder, and the first transverse air cylinder, the second transverse air cylinder and the third transverse air cylinder are perpendicular to each other; the second transverse air cylinder is connected with a second longitudinal air cylinder and a fifth longitudinalair cylinder which are parallel to each other through a first connecting part; the two ends of the second longitudinal air cylinder are vertically connected with a first longitudinal air cylinder anda third longitudinal air cylinder respectively; and the two ends of the fifth longitudinal air cylinder are vertically connected with a fourth longitudinal air cylinder and a sixth longitudinal air cylinder respectively.

title: Lower limb robot dynamics simulation platform and simulation method fusing balance strategy
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of lower limb robot simulation. The invention specifically discloses a lower limb robot dynamics simulation platform and simulation method fusing a balance strategy.The simulation platform adopts a modular design, comprises a robot dynamics model module, a humanoid gait planning module and a balance module, the robot dynamics model module is used for constructing a virtual controlled object and comprises an entity sub-module, a rigidity transformation sub-module and a rotational joint sub-module, and the rotational joint sub-module comprises an active jointsub-module and a passive joint sub-module; wherein the anthropomorphic gait planning module and the balance module are both connected with the robot dynamic model module, the anthropomorphic gait planning module is used for generating an expected joint angle of a virtual controlled object, and the balance module is used for limiting excessive movement of the mass center of the virtual controlled object; the simulation platform is simple and efficient to construct, a balance strategy is fused, the requirement of lower limb robot gait simulation for balance is met, and rapid switching of different simulation functions is facilitated through modular design.

title: Intelligent accompanying robot applied to growth of child
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent accompanying robot applied to the growth of a child. The robot comprises a head part, ear parts, a body part and leg parts, wherein the head part, the ear parts,the body part and the leg parts are formed into a humanoid structure of the whole robot and the frameworks of main functional areas. The head part is of a circular structure, the bottom of the head part is screwed into the body part, and hidden microphones are distributed in a gap at the joint of the head part and the body part. The intelligent accompanying robot applied to the growth of the child can promote the operational ability of the child, is applicable to a special period of a baby who likes throwing and smashing objects, arouses the chasing and playing interest of the baby, and trains the crawl capacity of the baby; each part of the intelligent accompanying robot can be split as a toy for playing, applicable to the babies in various stages for playing; the whole intelligent accompanying robot is lively and lovely; one robot has the functions of the plurality of toys, is highly attractive to the children, has the significant education function, and is extremely high in practicability and novelty.

title: Device convenient for measuring fingertip stress of humanoid dexterous finger
abstract: The utility model discloses a device convenient for measuring fingertip stress of a humanoid dexterous finger, which comprises an underactuated humanoid finger and a strain measuring device, the underactuated humanoid finger is provided with an upper knuckle, a left knuckle, a right knuckle and a knuckle connecting rod, the left knuckle, the right knuckle and the knuckle connecting rod are respectively connected with the upper knuckle through revolute pairs, and the left knuckle and the right knuckle are symmetrically arranged; and a strain gauge sensor is arranged on the knuckle connecting rod or the left knuckle or the right knuckle. On the basis of a reverse parallelogram mechanism, the change of stress borne by the front face and the back face of the fingertip of the robot dexterous finger is converted into the change of strain of a certain connecting rod in the connecting rod mechanism, and two kinds of telescopic strain of a component can be measured only through one strain gaugesensor and correspond to fingertip force in the front direction and the back direction of the fingertip of the robot dexterous finger. Meanwhile, the connecting rod mechanism of the finger adopts a symmetrical structure, so that the strain generated by transverse shearing stress on the middle knuckle connecting rod when the front and back surfaces of the finger are pressed is reduced, and the measurement accuracy is improved.

title: Hydraulic servo controller of hydraulically-driven biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a hydraulic servo controller of a hydraulically-driven biped robot. The hydraulic servo controller comprises a DSP (Digital Signal Processor), a CPLD (Complex ProgrammableLogic Device), an AD (Analog to Digital) acquisition module, a DA analog output module and a CAN (Controller Area Network) communication module, the DSP processor is connected with the AD analog quantity acquisition module and the DA analog quantity output module through the CPLD. The DA analog quantity output module is connected with the power amplification module; the DSP processor is connectedwith an upper computer through a CAN communication module. By means of the design, closed-loop control over the positions and force of all joints of the legs is achieved, the tracks of all the jointscan be planned through the coordinates of the feet relative to the hip platform, the positions of the feet in the robot system are controlled, posture compensation position control is conducted, leg compliance control is conducted according to plantar force, and the flexibility of a control strategy of the control system is improved.

title: Robot bionic foot mechanism and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a robot bionic foot mechanism and a biped robot, solves the problems of poor loading capacity and impact resistance in the walking process in the prior art, and has the effects of enhancing the loading capacity and the impact resistance in the walking process and being convenient to assemble and disassemble. According to the technical scheme, the sole comprises a frontsole body and a rear sole body which are separated from each other, a buffer assembly is arranged between the front sole body and the rear sole body, one side of the buffer assembly is connected withthe front sole body through a first connecting rod mechanism, and the other side is connected with the sole through a second connecting rod mechanism; a piston mechanism used for controlling the walking amplitude is installed between the front sole and the first connecting rod mechanism.

title: Foot state detection device of biped robot and slope walking method based on foot state detection device
abstract: The invention discloses a foot state detection device of a biped robot and a slope walking method. The foot state detection device comprises a pressure sensor module, an AD conversion module, an inertia measurement module, a communication module, a microcontroller module and a power module. On a basis of realizing an original foot pressure detection function, the foot state detection device of thebiped robot can detect a foot angle state, slope information detection of the ground is realized, and feedback is provided for the biped robot walking on a slope. The slope walking method is simple to realize, and the walking stability and adaptive capacity to the environment of the biped robot can be improved.

title: Display screen splicing method and display screen splicing system
abstract: The invention discloses a display screen splicing method and a display screen splicing system. The display screen splicing method is applied to a biped robot, and comprises the steps of receiving position information and reference plane information sent by a measuring device; fixing a connecting piece at a preset position of the base according to the position information; gluing the surface of thebase and forming a glue layer, specifically, the surface of the glue layer and the reference plane are located on the same plane; and fixing a display screen unit on the base with the glue layer through the connecting piece. Compared with the prior art, the display screen splicing method and the display screen splicing system solve the problem of bright lines or dark spots of display screens caused by uneven walls, and effectively guarantee the display effect of the display screens.

title: Walking supporting mechanism of biped walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a walking supporting mechanism of a biped walking robot. The walking supporting mechanism can allow the biped walking robot to walk stably, squat and stand in various road conditions under a loading condition. The upper body of the robot is provided with a supporting mechanism capable of extending forward or backward, wherein the supporting mechanism can enable the fallingpoint of a gravity action line of the robot under the loading condition to be positioned between the ground landing point of the supporting mechanism and the ground landing point of robot feet. The supporting mechanism can automatically extend forward or backward according to standing and walking conditions of the robot under the loading condition, so that the robot can kept center of gravity stable so as not to topple over, and can move stably and smoothly regardless of standing, flat ground walking, sloping climbing, walking upstairs and downstairs, squatting and standing up under the loading condition. When the robot is not loaded and does not need to be supported, a robot control system can control the supporting mechanism to be folded, retracted, stored close to the upper body, and the robot keeps biped appearance, thus reducing occupied space.

title: Four-wheel humanoid fighting robot structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a four-wheel humanoid fighting robot structure. title: Body structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The body structure of the humanoid robot comprises a lower supporting plate, an upper supporting plate and a shell, the upper supporting plate is arranged on the lower supporting plate, a first containing cavity is formed between the upper supporting plate and the lower supporting plate, the upper supporting plate and the lower supporting plate are combined to form a body main body, and at least one steering engine installation base is arranged on each of the two sides of the body main body. The shell is arranged on the upper supporting plate, a second containing cavity is formed between the shell and the upper supporting plate, and the second containing cavity is communicated with the first containing cavity. The utility model has reasonable design, can be simplified as much as possible under the condition of meeting the requirements of movement and operation, and can well share the pressure from the top, thereby prolonging the service life.

title: Biped walking robot

title: ROBOT FOR ADVERTISEMENT TRANSFORMABLE IN SITUATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a promotional robot capable of being transformed by situation which provides information for guide promotion to a customer in a public facility such as a department store, a shopping mall, a theater, an exhibition hall, and the like. The robot of the present invention can perform a gesture such as shaking the head from left to right and shaking the shoulders at the same time when a promotional voice comes out, thereby further inducing a person′s interest and increasing the effect of promotion. In addition, the robot can be transformed according to the situation, thereby arousing the user′s interest to maximize the effect of the promotion. The present invention comprises: a head part; a body part; an arm part; a lower half body part; a plurality of motors; and a control part.

title: Walking assisting robot device
abstract: The invention discloses a walking assisting robot device which comprises a pair of swing arm mechanisms which are symmetrically arranged, a waistband and tying belts. Each swing arm mechanism comprises a hanging frame, an installation plate, a disc-shaped cam and a driven part, wherein the installation plate is fixedly installed on the hanging frame, the installation plate is provided with a cam rotating shaft, the cam is rotationally arranged on the installation plate through the cam rotating shaft, the driven part is installed on the installation plate and abuts against the edge of the cam through an elastic mechanism, the cam pushes the driven part to move in a reciprocating manner in the plane perpendicular to the cam rotating shaft, and the elastic mechanism can be switched between compression energy storage and stretching releasing. A rocker is fixed to each cam, wherein the rocker and the cam rotate synchronously. By means of the walking assisting robot device, parts such as a motor, a speed reducer, an electric control plate and a battery are not arranged in the walking assisting robot device, the device is more portable and convenient to carry, mechanical assistance is adopted, gravity of the legs of a human body is sufficiently used for energy storage during walking, the battery is not used, environment friendliness is achieved, and the problem that the cost is too high due to the complexity degree of the structure is solved.

title: Humanoid robot head structure

title: Humanoid robot walking mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot walking mechanism. The first driven wheel and the second driven wheel are in transmission connection with the driving wheel through belts; two step lifting alternating mechanisms are arranged in the equipment box; the two step lifting rotation mechanisms are respectively connected with the first driven wheel and the second driven wheel; the utility model discloses a humanoid robot walking mechanism. title: Humanoid mechanical arm movement route planning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical arm movement route planning method and system. The method includes the steps that the start position and the target position of the to-be-moved space of ahumanoid mechanical arm are determined according to a D-H model of the humanoid mechanical arm; a sampling point of the to-be-moved space of the humanoid mechanical arm is explored through a rapidlyexploring random tree method, and in the exploring process, a random sampling point is determined through a bias probability sampling algorithm; and new node extension is conducted according to the determined random sampling point, and through combination with a new node, an extension random tree with the start position as a source and the target position as a terminal node is established. Finally, the route with the minimum total weight is found in all routes of the established extension tree, information of all nodes in the route with the minimum total weight is solved into joint angle information of humanoid mechanical arm movement through inverse kinematics, and the humanoid mechanical arm is made to move according to the joint angle information. By means of the humanoid mechanical armmovement route planning method and system, the search time can be saved, and the sampling point searching speed can be increased.

title: Self-propelled self-balancing picking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a self-propelled self-balancing picking robot. The robot comprises a robot main body (8); the robot is characterized in that a mechanical arm assembly (5) is arranged on the top of the robot main body (8), a mechanical grabber assembly (6) is arranged at an execution end of the robot arm assembly (5), a bolt-on hanging basket (7) is arranged at the front end of the robot main body (8), four walking components with three degrees of freedom are arranged on the lower portion of the robot main body (8), each walking component comprises a waist joint (4), a hip joint (3), aknee joint (2) and a foot (1), the waist joints (4) drive the hip joints (3), hip motors (35) on the hip joints (3) drive upper limbs (30), and the knee joints (2) drive lower limbs (20). title: Soft face skin and connection method of robot head shell and soft face skin
abstract: The invention discloses a soft face skin and a connection method of a robot head shell and the soft face skin. The connection method comprises the following steps that a plurality of connection pointsare marked on the soft face skin in advance; a driving connection point in the connection points is found out, and a connection base plate is arranged at the marked place of the driving connection point in the soft face skin; a perforated magnet is arranged on the surface of the connection base plate; connection rods are arranged on a plurality of driving units; the soft face skin is applied to the robot head shell, and the connection rods are embedded into holes of the perforated magnet and attached to the connection base plate through the magnetic force. By means of the connection method, the robot head shell is connected with and fixed to the soft face skin, meanwhile, the assembling and disassembling difficulty of the soft face skin is greatly lowered, the soft face skin of the robothead shell can be replaced more easily and conveniently, and the connection method can be widely applied to the field of humanoid robots.

title: Preparation method of conductive thermoplastic starch polymer and polymer-based humanoid soft finger with folding paper structure
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a conductive thermoplastic starch polymer and a polymer-based humanoid soft finger with a folding paper structure, belongs to the technical field of humanoid fingers, and aims to solve the problems that in an existing humanoid soft finger with the variable rigidity realized by utilizing a thermal phase change material, the variable rigidity responsespeed is low due to long response time of conversion from a glass state to a high-elasticity state, and the joint motion flexibility and the rigidity of the humanoid soft finger cannot be realized atthe same time. The polymer-based humanoid soft finger comprises a finger root, a metacarpophalangeal joint, a proximal phalanx, an interphalangeal joint, a middle phalanx, a finger tip joint, a distal phalanx, a strain restraint layer, a variable rigidity layer, a cooling layer and a contact layer, wherein each joint is provided with a U-shaped groove, and the outer side of each joint is wrappedwith Yoshimura line type folding paper; and three self-made conductive thermoplastic starch polymer plates are arranged at the bottom of the finger. The humanoid soft finger not only can realize rapidand active control of the rigidity of the phalanxes, but also can realize synchronous and passive adjustment of joint flexible motion and joint rigidity, and has the advantages of fast variable rigidity, high adaptability and flexibility in motion.

title: HUMANOID JOINT AND HUMANOID ROBOT ARM
abstract: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided are a humanoid joint capable of being recovered without structural damage in spite of an external shock, and a humanoid robot arm including the same. Here, the humanoid joint includes a first frame, a first socket, a second socket, a shaft, a first combination part, a second frame, an elastic tendon, a shock absorption part and a first power delivery part. The first frame is extended in one direction, and the first socket includes a first insertion groove placed at one end of the first frame and having an open upper part. The second socket includes a second insertion groove placed inside the first insertion groove and having an open upper part, and the shaft is installed independently from the first and second sockets. The shaft is inserted into the first combination part to be combined and includes a first ball inserted into the second insertion groove and rotated around the shaft. One end of the first frame is connected to the first combination part, and the elastic tendon pulls the shaft in the direction of the second insertion groove. The shock absorption part is installed between the first insertion groove and the second socket and absorbs a shock while being compressed when the second socket is moved. The first power delivery part delivers power to the first frame to enable the first frame to be folded or unfolded from the second frame.

title: Action figure and control method therof
abstract: Provided are an action figure and a control method thereof, which can control a posture of the action figure by using a user terminal. To this end, the action figure of the present application comprises: a body; a head portion extending upward from the body and capable of freely rotating at a predetermined angle; and a leg and arm portion including at least a pair of legs extending downward from the body and including feet each provided on ends thereof and arms extending from portions facing each on an upper portion of the body between the legs and the head portion and including hands each provided on ends thereof. The legs and arms each comprise: a first joint member extending from the body; a second joint member extending from an end of the first joint member to axially rotate; and a joint member disposed between an end of the second joint member and feet or arms. The body includes a control unit for storing power from an external power source, selectively communicating with the user terminal, and controlling the head portion and the leg and arm portion to be operated automatically or manually. The leg and arm portion includes a driving unit connected to the control unit and configured to designate, by operation signals of the control unit, a location on which the first joint member freely rotates, an angle at which the second joint member axially rotates on the end of the first joint member, and a location on which at least one of the feet or hands freely rotates.

The legs and arms each comprise: a first joint member extending from the body; a second joint member extending from an end of the first joint member to axially rotate; and a joint member disposed between an end of the second joint member and feet or arms. The body includes a control unit for storing power from an external power source, selectively communicating with the user terminal, and controlling the head portion and the leg and arm portion to be operated automatically or manually. The leg and arm portion includes a driving unit connected to the control unit and configured to designate, by operation signals of the control unit, a location on which the first joint member freely rotates, an angle at which the second joint member axially rotates on the end of the first joint member, and a location on which at least one of the feet or hands freely rotates.

title: Tactile humanoid hand based on nut-screw and tendon transmission
abstract: The invention relates to the field of bio-robot dexterous hand, in particular to a tactile humanoid hand based on nut-screw and tendon transmission. The tactile humanoid hand based on nut-screw and tendon transmission comprises 5 fingers, a palm plate, a wrist, a wrist support, a noseplate, a nut-screw mechanism group, a base, a rotating motor group, couplings and a tensioner group. The rotating motor group is fixedly installed on the base. The nut-screw mechanism group is coaxially arranged on the upper side of output shafts of the rotating motor group. The couplings are arranged between output shafts of the rotating motor group and the nut-screw mechanism group. The noseplate is arranged at the top end of the nut-screw mechanism group. The tensioner group is arranged between the noseplate and the nut-screw mechanism group in a surrounding manner. The wrist support is arranged at the top end of the noseplate, and the wrist is arranged at the top end of the wrist support. The palm plate is group on the top of the wrist. The five fingers are sequentially arranged at the top end of the palm plate. The tactile humanoid hand based on the nut-screw and tendon transmission realizes real-time change and transmission of the output force and output torque of the rotating motors, and the flexibility and adaptability of the grasping movement of the dexterous hand are improved.

title: Hydraulic biped robot independent of external power source
abstract: The utility model discloses a hydraulic biped robot independent of an external power source. The device comprises a small hydraulic pump station, a hip platform, an oil distribution group, a left legand a right leg, according to the utility model, the small hydraulic pump station is integrated on the hydraulic biped robot; by means of the hydraulic drive pump station, outdoor activities of the robot are not limited, the advantage that the robot is hydraulically driven to operate in the field can be well played, experiments prove that the pump station can provide enough pressure for normal walking of the robot, the robot can operate for 30 minutes under the full-load condition, and basic debugging and operating requirements are met; meanwhile, hydraulic oil of a small hydraulic pump station adopted by the robot is mainly injected into a pump station pipeline, an oil storage mechanism is mainly used for injecting the hydraulic oil, only a small amount of hydraulic oil is stored, and therefore the pump station is small in size and mass and can be conveniently integrated to the biped robot. In addition, after the pump station is integrated on the robot, a complete closed-loop system is formed, and disturbance of a connecting pipeline between the robot and an external pump station can be avoided during operation of the robot.

title: Upper body movement mechanism of humanoid robot

title: Wheeled humanoid robot with strong balance capability
abstract: The utility model discloses a wheel type humanoid robot with strong balance capacity. title: Robot teaching method for gymnastic sports
abstract: The invention provides a robot teaching method for gymnastic sports, and relates to the technical field of sports equipment. A robot can replace a person to carry out one-to-many gymnastic teaching, and the teaching quality is judged; and students with wrong actions are timely prompted to correct the actions. The method comprises the steps that S1, the humanoid robot makes gymnastic actions according to a pre-stored course; S2, the robot carries out image acquisition through CCD cameras at the eyes; S3, the robot identifies and analyzes acquired action images of the students, acquires action information of the students, compares the action information with standard actions in a database, and judges the overall consistency of the actions of the students and the correctness of the actions ofthe students; and S4, error prompting is carried out for the condition that the actions do not reach the standard. The technical scheme is suitable for the process of gymnastic teaching.

title: Bionic person oriented artificial muscle bidirectional driving mechanisms
abstract: The invention provides bionic person oriented artificial muscle bidirectional driving mechanisms. The driving mechanisms are divided into two types, namely a linear type and a U-shaped type; and the driving mechanism of each type comprises an external motor, an air bin, a piston, a gear, a rack, a movable metal strip and rubber strips. During working, the external motor is used for controlling theair pressure on the two sides of the air bin, and the pneumatic muscle connected with the driving mechanism is made to move by utilizing the air pressure difference between the air bin and the external environment; the pneumatic muscle drives the connected components to move; when the air pressure in the air bin is reduced, the pneumatic muscle generates tensile force; when the air pressure in the air bin is close to the outside, the pneumatic muscle is in a relaxed state; and when the air pressure is increased, the pneumatic muscle can generate thrust. According to the bionic person orientedartificial muscle bidirectional driving mechanism, the external motor is directly controlled, so that the bionic muscle has high response speed to accurately control the driving force; the two different types of driving mechanisms are suitable for different positions of the bionic person; and the external motor can be equipped according to the required power, and the flexibility is high.

title: Humanoid robot system based on cylinder
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot system based on a cylinder. The two ends of a waist first connecting part of an upper limb joint device are rotationally connected with a humeral support respectively, the humeral support is sequentially connected with a large arm connecting part, an universal joint and a small arm connecting part; the two ends of a waist first swinging air cylinder of a waist joint device are arranged on the waist first connecting part, the waist first swinging air cylinder is fixed on a waist second connecting part, the waist second connecting part is fixed on the rotating shaft of a waist second swinging air cylinder, the cylinder body of the waist second swinging air cylinder is fixed on a waist third connecting part, and the two sides of the waist third connecting part are rotationally connected with at least four waist cylinders respectively. The humanoid robot system has the advantages of compact structure, multiple degrees of freedom, multiple movementmodes, large movement space and range of motion.

title: Waterproof humanoid robot with projection drainage structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a waterproof humanoid robot with a projection drainage structure. The robot comprises a head, a robot body and a base which are sequentially connected from top to bottom.A groove is formed in the top of the head part; an antenna is fixed in the groove; a first drainage groove of a closed structure is formed in the groove. The edge of the orthographic projection of theantenna from top to bottom is overlapped with the first drainage groove; and the first drainage groove is used for draining water falling into the groove to the outside of the groove. And the grooveis convenient for accommodating and fixing the antenna. Water flowing from the top of the antenna to the groove and water directly falling into the groove can be discharged through the first drainagegroove. Therefore, water accumulation is effectively prevented, and the drainage function of the robot is improved.

title: Robot awakening system and initialization system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot initialization system which comprises a robot and a plurality of sensors. The robot is provided with a head, hands, a screen and a microprocessor; and the multiple sensors are arranged at the head, the hands and the screen respectively and electrically connected with the microprocessor. When the robot is charged completely, use information is transmitted to a user,the user receives the use information to touch one sensor of the screen, the hands and the head, the touched sensor generates and transmits an initial signal to the microprocessor according to the useinformation, the microprocessor executes an initialization program according to the initial signal and begins to check the multiple sensors and the screen, and then the robot is started and begins toact. The starting program can be completed just by arranging the sensors, and interaction and communication between the user and the robot are facilitated.

title: Hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with buffering function
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with a buffering function. The hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with the buffering function comprises a body support, hipjoint supporting frames arranged on the two sides of the body support, thighs hinged to the tail ends of the hip joint supporting frames, shanks hinged to the tail ends of the thighs and feet hingedto the tail ends of the shanks. Compared with the prior art, the hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with the buffering function has 12 DoF (each hip joint has 3 DoF, each knee joint has 1 DoF,and each ankle has 2 DoF), so that the motion flexibility is greatly improved; hydraulic drive is adopted, so that high loading capacity and disturbance resisting capacity are achieved; damper devices are adopted, so that compliance of motion is greatly improved; the Z-shaped feet are adopted and have a certain elastic energy storage function, the front part of each foot is furcate, and then walking has a certain complex land adaptability.

title: Biped walking robot with constant speed device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a biped walking robot with a constant speed device and a control method thereof. The biped walking robot with the constant speed device comprises the constant speed device, a rotating supporting shaft, a base frame and telescopic supporting legs; through rotating of the supporting legs, the walking of the walking robot is realized; the integral structure is simple and compact; and the turning radius is small. In addition, the invention further provides the control method of the biped walking robot with the constant speed device, by controlling relative motion between a longitudinal movement compensating device and a transverse movement compensating device of the constant speed device, a load above the constant speed device does constant speed motion relative to a geodetic coordinate system while the walking robot horizontally and stably moves on a road in the moving process; and therefore, problems of huge body and non-uniform load motion speed of an existing loading robot are solved.

title: Physiological parameter generating device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a physiological parameter generating device of a humanoid robot. According to the humanoid robot, conventional movement of a human body can be simulated in the humanoid robot through the breathing module and the steering engine module, and then physiological parameters of various forms are generated, for example, the breathing module can simulate expansion and contraction of the lung of the human body and mechanical movement of the thorax during breathing; the steering engine module can simulate actions of human body handholding, paper cup grabbing, bowing and the like. Thus, an effective means is provided for quality control and evaluation of a large number of health monitoring products, and monitoring of the products is more in line with actual human body conditions.

abstract: The utility model discloses a direct-drive humanoid finger convenient to control. title: Humanoid wrist structure convenient to control
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid wrist structure convenient to control. The auxiliary bevel gear shaft is perpendicular to the main bevel gear shaft, and the two main bevel gears and the auxiliary bevel gear are arranged in the gear box. title: Sensing system for wrist joint of humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model discloses a sensing system for a wrist joint of a humanoid dexterous hand, which comprises a wrist platform and a wrist joint driving mechanism, the wrist joint driving mechanism comprises a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear and a third bevel gear, and the first bevel gear, the third bevel gear and the second bevel gear are sequentially and orthogonally meshed; the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are arranged in a bilateral symmetry mode, the sides, opposite to each other, of the first bevel gear and the second bevel gear are each symmetrically connected with aY-direction transmission shaft, and each Y-direction transmission shaft is driven by a motor; each motor output shaft is provided with a torque sensor and a motor encoder; the third bevel gear is connected with an X-direction transmission shaft; and the X-direction transmission shaft is fixedly connected with the wrist platform. According to the utility model, the position, posture and torque information in the operation process of the humanoid dexterous hand can be reflected.

title: Wrist structure and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a wrist structure and a robot. title: Mechanical structure of humanoid biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a mechanical structure of a humanoid biped robot, which is characterized by comprising a head, a trunk, upper limbs and lower limbs. The head part is connected with the body through a steering engine fixing bracket; each single upper limb is composed of a shoulder joint, a big arm, an elbow joint, a forearm, a wrist joint and a hand, and the upper limbs and the trunk are connected through a shoulder joint rolling drive motor transmission shaft. Each single lower limb is composed of hip joints, thighs, knee joints, shanks, ankle joints and feet, and the lower limbs and the trunk are connected through hip joint rolling drive motor transmission shafts. The four limbs and the head are connected into a whole through the trunk, and a control assembly composed of a control panel, a steering engine driving plate and the like can be arranged in the trunk. title: Gas buffer type children education intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses a gas buffer type children education intelligent robot. title: Wire end tightening humanoid robot and using method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a wire end tightening humanoid robot and a using method thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a wire end gripping device, a moving device for driving the wire end gripping device and a guide fusing device, wherein the guide fusing device comprises an upper partition column, a lower partition column and a fusing device body, and a height difference is generated between the upper partition column and the lower partition column. In a first state, the upper partition column and the lower partition column can cooperate with at least one side plate to limit a wire from movingoutwards from the inside of the guide fusing device; in a second state, notches at same positions are formed in the upper partition column and the lower partition column so as to allow the wire to pass through; and the fusing device body can fuse the wire between the upper partition column and the lower partition column when the upper partition column and the lower partition column are in the first state. According to the scheme, manual work can be simulated to tighten wire ends, therefore, the wire end fixing firmness can be ensured, packaging tape is not required in use, and the cost is low. The wire is cut off by combining with a hot fusing way, the cutting requirements of various materials, such as metal, can be effectively met, the cutting stability is high, and the application rangeis wide.

title: Novel human exoskeleton active knee joint structure
abstract: The invention discloses a novel human exoskeleton active knee joint structure, comprising a thigh connecting mechanism, an intermediate driving mechanism, a crus connecting mechanism and a limiting straight rod, wherein the intermediate driving mechanism is located between the thigh connecting mechanism and the crus connecting mechanism, the thigh connection mechanism is connected with the crus connecting mechanism through the intermediate driving mechanism, and the limit straight rod is connected with the intermediate driving mechanism through a sliding pair. title: Control method, robot and computer storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control method, a robot and a computer storage medium. The control method is applied to the robot, and the robot comprises a head, hands, a trunk, legs, feet and a steering engine group, wherein the steering engine group at least comprises a first steering engine, a second steering engine, a third steering engine and a fourth steering engine. The control method comprisesthe following steps: detecting whether the robot prostrates on a plane or not; if the robot prostrates on the plane, controlling the third steering engine to rotate, enabling the head to lift until adistance between the head and the plane is equal to or smaller than a first preset distance; controlling the first steering engine and the second steering engine to rotate, and enabling the hand and the trunk part to rotate until the head is in contact with the plane; and controlling the four steering engine to rotate, and enabling the legs to rotate by taking feet as supporting points until the legs are perpendicular to the plane. The control method enables a robot stand-up process to be more flexible, and is higher in stability.

title: Ball kicking motion generating system and method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a ball kicking motion generating system and method of a humanoid robot. title: Rope-driven seven-freedom-degree humanoid manipulator based on parallel mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a rope-driven seven-freedom-degree humanoid manipulator based on a parallel mechanism. title: Two-way output arm integrated joint for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a two-way output arm integrated joint for a humanoid robot. The two-way output arm integrated joint is composed of a frameless torque motor, an electromagnetic safety brake, anabsolute value position sensor, a harmonic reducer, an output portion, bearings, bearing frames and a shell body. The frameless torque motor, the electromagnetic safety brake and the absolute value position sensor are mounted on a high-speed motor shaft. The harmonic reducer is connected with the high-speed motor shaft and a low-speed output shaft. The output portion is mounted on the low-speed output shaft. The bearings and the bearing frames are fixed into the shell body. A reduction gear, a sensing detection device and a braking device are integrated, and a special servo driver is adopted for drive. The structure is innovated and optimized, compared with existing products, the designed integrated joint can achieve two-way output, and the problems that due to single-port output, force bearing is not uniform, and a connecting manner is single are solved. The integrated joint is low in weight, small in size and large in bearing load and meets various performance indexes of arm movementof the humanoid robot.

The frameless torque motor, the electromagnetic safety brake and the absolute value position sensor are mounted on a high-speed motor shaft. The bearings and the bearing frames are fixed into the shell body. A reduction gear, a sensing detection device and a braking device are integrated, and a special servo driver is adopted for drive. The structure is innovated and optimized, compared with existing products, the designed integrated joint can achieve two-way output, and the problems that due to single-port output, force bearing is not uniform, and a connecting manner is single are solved. The integrated joint is low in weight, small in size and large in bearing load and meets various performance indexes of arm movementof the humanoid robot.

title: Leg walking control system of bionic robot
abstract: The invention relates to a leg walking control system of a bionic robot. The leg walking control system comprises the following steps that firstly, a first leg assembly lifts a corresponding leg, anda second leg assembly stands; secondly, the first leg assembly recovers to stand, and the second leg assembly pushes back; thirdly, the first leg assembly remains standing, and the second leg assemblylifts a corresponding leg; and fourthly, the second leg assembly recovers to stand, the first leg assembly pushes back, and the steps are circularly executed. The leg walking control system of the bionic robot can enable the legs of the bionic robot to imitate the posture similar to human walking, so that the bionic robot keeps balance and can walk forward stably, and the moving range is wider.

title: Educational robot
abstract: The present invention relates to an educational robot that includes a body which forms the main portion of the robot. The educational robot also includes a head mounted on the body which is capable of making human facial expressions. In addition, the educational robot includes a plurality of limbs that are capable of making human perceptible gesture. Further, the educational robot includes an interface housed in the body and allows the user to interact with the interface. In an example, the interface allows the user to select a multimedia content from a library of multimedia content. The educational robot includes an imaging device to capture an image of the user to identify the user. Further, the educational robot renders the multimedia content in an interactive and intuitive way.

title: Humanoid robot system

The humanoid robot system is composed of the air cylinder, a belt pulley, a connecting piece, a pneumatic muscle and spring combination, a connecting plate, a gas claw and the like. The swing cylinders are combined, the swing cylinders are in transmission combination with the belt, the gas claw drives the upper limb system, the pneumatic muscle and the spring combination body and the linear air cylinder drive the waist joint system, the linear air cylinder, the linear air cylinder and a rod structure to drive the lower limb system. title: Walking robot
abstract: The walking robot is a mobile robot. The walking robot moves in a bipedal manner. The bipedal movement of the walking robot is autonomous. The walking robot is a programmed device that: 1) can move in a bipedal fashion; 2) pick up and put down objects; 3) performs optical data processing functions such as avoiding objects during motion or identifying objects to pick up and put down; 4) performs speech recognition functions such as receiving spoken instruction; and, 5) responds to spoken instruction in an audible manner using a spoken language. The walking robot comprises a torso, a plurality of legs, a plurality of arms, and a helmet. The plurality of legs, the plurality of arms, and the helmet is attached to the torso. Both the plurality of legs and plurality of arms both rotate in the coronal plane, sagittal plane and the transverse plane.

title: Redundant series-parallel electro-hydraulic hybrid drive anthropomorphic mechanical leg
abstract: The invention discloses a redundant series-parallel electro-hydraulic hybrid drive anthropomorphic mechanical leg which comprises a hip joint module, a knee joint module, an ankle joint module, a soleand a six-dimensional sensor. The hip joint module is fixed to the body of the robot, the knee joint module is connected to the lower portion of a hip joint, the ankle joint is fixed to the knee joint module, the sole is fixed to the ankle joint, and the six-dimensional force sensor is fixed to the sole. The anthropomorphic mechanical leg overall mechanism has seven degrees of freedom, three degrees of freedom of hip joints, one degree of freedom of knee joints and three degrees of freedom of ankle joints, and accords with human motion degree of freedom distribution. The series-parallel hybrid mechanism gives full play to the advantages of series connection and parallel connection, has the advantages of being high in bearing capacity, small in motion inertia, good in dynamic characteristic and the like, has the position redundancy freedom degree, and is more flexible in motion compared with a non-redundancy mechanical leg.

abstract: The invention provides an under-actuated humanoid mechanical foot. And an elastic piece is also arranged between the front sole and the rear sole. Theunderactuated humanoid mechanical foot is simple in structure, under the combined action of the limiting protrusions and the arc-shaped limiting grooves, the rotation limit position existing betweentoes and the rear sole of a person can be simulated, and the simulation effect of the underactuated humanoid mechanical foot is better. title: Method for calculating dynamic model of 3D under-actuated biped robot on flexible ground
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a method for calculating a dynamic model of a 3D under-actuated biped robot on a flexible ground, which performs dynamic model calculation on both a single-foot support item and a biped support item of the 3D under-actuated biped robot on the flexible ground. Compared with a previous kinetic model calculation method, according tothe dynamic model calculation method provided by the invention, the ground flexibility is fully considered; the walking process of the robot is composed of a continuous single-foot phase and a non-transient biped phase in sequence, and a walking system is a segmented continuous dynamic system, so that the dynamic model of the 3D under-actuated biped walking robot is closer to the actual situation, and the actual application is facilitated.

title: Flexible humanoid hand
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible humanoid hand, and relates to the technical field of humanoid hands. The problems that an existing mechanical arm is complex in mechanical structure, large in mass,long in production cycle, high in manufacturing cost, large in energy consumption, a circuit is prone to age and potential safety hazards exist are solved. Every two adjacent knuckle-like structures in each finger-like structure are connected through a knuckle-like folding bending driver, and the knuckle-like folding bending driver at the root of each finger-like structure is connected with a palm-like structure; each knuckle-like folding bending driver is connected with an external air source feeding device through a gas guide pipe, so that bending or straightening at knuckles of the finger-like structures is realized; and each circular sector-shaped pneumatic structure communicates with a gas guide pipe, and the air guide pipes connect the circular sector-shaped pneumatic structures withthe external air source supply device, so that opening or closing at the joints of five finger-like structures is achieved. The flexible humanoid hand is used for reducing the overall weight of the flexible humanoid hand and enhancing the flexibility of the flexible humanoid hand.

title: Robot multi-joint self-adaptation compensation method based on perceptron model and stabilizing device
abstract: The invention relates to a robot multi-joint self-adaptation compensation method based on a perceptron model and a stabilizing device. The method comprises the steps that firstly, based on a robot inertial sensor and a gait generator, error data are obtained; secondly, the error data are input into the pre-built perceptron model, the perceptron model updates a network weighting parameter based onan associative learning strategy, and compensation value is calculated and output; and thirdly, based on the compensation value, a robot is subjected to motion compensation, and the compensation valueoutput by the perceptron model comprises hip joint compensation value, knee joint compensation value and ankle joint compensation joint. Compared with the prior art, the associative learning strategyis adopted, the network weighting parameter is updated through a supervisory Hebb learning rule, robustness is improved, self-adaptation control is achieved, compensation amount is dispersed to all joints, such as the ankle joint, the knee joint and the hip joint, of a leg, the joint loads are reduced, and the service life of a robot is prolonged.

title: Exoskeleton robot hydraulic drive system
abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton robot hydraulic drive system which includes an inner module, an outer module, a hip hydraulic cylinder and a knee hydraulic cylinder. The inner module includes amotor, a hydraulic pump, a fuel tank, a coupling and a first valve block, the fuel tank is located at the bottom of the first valve block, the motor is connected to the hydraulic pump through the coupling, and the motor is fixed in the first valve block. The outer module includes a valve-controlled motor, a reducer, a photoelectric code disc assembly, a rotary directional valve and a second valveblock, the valve-controlled motor, the reducer and the rotary directional valve are connected in sequence, the photoelectric code disc assembly is arranged on the rotary directional valve in a sleeving manner, the rotary directional valve is located on the second valve block, the hydraulic pump is fixed on the first valve block and is embedded in the second valve block, the valve-controlled motoris connected to the knee hydraulic cylinder, and the second valve block is connected to the hip hydraulic cylinder. The exoskeleton robot hydraulic drive system realizes human-machine gait coupling control, and achieves coordination between the human body and an exoskeleton.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot which comprises a robot body. The vision unit is used for scanning and recognizing an object surrounding the robot body. The voice conversation unit is used for receiving and analyzing external sounds, and carrying out voice replay according to the analyzed result. The action execution unit is used for controlling action of the robot body. The action balancing unit is used for controlling balance of the robot body when the action execution unit works. The communicating unit is used for updating data in the database in real time. The database is used for storing data and basic data generatedin the working process of all the units. title: Walking robot with two feet parallel to ground
abstract: The invention discloses a walking robot with two feet parallel to ground. The robot moves through a motor and a connecting rod. The robot comprises a trunk, servo motors and lower limbs which are muchlike some basic structures of a human body, and the robot is a humanoid biped walking robot. The trunk of the robot is box-shaped and is connected to the two lower limbs. The servo motors are mountedat joints of the robot. The two lower limbs are same in structure and are formed by two parallelogram mechanisms which are connected longitudinally. The technical scheme is as follows: by means of the characteristics of a parallelogram four-rod mechanism, two feet are parallel to the ground all the way in a walking process to fall to the ground stably, so that the walking stability of the robot is guaranteed.

According to the utility model, the bottom of the head shell is provided with the partial conical cover, the shoulder shell is welded with the upper conical butt joint shell and the lower conical butt joint shell, the chest shell is provided with the chest butt joint conical shell, and the head shell is in buttjoint with the shoulder shell and the chest shell through the sealing rubber pads after being in butt joint with the shoulder shell and the chest shell to form a closed shell, so that the interior canbe waterproof.

title: Humanoid robot walking mechanism
abstract: A humanoid robot walking mechanism relates to the field of robots and comprises a support, two walking units and a driving unit, and each walking unit comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a connecting plate, a mechanical leg and a mechanical sole located at the bottom of the mechanical leg; the driving unit comprises two crank assemblies installed on the support and a power assembly for providing power for the two crank assemblies to enable the two crank assemblies to rotate coaxially. According to the utility model, a hip joint is formed by the crank assembly; the deviceis formed by correspondingly connecting a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod and mechanical legs. The hip joint is connected with the knee joint through a connecting plate; on the premiseof keeping stability, the distance between the knee joint and the hip joint is correspondingly increased, so that the walking single-step length of the robot is increased, meanwhile, the walking mechanism is small in foot, the action flexibility of the robot is improved, and the adaptability of the foot to complex terrains is improved.

title: Humanoid robot mobile charging power supply
abstract: The utility model discloses a mobile charging power supply for a humanoid robot. title: Biped robot walking foothold planning method and apparatus based on speed control
abstract: The present invention relates to a biped robot walking foothold planning method and apparatus based on speed control. The method comprises: S1: obtaining target point world coordinates of a target point in a world coordinate system and a start orientation, a target orientation and a planned step number of a biped robot; S2: converting the target point world coordinates into target point defined coordinates in a defined coordinate system; and S3: calculating a target speed of biped robot walking according to the planned step number and the target point defined coordinates, obtaining an actual speed of biped robot walking through measurement, and using a PID controller optimized based on a fuzzy RBF neural network to make the actual speed of biped robot walking fit the target speed, to enable the biped robot to reach the target point and complete rotation from the start orientation to the target orientation. Compared with the prior art, the biped robot walking foothold planning method and apparatus based on speed control have advantages of efficiency, precision and the like.

title: Humanoid rescue robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot, in particular to a humanoid rescue robot which comprises a body shell, and a head shell is installed on the body shell. Two symmetrically distributed bionic upperlimbs are installed at the upper end of the body shell, two symmetrically distributed bionic lower limbs are installed at the lower end of the body shell, and hip steering engines are installed at the positions, at the upper ends of the bionic lower limbs, of the body shell through hip steering engine frames. An upper limb steering engine is mounted at the joint of the bionic upper limb and the body shell; and a lower limb steering engine is mounted at the top of the bionic lower limb. According to the utility model, the two bionic lower limbs move forwards and backwards alternately by utilizing the lower limb steering engine; the bionic upper limb part can also utilize the upper limb steering engine to finely adjust the balance of the robot, so that the whole humanoid rescue robot is driven to quickly move, and the control system controls the rotation of the upper limb steering engine and the lower limb steering engine according to the attitude data operation result of each bionic limb, so that the humanoid rescue robot walks more stably.

title: Two-joint robot finger with grabbing mode switching function
abstract: The invention discloses a two-joint robot finger with a grabbing mode switching function and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The two-joint robot finger is characterized by comprising a far finger segment, a near finger segment, a base, a motor I, a motor II, a shaft I, a shaft II, a wheel set I, a rope, a bearing wheel, a shaft III, a sliding table, a transmission part V, a wheel set II, a shaft IV, a fixed wheel, a shaft V, a lead screw, a sleeve wheel, a transmission part I, a transmission part II, a transmission part III, a sliding block and a transmission part VI. Through the displacement principle, the robot finger can be switched between the grabbing modes including the incomplete enveloping mode, the horizontal clamping mode and the stepless coupled mode. When grabbing an object, the robot finger is in an under-actuated mode and has the advantages of an under-actuated robot finger. When the robot finger is in the stepless coupled mode, the coupling degree of the finger can be changed according to the actual demands, and the two-joint robot finger can actively adapt to the shape and size of the object. The robot finger in the horizontal clamping mode can stably grab the object with a flat and long table top, and the grabbing range of the finger is enlarged.

title: Control system and control method for flexible exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention relates to a control system and control method for a flexible exoskeleton robot. The control system comprises inertial attitude sensors, a tension sensor, a main controller and a motor servo drive module, wherein the inertial attitude sensors are bound onto the thighs of a human body, and used for measuring the angle information of hip joints, and sending the angle information to themain controller by means of serial communication; the tension sensor is threaded into a pull rope, and used for measuring a tension signal on the pull rope, sending the tension signal to the main controller in the form of an analogue signal, and completing AD sampling on the main controller; the main controller comprises an FPGA module and a DSP processing module; the FPGA module communicates with the DSP processing module through an EMIF bus; and the motor servo drive module comprises an ARM servo controller, a three-phase inverter, a Hall current sensor and a brushless direct-current motor,and the brushless direct-current motor drives the joints of the human body to move by means of pull rope transmission, and provides auxiliary power for the human body. According to the control systemand control method for the flexible exoskeleton robot, the system reliability is improved, the control accuracy is increased, and the coordination and flexibility between exoskeleton man-machine systems are improved.

title: Optimal control method of gait of humanoid robot based on deep Q network
abstract: The invention discloses an optimal control method of a gait of a humanoid robot based on a deep Q network. The method comprises the steps of: constructing a gait model, and obtaining interaction databetween the humanoid robot and the environment during walking for providing training samples; performing learning and training on the deep Q network based on the training samples of a memory data poolto obtain a state-action strategy deep Q network model of the humanoid robot; obtaining state parameters of the humanoid robot in an action environment to serve as the input of the deep Q network model, and obtaining action parameters of the deep Q network model under the current state-action strategy; performing gait control on the humanoid robot by using the constructed gait model and accordingto the action parameters output by the deep Q network model; and achieving the purpose of updating the deep Q network in the training of the deep Q network model by generating an award function. By adopting the optimal control method disclosed by the invention, the walking speed of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the fast and stable walking of the humanoid robot can be realized.

title: Hip joint capable of simulating human-shaped doll
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid dolls, and discloses a hip joint capable of simulating a humanoid doll, which comprises a lumbosacral joint assembly, a hip joint assemblyand thigh assemblies, the lumbosacral joint assembly is provided with a left closing block and a right closing block, and the left closing block and the right closing block are positioned through a connecting column/hole and connected and fixed through a bolt. title: Mouth mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, in particular to a humanoid robot mouth mechanism which comprises a lip model, an upper jaw supporting plate and a jaw model, and the lip model and the upper jaw supporting plate are both arranged above the jaw model. Wherein the lip model comprises an upper lip, a lower lip and a lip corner, the upper lip is arranged above the lower lip, and the lip corner is connected between the upper lip and the lower lip; wherein the upper lip is connected with an upper lip driving mechanism, the lower lip is connected with a lower lip driving mechanism, the mouth corner is connected with a mouth corner driving mechanism, and the jaw model is connected with a jaw driving mechanism for driving the jaw model to rotate. title: Biped walking robot based on parallel mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped walking robot based on a parallel mechanism. The robot comprises a waist platform and two leg mechanisms symmetrically arranged and connected to the lower side of the waist platform, each leg mechanism comprises an upper platform, a lower platform and three telescopic cylinders hinged between the upper platform and the lower platform through universal joints, and the robot further comprises a steering mechanism installed on the waist platform and a sole mechanism installed at the bottom of each leg mechanism. According to the utility model, two three-degree-of-freedom leg mechanisms based on a parallel structure are driven by a single-degree-of-freedom waist driving motor; under the condition that the two legs are only provided with four degrees of freedom in total, the stable functions of straight moving, turning, obstacle crossing and stair climbing of the robot are achieved, and compared with an existing six-degree-of-freedom robot, the six-degree-of-freedom robot is simple in design structure, large in working space and high in effective load and self-weight ratio.

title: Teenager home tutoring robot
abstract: The invention provides a teenager home tutoring robot. The teenager home tutoring robot comprises a brain assembly, a neck assembly, an upper body assembly, a hand assembly, a hip assembly, a leg andfoot assembly, a health learning table board assembly, and a control system; and the APP operation interface of the robot is divided into five sections: robot action, home teacher, assisting living, parental care, and study table. The teenager home tutoring robot solves lots of homeschooling problems that teenagers are tutored by teachers after returning home, or parents are unable to tutor the teenagers after school, or the tutoring expense is too expensive for families. title: MODULAR GRAVITATIONAL ENERGY BELT (MGEB)
abstract: An energy scavenging device for increasing bi-pedal locomotion efficiency in powered exoskeletons, passive exoskeletons, & bi-pedal robots. The present inventive device, the modular gravitational energy belt (MGEB) includes a gravitational energy scavenging midsection which mechanically drives lower extremities. A double gear reduction drive unit is attached from the midsection to the upper-body for capturing gravitational potential energy generated via the shifting of upper body mass prior to each stride. This direct mechanical energy is then transferred via a bowden cable & tube system for driving lower extremities which are passively propped up in standing position with struts or springs. The method of mechanical energy transfer for lower extremities can be comprised of any well-known mechanical devices for transmitting mechanical force or energy. Placement of energy storage devices and drive train and other heavy mass components are preferably positioned in the upper half of the body where gravitational energy can be harvested.

title: Humanoid robot and head pitching control mechanism thereof
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot and a head pitching control mechanism thereof. The head pitching control mechanism comprises a head fixing piece (1) used for being fixedly connected with the head, a base (3) used for being fixedly connected with the neck, a driving device (4), a connecting rod (5), a sliding block (6) and a linear bearing (8). The base (3) is hinged to the head fixingpart (1), and the hinged axis of the base (3) and the head fixing part (1) is the rotating axis of the humanoid robot during head pitching. A cylindrical sliding shaft (61) is arranged at one end of the sliding block (6), the sliding shaft (61) is sleeved with the linear bearing (8), and the driving device (4) is used for driving the sliding block (6) to slide relative to the linear bearing (8). One end of the connecting rod (5) is hinged to the head fixing piece (1), and the other end is hinged to the sliding block (6). By adopting the head pitching control mechanism provided by the utility model, the rotating fulcrum of the head can be designed at the neck, and the rotation is ensured not to shake.
