title: Modular reconfigurable driving unit and flexible exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a modular reconfigurable driving unit and a flexible exoskeleton robot. The modular reconfigurable driving unit comprises a power assembly and a driving assembly, wherein the power assembly comprises a power shell and a motor arranged in the power shell, and the driving assembly comprises a driving shell, a main shaft, a clutch and a wire wheel; the driving shell is provided with a wire outlet hole, the main shaft is arranged in the driving shell, the main shaft is matched with the motor, and the motor can drive the main shaft to rotate; and the clutch is arranged in the shell, the clutch comprises a fixed part and a clutch part, the fixed part is connected to the main shaft, the wire wheel sleeves the main shaft, and the wire wheel is connected with the clutch part. The modular reconfigurable driving unit can realize the function of outputting a plurality of driving paths through a single motor, can simultaneously generate output forms of multiple driving paths, and meets the use requirements of multi-joint degree of freedoms of a human body. In addition, a holding electromagnet is capable of braking the wire wheel when the clutch part and the fixed part are disengaged.

title: Robot head moving device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot head moving device and a humanoid robot. title: Robot walking mechanism with mechanical unbalance prevention function
abstract: The utility model provides a robot walking mechanism with a mechanical unbalance prevention function, and aims to solve the problems that the foot landing area of a traditional humanoid robot is small, the posture of the robot is difficult to adjust, and unbalance is likely to happen at the rugged road surface position. title: Humanoid robot lower limb joint zero position calibration method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb joint zero position calibration method. title: Gait control method and control system of exoskeleton robot and exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides a gait control method and control system of an exoskeleton robot and the exoskeleton robot. The gait control method includes the steps: setting a step size and a step height, performing sample curve fitting so as to generate the plantar swing track of a swinging leg according to the step size and step height, using a trigonometric function relationship to calculate the hip joint swing angle and knee joint swing angle of the swinging leg according to the plantar swing track, and controlling the swinging leg to execute walking action according to the calculated angles. Theset gait conforms to the movement law of the human body, the appropriate plantar gait track can be planned for different individuals, and convenient adjustment can be achieved.

title: Three-dimensional attitude prediction method based on pseudo-image sequence evolution
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional attitude prediction method based on pseudo-image sequence evolution. The method comprises the following specific steps: step 1, inputting a joint point coordinate sequence; step 2, converting the joint point coordinate sequence into an image sequence, dividing a human body, and converting the image sequence to obtain a pseudo image sequence; step 3, constructing a sequence-to-sequence model, and predicting a future attitude sequence according to the pseudo-image sequence of the historical attitude; and step 4, outputting an articulation point coordinate sequence of the future attitude sequence. The invention provides a three-dimensional attitude prediction method based on pseudo-image sequence evolution. The method has (1) a new skeleton representation, and an attitude prediction problem being modeled as a video prediction problem; and (2) a new structure PISEP2, which predicts all future frames in a non-recursive manner, can effectively avoid error accumulation and improve the calculation efficiency.

title: Robotic mobility device and control
abstract: Robotic mobility assistant exoskeleton with frame members, which are attached adjacent to biological joints, supplements relative movement between skeletal members. Mechanical joint defines a center of relative rotation of frame members about three mutually perpendicular axes with the center of relative rotation of frame members being displaced from the outer surfaces of skeletal members to correspond in position with the center of biological joint. Actuation devices including powered cable springs rotate frame members. Control system executes calibrated user specific posture sequences and activates power. Mechanical joint exhibits cylindrical guide surfaces defining a slidable or rotatable connection of frame members and has a radius intersecting the center of the biological joint. Node control network distributes computing load and reduces communications overhead. Map unit has object recognition system for monitoring environment. Standard posture data derived from rules of ambulation and posture provide positioning control, optimized by energy-timed margins for balance maintenance.

title: Double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and single-leg structure
abstract: The invention discloses a double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and a robot single-leg structure. An ankle joint is arranged between a robot shank and a robot foot, a connecting rod is arranged on the back surface of the robot shank, and the tail end of the connecting rod is connected with a heel of the robot foot through a spring; the ankle joint is taken as a fulcrum of a lever, and thetension force of the spring and the gravity force of a robot are respectively positioned on two sides of the lever to form moments with opposite directions; and the gravity moment of the robot is balanced through the tension moment of the spring, so that the gravity center of the robot is restored to the balanced position of the robot. According to the double-foot robot ankle joint buffering device and the robot single-leg structure, the vibration of the robot caused by uneven ground can be buffered by arranging the spring; and through the contraction of the spring, when the gravity center isin an adjustable area, the robot has certain capability of automatically adjusting the posture to a stable standing state.

title: Robot dance file generation method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot dance file generation method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an expression animation for controlling the eye expression of a robot; analyzing the expression animation to obtain expression frames of the expression animation and a corresponding time axis; editing action frames matched with the expression frames according to the time axis, whereinthe action frames are used for controlling limb actions of the robot; and storing the expression frames and the matched action frames according to the time axis to generate a robot dance file. According to the invention, the expression frames and the corresponding time axis are obtained by analyzing the expression animation, then the action frames matched with the expression frames are edited according to the time axis, and the edited action frames and the expression frames are associated and stored according to the time axis, so that the robot dance file containing the expression frames and the matched action frames is obtained. Therefore, when the dancing file is executed by the robot, the expression frames and the action frames can be executed at the same time, so that eye expressions and limb actions of the robot are cooperatively carried out, and the richness and interestingness of dancing of the robot are improved.

title: Robot foot-waist coordination gait planning method and device, medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a foot-waist coordination gait planning method and device of a robot, a computer readable storage medium and the robot. The method comprises the steps that the foot posture angle of the biped robot is obtained, and the ankle joint position compensation amount of the biped robot is calculated according to the foot posture angle; acquiring a waist attitude angle of the biped robot, and calculating hip joint position compensation amount of the biped robot according to the waist attitude angle; calculating a hip-ankle position vector of the biped robot, wherein the hip-ankle position vector is a position vector from a hip joint to an ankle joint; compensating the hip-ankle position vector according to the anklejoint position compensation amount and the hip joint position compensation amount to obtain a compensated hip-ankle position vector; and inverse kinematics analysis is carried out on the compensatedhip and ankle position vector to obtain the joint angle of the biped robot, so that effective foot and waist coordination is realized, the accuracy of actions is improved, and various complex actionsare completed.

When the substrate is stressed to move downwards, the connecting rod is stressed to rotate, the second supporting arm is stressed to rotate, the second supporting arm drives the elastic assembly to be compressed or stretched in the rotating process, the elastic assembly provides buffering for rotation of the connecting rod in the stretching or compressing process, and the expansion buffering effect of the foot arch of the human foot is simulated. title: METHOD AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR CONTROLLING THE MOVEMENT OF A HUMANOID ROBOT OR OF A ROBOTIC ARM USING THE LEAST NUMBER OF DEGREES OF FREEDOM NECESSARY FOR THE EXECUTION OF A TASK AND COMPUTER-READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM THEREOF
abstract: It is disclosed a method (100) for controlling the movement of a humanoid robot or of a robotic arm. The method comprises the steps of: a) defining (102) a kinematic model of the robot or of the robotic arm, the model comprising a plurality of rigid segments connected by means of a plurality of joints; b) defining (103) at least one subtask to execute a task in Cartesian coordinates by means of the humanoid robot or robotic arm and defining at least one corresponding constraints group to be fulfilled during the execution of at least one sub-task; c) associating, to said at least one subtask and respective constraint, at least one priority level; d) calculating (105), by means of a quadratic programming, the values of the velocities of the plurality of joints for executing a sub-task and so as to fulfill the corresponding constraints group; e) adding (109), to the constraints group of said sub-task, a priority constraint comprising the values calculated of the velocities of the plurality of joints; f) calculating (110), by means of a linear programming, the final values of the velocity of the plurality of joints fulfilling said priority constraint.

title: Pneumatic humanoid robot system
abstract: The invention relates to a pneumatic humanoid robot system. The system adopts an air cylinder to drive the movement of hip joints, knee joints, foot joints, waist joints, shoulder joints, elbow jointsand wrist joints of a humanoid robot, and has a function of completely simulating joint movement of a person. The system is composed of a linear air cylinder, a swinging air cylinder, belt wheels, lead screws, bevel gears, toothed belts, toothed wheels and connecting pieces, the hip joints and the shoulder joints are driven by the swing cylinder through the belt wheels, the knee joints are drivenby the lead screws and the air cylinders in a combination manner, the foot joints are driven by a plurality of air cylinders, the elbow joints are driven by the swing cylinder, the wrist joints are composed of two groups of variable-distance swing parts and an air cylinder parallel mechanism, the hip joints, the knee joints, the foot joints, the waist joints, the shoulder joints, and the elbow joints and the wrist joints have 2, 1, 4, 6, 2, 1, 4 degrees of freedom correspondingly and a total of 34 degrees of freedom. According to the pneumatic humanoid robot system, a cylinder and cylinder combination driven are adopted, the system has the characteristics of large stroke, large working space and compact structure, and can be used for teaching and demonstration.

title: Collision drop-resistant robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a collision drop-resistant robot and a control method thereof, and relates to a robot and a control method thereof. The robot is provided with robot movement joints which are the same as the movement joints of a human body; a control system comprises a tilt angle sensor and a single chip microcomputer; and the single chip microcomputer comprises a signal acquisition unit, astorage unit, a central controller, a power supply management unit and a drive unit. The method comprises the following steps: the robot acquires the standard tilt angle value of each robot movementjoint and stores the standard tilt angle value in the storage unit after installation and debugging are completed; during the running of the robot, the tilt angle sensor acquires the tilt angle valueof each joint in real time and compares the tilt angle value with the standard tilt angle value; when a deviation exceeds a threshold value, a movement execution module is immediately controlled to adjust the robot to return to a standing and squatting state; and then a power supply of the movement execution module is turned off through a power supply management unit, and the robot stops and keepsthe squatting state. According to the collision drop-resistant robot and the control method thereof, the robot can be prevented from collision drop, and the workload of maintenance personnel can be reduced; and the collision drop-resistant robot is reliable in performance, simple in structure, low in cost, and easy to popularize and use.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of robots, in particular to a biped robot, which comprises two groups of adsorption components and three groups of driving joint components arranged between thetwo groups of adsorption components. The driving joint assembly is provided with a motor, the motor is rotationally connected to the adsorption assembly, and an adsorption block is arranged on the adsorption assembly. According to the utility model, the adsorption block is adopted, so that elevated iron walls such as iron walls and iron rods can be effectively adsorbed; each driving joint assemblyis directly driven by a motor, so that the transmission is simple and effective, and the movement is convenient and flexible; the robot is arranged to be of a double-leg type and a linear type, can be switched by driving the joint assemblies, can effectively cross a large obstacle during movement, can move forwards like worms, and can also quickly walk for a pipeline with a small inner wall; meanwhile, eight-degree-of-freedom bending adjustment can be achieved, and work with higher difficulty can be completed; waterproof and anti-corrosion effects are achieved, and the machine cannot be polluted by seawater, sewage and chemicals during working.

title: Method for generating target detection football candidate point of Nao robot based on Heatmap
abstract: The invention relates to a method for generating a target detection football candidate point of a Nao robot based on a Heatmap. The method comprises the steps of selecting a convolutional neural network as a target detection model; simulating competition environments, collecting a plurality of groups of pictures to make a data set for training and testing, generating a Heatmap, processing to obtain a Heatmap visualization result, reconstructing the convolutional neural network to accelerate the network calculation speed, setting a proper threshold value, taking points greater than the set threshold value in the Heatmap as candidate points of a ball, and finally sending the candidate points into a classifier to obtain a final accurate identification result. According to the method, the adaptive capacity of the Nao robot vision system to the light environment of the competition field is enhanced; high-precision recognition of the football can be achieved in different light environments;feature extraction is completed through few convolution layers; the recognition real-time performance is guaranteed; and meanwhile the football recognition accuracy is greatly improved through the method that football candidate points are generated and then enter the classifier to be recognized.

title: Humanoid robot experiment system
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid robot experiment system. title: Robot joint drive mechanism, robot lower limb and foot type humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot joint drive mechanism, a robot lower limb and a foot type humanoid robot. According to the scheme mainly adopted, the robot joint drive mechanism comprises a first joint piece, a second joint piece and at least one linear driver; the second joint piece and the first joint piece are connected to form a robot joint; each linear driver is provided with a first end anda second end which are oppositely arranged, wherein the first end of the linear driver is connected with the first joint piece, the second end is connected with the second joint piece, and accordingly under driving of the linear driver, the angle of the joint is adjusted; and a triangular electric drive structure is formed among the first joint piece, the second joint piece and each linear driver. The robot lower limb comprises the robot joint drive mechanism. The foot type humanoid robot comprises the robot lower limb. The robot joint drive mechanism, the robot lower limb and the foot type humanoid robot are mainly used for increasing the energy efficiency ratio of the robot joint drive mechanism and reducing the manufacturing cost of the foot type robot, and industrial and large-scale application of the large foot type robot is achieved.

title: Double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot
abstract: A double-leg and double-wheel composite motion robot comprises a trunk part, two mechanical legs and two mechanical arms, wherein the trunk part comprises a trunk and a crotch, the trunk and the crotch are connected through a rotary joint, and a trunk-crotch hydraulic cylinder is connected between the trunk and the crotch; the two mechanical legs are arranged on the two sides of the crotch, each mechanical leg is connected with the crotch through a rotary joint, and a driving wheel is installed at the bottom end of each mechanical leg; and the two mechanical arms are arranged on the two sidesof the trunk and connected with the trunk through rotary joints. The robot has the vertical walking and jumping capacity of a biped robot and the high moving speed of a wheeled robot. Meanwhile, the mechanical arms can achieve the functions of grabbing, carrying and the like; when the robot walks on a flat road surface, the robot can be driven by the driving wheels to move, the advancing speed isincreased, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved; when the robot needs to cross obstacles, the robot can play the advantages of a biped motion mode, and the functions of jumping, squatting, landing buffering and the like are achieved.

By means of the scheme, the robot can have high impact resistance, and the requirements for manufacturing and installing precision are not high.

title: Hip joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to a hip joint structure and a humanoid robot. In the hip joint structure, the mounting positions of ahip rotation driving piece and a hip side driving piece which are heavy are raised to a hip joint framework, the hip joint framework is driven to rotate through the hip rotation driving piece, powerof the hip side driving piece is transmitted to a thigh through a hip side transmission assembly to enable the thigh to move, and therefore, the weight and rotational inertia of the whole structure are reduced, the gravity center of the robot is effectively increased, and power needed by the hip joint is effectively reduced. The humanoid robot adopts the hip joint structure. The rotational inertiaof the hip joint structure is reduced, so that the power required by the hip joint structure is effectively reduced.

title: Biped robot and navigation positioning method and device thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a navigation positioning method of a biped robot, which comprises the steps of determining a first coordinate of a positioning point of the robot in a positioning point coordinate system projected to a central axis coordinate system of the robot; projecting the first coordinate of the positioning point projected in the central axis coordinate system of the robot to a predetermined two-dimensional plane to obtain a second coordinate and a course angle of the positioning point of the robot in the two-dimensional plane; obtaining an average coordinate in a robot swing period corresponding to the second coordinate; and determining a navigation point of the robot according to the average coordinate of the second coordinate and the course angle of the positioning point, and performing robot navigation planning according to the navigation point. The navigation point of the robot is determined according to the average coordinate and the course angle of the positioning point, so that the vibration of the positioning point of the robot can be effectively filtered, the accuracy of the navigation point can be effectively improved, the navigation rules of the biped robotcan be conveniently unified to an ROS navigation framework, the code utilization efficiency is improved, and the manpower and material resource cost can be saved.

title: Hand and foot combined device for walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to a hand and foot combined device for a walking robot. When the device is used as a mechanical hand for grabbing objects, under the drive of a motor for a driving push rod, three knuckles can be in fit with the upper portion, middle and lower portion of an object in sequence, clamping and wrapping for the object are realized, finger grabbing assemblies of an under-actuated structure can adaptively grab objects with different shapes and sizes, the structure is simple, and the cost is low. A lifting disc changes a junction point position through axial movement, the size ofan enveloping pace among the three finger grabbing assemblies can be changed, and the object grabbing adaptability and flexibility of the robot are better. When the device is used as supporting legsto be supported on the ground, wrist joint driving mechanisms are used as upper supports of legs and can drive finger mechanisms to rotate so as to adjust the operation posture, and the lower ends oflead screws can make contact with the ground to be used as feet of the supporting legs; the lifting adjusting disc is adjusted downwards, and the finger grabbing assemblies are driven outwards to be unfolded, the third finger knuckle can make contact with the ground to complete auxiliary supporting, and operation ability of the robot is improved.

title: Driving system for tendon transmission humanoid dexterous finger joints
abstract: The invention discloses a driving system for tendon transmission humanoid dexterous finger joints. title: Robot and control method and computer storage medium thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a control method and a computer storage medium thereof. The method comprises the following steps that data information of a robot in a teaching process is acquired;the data information is taken as a training sample, and input into a pre-established control model to train the control model; the system stability of the robot is judged based on the trained controlmodel; if the system is stable, the robot is controlled by using the control model; and if the system is unstable, return to the step of acquiring the data information of the robot in the teaching process. By means of the method, the precision loss of the model can be reduced, the stability of the system is improved, and the reoccurrence precision of humanoid motion of the robot is improved.

title: Singular-avoiding gait planning method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to a singularity-avoiding gait planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps of acquiring the waist posture and the foot posture of the biped robot; calculating a first position vector according to the waist pose and the foot pose, wherein the first position vector is a hip joint position vector in an ankle joint coordinate system; calculating a scaling factor corresponding to the first position vector; if the scaling factor meets a preset singularityjudgment condition, adjusting the first position vector according to the scaling factor to obtain a second position vector; and performing inverse kinematics analysis on the second position vector toobtain each joint angle of the biped robot. According to the embodiment of the invention, on the basis of the prior art, the consideration of a singular problem is added, and the possible singular problem is effectively avoided through the adjustment of the hip joint position vector.

title: Industrial robot system based on voice control
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent control, and discloses an industrial robot system based on voice control. The industrial robot system comprises a sound collecting module for collecting audio information, a central processor, a control module, a power module and a communication module. The central processor is electrically connected with the sound collecting module and used for achieving data analysis and processing. The control module is electrically connected with the central processor and used for controlling the head, trunk and four limbs of a robot. The power module is electrically connected with the central processor, sends out a control signal to a driving module through a controller and then decides the motion mode and motion speed of the robot. The communication module is electrically connected with the central processor, carries out communication through a 4G network and joins in power line carrier communication according to the development degree of a smart power grid. The robot can be remotely controlled through voice data, the robot and the virtual reality technology are combined, the circuit structure is simple, cost is low, maintenance is convenient, and the safety and reliability of a circuit are high.

title: Similarity measurement-based mechanical arm humanoid motion demonstration method
abstract: The invention discloses a similarity measurement-based mechanical arm humanoid motion demonstration method. According to the method, the angle of an elbow joint of a bent human arm is obtained; the elbow joint of a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is defined through the similarity measurement of a human arm and the mechanical arm; the other joint angles of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm are calculated; and humanoid motion is achieved. With the method adopted, operation can be simplified; the humanoid motion of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm with the undetermined joint number and joint length is achieved; and a calling program is packaged into a function module, so that the method is suitable for most robot platforms, and therefore, the universality of the robots is improved.

title: Simulation robot system suitable for automobile driving behavior research
abstract: The invention relates to a simulation robot suitable for automobile driving behavior research. The simulation robot comprises a head, two arms, a torso, hands, a flexible actuator and a motion controller of the simulation robot, a control host and a power supply system, so that the function of simulating human action and expression in a specified environment is realized; the action expression simulation is realized based on the control of the flexible actuator, and each joint part of the simulation robot adopts the flexible actuator to drive a skeleton structure; and the motion controller receives action control signals of an upper computer to control the action of the flexible actuator of each joint part. The head can realize actions of eyelid opening and closing, eyeball rotation, mouthopening and closing, head raising and head lowering and / or head left-right rotation, the two arms can realize waving of arms, the torso can realize the rotation of a body, and the hands are providedwith a plurality of degrees of freedom and can achieve the functions of grabbing objects and/or holding a steering wheel by the hands.

title: Connecting rod device suitable for controlling and limiting joint freedom degree of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a connecting rod device suitable for controlling and limiting the degree of freedom of joints of a humanoid robot. The device is composed of four connecting rods forming aparallelogram structure, spherical hinges of four connecting points of a parallelogram and rotating and sliding connection in the direction perpendicular to the midpoints of all sides of the parallelogram, and the device is characterized in that the device can rotate in a three-dimensional space and can also control the rotating amplitude of the device. Twisting of a robot or an exoskeleton jointcan be achieved, meanwhile, the rotating amplitude of the joint can be restrained, stable and reliable connection is achieved, and the effects of vibration reduction and vibration isolation are achieved.

title: Carrying device for test of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a carrying device for a test of a humanoid robot. The clamping grooves are connected with the clamping strips in a sliding manner; the clamping strip is fixed to the side face of the cylindrical pipe. title: TERRAIN AWARE STEP PLANNING SYSTEM
abstract: A method for terrain and constraint planning a step plan includes receiving, at data processing hardware (36) of a robot (10), image data (17) of an environment (8) about the robot from at least one image sensor (31). The robot includes a body (11) and legs (12). The method also includes generating, by the data processing hardware, a body-obstacle map (112), a ground height map (116), and a step-obstacle map (114) based on the image data and generating, by the data processing hardware, a body path (510) for movement of the body of the robot while maneuvering in the environment based on the body-obstacle map. The method also includes generating, by the data processing hardware, a step path (350) for the legs of the robot while maneuvering in the environment based on the body path, the body-obstacle map, the ground height map, and the step-obstacle map.

title: Socially assistive robot
abstract: A companion robot is disclosed. In some embodiments, the companion robot may include a head having a facemask and a projector configured to project facial images onto the facemask; a facial camera; a microphone configured to receive audio signals from the environment; a speaker configured to output audio signals; and a processor electrically coupled with the projector, the facial camera, the microphone, and the speaker. In some embodiments, the processor may be configured to receive facial images from the facial camera; receive speech input from the microphone; determine an audio output based on the facial images and/or the speech input; determine a facial projection output based the facial images and/or the speech input; output the audio output via the speaker; and project the facial projection output on the facemask via the projector.

title: Profiling finger of anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a profiling finger of an anthropomorphic robot, which at least comprises two knuckles, namely a fingertip and a finger root, and a traction rope fixing block is fixedly arranged in the fingertip; the upper portion of the traction rope fixing block is fixedly connected with one end of an upper fingertip traction rope, and the upper fingertip traction rope extends to thefinger root from the fingertip. The lower portion of the traction rope fixing block is fixedly connected with one end of a lower fingertip traction rope, and the lower fingertip traction rope extendsto the finger root from the fingertip. And the upper fingertip traction rope and the lower fingertip traction rope are arranged in parallel up and down. According to the five-finger linkage gripping device, synchronous stretching and bending actions of all joints of fingers can be achieved, and therefore five-finger linkage gripping is completed.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom thigh assembly of anthropomorphic robot and anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a two-degree-of-freedom thigh assembly of an anthropomorphic robot, which comprises a right thigh Z-axis rotating main structural member, the lower part of the right thighZ-axis rotating main structural member is fixedly sleeved with a thigh output gear, and the thigh output gear is connected with a thigh driving motor through a thigh Z-axis gear set; the thigh outputgear is arranged in the right thigh gear box body; the upper end of the right thigh gear box body is hollowly sleeved at the lower part of the right thigh Z-axis rotating main structural component; and the lower end of the right thigh gear box body is fixedly connected with the upper end of the right thigh framework. The two-degree-of-freedom hip joint has the upper-section rotational degree of freedom and the lower-section rotational degree of freedom, the two-degree-of-freedom hip joint can have the Z-direction rotational degree of freedom through the upper-section rotational degree of freedom, and the thigh can rotate through the lower-section rotational degree of freedom. title: Humanoid five-finger-shaped mechanical gripper
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid five-finger-shaped mechanical paw which comprises a palm and five mechanical fingers of the same structure, and the specific structure of each finger comprises an air cylinder, an air cylinder push rod, a rack, two near-base joint plates, a gear, a near-base joint shaft, a first belt wheel, two middle joint plates, a middle joint shaft, a second belt wheel, athird belt wheel, a tail joint, a tail joint shaft and a fourth belt wheel. The mechanical gripper is simple in structure; manufacturing cost is low, a pneumatic system is used as a driving mode; gear racks and belt transmission are adopted as a transmission mode. The gear and rack mechanism converts linear motion of an air cylinder push rod into rotary motion of a proximal joint shaft, the proximal joint is in transmission connection with the middle joint through a belt, the middle joint is in transmission connection with the tail joint through a belt so that the rotary motion of all the joints can be associated, reliability is high, and flexible grabbing of objects and multi-number expression are achieved.

title: Walking robot execution device with walking and object taking combined functions
abstract: The invention relates to a walking robot execution device with walking and object taking combined functions. When the device is used as a mechanical arm to grab an object, under the driving of a motorto a driving push rod, three knuckles can be sequentially attached to the upper portion, the middle portion and the lower portion of the object, and clamping and wrapping of the object are achieved.Finger grabbing assemblies of an under-actuated structure can grab objects of different shapes and sizes in a self-adaptive manner. In addition, the structure is simple and compact, the weight is low,and the cost is low. A lifting adjusting disc can change the size of an enveloping space among the three finger grabbing assemblies, so that a robot is higher in adaptability and flexibility when grabbing the object. When the device is used as a supporting leg to be supported to the ground, a wrist joint driving mechanism is used as the upper portion of the leg, a finger mechanism can be supported and driven to rotate to adjust the posture during work, the lower end of a lead screw can make contact with the ground to be used as a foot of the supporting leg, the lifting adjusting disc is adjusted downwards, the finger grabbing assemblies are driven outwards to be unfolded, a third finger joint makes contact with the ground to form auxiliary supporting, and the motion stability of the robotduring work is improved.

title: Biped robot motor driving system and intelligent temperature protection method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot motor driving system and an intelligent temperature protection method. According to the motor driving system, the temperatures of key devices such as a motor, a power switch tube, a bus electrolytic capacitor and the like are detected, and after the temperatures reach a first temperature threshold value, the maximum output power of the motor is controlled so as to inhibit the further increase of the temperatures of the key devices; and after the temperatures reach a second temperature threshold value, temperature fault information is sent to a biped robotcentral controller, so that a biped robot stops the current task so as to ensure the reliability of the motor and the motor driver. According to the motor driving system and the intelligent temperature protection method, the reliability of the lightweight motor driving system can be improved, and the flexibility and the endurance of the biped robot are expected to be further improved.

title: Motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure and a working method thereof. The walking structure comprises a hip skeleton, a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton and a foot plate. The upper end of the thigh skeleton is movably connected with the hip skeleton through hip joints; the lower end of the thigh skeleton is movably connected with the shank skeleton through knee joints; and the lower end of the shank skeleton is movably connected with the foot plate through ankle joints. A first motor assembly is installed on the thigh skeleton, the output end of the first motor assembly is fixedly connected with a crank, the crank is hinged to the upper end of a connecting rod, and the lower end of the connecting rod is hinged to the upper portion of the shank skeleton. The motor drives the knee joints to rotate through a four-connecting-rod mechanism and thus stable walking of the lower limbs of the biped robot is realized, so that a problem that the inertia of legsis large because the motor is directly installed at the knee joint is solved; timely response of shanks and feet is achieved, the response speed of foot ends can be remarkably increased, and installation and debugging are convenient.

title: Robot with self-locking structure and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a robot with a self-locking structure and a control method thereof, and relates to a robot and a control method thereof. The robot comprises a robot body with multiple degreesof freedom and a control system, wherein limbs of the robot body are provided with robot motion joints consistent with human motion joints, and each joint motor, each head control motor and each limbcontrol motor of the robot body are all self-locking motors. The method comprises the following steps that all the motors are in a self-locking state after the robot runs and is powered on; when a main motor rotates forwards, a pawl A is closed, a pawl B is opened, and when the main motor of the self-locking motor rotates reversely, the pawl A is opened, and the pawl B is closed; and after the robot returns to the zero point, all the motors are automatically locked. According to the robot and the control method, the problem that the motors are burnt out by manually pulling the joints when therobot is in a power-on state and stays still or the motors are damaged due to reverse manual pulling in the reverse rotation process of the robot motors can be solved, and the robot has the characteristics of good safety, high intelligent degree, simple structure and low cost, and is easy to popularize and use.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. According to the method, foot-endstress information of the robot is obtained; a zero moment point of the mass center of a body of the robot is worked out according to the foot-end stress information; the position trajectory of the robot is updated according to the zero moment point of the mass center of the body, and then an updated position of the mass center of the body is obtained; pose information of the robot is obtained; the pose trajectory of the robot is updated according to the pose information, and then an updated pose angle is obtained; inverse kinematic analysis is performed on the updated position of the mass center of the body and the updated pose angle, and all joint angles of legs of the robot are obtained; and the robot is controlled to move according to all the joint angles, and the stability of the robot during travelling is greatly improved.

title: Direct drive type humanoid biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a direct drive type humanoid biped robot, including two groups of symmetrical single-leg structures, wherein the single-leg structure comprises a two-degree-of-freedom hip jointthigh structure, a thigh and shank structure containing a single-degree-of-freedom knee joint and an under-actuated ankle joint structure; the two-degree-of-freedom hip joint thigh structure is connected with the thigh and shank structure containing the single-degree-of-freedom knee joint; and the thigh and shank structure containing the single-degree-of-freedom knee joint is connected with the under-actuated ankle joint structure. title: Humanoid elbow joint type robot variable stiffness joint
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a humanoid elbow joint type robot variable stiffness joint. The humanoid elbow joint type robot variable stiffness joint comprises a large arm, a small arm and a variable stiffness unit. The variable stiffness unit comprises an input shaft, a connecting frame and an output disc. The input shaft is connected with the connecting frame. Alead screw is arranged in the middle of the connecting frame, and input support rods are arranged on the two sides of the connecting frame. Two screw nuts which are opposite in the threaded directions are arranged on the lead screw. Two pulley frames are arranged on each input support rod. The pulley frames are fixedly connected with the corresponding screw nuts. Output support rods are arrangedon the two sides of the output disc. Two sliding blocks are arranged on each output support rod. Pulleys are arranged at the two ends of each pulley frame. Each pulley and the corresponding sliding block which are located on the same side are connected through a steel wire rope. A spring is arranged between the two sliding blocks of each output support rod in a sleeved manner. The output disc is connected with the small arm through an output connecting piece. A posture driving mechanism is arranged in the large arm, a stiffness adjusting mechanism is arranged in the small arm, the input shaftis driven to rotate through the posture driving mechanism, and the lead screw is driven to rotate through the stiffness adjusting mechanism. The humanoid elbow joint type robot variable stiffness joint can actively realize joint stiffness adjustment.

title: Vibration suppression method of humanoid flexible joint arm
abstract: The invention provides a vibration suppression method for a humanoid flexible joint arm. A control method based on virtual damping and inertia parameters is adopted, and the invention relates to the field of humanoid flexible arm control. The method comprises the following steps that: the problem that the system damping of a flexible joint is reduced due to introduction of a flexible element, so that the vibration time of the joint in the movement process is prolonged is solved, a joint driving equation is equivalent to a general form of a driving motor motion equation, a control strategy withthe introduction of virtual damping and inertia parameters is provided, a flexible joint control equation based on the virtual damping and inertia is established, and the purpose of shortening the vibration time in the acceleration and deceleration process of a flexible joint system is achieved by correspondingly changing the virtual inertia and damping parameters. Compared with other vibration suppression methods, the method has the advantages that on the premise of not increasing an additional hardware structure and a complex algorithm, the purpose of rapid attenuation of vibration of a flexible arm is achieved, the vibration suppression effect is achieved, and the adaptability and practicability of a humanoid flexible arm are improved.

title: Profiling hand of anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a profiling hand of an anthropomorphic robot, which comprises a palm and a finger assembly, and the palm part of the palm is fixedly connected with the palm part of the finger assembly; finger tips of the finger assemblies are connected with the upper-layer pulling plate through upper fingertip pulling ropes. title: Biped robot bionic foot capable of improving walking stability and gait naturalness
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot bionic foot capable of improving walking stability and gait naturalness, which is characterized in that firstly, a heel rubber non-slip mat touches the ground, and elastic deformation of a heel damping spring and a shape structure of a heel component plays a role in buffering; the toe rubber non-slip mat touches the ground; the thickness of the second bionic arch on the outer side is smaller than that of the first bionic arch on the inner side. The outer side bionic arch with lower rigidity firstly generates elastic deformation; along with the rise ofthe height of the outer side foot arch supporting piece; the inner side foot arch supporting piece begins to bear large acting force to generate upward displacement, the inner side bionic foot arch begins to generate elastic deformation, at the moment, the inner side bionic foot arch and the outer side bionic foot arch play a role in buffering at the same time, the variable rigidity interval of the whole bionic foot arch becomes large, and effective absorption of different impacts can be better completed. Finally, the bionic foot approaches the step that the tiptoe gets away from the ground, at the moment, the toe component rotates around the pin shaft, and the stretching effect of the first spring restores to the original state.

title: Anthropomorphic robot capable of realizing biped upright walking
abstract: The anthropomorphic robot capable of achieving double-foot upright walking comprises a trunk framework, a waist, a right leg and a left leg, the waist is connected with the trunk framework through a waist rotating platform, and the left side and the right side of the waist are connected with the left leg and the right leg through two-degree-of-freedom hip joints respectively. The lower portion ofthe trunk framework is fixedly connected with a waist rotating platform of the waist, the waist rotating platform is driven by a waist rotating mechanism to rotate, and therefore the trunk framework can be driven to rotate around the Z axis, and the waist Z-axis rotating freedom degree is achieved. An X-axis driving motor of the hip joint drives a hip joint ball to rotate around the X axis througha hip joint straight gear set, and the degree of freedom of hip joint X-axis rotation is achieved. The Y-axis driving motor achieves vertical reversing from X-axis rotation to Y-axis rotation througha bevel gear pair, and drives the tail end connecting flange to rotate around the Y-axis through the planet gear speed reducing mechanism, so that the Y-axis rotational freedom degree of the hip joint is achieved. Due to the 13 degrees of freedom, the upright walking posture of the robot can highly simulate the action of human beings.

abstract: The two-degree-of-freedom hip joint of the anthropomorphic robot comprises a hip joint ball, the hip joint ball is fixedly connected with a hip joint X-direction tail end large gear of a hip joint straight gear set along the X axis, and the input end of the hip joint straight gear set is connected with an X-axis driving motor. title: Waist rotating mechanism of anthropomorphic robot and anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The waist rotating mechanism of the anthropomorphic robot comprises a waist rotating driving motor, the waist rotating driving motor is connected with the input end of a waist straight gear set, and an output gear of the waist straight gear set is fixedly connected with a waist rotating platform. title: Motion imitation method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an action simulation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an action image of a simulated object; processing the action image by using a pre-trained convolutional neural network to obtain a position coordinate set corresponding to theaction image, wherein the position coordinate set comprises two-dimensional position coordinates of each human body joint point; calculating each joint angle of the simulated object according to the position coordinate set corresponding to the action image; and controlling the robot to move according to each joint angle of the simulated object. According to the embodiments of the invention, each joint angle of the simulated object can be obtained only by analyzing and processing the image acquired by a common camera without the help of a high-precision depth camera, and the robot is controlledto move according to the joint angles, so required cost is greatly reduced, and the robot can be popularized and used in a larger range.

title: Vibration suppressing method for humanoid flexible joint arm under variable load conditions
abstract: The invention provides a vibration suppressing method for a humanoid flexible joint arm under variable load conditions, adopts a control method based on load moment increment compensation of a joint motion equation, and belongs to the field of humanoid flexible arm control. The method includes the following steps: aiming at the problem of joint vibration during motion caused by load sudden changeof the humanoid flexible joint arm, proposing the control method of load moment increment compensation, and constructing a control equation of a flexible joint system during variable load by using zero rotation angle acceleration and zero rotation angle increment as control targets. The method provided by the invention avoids angular acceleration of the flexible joint mechanical arm during load change through the load moment increment compensation, thereby avoiding the vibration problem of the flexible joint mechanical arm during load sudden change; and compared with other vibration suppression methods, on the premise of no additional hardware structures and complex algorithms, the method provided by the invention realizes vibration suppression of the humanoid flexible joint mechanical armunder the variable load conditions, improves the adaptability and practicability of the humanoid flexible arm.

title: High-energy-efficiency walking biped robot leg and foot structure
abstract: The invention discloses a high-energy-efficiency walking biped robot leg and foot structure. The structure comprises a driving unit, a knee joint, a telescopic shank, a telescopic connecting rod unitand feet, the driving unit is installed in the knee joint, and the driving unit, the telescopic shank, the foot, the telescopic connecting rod unit and the driving unit are connected end to end to form a four-connecting-rod mechanism. The quadrilateral connecting rod mechanism drives the feet and ankle joints to move, the mass distribution of the leg and foot structure of the biped robot can be effectively optimized, the rotational inertia of the leg and foot structure of the biped robot is reduced, energy required for driving the legs and the feet to move is reduced, and the walking energy efficiency of the biped robot is improved. Besides, the shank part and the connecting rod part are each provided with a damping and buffering device, impact energy between feet and the ground in the walking process of the biped robot can be effectively absorbed and utilized, and therefore the walking energy efficiency of the biped robot is further improved.

title: Environment semantic perception method based on visual information
abstract: The invention provides an environmental semantic perception method based on visual information, which comprises the following steps: acquiring environmental image information by using a Kinect V1.0 camera to obtain a registered color image and depth image; resolving the three-dimensional pose of the camera according to the ORB feature points extracted from each frame through an ORB _ SLAM2 processbased on the registered color image and depth image to obtain camera pose information; performing semantic segmentation on each frame of image to generate semantic color information; synchronously generating a point cloud according to the input depth map and the internal reference matrix of the camera; registering the semantic color information into the point cloud to obtain a local semantic point cloud result; fusing the camera pose information with the local semantic point cloud result to obtain new global semantic point cloud information; and representing the fused global semantic point cloud information by using an octree map to obtain a final three-dimensional octree semantic map. According to the invention, deeper humanoid understanding is provided for environment detection of the extraterrestrial celestial body patroller.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom chest modeling device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a two-degree-of-freedom chest modeling device of a humanoid robot. The device comprises a chest breadth deformation device and a chest thickness deformation device connected with the chest breadth deformation device through a linkage piece, and the chest breadth deformation device comprises a first driving motor, a first lead screw connected with an output shaft couplerof the first driving motor, a first nut connected to the first lead screw in a threaded mode and a first connecting piece fixedly connected with the first nut; the chest thickness deformation devicecomprises a second driving motor, a second lead screw connected with an output shaft of the second driving motor through a coupler, a second nut connected to the second lead screw in a threaded mode,a second connecting piece fixedly connected with the second nut and a sliding assembly connected with the second connecting piece. The two-degree-of-freedom chest modeling device of the humanoid robotcan conduct synchronous deformation of two girths on the chest, the problem that a traditional chest modeling device is poor in modeling effect due to change of one girth or independent change of thetwo girths is solved, and the two-degree-of-freedom chest modeling device is simple in overall structure and easy to use.

title: Internal driving and positioning device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an internal drive positioning device of a humanoid robot. The internal drive positioning device comprises a base, a drive motor fixed to the base, a lead screw connected with an output shaft of the drive motor through a coupler, a nut connected to the lead screw in a threaded mode, a connecting piece fixedly connected with the nut and a rotation limiting structure connected with the connecting piece. The internal driving and positioning device of the humanoid robot is simple and reasonable in overall structure, stable in driving and accurate in positioning, the driving requirement of the humanoid robot can be well met, and the running reliability of the robot is improved.

title: Management and control system for smart home
abstract: The utility model discloses a management and control system for smart home. The robot comprises a humanoid intelligent robot body, a positioning assembly is arranged on the back of the robot body. Thepositioning assembly comprises a connecting shaft, a telescopic rod with the length capable of being locked and a bottom suction cup which are connected in sequence. One end of the connecting shaft is hinged to the back of the head of the robot body; the other end of the connecting shaft is connected with one end of a telescopic rod; the other end of the telescopic rod is hinged to the bottom suction cup, the bottom suction cup is attracted to the plane supporting the robot body, the axes of all the hinged positions are parallel, the connecting shaft is rotated around the hinged position between the connecting shaft and the back of the head of the robot body, and the bottom suction cup can be made to be away from or get close to the plane supporting the robot body. On the basis that an existing intelligent robot is large in head size and small in body size, the stable fixity is achieved, and the robot cannot topple over at will.

title: Walking control method and device of biped robot, storage medium and terminal
abstract: The invention discloses a walking control method and device of a biped robot, a storage medium and a terminal, and relates to the technical field of electronics, and mainly aims at solving the problems that in an existing dark or bright environment, when the biped walkable robot walks according to a black line road, recognition of a black line is easily influenced by exposed brightness, and the accuracy of a walking route is reduced. The method comprises the steps that a processor receives image signals and image information sent by a linear CCD image sensor and image shooting equipment respectively; exposure is determined according to the voltage value of the image signal, and a black line image is determined according to pixel information in the image information; the processor comparesthe exposure with a preset exposure, and compares the black line image with a preset black line image to obtain a first comparison result and a second comparison result; and a walking control instruction is generated according to the first comparison result and the second comparison result, and the walking control instruction is sent to a steering engine controller.

title: High humanoid multi-mode conversation method based on neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a high humanoid multi-mode conversation method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps of: 1) crawling conversation information on a website, storing conversation corpus into an Elasticsearch database, and automatically generating an index; 2) training a word vector by using the crawled conversation corpus and a Word2Vec model, and converting text information of the conversation corpus into semantic expression which can be recognized by a machine; 3) searching for answer corpora through a search engine, and selecting answers sorted in the front toform an answer set; 4) respectively inputting the questions and the acquired answer set into a twin network in the conversation system; 5) introducing an attention mechanism by adopting a seq2seq deep learning model.According to the method, a traditional retrieval type conversation system and a traditional generation type conversation system are combined together, and the technical problems thatat present, most conversation robots are low in answer statement quality, high in database requirement and need to train models with mass data can be solved.

title: Tail structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to a tail structure and a robot. In the tail structure, a first rod is connected to a robot body, a second rod is hinged to the first rod around the axis of the first rod, a tail shell is mounted on the second rod, and the two ends of an elastic piece are connected to the first rod and the second rodrespectively. When the robot body moves, the second rod can swing, the second rod drives the tail shell to swing, and the elastic piece is twisted to store energy in the process. When the robot body stops moving, that is, when the external force making the second rod swing disappears, the second rod can rotate to be restored under the action of the elastic piece, and the tail shell is rotated to be restored along with the second rod. Therefore, the flexibility of the tail in the moving process of the robot is improved, the tail shell can dynamically swing along with the robot body, the effectthat the tail of an animal swings while the animal walks is simulated, and the problem is effectively solved that the tail of an existing robot is inflexible and stiff.

title: Head structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots and particularly relates to a head structure and a robot. In the head structure, a trunk base and a mounting base are connectedthrough a cross rotating assembly. Two first driving assemblies are mounted on the trunk base, and output ends of the first driving assemblies are both hinged to the mounting base, that is, the two first driving assemblies are arranged in a parallel connection mode. As the two first driving assemblies drive the mounting base to make pitch oscillation and left-right side-sway movement, the head structure is more personified. For example, the output ends of the two first driving assemblies move upwards or downwards simultaneously, so that the mounting base is driven to make pitch oscillation movement; and for example, the output ends of the two first driving assemblies move upwards and downwards separately, and the mounting base is driven to make pitch and left-right side-sway compounded movement. The head structure adopts a smaller number of parts, the weight is small, the first driving assemblies for achieving the freedom of head pitch and side-sway are mounted on the trunk base, the head structure is small in inertia, the neck of the robot is made not too long, the overall structure is compact, and the space occupied is small.

title: Integrated joint and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to an integrated joint and a robot. The integrated joint adopts a motor assembly, a speed reducer, an output piece,a first bearing, a torque sensor and a driving plate. The shell serves as a fixed end, the driving plate controls the motor assembly to work, a motor shaft is controlled to output power to the speedreducer, the speed reducer is connected to the output piece, and the output piece outputs rotation. The output end of the speed reducer is supported on the shell through the first bearing. The torquesensor is connected with the speed reducer and the output piece, the torque borne by the output piece acts on the torque sensor through the speed reducer, the detection torque of the torque sensor isthe torque borne by the output piece, influence factors such as flexibility and friction of intermediate transmission links do not need to be considered, the torque value of the output piece is directly measured, and the rigidity and stability of a system are ensured more accurately, reliably and effectively. The integrated joint is applied to the robot, torque feedback is realized at each joint,and a more accurate force control effect can be achieved.

title: Humanoid flexible joint arm electro-mechanical coupling modeling method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid flexible joint arm electro-mechanical coupling modeling method, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid flexible arm modeling. The humanoid flexible joint armelectro-mechanical coupling modeling method comprises the steps that in order to solve the problems that the physical properties of a humanoid flexible joint arm are complex, and a conventional modeling method does not take the electro-mechanical coupling factor influence into account, the humanoid flexible joint arm which adopts a brushless direct-current motor to serve as a joint driving motor serves as a modeling object, the coupling relationship of the electromagnetic property of the brushless direct-current motor and the mechanical property of the arm is taken into account, system electric and magnetic field generalized coordinates are defined, a lagrange-maxwell operator which introduces the driving motor magnetic field energy item is established, a system electro-mechanical couplingmathematical model is established, and the electro-mechanical coupling state of a system is completely described. Compared with other modeling methods, the humanoid flexible joint arm electro-mechanical coupling modeling method has the advantages that the coupling mathematical relationship from the driving motor electrical input quantity to the flexible joint arm mechanical output quantity is established, and the electro-mechanical coupling property of the humanoid flexible joint arm system which adopts brushless direct-current motor driving is described.

title: Robot balance control method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot balance control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps as follows: acquiring left and right foot stress information of the robot; calculating a zero moment point of a body centroid of the robot according to the left and right foot stress information; calculating a first position offset and a second position offset of the robot according to the zero moment point of the body centroid respectively; updating the position track of the robot according to the first position offset and the second position offset to obtain an updated body centroid position; performing inverse kinematics analysis on the updated body centroid position to obtain eachjoint angle of the left leg and the right leg of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to each joint angle. Stability of the robot in the bending process is improved, and toppling isavoided.

title: Walking structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of a humanoid service robot and relates to a walking structure and a robot. In the walking structure, two sets of foot connecting pieces and connecting rods are arranged between a hip and a body, the hip, the body and the set of foot connecting pieces and connecting rods form a four-rod mechanism, the hip is relatively fixed, a hip steering engine can drive the body to swing relative to the hip, so the connecting rods and the foot connecting pieces are in linkage, the two foot connecting pieces are fixed to output shafts of the two foot steering engines respectively, and each set of four-bar mechanisms and the corresponding foot steering engine serve as one leg. Through digital accurate control of the steering engine, the robot can achieve flexible movement and gait control in all directions. All movement forms of the hip and the legs are achieved through the four-rod mechanism and the hip steering engine, cost of the steering engine is effectively saved, the power requirement is low, and energy consumption is low,. And moreover, the structure is more compact and reliable, the action of the whole robot is coordinated and controllable, and more anthropomorphic dynamic is shown.

title: Humanoid robot and leg structure thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of a humanoid service robot and particularly relates to a humanoid robot and a leg structure thereof. The leg structure is characterized in that the installation position of a knee joint driving piece with large weight is raised to a thigh part, the power of the knee joint driving piece is transmitted to a shank part through a knee joint transmission assembly to drive the shank part to swing, so the rotational inertia of the thigh part is reduced, and the power required by the knee joint between the thigh part and the shank part is effectively reduced. The humanoid robot adopts the leg structure, and the rotational inertia of the leg structure of the humanoid robot is reduced so that the power required by knee joints is effectively reduced.

abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot shank structure and a humanoid robot comprising the humanoid robot shank structure, the shank structure comprises a shank outer side plate and a shank innerside plate which are fixedly installed on the left side and the right side at a preset interval, and the upper ends and the lower ends of the shank outer side plate and the shank inner side plate arerespectively provided with an upper end annular part and a lower end annular part; the upper plug is positioned below the upper end annular part and is clamped between the shank outer side plate andthe shank inner side plate; the lower plug is positioned above the lower end annular part and is clamped between the shank outer side plate and the shank inner side plate; the inner cavity structure body is fixedly clamped between the upper plug and the lower plug and between the shank outer side plate and the shank inner side plate, and a containing cavity is formed in the inner cavity structurebody; and the shell wraps the peripheries of the shank outer side plate, the shank inner side plate, the upper plug, the lower plug and the inner cavity structure body. The shank structure of the humanoid robot has good strength and rigidity in all directions, and the internal space of the shank is fully utilized.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: Disclosed is a humanoid robot having driving modules at each joint, the driving module comprising: a driving part comprising a plurality of motors stacked in a height direction; and a rotating part which is provided at the end of the driving part, and which is connected to each motor through shafts so as to implement a multi-degree-of-freedom rotational motion.

title: Biped robot digital hydraulic driving method based on joint working condition multi-quadrant coupling
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot digital hydraulic energy-saving driving method based on joint working condition multi-quadrant coupling optimization, which relates to the field of biped robot hydraulic driving. An energy efficient conversion mechanism between hydraulic energy and kinetic potential energy of a biped robot hydraulic system is realized by establishing a biped robot finite-statemachine and a joint motion and load working condition map and adopting a multi-objective optimal configuration strategy to be matched with a global optimal working mode of a digital valve bank of thehydraulic system. The method has good biped robot hydraulic driving system analysis and energy-saving driving effects, and the overall energy efficiency value of the robot can be increased.

title: Moving posture anti-falling protection based robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a robot and a control method thereof, in particular to a moving posture anti-falling protection based robot and a control method thereof. The robot is provided with robot moving joints consistent with human body moving joints; a control system of the robot comprises a single-chip microcomputer and moving posture sensors mounted on the joints; and the single-chip microcomputer comprises a signal acquisition unit, a storing unit, a central processor, a power management unit, a driving unit A and a driving unit B. The control method comprises the following steps: during the robot operating process, the moving posture sensors collect the real-time moving posture value of each joint in real time, the control system compares the real-time moving posture value with a standard moving posture value, when the difference value exceeds the threshold value, a protective system is immediately started to prevent the robot from falling, and at the same time, all motor power supplies of a moving actuating module are shut off. The robot can prevent the robot from being damaged due to collision or prevent the robot from falling due to a power failure, has the characteristicsof being reliable in performance, safe and reliable, high in intelligent degree and simple in structure and reducing the workload of a repairing staff and is easy to popularize and use.

title: Humanoid robot with attitude calibration system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot with an attitude calibration system and a control method thereof, and relates to a robot and a control method thereof. The robot is provided with robot motionjoints consistent with human motion joints; the attitude calibration system comprises inclination angle sensors, angular velocity sensors and a single chip microcomputer; and the single chip microcomputer comprises a signal acquisition unit, a storage unit, a central processing unit, a power management unit and a driving unit. According to the method, each robot motion joint is provided with one inclination angle sensor and one angular velocity sensor, and in operation, the inclination angle sensor and the angular velocity sensor respectively collect real-time values of each joint and comparethe real-time values with a standard inclination value and a standard angular velocity value; when the deviations of the two numerical values exceed threshold values, the central processing unit immediately disconnects a power supply of a motion execution module, and the robot is in a stop shutdown state. According to the humanoid robot with the attitude calibration system and the control method thereof, the action deviation caused by mechanical loosening in operation can be prevented, the robot can be prevented from being collided and broken, the performance is reliable, the structure is simple, the cost is low, and the robot is easy to popularize and use.

title: Humanoid stair climbing robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid stair climbing robot and a control method thereof, and relates to a robot and a control method thereof. The robot comprises a humanoid robot body, a control system and a power supply system; the control system involves binocular cameras, a central processing unit and a driving unit; and the binocular cameras are arranged in two eyes of a robot head system, and the output ends of the binocular cameras are connected with the input end of the central processing unit. The method is characterized in that the height of a staircase is recognized through the binocular cameras, then the gravity center moves leftwards, a right leg is lifted to be placed on an upper step, then the gravity center moves rightwards, a left leg is lifted to be placed on the same step, then the gravity center moves rightwards, the left leg is lifted to be placed on an upper step, and then the gravity center moves leftwards, and the right leg is lifted to be placed on the same step, so that circulation is formed, and a stair climbing function is achieved by simulating the human stair climbing gait. According to the robot and the method, the automatic stair climbing function of a humanoid robot can be achieved, the flexibility is good, the intelligent degree is high, the structure is simple, the cost is low and the usage and popularization are easy.

title: Control method for robot based on triaxial angular speed anti-falling protection
abstract: The invention discloses a control method for a robot based on triaxial angular speed anti-falling protection, and relates to a robot control method. According to the method, a triaxial angular speed sensor is mounted on each robot motion join of the robot based on triaxial angular speed anti-falling protection, and collection parameters of the triaxial angular speed sensors comprise angular speedvalues in the directions X, Y and Z; and when the robot runs, the triaxial angular speed sensors collect the triaxial angular speed values of the joints during running in real time, the real-time triaxial angular speed values are obtained after data processing, the specific value of the real-time triaxial angular speed values and the standard angular speed value is worked out, and corresponding commands are judged and executed according to the specific value. Accuracy of the method is high, the defect that high-difficulty actions of the humanoid robot are hindered can be avoided, protection can be achieved on the situation that the robot is suddenly powered off to fall during running, a motor, a gear and a robot body can be protected, and the workloads of maintenance personnel can be reduced; and the structure is simple, cost is low, and application and promotion are easy.

title: Robot based on three-axis acceleration anti-falling protection and control method of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot based on three-axis acceleration anti-falling protection and a control method of the robot, and relates to a robot and a control method thereof. The robot is provided with robot motion joints consistent to human body motion joints. A control system of the robot comprises a storage unit, three-axis acceleration sensors, a central processor, a power management unit and a drive unit. The three-axis acceleration sensors are arranged on all the joints. According to the method, the three-axis acceleration sensors collect the three-axis acceleration average value of various joints in real time, the three-axis acceleration average value is compared with the standard three-axis acceleration average value in the storage unit, and when at least one difference value islarger than the first threshold value and smaller than or equal to the second threshold value, the control system is used for automatically controlling robot actions; and when at least one differencevalue is larger than the second threshold value, a protection system is immediately started, and meanwhile the power management unit disconnects a power source of a motion executing unit. The robot based on three-axis acceleration anti-falling protection and the control method of the robot have the characteristics that the self-protection capability is good, the workload of maintenance personnel can be reduced, safety and reliability are achieved, and the intelligent degree is high, and popularization and usage are easy.
