title: Robot facial emotion expression method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot facial emotion expression method, and relates to the technical field of robots. A robot comprises a head assembly, a neck assembly, a body assembly and a speaker; the head assembly further comprises a head top assembly, a face assembly and a chin assembly, two display screens are arranged on the face assembly, the display screens display sclera parts and eyelid parts to be used for simulating eyes, and grooves are formed in the lower edge of the head top assembly to be used for representing a left eyebrow and a right eyebrow. The emotion expression method includes the steps of static emotion expression, dynamic emotion expression, horizontally and obliquely moving of the head assembly, the sound change and the eye change. According to different emotion types, five groups of different emotion expressions are combined to one another to present the different emotion types. According to the robot facial emotion expression method, different facial expressionsare presented by controlling the position change of scleras, eyelids, the eyebrows, the head top and a chin, thus emotions are realistically expressed, the emotion expression effect of the robot is improved, the interestingness is enhanced, and the user experience is improved.

title: Servo and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a servo and a robot. A motor shaft of a motor assembly is connected to a sun gear of a planetary reducer, a planetary gear set meshes with the sun gear and an inner gear ring simultaneously, and a pin is connected with the planetary gear set and an output shaft in a penetrating mode. The motor shaft drives thesun gear to rotate at high speed, the sun gear drives the planetary gear set to rotate, and the planetary gear set is in meshing transmission with the inner gear ring to enable the pin to drive the output shaft to rotate at low speed. An output end single-circle absolute value sensor is arranged to detect the absolute position of the output shaft, a motor end single-circle absolute value sensor isarranged to detect the absolute position of the motor shaft, and the single-circle absolute value sensors are adopted to enable the servo to be compact in structure and to be reduced in size and weight. Two single-circle absolute value sensors are arranged, high-precision detection and correction on the absolute position of the output shaft are achieved, and it is avoided that when an incrementalencoder is started each time, a joint needs to be subjected to mechanical zeroing and absolute position correcting. The robot with the servo can also detect the absolute position of the output shaft.

title: Biped robot gait track generation method based on hybrid control and application
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot gait track generation method based on hybrid control and application. According to the biped robot gait track generation method, fuzzy control and CPG bionic control are combined, environment information fed back by a robot through real-time poses in the walking process serves as the input quantity of a fuzzy control system, gait track information of walkingof the robot is obtained based on the fuzzy control system, and a corresponding gait track is generated through a CPG model based on the gait track information. Compared with the prior art, the methodhas the advantages of being high in track precision, simple in algorithm, rapid and the like.

title: Joint structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of human shape-like service robots and relates to a joint structure and a robot provided with the joint structure. The joint structure uses a motor assembly, a reducer, a torque sensor and a driving circuit board assembly. A motor shell serves as a fixed end, the driving circuit board assembly controls the motor assembly to work, and a motor shaft of the motor assembly outputs power to the reducer, so that an output part outputs rotation. The torque sensor is arranged between the motor shell and the reducer, the torque subjected to the output part is acted to the torque sensor by the reducer, a detection torque of the torque sensor is the torque subjected to the output part, and intermediate transmission links are not considered in detection, sothat it is more accurate, reliable and effective, and the system rigidity and stability are ensured. The joint structure has the characteristics of high universality, high integration degree and modular structural design. By applying the joint structure to the robot, torque feedback is achieved in each joint, so that a more precise force control effect can be achieved, and the system rigidity andstability are ensured.

title: Robot joint structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a robot joint structure and a robot. According to the robot joint structure, a motor assembly adopts an outer rotor form, a stator is sleeved with a rotor, and a motor shaft is fixed to the rotor. A wave generator in a harmonic reducer is installed on the motor shaft, a flexible gear is driven by the wave generator and meshed with a rigid gear, and a joint output shaft is fixed to the flexible gear. During work, the motor shaft drives the wave generator to rotate at a high speed, the wave generator enablesthe flexible gear to generate flexible deformation, the flexible gear and the rigid gear are in meshing transmission, and power is output through the joint output shaft so as to make the wave generator rotate at a low speed. An output end encoder is adopted to detect the rotation angle of the joint output shaft. The robot joint structure is compact, the axial size is reduced, the size and the weight are reduced, and the robot joint structure is suitable for light weight and compact layout of robots.

title: Robot and integrated joint thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots and relates to a robot and an integrated joint thereof. The integrated joint of the robot integrates a motor assembly, a harmonic speed reducer, an output shaft, a motor end coder, an output end coder and a motor driver. The motor assembly provides power, and a motor shaft rotates at a high speed and transmits the power to theharmonic speed reducer. A wave generator of the harmonic speed reducer drives a flexible wheel to generate flexible deformation, the flexible wheel is in engaged transmission with a rigid wheel, andthe rigid wheel is fixed to a motor frame; and the flexible wheel rotates at a low speed and drives the output shaft to rotate to output power. The output shaft is supported on a bearing supporting structure through a first bearing. The motor end coder is used for detecting the rotating angle of the motor shaft, the output end coder is used for detecting the rotating angle of the output shaft, andthe motor shaft is driven to rotate through the motor driver to output preset displacement, speed and torque. The integrated joint of the robot is simple and compact in structure, capable of being quickly assembled and manufactured, capable of conveniently achieving electrical connection, light and low in cost.

title: Biped robot and track following method and device thereof
abstract: A track following method of a biped robot comprises: obtaining track serial numbers and current serial number increment values of the biped robot before non-supporting legs move; calculating a to-be-moved position of the non-supporting leg of the biped robot according to a preset to-be-followed track in combination with the track serial number before the non-supporting leg moves and the current serial number increment value; and judging whether the to-be-moved position of the non-supporting leg conforms to a preset walking limiting parameter or not, and determining the current target moving position of the non-supporting leg. Therefore, the target moving position of the non-supporting leg can be determined in real time according to the walking limiting parameters, the moving requirements of different following tracks are met, and the track following flexibility of the biped robot is improved.

title: Human finger-simulated inflatable soft three-finger holder
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of clamping equipment, and particularly relates to a humanoid finger inflatable soft three-finger holder. The robot comprises a controller, a fixing frame and bionic fingers. The controller is fixed to the top end of the fixing frame. The bionic finger is connected to the bottom end of the fixing frame and comprises a first joint, a second joint anda third joint, and the first joint, the second joint and the third joint are connected through torsion springs. When the articles need to be grabbed; the controller applies pressure into the first cavity through a hose. The piston rod extends into the second cavity from the first cavity under the action of pressure; at the moment, the bionic fingers are in an open state; when the clamping deviceis located above an object, the controller conducts pressure relief on the first cavity through the hose, the second joint and the third joint are bent under the action of torsion of the torsion spring, the piston rod can be extruded and then retract into the first cavity again, at the moment, the bionic fingers recover to be in a folded state again, and grabbing of the object is achieved.

title: Robot, visual tracking method thereof and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot, a visual tracking method thereof and a computer readable storage medium. The robot comprises a rotatable head and rotatable eyes arranged on the head. The visual tracking method comprises the following steps of acquiring an environment image; identifying a target object in the environment image; and rotating at least one of the head and the eyes to enable the eyesto directly face the target object. By means of the mode, it is guaranteed that when the visual orientation of the robot is adjusted, the human head and the eyes can be rotated, the situation that rotation by a large angle cannot be realized due to the fact that only one of the human head and the eyes is rotated is avoided, the movement of the robot is closer to that of a real person through rotation of the eyes, and man-machine interaction is enhanced.

title: Robot and obstacle avoidance method and device thereof
abstract: The robot obstacle avoidance method comprises the steps that three-dimensional space point cloud is acquired, and planes contained in the three-dimensional space point cloud are segmented to serve ascandidate ground sets; acquiring a ground normal vector, screening and comparing the planes in the candidate ground set according to the ground normal vector and the ground height at the previous moment, and determining the plane in the candidate ground set corresponding to the ground; deleting point clouds corresponding to the selected ground from the acquired three-dimensional space point cloudsto obtain obstacle point clouds, and generating laser frames according to the obstacle point clouds; and performing local obstacle avoidance according to the laser frame and the selected ground. According to the method, the three-dimensional space point cloud can be updated in real time, and the position of the obstacle in the scene is correspondingly updated in real time, so that the method canbe effectively applied to the humanoid robot for obstacle avoidance, and the obstacle avoidance precision of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Neural network optimization method for biped robot neural network controller
abstract: The invention discloses a neural network optimization method of a biped robot neural network controller. The biped robot neural network controller adopts a full-link deep neural network and is used for the walking control of a biped robot, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, optimizing a topological structure of the deep neural network; and S2, optimizing network parameters of the deep neural network after the topological structure is optimized. According to the method, the topological structure and the control parameters of the deep neural network are optimized, so that the network is effectively prevented from falling into local optimum, the problem of difficulty in the nonlinear control of the biped robot is well adapted and solved, and a parameter model of a robot systemcan be better fitted.

title: Action mapping method and system for heterogeneous humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to an action mapping method and system for a heterogeneous humanoid mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The action mapping method comprises the following steps of (1) acquiring joint angle data of a human arm; (2) calculating target wrist joint coordinate data and elbow joint coordinate data of the mechanical arm; (3) using elbow joint angle data and shoulder joint angle data of the mechanical arm as independent variables, taking a working space at the tail end of the mechanical arm as the independent variable value range, and at least constructing the fitness function based on the calculated deviation of a robot arm wrist joint position relative to the target wrist joint coordinate data, using a genetic algorithm to search out optimalelbow joint and shoulder joint angle data, and taking the optimal elbow joint and shoulder joint angle data as the wrist joint angle data and the elbow joint angle data of the mechanical arm; and calculating wrist joint angle change date based on the wrist joint angle of the human arm relative to change data. Terminal actions can be executed approximately by using the genetic algorithm, so that heterogeneous control can be performed well, and the method and the system are applied in the fields such as robot remote control.

title: Biped robot and track following method and device thereof
abstract: The track following method of the biped robot comprises the steps of obtaining track serial numbers and current serial number increment values of the biped robot before non-supporting legs move; calculating a to-be-moved position of the non-supporting leg of the biped robot according to a preset to-be-followed track in combination with the track serial number before the non-supporting leg moves and the current serial number increment value; when the to-be-moved positions of the non-supporting legs meet the preset walking limiting parameters, increasing the serial number increment value, recalculating the to-be-moved position of the non-supporting leg until the calculated Nth to-be-moved position of the non-supporting leg does not meet the preset walking limiting parameters of the biped robot, determining the (N-1) th to-be-moved position to be the current target moving position of the non-supporting leg, and N is larger than or equal to 1. Therefore, the moving requirements of different following tracks can be self-adapted, and the track following flexibility of the biped robot is improved.

title: Walking speed adjusting method for biped robot to simulate gait of person
abstract: The invention discloses a walking speed adjusting method for a biped robot to simulate the gait of a person. The method comprises steps of double-foot supporting phase adjustment and single-foot supporting phase adjustment, the double-foot supporting phase adjustment refers to adjusting the walking speed by adjusting the duration of a double-foot supporting phase, single-foot support phase adjustment refers to adjusting the walking speed by applying torque to change the track energy relative to the pitching degree of freedom of an ankle joint supported by the single-foot support. Compared witha conventional walking speed switching method, the method does not need to design multiple groups of gaits in advance, and achieves speed adjustment and switching based on the speed feedback throughthe change of gait parameters and the application of torque control. Based on the walking speed adjusting method provided by the invention, the robot can be effectively helped to realize real-time speed switching, so walking flexibility and environmental adaptability of the robot are improved.

title: Method for controlling stability of humanoid flexible arm system
abstract: The invention provides a method for controlling the stability of a humanoid flexible arm system. The control method based on virtual damping and inertia parameters belongs to the field of humanoid flexible arm control. The method comprises the steps that in order to solve the problem that system damping is reduced due to introduction of flexible elements in a flexible joint and accordingly the stability of the system is reduced, a flexible joint model based on virtual damping and inertia is established by introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters, a control equation for introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters is constructed, virtual inertia and damping characteristics are increased for a flexible joint system, the system damping ratio is improved, and the systemstability is improved. According to the method, by introducing virtual damping and the inertia parameters, on the premise of not adding additional hardware structures and complex algorithms, the damping ratio of the flexible joint system is increased, the stability of the humanoid flexible arm system is improved, and the adaptability and practicability of the humanoid flexible arm are improved.

title: Gear type single-steering-engine biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a gear type single-steering-engine biped robot, and belongs to the field of robot walking mechanisms. A main body structure of the robot comprises a robot body, the leg plates are vertically arranged on the left side and the right side of the machine body respectively; a steering engine is mounted on the upper side surface of the fuselage loading plate; an output shaftof the steering engine is fixedly connected with an input shaft perpendicular to the lower side surface of the loading plate; a worm is fixedly arranged at the shaft end of the input shaft and is meshed with the worm wheel; the worm wheel and a pinion of the straight-tooth cylindrical gear are arranged on the same output shaft; the small gear is meshed with a large gear of the straight-tooth cylindrical gear, so that the rotating speed of the steering engine can be reduced; the large gear is supported by a rotating shaft, power wheels are fixedly installed at the two ends of the rotating shaftrespectively and rotationally connected to the corresponding side leg plates respectively, a battery box is arranged on the upper side face of the vehicle body carrying plate, a power supply batteryis installed in the battery box, and the power supply battery drives the worm and gear by supplying power to the steering engine. The biped robot is simple and easy to understand in structure, low incost and flexible in walking, changes the situation that an existing biped robot is complex in structure, and achieves microminiaturization, simplification and light load of the biped robot.

title: Parallel humanoid robot arm based on gear and push-pull rod combined driving
abstract: The utility model discloses a parallel humanoid robot arm based on gear and push-pull rod combined driving. The glove comprises a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger and a palm. Each finger comprises a near knuckle, a middle knuckle and a far knuckle, the near knuckle and the middle knuckle are hinged and form a parallel double-hinge structure through a push rod, a first hinge seat and a first adjustable screw rod, and the middle knuckle and the far knuckle are hinged and form a parallel double-hinge structure through a pull rod, a second hinge seat and a second adjustable screw rod; the bottoms of the near knuckles are hinged to the palm and driven by a gear set. According to the utility model, the load capacity with higher stability can be accurately controlled and provided, and the automatic control of force, temperature and touch can be realized through the sensor; good flexibility is realized; butt joint of the thumb and any finger can be achieved, and the personification level is high.

title: ROBOT MOTION CONTROL SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: Disclosed are a robot motion control system and a method thereof which can help rhythm learning for promoting creativity and self-expression, which are very important elements of early childhood education. The present invention can increase an educational effect by promoting fun and interest through allowing a humanoid robot to be used for rhythmic learning of young children. In addition, there is an effect capable of learning dance routine through children′s song in consideration of taste of a particular young child as well as a large number of young children. The robot motion control system of the present invention comprises: a user terminal; a data storage unit; and a motion information analysis unit.

title: Miniature humanoid two-wheeled self-balancing robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots. The utility model relates to a robot, in particular to a miniature humanoid two-wheel self-balancing robot. The robot comprises a power source, a robot body, a head holder, two manipulators located on the two sides of the robot body, an ultrasonic sensor, two infrared sensors and a head steering engine. A bottom plate, a middle-layer plate and a top plate are sequentially arranged in the machine body from bottom to top in parallel. Two motor brackets are fixedly mounted on the lower end surface of the bottom plate; driving motors arerespectively arranged on the two motor brackets; an output shaft of each driving motor is sleeved with a driving wheel; a posture detection module for self-balancing is arranged on the bottom plate; acontrol module is arranged on the middle-layer plate, mechanical arm steering engines used for driving the mechanical arms to rotate are arranged on the two sides of the machine body respectively, and each mechanical arm is rotationally connected to the machine body through the mechanical arm steering engine on the corresponding side, so that additional balance weight is not needed, the structureis light, the self-balancing performance is good, and the robot can be suitable for various use occasions.

title: High-pressure energy storage hydraulic system device
abstract: The utility model provides a high-pressure energy storage hydraulic system device, and relates to the technical field of giant humanoid fighting robot power systems. The system comprises a high-pressure energy storage hydraulic system device, wherein the power device comprises a high-power motor; the power output end of the high-power motor is in power transmission connection with the high-pressure hydraulic pump, the oil outlet end of the high-pressure hydraulic pump is connected with the high-pressure energy storage device, the oil inlet end of the high-pressure hydraulic pump is connected with the hydraulic oil tank, and the oil outlet end of the high-pressure energy storage device is connected with the overflow valve and the hydraulic electromagnetic valve through hydraulic pipelines.Two ends of the cooling device are connected with two ends of the hydraulic oil tank through pipelines; the output device is connected with the hydraulic electromagnetic valve through a hydraulic pipeline. The hydraulic system is arranged on the back of the lifting giant robot, and due to the action of the high-pressure energy storage device, the execution speed is increased by 200% compared withthat of a common hydraulic system; therefore, the explosive power of an action system of the giant robot is improved, and the wonderful fighting performance requirement is met.

title: Compact biped robot joint driving device
abstract: The invention discloses a compact biped robot joint driving device comprising a motor rotor assembly, a motor stator assembly, an output shaft assembly, a cycloid gear assembly, a pin wheel assembly,a rolling bearing, bolts and a circlip for a shaft. The motor rotor assembly and an eccentric shaft of the cycloid gear assembly are connected through the bolts. The eccentric shaft is driven by the motor rotor assembly. Cycloid gears conduct eccentric rotation around the eccentric shaft. The cycloid gears of the cycloid gear assembly and pin teeth of the pin wheel assembly are in one-tooth-difference cycloidal engagement transmission, and speed reduction at a large reduction ratio is achieved between the motor rotor and the cycloid gears. The output shaft assembly and the cycloid gear assembly adopt a pin hole output mechanism, and synchronous output is achieved between the cycloid gears and the output shaft. The drive device adopts a hollow shaft structure, built-in type convenient and rapid wiring is achieved, and convenient and rapid assembly and disassembly of the connection bolts are achieved. The compact biped robot joint driving device can provide a biped robot joint with the drive device which is small in volume, light in mass, compact in structure and large in output torque and achieves convenient wiring.

title: Emotion information processing method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an emotion information processing method and device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, which is beneficial to displaying the emotion dissipation process of a robot and improving the humanoid degree of the robot. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention comprises the steps of determining first emotion information according to afirst emotion triggering event in response to the fact that a robot detects the first emotion triggering event; generating first control information according to the first emotion information, wherein the first control information is used for indicating the robot to sequentially execute a first behavior and a second behavior for expressing emotion, the first behavior is used for expressing an emotion indicated by the first emotion information, and the second behavior is used for expressing an emotion which is lighter than the emotion indicated by the first emotion information.

abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid robot development framework system capable of developing and controlling a robot and a display device for natural interaction between the robot and the display device included in the robot. title: Intelligent arm of novel humanoid
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent arm of a novel humanoid, and belongs to the field of robots. The intelligent arm of the novel humanoid comprises a wrist joint mechanism. An elbow joint mechanism is fixedly connected with the wrist joint mechanism. A shoulder joint mechanism is rotationally connected with the right side of the elbow joint mechanism. The elbow joint mechanism comprises an arm. A first elbow joint lower cover is fixedly connected with the right side of the top of the arm. A second elbow joint lower cover is fixedly connected with the right side of the bottom of the arm. The bottom of the first elbow joint lower cover is fixedly connected with the second elbow joint lower cover. By means of the scheme, an auxiliary spring is balanced by a small tension spring and an extension spring, the sensitivity of the simulation movements of the product can be improved, the power of a steering engine at the position can be effectively reduced, the product can be miniaturized, afreedom degree is added to a body and a shoulder joint, and when the whole arm is longitudinally raised or transversely stretched, labor can be saved under the action of the auxiliary spring and theaction of a shoulder joint structural member.

title: LOAD REDUCTION DEVICE, LOAD REDUCTION METHOD, AND STORAGE MEDIUM FOR STORING PROGRAM THEREIN
abstract: This load reduction device is provided with: a torque estimation unit which calculates a standing-leg torque and an idling-leg torque that are outputted, during a standing-leg period and an idling-leg period, respectively, by a drive mechanism for outputting torques to mitigate loads exerted to the user at the joints of legs of the user, on the basis of values of loads exerted on the soles of the feet of the legs and the angles at the respective joints of the legs; a standing-leg/idling-leg determination unit which determines whether each of the legs is in a standing-leg state or an idling-leg state; and a torque output smoothing unit which, upon change in the state of each leg, smooths a transition in the torque outputted by the drive mechanism in accordance with a transit time on the basis of the standing-leg torque and the idling-leg torque.

title: Robot head structure
abstract: The invention discloses a robot head structure, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot head structure comprises a head top unit, a face unit, a jaw unit, a head joint assembly and a neck assembly, the head top unit is located above the face unit, the jaw unit is located below the face unit, the rear side of the face unit is connected with the head top unit and the jaw unit correspondingly, the head joint assembly is located on the rear side of the face unit, the rear side of the face unit is further connected with the head joint assembly, the neck assembly is located below thehead joint assembly, and the head joint assembly is connected with the neck assembly. The brand-new and unique robot head structure which can simulate human head and facial expressions and express different emotions through the mutual motion relation of all the unit assemblies and different opening angles formed between all the unit assemblies is provided.

title: Dual-arm robot humanoid work planning method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a dual-arm robot humanoid work planning method based on deep learning. The method includes the following steps of S1, training a strategy network, wherein the strategy network can calculate the probability of mechanical arms at each state at the next moment according to the current state and the target state of the mechanical arms and give various movement plans; S2, determining an evaluation function, wherein the evaluation function is used for evaluating the movement plans provided by the strategy network; and S3, executing tree search through the combination of the strategy network and the evaluation function to obtain the result of mechanical arm route planning. With a human movement action sample as the guidance, meanwhile in combination with the specific environment where the current robot is located, the human movement action sample is selected or changed, and therefore a dual-arm robot performs humanoid work planning.

title: Connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device
abstract: The invention relates to a connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device, and belongs to the technical field of robot hands. The connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device comprises a motor, a transmission mechanism, a base, a first finger section, a second finger section, a near joint shaft, a far joint shaft, a first connecting rod, a secondconnecting rod, a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, a third rotating shaft, a spring part and a limiting bump. The device has coupling grabbing and self-adaptive grabbing functions, thefunction of using the single motor to drive robot fingers with two joint freedom degrees to achieve grabbing is achieved, simultaneous movement of two joints is achieved in the initial stage in a coupling linkage mode, tail end pinching grabbing is facilitated, the two finger sections can be used for making contact with a large object, and the wrapping grabbing effect is achieved; and the connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device can automatically adapt to objects of different shapes and sizes, does not need real-time sensing and complex control over the environment and the objects, and is simple in structure, low in cost and suitable for anthropomorphic robots.

title: Service robot trunk and service robot thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a service robot trunk. The service robot trunk comprises a chest mechanism, a waist mechanism, a knee mechanism and a base, wherein a waist pitching joint comprises a waist pitching driving mechanism, a waist pitching transmission mechanism, a waist pitching upper plate and a waist pitching lower plate; the waist pitching upper plate is fixedly connected with the chest mechanism; the waist pitching transmission mechanism can drive the waist pitching upper plate to move; a waist rotating joint comprises a waist rotating supporting mechanism and a waist rotating driving mechanism; the waist rotating driving mechanism is fixedly connected with the waist rotating supporting mechanism; the waist pitching lower plate is fixedly connected with the waist rotating driving mechanism; the knee mechanism comprises a knee pitching joint; the knee pitching joint comprises a knee pitching driving mechanism, a knee pitching transmission mechanism, a knee pitching upper plate and a knee pitching lower plate; the knee pitching lower plate is fixedly connected with the base; and the knee pitching upper plate is fixedly connected with the waist rotating supporting mechanism. The trunk is simple in design structure and reliable in performance and can bewell combined with other elements of the service robot.

title: Humanoid gait planning method of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid gait planning method for a biped robot, and the method enables the movement characteristics of human walking to be integrated into the gait planning of the biped robot, so as to improve the walking energy efficiency of the robot and improve the endurance of the robot. The humanoid gait planning method comprises double-foot support phase planning and single-foot support phase planning, in the biped support phase, the robot enables the mass center of the robot to move forwards by means of the thrust of the ankle, meanwhile the mass center of the robot gets close to the supporting legs in a forward plane, so that the landing time is provided to the single-foot supporting phase; and in the single-foot supporting phase, the degree of freedom of the single-footsupporting phase and the degree of freedom of the lateral plane of the robot supporting ankle joint are in a passive state, the mass center of the robot moves forwards naturally under the action of gravity, and the swinging foot moves to the foot falling point quickly within the estimated landing time.

title: Method for planning and controlling gaits when biped robot suffers from external thrust disturbance in advancing direction
abstract: The invention provides a method for planning and controlling gaits when a biped robot suffers from external thrust disturbance in the advancing direction. When the robot is provided with under-actuated ankles or the ankles are in a force control manner, external disturbance borne by the robot can be shown through the state change of the ankle joint freedom degree (or other variables relevant to the ankle joint freedom degree). Based on the thought, according to the method for planning and controlling the gaits, the force control manner is adopted for the ankle joints of the robot, then the included angles between connecting lines between the supporting leg ankles and supporting leg hip joints and the vertical direction are selected to serve as the state variables of the robot to representthe state of the robot, and the state of the robot is estimated and calculated in real time based on a simplified inverted pendulum model. Based on the method, external thrust information borne by therobot does not need to be measured, and real-time feedback and control can be achieved.

title: Service-oriented robot with multiple mechanical arms
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot and artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a service-oriented robot with multiple mechanical arms. The service-oriented robot comprises a headmodule, a body module, mechanical arm modules, a leg module, a chassis module and vision modules, wherein the mechanical arm modules comprise general interfaces, mechanical arms and end effectors, and each robot comprises at least three mechanical arms. The general interfaces are adopted by all the mechanical arm modules, and can be installed in any mechanical arm docking interfaces of the robot,and very high interchangeability is achieved; all the mechanical arm modules have own vision modules, and can collect self data to a control system; the control system can process the movement of each mechanical arm module in parallel without priority, and thus each mechanical arm module can complete self movement at the same time; and the multiple mechanical arm modules can complete different tasks independently or work together, the working efficiency of the robots is greatly improved, and the time and the number of the robots are saved.

title: Joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a joint structure and a robot with the joint structure. The joint structure adopts a motor assembly, a speedreducer, a torque sensor and a driving circuit board assembly, a motor shell serves as a fixed end, the driving circuit board assembly controls the motor assembly to work, and a motor shaft of the motor assembly outputs power to the speed reducer to enable an output part to output rotation. The torque sensor is arranged between the motor shell and the speed reducer, the torque borne by the outputpart acts on the torque sensor through the speed reducer, the detection torque of the torque sensor is the torque borne by the output part, an intermediate transmission link does not need to be considered in the detection process, accuracy, reliability and effectiveness are achieved, and the rigidity and stability of the system are guaranteed. The joint structure has the advantages of being highin universality, high in integration degree and modular in structural design. The joint structure is applied to the robot, torque feedback is achieved at all joints, the more accurate force control effect can be achieved, and the rigidity and stability of the system are ensured.

title: Integrated joint and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to an integrated joint and a robot. The integrated joint adopts a motor assembly, a speed reducer, an output piece, a first bearing, a torque sensor and a driving plate. The shell serves as a fixed end, the driving plate controls the motor assembly to work and controls the motor shaft to output power to the speed reducer, and the speed reducer is connected to the output piece to enable the output piece to output rotation. The output end of the speed reducer is supported on the shell through a first bearing. The torque sensor is connected with the speed reducer and the output piece; the torque borne by the output part acts on the torque sensor through the speed reducer, the torque sensor detects the torque which is the torque borne by the output part, the torque value of the output part is directly measured without considering the influence factors such as flexibility and friction of an intermediatetransmission link, the measurement is more accurate, reliable and effective, and the rigidity and stability of the system are ensured. The integrated joint is applied to a robot, torque feedback is achieved at each joint, and a more accurate force control effect can be achieved.

title: Robot and integrated joint thereof
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a robot and an integrated joint thereof. According to the robot integrated joint, a motor assembly, a harmonic reducer, an output shaft, a motor end encoder, an output end encoder and a motor driver are integrated into a whole. The motor assembly provides power, and the motor shaft rotates at a high speed and transmits the power to the harmonic reducer. A wave generator of the harmonic reducer drives the flexible gear to deform flexibly, the flexible gear is in meshing transmission with the rigid gear,the rigid gear is fixed to the motor frame, and the flexible gear rotates at a low speed and drives the output shaft to rotate to output power. The output shaft is supported on the bearing supportingstructure through a first bearing. The motor end encoder is used for detecting the rotation angle of the motor shaft, the output end encoder is used for detecting the rotation angle of the output shaft, and the motor driver is used for driving the motor shaft to rotate to output preset displacement, speed and torque. The robot integrated joint is simple and compact in structure, rapid to assembleand manufacture, convenient to electrically connect, light in weight and low in cost.

title: Biped robot foot compliance balance control system and method
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot foot compliance balance control system and method. A six-dimensional force sensor and an inertia measurement unit respectively collect the foot stress and postureof a robot in an actual state, and transmit the foot stress and posture to a control rule classifier; the control rule classifier is designed by combining the robot walking state, the robot posture and the robot foot stress information, and a corresponding control rule is inferred; a posture controller acquires virtual force and virtual torque according to the control rule and the real-time posture of the robot, and inputs the virtual force, the virtual torque and the actual foot stress into a foot compliance model, so that an ankle joint angle adjustment amount is output, and the balance of the robot is maintained. The system and the method are used for realizing compliance balance control of the robot standing on the ground with variable angles and walking on the uneven ground.

title: Intelligent humanoid security and protection robot system based on double-wheel balance car
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent humanoid security and protection robot system based on a double-wheel balance car. The intelligent humanoid security and protection robot system comprises a walking mechanism. Driving shafts are mounted on the surfaces of the two sides of the walking mechanism. Rolling wheels are arranged on the outer sides of the driving shafts. Rotating discs are arranged on the outer sides of the rolling wheels. The peripheries of the rotating discs are correspondingly connected with brushes. Universal wheels are mounted at the front end of the surface of the lower side of the walking mechanism. A detector is arranged on the surface of the outer side of the walking mechanism. A security and protection mechanism is mounted at the upper end of the walking mechanism.A camera is arranged on the outer surface of the upper side of the security and protection mechanism. According to the intelligent humanoid security and protection robot system based on the double-wheel balance car, by using the walking mechanism, the device can judge the size of an obstacle while completing the security and protection operation, meanwhile, the situation that the device is impacted in the motion process can be avoided, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title: Humanoid self-feeding robot
abstract: The invention relates to robots, in particular to a humanoid self-feeding robot comprising a device bracket, a moving mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a rotating mechanism, a jacking frame, a clampingmechanism, a supporting mechanism and a righting mechanism. The device can be driven by the moving mechanism to move, and the rotating mechanism, the jacking frame, the clamping mechanism, the supporting mechanism and the righting mechanism are driven by the lifting mechanism to rise and fall for regulating the height of the device; the upper frame, the clamping mechanism, the supporting mechanismand the righting mechanism are driven by the rotating mechanism to rotate, and the lifting mechanism is cooperated with the rotating mechanism to move for regulating the clamping position of the device; the side edges of rectangular objects in different sizes are clamped through the clamping mechanism, and the bottom edges of the rectangular objects in different sizes are supported through the supporting mechanism; and the top edges of the rectangular objects in different sizes are righted through the righting mechanism.

title: Intelligent biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides an intelligent biped robot which comprises a foot plate, a foot pad, a first steering engine, a leg supporting plate, a first side plate, an ultrasonic supporting plate, a second side plate, a horn, an ultrasonic sensor, an infrared receiving and transmitting integrated sensor, a battery box, a control panel, a bottom plate, an upper plate, a second steering engine and aTF card. title: Foot structure of biped robot and all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a foot structure of a biped robot and an all-terrain pavement adaptation method thereof. When the biped robot adopting the foot structure walks on a non-flat road surface, active adaptation can be conducted according to the actual terrain of the road surface, the corresponding posture is adjusted in time, the standing and walking stability of the biped robot is rapidly andeffectively improved, and the problems, for example, that when the biped robot walks on the uneven road surface, the foot ground contact area is small, and overall balance is difficult to maintain are solved. According to the all-terrain road surface adaptive foot structure, the foot bottom is divided into four areas, and the four areas are independently stressed and deformed, so the foot of therobot is kept in good contact with the ground on the uneven road surface; and meanwhile, the situation that the foot touches the ground is obtained through the force measuring sensors distributed in the four areas of the foot, the actual topographic distribution of the foot is speculated according to the situation, related joints of the robot are driven to be adjusted, and active adaptation of thefoot and the overall posture of the robot to the uneven road surface is completed.

title: Design method for lower limb structure size of biped robot
abstract: From the perspective of facilitating gait planning and control of a biped robot, the invention provides a design method of the lower limb structure size of the biped robot, and provides theoretical and method guidance for the design of the lower limb structure size of the biped robot. Firstly, according to the human body size proportion, the overall height size of lower limbs, the thigh length size of a robot and the shank length size are designed; then, from the perspective of facilitating motion analysis and control of the biped robot, the width size of the lower limbs of the robot is designed; and finally, the sole size of the robot is designed according to the sizes and mass distribution of the upper limbs and the lower limbs of the robot.

title: Biped robot sole structure with rapid shock absorption and road surface adaptability
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot sole structure with rapid shock absorption and road surface adaptability. The mechanism can effectively improve the shock absorption and buffer capacity of feetof a humanoid robot and improve the adaptability of the robot to uneven road surfaces. The sole mechanism comprises a retainer used for installation and playing a supporting role, a longitudinal archmechanism and a transverse arch mechanism which are connected with the retainer, and an inner side forefoot module, an outer side forefoot module, an inner side heel module and an outer side heel module which are connected with the arch mechanism. The rapid shock absorption and road surface adaptation sole mechanism for the flat plate foot of the humanoid robot is suitable for meeting the requirements of various humanoid robots with the flat plate foot as a main sole structure for quick shock absorption and uneven road surface adaptation.

title: Multifunctional humanoid multi-legged robot
abstract: A multifunctional humanoid multi-legged robot comprises at least four multi-joint or multi-degree-of-freedom bionic mechanical legs, and the bionic mechanical legs are connected with the bottom or theperiphery of a humanoid robot body. Or the at least four bionic mechanical legs form a multi-legged robot platform through connecting pieces and then are connected with the trunk of the humanoid robot. The adaptive capacity and the climbing and running capacity of a traditional humanoid robot to complex terrains can be greatly improved; the loading capacity of the robot can be greatly improved, and the problems that the structure of the humanoid robot is complex and the gravity center change needs a large amount of servo adjustment control can be simplified and solved; the robot can be applied to the fields of security, defense, service, entertainment, performance, communication and the like, and various requirements of people can be met by one robot.

title: Ventilation and heat dissipation device for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The utility model relates to a robot, in particular to a ventilation and heat dissipation device for humanoid robots. The device comprises a main control bin, a central column and a protection frame, arms are fixed to the two ends of the main control bin through movable connection. Legs are mounted at the bottom of the main control bin; the top of the main control bin is connected with a head part; a heat dissipation opening is formed in the main control bin through one-time injection molding; According to the utility model,the protection frame, the pulleys, the sliding grooves and the heat dissipation openings are arranged; after the accompanying embedded installation of the negative pressure fan is completed; the device is manually controlled to pull the protection frame to slide along a track arranged in the sliding groove through the pulley; according to the device, when the covering structure is used for shielding and isolating from the front side of the heat dissipation opening, the interference of external factors to the whole heat dissipation operation can be effectively reduced.

title: Biped robot foot landing position control system and method
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot landing position control system and a biped robot landing position control method. The biped robot landing position control method comprises the following steps of: 1) planning a feasible collision-free path by using a path planning algorithm; 2) determining foot-landing regions of swinging foots according to a step length constraint, motion ability, foot sizeand center offset of a biped robot; 3) and determining a specific foot position of the robot through fuzzy processing. According to the biped robot landing position control system and the biped robotlanding position control method, when a specific walking action is executed after path planning of the biped robot is finished, proper foot landing positions on the two sides of the path are selected;and the biped robot landing position control system and the biped robot landing position control method have the advantages of being simple, easy to implement, small in calculation load, high in speed, capable of exerting the extreme movement capacity of different biped robots and enabling the biped robots to move more flexibly and the like.

title: Single-foot support phase gait planning method of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a single-foot support phase gait planning method of a biped robot. According to the method, the landing time of an underactuated free robot is estimated on the basis of a simplified model, possible landing time errors are further considered, the robot is made to move to a target pose in advance, and then the pose is kept for landing; besides, in order to prevent the robot swinging foot from scraping the ground, the method decomposes the action process of swinging the leg by the single-foot support, which comprises leg lifting action and leg swinging action. Based on thesingle-foot support phase gait planning method provided by the invention, the robot can be effectively helped to reach an expected foothold in the single-foot support phase and can be prevented frombeing scraped with the ground, so that the walking movement and task operation of the biped robot are favorably realized.

title: Humanoid robot tumbling prediction method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot tumbling prediction method, which comprises the steps of collecting state data when a robot tumbles towards different directions and is stable, forming an SVM training data set, performing training to obtain an SVM classifier, inputting the state data of the robot into the trained SVM classifier, outputting a classification result by the SVM classifier, in the judgment buffer time after the SVM classifier outputs the classification result, counting the proportion of the period which is judged to be about to fall to the total control period number, and finally determining the robot fall prediction result according to the proportion output. The method for obtaining the training data set is simple and can be applied to a fall-down prediction method during movement of the robot.

abstract: The utility model discloses a foot state detection device of a biped robot. The device comprises a pressure sensor module, an AD conversion module, an inertia measurement module, a communication module, a microcontroller module and a power supply module. The foot state detection device can detect the foot angle state on the basis of realizing the original foot pressure detection function, realizesthe gradient information detection of the ground, and provides feedback for the biped robot to walk on the inclined plane.

title: Dancing Robot that learns the relationship between dance and music
abstract: The present invention relates to a robot capable of learning a correlation between a dance and music to dance. According to the present invention, the robot (1) having a human shape to control a portion corresponding to each joint of a person by a motor (10) to dance comprises: a microphone (100) to receive music; a data storage unit (200) storing data resulting from learning a correlation between a dance and music; a data input unit (300) to communicate with the data storage unit (200) in a wired/wireless manner to input music or dance image data to store the music or the dance image data in the data storage unit (200); and a control unit (400) connected to the motor (10), the microphone (100), and the data storage unit (200) to control to dance in accordance with music received from the microphone (100).

title: Hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with buffering function
abstract: The utility model discloses a hydraulic biped robot lower limb mechanism with a buffering function. title: Biped robot gait control method and biped robot
abstract: There are a biped robot gait control method and a biped robot, where the method includes: obtaining six-dimensional force information, and determining a motion state of two legs of the biped robot; calculating a ZMP position of each of two legs of the biped robot; determining a ZMP expected value of each of the two legs in real time; obtaining a compensation angle of an ankle joint of each of the two legs of the biped robot by inputting the ZMP position, a change rate of the ZMP position, the ZMP expected value, and a change rate of the ZMP expected value to an ankle joint smoothing controller so as to perform a close-loop ZMP tracking control on each of the two legs; adjusting a current angle of the ankle joint of each of the two legs of the biped robot in real time; and repeating the forgoing steps.

title: HUMANOID ROBOTIC ARM SOMATOSENSORY CONTROL SYSTEM AND RELATED PRODUCT
abstract: A humanoid robotic arm somatosensory control system, the system comprising: a somatosensory detection unit (101), an operation unit (102), a robotic arm (104) and a control unit (103). An output terminal of the somatosensory detection unit (101) is connected to an input terminal of the operation unit (102), the operation unit (102) and the control unit (103) are connected by means of a wireless communication module, and an output terminal of the control unit (103) is connected to an input terminal of the robotic arm (104), wherein the somatosensory detection unit (101) is used to obtain movement parameters of a target user; the operation unit (102) is used to calculate movement parameters of the robotic arm (104) by using a preset algorithm according to the movement parameters of the target user, and send the movement parameters of the robotic arm (104) to the control unit (103); and the control unit (103) is used to receive the movement parameters of the robotic arm (104) sent by the operation unit (102), and control the movement of the robotic arm (104) according to the movement parameters of the robotic arm (104). The described system reduces the duration when computing, and reduces to a certain extent the time delay when controlling the robotic arm. Also disclosed are a humanoid robotic arm and a robot.

title: JOINT STRUCTURE OF HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to a lower limb joint structure of a humanoid robot. The lower limb joint structure of the humanoid robot of the present invention includes: a first frame equipped with a first motor; a first link having one end coupled to the first motor; a joint unit to which the other end of the first link is rotationally coupled; a second link of which one end is rotationally coupled to the joint unit; and a second frame including a second motor to which the other end of the second link is coupled. title: Motion synthesis method based on spherical nonlinear interpolation
abstract: The invention discloses a motion synthesis method based on spherical nonlinear interpolation, and relates to the field of computers. The method comprises the following specific steps: preparing data training and standardizing joint coordinates; extracting a motion law of the motion sequence, learning a motion law dictionary and a motion frame dictionary according to standardized motion data, solving sparse representation coefficients of the head frame and the tail frame on the motion frame dictionary by using an orthogonal matching pursuit algorithm, reconstructing the motion law on the motionlaw dictionary, and synthesizing a complete motion sequence; the method has the advantages that in the field of film and television industry, the method can be used for synthesizing 3D human motion to drive virtual characters; in the field of robots, some special actions can be synthesized to drive a humanoid robot; in the field of medical rehabilitation, the method can be used for synthesizing normal movement postures of patients with dyskinesia so as to assist psychological treatment.

title: Biped robot structure and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot structure. The biped robot structure comprises a hip, an upper supporting rod, a lower supporting rod, a first power mechanism, a second power mechanism and a third power mechanism. The invention further provides a control method of the biped robot structure. The control method comprises the following steps: the first power mechanism and the third power mechanism are controlled to operate for passive walking; and when a robot encounters an obstacle in the forward walking direction, the second power mechanism is controlled to operate to make the angle of the swing shaft of the lower supporting rod deflect. The second power mechanism can drive the third power mechanism to rotate at the lower end of the upper supporting rod, so the angle of the swing shaft of the lower supporting rod is changed, the lower supporting rod swings towards the left front or the right front, the lower supporting rod bypasses the obstacle from the side face of the obstacle,and the situation that the knee lifting action of the robot is interfered due to the obstacle right ahead the lower supporting rod is avoided.

title: Facial organ mechanism of humanoid expression robot
abstract: The invention provides a facial organ mechanism of a humanoid expression robot. The facial organ mechanism comprises an eye movement mechanism, a mouth movement mechanism and a base; the eye movementmechanism is divided into an eyeball movement mechanism and an eyelid mechanism, wherein the eyeball movement mechanism adopts a spherical hinge and parallel four-bar linkage structure, so that up-and-down and left-and-right coupled rotation of eyeballs is realized; the eyelid mechanism adopts a swing guide rod mechanism, so that blinking action of the robot is realized; the mouth movement mechanism adopts spur gear transmission, so that mouth opening and closing action is realized through utilizing the meshing characteristic of the mouth movement mechanism; and the base can be connected witha robot body, the eye movement mechanism and the mouth movement mechanism are fixedly connected with the base, and therefore facial organ actions of the humanoid expression robot are achieved. The facial organ mechanism is compact in design so as to be able to move in a narrow space of a head; and meanwhile, the facial organ mechanism is flexible in movement, and can truly simulate eyeball rotation, blinking action and mouth opening and closing action of human beings.

title: Mapping method applied to humanoid robot double-hand motion imitation
abstract: The invention provides a mapping method applied to humanoid robot double-hand motion imitation. The mapping method comprises the steps that positions of double shoulders, double elbows, double knees and a head of a human body in a world coordinate system are obtained, and corresponding target motions of double arms, double legs, a trunk and the head of a humanoid robot are calculated by utilizinga rotation matrix; the posture of human hands in the world coordinate system is obtained through a VR game handle and is converted into the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system; and the human body hand posture of the human body relative to the coordinate system is the same as humanoid robot hand target posture RhandJ of the robot relative to the coordinate system, the RhandJ is decomposed into humanoid robot wrist posture RwristA and humanoid robot forearm posture RarmJ, a value expressed by an XYZ euler angle corresponding to the RwristA is taken as a target value of a humanoid robot wrist driving device, and human body wrist rotation is made to be accurately mapped to humanoid robot wrists.

title: Walking leg assembly, walking device and walking robot
abstract: The invention provides a walking leg assembly, a walking device and a walking robot. The walking leg assembly comprises a walking leg support, a first walking foot, a second walking foot, a first camand a second cam. The first cam and the second cam are rotatably connected to the walking leg support respectively, the first cam and the second cam synchronously rotate and are connected between thefirst walking foot and the second walking foot, the rotation of the first cam drives the first walking foot and the second walking foot to periodically move in the first direction, and the rotation ofthe second cam drives the first walking foot and the second walking foot to periodically move in the second direction. Compared with a transmission mode of utilizing a hydraulic cylinder and a connecting rod or a crank rocker and the like, the above transmission mode of the invention is helpful for reducing the size of the walking leg assembly and the walking space occupied by the walking leg assembly during walking, helps the walking robot to penetrate through a channel with the same width as the robot body, and is helpful for forming the walking relation matched with the walking robot amongthe multiple walking leg assemblies according to the application scene of the walking device or the walking robot.

title: Highly-intelligent transformable robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, in particular to a highly-intelligent transformable robot. The highly-intelligent transformable robot comprises a scene selection module, a navigation module, a posture changing module, an operation module and an execution module, wherein the scene selection module selects difference task scenes, and extracts corresponding task informationand execution motions, the navigation module conducts navigation control over the walking path according to external environment information, the posture changing module controls the highly-intelligent transformable robot to conduct posture change in the process of navigation control, the operation module controls the highly-intelligent transformable robot to execute corresponding operation motions when the highly-intelligent transformable robot moves to determined execution positions in the task information, and the execution module controls driving motors of all mechanical arms according tocontrol instructions output by all the modules, and thus the highly-intelligent transformable robot is controlled to conduct path navigation and posture change and execute corresponding operation motions. The highly-intelligent transformable robot has the advantages that the purpose of conducting adaptive adjustment and switching on the humanoid robot between the standing posture and other postures according to the change in tasks and scenes is achieved, and various tasks in the scenes can be automatically finished according to external instructions.

title: Similarity-in-form and similarity-in-spirit combined person simulating double-arm robot motion planning control method
abstract: The invention provides a similarity-in-form and similarity-in-spirit combined person simulating double-arm robot motion planning control method. The human motion action is converted into person simulating double-arm robot motion planning based on similarity-in-form control, and the tail end smoothness character of each mechanical arm during person simulating double-arm robot operation is similar to the person based on similarity-in-spirit control. By means of the method, the motion experience when the human carries out the task operation in the unstructured environment can be effectively usedfor reference, robot rapid planning in the unstructured environment is achieved through similarity-in-form control, the human arm motion and rigidity changing rule can be used for reference, tail endsmoothness control parameters are corrected online based on the person motion intention, accordingly, the mechanical arms show the smoothness character similar to the person when making contact with the environment or operation target, and accordingly the person simulating double-arm safety and protection robot operation task executing effect in the unstructured environment is improved.

title: Control system of sensing head of highly intelligent humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, in particular to a control system of a sensing head of a highly intelligent humanoid robot. The control system comprises sensing head equipment and processing equipment. The sensing head equipment is arranged on the head of the highly intelligent humanoid robot and comprises a laser sensing module, a wide baseline module, a narrow baselinemodule and a wide angle module. The processing equipment is arranged on the highly intelligent humanoid robot and is connected with the sensing head equipment and four limbs of the highly intelligenthumanoid robot and used for receiving the distance detection result, the front image detection result, the lower image detection result and the panoramic image detection result, an environment model of the highly intelligent humanoid robot is constructed, and a control command for controlling motion of the four limbs is generated. By means of the technical scheme, the control system has the beneficial effects that dead corners are prevented from being generated to the sensing head of the highly intelligent humanoid robot, errors between the environment imaging model and the true environment are reduced, and operation accuracy of the highly intelligent humanoid robot is improved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom neck structure of service robot
abstract: The invention provides a three-degree-of-freedom neck structure of a service robot. The three-degree-of-freedom neck structure comprises a pitching and side-sway joint, a rotary joint and a base. Thepitching and side-sway joint is based on a spur gear transmission structure and a differential bevel gear structure, and can realize the pitching and side-sway movement of a neck; and the rotary jointadopts a deep groove ball bearing being matched with a thrust ball bearing, radial force and axial force can be simultaneously born, and the neck rotary movement is realized. The base is connected with a robot body, the pitching and side-sway joint is connected with the base, the rotary joint is connected with the pitching and side-sway joint, and the robot head is connected with the rotary joint, so that the three-degree-of-freedom neck movement of the service robot is realized. The three-degree-of-freedom neck structure is compact, the movement is flexible, and snaking, shaking and noddingmovements of human can be truly imitated, so that the service robot is more easily accepted by people.

title: Humanoid remote control method for immersion type dual-arm robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid remote control method for an immersion type dual-arm robot. The humanoid remote control method for the immersion type dual-arm robot comprises the following steps ofthrough arm exercise of an operator, driving double arms of a wearable exoskeleton movement capturer to move; resolving data acquired by an angular displacement sensor at each degree of freedom of thewearable exoskeleton movement capturer into an operator arm posture; transmitting the operator arm posture to the dual-arm robot through remote communication, so that double arms of the dual-arm robot and arms of the operator act synchronously; detecting the stress condition of each joint of the dual-arm robot through torque transducers equipped for the double arms of the dual-arm robot; resolving the stress condition of each joint of the dual-arm robot acquired by the torque transducers into force feedback produced by each degree of freedom of the wearable exoskeleton movement capturer; andthrough controlling the output torque of a torque motor equipped at each degree of freedom of the wearable exoskeleton movement capturer, providing force feedback for the arms of the operator.

title: Active waist power-assisted exoskeleton robot electrical system
abstract: The invention discloses an active waist power-assisted exoskeleton robot electrical system which comprises a main control unit, a handheld terminal, a driving unit, a navigation attitude reference system, a current detection unit and a power supply unit. The handheld terminal, the driving unit, the navigation attitude reference system and the current detection unit are electrically connected withthe main control unit; the main control unit, the navigation attitude reference system, the current detection unit and the power supply unit are arranged on the back of an exoskeleton robot, the driving unit is arranged on hip joints of two legs of the exoskeleton robot, the handheld terminal is independent of an exoskeleton robot body, the driving unit comprises a motor, a speed reducer and a motor driver, and the current detection unit is used for measuring current of the driving unit; and the navigation attitude reference system inclines forwards relative to the back of the exoskeleton robot. According to the active waist power-assisted exoskeleton robot electrical system, the singularity problem of an MPU6050 acceleration sensor in measuring a 90-degree angle is effectively solved by amanner of mounting the navigation attitude reference system relative to the back of the exoskeleton robot in a forward tilting manner.

title: Humanoid robot foot grounding detection method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot foot grounding detection method, which comprises the steps of extracting motion state points of all robots and contact states corresponding to the motion statepoints in a plurality of walking periods through walking simulation to form a training data set; training a support vector machine SVM by using the training data set to obtain a foot contact detector;actually-detected motion state point data are classified by using a foot contact detector, so that detection of foot contact with the ground of the humanoid robot is realized. Sensors do not need tobe arranged at the tail ends of feet of the humanoid robot, and redundant mechanical structures can be avoided; no extra processing process is needed, and detection of foot grounding is achieved according to knee joint movement.

title: Bionic welcome robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of welcome services, and particularly relates to a bionic object welcome robot. The welcome robot comprises a robot main body imitating the shape of a human body, a surface shell of the robot main body is made of a high-simulation material, and a bidirectional welcome device is arranged in the head of the robot main body, wherein the bidirectional welcome device comprises a first detector, a second detector, a loudspeaker and a controller; the first detector, the second detector and the loudspeaker are electrically connected with the controller respectively; the first detector and the second detector are located on the two eyes respectively; the controller judges a moving direction of a person according to infrared signals collected by the two detectors when the person passes by, and controls the loudspeaker to play corresponding voice according to the moving direction. According to the invention, a human-body-like shape and the high-simulation shell are adopted, so that the simulation performance is high and the consumption experience of guests is improved; and the corresponding voice is played according to the moving direction of the person, so that the quality of guest service is improved.

title: Anthropomorphic rotating mechanism and method for robot head
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic rotating mechanism and method for a robot head. The anthropomorphic rotating mechanism comprises the robot head and a robot body, a vertical motor is mountedon the robot head and mounted on the robot body through a horizontal motor, and a 4mic array and a camera are further arranged on the front face of the robot head. The anthropomorphic rotating mechanism and method for the robot head have the beneficial effects that 1, an aluminum tube is good in ductility and easy to machine and manufacture; 2, a layer of naturally-formed oxide film is arranged on the surface of the aluminum tube, so that the aluminum tube is not prone to being corroded by a medium; 3, the hardness of the aluminum tube is smaller than that of red copper, so that friction damage to a red copper tube is avoided; 4, the aluminum tube is low in density and weight, so that the overall weight of a heat exchanger is not affected; and 5, the aluminum tube is large in output, lowin price, economical and practical.

title: Underactuated robot finger device based on rope winding
abstract: The invention discloses an underactuated robot finger device based on rope winding. The problem that in the prior art, an anthropomorphic robot finger still needs to be improved is solved. The underactuated robot finger device comprises a base outer shell, a first finger middle shell, a second finger middle shell and a finger tail shell which are hinged in sequence, and loosening reset springs arearranged at hinged positions; one end of the base outer shell is connected with a mechanical arm, and the other end of the base outer shell is provided with a gripping control motor, a first universal joint, a gripping adjustment driving wheel, a gripping adjustment spring, a pull rope, a pull rope winding device, a pull rope straight sleeve and an arc-shaped pull rope positioning sleeve; a second universal joint and a first gripping adjustment driven wheel are arranged at the hinged position of the first finger middle shell and the second finger middle shell; and a third universal joint anda second gripping adjustment driven wheel are arranged at the hinged position of the second finger middle shell and the finger tail shell. According to the technology, the effect of muscle stretchingis simulated by producing tensile force by winding two pull ropes to shorten the length in a vertical direction.

title: Biped walking stability analysis method based on track mechanical energy
abstract: The invention discloses a biped walking stability analysis method based on track mechanical energy, and the method comprises the following steps: selecting a biped robot foothold and a corresponding foothold period of the current step, and calculating the track mechanical energy En of the current step according to an expression of the track mechanical energy of the biped robot; calculating the track mechanical energy En + 1 of the next step according to the track mechanical energy expression of the biped robot based on the foothold and the corresponding foothold period of the biped robot of the next step; constructing a stability judgment condition according to En, En + 1 and the target mechanical energy Etr capable of realizing periodic stable walking, and if the stability judgment condition is met, indicating that the walking of the biped robot converges to the target mechanical energy to realize progressive stability; if the formula is not met, optimizing the current position Pn andthe period Tn of the current position Pn. According to the invention, on the basis of original track energy and improvement, track mechanical energy is provided, the mass center movement speed direction and the direction, relative to ZMP, of the mass center position are introduced through the track mechanical energy, and the track mechanical energy can be used for representing the magnitude and direction of external disturbance.
