title: Power supply control system and method for high-intelligence humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, in particular to a power supply control system and method for a high-intelligence humanoid robot. The system comprises: a client which is usedfor sending a starting instruction or a stopping instruction; the system also comprises a processing end, and the processing end comprises an instruction receiving module; a main battery module whichis provided with a main battery power supply switch; an auxiliary power supply module; and a power supply switching module, wherein the first input end of the power supply switching module is connected with the battery module, the second input end of the power supply switching module is connected with the auxiliary power supply module, and the output end of the power supply switching module is connected with the high-intelligence humanoid robot. The technical scheme has the beneficial effects that when the main battery module is replaced, the high-intelligence humanoid robot can be kept in anelectrified state all the time, energy loss and important position information loss caused by shutdown of the high-intelligence humanoid robot are avoided, and the operation safety of the robot is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps that S1, simulation control is carried out, specifically,the current state of a humanoid robot is obtained, and the target angle of each joint of the humanoid robot are calculated and determined through a preset deep reinforcement learning model accordingto the current state; and S2, PD control is carried out, specifically, through a PD controller, the target angle serves as a control target, the actual angle and the joint torque of the joint serve asfeedback, the control torque of the joint is determined, and the joint is controlled to act according to the control torque. The method has the advantages of good control stability, good reliabilityand the like.

title: Humanoid robot system based on pneumatic muscles and air cylinders
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot system based on pneumatic muscles and air cylinders. Upper limb joints are arranged on the two sides above waist joints; lower limb joints are symmetrically arranged below; a big arm branched chain I, a big arm branched chain II, a big arm branched chain III and a big arm branched chain IV are rotatably connected with the two sides above breast connectingpieces of the waist joints and are rotatably connected with a big arm connecting piece I separately; the big arm branched chain I and the big arm branched chain III have the same structure, and each of the big arm branched chain I and the big arm branched chain III comprises a big arm pneumatic muscle II, a big arm air cylinder III and a big arm pneumatic muscle III; the big arm branched chain IIand the big arm branched chain IV have the same structure, and each of the big arm branched chain II and the big arm branched chain IV comprises a big arm air cylinder I, a big arm pneumatic muscle Iand a big arm air cylinder II; the big arm connecting piece I is rotatably connected with a middle connecting piece; the middle connecting piece is fixedly connected with a big arm connecting piece II; and the big arm connecting piece II is rotatably connected with pneumatic muscle groups.

title: Biped robot gait control method and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait control method and a biped robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining six-dimensional force information, and judging a supporting state of the bipedrobot according to the six-dimensional force information; calculating the ZMP position of each foot of the biped robot according to the six-dimensional force information; setting a ZMP expected valueof each foot according to the supporting state and a body posture error; determining an ankle joint compensation angle of each foot of the biped robot according to the ZMP position, the change rate ofthe ZMP position, the ZMP expected value and the change rate of the ZMP expected value; tracking and adjusting the current ankle joint angle of the biped robot in real time according to the ankle joint compensation angle; and circulating the steps at a set frequency until posture control or ankle joint compliance is completed in different supporting states.

title: Biped robot positioning method and device and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a biped robot positioning method and device and a robot, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first mass center position of the robot in a world coordinate system, and building a first body coordinate system of the robot; acquiring a first displacement of the robot moving in a world coordinate system at a first preset time interval; projecting the first displacement to an X axis of a first body coordinate system, and obtaining a second displacement projected to the X axis of the first body coordinate system; converting the second displacement into a world coordinate system to obtain a first displacement increment; determining a second centroid position according to the first centroid position and the first displacement increment; and when it is detected that the forward speed of the robot is not zero and the steering speed is zero at the first moment, determining the second mass center position as the positioning position of the robot. according to the invention, the obtained real-time positioning in the navigation process of the robot can be more accurate, it is guaranteed that the robot smoothly reaches the navigation destination, and therefore the accuracy of intelligent navigation is high.

title: Bionic robot hand joint connecting and driving method
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot hand joint connecting and driving method. The bionic robot hand joint connecting and driving method is characterized in that a flexible limiting piece and a linkage piece for operating a finger joint to move are arranged outside the finger joint of each finger, the linkage pieces are driven by a driving mechanism, and the limiting pieces limit the movement ranges of the finger joints to realize the movement of robot hand joints. According to the bionic robot hand joint connecting and driving method, the finger joints are driven to stretch out and draw back through cooperation of the limiting pieces and the linkage pieces, the structure is simple, the bearing capacity is high, each finger is independently driven, and human hand movement is completely simulated.

title: Head rotating mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a head rotating mechanism of a humanoid robot. The device comprises a bottom plate, a connecting cylinder, a second stepping motor output shaft and a first stepping motor output shaft, a first stepping motor and a second stepping motor are fixedly connected to the two sides of the upper end face of the bottom plate. Two supporting columns are fixedly connected between the first stepping motor and the second stepping motor; an output shaft of the first stepping motor is fixedly connected with the first fixed block; the first fixed block is fixedly connected with the first bracket; the first support is fixedly connected with the robot head fixing block, the connecting cylinder is fixedly connected with the first bevel gear, the robot head fixing block is fixedly connected with the second support, the second support is fixedly connected with the second fixing block, an output shaft of the second stepping motor is fixedly connected with the second bevel gear, andthe first bevel gear is meshed with the second bevel gear.

title: Humanoid mechanical finger
abstract: A humanoid mechanical finger comprises a finger part and further comprises a motor, a first gear pair, a second gear pair and a reversing device. The utility model belongs to the technical field of artificial bionic machinery, and particularly relates to a mechanical finger. According to the utility model, the action behavior of the finger part 5 is controlled by controlling the rotation of the motor 1. The rotating speed of a motor is very high, control is not facilitated, and a two-stage speed reducer composed of a first gear pair 2 and a second gear pair 3 can just solve the problem. And the high rotating speed is reduced, so that the rotation of the fingers can be more stably controlled. The reversing device 4 is formed by meshing a pair of bevel gears, the original rotating directionaround a motor shaft is changed into the rotating direction perpendicular to the motor shaft, and therefore fingers are driven to rotate.

abstract: A robot is disclosed. title: Base joint of robot humanoid dexterous hand finger
abstract: The invention discloses a base joint of a robot humanoid dexterous hand finger which comprises a joint seat, a cross shaft, a finger proximity section, a first drive bevel gear, a second drive bevel gear, a driven bevel gear, a first driving assembly and a second driving assembly. The cross shaft comprises a first shaft and a second shaft. The first shaft is rotationally connected with the joint seat, and the first drive bevel gear and the second drive bevel gear are rotationally arranged on the first shaft in a sleeving manner. The driven bevel gear is arranged on the second shaft in a sleeving manner and is fixed to the finger proximity section. The finger proximity section is rotationally connected with the second shaft. The output end of the first driving assembly is connected with thefirst drive bevel gear, and the output end of the second driving assembly is connected with the second drive bevel gear. By means of the base joint of the robot humanoid dexterous hand finger, the structure of an executing mechanism is simple, and due to a tendon rope and pulley driving differential structure, the humanoid motion of two degrees of freedom of the joint of the finger proximity section is achieved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a base joint of a robot humanoid dexterous hand finger which comprises a joint seat, a cross shaft, a finger proximity section, a first drive bevel gear, a second drive bevel gear, a driven bevel gear, a first driving assembly and a second driving assembly. The cross shaft comprises a first shaft and a second shaft. The first shaft is rotationally connected with the joint seat, and the first drive bevel gear and the second drive bevel gear are rotationally arranged on the first shaft in a sleeving manner. The driven bevel gear is arranged on the second shaft in a sleeving manner and is fixed to the finger proximity section. The finger proximity section is rotationally connected with the second shaft. The output end of the first driving assembly is connected with thefirst drive bevel gear, and the output end of the second driving assembly is connected with the second drive bevel gear. title: Novel multi-functional humanoid robot platform and control system of same
abstract: The invention provides a novel multi-functional humanoid robot platform and a control system of the system, which comprise a multi-functional humanoid robot hardware platform and a multi-functional humanoid robot control system, wherein the multi-functional humanoid robot hardware platform comprises a full-direction movable chassis, a liftable platform and a pair of bionic mechanical arms, and theliftable platform is installed on the full-direction movable chassis; the set of bionic mechanical arms are installed on the liftable platform; and the multi-functional humanoid robot control systemcomprises a communication bus part, a core control circuit, a full-direction movable chassis control circuit, a liftable platform control circuit, a mechanical front arm controller and a mechanical rear arm controller, and the communication bus part is connected to the core control circuit, the full-direction movable chassis control circuit, the liftable platform control circuit, the mechanical front arm controller and the mechanical rear arm controller respectively. The platform and the system are multi-functional, universal and operation-friendly.

title: Control method of following robot joints
abstract: The invention discloses a control method of following robot joints. A plurality of forward and backward displacement signals or pulse signals emitted at the drive of human body joints are transmittedto a control unit, the control unit outputs a pulse proportionally according to the signals and controls a corresponding plurality of driving motors so as to drive a plurality of servo electric cylinders to move the corresponding length, and the robot joint precise following is realized by the parallel motion of the servo electric cylinders. Through parallel sampling and controlled motion of a plurality of sensors and the servo electric cylinders, the control method of the following robot joints realizes the multi-degree-of-freedom flexible accurate following of the shoulder joint, the hip joint and the like of the following robot.

title: Thumb rotating mechanism, bionic hand and bionic robot
abstract: The invention provides a thumb rotating mechanism, a bionic hand and a bionic robot. The thumb rotating mechanism comprises a thumb mounting base and a rotating part, wherein the first end of the thumb mounting base is used for connecting a bionic thumb, the second end of the thumb mounting base is rotatably connected with the rotating part, the axial direction of the rotating part is perpendicular to the thumb mounting base, and the rotating part can be driven by external force to rotate so as to drive the thumb mounting base to rotate around the axial direction of the rotating part. Throughthe above arrangement, the thumb mounting base can be driven to rotate in the axial direction of the rotating part by using the rotation of the rotating part, then the bionic thumb can be driven to rotate in a plane, the rotatable range of the bionic thumb is greatly widened, and therefore the fine operation is achieved favorably.

title: Exoskeleton robot waist adjusting and rotating mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton robot waist adjusting and rotating mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of exoskeleton robots. A waist of a robot is connected with leg fixing rods through a rotary compensation assembly; the rotary compensation assembly includes an installation plate which is installed on the waist of the robot, the leg fixing rods are rotatably installed on the installation plate, compensation blocks are coaxially installed on the leg fixing rods, a first limiting block and a second limiting block are fixedly installed on the installation plate, the first limiting block is arranged in the clockwise rotation direction of the compensation blocks, and the first limiting block and the compensation blocks are arranged at intervals; and the second limiting blockis arranged in the counter clockwise rotation direction of the compensation blocks, and the second limiting block and the compensation blocks are arranged at intervals. The exoskeleton robot waist adjusting and rotating mechanism is provided with a compensation angle when feet swing inwards and a compensation angle when the feet swing outwards so that legs of the exoskeleton robot can swing inside and outside with the transfer of the center of gravity of a human body, the walking action is relatively flexible, and the comfort is high.

title: Dance star with platform air chamber
abstract: The utility model discloses a dance star with a platform air chamber. According to the main design, a platform with an air chamber function is added to the dance star, the two legs of the humanoid dance star can share one draught fan, the problem that the two legs of the humanoid dance star need one draught fan is solved, and the manufacturing cost of the dance star is saved. Air is pumped in by the draught fan 2, passes through the air chamber platform 3, then enters the dance star 1 through the foot parts 4 and 5 of the dance star 1 and finally rushes through an upper air opening of the dance star, and the dance star is driven to wave under the counter-acting force of rushing out of the air.

title: Servo hydraulic drive robot
abstract: The invention provides a servo hydraulic drive robot. The robot comprises a platform, hip joint connecting rods, thighs, thigh connecting rods, shanks and first servo drivers. title: Biped robot moving chassis

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom biped robot platform device
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom biped robot platform device used for the robot technology. title: Evaluation method, apparatus and system of driver monitoring device, and evaluator
abstract: The invention relates to an evaluation method, apparatus and system for a driver monitoring device, and an evaluator. The method comprises the following steps: receiving alarm information sent by a preset data collector, wherein the alarm information comprises driver action information, the alarm information is generated by the action of a to-be-monitored driver monitoring device for monitoring ahumanoid robot in a simulated driving environment, and the data collector is used for collecting the alarm information; and carrying out consistency comparison on the driver action information and a preset test action to obtain an evaluation result of the monitoring device. By adopting the method, the apparatus or the system, the detection repeatability and controllability of the driver monitoringdevice can be improved, the detection risk is reduced, and meanwhile, the environmental adaptability of the driver monitoring device is evaluated.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand capable of being worn on special protective garment glove
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid dexterous hand capable of being worn on a special protective garment glove, and relates to the technical field of mechanical hand structures. The humanoid dexteroushand comprises multiple fingers, a palm connecting platform and a parallel-connection wrist mechanism. The multiple fingers are arranged at one end of the palm connecting platform, and the parallel-connection wrist mechanism is arranged at the other end of the palm connecting platform. According to the problems that existing mechanical hand structure parts are too large and secondary assembling cannot be achieved fast, the structure-compact and independent fingers are designed, and the fingers are connected with the palm connecting platform through finger fastening nuts. According to the problem that existing mechanical hands have no wrist joints or motion centers of wrist joints do not coincide, the parallel-connection wrist mechanism is designed, the parallel-connection wrist mechanism is provided with two rotating freedom degrees, motion centers coincide, and the effect is basically consistent with the motion effect of human hands. Wearing and operation of the humanoid dexterous hand in the special narrow non-structure space, the special protective garment glove, are achieved, and motion and mechanics performance testing can be carried out on the special protective garment glove.

title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM, AND RELATED PRODUCT
abstract: A robot control system, a humanoid robotic arm comprising the system, and a robotic arm system. The robot control system comprises a control sub-system (101) and a robot (102). The control sub-system comprises a processor (1011), a communications module (1012), a motion generation module (1013), and an acquisition module (1014). The processor has a coupling connection to the communications module. The motion generation module is used to generate a target motion posture. The acquisition module is used to acquire the target motion posture generated by the motion generation module and to obtain target motion information. The communications module sends the robot motion instruction to the robot. The robot receives the robot motion instruction and moves according to the robot motion instruction. The robot control system improves convenience of robot control.

title: Rigid and flexible combined humanoid five-finger mechanical gripper
abstract: The invention discloses a rigid and flexible combined humanoid five-finger mechanical gripper. The mechanical gripper comprises bionic finger joints, rigid wire drive joints and a bionic palm. title: Walking supporting mechanism of biped walking type robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a walking supporting mechanism of a biped walking type robot. The walking supporting mechanism is beneficial for the biped walking type robot to stably walk, squat and stand on various road conditions under the condition that the biped walking type robot bears loads. A supporting mechanism capable of extending forwards or backwards is arranged on an upper body of the robot, and the supporting mechanism can enable a falling point of a gravity action line of the robot during load bearing to be located between a landing point of the supporting mechanism and a landing point of a foot of the robot. The supporting mechanism automatically stretches forwards or backwards according to the load-bearing standing and walking conditions of the robot, so that the gravity center of the robot can be kept stable and cannot topple over no matter the robot stands, walks on the flat ground, climbs a slope, goes upstairs and downstairs, squats or stands up under the load-bearingcondition, and the robot moves stably and smoothly. When the robot does not bear load and does not need to assist in supporting, the robot control system controls the supporting mechanism to be folded and retracted and stored close to the upper body, and the robot keeps the appearance of the biped robot and reduces space occupation.

title: Robot walking control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning and medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot walking control method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises: setting a reward mechanism; constructing a multi-expert neural network; wherein the multi-expert neural network comprises a top-layer network and at least one bottom-layer network; training a top-layer network by using the reward mechanism and the collected sample data; and in the operation process of the robot, the top-layer network fusiung the output of the bottom-layer network according to the training result and the data measured by the robot in real time, outputting a controlinstruction according to the fusion result, sending the control instruction to the robot and controlling motors of joints in the robot. According to the method, continuous switching can be carried outamong different expert networks, the diversity of combination is increased, and the defects of asymmetry and non-naturalness of movement gaits of an existing robot are overcome. According to the method, the walking gait obtained by human motion capture is used as a reference object for training and learning, so that the multi-expert neural network can be converged to a periodic symmetrical walking strategy which is natural like a human body more quickly.

title: Resonance suppression method for humanoid flexible arm
abstract: The invention provides a resonance suppression method for a humanoid flexible arm, particularly provides a resonance suppression method for a humanoid flexible arm based on a PR controller, and belongs to the field of vibration control. An output shaft of a joint motor end of the humanoid flexible arm is connected with a fixed end of an arm connecting rod through a harmonic reducer, and the inherent flexibility of a flexible gear of the harmonic reducer introduces a resonance frequency point to cause the resonance problem of the humanoid robot arm. According to the resonance suppression methodfor the humanoid flexible arm, the PR controller is introduced into a control system of the humanoid flexible arm, the disturbance suppression capability of the PR controller at a specific frequencypoint is utilized, so that the resonance caused by the fact that the output signal frequency of the controller is equal to the resonance frequency of the humanoid flexible arm is avoided, and the operation performance and the stability of the humanoid flexible arm are improved.

title: Stair climbing gait planning and controlling method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a stair climbing gait planning and controlling method of a humanoid robot. title: Belly elastic shaping device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a belly elastic shaping device of a humanoid robot, which comprises an elastic shaping sheet, the elastic shaping sheet is of a symmetrical structure and comprises at leastfour shaping ends extending outwards, and the elastic shaping sheet is in an X shape, a cross shape, a shape like a Chinese character'wang 'or a shape like a Chinese character'mi'. According to the shaping device, the elastic shaping piece is used for shaping the belly, compared with a traditional shaping mode of fixing a model and a rubber gasket, the structure is simpler, the elastic shaping piece can be driven by the driving device to stretch out and draw back when the size of the robot changes, and a good shaping effect is achieved in combination with bending deformation of the shaping end.

title: Walking structure of humanoid biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a walking structure of a humanoid biped robot. The walking structure comprises a thigh frame (300), a shank frame (600), a knee joint driving mechanism (400) and a spring energy storage mechanism (500). The knee joint driving mechanism (400) is arranged at the lower end of the thigh frame (300), is connected with the upper end of the shank frame (600), and can drive theshank frame (600) to rotate; the lower end of the thigh frame (300) is connected with the lower end of the shank frame; wherein one end of the spring energy storage mechanism (500) is connected withthe thigh frame (300), the other end of the spring energy storage mechanism (500) is connected with the shank frame (600), and the spring energy storage mechanism (500) has a first state of compression energy storage and a second state of return energy release. According to the scheme, the problems that an existing humanoid biped robot is poor in stability and large in energy consumption in the walking process can be solved.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom prosthetic wrist
abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom prosthetic wrist, and relates to the technical field of humanoid prostheses. The prosthetic wrist is composed of a rotating structure and a rollover structure, the rotating structure comprises a wrist base, a first driving motor, a first transmission system and a rotating platform, and the first driving motor drives the rotating platform to rotate through the first transmission system; and the rollover structure comprises a second driving motor, a second transmission system and a rollover platform, and the second driving motor drives the rolloverplatform to conduct rollover through the second transmission system. Through the implementation of the invention, the rotation and rollover functions of the prosthetic wrist are realized, the degreeof freedom of an artificial limb is improved, the prosthetic wrist has the advantages of compact structure, simplicity in operation, light weight and the like, and the humanoid property and dexterityof the artificial limb of a user are improved.

title: Modularized three-degree-of-freedom tendon rope transmission humanoid dexterous mechanical finger and control method
abstract: The invention provides a modularized three-degree-of-freedom tendon rope transmission humanoid dexterous mechanical finger and a control method. The mechanical finger comprises an interphalangeal joint, a base joint, a testing module, a driving module and a driving tendon rope driven by the driving module, wherein the driving tendon rope is used for driving the interphalangeal joint to bend and unfold and the base joint to bend, unfold and swing laterally, and the testing module is used for testing the pitching moment of the interphalangeal joint and the pitching moment and the side-sway moment of the base joint. According to the modularized three-degree-of-freedom tendon rope transmission humanoid dexterous mechanical finger and the control method, under the condition that fingertip loadsare enough, it is guaranteed that the flexibility of the finger is similar to that of fingers of a human hand, and motors can be arranged in a metacarpal bone part of the finger in a centralized mode, so that long-distance tendon rope transmission is achieved; and meanwhile, the structure of the finger is designed to be modularized, so that assembling and maintaining are simplified.

title: Service guide robot for accessing and transferring files
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a service guide robot for accessing and transferring files. The service guide robot comprises a head and a machine body, the head is fixedly connected to the top of the machine body, and a main control computer, an array type language interaction module, an ultrasonic wave sensor array module and a cloud server are arranged on the head; a base plate controller and a door opening mechanism driving module are arranged in the machine body; a storage cavity is formed in the front side surface of the machine body, and a box door is arranged on the front side surface of the storage cavity; and an upper arm and a first rotary motor driving the upper arm to move are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the machine body, and a lower limb and a second rotary motor driving the lower limb to move are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the lower end of the machine body. Functions of storing and transferring the files can be realized, and whether a human body or other barriers approach in front of the robot or not can be effectively detected.

title: Rear flip biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a back flip biped robot which comprises two groups of symmetrical substructures, and each group of substructures comprises a coaxial high-torque double-output speed reduction structure, a light-weight zither-shaped leg structure and a driven double-parallelogram foot structure; each light-weight zither-shaped leg structure is driven by a coaxial high-torque double-output speed reduction structure to achieve leg movement of the coronal plane, and each driven double-parallelogram foot structure is driven by the zither-shaped leg structure to achieve parallelism of the bottom face of the foot and the cross section of the body. The ratio of the output torque of the joint to the self mass of the joint is large, the defects of a common biped robot are overcome, relativelyviolent motions such as running, jumping and backward overturning can be achieved, and the biped robot can be widely applied to the fields of production logistics, industrial application and leg andfoot research.

title: Human motion intention recognition method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a human motion intention recognition method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion coordinates of a human body in motion; determining coordinates of a sight attention point in human motion through a wearable glasses type eye tracker; recognizing obstacle coordinates in a visual field scene in human motion through the trained convolutional neural network model; and according to the motion coordinates, the attention point coordinates and the obstacle coordinates, predicting human body motion yaw angle information through a trained recurrentneural network model. According to the method, the walking motion direction of the human body can be quickly and accurately recognized, so that accurate wearer motion information can be provided forthe exoskeleton robot.

title: Intelligent road construction warning device and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent road construction warning device and a working method thereof. A main body of the intelligent road construction warning device is a humanoid robot, and a controller connected with an external remote controller is arranged in the robot. A camera, a voice player and a gas sensor for sensing toxic and harmful gas are arranged at the head of the robot; a distance sensor used for sensing the distance of a coming vehicle, a temperature sensor used for sensing the ambient temperature and a display screen used for displaying alarm information are arranged at thechest position of the robot. A communicator for communication alarm is arranged at the waist position of the robot; when all the parts work, the controller controls all the joints of the robot to rotate to form corresponding traffic indication states according to signals of the remote controller, the camera, the gas sensor, the distance sensor and the temperature sensor, and meanwhile the controller controls the display screen, the voice player and the communicator to reach corresponding warning work states. Various traffic guidance gestures can be simulated in a remote control mode, the warning state is adjusted according to the surrounding dangerous state, and construction and surrounding safety is guaranteed.

title: Intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and operation method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of mobile robots and artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to an intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and an operation method. The system comprises a sensor module, algorithm modules and a grabbing module, and the sensor module is mainly composed of a depth camera and used for obtaining RGB data and three-dimensional point cloud dataof objects to be grabbed; the algorithm modules can process the RGB data and the three-dimensional point cloud data so as to obtain the shapes, the poses and the categories of the objects to be grabbed, and data such as the distance, the direction, the force and the angle needed by grabbing are provided for the grabbing module; and the grabbing module comprises a humanoid palm and a humanoid arm and is used for completing the grabbing action. According to the intelligent service robot hand-eye cooperation system and the operation method, through cooperation of the depth camera, the multiple algorithm modules and the grabbing module, the objects in various shapes and located at various positions can be accurately grabbed, and the objects are recognized.

title: Integrated security patrol robot
abstract: The invention provides an integrated security patrol robot. title: Humanoid walking aid robot for accompanying aged
abstract: The utility model discloses an anthropomorphic walking aid robot for accompanying the aged. The anthropomorphic walking aid robot comprises an upper half body frame, mechanical armrest arms, a seat integration device, a lower half body frame, a half body lifting device, an axle distance increasing device, a displacement power device and a control system. The two sets of mechanical arm bodies are rotationally connected to the left side and the right side of the upper half body frame. The seat integrated device is connected to the bottom of the upper half body frame; the bottom of the upper halfbody frame is connected with the lower half body frame through a half body lifting device, and the upper half body frame can ascend and descend under the action of the half body lifting device; the axle distance increasing device is used for increasing the stability of the elderly-accompanying walking aid robot; the displacement power device is used for realizing the movement of the elderly-accompanying walking-aid robot; and the control system realizes automatic control of the elderly-accompanying walking-aid robot. The walking aid has the advantages of being high in safety, capable of assisting in walking, flexible to move and the like, and solves the problems faced by the old in daily life.

title: Joint mechanism, joint tightness adjusting assembly, simulated human skeleton and simulated doll
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of simulation frameworks, simulation dolls and bionic humanoid robots. The joint mechanism comprises a joint tightness adjusting assembly, a simulated human skeleton and a simulated doll, wherein the joint mechanism comprises a rope with adjustable tension and at least one joint, the joint comprises a first component and a second component capable of moving relative to the first component, the rope is at least connected with the first component and the second component in one joint in series, and the tightness of the joints connected in series by the ropeis adjusted by changing the tension of the rope; the joint tightness adjusting assembly and the simulation human body skeleton at least comprise spherical joints. The spherical joint comprises a ballhead and a ball seat matched with the ball head. The rope is connected with the ball head and the ball seat of at least one spherical joint in series, the tension adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the tension of the rope, the joint tightness adjusting assembly and the simulated human body skeleton achieve free adjustment of joint tightness, the simulated doll is provided with the simulated human body skeleton, and the anthropomorphic action of the simulated doll is more vivid.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot. The robot comprises a shoulder, the upper end of the shoulder is connected with a head, the left end and the right end of the shoulder in the Y-axis direction are connected with arm parts, the lower end of the shoulder is connected with a spine part, the lower end of the spine part is connected with a crotch part, the two ends of the crotch part are connected with legs, and the head rotates relative to the shoulder with the Z axis as the rotating axis through a connecting assembly; the upper end of the arm part rotates relative to the shoulder partby taking an X axis as a rotating axis through a connecting assembly; the crotch part rotates relative to the spine part by taking an X axis and a Y axis as rotating axes respectively through a connecting assembly; the upper ends of the legs rotate relative to the crotch with the X axis as the rotating axis through the connecting assemblies. According to the humanoid robot provided by the utilitymodel, a main connecting skeleton is manufactured through a bionic process, and the robot is controlled to complete a humanoid motion path track by taking the rotating shaft motor as a connecting pairof each joint, so that better extension development is carried out on the basis of the humanoid motion path track.

title: CONTROL DEVICE FOR ROBOT
abstract: A control device for a robot that can decrease damage when the robot falls forward or rearward and can be applied to an assist robot is provided. A controller 20 of a control device 1 determines whether a robot 2 is in a fall start state in which the robot starts to fall in one of a forward direction and a rearward direction based on detection signals from sensors 21 to 23 (STEP10 to STEP20), performs knee joint control such that a part in the one direction of a knee joint and a hip joint comes into contact with a walking surface (STEP45 and STEP63), and performs hip joint control such that the center of gravity GC_u of an upper body moves in the direction opposite to the one direction (STEP46 and STEP6 4) when it is determined that the robot 2 is in the fall start state.

title: Humanoid robot claw with variable stiffness
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot claw with variable stiffness. The humanoid robot claw comprises fingers and a palm connected with the fingers; the fingers contain N fingers, and in the N fingers, a thumb is at least arranged; and the N-1 fingers except the thumb are of the same structures; except for the thumb, each finger is driven by a variable stiffness linear driving device to do curvature movement, and the variable stiffness linear driving device is installed on the palm and used for adjusting the stiffness of each finger to adapt to a grasping target; and the thumb is driven byan opposite palm driver installed on the palm to rotate, the thumb is driven by a thumb driver to do curvature and deflection movement, and the change of grasping posture is achieved by the relative movement of the thumb and other fingers. According to the humanoid robot claw, the change of finger joint stiffness is achieved through the variable stiffness linear driving device, the relative movement of the thumb is matched, and the adaptability of the robot claw to grasp the target is improved.

title: Household vegetable field monitoring device based on biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a household vegetable field supervising device based on a biped robot. The system comprises a biped robot, a single-chip microcomputer controller, a navigation positioningmodule, a humidity measurement module, an ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, an image monitoring module, a buzzer, a watering module, a wireless communication module and an upper computer system. According to the utility model, a biped robot is used as a carrier, and a navigation positioning module, a humidity measurement module, an ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, an image monitoring module, a watering module, a buzzer, a wireless communication module and an upper computer system are carried to realize various functions. title: Apparatus for Adjusting Length of Wire using Pulley Rotation Preventing Structure and Wearable Robot including the same
abstract: According to the present invention, disclosed are an apparatus for controlling the length of a pulley-stopping-type wire of a wearable robot and a wearable robot including the same. The apparatus includes: a back plate assembly part provided to be assembled with a back plate part of a wearable robot, and including a wire storage part in which a wire can be wound and stored in the wound state; a shoulder placement part connected with the back plate assembly part, and having at least one curved to be mounted on the shoulders of the user; and a gripper control part assembled with a gripper part, which is worn on a hand of the user, of the wearable robot, and controlling the entry and withdrawal of the wire by a hand motion of the user by connecting one end of the wire. Therefore, the apparatus can fix the length of the wire by using grasping power.

title: Torsion spring buffer structure for neck of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a torsion spring buffer structure for a neck of a robot. The torsion spring buffer structure comprises a bottom right bracket, a bottom connecting rod, a bottom rotating bracket, a bearing seat, a bottom left bracket and a bottom supporting plate; the bearing seat is connected with the bottom supporting plate and the bottom rotating bracket; a bottom right pressing plate and a bottom left pressing plate are arranged side by side on the bottom rotating bracket; the other end of the bottom supporting plate is provided with a second driving assembly; the bottom right bracket and the bottom left bracket are distributed side by side between the bottom right pressing plate and the bottom left pressing plate and provided with a right torsion spring and a left torsion spring correspondingly in a sleeved mode; the bottom right bracket and the bottom left bracket are rotationally connected with the bottom right pressing plate and the bottom left pressing plate through rotating shafts; a first driving assembly is arranged on the bottom rotating bracket; and the two ends of the bottom connecting rod are connected with the bottom right bracket and the bottom left bracketcorrespondingly. Joints of the robot in the torsion spring buffer structure have good flexibility and elasticity, transmission is accurate, the size of nodes can be controlled, the joints of the robot are more compact in structure, and the need of simulating movement of the neck of a person by the robot can be met.

title: Thumb structure and robot
abstract: The application belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a thumb structure and a robot. According to the thumb structure, a distal knuckle is pivotally connected witha proximal knuckle, the proximal knuckle is connected with a fixed base in a spherical hinge mode, two ends of a connecting rod are connected with the distal knuckle and the fixed base in a sphericalhinge mode respectively, and a first drive assembly and a second drive assembly drive the proximal knuckle to swing in the swing directions of two central shafts, so that swing in two degrees of freedom of the proximal knuckle is achieved. The connecting rod and the distal knuckle are ganged in a following mode to achieve bending and extension of the distal knuckle. Compared with a traditional thumb tandem joint, the two drive assemblies in the thumb structure can be placed closely, so that the thumb structure occupies small space, and anthropomorphic appearance is better achieved. Resisting moment of the proximal knuckle and the distal knuckle relative to the root part of the proximal knuckle is relatively small, so that the drive assemblies can provide great output force, and the thumb structure can provide great power of gripping. According to the robot with the thumb structure, the thumb structure occupies small space and can provide great power of gripping.

title: Stable walking control method and device for biped robot, equipment and readable medium
abstract: The invention discloses a stable walking control method and device for a biped robot, equipment and a readable medium. The stable walking control method comprises the steps: constructing a simplifiedrigid body dynamic model of a biped robot; constructing a centroid state prediction model by using the simplified rigid body dynamic model of the biped robot based on a model prediction control method; simplifying an optimization equation set in the model prediction control method into a quadratic programming equation set according to the centroid state prediction model; solving the quadratic programming equation set to obtain optimized ground reaction force so as to obtain stable walking control parameters; and controlling the biped robot according to the stable walking control parameters. According to the method, a problem is analyzed through the centroid control framework, and analysis of control over all parts of the body in the walking process of the robot is simplified; meanwhile, compared with a traditional feedback control method, the model prediction control method has high predictability, so that the robot has better robustness when walking on an unknown rugged road surface.

title: Biped robot lower limb structure based on modular joints
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot lower limb structure based on modular joints. The biped robot lower limb structure comprises hip joint mechanisms, thigh pieces, knee joint mechanisms and shankmechanisms, the lower ends of the hip joint mechanisms are rotationally connected with the thigh pieces, and the hip joint mechanisms are used for driving the knee joint mechanisms and the shank mechanisms to swing front and back, swing left and right and rotate inside and outside; the knee joint mechanisms are fixedly arranged on the thigh pieces and used for driving the shank mechanisms to swingfront and back; and the shank mechanisms are movably arranged at the lower ends of the thigh pieces and driven by the knee joint mechanisms to rotate forwards and backwards. The gravity center of thelegs of the biped robot can be adjusted upwards, so that the inertia of the legs of the biped robot is smaller during swinging, and the biped robot can walk more stably and quickly.

title: Foot structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a foot structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a chassis and a middle plate, the chassis and the middle plate are horizontally arranged, and the middle plate is positioned at the upper part of the chassis; a first damping disc is mounted on the upper surface of the chassis; a second damping disc is mounted on the lower surface of the middle plate; wherein the second shock absorption disc is located over the first shock absorption disc, the first shock absorption disc and the second shock absorption disc are both annular, a first shock absorption spring is installed between the first shock absorption disc and the second shock absorption disc, and the upper end and the lower end of the first shock absorption spring are located in an inner hole of the secondshock absorption disc and an inner hole of the first shock absorption disc respectively. The foot structure of the humanoid robot is good in stability and small in front-back shaking in the moving process, the shaking amplitude of the upper structure of the chassis is small when the humanoid robot moves on an uneven road surface, and food is not prone to spilling out.

title: Multi-directional rotary robot
abstract: The embodiment of invention discloses a multi-directional rotary robot. The multi-directional rotary robot comprises a torso module, a head module, a leg module and a hand module. The torso module isused for generating control commands according to voice signals and controlling the robot to move. The head module is connected with the torso module and used for rotating horizontally or up and downaccording to the control commands. The leg module is connected with the torso module and used for supporting the robot and moving horizontally according to the control commands. The hand module is connected with the torso module and used for moving horizontally or up and down according to the control commands. According to the multi-directional rotary robot disclosed by the embodiment of invention, through the torso module, human voices are recognized, and the control commands are generated to control the robot to move; moreover, the robot can rotate freely in multiple directions and perform various movement; the problem in the prior art that the robot does little movement and has few rotation directions is solved; it is achieved that the robot can move intelligently in multiple directionsaccording to the human voices; and the user experience is improved.

title: Robot joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a robot joint structure and a robot. In the robot joint structure, a motor assembly adopts an outer rotor form, a rotor is sleeved outside a stator, and a motor shaft is fixed on the rotor. A wave generator in the harmonic reducer is installed on a motor shaft, the flexible gear is driven by the wave generator and meshed with the rigid gear, and the joint output shaft is fixed to the flexible gear. During work, the motor shaft drives the wave generator to rotate at a high speed, the wave generator enables the flexible gear to generate flexible deformation, the flexible gear and the rigid gear are in meshing transmission, and power is output through the joint output shaft to rotate at a low speed. And an output end encoder is adopted to detect the rotation angle of the joint output shaft. The robot joint is compact in structure, the axial size is reduced, the size and the weight are reduced, andthe robot joint is suitable for light weight and compact layout of robots.

title: Humanoid robot and leg structure thereof

title: Humanoid martial arts arena robot based on STM32
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid martial arts arena robot based on STM32, which comprises a robot body, a control circuit board is arranged on the robot body, and a single chip microcomputer, a power supply module, a motor control port, a steering engine control port, a photoelectric sensor interface and an infrared sensor interface are integrated on the robot body; wherein a plurality of infrared distance measuring sensors and photoelectric sensors are arranged on the robot body, steering engines are arranged at shoulder joints, elbow joints, wrist joints, hip joints and knee joints of the robot body respectively, and the steering engines are electrically connected with steering engine control ports and a power supply module; chassis bodies are arranged at the feet of the robot body,a plurality of motors with wheels are arranged below the chassis bodies, and the motors are electrically connected with motor control ports and a power supply module. title: Collaborative method of humanoid multi-robot
abstract: The invention provides a collaborative method of a humanoid multi-robot. The collaborative method comprises the following steps of determining a task allocation mathematical model, describing a task allocation problem, and determining tasks, the robot capability and an objective function; after describing the task allocation problem, defining a robot task sequence and formulating constraint conditions of the objective function; decomposing the tasks, establishing a hierarchical structure model of a robot system, and designing a behavior task tree of each robot on the basis of the hierarchicalstructure model; and completing the task allocation of distributed artificial intelligence through a negotiation mechanism of a contract net protocol CNP. Experimental verification shows that the method of the invention effectively improves the collaboration efficiency among multi-robot teams, shortens the running time of a multi-robot system, and has the effectiveness and robustness in solving practical and time-critical task allocation problems.

title: Intelligent matching and checking robot
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent matching and checking robot, and belongs to the field of medical intelligentization. The robot comprises a body, a head and feet. After data interchange is conducted on the robot, the environment in a laboratory is analyzed, potential risks are analyzed, an alarm is given to an experimenter through a voice module, and if the experimenter is not found, related personnel are informed through remote alarm reminding. The robot can position a user by arranging a sound source positioning unit, a motion assembly drives the robot to move to the user according tothe environment information and the position information of the user acquired by a camera module, a facial recognition unit carries out identity verification, the information is acquired through a wireless communication module connected with a server, and finally, the voice module achieves interaction with the user to complete a user instruction.

title: Walking structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a walking structure and a robot. In the walking structure, two sets of foot connecting pieces and connecting rods are arranged between the hip and the body, the hip, the body and the set of foot connecting pieces and connecting rods form a four-rod mechanism, the hip is relatively fixed, and the hip steering engine can drive the body to swing relative to the hip, so that the connecting rods and the foot connecting pieces are in linkage. The two foot connecting pieces are fixed to output shafts of the two foot steering engines respectively, and each four-bar mechanism and the corresponding foot steering engine serve as one leg. Through digital accurate control of the steering engine, the robot can achieve flexible movement and gait control in all directions. All movement forms of the hip and the legs are achieved through the four-rod mechanism and the hip steering engine, the cost of the steering engine is effectively saved, the power requirement is low, and energy consumption is low. And meanwhile, the structure is more compact and reliable, the action of the whole robot is coordinated and controllable, and more anthropomorphic dynamic is shown.

title: Steering engine and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a steering engine and a robot. A motor shaft of the motor assembly is connected to a sun gear of the planetary reducer, the planetary gear set is meshed with the sun gear and the inner gear ring at the same time, and the pin shaft penetrates through the planetary gear set and the output shaft. The motor shaft drives the sun gear to rotate at a high speed, the sun gear drives the planet gear set to rotate, the planet gear set is in meshing transmission with the inner gear ring, and the pin shaft drives the output shaft to rotate at a low speed. The output end single-circle absolute value sensor is arranged to detect the absolute position of the output shaft, the motor end single-circle absolute value sensor is arranged to detect the absolute position of the motor shaft, and the single-circle absolute value sensor is adopted, so that the steering engine is compact in structure and small in size and weight. And two single-turn absolute value sensors are configured, so that high-precision detection and correction of the absolute position of the output shaft are realized, and mechanical zero returning correction of the absolute position of the joint when the incremental encoder is started each time is avoided. The robot with the steering engine can also detect the absolute position of the outputshaft.

title: Hip joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to a hip joint structure and a humanoid robot. Hip joint structure, the mounting positions of the hiprotation driving piece and the hip side driving piece which are heavy are raised to the hip joint framework; the hip joint framework is driven to rotate through the hip rotation driving piece, power of the hip side driving piece is transmitted to the thigh through the hip side transmission assembly to enable the thigh to move, and therefore the weight and rotational inertia of the whole structureare reduced, the gravity center of the robot is effectively increased, and power needed by the hip joint is effectively reduced. The humanoid robot adopts the hip joint structure, and the rotational inertia of the hip joint structure is reduced, so that the power required by the hip joint structure is effectively reduced.

title: Tail structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to a tail structure and a robot. In the tail structure, a first rod piece is connected to a robot body, a second rod piece is hinged to the first rod piece around the axis of the first rod piece, a tail shell is installed on the second rod piece, and the two ends of an elastic piece are connected to the first rod piece and the second rod piece respectively. When the robot body moves, the second rod piece can swing, the second rod piece drives the tail shell to swing, and the elastic piece is twisted to store energy in the process. And when the robot body stops moving, namely, the external force for promoting the second rod piece to swing disappears, the second rod piece can rotate and reset under the action of the elastic piece, and the tail shell rotates and resets along with the second rod piece. Therefore, the flexibility of the tail of the robot in the moving process is enhanced, the tail shell can dynamically swing along with the body of the robot, the effect that the tail of an animal swings while walking is simulated, and the problem that an existing robot is inflexible and stiff in tail fixing is effectively solved.

title: Method for stably controlling gait of biped robot under slope condition
abstract: The invention relates to improvement of a robot technology, and particularly relates to a method for stably controlling the gait of a biped robot under a slope condition. An improved DQN algorithm isobtained by replacing a comment function with a double-Q learning correction function, and the problem of walking control of the biped robot under the large slope condition is solved. The method comprises the steps of building a humanoid biped robot model, pre-training control parameters and biped robot walking motion stability. A simplified six-degree-of-freedom connecting rod model is adopted inthe humanoid biped robot model, and a planar foot bottom structure form is adopted in the feet. Controller training is carried out on the pre-training control parameters through deep reinforcement learning of an improved DQN network structure. The biped robot walking motion stability is achieved through a trained controller.

title: Special equipment limited space detection robot
abstract: The invention provides a special equipment limited space detection robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The robot is a humanoid robot with limbs, a camera, a central controller and a power source are installed on the robot, the robot can walk uprightly, bend down and crawl, each of the limbs of the robot is provided with a corresponding electromagnet, the electromagnetsare in circuit connection with the central controller, the electromagnets on the limbs are controlled to be powered on and powered off alternately, and then upright walking and crawling of the robot on the side wall, the top or the inclined part of a ferromagnetic limited space container are achieved, so that all-dimensional visual inspection is carried out. Compared with an existing robot four-limb structure, a structure of the limbs and a driving mechanism of the robot is simpler, and the electromagnets are easy to install for intelligent control.

title: High-energy-efficiency light-weight leg and foot structure layout and design method of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-energy-efficiency light-weight leg and foot structure layout and design method for a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: firstly determining the layout forms of driving motors at all multi-degree-of-freedom joints of the biped robot, wherein the layout forms comprise a series connection form and a parallel connection form; then determining the layout sequence of the driving motors at each multi-degree-of-freedom joint of the biped robot; and finally, performing size layout between the driving motors at all joints of the biped robot from the perspective of energy efficiency optimization. The layout form, the layout sequence and the size layout design scheme of each leg and foot joint driving motor of the biped robot are provided. Based on the legand foot structure layout and design method of the biped robot, the rotational inertia of the leg-foot structure of the biped robot can be effectively reduced, the walking energy efficiency of the robot is improved, and the cruising ability of the robot is improved.

title: Motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a motor-driven biped lower limb walking structure which comprises a hip skeleton, a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton and a foot plate, the upper end of the thigh skeletonis movably connected with the hip skeleton through a hip joint, the lower end of the thigh skeleton is movably connected with the shank skeleton through a knee joint, and the lower end of the shank skeleton is movably connected with the foot plate through an ankle joint. A first motor assembly is installed on the thigh framework, the output end of the first motor assembly is fixedly connected witha crank, the crank is hinged to the upper end of a connecting rod, and the lower end of the connecting rod is hinged to the upper portion of the shank framework. The motor drives the knee joint to rotate through the four-connecting-rod mechanism, stable walking of the lower limbs of the biped robot is achieved, the problem that the inertia of legs is large due to the fact that the motor is directly installed at the knee joint is avoided, timely response of shanks and feet is achieved, the response speed of foot ends can be remarkably increased, and installation and debugging are convenient.

title: Mechanical balancing device and bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical balancing device and a bionic robot applying the mechanical balancing device. According to the mechanical balancing device, the structure is simple, meanwhile the change of posture of the bionic robot can besensed in real time through the balancing rotor, corresponding changes can be made according to the corresponding posture, and thus the effect of maintaining the balance of the bionic robot in real time can be achieved.

title: Hospital medical guide humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid robot for hospital medical guidance. An annular sponge sleeve is arranged below the iron groove, clamping plates are arranged on the two sides of the sponge sleeve respectively, and an annular brush wire layer is fixedly arranged at the lower end of the sponge sleeve. title: Modular rope-driven humanoid arm
abstract: The utility model discloses a modular rope-driven humanoid arm. Wherein the shoulder modules, the elbow modules and the wrist modules are connected in sequence, the connecting modules are arranged among the modules to achieve connection, independent motor driving systems and rope transmission systems are arranged in the shoulder modules, the elbow modules and the wrist modules, and the tail ends of the wrist modules are connected with a plurality of fingers to form the seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm. Three-degree-of-freedom rope-driven joint modules based on parallel mechanisms are arranged in the shoulder modules and the wrist modules, the elbow modules are single-degree-of-freedom rope-driven swing joint modules, unified interfaces are arranged at the connecting positions of the modules, and the adjacent modules can be installed at will. Compared with the prior art, the mechanical arm is convenient to assemble, easy to disassemble, light in weight and convenient to carry and maintain, the left arm and the right arm can be formed by completely identical modules, and the length can be adjusted through different connecting modules; the method is very suitable for large-scale production, and facilitates control of production and use cost.

title: Connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device
abstract: A connecting rod coupling self-adaptive underactuated robot finger device belongs to the technical field of robot hands and comprises a motor, a transmission mechanism, a base, a first finger section,a second finger section, a near joint shaft, a far joint shaft, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, a third rotating shaft, a spring partand a limiting lug. title: Joint structure and human body
abstract: The invention provides a joint structure and a human body. Provided is the joint structure capable of improving the flexibility of a movable part of the human body. The joint structure of the human body is provided with: a first swing link that is connected to a waist base and is capable of swinging in a swing direction; a second swing link, one end of which is connected to the first swing link and the other end of which is connected to the leg, wherein the second swing link is swingable in the swing direction with respect to the first swing link. By means of multi-stage swing achieved throughfirst swing and second swing, the other end (a third swing bearing) of the second swing connecting rod can be pulled out from a waist part in a staged mode or made to enter the waist part in a stagedmode. During the first swing, the first swing connecting rod swings relative to the waist base body, and during the second swing, the second swing connecting rod swings relative to the first swing connecting rod.

title: Arm integrated joint for two-way output humanoid robot
abstract: An arm integrated joint for a two-way output humanoid robot is composed of a frameless torque motor, an electromagnetic safety brake, an absolute value position sensor, a harmonic reducer, an output part, a bearing, a bearing frame and a shell. Wherein the frameless torque motor, the electromagnetic safety brake and the absolute value position sensor are arranged on a high-speed motor shaft; the harmonic reducer is connected with a high-speed motor shaft and a low-speed output shaft; the output part is mounted on the low-speed output shaft; and the bearing and the bearing bracket are fixed inthe shell. According to the utility model, a speed reducing device, a sensing detection device and a braking device are integrated into a whole, and a special servo driver is adopted for driving. Compared with an existing product, the designed integrated joint has the advantages that bidirectional output can be achieved, and the problems of uneven stress, single connection mode and the like causedby single-port output are solved. The integrated joint is light in weight, small in size and large in bearing load, and various performance indexes of arm movement of the humanoid robot are met.

title: Indoor explanation system based on humanoid robot and method of indoor explanation system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to an indoor explanation system based on a humanoid robot and a method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot. The method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot comprises the steps that the robot calibrates a corresponding explanation position point through an explanation route of the robot, and after the robot arrives at the explanation position, corresponding infrared sensing module sends out request in a request receiving mode when the robot moves to the position of a corresponding infrared sensing module; and after the robotreceives the request of the corresponding infrared sensing module, the robot starts to adjust the position of the robot and then carries out corresponding scene explanation. Compared with the prior art, the method of the indoor explanation system based on the humanoid robot has the advantages that the working pressure of an explainer is reduced, it is guaranteed that the explaining is clear and accurate, the movement position of the robot is mastered in all directions, and the movement position of the robot is more accurate during explaining.

title: Remote mutual-inductance robot
abstract: The invention provides a remote mutual-inductance robot comprising a control end and a far-end robot. The control end comprises an inductance control bin. title: Boosting joint, boosting supporting leg and boosting exoskeleton
abstract: The invention discloses a boosting joint comprising a joint seat. The joint seat is provided with a rotating shaft which is in rotating fit with the joint seat and a boosting drive mechanism used fordriving the rotating shaft to rotate relative to the joint seat. The boosting drive mechanism comprises a drive wheel arranged outside the rotating shaft in a sleeving manner and a power mechanism used for driving the drive wheel to rotate. A rotation limiting structure used for limiting the angle range in which the rotating shaft can freely rotate relative to the drive wheel is arranged between the rotating shaft and the drive wheel. The invention also provides a boosting supporting leg and a boosting exoskeleton. By arranging the rotation limiting structure between the rotating shaft and thedriving wheel, the rotating shaft can rotate freely within the angle range limited by the rotation limiting structure, and then a margin of rotation is reserved between the rotating shaft and the driving wheel; in this way, the user can use the leg to drive the rotating shaft to rotate freely relative to the driving wheel at the starting stage, so that the walking data of the user can be obtained, the walking intention of the user can be predicted; and then it is convenient to use the boosting drive mechanism to provide boosting.

title: Three-dimensional path planning method for biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional path planning method of a biped robot and belongs to the technical field of robot path planning. The method comprises steps of comprehensively considering the maximum height of the biped robot capable of crossing an object or climbing steps, the maximum width of the biped robot capable of crossing the object, the foot length of the biped robot and the position and size of the object in a three-dimensional environment; redesigning the cost of the node, carrying out cost evaluation, and calculating a three-dimensional path with the minimum cost in advance in a complex environment with various types of objects. The path planned by the method can guide the robot to cross, bypass and go upstairs in a corresponding environment. Compared with the prior art, the motion potential of the biped robot can be brought into full play, and passing efficiency is improved, and meanwhile, the operation load of the biped robot is reduced, and the calculation speed is higher.

title: Intelligent nursing robot assisting nurses in clinical work
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing robot assisting nurses in clinical work. The intelligent nursing robot includes a data processing and control system, a pain recognition system, a nursing operating system, a medicine distribution system and a walking system, wherein the pain recognition system, the nursing operating system, the medicine distribution system and the walking system areconnected with the data processing and control system; the pain recognition system can acquire the facial expression of a patient and transmit the facial expression to the data processing and controlsystem; the nursing operating system can obtain the vital characteristics of the patient and upload the vital characteristics to the data processing and control system; the medicine distribution system distributes packaged medicine bags to the patient; the walking system walks and turns after receiving a remote operation instruction; and the data processing and control system quantifies the pain level of the patient, uploads data to a hospital patient management center, drives an action actuator to distribute medicines, and drives a walking and turning module for making rounds of wards. The robot can perform repetitive nursing operations on behalf of nurses, the nurses are freed to better provide patients with high-quality nursing services, the distributed medicines can be given out, and the pain levels of patients can be quantified.

title: Biped robot with variable-rigidity ankle joints
abstract: A biped robot with variable-rigidity ankle joints comprises a left leg, a right leg and a pelvis. The left leg and the right leg comprise thighs, shanks and feet respectively, the pelvis is connectedwith the thighs through hip joints, the thighs are connected with the shanks through knee joints, the shanks are connected with the feet through the ankle joints, and the left leg and the right leg are connected through the pelvis; each ankle joint comprises an ankle joint driving motor, an ankle joint transmission gear pair, a rotating crank, an ankle joint rotating shaft and a passive exhaust variable rigidity mechanism; the passive exhaust variable rigidity mechanism comprises an air cylinder and a connecting piece; and a connecting piece is installed at an end of a piston rod of the air cylinder, the ankle joint driving motor is installed on each thigh, the rotating crank is rotatably installed on the knee joint rotating shaft, the ankle joint driving motor drives the rotating crank torotate around the knee joint rotating shaft through the ankle joint transmission gear pair, and a cylinder body of the air cylinder is rotatably connected with the feet. Walking movement in a two-dimensional plane can be achieved, and walking stability of the biped robot and an adaptability of the biped robot to uneven ground are improved.

title: Balance assembly of artificial intelligence education robot
abstract: The invention discloses a balance assembly of an artificial intelligence education robot. The balance assembly comprises a robot body and two bionic feet movably connected with the robot body. The twobionic feet are internally provided with driving walking wheels capable of steering respectively. The driving walking wheels are connected with steering control mechanisms. The steering control mechanisms conduct driving steering after the robot body senses an obstacle. According to the balance assembly of the artificial intelligence education robot, the balance capacity and the obstacle steeringcapacity of the balance assembly are improved, and the problems of toppling and the like of the balance assembly are avoided.

title: Robot gait planning method and device, robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot gait planning method and device, a robot and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps that feedback force collected by a preset sensor is acquired, a support state of the robot is determined according to the feedback force; If the robot is in a biped support state, a balance position of the sole portion is determined according to a preset inertial measurement unit and information fed back by a joint code disk, reference positions of the sole portion at various times within preset transition duration are separately calculated according to the balance position, the feedback force, the reference positions and preset reference force are input into an impedance controller for calculation to obtain updated reference positions, inverse kinematics calculation is performed to obtain motion angles of all joints of the robot, and each joint of the robot is controlled to move according to the motion angles, thereby greatly improving a speed and stability of the biped robot on a rough road surface.

title: Offset early warning method and device for robot and robot
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of robots. The invention provides an offset early warning method and device for a robot and the robot. The method comprises the steps that when it isdetermined that the robot is in a biped standing state and does not shake any more, acquiring and recording a first attitude angle parameter; triggering a timer to start timing, and when the timing duration of the timer reaches the preset duration, acquiring and recording a second attitude angle parameter; according to the first attitude angle parameter and the second attitude angle parameter, calculating an inertial measurement unit IMU offset of the robot; when determining that the IMU offset is greater than the preset offset, sending offset prompt information, and keeping the current stateof the robot unchanged. The problems that offset abnormity occurs during walking of the robot due to data drift of the inertia measurement unit, and the walking stability and safety of the robot cannot be effectively guaranteed are effectively avoided, and the movement stability and safety of the robot are guaranteed.
