title: Intelligent 5G communication robot Beidou mobile phone
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent 5G communication robot Beidou mobile phone, which comprises a body part, a head part, upper limb parts and lower limb parts, wherein the body part is integrallyof a cubic structure, an L-shaped clamping plate is arranged at the bottom of the body part, a liquid crystal screen is arranged on the back face of the body part, the two side faces of the body partare each provided with an upper limb groove, and the bottom of the body part is further provided with a lower limb groove; the body part is provided with an indicator lamp, a control key and an external interface, and the head part is provided with an illuminating lamp, double cameras, a microphone, a loudspeaker and a wifi antenna; and a control circuit is arranged in the body part. title: Development of an Android-based multi-purpose robot platform device
abstract: The present invention relates to an android-based versatile robot platform apparatus. An object of the present invention is to provide the android-based versatile robot platform apparatus which enables a robot to operate and perform various functions. The present invention, in the versatile robot platform apparatus for operating the robot equipped with a doll selected according to a user′s taste among various types of interchangeable upper body dolls including men, women, and animals, comprises: an android AP platform which downloads an oral storybook app according to a user input command, and transmits an identification command for creating an environment suitable for each content of an oral story included in a downloaded oral story app according to content development of the oral story through short-range wireless communication according to a predetermined transmission protocol; a display unit; an audio output unit; a first environmental factor generation unit; a second environmental factor generation unit; a third environmental factor generation unit; and a robot operation control platform.

title: COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR SELF-LEARNING OF AN ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT AND RELATED SELF-LEARNING SYSTEM
abstract: The computer-implemented method (M) for self-learning of an anthropomorphic robot comprises the following steps: acquisition at predefined time intervals and by means of a three-dimensional vision sensor (V) of a sequence of images (I) relating to a machining operation carried out by an operator (O) on a reference object (R) within a learning area (step 12); processing, for each of the acquired images (I) of said sequence of images, of a point cloud (N) relating to the operator (O) and to the reference object (R) within the framed learning area (step 13); for each processed point cloud (N), identification of a tool (U) used by the operator (O) during the machining operation and of different parts of the body of the operator (O) (step 21); determination of coordinates (X, Y, Z) of movement axes relating to the tool (U) and to the different parts of the body of the operator (O) (step 22); calculation of a roto-translation matrix (RX, RY, RZ) of the tool (U) in space starting from the coordinates (X, Y, Z) of movement axes relating to the tool (U) and to different parts of the body of the operator (O) (step 31); calculation of the complete trajectory (T) of the tool (U) starting from the succession of the coordinates (X, Y, Z) of the movement axes of the tool (U) and from the succession of the angles of the roto-translation matrix (RY, RY, RZ) that identify the spatial inclination of the movement axes of the tool (U); conversion of the calculated trajectory (T) into a program module (P) for an anthropomorphic robot provided with a tool (U), wherein the program module (P) comprises a sequence of instructions for the movement of the tool (U) along the trajectory (T).

title: Humanoid patrol operation method and system for semantic intelligent substation robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid patrol operation method and system for a semantic intelligent substation robot. The robot humanoid patrol operation method for the semantic intelligent substation comprises the following steps: autonomously constructing a three-dimensional semantic map of an unknown substation environment; based on the three-dimensional semantic map, combining the inspection/operation task and the current position of the robot to autonomously plan the walking path of the robot; controlling the robot to move according to the planned walking path, and carrying out an inspection/operation task in the advancing process; in the process of carrying out the inspection/operation task, adjusting the pose of the mechanical arm carrying the inspection/operation tool in real time, sothat the image of the equipment to be inspected is automatically collected and recognized at the optimal angle or the operation task is automatically executed at the optimal angle, and the full-autonomous inspection/operation task of the transformer substation environment is completed.

title: Humanoid robot leg with stepping advancing function
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg with a stepping advancing function, and belongs to the field of humanoid robot legs. The humanoid robot leg comprises a hip joint, and a robot leg A and arobot leg B which are rotationally arranged on the hip joint, wherein the hip joint comprises a hip joint bottom plate, a support A, a support B, a lead screw, a guide rail, a hollow rotating shaft A,a hollow rotating shaft B, a driving wheel A, a driving wheel B and a rotating shaft, the rotating shaft is provided with a friction wheel A, a compression-resistant spiral spring A, a thrust bearingA, a thrust bearing B, a compression-resistant spiral spring B, a pressing sliding block and a friction wheel B; and the robot leg A and the robot leg B are identical in structure and each comprise arobot thigh, a fixed shaft, a driven wheel, a robot shank and a robot foot. The stepping robot leg is simple and reasonable in structure, capable of achieving gravity center translation before and after walking, suitable for walking of a robot and higher in motion stability.

title: Humanoid robot frame structure and humanoid robot comprising same
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot frame structure and a humanoid robot comprising the same, and belongs to the field of robots. The human-shaped robot frame structure comprises a body part,a head part and two arm parts, and is characterized in that two first steering engines are installed in the body part, two first connecting pieces connected with the output ends of the first steeringengines are hinged to the body part, the other ends of the first connecting pieces are hinged to second connecting pieces, and the two arm parts are connected with the head part and the two arm partsrespectively. A second steering engine of which the output end is connected with the first connecting piece is mounted in the second connecting piece; the other end of the second connecting piece ishinged to the third connecting piece, the other end of the third connecting piece is hinged to the fourth connecting piece, a third steering engine is installed in the fourth connecting piece, a fifthconnecting piece connected with the output end of the third steering engine is hinged to the other end of the fourth connecting piece, and the other end of the fifth connecting piece is connected with the foot. And a fourth steering engine of which the output end is connected with the fifth connecting piece is mounted in the foot part.

title: Method for controlling follow-up bionic robot to walk
abstract: The invention discloses a method for controlling a follow-up bionic robot to walk, which is characterized in that a control system captures all actions of a controller through video capture or a wearable sensor by using a reverse numerical control follow-up pedal device of a mirror image principle; a controller acts in situ to control the follow-up robot to imitate a person to walk according to acertain gradient or height. The follow-up robot can be controlled to completely simulate the gait of a user to walk, the follow-up robot can be controlled to walk in any range, especially climb mountains, go upstairs or walk at a certain slope, and the problem that an existing robot walks with two feet is solved.

title: Balance control method and device, humanoid robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a balance control method and device, a humanoid robot and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of robot control. According to the method and device, the robot andthe readable storage medium, on the basis of the current motion data of a foot sole, a mass center and a waist of the humanoid robot, the expected acceleration of the foot sole and the mass center tending to a current balance expected track and the expected angular acceleration of the waist tending to the current balance expected track are obtained; then, according to the current angular speed ofeach joint of the humanoid robot, the expected acceleration of the waist and the expected acceleration of the foot sole and the mass center, the expected angular acceleration, which meets the balanceexpected track and meets the control requirements of the foot sole, the mass center and the waist at the same time, of each joint is calculated; and the corresponding real joints are controlled to operate according to the expected angular acceleration of each joint on the basis of the angular displacement of each joint, so that the balance control effect on the foot sole, the mass center and thewaist is achieved by adjusting the operation states of the real joints, the control interference among the foot sole, the mass center and the waist is avoided, and the balance control difficulty is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot gait planning method and device and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid robot gait planning method, a humanoid robot gait planning device and a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring stressinformation of a swinging leg of the humanoid robot in a single-foot supporting period at present; judging whether the swinging legs fall to the ground or not according to the stress information, andacquiring biped stress information and waist poses of the humanoid robot after the humanoid robot enters a biped supporting period when it is judged that the swinging legs fall to the ground; controlling an original supporting leg according to the waist pose and the expected waist track in the biped supporting period, and controlling an original swinging leg according to the expected swinging legtrack; and judging whether a preset task switching condition is met or not according to the biped stress information and the biped supporting period transition duration, and switching the trajectory tracking tasks of the original supporting leg and the original swinging leg when the preset task switching condition is met. According to the technical scheme, smooth alternate switching of the supporting legs and the swinging legs can be achieved in the rapid walking process of the humanoid robot, and the dynamic stability and the like of the posture and the speed of the humanoid robot are guaranteed.

title: Dynamic humanoid warm body robot system based on garment detection under practical application scenarios
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic humanoid warm body robot system based on garment detection under practical application scenarios. The dynamic humanoid warm body robot system comprises a robot body.The inner sides of the robot body are connected with each other through connection rods, and leatherette, a heating film, temperature sensors and a connection wire are installed in the robot body. Theheating film is arranged on the inner side of the leatherette, and the temperature sensors are installed on the inner side of the heating film and are connected with each other through connection wires. The robot body is located in a detection bin, the detection bin and the robot body are fixedly connected with each other through a fixing rod, and the detection bin and a display are connected with each other. According to the dynamic humanoid warm body robot system based on garment detection under the practical application scenarios, the detection bin is used, thus the dynamic humanoid warm body robot system can complete different detection of the robot body through different needs, and work efficiency of the dynamic humanoid warm body robot system is improved.

title: Biped robot teaching aid for pupils

title: Inverse kinematics solving method of high-energy-efficiency lightweight structure biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method for a biped robot with a high-energy-efficiency light-weight structure, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a robot coordinate system by adopting a spinor method, and constructing an expression equation capable of being used for inverse kinematics solving by constructing a vector capable of representing attitude information; performing numerical solution on inverse kinematics of the robot by adopting a Newton-Raphson algorithm; according to the method, the existence of the driving connecting rod is further considered, and an analytical method is adopted to calculate the actually required rotation angle of the driving motor. The method can be used for inverse kinematics solving under the condition that the hip joint motor shafts of the robot are not intersected.

title: Active power-assisted control method and device based on terrain judgment and exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses an active power-assisted control method and device based on terrain judgment and an exoskeleton robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining ground contour point clouddata obtained through the forward scanning of the ground by a laser radar, and building the front ground contour distribution based on the ground contour point cloud data; identifying a front ground contour type according to the front ground contour distribution and a terrain identification model, and determining a human motion gait mode according to the front ground contour type; estimating frontterrain contour parameters according to the ground contour point cloud data and the front ground contour type, and estimating a human body joint movement track according to the front terrain contourparameters and a human body movement gait mode; and determining an active assistance strategy of an exoskeleton according to the human joint movement track. title: Finger joint of tendon-driven humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention provides a finger joint of a tendon-driven humanoid dexterous hand in order to solve the technical problems that in the prior art, a humanoid dexterous hand is complex in structure, anda large amount of space is needed on the finger joint. The finger joint comprises a swing joint and a bent joint set. The bent joint set comprises a plurality of bent joints which are connected in a hinged mode. One end of the swing joint is connected with a palm of the humanoid dexterous hand, and the other end of the swing joint is connected with the bent joints. A roller skate is arranged at the joint of every two adjacent bent joints. A first slot is formed in each bent joint. A limiting rope knot is located on the side, away from the swing joint, of each first slot. A second slot is formed in each bent joint. A bent tendon rope is wound in the circumferential direction of the roller skate located at the end, close to the swing joint, of each bent joint and then penetrates out of the corresponding second slot. A return tendon rope is arranged in the finger joint. A swing tendon rope is arranged in the swing joint. A third slot is formed in the swing joint. The bent tendon rope, thereturn tendon rope and the swing tendon rope penetrate out of the third slot and then are connected with the palm.

title: Stepping mechanical leg capable of being used for biped obstacle crossing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a stepping mechanical leg capable of being used for a biped obstacle crossing robot, and belongs to the field of stepping robots. The stepping mechanical leg comprises two setsof mechanical single legs which are rotationally arranged on a robot body and are completely the same in structure. Each mechanical single leg comprises a connecting rod thigh with the upper end rotationally arranged on the robot body and a walking shank hinged to the lower end of the connecting rod thigh. The connecting rod thigh comprises a thigh top plate, a connecting rod A, a connecting rodB, a connecting rod C, a connecting rod D, connecting rod springs, lifting rods, anti-compression springs, steel wire ropes A and steel wire ropes B; the walking shank comprises a shank rod, a lockingplate, a motor B, a lead screw and a nut; a torsion spiral spring B is arranged between the sole plate and the shank rod, and torsional elastic deformation occurs when the shank moves forwards. The stepping mechanical leg is simple and reasonable in structure, capable of achieving gravity center translation during stepping to improve stepping stability, capable of crossing obstacles and capable of being used for a biped obstacle crossing robot.

title: Hydraulic drive type foot type bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic drive type foot type bionic humanoid robot and relates to the field of fluid transmission and control innovation. title: Legged high-dexterity self-balancing capable robot actor
abstract: A robot actor, or character mobility hardware platform, adapted to unleash or provide a wide variety of characters in the physical world. The robot actor enables the often screen-constrained characters to become life-like, interactive participants with nearby people in ways not presently achievable. title: BIPED ROBOT UNEVEN ROAD SURFACE DYNAMIC RUNNING GAIT IMPLEMENTATION METHOD
abstract: A biped robot indoor and outdoor road surface dynamic running gait implementation method, wherein a state machine for an entire running cycle is arranged, and balance control and motion trajectory planning of a robot is performed in each state. When the robot changes from an in-the-air phase to an on-the-ground phase, posture balancing and ground cushioning are controlled by means of a SLIP model, and after the robot is stably on the ground, the centre of mass of the robot is controlled to a set height by means of a LIP model. In addition, the in-the-air phase of the robot running is generated via support leg and swing leg trajectory planning and state switching, to implement the running motion of the robot, increase the motion speed of the robot, and improve the dynamic balancing performance of the robot running. The method has a certain versatility with respect to common biped robots, and also has good adaptability to uneven outdoor terrain.

title: Robot pose estimation method and device, humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot pose estimation method and device, a humanoid robot and a storage medium and relates to the technical field of robots. According to the method, measured pose parametersof a waist central point of the humanoid robot are obtained by processing obtained waist pose parameters and sole motion parameters of the humanoid robot; predicted pose parameters of the waist central point of the humanoid robot are calculated according to the waist pose parameters; and the measured pose parameters and the predicted pose parameters are fused to obtain estimated pose parameters ofthe waist central point of the humanoid robot. Therefore, the estimated pose parameters of the waist central point of the humanoid robot are obtained by fusing a kinematic solution and an IMU prediction result, the phenomenon of drift occurring when only the IMU prediction result is adopted can be avoided, noise generated when only the kinematic solution is adopted also can be avoided, and the estimation precision of waist state parameters of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Planar walking biped robot based on link rod
abstract: The utility model discloses a planar walking biped robot based on a link rod. A motor electrifying output shaft on the inner side of the robot shell is controlled to drive a driving rod to rotate; meanwhile, the driving rod drives thestanding rod and the middle extension rod to rotate; the middle extension rod drives the middle rod to rotate; therefore, the middle rod drives the connecting plate and the bottom plate to rotate away from the ground to move; meanwhile, the balancing weight on the balancing weight table can rotate to enable the gravity centers of the left end and the right end of the robot to deviate, so that therobot is stable in the turning and moving process, and the beneficial effects that the robot stably moves and rotates, meanwhile, the design threshold is lowered, and popularization is facilitated are achieved.

title: ROBOT DEVICE AND CONTROL METHOD FOR ROBOT DEVICE, AND LOAD COMPENSATION DEVICE
abstract: Provided is a robot device having a load compensation function corresponding to load fluctuation. The robot device has: at least one movable unit; a load compensation unit that compensates for the load acting on the movable unit using an elastic body; and an initial displacement amount setting unit for giving the elastic body an initial displacement amount corresponding to a desired position or posture of the movable unit. The initial displacement setting unit has an actuator for displacing the elastic body by only the initial displacement amount, and locks the actuator in a state in which the elastic body has been displaced by only the initial displacement amount. The movable unit is a leg including a joint having a degree of freedom of rotating about the pitch axis, and the initial displacement amount setting unit sets the initial displacement amount on the basis of the toe strength of the leg.

title: Robot falling protection method and system based on impact prediction and active compliance
abstract: The invention relates to a robot falling protection method and system based on impact prediction and active compliance. The method comprises the steps of after a robot is subjected to thrust, calculating and obtaining motion control parameters of the robot by using a pre-trained falling protection control model; conducting impact prediction according to the motion control parameters of the robot,and thus obtaining a predicted moment when the robot impacts the ground; and according to the motion control parameters of the robot and the predicted moment when the robot impacts the ground, conducting active compliance on the robot, and thus realizing robot falling protection. The system comprises a falling detection module and a falling protection module. According to the method, the moment when the robot touches the ground is predicted, and active compliance is executed in advance according to the prediction result, so that interference caused by sensor delay is reduced, and impact forceis reduced. The method can be used for falling protection of a humanoid robot, provides help for research and application of the robot in a complex environment, and reduces possible damage to the robot.

title: Control method and control device for self-leaning robot and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and a control device for a self-leaning robot and electronic equipment. The control method comprises the following steps of acquiring a cooperation video stream, wherein the cooperation video stream comprises a plurality of cooperation individuals; extracting an operation area image sequence corresponding to each cooperation individual in the cooperation video stream; dividing the operation area image sequence into a plurality of sequence fragments according to action type; determining an operation element of each cooperation individual according to each sequence fragment, wherein the cooperation element is provided with a corresponding operation weight; inputting the action types, the operation element and the operation weight into a preset viterbiresolver to generate an operation command syntax tree; and executing an action corresponding to the cooperation video stream by analyzing the operation command syntax tree by the self-learning robot.A self-learning technological purpose in different environments and workflows is achieved, the labor and time costs are lowered effectively, and the production efficiency is improved.

title: Piezoelectric-piezoresistive composite humanoid tactile finger and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a piezoelectric-piezoresistive composite humanoid tactile finger and a preparation method thereof. A humanoid tactile finger body is composed of a finger-shaped substrate, a piezoelectric-piezoresistive sensitive array and a bionic fingerprint, the piezoelectric-piezoresistive sensitive array is embedded in the surface layer of the finger-shaped substrate, the bionic fingerprint covers the piezoelectric-piezoresistive sensitive array, and the piezoelectric-piezoresistive sensitive array is composed of a plurality of sensitive units. Each sensitive unit is composed of aflexible packaging layer, a silicone oil liquid layer, a piezoelectric wire, a piezoresistive wire, a flexible cavity layer and a flexible substrate layer, wherein the piezoelectric wire is sequentially composed of a first tungsten wire, a PVDF piezoelectric layer and a first copper-plated conductive layer from inside to outside, and the piezoresistive wire is sequentially composed of a second tungsten wire, a conductive rubber layer and a second copper-plated conductive layer from inside to outside. The piezoelectric wires and the piezoresistive wires of the piezoelectric-piezoresistive composite humanoid tactile finger are used for measurement of dynamic force and static force respectively, the composite measurement function of the humanoid tactile finger on high-density curved surface distributed dynamic force and static force can be improved, and rich contact force feedback information is provided for stable operation and accurate recognition of a bionic artificial hand on an object.

title: Humanoid robot walking control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot walking control method, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and provides the following technical scheme in order to solve the problem of improving the stability and balance ability of a humanoid robot in the walking process: the humanoid robot walking control method performs offline gait planning on the humanoid robot, so a joint movement track generated by the humanoid robot in an off-line tracking mode has the walking capacity; state information in the walking process of the humanoid robot is collected in real time, the walking posture of the humanoid robot is adjusted on line in real time in response to a stability controller of the state information, the humanoid robot can walk on an uneven road surface, and the effect is that walking control over the humanoid robot is achieved in the mode of combining offline gait planning and line stability control, and the humanoid robot has the effect that the humanoid robot has the capability of adapting to complex environments.

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot. The leg mechanism comprises a hip joint driving mechanism, a thigh structural part, a shank structural part, a foot plate structural part,a knee joint driving mechanism and an ankle driving mechanism, wherein the hip joint driving mechanism comprises a U-shaped connecting piece, a hip rotating steering engine, a hip side-sway steering engine and a hip front-sway steering engine; the thigh structural part is connected to the hip front-sway steering engine; the shank structural part is rotationally connected to the thigh structural part; the foot plate structural part is movably connected to the shank structural part; the knee joint driving mechanism is arranged on the thigh structural part and used for driving the shank structural part to rotate relative to the thigh structural part; and the ankle driving mechanism is used for driving the foot plate structural part to rotate relative to the shank structural part. According tothe leg mechanism and the humanoid robot, the hip rotating steering engine, the hip side-sway steering engine and the hip front-sway steering engine are all integrated on the U-shaped connecting piece, so that the mass center of the leg mechanism is improved; and the knee joint driving mechanism is arranged on the thigh structural part, the mass center of the leg mechanism can be correspondinglyincreased, and therefore driving force needed by the leg mechanism and the humanoid robot can be reduced.

title: Dynamic motion generation and control method for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot dynamic motion generation and control method which comprises the following steps: in a single-foot supporting period, establishing a whole-body dynamics feedbacklinearization controller to control the lengths of supporting legs and the pitching posture of an upper body so as to keep the dynamic motion characteristics of a biped robot; decoupling the kinetic coupling of the swinging leg and the whole body based on a whole body kinetic model, controlling the position of future observation planning by establishing a swinging leg prediction control model, giving a series of target points at the tail end of the future leg through the adjustment of the foothold, planning the tail end track of the swinging leg according to the environmental information, andadjusting the foothold of the movable leg in real time; taking the whole body dynamic moment control quantity of the supporting legs and the control moment of the swinging legs as the motion control input of the biped robot; according to the method, the dynamics of the biped robot is introduced into real-time planning and online control, a high-dimensional nonlinear system is decoupled, and the swinging legs are independently controlled to achieve dynamic stable movement.

title: Flexible three-dimensional tactile sensor for humanoid grabbing
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of tactile sensors, and provides a humanoid grabbing-oriented flexible three-dimensional tactile sensor which is divided into five layers, the first layeris a flexible non-conductive material layer, the second layer is an electrode layer, the third layer is a force-sensitive material layer, the fourth layer is an electrode layer, the fifth layer is a flexible non-conductive material layer, and the whole sensor is of a symmetrical structure. A traditional single-measuring-point tactile sensor can only measure the magnitude of force in one dimension,a distributed multi-sensing-unit design scheme is adopted in the device, tactile force information of all points on a two-dimensional plane can be measured, and stress position information can be fedback. According to the characteristics of humanoid grabbing of the manipulator, four rows and seven columns of three-dimensional sensing arrays are designed, and the three-dimensional sensing arrayscan be used for measuring the front grabbing stress of the mechanical gripper and can also be used for measuring the front and side stress conditions of finger tips in different postures during humanoid grabbing of the manipulator.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot. In the biped robot, leg structures are arranged on an upper body frame in pairs at an interval. In one leg structure, a first steering engine and a second steering engine are arranged on the upper body frame in parallel at an interval, the first steering engine can drive a first rocker to swing so as to drive a first connecting rod, the second steering engine can drive a second rocker to swing so as to drive a second connecting rod, a supporting leg pivoted with the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod is driven, and the supporting leg can provide an enough supporting effect. The leg structures are simple, and the whole robot is small in mass. According to the biped robot, the first steering engines and the second steering engines which are large in mass are arranged on the upper body frame, parts, except for the first steering engines and the second steering engines,of the leg structures are small in mass relative to an upper body part, the overall mass center of the robot is adjusted to the upper body part, inertia of the leg structures in the working process is reduced, and the influence on the posture of the robot is reduced; and requirements for a walking stability control algorithm are reduced, and required driving force is reduced so as to reduce powerconsumption of the steering engines.

title: Human-simulated dexterous hand capable of being worn on special protective clothing glove
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid dexterous hand capable of being worn on a special protective clothing glove, which relates to the technical field of manipulator structures and comprises a plurality of fingers, a palm connecting platform and a parallel wrist mechanism, wherein the fingers are arranged at one end of the palm connecting platform, and the parallel wrist mechanism is arranged atthe other end of the palm connecting platform. In order to solve the problem that an existing mechanical arm is large in structural part and cannot be quickly and secondarily assembled, fingers whichare compact in structure and independent of one another are designed, and the fingers are connected with a palm connecting platform through finger fastening nuts. In order to solve the problem that an existing manipulator has no wrist joint or the movement centers of the wrist joints do not coincide, a parallel wrist mechanism is designed, a movable platform of the parallel mechanism has two rotational degrees of freedom, the movement centers coincide, and the effect is basically consistent with the hand movement effect. Wearing and operation of the human-simulated dexterous hand in a specialnarrow non-structural space of the special protective clothing glove are achieved, and motion and mechanical property tests can be conducted on the special protective clothing glove.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that when the walking speed of the robot is larger than a preset speed threshold value, the amplitude of the waist yaw angle of the robot is determined according to the walking speed; motion planning isconducted on the waist yaw angle of the robot according to the amplitude; and the robot is controlled to execute the joint motion according to the planned waist yaw angle. According to the robot control method and device, the computer readable storage medium and the robot, the deflection torque caused by the acceleration of swinging legs is absorbed or counteracted by actively controlling the yawangle of the waist, so that the stability of the robot in the rapid walking process is greatly improved.

title: Stability adjusting method and system for passive rhythm walking of asymmetric sideless wheel model
abstract: The invention discloses a stability adjusting method and system for passive rhythm walking of an asymmetric rimless wheel model, and the asymmetric rimless wheel model in the method is formed by the fixed connection of two rimless wheel frames with the number of spokes being n/2 at a certain relative angle, and a reachable region at the tail end of each spoke of the asymmetric rimless wheel modelis a cut region. And further the region is divided into a sub-region I, a sub-region II, a sub-region III and a sub-region IV according to different functional action rules. The final system stabilitycalculation module obtains a characteristic value used for evaluating the system stability by solving a motion equation of the system, and the final system stability active adjustment module adjuststhe final stability of the system by adjusting geometrical characteristic parameters of the model. The method has more direct and effective guiding significance for realizing stable biped walking of the foot-type robot.

title: Online stably controlled humanoid robot based on bionic reinforcement learning type cerebellum model
abstract: The invention relates to an online stably controlled humanoid robot based on a bionic reinforcement learning type cerebellum model and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. In order to solve the problem of improving the stabilizing and balancing abilities of the humanoid robot in a walking process, the humanoid robot comprises an apparatus for planning an offline gait of the humanoid robot anda cerebellum model controller, wherein the apparatus output makes the humanoid robot tracks a joint movement locus generated offline to have the walking ability; and the cerebellum model controller, responding to the offline gait, comprises a state encoding module, a cerebellum model, an inferior olive feeding module and a motion mapping module, wherein the state encoding module adjusts an activated state of PF according to state information collected by a sensor of the humanoid robot, the inferior olive feeding module modifies a behavior selection probability and a cerebellum nerve cell storage weight based on evaluation information fed back by an environment, and the motion mapping module adjusts actions of the robot according to output of a functional module. The online stably controlled humanoid robot has an effect of improving the stabilizing and balancing abilities of the humanoid robot in the walking process.

title: Motion balancing device of biped walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motion balancing device of a biped walking robot. The device comprises mechanical feet, mechanical legs are arranged at the tops of the mechanical feet, a manipulator is arranged at the tops of the mechanical legs, bodies are arranged at the two sides of the manipulator, and a head is arranged at the top of the manipulator. Each mechanical foot comprises a foot plate, anda buckle is inserted into the center of the bottom of each foot plate. According to the scheme, sensors can be placed in inner cavities of placing grooves, one ends with cables penetrate through cable grooves, buckles are buckled in inner cavities of buckle grooves, meanwhile, abut-joint blocks are buckled in inner cavities of abut-joint grooves, the sensors can be buckled in inner cavities of the foot plates, pulling blocks are pulled towards the two sides, clamping blocks at the inner sides of the pulling blocks can be brought out of clamping grooves, and therefore clamping mechanisms are taken out. The mounting and dismounting process is simple and convenient, mounting and dismounting can be completed without screwing or unscrewing screws, and the mounting and dismounting efficiency isgreatly improved.

title: Modular joint of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a modular joint of a biped robot. The joint comprises a speed reducer, a hollow motor, an input shaft, a motor encoder, a joint output encoder and a motor driving plate. On thepremise that design parameter requirements are met, due to the fact that the number of joints of the biped robot is large, in order to meet the maximum torque/weight parameter and give considerationto the feasibility of production and manufacturing, a hollow motor bearing and a speed reducer are shared, and a motor rotor output shaft and a speed reducer input shaft are shared at the same time, therefore, the transmission connection precision of the motor and the speed reducer is higher. title: Gait correction method and device for biped robot and computer equipment
abstract: The invention provides a gait correction method and device for a biped robot and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps: the current supporting posture of a current supporting leg of the biped robot is obtained by a system in the movement process, and then the relative posture between the supporting legs is obtained through calculation according to the current supporting posture and the ideal supporting posture preset in the next step; corrected gait parameters of the next step are calculated by the system according to the relative posture between the supporting legs in the two steps and the joint distance between the left ankle joint and the right ankle joint in the initial state when the biped robot stands; and finally, the next supporting leg is controlled by the system to move according to the corrected gait parameters. In the moving process, the system monitors the foothold of the biped robot in real time and adjusts the gait parameters of the biped robot in the next step according to a preset algorithm, so that the ideal foothold position of the biped robot is tracked in real time in the moving process, preset path deviation caused by motion errors is avoided, andthus the collaboration of the multi-biped robot formation in the movement process is ensured.

title: Robot target image capturing method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot target image capturing method. The robot target image capturing method comprises the following steps that a robot rotates to drive a 3D camera at the head of the robotto recognize a target object and shoot an image; the robot moves to the optimal working space when a manipulator of the robot grabs the target object; the 3D camera shoots the target object from different directions and transmits an image signal to a computer, and the computer carries out 3D modeling on the target object by using image information; a grabbing pose of an end effector of the manipulator is planned according to inverse kinematics, and a target grabbing path with no collision during movement of the manipulator is generated; and an inverse kinematics model of the manipulator is used for calculating the rotation quantity of each joint motor, an expected track is generated, and the end effector generates corresponding action to coordinate so as to stably grab the target object ina humanoid manner. According to the robot target image capturing method, the 3D camera is used for shooting the image, a visual feedback method is used for positioning the target object, and the expected track for grabbing the target object is calculated according to the inverse kinematics so that an imitation hand can perform human-machine interaction better and can work in a complex environmentmore flexibly.

title: Robot footprint planning method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot footprint planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps of performing global scanning on a specified target space by using a preset 3D visual sensor to obtain the depth information of the target space; performing three-dimensional reconstruction of the target space according to the depth information to obtain a voxelized terrain environment surface map of the target space; respectively dividing each walkable area in the topographic environment surface map; performing triangulation processing on each walkable area to obtain a three-dimensional navigation grid of the target space; and performing footprint planning of the robot according to the three-dimensional navigation grid and the biped joint kinematics constraint of the robot. Through the embodiment of the invention, the geometric attribute of the complex terrain surface can be accurately estimated, the consideration of the kinematics constraint of the biped joints of the robot is added during footprint planning, and the method can be directly suitable for the humanoidrobot.

title: Humanoid operation ultrasonic robot autonomous scanning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid operation ultrasonic robot autonomous scanning method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a human body ultrasonic image through a preset scanning skill and a human body positioning point, and carrying out the training of a scanning result corresponding to the human body ultrasonic image through a preset learning frame, expressing a scanningresult as a normalized feature vector through a human body digital twinning model; obtaining an explicit positioning point in the human body ultrasonic image according to the human body digital twinning model, and positioning an implicit ultrasonic positioning point and a target part corresponding to the implicit ultrasonic positioning point according to the explicit positioning point; and analyzing the target part through a constructed video auxiliary analysis system so as to determine the authenticity of the target part. title: Flexible three-dimensional tactile sensor for humanoid grabbing
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of tactile sensors, and provides a flexible three-dimensional tactile sensor for humanoid grabbing, which is divided into five layers, namely a flexible non-conductive material layer as a first layer, an electrode layer as a second layer, a force-sensitive material layer as a third layer, an electrode layer as a fourth layer and a flexible non-conductive material layer as a fifth layer, and is of a symmetrical structure as a whole. A traditional single-measuring-point tactile sensor can only measure the magnitude of force in a one-dimensional mode, a distributed multi-sensing-unit design scheme is adopted in the device, tactile force information of all points on a two-dimensional plane can be measured, and stress position information can befed back. According to the characteristics of humanoid grabbing of the mechanical arm, the four-row seven-column three-dimensional sensing array is designed, and the three-dimensional sensing array can be used for measuring the front grabbing stress of the mechanical holder and measuring the front stress condition and the side stress condition of the finger tip under different postures when the mechanical arm performs humanoid grabbing.

title: Walking balance detection system and method for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a walking balance detection system and method for a biped robot. The walking balance detection system comprises an acoustic ranging unit, a knee bending control unit, a sole control unit and a range adjusting unit. The acoustic ranging unit comprises a sound wave emitter and a sound wave receiver, the sound wave emitter is arranged at the crotch of the robot to emit sound waves to the ground, and the sound wave receiver receives reflected sound waves; the knee bending control unit controls the rotation angle of a knee joint gear of the robot; the sole control unit controls the rotation angle of the ankle joint gear of the robot; and the range adjusting unit is used for setting a robot motion range and adjusting according to an actual distance measuring result. The height detection range is set according to the height change of the robot during walking, the balance state of the robot during walking is judged through acoustic ranging, and the walking balance stateof the biped robot is judged more accurately.

title: Camel-type chassis device and pedestrian simulation system for testing
abstract: The invention discloses a camel-type chassis device and a pedestrian simulation system for testing. The camel-type chassis device comprises a chassis, a suspension mechanism, a control mechanism and adriving mechanism, wherein a slope plate assembly is arranged around the chassis; the driving mechanism comprises a Mecanum wheel, a transmission gear and a driven gear; the Mecanum wheel is connected with a transmission gear of a speed reduction direct current motor through the driven gear; the Mecanum wheel is connected with a compression spring; the suspension mechanism is mechanically designed and is connected with a frame; the pedestrian simulation system for testing designed by utilizing the camel-type chassis device further comprises a humanoid framework; the humanoid framework is divided into a trunk framework and limb frameworks; the trunk framework and the limb frameworks are connected through connecting pieces; the connecting pieces are connected with limbs through output shafts of direct current motors; the direct current motors are respectively arranged on shoulders and hips of the humanoid framework; and the humanoid framework adopts a telescopic rod.

The camel-type chassis device comprises a chassis, a suspension mechanism, a control mechanism and adriving mechanism, wherein a slope plate assembly is arranged around the chassis; the driving mechanism comprises a Mecanum wheel, a transmission gear and a driven gear; the Mecanum wheel is connected with a transmission gear of a speed reduction direct current motor through the driven gear; the Mecanum wheel is connected with a compression spring; the suspension mechanism is mechanically designed and is connected with a frame; the pedestrian simulation system for testing designed by utilizing the camel-type chassis device further comprises a humanoid framework; the humanoid framework is divided into a trunk framework and limb frameworks; the trunk framework and the limb frameworks are connected through connecting pieces; the connecting pieces are connected with limbs through output shafts of direct current motors; the direct current motors are respectively arranged on shoulders and hips of the humanoid framework; and the humanoid framework adopts a telescopic rod.

title: Robot, motion coordination method thereof, control device and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a motion coordination method. The method comprises the steps of controlling a robot to execute a set walking action according to a set gait control parameter, and obtaining a first duration and a second duration, wherein the first duration is the duration required for the first foot to complete the set walking action, and the second duration is the duration required for thesecond foot to complete the set walking action, determining a motion adjustment parameter according to the first duration and the second duration, and adjusting the set gait control parameter according to the motion adjustment parameter so as to enable the first foot and the second foot to move coordinately. The invention further discloses a robot control device, a robot and a computer readable storage medium, which aim to improve the motion coordination of the robot.

The method comprises the steps of controlling a robot to execute a set walking action according to a set gait control parameter, and obtaining a first duration and a second duration, wherein the first duration is the duration required for the first foot to complete the set walking action, and the second duration is the duration required for thesecond foot to complete the set walking action, determining a motion adjustment parameter according to the first duration and the second duration, and adjusting the set gait control parameter according to the motion adjustment parameter so as to enable the first foot and the second foot to move coordinately. The invention further discloses a robot control device, a robot and a computer readable storage medium, which aim to improve the motion coordination of the robot.

title: Intelligent 5G communication robot Beidou mobile phone
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent 5G communication robot Beidou mobile phone which comprises a body part, a head part, upper limb parts and lower limb parts, the whole body part is of a cubic structure, L-shaped clamping plates are arranged at the bottom of the body part, a liquid crystal screen is arranged on the back face of the body part, and the two side faces of the body part are each provided with an upper limb groove. A lower limb groove is formed in the bottom of the trunk part; the trunk part is provided with an indicating lamp, a control key and an external interface; the headpart is provided with an illuminating lamp, double cameras, a microphone, a loudspeaker and a wifi antenna; and a control circuit is arranged in the trunk part. The mobile phone provided by the invention is a humanoid smart mobile phone, and can be connected with a conventional mobile phone for extension.

title: Reconfigurable biped robot with multiple motion modes
abstract: The utility model discloses a reconfigurable biped robot with multiple motion modes, which is of a bilateral symmetry structure and comprises a body part, a left hip part, a right hip part, a left legand a right leg, and the body part is rotatably connected with the left hip part and the right hip part which are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the body part. The left leg and the right legare rotatably connected with the left hip part and the right hip part respectively; the left leg comprises a thigh part, a shank part, a flexible cushioning part, a sole part, a toe part, a balance connecting rod part, a driving wheel part and a driven wheel part, the left hip part and the right hip part are the same in structure, and the left leg and the right leg are the same in structure. By changing the driving joint and changing the robot configuration, switching of the motion modes of the biped robot is achieved, and efficient driving of the biped robot under different scenes and different function requirements is achieved.

title: Parallel four-foot robot dog
abstract: The invention provides a parallel four-foot robot dog. The parallel four-foot robot dog comprises two-degree-of-freedom five-connecting-rod mechanical legs, power transmission systems, an STM32 single-chip microcomputer control system and a robot body. The STM32 single-chip microcomputer control system is fixed at the upper part of the bottom of the robot body, four independent power transmissionsystems are arranged in four directions in the robot body respectively, and the two-degree-of-freedom five-connecting-rod mechanical legs are arranged at the lower part of the robot body and connectedto the outer sides of the power transmission systems. The parallel four-foot robot dog provided by the invention adopts a simple design principle to complete the concept of complex actions; the design is reasonable, the structure is simple, and the module integration is high; and compared with other series robot dogs, the parallel four-foot robot dog is small in heavy load ratio, and has the advantages of being high in precision, strength and rigidity, high in bearing capacity, free of accumulative errors, convenient to control and the like.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The leg structure comprises a thigh part, a shank part, a knee rotating assembly connected between the thigh part and the shank part, a hip joint part installed on the thigh part and an ankle joint part installed on the shank part. The ankle joint piece comprises an ankle side swing assembly used for driving a foot plate to sway laterally and an ankle front-sway assembly used for driving the ankle side swing assembly to sway forwards. The ankle forward swing assembly comprises an ankle forward swing motor fixedly installed on the shank part, an ankle forward swing speed reducer with the fixed end installed on the shank part, and an ankle forward swing transmission mechanism arranged between the ankle forward swing motor and theankle forward swing speed reducer. And the output end of the ankle front swing speed reducer is connected with the ankle side swing assembly. The ankle forward swing speed reducer only needs to be connected with the ankle side swing assembly, the ankle forward swing motor does not need to be arranged on the rotating axis of the ankle forward swing assembly, the size of the ankle forward swing assembly can be reduced, and then the local size of the leg structure is reduced.

title: Dynamic bearing intelligent sensing type automatic pedestrian sole cleaning device
abstract: According to the dynamic bearing intelligent sensing type pedestrian sole automatic cleaning device, a cleaning equipment executing mechanism comprises a negative pressure dust suction box, an infiltration tank and a drying air cushion which are linearly arranged in sequence, a radar sensor is installed on the negative pressure dust suction box, a water level sensor and a cleaning motor are installed in the infiltration tank, and a main controller and an MOS tube are installed in a single chip microcomputer; the power supply, the radar sensor and the water level sensor are connected to the single-chip microcomputer, and the single-chip microcomputer is connected with the water inlet solenoid valve, the cleaning motor and the pollution discharge motor. Through mutual cooperation of dust collection, wetting, separation and dirt removal and forced air dehydration and drying, centralized control actions are started and stopped through a sensor, and the shoe sole can be rapidly cleaned in the walking process. Dust, dirt and particle sundries embedded in anti-skid lines of the shoe sole can be thoroughly cleaned at a time, dust collection, wetting dirt removal, top-blowing drying and servo work are continuously completed in the walking process, and the shoe sole cleaning device can be easily embedded and installed in a humanoid path channel node or walking equipment and the like.

title: ROBOT SYSTEM FOR WALKING AUTOMATION
abstract: The robot system for walking automation (1000) according to the present invention comprises: a wearable robot (1-1) that generates a walking motion in the front of a treadmill (1-5) that reproduces a walking speed, and that has the total length of the treadmill (1-5) as a robot boarding path; a BWS (1) that is placed on a side of the wearable robot (1-1) and compensating for weight by adjusting the balance of forces between a harness (50) and a balance weight (23); a two-degree of freedom manual mechanism device (120) that is placed on the back of the wearable robot (1-1) to perform a translational movement and counterbalance up/down/left/right movements with respect to the walking motion. Due to these features, improvement is achieved from the user's standpoint by shortening the movement distance of the robot boarding path and improving the space utilization of a building by taking up less space for the system. In particular, the system improvement is achieved by automatically adjusting the robot length/height/width to be suitable for a body shape while using a camera, a torque sensor, and a force sensor to determine the training effect.

title: Human-machine interfaces and methods which determine intended responses by humans
abstract: Human-machine interfaces may capture interactions by humans with robots (e.g., robots with a humanoid appearance), the interactions taking a variety of forms (e.g., audio, visual), and may determine an intent of the humans or meaning of human responses via analysis of the interactions. Intent can be determined based on analysis of aural response, including meaning or semantics and/or tone. Intent can be determined based on analysis of visually detectable responses, including head motions, facial gestures, hand or arm gestures, eye gestures. Responses may be compared for consistency. Humans may be queried to confirm determined intended response.

title: Humanoid robot waist joint and implementation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot waist joint and an implementation method thereof. The humanoid robot waist joint comprises a torque transmission mechanism and a tension spring unloading mechanism; the torque transmission mechanism comprises a large belt wheel, a small belt wheel and a synchronous belt, wherein the pitch diameter of the large belt wheel is twice that of the small belt wheel, and the small belt wheel is fixedly connected with the upper half body of a humanoid robot; when the humanoid robot bends down, nonlinear time-varying torque generated by the gravity of the upperhalf body to the central axis of the small belt wheel is transmitted to the large belt wheel by the synchronous belt; the tension spring unloading mechanism comprises a tension spring, a guide rail and a sliding block; hooks at the two ends of the tension spring are connected to shaft shoulder screws on the side face of the large belt wheel and hooks at the top of a sliding block respectively; andthe sliding block slides horizontally and freely in a fixed guide rail below the large belt wheel, so that the tension spring is always kept perpendicular to the guide rail in the rotating process ofthe large belt wheel. According to the humanoid robot waist joint provided by the invention, the motor torque ripple is greatly reduced, dynamic characteristics of the humanoid robot are improved, control difficulty is reduced, motor power is reduced, and energy consumption is reduced.

title: Paddy field robot mechanical leg length adjusting method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a paddy field robot mechanical leg length adjusting method and system based on reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: a biped robot walks in a paddy fieldenvironment according to an operation plan, and machine vision is started to collect an image; in the putting-down process of the first mechanical leg, the robot airborne chip obtains the collected image in real time and performs semantic segmentation to obtain a category image, and the covering position of the paddy field surface on the mechanical leg is judged according to the category image; the robot subtracts the category image of the previous frame of image from the category image of the current image to serve as a current moment state; a reinforcement learning model is called, a currentstate is input, a score value of each execution action is obtained, and the action with the highest score value is taken as a decision result; the duty ratio of the PWM circuit is adjusted accordingto the decision result; and after the first mechanical leg stops sinking and tends to be stable, the second mechanical leg is lifted and walks forwards, the second mechanical leg is put down, and therobot adjusts the length of the second mechanical leg. The problem that a biped robot sinks in a paddy field soil environment can be solved.

title: Biped motion data acquisition system based on inertial measurement unit group
abstract: The invention discloses a biped motion data acquisition system based on an inertial measurement unit group, and the system comprises five inertial measurement units which are respectively arranged atthe center of gravity, knee joints and ankle joints of two legs of a biped robot and are electrically connected with a processor unit; a processor unit which is used for processing the received measurement data, completing data reconstruction and converting multiple groups of data obtained by the five inertial measurement units into biped motion data; a data interaction unit which is used for being electrically connected with the processor unit, receiving the motion model data transmitted by the processor unit, performing format encapsulation processing on the data, uploading the data, receiving downlink control data, decompressing the data and transmitting the decompressed data to the processor unit; and a power supply module which supplies power to the whole system, internally comprisesmultiple paths of level conversion circuits and provides required working voltage for other units. The system can simplify the construction process of the motion model, meets the requirement of quickly constructing a motion analysis system, and has portability.

title: Stable walking method for biped robot to go downstairs
abstract: The invention discloses a stable walking method for a biped robot to go downstairs. The method is characterized in that when the biped robot adopting the method walks down at the step, various sensorsarranged on feet can be used for quickly obtaining the edge and height information of the step, and meanwhile, the biped robot walks in a foot downward detection mode through gravity center adjustment and foot actions. And gravity center movement and stable step walking are realized according to foot sensor information and a downward detection result. The method can effectively avoid the phenomenon that when the biped robot encounters dangerous terrains such as step descending, accurate step information is difficult to obtain for posture adjustment, so that the robot walks unstably and even topples over. The method uses the feet for step sensing, has the characteristics of rapid execution, accurate movement, stability, reliability and the like; meanwhile, the method mainly depends on thefeet of the robot, has no requirement on specific configuration, is suitable for various biped robots, and can significantly improve the stable walking ability of the robot at the steps.

title: Walking robot for maker education
abstract: The utility model provides a walking robot for maker education, which comprises a main control board, a battery box internally provided with a battery, a main support, a motor and a pair of walking mechanisms used for walking, the main control board, the motor and the battery box are arranged on the main support, the motor and the battery box are electrically connected with the main control board,and the motor is connected with the walking mechanisms to drive the walking mechanisms to move. The pair of walking mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the main machine frame, each walking mechanism comprises supporting feet, a connecting rod and a pair of multifunctional gears, the pair of multifunctional gears are arranged up and down and connected withthe motor, mounting through holes located in the non-center positions are formed in the pair of multifunctional gears, and the connecting rods are fixedly connected with the supporting feet and fixedly connected with the two transmission wheels through the mounting through holes. The teaching robot is simple in structure, when the motor drives the multifunctional gear to rotate, the connecting roddrives the supporting feet to move up and down back and forth along with the rotation of the multifunctional gear, pushing force is generated towards the front direction, and the two supporting feetachieve humanoid walking actions.

title: Mechanical structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a mechanical structure of a biped robot. The mechanical structure comprises a body frame, a head device, a lower limb device and upper limb devices, wherein a power sourcemotor is arranged in the body frame; the head device and the lower limb devices are arranged at the top and the bottom of the body frame; a head linkage rod mechanism controlling the head to swing andthe mouth to open and close and connecting rod cam mechanisms oppositely arranged at the two ends of the head linkage rod mechanism are arranged in the head device, and a gear train mechanism used for transmitting and converting movement is arranged in the body frame. The lower limb device is internally provided with a lower half body connecting rod mechanism for controlling leg walking and a lower half body swing rod limiting piece for limiting the leg walking amplitude, and the upper limb device is internally provided with an arm connecting rod mechanism for controlling arm swinging and anarm swing rod limiting piece for limiting the arm swinging amplitude. The mechanical structure is compact and simple, the overall weight and the manufacturing cost of the biped robot are reduced, flexible movement of the head and limbs is achieved, walking is free, and walking stability is good.

title: COMPUTER-IMPLEMENTED METHOD FOR THE REAL-TIME CONTROL OF AN ANTROPOMORPHIC ROBOT AND RELATED SYSTEM FOR THE REAL-TIME CONTROL
abstract: The computer- implemented method (100) for the real-time control of an anthropomorphic robot (2) comprises the following steps: by means of at least one camera (8) arranged at the point where the grippers (7) of an anthropomorphic robot (2) are located, detecting images of at least one object (5) to be handled and of the surrounding area; by means of graphical user interface means (13) accessible by an operator (O), displaying at least the images detected by the camera (8); by means of at least one three-dimensional vision sensor (14), detecting the movements of at least the hands of the operator (O); moving the anthropomorphic robot (2) depending on the movements of the operator (O) detected for the real-time handling of the object (5).

title: Biped robot compliant gait control method and system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot compliant gait control method and system, equipment and a medium, and belongs to the field of robot control. The biped robot compliant gait control method comprises the steps that of: calculating an actual tail end state of a biped robot in an initial state, and adjusting the leg rigidity and a ground contact angle until a difference optimization function between the actual tail end state and an expected tail end state is minimum, so as to obtain the optimal leg rigidity and the optimal ground contact angle; training a multi-layer neural network by utilizing multiple groups of the initial states, the expected tail end states, the optimal leg rigidity and the optimal grounding angles, so that a loss function of the multi-layer neural network is minimum;and inputting the initial state and the expected tail end state of the current gait period into the trained multi-layer neural network, and controlling the biped robot in the current gait period according to an output leg rigidity control quantity and a ground contact angle control quantity. The rigidity and the ground contact angle of the two legs of the robot are controlled, ground impact during ground contact is reduced, the stability of the robot is improved, and rapid and precise control in any initial state is achieved.

title: Robot footprint generation method and device, robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot footprint generation method and device, a robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps of: performing softening processing on a preset walking path to obtain a target walking path; processing the target walking path according to the biped spacing of a biped robot to obtain a biped walking path ofthe biped robot; and obtaining a footprint sequence of the biped robot according to a preset stepping distance and the biped walking path. According to the method, the target walking path after softening processing is obtained, the break angle in the target walking path is subjected to smoothing processing, then the biped walking path obtained based on the target walking path is softer and smoother, the footprint sequence obtained based on the biped walking path is softer and smoother, steering is more natural, the biped robot is controlled to walk based on the footprint sequence, so that thebiped robot can walk more smoothly.

title: SERIES ELASTIC ACTUATOR DEVICE
abstract: The present invention relates to a series elastic actuator device, which comprises: a housing unit; a first generation unit which is built in the housing unit and generates power when electric power is applied; a first transmission unit for transmitting the power of the first generation unit; a first driving unit connected to the first transmission unit and driven; a second generation unit built into the housing unit and generating power when electric power is applied; a second transmission unit which transmits the power of the second generation unit and passes through the first transmission unit; and a second driving unit connected to the second transmission unit and driven. The series elastic actuator device may provide power to the joint of the biped or quadruped robot and reduce the amount of impact from the outside.

title: Method and system for driving character gesture by voice
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for driving a character gesture by voice. The method comprises the following steps: extracting text features and audio features in a voice signal; inputting the text features and the audio features into an autoregressive model to predict and obtain a current-stage joint angle rotation sequence through the autoregressive model, and feeding back the current-stage joint angle rotation sequence to the autoregressive model for predicting a next-stage joint angle rotation sequence; and generating a gesture through the current joint angle rotation sequence, and synthesizing and outputting the gesture and the voice signal. According to the invention, two gestures can be generated at the same time, and continuous gestures can be obtained by setting theprediction structure of the autoregression model, so that a vivid effect can be achieved, a user can conveniently perceive the emotion of a virtual character, and the method can be widely applied to virtual agents and humanoid robots.

title: Body rotation telescopic household service robot capable of effectively saving space
abstract: The invention provides a body rotation telescopic household service robot capable of effectively saving space. The body rotation telescopic household service robot comprises a head, shoulders, arms, mechanical hands, a body, a chassis assembly and a controller. The body is connected to the chassis assembly through a first telescopic mechanism. The shoulders are fixed to the upper portion of the body. The two arms are connected to the two sides of the shoulders. The two mechanical hands are connected to the ends of the two arms. The head is connected to the shoulders. Each arm comprises a second telescopic mechanism. The chassis assembly comprises a bottom plate, a traveling mechanism and a rotating mechanism. The bottom plate is connected with the first telescopic mechanism through the rotating mechanism. The traveling mechanism is connected to the lower portion of the bottom plate and comprises a universal wheel and two hub motors. The shoulders, the arms, the hub motors, the rotatingmechanism, the first telescopic mechanism, the second telescopic mechanisms and the mechanical hands are connected with the controller. The body rotation telescopic household service robot capable ofeffectively saving space saves space, adapts to a family operation environment, and is simple, convenient, easy to use, safe and reliable.

title: Facial expression quantitative representation method and system and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a facial expression quantitative representation method and system and a medium, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out the face detection, obtaining a faceimage, carrying out image preprocessing on the face image, extracting facial expression features, wherein the facial expression features comprise expression area shape features and expression area intensity features, carrying out facial expression classifier model training by adopting the facial expression features, and constructing a facial expression detection model comprising expression regionshape features and expression region strength features. According to the method, the characteristics of different facial expressions can be quantified, a data basis can be provided for similarity detection of the same facial expression, a data reference is provided for driving control of the facial expression motion unit of the humanoid robot, and the method can be widely applied to the technicalfield of facial expression representation.

title: Series-parallel anthropomorphic mechanical leg

The whole mechanical leg forms a six-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hybrid mechanism through the two-degree-of-freedom hip joint module, the two-degree-of-freedomknee joint module and the two-degree-of-freedom ankle joint module. title: Back-support type movable structure and movable face structure of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a back-support type movable structure and movable face structure of a robot. The back-support type movable structure and movable face structure of the robot comprises a stresssupporting frame, wherein a face support is movably connected to the top of the stress supporting frame; a mouth support is movably connected to the bottom of the face support; eye moving mechanisms are symmetrically and movably installed at the inner side of the face support; arms are symmetrically and movably installed at the middle part of the stress supporting frame; elbow joints are installedon the arms; and legs are symmetrically and movably installed at the bottom of the stress supporting frame. According to the back-support type movable structure and movable face structure of the robot, the stress supporting frame is adopted, bearing and gravity center control are achieved, connecting parts between vertical columns and a robot body are supported in a stress manner, the motor drives the face support, a bearing element and eyeballs, the face support, the bearing element and the eyeballs can rotate independently or synchronously, a simple structure is achieved, real expressions can be simulated, and the arms and the legs can rotate separately, so that the walking state of the robot can be simulated.

title: Humanoid and non-humanoid switching robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid and non-humanoid switching robot which comprises a stress leg and a stress supporting pillar, the stress supporting pillar is located on the rear side of the stressleg and used for supporting the stress leg, and the top of the stress leg is rotationally connected with a deformable trunk body. Rotatable deformable trunk bodies are installed on the two sides of the deformable trunk body, the deformable trunk body is rotationally connected with stress legs, deformable hands and shoulders are movably connected to the two sides of the deformable trunk body, and arobot head is movably connected to the deformable trunk body; according to the scheme, the deformable trunk body is connected with the fixed stress legs in a rotating mode, the deformable hands, theshoulders and the robot head are movably arranged on the deformable trunk body, and after the deformable trunk body is turned over, the deformable hands, the shoulders and the robot head can be adjusted according to the current form to achieve the purpose of being suitable for the current state; and moreover, the deformation steps are simple, and the operation is convenient.
