title: Wheel-foot composite walking mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot composite walking mechanism which comprises a hip joint rotating shaft, a knee joint motor fixing plate, a knee joint motor, a knee joint rotating shaft, an anklejoint motor, a shank structural part, an ankle joint rotating shaft, a foot structural part, a driving wheel and a driven wheel. The driving wheel and the driven wheel are arranged on the foot structural part, so that when the robot walks on the flat ground, all the motors of the legs enable the joints to be in a locked state through the locking elements; and at the moment, walking of the robot can be controlled as long as the driving wheel is independently controlled; the advantages of the wheeled robot can be played, and the walking speed is increased; other joints do not need to participatein movement, and the motors can be completely in a power-off state, so that energy is saved, and the working time is prolonged; and when the robot encounters an obstacle and needs to cross the obstacle, the driving wheel and the driven wheel on the foot structural part are locked, motors of the legs act in a coordinated mode, and the advantage that a conventional biped robot is good in environmental adaptability is brought into play.

title: Humanoid biped robot and shank structure thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid biped robot and a shank structure thereof. The shank structure comprises two side plates which are oppositely arranged in the vertical direction, wherein a longitudinally-extending containing cavity is formed between the two side plates; an ankle joint which comprises a two-degree-of-freedom rotating joint, wherein the two-degree-of-freedom rotating joint is arranged at the bottom end of the containing cavity and has a first rotating degree of freedom around a first axial direction and a second rotating degree of freedom around a second axial direction in a plane perpendicular to the side plate, and the first axial direction is perpendicular to the second axial direction, and the first axial direction is perpendicular to the side plate; a first driving mechanism which is used for driving the two-degree-of-freedom rotating joint to rotate around the first axial direction through a first driving rope; a second driving mechanism which is used for drivingthe two-degree-of-freedom rotating joint to rotate around the second axial direction through a second driving rope, wherein the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are arranged inthe containing cavity in the longitudinal direction.

title: Home nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a household nursing robot. The household nursing robot comprises an upper body, a lower body, a camera device arranged on the upper body, a pair of humanoid arms arranged on the two sides of the upper body, a bridge plate device located between the upper body and the lower body, a movable closestool located in the lower body and capable of being drawn out in the horizontaldirection, and main wheels installed below the lower body. The bridge plate device is provided with a bridge plate control device used for controlling the upper body to incline forwards/backwards andcontrolling the humanoid arm to act. The household nursing can be provided for bedridden patients or users with disabled lower limbs for a long time, standing, lying, turning over, toileting and massage nursing are assisted, and dependence of old people on nursing personnel can be reduced.

title: Intelligent humanoid security robot system based on double-wheel balance car
abstract: The intelligent humanoid security robot system comprises a walking mechanism, driving shafts are installed on the surfaces of the two sides of the walking mechanism, rolling wheels are arranged on theouter sides of the driving shafts, rotating discs are arranged on the outer sides of the rolling wheels, and brushes are connected to the peripheries of the rotating discs. Universal wheels are installed at the front end of the surface of the lower side of the walking mechanism, a detector is arranged on the surface of the outer side of the walking mechanism, a security mechanism is installed atthe upper end of the walking mechanism, and a camera is arranged on the outer surface of the upper side of the security mechanism. According to the intelligent humanoid security robot system based onthe double-wheel balance car, through the use of the walking mechanism, the device can complete security operation and meanwhile can complete judgment of the size of an obstacle, meanwhile, the situation that the device collides in the moving process can be avoided, and the practicability of the device is improved.

title: Humanoid robot structure with height convenient to adjust
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot structure convenient to adjust height, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a machine body, an inserting groove is formed in the machine body, a telescopic frame is connected to the top of the machine body in a matched mode, the bottom of the telescopic frame extends into the inserting groove, and a motor is installed in the machine body. A lead screw is installed at the power output end of the motor, a lead screw sleeve is connected to the outer side wall of the lead screw in a matched mode, a bearing sleeve is installed onthe outer wall of the lead screw sleeve, the motor drives the lead screw to rotate, the lead screw sleeve synchronously rotates in the rotating process of the lead screw and moves in the vertical direction of the lead screw, and the bearing sleeve can synchronously move along with the lead screw sleeve without rotating. The telescopic frame is driven to move upwards through the fixing rod, then the overall height of the robot is increased, when the height needs to be reduced, the height of the robot can be reduced only by enabling the motor to operate reversely and enabling the lead screw sleeve and the bearing sleeve to drive the telescopic frame to move downwards, using is flexible, adjusting is convenient, and using flexibility of the robot is improved.

title: Remote mutual inductance robot
abstract: The utility model provides a remote mutual inductance robot which comprises a control end and a far-end robot, the control end comprises a sensing control cabin, the sensing control cabin comprises ashell, a walking chassis, a sensing control cabin processor and a human body action recognition device, the shell is of a cylindrical structure, and the walking chassis is installed at the bottom in the shell. title: Data generation method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a data generation method and device and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps: importing a robot model by using a game engine; simulating an RGBD camera through a scene capture component in the game engine; utilizing a joint control module in the game engine to control a human hand of the imported robot model to act in a visual field range of the RGBD camera; utilizing the RGBD camera to collect RGBD image data; and according to the RGBD image data and the coordinate information of 3D poses of 21 key points, generating an annotation data setwith coordinates of the 21 key points.

title: FOOTSTEP CONTACT DETECTION
abstract: A method (300) of footstep contact detection includes receiving joint dynamics (!34JD) for a swing leg (l20sw) of the robot (100) where the swing leg performs a swing phase of a gait of the robot. The method also includes receiving odometry (192) defining an estimation of a pose of the robot and determining whether an unexpected torque on the swing leg corresponds to an impact (202) on the swing leg. When the unexpected torque corresponds to the impact, the method further includes determining whether the impact is indicative of a touchdown of the swing leg on a ground surface (12) based on the odometry and the joint dynamics. When the impact is not indicative of the touchdown of the swing leg, the method includes classifying a cause of the impact based on the odometry of the robot and the joint dynamics of the swing leg.

title: Virtual operation demonstration system for man and robot skill transmission
abstract: The invention discloses a virtual operation demonstration system for human and robot skill transmission. The system is mainly composed of three parts of virtual scene modeling, job information captureand knowledge mining analysis. A home work scene is built based on the virtual reality technology, whole-body motion capture and environment global information perception of a demonstrator are achieved, a behavior hierarchical multi-weight segmentation recognition algorithm combining motion features and operation object semantics is designed to obtain task behavior high-level semantic knowledge,and a task behavior state machine is generated. title: Test system and test method for counteracting gravity lower limb exoskeleton

title: Flexible humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model discloses a flexible humanoid manipulator. The first connecting structure comprises a first inserting column and a first inserting hole which are movable and matched in an inserted mode. title: Humanoid robot facial expression imitation method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot facial expression imitation method based on deep reinforcement learning. The humanoid robot facial expression imitation method comprises the following steps of1, acquiring a to-be-imitated target human face picture, performing face action unit vector prediction on the face picture by a deep reinforcement learning algorithm operated by a humanoid robot entity, and obtaining a corresponding face action unit vector and a motor action vector; 2, enabling the motor action vector to act on the humanoid robot entity, and capturing a corresponding facial expression of a humanoid robot; and step 3, taking the corresponding facial expression as an initial state, and controlling the face action of the humanoid robot to simulate the target human facial expression according to the initial state by using the deep reinforcement learning algorithm operated in the humanoid robot until the humanoid robot completes the simulation of the target human facial expression. According to the method, the number of times of training on the humanoid robot entity is reduced, the service life of humanoid robot hardware is prevented from being influenced, and accurate simulation of the target facial expression can be ensured.

title: Humanoid robot falling prediction method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot falling prediction method. The method comprises the steps that within a set prediction interval time, according to the number of sampling times, a real falling result, inertial sensor collection data and mass center position data corresponding to a humanoid robot are sequentially obtained, and zero moment points ZMP of the humanoid robot in the x directionand the y direction are obtained through calculation; then, data preprocessing is carried out, and a robot motion feature matrix containing eight-dimensional data is obtained; the above steps are repeated, and real falling results and robot motion feature matrixes within multiple prediction interval times are obtained; the multiple robot motion feature matrixes are sequentially used as input of aneural network model, the real falling results are combined, the neural network model is trained, and a humanoid robot falling prediction model is obtained; and the falling prediction model is used for carrying out falling prediction. Compared with the prior art, whether falling happens or not and the falling direction can be accurately predicted, and the method can be well suitable for falling prediction of different robots.

title: LEVER-POLYSPAST DRIVE OF MANIPULATORS HINGES
abstract: FIELD: mechanical engineering.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to mechanical engineering, namely to the creation of light, highly mobile manipulators with high power-torque characteristics. The invention consists in the use of cable drives of hinge assemblies multilink manipulators of the effects of leverage, creating the optimum angles of application of tractive force of cables to the elements of the hinge assembly, and effects of the use of polispasts to increase traction force of cable without increasing the torque on a shaft of a winch device of the cable drive. These two effects will eliminate the phenomenon of a decrease in the magnitude of the moment of forces created by the cable drive on the movable element of the hinge assembly. Thus, an increase in the efficiency of the manipulator is achieved by maintaining high power-torque characteristics in all configurations of the multi-link manipulator. To achieve a technical result, the design of the hinge assembly includes an additional lever with a pulley or pulleys installed on it, in which the cable drive is stored and as a result, the angle between the direction of the cable pull and the geometric axis of the specified element of the hinge assembly increases. In addition, the driving cable is stored in pulleys additionally installed in the fixed and movable elements of the hinge assembly and polispasts are created that multiply the traction forces of the cable applied to the movable element of the hinge assembly.EFFECT: technical result is the creation of anthropometric manipulator of android robot with kinematic and power-torque characteristics, superior to kinematic and power-torque characteristics of the human hand at a comparable weight and dimensions.3 cl, 4 dwg

title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for moving a bipedal exoskeleton (1) accommodating a human operator, the method comprising the implementation, by data processing means (11c) of the exoskeleton (1), of steps of: (a) obtaining a theoretical elementary trajectory of the exoskeleton (1); (b) executing a control loop defining the change in an actual position of the exoskeleton (1) so as to implement an actual elementary trajectory close to said theoretical elementary trajectory, comprising, in each iteration of the loop: - estimating a current state of the exoskeleton (1) as a function of said actual position; - determining a force torsor to be applied to the exoskeleton (1) in the next iteration of the loop to compensate for a deviation between said estimated current state of the exoskeleton (1) and an expected state of the exoskeleton (1) according to said theoretical elementary trajectory; the determination of the force torsor and/or the application thereof to the exoskeleton (1) taking into account a model of the flexibility of the exoskeleton (1) with respect to a rigid robot.

title: Visual interface and communications techniques for use with robots
abstract: A humanoid robot may include one or two eye resembling features in the form of image sensor(s) that capture images of at least a portion of an environment. The fields-of-view of the image sensor(s) will change as a pose (i.e., position, orientation, position and orientation) of the head, torso, or even entire humanoid robot changes. abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid metamorphic hand based on a reconfigurable hooke hinge pair. title: Method for reproducing virtual human arm motion under task constraints
abstract: The invention aims to provide a method for reproducing virtual human arm motion under task constraints. The method is specifically implemented according to the following steps: step 1, improving construction steps based on a random sampling algorithm and initializing a growth tree; 2, establishing an anthropomorphic arm configuration prediction model; 3, carrying out sampling in the task space, and obtaining the optimal anthropomorphic arm configuration; 4, searching a suboptimal arm configuration by using an artificial potential field method; and step 5, achieving motion reproduction of the virtual human arm. According to the method, the problems that point-to-point motion reproduction and seven-degree-of-freedom virtual human arm redundant solution cannot be carried out under task constraints in the prior art are solved.

title: Humanoid robot skull

title: Intelligent road construction warning device
abstract: The utility model relates to an intelligent road construction warning device, the main body of which is a humanoid robot, and the robot is internally provided with a controller connected with an external remote controller. A camera, a voice player and a gas sensor for sensing poisonous and harmful gas are arranged at the head position of the robot; a distance sensor used for sensing the distance of an incoming vehicle, a temperature sensor used for sensing the ambient temperature and a display screen used for displaying alarm information are arranged in front of the chest of the robot. A communicator for communication alarm is arranged at the waist position of the robot; when all the parts work, the controller controls all joints of the robot to rotate to form corresponding traffic indication states according to signals of the remote controller, the camera, the gas sensor, the distance sensor and the temperature sensor, and meanwhile the display screen, the voice player and the communicator are controlled to achieve corresponding warning working states. According to the utility model, various traffic command gestures can be remotely controlled and simulated, the warning state is adjusted according to the surrounding dangerous state, and the construction and the surrounding safety are ensured.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps that left foot stress information and the right foot stress information of the robot are acquired; a zero moment point of the mass center of the robot is calculated according to the left footstress information and the right foot stress information; an expected carrying output quantity of the robot is calculated according to the zero moment point of the mass center of the body; based on apreset linear inverted pendulum model, a motion trail of the robot is updated according to the expected carrying output quantity to obtain an updated mass center position of the body; inverse kinematics analysis is performed on the updated mass center position of the body to obtain joint angles of the left leg and the right leg of the robot; and the robot is controlled to move according to the joint angles. By means of the robot control method and device, the computer readable storage medium and the robot, it can be guaranteed that the mass center is within the supporting range when the robotcarries an object, and the stability of the robot is greatly improved.

title: Humanoid pneumatic soft robot finger
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid pneumatic soft robot finger. The humanoid pneumatic soft robot finger comprises a front-section flexible unit, a pneumatic actuator unit, a middle-section flexible phalanx unit, a pneumatic actuator unit and a rear-section flexible phalanx unit which are sequentially connected, wherein the pneumatic actuator units are of a comb-tooth-shaped structure as a whole and comprise a base and a plurality of comb teeth arranged on the base side by side in the length direction of the finger; a main cavity is formed in the base, and a sub-cavity communicating with the main cavity is formed in each comb tooth; and air channels penetrating in the length direction of the finger are formed in the middle-section flexible phalanx unit and the rear-section flexible phalanxunit, and the air channels communicate with the main cavity of the pneumatic actuator units through holes formed in the side faces of the pneumatic actuator units. The humanoid pneumatic soft robot finger has the advantages of being simple in manufacturing process, low in cost, large in bending amplitude, controllable in output and the like, and a feasible scheme is provided for a robot to achieve humanoid hand type grabbing.

title: Humanoid robot arm structure and robot arm control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm structure, relates to a humanoid robot, and solves the technical problems that a traditional robot controls fingers through stay wires, and the fingers areinflexible due to stay wire interference and prone to being twisted. The humanoid robot arm structure comprises an arm, a palm, a thumb and a plurality of grabbing fingers, a first pushing mechanismhinged to the thumb and a plurality of second pushing mechanisms hinged to the grabbing fingers in a one-to-one correspondence mode are installed in the palm, the first pushing mechanism pushes the thumb to rotate towards the center of the palm, and the second pushing mechanisms pushe the grabbing fingers to rotate towards the palm. title: Bionic mechanical leg
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a bionic mechanical leg which comprises a hip, a hip joint, a thigh, a knee joint, wherein the hip and the hip joint are composed of shape memory alloy, reset springs, cross shafts and screw rods, the thigh is composed of second telescopic pieces, and the knee joint is provided with two rotating shafts. title: Biped walking robot with single hip joint driving function

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of anthropomorphic robots, and provides a rigid-flexible coupling underactuated finger and a three-finger underactuated robot hand. abstract: Disclosed are a robot and an integrated joint thereof, belonging to the technical field of humanoid service robots. By means of a robot integrated joint (100), an electric motor assembly (10), a harmonic reducer (20), an output shaft (30), an electric motor end encoder (61), an output end encoder (62) and an electric motor driver (63) are integrated into a whole. The electric motor assembly (10) provides power, and an electric motor shaft (12) rotates at a high speed and transmits the power to the harmonic reducer (20). A wave generator (21) of the harmonic reducer (20) drives a flexible gear (22) to flexibly deform, the flexible gear (22) and a rigid gear (23) are in meshing transmission, the rigid gear (23) is fixed to an electric motor frame (11), the flexible gear (22) rotates at a low speed, and the flexible gear (22) drives the output shaft (30) to rotate so as to output power. The output shaft (30) is supported on a bearing supporting structure (40) by means of a first bearing (51). The electric motor end encoder (61) is used for measuring the rotation angle of the electric motor shaft (12), the output end encoder (62) is used for measuring the rotation angle of the output shaft (30), and the electric motor driver (63) is used for driving the electric motor shaft (12) to rotate so as to output a preset displacement, speed and torque. The robot integrated joint (100) is simple and compact in structure, rapid to assemble and manufacture, convenient to electrically connect, lightweight and low in cost.

title: INTEGRATED JOINT AND ROBOT
abstract: An integrated joint, comprising a motor component (20), a speed reducer (30), an output member (40), a first bearing (50), a torque sensor (60), and a drive plate (70). A housing (11) serves as a fixing end. The drive plate (70) controls the motor component (20) to operate, and controls a motor shaft (21) to output the power to the speed reducer (30). The speed reducer (30) is connected to the output member (40) for enabling the output member (40) to output the rotation. An output end of the speed reducer (30) is supported onto the housing (11) by means of the first bearing (50). The torque sensor (60) is connected to the speed reducer (30) and the output member (40). The torque received by the output member (40) acts on the torque sensor (60) by means of the speed reducer (30). A measured torque of the torque sensor (60) is a torque received by the output member (40). The torque value of the output member (40) is directly measured without considering influencing factors of the intermediate transmission link such as the flexibility and friction, and is more accurate, reliable, and effective, thereby ensuring the rigidity and stability of a system. The integrated joint relates to the technical field of humanoid service robots. By applying the integrated joint in a robot, the torque feedback at joints is achieved, and a more accurate force control effect can be achieved.

title: INTERACTION METHOD, INTERACTIVE SYSTEM, INTERACTIVE DEVICE, AND PROGRAM
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to give users the impression of having sufficient interactive capabilities. A humanoid robot (50) presents a first system utterance in order to elicit a user experience regarding a topic during interaction. A microphone (11) receives a first user utterance uttered by a user (101) after the first system utterance. If the first user utterance includes a user experience, the humanoid robot (50) presents a second system utterance in order to elicit an evaluation from the user regarding the user experience. The microphone (11) receives a second user utterance uttered by the user (101) after the second system utterance. If the second user utterance includes a positive evaluation or a negative evaluation from the user, the humanoid robot (50) presents a third system utterance sympathizing with said positive evaluation or negative evaluation.

title: Ankle joint structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to an ankle joint structure and a robot. In the ankle joint structure, a shank part is provided with two driving mechanisms, and the two driving mechanisms are connected with a foot part through different transmission mechanisms. Each transmission mechanism comprises a swinging arm and a connecting rod which are hinged. The driving mechanisms can drive the swinging arms to swing to drive the connecting rods to move and further drive the joints of the connecting rods and the foot part to move. The shank part and the foot part are hinged and matched with the two sets of driving mechanisms and transmission mechanisms, the foot can be adjusted in the three connecting positions, and all-directional movement of the ankle joint is achieved. When the connecting positions of the two connecting rods and the foot part move in the same direction, the ankle joint pitching motion is realized. When the connecting positions of the two connecting rods and the foot part move upwards and downwards respectively, ankle joint rolling movement is achieved. The ankle joint structure is high in integration, small in size, light in weight, capable of achieving a parallel driving mode, good in transmission rigidity and capable of reducing the rotational inertia of the shank and improving the control performance on the leg.

title: Path planning method of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a path planning method of a biped robot. The method comprises the steps: building a 3D dense point cloud chart through an orbslam2 based on a multi-source sensor RGBD, and carrying out the compression and filtering of ground information through an Octomap; and then generating an occupation lattice map through 2D projection, and finally performing global and local path planning navigation real-time obstacle avoidance by using a cost map Costmap and an obstacle layer and using improved D* and DwA. According to the method, a global path planning method and a local path planning method are fused, angle evaluation is added to actual cost values of child nodes of a D* algorithm, unnecessary turning processes are reduced, and meanwhile, selection of the child nodes is limited so that path planning is safer and more reliable.

title: Posture adjusting method, device and equipment of biped robot, and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a posture adjusting method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium, and relates to the field of biped robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed of the body of the biped robot; calculating a target rolling compensation angle of the sole of the biped robot according to the rolling angle and the rolling angle speed; calculating height compensation values of the two feet according to the target rolling compensation angle and the horizontal position distance between the two feet of the biped robot; and according to the height compensation value, adjusting the foot sole height of the two feet. Compared with the prior art, the problems that the mass center position of the robot cannot be effectively adjusted, and the posture control effect is poor are solved.

title: Biped robot bionic foot system with active terrain perception capability
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot bionic foot system with an active terrain perception capability, and the system works cooperatively through multiple sensors, has the active terrain perception capability, and can provide more comprehensive road surface terrain information for the walking of a biped robot. According to the system, through a bionic foot design method, the buffering and damping effects of feet on road impact can be effectively improved, the effective ground contact area of the feet is increased, and the walking stability and mobility of the robot are improved. The system is an intelligent foot system at the same time, and a sensing system of the system can perform hierarchical and staged active sensing on a road surface to obtain topographic information, so that reference is provided for walking of the robot. The system has certain processing and learning capabilities, can obtain road surface topography information based on preliminary processing of sensor signals, feeds back the road surface topography information to an upper-layer system, collects and learns corresponding sensing and processing results, and enhances the sensing and processing capabilities of the system for unknown topography. The foot system can effectively help the biped robot walk stably on various uneven pavements.

title: Thumb structure and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and relates to a thumb structure and a robot. In the thumb structure, the far knuckle is pivoted to the near knuckle, the near knuckle spherical hinge is connected to the fixing seat, the two ends of the connecting rod are connected with the far knuckle and the fixing seat spherical hinge respectively, the near knuckle is driven by the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly to swing around the two center shafts, and the near knuckle swings in two degrees of freedom. And the connecting rod is linked with the far knuckle in a following manner to realize the bending and stretching actions of the far knuckle. Compared with a traditional thumb series joint, the two driving assemblies in the thumb structure can be placed closer, so that the occupied space of the thumb structure is smaller, and the anthropomorphic appearance is better achieved. And the resisting torques of the near knuckles and the far knuckles relative to the roots of the near knuckles are smaller, so that the driving assembly can provide larger force, and the thumb structure can provide larger grip strength. According to the robot with the thumb structure, the occupied space of the thumb structure is small, and large grip strength can be provided.

In the thumb structure, the far knuckle is pivoted to the near knuckle, the near knuckle spherical hinge is connected to the fixing seat, the two ends of the connecting rod are connected with the far knuckle and the fixing seat spherical hinge respectively, the near knuckle is driven by the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly to swing around the two center shafts, and the near knuckle swings in two degrees of freedom. And the connecting rod is linked with the far knuckle in a following manner to realize the bending and stretching actions of the far knuckle. Compared with a traditional thumb series joint, the two driving assemblies in the thumb structure can be placed closer, so that the occupied space of the thumb structure is smaller, and the anthropomorphic appearance is better achieved. And the resisting torques of the near knuckles and the far knuckles relative to the roots of the near knuckles are smaller, so that the driving assembly can provide larger force, and the thumb structure can provide larger grip strength. According to the robot with the thumb structure, the occupied space of the thumb structure is small, and large grip strength can be provided.

title: Zero moment point jitter processing method and apparatus and robot using the same
abstract: The present disclosure provides a zero moment point jitter processing method as well as an apparatus and a robot using the same. The method includes: obtaining left foot force information and right foot force information collected by sensors; calculating a first zero moment point and a second zero moment point of soles of two feet of a robot based on the left foot force information and the right foot force information; calculating a third zero moment point of the robot according to the first zero moment point and the second zero moment point; calculating a jitter amplitude of the third zero moment point within a preset period; and adjusting a position of the third zero moment point in response to the jitter amplitude being not larger than a predetermined jitter amplitude threshold. In this manner, the robot can eliminate zero moment point jitters within a certain amplitude.

In this manner, the robot can eliminate zero moment point jitters within a certain amplitude.

title: Robot path planning algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a robot path planning algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning, and aims to provide an intelligent path planning algorithm capable of running on line in real time based on deep reinforcement learning in combination with robot physical model constraints and an artificial potential field theory. A natural and humanoid foothold path capable of avoiding obstacles and meeting robot walking constraint requirements is planned for biped robots such as a self-balancing exoskeleton robot and a humanoid robot in a dynamic environment with the obstacles.

title: Biped robot leg structure based on five connecting rods
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot leg structure based on five connecting rods. Two groups of two-degree-of-freedom hip joint motor assemblies are arranged on the machine body, and output shafts of the hip joint motor assemblies are fixedly connected with a rack of a five-connecting-rod structure; hip/knee joint motors are respectively mounted at two ends of the frame, and output shafts of the hip/knee joint motors are fixedly connected with hip joint connectors; the connecting part of the hip joint connector is fixedly connected with the thigh rod piece; the thigh rod piece is freely hinged to the shank rod piece through the knee joint; the other ends of the two shank rod pieces are hinged and hinged to the feet of the robot. An ankle joint motor is fixed at the upper part of the first shank rod piece; a rotating output shaft of the ankle joint motor is connected with one end of a first ankle joint connecting rod, and the other end of the first ankle joint connecting rod rotates around the rotating output shaft of the ankle joint motor; the other end of the first ankle joint connecting rod is further hinged to the robot foot through a second ankle joint connecting rod parallel to the first shank rod piece. The inertia of the foot end can be reduced, and therefore the single-leg load bearing capacity and the foot control degree of the robot are improved.

title: Distributed energy humanoid robot suitable for flammable and combustible scenes
abstract: The invention discloses a distributed energy humanoid robot suitable for flammable and combustible scenes, and relates to the technical field of robots. The distributed energy humanoid robot comprises a head, a trunk, four limbs and a control system, wherein the head comprises a sensing system and independently provided with a power supply unit. The trunk comprises a computer, and the computer is powered by a power supply unit. Four power supply units are correspondingly arranged on two arms and two legs of the four limbs. The control system comprises a vision system and a hydraulic system, and the four limbs are driven by the hydraulic system. All the power supply units comprise intrinsic safety power supplies. According to the distributed energy humanoid robot suitable for the flammable and combustible scenes, aiming at the use conditions and defects of an existing robot, the distributed intrinsic safety power supplies are used, the four limbs are hydraulically driven, so that hands of the robot have the capability of fine action skills and most action functions of people, the robot can be applied to general scenes, and can serve flammable and combustible scenes under a coal mine or on the ground.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom prosthetic wrist
abstract: The utility model discloses a two-degree-of-freedom prosthetic wrist, and relates to the technical field of humanoid prostheses, the prosthetic wrist is composed of a rotating structure and a side turning structure, the rotating structure comprises a wrist base, a driving motor I, a transmission system I and a rotating platform, the driving motor I drives the rotating platform to rotate through the transmission system I; the side turning structure comprises a second driving motor, a second transmission system and a side turning platform, and the second driving motor drives the side turning platform to turn laterally through the second transmission system. Through the implementation of the artificial limb, the functions of rotation and rollover of the wrist of the artificial limb are achieved, the degree of freedom of the artificial limb is improved, the artificial limb has the advantages of being compact in structure, easy to operate, light in weight and the like, and humanoid property and flexibility of the artificial limb of a user are improved.

title: Novel human-simulated dexterous hand finger joint
abstract: In order to overcome the technical problems that in the prior art, a humanoid dexterous hand is complex in structure, and a large amount of space is needed on a finger joint, the utility model provides a novel humanoid dexterous hand finger joint which comprises a swing joint and a bending joint group, and the bending joint group comprises a plurality of bending joints which are connected in a hinged mode. Wherein one end of the swing joint is connected with a palm of the humanoid dexterous hand, the other end of the swing joint is connected with the bending joint, a roller skate is arranged at the joint of every two adjacent bending joints, a first slotted hole is formed in each bending joint, the limiting rope knot is located on the side, away from the swing joint, of each first slotted hole, and a second slotted hole is formed in each bending joint. The bent tendon rope is wound in the circumferential direction of the roller at the end, close to the swing joint, of the bent joint and then penetrates out of the second slotted hole, a reset tendon rope is arranged in the finger joint, a swing tendon rope is arranged in the swing joint, a third slotted hole is formed in the swing joint, and the bent tendon rope, the reset tendon rope and the swing tendon rope penetrate out of the third slotted hole and then are connected with the palm.

title: Novel humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: In order to solve the technical problems that in the prior art, the dexterous hand is low in dexterous property due to the fact that the number of degrees of freedom of the dexterous hand is too small, and a tendon rope and the internal structure of a finger are prone to interference, the utility model provides a novel humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a palm and a plurality of finger base joints. The bending joint set comprises a plurality of bending joints which are connected in a hinged mode, one end of each swinging joint is connected with the palm, the other end of each swinging joint is connected with the corresponding bending joint, a roller skating part is arranged at the connecting position of every two adjacent bending joints, a bending tendon rope, a restoring tendon rope and a swinging tendon rope are arranged in the finger base joint, and a first groove hole is formed in each swinging joint. The bent tendon rope, the reset tendon rope and the swing tendon rope penetrate out of the first groove hole and then are connected with the palm, the palm is provided with a constant force spring connected with the reset tendon rope, the constant force spring corresponds to the finger base joint one by one, the bent joint and the swing joint are each provided with an angle sensor, and the palm is provided with a monitoring response module.

title: Upper artificial limb joint rotating structure
abstract: The utility model discloses an upper artificial limb joint rotating structure which comprises a first joint transmission piece, a second joint transmission piece, a third joint transmission piece, a fourth joint transmission piece, a fifth joint transmission piece, a sixth joint transmission piece and a grabbing manipulator. The first joint transmission piece comprises a first joint arm, a first steering engine, a first belt wheel, a first transmission shaft, a second belt wheel and a first synchronous belt. According to the upper artificial limb joint rotating structure, through matched rotation of all joints, the upper artificial limb joint rotating structure can freely move like an upper limb of a human body, so that a product can be better grabbed or put, and therefore the upper artificial limb joint rotating structure has a high humanoid effect, and movement of all joints adopts steering engines to control the movement state, the angle direction and the like; therefore, the control is more accurate, and the products are more smoothly grabbed or put.

title: Bionic tension-compression body knee joint for biped walking robot
abstract: A bionic tension and compression body knee joint for a biped walking robot belongs to the technical field of mechanical bionic engineering, and consists of a bionic double-ball component of a compression body, a bionic ball socket component and a ligament component of a tension body. Six-degree-of-freedom movement similar to a human knee joint is realized by guiding and limiting joint movement through a bionic ligament; the method is suitable for the biped walking robot, and low-energy-consumption, high-stability, high-flexibility and high-anthropomorphic movement can be achieved.

title: Humanoid gait control method, device and equipment of humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid gait control method, device and equipment of a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a first vector from a virtual centroid to a left ankle joint and a second vector from the virtual centroid to a right ankle joint of the humanoid robot at a current moment, and obtaining a virtual centroid original planning value of the humanoid robot at the current moment; according to the first vector, the second vector, the virtual centroid original planning value and a preset algorithm for reducing the virtual centroid height, determining the target virtual centroid height of the humanoid robot after the virtual centroid is reduced at the current moment; and controlling the humanoid robot to walk straight knees according to the target virtual centroid height. The height of the virtual centroid of the humanoid robot is reduced by using the vector between the two legs and the virtual centroid of the humanoid robot, straight knee walking is realized by reducing the height of the virtual centroid, gait control of the humanoid robot is optimized, the torque requirement of a knee joint steering engine is further reduced, and the hardware design weight is reduced.

title: biped robot gait stability control method
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot gait stability control method which comprises the steps of establishing a neural network model based on a nerve cell layer, training by utilizing gait data of a first biped robot obtained by a gait measurement device, and training gait balance of the first biped robot. According to the biped robot, the training depth of the gait control model can be increased based on the empirical data of the biped robot or other biped robots.

title: Humanoid doll with movable joint
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid doll with movable joints, which comprises a doll body, and the doll body comprises a body, a head part arranged above the body, upper limbs symmetrically arranged on two sides of the body and lower limbs arranged below the body; the head part is axially and rotationally connected with the body through a first connecting column; the trunk is axially and rotationally connected with the upper limbs through second connecting columns; the body is rotationally connected with the lower limbs through connecting joints; a positioning part connected with the body is arranged in the middle of the connecting joint; and a balancing weight is arranged in the lower limb. The balancing weights are arranged in the lower limbs, the gravity center of the human-shaped doll is lowered, balance is kept when the postures of the upper limbs of the human-shaped doll change, and the human-shaped doll is easy to place stably; the wear-resistant rubber ring is arranged at the rotating shaft of the lower limb, so that the service life of the connecting joint is prolonged, and the service life of the doll is prolonged.

title: Special equipment limited space detection robot
abstract: The utility model provides a special equipment limited space detection robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The robot provided by the utility model is a humanoid robot with four limbs, the camera, the central controller and the power supply are arranged on the robot, the robot can vertically walk, stoop and crawl, the four limbs of the robot are all provided with the electromagnets, the electromagnets are in circuit connection with the central controller, and the electromagnets on the four limbs are controlled to be powered on and powered off alternately. And the robot can vertically walk and crawl on the side wall, the top or the inclined part of the ferromagnetic limited space container, so that all-around visual detection is carried out. Compared with an existing robot limb structure, the structure of the limb and the structure of the driving mechanism are simpler, and the electromagnet is easy to install for intelligent control.

title: Robot interaction method and device, storage equipment and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a robot interaction method and device, storage equipment and electronic equipment. The robot comprises a body, a rotatable head and a rotatable chassis, the rotatable head and the rotatable chassis are arranged on the body, and the robot interaction method comprises the steps: after dialogue information is received, obtaining the current sound source direction corresponding to the dialogue information and the current pose of the robot; calculating first pose adjustment information according to the current sound source direction and the current pose; and adjusting the pose of the head and/or the chassis based on the first pose adjustment information, so that the head of the robot is matched with the current sound source direction. According to the robot interaction method provided by the invention, the man-machine interaction efficiency and safety can be improved.

title: Method and device for dynamically generating footprint set, storage medium and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for dynamically generating a footprint set. The method comprises the steps of obtaining preset footprint calculation parameters; calculating to obtain a foothold position according to a preset footprint calculation parameter; determining a foothold range according to the foothold position, and performing collision detection on the foothold range; when the collision detection result shows that no collision exists, recording the position of the corresponding foothold into a footprint set; after recording is completed, obtaining a preset adjustment amplitude to update the preset displacement angle; and entering the step of calculating according to the preset displacement angle to obtain the position of the foothold until the generation of the footprint set is completed. According to the scheme, the preset displacement angle is continuously adjusted and calculated to obtain the position of each foothold, and the feasible foothold positions are recorded into the footprint set, so that more feasible foothold is provided for navigation planning, the calculation time consumption is short, the probability that the planned foothold has no solution is reduced, and the navigation planning efficiency is improved. In addition, the invention further provides a device for dynamically generating the footprint set, a storage medium and the biped robot.

title: Reconfigurable biped robot with multi-connecting-rod structure
abstract: The invention discloses a reconfigurable biped robot with a multi-connecting-rod structure, the mechanical structure of the biped robot is bilaterally symmetrical, the biped robot comprises a trunk part, a left leg assembly and a right leg assembly, and the trunk part is rotatably connected with the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly which are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the trunk part; the left leg assembly comprises a hip rotating component, a hip connecting component, a thigh component, a shank component, a sole component, a driven swing rod component, a driven connecting component, a driving wheel component, a driven wheel component, a connecting rod driving component, a connecting rod connecting component, a connecting rod bearing component and a connecting rod lower end component, and the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly are the same in structure. By changing the driving joints and changing the robot configuration, free switching of the biped robot between the biped motion mode and the wheeled motion mode is achieved, and efficient movement of the biped robot under different working conditions is achieved.

title: Humanoid parallel robot dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to a robot dexterous hand based on humanoid parallel fingers. The robot dexterous hand comprises a palm and three three-degree-of-freedom humanoid parallel fingers of the same structure, and the three three-degree-of-freedom humanoid parallel fingers include the first finger, the second finger and the third finger. Three rotatable circular truncated cones are arranged on the palm and used for being fixedly connected with the fingers, and each finger structurally comprises a double-parallel-connection five-rod RR-RPR mechanism, a parallelogram mechanism and a fingertip. Each finger structure has the three-degree-of-freedom motion of two-translation and one-rotation, a complete driving mode is adopted, driving motors are all installed at the positions of finger bases, the load and inertia of the fingers are reduced, and the dexterous hand can achieve six-degree-of-freedom operation on objects grabbed by the fingertips. Compared with an existing humanoid robot dexterous hand technology, the robot dexterous hand adopts a parallel mechanism, the structural advantages of the parallel mechanism are exerted, the robot dexterous hand has the characteristics of being high in bearing capacity, good in motion precision, high in task adaptability and high in object operability, the grabbing capacity is greatly improved, and the application range is greatly widened.

title: Driving system of electro-hydraulic hybrid biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a driving system of an electro-hydraulic hybrid biped robot. Hydraulic driving is adopted for a large-load joint, the joint driving force and impact resistance are improved, motor driving is adopted for a small-load joint, and energy consumption of a driving system is reduced; the hydraulic power source comprises a high-pressure energy storage unit and a low-pressure energy storage unit, a hydraulic driving unit and a hydraulic pump are connected into the high-pressure energy storage unit or the low-pressure energy storage unit through a load pressure matching unit and an oil source pressure matching unit respectively, and energy consumption of the driving system is further reduced. Through parameter setting of the electro-hydraulic hybrid driving system, the energy consumption of the driving system is reduced, and the energy density of the driving system is improved, so that the purpose of efficient driving of the electro-hydraulic hybrid driving system is achieved.

title: Mechanical bionic foot and bionic walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical bionic foot and a bionic walking robot, and the mechanical bionic foot comprises a support, a limb being able to rotate around a first pivot shaft arranged on the support, and a driving mechanism arranged on the support; the power output end of the driving mechanism can form a two-degree-of-freedom motion trail under the driving of driving equipment, and the power output end of the driving mechanism is connected to the limb; and the limb is provided with a walking end, and the limb is arranged to be capable of amplifying the motion trail of the power output end on the walking end in an equal proportion mode. Therefore, the motion trail of the power output end can be reflected on the walking end of the limb after being amplified in equal proportion through the limb, and the motion trail of the walking end is stable and controllable; in addition, walking can be achieved only by driving the driving mechanism through one piece of driving equipment, the light weight of the mechanical bionic foot is achieved, and the production cost of the mechanical bionic foot is reduced.

title: Trajectory planning system and method for robot
abstract: The invention provides a trajectory planning system and method for a robot. The method comprises the steps that a path planner generates an obstacle avoidance path and a gait period, and forms a foothold sequence; a gait planner outputs a robot centroid trajectory, a left foot trajectory, a right foot trajectory and a resampled foothold sequence; and a joint trajectory planner calculates to obtain a joint trajectory for driving the robot. A systematic end-to-end full-autonomous trajectory planning algorithm for an exoskeleton robot is provided for the first time, a rough movement intention instruction of a wearer is directly converted into a specific joint trajectory instruction, then the exoskeleton robot is driven to achieve manned self-balancing walking, the intelligence and usability of the exoskeleton robot are improved, and the application range of the exoskeleton robot is widened.

title: Humanoid robot and multi-rotational-degree-of-freedom ankle joint thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a multi-rotational-degree-of-freedom ankle joint thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a cross shaft, an ankle support. an ankle joint first transmission shaft and an ankle joint second transmission shaft, wherein the cross shaft comprises a first direction shaft and a second direction shaft which are perpendicular to each other, the first direction shaft is used for being rotatably mounted on a lower connecting part of a shank shaft, and the second direction shaft is a hollow shaft with a through hole; and the ankle support is provided with a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is inserted into the through hole of the second direction shaft, so that the ankle support rotates around the second direction shaft. According to the ankle joint, two rotational degrees of freedom of the ankle joint or a foot can be realized, and a multi-direction swinging function at a simulated human ankle is realized by a relatively simple and innovatively designed structure.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of electronic information, and provides a five-finger manipulator humanoid grabbing finite element modeling and analysis method. title: Track planning method and device for robot to descend steps and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a track planning method and a device for a robot to descend steps and the robot. The method comprises the steps that the step descending process of the robot is divided into a plurality of preset planning stages; the starting position of a swing foot of the robot is adjusted according to the ankle-heel distance, wherein the ankle-heel distance is the horizontal distance between an ankle joint and a heel of the robot; an initial state and a termination state of the swing foot of the robot in each planning stage are determined according to the starting position; and curve fitting is carried out according to the initial state and the termination state to obtain a planned track of the swing foot of the robot. According to the track planning method and the device for the robot to descend the steps and the robot, staged track planning can be carried out on the step descending process of the robot, so that the stability of the robot during step descending is greatly improved.

title: Combined centroid state acquisition method and device, humanoid robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiments of the invention provide a combined centroid state acquisition method and device, a humanoid robot and a readable storage medium. The combined centroid state comprises the speed of a combined centroid. The combined centroid state acquisition method comprises the following steps that the motion state of each real joint of the humanoid robot and the motion state of a floating base are acquired, wherein the floating base is equivalent to a plurality of virtual joints which are connected in sequence, the rotating shaft position, the mass center position and the rotating matrix of a single connecting rod in a world coordinate system are sequentially calculated based on a chain multiplication according to the positions of the corresponding joints, and then a Jacobian matrix of the mass center of the single connecting rod is solved; a Jacobian matrix of a combined mass center are calculated according to the Jacobian matrix of each connecting rod mass center and the combined mass; and the speed of the combined centroid is calculated according to the Jacobian matrix of the combined centroid and the like. According to the method, based on the motion state of the real joint and the motion state of the floating base, the Jacobian matrix and the derivative thereof are solved in a recursion mode, the calculation error rate can be reduced, and then great convenience is brought to related motion control of the robot.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot balance control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. title: Biped robot path planning method and device and biped robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a biped robot path planning method and device and a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: generating a candidate node set of a next foothold through the parameters of the biped robot and the joint movement information of a current node, adding effective candidate nodes in the candidate node set to the priority queue to select optimal nodes to achieve expansion of the next node, wherein the output optimal nodes generate a foothold sequence from the initial node to the target node so that the path node search amount of the biped robot during double-leg crossed landing can be greatly reduced; and thus the path planning efficiency is improved.

title: Rehabilitation robot with service function
abstract: The invention discloses a rehabilitation robot with a service function. Therehabilitation robot comprises a robot body, the robot body is provided with a trunk, a head and a walking mechanism, supporting devices are fixedly arranged on the two sides of the trunk, the head is provided with a service function device, and the service function device is provided with at least one camera, a third microprocessor and a loudspeaker. The third microprocessor is connected with the camera and the loudspeaker; the camera is used for capturing a face image and sending the face image to the third microprocessor, the third microprocessor recognizes the face image, and when it is found that the face image is not provided with the mask or is not correctly provided with the mask, the third microprocessor sends out prompt information through the loudspeaker. The rehabilitation robot can support the arm of a patient to walk, is beneficial to rehabilitation exercise of the patient, and can also carry the patient to carry out propaganda service work in the walking process.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps of: determining a planned capture point and a measured capture point of a robot, and calculating a capture point error of the robot; acquiring a left foot position, a right foot position and a planned zero moment point of the robot, and respectively calculating an expected left foot supporting force and an expected right foot supporting force of the robot; according to the capture point error, the expected left foot supporting force and the expected right foot supporting force, calculating the expected left foot torque and the expected right foot torque of the robot respectively; acquiring a measured left foot moment and a measured right foot moment of the robot, and respectively calculating an expected left foot posture and an expected right foot posture of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to the expected left foot posture and the expected right foot posture. According to the invention, the two feet of the robot can quickly adapt to the uneven ground, and good stability can be kept.

title: Music dance self-programming robot
abstract: The invention discloses a music dance self-programming robot. The music dance self-programming robot comprises a robot body, four limbs, a head and a control system, wherein the four limbs and the head are rotationally connected with the robot body, and the control system is arranged in the robot body; the control system comprises a motor, a power supply, an acquisition module, a storage module and a processing module, wherein the motor is electrically connected with the four limbs and the head; the power supply is electrically connected with the motor; the acquisition module is used for acquiring audio data and video data; the storage module is used for storing a music dance self-programming algorithm; and the processing module is used for executing the music dance self-programming algorithm stored in the storage module through the audio data and the video data acquired by the acquisition module, outputting audio and video melody actions and controlling the motor to drive the four limbs and the head to swing on the basis of power supply of the power supply. According to the music dance self-programming robot, the audio data and the video data are ingeniously combined and vectorized, combination of the audio data and the video data is achieved, diverse dancing achieved through self-programming is achieved, and intelligence is achieved.

title: Robot state estimation method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot state estimation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps: acquiring left foot stress information and right foot stress information of the robot; according to the left foot stress information and the right foot stress information, calculating a double-foot zero moment point of the robot under a world coordinate system; and calculating the mass center position of the robot based on a preset linear inverted pendulum model. According to the method, the brand new linear inverted pendulum model is pre-constructed, the biped zero moment point of the robot is taken as the supporting point of the model, the influence of the position change of the biped zero moment point on the position of the center of mass is fully considered, and a more accurate estimation result can be obtained based on the model.

title: Leg balancing structure and bionic robot comprising same
abstract: The invention provides a leg balancing structure and a bionic robot comprising the leg balancing structure. The leg balancing structure comprises a thigh shaft, a shank shaft and a knee joint, the shank shaft can rotate around the axis of the knee joint, and the leg balancing structure further comprises a shank balance weight structure fixedly installed at the top of the shank shaft; the shank balance weight structure is higher than the axis of the knee joint, and under the condition that the shank shaft rotates, the shank balance weight structure and the shank shaft synchronously and reversely rotate around the axis of the knee joint. The shank balance weight structure structure is arranged at the position, above the axis position of the knee joint, of the shank shaft, so that the shank is provided with hardware structures on the two sides of the rotation center of the knee joint, the structures on the two sides are fixedly connected, and the rotation directions are opposite; the rotational inertia of the shank at the knee joint position is much smaller than that of a cantilever type structure, and therefore the requirement for the motor torque during walking of the humanoid robot is lowered.

title: Bionic robot and leg structure thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bionic robot and a leg structure thereof, the leg structure comprises a thigh leg, a shank leg, a foot, a knee joint and an ankle joint, and the leg structure further comprises a knee joint driving mechanism and an ankle forward and backward lifting driving mechanism; a first accommodating cavity is formed in the thigh shaft and is used for accommodating the knee joint driving mechanism; a second accommodating cavity is formed in the thigh leg and is used for accommodating an ankle forward and backward lifting driving mechanism; the knee joint driving mechanism drives the knee joint through the first transmission mechanism so as to drive the shank shaft to rotate; the ankle forward and backward lifting driving mechanism drives the ankle joint through the second transmission mechanism so as to drive the foot to rotate. The thigh leg is provided with two containing cavities, driving mechanisms of the knee joint and the ankle joint can be moved upwards, the weight of a cantilever at the tail end of the leg of the bionic robot is reduced, the rotational inertia of the knee joint and the ankle joint during rotation can be effectively reduced, and therefore the requirement for motor torque is reduced, the joint structure space is optimized, and the joint weight is reduced; and the flexibility and the movement performance of the bionic robot are improved.

title: Musculoskeletal system control method and system based on speed precision balance and device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of control, particularly relates to a musculoskeletal system control method and system based on speed precision balance and a device, and aims to solve the problem that an existing humanoid musculoskeletal robot control method cannot well perform antagonistic muscle collaborative contraction control. The method comprises the following steps of acquiring estimated motion precision of a musculoskeletal system through a Fitts' law; calculating a supervised item torque based on the estimated motion precision through a striatum inspired speed modulation strategy; calculating a muscle activation signal vector through a muscle activation signal network; and calculating an action award based on the muscle activation signal vector and the supervised item torque, then calculating a loss function, adjusting parameters of the muscle activation signal network based on the loss function, increasing the value of the action reward, and repeatedly iterating to obtain a muscle activation signal sequence required by control. According to the method, structural information of the musculoskeletal system is utilized, a universal antagonistic muscle cooperative contraction control strategy is constructed, and smooth movement is guaranteed.

title: Biped robot gravity center control method and simulation system based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gravity center control method and system based on reinforcement learning, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a robot three-dimensional assembly construction step is conducted, specifically, a robot three-dimensional model is constructed on the basis of basic cube assemblies, and the freedom degree of each part is set; a robot gravity system construction step is conducted, specifically, parameters of the basic cube assemblies and the gravity center of a robot in an initial state are calibrated, and a robot gravity system is constructed; a robot inertia system construction step is conducted, specifically, a rotational inertia model based on joints of a leg is constructed; a robot gravity center control step is conducted, specifically, a gravity center control strategy of the gravity center and steady-state walking of the biped robot is constructed, and calibration and setting of gravity center control related parameters are conducted; and a robot analog simulation step is conducted, specifically, control simulation of the gravity center and steady-state walking of the biped robot is achieved on the basis of a reinforcement learning framework. According to the method, the efficient and instant gravity center control of the robot can be realized, and the robot adapts to changeable road environments.

title: Robot disturbance rejection control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot disturbance rejection control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that the disturbance rejection index of a robot in the current control period is determined according to the mass center parameters of the robot in the current control period, wherein the mass center parameters comprise the mass center position and the mass center speed; the target trunk inclination angle and the target upper limb swing angle of the robot in the current control period are determined according to the disturbance rejection index of the robot in the current control period and the trunk inclination angle and the upper limb swing angle of the robot in the previous control period; and the pose of the robot in the previous control period is adjusted according to the target trunk inclination angle and the target upper limb swing angle of the robot in the current control period, and the robot is controlled to move according to the adjusted pose so as to reject disturbance. According to the scheme, the problem that in the prior art, disturbance rejection is likely to be hindered by the surrounding environment when achieved by taking one step is well solved, and the disturbance rejection performance of the robot is effectively improved.

title: Inverse multi-solution selection and time optimal trajectory planning algorithm of mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the field of mechanical arms of foot type robots, in particular to an inverse multi-solution selection and time optimal trajectory planning algorithm of a mechanical arm. According to the algorithm, the most appropriate group of solutions can be rapidly selected from multiple inverse solutions according to the current pose of the mechanical arm, so that singular patterns are effectively avoided, smooth switching between different inverse solutions is achieved, and continuity and non-oscillation of control and action of the mechanical arm are guaranteed; and a trajectory with optimal time is planned by using a trajectory planning method combining a heptatic polynomial and conditional proportional control, so that smooth, continuous and derivable joint angles, angular velocities, angular accelerations and angular jerk are ensured; and meanwhile, multi-target and multi-constraint conditions are met, and the specification of an actuator is met; and the constraint condition comprise joint angular velocity maximum value constraint or joint angular acceleration maximum value constraint, and the like. According to the algorithm, the calculation amount of multi-solution selection and trajectory planning is greatly reduced, real-time and efficient time optimal trajectory planning can be realized, and the algorithm can be popularized and applied to a low-calculation-power controller.

title: Coupling bionic foot pad for improving ground contact stability of leg-foot type robot
abstract: The invention relates to a coupling bionic foot pad for improving the ground contact stability of the leg-foot type robot, the bionic foot pad can achieve an excellent biomechanical function by simulating a unique compartment structure and material combination of a human heel pad. title: Floor impact adjusting mechanism suitable for series-parallel biped robots

title: Control system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: Disclosed are a control system and a method for a humanoid robot. According to the present invention, the method for the humanoid robot photographs a user through two lenses apart from each other, estimates the posture of the user from each of two images photographed from two different points of view, checks the three-dimensional position of each joint of the user from the estimated postures, removes noise, and corrects the positions of the corresponding joints. Afterwards, the method uses the three-dimensional position information of each joint, generates an angle of each motor included in the humanoid robot for the corresponding humanoid robot to show the same posture as that of the user, provides the angle to the humanoid robot, and thereby controls the posture of the humanoid robot. Accordingly, the present invention is able to rapidly control the humanoid robot in a stable manner from a remote place through a relatively simple calculation even without using a depth sensor.

title: Biped robot walking control method and system based on double-agent cooperative game
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking control method and system based on a double-agent cooperative game. The biped robot walking control method comprises the steps of constructing a first deep reinforcement learning module and a second deep reinforcement learning module which are used for providing a robot action control strategy; collecting a first state parameter, and enabling the first deep reinforcement learning module to output a first optimal action control strategy; collecting a second state parameter, and enabling the second deep reinforcement learning module to output a second optimal action control strategy, wherein the first state parameter and the second state parameter are state parameters of left and right legs of the robot respectively; and completing the cooperative control over the actions of the two legs of the robot based on the first optimal action control strategy and the second optimal action control strategy. According to the method, two deep reinforcement learning models are constructed to analyze the action control strategies of the two legs of the robot respectively, and the two legs of the robot are independently controlled, so that the stability of the output action is improved, the control dimension of the control model is reduced, and the difficulty of model fitting is reduced.

title: Pneumatic-based profiling robot
abstract: The invention relates to a pneumatic-based profiling robot. title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. title: Two-foot walking robot

The two-foot walking robot includes a control unit, a head platform, a ball-like joint, an abdomen unit and leg units symmetrically arranged on the abdomen unit at intervals, wherein the control unit is fixed on the head platform; and the two ends of the ball-like joint are fixedly connected with the head platform and the abdomen unit respectively. title: THUMB MECHANISM AND HUMANOID HAND INCLUDING THE THUMB MECHANISM
abstract: To provide a thumb mechanism that enables a motion closer to the motion of a human thumb, and to provide a humanoid hand including the thumb mechanism.SOLUTION: When force for rotation in a counterclockwise radial direction acts on a first bone member (a thumb mechanism), the first bone member moves to a position of a dotted line while rotating in a counterclockwise direction. In other words, the first bone member (the thumb mechanism) performs a motion such that rotation around a center point P and lateral movement to a center point P1 are synthesized. On the other hand, when force for rotation in a clockwise radial direction acts on the first bone member (the thumb mechanism), the first bone member moves to a position of an alternate long and short dash line while rotating in a clockwise direction.
