title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps of determining an expected zero moment point of the robot; acquiring a left foot position and a right foot position of the robot, and respectively calculating a left foot expected supporting force and a right foot expected supporting force of the robot according to the expected zero moment point, the left foot position and the right foot position; obtaining a left foot measurement supporting force and a right foot measurement supporting force of the robot, and respectively calculating a left leg length variation and a right leg length variation of the robot according to the left foot expected supporting force, the right foot expected supporting force, the left foot measurement supporting force and the right foot measurement supporting force; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg length variation of the left leg and the leg length variation of the right leg. By means of the robot, the robot can keep good stability even in the uneven ground environment.

title: BIPEDAL WALKING ROBOT, AND CONTROL METHOD OF BIPEDAL WALKING ROBOT

title: Bimodal terrain recognition method, hardware system and sensor installation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bimodal terrain recognition method, a hardware system and a sensor installation method thereof. A field detection biped robot terrain perception and recognition storage resolving unit based on visual and tactile bimodal fusion is adopted, road condition information collection and priori knowledge learning by the biped robot in the field walking process are achieved, and then self-adaptive switching between a remote recognition mode and a short-range recognition mode is achieved. Meanwhile, a DSP + FPGA + FLASH three-core processor heterogeneous integrated structure is adopted as a hardware system and is used for acquiring and generating a navigation map in a visual semantic environment, a navigation map of tactile semantic information and real-time position and attitude information of the robot in real time, and visual images acquired in the walking process of the robot and data output by a sole sensor array are stored in real time through a FLASH memory. Meanwhile, a video sensor, a plurality of inertial measurement units and a pressure sensor array are mounted on the biped robot body, so that the authenticity and effectiveness of acquired information in the field walking process are ensured.

title: Humanoid eye and head movement mechanism

title: Humanoid robot gait generation method based on centroid height compensation
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait generation method based on centroid height compensation. Human body natural gait motion planning and gait motion planning under a 3-D linear inverted pendulum model are combined. The method comprises the following steps: 1, analyzing human body natural gait motion planning; 2, analyzing centroid height compensation; wherein in the step 1, the human body natural gait motion plan is simplified into a 3-D linear inverted pendulum model for analysis; in the step 2, on the basis of analysis in the step 1, the influence of the motion of the swinging legs on the motion trail of the centroid height when the humanoid robot walks is analyzed, centroid height compensation is introduced to solve the problem, the walking gait of the humanoid robot is divided into four stages, and gait generation of the humanoid robot is planned. title: Motion planning method for humanoid robot to dynamically and continuously cross obstacles
abstract: The invention discloses a motion planning method for a humanoid robot to dynamically and continuously cross obstacles. The motion planning method comprises the following steps of S1, motion planning constraint of the humanoid robot for continuously crossing obstacles; and S2, a motion planning algorithm of the humanoid robot for continuously crossing the obstacles. S1 comprises geometric and two-leg motion constraint, balance constraint and constraint for reducing ground collision; and S2 involves a general feasibility analysis unit, a leg track generator, a double-foot adapter and an upper body motion generator. title: Continuous dynamic stable jumping control method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a continuous dynamic stable jumping control method for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. According to a whole-body kinetic equation of the humanoid robot, driving torques of all joints of lower limbs of the humanoid robot are obtained, the driving torques are applied to the lower limbs of the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot enters a take-off stage; when the upper body position of the humanoid robot reaches a take-off height, the humanoid robot enters an air stage, and all joints of the humanoid robot are controlled to reach expected postures during landing; and when the humanoid robot falls from the air and makes contact with the ground, the humanoid robot enters the landing stage, a jumping cycle is completed, and the initial state of jumping of the robot is returned. The continuous dynamic stable jumping control of the humanoid robot is ensured, the motion ability of the humanoid robot is remarkably improved, and the environment adaptability of the humanoid robot is further enhanced.

title: Gait planning method for biped humanoid robot walking on slope
abstract: The invention discloses a gait planning method for a biped humanoid robot walking on a slope. Through the virtual ground method and the asymmetric linear inverted pendulum method, the biped humanoid robot stably and dynamically walks in any direction on the slope with smaller landing impact, and obtains stable and practical walking gaits on the slope.

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a high-integration modularized humanoid mechanical arm thereof. The high-integration modularized humanoid mechanical arm has the characteristics of being high in integration level, modularized, high in load weight ratio and large in motion space.

title: Humanoid robot and joint thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a joint thereof, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The joint of the humanoid robot comprises a joint frame with an integrated structure, a first driving module, a second driving module, a connecting rod transmission module, a synchronous belt transmission module and a cross shaft joint module, wherein the first driving module, the second driving module and the cross shaft joint module are sequentially fixed inside the joint frame in the direction of the execution end, and the connecting rod transmission module and the synchronous belt transmission module are located on the two sides of the joint frame. abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a two-degree-of-freedom modular humanoid robot joint thereof, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. title: Geometric calculation method for inverse kinematics of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a geometric calculation method for inverse kinematics of a biped robot. The method comprises the following steps: building a motion model of the biped robot, wherein the motion model comprises the motion description of a body position rbody (n), the motion description of a foot position rfoot (n) and the motion description of a leg position; based on the motion description of the body position rbody (n) and the motion description of the foot position rfoot (n), obtaining the position of a hip joint rhip (n) and the position range (n) of an ankle joint in the motion process of the biped robot, and obtaining the position and the relative angle of a leg joint actuator of the biped robot through the geometrical relation between leg joints in the motion process of the biped robot; and finally, according to the reference direction of the control angle of the joint actuator in the movement process of the robot, determining the angle Q (n) of the joint actuator solved by inverse kinematics. Low-dimensional matrix organization operation is adopted in three-dimensional robot inverse kinematics calculation, the calculation amount of inverse kinematics calculation is reduced, and the method is suitable for occasions where large-scale parallel calculation is needed in the robot motion optimization process.

title: Bionic biped walking robot with heavy-load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic biped walking robot with heavy-load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions. The bionic biped walking robot is composed of a robot body, a coronal plane swinging mechanism and two mechanical legs. The coronal plane swinging mechanism comprises a motor, a crank and a main shaft; each mechanical leg comprises a hip joint movement mechanism, a knee joint movement mechanism, an ankle joint movement mechanism and a mechanical foot mechanism. The hip joint movement mechanism comprises a leg motor, a crank, a hip connecting rod and a thigh; the knee joint movement mechanism comprises thighs, middle legs and leg connecting rods; the ankle joint movement mechanism comprises a middle leg and a shank; the mechanical foot mechanism comprises two foot motors and two toes, and each toe is composed of a damping spring, an upper foot plate and a foot bottom plate. The biped robot capable of achieving two-dimensional movement, heavy load and vibration reduction is designed by simulating the biological anatomical structure and hind limb movement characteristics of an ostrich. Movement of the mechanical leg on the sagittal plane and the coronal plane is achieved through the coronal plane swing mechanism and the hip joint movement mechanism, and the heavy load vibration reduction target of the mechanical leg is achieved through the bearing joints and the toe mechanism.

title: Robot action simulation method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot action simulation method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the field of robots. The method comprises the steps of performing skeleton key point detection on a collected action image to obtain the positions of a plurality of skeleton key points in the action image; transforming the position of each skeleton key point by regarding the trunk center of a target human body in the action image as an original point to obtain a target rotation angle of a joint corresponding to each skeleton key point; and controlling the joint corresponding to each skeleton key point to rotate based on the corresponding target rotation angle. Compared with the prior art, the problem that action sequences only can generate limited action combinations, and consequently action simulation cannot be performed in real time is avoided.

title: Rope-driven wrist module based on three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hybrid mechanism and use method of rope-driven wrist module
abstract: The invention discloses a rope-driven wrist module based on a three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hybrid mechanism. title: Hardware architecture of combat evolution system of humanoid combat robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hardware architecture of combat evolution system of a humanoid combat robot. title: Sound source positioning method and device during interaction and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, provides a sound source positioning method and device during interaction and a computer readable storage medium, and aims to accurately position the direction of a sound source and improve the efficiency and experience during interaction. The sound source positioning method comprises the steps of: picking up target sound information around a robot by a sound pickup array; determining azimuth information of a sound source of the target sound information according to the target sound information picked up by the sound pickup array; and sending the azimuth information of the sound source of the target sound information to a servo mechanism of the robot, so that the servo mechanism rotates a humanoid head of the robot to directly face the sound source sending the target sound information. According to the sound source positioning method and the device, the servo mechanism rotates the humanoid head of the robot, the humanoid head exactly faces the sound source emitting the target sound information, the interaction efficiency of the robot and the user is improved, and the use experience of the user can also be improved.

title: Biped robot gait energy consumption evaluation method based on centroid model
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot gait energy consumption evaluation method based on a centroid model, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, establishing the centroid model according to the distribution position of the mass M of a biped robot in a body, and describing the motion trail of the biped robot by using the centroid model; secondly, constructing a load torque equation of the joint actuator through the Cartesian product of the space position vector and the mass center gravity vector in the motion process of the biped robot, obtaining the axial load torque [tau](n) of the joint actuator based on the axis direction of the joint actuator, and finally in the motion process of the biped robot, establishing an energy consumption index function E according to the angular velocity [omega](n) and the axial load torque [tau](n) of the joint actuator of the biped robot. According to the method, the problem that the instantaneous power loss of each joint actuator of the biped robot is difficult to measure is solved, parameters which are easy to obtain in a biped robot motion planning algorithm are used for constructing an index function for describing the energy consumption in the robot motion process, and the advantages and disadvantages of different algorithms can be rapidly and accurately evaluated.

title: Network arrangement optimization method for biped robot gait mode generation
abstract: The invention relates to a network arrangement optimization method for biped robot gait mode generation, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, giving a robot step length s, building a finite term Fourier series model related to a parameter ak to represent a robot body track rb(n), setting a gap as mu k, building a set Ak through the parameter ak, correspondingly generating a network arrangement space set Us, and setting the set as Uk; then mapping any inverse kinematics-based model, obtaining a net arrangement space set Rs meeting the ZMP trajectory stability, taking elements meeting the requirement of an AZR variable eta in the net arrangement space set Rs, calculating gait energy consumption, obtaining a seed set, finally, constructing a search space L[lambda] according to a search interval [delta][lambda] by taking a seed as a midpoint, finding a point with the lowest energy consumption in the search space L[lambda], and obtaining a joint angle sequence with the lowest energy consumption based on the point with the lowest energy consumption. The gait energy consumption is remarkably reduced while the motion stability of the robot is considered.

title: Gait control method of under-actuated biped walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a gait control method of an under-actuated biped walking robot, which comprises the following steps of: 1, establishing a kinetic model of the under-actuated biped walking robot; 2, establishing a virtual constraint, and substituting the virtual constraint into the dynamical model of the robot to obtain a zero dynamical model of the robot; 3, taking the minimum walking energy consumption of the robot as an objective function, establishing a nonlinear constraint optimization model, and solving the nonlinear constraint optimization model to obtain an ideal gait of the robot; and 4, based on the deviation between the current state of the robot and the ideal gait, establishing feedback control to control the gait of the robot. The method has the substantive effects that stable walking is realized by adjusting the swing time and the trunk angle of the robot in real time, feedback adjustment and control are performed based on the current state of the robot, and the method has stronger real-time response, can be used for gait control under the condition of large disturbance, and has a promotion effect on the practical application of the biped robot.

title: Locking structure and robot with same
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a locking structure, which is characterized in that a first main body and a second main body are mutually locked through more than two groups of elastic locks, each group of elastic locks has elasticity and is respectively connected with the first main body and the second main body, each group of elastic locks is in a compressed or stretched state, and the elastic locks are connected with the first main body and the second main body. And when the resultant force of the elastic forces of more than two groups of elastic locks on the second main body is equal to zero, the second main body is locked relative to the first main body. The utility model further provides a robot adopting the locking structure, the robot upper body assembly of the robot is the first main body, the robot lower body assembly of the robot is the second main body, the robot upper body assembly and the robot lower body assembly are detachably connected through the elastic lockset, and therefore the whole robot can be disassembled, assembled, replaced, transported and the like conveniently.

title: EDUCATIONAL ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to an educational robot that includes a body which forms the main portion of the robot. The educational robot also includes a head mounted on the body which is capable of making human facial expressions. In addition, the educational robot includes a plurality of limbs that are capable of making human perceptible gesture. Further, the educational robot includes an interface housed in the body and allows the user to interact with the interface. In an example, the interface allows the user to select a multimedia content from a library of multimedia content. The educational robot includes an imaging device to capture an image of the user to identify the user. Further, the educational robot renders the multimedia content in an interactive and intuitive way.

title: Robot gait planning method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot gait planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a foot attitude angle of the biped robot; calculating an ankle-foot position vector according to the foot attitude angle, wherein the ankle-foot position vector is a position vector from an ankle to a sole supporting point of the biped robot; calculating the ankle position change amount of the biped robot according to the foot attitude angle and the ankle-foot position vector; compensating the ankle position of the biped robot according to the ankle position variation, and obtaining the compensated ankle position. According to the embodiment of the invention, the leg length is increased by virtue of the change of the foot attitude angle, namely, the turning of the foot sole, so that the movement efficiency of the biped robot under the conditions of complex movement, rapid walking and the like is improved, meanwhile, the problem of shaking of the swinging leg caused by the violent change of the ankle position in the movement process is solved, and the movement balance of the biped robot is improved.

title: Debugging method of humanoid robot, wireless debugging device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a debugging method of a humanoid robot, a wireless debugging device and the humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot communication. The method is applied to a wireless debugging device, an upper computer is in wireless communication connection with a humanoid robot through the wireless debugging device, and the method comprises the steps: receiving a debugging instruction sent by the upper computer, wherein the debugging instruction is used for instructing the humanoid robot to execute a preset action; converting the debugging instruction into an adjusting signal in a preset format; sending an adjusting signal to the humanoid robot; and receiving an adjustment feedback signal sent by the humanoid robot, and sending the adjustment feedback signal to the upper computer. According to the invention, remote control debugging of the humanoid robot can be realized more flexibly.

title: Design of seven-connecting-rod biped robot and hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG
abstract: The invention discloses a seven-connecting-rod biped robot building method and a hybrid control method based on ZMP and CPG, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and robot control. The invention designs a small biped robot, the robot comprises a control module, a driving module, a sensor module and a power supply module, and has the characteristics that the open source property is strong, a bottom layer drive can be built by the robot, and environmental perception can be fully performed, and the ZMP and CPG hybrid control method is provided based on the robot. The zero moment point of the robot is measured and calculated through a pressure sensor module of the robot, the deviation between an actual zero moment point and an expected zero moment point serves as compensation and is fed back to open-loop CPG control, closed-loop control of the system is achieved, and walking stability is improved. According to the invention, the biped robot can have higher open source performance and environment perception capability, and the hybrid control method can enable the robot to realize closed-loop control of a robot walking system on the premise of avoiding huge calculated amount.

title: Biped robot with safety patrol function
abstract: A biped robot with the safety patrol function comprises a left side foot system, a right side foot system, a supporting wheel system, a rack and a camera system. The left side foot system comprises eleven left side rods 1-11, a left foot and a left motor. The right side foot system comprises eleven right side rods 1-11, a right foot and a right motor; and the left motor and the right motor respectively drive the left side rod and the right side rod to realize forward stepping of the left foot and the right foot. The robot has high obstacle crossing performance, the stability of the robot in the moving process can be improved through the supporting wheel system, and the robot can be suitable for an unstructured rugged environment.

title: AZR adjusting method for real-time walking gaits of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to an AZR adjustment method for real-time walking gaits of a biped robot. The method comprises the steps that: an online database is built through the calculation data of an offline system of the robot, wherein the online database comprises a robot step length set S, an AZR set H, a walking gait set G and an energy consumption set E; with a robot target travel distance d and expected AZR position rAZR given, a step length sequence Sm <*> with the lowest energy consumption is planned; each step length of the robot and an AZR variable eta i are taken out, an online database is inquired, a motor angle sequence gi for gait control is obtained; a real-time ZMP track rZMP is calculated according to a footstep pressure set Fi in walking of the robot; a deviation value ei of the rZMP (n) and rAZR (n) is utilized, a correction value eta i+1 of the AZR variable eta i is obtained through a PI correction method, and an online database is queried according to the correction value eta i+1 and the step length si+1, and the gait track of the biped robot is optimized on line. According to the method, the interference of robot modeling and environmental errors can be overcome, high-robustness and low-energy-consumption gait control is realized in the walking process of the biped robot, and the walking problem of the biped robot with high nonlinear characteristics is well solved.

title: Head and eye watching control device of humanoid robot, and control method of control device
abstract: The invention provides a head and eye watching control device of a humanoid robot. The head and eye watching control device of the humanoid robot comprises an electric push rod for controlling the head of the humanoid robot to move up and down; angle sensors which collect the pitching angle of the head of the humanoid robot and is used for closed-loop control of the electric push rod; a steering engine for controlling eyes of the humanoid robot to rotate; a motor for controlling the head of the humanoid robot to move left and right; an encoder for collecting the rotation angle of the motor; a depth camera for collecting video data and depth data; a microphone array used for identifying the orientation of a user; and a controller used for connecting the sensors and collecting information of the sensors. The invention also provides a control method of the device at the same time, the user is positioned through the camera and the microphone array, and then the corresponding motor is controlled to move to a specified angle. According to the head and eye watching control device of the humanoid robot, and the control method of the control device provided by the invention, when the humanoid robot executes the interaction task, the head and the eyes always watch the face of the user, so that the robot is closer to humans in the aspect of interaction action.

title: Novel humanoid robot vision-voice acquisition tie device based on ROS system
abstract: The invention relates to a novel humanoid robot vision-voice acquisition tie device based on an ROS system. The tie device can be used on a humanoid robot and assists the humanoid robot in completing vision and voice acquisition tasks. The tie device is designed in a hidden mode, a tie and a sensor can be well combined, and video information and audio information can be acquired under the condition that the overall appearance of the robot is not affected. A framework of the ROS system is used for acquisition of the sensor, and development convenience and decoupling performance can be well guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot joint multistage control device and method based on ROS (Robot Operating System)
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint multistage control device based on a ROS (Robot Operating System). The humanoid robot joint multistage control device is characterized in that a main control chip receives a control instruction sent by an industrial personal computer end; the industrial personal computer carries the ROS; a direct current motor driver receives a signal sent by the main control chip and converts the signal into a motor driving signal; the direct current motor is controlled to rotate in cooperation with an angle sensor, so that a joint angle control task controlled by the direct current motor is completed; a joint motor interface drives a steering engine motor to complete a joint task; an angle sensor interface acquires the current angle of the motor as a control feedback quantity to control the angle of the direct current motor; the industrial personal computer is in communication connection with the main control chip; an integrated circuit board is used for connecting the main control chip and each interface; and a man-machine interaction upper computer panel is used for interacting with a user. The invention further provides a control method. According to the humanoid robot joint multistage control device and method based on the ROS, all the joints of a humanoid robot are connected into the same controller, so that the corresponding robot joints can be rapidly controlled to do joint actions after control instructions sent by other functional nodes are received under the ROS.

title: Head structure of humanoid expression robot and robot
abstract: The invention provides a head structure of a humanoid expression robot and the robot. The head structure comprises a facial expression realization mechanism, a neck mechanism and a base, the facial expression realization mechanism is connected with the neck mechanism, the neck mechanism is connected with the base, the neck mechanism comprises a differential bevel gear structure based on a parallelogram, the neck mechanism is used for achieving neck rotation, pitching and side-sway movement, the facial expression realization mechanism comprises a multi-connecting-rod driving structure and external silica gel skin, and the facial expression realization mechanism is used for achieving facial frowning, eyelid opening and closing, eyeball rotation and mouth stretching and opening and closing movement. The robot is simple and compact in structure, flexible in action and capable of truly simulating head swinging, head shaking and nodding actions of human beings and achieving frowning, eyelid opening and closing, eyeball rotation and mouth stretching and opening and closing movement, so that the humanoid robot is more anthropomorphic, and human-computer interaction activities with people are easier.

title: Biped robot gravity center transfer control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gravity center transfer control method. The method comprises the following steps of utilizing opposite rotation between joint motors (a left motor and a right motor) to enable two feet to generate opposite forces on the ground, and enabling a middle connecting rod to rotate due to interaction of the forces so as to realize movement of the gravity center and further realize alternate advancing of the two feet.

title: Biped robot control method and device and biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot control method and device and a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot walking path determination. The method comprises the steps that a visual image, collected by a camera, of a scene where the biped robot is located currently is obtained, the visual image comprises at least one foothold, and each foothold is used for identifying a position area; affine transformation processing is conducted on the visual image according to an affine transformation matrix, the target coordinate position corresponding to a target foothold in the visual image is obtained, the affine transformation matrix is obtained by conducting calibration processing on a camera in advance, and the target foothold is the next foothold of the current foothold of the two feet of the robot; the target coordinate position is the coordinate position of the target foothold in a world coordinate system; and the two feet of the robot are controlled to walk to the target coordinate position. The target coordinate position can be obtained through the affine transformation matrix, then accurate foothold coordinate information is provided, and the walking stability of the robot is improved.

title: Single-degree-of-freedom artificial limb wrist
abstract: The utility model discloses a single-degree-of-freedom artificial limb wrist, which relates to the field of humanoid artificial limbs and comprises a wrist base, a driving motor, a wrist shell, a transmission unit and a fixed matching unit, the wrist base comprises a base platform, a first base positioning hole, a second base positioning hole, a third base positioning hole, a base wire outlet hole and a base threaded hole; the driving motor comprises a motor threaded hole and a motor worm; the transmission unit comprises a first duplicate gear, a second duplicate gear, a first flat gear set, a second flat gear set and an inner gear; the fixed matching unit comprises a wire outlet pipe, a bearing, a first baffle plate and a second baffle plate; the wrist shell comprises a first shell and a second shell, and a driving motor, a transmission unit and a fixed matching unit are mounted in the wrist shell. Through the implementation of the utility model, the positive rotation and the negative rotation of the artificial limb wrist can be realized, and meanwhile, the problems of wire winding and wire breaking are solved.

title: Robot control method, computer-readable storage medium and robot
abstract: A robot control method includes: obtaining force information associated with a left foot and a right foot of the robot; calculating a zero moment point of a COM of a body of the robot based on the force information; updating a motion trajectory of the robot according to the zero moment point of the COM of the body to obtain an updated position of the COM of the body; performing inverse kinematics analysis on the updated position of the COM of the body to obtain joint angles of a left leg and a right leg of the robot; and controlling the robot to move according to the joint angles.

title: Nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a nursing robot which is composed of a power system, a control system, a head, two arms, a body, legs and a chassis. The robot replaces a person for nursing, actions and expressions of a nursing person are simulated in real time, field conditions are captured and fed back to the nursing person, interactive communication and nursing are completed, the effect of being personally on the scene is achieved, and robot nursing is achieved.

title: Method for achieving object hardness identification and self-adaptive grabbing based on humanoid manipulator device
abstract: The invention discloses a method for achieving object hardness identification and self-adaptive grabbing based on a humanoid manipulator device. title: Decoupling control method and device for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a decoupling control method and device for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps: decomposing a task to obtain a kinematics task and a dynamics task, and dividing joints into kinematics task joints and dynamics task joints; according to the expected position and the expected speed of the tail end in the kinematics task and the actual motion state of the tail end, solving the expected position and the expected speed of joints of the kinematics task to be used for executing the kinematics task; calculating the torque of the kinematics task joints; and based on the calculated torque of the kinematics task joints, solving an optimization model of the torque required by the kinematics task joints to obtain the torque required by the kinematics task joints for executing the kinematics task. According to the technical scheme, two control modes of kinematics control and dynamics control can be realized at the same time under the same framework, the control modes of different control tasks can be selected according to task requirements, and no conflict is generated in the control effect.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a main body, two leg structures and a balance part, wherein the two leg structures are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the main body and can swing relative to the main body; and the balance part comprises a flywheel and a first driving piece, the first driving piece is installed on the main body, the first driving piece is connected with the flywheel and used for driving the flywheel to rotate, and the extending direction of the rotating axis of the flywheel is perpendicular to the distribution direction of the leg structures on the main body. According to the biped robot in the above embodiment, the leg structures swing relative to the main body, so the robot can avoid obstacles in an advancing process; and the torque generated by rotation of the flywheel can offset the torque applied to the main body due to lifting of the leg structures, and the robot keeps balanced in a walking process, so the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.

title: Attitude measurement method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an attitude measurement method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of biped robots. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a first attitude transformation matrix from a soaring foot end to a trunk at a landing moment and a second attitude transformation matrix from a supporting foot end to the trunk; according to the first attitude transformation matrix and the second attitude transformation matrix, calculating a position transformation matrix of the foot end of the flying foot relative to the foot end of the supporting foot; according to the position transformation matrix and the position of the supporting leg at the landing moment, calculating a first position of the soaring leg at the landing moment; according to the first position, calculating he attitude parameter of the biped robot at the landing moment. By applying the embodiment of the invention, the first position of the soaring foot at the landing moment can be used as the position of the supporting foot for recording the next motion state; and further, the attitude parameters of the biped robot at the landing moment can be calculated based on the calculated positions of the supporting legs, so that the measurement error is reduced, and a relatively accurate attitude measurement result is obtained.

title: Robot trajectory planning method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot trajectory planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The robot trajectory planning method comprises the following steps of constructing a phase variable of robot trajectory planning, wherein the phase variable is a function of two position components of a trunk of a robot on a horizontal plane; and using the phase variable to replace a time variable to perform trajectory planning on the swing foot of the robot in each preset coordinate axis direction. According to the robot trajectory planning method, the robot does not continue to follow a set track after being disturbed by the environment, and correspondingly adjusts the state according to bearing disturbance, so that the influence caused by the disturbance is offset, the walking stability is kept, and the phenomenon that the swinging foot touches the ground in advance or lagging is avoided.

title: Humanoid robot double-arm teaching control lever with pressure feedback
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot double-arm teaching control lever with pressure feedback. The humanoid robot double-arm teaching control lever is composed of a base, a plurality of humanoid mechanical double arms and a control grab handle, wherein rotating joints of the humanoid mechanical double arms are connected with one another, and the control grab handle is provided with a button and a vibration ring belt. A central support of the base fixes the mechanical arms and is connected with the symmetric center of main trunks of the mechanical arms. The mechanical arm comprises five rotating joints, and five ball bearings are arranged on the five rotating joints and connected with the trunk, the shoulder part, the elbow part and the control grab handle of the mechanical arm correspondingly. An absolute position rotation sensor is arranged at the ball bearing and used for measuring the absolute angle of the joint, and the control grab handle is connected with the elbow joint through a connecting rod. Keys are mounted at the front end of the control grab handle and used for controlling closing of palms of the humanoid robot; a vibrating ring belt is connected to the tail end of the vibrating rod, and a micro vibrating motor is embedded in the ring belt. The teaching process of the mechanical arm is simplified, operation is simpler and more visual, meanwhile, the control lever has pressure feedback, and richer on-site experience can be given to an operator.

abstract: The invention relates to an energy-saving bionic tension-compression body patellofemoral joint for a biped walking robot, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical bionic engineering. title: Robot step length processing method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot step length processing method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. When it is detected that the humanoid robot is not in the balance state at present, the current body deflection posture parameters, the lower limb body parameters and the leg swing frequency of the humanoid robot can be correspondingly obtained, and then the humanoid robot can be controlled according to the obtained body deflection posture parameters, the lower limb body parameters and the leg swing frequency. And a to-be-implemented step length of the humanoid robot is automatically calculated, which currently meets the posture balance requirement and is used for maintaining the stable state of the humanoid robot, by using a swing leg drop point capturing algorithm, so that the humanoid robot can recover the balance state after adopting the calculated step length to move, and the anti-interference capability of the robot is improved.

abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm control method and device, operation control equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of mechanical arm control. abstract: The invention relates to a glenohumeral joint bionic mechanism and a glenohumeral joint angle identification method.The mechanism comprises a shoulder forward-stretching and backward-retracting fixing frame, an abduction and adduction fixing frame and two spherical rhombus mechanisms located between the shoulder forward-stretching and backward-retracting fixing frame and the abduction and adduction fixing frame, and the four edges of each spherical rhombus mechanism are arc-shaped. title: Biped robot walking control method and biped robot
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of robots, and provides a biped robot walking control method. The method comprises the steps of acquiring distance information between the mass center of the biped robot and a preset foot key point, and acquiring initial mass center position information; calculating a mass center position offset based on the distance information and a preset calculation strategy; adjusting the initial mass center position information based on the mass center position offset to obtain target mass center position information of the biped robot; and based on the target mass center position information and a preset inverse kinematics algorithm, determining target walking parameters of the biped robot, wherein the target walking parameters are used for enabling the biped robot to walk. According to the method, the mass center position offset is obtained so that the mass center position of the biped robot is adjusted to the position between two feet, and the robot can stably walk when going uphill.

title: Humanoid robot and control method thereof, and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a control method thereof, and a computer readable storage medium. The control method comprises the steps that current plantar moment information, a plantar inclination angle, a first joint inclination angle and a second joint inclination angle of the humanoid robot are obtained; a current first joint motor feed-forward angular velocity and a current second joint motor feed-forward angular velocity of the humanoid robot are obtained through calculation based on the information, and then the first joint motor feedback angular velocity and the second joint motor feedback angular velocity of the humanoid robot are further obtained through calculation; and finally, according to the feedforward angular velocity of each motor and the feedback angular velocity of each motor, a reference angle of each motor is acquired so that each motor performs deviation control on each joint through the reference angle of each joint motor. By means of the mode, the control method integrating feedforward control and feedback control is adopted, the mass center control precision is ensured, meanwhile, a response lag problem existing in feedback control is effectively solved, and the balance capacity and the anti-interference capacity of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Spring load inverted pendulum model of biped robot and gait planning method
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of biped robot gait planning, and discloses a spring load inverted pendulum model of a biped robot and a gait planning method. The model comprises two legs and a mass center, and one ends of the two legs are connected to the mass center; the rigidity of the legs can be adaptively adjusted according to the step length of the biped robot; and the model further comprises ankle joints and a foot, and the other ends of the two legs are connected to the foot through the ankle joints respectively. The spring load inverted pendulum model has the finite-size feet and actively-controlled ankle joints, can effectively improve the control performance and movement performance of a robot, and can be applied to various biped or humanoid robots containing the active ankle joints and the feet; and the model has the characteristic of being adjustable in leg rigidity, can realize flexible landing and reduce foot-to-ground impact, and can improve the step length range of the biped robot in combination with a gait planning method of a self-adaptive leg stretching strategy.

title: Humanoid expression display circuit and display device
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid expression display circuit and a display device, an eccentric shaft is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft and is located at the top end of the first rotating shaft, a transmission rod is fixedly connected with the eccentric shaft and is located above the eccentric shaft, a second rotating shaft is movably connected with the transmission rod, and the second rotating shaft is located above the transmission rod. The eccentric shaft is fixedly connected with the first rotating shaft and located above the transmission rod, the support is fixedly connected with the second rotating shaft and located on the side face of the second rotating shaft, the rotating motion of the first motor is changed into vertical reciprocating motion of a short stroke through the eccentric shaft, during rapid rotation, the limb movement during anger expression is simulated through rapid shaking, and during full-speed rotation, the limb movement is simulated through rapid shaking. The anthropomorphic expression display circuit and the anthropomorphic expression display device have the advantages that the anthropomorphic expression display circuit and the anthropomorphic expression display device are more anthropomorphic through the positive and negative rotation of the second motor and the anthropomorphic motion of the depression expression simulation when the anthropomorphic expression is simulated by the slow jitter.

title: Novel electronic control system and method for voice robot mouth shape synchronous matching
abstract: The invention discloses a novel electronic control system for voice robot mouth shape synchronous matching. The system comprises a PCB. A CPU and a motor driving module are integrated on the PCB, and the motor driving module is connected with a driving motor which is positioned at the mouth part of a voice robot and is used for enabling the mouth part to open and close; and the signal input end of the PCB is connected with a voice detection module, and the voice detection module is connected with a Bluetooth loudspeaker box. According to the invention, loudspeaker audio signals are detected, and a serial driving motor is matched; and a content is accessed and handed over to a mobile phone or voice service cloud connected with Bluetooth sound equipment without conversation handling, a user can freely select on the mobile phone according to needs, third-party conversation service software is switched at a low threshold, an expansion capability is maximized, conversation topic expansibility and interaction intelligence depth are not limited, and meanwhile, action modeling and the voice can be synchronized to achieve a ''double-spring'' effect, and the interestingness of interaction is not lost.

title: Robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. When the biped robot is detected to be in the unbalanced state at present, the current body balance prediction step length of the biped robot can be correspondingly obtained, and smooth transition processing is performed on the body balance prediction step length according to the current moving step length of the biped robot, an expected balance step length corresponding to the predicted body balance step length is obtained, then a leg planning track corresponding to the expected balance step length is obtained, and finally the current swing leg of the biped robot is controlled to move according to the leg planning track so that the biped robot can recover to a balance state, and the stepping phenomenon of the robot is avoided, and the operation reliability of the robot is improved.

title: Intelligent humanoid grape picking robot
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent humanoid grape picking robot which comprises a trolley, a robot body, a left clamping mechanical arm, a binocular stereo camera, a man-machine interaction panel, a right shearing mechanical arm, a remote controller and a fruit picking basket. The trolley comprises a base and omni-directional wheels, and the omni-directional wheels are arranged at the bottom of the base; the robot body is of a vertically-arranged human-body-imitating frame body structure and is fixedly and vertically installed on the base; the left clamping mechanical arm and the right shearing mechanical arm are symmetrically arranged and installed along the left side and the right side of the robot body correspondingly; the binocular stereo camera and the man-machine interaction panel are fixedly arranged on the upper position of the front side of the robot body; the fruit picking basket is fixedly installed on the base in front of the robot body; and the remote controller is independently configured. The intelligent humanoid grape picking robot has the beneficial effects that the overall structure and the operation process of the equipment are designed in a human-body-imitating mode, the intelligent degree is high, the picking process is scientific and reasonable, continuous picking and placing of whole grape strings can be achieved, the flexibility is high, and the adaptability is high.

title: Motion control method and device, robot control equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a motion control method and device, robot control equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. A reverse Jacobian matrix of a whole body generalized coordinate vector of a humanoid robot at the current moment relative to an actual task space vector is calculated, and according to the preset position limiting condition corresponding to the whole body generalized coordinate vector, the actual task space vector is combined with a to-be-executed task space vector at the current moment into a null space of the reverse Jacobian matrix, a target generalized coordinate vector corresponding to the to-be-executed task space vector is calculated, then the motion state of the humanoid robot is controlled according to the target generalized coordinate vector, and the motion of the humanoid robot is integrally optimized from the angle of null space, so that the purpose of controlling the humanoid robot to avoid the joint motion limit is achieved, the arm operation space is expanded on the basis of maintaining the balance of the legs of the robot, and the operation performance of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: GEOMORPHIC FEATURE ADAPTIVE FOOT MODULE FOR WALKING ROBOT
abstract: Disclosed is a terrain adaptive foot module of walking robot, comprising: leg links coupled to a main body to be slidable up and down; a second link whose upper end is connected to the leg link and the lower end is connected to a foot plate; supports coupled to the bottom of the main body so as to be slidable up and down; and a rocker provided on the main body and protruding when the support is raised to block the lowering of the leg link.

title: Camel negative type chassis device and pedestrian simulation system for testing
abstract: The utility model discloses a camel negative type chassis device and a pedestrian simulation system for testing, the camel negative type chassis device comprises a chassis, a suspension mechanism, a control mechanism and a driving mechanism, the periphery of the chassis is provided with a slope plate assembly, and the driving mechanism comprises Mecanum wheels, a transmission gear and a driven gear; the Mecanum wheel is connected with a transmission gear of the speed reduction direct current motor through a driven gear; the Mecanum wheels are connected with compression springs; the suspension mechanism is mechanically designed and is connected with the frame; the pedestrian simulation system for testing, which is designed by utilizing the camel negative type chassis device, further comprises a humanoid skeleton which is divided into a trunk skeleton and four limb skeletons; the trunk skeleton and the limb skeletons are connected through connecting pieces, the connecting pieces are connected with the limbs through output shafts of directcurrent motors, and the directcurrent motors are arranged on the shoulders and the hips of the humanoid skeleton respectively; and the humanlike framework adopts a telescopic rod.

title: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE BASED COMPUTATIONAL MODEL FOR SPATIAL-TEMPORAL AND EMOTIONAL REASONING OF HUMANOID ROBOTS
abstract: ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE BASED COMPUTATIONAL MODEL FOR SPATIAL TEMPORAL AND EMOTIONAL REASONING OF HUMANOID ROBOTS Abstract: The smart interaction between humans and robots faces challenges due to the Key decision, understanding, and evolutionary preparation processes. Recursive activity analysis and meta cognitive thought mechanisms are needed and the prefrontal cortex part inherently recognizes the thinking abilities in the human brain. The proposed artificial intelligence-based computational model involved in developing a humanoid robot control structure that can reason spatially, temporally, and emotionally. The proposed novel approach for humanoid robots includes a representation of the prefrontal cortex. The emphasis of computational pathways is on biophysically feasible neural systems embedded in various dynamics. The system's key elements are medial, ventrolateral, dorsolateral, and anterior prefrontal areas are made up of multiple computational units and are in charge of managing cognitive function. The cognitive function areas of the computational prefrontal cortex system were subjected to a reinforcement paradigm dependent understandable Artificial Intelligence (AI) protocol. The developed software can monitor and manage the humanoid robot's perceptual conditions and cognitive functions, such as empathy, focus, and explicit goal reasoning skills. This invention provokes the development of the computational model that is based on Artificial Intelligence (AI). The humanoid robot learning instrument for manipulating emotional responses and learning how they interact with cognition emotions ought to be accessible as personality traits with the representations. This model is developed specifically for humanoid robots to respond to spatial-temporal and emotional reasoning. The module's primary feature is to provide a computational representation of awareness and perception so the humanoid robot can execute reasoning ability that combines emotional reasoning and spatial-temporal. The primary goal of the research is to develop a fitting theoretical structure for a cognitive perspective for a humanoid robot.

title: Real-time active vision method of humanoid soccer robot based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of vision, and particularly relates to a real-time active vision method of a humanoid soccer robot based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: a selection method, target determination, a training process and details, wherein the selection method expresses a problem as a scenario reinforcement learning problem by defining a Markov decision process; meanwhile, an accurate belief is obtained from the current environment state; the target measurement is used for determining an optimal view angle according to the positions of the robot and the ball, and evaluating the efficiency of the self-positioning view angle by adopting an entropy-based method; the training process and details are output based on an entropy algorithm and used for online control over the head of the robot, and a deep Q-learning method is used for solving the problem of scenario reinforcement learning.

title: Walking navigation and repositioning method of humanoid robot in complex unknown labyrinth environment
abstract: The invention provides a walking navigation and repositioning method of a humanoid robot in a complex unknown labyrinth environment. The walking navigation comprises a training preparation stage and an actual operation stage. In the training preparation stage, the humanoid robot is adjusted to a default observation posture, images are collected, and space actual positions corresponding to all pixels are estimated. In the actual operation stage, the humanoid robot collects images in real time, recognizes and obtains a labyrinth ground boundary line, estimates position information of the humanoid robot and obtains surrounding boundary information of the current position; a routing navigation algorithm is executed to obtain a next node target position, and the humanoid robot advances towards the node target position; and it is detected whether the humanoid robot falls down and collides, and if so, a relocation algorithmis executed to correct the position and orientation of the humanoid robot. The method provided by the invention only depends on a visual system, the technology transportability and generalization performance are high, the fault-tolerant capability of walking navigation is improved by the repositioning method, and the success rate and execution efficiency of a labyrinth navigation task are improved.

title: Exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches comprises a shank fixing block, a constraint branch, a sole plate, a first driving branch, a second driving branch and a third driving branch; the sole plate is connected to the shank fixing block through the constraint branch; one end of the first driving branch, one end of the second driving branch and one end of the third driving branch are arranged on the shank fixing block, and the other ends are hinged to the sole plate; the first driving branch and the second driving branch are linked to drive the sole plate to realize inward turning/outward turning rotation; and the first driving branch, the second driving branch and the third driving branch are linked to drive the sole plate to realize dorsiflexion/plantar flexion rotation and inward rotation/outward rotation. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with three flexible driving branches has three rotational degrees of freedom, each degree of freedom is an active degree of freedom, and dorsiflexion/plantar flexion rotation, inward turning/outward turning rotation and inward rotation/outward rotation of ankle joints of lower limbs of a human body can be simulated and reproduced.

title: Balancing device for robot joints
abstract: The invention discloses a balancing device for robot joints, and relates to the technical field of robot joint balancing devices. In order to better solve the balance problem of a robot, the balancing device specifically comprises a robot body, arm assemblies and leg assemblies are rotatably arranged at the two sides of the robot body, and foot assemblies are rotatably arranged at the bottoms of the leg assemblies; and joint motors for controlling the arm assemblies, the leg assemblies and the foot assemblies to rotate are mounted at the joints of the arm assemblies, the leg assemblies and the foot assemblies. According to the balancing device, by arranging an angle sensor, a balance water bag, a pressure sensor and other structures, the motion state of the robot can be sensed in real time through the angle sensor and the pressure sensor, water is quantitatively conveyed into the balance water bag through a water pump, and therefore the purpose of balance weight balance is achieved; and the balance water bag is arranged at the outer side, so that a certain buffering protection performance is achieved, and the reliability is improved.

title: Human facial expression imitating robot head
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid facial expression robot head, which comprises a mouth mechanism, a nose wing mechanism and an eye mechanism, the mouth mechanism and the nose wing mechanism are respectively provided with a steering engine for driving, the eye mechanism comprises an eyeball driving device and an eyebrow steering engine, the power output end of the eyeball driving device is provided with an eyeball transmission device, and the eyeball transmission device is connected with the eyebrow steering engine. The eyeball transmission device drives the eyeball model to rotate in multiple directions, an eyebrow transmission device is arranged at the power output end of the eyebrow steering engine and comprises an eyebrow connecting rod and an eyebrow rocker, an eyebrow steering engine arm is installed at the power output end of the eyebrow steering engine, the eyebrow connecting rod is hinged to the eyebrow steering engine arm, one end of the eyebrow rocker is hinged to the eyebrow connecting rod, and the other end of the eyebrow rocker is hinged to the eyebrow steering engine arm. An eyebrow fixing piece is installed at the other end of the eyebrow rocker, the eyebrow rocker can rotate with the middle of the eyebrow rocker as the axis, so that the eyebrow fixing piece drives the eyebrow model to bounce up and down, the facial expressions of the robot are richer, and the eyebrow model is applied to the field of robots.

title: Robot walking control method and device, robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a robot walking control method and device, a robot and a readable storage medium. According to the walking control method, when the horizontal planning speed is larger than a preset speed threshold value in the current direction, the forward horizontal position, relative to supporting legs, of the waist in the current planning step is obtained through forward kinematics calculation to serve as a current driving variable, and trajectory planning functions corresponding to joints of the robot relative to the current driving variable are calculated and acquired; the forward horizontal actual measurement speed and the forward horizontal planning speed of the waist relative to the supporting legs are compared; when the forward horizontal actual measurement speed is greater than the forward horizontal planning speed, the driving variable and the trajectory planning functions are updated according to the forward horizontal actual measurement speed so as to realize walking control of the robot; and when the forward horizontal actual measurement speed is smaller than or equal to the forward horizontal planning speed, the driving variable and the trajectory planning functions are updated according to the forward horizontal planning speed so as to realize walking control of the robot. Therefore, the walking stability of the robot is improved.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a robot walking control method and device, a robot and a readable storage medium. According to the walking control method, when the horizontal planning speed is larger than a preset speed threshold value in the current direction, the forward horizontal position, relative to supporting legs, of the waist in the current planning step is obtained through forward kinematics calculation to serve as a current driving variable, and trajectory planning functions corresponding to joints of the robot relative to the current driving variable are calculated and acquired; the forward horizontal actual measurement speed and the forward horizontal planning speed of the waist relative to the supporting legs are compared; when the forward horizontal actual measurement speed is greater than the forward horizontal planning speed, the driving variable and the trajectory planning functions are updated according to the forward horizontal actual measurement speed so as to realize walking control of the robot; and when the forward horizontal actual measurement speed is smaller than or equal to the forward horizontal planning speed, the driving variable and the trajectory planning functions are updated according to the forward horizontal planning speed so as to realize walking control of the robot. Therefore, the walking stability of the robot is improved.

title: Attitude control method and device, biped robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an attitude control method and device, a biped robot and a readable storage medium, and relates to the field of robot control. The attitude control method comprises the steps of: when detecting that a current posture of an upper body of the biped robot deviates from a preset expected track, determining a current supporting foot of the biped robot and target generalized coordinates of the upper body of the robot relative to the supporting feet; decoupling a posture feedback linear controller equation used for reflecting dynamic feedforward information according to the target generalized coordinates to obtain a target generalized force pitching component and a target generalized force rolling component of the upper body of the robot under the action of the supporting foot, and then determining a target joint control signal corresponding to the supporting foot; and controlling a robot joint corresponding to the supporting foot to operate according to the target joint control signal, so that the posture of the upper body is kept consistent with the preset expected track, the posture control response speed and walking continuity of the biped robot are improved, and the biped robot does not need to have the ankle joint driving capacity.

title: Humanoid robot modeling method and device based on floating base flywheel inverted pendulum

title: Inhaul cable driving mechanism with torque sensor and portable power assisting equipment of inhaul cable driving mechanism

title: Humanoid robot jumping landing state detection system and method
abstract: The invention provides a jumping landing state detection system and method for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. According to the method, the joint control torque required by each joint of the robot in the air is calculated according to the current motion state of the humanoid robot, so that the expected control current of each joint of the humanoid robot is obtained, and when the humanoid robot completes expected motion, according to the expected control current of each joint, the error between the expected control current and the actual control current of each joint is obtained, when the error value is larger than an allowable value, it is judged that the humanoid robot makes contact with the ground, and the motion controller generates a new expected motion angle. According to the method, the landing state of the robot can be accurately obtained, the motion stability control over the humanoid robot after landing is completed, and meanwhile the control over robot motion state switching becomes easy.

abstract: Humanoid, pro-active, expressive, mobile, telescopic and multi-function robot with artificial intelligence system, adapted for providing assistance and information in hotel structures; said robot being characterized in that it comprises: - an upper component, with video cameras inserted in two eye sockets, provided with a sonar which allows omni-directional navigation, a plurality of directional microphones and at least two speakers; - a central body comprising two limbs, a screen and a touch-screen interface; - a tank provided with stair-climbing wheels, lower brushes and a staircase detector sensor; - a smart cleaning function, adapted to perform a deep cleaning through said lower brushes and a suction system; - a lower block comprising said artificial intelligence system adapted to implement dialogues, languages and to adapt according to the context.

title: Robot and gait control method and device thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and provides a robot and a gait control method and device thereof. The method comprises the steps that state information of the robot at the current moment is acquired; an optimized objective function and a constraint model corresponding to a preset gait optimization model of three mass points are determined according to the state information in combination with a reference trajectory of the robot; according to the optimized objective function and the constraint model, an optimized trunk mass center track and an optimized swing leg track of the robot are determined; and gait control is carried out on the robot according to the optimized trunk mass center track and the optimized swing leg track. Due to the fact that the track of swinging legs and the track of the mass center of a trunk are combined during gait control, and compared with a method only adopting the position of a foothold, the robot can better bear external interference, and the moving stability of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot based on cross-joint cooperative driving

According to the humanoid robot, peak values are output at the same time through double motors of cooperative driving, and compared with the prior art, half of the torque output requirement of a single joint is theoretically reduced, and the cooperative driving capacity of all the joints is enhanced; and on the premise of reducing transmission mechanisms, the inertia upward movement degree is maximized.

title: Mass center pose estimation method and device, computer-readable storage medium, and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a mass center pose estimation method and device, a computer-readable storage medium, and a robot. The method comprises: obtaining a waist measurement posture of the robot and all joint angles of supporting legs; calculating ankle postures of the supporting legs according to the waist measurement posture and the joint angles; compensating preset initial ankle positions according to the ankle postures to obtain ankle positions of the supporting legs; calculating a waist pose of the robot according to the ankle poses of the supporting legs and all the joint angles; and calculating a mass center pose of the robot according to the waist pose. According to the method, the ankle poses are fully considered in the calculation process of the mass center pose, so that the situation of sole overturning can be effectively processed, and the result accuracy is greatly improved.

title: Leg power system mechanism of leg-foot type robot and leg-foot type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg power system mechanism of a leg-foot type robot and the leg-foot type robot. The system mechanism comprises a hip joint power unit, a thigh power unit, a shank power unit and a trunk unit. The hip joint motor drives the thigh connecting rod and the shank connecting rod to swing within a certain range on the two sides of the body, the thigh motor drives the thigh connecting rod to swing within a certain range in the front-back direction of the body, and the shank motor drives the balance power transmission mechanism to achieve swing of the shank connecting rod within a certain range in the front-back direction of the body. According to the leg power system mechanism of the leg-foot type robot and the leg-foot type robot, the leg power system mechanism has no singular position in the moving process, stable and balanced torque output of a power system is achieved, precision and controllability are achieved, and the overall bearing capacity is improved; and the accuracy of the control position of a leg power system of the leg-foot type robot and the reliability of track movement are improved. title: Biped robot walking control method based on adversarial network and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking control method and electronic equipment based on an adversarial network, and the method comprises the steps: S1, collecting multiple groups of data of a biped robot, wherein each group of data comprising state data, action data and state data after action; S2, inputting the data acquired in the step S1 into an adversarial network for training; and S3, controlling the biped robot to walk according to the action data output by the trained adversarial network. According to the method, an unsupervised neural network optimization algorithm (adversarial network) is adopted, an optimal dynamic model of the robot can be obtained under the mutual game of a generator and a discriminator, and an intelligent swarm search optimization algorithm (particle swarm optimization algorithm) is adopted, so that optimal action parameters can be obtained.

title: Upper limb exoskeleton robot

title: Humanoid manipulator controlled by wearable exoskeleton

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot, and the leg mechanism comprises a hip joint driving mechanism which comprises a U-shaped connecting piece, a hip rotation steering engine, a hip side-sway steering engine and a hip forward-sway steering engine; the thigh structural part is connected to the hip forward swing steering engine; the shank structural part is rotationally connected to the thigh structural part; the foot plate structural part is movably connected to the shank structural part; the knee joint driving mechanism is arranged on the thigh structural part and used for driving the shank structural part to rotate relative to the thigh structural part; the ankle driving mechanism is used for driving the foot plate structural part to rotate relative to the shank structural part. title: Walking control method, device and equipment of biped robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a walking control method, device and equipment of a biped robot and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot automatic control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the position of a target label of a target step, wherein the target label is arranged on the target step; determining the information of the height, relative to the current position, of the target step according to the position of the target label; determining the position of a target foothold according to the current position and the information of the height; determining the moving path of the centroid of the biped robot according to the position of the target foothold and the current centroid position of the biped robot; and controlling the both feet of the biped robot to walk to the target foothold according to the joint angle changing sequence corresponding to the centroid moving path. The way that the robot climbs the stairs and walks down the stairs can be determined according to the height of the stairs and the ground related information, and the flexibility of the biped robot is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent lifting type exoskeleton robot. title: Modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid arm
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot research and engineering, in particular to a modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid arm. The modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid arm specifically comprises a shoulder module, an elbow module, a wrist module and arm connecting parts for connecting the modules, the shoulder module and the wrist module are of a three-degree-of-freedom structure, the elbow module is of a single-degree-of-freedom structure, the shoulder module is connected with the elbow module through one arm connecting part, the elbow module is connected with the wrist module through one arm connecting part; the arm connecting parts are key components for connecting all the modules, and quick assembly of arm interfaces and module interfaces is adopted. The whole humanoid arm rotates with seven degrees of freedom, the shoulder module, the elbow module and the wrist module are connected with driving mechanisms correspondingly, and the driving mechanisms are in linkage with kinematic chain sets and drive the shoulder module, the elbow module and the wrist module to move correspondingly. The driving mechanism is arranged independently from each module, and is connected with each module through Bowden wire pipes for driving, so that the overall weight of the modules is reduced.
