title: Meal delivery biped robot control system
abstract: The utility model provides a meal delivery biped robot control system. The meal delivery biped robot control system comprises a sensor module, a mechanical module and a power module. The sensor module comprises an obstacle avoidance module in signal connection with the central processing unit, a voice module with a voice broadcast function, a storage module, a laser radar module, a binocular camera, a GPS module, a communication module and a sole sensor; the binocular camera has image recognition and distance measurement functions; the laser radar module assists the GPS module in positioning; the upper computer is connected with the central processing unit through the communication module, and control over the robot is achieved in the upper computer. The plantar sensor is used for detecting plantar pressure and collecting data to the central processing unit for closed-loop control; the mechanical module comprises robot arms and legs driven by motors, and three degrees of freedom are achieved. title: Intelligent interactive humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of interactive robot disinfection, and discloses an intelligent interactive humanoid robot. The intelligent interactive humanoid robot comprises a robot body, a head body is fixedly connected to the top of the robot body through bolts, arm bodies are connected to the two sides of the robot body through bolts, a display touch screen is fixedly connected to the interior of the robot body through bolts, an automatic disinfecting and cleaning mechanism is arranged in the robot body, a storage opening is formed in the position, located below the display touch screen, in the robot body, a homing mechanism is arranged in the position, located below the automatic disinfecting and cleaning mechanism, in the robot body, and a walking base is welded to the bottom of the robot body. According to the intelligent interactive humanoid robot, through the automatic disinfecting and cleaning mechanism and the homing mechanism, the effects of automatically spraying disinfectant fluid to the surface of the display touch screen and wiping, scraping and cleaning the display touch screen back and forth can be achieved, the problem that bacterial viruses are spread and diffused through the display touch screen can be solved, and meanwhile, the disinfectant fluid after cleaning is guided and collected.

title: Smart task type biped robot based on SLAM and machine vision and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a smart task type biped robot based on SLAM and machine vision and a control method thereof. The robot comprises steering engines, wheels, at least two sets of adjusting mechanisms connected with the steering engines and the wheels and driving parts connected with the wheels, wherein the adjusting mechanisms are symmetrically distributed on the two sides of the steering engines; each adjusting mechanism comprises a support rotationally connected with the wheels, a supporting arm, a first joint driver and a second joint driver, one end of the supporting arm is rotationally connected with the support through the first joint driver, and the other end of the supporting arm is rotationally connected with the steering engine through the second joint driver; when the first joint driver and the second joint driver rotate in the same direction, the steering engine and the wheels get close to each other or get away from each other. The robot has the effects of being convenient to move in complex terrains and improving the moving speed.

title: Walking control method and device of biped robot, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a walking control method and device of a biped robot, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot trajectory planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the positions of a first label and a second label on a target road, and arranging a plurality of labels on the target road, wherein the first label and the second label are any two adjacent labels on the target road, and the first label is a label in a target area where the biped robot is located currently; determining relative position information of the second label relative to the first label; and controlling the biped robot to walk from the position of the first label to the position of the second label according to the relative position information. According to the walking control method and device of the biped robot, the equipment and the storage medium provided by the invention, the accuracy of the walking direction and distance of the robot can be improved, and walking errors are reduced.

title: Bionic three-axis intersection type exoskeleton robot hip joint
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a bionic three-axis intersection type exoskeleton robot hip joint. According to the exoskeleton hip joint, active motion assistance with three degrees of freedom of forward bending/backward stretching, inward folding/outward unfolding and inward rotation/outward rotation is achieved, the motion flexibility is improved, the three rotating shafts are intersected at the center of the human body hip joint, no motion deviation exists, and the wearing comfort is improved.

title: Exoskeleton robot ankle joint with double flexible driving branches
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to an exoskeleton robot ankle joint with double flexible driving branches. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint comprises a shank fixing block, a constraint branch, a sole plate, a first driving branch and a second driving branch, wherein the sole plate is connected with the shank fixing block through the constraint branch, the first driving branch and the second driving branch are arranged on the shank fixing block, and the sole plate is driven by the first driving branch and the second driving branch to realize dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and introversion/ectropion rotation. The exoskeleton robot ankle joint with the double flexible driving branches has two active degrees of freedom of dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and inward turning/outward turning, the rotation centers of the two joints are highly superposed to the center of the ankle joint of a human body, the structural rigidity is high, the driving force is sufficient, the center of gravity is close to the upper part, and each driving unit is connected with an elastic element in series, so that flexible and safe power output of each joint can be realized.

title: Series-parallel hybrid-based seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a series-parallel hybrid-based seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm device, The series-parallel hybrid-based seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm device comprises a shoulder joint, a large arm rotating joint, an elbow joint, a small arm rotating joint and a wrist joint. title: Control system and control method for humanoid mushroom picking double-arm robot
abstract: The invention provides a control system and a control method for a humanoid mushroom picking double-arm robot, belongs to the technical field of automatic control, and particularly relates to the control system and the control method for the humanoid mushroom picking double-arm robot. title: Humanoid robot control system for shoe and clothing display
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot control system for shoe and clothing display. title: Mass center track generation method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a mass center track generation method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a mass center actual pose, a left foot pose and a right foot pose of the robot; determining a first pose tracking vector of the robot according to the actual pose of the mass center and the pose of the left foot; determining a second pose tracking vector of the robot according to the actual pose of the mass center and the pose of the right foot; and according to the first pose tracking vector and the second pose tracking vector, controlling a mass center expected pose of the robot to alternately track the left foot pose and the right foot pose so as to generate a mass center expected trajectory of the robot. According to the method, the mass center track is generated according to the control idea that the mass center alternately tracks the two feet, and the stability of the robot is effectively improved.

title: Humanoid robot breathing mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot breathing mechanism which comprises a supporting frame, a breathing driving assembly, a shoulder assembly and a chest assembly. The shoulder assembly and the chest assembly are both in sliding fit with the supporting frame. The sliding directions of the shoulder component and the chest component are parallel to or coincide with a sagittal plane; the breath driving assembly drives the shoulder assembly and the chest assembly to slide at the same time. The breathing mechanism of the humanoid robot can simulate the breathing state of a human body, and the robot can be more vivid and approximate to a real person through the fluctuating motion of the chest and the shoulders.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a crotch part, a walking part and a walking part, the crotch is of a frame-shaped structure composed of two oppositely-arranged first racks and two oppositely-arranged second racks, and the first racks and the second racks are connected through rotating pairs. A first ball screw group is arranged at the inner side end of the second rack; the leg part is arranged at the lower end of the crotch part; and the leg part comprises two robot legs, and the two robot legs are respectively connected with the two second racks. The utility model has the characteristics of simple structure, low cost and high reliability.

title: Humanoid robot hand structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot hand structure. The humanoid robot hand structure comprises a support and five fingers of a thumb mechanism, an index finger mechanism, a middle finger mechanism, a ring finger mechanism and a little finger mechanism which are arranged on the support, wherein the thumb mechanism is provided with three frame knuckles, the other four fingers are respectively provided with four frame knuckles, and a joint device is arranged between every two adjacent knuckles in the five fingers and used for controlling the fingers to bend or unbend; and the thumb mechanism, the index finger mechanism, the ring finger mechanism and the little finger mechanism are respectively provided with a swing device for controlling the fingers to diverge or fold. According to the humanoid robot hand structure, the joint devices and the swing devices are adopted to control bending and diverging actions of the fingers respectively, a rotating device is arranged to control the rotation of the thumb, and therefore the defects that in the prior art, a robot hand is poor in flexibility and small in freedom degree are overcome, various complex work tasks can be completed, and the grab force of the fingers can be greatly improved by means of pull wire driving; and the humanoid robot hand structure is widely suitable for being matched with intelligent robots.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure and a humanoid robot, and the leg structure comprises a thigh part, a shank part, a knee rotating assembly connected between the thigh part and the shank part, a hip joint part mounted on the thigh part, an ankle joint part mounted on the shank part, and a foot plate connected with the ankle joint part. The force sensor is connected between the foot plate and the ankle joint piece; the ankle joint piece comprises an ankle side-sway assembly used for driving the foot plate to sway laterally and an ankle front-sway assembly used for driving the ankle side-sway assembly to sway forwards. The ankle forward swing assembly comprises an ankle forward swing motor fixedly installed on the shank part, an ankle forward swing speed reducer with the fixed end installed on the shank part and an ankle forward swing transmission mechanism arranged between the ankle forward swing motor and the ankle forward swing speed reducer. The output end of the ankle forward swing speed reducer is connected with the ankle side swing assembly. The ankle forward swing motor does not need to be arranged on the rotating axis of the ankle forward swing assembly, the size of the ankle forward swing assembly can be reduced, and then the local size of the leg structure is reduced.

title: eye drive system of humanoid robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid robot pupil driving system capable of facilitating interaction with a user by enabling pupils to be freely moved. According to the present invention, the system includes: a control part; a pupil member installed on an eyeball position at a predetermined distance from the control part, while having a storage space therein; a pupil member located in the storage space of the pupil member; center permanent magnets located in the centers of the eyeball member and the pupil member respectively to locate the pupil member in the center of the eyeball member through a magnetic force; a center electromagnet coil installed between the center permanent magnets, and electrically connected with the control part to offset the magnetic force of the center permanent magnets in accordance with a control signal of the control part; a plurality of side permanent magnets installed on the edge of the pupil member; and side electromagnet coils installed on the edge of the eyeball member, while installed adjacently to be matched with the side permanent magnets respectively, and electrically connected with the control part to draw the pupil member by sending a current to an adjacent side permanent magnet in accordance with a control signal of the control part.

title: Active-passive combined upper limb power-assisting robot
abstract: The invention discloses an active-passive combined upper limb power-assisting robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The active-passive combined upper limb power-assisting robot comprises a waist mechanism, a back mechanism and shoulder mechanisms, and the waist mechanism and the back mechanism are located on the back waist and the back of a human body respectively; the robot further comprises the shoulder mechanisms and passive power-assisting mechanisms; the lower ends of the shoulder mechanisms are connected with the back mechanism, the upper ends of the shoulder mechanisms are located above the back mechanism, and shoulder joints are assisted in abduction/constriction, inward rotation/outward rotation and forward flexion/backward extension movement through driving force; the lower ends of the passive power-assisting mechanisms are connected with the back mechanism, the upper ends of the passive power-assisting mechanisms are connected with the shoulder mechanisms, and the passive power-assisting mechanisms are used for providing multi-directional boosting force and supporting force for a user and the shoulder mechanisms; and the shoulder mechanisms have six degrees of freedom, not only provide supporting force for the shoulders, but also provide assistance in three degrees of freedom directions of abduction/convergence, inward rotation/outward rotation and forward flexion/backward extension of the shoulder joints by utilizing the passive power-assisting mechanisms and torsion springs, and effectively provide multidirectional assistance for a human body to carry and lift goods.

title: Humanoid quadruped robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid quadruped robot which comprises legs, mechanical arms, a waist part, a moving platform, a head part and a trunk part, the bottom end of the trunk part is connected with the moving platform through the waist part, the number of the legs is four, the four legs are all connected to the moving platform, each leg part is movably connected with the moving platform, and the humanoid quadruped robot can move front and back or left and right through the leg parts; the number of the mechanical arms is two, the two sides of the trunk part are movably connected with the two mechanical arms respectively, and the top end of the trunk part is movably connected with the head part; and an environment sensing device is arranged on the humanoid quadruped robot. title: Robot trajectory determination method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot trajectory determination method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of biped robot path planning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an advancing starting point and an advancing ending point of the biped robot; determining a target sub-trajectory according to the advancing starting point and the advancing ending point, wherein the target sub-trajectory comprises a preset number of to-be-executed footholds; determining a target foothold according to the position of the first to-be-executed foothold in the target sub-trajectory; controlling the biped robot to advance to a first to-be-executed foothold in the target sub-trajectory; deleting the first to-be-executed foothold from the target sub-trajectory, and adding the target foothold into the target sub-trajectory to obtain a new target sub-trajectory; and controlling the biped robot to advance to the advancing end point according to the new target sub-trajectory. According to the method and the device, the accuracy of the biped robot during robot path tracking can be improved, so that the biped robot can reach an expected target end point more accurately.

title: State estimation method, device and equipment of parallel configuration humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a state estimation method, device and equipment of a parallel configuration humanoid robot and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first state estimation value obtained according to a sensor at a leg joint position of the humanoid robot, a second state estimation value obtained according to a sensor at a leg ankle position of the humanoid robot and a third state estimation value obtained according to a sensor at a waist position of the humanoid robot at the same time; adopting forward kinematics to obtain a leg pose estimation value under the body coordinate system according to the first state estimation value and the third state estimation value; and obtaining a centroid pose estimation value under the world coordinate system according to the leg pose estimation value under the body coordinate system, the first state estimation value, the second state estimation value and the third state estimation value. The pose of the centroid in the world coordinate system is accurately estimated based on the state estimation value of the sensor, the state estimation problem of the parallel configuration humanoid robot is solved, and the centroid state estimation accuracy is improved.

title: Child accompanying robot based on emotion intelligent recognition and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a child accompanying robot based on emotion intelligent recognition. The child accompanying robot comprises an emotion recognition module, an action interaction module, a language interaction module and a control module. The emotion recognition module is used for judging the emotion of a child according to collected signals and outputting an emotion recognition value; the action interaction module is used for controlling the motion form of a robot body according to a control instruction output by the control module; the language interaction module is used for outputting audio information according to the control instruction output by the control module; and the control module is used for outputting a control instruction of a corresponding level according to the emotion recognition value and a user input instruction, and outputting the control instruction to the action interaction module and the language interaction module respectively. According to the child accompanying robot based on emotion intelligent recognition, the functions of recognizing expressions and languages of children and judging the emotional states of the children based on a robot NAO platform are achieved, then corresponding interactive responding made, and the purpose of enabling the children to grow healthily and happily is finally achieved by pertinently interacting with the children according to the emotions of the children.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that the step length of the robot in the advancing process is obtained; the mass center swing angle amplitude and the double-arm swing angle amplitude of the robot are determined according to the step length; the position vector difference between the mass center of the robot and the two feet is obtained; a swing angle coefficient of the robot is calculated according to the position vector difference and the step length; according to the swing angle coefficient, the mass center swing angle amplitude and the double-arm swing angle amplitude, the mass center swing angle and the double-arm swing angle of the robot are determined; and the robot is controlled to move according to the mass center swing angle and the double-arm swing angle. According to the method, the corresponding swing angles are planned for the mass center and the two arms of the robot, the deflection torque generated in the walking process can be effectively counteracted, and the stability of the robot is greatly improved.

title: Human-powered mechanical toy batters
abstract: A humanoid batter toy system comprising: a baseball home plate comprising: a bottom plate, a top plate, wherein the set of gear transfers the torque force to the leg shaft. The baseball batter humanoid includes the leg shaft coupled to a hip gear in the baseball batter humanoid, wherein the hip gear receives the torque force uses the torque force to cause an upper torso of baseball batter humanoid to rotate a baseball bat in a batter swinging motion, wherein the metal rope is placed in a central manner within the upper torso portion and when metal wire rope is pulled, the shoulder rotation of the baseball batter humanoid occurs.

title: Large-bearing humanoid double-arm service robot
abstract: The invention discloses a large-bearing humanoid double-arm service robot. The large-bearing humanoid double-arm service robot comprises a large-bearing four-wheel differential moving chassis, a controller, an upper computer, a power supply system, a mechanical body, a first humanoid mechanical arm, a second humanoid mechanical arm, a depth camera and a laser radar. The laser radar scans an indoor environment, and transmits scanning data to the upper computer; the upper computer performs mapping according to the data; the upper computer performs trajectory planning according to given position points to obtain feasible trajectories; the upper computer transmits trajectory routes to a lower computer; the lower computer drives first to fourth direct-current motor modules to operate to drive first to fourth large-bearing wheels to operate to target positions; the upper computer plans motion trajectories of the humanoid mechanical arms according to object information, and transmits controllable information to the controller; and the controller drives the first humanoid mechanical arm and the second humanoid mechanical arm to correspondingly work to fulfill a service function.

title: Humanoid robot leg movement structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg movement structure. The humanoid robot leg movement structure comprises a first supporting leg, a first motor, a second motor, a control box, a storage battery, damping mechanisms, connecting plates, adjusting mechanisms and an obstacle avoidance sensor, wherein the first supporting leg is connected with a second supporting leg in a clamped mode, the first motor is arranged on one side of the interior of a fixed box, the second motor is arranged on the other side of the interior of the fixed box, the control box is arranged above the fixed box, the storage battery is arranged on one side of the interior of the control box, the damping mechanisms are arranged in the first supporting leg and a third supporting leg, the connecting plates are arranged in the second supporting leg and a fourth supporting leg, one end of the adjusting mechanism is fixedly connected with the third supporting leg, and the obstacle avoidance sensor is arranged on a supporting base below the second supporting leg. The humanoid robot leg movement structure is provided with the damping mechanisms and the adjusting mechanisms, the damping mechanisms effectively reduce vibration generated by movement of the robot, and the height of the legs of the robot is conveniently adjusted through the adjusting mechanisms.

title: ROBOT

title: Transmission device with variable rigidity and damping based on magnetorheological fluid and design method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a transmission device with variable rigidity and damping based on magnetorheological fluid and a design method thereof. According to the designed transmission device, variable rigidity and damping of a mechanism are achieved by utilizing the characteristic that a permanent magnet is different in stress on a non-uniform magnetic field and the characteristic that the magnetorheological fluid is different in shear stress in a variable magnetic field. The designed transmission device with variable rigidity and damping based on the magnetorheological fluid is composed of an outer wall, a linear large bearing, an inner wall, an end cover, a first coil, a shaft, the magnetorheological fluid, a first spring, an inner end cover, a permanent magnet PM, a second coil, a second spring, a permanent magnet PM fixing piece, a bottom cover and a linear bearing. title: Robot balance control method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot balance control method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. title: Multi-joint linkage robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-joint linkage robot. A shoulder joint assembly comprises a supporting frame with one end rotationally connected to one side of the lower end of a main frame assembly, the side wall of the lower end of a second supporting plate is rotationally connected with a third supporting plate through a second connecting shaft, and the lower end of the third supporting plate is connected with walking feet; a first linkage mechanism used for driving the second supporting plate to swing is installed on the side wall of the first supporting plate. The shoulder joint assembly further comprises a pushing mechanism which is located in the supporting frame and drives the first linkage mechanism to rotate when the supporting frame swings. According to the multi-joint linkage robot, shoulder joints, knee joints and ankle joints of the robot are linked together through the linkage mechanism, multi-joint linkage movement of the robot is driven through work of a reduction gearbox, bionic work of the robot is achieved, the size and weight of the robot joints can be reduced, the reduction gearbox is installed in the middle of an inner cavity of the main frame assembly, and stable operation of the robot is achieved; and the integrity and the integration level of the structural design are improved.

abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot with high safety and capable of carrying out video call, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, the humanoid robot comprises a robot main body, a head body, arms and legs, the top of the robot main body is provided with the head body, the outer surface of the head body is provided with a voice receiver, and two sides of the head body are provided with loudspeakers. title: Humanoid robot identity authentication method and system based on gait recognition
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot identity authentication method and system based on gait recognition. The system comprises a pedestrian detection module, a pedestrian tracking module, an action classification module, a gait identity recognition network model construction and training module, a classification gait recognition module, a recognition result credibility judgment module and the like. The pedestrian detection module is responsible for separating pedestrian images from video frames; the pedestrian tracking module is responsible for video association of the same pedestrian; the gait identity recognition network model construction and training module is used for building a binary classification recognition model based on a GaitSet gait recognition network and training two network variants for recognizing walking gait identity and running gait identity; the action classification module is used for classifying pedestrian walking actions into three types of standing, walking and running, so that a classification gait recognition module can conveniently execute corresponding gait recognition; and the recognition result credibility judgment module is used for determining a credible identity in statistical significance from the plurality of segmented video recognition results. According to the invention, the difference principle of real person/robot gait actions is utilized, so that the authentication precision is high.

title: Humanoid robot action system based on human body posture control and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action system based on human body posture control and a control method. The system comprises an operator, an upper computer and a robot body. The control method comprises the following steps: labeling all the steering engines of the robot body one by one, and recording robot posture information, for example, opening Bluetooth of all the gyroscopes by an operator, connecting the gyroscopes to an upper computer one by one, making posture changes by the operator, and conducting space positioning by all the gyroscopes; integrating the current posture information recorded by the upper computer with the posture information of the human body to solve a conversion matrix between the posture of the human body and the posture of the robot, and conducting correlation coefficient calculation sequentially on the conversion matrix and a standard conversion matrix in an action group database; searching an optimal correlation coefficient, reading the steering engine information correspondingly stored in the action group database, and compiling the stored steering engine information into a control instruction; and receiving the action control instruction and executing corresponding joint movement by the humanoid robot, wherein all the steering engines reach preset angles, and action control over the humanoid robot is completed.

title: Balance control method and device for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a balance control method and device for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps: solving different decomposition task models through employing the related actual states of the robot, obtained through the feedback in a corresponding control period, and a planned corresponding expected state, obtaining a task equation of each decomposition task in a corresponding control period; based on the task equations, optimally solving the multi-task error optimization function, wherein the multi-task error optimization function is constructed based on all the decomposition task models and weights and setting constraint conditions needing to be met when the robot executes the decomposition tasks; and if the optimal solution is solved in the corresponding control period, obtaining a joint control instruction of the corresponding control period according to the optimal solution so as to control a corresponding joint to execute a task. According to the technical scheme, the situation that necessary constraints are met is ensured while the robot executes multiple tasks, errors of all the tasks are comprehensively considered to ensure execution of the whole task, and high robustness and the like are achieved.

title: Human walking posture simulated exoskeleton bendable foot structure and exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a human walking posture simulated exoskeleton bendable foot structure which comprises a front sole structure and a rear sole structure which are arranged in a separated mode, a hinge seat is installed on at least one side wall of the front sole structure, and at least one bridging structure is arranged between the front sole structure and the rear sole structure through the hinge seat. The height of the axis of the hinge seat is greater than that of the top of the front sole structure, so that the bending axis of the front sole structure and the bending axis of the rear sole structure are coaxial with the axis of a toe-shaped bending joint of a user, and the user and the exoskeleton bendable foot structure are completely fused into a whole. A user can alternately normally walk at a high speed, a low speed, stairs climbing, climbing and the like according with toe-walking bending, heel landing and whole sole stable landing. The invention further discloses an exoskeleton robot which comprises the exoskeleton bendable foot structure and the thigh and shank structure rotationally connected with the exoskeleton bendable foot structure, so that the legs and the feet of the user are in multi-degree-of-freedom coaxial comfortable movement fit with the robot through the joints of the legs and the feet.

title: Intelligent service type multifunctional foot robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent service type multifunctional foot robot. The intelligent service type multifunctional foot robot comprises a robot body and a heat dissipation assembly, a head, hands and feet are arranged on the surface of the robot body, a mounting cavity is formed in the robot body, an electrical element is arranged in the mounting cavity, and an electric wire and a plug which are electrically connected with the electrical element are arranged on the back face of the robot body; and the heat dissipation assembly is used for conducting heat dissipation work on the interior of the mounting cavity, the heat dissipation assembly comprises a gas collection part and a driving part, the gas collection part is used for absorbing and discharging heat generated when the electrical element works, and the driving part is used for providing driving force for the gas collection part to conduct reciprocating type heat dissipation work. In the working process of the robot, a worker only needs to start the driving part, at the moment, the gas collection part can absorb and discharge heat generated by the electrical element in the working process in a reciprocating mode, the condition that the electrical element is damaged due to the fact that the electrical element is located in a high-temperature environment for a long time is avoided, and the maintenance rate of the robot is reduced.

title: THERAPEUTIC ROBOT FOR FACILITATING TRAINING AND THERAPY FOR THE ELDERLY
abstract: A therapeutic robot (100) for facilitating training and non-pharmacological therapies for elderly is provided. The therapeutic robot (100) provides a personalized training to the user, and provides thematic interactions with the user. The therapeutic robot (100) includes a head section (120), a torso (110), and two or more limb sections. The two or more limb sections are pivotable relative to the torso (110). One or more accelerometers (220) or gyroscopes, a plurality of pressure sensors (210), and a plurality of magnetic field sensors (230) are provided for detecting the interaction of the user with the therapeutic robot (100). A microcontroller unit (310) is configured to provide an instruction to the user, receive signals, and trigger execution of a real-time feedback as a motivation program for facilitating the user to follow the instruction and complete a predefined task in real-time.

title: Mobile humanoid picking robot for mushrooms
abstract: The invention discloses a mobile humanoid picking robot for mushrooms. The mobile humanoid picking robot for mushrooms comprises a mobile chassis, a lifting mechanism and picking double arms. A structural modular design is adopted, adaptability is high, and the mobile chassis can perform real-time path planning and autonomous navigation to realize a flexible operation in a narrow space of a mushroom house; the lifting mechanism can automatically ascend and descend according to a height of a mushroom bed and can meet a mushroom picking requirement in a factory shelf type planting mode; and due to a double-arm structure of the picking double arms, full-plane coverage and traversal of the mushroom bed and autonomous coordination obstacle avoidance can be achieved, and working efficiency, fault tolerance and flexibility are improved. The mobile humanoid picking robot for mushrooms can effectively meet a picking requirement of efficient and lossless picking in a narrow space under the factory mushroom planting background, and solves problems that factory labor cost is high and mushroom commercial value is low.

title: Multi-finger humanoid dexterous hand driven by fluid
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-finger humanoid dexterous hand driven by fluid. The multi-finger humanoid dexterous hand is composed of a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger and a driving control system. Each single finger comprises a proximal knuckle, a middle knuckle and a distal knuckle; a proximal knuckle rotating shaft of each finger is connected with the palm, and the other end of each proximal knuckle is connected with a first knuckle connecting assembly; and the driving control system comprises an output end and a fluid driving module, and the fluid driving module can drive the output end to rotate around rotating shafts to complete movement of all joints of the fingers. The fluid driving module supplies fluid through a pipeline, expands and generates force, and then drives the output end fixed to a shell of the fluid driving module to move, and movement of the joints of the fingers is completed. The dexterous hand can grab an object in a flexible manner. The integration and replaceability are improved through the modular design, all knuckles are independently controlled, and complete movement of a plane can be achieved; and the object can be grabbed more flexibly.

title: Humanoid robot with good climbing and ridge crossing performance

Through the arrangement of the baffle, the electromagnet, the magnetic block, the rotating shaft, the clamping groove, the clamping rod and the connecting rope, when the infrared tracing sensor needs to be used, a user closes the electromagnet through the operation table, then the baffle is rotated upwards, the baffle rotates to drive the magnetic block to rotate, and when the clamping groove in the baffle is aligned with the clamping groove in the robot body, the rotating shaft rotates to drive the rotating shaft to rotate. A user inserts the clamping rod into the clamping groove so that the baffle can be limited and fixed, and the infrared tracing sensor is exposed in the air so that the infrared tracing sensor can be used conveniently.

title: Robot and head structure thereof
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot and a head structure thereof, the head structure comprises a first supporting part, a second supporting part, a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism, the first supporting part and the second supporting part are arranged in a crossed mode, and a body of the first driving mechanism is installed on the first supporting part. The body of the second driving mechanism is mounted at the output end of the first driving mechanism; and the head part is provided with a visual module, and the bottom end of the head part is arranged at the output end of the second driving mechanism. Due to the fact that most of existing humanoid robots are characterized in that heads are directly fixed to robot bodies or only simple actions of left-right swinging are achieved, multi-degree-of-freedom actions cannot be achieved, and meanwhile stability is poor, the robot and the head structure thereof have the advantages of being low in cost and high in stability at the same time.

title: Humanoid robot applied to shoe and clothing display
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot applied to shoe and clothing display, which comprises an AGV (automatic guided vehicle) chassis, an autonomous charging device, a support column, a man-machine interaction acquisition system, a dynamic model and a model control system, the AGV chassis comprises a bottom plate, an outer shell frame arranged above the bottom plate in a covering mode and connected with the bottom plate, a wheel mechanism installed on the bottom plate and exposed out of the lower surface of the bottom plate, and an intelligent movement control assembly arranged in the outer shell frame on the bottom plate. The lower end of the supporting column is connected to the bottom plate, and the upper end of the supporting column is provided with a mounting seat module; the dynamic model is erected on the mounting seat module; the autonomous charging device is used for being connected with the AGV chassis to charge the AGV chassis; the man-machine interaction acquisition system and the model control system are arranged in the mounting seat module and are in circuit connection with the intelligent mobile control assembly; autonomous navigation movement can be achieved when the robot is applied to shoe and clothing display, information can be collected, man-machine interaction is achieved, and dynamic display is achieved.

title: Chimpanzee bionic walking robot
abstract: The invention relates to a chimpanzee bionic walking robot which comprises a main body frame, an action execution module and a control module, the main body frame comprises a box body and discs symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the box body, and the control module is arranged in the box body; the action execution module comprises four foot movement mechanisms, every two foot movement mechanisms are installed on the disc through first sliding rails, and each foot movement mechanism comprises a first stepping motor, a first crank connecting unit, a first sliding block and a foot; the control module, the first stepping motor, the first crank connecting unit and the foot part are sequentially connected, the first sliding block is arranged on the first sliding rail in a sliding mode, and the first crank connecting unit is connected with the first sliding block. Compared with the prior art, the robot has the advantages of flexible movement, various modes and the like, and can be used as a simulation mechanical carrier for tasks such as reconnaissance, survey and rescue in a complex road condition environment.

title: Humanoid robot walking control method for adjusting joint angles of two legs based on neural network
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot walking control method for adjusting the angles of joints of two legs based on a neural network, and the method comprises the steps: firstly a BP neural network to approach a complex nonlinear relation among the walking ZMP error of a humanoid robot, the actual angle of each joint of the two legs and the angle correction value of each joint of the two legs is designed and trained, then, a double-closed-loop control system is adopted in walking of the humanoid robot, an outer closed loop takes the error of expected ZMP and actual ZMP and the actual angle of each joint of the two legs as input, and the BP neural network controller outputs the angle correction value of each joint of the two legs, according to the error of the expected angle, the actual angle and the angle correction value of each joint of the two legs, the joint driving torque is obtained through the PD controller in the inner closed loop, and angle tracking control over each joint is carried out. Simulation results show that the method well corrects the ZMP error, improves the stability margin, and enables the humanoid robot to walk continuously and stably.

title: Hip joint mechanism and foot type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint mechanism and a foot type robot, the hip joint mechanism comprises an angle adjusting mechanism, a left swing driving mechanism, a right swing driving mechanism and two front-back driving mechanisms; the angle adjusting mechanism is used for adjusting the included angle between the left swing driving mechanism and the right swing driving mechanism, and after the angle adjusting mechanism is connected with legs and feet of the foot type robot, the legs and the feet can be driven to move, and the angle between the two feet can be adjusted. The left swing driving mechanism and the right swing driving mechanism are matched to be used for driving the angle adjusting mechanism to bend and swing leftwards and rightwards. The two front-back driving mechanisms are used for driving the left swing driving mechanism, the right swing driving mechanism and the angle adjusting machine to bend and swing forwards or backwards. The angle between the two feet can be adjusted through the angle adjusting mechanism, and the flexibility of foot movement is effectively improved; the lower half body of the foot type robot has nine degrees of freedom, compared with the prior art, seven driving devices can be reduced, the overall weight is effectively reduced, and the driving torque is low.

title: Wearable large robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a large wearable robot which is operated without an external driving force by a wearer entering a space formed inside, comprising: a body which includes a cover having a rear surface cover and a front surface cover rotatably engaged with an upper side of the rear surface cover, and a support frame engaged with the rear surface cover for fixing the upper body of the wearer; arm units detachably engaged with both sides of the body to be placed on both sides of the cover with both arms of the wearer inserted; and leg units placed on a lower side of the body with both legs of the wearer inserted for forming the legs of the large robot. The support frame includes: one or more vertical frames placed in a parallel direction on a front surface of the rear surface cover; one or more horizontal frames horizontally connecting the vertical frames; protruding units respectively engaged with both sides on an upper side of the horizontal frames placed on an upper end by protruding from the rear surface cover toward a front side; arm connectors formed in a rod shape and extended horizontally to be engaged with the ends of the protruding units which protrude toward a front side; and fixing straps engaged with the vertical frames and the horizontal frames to be hung on the shoulders of the wearer. The present invention aims to provide a large wearable robot which is able to allow the wearer to move more freely.

title: Biped robot control method and device, biped robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of biped robots, and provides a biped robot control method and device, a biped robot and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the initial distance between the mass center of a double inverted pendulum model of the biped robot and a supporting point, the initial movement speed of the mass center and the initial displacement of the mass center; according to the initial distance and the initial moving speed, obtaining a measurement value of a stable point of the double inverted pendulum model; acquiring a control output quantity according to the initial moving speed and the measured value of the stable point; according to the initial moving speed, the initial displacement and the control output quantity, obtaining an expected value of the displacement of the mass center of the double inverted pendulum model; and according to the expected value of the displacement, controlling the lateral movement of the biped robot, so the stability and the adaptive capacity of lateral movement can be effectively improved when the biped robot is interfered by the external environment or human factors, stable control over lateral movement of the biped robot is achieved, and the anti-interference capacity of the biped robot is improved.

title: Integrated intelligent foot plantar pressure measuring system capable of adapting to different foot lengths
abstract: The invention provides an integrated intelligent foot plantar pressure measuring system capable of adapting to different foot lengths, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The integrated intelligent foot plantar pressure measuring system aims to solve the problems that an existing product cannot meet the measuring requirement of a human body for highly locomotive actions, sensors are arranged unreasonably, the size cannot be adjusted, and flexibility is poor. The integrated intelligent foot plantar pressure measuring system comprises a foot plantar pressure measuring unit, a foot positioning device, a front sole mounting plate and a rear sole mounting plate. The foot stress conditions of experimental objects with different foot lengths during movement are measured through a transverse telescopic device and a longitudinal telescopic device in the foot positioning device, the stress conditions of the human body in the movement process are analyzed, the sensors are arranged in a main force bearing area of the sole, the number and positions of the sensors are reasonably arranged, and the weight and cost of the pressure measuring device are the lowest while the measuring precision is ensured. Data collected by the sensors are sent to an upper computer through a wireless module. The effectiveness and reliability of the integrated intelligent foot plantar pressure measuring system are verified through experiments.

title: Robot walking control method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot walking control method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. After a current flat ground walking planning track of a biped robot and the target slope angle of a slope where the biped robot is located currently are obtained, a leg swing planning track in the flat ground walking planning track is adaptively adjusted based on the target slope angle, and an expected leg swing track is obtained; parameter compensation is carried out on a mass center position planning track in the flat ground walking planning track based on the target slope angle to obtain an expected mass center position track, and then expected driving parameters matched with the expected leg swing track and the expected mass center position track at the same time are calculated based on a robot inverse kinematics algorithm; and then the expected driving parameters are adopted to control the biped robot to move, so that the biped robot stably walks on a corresponding slope when encountering a slope terrain in the flat ground walking process, and the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.

title: Biped robot control method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot control method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that when the biped robot enters a target scene, an operation instruction for a target object is generated; according to the operation instruction and a first top view image collected by a second shooting device, the biped robot is controlled to execute a search action for the target object; if the target object is searched according to the front image information collected by a first shooting device, the biped robot is controlled move from the current position to a target operation point corresponding to the target object according to a preset approaching gait; and the biped robot is controlled to execute an operation action aiming at the target object according to the target operation point and the associated region of the target position. Through the scheme, the biped robot can quickly, accurately and stably finish the ball kicking action, so that the ability of the biped robot to adapt to complex ball kicking scenes is improved, and the flexibility and controllability of movement of the biped robot are improved.

title: Industrial robot and industrial robot obstacle avoidance system thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of industrial robots, and particularly relates to an industrial robot and an industrial robot obstacle avoidance system thereof. The industrial robot comprises soles, mechanical legs, a machine body, a mechanical arm and a machine head used for circumferential rotation scanning, wherein after the tops of the soles are hinged to the bottoms of the mechanical legs, walking can be realized; and after the tops of the mechanical legs are hinged to the bottom of the robot body, the robot can get up or sit up. According to the invention, the characteristic of radar scanning imaging is fully utilized, and the contour shape of an obstacle in front of the robot is displayed through radar scanning, so that an area outside the contour shape of the obstacle is an obstacle-free walking area of the robot; and radar detection can be carried out on obstacles with entities and uneven ground or potholes, the robot can adapt to cargo carrying actions in different environments, and potential safety hazards caused by manual carrying of inflammable and explosive articles are eliminated.

title: Intelligent propaganda voice robot structure
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent propaganda voice robot structure, which comprises a robot body; the lower end of the robot body is fixedly provided with a chassis module used for moving; the upper end of the robot body is fixedly provided with a human body imitating head assembly; a loudspeaker used for voice propaganda, a sound pickup used for receiving voice signals of a user, a camera used for receiving image signals of the user and a wireless device used for receiving and transmitting wireless signals are installed on the head assembly; and a power source device used for supplying power is installed in the robot body. According to the intelligent propaganda voice robot structure provided by the invention, voice propaganda is carried out through the loudspeaker, the voice propaganda is used for replacing traditional image propaganda to attract attention of other people, the sound pickup and the camera are used for receiving sound and images of the user, voice interaction between a robot and people can be achieved, and the advantages of voice propaganda can be brought into full play.

title: Augmented reality method based on binocular camera and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to an augmented reality method based on a binocular camera and a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps of: (1) obtaining the position and rotation information of a humanoid robot, obtaining the pose information of a binocular camera, and restoring the pose information of a virtual binocular camera; (2) collecting video images in real time, carrying out depth calculation on the video images, and obtaining shot live-action video data and depth information; (3) restoring the acquired video images by using the depth information to obtain a 3D virtual scene structure, and fusing the virtual scene and the live-action video; and (4) transmitting the synthesized binocular video to a client through a network. According to the method, real scene data can be collected in real time, images are processed in combination with related algorithms, analysis and structural reconstruction are carried out on shot scene pictures, and geometric virtual objects are fused, so that accurate virtual-real fusion is achieved, the watching feeling of experiencers is improved, real-time transmission is achieved, and the accuracy, the reality sense, the immersion sense and the interactivity are greatly improved.

title: Secondary-higher vocation and undergraduate through education consultation service robot
abstract: The invention provides a secondary-higher vocation and undergraduate through education consultation service robot. The secondary-higher vocation and undergraduate through education consultation service robot comprises a driving module, a height adjusting module and a robot body, wherein the height adjusting module is fixed on the upper end of the driving module; the robot body comprises a head part, a body part, a tablet computer, a monitoring and identifying assembly, a loudspeaker, a self-cleaning assembly and an arm assembly; the lower end of the body part is connected with the height adjusting module; the head part is arranged at the upper end of the body part; the arm assembly is connected with the body part; the tablet computer is fixed on the body part; the self-cleaning assembly is arranged on the body part; the monitoring and identifying assembly and the loudspeaker are arranged on the head part and are connected with the tablet computer; the monitoring and identifying assembly is connected with the self-cleaning assembly; and related information about secondary-higher vocation and undergraduate through education consultation service is stored in the tablet computer; and the secondary-higher vocation and undergraduate through education consultation service robot can provide consultation of examination time for entering higher schools and transferring to higher grades.

title: Humanoid robot capable of automatically recharging
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot capable of automatically recharging, and relates to the field of robots, the humanoid robot comprises a robot main body and a charging seat, a gravity center sensor is installed in the robot main body, an annular storage frame is fixed in the middle of the outer surface of the robot main body, and an emergency safety air bag is arranged in the annular storage frame. A moving seat is mounted at the bottom of the robot body, and a charging cavity is formed in the middle of the bottom of the moving seat. By arranging the gravity center sensor, the annular storage frame and the emergency safety air bag, when the robot inclines to a certain angle, the gravity center sensor can detect and know that the robot inclines in time, then the emergency safety air bag in the annular storage frame can be rapidly opened, and after the robot falls down, the emergency safety air bag can be rapidly opened. The expanded emergency safety air bag makes contact with the ground before the robot, damping and buffering can be achieved, the shell of the robot can be prevented from being directly collided by the ground, and the situation that the safety of the robot is insufficient is avoided.

title: Walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a walking robot which is driven in a servo hydraulic mode. The walking robot comprises a left foot, a right foot, a left leg and a right leg, wherein the left leg and the right leg are connected with the left foot and the right foot respectively, and the left leg and the right leg are installed on the two sides of the bottom end of an ischium support through a thigh rotating shaft correspondingly. A waist frame is installed on the ischium support, and a control module is arranged on the waist frame and used for controlling a servo driving part. A hydraulic mechanism comprises a hydraulic transmission mechanism and a hydraulic power mechanism, the servo driving part is arranged on the waist frame and used for being connected with the hydraulic power mechanism of the hydraulic mechanism and driving the hydraulic power mechanism of the hydraulic mechanism, and the hydraulic power mechanism is connected with the hydraulic transmission mechanism, drives the hydraulic transmission mechanism and is used for driving the left leg and the right leg to move. According to the walking robot which is characterized in that servo motors are connected with hydraulic transmission and controls the hydraulic transmission, the walking robot is small in appearance size, large in load, simple in structure and high in humanoid freedom degree, walking is closer to the human walking posture, power units of the walking robot are concentrated on the upper body, lower limbs are relatively light in weight, only action output is conducted, and a self-balancing algorithm based on an inverted pendulum principle can be adopted to keep balance more advantageously.

title: Humanoid robot framework
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of intelligent robots. The humanoid machine framework comprises a head structure fixedly installed on the upper portion of the chest, and the head structure comprises a head driving device and a change gear set. A rotating output shaft of the head driving device is provided with spline teeth, the spline teeth are fixedly inserted into one end of a connecting sleeve on the bottom plate and fixedly meshed with inner spline teeth of the connecting sleeve, and the other end of the connecting sleeve is provided with a first input gear. The first input gear is meshed with the second gear of the change gear set, and the third gear of the change gear set is meshed with the fourth gear. The fourth gear is provided with a radial protruding part, and an eye device is fixedly connected to the radial protruding part in a rotating mode. The robot head driving mechanism of the humanoid robot skeleton can drive eyes on the robot head to rotate along with rotation of the robot head while driving the robot head to rotate.

abstract: To enable natural response movement to be executed to a person to be communicated.SOLUTION: A system 10 includes an android robot 12, and the robot determines whether or not a person is in a prescribed range by referring to person data concerning the heads and the hands of one or a plurality of persons obtained based on output of a distance image sensor 18. title: Ankle joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid service robots, and particularly relates to an ankle joint structure and a robot. In the ankle joint structure, the shank part is symmetrically provided with two driving mechanisms, and the two driving mechanisms are respectively connected with the foot part through different transmission mechanisms. The transmission mechanism comprises a swing arm and a connecting rod which are hinged. The driving mechanism can drive the swing arms to swing to drive the connecting rods to move and further drive the joints of the connecting rods and the feet to move. The shank part is hinged to the foot part, and the foot part can be adjusted at three connecting positions by matching with the two groups of driving mechanisms and transmission mechanisms, so that all-direction movement of the ankle joint is realized. When the joints of the two connecting rods and the feet move in the same direction, pitching motion of the ankle joints is achieved. When the joints of the two connecting rods and the feet move upwards and downwards respectively, the ankle joints roll over. The ankle joint structure is high in integration, small in size, light in weight, good in transmission rigidity, capable of achieving a parallel driving mode and capable of reducing the rotational inertia of the shank and improving the control performance of the leg.

title: Biped robot with multiple motion modes
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped robot with multiple motion modes, which belongs to the technical field of robots and is characterized by comprising a four-crank-lever mechanical leg mechanism, a machine body box, a leg box, a coaxial transmission system, a hinge gear transmission system and a power motor. The coaxial transmission system is output by a power motor and decelerated to an inner sleeve shaft and an outer sleeve shaft through a synchronous belt, and two curved bars of the four-curved-bar mechanical leg are respectively connected with the inner sleeve shaft and the outer sleeve shaft in the coaxial transmission system and are fixed on a leg box body; a lower plate of the machine body is connected with a lower plate of the leg box body through a hinge gear transmission system, and output of a power motor at the machine body is reduced to a hinge sleeve at the leg box body through transmission of a pair of gears; the number of the power motors is six. The leg motor is controlled to drive the four-crank-lever mechanical leg mechanism to generate structural deformation, and the motor at the machine body is controlled to realize rotation and swing of the leg box body. By coordinating and controlling the six motors, the biped robot can achieve wheel, foot and claw type movement and conversion and left-right walking movement.

title: Robot arm and robot

title: Biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to uneven road surface
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to an uneven road surface. The biped robot foot structure is composed of a ball spherical hinge body with spatial multi-degree-of-freedom, a sole thin plate, an attitude sensor, a torsional spring assembly, an integrated connecting block and the like. The whole foot structure is designed in a modular decomposition mode, the plantar thin plates are connected through the torsional springs and are integrated through the integrated connecting block, and an airflow channel is led out. When the foot structure encounters an uneven ground, passive self-adaptive adjustment can be achieved through the torsion effect of the torsion spring. When the action effect of the torsional spring is not obvious, the air pressure control module needs to be started, the pressure of compressed air in the air pressure cabin is adjusted, posture control over the plantar thin plate is completed under the action of the rubber air spring, and active self-adaptive adjustment of the robot foot to the ground is achieved. By utilizing the characteristics of the torsional spring and combining with an air pressure control technology, active and passive self-adaption of the foot of the robot to the ground is realized, and the adaptive capacity of the foot of the robot to the environment can be improved.

title: Wheel-foot combined type biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel and foot combined type biped robot. Meanwhile, the wheel type parts are installed on the hinged shafts of the thighs and the shanks, the motor is arranged on the robot body and is driven through the connecting rod system, and the effects of reducing the inertia of the foot ends, improving the movement speed and reducing energy consumption are achieved. When the robot is in a wheel type motion state, the leg structure of the robot is of a right triangle structure; at the moment, the spring damping element composed of the damping spring and the damping rod can achieve the effects of buffering, damping and reducing the impact of the rod direction impact force on the machine body and the motor in the advancing process, and meanwhile energy can be absorbed and stored. Then the energy is released in time in the advancing process, so that the energy utilization rate is increased.

title: Humanoid robot with anti-collision function
abstract: The humanoid robot with the anti-collision function comprises a robot body, an anti-collision device is fixedly connected to the front end of the robot body, protection devices are fixedly connected to the left end and the right end of the robot body, bottom blocks are fixedly connected to the four corners of the lower end of the robot body, and the lower ends of the four bottom blocks are jointly and fixedly connected with a dustbin. An air pump is fixedly installed in the middle of the upper end of the dustbin, a suction pipe is connected to the middle of the lower end of the air pump in a penetrating mode, dust removal devices are fixedly connected to the left portion and the right portion of the lower end of the dustbin, and a dustbin door is movably connected to the lower portion of the front end of the dustbin through hinges. According to the humanoid robot with the anti-collision function, the anti-collision device is arranged, so that the influence of external vibration on the interior can be effectively reduced, meanwhile, a user can be prevented from being hurt when touching the robot, and the safety of the robot is improved.

title: Force applying auxiliary device and control method thereof
abstract: A force applying auxiliary device and a control method thereof are provided. The force applying auxiliary device includes a sensor group, a processor, and a force applying driver. The sensor group includes a first sensor disposed on a first side and a second sensor disposed on a second side. The processor collects motion posture data of a user according to the first sensor and the second sensor, and determines whether a motion of the user is abnormal. When determining that the motion of the user is abnormal, the processor selects at least one preset abnormal pattern as a specific abnormal pattern according to the motion posture data, and controls the force applying driver to provide a force by using the specific abnormal pattern. A force difference between first and second forces applied to first and second side feet is adjusted based on a difference in sampling values between the sensors.

title: Biped robot gait control method and device and computer equipment
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot gait control method, a biped robot gait control device and computer equipment. A control system constructs phase variables of virtual constraints of different stages based on the mass center state (namely the mass center lateral speed and the mass center lateral position) of a biped robot. Then, a calculation formula for representing the motion trails of the swing legs of the biped robot in different stages is constructed through the phase variables, so that the joint angles, corresponding to the motion trails, of the joints of the two feet of the biped robot are obtained in a joint inverse solution mode, and gait control over the robot is achieved. Meanwhile, the phase variable based on the mass center state is used for replacing time to plan the motion trail of the robot, so that the robot does not continue to follow the set motion trail after being disturbed, instead, the gait of the robot is adjusted according to the disturbed, and thereby the stability of the biped robot in the in-situ stepping motion is guaranteed.

title: Biped robot gait control method and control device
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait control method and a control device. The method comprises adoption of two stages of simulation learning and reinforcement learning. The simulation learning comprises the steps of building a biped robot simplified model, repeatedly reading the current state of a complete model from a simulation environment, and according to the current state of the complete model and an action target, solving a trajectory planning problem and task space control for the simplified model to obtain an imitation learning data set, using the data set to supervise and train the first neural network, storing a neural network parameter corresponding to the minimum mean square error in all tracks in the imitation learning process as an optimal parameter. The reinforcement learning comprises the steps of initializing the parameters of the second neural network into the optimal parameters, and training the second neural network, and after reinforcement learning convergence, using the second neural network after reinforcement learning to control the biped robot to walk. According to the method, search is started from the vicinity of a better solution in reinforcement learning at the beginning, and the learning efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Deflection moment compensation method for biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a deflection moment compensation method for a biped robot, and provides a method for realizing deflection moment compensation based on an upper body movement mode of a robot aiming at the problem that deflection moment is generated on a contact surface between free legs of the robot and the ground in acceleration and deceleration processes of the free legs of the robot.According to the whole body structure freedom degree layout of the robot, the motion of the waist joint or the arm joint is designed to generate compensation torque, so that the deflection torque is controlled within the maximum friction torque. The energy consumption function is constructed for the compensation torque, the energy consumption of the motion modes of the waist joint and the arm joint is evaluated, the optimal compensation scheme for the deflection torque of the robot is determined, and the method has important significance for improving the walking stability and prolonging the service life of the robot. According to the method, the energy loss factor is fully considered, effective compensation of the deflection moment in the walking process is achieved based on the upper body movement, the method can be suitable for the movement scene of the biped robot with the full degree of freedom, and the walking capacity of the robot is further improved.

title: Wheel type biped robot attitude control method
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel type biped robot attitude control method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a low-dimensional single wheel-inverted centroid pendulum model, and optimally controlling the relative position of a centroid and a wheel shaft, so as to realize the wheel type stability and moving ability; and establishing a whole-body dynamic model of the biped robot, solving a whole-body dynamic compensation control quantity and a whole-body dynamic compensation adjusting quantity according to the reference pose of the robot, and realizing pose control of the leg type high-dimensional nonlinear system. title: Biped walking robot
abstract: The utility model provides a biped walking robot, belongs to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems that most existing biped walking robots are single in walking mode, poor in stability and incapable of providing a stable platform for scientific research equipment. title: Steadily walking humanoid double-foot leg mechanism

title: Humanoid nursing robot based on spherical motors

title: IDENTIFYING STAIRS FROM FOOTFALLS
abstract: A method of identifying stairs (20) includes receiving a plurality of footfall locations (128) of a robot (100). Each respective footfall location indicates a location where a leg (120) of the robot contacted a support surface (12). The method also includes determining a plurality of candidate footfall location pairs (212) where the candidate footfall location pair includes a first and a second candidate footfall location. The method further includes clustering the first candidate footfall location into a first cluster group (222) based on a height of the first candidate footfall location and clustering the second candidate footfall location into a second cluster group based on a height of the second candidate footfall location. The method additionally includes generating a stair model (202) by representing each of the cluster groups as a corresponding stair and delineating each stair based on a respective midpoint (MP) between each adjacent cluster group.

title: Method and device for planning throwing trajectory of redundant arm of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of throwing trajectory planning, and discloses a method and a device for planning a throwing trajectory of a redundant arm of a humanoid robot and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a preset acceleration change curve; generating an acceleration stage trajectory according to the preset acceleration change curve, the world starting point position, the world target point position and the world ending point position; obtaining a throwing trajectory according to the acceleration stage trajectory; adopting a preset time interval to carry out discrete processing on the throwing trajectory to obtain a plurality of discrete positions; solving the joint angle of each discrete position to obtain a plurality of solving results; and when no solution results exist, adjusting the position of the world ending point position, repeatedly executing the step of obtaining the preset acceleration trajectory curve until each solution result exists, and determining a target joint angle set according to each joint angle corresponding to each solution result. The throwing trajectory planning of the humanoid robot is realized, the trajectory solving precision is improved, and the trajectory solving rate is increased.

title: Gait planning method and device for dynamic obstacle avoidance, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a gait planning method and device for dynamic obstacle avoidance, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. According to the method, obstacle detection is carried out on an advancing path of the robot; if the obstacle is detected, the envelope size of the obstacle is measured through vision; if the envelope size of the obstacle is smaller than a preset size threshold value, gait planning of the robot is carried out according to a preset stepping gait; and if the envelope size of the obstacle is larger than or equal to the size threshold value, gait planning of the robot is carried out according to a preset winding gait. Through the method, the size of the obstacle is detected based on vision, the entering gait algorithm is judged according to the size of the obstacle, the stepping gait and the winding gait are planned, the adaptive capacity of the biped robot to the complex obstacle environment is improved, and meanwhile the movement efficiency of the robot is improved.
