title: Universal joint, leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a universal joint, a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The universal joint comprises a linkage shaft, a rotating piece and an adapter, the rotating piece is connected to the linkage shaft in a sleeving mode and can rotate relative to the linkage shaft, shaft necks are further arranged on the two opposite sides of the rotating piece, the two shaft necks are oppositely arranged, and the central axes of the two shaft necks are perpendicular to the central axis of the linkage shaft; the adapter comprises a connecting part and two adapter parts, the two opposite ends of the connecting part vertically extend to form the two adapter parts, the two adapter parts are connected with the two shaft necks in a sleeving mode respectively, and the adapter and the rotating piece can rotate relative to each other. Compared with the prior art, the universal joint has the advantages that the structure is obviously simplified, the occupied space of the universal joint is small, and the required variable-angle space is small, so that the universal joint can adapt to the narrow design space of the humanoid robot; and even in the narrow design space of the humanoid robot, angle-variable movement and state adjustment can be flexibly achieved between the adapter and the linkage shaft of the universal joint within a large range.

title: Orthogonal joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides an orthogonal joint structure and a humanoid robot. The orthogonal joint structure comprises a cross shaft, a shaft seat and a rotating piece; the cross shaft comprises a first shaft and a second shaft which are orthogonally arranged; the shaft seat comprises a base and two supports fixed onto the base, the two supports are arranged at two opposite ends of the first shaft respectively, and the supports are provided with rotating holes for the end portions of the first shaft to penetrate through; and the rotating piece comprises two rotating feet with which two opposite ends of the second shaft are sleeved respectively, and the rotating piece can rotate around the second shaft. The orthogonal joint structure has two orthogonal rotating degrees of freedom so that the orthogonal joint structure can be adopted for joint parts such as ankle joints of the humanoid robot conveniently, and pitching motion and roll-over motion are flexibly achieved; and the orthogonal joint structure is simple in structure, convenient to machine, high in machining precision and small in assembly part number, so that the transmission precision is improved.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots and provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The leg structure comprises a thigh structural part, a foot plate structural part, two ankle joint drivers, a shank structural part and two linkage assemblies, wherein the two ankle joint drivers are symmetrically fixed on the inner side of the thigh structural member, and each ankle joint driver is provided with an outward output end and an inward tail end; one end of the shank structural part is rotationally connected to tail ends of the two ankle joint drivers, and the other end of the shank structural part is universally and rotationally connected to the foot plate structural part; the two linkage assemblies are movably connected between output ends of the two ankle joint drivers and the foot plate structural part respectively. According to the leg structure, the two ankle joint drivers participating in forming the ankle joint are symmetrically fixed in the thigh structural part close to the knee joint and far away from the ankle side, so the mass center of the leg structure can be effectively improved, the rotational inertia of the leg structure can be effectively reduced, and torque requirements of the drivers of all joint parts of the leg structure can be correspondingly reduced.

title: Biped robot structure topological optimization method based on inertial release method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot structure topological optimization method based on an inertial release method. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a three-dimensional model of a biped robot; importing the model into dynamic analysis software, and establishing a rigid body dynamic model; making modal analysis on the to-be-optimized structure, importing an analysis result into the rigid body dynamic model, and carrying out rigid-flexible coupling dynamic simulation; obtaining a stress nephogram and a load of the to-be-optimized component; performing strength analysis on the to-be-optimized structure by adopting an inertial release method, comparing an obtained stress cloud picture with a result obtained by rigid-flexible coupling dynamics analysis, and verifying the correctness of the inertial release method; and carrying out topological optimization, carrying out improved design on the structure according to an optimization result, and checking the strength of the structure. Calculation precision can be improved on the basis of improving the calculation efficiency, an effective analysis process and method are provided for structural optimization of the biped robot, and the invention can be used for lightweight design of other structures with complex movement conditions and high movement speed.

title: Interaction method, device and equipment of anthropomorphic robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an interaction method, device and equipment of an anthropomorphic robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a target robot firstly actively collects environment information in a surrounding preset range, wherein the environment information comprises at least one of sound information, image information and contact information between the target robot and other people, and then the identity information and the emotional state of a user in the surrounding preset range are recognized by using the environment information; and then, according to the identity information and the emotional state of the user, anthropomorphic interaction information, such as voice information, expression information or action information, which accords with the emotional state of the user are actively fed back to the user. Visibly, the target robot in the application identifies the emotional state of the user such as a surrounding family member by actively collecting the surrounding environment information, and actively feeds back the anthropomorphic interaction information such as voice or action conforming to the emotional state to the user, so that the anthropomorphic degree of the robots is improved, and the use experience of the user is also improved.

title: Bionic biped walking robot with heavy load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions
abstract: The utility model discloses a bionic biped walking robot with heavy-load vibration buffering and stabilizing functions. The bionic biped walking robot is composed of a robot body, a coronal plane swinging mechanism and two mechanical legs. The coronal plane swinging mechanism comprises a motor, a crank and a main shaft; each mechanical leg comprises a hip joint movement mechanism, a knee joint movement mechanism, an ankle joint movement mechanism and a mechanical foot mechanism. The hip joint movement mechanism comprises a leg motor, a crank, a hip connecting rod and a thigh; the knee joint movement mechanism comprises thighs, middle legs and leg connecting rods; the ankle joint movement mechanism comprises a middle leg and a shank; the mechanical foot mechanism comprises two foot motors and two toes, and each toe is composed of a damping spring, an upper foot plate and a foot bottom plate. The movement of the mechanical leg on the sagittal plane and the coronal plane is realized by utilizing the coronal plane swinging mechanism and the hip joint movement mechanism, and the heavy load vibration reduction target of the mechanical leg is realized by utilizing the bearing joint and the toe mechanism.

title: suit type robot structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The present invention provides a suit type lower body robot which comprises a foot link body in contact with a floor surface; an ankle joint part in connection with the foot link body; a knee joint part formed at an upper part of the ankle joint part; a hip joint part formed at an upper part of the knee joint part; a first link body connecting the ankle joint part and the knee joint part; a second link body connecting the knee joint part and the hip joint part; and a coxa degree of freedom compensation device formed between the first link body and the foot link body and compensating the degree of freedom in the coxa by adjusting the entire length between the foot link body and the hip joint in an extended or reduced form.

title: ROBOTIC SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ENDOVASCULAR SURGERY
abstract: FIELD: medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to medicine, namely to methods for carrying out endovascular surgery using robotic means. The method includes the steps at which: place the patient on the operating table; an introducer with a hemostatic valve is injected into the blood vessels; control the position of the introducer using the methods for X-ray contrast study of blood vessels, the position of diagnostic guides, catheters, balloon catheters and stents. At the same time, catheters and guides are also controlled with the help of an anthropomorphic manipulator of an anthropomorphic robot, which is connected via a united network to a remote computer device of the surgeon and which repeats the movements of the surgeon's hands. The anthropomorphic manipulator is controlled by a unit for determining the position of the surgeon's hands in space, connected to the surgeon's remote computer device. The process is monitored through the display, which displays the data of the methods for contrast study of blood vessels. An anthropomorphic manipulator is performed with the possibility of anthropomorphic gripping of the catheter, its longitudinal movement and the possibility of its smooth rotation.EFFECT: possibility of carrying out endovascular surgery using the usual movements of the surgeon's hands.9 cl, 6 dwg

title: Nurse robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of rehabilitation therapy, and particularly relates to a nurse robot. The nurse robot comprises a movable base assembly, a front-back pitching assembly, a left-right swinging assembly, a chest frame and upper limb assemblies, the upper limb assemblies are installed on the left side and the right side of the chest frame, the front-back pitching assembly comprises a pitching driving motor, a pitching driving belt wheel which is connected to an output shaft of the pitching driving motor, a pitching driven belt wheel which is connected with the pitching driving belt wheel through belt transmission, a pitching worm which is coaxially connected with the pitching driven belt wheel, a pitching worm gear which meshes with the pitching worm and a pitching shaft which is fixedly connected to the pitching worm gear, and rotating shafts of the pitching worm gear and a swinging worm gear are perpendicular to each other. According to the nurse robot, the front-back pitching assembly can achieve forward and backward pitching of the nurse robot, the left-right swinging assembly can achieve left-right swinging of the waist of the nurse robot, in addition, the upper limb assemblies can achieve holding, medicine feeding, meal feeding and the like of a patient, general nursing can be completed for the patient, and the state of the patient can be monitored.

title: Robot limb action control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot limb action control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a 3D model of a robot; treating the 3D model, and generating the motion trail of each joint of the robot; according to the motion trails, controlling a mechanical arm of the robot to implement action of the mechanical arm; acquiring a first coordinate of the robot and a second coordinate of a target under a world coordinate system; according to the first coordinate and the second coordinate, calculating the pitch angle and the deflection angle of left-right rotation of the robot needing to rotate up and down; according to the pitch angle, controlling the head of the robot to rotate up and down to implement action of the head; if the deflection angle is within the range of left-right rotation of the head of the robot, controlling the head of the robot to rotate left and right so as to implement action of the head; and if the deflection angle exceeds the range of left-right rotation of the head of the robot, controlling the head of the robot to rotate left and right to the range limit, and then controlling a chassis of the robot to move to complete the angle exceeding the range of left-right rotation of the head so as to implement action of the chassis.

title: Humanoid steering engine robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a humanoid steering engine robot which comprises a trunk, a front cover, a rear cover, a first disc, a second gear, a third gear, a first joint, a right hand, a left hand, a right leg and a left leg. Most of the body of the humanoid robot is of a unique 3D printing structure, and the purpose that the robot is more flexible and stable is achieved under the condition that the strength is guaranteed. And the manufacturing cost is low, and the raw material can be plastic, so that the manufacturing cost is effectively reduced. The self-weight is lighter than that of the existing product; the transportation is convenient. The appearance can be moderately changed and designed according to requirements, the structure is simpler than the market design, good structural performance and replacement capacity can be provided, and richer application scenes can be adapted. According to the utility model, an independently designed four-limb reinforcing structure is adopted, and a sleeve and gear connection structure is adopted for connecting the four limbs with the trunk part, so that the contact area of the connection part is effectively enlarged by multiple times, and the four limbs are not easy to shake after being connected to the trunk part.

title: Bionic finger, bionic mechanical hand and bionic robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robots, in particular to a bionic finger, a bionic mechanical hand and a bionic robot. The bionic finger comprises a fingertip, a base, a rod piece and a finger seat; the base is used for being connected with a palm; one end of the rod piece is in transmission connection with the base through a first rotating shaft, and the other end of the rod piece is in transmission connection with the fingertip through a first connecting piece; one end of the finger seat is in transmission connection with the fingertip through a second connecting piece, and the other end of the finger seat is in transmission connection with the base through a third connecting piece; and the first rotating shaft is driven to rotate, and the rod piece drives the fingertip and the finger seat to synchronously do bending and stretching actions. According to the scheme, synchronous bending of the fingertip and the finger seat can be achieved through cooperation of the above structures, and therefore the production cost is reduced, the overall layout is simplified, and the stability of the mechanical hand is improved.

title: Humanoid robot with high-dynamic four-foot movement mode and double-arm working mode
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot with a high-dynamic four-foot movement mode and a double-arm working mode. The robot comprises a robot body system and a four-limb system. The four-limb system is composed of four limb subsystems with the same composition structure, and each limb subsystem comprises a power hub, a large limb, a small limb, a limb tail end structure and a small limb transmission structure. Each power hub comprises a side-sway driving unit, a large limb driving unit, a small limb driving unit, a shoulder-hip switching driving unit, a basic frame, a side-sway frame, a universal joint, a large bevel gear, a small bevel gear, a large bevel gear connecting structure and a shoulder-hip switching transmission structure, wherein the shoulder-hip switching driving unit drives the basic frame to rotate through the shoulder-hip switching transmission structure. The robot has multiple operation modes such as a high-dynamic double-foot movement mode, a high-dynamic four-foot movement mode and a double-arm working mode, so that the robot has relatively flexible double-arm movement capability and high-performance and high-dynamic four-foot movement capability.

title: Control method based on leg and arm multiplexing hexapod robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a control method based on a leg-arm multiplexing hexapod robot and the robot, and the method comprises the following steps: building a model by taking the trunk mass center of the leg-arm multiplexing hexapod robot as an original point, and obtaining the feedforward force of each supporting leg of the robot by using the position vector of the leg supporting point of the robot relative to the mass center point and the virtual supporting force at the trunk mass center; constructing a whole-body dynamic model of the robot by utilizing the floating degree of freedom of the robot trunk, the motion degree of freedom of the robot joints and the obtained feedforward force of each supporting leg, and obtaining the joint torque of each supporting leg of the robot; acquiring a joint angle and a joint torque in a swing track of a non-supporting leg of the robot by utilizing the change of position coordinates of the robot; and achieving robot control based on the joint torque of each supporting leg and the joint angle and the joint torque of the non-supporting leg. Supporting force can be optimized in real time, the movement track can be adjusted, and robust movement under external force disturbance is achieved; and during arm type operation, a single-arm mode and a double-arm mode are flexibly configured, and various operations such as pushing and the like are realized.

title: Biped robot dance balance control method and device and biped robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a biped robot dance balance control method and device and a biped robot. The method comprises the steps: obtaining the actual joint angle and the actual sole stress fed back by the robot under the condition that the robot is provided with at least one supporting leg, calculating the ZMP deviation through the joint angle and sole stress information fed back in real time, calculating expected momentum by utilizing the ZMP deviation, and finally calculating a joint angle capable of simultaneously meeting dance motion tracking and balance motion by combining a joint angular velocity optimization function taking a difference value between a joint reference angle and the actual joint angle as an optimization variable so as to carry out control. According to the scheme, under the condition that the dance movement track does not need to be strictly designed, the whole robot stability under the dance movement is achieved, and the higher external anti-interference capacity and the fast response capacity are achieved.

title: Three-in-one comprehensive performance testing platform of humanoid robots
abstract: The invention discloses a three-in-one comprehensive performance testing platform of humanoid robots and relates to the technical field of testing of humanoid robots. The three-in-one comprehensive performance testing platform comprises a base, wherein a load mounting plate and a mounting bracket for mounting a joint module are sequentially arranged on the base from left to right; a load end bottom layer moving mechanism for driving the load mounting plate to move in a left-right direction is arranged on the base; a load moving plate and a rear end bearing seat are sequentially arranged on the load mounting plate from left to right; a load end top layer moving mechanism for driving the load moving plate to move in the left-right direction is arranged on the load mounting plate; a rear end load servo motor and a rear end torque rotating speed sensor are sequentially arranged on the load moving plate from left to right; the rear end load servo motor is connected with the rear end torque rotating speed sensor through a coupler; the rear end torque rotating speed sensor is connected with the bearing seat through a coupler; a rear end grating is arranged at the right end of the rear end bearing seat; the rear end bearing seat is connected with the joint module through a coupler; and the joint module can be tested.

title: Robot for training doctor-patient communication ability and working method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of teaching training, and particularly relates to a robot for training doctor-patient communication ability and a working method thereof. The robot for training doctor-patient communication ability comprises a humanoid robot shell and further comprises a central processing module installed in the humanoid robot shell, a sound sensor installed in the humanoid robot shell and electrically connected with the central processing module, a loudspeaker installed in the humanoid robot shell and electrically connected with the central processing module, an emotion display module installed on the humanoid robot shell, electrically connected with the central processing module and used for feeding back the current emotion state of the robot, and a display screen installed on the humanoid robot shell and electrically connected with the central processing module. A medical student can understand words which easily cause ambiguity to people or easily stimulate emotions of other people in usual communication through personality dialogue with the robot, and the most suitable communication method is found through multiple times of repeated exercises.

title: Robot for home-based elderly care
abstract: The invention provides a robot for home-based elderly care, and relates to the field of medical robots. Sensing parts of the robot are arranged in a personification mode, so that the intimacy can be increased, the device becomes vivid, and a voice conversation function can be added, so that the effects of voice control and robot accompanying are achieved; a human skeleton can be modeled through the key core coordinate points of a human body, so that whether the skeleton structure of a home-based elderly care object is normal or not is mastered; and through redrawing the muscle; a human body posture model is obtained , so that the posture of the home-based elderly care object is judged, such as whether humpback occurs or not and whether the muscle is over-nervous or not; corresponding sound is synthesized by collecting the acoustic characteristics of family members of the home-based elderly care object during sound synthesis,and a dialogue can be conducted on the home-based elderly care object through the sound of the family members during dialogue, so that the feeling of loneliness when the home-based elderly care object is alone can be effectively relieved, and the accompanying effect is achieved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel anthropomorphic wrist device
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel anthropomorphic wrist device. The device comprises a rotating module and a parallel module, wherein the rotating module is of a series structure and can achieve rotating motion of a wrist. The parallel module is of a left-right symmetrical structure and can achieve flexion, extension and deflection movement of the wrist. The wrist device is high in rigidity, high in bearing capacity and simple and compact in structure and has certain self-locking capacity; and three groups of rotary encoders can be mounted, so that the control precision is high. The wrist device can realize motions in three directions of flexion and extension, deflection and rotation, three groups of motion rotating shafts are mutually orthogonal and easy to control, and the wrist device has a motion range and anthropomorphic motion characteristics similar to the human wrist, is particularly suitable for being applied to an artificial hand, and also can be used as a wrist of a humanoid robot.

title: Accompanying robot fixing frame

title: Humanoid manipulator device for object hardness identification and self-adaptive grabbing
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid manipulator device for object hardness identification and self-adaptive grabbing. The device comprises a support, a humanoid manipulator, a sensing module, an STM32 control panel, an upper computer and a driving module. The humanoid manipulator is fixed to the support, the sensing module is arranged on fingers of the humanoid manipulator, the driving module is arranged and connected to the back face of a palm of the humanoid manipulator, the input end of the STM32 control panel is electrically connected with the sensing module, and the output end of the STM32 control panel is electrically connected with the driving module. The humanoid manipulator device is used for identifying the hardness of an object, is used for adaptively and stably grabbing objects with different hardness attributes, is constructed through 3D printing, is provided with various sensing modules, and is expected to become a portable artificial limb or be applied to the field of service robots.

title: Head structure of humanoid expression robot and robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid expression robot's head structure and robot, the head structure includes: facial expression realization mechanism, neck mechanism and base, facial expression realization mechanism is connected with neck mechanism, neck mechanism is connected with base, neck mechanism includes parallelogram-based differential bevel gear structure, and the differential bevel gear structure is connected with the base. The neck mechanism is used for achieving neck rotation, pitching and side-sway movement, the facial expression achieving mechanism comprises a multi-connecting-rod driving structure and external silica gel skin, and the facial expression achieving mechanism is used for achieving facial wrinkles, eyelid opening and closing, eyeball rotation and mouth stretching and opening and closing movement. The humanoid robot is simple and compact in structure, flexible in action and capable of truly simulating head swinging, head shaking and nodding actions of human beings and achieving wrinkling, eyelid opening and closing, eyeball rotating and mouth stretching and opening and closing motions, so that the humanoid robot is more anthropomorphic, and human-computer interaction activities with people are easier.

title: Open-source biped robot capable of moving in diversified mode
abstract: The open-source biped robot capable of moving in the diversified mode comprises a robot body and a motor, a supporting block is arranged below the robot body, the motor is arranged in the supporting block, the motor is electrically connected with the robot body, a driving shaft is arranged in the motor in a driving mode, and the driving shaft is electrically connected with the robot body. The surface of the driving shaft is sleeved with a first ratchet mechanism and a second ratchet mechanism from top to bottom. According to the open-source biped robot capable of moving in a diversified mode, when a motor rotates forwards, a first ratchet mechanism drives a driving cylindrical gear to rotate, so that the driving cylindrical gear drives a reciprocating lead screw to rotate through a driven cylindrical gear, and the reciprocating lead screw drives a first sliding block to slide up and down when rotating; and therefore, the first sliding blocks drive the moving wheels to be stored and put down through the supporting shafts, and it is convenient to make the robot body move in a rolling wheel mode through the moving wheels in the follow-up process.

title: Robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot. title: Biped robot lower limb mechanical structure designed by using single-shaft steering engine
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot lower limb mechanical structure designed by using a single-shaft steering engine. The biped robot lower limb mechanical structure comprises a waist connecting seat; a walking assembly; the walking assembly is arranged at the lower end of the waist connecting seat and comprises a right leg walking assembly and a left leg walking assembly which are the same in structure and are oppositely arranged, each of the right leg walking assembly and the left leg walking assembly comprises a first single-shaft steering engine, a second single-shaft steering engine and a third single-shaft steering engine, and the first single-shaft steering engine is connected with the waist connecting seat through a first U-shaped support; the second single-shaft steering engine is fixedly connected with the first single-shaft steering engine, the third single-shaft steering engine is connected with the second single-shaft steering engine through a second U-shaped support, and the lower portion of the third single-shaft steering engine is connected with a foot connecting base through a third U-shaped support. The mechanical structure is simple in design, the structure is simplified, and the problem that a biped robot designed based on a single-shaft steering engine is unstable in operation can be effectively solved.

title: Elastic adaplive ball and socket joint
abstract: The subject of the invention is an elastic adaptive ball joint intended for use in robot joints, in particular walking robots, exoskeletons, and humanoid robots operating under conditions of high stability in remaining in a specified position and reduction of resistance to motion during displacement. The invention is characterized in that the socket is formed by elastic spherical cups (5) which terminate in flat elastic arms (3) placed opposite each other. The spherical cups (5) have semicircular inner surfaces slidingly adhering to the spherical surfaces (2) of the ball pin (1). The flat elastic arms (3) have bends in their central portion forming elastic flat parts (10) inclined at an angle α. The flat elastic arms (3) on the side opposite the socket converge at their end portion, adhering to each other, and are connected to a pushrod (6), and the flat elastic arms (3) on the socket side are attached to the housing (4) of the pushrod.

title: Ball-and-socket joint
abstract: The invention is a ball joint with a high degree of mobility intended for use in robot joints, in particular walking robots, exoskeletons, and humanoid robots operating under conditions of high stability in remaining in a specified position and reduction of resistance to motion during displacement. The first sliding pair is formed by a ball pin (1) terminating in a spherical head (2), which is mounted in a ball socket (4). The second pair is formed by a ball (23) adjacent to which are a first multi-turn spring (21) and a second multi-turn spring (25). Thanks to the elastic tie rod elements (17), after the load ceases to act, the joint can automatically set itself to the initial position. Thanks to the use of flexible tie rods (17) in the joint structure, it is possible to increase the deflection angle of the entire joint.

title: Adaptive ball-and-socket joint
abstract: The subject of the invention is an adaptive ball joint intended for use in robot joints, in particular in joints of walking robots, exoskeletons, and humanoid robots operating under conditions of high stability in remaining in a specified position and reduction of resistance to motion during displacement. An adaptive ball joint having an upper assembly and a lower assembly. The upper assembly comprises a ball pin (1) terminating in a ball in which an elastic pin (7) terminating in a spherical element (8) is mounted. The lower assembly comprises a stem (4), a cylindrical housing having side holes (10). Sliding rings (13) are slidably mounted in the side holes (10), which rings, via a compression spring (14) and pressure screws (15), are slidingly connected to the ball. In the stem (4) there is a conical hole (12) in which the spherical element (8) of the elastic pin (7) is placed. The joint has the possibility of preliminary adjustment of the change in clearance value and resistance to motion. The design of the joint ensures automatic return of the upper assembly and the lower assembly to the initial position.

title: Rotary and self-aligning joint
abstract: The invention relates to a rotary-oscillating joint intended for use in joints of robots, exoskeletons and humanoid robots operating under conditions of high stability of remaining in a specified position and reducing motion resistance during movement. title: Rope-driven wrist module based on three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a rope-driven wrist module based on a three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel mechanism, the wrist module is composed of a three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel module and a drive control integrated module, the three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel module comprises a spherical pure rolling parallel mechanism and a tension amplification mechanism, the spherical pure rolling parallel mechanism realizes two-degree-of-freedom spherical motion of the wrist, a lower platform of the parallel mechanism is designed to have one rotational degree of freedom, so that a series-parallel mechanism is formed, and the tension amplification mechanism ensures that the mechanism is light in weight and does not lose rigidity at the same time; the driving and control integrated module is used for integrating a motor, a driver and a controller to form an independent electromechanical system; the series-parallel hybrid mechanism is designed by combining the advantages of rope driving and modularization and has the advantages of light weight, reconfigurability, good flexibility and the like, the degree-of-freedom configuration of the series-parallel hybrid mechanism is consistent with that of a real wrist, high-fidelity humanoid wrist movement can be realized, and a new design thought is provided for humanoid service robot wrist design.

title: Biped robot for ice and snow entertainment
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an ice and snow entertainment biped robot which comprises a rotating shaft, fan-shaped teeth, a base body, a motor, a disc, a rocker, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a fourth connecting rod, a tripod and ground feet. The motor comprises two direct-current gear motors, and the two direct-current gear motors are installed on the upper portion and the lower portion of the base body respectively. The disc is connected with an output shaft of a direct-current gear motor installed below the base body. The toothed part of the fan-shaped tooth is meshed with an output shaft gear of the direct-current gear motor mounted above the base body, and the top of the fan-shaped tooth is connected with the rotating shaft; the ice and snow entertainment biped robot is diversified in function, ingenious in structure, easy to control, high in stability and low in cost, can walk on an ice and snow field to complete ice and snow entertainment activities, and adds new power for development of the ice and snow tourism industry.

title: Nylon rivet connection type assembled biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a nylon rivet connection type assembled biped robot. The nylon rivet connection type assembled biped robot comprises an upper plate, a Raspberry Pi is installed at the top of the upper plate, a Root-Hat PCB is installed at the top of the Raspberry Pi, a lower plate is installed at the bottom of the upper plate, steering engines are installed on the two sides of the bottom of the lower plate, U-shaped pieces are installed on the steering engines through M1.5 X4 self-tapping screws, and big feet are installed at the bottoms of the U-shaped pieces. title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a machine body and a machine base which are spliced through metal, a rotatable holder is installed at the joint of the machine base and the machine body, triangular crawler wheels are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the machine base, mechanical arms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the machine body, and a plurality of detection simulation eyes are embedded in one side of the machine body. A sliding protective cover is installed on the side, close to the detection simulation eye, of the machine body. The machine body is formed by splicing metal structures and is more stable, the two sides of the machine base are each of a triangular crawler belt structure, the machine body is of a humanoid structure and can simulate some actions of a person, the joint of the machine body and the machine base is provided with the rotatable holder, the upper half body can rotate within 180 degrees, and the machine body can rotate within 180 degrees. The robot can be manually assembled by students, the operational ability is greatly improved, the traveling is more stable through triangular crawler wheels, the cross-country ability is also improved, the upper body is of a humanoid structure, and the students can conduct programming.

title: Medical care robot
abstract: A medical care robot aims at patients lying in bed for a long time and patients who need to lie in bed after an operation and are inconvenient to move after the operation. The medical care robot has the main functions that the medical care robot can help the patients to sit, stand, convert space and other daily life application requirements in a self-service manner. According to the medical care robot, a power device in a robot body is adopted, an intelligent control mode of system integration software and hardware is adopted, human skeleton structure simulation design is adopted, and a skeleton is wrapped with medical sponge to enhance the comfort of contacting a human body; and the robot has the main purposes that manual nursing is replaced, the bedridden patients and the patients who are inconvenient to move after operation are held up from a bed to sit on the bedside, the patients can be held up to stand on the ground, and the accurate positions of the patients standing on the ground can be accurately controlled by utilizing the characteristics that the lower limbs of the robot can bend, stretch and stoop.

title: Robot expression driving method and device
abstract: The invention provides a simulation robot expression driving method and device, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a robot face static expression model, and obtaining the information of a robot face mark point; binding a plurality of facial expressions of the first real person on the robot face static expression model to obtain a virtual human model based on the robot face static expression model; obtaining the expression of a second real person, driving the virtual human model by the current expression of the second real person, and extracting the position information and the number of the mark point of the virtual human model under the current expression; inputting the extracted position information and serial numbers of the mark points of the virtual human model under the current expression into a trained network model, and driving the robot to make the same facial expression as the second real person based on the output motor parameters. A real person drives a virtual person to make high-precision expressions, and then the robot is driven to make corresponding expression actions through facial high-precision data. The vivid and perfect expression presentation effect of the robot is achieved.

title: Robot humanoid operation action knowledge base construction method and system
abstract: The invention provides a robot humanoid operation action knowledge base construction method and system, and relates to the technical field of epidemic prevention robots. The method comprises the steps: S1, carrying out the universal solving of an inverse planning problem of a robot through employing an inverse RRT algorithm; S2, decomposing tasks of the robot, establishing a task instruction set, extracting key task feature knowledge in the task instruction set, and listing feature knowledge required by each task; S3, according to the feature knowledge, performing modeling on multi-task planning of the robot by using a tabu search algorithm so as to perform multi-task corresponding planning on the heterogeneous robot; and S4, through multi-task corresponding planning, constructing a sub-task offline knowledge base based on manual and priori knowledge. The problem that the inverse kinematics problem of a traditional humanoid epidemic prevention robot is difficult to directly solve can be solved, and the rapid collaborative operation capability of multiple robots in a complex environment is improved.

title: Dynamic step climbing control method for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic step climbing control method for a biped robot. Posture control and height control of the biped robot are achieved based on joint torque control of the supporting legs, the walking stability of the biped robot can be greatly improved through torque control, and the mass center track of the robot does not need to be planned in the step crossing process; and stable maintenance of the height, the attitude angle and the speed of the robot in the step crossing process is realized through the feedback control law of the attitude, the height and the speed of the robot. The speed control part is the key for the robot to stably climb the steps, the expected function relation curve of the displacement and the time of the robot can be obtained by integrating the expected function relation curve of the step climbing speed and the time, and the forward displacement of the robot is controlled by the forward force borne by the mass center of the robot. The complex step of planning the mass center track of the robot in the ZMP algorithm is omitted, and meanwhile the stability of the robot in the step climbing process is improved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic step climbing control method for a biped robot. Posture control and height control of the biped robot are achieved based on joint torque control of the supporting legs, the walking stability of the biped robot can be greatly improved through torque control, and the mass center track of the robot does not need to be planned in the step crossing process; and stable maintenance of the height, the attitude angle and the speed of the robot in the step crossing process is realized through the feedback control law of the attitude, the height and the speed of the robot. The speed control part is the key for the robot to stably climb the steps, the expected function relation curve of the displacement and the time of the robot can be obtained by integrating the expected function relation curve of the step climbing speed and the time, and the forward displacement of the robot is controlled by the forward force borne by the mass center of the robot. The complex step of planning the mass center track of the robot in the ZMP algorithm is omitted, and meanwhile the stability of the robot in the step climbing process is improved.

title: Intelligent nurse robot system capable of being remotely operated
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent nurse robot system capable of being remotely operated, and relates to the technical field of medical treatment. According to the intelligent nurse robot system capable of being remotely operated, remote control over the nurse robot is achieved through the remote control terminal, the vision and laser radar sensing module is used for sensing the position and pose of a person so that the elderly can be supported and embraced on the back with higher accuracy, and the infection probability of medical staff is effectively reduced.

title: High-performance intelligent accompanying robot for medical care based on cloud service
abstract: The invention relates to the field of accompanying robots, and particularly discloses a high-performance intelligent accompanying robot for medical care based on cloud service. According to the high-performance intelligent accompanying robot, after a second camera obtains picture data of relatives and friends, the controller obtains head features of the relatives and friends, and the head features of the relatives and friends are simulated on the shell of the nursing end; and after a second receiver obtains the voice data of the relatives and friends, the controller obtains the language features of the relatives and friends through the AI, the controller controls the first loudspeaker to simulate the language features of the relatives and friends, the head appearance and language which are more easily accepted by an elderly user can be more accurately simulated, and the daily life quality of the elderly user is improved.

title: Control method, device and equipment of humanoid robot joint and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a control method, device and equipment of a humanoid robot joint and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target task of the humanoid robot joint and an expected position corresponding to the target task; according to the expected position, carrying out Jacobian matrix calculation on the target task so as to obtain a first Jacobian matrix; carrying out ill-condition number calculation on the first Jacobian matrix so as to obtain a target ill-condition number; according to the expected position, carrying out Jacobian matrix calculation on each subtask of the target task so as to obtain a second Jacobian matrix; carrying out two-norm calculation on each second Jacobian matrix so as to obtain a target two-norm; and according to the target ill-condition number and each target two-norm, carrying out task reachability evaluation on the target task so as to obtain a task reachability evaluation result for motion control. Comprehensive evaluation of reachability of the task and the subtasks of the layer is achieved, and the accuracy of task reachability evaluation is improved.

title: Synchronized multi-modal robot
abstract: A multi-modal robot that is configured to operate with a bipedal locomotion that may be augmented with aerial locomotion. Many embodiments of a robot may incorporate a robot with a main body portion that houses the various control systems and mechanical controls of the robot. The body of the robot can have a number of different propellers connected to an upper portion of the body and configured to generate lift and/or stability for the body of the robot. Additionally, many embodiments have at least two leg elements connected to a bottom portion of the body by way of a servo mechanism. The legs are configured to provide support for the body of the robot as well as generate a walking locomotion through the movement of the legs.

title: Whole-body control method, device and appliance for force-controlled humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a whole-body control method, device and appliance for a force-controlled humanoid robot and a medium. The method comprises the steps of acquiring multiple to-be-executed tasks, wherein each to-be-executed task carries a priority, and the to-be-executed tasks are tasks synchronously executed by the force-controlled humanoid robot; conducting target generalized joint space joint output calculation on each to-be-executed task based on constrained robot full dynamics, the fact that a task Jacobian matrix of a kth-level priority needs to be in a null space of a task Jacobian matrix of a (k-1)th-level priority and the fact that the task Jacobian matrix of the kth-level priority is a function related to the task Jacobian matrix of the (k-1)th-level priority; and taking each target generalized joint space joint output as a whole body control result. Therefore, all the to-be-executed tasks needing to be executed synchronously are subjected to overall coordination control, the overall coordination of the force-controlled humanoid robot is improved, the conflict among the tasks executed synchronously is reduced, and it is ensured that the tasks with the higher priorities are executed preferentially.

title: Steering engine for foot type robot and foot type robot
abstract: The invention provides a steering engine for a foot type robot and the foot type robot. In the steering engine for the foot type robot, a first output shaft and a second output shaft are both provided with a first end and a second end, the first output shaft and the second output shaft are both rotatably installed in a machine shell, the first output shaft is a hollow shaft, the first end of the first output shaft extends out of the machine shell, the second output shaft is coaxially arranged in the first output shaft, the first end of the second output shaft extends out of the first end of the first output shaft, and the first motor/the second motor is installed in the machine shell and connected with the first output shaft/the second output shaft through the first transmission mechanism/the second transmission mechanism so as to drive the first output shaft/the second output shaft to rotate. The steering engine for the foot type robot has the advantages that the combined control precision of the thighs and the shanks of the foot type robot can be high, the movement consistency and stability of the thighs and the shanks between the leg assemblies are high, the assembly difficulty is low, the size is smaller, and the appearance attractiveness is high.

title: Humanoid image recognition method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid image recognition method and system. Image data of a real scene are classified and put into training, an independent algorithm module is obtained, the accuracy of an algorithm is improved, with the human thinking logic, logic judgment is introduced, logic judgment is added outside the algorithm module, and a proper algorithm model is automatically selected. Therefore, the matching performance of algorithm module is improved, the influence of interference factors such as distance, illumination, angle, shape and the like in a real application scene on image recognition is fundamentally solved, and the problems of false alarm, false alarm, missing alarm and repeated alarm caused by the fact that the algorithm cannot adapt to distance, illumination, angle and shape changes in the real application scene are reduced.

title: Humanoid robot arm
abstract: The humanoid robot arm provided by the utility model has the beneficial effects that the mechanical arm can be detached, and a clamping tool can be simply replaced. The utility model relates to the technical field of robot equipment, in particular to a humanoid robot arm, which comprises a clamping device, a driving device, a rotary fixing device and a moving device, the driving device is connected onto the clamping device, the clamping device is connected onto the rotary fixing device, and the rotary fixing device is connected onto the moving device. title: TRANSFORMABLE ROBOT
abstract: The present invention provides a transformable robot, the transformable robot comprises an arm structure, a leg structure and a head of the robot which are fixed to a ribcage structure. The arm structure comprises a left arm and a right arm, the leg structure comprises a left leg and a right leg; the ribcage structure comprises a first steering gear fixed on an upper part of a second fixing frame, a rotating output shaft of the first steering gear successively passes through a top wall of the second fixing frame and a first backing plate to fixedly connected with a first steering wheel fixed on a first rotating frame; the first steering wheel is provided with an arc-shaped limited opening; a limited column on the first backing plate is movably passed through the limited opening; the rotating output shaft of the first steering gear rotates to drive the first rotating frame to rotate. The transformable robot may realize a transformation from a human form to a car form or from the car form to the human form by controlling the steering gears on each joint of the robot through a controller. In the car form, the transformable robot may realize a movement through the steering gears. In the human form, the robot may realize a biped walking through the steering gears.

title: Split type modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid arm
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of robot research and engineering, in particular to a split type modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid arm. The robot specifically comprises a shoulder module, an elbow module, a wrist module and arm connecting pieces for connecting the modules, the shoulder module and the wrist module are of a three-degree-of-freedom structure, the elbow module is of a single-degree-of-freedom structure, the shoulder module is connected with the elbow module through one arm connecting piece, the elbow module is connected with the wrist module through one arm connecting piece, and the arm connecting pieces are connected with the wrist module through the other arm connecting piece. The arm connecting piece is a key component for connecting all the modules, and quick assembly of an arm interface and a module interface is adopted. The whole humanoid arm rotates with seven degrees of freedom, the shoulder module, the elbow module and the wrist module are connected with driving mechanisms respectively, and the driving mechanisms are in linkage with the kinematic chain sets and drive the shoulder module, the elbow module and the wrist module to move respectively. And the driving mechanism is arranged independently from each module, and is connected with each module through Bowden wire pipes for driving, so that the overall weight of the module is reduced.

title: Mechanical arm track correction method based on position feedback information and control terminal
abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical arm track correction method based on position feedback information, a control terminal and intelligent human body meridian conditioning equipment. According to the method, human body surface point cloud data is acquired, and a walking track is established according to the human body surface point cloud data; real-time displacement data of the tail end of a mechanical arm in all directions are obtained, correction feedback is conducted on the walking track according to the real-time displacement data, and a real-time correction feedback result is obtained; and a motion instruction is executed according to the real-time correction feedback result. The technical effect that real-time correction feedback adjustment is conducted on the walking track of the mechanical arm is achieved, the walking track of the tail end of the mechanical arm is accurately corrected, the tail end of the mechanical arm can apply force to walk according to the body surface characteristics of the human body, and therefore potential safety hazards caused by the mechanical arm to the human body are avoided.

title: Humanoid robot hand structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot hand structure which comprises a support and five fingers of a thumb mechanism, an index finger mechanism, a middle finger mechanism, a ring finger mechanism and a little finger mechanism which are arranged on the support. Wherein the thumb mechanism is provided with three frame type knuckles, the other four fingers are respectively provided with four frame type knuckles, and a joint device is arranged between every two adjacent knuckles in the five fingers and used for controlling the fingers to bend or unbend; the thumb mechanism, the index finger mechanism, the ring finger mechanism and the little finger mechanism are respectively provided with a swinging device for controlling the fingers to diverge or fold; the joint device and the swing device are adopted to control bending and forking actions of the fingers respectively, the rotating device is arranged to control rotation of the thumb, and therefore the defects that in the prior art, a robot hand is poor in flexibility and small in freedom degree are overcome, various complex work tasks can be completed, and the grabbing force of the fingers can be greatly improved through pull wire driving. The device is widely suitable for being matched with intelligent robots.

abstract: An embodiment of the present invention provides a hip joint link apparatus including: an upper body link fixed to an upper body of a wearable robot, and a hip joint jointer linking a thigh link linked to a thigh of the wearable robot, wherein the hip joint jointer has a four-revolute joint structure including a plurality of revolute joints and a plurality of links; an arbitrary input moment to the hip joint jointer is changed to an output moment in a predetermined direction based on a state of being transmitted to the plurality of links through the plurality of revolute joints; and the hip joint jointer assists a flexion moment, an extension moment, an abduction moment, and an adduction moment.

title: Modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger capable of being bent in segmented mode and manufacturing method of modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger
abstract: The invention provides a modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger capable of being bent in segmented mode. The modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger comprises a plurality of bionic knuckles which are detachably connected end to end in sequence; each bionic knuckle comprises a soft closed cavity and an air pipe communicating with the inside of the closed cavity; and a strain limiting layer for limiting axial extension and a fiber winding layer for restraining radial expansion are respectively arranged on the opposite side walls of the closed cavity, so that the closed cavity is bent towards one side of the strain limiting layer when being inflated.c The modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger capable of being bent in segmented mode has the beneficial effects that on one hand, the multiple bionic knuckles capable of being bent in a segmented mode are arranged, bending of any bionic knuckles can be independently controlled to simulate human fingers to be bent in a segmented skeleton mode through multiple joints so as to adapt to various complex application scenes, and the modular pneumatic soft humanoid finger can replace a human hand to complete most daily work such as grabbing; and on the other hand, the expandability is improved through the modular design, and mounting and dismounting are convenient.

title: Knee joint elastic driving device and exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides a knee joint elastic driving device and an exoskeleton robot. The knee joint elastic driving device comprises a driving module, a thigh part, a knee joint, a shank part and an elastic rod, wherein the lower end of the thigh part is connected to the shank part through the knee joint, the driving module is installed on the thigh part, one end of the elastic rod is in transmission connection with the driving module, the other end of the elastic rod is in transmission connection with the shank part, and when the driving module drives the shank part to pivot relative to the thigh part through the elastic rod, the elastic rod is deformed. According to the knee joint elastic driving device, the elastic rod is adopted by the knee joint elastic driving device, so that the knee joint can be effectively assisted in the bending and stretching direction as well as the buckling direction, the driving module can be lagged behind the action of a human body, the requirement for a driving motor can be lowered, and meanwhile, a sensor can be integrated on the elastic rod, so that the human body motion intention recognition is more accurate.

title: Service robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, in particular to a service robot which comprises a main body, a head and two upper limbs and further comprises a control module arranged in the main body, a voice recognition module and a plurality of drawer type storage compartments, wherein the voice recognition module is arranged outside the main body, is connected with the control module and is used for collecting first-class voice signals within a current sight range of the service robot; and the plurality of drawer type storage compartments are arranged on the main body and used for storing corresponding tableware, each storage compartment is connected with a first-class driving motor, the plurality of first-class driving motors are connected with the control module, and the control module controls the corresponding storage compartments to pop out according to first-class voice signals collected by the voice recognition module for guests to take out the corresponding tableware from the storage compartments. title: Biped robot stair climbing gait planning method based on cooperative control
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motion rules of humanoid robots, and discloses a biped robot stair climbing gait planning method based on cooperative control. The method comprises the steps of S10, building a kinematics model of a first robot and a second robot for carrying an object according to a preset D-H parameter method; and S20, planning a first preset gait track of the first robot through cubic polynomial interpolation, obtaining an angle of a knee joint of the first robot based on a preset algorithm, and controlling the first robot to complete a first preset gait action. According to the method, the stair climbing gaits of the two robots are planned through cubic polynomial interpolation, the time-related tracks of hip joints and ankle joints of the robots are obtained, the motion law of all the joints in the complete gait period of the robots is obtained, and the two robots cooperate to stably carry the object to complete stair climbing.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of motion rules of humanoid robots, and discloses a biped robot stair climbing gait planning method based on cooperative control. The method comprises the steps of S10, building a kinematics model of a first robot and a second robot for carrying an object according to a preset D-H parameter method; and S20, planning a first preset gait track of the first robot through cubic polynomial interpolation, obtaining an angle of a knee joint of the first robot based on a preset algorithm, and controlling the first robot to complete a first preset gait action. According to the method, the stair climbing gaits of the two robots are planned through cubic polynomial interpolation, the time-related tracks of hip joints and ankle joints of the robots are obtained, the motion law of all the joints in the complete gait period of the robots is obtained, and the two robots cooperate to stably carry the object to complete stair climbing.

title: Human walking simulating mechanical leg
abstract: The invention relates to a human walking simulating mechanical leg which comprises a hip support, a thigh support, a shank support, a foot supporting plate and an ankle joint unit, wherein the ankle joint unit comprises multiple sets of ankle driving mechanisms and an ankle connecting support, each ankle driving mechanism comprises an ankle driving motor, an ankle transmission assembly, an ankle sliding assembly and an ankle connecting rod, an output shaft of the ankle driving motor controls the foot supporting plate to rotate through transmission of other components, the ankle connecting rod is connected with the ankle sliding assembly and the foot supporting plate through spherical hinges, and the shank support is rotationally connected with the foot supporting plate through the ankle connecting support. According to the invention, the multiple ankle telescopic pieces drive the ankle connecting rod, and a driving or transmission mechanism does not need to be mounted near the rotating shaft of the ankle joint, so that the complexity of the mechanism is reduced, the weight of the ankle joint is reduced, the driving force for controlling the ankle joint is reduced, and the sensitivity of the ankle joint is improved; and the ankle telescopic piece is arranged on the thigh support, so that the weight of the shank support can be reduced, and the torque required for driving the hip joint and the knee joint is reduced.

title: Human walking simulating mechanical leg
abstract: The invention relates to a human walking simulating mechanical leg which comprises a hip support, a thigh support, a shank support, a foot supporting plate and a driving unit, wherein the driving unit comprises a hip joint unit for driving the thigh support to rotate relative to the hip support, a knee joint unit for driving the shank support to rotate relative to the thigh support, and an ankle joint unit for driving the foot supporting plate to rotate relative to the shank support, three degrees of freedom of the hip joint unit, one degree of freedom of the knee joint unit and two degrees of freedom of the ankle joint unit can be achieved, and the positions of the driving motor and a telescopic piece are more flexible through different transmission structures. According to the invention, a first hip driving motor and a first hip transmission shaft can be completely arranged in the pelvis, and a third hip driving motor can be placed on the inner side of the thigh, so that the mechanism complexity of a hip joint part is reduced; the knee telescopic piece can be arranged on the inner side of the thigh, and larger and more stable driving force is provided; and a driving or transmission mechanism does not need to be installed near the ankle joint rotating shaft, the mechanism complexity is reduced, the weight is reduced, and the sensitivity is improved.

title: Hemispherical body posture detection round box
abstract: The utility model relates to a hemispherical body posture detection round box, which comprises a hemispherical box body and a top cover, a detection unit is arranged in the box body, the detection unit is provided with a detection window, and the top cover is provided with a cooling fan for cooling the detection unit. The teenager body posture detection device has the advantages that the box body and the top cover are adopted to form the semispherical body posture detection round box, the semispherical body posture detection round box is suitable for forming the humanoid teenager body posture detection device, the vent holes and the cooling fan are arranged on the detection round box, detection components can be fully cooled, and the detection effect is good. The body posture detection device is prevented from being overheated and can stably operate for a long time; the top cover provided with the cooling fan is convenient to mount and dismount, and the interior of the detection round box can be conveniently cleaned and maintained.

title: Control method of bionic biped robot and bionic biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a bionic biped robot and the bionic biped robot. Legs of the bionic biped robot comprise a hip mechanism, a knee mechanism, an ankle mechanism and a toe mechanism which are sequentially connected through connecting rods, each of the hip mechanism, the knee mechanism and the ankle mechanism comprises a plurality of joints, the toe mechanism comprises a toe joint and a sole connected with the toe joint, and the control method comprises: obtaining a moving instruction of the bionic biped robot, determining an initial state and an end point state of a leg of the bionic biped robot; according to the terminal point state of the leg, determining the terminal point pose of the toe joint; according to the initial state of the leg and the end point pose of the toe joint, determining the turning angle of each joint in the hip mechanism, the knee mechanism and the ankle mechanism; according to the rotation angle of each joint and the initial state of the leg, determining the speed, acceleration and force of each joint, and controlling each joint to rotate, so that the bionic biped robot moves according to the movement instruction.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method of a bionic biped robot and the bionic biped robot. title: Biped robot capable of being autonomously spliced, multi-configuration robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot capable of being automatically spliced, a multi-configuration robot and a control method of the multi-configuration robot. The biped robot comprises a trunk, arms, legs, tolerance butt joint sleeves and a trunk butt joint device. Arms are correspondingly arranged on the left and right sides of the trunk, and two legs are arranged on the lower side of the trunk; the tolerance butt joint sleeve is movably arranged on the rear side of the trunk through a base, and the trunk butt joint device is fixed to the front side of the trunk. Biped robot single bodies can form a multi-configuration foot type combination body in a self-organization and reconstruction mode, multi-foot configuration states such as biped, four-foot and six-foot are achieved, the movement stability and the load capacity of the foot type robot are improved in a foot type modular splicing combination mode, and movement and operation such as strong complex terrain movement and cooperative carrying are achieved.

title: Balance control method for dynamic walking of biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a balance control method for dynamic walking of a biped robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly planning an ideal gait, further calculating the landing time according to the current state of the robot, determining a priority plane, calculating the position of a landing point based on the priority plane, and achieving the planning control of the landing point under the condition of external disturbance. The method does not need to measure the size and direction of the disturbance, achieves the balance control of the robot only by observing the state change of the robot after the disturbance is applied, and can be used for the situation that the biped robot is disturbed in all directions in the omni-directional walking process.

title: High-stability double-foot stepping humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-stability double-foot stepping humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The robot comprises a body connecting plate, a robot body arranged on the body connecting plate, a robot head arranged on the robot body, a composite machine leg A and a composite machine leg B, wherein the composite machine leg A and the composite machine leg B are rotationally arranged at the bottom of the body connecting plate; a driving motor, a gear winding wheel A and a gear winding wheel B are further arranged on the body connecting plate; the composite machine leg A and the composite machine leg B are the same in structure and comprise mechanical thighs with the upper ends connected with the lower end of the body connecting plate through mechanical hip joints, mechanical shanks with the upper ends connected with the lower ends of the mechanical thighs through flexible mechanical knee joints and mechanical feet connected with the lower ends of the mechanical shanks through mechanical ankle joints. The mechanical thigh is provided with a rotating shaft sliding groove. The high-stability biped stepping humanoid robot is reasonable in structure, provided with the flexible knee joints and capable of reducing stepping friction force and improving stepping motion stability.

title: Intelligent greeting service robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent greeting service robot. The intelligent greeting service robot is composed of a moving main body and a robot head. A QR code scanning frame is installed in the middle of the lower end of the front side face of the moving main body. Mechanical arms are symmetrically and rotatably mounted on the two sides of the moving main body. The intelligent greeting service robot comprises a sealing frame fixedly connected to the inner side of a display, an ultraviolet disinfection lamp mounted in the moving main body and correspondingly arranged at the right upper end of the sealing frame, an adjusting block arranged in a side sliding groove in a penetrating manner, and a mechanical camera embedded in the middle position of the upper end of the front side of the robot head. According to the intelligent greeting service robot, the novel structural design is adopted, and therefore a mechanical eyeball and the robot head can be controlled by the robot to correspondingly swing according to an eye tracking module; the interactive simulation performance of the robot in use is improved, and disposable protection package services can be provided by the robot in a non-contact mode; and the use functionality of the robot is improved.

title: Falling control method and device of humanoid robot, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a falling control method and device of a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps that according to a falling early warning signal of the humanoid robot, falling protection parameters of the humanoid robot in the falling process are obtained through preset multi-objective functions, wherein the preset multi-objective functions comprise a posture constraint function, a zero moment point constraint function and an angular momentum optimization function of the humanoid robot, and the falling protection parameters comprise the angular velocity and the linear velocity of each connecting rod in the humanoid robot and the position of each connecting rod in a world coordinate system; and according to the falling protection parameters, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute falling protection actions. By applying the method, when it is determined that the humanoid robot tends to fall to the ground according to the falling early warning signal, the humanoid robot can be controlled to execute the falling protection actions in time according to the falling protection parameters, and damage to the humanoid robot can be effectively reduced.

title: Humanoid robot palm structure
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot palm structure which comprises a palm skeleton, a plurality of connecting rod mechanisms which are rotatably mounted on the palm skeleton and are used for simulating fingers and driving motors which are arranged on the palm skeleton and are in driving connection with the corresponding connecting rod mechanisms through ball amplitude connecting rods, wherein one of the five driving motors is arranged on the palm center side, and the four driving motors are arranged on the palm side and are tightly arranged up and down. For the humanoid robot palm structure disclosed by the invention, through reasonable layout of the driving motors of the fingers, a width, a length and the size in a height direction of the palm are reduced, so that the size of the palm better conforms to the size of a palm of a real person; and the driving motors drive the corresponding connecting rod mechanisms to act through the ball amplitude connecting rods, so that motor shafts of the driving motors and rotating shafts of the connecting rod mechanisms are not located on a same plane, the space problem of layout of the driving motors can be solved, and thus the size of the palm is effectively reduced.

title: Raspberry Pi-based humanoid entity robot system
abstract: The invention relates to a Raspberry Pi-based humanoid entity robot system. The system comprises a voice recognition unit which is used for obtaining voice data and carrying out recognition of the obtained voice data to obtain a corresponding voice recognition result, an image recognition unit which is used for acquiring the image data and recognizing the acquired image data to obtain a corresponding image recognition result, a deep learning unit which is used for obtaining a deep learning feedback result according to the voice recognition result and/or the image recognition result, an AI twinning unit which is used for acquiring motion video data of a person and processing the acquired motion video data of the person to obtain a corresponding motion parameter result, and a processing unit which is used for forming a corresponding feedback instruction according to the deep learning feedback result and controlling an entity robot to execute, and is used for forming the corresponding motion instruction according to the motion parameter result and controlling the entity robot to execute. The system makes up the blank of system design in the field of Raspberry Pi humanoid entity robots.

title: Motion track planning method and device for biped robot, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a motion track planning method and device for a biped robot, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps that if it is determined that the biped robot is controlled to move from a current step to a first step, a target motion track of the mass center of the biped robot is obtained, the target motion track of the mass center is obtained by superposing motion tracks of the mass center in at least two directions, and the motion tracks in all the directions are obtained through different track planning algorithms; according to the target movement track of the mass center, the biped robot is controlled to move from the current step to the first step, the movement track of the biped robot for climbing stairs can be decomposed into the movement tracks of the mass center in at least two directions, and track planning is conducted through multiple track planning algorithms; therefore, when the motion of the biped robot is controlled by adopting the target motion track obtained by superposing the motion tracks of the mass center in the at least two directions, the walking stability of the biped robot can be improved.
