title: Humanoid robot with anti-collision function
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot with an anti-collision function, which comprises a robot trunk, a spring clamping seat, a buffer spring cap, a first buffer spring, supporting steel plates, a plastic coating layer, a second buffer spring, a fixed sleeve, a limiting baffle and a supporting rod, the outer surface of the supporting steel plate is coated with a plastic coating layer, buffer spring caps are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the supporting steel plate, spring clamping bases are installed on the right sides of the buffer spring caps, and first buffer springs are installed in the connecting positions of the spring clamping bases and the buffer spring caps. A supporting rod is arranged on the right side of the supporting steel plate, and a fixing sleeve is arranged on the right side of the supporting rod. By means of the design, the problem that an original humanoid robot is prone to being collided and damaged is solved, and the humanoid robot is reasonable in structure, has the anti-collision function and is high in use safety.

title: Biped walking robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped walking robot which comprises a power assembly for providing power, cams are arranged on the left side and the right side of the power assembly respectively, and the cams can rotate in the circumferential direction under driving of the power assembly. The two cams are connected with supporting legs used for walking of the robot respectively, and the cams rotate to drive the supporting legs to move up and down in a reciprocating mode. The lower ends of the supporting legs are provided with bottom rods arranged in the front-back direction, the power assembly is longitudinally arranged between the two supporting legs and located in the middle of the bottom rods, and the rear end of the power assembly is connected with a battery box. The battery box is configured as a balancing weight of the robot; the driving assembly drives the cam to drive the supporting leg to move up and down in a reciprocating mode, walking of the supporting leg is controlled through the cam, the structure is simple and ingenious, and cost is saved; the battery box is used as a balancing weight, so that the whole gravity center is stable, and the battery box is not prone to rollover.

title: HIP MECHANISM
abstract: An embodiment of the present invention provides a hip joint connecting device capable of assisting bending direction moment, extension direction moment, outer direction moment, and inner direction moment changed during a walking cycle by using one driving device per leg when walking a wearing robot. The hip joint connecting device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a hip joint unit which connects an upper body link which is fixed to an upper body of the wearing robot; and a thigh link which is connected to a thigh. The hip joint unit connects a plurality of rotation joints and a plurality of links by a four-segment mechanism; and assists the bending direction moment, the extension direction moment, the outer direction moment, and the inner direction moment necessary for walking the wearing robot by allowing corresponding input moment to be changed to output moment of a corresponding direction depending on a state of allowing the input moment to be transmitted to the plurality of links through a plurality of rotation joints.

title: Head structure of humanoid expression robot and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a head structure of a humanoid expression robot and the robot, wherein the head structure comprises a mouth moving mechanism located on the lower portion and an eye moving mechanism located on the upper portion, the mouth moving mechanism comprises a transversely-arranged top plate, and a double-shaft steering engine and a lower jaw plate are arranged at the bottom of the top plate; the output end of the double-shaft steering engine is installed on the rear portion of the top plate in the width direction of the top plate, the lower jaw plate comprises two jaw supporting plates which are arranged oppositely and installed at the two output ends of the double-shaft steering engine respectively, and the lower ends of the two jaw supporting plates are connected with an arc-shaped jaw body plate; and the front end of the top plate is provided with a nose bridge plate which is vertically arranged, and a mouth connecting rod mechanism which is integrally rhombic is hinged between the lower end of the nose bridge plate and the jaw body plate. The head structure and the robot have the advantages of being ingenious in structural design, high in space utilization rate, beneficial to enhancing expressive force of all organs of a robot head and the like.

title: Lightweight humanoid mechanical arm capable of moving smoothly
abstract: The invention discloses a lightweight humanoid mechanical arm capable of moving smoothly, which comprises a large arm, a small arm and an elbow joint, wherein the elbow joint comprises two hinged supports which are connected in a hinged manner; the two hinged supports are respectively mounted on the large arm and the small arm; each hinged support is provided with two supporting rods parallel to a hinged shaft; the two supporting rods are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the hinged shaft in the width direction of the hinged supports and are close to the large arm or the small arm; each supporting rod is provided with a plurality of rotatable pulleys; the upper end of the large arm is provided with a driving shaft which is rotatably arranged; the driving shaft is parallel to the supporting rods; one end of the driving shaft is connected with a driving motor; a pull rope in a single spiral shape is wound on the driving shaft; the two ends of the pull rope sequentially bypass the pulleys on the two supporting rods on the same side respectively; and the end part of the pull rope is fixed to one supporting rod or one pulley. The lightweight humanoid mechanical arm capable of moving smoothly has the advantages that weight distribution is reasonable, the self weight of the mechanical arm is reduced, the flexibility and operation stability of the mechanical arm are improved, and cost is reduced.

title: Audition and vision collaborative humanoid robot head orientation method
abstract: The invention provides an audition and vision collaborative humanoid robot head orientation method. The method is characterized by mainly comprising the following steps of firstly, acquiring a voice signal through a microphone array and recording time; recognizing by using a human voice recognition method, and counting the number of microphones for collecting human voice; setting a candidate target orientation according to time when the number of the voice microphones is greater than 1; then rotating a camera and acquiring a video; obtaining human face image frames from the video, obtaining a human face recognition result through recognition by means of a human face recognition method, and counting the number of human faces; when the number of the human faces is greater than 1, calculating human face areas and sorting the human face areas; setting candidate target human faces according to the ranking; then, achieving lip movement recognition through a lip movement detection algorithm; setting a target orientation according to the area when the number of the human faces with lip movement is greater than 1; and finally rotating the head of the humanoid robot to realize orientation. According to the method, the humanoid robot can distinguish the human voice from other voices and can accurately interact with the target human voice.

title: Robot facial expression implementation mechanism and control method
abstract: The invention relates to a robot facial expression implementation mechanism and a control method. The robot facial expression implementation mechanism comprises an eyelid control module, an eyeball up-and-down control module, an eyeball left-and-right control module and a mouth opening and closing control module, wherein the eyelid control module, the eyeball up-and-down control module, the eyeball left-and-right control module and the mouth opening and closing control module are mutually independent and are used for implementing various facial expressions. According to the method, an emotion decision making model is adopted, feedback self-adaptive learning is carried out on the basis of environment information collected by a robot and intelligent agent perception, behavior and action information obtained through cognition, the behavior at the current state is obtained, and then the behavior is displayed through the robot facial expression implementation mechanism. Compared with the prior art, the robot facial expression implementation mechanism and the control method have the advantages of being simple in structure, diversified in facial expression and flexible in man-machine interaction.

title: Power assembly of exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power assembly of an exoskeleton robot. The power assembly comprises waist binding modules, power modules and action detection modules, wherein the waist binding module comprises waist adapters and a waist binding band, and a waist threading hole for the waist binding band to penetrate through is formed in each waist adapter; the power module comprises a motor and a harmonic reducer, a motor output shaft of the motor is fixedly connected with a wave generator of the harmonic reducer, and an output shaft of the harmonic reducer is fixedly connected with the waist adapter; the motor is hinged to the hip connecting rod through a quick bolt, and the length direction of the quick bolt is parallel to the axial direction of a rotating shaft of a human hip joint; the action detection module comprises a leg connecting rod and a leg pressure plate, the leg connecting rod is fixedly connected with the hip connecting rod, the leg pressure plate is installed on the leg connecting rod, the leg pressure plate is provided with an inertial measurement unit and a leg threading hole, and the leg threading hole is used for allowing a leg bandage to penetrate through. According to the power assembly, the action output of the exoskeleton robot can be ensured to be coordinated and consistent with a carrying action of a human body.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a planned capture point and a measurement capture point of a robot, and calculating a capture point error of the robot according to the planned capture point and the measurement capture point; integrating the capture point error in a supporting stage of a supporting leg of the robot to obtain an accumulated capture point error of the robot; before a swing leg of the robot starts to swing, adjusting the step length of the robot according to the accumulated capture point error and the capture point error to obtain the adjusted step length; and controlling the swing leg of the robot to move according to the adjusted step length. According to the robot control method and device, the step length is adjusted by comprehensively considering the capture point error and the accumulated capture point error so as to influence the impact force of the outside world, and the stable state of the robot can still be kept without being damaged even if the robot is subjected to large impact force.

title: Damping shank structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a damping shank structure of a humanoid robot. The damping shank structure comprises a shank supporting column, a cross shaft body, a motor, a motor connecting frame, a motor driver, a motor output piece, a connecting rod, a flexible connecting column, a strain sensor and the like. The shank supporting column comprises three supports, the first support and the second support are outer contour supports of the shank, the two supports are each of a structure with the continuous upper section and the bifurcate lower section, and the third support is arranged in the shank and provided with five connecting points. The three supports are integrally formed through a selective laser melting technology, and no mechanical connection joint exists. A flexible connecting column is arranged in the middle of the connecting rod. The problem that connecting threads on the shanks fail when the robot moves is effectively solved, vibration energy borne by the motor when the robot feet impact the ground is reduced, and high-precision movement of the robot is achieved while the service life of the motor and the service life of the vulnerable connecting piece are prolonged.

title: Human waist-simulated rotating mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid waist rotating mechanism, which belongs to the field of robot waist rotating mechanisms, and comprises a stepping motor for providing driving, an upper body connecting part and a lower body connecting part are arranged on one side of the stepping motor facing the output end, one end of the upper body connecting part is connected with the stepping motor, and the other end of the upper body connecting part is connected with the lower body connecting part. The upper body connecting part comprises a waist connecting flange used for being connected with the upper half body of the robot, the output end of the stepping motor penetrates through the top of the waist connecting flange and is fixed to the waist connecting flange, and a steel wheel connecting flange is installed at the bottom of the waist connecting flange. A transmission cavity is formed in the steel wheel connecting flange, a harmonic gear is arranged in the transmission cavity in a matched mode, and the outer wall of the harmonic gear is in flexible transmission connection with the inner wall of the steel wheel connecting flange. Accurate control over the angle needed by the waist turning mechanism is achieved.

title: Foot sole supporting assembly of biped humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a sole supporting assembly of a biped humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. According to the technical key points, a base is included, a through groove is horizontally formed in the base, an adjusting device is additionally arranged and connected with the base, the adjusting device comprises a motor, the motor is connected with the base and located in the through groove, the output end of the motor is connected with a double-thread threaded rod, and the end, away from the motor, of the double-thread threaded rod is rotationally connected with the base; a first sliding block and a second sliding block are additionally arranged, the double-end threaded rod is sleeved with the first sliding block and the second sliding block, the first sliding block and the second sliding block are in threaded connection with the double-end threaded rod, the first sliding block and the second sliding block are attached to the base and are in sliding connection with the base, the end, away from the ground, of the first sliding block is connected with a first clamping rod, and the second sliding block is connected with a second clamping rod. And the second clamping rod and the first clamping rod are arranged on the same side, so that the problems that an existing robot mounting base cannot be adjusted, and only a robot with a fixed size can be placed are solved.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The biped robot comprises a main body, two leg structures and a balance part, the two leg structures are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the main body and can swing relative to the main body, the balance part comprises a flywheel and a first driving piece, the first driving piece is installed on the main body, and the flywheel is connected with the first driving piece. The first driving piece is connected with the flywheel and used for driving the flywheel to rotate, and the extending direction of the rotating axis of the flywheel is perpendicular to the distribution direction of the leg structures on the body. According to the biped robot, the leg structure swings relative to the body, the robot can avoid obstacles in the advancing process, torque generated by rotation of the flywheel can counteract torque applied to the body due to lifting of the leg structure, the robot is kept balanced in the walking process, and the walking quality of the robot is improved. Therefore, the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.

title: Humanoid quadruped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid quadruped robot which comprises legs, mechanical arms, a waist part, a moving platform, a head part and a trunk part, the bottom end of the trunk part is connected with the moving platform through the waist part, the number of the legs is four, the four legs are all connected to the moving platform, and the mechanical arms are connected to the bottom end of the trunk part. Each leg part is movably connected with the moving platform, and the humanoid quadruped robot can move front and back or left and right through the leg parts; the number of the mechanical arms is two, the two sides of the trunk part are movably connected with the two mechanical arms respectively, and the top end of the trunk part is movably connected with the head part; and an environment sensing device is arranged on the humanoid quadruped robot. The humanoid quadruped robot is provided with the laser radar and the depth camera, the SLAM technology and machine vision can be introduced into the humanoid quadruped robot, and autonomous operation of the humanoid quadruped robot in complex working conditions can be achieved.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The leg structure comprises a thigh structural part, a foot plate structural part, two ankle joint drivers, a shank structural part and two linkage assemblies. The two ankle joint drivers are symmetrically fixed on the inner side of the thigh structural member, and each ankle joint driver is provided with an outward output end and an inward tail end; one end of the shank structural part is rotationally connected to the tail ends of the two ankle joint drivers, and the other end of the shank structural part is universally and rotationally connected to the foot plate structural part; the two linkage assemblies are movably connected between the output ends of the two ankle joint drivers and the foot plate structural part respectively. According to the leg structure, the two ankle joint drivers participating in forming the ankle joint are symmetrically fixed in the thigh structural part close to the knee joint and far away from the ankle side, so that the mass center of the leg structure can be effectively improved, the rotational inertia of the leg structure can be effectively reduced, and the torque requirements of the drivers of all joint parts of the leg structure can be correspondingly reduced.

title: Binocular bionic mechanism and humanoid model
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a binocular bionic mechanism and a humanoid model. The mechanism comprises a mounting frame, eyeball universal shaft mechanisms and a manual driving mechanism, wherein the two eyeball universal shaft mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the mounting frame respectively; each eyeball cardan shaft mechanism comprises an eye-wheel-shaped cardan shaft sleeve, a simulation eyeball arranged in the eye-wheel-shaped cardan shaft sleeve and an elastic pressing piece fixed to the side, away from the eye-wheel-shaped cardan shaft sleeve, of the mounting frame; an arc-shaped through groove is formed in the elastic pressing sheet; the manual driving mechanism comprises a linkage cross arm, two swing arm shafts arranged on the sides, away from the eye-wheel-shaped universal shaft sleeves, of the two simulation eyeballs respectively, and a limiting structure arranged between the installation frame and the linkage cross arm. Arc-shaped sliding grooves are formed in the two sides of the linkage cross arm. One end of each swing arm shaft is connected to the arc-shaped sliding groove in a sliding mode. And the limiting structure is configured to limit the linkage cross arm to only rotate up and down along a preset arc-shaped track relative to the mounting frame.

title: Seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The utility model discloses a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm, which comprises a robot body and free arms, the free arms are symmetrically arranged on two sides of the robot body, the free arms are rotatably connected with the robot body, each free arm comprises a shoulder joint, an elbow arm, a wrist arm and a palm, the elbow arm is rotatably arranged on the head of the shoulder joint, and the wrist arm is rotatably arranged on the head of the shoulder joint. The wrist arm is rotationally installed at the tail end of the elbow arm, the palm is rotationally installed at the head of the wrist arm, the overall flexibility, sensitivity and obstacle avoidance of the mechanical arm are improved by increasing joint movement, the humanoid mechanical arm can be conveniently used in many occasions, it is guaranteed that some complex operations can be conducted on human beings in different environments, and the humanoid mechanical arm is suitable for popularization and application. The robot can adapt to changes in real time according to an operation environment, has certain flexibility in a narrow and dangerous working space, and realizes obstacle avoidance response and self-protection through adjustment of all parts.

title: Joint of biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint of a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of biped robots. The joint of the biped robot comprises a reinforcing shell, a reinforcing plate is fixedly arranged in the middle of the reinforcing shell, two mounting cavities are formed between the reinforcing shell and the reinforcing plate, rotating mechanisms are arranged in the middles of the two mounting cavities, and each rotating mechanism comprises two vertical plates; the two vertical plates are fixedly arranged at the tops and the bottoms of the two mounting cavities correspondingly. According to the joint of the biped robot, the rotating mechanism is arranged, the two second supporting plates can rotate along the axis point of the flange plate, then the joint can rotate, the overall design is simple, the structure is compact, use is convenient, meanwhile, the rotating angle of the joint is adjustable, and the stability of the robot during walking or squatting can be effectively guaranteed.

title: DOOR OPENING BEHAVIOR AND ROBOT PRESENTING THE BEHAVIOUR
abstract: Data processing hardware (142) of a robot (100) performs operations to identify a door (20) within an environment (10). A robotic manipulator (126) of the robot grasps a feature (26) of the door on a first side facing the robot. When the door opens in a first direction toward the robot, the robotic manipulator exerts a pull force to swing the door in the first direction, a leg (120) of the robot moves to a position that blocks the door from swinging in a second direction, the robotic manipulator contacts the door on a second side opposite the first side, and the robotic manipulator exerts a door opening force on the second side as the robot traverses the doorway. When the door opens in the second direction away from the robot, the robotic manipulator exerts the door opening force on the first side as the robot traverses the doorway.

title: Humanoid standing anti-disturbance control method for humanoid robot
abstract: According to the humanoid standing anti-disturbance control method for the humanoid robot, a whole-body motion control method based on quadratic programming optimizes joint angles and contact force, does not apply position constraint to a foot pressure center, and effectively cooperates with all joints of the whole body of the humanoid robot to realize humanoid tiptoeing motion when being disturbed; according to the method, a tiptoeing trigger condition and a stepping trigger condition are also designed, and by judging whether the trigger conditions are met or not, the humanoid robot adopts a corresponding humanoid anti-disturbance strategy according to the magnitude of external disturbance; and tiptoeing and stepping are effectively combined, so that the standing anti-interference capability of the robot is improved.

title: Robot frogman, humanoid mechanical arm and driving mechanism for stepless bending and twisting
abstract: The invention relates to a robot frogman, a humanoid mechanical arm and a driving mechanism for stepless bending and twisting, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The driving mechanism for bending and twisting comprises a rigid rod body, a woven alloy net sleeve, a flexible filling sleeve, an outer connecting ring and a flexible wrapping sleeve, the woven alloy net sleeve is of a cylindrical net sleeve structure formed by weaving shape memory alloy wires; the two ends of the woven alloy net sleeve are fixedly connected to the outer connecting ring; on the woven alloy net sleeve, two crossed shape memory alloy wire sections are fixedly connected in an immovable manner through a node connecting piece at the intersection of the two crossed shape memory alloy wire sections; and an arm action driving unit provides a driving voltage with the same potential for a junction point of two crossed shape memory alloy wire sections arranged on the node connecting piece through a wire of which one end is connected to the node connecting piece. According to the driving mechanism for stepless bending and twisting based on the structural improvement, the flexibility of arm operation is effectively improved, the arm twisting action is easy to control, and the driving mechanism can be widely applied to the technical fields of robots, deep sea detection and the like.

title: Intelligent bionic foot type robot

title: Robot stress protection system based on synaptic transistor
abstract: The invention discloses a robot stress protection system based on a synaptic transistor, which comprises a resistive temperature sensor, a Wheatstone bridge, a voltage-to-frequency circuit, a synaptic transistor, a voltage comparison circuit and a robot. The robot mainly comprises a microprocessor and a steering engine set. The resistive temperature sensor and the Wheatstone bridge are used for simulating a receptor of an animal and correspondingly converting the temperature into a voltage signal. The voltage-to-frequency circuit simulates afferent nerves for converting the voltage signal into an electric pulse with a corresponding frequency. The synaptic transistor can generate an excitatory post-synaptic current according to the amplitude, frequency and duration of an input pulse of a side gate, and the post-synaptic current is promoted or suppressed under the control of a main gate. When the post-synaptic current reaches a threshold of a voltage comparator, the stress protection is triggered. By simulating behaviors and mechanisms of organisms, a humanoid robot can obtain higher sensitive perception ability and damage prevention ability. Therefore, the adaptive capacity under severe working conditions can be improved.

title: Clamping device for humanoid robot
abstract: The clamping device for the humanoid robot comprises a robot body, the robot body is arranged on the top of the ground in parallel, a connecting block is rotationally installed at the bottom of the robot body, and a lifting air cylinder is installed at the bottom of the connecting block in an embedded mode. According to the clamping device for the humanoid robot, by arranging an adjusting rod, a user can rotate a driving gear through the adjusting rod at any time, and then a driven gear is driven to rotate, so that the angle formed by a first clamping plate and a second clamping plate is adjusted, and the clamping device can clamp objects in more shapes; by means of an arc-shaped hole, a driving gear cannot affect a connecting shaft when rotating, and by means of an annular plate and a limiting rod, after the angle of a clamping plate is adjusted, an adjusting rod can be firmly fixed; and the situation that when the clamping device clamps the articles, the driving gear suddenly rotates, and consequently the articles fall off is avoided.

abstract: The utility model discloses a steering engine transmission structure and a humanoid robot. title: Variable rigidity and damping transmission device based on magnetorheological fluid
abstract: The utility model provides a variable rigidity and damping transmission device based on magnetorheological fluid. According to the designed transmission device, the variable rigidity and damping of a mechanism are achieved by utilizing the characteristic that a permanent magnet is different in stress on a non-uniform magnetic field and the characteristic that the magnetorheological fluid is different in shear stress in a variable magnetic field. The variable rigidity and damping transmission device based on the magnetorheological fluid is composed of an outer wall, a linear large bearing, an inner wall, an end cover, a first coil, a shaft, the magnetorheological fluid, a first spring, an inner end cover, a permanent magnet PM, a second coil, a second spring, a permanent magnet PM fixing piece, a bottom cover and a linear bearing. The rigidity and the damping can be independently controlled, the mechanism can be applied to many different human-centered occasions such as rehabilitation robots, intelligent prostheses and humanoid robots, the variable damping and variable rigidity functions of human muscles can be simulated, and the mechanism flexibility of the application occasions and the environment self-adaptability are improved.

title: Humanoid robot

title: Robot rack, robot and testing device of robot rack
abstract: The invention relates to a robot rack, a robot and a testing device of the robot rack. In the robot rack, leg structures are arranged on an upper body frame in pairs at intervals. In one leg structure, a first motor and a second motor are arranged on the upper body frame side by side, the first motor can drive a first supporting rod to move, the second motor can drive a second supporting rod to move, so that soles connected with the first supporting rod and the second supporting rod are driven to move. The leg structures can realize the movement of the robot by adopting fewer motors, and the mass of the whole machine is smaller. The rotational inertia of the upper body frame is adjusted through a rotational inertia adjusting mechanism. title: Real-time control method and device for joints of parallel biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time control method and device for joints of a parallel biped robot. According to the method, the solving of a joint angle is conducted through a Newton-Raphson numerical algorithm based on the continuity of gait planning of the biped robot and the real-time performance of closed-loop control of the joints of the biped robot; and in the solving process, the instruction value of parallel joint angle control in the last period during actual control serves as the initial value of joint angle solving, and therefore the iteration range is narrowed, the iteration frequency is reduced, and real-time solving of the parallel joints is achieved under the condition that the frequency needed by the biped robot is kept.

title: Upper body structure of humanoid nursing robot

title: GENETIC ALGORITHM AND CONTROL METHOD FOR LEARNING MOVEMENTS AND POSITION RECOVERY OF A BIPED HUMANOID ROBOT AFTER FALL
abstract: The invention relates to a genetic algorithm and a control module for learning movements and position recovery of a biped humanoid robot after a fall. According to the invention, the control module comprises a microprocessor (1) which sends commands, via a serial communication interface (3), for operating some servomotors M (6...11) positioned at the joints of the humanoid robot's legs, said command representing a string of characters according to the genetic algorithm of the invention, string of characters encoding a PWM signal equivalent to the rotation angle of each servomotor to obtain coordinated movements specific to bipedal movement, the possible movement incident, the fall, and the position of the robot being detected by a 6-axis accelerometer (2), which is controlled by an I2C interface.

title: Power transmission tower humanoid climbing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power transmission tower humanoid climbing robot, which comprises two sets of synchronous belt mechanisms, two sets of telescopic adjusting mechanisms, a rotating mechanism and four paw mechanisms, wherein each synchronous belt mechanism comprises a synchronous belt sliding rail and a synchronous belt sliding block, the synchronous belt sliding block is arranged on the synchronous sliding rail in a sliding mode, the two synchronous belt sliding blocks are connected through the rotating mechanism to achieve the telescopic adjustment of longitudinal climbing movement, the telescopic adjusting mechanisms can drive the paw mechanisms connected with the telescopic adjusting mechanisms to move longitudinally, the paw mechanisms grasp and loosen climbing rods, the paw mechanism is provided with an infrared distance meter, a photoelectric switch and a visual camera, the infrared distance meter is used for precise limiting in the moving process of the climbing robot so as to achieve accurate rod grabbing, and people can observe the overall motion condition of the climbing robot through the visual camera, so that the obstacle detection precision of the robot is improved. title: Integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated ankle-foot system for improving walking stability of a biped robot. The integrated ankle-foot system comprises a robot shank and ankle drive transmission system, a two-degree-of-freedom ankle joint, a bionic design foot and a foot sensing and data processing module, wherein the ankle drive transmission system is integrated in the internal space of a shank, the foot sensing and data processing module is integrated in a foot body, and the whole system is compact in design and high in integration degree. The foot part comprises a half sole passive joint and a heel buffering module, the road surface impact on the foot part can be effectively buffered, human gait-simulated walking is achieved, and the stability and the movement capacity of the robot are improved. A parallel linear driving system is integrated at the shank of the system, so that the ankle drive performance is ensured, and meanwhile, the exposure of parts of a driving transmission system is reduced. Various sensors in the system are used for collecting posture information of the road surface and the ankle-foot system, and adaptive posture adjustment of the ankle-foot system on the uneven road surface is achieved through the data processing module.

title: Humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid manipulator which comprises fingers, an upper half palm and a lower half palm, the upper half palm is arranged at the top of the lower half palm, the top of the right side of the lower half palm is fixedly connected with a first motor through a motor mounting groove, and the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first bevel gear. One side of the first bevel gear is meshed with a second bevel gear, one side of the second bevel gear is provided with a gear meshing transposition device, the bottom of the gear meshing transposition device is meshed with a first spur gear, the top of the left side of the lower half palm is fixedly connected with three second motors, and the number of the second motors is three. A palm connecting shaft base is arranged on the left side of the second motor. According to the humanoid manipulator, through the under-actuated connecting rod structural design, stable and accurate grabbing can be achieved under the condition that the occupied space is reduced as much as possible, and the structural mass is reduced.

title: Orthogonal joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides an orthogonal joint structure and a humanoid robot. The orthogonal joint structure comprises a cross shaft, a shaft seat and a rotating piece. The cross shaft comprises a first shaft and a second shaft which are orthogonally arranged; the shaft seat comprises a base and two supports fixed to the base, the two supports are arranged at the two opposite ends of the first shaft respectively, and the supports are provided with rotating holes for the ends of the first shaft to penetrate through. The rotating piece comprises two rotating feet which are connected to the two opposite ends of the second shaft in a sleeving mode respectively, and the rotating piece can rotate around the second shaft. The orthogonal joint structure has two orthogonal rotational degrees of freedom, so that joint parts such as ankle joints of the humanoid robot can conveniently adopt the orthogonal joint structure, and pitching motion and rolling motion are flexibly realized. The orthogonal joint structure is simple in structure, convenient to machine, high in machining precision and small in number of assembly parts, and therefore the transmission precision is improved.

title: Bionic accompanying robot for old people
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic accompanying robot for old people. The robot comprises a robot body, bionic legs are arranged on the side face of the robot body, first rotating joints are arranged at the joints of the bionic legs and the robot body, second rotating joints are arranged in the middles of the bionic legs, rubber pads are arranged at the bottoms of the bionic legs, a camera module and a fingerprint recognition module are arranged at one end of the robot body, a main board is arranged in the robot body, a Bluetooth module, a processor, a GPS module, a network connection module and an alarm module are installed on the main board, a power source is arranged in the robot body, first motors are arranged at the connection positions of the robot body and the bionic legs, and second motors are arranged on the second rotating joints. title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention particularly relates to a biped robot which comprises a crotch part and two leg parts located on the left side and the right side of the crotch part and further comprises at least one set of knee joint driving module and at least one set of ankle joint driving module which can be self-locked. Each leg part comprises a thigh part, a knee joint, a shank part, an ankle joint and a foot part which are connected in sequence. Hip joints are arranged between the thigh parts and the crotch for connection. Two ends of the knee joint driving module are respectively connected with the thigh part and the shank part and control the thigh part and the shank part to rotate relatively. Two ends of the ankle joint driving module are connected with the shank part and the foot part respectively, and control the shank part and the foot part to rotate relatively. The knee joint driving module and the ankle joint driving module are self-locked and static when the legs of the biped robot are powered off, the original posture of the biped robot is effectively kept, the biped robot is prevented from falling down, and the safety is improved. The problems that in the prior art, when a robot is in the state of insufficient power or sudden power failure, joints of the robot can be immediately parked and fall down or lie down, and the safety implicit problem that people are hit or objects are damaged exists are solved.

title: Upper and lower body action matching method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an upper and lower body action matching method and device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The upper and lower body action matching method and device mainly aim at ensuring that the upper and lower body actions are matched in the process that a role moves to release skills. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring azimuth information corresponding to waist bones in the process that a target role completes skill release through upper body actions, and acquiring a footstep moving direction corresponding to the target role; according to the azimuth information, determining a waist twisting angle of the target role in a skill release process; and according to the waist twisting angle and the footstep moving direction, determining a lower body action matched with the upper body action of the target role, and playing the lower body action. The invention is suitable for matching upper and lower body actions.

title: Structure and control method of bionic robot intelligent power arm with multiple sensors
abstract: The invention discloses a structure and a control method of a bionic robot intelligent power arm with multiple sensors, wherein the structure comprises a plurality of knuckles and a plurality of finger roots, and further comprises a power set and a traction set; the power set comprises a plurality of motors, and the traction set comprises a plurality of flexible ropes; first Hall elements and magnetic sheets are arranged on the knuckles, and the first Hall elements detect the pressure on knuckles through the magnetic sheets; the structure comprises a CPU control circuit board used for eliminating the mutual influence of the first Hall elements when the knuckles are stressed respectively; the output end and the fixed end of the motor are each provided with a magnetic ring; and the structure comprises a plurality of second Hall elements, and the second Hall elements and the magnetic rings are in one-to-one correspondence to form an encoder to control the rotation angle and the dynamic performance of the motor. Through control of the power arm, the bionic palm and the fingers have enough flexibility and grabbing force, the practical performance is improved, all the fingers are flexibly controlled, so that movement is more stable and humanoid, and the robot is specially used for a service type humanoid robot.

title: ELECTRONIC MEDICAL RECORD SYSTEM
abstract: To provide an electronic medical record system that is able to adjust a guidance voice according to the age of a patient, etc.SOLUTION: In an electronic record system 101, an electronic record server 108 reads, with a two-dimensional code reader 103, a medial examination card on which a two-dimensional code in which a patient ID is encoded; and calculates the age of a patient when acquires the patient ID. A humanoid robot 107 incorporating a speaker 109 reads utterance command data transmitted from the electronic medical record server and generates synthetic voice for reading a sentence included in the utterance command data. Then, when if the age of the patient for whom an utterance is to be given is from 9 to 69 years inclusive, the humanoid robot 107 reproduces a guidance voice at a normal utterance speed. If the age of a patient is not older than 9 to 69 inclusive, the guidance voice is reproduced at an utterance speed lower than the normal utterance speed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Outer limb robot with shoulders swinging along with big arms of human body
abstract: The invention discloses an outer limb robot with shoulders swinging along with big arms of a human body. title: Biped robot lower limb structure and movement method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot lower limb structure, which comprises thigh parts, shank parts, foot parts, damping parts, balance parts, knee extension limiting parts, ratchet wheel and pawl parts and crank rocker parts, the bottom ends of the thigh parts are hinged to the top ends of the shank parts, the bottom ends of the shank parts are hinged to the foot parts, and the knee extension limiting parts are installed between the joints of the thigh parts and the shank parts; the ratchet wheel and pawl part is installed in the thigh part and connected with the knee extension limiting part, the crank rocker part is installed between the connecting positions of the shank part and the foot part, and the damping part and the balance part are installed in the foot part. The invention further discloses a movement method of the robot. According to the invention, an arranged humanoid foot part with radian is matched with the damping part and the balance part to play a role in stable walking, buffering and damping, and the crank rocker part drives the foot part to rotate up and down, so that the walking instability caused by an overlarge motion angle of the foot part can be avoided; and the knee extension limiting parts of the knee joints can play a role in limiting the straight state of the shanks.

title: Structural design method, product and application of plane spring
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field related to robot structural design, and discloses a structural design method, a product and application of a plane spring. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a plane coordinate system, and constructing two bilaterally symmetrical splines on an X axis; S2, constructing contour points of the outer contour of the plane spring above the X axis, wherein the contour points below the X axis and the contour points above the X axis are symmetric about the X axis; connecting the contour points on all the outer contours to form the section of the plane spring; and S3, constructing fitness functions of the rigidity model and the stress model of the plane spring, respectively assigning the horizontal and vertical coordinates of the contour point, calculating the fitness functions, and when the horizontal and vertical coordinates of the contour point not only ensure that the plane spring meets the requirements of rigidity and stress, but also the value of the fitness functions is minimum, determining that the contour point is the required contour point. By means of the flexible knee joint, the design of the lightweight and miniaturized flexible knee joint of the biped robot is achieved, and the performance requirements of the robot for walking in various unstructured environments are met.

title: Language and image understanding system based on multiple protocols
abstract: The invention discloses a language and image understanding system based on multiple protocols, which comprises an image collection module, a voice broadcast module and a human body recognition module, and is characterized in that the human body recognition module comprises a limb movement speed analysis unit, a user disability condition analysis unit and an audio and video splitting unit; the limb movement speed analysis unit is used for measuring the limb movement speed of the user during the period when the limb extends to contact with the robot so as to judge the limb flexibility level of the user, and if the limb flexibility level is high, the playing speed of a picture displayed by a robot display screen is high, so that time is saved, and the subsequent waiting time of the deaf-mute is prevented from being too long; the user disability condition analysis unit is used for detecting whether a user has hearing failure or language failure, or both of the hearing failure and the language failure, and the audio and video splitting unit is used for starting a voice function and an image function in different time periods according to a disability analysis report of the user. The invention has the advantages of being high in practicability and capable of automatically recognizing sign languages and solving problems in various response modes.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of meal delivery robots, and discloses a humanoid trackless intelligent meal delivery robot for a restaurant. title: Rigid-flexible mixed finger, finger mold and finger manufacturing method
abstract: The invention provides a rigid-flexible mixed finger, a finger mold and a finger manufacturing method. The rigid-flexible mixed finger comprises an IP interphalangeal joint (1), an MCP metacarpophalangeal joint (2), a DP phalanx (3), an MP phalanx (4), a PP phalanx (5), a bending sensor (6) and a base (7). The IP interphalangeal joint (1) comprise DIP interphalangeal joint (8) and a PIP interphalangeal joint (9); the DP phalanx (3), the DIP interphalangeal joint (8), the MP phalanx (4), the PIP interphalangeal joint (9), the PP phalanx (5), the MCP metacarpophalangeal joint (2) and the base (7) are connected in sequence and wrap a silica gel shell (9), and the bending sensor (6) is wound on the IP interphalangeal joint (1) and the MCP metacarpophalangeal joint (2). A finger air cavity is of an inverted trapezoidal structure in the length direction. The rigid-flexible mixed finger is used for solving the problem that an existing hard robot finger damages a soft object prone to deformation in the grabbing or operation task, and humanoid actions, grabbing and operation can be achieved.

title: Human skin-simulated flexible capacitive sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a human skin-simulated flexible capacitive sensor and a preparation method thereof. The flexible capacitive sensor comprises a substrate layer, an electrode layer, a hydrogel layer and a fixed packaging layer, wherein the substrate layer, the electrode layer and the hydrogel layer are sequentially arranged from bottom to top, and the fixed packaging layer is used for wrapping and packaging the three-layer structure of the substrate layer, the electrode layer and the hydrogel layer; compared with a traditional product, the sensor has higher sensitivity and better ductility and plasticity. The array electrode structure can realize multifunctional sensing of pressure. The hydrogel layer is similar to the human skin in touch, and the ionic liquid is added into the hydrogel, so that the sensing mechanism of the hydrogel layer is similar to the sensing mechanism of the human body. The obtained humanoid multifunctional flexible skin has wide application scenes in the fields of epidermis sensing systems of humanoid robots, sensing of artificial limbs, medical treatment and the like.

abstract: The invention discloses a primate-imitating multi-motion-mode robot with jumping ability. The primate-imitating multi-motion-mode robot comprises a trunk, a left arm, a right arm, a left leg and a right leg, wherein the left arm is arranged on the upper left portion of the trunk, the right arm is arranged on the upper right portion of the trunk, and the left arm and the right arm can both execute arm twisting actions, arm swinging actions and arm bending actions. The left leg is arranged on the left lower portion of the trunk, the right leg is arranged on the right lower portion of the trunk, and the left leg and the right leg can perform leg twisting, leg swinging, leg bending and jumping actions; a head cover is arranged on the top of the trunk. According to the primate-imitating multi-motion-mode robot with the jumping ability, the joint design is simplified, the overall weight of the robot is reduced, the manufacturing cost of the robot is further reduced, and through the jumping ability of the primate-imitating multi-motion-mode robot, the adaptive capacity of the primate-imitating multi-motion-mode robot in a complex environment is further improved. title: Human motion posture migration method and device, control equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a human motion posture migration method and device, control equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: performing three-dimensional human body posture recognition on video content of a target motion video of a target person to obtain three-dimensional human body motion posture information of the target motion video; redirecting the three-dimensional human body motion posture information of the target motion video to the target humanoid robot according to the body joint distribution condition of the target humanoid robot to obtain robot motion posture information matched with the target humanoid robot; and completing the human body motion posture migration operation of the target person. Therefore, the human body motion posture obtaining effect with low cost and small scene limitation is achieved through the content analysis operation of the conventional motion video; the implementation cost of the whole human motion posture migration scheme is effectively reduced, and the application range of the human motion posture migration scheme is expanded.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb oriented to space microgravity environment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb oriented to a space microgravity environment. The humanoid robot lower limb comprises a waist connecting piece, hip joints, thighs, knee joints, shanks, ankle joints and humanoid feet. Wherein one degree of freedom of the hip joint, one degree of freedom of the knee joint and two degrees of freedom of the ankle joint adopt a mode of driving a worm and gear or a screw sleeve by a steering engine, transmission is performed by combining a four-bar mechanism, and each joint can be self-locked. Each joint has angle feedback, and an error feedback amplification mechanism is designed for one degree of freedom of the knee joint and the ankle joint, so that the control is more accurate. The humanoid robot lower limb is light in structural weight, light and simple in design, high in transmission control reliability, high in similarity with a human body and suitable for a space microgravity environment.

abstract: The utility model discloses a joint connecting piece and a humanoid robot. The base shell comprises a packaging bottom plate and a surrounding plate, a frustum-shaped shell with openings in the two ends is defined by the surrounding plate, the openings in the two ends of the frustum-shaped shell are the first opening and the second opening, the area of the first opening is larger than that of the second opening, and the packaging bottom plate blocks the first opening and is provided with a first receding opening for the joint component to pass through; the mounting vertical lug is connected to the end, away from the packaging bottom plate, of the surrounding plate, at least partially surrounds the second opening, and the mounting vertical lug is used for being connected with a joint component. According to the technical scheme, the joint part is contained in the joint connecting piece, so that the joint part is effectively protected, and the operation safety and stability of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Robot motion planning method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot motion planning method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. title: Design method of under-actuated humanoid robot paw and other fingers
abstract: The invention discloses a design method of an under-actuated humanoid robot paw and other fingers, the robot paw designs a thumb side-sway joint for a thumb, a common grabbing function of a human hand is realized with a small number of driving devices, complex grabbing operation can be carried out, and all the driving devices of the paw are self-locked, so that the under-actuated humanoid robot paw is convenient to use. After the gripper grabs an object, the driving device does not need to work continuously, so that the energy consumption of the robot gripper is reduced; a single-degree-of-freedom multi-connecting-rod mechanism is adopted for the finger part, a driving device of the single-degree-of-freedom multi-connecting-rod mechanism is located on the palm part, the under-actuated movement scheme is more reasonable in arrangement, the finger size is smaller, and the sensor arrangement space is larger; the fingertip pressure sensor is arranged in the paw, the pressure is detected through the movable far-section lower shell, and compared with a traditional arrangement scheme that the fingertip pressure sensor is attached to the surface, the detection area is larger, and the reliability is higher.

title: Multi-space fusion man-machine skill migration and parameter compensation method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-space fusion man-machine skill migration and parameter compensation method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-space skill parameter through human demonstration, decomposing a stiffness multi-space matrix into a feature value matrix and a feature vector matrix, converting a Riemannian space matrix into a quaternion, and representing the quaternion in an axial angle form; a multi-space fusion dynamic system, a regular system module and a linear weighted regression updating module are used for achieving skill parameter migration, the skill parameters are migrated to a robot humanoid variable impedance controller, and the robot reproduction effect obtained by comparing the corresponding skill parameters with the effect demonstrated by a demonstrator under the skill parameters. And importing the difference value under multiple demonstrations and the actual operation effect of the robot into a probability model for training, establishing a rule model between the actual value and the difference value, and performing skill parameter compensation according to the difference between predicted values obtained by robot end feedback and rule model regression in an actual scene. According to the invention, multi-space man-machine skill transmission can be realized, and an accurate reproduction effect is ensured.

title: Bionic metatarsophalangeal joint mechanism and device based on tensegrity structure
abstract: The invention relates to a bionic foot metatarsophalangeal joint mechanism and a bionic foot metatarsophalangeal joint device based on a tensegrity structure, the bionic foot metatarsophalangeal joint mechanism comprises a bionic foot half sole, a tensegrity unit, a bionic foot rear sole and a spring suite, and the defects that a traditional bionic foot is large in size, heavy in weight, poor in flexibility, complex in control system and the like are overcome. The metatarsophalangeal joint has flexibility brought by a tensegrity structure and stability brought by spring rigidity matching, is good in flexibility, ensures low manufacturing cost, enables structure building to be simpler and quicker, gives full play to smoothness of the metatarsophalangeal joint in the walking process of the humanoid walking robot, and ensures stable walking of the robot; the mechanism is simple in structure, the movement process of the mechanism simulates cooperative rotation of the first metatarsophalangeal joint, the second metatarsophalangeal joint, the third metatarsophalangeal joint, the fourth metatarsophalangeal joint, the fifth metatarsophalangeal joint, the fifth metatarsophalangeal joint and the fifth metatarsophalangeal joint in the walking process of a human foot, inward flexion and outward extension can be achieved in the coronal plane direction, and the performance optimization and design wide application prospects are realized.

title: Biped robot balance controller based on rapid ankle adjustment
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot balance controller based on rapid ankle adjustment. The biped robot balance controller comprises a mass center controller, a state discriminator, a zero moment point tracker, a temporarily stable state controller and a force/moment tracker. The mass center controller calculates the position of an expected zero moment point according to the position and speed feedback of the mass center of the robot; a state discriminator judges the state of an expected zero moment point: when the position of the expected zero moment point is in a stable domain, a zero moment point tracker calculates the expected contact force/moment of the two feet according to the actual position of the zero moment point and the position of the expected zero moment point, and then the force/moment tracker is used for realizing the tracking of the expected contact force/moment; when the position of the expected zero moment point is in a critical stability domain, the critical stability state controller pulls the expected zero moment point back to the stability domain; and when the expected zero moment point position is in the divergence domain, the foothold control is triggered. According to the invention, the robot can realize rapid balance response and stable movement.

title: Humanoid robot chassis
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot chassis which comprises a chassis body, bottom idler wheels are arranged at the bottom of the chassis body, annular rubber rings are arranged on the chassis body and located on the outer sides of the bottom idler wheels, and a plurality of side face installation pipes are arranged on the side face of the chassis body. The utility model relates to a humanoid robot chassis, which belongs to the field of robots, avoids direct contact collision of a chassis main body, partially buffers the collision, avoids collision damage as much as possible, can move outwards to adjust the distance, is more flexible to use, and has the advantages of simple structure, convenience in use and the like through the structures such as an inner side annular rod and an outer side arc-shaped rubber rod. Part of obstacles can be pushed away to a certain extent through the annular rubber ring, and movement is prevented from being affected.

title: Wearable parallel structure biped robot capable of assisting walking
abstract: The invention discloses a wearable parallel-structure biped robot capable of assisting walking, belongs to the field of foot type robots, and aims to solve the problems that most existing exoskeleton robots are series-connection biped robots and are poor in coordination with wearers, insufficient in rigidity and low in walking speed due to low degree of freedom, and parallel robots are large in size, complex in structure and poor in walking speed although the rigidity is high. The wearable parallel structure biped robot capable of assisting walking is provided by combining the advantages of a parallel robot and improving the parallel structure to be applied to exoskeleton and biped aspects, the core of the parallel structure biped robot is that a Delta configuration parallel robot is adopted, the legs can be flexibly controlled, the bearing capacity is high, and the rigidity is good. The coordination of the whole robot is completed through motion control of the two Delta configuration robots. And during longitudinal movement, high-speed movement is realized by imitating the running action of a leopard. And during transverse movement, the robot can move by imitating the walking action of people.

title: Movable humanoid robot in space station cabin based on 3D printing
abstract: The invention discloses a movable humanoid robot in a space station cabin based on 3D printing. title: Human finger simulating device based on two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid finger device based on two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanisms. The humanoid finger device comprises a first four-bar mechanism, a second four-bar mechanism, a third four-bar mechanism, a coupling rod assembly, the first two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism and the second two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism. The first four-bar mechanism is hinged to the third four-bar mechanism and is in transmission connection with the third four-bar mechanism through a coupling rod assembly; the first two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism is mounted on the first four-connecting-rod mechanism; and the second two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism is mounted on the third four-connecting-rod mechanism. A four-connecting-rod mechanism formed between the finger sections and the finger joints can achieve bending and stretching movement of the simulated human fingers, meanwhile, adaptability of a two-rod tensioning overall structure is utilized, adaptive grabbing of objects in different shapes is formed through the two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism, and when the connecting-rod mechanism provides large grabbing force and reliability, the grabbing efficiency is greatly improved. And objects in different shapes can be grabbed in a self-adaptive mode through the tensioning mechanism, and the manufacturing and maintaining cost is low.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid finger device based on two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanisms. The humanoid finger device comprises a first four-bar mechanism, a second four-bar mechanism, a third four-bar mechanism, a coupling rod assembly, the first two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism and the second two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism. The first four-bar mechanism is hinged to the third four-bar mechanism and is in transmission connection with the third four-bar mechanism through a coupling rod assembly; the first two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism is mounted on the first four-connecting-rod mechanism; and the second two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism is mounted on the third four-connecting-rod mechanism. A four-connecting-rod mechanism formed between the finger sections and the finger joints can achieve bending and stretching movement of the simulated human fingers, meanwhile, adaptability of a two-rod tensioning overall structure is utilized, adaptive grabbing of objects in different shapes is formed through the two-rod tensioning adaptive mechanism, and when the connecting-rod mechanism provides large grabbing force and reliability, the grabbing efficiency is greatly improved. And objects in different shapes can be grabbed in a self-adaptive mode through the tensioning mechanism, and the manufacturing and maintaining cost is low.

title: Robot motion trail processing method and device, controller and medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot motion trail processing method and device, a controller and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. Comprising the following steps: acquiring a motion track between footholds of the biped robot; according to each track point on the motion track, determining an optimal attitude parameter of each track point by adopting a particle vector preferential algorithm; updating the attitude parameter of each track point on the motion track by adopting the optimal attitude parameter of each track point to obtain a target motion track; and controlling the biped robot to walk according to the target motion trail. Determining an optimal attitude parameter of each track point by adopting a particle vector preferential algorithm; updating the attitude parameter of each track point on the motion track based on the determined optimal attitude parameter of each track point to obtain a target motion track; and the biped robot is controlled to move according to the target movement track, and the walking stability of the biped robot can be improved.

title: Waist transmission mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist transmission mechanism and a humanoid robot, the waist transmission mechanism comprises a waist fixing seat, a thoracic cavity connecting seat and two waist connecting rod assemblies, the waist fixing seat and the thoracic cavity connecting seat are in universal connection, and the two waist connecting rod assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the thoracic cavity connecting seat; the waist connecting rod assembly comprises a waist driving part, a first connecting rod driven by the waist driving part to rotate and a second connecting rod movably connected with the first connecting rod. The end, away from the first connecting rod, of the second connecting rod is movably connected to the waist fixing base. According to the waist transmission mechanism and the humanoid robot, pitching and side-sway movement of the waist are achieved at the same time through the two symmetrically-arranged waist connecting rod assemblies, compared with a traditional steering engine series connection scheme, the occupied space is small, the weight of the mechanism is small, when the waist conducts pitching and side-sway movement, other steering engines do not need to be driven to rotate, and the labor intensity of workers is lowered. The moment of inertia is correspondingly reduced, and the torque demand for the waist connecting rod assembly is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot control system based on vision and wireless technology
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot control system based on vision and wireless technologies, which comprises a machine model and a vision module arranged at the top end of the machine model, and is characterized in that the vision module is connected with an acquisition module, and the acquisition module is connected with a graph generation module; the graphic generation module is connected with the central control system, the central control system is connected with the three-dimensional space positioning module and the wireless communication module, the central control system is connected with the remote terminal through the wireless communication module, and the visual module integrates collected data through the acquisition module and transmits the data to the central control system. According to the method and the device, the effects of accurately controlling the machine model and preventing the machine model from being damaged due to collision caused by errors of the moving trajectory of the machine model are achieved.

title: Hip and waist joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a hip and waist joint structure and a humanoid robot. The hip and waist joint structure comprises a waist support, a waist driving assembly arranged in the middle of the waist support and two hip driving assemblies arranged on the two sides of the waist support correspondingly; the hip driving assembly comprises a hip side module, a hip side transmission assembly, a hip rotation module and a hip front module which are fixedly connected to the waist support, the hip side transmission assembly is used for connecting the rotation movement end of the hip side module and the hip rotation module, and the rotation movement end of the hip rotation module is connected with the hip front module. According to the hip and waist joint structure and the humanoid robot, part of modules of the hip driving assembly are located at the waist joint, and the overall mass center of the hip driving assembly is increased. According to the leg structure, the hip side module is located at the transmission front end of the hip joint through the hip side transmission assembly, the hip rotation module only needs to drive the hip front module to rotate, the rotational inertia is small, the hip side module and the hip rotation module can be located at the waist joint, and the overall mass of the leg structure is reduced.

title: Centroid height planning method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a mass center height planning method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that the waist posture of the robot is determined according to a preset linear inverted pendulum model and a preset mass center height fixed value; the step length of the robot is obtained, and the left foot posture and the right foot posture of the robot are determined according to the waist posture and the step length; and according to a preset leg length constraint value, the waist posture, the left foot posture and the right foot posture, the mass center height of the robot is planned. According to the method and the device, the leg length constraint of the robot is fully considered in the planning process, so that the condition of no solution in inverse kinematics can be effectively avoided.

title: Full-automatic biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a full-automatic biped robot, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a trunk support, a control system, a monitoring terminal and a power supply, and a holder module in communication connection with the monitoring terminal is arranged at the top of the trunk support. Hand parts are arranged on the two sides of the trunk support respectively, each hand part comprises a shoulder joint connecting piece, and a universal ball is fixedly arranged on each shoulder joint connecting piece. A waist connecting piece is rotationally arranged at the bottom of the trunk support, and feet are arranged on the two sides of the waist connecting piece respectively. The foot part comprises a knee joint connecting piece, an advancing wheel is rotationally arranged in the middle of the knee joint connecting piece, the hand part and the foot part are in control connection with the control system, and the monitoring terminal is in communication connection with the control system. When the cloud deck module is used for detecting an obstacle with a large gradient, the monitoring terminal controls the robot to be converted from wheel type advancing to double-foot walking and obstacle crossing through the control system, the robot adapts to complex terrains, and reconnaissance efficiency is improved.

title: Single joint continuous action control method and system of humanoid entity robot
abstract: The invention discloses a single-joint continuous action control method and system for a humanoid entity robot, and the method comprises the steps: building a unified reference time axis, coding the actions executed by all actuators according to the time axis, and obtaining an action coding stream of all time points of all actuators; defining a minimum action time interval for executing a single actuator each time; acquiring an action code stream of a single actuator at a sampling time point; calculating coefficients a, b, c and d of a cubic spline function S (t) = a * t3 + b * t2 + c * t + d according to the sampling time point, wherein t represents the time value of the sampling time point; substituting the calculated coefficient into a cubic spline function, and then adding a compensation factor to calculate a cubic spline interpolation result of each sampling time point; and executing each actuator according to the calculation result. According to the method, the unique action control flow of a single actuator is adopted, and the cubic spline interpolation improved algorithm is adopted for control, so that the instability and the inaccuracy of an existing humanoid entity robot algorithm are solved.

title: Humanoid neural network model walking robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid neural network model walking robot which comprises a simulation box body and a body, a fixed box is installed in the center of the bottom of the simulation box body, a pneumatic cylinder is installed in the center of the bottom in the fixed box, a movable block is installed at the output end of the pneumatic cylinder, and first supporting rods are hinged to the two ends of the movable block. According to the walking robot simulation device, the movable block can be driven to move through the pneumatic cylinder, the first supporting rod can be limited and supported through the movable block, the functions of the walking robot simulation device can be increased through the triangular gradient formed by the top of the first supporting rod and the top of the second supporting rod, and the first groove, the first spring and the first clamping block are used in cooperation; a baffle can be fixed to facilitate walking of the body simulating steps and a high platform, through cooperative use of a second groove, a second spring and a second clamping block, the angle of a first supporting rod and the angle of a second supporting rod are conveniently limited, and the walking robot can walk on the baffle to collect various information.

title: Method for giving mission sense to artificial intelligence robot system
abstract: The invention discloses a method for giving a sense of mission to an artificial intelligence robot system. title: INTERACTIVE HUMANOID ROBOT TO FACILITATE TEACHING IN A COLLABORATIVE CLASSROOM LEARNING ENVIRONMENT
abstract: An interactive humanoid robot (200) that assists in teaching in a classroom learning environment is disclosed herewith. The robot (200) receives a signal indicating a question being raised by a student. The robot (200) processes the signal using a processor (210), the processor (210) is configured to provide contextual based interaction in a collaborative classroom environment. The collaborative classroom environment comprises one or more students, one or more teachers and the robot (200). Further, the robot (200) does a speech to text conversion. The robot determines the identity of the student. Further, the robot (200) determines the answer for the question raised by the student and delivers the answer to the question.

title: Road surface self-adaptive posture control method for ankle of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a road surface self-adaptive posture control method for ankles of a biped robot. Firstly, pressure distribution of all areas of a foot is obtained through processing of a force sensor arranged at the sole of the robot; then, according to the pressure distribution of the foot area, road surface unevenness information is obtained; information is collected through a tilt angle sensor arranged on the shank of the robot, and the posture of the shank of the robot is obtained through processing; then foot inclination information is obtained according to the postures of the shanks; then, according to the road surface unevenness and foot inclination information, the motion state required for stabilizing the feet of the robot is obtained; according to the motion state, the motion angle of the ankle joint motor is obtained through calculation; finally, corresponding driving commands are sent to motors of the ankle joints, and self-adaptive control over the road surface by the feet is achieved. By means of the method, the biped robot can be helped to walk stably on various uneven road surfaces with certain unevenness, and road surface self-adaptive posture control based on ankle movement is provided for the biped robot.
