title: Humanoid gait planning method, system and device for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid gait planning method, system and device for a biped robot. The method comprises the steps of control instruction planning, nominal leg trajectory planning and leg shutdown trajectory planning. According to the control instruction planning, a control instruction of the handle is converted into forward and lateral stepping steps of the robot, a steering rotation angle and walking time; the nominal leg track planning is that a periodic motion track of a nominal leg is designed according to the output of the control interface layer; according to the leg joint trajectory planning, the periodic motion trajectory of the nominal leg is calculated into the motion angle of each joint of the robot leg. Compared with a traditional design method of the central pattern generator of the biped robot, the method plans the walking posture of the biped robot in the walking process through the design of the nominal leg, the gait with the humanoid feature can be designed more visually and more efficiently, and therefore the walking flexibility and the environment adaptability of the robot are improved.

title: Steering engine
abstract: The utility model relates to a steering engine which comprises an upper cover (1), a middle cover (2), a lower cover (3), a direct current motor (21) and gear sets meshed with each other, the width of the bottom of the lower cover (3) is smaller than the width of the middle cover (2) and the width of the upper cover (1), when the steering engine is installed on the shoulder of a robot, a gap between the steering engine and a joint U-shaped piece is further reduced, and the steering engine is more suitable for a'thin arm 'type humanoid robot.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot, the leg structure comprises a thigh structural member, a shank structural member rotationally connected with the thigh structural member, a knee lead screw assembly and a knee connecting rod, the knee lead screw assembly is arranged on the thigh structural member, one end of the knee connecting rod is rotationally connected to the linear motion end of the knee lead screw assembly, and the other end of the knee connecting rod is rotationally connected to the linear motion end of the knee lead screw assembly; the other end of the knee connecting rod is rotationally connected to the shank structural part. According to the leg structure and the humanoid robot, the knee lead screw assemblies are arranged on the thigh structural parts, the mass center of the leg structure is increased, and the rotational inertia of the leg structure is reduced. Meanwhile, a lead screw in the knee lead screw assembly has the effect of increasing the force, under the condition that the same knee joint torque is output, the needed torque is smaller, the smaller and lighter knee lead screw assembly can be used, and the weight of the leg structure is reduced. In addition, by arranging the knee connecting rod, the stroke of the lead screw can be reduced, and a large motion angle of the knee joint can be achieved in a limited leg space.

title: Continuous action semantic coding and translating method and system of humanoid entity robot
abstract: The invention discloses a continuous action semantic coding and translating method and system for a humanoid entity robot. The method comprises the steps that a unified reference time axis is established, and a sampling and coding element action data structure and a decoding element action data structure are set; performing data sampling on each actuator according to a sampling and coding element action data structure; the sampling points are coded according to action semantics, and codes are output and stored in an action library after coding is completed; when the robot moves, the action code stream is firstly taken out from the action library, and the action code stream is decoded; after decoding, calculating a continuous action coding stream by adopting an action smoothing algorithm, and filling each action point of the continuous action coding stream according to a decoding element action data structure; and outputting the decoding action coded stream and executing the decoding action coded stream according to the unified time axis. All joints of the humanoid robot can independently move at the same time point, and finally linkage action of the humanoid robot can be achieved on the overall effect.

title: Biped robot external thrust detection device and detection method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot external thrust detection device and a detection method thereof, which can be used for artificially and randomly manufacturing single-point biped robot external thrust instead of sensing the external thrust by a multi-point sensor of a robot. The device combines pose information of the detection device, pose information of the biped robot and model information of the detection device and the biped robot to detect acting force information of the biped robot in a distributed mode, the acting force information is transmitted to the main control system in real time, and a man-machine system of the device displays the external thrust condition in real time in a 3D mode. According to the method, the building cost of a biped robot sensing system is reduced, the verification work of a core control algorithm is started more quickly, and the project convergence period is shortened. The distributed design of the detection method reduces occupation of resources of the main control system and accelerates the control frequency.

title: Robot action adjusting method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot action adjusting method and device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot posture calibration. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a normal action result sequence sent by a first biped robot and identification information of the first biped robot; obtaining a sequence request instruction sent by the second biped robot, wherein the sequence request instruction comprises identification information of the second biped robot; judging whether the identification information of the second biped robot is matched with the identification information of the first biped robot or not; if yes, the action result sequence is sent to the second biped robot, so that the second biped robot conducts action adjustment processing based on the action result sequence. According to the method, the posture of the biped robot entering the abnormal state can be adjusted more accurately and efficiently.

title: Novel parallel leg biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a novel parallel-leg biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. All actions of the legs of the human body can be basically achieved, and the advantages of high bearing capacity, good stability, large working space, high flexibility and the like are achieved. The novel parallel leg biped robot comprises a fixed base assembly and two system branch chains. The lower parts of the two system branch chains are connected with the motion platform; the system branch chain comprises a core branch chain, two main branch chains and two auxiliary branch chains; the core branch chain comprises a connecting platform and a first linear driving device, and the connecting platform is arranged at the fixed end of the first linear driving device; the two ends of the first linear driving device are hinged to the fixed base assembly and the moving platform correspondingly. The two auxiliary branch chains each comprise a second linear driving device with the two ends connected with the fixed base assembly and the connecting platform correspondingly. The two main branch chains each comprise a third linear driving device, and the two ends of each third linear driving device are connected with the fixed base assembly and the moving platform correspondingly. The method is used for improving the performance of the biped robot.

All actions of the legs of the human body can be basically achieved, and the advantages of high bearing capacity, good stability, large working space, high flexibility and the like are achieved. The novel parallel leg biped robot comprises a fixed base assembly and two system branch chains. The lower parts of the two system branch chains are connected with the motion platform; the system branch chain comprises a core branch chain, two main branch chains and two auxiliary branch chains; the core branch chain comprises a connecting platform and a first linear driving device, and the connecting platform is arranged at the fixed end of the first linear driving device; the two ends of the first linear driving device are hinged to the fixed base assembly and the moving platform correspondingly. The two auxiliary branch chains each comprise a second linear driving device with the two ends connected with the fixed base assembly and the connecting platform correspondingly. The two main branch chains each comprise a third linear driving device, and the two ends of each third linear driving device are connected with the fixed base assembly and the moving platform correspondingly. The method is used for improving the performance of the biped robot.

title: Humanoid robot integrated joint three-dimensional adjustable mounting mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses an integrated joint three-dimensional adjustable mounting mechanism for a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of humanoid robot testing and comprises a base provided with a bottom mounting plate and a Y-axis moving mechanism for driving the bottom mounting plate to move along the Y-axis direction. The bottom layer mounting plate is provided with a top layer mounting plate and an X-axis moving mechanism for driving the top layer mounting plate to move in the X-axis direction, the top layer mounting plate is provided with a mounting bracket for mounting an integrated joint and vertical guide mechanisms located at the two ends of the mounting bracket and used for guiding the mounting bracket, and the top layer mounting plate is provided with a lower inclined surface; the lower inclined surface is arranged obliquely upwards along the Y-axis direction, a driving mechanism for driving the lower inclined surface to move along the Y-axis direction is arranged on the top-layer mounting plate, an upper inclined surface is arranged at the lower end of the mounting bracket, and the upper inclined surface is matched with the lower inclined surface, so that after the Z-axis is adjusted in place, the levelness does not need to be adjusted again, and the adjustment is convenient and rapid.
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an integrated joint three-dimensional adjustable mounting mechanism for a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of humanoid robot testing and comprises a base provided with a bottom mounting plate and a Y-axis moving mechanism for driving the bottom mounting plate to move along the Y-axis direction. title: Three-in-one comprehensive performance test board for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a three-in-one comprehensive performance test board for a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of humanoid robot testing and comprises a base, a load mounting plate and a mounting bracket for mounting a joint module are sequentially arranged on the base from left to right, and a load end bottom layer moving mechanism for driving the load mounting plate to move along the left-right direction is arranged on the base. A load moving plate and a rear end bearing seat are sequentially arranged on the load mounting plate from left to right, a load end top layer moving mechanism for driving the load moving plate to move in the left-right direction is arranged on the load mounting plate, and a rear end load servo motor and a rear end torque rotating speed sensor are sequentially arranged on the load moving plate from left to right. The rear-end load servo motor is connected with the rear-end torque rotating speed sensor through a coupler, the rear-end torque rotating speed sensor is connected with the bearing seat through a coupler, the right end of the rear-end bearing seat is provided with the rear-end grating, the rear-end bearing seat is connected with the joint module through a coupler, and the joint module can be tested.

title: METHODS FOR TRAINING A NEURAL NETWORK AND FOR USING SAID NEURAL NETWORK TO STABILIZE A BIPEDAL ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for training a neural network for stabilizing a bipedal robot (1) presenting a plurality of degrees of freedom actuated by actuators, the method being characterised in that it comprises the implementation by the data processing means (11) of a server (10) of steps of:(a) In a simulation, applying a sequence of pushes on a virtual twin of the robot (1).(b) Performing a reinforcement learning algorithm on said neural network, wherein the neural network provides commands to said actuators of the virtual twin of the robot (1), so as to maximise a reward representative of a recovery of said virtual twin of the robot (1) from each push.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for training a neural network for stabilizing a bipedal robot (1) presenting a plurality of degrees of freedom actuated by actuators, the method being characterised in that it comprises the implementation by the data processing means (11) of a server (10) of steps of:(a) In a simulation, applying a sequence of pushes on a virtual twin of the robot (1).(b) Performing a reinforcement learning algorithm on said neural network, wherein the neural network provides commands to said actuators of the virtual twin of the robot (1), so as to maximise a reward representative of a recovery of said virtual twin of the robot (1) from each push.

title: METHOD FOR MOVING AN EXOSKELETON
abstract: The invention relates to a method for moving a bipedal exoskeleton (1) accommodating a human operator, the method being characterised in that it involves the implementation, by data processing means (11) of the exoskeleton (1), of the following steps: (a) obtaining at least one postural instruction to be applied by the exoskeleton (1) in order for the operator to perform an exercise movement; (b) determining a trajectory of the exoskeleton (1) by means of hierarchised inverse kinematics based on the at least one determined postural instruction, said hierarchised inverse kinematics comprising a stack of hierarchised tasks comprising, as the task of highest priority, a task of keeping the feet of the exoskeleton (1) on the ground as the operator performs the exercise movement.

title: Method and device for generating anthropomorphic action track of double-arm robot and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic action track generation method and device of a double-arm robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring human body action inertial navigation data acquired by VR (Virtual Reality) equipment; according to a human skeleton model and the human motion inertial navigation data, calculating to obtain a skeleton point position of each frame of motion sampling; analyzing the motion trend of the skeleton point position, and extracting a frame which is suddenly changed as a key frame of an action; mapping the position of the human skeleton point of each key frame to a robot space, and reversely solving the angle of each joint; and a high-order trajectory planning method is adopted, and the angles of all the joints are used for generating the anthropomorphic action trajectory of the robot according to the execution time of the human body actions.
abstract_en: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic action track generation method and device of a double-arm robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring human body action inertial navigation data acquired by VR (Virtual Reality) equipment; according to a human skeleton model and the human motion inertial navigation data, calculating to obtain a skeleton point position of each frame of motion sampling; analyzing the motion trend of the skeleton point position, and extracting a frame which is suddenly changed as a key frame of an action; mapping the position of the human skeleton point of each key frame to a robot space, and reversely solving the angle of each joint; and a high-order trajectory planning method is adopted, and the angles of all the joints are used for generating the anthropomorphic action trajectory of the robot according to the execution time of the human body actions.

title: Robot gait planning method and device, motion planning equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot gait planning method and device, motion planning equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. According to the mass center height real-time information of the humanoid robot at the current moment, the first mass center height expectation information at the end of the current gait period and the second mass center height expectation information at the end of the next step state period; planning a first centroid height change track of the remaining stepping time period of the current gait period and a second centroid height change track of the next step state period, according to the first centroid height change track, the second centroid height change track, the centroid forward real-time information at the current moment and the centroid forward expected termination speed at the end of the next step state cycle, centroid forward expected information at the end of the current gait cycle and the expected position of a landing point are calculated; therefore, based on the real-time state of the robot, the gait track planning operation with the height of the center of mass adjustable is realized, and the motion anti-interference capability and the motion stability of the humanoid robot are improved.
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot gait planning method and device, motion planning equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. title: Gait planning method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a gait planning method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: according to current posture information of the upper body of the humanoid robot, first expected posture information at the end of a current gait cycle and second expected posture information at the end of a next step state cycle, obtaining a first posture information; a first angular acceleration track of the upper body posture of the humanoid robot in the remaining time period of the current gait cycle and a second angular acceleration track of the upper body posture of the humanoid robot in the next step state cycle are obtained through calculation, and the three pieces of posture information comprise the angle of the target posture angle and the angular speed of the target posture angle; the target attitude angle comprises a pitch angle and/or a roll angle; according to the first angular acceleration track and the second angular acceleration track, the foot landing point position of the humanoid robot at the end of the current gait cycle is obtained through calculation, and the foot landing point position enables the humanoid robot to be stable. Therefore, the upper body posture of the robot can meet actual requirements, and meanwhile the stability of the robot is guaranteed.

title: Biped robot space domain gait planning and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot space domain gait planning and control method which comprises the following steps: setting the horizontal distance of a biped robot hip joint relative to a supporting leg ankle joint as a phase variable delta, and designing and optimizing a swing leg joint reference angle track based on the phase variable according to a current state, a reference step length and a reference speed; swinging leg gait planning in a space domain is completed; a second-order inverted pendulum model is established, and a support leg hip joint reference moment for speed control is optimized through nonlinear model prediction control; after the swing leg joint reference angle track and the supporting leg hip joint reference torque are obtained, the joint torque is optimized in a multi-target task through whole-body dynamics Quadratic Programming control, and then gait walking of the robot is controlled. According to the method, the motion of swinging the ankle joint is separated from the time, so that the ankle joint only depends on the own state, and the robustness is enhanced.

title: Driving method and device of biped robot, controller and medium
abstract: The invention provides a driving method and device of a biped robot, a controller and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps that according to preset walking variable parameters and multiple to-be-adjusted parameters of the biped robot, multiple walking target functions are constructed, and each walking target function corresponds to one to-be-adjusted parameter; according to preset walking variable parameters, solving to-be-adjusted parameters in the plurality of walking target functions to obtain values of the plurality of to-be-adjusted parameters; and driving the biped robot to walk according to the values of the multiple to-be-adjusted parameters. A plurality of walking target functions are constructed, a plurality of to-be-adjusted parameters in the plurality of walking target functions are optimized and solved according to preset walking variable parameters, so that the obtained values of the plurality of to-be-adjusted parameters are more reasonable, the biped robot is driven based on the values of the plurality of to-be-adjusted parameters, and on the premise that the speed and stability are guaranteed, the walking speed of the biped robot is improved. The requirement for joint performance is lowered, and the driving effect of the robot can be improved.

title: Biped robot falling protection method and device, controller and medium
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot falling protection method and device, a controller and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The tumble protection method for the biped robot comprises the steps that in the movement process of the biped robot, whether the biped robot is about to tumble or not is detected; if the biped robot is about to fall down, optimal value solving is carried out on the preset target optimization parameters, and a fall-down protection movement track is determined; and controlling the biped robot to perform tumble protection motion according to the tumble protection motion trail. When it is determined that the biped robot is about to fall down, optimal value solving is carried out on the preset target optimization parameters, a fall-down protection movement track is determined, the biped robot is controlled to carry out fall-down protection movement based on the fall-down protection movement track, and damage to the robot in the fall-down process is avoided.

title: Electrical self-repairing artificial muscle fiber and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an electrical self-repairing artificial muscle fiber and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of artificial muscle materials. The fiber sequentially comprises an elastic silica gel layer, an inner electrode layer, an elastic silica gel layer, a quasi-solid elastomer layer, an elastic silica gel layer and an outer electrode layer from inside to outside. The quasi-solid elastomer layer comprises a thermoplastic elastomer and dielectric liquid filled in the thermoplastic elastomer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: sequentially coating the elastic silica gel, the inner electrode and the elastic silica gel on the surface of a thermoplastic fiber template, then removing the thermoplastic fiber template, taking the thermoplastic fiber template as a collection template, carrying out electrostatic spinning to obtain a composite fiber of which the surface is coated with a thermoplastic elastomer, sequentially coating the elastic silica gel and the outer electrode, pouring dielectric liquid and packaging. The electrical self-repairing artificial muscle fiber is high in energy density, power density and driving frequency, has electrical self-repairing capacity, is not prone to high-voltage breakdown failure, and is suitable for application of humanoid robots, intelligent prostheses and the like.

title: CONTROL DEVICE FOR HUMAN TYPE TOY ROBOT
abstract: The present invention provides a control device for recognizing a user's hand motion to control the motion of a humanoid robot toy, the control device comprising: a main body for recognizing the hand motion and transmitting a recognized signal to the robot toy; and a band for fixing the main body to a user's wrist.

title: Angle joint assembly of Wearable robot
abstract: Disclosed is an ankle joint system having an impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism, wherein the ankle joint system supports ankle muscular strength and absorbs an impact at the same time. The ankle joint system of a wearable robot has the impact absorbing and balance supporting mechanism and is operated by one or more of a pitch degree of freedom, a yaw degree of freedom, and a roll degree of freedom. The ankle joint system comprises a foot plate unit, a floor plate, a support unit, an ankle link, an ankle assembly unit, and a rolling hinge.

title: Multifunctional intelligent old-age care robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a multifunctional intelligent old-age care robot. The multifunctional intelligent old-age care robot is of a humanoid structure composed of a robot head, robot hands, a robot chest, a robot neck, robot legs and a robot waist. The head of the robot is provided with a high-definition display screen, a high-definition camera, a microphone and a sound module; the robot chest is provided with an intelligent watch charging base; the robot hand is provided with a mechanical claw; the robot neck is provided with a bionic cervical vertebra and a servo motor; the robot legs are provided with moving tracks; a gyroscope is arranged at the waist of the robot to maintain overall balance of the robot; a quick charging port is formed in the back of the robot; an infrared sensor is arranged at the bottom of the robot and used for establishing a current space two-dimensional model. An integrated circuit mainboard is embedded in the robot trunk part, and the robot circuit mainboard part carries multiple sensors including a communication module, a color sensor, a temperature and humidity sensor and the like; and the main board is also provided with an additional expansion interface, so that a user can perform expansion according to own requirements.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom artificial limb wrist
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and particularly discloses a three-degree-of-freedom artificial limb wrist which comprises a pronation and supination unit, a wrist bending and stretching unit and an abduction and adduction unit, and the pronation and supination unit comprises a gear motor, a wrist arm connecting piece and a wrist base which are connected in sequence; the wrist bending and stretching unit comprises a worm driving assembly, a worm wheel shaft and a wrist and palm connecting piece, and the worm driving assembly is installed on the wrist base; two ends of the worm wheel shaft are fixed on the wrist and palm connecting piece; the abduction and adduction unit comprises a lead screw, a polished rod and a palm connecting piece, the lead screw is movably installed on the wrist and palm connecting piece, a lead screw nut is meshed with the lead screw, a second gear is fixed to the lead screw, the second gear is meshed with a first gear, and the first gear is installed on the wrist base; the polished rod is movably sleeved with a lead screw nut sliding block, and the lead screw nut sliding block is fixed to the lead screw nut and the palm connecting piece; and the palm connecting piece is movably mounted on the wrist and palm connecting piece. The mechanism is compact in structure, light in weight and capable of achieving three-degree-of-freedom movement.

title: Knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot with humanoid knee joint
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot with a humanoid knee joint, which comprises a connecting piece, a guide rail and a cylindrical block, the guide rail is arranged on the side wall of the connecting piece, and the cylindrical block is slidably connected to the inner side wall of the guide rail. T-shaped limiting grooves are formed in the side wall faces, away from the center and close to the center, of the interior of the guide rail, limiting blocks which are in sliding connection with the two limiting grooves are fixedly installed on the side wall of the cylindrical block, and supporting springs which are fixedly connected with the wall faces of the corresponding positions of the limiting blocks are fixedly connected to the inner side walls of the limiting grooves. According to the utility model, because the sliding speed of the cylindrical block is too high, when the cylindrical block moves along the guide rail along with the movement of external equipment, the cylindrical block can pull the supporting spring to limit the moving speed of the cylindrical block to a certain extent, and the situation that the sliding speed of the cylindrical block is too high because the guide rail is arc-shaped is avoided.

title: Servo joint motor applied to biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the related technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly discloses a servo joint motor applied to a biped robot, which comprises an inner rotor brushless mechanism and a double-balance-wheel speed reducer mechanism, the inner rotor brushless mechanism and the double-balance-wheel speed reducer mechanism are both installed in the heat dissipation shell, the double-balance-wheel speed reducer mechanism is installed on the front side of the heat dissipation shell, and the inner rotor brushless mechanism is installed on the rear side of the double-balance-wheel speed reducer mechanism. The double-balance-wheel speed reducer mechanism comprises a front fixing disc, an output end fixing disc, a driving shaft and a cycloidal gear assembly, the front fixing disc is installed at the front end of the heat dissipation shell, the driving shaft is installed on the cycloidal gear assembly, and the cycloidal gear assembly is installed between the front fixing disc and the heat dissipation shell; the inner rotor brushless mechanism comprises a connecting shell, an inner rotor, a rear fixing disc, a control circuit board and a protective rear cover. The inner rotor brushless and double-balance-wheel speed reducer is integrated in the servo joint motor, and the servo joint motor has the advantages of being small in size, large in bearing capacity, easy and convenient to assemble and stable in transmission.

title: Method for Recovering Balance of Humanoid Robot via Step Generation
abstract: The present invention provides a balance restoring method of a humanoid robot comprising the following steps of: setting an inverted pendulum model based on a behavior of a humanoid robot; setting a hybrid model through coordinate conversion from the inverted pendulum model; and stabilizing the hybrid model by using an input based on a change in a step of the humanoid robot. In the stabilization step, a position and time of the step of the humanoid robot is controlled. The present invention provides the balance restoring method that can be easily operated in real time and can be theoretically identified.

In the stabilization step, a position and time of the step of the humanoid robot is controlled. The present invention provides the balance restoring method that can be easily operated in real time and can be theoretically identified.

title: Rope-driven humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model discloses a rope type driving humanoid manipulator which is applied to a mechanical arm of a robot, the rope type driving humanoid manipulator comprises a front arm assembly and a palm assembly arranged on the front arm assembly, and the palm assembly comprises a palm and a plurality of flexible and extendable fingers hinged to the palm. When the fingers bend and stretch, the palm assembly can take and place objects. The flexible fingers are matched with the palm to simulate a human body to grab objects, the degree of freedom and the flexibility of manipulator operation are improved, and the manipulator can adapt to more use occasions.

title: Robot motion correction method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot motion correction method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: according to mechanism motion state information of a leg parallel mechanism of a target biped robot at the current moment, determining a target Jacobian matrix of the leg parallel mechanism at the current moment, wherein the target Jacobian matrix is used for describing a kinematics association relationship between a driving joint angular velocity and a tail end attitude angular velocity; then, according to the attitude angular velocity constraint condition, the target Jacobian matrix and the expected joint angular velocity of the leg parallel mechanism at the next moment, mechanism motion optimization is carried out with the optimization purpose of minimizing the difference between the expected joint angular velocity and the driving joint angular velocity corresponding to the target tail end attitude angular velocity; and the corresponding target tail end attitude angular velocity is obtained, so that the joint velocity of the leg parallel mechanism is effectively limited, the body jumping phenomenon of the leg parallel mechanism near the mechanism limit position is improved, and the motion stability of the biped robot is improved.

title: Redundant mechanical arm humanoid inverse kinematics solution method based on human body muscle-bone model
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of humanoid mechanical arm inverse kinematics algorithms, and discloses a redundant mechanical arm humanoid kinematics inverse solution solving method based on a human body muscle-bone model, which comprises the following steps of: (1) constructing a target equation by taking minimization of muscle loss as a target; (2) calculating an inverse solution qs of a joint angle by adopting an analysis IK algorithm of a position domain, mapping the qs into an initial value qind for solving a numerical value IK, further optimizing and solving the joint angle q by adopting an LM method, and taking q as an initial value for local optimal solution; (3) performing local optimization search based on the initial value of the arm joint angle q until a termination criterion is met, and selecting an optimal result from all current local optimal values as a global optimal solution qopt; and (4) mapping of the muscle-bone model and the anthropomorphic mechanical arm is established through the swing angle of the arm, and then the obtained global optimal solution is mapped into the mechanical arm kinematics model to determine the anthropomorphic posture of the mechanical arm. The safety sense and the comfort degree of the mechanical arm are improved, and the man-machine interaction efficiency is improved.

title: Robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a control method thereof, and the control method comprises the steps: receiving a voice instruction sent by a user; sound source localization is carried out on the voice instruction to determine the position relation between a user sending the voice instruction and the robot; adjusting the pose of the robot based on the position relation, and collecting an image in the pose state; and adjusting the head of the robot according to the position of the face of the user in the image, so that the front side of the head faces the face of the user. The robot can feed back a voice instruction sent by a user through anthropomorphic limb actions.

title: Force-electricity characteristic characterization system for humanoid movement
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid motion force-electricity characteristic characterization system, which comprises a detection box and a test system matched with the detection box for use, a simulated artificial leg mechanism and a simulated artificial thoracic cavity mechanism are hung in the detection box, and a control host for monitoring the working conditions of the simulated artificial leg mechanism and the simulated artificial thoracic cavity mechanism is also arranged outside the detection box; the artificial leg simulating mechanism comprises a mechanical leg of which one end is fixedly connected with the top in the detection box, an artificial joint for driving the mechanical leg to swing and bionic leg skin covering the outer side of the mechanical leg; the artificial thoracic cavity simulating mechanism comprises a thoracic cavity mold doing expansion and contraction movement and bionic thoracic cavity skin wrapping the outer side of the thoracic cavity mold; during testing, to-be-tested electronic materials are respectively fixed on the bionic leg skin or/and the bionic chest skin. The performance of the electronic material can be detected by simulating actual environmental factors of a human body, and the reliability of the electronic material is evaluated in a mechanical-electrical characteristic characterization mode.

title: Biped robot with wheels assisting in turning
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped robot with wheels assisting in turning, which comprises a mounting plate, a main control board, a battery and two robot legs, the main control board and the battery are arranged at the top of the mounting plate, the two robot legs are symmetrically arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, first U-shaped connecting pieces in the robot legs are fixed at the bottom of the mounting plate, and first steering engines are hinged to the first U-shaped connecting pieces. The second steering engine is fixedly connected with the first steering engine, the second U-shaped connecting piece is hinged to the second steering engine, the third U-shaped connecting piece is fixedly connected with the second U-shaped connecting piece, the arrangement directions of the third U-shaped connecting piece and the second U-shaped connecting piece are perpendicular to each other, the upper portion of the third steering engine is hinged to the third U-shaped connecting piece, the lower portion of the third steering engine is hinged to the fourth U-shaped connecting piece, and the bottom of the third steering engine is fixed to the bottom of the fourth U-shaped connecting piece. title: Parallel mechanism and four-bar mechanism combined robot
abstract: The invention relates to a parallel mechanism and four-bar mechanism combined robot which drives robot joints to move through air cylinders, pneumatic motors and pneumatic muscles and has the function of completely simulating joint movement of a person. The parallel mechanism and four-bar mechanism combined robot is mainly composed of an air cylinder, a pneumatic motor, a worm gear, a worm, pneumatic muscles, a connecting piece and a joint control system. The waist joint adopts a plurality of pneumatic muscles connected in series to construct a single muscle to form a parallel joint, the hip joint is driven by a combination of a pneumatic motor and a worm and gear, the knee joint is combined with a rod structure through an oscillating cylinder and is combined with a linear cylinder, the ankle joint and the foot are driven by the linear cylinder, and the shoulder joint is driven by the cylinder in parallel; the elbow joint is combined with a rod structure through a pneumatic motor, and movement of the wrist joint is completely achieved through a pneumatic claw. The device is driven by the pneumatic muscle, the air cylinder and the pneumatic motor, has the advantages of being compact in structure, diversified in movement mode and wide in movement range, and can be used for teaching and demonstration.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand jointly driven by hydraulic pressure and micro motor
abstract: The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger and a finger-metacarpal joint transmission mechanism, assembly groove holes are formed in the palm, the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are distributed and installed on the palm through the assembly groove holes, and the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are connected with the finger-metacarpal joint transmission mechanism. The finger and metacarpal joint transmission mechanism is installed on the palm through screws, and the transmission mechanism drives the thumb to rotate around the palm and drives the four fingers to laterally swing towards the two sides of the palm. According to the dexterous hand, the grabbing action is controlled through the hydraulic driver, when the dexterous hand grabs an object, the output force of the tail ends of the knuckles is large, the grabbing stability is good, and the grabbing precision is high. Parts such as the palm, the fingers and the joints can be modularized, so that the interchangeability of the parts and the maintainability of the whole hand are enhanced.

title: Pneumatic and configuration combined profiling robot system
abstract: The invention relates to a pneumatic and configuration combined profiling robot system which drives a shoulder joint, an elbow joint, a wrist joint, a waist joint, a hip joint, a knee joint and an ankle joint to move through air cylinders and pneumatic muscles and has the function of completely simulating human movement. The profiling robot is mainly composed of an air cylinder, a pneumatic muscle, a pneumatic claw and a connecting piece. The shoulder joint and the elbow joint achieve movement in multiple directions through multiple sets of antagonistic muscle pneumatic muscles, and the wrist joint is formed by combining pneumatic muscles and pneumatic claws which are connected in parallel. The waist joint is formed by connecting a plurality of groups of crossed air cylinders in parallel, so that the motion space accessibility and rigidity of the joint are greatly improved, and singularity is avoided. The hip joints are two parallel pneumatic drives, the knee joints are formed by combining pneumatic muscles and four-rod parallelogram structures, and the ankle joints are formed by combining air cylinders and rod structures. The device is driven by the pneumatic muscle and the air cylinder, has the characteristics of rigid-flexible combination, multiple degrees of freedom and good explosion-proof performance, and can be used for teaching and demonstration.

title: Method, system and device for controlling piano playing action based on humanoid arm claw robot
abstract: The invention discloses a piano playing action control method, system and device based on a humanoid arm claw robot. The system comprises a music score storage and analysis module, a piano playing action sequence generation module, an action instruction generation and sending module and an action instruction receiving and executing module. And the music score information is read by using the music score storage and analysis module. And then a playing action sequence of the humanoid arm claw is obtained by using a playing action sequence generation module. Converting the arm claw action into a corresponding action instruction by utilizing an action instruction generating and sending module, and sending the action instruction to an arm claw execution end; and finally, the action instruction receiving and executing module is used for receiving and executing the action instruction by the mechanical arm and claw, and finally the playing of the piano by the humanoid arm-claw robot is realized. Based on the method provided by the invention, the human arm and claw simulated piano playing robot can give full play to the performances of the arms and the claws, and a better piano playing effect is efficiently and stably realized.

title: Real-time visual key detection and positioning method for humanoid piano playing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time visual key detection and positioning method for a humanoid piano playing robot. Firstly, a color image and a depth image are obtained and preprocessed; performing background coarse filtering on the color image to obtain a piano surface candidate area; obtaining a white key region by adopting a region growing algorithm, and extracting upper and lower contour boundary lines of a white key surface to obtain a key positioning point set; then, carrying out white key surface fitting by utilizing the depth map information of the white key region to obtain point cloud information corresponding to the positioning points; and finally, obtaining coordinates of all positioning points in a camera coordinate system by adopting a point cloud registration algorithm. In addition, through coordinates obtained through positioning detection, whether the key position is abnormal or not is judged based on a point cloud transformation matrix. According to the method, the positions of the piano keys can still be rapidly detected and positioned in different interference environments, whether the piano keys are in abnormal states such as movement or not is judged according to the positioning result, and better robustness and safety are achieved for arm claw positioning of the humanoid piano playing robot.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a head and neck mechanism, a shoulder and arm mechanism, a wrist mechanism, a hand mechanism, a finger mechanism, a waist mechanism, a crossing mechanism, a leg mechanism, an ankle mechanism, a foot plate mechanism and a thoracic cavity mechanism. The upper side of the thoracic cavity mechanism is rotationally connected with the head and neck mechanism, the two sides of the thoracic cavity mechanism are rotationally connected with one end of the shoulder and arm mechanism, the lower side of the thoracic cavity mechanism is rotationally connected with one side of the waist mechanism, and the other side of the waist mechanism is rotationally connected with the straddle mechanism; the two sides of the straddle mechanism are rotationally connected with one end of the leg mechanism, the other end of the leg mechanism is rotationally connected with the foot plate mechanism through the ankle mechanism, the hand mechanism is rotationally installed at the other end of the shoulder-arm mechanism, and the finger mechanism is installed on the hand mechanism. A steering engine assembly is installed in the hand mechanism and is in transmission connection with the finger mechanism.

title: Humanoid robot upper body posture control method based on online learning
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot upper body posture control method based on online learning, which comprises the following steps: constructing a hip joint compensation model based on a logistic regression model, and training model parameters of the hip joint compensation model offline by using collected historical data; in each gait cycle, a hip joint compensation value is obtained based on the current hip joint compensation model to carry out upper body posture control of the humanoid robot, and model parameters are periodically updated on line when each gait cycle is finished; the collected historical data is operation data of the humanoid robot under different PID parameters, wherein the humanoid robot adopts PID control. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of being high in robustness, capable of enabling the robot to walk more stably and the like.

title: Motion control system of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped robot motion control system, comprising a processing unit used for processing collected measurement data and configuring a biped robot to output a control signal; the motor control unit responds to the control signal to control the voltage and current output of the motor, so that the motor is at an expected rotating speed and an expected rotating direction; the steering engine control unit responds to the control signal so as to control voltage and current output of a steering engine, and human joints are simulated through the steering engine so that the biped robot can be in a designated running state; the motion state detection unit is used for obtaining the space motion speed and the space orientation inclination angle of the biped robot, and the external environment detection unit is used for obtaining the surrounding environment state of the biped robot. According to the utility model, all the units work cooperatively, the integration level is high, and the expansibility is stronger.

title: Full-autonomous multi-control humanoid biped robot based on 3D printing
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of 3D printing, and particularly relates to a full-autonomous multi-control humanoid biped robot based on 3D printing, which comprises a head part, an upper chest and back part, a waist part, a lower chest and back part, hand parts and leg parts, the head part comprises a first steering engine, the upper end of the first steering engine is fixedly provided with a head part shell, and the lower end of the first steering engine is fixedly provided with a second steering engine shell; the body part of the full-autonomous-vision humanoid robot adopts a unique 3D printing structure, inertia force generated during walking is reduced under the condition that the strength is guaranteed, so that a better walking effect is achieved, the manufacturing cost is low, plastic can be selected as raw materials, the manufacturing cost is effectively reduced, and compared with an existing product, the full-autonomous-vision humanoid robot is light in weight, convenient to transport and convenient to carry due to the adoption of 3D design. title: Humonoid robot
abstract: The present invention provides a humanoid robot which comprises: a waist joint unit (120) connected to a lower frame (121); an upper body (130) connected to the waist joint unit (120) and disposed in an upper part of the lower frame (121); a shoulder joint unit (140) connecting a pair of left and right arms (150) to the upper body (130); an elbow joint unit (160) joining a rear arm (152) to a front arm (154) to form the pair of arms (150); and a head joint unit (170) connecting a head (180) to the upper body (130), wherein the humanoid robot has a head rotational motor (172) with three degrees of freedom, the shoulder joint unit (140) with two degrees of freedom, the elbow joint unit (160) with two degrees of freedom, and the waist joint unit (120) with two degrees of freedom. title: Biped robot capable of avoiding obstacles
abstract: The utility model particularly relates to a biped robot capable of avoiding obstacles, which comprises a crotch part and two leg parts located on the left side and the right side of the crotch part, the leg parts comprise thigh parts, knee joints, shank parts, ankle joints and foot parts which are connected in sequence, and hip joints are arranged between the thigh parts and the crotch part for connection; the obstacle-avoidance biped robot is provided with a plurality of driving devices, and the driving devices control rotation of hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints. At least one environment detection sensor is installed on the front side of the shank part, a central processing unit is arranged in the obstacle-avoiding biped robot, and the environment detection sensor is used for detecting whether an obstacle exists in the advancing direction of the leg part and feeding back a detection signal to the central processing unit. And the central processing unit sends out an execution instruction to one or more driving devices for driving the ankle joint, the knee joint and the ankle joint. The obstacle avoidance device can detect whether the robot has obstacles in the advancing direction, feed back signals to the central processing unit, plan advancing paths and send execution instructions to all the driving devices, and the obstacle avoidance function is achieved.

title: Palm structure, mechanical foot and robot

The sole body is arranged on the bottom base plate, that is, the bottom base plate is additionally arranged below the sole body, and the whole sole body is ensured to be arranged on the bottom base plate, so that the whole sole body is in contact with a supporting surface (such as the ground) through the bottom base plate, and the contact area between the sole body and the supporting surface is increased; therefore, the gravity center adjusting range of the sole body is enlarged, and the gravity center stability of the sole body is improved. By means of the technical scheme, the technical problems that in the prior art, when standing and walking debugging is conducted on the biped robot, the robot easily falls down, and the debugging difficulty is high are solved.

title: Self-adaptive admittance control method of lower limb exoskeleton robot and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive admittance control method of a lower limb exoskeleton robot and a related device. The method comprises the steps that the interaction torque between the legs of the human body and the exoskeleton robot at the current moment and the angle formed by the exoskeleton robot and the vertical direction are obtained; inputting the interaction torque and the angle into a self-adaptive admittance parameter adjustment model, and outputting a first quality parameter and a first damping parameter; inputting the interaction torque and the angle into a recurrent neural network, and outputting a second quality parameter and a second damping parameter; fusing the first and second quality parameters to obtain a final quality parameter, and fusing the first and second damping parameters to obtain a final damping parameter; a target angle value is obtained according to the final quality parameter, the damping parameter, the interaction torque and the angle, and the exoskeleton robot is controlled through the target angle value; taking the next moment as the current moment, and continuing to execute the step of obtaining the interaction moment and angle. In this way, the tracking effect of the exoskeleton robot can be improved.

title: Raspberry Pi-based humanoid entity robot control system
abstract: The invention relates to a Raspberry Pi-based humanoid entity robot control system, and the system comprises a communication unit which is used for receiving a control instruction from an upper application and analyzing the control instruction into an action instruction; the control unit is connected with the communication unit and is used for receiving the action instruction and carrying out semantic coding according to the action instruction to obtain an action semantic coding stream; the action unit is connected with the control unit and used for receiving the action semantic coded stream, decoding the received action semantic coded stream to obtain an action code stream, and performing calculation according to a control algorithm to obtain execution action data; the execution unit is connected with the action unit, the execution unit is further in control connection with a motor and a steering engine on the humanoid entity robot, and the execution unit is used for receiving the execution action data and controlling the corresponding motor and the steering engine to execute the received execution action data. title: Biped robot and quadruped robot

title: Modularized pneumatic soft humanoid finger capable of achieving segmented bending and mold of modularized pneumatic soft humanoid finger
abstract: The utility model provides a modularized pneumatic soft humanoid finger and a mould thereof capable of realizing segmental bending, the finger comprises a plurality of bionic knuckles which are sequentially connected through magnetic attraction, each bionic knuckle comprises a sealed cavity made of silica gel and an air pipe communicated with the inside of the sealed cavity, the sealed cavity is a columnar cavity with an arched section, and the air pipe is communicated with the inside of the sealed cavity. title: Hybrid dynamics modeling and motion planning method for biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control, and relates to a biped robot hybrid dynamics modeling and motion planning method which specifically comprises the steps that 1, a biped robot is initialized, a coordinate system describing motion of the biped robot is established, and a biped robot kinematics model is established; step 2, setting joint angular kinematics constraints of the biped robot; 3, analyzing the generalized dynamic model of the biped robot; 4, constructing a hybrid dynamical model of the biped robot; and 5, designing a motion planning method of the biped robot based on the hybrid dynamical model, designing an optimization target and linear and nonlinear constraints, describing a motion planning problem, and solving through a nonlinear optimization method to obtain a motion track of the biped robot. The method has high application value in the aspects of motion planning and control of the biped robot.

title: Leg of biped robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model discloses a leg part of a biped robot. title: Biped robot

title: Bouncing motion control method and device of biped robot and biped robot
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of robots, and provides a bounce motion control method and device of a biped robot and the biped robot, and the bounce motion control method comprises the steps that before the biped robot leaves the ground, the motion track of the biped robot after the biped robot leaves the ground is estimated according to the time when the biped robot stays in the air or the time when the biped robot overturns in the air; calculating a first motion angle of each joint of the legs of the biped robot according to the motion track and inverse kinematics; determining constraint conditions according to the motion type to which the action to be executed by the biped robot belongs; optimizing the first motion angle according to the constraint condition to obtain a second motion angle; and controlling the bouncing motion of the biped robot according to the second motion angle. By means of the method, it can be guaranteed that the biped robot bounces at the second movement angle not exceeding the angle limit of the joints.

title: Robot based on rigid and flexible pneumatic element fusion, control system and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot based on rigid and flexible pneumatic element fusion, a control system and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot is mainly composed of an air cylinder, pneumatic muscles, a lower bottom plate, side bones, middle bones, connecting rods, thigh side panels, shank side panels, pneumatic motors and a control system. The multiple air cylinders drive the chest joints to linearly move and rotate, and the multiple air cylinders of the shoulder joints drive the joints to rotate and assist the chest joints to move at the same time. The elbow joint is formed by combining a thin-wall air cylinder and two sets of four-bar mechanisms. The hip joints and the ankle joints are driven by multiple groups of pneumatic muscles on the outer sides and connected by one or more pneumatic muscles in the middle, so that the hip joints and the ankle joints can assist in driving and can also play a role of spherical hinges, and the knee joints are synergistically moved by two pneumatic muscles. The mechanical arm is driven by the pneumatic muscle and the air cylinder, has the characteristics of rigidity and flexibility, multiple degrees of freedom and large working space, and can be used for commercial services such as teaching demonstration, industrial automatic production lines, catering and ordering and the like.

title: Bionic robot, system and method based on series-parallel hybrid pneumatic muscles and air cylinders
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot, system and method based on series-parallel pneumatic muscles and air cylinders, the pneumatic muscle air cylinders drive a waist joint, a hip joint, a knee joint, an ankle joint, a shoulder joint, an elbow joint and a wrist joint to move, and the bionic robot has the function of completely simulating joint movement of a person. The waist joint upper layer, the waist joint middle layer and the waist joint lower layer are composed of four pneumatic muscles which are connected front, back, left and right, and the waist joint upper layer, the waist joint middle layer and the waist joint lower layer are connected in parallel through four air cylinders. The hip joint is jointly driven by two parallel air cylinders and two pneumatic muscles connected with the waist joint and the shank, the knee joint is driven by two pneumatic muscles connected with the waist joint and the shank and two pneumatic muscles connected with the thigh and the shank in parallel, and the ankle joint is driven by four pneumatic muscles connected in parallel. And the wrist joint is driven by two groups of big arm pneumatic muscle antagonism muscles. The mechanical arm is driven by the pneumatic muscles and the air cylinders and has the advantages of being rigid and flexible, high in bearing capacity and large in motion space.

abstract: The humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot comprises a lower machine body and an upper machine body, a rotating groove is formed in the upper side of the lower machine body, a rotating column is rotationally connected into the rotating groove through a bearing, the upper machine body is fixedly connected to the upper end of the rotating column, and a driving device for controlling the rotating column to rotate in the rotating groove is installed on the upper side of the lower machine body. The outer wall of the upper machine body is fixedly connected with two parallel supporting rods, each supporting rod is provided with a horizontal guide hole, a tray is arranged on one side of each supporting rod, a moving device for controlling the tray to reciprocate in the direction of the guide holes is arranged in each supporting rod, a cover disc is arranged on the upper side of each tray, and a lifting device for controlling the cover disc to move up and down is arranged on the upper machine body. According to the humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot, in the process that the tray pushes dishes to the upper side of a customer dining table, the lifting rope can pull the cover plate to move upwards and be separated from the tray, so that fresh dishes are pushed to the customer dining table, and customers can take the dishes on the tray conveniently.

title: Deep learning-based humanoid robot soccer system
abstract: The present invention relates to a deep learning-based humanoid robot soccer system, which comprises: a robot controller mounted on a humanoid-type robot to recognize the movement, motion, surrounding objects of the robot or the existence of a counterpart robot based on a deep learning method, and controlling the operation of the robot based on the recognized information; and a game controller which is connected to the robot controller through a network, analyzes recognition information and operation information transmitted from the robot controller, determines whether the robot violated the rules of a soccer being played, controls the robot according to the determination result, and sets the number and type of participants who will participate in the robot soccer and a difficulty level. The present invention can provide scalability of a robot market by improving the intimacy of the robot soccer game.

title: Robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot stepping control method and device, robot control equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The expected supporting force of the two feet is determined according to the current zero moment point planning data and the actual position data of the two feet of the biped robot, and then the expected supporting force of the two feet is obtained according to the expected supporting force of the two feet, the current mass center movement planning data, the actual mass center movement data, the two-foot stepping planning data and the actual stress data of the two feet. The current expected joint attitude angles of the ankle joints and the expected joint positions matched with the actual foot supporting state are determined based on a compliance control algorithm, and therefore all-directional compliance control over the expected foot pose condition is conducted according to the actual motion condition of the biped robot. The expected foot position and the expected foot posture are both substantially matched with the actual ground condition, so that the foot falling impact force in the single-foot supporting period and the inter-foot internal force in the double-foot supporting period are reduced, and the walking stability and the terrain adaptability of the biped robot are improved.

title: Biped robot sole stress state detection system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot foot sole stress state detection system and method. title: Flexible waist structure suitable for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible waist structure suitable for a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. According to the invention, excessive energy can be consumed when the execution element acts, the collision of the execution element caused by inertia is avoided, the vibration generated by movement is effectively reduced, the stability of the robot during movement is improved, and the action of the robot is more flexible.

title: Intelligent humanoid robot control system and method
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent humanoid robot control system and method. The method comprises the steps that a posture picture of a human body is obtained, the posture picture is recognized, and final posture parameters containing included angle data between all joints of the human body are generated; obtaining current posture parameters, calculating the change of the robot from the current limb movement to the final limb movement, and calculating the angle difference data and the rotation direction of each joint motor of the robot; comprising a posture transition strategy used for controlling stable posture transformation of the robot, the posture transition strategy obtains angle difference data and generates a control instruction used for controlling the rotation angle and the rotation speed of each limb of the robot, and the robot controls a joint motor of the robot to rotate in the corresponding rotation direction according to the control instruction to complete motion transformation. When the robot stands with one foot, the robot can be rapidly and efficiently controlled to conduct action conversion, meanwhile, stable action of the robot can be guaranteed, and the falling probability of the robot is reduced.

title: Modularized movable joint
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, in particular to a modular movable joint which comprises a joint assembly used for connecting two or more frameworks, and the joint assembly comprises a fixing frame and an adapter. The fixing frame is detachably connected with one framework, the adapting piece is detachably connected with the other framework, the adapting piece is rotatably connected with the fixing frame, and the rotating axis of the adapting piece is parallel to a sagittal axis, a coronal axis or a vertical axis. Compared with the prior art, the modularized movable joint provided by the invention has the advantages that the independent joint modules are designed, the periods of designing, disassembling, assembling and replacing robot components are shortened, the appearance and posture of a robot can be quickly changed, the modularized movable joint can be applied to different use scenes and various simulated humanoid robots, and the requirement of quickly customizing different images is met.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot navigation method which is based on a robot system, the robot system comprises a robot and a plurality of movable distance measuring devices, and the robot is provided with a manipulator and a plurality of sensors with fixed positions; the navigation method comprises a distance measuring equipment grabbing process and a path planning process. The process of grabbing the distance measuring equipment comprises the steps that the robot arm receives a grabbing command, the manipulator grabs the distance measuring equipment of the type specified by the command, the manipulator adjusts the position of the distance measuring equipment in a self-adaptive mode, and the robot is matched with the corresponding SLAM algorithm according to the type of the distance measuring equipment. The path planning process comprises the steps that the robot combines map information, surrounding obstacle information obtained by a sensor and/or distance measuring equipment, real-time position information of the robot and position information of a target point, a path reaching the target point is generated based on an SLAM algorithm, the position of the robot is monitored in real time in the advancing process of the robot to judge whether the robot deviates from the path or not, and the path is adjusted when the robot deviates from the path. According to the invention, the robot can flexibly replace the mobile distance measuring equipment for auxiliary navigation to adapt to different scenes.

title: Humanoid robot teaching control system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot teaching control system and method. The multi-media education robot comprises a humanoid robot body, an emotion recognition module, a state analysis module, an information processing module, a multi-media communication module and a man-machine interaction module. The emotion recognition module is mainly responsible for collecting and recording information; the information processing module is used for checking the collected and recorded information and the state analysis model; and the man-machine interaction module timely adjusts a student learning scheme according to a proofreading result of the information processing module, and finally feeds back a new scheme to the multi-media server. title: Humanoid robot damping foot with variable length and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a length-variable damping foot of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The damping foot comprises a foot front end, a foot rear end and a damping device, the damping device comprises a rubber block, a bottom plate, a storage bin, a warping plate used for fixing the storage bin and a cover plate connected to the top of the storage bin. The bottom plate and the warping plate are each of an upwards-bent arc-shaped structure, and the rubber block is arranged between the bottom plate and the storage bin. The front portion of the foot front end is bent upwards, a first row of holes are formed in the middle, and a first sensor, a first damping layer and an anti-skid layer are sequentially arranged on the bottom face of the front portion of the foot front end. A second row of holes are formed in the front portion of the foot rear end, and the rear portion of the foot rear end is connected with the damping device. The foot length of the robot can be changed within a certain range, so that the foot length limit value required by stable walking of different robots can be determined, sole vibration generated by control errors and uneven ground can be borne, and the problems that the length of a current robot foot cannot be adjusted, and the stability is poor are solved. The problems of vibration and sole slipping when a person walks on the uneven ground in a human gait simulation mode are solved.

title: Biped walking device using two independent rotating motors control method for bipedal walking
abstract: The present invention relates to a biped walking device using two independent rotary motors, and a biped walking control method using the same. More specifically, the biped walking device comprises two independent type left leg module (100a) and independent type right leg module (100b). Each of the independent type left leg module (100a) and the independent type right leg module (100b) includes a main leg part (121) and an auxiliary leg part (122). The biped walking device further comprises: a module body (110) supported by the main leg part (121) and the auxiliary leg part (122); a rotary motor (140) connected to the main leg part (121) of the module body (110) to operate the main leg part (121) and the auxiliary leg part (122); and a sensing and control module (160) having a control board (161) and a magnetic sensor (162). Each of the main leg part (121) has a magnet end (150) and is controlled in walking by the control board (161) according to a sensing result of the magnetic sensors (162) individually formed for the independent type left leg module (100a) and the independent type right leg module (100b). The biped walking device using two independent rotary motors and the biped walking control method using the same can accurately control walking time through individual sensing of motors independently rotating at each leg, reduce waddling and inclination of a robot body during biped walking, and realize smooth walking.

title: Biped robot with multi-degree-of-freedom waist and hip structure

title: Biped robot foothold planning method based on variable parameter speed mapping and quadratic programming
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot foothold planning method based on variable parameter speed mapping and quadratic programming, and the method comprises the steps: walking cycle planning based on variable parameter speed mapping, realization of foothold attitude planning based on the walking cycle planning, realization of foothold position planning based on the walking cycle planning and the foothold attitude planning, and realization of foothold position planning based on the walking cycle planning and the foothold attitude planning. Respectively matching the position and attitude information of the foothold with the time sequence information one by one to obtain a foothold vector describing the complete spatio-temporal information of each step in the prediction interval; the space feasibility and the time feasibility are both considered, the foothold position and posture and the walking period of the robot can be planned online, and the rapid response capacity and maneuverability of the biped robot to deal with dynamic obstacles are improved.

title: Five-degree-of-freedom full-drive humanoid thumb and humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid dexterous hands, and provides a five-degree-of-freedom full-drive humanoid thumb and a humanoid dexterous hand, the five-degree-of-freedom full-drive humanoid thumb comprises a thumb base, a first knuckle, a second knuckle, a third knuckle, a fourth knuckle and a fifth knuckle; the first knuckle and the thumb base are rotatably connected to form a first joint, the second knuckle and the first knuckle are rotatably connected to form a second joint, the third knuckle and the second knuckle are rotatably connected to form a third joint, and the fourth knuckle and the third knuckle are rotatably connected to form a fourth joint. title: Centralized driving type rigid humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention provides a centralized driving type rigid humanoid mechanical arm. A large arm driving motor drives a whole large arm assembly to rotate; the toggle plate driving motor and the small arm driving motor are installed on the large arm support, an output shaft of the toggle plate driving motor drives the toggle plate to rotate through the toggle plate transmission connecting rod, the small arm driving motor drives the small arm body to rotate through the small arm transmission connecting rod, and a rotating shaft of the toggle plate perpendicularly intersects with a rotating shaft of the small arm body. The forearm body can realize rotation of at least three degrees of freedom; the output shaft of the toggle plate driving motor and the output shaft of the forearm driving motor are collinear and perpendicularly intersect with the output shaft of the forearm driving motor, the motors are not installed at the joints of the large arm assembly and the forearm assembly, and when the large arm assembly and the forearm assembly rotate together or only the forearm assembly rotates, the motors are driven to rotate. The influence of the motor on the rotational inertia is reduced to the minimum, and the movement flexibility, movement stability and movement precision of the mechanical arm are improved.
