title: Flying leg meal delivery robot
abstract: The flying leg meal delivery robot comprises a head assembly, an upper body assembly and a chassis assembly, the chassis assembly comprises a chassis, a top fixing plate, a device box body composed of a front shell and a rear shell, the upper body assembly comprises a box body, and a first dinner plate supporting column, a second dinner plate supporting column and a third dinner plate supporting column are sequentially arranged on the periphery of the interior of the box body; the first dinner plate supporting column, the second dinner plate supporting column and the third dinner plate supporting column are sequentially provided with a top cover plate, two dinner plates and a box body fixing plate which are connected with the dinner plate supporting column, the second dinner plate supporting column and the third dinner plate supporting column from top to bottom, a right door rotating shaft and a left door rotating shaft are arranged on the two sides of the front face of the box body respectively, and the head assembly comprises a shell which is internally provided with a touch screen, a screen fixing frame and an Android plate. title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR GENERATING FACIAL EXPRESSION DATA OF HUMAN-FRIENDLY ROBOT
abstract: A method for generating facial expression visualization information for expressing an emotion of a human-friendly robot according to the present invention comprises the following steps of: defining at least one emotion expression item which can be expressed by the human-friendly robot; collecting facial expression images in which each of the at least one emotion expression item is visually expressed; extracting characteristic points from the collected facial expression images according to predefined standards; and generating facial expression visualization information that intuitively visualizes each of the at least one emotion expression item based on the extracted characteristic points. An apparatus for generating facial expression visualization information supports the human-friendly robot to express a variety of emotions.

title: ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR IDENTIFYING HUMAN GAIT PATTERN AND METHOD THERE OF
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for identifying the walking pattern of a target and an electronic device performing the same. In particular, a method for a robot device to identify the walking pattern of a target according to one embodiment of the present invention may comprise: a step of filming a target by means of a camera connected to the robot device to acquire an image; a step of generating human body skeleton information from the acquired image; a step of identifying the filming angle of the camera with respect to the target based on the connecting relationship of at least one link in the generated human body skeleton information; a step of determining the joint information of the robot model based on the identified filming angle of the camera; and a step of identifying the walking pattern of the target by performing a posture simulation of a humanoid robot based on the determined joint information. Therefore, the method for identifying the walking pattern of a target by using the humanoid robot model and the electronic device performing the same may be provided.

title: Q- Q-learning based cooperative robot control system
abstract: The present invention relates to a Q-learning-based cooperative robot control system and, more specifically, to a cooperative robot control system which controls a humanoid robot, which comprises a motion state recognition module to recognize the motion of a user and a motion control module to control the motion of a cooperative robot working unit provided to perform a work according to the motion of a user collected by the motion state recognition module, to be operated together for cooperation according to the motion of the user. The motion state recognition module comprises a workpiece image recognition module provided at the front side of the humanoid robot to film the image of a workpiece mounted on a working unit to convert the same into data. The motion control module controls the motion of the working unit based on the range of the workpiece image according to the angle of the workpiece mounted on the working unit, which is filmed by means of the workpiece image recognition module. Therefore, errors in the motion of the working unit may be reduced.

title: Humanoid robot face friendliness evaluation and design method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot face friendliness evaluation method and a humanoid robot face friendliness design method. The method comprises the following steps: (1) simulating and generating a face of the humanoid robot based on different face features; (2) collecting EEG signals and eye movement signals generated by participants on the face of the humanoid robot in the friendly evaluation experiment process, and recording preference feedback of the participants; (3) in combination with preference feedback of participants, performing preference evaluation on the acquired electroencephalogram signals and eye movement signals to obtain preference ranking based on the electroencephalogram signals and the eye movement signals; and (4) obtaining a face feature preference ranking based on a preference ranking result of the electroencephalogram signals and the eye movement signals, and then selecting friendly face features to be combined into the face of the humanoid robot. On the basis of the method, the face of the humanoid robot preferred by the user can be designed, the user can generate comfortable emotion and does not generate the conflict feeling during man-machine interaction, and therefore good user experience is obtained, and humanoid robots are promoted to enter the public.

title: Series-parallel lower limb mechanism simulating walking of two feet of human
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and discloses a humanoid biped walking hybrid mechanism which comprises a crotch, thighs, shanks and feet. And the crotch part is positioned at the uppermost part of the mechanism and is horizontally placed. Hip joints are arranged on two sides and sequentially connected with the thighs, the shanks and the feet. The robot comprises a crotch part, hip joints, thighs, shanks and feet, the hip joints, the thighs, the shanks and the feet all adopt parallel mechanisms and are driven by a direct-current motor, and double-foot walking is achieved through linkage of branch chains of the parallel mechanisms. By the adoption of the parallel mechanism, large-range rotation of all parts can be achieved through small-angle displacement of all the direct-current motors, a high-precision and large-reduction-ratio speed reducer does not need to be used, the other action is driven by three direct-current motors at the same time, and the load capacity of the mechanism can be improved.

title: Method for avoiding self-collision of foot type robot, related device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method for avoiding self-collision of a foot type robot, a related device and a storage medium, which are used for reducing the occurrence of collision between two legs when the robot is subjected to lateral disturbance and improving the stability of the robot in the advancing process. The method comprises the steps that the distance between the foot end of a first leg and a second leg of the robot is updated; judging whether the distance is smaller than or equal to a first distance; if yes, repulsive force is applied to the first leg through a power module of the first leg, so that the distance between the foot end of the first leg and the second leg is larger than a second distance.

title: HUMANOID GAIT CONTROL METHOD, DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM OF HUMANOID ROBOTS
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid gait control method, device, apparatus and storage medium of humanoid robots. The method includes: obtaining a first vector from a virtual centroid to an ankle joint of a left leg of the humanoid robot at a current moment and a second vector from the virtual centroid to an ankle joint of a right leg at the current moment, and obtaining an original planning value of the virtual centroid of the current moment of the humanoid robot; determining a height of the target virtual centroid of the humanoid robot after the virtual centroid is reduced at the current moment according to the first vector, the second vector, the original planning value of the virtual centroid and a preset virtual centroid height reduction algorithm; and controlling the humanoid robot to walk on straight knees according to the height of the target virtual centroid.

title: Biped robot and leg damping and energy recovery device thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot and a leg damping and energy recovery device thereof, and relates to the technical field of robots. An energy recovery mechanism comprises a left foot assembly, a right foot assembly, a magnetic wire cutting coil and a coil driving assembly, energy recovery magnets are arranged on the two opposite inner side faces of an annular base of the left foot assembly and the right foot assembly, the coil driving assembly is rotationally connected to the inner bottom of the annular base, and the magnetic wire cutting coil is clamped to the top of the coil driving assembly; transmission structures are engaged with the surfaces of the tooth columns of the left and right foot assemblies and used for driving the coil driving assemblies to rotate. When the biped robot walks, the vibration of the feet drives the tooth columns to move up and down, under the cooperation of the tooth columns and the second transmission gear and the cooperation of the first transmission gear and the gear ring, forward and reverse rotation of the coil driving assembly is achieved, and magnetic induction lines are cut by the magnetic line cutting coil; vibration energy of walking of the biped robot is effectively converted into electric energy to be stored for the robot to use.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom humanoid variable-rigidity wrist joint based on rope transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robot joints, and particularly discloses a three-degree-of-freedom humanoid variable-rigidity wrist joint based on rope transmission, which comprises a rope transmission assembly and a wrist rotating assembly, in the rope transmission assembly, a variable-rigidity plate comprises four variable-rigidity modules, and each variable-rigidity module comprises a motor fixing frame, a small plastic-coated bearing, a large plastic-coated bearing and a steel wire rope and is used for achieving variable-rigidity movement of the steel wire rope; one motor in the power transmission plate pulls the two steel wire ropes on one diagonal line, and the other motor pulls the two steel wire ropes on the other diagonal line; an artificial hand interface upper plate in the two-plate U-shaped hinge plate is mounted on an artificial hand interface lower plate through a universal joint; the upper end of the steel wire rope penetrates through the artificial hand connector lower plate and then is fixed to the artificial hand connector upper plate, and the steel wire rope can drive the artificial hand connector upper plate to move in two directions relative to the lower plate. The wrist rotating assembly is used for driving the rope transmission assembly to rotate. Three-degree-of-freedom movement of the wrist joint can be achieved, and free rigidity change can be achieved at any moment during movement.

title: Universal joint, leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a universal joint, a leg structure and a humanoid robot. The universal joint comprises a linkage shaft, a rotating part and an adapter, the rotating part is connected to the linkage shaft in a sleeving mode and can rotate relative to the linkage shaft, shaft necks are further arranged on the two opposite sides of the rotating part, the two shaft necks are oppositely arranged, and the central axis of the two shaft necks is perpendicular to the central axis of the linkage shaft. The adapter comprises a connecting part and two adapter parts which are formed by vertically extending from the two opposite ends of the connecting part respectively, the two adapter parts are connected with the two shaft necks in a sleeving mode respectively, and the adapter and the rotating part can rotate relative to each other. Compared with the prior art, the universal joint has the advantages that the structure is obviously simplified, the occupied space of the universal joint is small, and the required variable-angle space is small, so that the universal joint can adapt to the narrow design space of the humanoid robot, and the universal joint can not be damaged even in the narrow design space of the humanoid robot. Angle-variable movement and state adjustment can be flexibly achieved between the adapter and the linkage shaft of the universal joint within a large range.

title: Wheel type biped robot

title: Actuator for driving facial experssion of robot
abstract: An actuator for driving a facial expression of a robot is provided. abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of automatic meal delivery robots, in particular to a humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot which comprises a meal delivery robot body, a supporting frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the meal delivery robot body, a heat preservation box is arranged at the bottom of the supporting frame, and side frames are fixedly connected to the two sides of the heat preservation box. title: Intelligent bionic double-foot inspection robot
abstract: The invention, which relates to the field of factory intelligent management, discloses an intelligent bionic biped inspection robot comprising a background control module, a target determination module, a route determination module and a walking navigation module. The target determination module is used for receiving an inspection instruction issued by the control center, analyzing the inspection instruction to obtain a to-be-inspected area, and determining walking routes of the inspection robot advancing from the current position to the to-be-inspected area and inspection areas where the walking routes need to pass according to the to-be-inspected area obtained through analysis; the route determination module is used for obtaining the determined walking routes and sequentially judging the inspection states of the inspection areas needing to pass through in the walking routes. According to the invention, ordered navigation when the inspection robot walks to the to-be-inspected area can be realized, and the inspection robot does not interfere with the inspection robots working in other inspection areas in the walking process.

title: Six-axis arm structure of simulation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a six-axis arm structure of a simulation robot, which realizes multi-degree-of-freedom rotation, designs corresponding matching connection modes for each joint according to different requirements, reduces the size of the joint part, lays a foundation for the overall miniaturization design, enables the appearance of the whole robot arm to be more similar to that of a human arm, and improves the reliability of the robot arm. Almost all actions which can be achieved by real human arms can be realized; and each joint position adopts a middle connecting and fixing mode, so that the central positions of all parts can be kept consistent as much as possible, the overall size is reduced, and the overall appearance is improved. According to the invention, the problems of space waste, unreasonable structure and low simulation degree of the arm design of the existing simulation machine are solved.

title: Bionic multi-degree-of-freedom adjustable exoskeleton robot hip joint mechanical structure
abstract: The invention provides a bionic multi-degree-of-freedom adjustable exoskeleton robot hip joint mechanical structure which is characterized in that a back plate is connected with the back of a human body; the thigh support is connected with the thigh of a human body; the first hip connecting rod is rotatably mounted on the back plate along a first rotating axis, and a set included angle is formed between the first rotating axis and the horizontal plane; the second hip connecting rod is rotatably mounted on the first hip connecting rod along a second rotating axis; the included angle between the second rotation axis and the first rotation axis and far away from the back plate is an acute angle; the driving unit is mounted on the second hip connecting rod; the output end of the driving unit is connected with the thigh support and used for driving the thigh support to rotate along a third rotation axis, and the third rotation axis is perpendicular to the second rotation axis. By means of the structure, the hip and thighs of the human body can stretch inwards and stretch outwards, bend forwards and stretch backwards and rotate inwards and outwards, the coordination between the hip joints and the human body is improved, and the falling feeling of the waist or the back is relieved.

title: Dynamic footprint set generation method, biped robot using the same, and computer readable storage medium
abstract: A dynamic footprint set generation method, a biped robot using die same, and a computer readable storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining preset footprint calculation parameters; calculating a landing point position based on the preset footprint calculation parameters; determining a landing point range based on a landing point position, and performing a collision detection on the landing point range; recording the corresponding landing point position in a footprint set in response to the detection result representing there being no collision; obtaining a preset adjustment amplitude to update a preset displacement angle after the recording is completed; and returning to the calculating the landing point position until the footprint set is generated. By continuously adjusting the preset displacement angle, each landing point position is calculated accordingly, and the valid landing point positions are recorded in the footprint set, which provides more feasible landing points for navigation planning.

abstract: A humanoid robot control method, a mobile machine using the same, and a computer readable storage medium are provided. title: Robot gait optimization method
abstract: In order to improve the stability control effect of biped robots in a cooperative state, the invention provides a robot gait optimization method which is used for optimizing the gait of a first biped robot. Comprising the steps that a neural network model is established based on a nerve cell layer, gait data, obtained by a gait measuring device, of a first biped robot are used for training, and gait balance of the first biped robot is trained; and optimizing the gait of the first biped robot according to the balance result and the gait data of the second biped robot. According to the biped robot, the training depth of the gait control model can be improved based on experience data of the biped robot or other biped robots, and the biped robot can effectively cooperate with other biped robots to achieve experience sharing of the biped robots; therefore, the effects of jointly carrying the same goods and quickly adapting to a new environment so as to give more important tasks with enough running time and the like are achieved.

title: Biped robot with multiple motion modes
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot with multiple motion modes, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and is characterized by comprising a four-curved-bar mechanical leg mechanism, a machine body box body, a leg box body, a coaxial transmission system, a hinge gear transmission system and a power motor, the coaxial transmission system is output by a power motor and decelerated to an inner sleeve shaft and an outer sleeve shaft through a synchronous belt, and two curved bars of the four-curved-bar mechanical leg are respectively connected with the inner sleeve shaft and the outer sleeve shaft in the coaxial transmission system and are fixed on a leg box body; a lower plate of the machine body is connected with a lower plate of the leg box body through a hinge gear transmission system, and output of a power motor at the machine body is reduced to a hinge sleeve at the leg box body through transmission of a pair of gears; the number of the power motors is six. The leg motor is controlled to drive the four-crank-lever mechanical leg mechanism to generate structural deformation, and the motor at the machine body is controlled to realize rotation and swing of the leg box body. By coordinating and controlling the six motors, the biped robot can achieve wheel, foot and claw type movement and conversion and left-right walking movement.

title: Walking robot
abstract: A walkable robot includes a main body, a walking mechanism coupled to the main body and supporting the main body; the walking mechanism comprises a first leg mechanism and a second leg mechanism, the first leg mechanism is operably coupled to the main body through a first main joint and can rotate around the first main joint relative to the main body, and the second leg mechanism is operably coupled to the second main joint relative to the main body. title: Standing pose adjusting method and system for foot type inspection robot
abstract: The invention provides a standing pose adjusting method and system for a foot type inspection robot. The standing pose adjusting method comprises the steps that pose information and geometric information of the foot type inspection robot after standing stably are obtained; obtaining an initial coordinate of the foot end in a shoulder joint coordinate system according to the obtained attitude information and geometric information; new coordinates of the foot ends in a shoulder joint coordinate system are obtained by combining the initial coordinates, the body posture adjustment amount and the distance between the left foot and the right foot, and posture adjustment is conducted according to the new coordinates; the position precision and the angle precision of final standing are improved through in-situ trunk translation and in-situ trunk torsion after standing is stable.

title: Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot head expression control system
abstract: The invention discloses a Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot head expression control system. The system comprises an expression information input module, an expression library, a decoding module, an action smoothing algorithm module, an execution module and an expression state feedback module. Expression information is input through the expression information input module, a corresponding expression code is inquired in the expression library, the expression code is extracted from the expression library and decoded through the decoding module, and a decoded code stream is output to the action smoothing algorithm module for smoothing the expression action. And outputting the smoothed data to an execution module to execute an executor, and feeding back the expression state through the expression state feedback module during execution. The invention provides a Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot head expression control system. The Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot head expression control system solves the problem that there is no Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot head expression control system in the prior art so as to make up the technical blank.

title: Whole-body motion planning and control method for double-wheel leg-arm robot
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body motion planning and control method for a double-wheel leg-arm robot, provides a multi-task space planning method based on hierarchical optimization aiming at the collaborative motion of a trunk and arms of the double-wheel leg-arm robot and the force output requirement of the tail ends of the arms, and solves the problem of whole-body motion planning redundancy. Wheel leg-trunk-arm force transmission is analyzed based on a two-stage table-trolley model, and arm movement and operation virtual generalized force is incorporated into trunk generalized force planning in a feedforward compensation mode. Left and right wheel leg force distribution characteristics are analyzed, a self-balancing whole-body torque controller based on quadratic programming is provided through construction, nonlinear constraints of all layers are dominated, and therefore the wheel leg torque meeting the whole-body dynamic balance is calculated and obtained. The wheel leg posture generated by applying the torque can keep the double-wheel leg-arm robot at a dynamic balance point, and the dynamic stability of movement operation is improved.

title: DISEASE JUDMENT AND HUMAN CARE ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to a disease-judging human-care robot, and more particularly, to a disease-judging human-care robot which is a robot equipped with voice recognition and motion detection functions, is free to move, and can perform silver care for elderly people living alone with a built-in health management function by measuring health conditions such as a urine test, blood sugar measurement, blood pressure measurement, body temperature measurement, and weight measurement. It relates to a disease-judging human-care robot having a function of finding a solution and prescribing when the exact name of a disease is unknown or when suffering from a rare disease not only at home but also in medical institutions.

title: Double-arm structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot double-arm structure which comprises a driving robot, an arm body is arranged on the driving robot, a connecting plate is arranged at the end, away from the driving robot, of the arm body, an installing plate used for installing a mechanical claw is arranged on one side of the connecting plate, and a supporting frame is arranged on the end face of one side of the connecting plate. title: Multi-modal expression control method and device for bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode expression control method and device for a bionic robot. The method comprises the steps that audio features and text features are extracted from dialogue data of a user; constructing an emotion list and an expression list which are mutually mapped by adopting the audio features and the text features; acquiring a facial expression image of a user in real time, and determining an emotion category label of the user based on an expression action of the facial expression image; and searching a corresponding expression control tag and a corresponding expression control category from the expression list based on the emotion category tag, and controlling the bionic robot to execute the expression control category and the expression control tag to execute expression actions. According to the method and the device, the mapping relationship between the emotion and the expression can be constructed by utilizing the voice data of the user, and the corresponding facial expression can be displayed to the user based on the emotion of the user when the speaking emotion of the user is determined, so that the accuracy of matching the facial expression and the use experience of the user are improved.

title: In-situ self-growth forming method of curvature surface adhesion structure
abstract: An in-situ self-growth forming method of a curvature surface adhesion structure comprises the steps that firstly, an upper pole plate is prepared and treated, then, a lower pole plate and a forming polymer material are prepared and treated, conformal rheoforming of the adhesion structure is induced by an electric field, the upper pole plate makes contact with the lower pole plate through a dielectric support, an external direct-current power source is applied, and the adhesion structure is formed. Enabling the electric field force applied to the polymer film to overcome surface tension and viscous resistance to flow, growing an array microstructure according to the most unstable wavelength, after the array microstructure is in contact with the dielectric layer, generating an electrowetting phenomenon, and keeping a stable voltage until the array microstructure wets and flows into a mushroom shape with a brim; and finally, curing and demolding the polymer to obtain an adhesion structure which is conformal with the curved target surface of the upper pole plate. The contact and adhesion effects on the surface of a curved target are improved, the machining efficiency is improved, and the device can be applied to picking and attachment increasing of a humanoid dexterous hand, space grabbing, picking and transferring of precise curved devices and the like.

title: Balance compensation structure for ankle joint of biped walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped walking robot ankle joint balance compensation structure which comprises two telescopic units which are oppositely arranged, the two telescopic units are symmetrically arranged on the two opposite sides of a foot sole assembly with the center axis of the foot sole assembly as the symmetry axis of the foot sole assembly, and each telescopic unit comprises a lower base hinged to one side of the foot sole assembly and an upper base hinged to the other side of the foot sole assembly; a first guide sleeve which is vertically arranged is mounted at the upper part of the lower base; the lower end of the spiral spring is movably inserted into the first guide sleeve and is fixedly connected to the lower base; the upper base is arranged above the lower base and hinged to one side of the lower end of the shank assembly, a second guide sleeve is installed on the lower portion of the upper base, the second guide sleeve and the first guide sleeve are coaxially arranged, and the upper end of the spiral spring is movably inserted into the second guide sleeve and fixedly connected to the upper base. The problem that an existing biped walking robot is poor in instantaneous adaptability under complex road conditions is solved.

abstract: The invention belongs to the field of automatic tea fermentation processes, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot for a fermented tea production line and a full-automatic tea fermentation process.The humanoid robot for the fermented tea production line comprises a movable base, a material box translation mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a mechanical arm, a sensing device, a spraying device and a control system; the mobile operation robot is adopted to perform'humanoid 'operation, and is matched with an automatic production line system to meet the requirements of the fermented tea processing technology, so that the intelligent mobile robot which can perform'humanoid' operation and has the function of integrating the fermented tea processing technology is realized, automatic and unmanned operation can be performed in the fermented tea processing process, manual operation is completely replaced, and the production efficiency is improved. title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid driven humanoid robot lower limb mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an electro-hydraulic hybrid driven humanoid robot lower limb mechanism which comprises a pelvic bone mechanism and two symmetrical leg structures, each leg structure comprises a foot mechanism, an ankle joint mechanism, a shank part, a knee joint mechanism, a thigh part and a hip joint mechanism, and the upper end of each thigh part is connected with the pelvic bone mechanism through the corresponding hip joint mechanism. The lower end of the thigh part is connected with the upper end of the shank part through the knee joint mechanism, and the lower end of the shank part is connected with the foot mechanism through the ankle joint mechanism. The leg structure of the humanoid robot is light and flexible, the power density of the robot is improved, meanwhile, the operation efficiency of the robot is enhanced, and the working time of the robot is prolonged.

title: Humanoid robot high-dynamic motion mass center compliance control method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot high-dynamic motion centroid compliance control method, which comprises the following steps: designing a feedback controller based on a linear quadratic regulator, and calculating the compensation amount of the second-order derivative of the centroid momentum; integrating the compensation quantity of the second-order derivative of the mass center momentum to obtain the compensation quantity of the mass center position and the momentum, superposing the compensation quantity of the mass center position and the momentum to the expected mass center position and the momentum, updating the expected trajectory, and sending the solved joint trajectory to the robot for execution. According to the method, the compensation amount of the second derivative of the centroid momentum is calculated, the feedback coefficient required by compliance control is obtained, and the time for adjusting the feedback coefficient is effectively shortened; the variable quantities of the line momentum and the angular momentum of the mass center are considered at the same time, compliant control over the mass center in the moving direction and the rotating direction is achieved, and the stability of high-dynamic motion of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot which comprises a robot body, a robot base is arranged at the bottom end of the robot body, a meal placing groove is formed in the middle of the robot body, and a meal placing plate is installed in the meal placing groove. The dining table can move along the sliding rails in the dining groove, dinner plates can be conveniently pushed out, diners can take meals conveniently, the dining plate is convenient to disassemble and assemble, the interior of the dining groove can be cleaned conveniently, and the interior of the dining groove can be kept sanitary and clean. The heating ring is used for heating some cold dishes, so that the dishes are kept in a warm state, and eating is facilitated; and the interior of the meal placing groove is sterilized and disinfected through the ultraviolet lamp, and the opening of the meal placing groove is shielded through the check curtain, so that the interior of the meal placing groove is kept sanitary. The surfaces of the rollers are sleeved with the anti-skid sleeves, so that the rollers can stably move in the restaurant.

abstract: An intelligent humanoid robot capable of independently making decisions in order to provide an intelligent system capable of executing various functions effectively and promptly, and designed to talk to humans while recognizing obstacles ahead and along directions and therefore making decisions accordingly, together with additional functions of the speech recognition module together with the EMIC-2 text-to-speech converter module, which makes the robot interactive.

title: Intelligent drum set playing robot
abstract: An intelligent drum set playing robot adopts a humanoid design, is arranged on an electric lifting seat, and comprises a driving mechanism, an input mechanism and a control mechanism, the control mechanism comprises a main controller and an auxiliary controller, the input end of the main controller is connected with the input mechanism, the output end is connected with the auxiliary controller, and the auxiliary controller is connected with the driving mechanism; the input mechanism comprises a microphone and a camera, the microphone is used for converting external drumbeat signals into internal electric signals and transmitting the internal electric signals to the main controller for analysis and classification, and the camera is used for collecting visual signals by identifying drumbeats on a standard paper spectrum and sending the visual signals to the main controller; the visual signal is converted into an electric signal to be transmitted to the main controller for analysis and classification; the driving mechanism comprises joint moving structures of the hands, the arms, the head and the legs, the joint moving structures are controlled through a steering engine, the steering engine is connected with an auxiliary controller, and the auxiliary controller is used for controlling the steering engine to act by receiving instructions of the main controller so as to implement playing operation.

title: Intelligent Chinese zither playing robot
abstract: An intelligent Chinese zither playing robot is in humanoid design and comprises a driving mechanism, a scanning mechanism, a voice mechanism and a control mechanism, the control mechanism comprises a main controller and an auxiliary controller, the main controller is connected with the scanning mechanism, the voice mechanism and the auxiliary controller, and the auxiliary controller is connected with the driving mechanism; the scanning mechanism comprises double cameras at the eyes of the robot, collects visual signals by identifying a music score on a standard paper score, converts the visual signals into electric signals and transmits the electric signals to the main controller for analysis; the voice mechanism comprises microphones arranged in the ears of the robot and a sound production device arranged in the mouth of the robot, and the microphones are used for converting external sound signals into internal electric signals and transmitting the internal electric signals to the main controller for analysis; the driving mechanism comprises joint moving structures of elbow joints, wrist joints and finger joints, the joint moving structures are controlled through a steering engine, the steering engine is connected with an auxiliary controller, and the auxiliary controller is used for controlling the steering engine to act by receiving an instruction of the main controller so as to implement playing operation.

title: Anti-falling accompanying robot
abstract: The anti-falling accompanying robot comprises a robot body with a head, a trunk and four limbs, the head is arranged at the upper end of the robot body, a display screen is arranged on the front side of the head, and handrails are arranged on the left side and the right side of the head; a drawing type storage box is arranged on the front side of the trunk; a folding stool mechanism is arranged at the free end of the upper limb in the four limbs and is used for a user to sit; walking wheels are arranged on the lower limbs of the four limbs; wherein a power supply module is arranged in the main body, and the power supply module is electrically connected with the display screen; the head, the trunk and the four limbs are movably connected. The robot is high in practicability and functionality and can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Lightweight humanoid musculoskeletal mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, and provides a lightweight humanoid musculoskeletal mechanical arm which comprises a base, a driver module, a sensing information acquisition module, an artificial muscle unit assembly and an arm assembly, and the driver module is arranged on the base; the sensing information acquisition module is arranged on the base and is electrically connected with the driver module; the artificial muscle unit assembly is arranged on the base and is connected with the driver module, so that the driver module transmits a signal to the artificial muscle unit assembly; one end of the arm assembly is movably connected with the base and is in transmission connection with the artificial muscle unit assembly through a pipeline transmission structure; wherein the artificial muscle unit assembly drives the arm assembly to act through the pipeline transmission structure. The invention aims to provide a musculoskeletal arm hardware platform simulating the human upper limbs, which has flexibility and safety.

title: CONTROL METHOD, PROGRAM, AND ROBOT
abstract: The present invention provides a robot acquiring a moving speed of a user via at least one optical sensor, acquiring, via a biological sensor monitoring biological information of the user, a first measurement value varying in correlation to the level of fatigue caused by walking or running of the user, and when the first measurement value of the biological information of the user exceeds a first threshold, controlling an actuator to reduce a movement speed of the robot from a first speed to a second speed slower than the moving speed of the user.

title: Humanoid arm
abstract: According to the humanoid arm, human arm joints are highly imitated through seven-degree-of-freedom series-connection humanoid mechanical arms, the degree of freedom key similar to that of the human arm can be achieved, and then the seven-axis mechanical arms are controlled through hand-eye coordination of a depth camera and a control system to highly imitate actions of the human arm to grab a target object. According to the humanoid arm, the structure of a human arm is highly simulated in structure, the grabbing action of the human arm can be highly simulated in action, and in addition, a moving path can be planned in real time to avoid obstacles so as to accurately, rapidly and efficiently reach the position beside a target object for grabbing. The problem that an arm structure of an existing robot is not high in simulation degree is solved.

title: Tensioning integral type bionic shoulder joint system and motion trail planning method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a tension integral type bionic shoulder joint system and a motion trail planning method thereof. The system comprises a bottom plate, a fixed platform, a movable platform, an active tension unit, a passive tension rope unit, a flexible tension spring unit, a plurality of groups of driving units and a control unit. The bionic shoulder joint component and the passive tension rope unit are integrally of a Y-shaped structure, the fixed platform and the control unit are fixed to the bottom plate, and the movable platform and the fixed platform are connected through the active tension unit, the passive tension rope unit and the flexible tension spring unit. The control unit controls the multiple sets of driving units to achieve abduction and adduction, anteflexion and posterior extension and extorsion and intorsion movement of the bionic shoulder joint by planning the movement track. Aiming at the defects that a traditional structure is large in mass, complex in structure, poor in flexibility and the like, the morphological structure of the shoulder joint and the tensegrity structure are organically fused, the bionic shoulder joint system with adaptability and flexibility is obtained through bionic mapping, and the bionic shoulder joint system is compact in structure, convenient to control and widely applied to humanoid robot joints.

title: Hybrid-driven whole-body exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hybrid-driven whole-body exoskeleton robot which comprises lower limb assistance systems, upper limb cooperation assistance systems and a back structure, the lower limb assistance systems, the upper limb cooperation assistance systems and the back structure are all of a bilateral symmetry structure, and the two upper limb cooperation assistance systems are installed on the two sides of the upper end of the back structure correspondingly. The two lower limb assistance systems are installed on the two sides of the lower end of the back structure correspondingly, the upper limb cooperation assistance system comprises a three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint and a tail end executing mechanism, and the tail end executing mechanism is fixedly installed at the tail end of the three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint and controlled and driven by the three-degree-of-freedom spherical parallel joint. The lower limb assisting system comprises knee joints, hip joints and ankle joints, the upper ends of the knee joints are hinged to the hip joints, the lower ends of the knee joints are hinged to the ankle joints, and the ankle joints are fixedly connected with the foot wearing device. The robot has the heavy load power assisting capacity and the cooperative operation capacity at the same time, and the upper limbs, the hip joints and the knee joints select different driving modes to achieve efficient driving.

title: Biped robot walking stability optimization method based on improved PPO algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking stability optimization method based on an improved PPO algorithm, and the method specifically comprises the steps: introducing long and short-term memory into a neural network, selectively reserving the sample information of a previous stage to fit the prediction of a subsequent sample, adding an attention mechanism into an action network, and carrying out the dynamic self-adaptive weighting of an input feature, thereby achieving the optimization of the walking stability of a biped robot. The variable weight dependence of the state information of different time steps on subsequently taken actions is fitted, an improved PPO algorithm is obtained, and the walking control problem of the biped robot in different environments can be solved, including parameter adjustment of simulation training and stability of walking motion. The walking environment of the simulation robot is a Bipedalwalker-v3 environment in a Gym (Gym) developed by Open AI (Artificial Intelligence); the pre-training control parameters are trained and adjusted by using an improved PPO algorithm; the walking movement stability of the biped robot is achieved through a trained controller.

title: Mouth mechanism of humanoid expression robot
abstract: The invention discloses a mouth mechanism of a humanoid expression robot, which is characterized by comprising a top plate and a lower jaw plate which are transversely arranged, top support plates which are arranged opposite to each other are arranged below two sides of the width of the top plate, and the lower jaw plate comprises two jaw support plates which are arranged opposite to each other and coaxially hinged to the two top support plates; the lower ends of the two jaw support plates are connected with a jaw bottom plate; a jaw movement motor is further mounted on the top support plate, and an output shaft of the jaw movement motor is coaxially connected with a rotating shaft of the jaw support plate; a lower lip assembly is arranged at the front end of the jaw bottom plate, and an upper lip assembly corresponding to the lower lip assembly is arranged at the front end of the top plate. The device has the advantages of ingenious structure, high space utilization rate, capability of simulating mouth actions and the like.

title: Wearable Robot Having Structure To Minimize Acceleration Impact
abstract: A wearable robot including an acceleration impact minimization structure is disclosed. A wearable robot according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a suit in the form of clothing provided with a plurality of bending joints at positions corresponding to a wearer's joints; a joint driving unit built into the bending joints and driven according to a control signal from a control unit; an inner motion detection unit which is mounted on the inner surface of the suit, has a structure in direct contact with the wearer's body, is spaced apart from the inner surface of the suit by a predetermined length by the first elastic restoring member mounted on the inner surface of the suit, and changes the separation distance from the inner surface of the suit according to the motion of the wearer's body; an outer motion detection unit which is mounted on the outer surface of the suit and has a structure in direct contact with an external object, and in which a separation distance with the outer surface of the chute is changed according to contact pressure of an external object; and a control unit mounted inside the suit and controlling an operation of the joint driving unit based on data acquired through the inner motion detection unit and the outer motion detection unit. It is possible to reduce dependence on mechanical systems.

title: Foot buffering device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a foot buffering device of a humanoid robot. The upper portion of a toe-metatarsal joint component is rotationally connected with one end of a foot back plate spring. The metatarsophalangeal joint component is rotatably connected with one end of the metatarsal bone connecting rod The scaphoid bone block is fixedly connected with the other end of the foot back plate spring and is rotatably connected with the other end of the metatarsal bone connecting rod; the foot back plate spring is arranged on the upper portion of the metatarsal bone connecting rod in parallel. The calcaneus part is rotatably connected with the scaphoid block through two groups of calcaneus connecting rods; the two ends of the arch spring damper are hinged to the calcaneus component and the metatarsal bone connecting rod respectively. The device imitates the physiological structure of the foot of a person and is of an arch-shaped structure; the foot arch spring damper and the foot back plate spring are arranged, and the buffering effect is achieved through the foot linkage relation and the tension effect of the two springs; and three different rigidity states are provided for foot landing, so that the energy efficiency is improved, and the device adapts to complex terrains.

title: Robot telescopic swing mechanism and bionic robot
abstract: The invention aims to provide the robot telescopic swing mechanism and the bionic robot to solve the technical problem that two arms of a bionic robot in the prior art can only swing in the same plane, so that the application range of the bionic robot is small. The bionic robot comprises a clamping jaw and further comprises a robot telescopic swing mechanism for driving the clamping jaw to adjust different poses, the robot telescopic swing mechanism comprises a first telescopic arm and a second telescopic arm, each telescopic arm comprises a base, and two driving telescopic rods are fixed to each base. Each driving telescopic rod comprises a fixed rod fixed to the base, a movable rod movably matched with the fixed rod in a guiding mode and a telescopic driving mechanism driving the movable rod to move, the first telescopic arm further comprises a first telescopic connecting rod, and the second telescopic arm further comprises a second telescopic connecting rod. And the first telescopic connecting rod and the second telescopic connecting rod are in running fit, and a rotation driving mechanism is arranged at the running fit position, so that the first telescopic arm and the second telescopic arm can rotate relatively.

title: Shaft-driven three-degree-of-freedom wheel foot walking mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to a shaft-driven three-degree-of-freedom wheel foot walking mechanism. Three degrees of freedom of legs comprise a forward swing joint degree of freedom, a lateral extension joint degree of freedom and a knee joint degree of freedom. Knee joint motors are integrated in a robot trunk mainly through connecting rod mechanisms, and wheel motors are integrated at the upper ends of thighs through transmission shafts. Rotational inertia generated when the wheel foot mechanism moves is reduced, and the maneuvering performance of the wheel foot mechanism is improved. Compared with a wheel edge motor, the wheel foot mechanism has the advantages of light weight of a moving end, small rotational inertia, small motor load, low control difficulty and the like, so that the performance requirement and the use burden of a joint motor can be greatly reduced by shaft transmission, and the overall reliability of the wheel foot mechanism is improved.

title: Bionic biped robot and stable gait planning method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a bionic biped robot and a stable gait planning method thereof. The robot is composed of an electromechanical control box, two mechanical legs with three degrees of freedom and a joint yaw assembly. The joint yaw assembly controls steering motion of the robot. Each mechanical leg comprises a thigh part, a shank part and a buffer hoof foot; the thigh part adopts a quadrilateral serial mechanism, and a hip joint rolling motor, a hip joint pitching motor and a knee joint pitching motor are arranged at the hip joint; the shank adopts a light carbon fiber structure and is passively controlled; the buffering hoof foot is designed by referring to the characteristics of hoof walking type biological feet. And the robot is simplified into a spring-load inverted pendulum model for kinetic analysis and gait planning, the gait stability is evaluated by adopting a method of combining a Poincare cross section and attraction domain characteristics, the optimal parameters of the stable gait are obtained, and the robustness of the robot in the motion state is ensured. The robot has the characteristics of flexible walking, quick response, high efficiency and energy conservation.

title: Modularized motion control system of leg-foot type bionic robot
abstract: The invention relates to a modular motion control system of a leg-foot type bionic robot, and belongs to the technical field of leg-foot type bionic robots. The system comprises a geometry and quality characteristic module, a toe trajectory planning module, a phase sequence gait planning module, a single-leg control module and a force position PD control module, wherein the single-leg control module comprises a forward and inverse kinematics calculation module, a dynamics module and the like. According to the invention, functions of motion control are divided, and divided function modularization is developed, so that integral non-strong coupling integration is realized; according to the method, top-down planning control, single-point development, integration among modules, collaborative hierarchical research and development and testing of the system and efficient and high-reliability research and development of loose coupling and process motion collaboration of the leg-foot type bionic robot motion control software are realized, and the development and testing efficiency of the leg-foot type bionic robot motion control software is improved.

title: Tendon rope under-actuated humanoid multi-fingered dexterous hand device
abstract: The invention provides a tendon rope underactuated humanoid multi-fingered dexterous hand device, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. Comprising a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger, a palm base, a palm cover plate and a palm wire arranging device. Wherein the relative positions of the five fingers and the palm imitate the relative positions of the fingers and the palm of a human hand; the middle finger and the index finger have the same structure and size, and the middle finger is fixedly connected with the palm skeleton in the same connection mode as the index finger; the little finger and the ring finger are the same in structure and size, the little finger is fixedly connected with the palm framework, and the connection mode is consistent with that of the ring finger. The underactuated form of the humanoid multi-fingered dexterous hand device enables the whole structure to be simple and efficient, the mechanical characteristic enables fingers to automatically adapt to the shape of an object, and the humanoid multi-fingered dexterous hand device has good shape adaptability and good external impact resistance flexibility; the driver with large mass can be far away from the end executing mechanism, the inertia of the end executing mechanism is reduced through reasonable arrangement, and the dynamic performance is improved; and the background and requirements of bionic design are met.

title: Humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid manipulator, and relates to the technical field of manipulators. According to the humanoid manipulator, a plurality of palm touch sensors are arranged on a palm plate; a main control panel is arranged in the core mounting plate, and a plurality of sensors used for detecting the attitude angle, the acceleration, the temperature and the current of the humanoid manipulator respectively are arranged on the main control panel; the fingers comprise four fingers and a thumb, the four fingers are modularized under-actuated fingers, and the thumb is a full-drive finger; the far knuckles, the middle knuckles and the near knuckles of the four fingers are each provided with a plurality of four-finger touch sensors, and the metacarpophalangeal joints and the far interphalangeal joints of the four fingers are each provided with a position sensor. A plurality of thumb touch sensors are respectively arranged on the far knuckles and the near knuckles of the thumb, and position sensors are respectively arranged on the carpal joint and the distal interphalangeal joint of the thumb. The sensing ability, the flexibility and the integration degree of the humanoid manipulator are effectively improved, the installation, maintenance and replacement cost is effectively reduced, and meanwhile the installation and maintenance difficulty is reduced.

title: Human body skill learning method and system for outer limb grasping control
abstract: The invention provides a human body skill learning method and system for outer limb grasping control. The method comprises the steps that posture information and motion information in the human body arm grasping process are acquired, and a motion track is generated; a control model of human arm movement and outer limb movement is established based on teaching learning, and the outer limb simulates the movement track of the human arm through the control model; tactile information in the outer limb grasping process is obtained and fed back to the human arm, and the human arm adjusts the grasping posture according to the tactile information fed back by the outer limb; a plurality of motion tracks generated in the human arm grasping process are learned to obtain a learning track, and the learning track and corresponding posture information are sent to an outer limb, so that the outer limb can adapt to environment change.

title: Biped robot leg suspension structure
abstract: The utility model particularly relates to a biped robot leg suspension structure which comprises a suspension frame and a platform, the platform is arranged at the top of the suspension frame, the suspension frame is a frame body of a hollow structure, the interior of the frame body of the suspension frame is hollow, and the left end and the right end of the suspension frame extend to form suspension parts respectively. The suspension device is used for suspending and connecting hip joints or/and legs of the biped robot. According to the utility model, the suspension frame with the hollow structure and the hollow interior is adopted, the suspension frame has the structural advantages of high strength and light weight, the three-dimensional frame structure forms triangular support, the rigidity is enhanced on the basis of the fewest materials, the space of the frame structure is flexible, and objects such as electric wires of a motor can pass through the hollow space. The problems that a leg hanging support of an existing biped robot is too large and heavy, so that the whole robot faces huge burden, a motor needs to use higher power, the endurance is reduced due to excessive electricity consumption, and harm is more serious when the robot falls down are solved.

title: Expression recognition and simulation system based on network reasoning and motor driving
abstract: The invention provides an expression recognition and simulation system based on network reasoning and motor driving, which comprises a visual module, a control module, a reasoning module and a driving module, and is characterized in that the visual module collects face information and transmits the face information to the control module, and the control module controls the reasoning module to recognize the face information and obtain corresponding micro expression features; the control module controls the driving module to perform simulation expression conversion according to the micro expression features; the reasoning module is a deep learning model based on a U-Net network; the driving module comprises at least eight control groups arranged on the head of the robot. According to the application, the robot is endowed with dynamic characteristics through the expression recognition and simulation system, so that the communication between the robot and people is more natural, and the communication experience is better. The deep learning model constructed based on the U-Net network does not depend on traditional methods such as a sensor and image processing, and the dependence on a hardware system can be greatly reduced under the condition that facial expression simulation is performed by using the constructed deep learning model.

title: Wheel-foot switching mechanism and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a wheel-foot switching mechanism and a control method thereof.The wheel-foot switching mechanism comprises a transverse rolling support, an outer rotor motor, a transverse rolling motor and a direct current motor, one side of the transverse rolling support is fixedly connected with a shell of the transverse rolling motor, an output shaft of the transverse rolling motor is fixedly connected with one end of a cross shaft support, and the other end of the cross shaft support is rotationally connected with the transverse rolling support; an outer rotor motor is fixedly connected to the cross shaft support, a shell of the outer rotor motor is rotationally connected with a lead screw/worm and gear structure, the lead screw/worm and gear structure is fixedly connected with a sole push rod, the sole push rod is fixedly connected with a sole, and the lead screw/worm and gear structure is driven by a direct current motor; and the outer rotor motor is also fixedly connected with a tire hub. The humanoid robot provided with the wheel-foot switching mechanism can conduct mode switching at any time in the movement process, the switching speed is high, and the system reliability is high.

title: Mobile humanoid mushroom picking robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a mobile humanoid mushroom picking robot which comprises a mobile chassis, a lifting mechanism and picking double arms and is characterized in that structural modular design is adopted, adaptability is high, and the mobile chassis can perform real-time path planning and autonomous navigation to realize flexible operation in a narrow space of a mushroom house; the lifting mechanism can automatically ascend and descend according to the height of the mushroom bed, and the mushroom picking requirement in a factory shelf type planting mode can be met; due to the double-arm structure of the picking double arms, full-plane coverage and traversal of a mushroom bed and autonomous coordination obstacle avoidance can be achieved, and the working efficiency, fault tolerance and flexibility are improved; the mushroom picking robot can effectively meet the picking requirement that the mushroom picking robot achieves efficient and lossless picking in a narrow space under the factory mushroom planting background, and the problems that the factory labor cost is high, and the mushroom commercial value is low are solved.

title: Hand-eye-foot coordinated control mobile operation robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent mobile operation robots, and particularly relates to a hand-eye-foot coordinated control mobile operation robot which takes a visual perception system as eyes of the robot and takes a driving wheel system of a mobile body as feet of the robot. According to the operation robot, the control quantity of the moving body, the mechanical arm and the tail end executing mechanism is determined according to the weight coefficient, and when the moving body is in a moving state, the posture adjustment of the mechanical arm and the action of the tail end executing mechanism are carried out at the same time; and the tail end executing mechanism completes the operation preparation action. The mobile operation robot has the characteristics of'humanoid 'operation from a certain sense, the movement of the mobile body, the pose adjustment of the mechanical arm and the action of the end execution mechanism of the mechanical arm are synchronously carried out, the operation action is more coherent and coordinated, the operation efficiency is higher, the whole operation process is more humanoid, and the intellectualization is more fully embodied.

title: Bionic accompanying robot
abstract: The invention provides a bionic accompanying robot, and mainly relates to the technical field of robots. The robot has the beneficial effects that when the robot is used, the feet of the robot can be replaced through the foot changing mechanisms at the bottoms of the mechanical legs, the adaptability of the robot to different road conditions is improved, and the stability of the robot is improved.

title: Interaction force detection integrated joint
abstract: The invention provides an interaction force detection integrated joint. The interaction force detection integrated joint comprises a main control module, a communication module, an interaction force detection module and a joint rotating module. The main control module, the communication module and the interaction force detection module are fixed on the joint rotation module; the joint rotating module is used for connecting upper and lower limbs of the integrated joint to realize relative movement of the upper and lower limbs; the interaction force detection module is used for detecting the deformation condition of the joint rotation module; the main control module is used for processing data of the interaction force detection module and the joint rotation module; and the communication module is used for realizing communication between the main control module and the exoskeleton master control circuit, the interaction force detection module and the joint rotation module. As an active joint driving assembly of the exoskeleton robot, the motion intention of the human body is sensed, and necessary parameters are provided for motion control of the exoskeleton.

title: Obstacle detection method and system, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an obstacle detection method and system, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the three-dimensional map construction of a front region of a robot, obtaining a target three-dimensional map, and recording the current position of the robot as reference positioning information; matching the target three-dimensional map with the local part of a pre-constructed standard three-dimensional map by using the reference positioning information; planning a to-be-detected path in the target three-dimensional map by using a standard walking path planned in the target three-dimensional map in advance to obtain a target detection path; and carrying out obstacle detection on the target detection path in the standard three-dimensional map. By applying the technical scheme, real-time obstacle detection can be carried out on the front path of the biped robot, so that the biped robot can timely and correctly make a corresponding walking plan.

title: Vacuum robot foot structure and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a vacuum type robot foot structure and a robot. The vacuum type robot foot structure comprises a sole shell and an adsorption part arranged on the lower side of the sole shell. The sole shell is provided with a vacuum extraction part used for vacuumizing the adsorption part and an air inlet and outlet control part used for controlling air inlet and air outlet of the adsorption part, and the vacuum extraction part is connected with the adsorption part through the air inlet and outlet control part. By means of controllable vacuum negative pressure, balance and stability of movement of the two feet of the robot on the smooth and flat ground are achieved, the technical difficulty of balance and stability during walking of the two feet is greatly reduced, and the walking of the biped robot has feasibility and practicability in most indoor application environments.

title: Driven wheel self-locking anti-skid foot capable of being actively switched
abstract: The invention relates to a driven wheel self-locking antiskid foot capable of actively switching, which comprises a support, a driven wheel, a self-locking foot structure, a gear shifting switching structure and a drive-by-wire structure, and is mainly used for switching between roller skating type advancing and foot type advancing through a pull rope by utilizing a margin rotating angle of a side unfolding joint of a foot type robot. After the wheels are locked, the ground contact friction force of the foot ends is increased through a self-locking mechanism, and large-gradient uphill of the foot type robot is achieved. Wheel-foot switching is achieved through a mechanical device, no new driving part is introduced, the structure is simple, control is convenient, and the multi-mode walking function of the foot type robot is achieved. The trafficability of the foot-type robot on the large-gradient ground and the maneuverability of a structured road are improved, and the overall performance of the robot is improved.

title: Static path planning method, device and system based on humanoid trajectory
abstract: The invention discloses a static path planning method, device and system based on a humanoid trajectory. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring trajectory data of a manually driven vehicle; mapping the obtained starting point position and the terminal point position to a manual driving vehicle track to obtain a corresponding starting point mapping point and a terminal point mapping point so as to form a road track; according to the manual driving vehicle trajectory data and the road section trajectory, calculating boundary information of the road section trajectory and a value range of a preset driving parameter; mapping the current node to a manual driving vehicle track, generating mapping point information, and performing variable-step node diffusion based on the mapping point information by taking boundary information of a road track and a value range of a preset driving parameter as constraint conditions to obtain a diffusion node until the diffusion node is connected to a final position; the initial value of the current node is a starting point position; and connecting the diffusion nodes to obtain a smooth path. According to the invention, the environmental adaptability and rationality of path planning in a complex environment can be effectively improved.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent services, and discloses a crown seizing service robot and a non-imperative active intelligence implementation method. title: Multi-degree-of-freedom robot with two humanoid arms
abstract: The multi-degree-of-freedom robot comprises a support system, the support system comprises a supporting plate and two connecting plates, the two connecting plates are vertically installed on the left side and the right side of the supporting plate respectively, and a left arm system and a right arm system are symmetrically installed on the two connecting plates. Each of the left arm system and the right arm system comprises a first shoulder joint, a second shoulder joint, a first connecting flange, a third shoulder joint, a second connecting flange, an elbow joint, a third connecting flange, a first wrist joint, a fourth connecting flange, a second wrist joint and a fifth connecting flange; according to the device, the structure and behavior characteristics of human arms are combined, multiple sets of motors and speed reducers are controlled through the coding assembly to achieve multi-degree-of-freedom rotation of the shoulder joint, the elbow joint and the wrist joint, the high function of simulating the two arms of a human is achieved, the structure is compact, the high load capacity can be met, and the application range is wide.

title: Human-shaped agent posture generation method based on physical simulation
abstract: The invention discloses a human-shaped agent posture generation method based on physical simulation. The human-shaped agent posture generation method comprises the steps that a digital physical simulation model of a human-shaped agent is constructed with a physical simulation environment as a framework; acquiring posture change sequence data of human motion and converting the posture change sequence data into skeleton structure data; converting a joint rotation parameter of the skeleton structure data into a joint index parameter and generating model training sample data; constructing a reward function based on the target task and constructing feature input of the reverse reinforcement learning network; based on the model training sample data, training the digital physical simulation model based on the reverse reinforcement learning network to obtain the trained digital physical simulation model; and inputting the updated target task and the initial state parameter into the trained digital physical simulation model to generate state information.

title: Lightweight humanoid robot arm device based on mixing of belt transmission and rope transmission
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid mechanical arm based on rope driving. The humanoid mechanical arm based on rope driving comprises a shoulder joint, a large arm, an elbow joint, a small arm and a wrist joint. The shoulder joint is a modular serial connection mechanism, and a first module, a second module and a third module of the shoulder joint are connected pairwise through a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece respectively; the third shoulder joint module is connected with the big arm part through two first connecting plates; the big arm part is connected with the elbow part through a second big arm connecting body; the elbow joint is connected with the forearm through the forearm first connecting body; and the small arm is connected with the wrist part through a second small arm connecting body. According to the embodiment of the invention, a mode of combining belt transmission and rope transmission is adopted, and a humanoid appearance design is adopted, so that the problems of cumbersome operation and low efficiency of a humanoid mechanical arm are solved.

title: Humanoid robot control system based on auditory sense
abstract: A humanoid robot control system based on auditory sense provided by the present invention comprises a processing module, a control receiving module and an auditory sense receiving module, the output end of the auditory sense receiving module is electrically connected with the input end of an audio analysis module, and the output end of the audio analysis module is electrically connected with the input end of the processing module. The auditory receiving module comprises a wireless receiving module, a video receiving module and a voice receiving module; the output end of the control receiving module is electrically connected with a control data analysis module, and the output end of the data analysis module is electrically connected with the input end of a processing module; the output end of the remote control module is electrically connected with the input end of a processing module. According to the control receiving module, preset actions of the controller are analyzed through the control data analysis module, the analyzed actions are transmitted to the processing module again, repeated operation is carried out when the preset specified actions are achieved, continuous control is not needed, and special robots such as factory operation are not needed.

title: Ankle joint bionic control method and control module for upright balance of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an ankle joint bionic control method and control module for upright balance of a biped robot, and relates to the field of biped robot balance control. According to the ankle joint angle theta foot of the biped robot at a certain moment and the movement speed vc and acceleration ac information of the mass center of the biped robot, bionics modeling is carried out, and the ankle joint angle theta foot of the biped robot at a certain moment is obtained. The expected ankle joint acting moment tau q in the current state is obtained through calculation, and then an ankle joint driver acts to generate the expected ankle joint acting moment, so that the force exerting action of the biped robot is adjusted, and the biped robot is kept upright and balanced. On the basis of bionics, the method is established in combination with parameters of the biped robot and does not depend on the external environment where the biped robot is located, and therefore the self-adaptability and robustness of the method are guaranteed; meanwhile, instantaneous adjustment is carried out according to the motion parameters of the biped robot and the state parameters of the biped robot, feedback is more timely and accurate, and the balance adjusting and controlling effect is better.

title: FORCE MEASUREMENT SYSTEM FOR ATTITUDE CONTROL OF WALKING ROBOT
abstract: According to the present invention, a force measurement system for controlling a posture of a walking robot comprises: a load cell sensor mounted on a foot of a walking robot to measure vertical load by weight of the walking robot during walking of the walking robot; a load end bearing connected to the load cell sensor and removing rotation moment applied to the load cell sensor except the vertical load; and a control unit measuring landing power of the walking robot from data measured by the load cell sensor and calculating a ZMP (zero moment point).
