title: Self-adaptive variable instantaneous center exoskeleton robot knee joint
abstract: A self-adaptive variable instantaneous center exoskeleton robot knee joint comprises a thigh rod, a shank rod, a driving line wheel, a joint shaft and a self-adaptive adjusting instantaneous center mechanism. The joint shaft is rotatably arranged on the lower portion of the thigh rod, the driving line wheel is fixed to one end of the joint shaft, a bionic fitting instantaneous center structure is adopted between the lower portion of the thigh rod and the upper portion of the shank rod, and a self-adaptive variable instantaneous center mechanism is arranged between the thigh rod and the shank rod and can move up and down relative to the thigh rod and the shank rod. The self-adaptive adjusting instantaneous center mechanism comprises a thigh telescopic liquid chamber, a shank telescopic liquid chamber and a liquid guide pipe; the thigh telescopic liquid chamber is connected with the shank telescopic liquid chamber through the liquid guide pipe, and the thigh telescopic liquid chamber is arranged on the thigh rod and can move up and down relative to the thigh rod. The defects that an existing power-assisted exoskeleton robot knee joint mechanism cannot adapt to the motion state of the human knee joint, and then normal movement of the human body is interfered are overcome.

title: Lightweight human body boosting method based on single-drive actuator and booster
abstract: The invention relates to a light-weight human body power assisting method based on a single-drive actuator. The method comprises the steps that rotating mechanisms capable of driving thighs on the two sides to alternately move front and back relative to the crotch are arranged on the two sides of a hip joint of a human body; the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating base located on the hip joint side and a driving rod capable of driving the legs to swing relative to the rotating base. The driving rods on the two sides of the hip joint drive the thighs to alternately swing relative to the crotch under the action of the same driving actuator. The cost, the power consumption and the weight are reduced, the overall power assisting performance is improved, and control is very convenient. Wherein the rotating base is rigidly connected with the driving actuator; the driving actuator is suspended on one side of the human body; assistance generated by the driving rod rotating relative to the rotating base directly acts on the two legs, so that the two legs are separated and combined and are irrelevant to the crotch. Therefore, the crotch only needs to bear part of the weight of the power assisting device, and the situation that local labor is saved and overall labor is wasted is avoided.

title: Humanoid mechanical leg
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of walking propelling devices, in particular to a humanoid mechanical leg which comprises a body mechanism, two first driving mechanisms, two upper leg parts, two second driving mechanisms, two lower leg parts and two foot mechanisms, one first driving mechanism works to drive one upper leg part to move towards the side away from the other upper leg part, and the other first driving mechanism works to drive the other lower leg part to move towards the side away from the other lower leg part. Meanwhile, one second driving mechanism drives one lower leg part to move towards the side away from the other lower leg part, the other first driving mechanism drives the other upper leg part to move towards the side close to one first driving mechanism, and the other second driving mechanism drives the other lower leg part to move towards the side close to one lower leg part; when the other first driving mechanism drives the other upper leg part and the other second driving mechanism drives the other lower leg part to reach the preset threshold value, the body mechanism can be driven to move, and therefore the problem that an existing mechanical leg is large in size is solved.

title: EXOSKELETON AND METHOD
abstract: The invention relates to an exoskeleton (20) comprising: a base portion (1) for mounting on a torso (2) of a human body; a support portion (3), which is movably coupled to the base portion (1), for supporting an arm (4) of the human body; an actuator device (5), in particular a pneumatic actuator device, that acts on the support portion (3) in order to provide a supporting force for the arm (4), the base portion (1) comprising a back part (8), a waist belt (16), as well as a force transmission assembly that extends from the back part (8) to the waist belt (16) and provides a force transmission path from the back part (8) to the waist belt (16) in order to transmit a reaction force transmitted from the support portion (3) to the back part (8) further to the waist belt (16). The force transmission assembly comprises a joint assembly for providing at least one rotational and/or translational degree of freedom between the back part (8) and the waist belt (16). The force transmission assembly also comprises a rigid force transmission element (18) which extends from the back part (8) to the waist belt (16) and via which the force transmission path passes.

title: CAN-based humanoid robot multi-type motor control system
abstract: The invention discloses a CAN-based humanoid robot multi-type motor control system. The humanoid robot mainly comprises a closed-loop stepping motor, four CAN servo motors and two RS485 steering engines, and further comprises an industrial personal computer track planning module and a motion control module. Wherein the trajectory planning module adopts an ROS robot system to carry out trajectory information processing. The trajectory planning module is in TCP communication with the motion control module, CAN bus protocol communication is used in the motion control module, the motion control module comprises an execution node module, a feedback module and a conversion module, the execution node module is responsible for issuing trajectory information, the feedback module is responsible for collecting data on a bus and feeding back and uploading the data, and the conversion module is responsible for converting the data. And the controller also has the function of a stepping motor controller. The conversion module is responsible for converting an instruction on a bus into an RS485 instruction.

title: Humanoid robot, control method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot, a control method and device thereof and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that motion data are collected through sensors arranged at all joints of a data glove; determining attitude data of quaternion corresponding to the joint according to the motion data; determining an Euler angle corresponding to the joint according to the attitude data of the quaternion of the joint; and controlling a manipulator of the humanoid robot according to the Euler angles corresponding to the joints. Therefore, the manipulator of the humanoid robot can move according to the hand action of the control personnel, the manipulator of the humanoid robot can complete various complex actions, and the application range of the manipulator is widened.

title: Five-finger humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a five-finger humanoid manipulator which structurally comprises joints, a palm, a steering wheel, a protective sleeve and an adjusting mechanism, the joints are connected to the palm through the adjusting mechanism, the palm is rotationally matched with the steering wheel and connected with the protective sleeve, a wrapping structure and an internal control device are arranged on a power assisting body, and the wrapping structure and the internal control device are matched on a movable disc so that the power assisting body can rotate around the steering wheel. When the supporting rods are inclined between the connecting chains and the half-fold type air bag strips, the buckling blades shake on the supporting rods by means of the spiral structures of the running-in strips and gradually roll inwards on the inner control device towards the movable disc, and the inner control device is controlled to extend and extend outwards. And the wrapping structure is matched with the movable disc to be gradually folded on the supporting rod in a cross mode, the strength of deflection supporting of the supporting rod between the connecting chain and the air bag strip is determined, the joint can be guided to be stably and regularly located at the horizontal position, and the flexibility of the mechanical arm is enhanced.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure with differential joint decoupling and inertia upward movement characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg structure with differential joint decoupling and inertia upward movement characteristics, structurally, a joint driving unit is changed into a linear joint device, and the humanoid robot leg structure comprises two first linear joint groups arranged at the hip, two second linear joint groups arranged at the thigh and a first connecting rod group which are matched with each other; joint motors of the first linear joint group and the second linear joint group rotate in the same direction, so that the linear joints simultaneously extend and contract, and front-back swinging is realized; when the two joint motors rotate reversely, differential motion occurs, and left-right swing is achieved; a third linear joint group arranged between the thigh and the shank can finish the jumping or landing action of the robot; the invention further provides a decoupling mechanical structure of the knee joint and the ankle joint, and the coupling influence of knee joint movement on the ankle joint can be eliminated.

title: Humanoid robot body
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot body which comprises a body, two driving mechanisms and a power source, each driving mechanism comprises an opening assembly, two first stabilizing assemblies, a second stabilizing assembly, a triangular plate and an arm assembly, and the body provides installation conditions for the two driving mechanisms and the power source. Power can be provided for all parts through a power source, when the arm assembly needs to be transversely opened, the opening assembly is started and works to drive the arm assembly on the triangular plate to transversely move, meanwhile, the two first stabilizing assemblies and the two second stabilizing assemblies work, and the stability of the triangular plate in the moving process can be improved; the arm assemblies can move longitudinally and can rotate, and therefore the problem that an existing robot body is poor in flexibility is solved.

title: Humanoid robot low-attitude creeping whole-body motion planning method based on key mode decomposition and CPG
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot low-attitude creeping whole-body motion planning method based on key mode decomposition and CPG, and the method comprises the steps: decomposing a linear low-attitude creeping motion into four key motion modes, carrying out the parameter determination and initialization of a CPG coupling network based on a Hopf oscillator according to the key motion modes, solving a mathematical model of the CPG coupling network, and carrying out the planning of the low-attitude creeping whole-body motion of a humanoid robot. Obtaining sagittal plane key movement tracks of a right shoulder pitching joint, a left shoulder pitching joint, a right leg hip pitching joint and a left leg hip pitching joint of the robot; according to the phase and amplitude of key motion mode conversion, the sagittal plane key motion trail is mapped into a whole-body motion trail, the whole-body motion trail is sent by the industrial personal computer to all joints of the robot to be executed, and linear low-attitude creeping motion of the humanoid robot is achieved. According to the invention, based on the crawling key mode decomposition and the CPG coupling network, the trajectory planning of the low-attitude crawling whole-body collaborative motion of the humanoid robot is realized.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robot arms, in particular to a humanoid robot which comprises a head mechanism, a body mechanism, two arm mechanisms and two leg mechanisms, the body mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the head mechanism, and the two arm mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the body mechanism respectively. title: Dancing smart robot studied dance gesture
abstract: The present invention relates to a smart robot dancing by learning dance moves. In accordance with the present invention, a humanlike smart robot learning dance moves by using deep learning includes: a dance move learning unit extracting dance move data from a video with music inputted therein by using deep learning three-dimensional posture estimation technology, and learning the data through deep-learning reinforcement learning training; a music feature extraction unit extracting musical features through the data learned by the dance move learning unit; a database receiving the extracted features of the music from the music feature extraction unit to store the features as data; and a control unit connected with the database to control the robot such that the robot can dance to the music inputted from the dance move learning unit. Therefore, the present invention is capable of eliminating the need for a worker to perform excessive work for implementing dance moves of a robot.

title: ROBOT
abstract: The present invention provides a robot that implements human action. This robot (1) comprises: a drive unit capable of traveling autonomously; a torso part (12) mounted on the drive unit; and a head part disposed above the torso part (12). The head part has an imaging unit and a transmission unit which transmits, in the form of a signal, a video image captured by the imaging unit to a user terminal. title: Operation method of walking robot
abstract: The invention provides an operation method of a walking robot, and the method comprises the steps: 1, controlling the walking robot to advance to reach a switch cabinet; 2, controlling the depth camera to shoot current image information; 3, judging the appearance and position of the switch of the switch cabinet according to the image information, and determining an end tool matched with the switch of the switch cabinet; 4, a rack assembly and/or a mechanical arm of the walking robot are/is controlled to move, and the tail end tool is driven to be in butt joint with the switch; step 5, controlling the end tool to operate the switch; and 6, detecting the operation torque of the end tool on the switch cabinet switch in real time, intelligently controlling the driving rotating speed and torque, and completing the switch operation. 7, sound characteristics in the operation process are analyzed, and the state of the indicator is judged through the visible light camera; and determining that the execution mechanism is in place. And step 8, switching the end tool to a zero torque state, and completing safe connection between the end tool and the switch.

title: Ground knife switch assembly operation method of walking robot
abstract: The invention provides a ground switch assembly operation method of a walking robot. The ground switch assembly operation method comprises the following steps: step 1, shooting image information of a current switch cabinet through a first depth camera; 2, determining the position of a switch to be operated on the switch cabinet according to the image information; 3, the rack assembly is controlled to move, so that the executing mechanism roughly corresponds to the switch; 4, the feeding assembly is controlled to move forwards, so that the executing mechanism is in butt joint with the switch; 5, the outer sleeve assembly is controlled to rotate, an executing mechanism is screwed to be opened and closed, meanwhile, a driving mechanism is controlled to rotate reversely, and the rotating speed of the driving mechanism and the rotating speed of rotating driving are consistent; and 6, detecting the torque of the rotary drive, and judging whether the execution mechanism is operated in place or not according to the curve characteristics of the torque and the angle. 7, analyzing sound characteristics in the operation process and judging the state of the indicator through visible light; and determining that the execution mechanism is in place.

title: Electrical system of humanoid manipulator and humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention provides an electrical system of a humanoid manipulator and the humanoid manipulator, and relates to the technical field of manipulators. The electrical system of the humanoid manipulator comprises sensors, circuit boards, connecting assemblies and a main control board, the sensors are connected with the circuit boards, and the connecting assemblies are used for connection between the circuit boards and connection between the circuit boards and the main control board; the sensor comprises a position sensor and a touch sensor, the position sensor is used for measuring the finger position of the humanoid manipulator, and the touch sensor is used for measuring the finger pressure of the humanoid manipulator; the circuit board is used for obtaining corresponding position signals and pressure signals from the sensor and sending the position signals and the pressure signals to the main control board through the connecting assembly. According to the technical scheme, the sensing capacity and the integration degree of the humanoid manipulator to the external environment are effectively improved, and then electrical control over the humanoid manipulator is reliably achieved.

title: Ground contact detection method of humanoid robot based on foot buffer device
abstract: The invention discloses a ground touch detection method of a humanoid robot based on a foot buffer device, which is based on the foot buffer device of a humanoid foot physiological structure, and comprises the following steps: acquiring the output voltage of a strain gauge in real time by utilizing a front and rear foot trigger switch carried on the foot buffer device, a strain gauge built in a foot back plate spring and a front and rear foot encoder; angles of anterior and posterior foot encoders and states of anterior and posterior foot trigger switches are determined, and a grounding judgment function is established to fuse the data, so that whether the feet touch the ground or not is judged; in addition, the invention further provides a fuzzy decision grounding judgment method, foot deformation data collected by the two encoders are utilized, real-time angles and reference angles of the encoders are used as basic input of fuzzy reasoning, and a specific fuzzy rule and decision are made to obtain a foot grounding part.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground touch detection method of a humanoid robot based on a foot buffer device, which is based on the foot buffer device of a humanoid foot physiological structure, and comprises the following steps: acquiring the output voltage of a strain gauge in real time by utilizing a front and rear foot trigger switch carried on the foot buffer device, a strain gauge built in a foot back plate spring and a front and rear foot encoder; angles of anterior and posterior foot encoders and states of anterior and posterior foot trigger switches are determined, and a grounding judgment function is established to fuse the data, so that whether the feet touch the ground or not is judged; in addition, the invention further provides a fuzzy decision grounding judgment method, foot deformation data collected by the two encoders are utilized, real-time angles and reference angles of the encoders are used as basic input of fuzzy reasoning, and a specific fuzzy rule and decision are made to obtain a foot grounding part.

title: Robot mass center motion planning method and device and biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot mass center motion planning method and device and a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: calculating a single gait expected periodic trajectory of the robot based on a kinetic equation constructed by a simplified model of the robot; correcting the expected periodic trajectory according to the fed back mass center state of the robot, and generating an expected mass center trajectory of the robot by using the corrected expected periodic trajectory; and controlling the robot to move according to the expected centroid trajectory. According to the method, trajectory planning and trajectory correction are carried out on the single gait cycle, then the trajectory planning and the trajectory correction are combined to obtain the expected centroid trajectory, and compared with a traditional centroid planning method, the method is simpler and faster, and trajectory correction and the like can be conveniently carried out in real time according to new task requirements.

title: Rope-driven humanoid mechanical arm and industrial robot
abstract: The invention discloses a rope-driven humanoid mechanical arm which is characterized in that rope driving is used as a main power transmission mode, and main mass components including a first shoulder joint driving assembly, a second shoulder joint driving assembly, a third shoulder joint driving assembly and an elbow and wrist joint driving module are all arranged at the rear part (namely arranged close to shoulder joints); the motion inertia of the mechanical arm is greatly reduced, and the operation safety is improved; the rope connected with the elbow transmission pulley is arranged in the elbow connector in a penetrating mode, the rope connected with the wrist transmission pulley is arranged outside the elbow connector, and decoupling between the rope of the wrist joint part and the rope of the elbow joint part is achieved. According to the mechanical arm, light weight of the structure is achieved, and the mechanical arm is simpler in structure and easier to deploy and maintain due to modularization of different functional parts. The invention further provides an industrial robot comprising the rope-driven humanoid mechanical arm.

title: Motion data generation system, motion data generation method, and motion data generation program of robot
abstract: A motion data generation system of a robot including an upper body, a waist, and a lower body is provided. The motion data generation system includes a subject motion data acquisition unit that acquires upper body motion data captured from motion of the upper body of a subject and captured waist motion data captured from motion of the waist of the subject, a manually generated motion data acquisition unit that acquires lower body motion data and manually generated waist motion data, the lower body motion data and the manually generated waist motion data being generated through manual input by a user, and a robot motion control unit. The robot motion control unit includes a leg state determination unit and a waist motion data generation unit.

title: Robot expression online driving method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot expression online driving method. The method comprises the steps that a face driving sequence of a performer is input into a face deformation extraction subnet based on regional space-time attention to generate space-time semantic representation vectors of all regions of the face; inputting a driving sequence of a driving motor of the robot and the space-time semantic representation vector of each area of the face of the performer into a face-motor cross cooperation subnet; an output result of the face-motor cross collaboration subnet is input into a driving sequence generation subnet based on B-spline smooth constraint, and rolling generation and normalization of a future motor driving sequence are realized based on multi-layer LSTM and the B-spline smooth constraint; the robot online expression learning based on the RobotFELNet is realized; the method has the advantages that more accurate target driving data is provided for robot facial expression learning, and finally the facial expression learned by the robot is more vivid.

title: Robust visual servo control method for anthropomorphic manipulator with view field constraint
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic manipulator robust visual servo control method with view field constraint. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional code image on a workpiece through a camera sensor mounted on a robot wrist and sending the two-dimensional code image to an industrial personal computer; the industrial personal computer recognizes image features in real time, generates 7DOF robot control signals and sends the control signals to the robot, and tracking of visual feature points is completed; a human seven-degree-of-freedom arm structure is simulated, shoulder joints, elbow joints and wrist joints of a 7DOF humanoid mechanical arm are defined, and arm angles are calculated; a barrier Lyapunov function and an arm angle are combined to design a visual servo field-of-view constraint controller with a humanoid characteristic, a feature point track is reserved in a camera field-of-view range in an indirect constraint tracking process, and meanwhile, a mechanical arm can realize humanoid motion based on arm angle rotation. A sliding mode torque controller is designed to drive the robot to reach an expected feature position, finally, feature points are restrained not to exceed the view field of a camera, the success rate of a visual servo task is increased, and humanoid arm angle rotation motion is achieved.

title: Bionic expression robot head device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a bionic expression robot head device which comprises an eyebrow assembly, an eye assembly and a mouth mechanism capable of performing mouth action adjustment which are sequentially connected from top to bottom. The eye assembly comprises a supporting piece fixedly arranged at the top of the mouth mechanism and used for installing eyeballs, an eyelid unit arranged at the top of the supporting piece and an eyelid adjusting unit connected with the eyelid unit. The eyelid unit comprises a mounting frame body, an upper eyelid part and a lower eyelid part, the mounting frame body is fixedly arranged at the top of the supporting part, the upper eyelid part and the lower eyelid part are rotationally connected to the mounting frame body and arranged on the outer side of an eyeball in a sleeving mode, and the eyelid adjusting unit is connected with the upper eyelid part and the lower eyelid part and can drive the upper eyelid part and the lower eyelid part to turn over; by arranging the eye assembly, on the basis that the eyeball can rotate, adjustment of the eyelid is increased, and the upper eyelid piece and the lower eyelid piece arranged on the outer side of the eyeball in a sleeving mode are utilized, so that the human eyelid is simulated more truly.

title: Attitude recognition and following system based on arm extensible modeling library
abstract: The invention discloses a posture recognition and following system based on an arm extensible modeling library. The posture recognition and following system comprises a posture recognition module, a database, a comparative analysis module, a calling module, an updating module and a following control module. The posture recognition module and the database are connected with the comparative analysis module; the updating module and the calling module are connected with the comparative analysis module; the updating module and the calling module are connected with the following control module; the updating module is connected with the database; the posture recognition module is used for collecting human body posture data; the database is used for storing and recording the historical posture data of the arm; the comparative analysis module is used for performing comparative analysis and matching with robot joint point angles; the calling module is used for calling simulation data matched with the posture data recognized by the posture recognition module from a database; the updating module is used for storing unmatched attitude data in the database; and the following control module is used for receiving and controlling the instruction data.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a posture recognition and following system based on an arm extensible modeling library. title: Biped robot
abstract: The biped robot comprises a hip support, two legs are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of the hip support, and each leg comprises a hip ball joint, a thigh, a knee joint, a shank, an ankle ball joint and a sole which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; a second driving mechanism and a third driving mechanism are arranged on the hip ball joint, the second driving mechanism controls the hip ball joint to drive the thigh to perform side-sway motion by taking a second straight line as a rotating shaft, the third driving mechanism controls the hip ball joint to drive the thigh to perform pitching motion by taking a third straight line as a rotating shaft, and the second straight line and the third straight line are orthogonal; a fifth driving mechanism and a sixth driving mechanism are arranged on the ankle ball joint, the fifth driving mechanism controls the ankle ball joint to drive the foot sole to perform side-sway motion by taking a fifth straight line as a rotating shaft, the sixth driving mechanism controls the ankle ball joint to drive the foot sole to perform pitching motion by taking a sixth straight line as a rotating shaft, and the fifth straight line and the sixth straight line are orthogonal. The shape and gait of the robot are more anthropomorphic, coupling linkage does not exist between degrees of freedom, and the control difficulty is reduced.

title: Biped robot motion control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot intelligent control, and provides a biped robot motion control method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the current state information of a biped robot; according to the current state information of the biped robot, using the trained deep reinforcement learning algorithm model to obtain a disturbance prediction value; according to the expected posture and the expected speed of the robot and the disturbance prediction value, the optimal ground reaction force is obtained; supporting legs of the biped robot are controlled based on the optimal ground reaction force, and then motion control over the biped robot is achieved. The novel leg disturbance prediction control method based on deep reinforcement learning is provided based on single rigid body model prediction control, the method is suitable for the biped robot with the leg mass ratio smaller than 30%, and the application range of the single rigid body model prediction control method is widened.

title: Hand marker tracking method and system based on gestures
abstract: The invention discloses a hand marker tracking method and system based on gestures, and belongs to the technical field of machine monocular vision and the field of medical equipment. The method comprises the following steps: determining a gesture of a tested person by wearable gesture measurement equipment; acquiring a color image of the hand of the tested person; determining the spatial position of a hand marker according to the color image; when the gesture is a set gesture, the robot starts to track the marker according to the spatial position of the marker to perform head rotation motion; and when the gesture is not the set gesture, the robot stops rotating the head, and the head of the robot is fixed at the stop position. According to the invention, the robot can track the gesture and position of the tested person and move to the angle and position required by practice, the actual interaction operation between a doctor and a patient can be truly simulated, and a practice platform for treatment techniques is provided for a doctor.

title: JOINT DRIVING SYSTEM
abstract: According to the disclosed invention, a joint driving system comprises: a link unit having at least one pair of links connected and linked to each other to support joint movement of a human body; a driving unit provided at one of the pair of links to assist driving force of a joint; a storage unit selectively connected to the driving unit to store or output the driving force of the driving unit; and a guide unit guiding the driving unit and the storage unit to be connected to or separated from each other. The storage unit outputs the stored driving force to assist muscular strength for linking operation of the link unit. According to the configuration, the usability can be improved to facilitate switching between a muscular strength assistance mode and a walking mode.

title: Multi-sensor information fusion gait recognition method of humanoid foot and foot biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-sensor information fusion gait recognition method of a humanoid foot and foot biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot gait recognition. The problems that an existing robot gait recognition method is single in data fusion algorithm, and an information description and processing method lacks objectivity are solved. Comprising the following steps: enabling a pre-processed pitch angle, pre-processed ankle stress data and pre-processed plantar pressure to correspond to corresponding fuzzy sets, and respectively calculating state membership degree matrixes of the fuzzy sets; respectively determining the state membership degrees of the preprocessed pitch angle, the preprocessed ankle stress data and the preprocessed plantar pressure to the set gait phase according to a preset fuzzy inference rule; the gait phase membership degree fused by the sensors is obtained through calculation of all state membership degrees, and the gait phase corresponding to the maximum gait phase membership degree calculation result serves as the current gait recognition result. The method is used for gait recognition of the robot.

title: Parallel shaft type multifunctional exoskeleton system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and discloses a parallel shaft type multifunctional exoskeleton system which comprises an upper body trunk, two arm trunks and two leg trunks, and the two arm trunks are connected with the upper body trunk through a plurality of parallel driving shafts. The two leg trunks are connected with the lower portion of the upper trunk through middle joints respectively. The mechanism can realize movement coordination with the ball joint of the human body in a parallel driving mode, and is simple and compact in structure, convenient to disassemble and expand functional parts, low in mass and high in movement flexibility.

title: Biped robot walking centroid state estimation method based on federated Kalman filtering
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking centroid state estimation method based on federated Kalman filtering, an inertial filter, a kinematics filter and a linear inverted pendulum filter respectively process measurement information of an inertial measurement unit, a joint coded disc and a force sensor, and the state of the walking centroid of a biped robot is estimated through Kalman filtering time updating and measurement updating. Obtaining a secondary centroid state estimation vector and a corresponding error covariance matrix; performing Kalman filtering time updating on the main filter to obtain a secondary centroid state estimation vector and a corresponding error covariance matrix; the main filter performs optimal fusion on the basis of the sub-filters, the secondary centroid state estimation vector of the main filter and the corresponding error covariance matrix, and a single-time optimal centroid state estimation vector is obtained and acts on the robot; and at the next moment, feeding back and resetting each filter by using the corresponding error covariance matrix Pg and the information distribution coefficient, and repeating the steps to obtain the optimal centroid state estimation vector. The method is high in calculation speed, and improves the reliability of state estimation.

title: MOBILITY SURROGATES
abstract: A mobility surrogate includes a humanoid form supporting at least one camera that captures image data from a first physical location in which the first mobility surrogate is disposed to produce an image signal and a mobility base. title: Dynamic walking control method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic walking control method for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: converting the mass and inertia of connecting rods of all parts of the humanoid robot to a mass center in a modeling stage, simplifying the humanoid robot into an integral model which is equal in mass and inertia at the mass center, simplifying the model, and keeping the main information of a whole robot system. According to the method, the effect of each connecting rod of the robot on the whole is considered, so that the modeling precision is improved, and the state of the robot can be controlled more accurately. And secondly, when the model of the acting force of the ground to the robot is established, the three-dimensional force and the three-dimensional torque are considered at the same time, so that the model can be universally used on humanoid robots with/without ankles. And finally, in a controller optimization problem solving stage, the whole problem is organized into a compact convex quadratic programming problem, the calculation speed is improved, and the stability of the proposed model prediction controller can be ensured by determining a weight matrix of a terminal state by using a Riccati equation.

title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot power assisting system of self-adaptive gravity adjusting mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot power assisting system of a self-adaptive gravity adjusting mechanism. According to the gravity self-adaptive adjusting mechanism, through the thought of an inner meshing modified gear transmission mechanism, the gravity self-adaptive adjusting mechanism is designed to convert joint movement into linear movement of a feature point along the axis of a swing connecting shaft, a spring is placed in an exoskeleton, and the gravity self-adaptive adjusting function of minimizing the space layout of the exoskeleton and achieving safety is achieved. The energy self-collecting, storing and releasing device can store useless energy in the walking process of the human body and store and release the useless energy according to gait planning requirements, and therefore the cruising ability of the exoskeleton is improved. A pair of bistable switches is designed to achieve switching of different power assisting modes, a control strategy based on deep reinforcement learning is provided, human body motion information detected by a sensor is converted into state feature representation through deep learning, an auxiliary detection result is optimized through reinforcement learning, and the auxiliary effect of the lower limb exoskeleton is improved.

title: Robot walking balance and coordination control device and system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a robot walking balance and coordination control device and a system thereof.The robot walking balance and coordination control device comprises a mounting shell, a mounting pipe is fixedly connected into the mounting shell, and a plurality of mounting blocks are fixedly connected to the inner side wall of the mounting pipe in the circumferential direction. Comprising the following steps: S1, performing initialization operation; s2, balancing the system; s3, power correction; s4, performing pneumatic correction; s5, correcting the limbs. According to the invention, the electric control mechanism is arranged, the inclination angle of a single limb of the robot is compared and analyzed with a set program in the moving process, and the inertia block is used for performing inertia overturning on a wrong deflection angle, so that reverse inertia push-away is provided for a single limb structure, and the balance and coordination of the single limb are maintained; and meanwhile, a pneumatic rod device is matched to assist in leveling the limbs, so that the balance of the limbs of the robot is effectively ensured.

title: Humanoid foot and foot plate system with integral structure for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an integral structure humanoid foot and foot plate system of a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of foot plates of biped robots. The problems that an existing biped robot with a single-degree-of-freedom foot mechanism is poor in terrain adaptability and stiff in walking gait are solved. A sole corresponding section and a heel corresponding section of a rubber foot pad are respectively provided with a film pressure sensor; the sole section and the heel section of the humanoid foot skeleton are positioned on the film pressure sensor; a three-dimensional force sensor is arranged in the heel section and is connected with a shank of the robot through an ankle connecting piece; an IMU attitude sensor, a DSP information acquisition controller, a plantar pressure signal processing circuit and a three-dimensional force signal processing circuit are arranged in the humanoid foot skeleton; sensing signals are transmitted to the DSP information acquisition controller; the split type shell rear section and the split type shell front section are detachably connected and installed on the humanoid foot framework to form an integral shell. According to the invention, an integral structural design is adopted, so that better adaptability to terrains is achieved.

title: Intelligent double-arm humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent double-arm humanoid robot. The three-dimensional scene construction module is respectively connected with the position parameter acquisition module and the remote communication module, the position parameter acquisition module is also connected with the remote communication module, the remote communication module is further respectively connected with the background control module and the controller, the controller is connected with the adjusting module, and the adjusting module is connected with the execution module. According to the invention, man-machine interaction is realized, and the three-dimensional scene is constructed through the three-dimensional scene construction module, so that the target position is more accurate, and fire-fighting operation is convenient to execute.

title: Joint module, leg structure and robot
abstract: The invention provides a joint module, a leg structure and a robot. The joint module comprises a shell, a motor assembly, a speed reducer and a control circuit board, and the shell is provided with a containing cavity; the motor assembly is arranged in the containing cavity, and a first magnetic attraction element is arranged at the end of a motor shaft of the motor assembly. The speed reducer is arranged in the containing cavity and connected with the motor assembly, and a second magnetic attraction element is arranged on the speed reducer; the control circuit board is connected with the shell, a first magnetic induction chip and a second magnetic induction chip are integrated on the control circuit board, and the first magnetic induction chip detects position information and rotating speed information of the input end of the motor assembly through the first magnetic attraction element. The second magnetic induction chip detects position information and rotating speed information of the output end of the motor assembly through the second magnetic attraction element. The problem that the walking reliability of a leg structure cannot be ensured due to the fact that the detected position information is lost after a single-circle absolute value encoder of a joint module in the prior art is powered off and restarted is solved.

title: Crawling track planning and motion control method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot crawling trajectory planning and motion control method, which comprises the following steps: establishing oscillator model expressions of a left leg hip joint, a right leg hip joint, a left arm shoulder joint and a right arm shoulder joint of a humanoid robot, further solving the value of a state variable, taking the value of the state variable as a joint trajectory value, respectively multiplying the value by an amplitude coefficient, and calculating the crawling trajectory of the humanoid robot. Obtaining tracks of all joints in the crawling process of the robot; and in the crawling process of the robot, a waist joint reference trajectory value is determined, and direction control over the robot in the crawling process is achieved. According to the method, only oscillator models of the left leg hip joint, the right leg hip joint, the left arm shoulder joint and the right arm shoulder joint of the humanoid robot are established, and the trajectory of each joint is obtained, so that the calculation amount is reduced; in the crawling motion control process of the humanoid robot, only the reference track value of the waist joint is determined, direction control over the robot in the crawling process is achieved, energy consumption of the robot is reduced, and the control speed is increased.

title: Biped robot omni-directional walking centroid trajectory planning method based on double-layer model predictive control
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot omni-directional walking centroid trajectory planning method based on double-layer model predictive control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a sparse centroid motion trajectory and a ZMP trajectory through an upper MPC under the condition of meeting ZMP stability constraint and centroid motion feasible region constraint; the lower-layer MPC takes tracking of the upper-layer sparse trajectory as a target to obtain a dense centroid position motion trajectory; and after the dense trajectory is judged to be non-divergent by the centroid trajectory detector, the centroid movement position at the current moment is output for the robot to use. According to the method, a variable-period double-layer model prediction control structure is adopted, the accuracy and real-time performance of track generation are considered, and robot hardware can be prevented from being damaged by divergent tracks through centroid track detection.

title: Bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device. The bionic obstacle-crossing double-foot jumping mechanical device comprises a lower limb jumping mechanism, an upper limb grabbing mechanism, a main body structure, an inertia pendulum mechanism and a transmission mechanism. Wherein the upper limb grabbing mechanism and the lower limb jumping mechanism are jointly connected to the robot main body structure. The lower limb jumping mechanism is of a symmetrical structure and is connected with the transmission mechanism through a crank connecting rod, and stretching and compressing movement of the leg mechanism can be completed. The upper limb grabbing mechanism is similar to the lower limb jumping mechanism, and the upper limb grabbing mechanism plays an auxiliary role when the lower limbs jump, so that the lower limbs of the robot can complete two times of force storage jumping. The transmission mechanism is embedded in the main body structure, and power is transmitted to execution components of the biped robot through gears and transmission shafts. The inertia pendulum mechanism plays a role in balancing the posture of the jumping robot in the air. According to the double-foot jumping robot, the climbing action of a wall with a certain height can be completed through two times of continuous jumping.

title: Method for state detection and standing planning after falling of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a state detection and standing planning method after falling of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: calculating the position and direction of each connecting rod according to the direction of the robot and a motor angle value corresponding to a joint, and obtaining the position and direction of each connecting rod through motion capture clothes, the positions and the directions of all the connecting rods are compared, when the absolute value of the difference value between the positions and the directions is smaller than or equal to a set threshold value, the structure of the robot body is normal, then the external environment where the robot is located is detected, and therefore whether the robot can stand or not is judged; and if yes, calculating the distance between the real-time state value and the reference value corresponding to the state that the standing process must experience by using a Mahalanobis distance calculation method, and controlling the corresponding joint of the robot to reach the state corresponding to the minimum distance value. According to the invention, the problems of state detection and standing planning of the robot in a complex environment are solved, and the adaptability of the robot is improved.

abstract: The utility model relates to the field of robots, in particular to a humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot which comprises robot bodies, pulleys are arranged at the lower ends of the two sides of the robot bodies, mechanical arms are hinged to the middle positions of the two sides of the robot bodies, and a placing plate is arranged on one side between the robot bodies. title: Multi-image human body posture generation method and device based on modal guidance
abstract: The invention provides a multi-graph human body posture generation method and device based on modal guidance, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a training data set which comprises a human body motion sequence; inputting the training data set into a modal guidance multi-graph model, wherein a modal guidance multi-graph network comprises a time sequence feature enhancement sub-network and a feature extraction sub-network; cutting the human body action sequence through a time sequence feature enhancement sub-network, enhancing the feature proportion of the last T frames, and obtaining a feature enhancement data set; meanwhile, the contribution degree of the last frame in the input sequence is improved by copying the last frame; dividing the feature enhancement data set into a plurality of modal subsets according to the action amplitude; modeling is carried out on the modal subsets through the feature extraction sub-network to extract features, and then the modal subsets are restored to a human body global posture sequence according to a division mode of the motion amplitude. According to the method, modal-guided multi-graph modeling of different dynamic and static joint points is realized.

title: Power-assisted steering lower limb exoskeleton robot device
abstract: The invention relates to a power-assisted steering lower limb exoskeleton robot device. The device comprises a guide rail, a gear, a rack, a servo motor, a laser sensor and a limiting device, the servo motor provides power for steering of the lower limb exoskeleton robot, and the guide rail, the gear and the rack are all fixed in a U-shaped groove of a pressure sole shoe and are meshed with one another to rotate so as to drive the lower limb exoskeleton robot to steer. The laser sensor can adjust the rotating speed of the servo motor so that the body of the patient can be kept balanced in the steering process, and the limiting device is used for preventing the body of the patient from spraining due to the too large steering amplitude. The lower limb exoskeleton robot solves the problem that a hemiplegic patient wears the lower limb exoskeleton robot to walk and is difficult to steer.

title: Training method of posture detection model and driving method and device of digital human
abstract: The invention provides a training method of a posture detection model, a driving method and device of a digital human, and computer equipment. The training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a training image containing a preset object, a first key point coordinate of the preset object and a key point heat map of the preset object; inputting the training image into an initial posture detection model to obtain a predicted key point coordinate of the preset object by using a coordinate regression module in the initial posture detection model, and obtaining a predicted key point heat map by using a heat map generation module in the initial posture detection model; and training the initial posture detection model to obtain a posture detection model by taking the reduction of the difference between the first key point coordinate and the predicted key point coordinate and the reduction of the difference between the key point heat map and the predicted key point heat map as targets. The training method gives consideration to both accuracy and training speed, the posture detection model obtained through training needs to input images, a motion capture system is not needed, and the training method is convenient for various users to use.

title: Automatic parameter adjusting method applied to walking controller of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic parameter adjusting method applied to a biped robot walking controller. The automatic parameter adjusting method comprises the steps that walking controller parameters are decomposed into first inverse kinematics controller parameters, first inverse dynamics controller parameters and first active impedance controller parameters; closing an inverse kinematics controller and an active impedance controller of the walking controller, and optimizing parameters of the first inverse kinematics controller by using a Bayesian optimization method to obtain parameters of a second inverse kinematics controller; keeping the parameters of the second inverse kinematics controller unchanged, and alternately optimizing the parameters of the first inverse kinematics controller and the parameters of the first active impedance controller by using a Bayesian optimization method to obtain the parameters of the second inverse kinematics controller and the parameters of the second active impedance controller; combining the second inverse kinematics controller parameter, the second inverse dynamics controller parameter and the second active impedance controller parameter to obtain an optimized walking controller parameter; the parameter accuracy of the walking controller can be improved.

title: Robot based on multi-modal fusion in complex limited environment and operation method
abstract: The invention provides a robot based on multi-mode fusion in a complex and limited environment and an operation method. The robot comprises a robot body, multiple touch sensors, a wireless communication module, a human-computer interaction interface and a controller. The controller generates a motion equation of the robot through a motion control system algorithm according to environment information obtained by the depth camera system, communication information between the wireless communication module and the man-machine interaction interface and data feedback of the multiple touch sensors, and sends signals to steering engines and servo motors of all joints. Coordinated movement of all joints of the robot is controlled. According to the wheeled humanoid robot based on multi-modal fusion, the humanoid design is adopted, high intelligence is achieved, the precision is high, the double mechanical arms can work at the same time, and human behaviors can be simulated to complete operation on objects in the complex and limited environment.

title: Robot with adjustable shoulders
abstract: The invention discloses a shoulder-adjustable robot which structurally comprises a head, a shoulder adjusting mechanism, arms, a body and moving feet, the head is mounted in the middle of the upper end of the shoulder adjusting mechanism, the arms are arranged at the outer side end of the shoulder adjusting mechanism, and a motor is started to drive a telescopic rod to rotate; the traction sliding block drives the outer side end of the lifting mechanism to rotate, annular guiding is carried out through the guide groove, the arms are driven to rotate around the upper end of the body under the state that the body is kept still, meanwhile, through stretching and retracting of the telescopic rod, free stretching and retracting adjustment is carried out on the arms, automatic stretching and retracting of the air cylinder are carried out, and the sliding block pulls a worm to rotate and stretch and retract as a whole. And meanwhile, a worm rotates to enable a sliding block to drive a supporting shell to ascend and descend, a connecting rod on the outer side of a rotating rod drives a ball to slide in a guiding frame, blocking in the rotating process is avoided, then a motor is started to drive a hinged plate to rotate, the arm is driven to ascend, descend, stretch and rotate, and the working range of the arm is widened.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot and humanoid cooperation path planning method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid double-arm robot and a humanoid cooperation path planning method thereof, and relates to the field of double-arm cooperation robotics.The humanoid double-arm robot is characterized in that the humanoid double-arm robot comprises a head module, double mechanical arms and a trunk, and the head module comprises a binocular stereoscopic vision assembly, a two-degree-of-freedom neck and a center plate; the binocular stereoscopic vision assembly comprises a first driving structure, a second driving structure, eye sockets and eyeballs, the first driving structure is used for driving the eyeballs to move left and right, and the second driving structure is used for driving the eye sockets to do pitching motion; and the two-degree-of-freedom neck part can drive the central plate to do reciprocating circular motion and the head pitching motion. The humanoid double-arm robot is more similar to the eyes and the neck of a human body, the autonomy and personification of a cooperative path are considered, the three-dimensional contour of an object is more easily determined, the view field is adjusted in real time, then the precise action of the double arms is ensured, and the application potential in the scenes of education, accompanying, old-age and disabled helping and the like is expanded.

title: Biped robot cascade control method and device based on task hierarchical optimization
abstract: The invention relates to a task hierarchical optimization-based biped robot cascade control method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring an expected speed and an expected angular speed of a biped robot, and calculating an expected base state according to the expected speed and the expected angular speed; the motion state of the biped robot is obtained, and base state estimation and foot end contact force estimation are conducted according to the motion state; according to the expected base state and base state estimation, a single rigid body model is constructed, and the control force spinor of supporting legs of the biped robot is calculated; according to the expected speed, the landing point of the swing leg of the biped robot is calculated, and trajectory planning is obtained; according to the control force spinor and trajectory planning, the foot end contact force tracks the control force spinor, and a slack variable is calculated; calculating a joint control moment of the biped robot according to the current foot end contact force and the slack variable; according to the joint control torque, the biped robot is controlled to move in real time. By adopting the method, the high-speed motion cascade control of the biped robot can be realized.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot head system
abstract: A three-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot head system comprises a rotating joint, a pitching joint, a deflection joint, a camera and a head shell. The pitching joint and the deflection joint are arranged in the head shell, the fixed part of the pitching joint is arranged at the output end of the rotating joint, the fixed part of the deflection joint is arranged at the output end of the pitching joint, the head shell and the camera are both installed at the output end of the deflection joint, an observation opening is formed in the head shell, and a lens of the camera directly faces the observation opening. The three-degree-of-freedom head system is compact in structure, modular in design and good in universality, the movement flexibility and operability of the head of the humanoid robot are improved through the three-degree-of-freedom head system, and the three-degree-of-freedom head system can be easily integrated to a humanoid robot platform.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom waist structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a three-degree-of-freedom waist structure for a humanoid robot, which is characterized in that through a compact mechanical structure, the rotation of three motors is utilized to drive the waist structure to make the actions of twisting, bending forwards and backwards and tilting leftwards and rightwards which can highly simulate the waist of a human body. According to the three-degree-of-freedom waist structure for the humanoid robot, the three joint motors are reasonably arranged in space, fixing and transmission are carried out through related structural parts, and the degree of freedom of the waist in three directions is achieved. Each motor corresponds to one degree of freedom, and the movement of each degree of freedom does not interfere with each other; three degrees of freedom can enable the upper half body to reach any position in a space limiting area; and actions of the robot are more anthropomorphic. The utility model solves the problem that the waist structure of the existing robot adopts a motion mechanism similar to a ball amplitude and has great difference with the waist characteristic of a human body.

title: Wheel type biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a wheel type biped robot which comprises a main body, leg mechanisms are symmetrically and movably connected to the left side and the right side of the main body, trundle modules are rotationally connected to the bottom ends of the leg mechanisms, each leg mechanism is a five-connecting-rod mechanism, each five-connecting-rod mechanism comprises a connecting rod A, one end of each connecting rod A is rotationally connected with the corresponding trundle module, and the other end of each connecting rod A is rotationally connected with the corresponding trundle module. A connecting rod C is hinged to a rod body of the connecting rod A, a connecting rod D is hinged to the other end of the connecting rod C, and the other end of the connecting rod D is rotationally connected to the main body. According to the utility model, the design is reasonable, the asymmetric five-connecting-rod mechanism is adopted, the joint output torque can be reduced compared with the existing serial leg driving mode, and the space occupied by the legs can be reduced under various postures compared with the existing symmetric five-connecting-rod mechanism.
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wheel type biped robot which comprises a main body, leg mechanisms are symmetrically and movably connected to the left side and the right side of the main body, trundle modules are rotationally connected to the bottom ends of the leg mechanisms, each leg mechanism is a five-connecting-rod mechanism, each five-connecting-rod mechanism comprises a connecting rod A, one end of each connecting rod A is rotationally connected with the corresponding trundle module, and the other end of each connecting rod A is rotationally connected with the corresponding trundle module. A connecting rod C is hinged to a rod body of the connecting rod A, a connecting rod D is hinged to the other end of the connecting rod C, and the other end of the connecting rod D is rotationally connected to the main body. According to the utility model, the design is reasonable, the asymmetric five-connecting-rod mechanism is adopted, the joint output torque can be reduced compared with the existing serial leg driving mode, and the space occupied by the legs can be reduced under various postures compared with the existing symmetric five-connecting-rod mechanism.

title: Hollow biped robot joint
abstract: The utility model discloses a hollow type biped robot joint which comprises a harmonic reducer, a motor, an absolute encoder and a driver assembly, the harmonic reducer is installed at the front end of the motor, the driver assembly is installed at the rear end of the motor, the absolute encoder is fixedly connected to the motor, and the absolute encoder is fixedly connected to the driver assembly. Information collected by the absolute encoder can be transmitted to the driver assembly. A cross roller bearing in a traditional harmonic reducer is designed, the diameter of an outer ring of the cross roller bearing is only slightly larger than that of a rigid wheel, the cross roller bearing is a thin bearing with the inner ring and the outer ring integrated, and due to the fact that the section face is extremely small, light weight and miniaturization of the harmonic reducer can be achieved, and the harmonic reducer is suitable for being used in a large-scale production line. The harmonic reducer is a constituent part of the robot joint, so that the robot joint is light and miniaturized, and the output flange and the fixed flange in a traditional harmonic reducer are made of high-strength aluminum alloy, so that the weight of the harmonic reducer is further reduced.

title: Thigh mechanism, leg device and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a thigh mechanism, a leg device and a biped robot. The thigh mechanism comprises a thigh transmission assembly and a thigh driving assembly. The thigh transmission assembly comprises a thigh mounting piece, a shank connecting piece, a thigh supporting rod, a first plate spring and a thigh transmission rod. The thigh mounting piece comprises a first mounting part rotationally connected with one end of the thigh supporting rod, a second mounting part rotationally connected with the trunk device and a third mounting part arranged between the first mounting part and the second mounting part. The other end of the thigh supporting rod is rotationally connected with the shank connecting piece, one end of the first plate spring is fixedly arranged on the shank connecting piece, the other end of the first plate spring is rotationally connected with one end of the thigh transmission rod, and the other end of the thigh transmission rod is rotationally connected with the third mounting part. The thigh driving assembly is used for driving the thigh supporting rod to rotate. The transmission swing of the thigh mechanism is small, motion interference can be reduced, and the reliability of the leg device and the biped robot can be improved.
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a thigh mechanism, a leg device and a biped robot. The thigh mechanism comprises a thigh transmission assembly and a thigh driving assembly. The thigh transmission assembly comprises a thigh mounting piece, a shank connecting piece, a thigh supporting rod, a first plate spring and a thigh transmission rod. The thigh mounting piece comprises a first mounting part rotationally connected with one end of the thigh supporting rod, a second mounting part rotationally connected with the trunk device and a third mounting part arranged between the first mounting part and the second mounting part. The other end of the thigh supporting rod is rotationally connected with the shank connecting piece, one end of the first plate spring is fixedly arranged on the shank connecting piece, the other end of the first plate spring is rotationally connected with one end of the thigh transmission rod, and the other end of the thigh transmission rod is rotationally connected with the third mounting part. The thigh driving assembly is used for driving the thigh supporting rod to rotate. The transmission swing of the thigh mechanism is small, motion interference can be reduced, and the reliability of the leg device and the biped robot can be improved.

title: Waist assembly of humanoid robot for automobile test
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile testing devices, and discloses a waist assembly of a humanoid robot for automobile testing, which comprises a mounting seat, a first transmission gear, a second transmission gear, a third transmission gear, a first turntable, a second turntable, a third turntable and a driving mechanism, and the driving mechanism comprises a first motor, a second motor, a third motor, a fourth motor and a pushing part; output shafts of the first motor, the second motor, the third motor and the fourth motor are respectively provided with a first driving gear, a second driving gear, a third driving gear and a fourth driving gear, the first driving gear is meshed with the first transmission gear, the second driving gear is meshed with the second transmission gear, and the third driving gear is meshed with the third transmission gear; the abutting piece can drive the fourth motor to do lifting motion so that the fourth driving gear can be meshed with the first transmission gear or the second transmission gear or the third transmission gear. The waist assembly has the advantages that the waist assembly is good in simulation effect and high in degree of freedom, and it can be guaranteed that the progress of a test is smooth.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of automobile testing devices, and discloses a waist assembly of a humanoid robot for automobile testing, which comprises a mounting seat, a first transmission gear, a second transmission gear, a third transmission gear, a first turntable, a second turntable, a third turntable and a driving mechanism, and the driving mechanism comprises a first motor, a second motor, a third motor, a fourth motor and a pushing part; output shafts of the first motor, the second motor, the third motor and the fourth motor are respectively provided with a first driving gear, a second driving gear, a third driving gear and a fourth driving gear, the first driving gear is meshed with the first transmission gear, the second driving gear is meshed with the second transmission gear, and the third driving gear is meshed with the third transmission gear; the abutting piece can drive the fourth motor to do lifting motion so that the fourth driving gear can be meshed with the first transmission gear or the second transmission gear or the third transmission gear. The waist assembly has the advantages that the waist assembly is good in simulation effect and high in degree of freedom, and it can be guaranteed that the progress of a test is smooth.

title: Biped robot control method and biped robot using the same and computer readable storage medium
abstract: A biped robot control methods and a biped robot using the same as well as a computer readable storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining an initial distance between a centroid of a double inverted pendulum model of the biped robot and a support point of the biped robot, an initial moving speed of the centroid and an initial displacement of the centroid; calculating a measured value of a stable point of the doable inverted pendulum model based on the initial distance and the initial moving speed; calculating a control output quantity based on the initial moving speed and the measured value of the stable point; calculating a desired displacement of the centroid of the double-inverted pendulum model based on the initial moving speed, the initial displacement, and the control output quantity; and controlling the biped robot to move laterally according to the desired displacement.
abstract_en: A biped robot control methods and a biped robot using the same as well as a computer readable storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining an initial distance between a centroid of a double inverted pendulum model of the biped robot and a support point of the biped robot, an initial moving speed of the centroid and an initial displacement of the centroid; calculating a measured value of a stable point of the doable inverted pendulum model based on the initial distance and the initial moving speed; calculating a control output quantity based on the initial moving speed and the measured value of the stable point; calculating a desired displacement of the centroid of the double-inverted pendulum model based on the initial moving speed, the initial displacement, and the control output quantity; and controlling the biped robot to move laterally according to the desired displacement.

title: Robot balance control method, robot controller and computer readable storage medium
abstract: A robot balance control method, a controller, and a computer readable storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining a desired motion trajectory matching a current motion status by performing a parameter adaptation adjustment on a current planned motion trajectory; determining, according to the motion status, a desired state parameter of each of soles, a centroid, and a waist of a humanoid robot for conforming to the desired motion trajectory; calculating, based on the motion status and the desired state parameter of each of the soles, the centroid, and the waist of the humanoid robot, a desired driving parameter of the humanoid robot for simultaneously meeting a robot dynamics requirement, a sole control requirement, a centroid control requirement, a waist control requirement, and force control parameter distribution constraint(s) at the current moment; and controlling, based on the desired driving parameter, a movement of the humanoid robot.
abstract_en: A robot balance control method, a controller, and a computer readable storage medium are provided. The method includes: obtaining a desired motion trajectory matching a current motion status by performing a parameter adaptation adjustment on a current planned motion trajectory; determining, according to the motion status, a desired state parameter of each of soles, a centroid, and a waist of a humanoid robot for conforming to the desired motion trajectory; calculating, based on the motion status and the desired state parameter of each of the soles, the centroid, and the waist of the humanoid robot, a desired driving parameter of the humanoid robot for simultaneously meeting a robot dynamics requirement, a sole control requirement, a centroid control requirement, a waist control requirement, and force control parameter distribution constraint(s) at the current moment; and controlling, based on the desired driving parameter, a movement of the humanoid robot.

title: Two-leg bionic robot based on gravity center adjustment and balancing method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a two-leg bionic robot based on gravity center adjustment and a balancing method thereof.The two-leg bionic robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms, a crotch, a circulating mechanism and legs, the head is arranged above the trunk, the arms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the trunk, and the crotch is arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the trunk; compared with the prior art, the robot is simpler, human body limbs are adjusted mainly through bionic human body toppling data, firstly, basic motion data of a human body need to be detected, toppling data of the robot are measured, and then the robot can be used for adjusting the limbs of the human body according to the measured toppling data. According to the robot, the balance mechanism and the circulation mechanism are arranged, the gravity of the robot can be converted into the suction force of the robot to the ground through the balance mechanism, and therefore the probability that the robot topples over is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot upper limb
abstract: An upper limb of a humanoid robot comprises a base, a waist, two mechanical arms and two mechanical claws. Each mechanical arm is an eight-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm and comprises a four-degree-of-freedom shoulder, a one-degree-of-freedom elbow and a three-degree-of-freedom wrist which are connected together in sequence, the four-degree-of-freedom shoulder comprises a one-degree-of-freedom shoulder-sternoclavicular joint so that the mechanical arm can rotate around the waist in the horizontal plane, and each mechanical claw is connected with the corresponding three-degree-of-freedom wrist; the waist part is of a three-degree-of-freedom structure and comprises a one-degree-of-freedom pitching joint, a one-degree-of-freedom rotating joint and a one-degree-of-freedom rolling joint which are connected in sequence, the one-degree-of-freedom pitching joint is installed on the base, and the one-degree-of-freedom shoulder-sternoclavicular joint is connected with the one-degree- The mechanism has the advantages of high degree of freedom, compact structure, high load capacity, excellent working space and excellent operability.
