title: Humanoid message service robot with follow-up head
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid news service robot with a follow-up head, and belongs to the field of service robots, the humanoid news service robot comprises a base, the bottom of the base is provided with a movable chassis, the upper end of the base is rotatably provided with a follow-up mechanism, the follow-up mechanism is rotatably provided with a head, and the follow-up mechanism comprises an orientation adjusting mechanism and an inclination angle adjusting mechanism; the orientation adjusting mechanism comprises an orientation adjusting rotary disc and an orientation adjusting motor, the inclination angle adjusting mechanism comprises two inclination angle adjusting stand columns and an inclination angle adjusting motor, a user can directly wake up the service robot through voice passwords, and the direction of the head of the waken robot can be adjusted along with the face of the user. The user can easily face the human-computer interaction interface, the user does not need to actively adapt to the head position of the robot, interaction between the user and the robot is facilitated, the comfort degree of the user when the user uses the service robot can be effectively improved, and the interaction experience of the user is improved.

title: Vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring facial data of a main driver, and determining the central position of the face of the main driver; determining a rotation control point, and determining the rotation control point according to the mapping relation between the image position and the rotation device control range; connecting with a user mobile phone to obtain a user schedule; and playing greeting words and displaying greeting expressions and schedules. According to the vehicle-mounted robot anthropomorphic interaction method and system disclosed by the invention, the optimal position adjustment of image acquisition is realized through the robot camera, the optimal image acquisition under a simple installation condition is realized, and thus greeting greeting and schedule display are realized; and the intelligent interaction capability of the in-vehicle welcome mode is improved.

title: Rigid-soft hand-simulated autonomous grabbing method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a rigid-soft humanoid hand autonomous grabbing method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control. The capturing method comprises the following steps: acquiring an RGB image of an object by using a depth camera; inputting the RGB image into a YOLOv3 target detection algorithm based on a deep neural network model, and outputting a grabbing mode and a grabbing area of an object; inputting the RGB image into an OpenCV-based image processing method, and outputting a grabbing angle of an object; and according to the grabbing mode, the grabbing area and the grabbing angle, the rigid-soft hand-simulated object is controlled to be grabbed. According to the method, grabbing mode prediction and grabbing pose estimation can be achieved at the same time, complex grabbing planning is avoided, and slight contact between a rigid and soft simulated human hand and a desktop is allowed; accurate control over the rigid-soft imitated human hand can be achieved, and the rigid-soft imitated human hand can accurately and powerfully grab objects.
abstract_en: The invention provides a rigid-soft humanoid hand autonomous grabbing method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control. title: Emotional robot mechanical arm track generation method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an emotion robot mechanical arm track generation method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: mapping human emotion, man-machine distance and environment temperature to a VA (Valence, Arousal) emotion model, and obtaining values of emotion information Valence and Arousal; according to the values, kinematics feature mapping is adopted to obtain the motion trail variable quantity of the mechanical arm in the current emotional state; and a new motion track is obtained by modifying the original track of the mechanical arm, so that real-time emotion expression of the mechanical arm is realized. The motion trail of the mechanical arm of the emotion robot can be generated according to the current environment and the real-time emotion, and natural and harmonious man-machine interaction is achieved.

The motion trail of the mechanical arm of the emotion robot can be generated according to the current environment and the real-time emotion, and natural and harmonious man-machine interaction is achieved.

title: Passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints
abstract: The invention discloses a passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, the passive biped robot comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly and an ankle assembly; and the leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the ankle assembly. The bionic hip joint realizes the movement of the biped robot hip joint on three planes, is more similar to the hip joint movement range of human gaits, and is beneficial to natural walking. Under the condition that no external drive is added to the biped robot, alternate swing of the two legs is achieved through elastic starting of the foot springs. The bionic ankle achieves elastic starting in the walking process, and meanwhile the adaptability of the toes to walking on the ground is improved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive biped robot with bionic hip joints and ankle joints, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, the passive biped robot comprises a hip assembly, a leg assembly and an ankle assembly; and the leg assembly is arranged between the hip assembly and the ankle assembly. title: Foot assembly, leg device and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a foot assembly, a leg device and a biped robot. The foot assembly comprises a foot connecting piece and buffer rubber. The buffering rubber is fixedly connected with the foot connecting piece and comprises a first pressure bearing body, a second pressure bearing body arranged at an interval with the first pressure bearing body and a foot arch part arranged between the first pressure bearing body and the second pressure bearing body. The first pressure-bearing body comprises a first pressure-bearing surface, the second pressure-bearing body comprises a second pressure-bearing surface, and an anti-skid part is arranged between at least one of the first pressure-bearing surface and the second pressure-bearing surface. The foot assembly is good in buffering performance, is applied to a leg device and a biped robot, and can improve the stability of leg control.

title: Shank mechanism, leg device and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a shank mechanism, a leg device and a biped robot. The shank mechanism comprises a foot assembly, a shank transmission assembly and a shank driving assembly. The foot assembly comprises a heel part, a toe part and a first connecting part arranged between the heel part and the toe part, and the heel part is provided with a second connecting part arranged at an interval with the first connecting part. The crus transmission assembly comprises a crus supporting rod, a crus driving rod and a crus transmission rod, the crus supporting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting part, the crus driving rod is rotationally arranged on the crus supporting rod, the crus driving rod is rotationally connected with the crus transmission rod, and the crus transmission rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting part. The shank driving assembly is arranged on the shank supporting rod and is in transmission connection with the shank driving rod, and the shank driving rod drives the shank transmission rod to swing. The transmission swing of the shank mechanism is small, and the reliability of the leg device and the biped robot can be improved.

title: Suspension support for robot teaching
abstract: The utility model discloses a suspension support for robot teaching, which comprises a base, a lifting assembly is movably mounted on the top surface of the base, a connecting rod is fixedly mounted on the top surface of the lifting assembly, and a rotating assembly is movably mounted on the surface of the connecting rod. According to the scheme, the lifting assembly is arranged, the driving gear is driven by the driving device to rotate, so that the second driven gear engaged with the surface of the driving gear can synchronously rotate, and the two first driven gears can be driven to rotate through the connecting shaft in the second driven gear; therefore, through meshing of a rack and a first driven gear, the column body can ascend and descend at a certain height in the bottom column, and the effect of improving the practicability of the device is achieved; and the rotating assembly is arranged, a rotating ring rotates in the fixing disc, and therefore the rotating assembly can be connected to the arm of the humanoid robot in a sleeving mode through a clamping ring, the purpose of hanging the robot is achieved, and the effect of improving the convenience of the device is achieved.

title: Energy efficient legged mobile robot
abstract: A mobile robot includes a non-inverted pendulum body hereafter referred to as NPB with at least one pivot axis and this pivot axis divides the NPB into two portions. One portion of the NPB contains the center of mass of the NPB that can have structures to carry external payloads. The second portion of the NPB can have one or more manipulator arm and vision units. On the pivot axis is disposed at least one leg rotatabily coupled to the NPB. The other end of the leg has a foot joint on which is disposed a drive wheel or a foot. With additional degrees of freedom for each leg the robot can move similar to humanoids, be able to carry and sustain heavy loads with minimal leg joint torques and/or manipulate heavy loads and forces with self-compensating mass of the NPB while using minimal leg joint torques.

title: Control method and device of foot type robot, control equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a control method and device of a foot type robot, control equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a control intention of a user and scene information of a scene where the user is located are obtained; identifying a target object from the scene according to the control intention and the scene information; obtaining a target control instruction corresponding to the control intention; and adopting the target control instruction to control the foot type robot to execute a target action for the target object. According to the invention, the interaction mode between a person and a robot can be effectively enriched, the dimension and application scene of interaction are expanded, and the man-machine interaction effect is improved.

title: NURSING CARE ROBOT
abstract: A nursing care robot according to the present disclosure comprises: a head part; a chest part; an arm part attached to the chest part; a movable neck provided between the head part and the chest part and having a neck joint shaft; a movable shoulder provided between the chest part and the arm part and having a shoulder joint shaft; and a movable hip provided below the chest part and having a hip joint shaft. If viewed from the side surface direction of a standard posture, the neck joint shaft is disposed so as to be offset rearward with respect to the shoulder joint shaft, and the hip joint shaft is disposed so as to be offset forward with respect to the shoulder joint shaft.

title: Humanoid robot hand driving structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot hand driving structure which comprises a front arm, a wrist joint and a plurality of pneumatic machines, the front end of the front arm is connected with the wrist joint in a fastening mode, and the wrist joint is further fixedly connected with a robot hand and used for driving the robot hand to swing. The plurality of pneumatic machines are respectively sleeved on the front arm and are distributed in parallel at equal intervals along the axial direction of the front arm; the pneumatic machines are further connected with the tail ends of stay wires of the robot hands, and when the pneumatic machines work, the corresponding fingers in the robot hands can be bent, straightened, forked or folded by controlling the stay wires. The pneumatic machine is adopted to control the stay wire so that the corresponding fingers can be bent, straightened, forked or folded, and the pneumatic wrist joint is combined to control the overall swing of the robot hand, so that the defect that the occupied space is large in the prior art is overcome, various complex work tasks can be completed, and the requirements of users can be met conveniently; the device is widely suitable for being matched with intelligent robots.

title: Humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot, which belongs to the technical field of meal delivery robots, and comprises a trackless automatic meal delivery robot main body and a meal delivery box, and the trackless automatic meal delivery robot main body is fixedly connected with the meal delivery box. According to the utility model, the controller can control the servo motor to rotate the ball screw, so that the commodity shelf can stably slide out or draw in, dishes are respectively placed in the commodity shelf according to table numbers in a kitchen, the table number information is input through the remote controller, and numbers are displayed on the display screen, so that when the dishes are sent to one table, the dishes can be conveniently placed in the commodity shelf. When the table is used, the IC card of the table can be pasted to the card reader, so that the controller can control the servo motor to rotate to drive the group of storage racks to be discharged, a worker or a customer can take out dishes from the storage racks, and the storage racks can be collected into the meal delivery box through the closing button after the dishes are taken out; according to the humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot device, meal products on multiple tables can be conveniently delivered at the same time, and the working efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Depth generation-based humanoid dexterous hand object grabbing method and robot system
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot grabbing, particularly relates to a humanoid dexterous hand object grabbing method based on depth generation and a robot system, and aims to solve the problem that application of a humanoid dexterous hand is greatly limited due to high grabbing and operation planning complexity caused by complex structure and high degree of freedom of a driving mode of the humanoid dexterous hand. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring single-view point cloud data of an object to be grabbed and performing point cloud completion; sampling of complete point cloud data supplemented by a farthest point sampling method; on the basis of the sampling point set, grabbing configuration of the to-be-grabbed object is generated, and fine adjustment of the grabbing configuration is carried out; and controlling the humanoid dexterous hand to grab the to-be-grabbed object through the finely-adjusted grabbing configuration. According to the method, the humanoid dexterous hand can flexibly grab similar and unknown objects, the accuracy and precision of grabbing configuration are high, the network convergence speed is high, the performance is good, and the robustness is high.

title: Driving mechanism of bionic human head, mouth and face unit
abstract: The invention discloses a driving mechanism of a bionic human head, mouth and face unit, which comprises a mouth corner movement unit, a lip movement unit, a cheek movement unit and a tongue movement unit, and is characterized in that the tongue movement unit comprises a tongue mounting frame, upper teeth, lower teeth, a tongue, a lower jaw and a lower jaw mounting frame; a tongue driving steering engine drives a tongue driving connecting rod to pull a tongue pull rod so that the tongue can stretch out and draw back and move up and down, the mouth corner movement unit comprises control points arranged on the mouth corners on the two sides, the lip movement unit comprises two control points of the upper lip, and the cheek movement unit comprises two cheek control points. Movement of all control points of the mouth corner movement unit, the lip movement unit and the cheek movement unit is achieved in the mode that a steering engine drives a skin connecting magnet at the tail end of a driving connecting rod through the driving connecting rod, and the skin connecting magnet is connected with the skin. The invention has the advantages that the lower teeth move along with the lower jaw to realize the opening and closing of the mouth, the stretching and up-and-down movement of the tongue, and the movement of the mouth corners, the mouth corners and the cheeks to realize smile, beep and other actions.

title: Bionic woven ligament for pulling and pressing hip joint
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic woven ligament for a pulling and pressing body hip joint, and relates to the technical field of mechanical bionic engineering.The bionic woven ligament comprises a bionic iliofemoral ligament body and a bionic pugfemoral ligament body which are woven in a multi-knot transverse grain weaving mode, the near end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament body is used for being attached to anterior inferior spine and acetabular margin, and the near end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament body is used for being attached to the acetabular margin; the far end of the bionic iliofemoral ligament is used for being attached to an intertrochanteric line; the near end of the bionic ligament smegmatis is used for being attached to a pubic protrusion, a pubic superior ramus and the pubic part of the acetabular margin, and the far end of the bionic ligament smegmatis is used for being attached to the lower side of the femoral neck. According to the bionic woven ligament for the pulling and pressing body hip joint, the shape and performance close to those of the hip joint ligament of the human body can be achieved in a biped walking robot.

title: Multi-finger hydraulic humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid manipulator, in particular to a multi-finger hydraulic humanoid manipulator which aims at solving the problems that a traditional hydraulic system driven by hydraulic pressure in the prior art is high in redundancy and not beneficial to integrated design of a manipulator part, and further needs to provide a multi-finger hydraulic humanoid manipulator capable of reducing the redundancy mass of the hydraulic system, simplifying a hydraulic driving structure and improving the reliability of the manipulator part. The invention discloses mechanical equipment for improving tail end control precision. The thumb structure comprises a thumb and two thumb driving hydraulic cylinders which are connected in parallel; the single-finger structure comprises a single finger and a single-finger driving hydraulic cylinder; the three single finger structures are installed at the front end of the palm framework, each single finger is rotationally connected with the palm framework, each single finger driving hydraulic cylinder is connected with one single finger, the thumb structure is installed on the side face, close to the rear end, of the palm framework, and the thumb of the parallel connection structure is rotationally connected with the side face of the palm framework. The single-finger driving hydraulic cylinder shell, the thumb driving hydraulic cylinder shell and the servo valve are all installed on the palm framework. The invention belongs to the field of robots.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT HAVING ROBOT ARM
abstract: A humanoid robot having a robot arm according to the present invention includes: a robot body having a robot arm operated according to a robot arm control signal; a lower driving part connected to a lower part of the robot body; a main lidar sensor part disposed in the lower driving part and having a beam irradiation module for irradiating a beam upward to determine an object; a beam adjustment part changing a center line of an angle of view of the beam irradiation module so that a movable range in which the robot arm operates and a range of an angle of view of the main lidar sensor part do not overlap each other; and a control part for determining that an obstacle exists when the main lidar sensor part determines the object.

title: INSPECTION UNIT INSPECTION APPARATUS WITH THE SAME METHOD FOR CONTROLLLING THE SAME
abstract: The present invention provides a humanoid test robot unit, a wearing robot test system including the same, and a control method of the wearing robot test system, capable of obtaining reliability by providing simulation in the same condition by repeated experiments. According to the present invention, the wearing robot test system (1) includes: the humanoid test robot unit (10); a trajectory generating unit (5) generating reference trajectory information for implementing a movement of the humanoid test robot unit (10); and a system control unit (2) transmitting the reference trajectory information generated by the trajectory generating unit (5) to the humanoid test robot unit (10) and outputting a test result on a wearing robot to be tested, by a system output unit (6) by receiving state information sensed in the humanoid test robot unit (10). The humanoid test robot unit (10) includes: a humanoid robot body (100) capable of being worn by a test wearing robot; a robot control unit (20) executing a motion control of the humanoid robot body (100); a robot sensing unit (50) sensing the state of the humanoid robot body (100); and a robot output unit (70) including a robot joint motor unit (71) providing a motion execution driving force of the humanoid robot body (100) according to a driving control signal of the robot control unit (20).

title: Robot intelligent voice control system
abstract: The invention discloses a robot intelligent voice control system in the field of robot voice control, and the system comprises a microphone input module and an ultrasonic sensor, the microphone input module and the ultrasonic sensor are both connected with a single-chip microcomputer chip SPCE061A, the chip SPCE061 is connected with a robot action module, a voice output module and a communication module, and the communication module is connected with a wireless communication module. Wherein the robot action module comprises a left leg motor, a right leg motor, a head motor and a loudspeaker, and the single-chip microcomputer chip SPCE061A, the ultrasonic sensor and the robot action module are powered by the power supply module; the voice recognition module is used for collecting voice commands sent by people, the voice commands are processed by the single chip microcomputer and compared with stored voice commands, corresponding control signals are generated according to comparison results, then the robot is controlled to do corresponding actions, the communication module is used for transmitting data to the upper computer, and the upper computer is used for controlling the robot to do corresponding actions. A large amount of voice data is processed through the upper computer, the system is simple and practical, the cost is low, resources can be effectively saved, and the system cost is reduced.

title: MOTION CONTROL METHOD AND TWO-LEGGED ROBOT
abstract: A method for controlling motion of a two-legged robot includes: acquiring gait parameters of the two-legged robot; inputting the gait parameters to a preset gait planning model; determining gait trajectory parameters of the two-legged robot based on the gait parameters through the preset gait planning model, in which the gait trajectory parameters include a center-of-mass state corresponding to a double support phase and a center-of-mass state corresponding to a single support phase, and the center-of-mass state includes a center-of-mass position and a center-of-mass movement speed; and controlling the two-legged robot to move according to the gait trajectory parameters.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR CONTROLLING BIPED ROBOT, AND READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for controlling a biped robot, and a readable storage medium. The method includes: acquiring (11) a support phase of the biped robot in a current state; acquiring (12) a current forward speed and a current lateral speed of a center of mass of the biped robot at an end of the support phase; acquiring (13) a torque vector of an ankle joint of a support leg of the biped robot according to the current forward speed and the current lateral speed; acquiring (14) a target torque vector according to the torque vector and a preset Quadratic Programming (QP) model; and controlling (15) the biped robot to move according to the target torque vector.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for controlling a biped robot, and a readable storage medium. title: A HYDRAULICALLY POWERED ROBOT
abstract: A hydraulically powered robot (200) is disclosed. The robot (200) includes at least one hip joint (202) having a maximum of two degrees of freedoms (DOFs), at least one ankle joint (204) having a maximum of two DOFs, at least one knee joint (206) comprising a maximum of one DOF, at least one shoulder joint (208) having a maximum of three DOFs, at least one elbow joint (210) having a maximum of one DOF, and at least one wrist joint (212) having a maximum of one DOF. Each joint includes a hydraulic pump (214) that includes a piston rod (216), a cylinder (218), a lead screw (220) coupled to the piston rod (216), and a motor (222) configured to rotate the lead screw (220) to cause a linear motion of the lead screw (220) and the piston rod (216) relative to the cylinder (218).
abstract_en: A hydraulically powered robot (200) is disclosed. The robot (200) includes at least one hip joint (202) having a maximum of two degrees of freedoms (DOFs), at least one ankle joint (204) having a maximum of two DOFs, at least one knee joint (206) comprising a maximum of one DOF, at least one shoulder joint (208) having a maximum of three DOFs, at least one elbow joint (210) having a maximum of one DOF, and at least one wrist joint (212) having a maximum of one DOF. Each joint includes a hydraulic pump (214) that includes a piston rod (216), a cylinder (218), a lead screw (220) coupled to the piston rod (216), and a motor (222) configured to rotate the lead screw (220) to cause a linear motion of the lead screw (220) and the piston rod (216) relative to the cylinder (218).

title: Intelligentization-based education humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to an intellectualization-based education humanoid robot in the technical field of intelligent education, which comprises a mechanical trunk, a driving rotating shaft arranged at the bottom of the mechanical trunk, a mechanical crotch arranged at the bottom of the driving rotating shaft, electric universal balls arranged on two sides of the bottom end of the mechanical crotch, and first supporting legs arranged below the sides of the electric universal balls. An electric rotating wheel is arranged at the bottom of the first supporting leg, a second supporting leg is further arranged at the bottom of the first supporting leg, and a sole is arranged at the bottom of the second supporting leg. The mechanical trunk is connected with the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg through the arranged mechanical crotch, so that the mechanical trunk can be supported by the mechanical crotch, a good supporting effect is achieved, and the mobility between the first supporting leg and the mechanical crotch and between the first supporting leg and the second supporting leg is achieved through the arranged electric universal ball and the arranged electric rotating wheel. Therefore, the function that the robot moves through the two feet is achieved, traditional moving disc driving is effectively replaced through the design, the trafficability of the robot in the moving process is greatly improved, and the practicability of the robot is improved.

title: Sectional type fitting robot
abstract: The sectional type fitting robot comprises a supporting frame and further comprises main diaphragms and auxiliary diaphragms, when the robot stands upright, the end face, facing the same direction as the head-up direction of the two eyes of the robot, of the supporting frame serves as the front face, and the front face, the back face, the left side face and the right side face of the supporting frame are each provided with a plurality of main diaphragms; a window is formed in at least one of the main diaphragms located on the front face or the back face, the auxiliary diaphragms are arranged in the windows, the auxiliary diaphragms and the main diaphragms are arranged at intervals, and the main diaphragms or the auxiliary diaphragms located on the front face or the back face can horizontally move relative to the supporting frame in the direction facing the front face or the back face. The main diaphragms positioned on the left side surface or the right side surface can horizontally move relative to the supporting frame along the direction towards which the left side surface or the right side surface faces; according to the fitting robot, the main membrane and the auxiliary membrane which are matched with each other are arranged on the four side faces of the supporting frame correspondingly, so that the size of a specific part on the body can be adjusted carefully, and the size adaptability of the fitting robot is enhanced.

title: Simulation facial expression robot neck movement mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a neck movement mechanism of a simulation facial expression robot. The neck movement mechanism comprises a neck rotating mechanism, a neck side swinging mechanism, a neck mounting bottom plate, a supporting base, a shoulder shell and a head supporting stand column. Wherein the neck rotating mechanism is driven by a double-shaft steering engine to complete the rotating action. The neck side-sway mechanism can achieve front-back, left-right and side-sway movement of the neck, wherein the neck movement is completed by driving a difference gear through a difference shaft by two steering engines. According to the neck movement mechanism designed by the invention, the multi-degree-of-freedom movement of the neck can be realized, and the neck movement of a human body is simulated more similarly, so that the neck movement of the facial expression robot looks more flexible.

title: Social robot-oriented multi-modal fusion emotion recognition method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a social robot-oriented multi-modal fusion emotion recognition method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining real-time perception information of a target person, the real-time perception information comprising image information, touch information and sound information; pre-processing the real-time sensing information to obtain pre-processed sensing information; and obtaining an emotion recognition result according to the preprocessed perception information. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that vision, voice and touch sensing data are fused for emotion recognition, the microphone and the myoelectricity sensor are used for acquiring the voice sensing data and the vision sensing data, a plurality of key points are adopted for capturing human body parameters, recognition accuracy is improved, and meanwhile the method is suitable for more environments.

title: Humanoid soil gathering and returning landfill mechanism device
abstract: A humanoid soil gathering and returning landfill mechanism device comprises a left crank-rocker-like mechanism and a right crank-rocker-like mechanism which are matched with each other to gather soil, each crank-rocker-like mechanism comprises a soil returning cup, a concave cavity is formed in the inner side of each soil returning cup, and a mounting lug plate is arranged on the outer side face of each soil returning cup; the mounting lug plate is fixedly connected with the lower end of the V-shaped soil return connecting rod through a first bolt; the upper end of the V-shaped soil return connecting rod is hinged with the lower end of the side link through a second bolt; the upper end of the frame connecting rod is rotationally connected with the front end of the second optical axis, and the rear end of the second optical axis rotationally penetrates through the upper end of the rack rod; the corner end of the V-shaped soil returning connecting rod is rotationally connected with the front end of the first optical shaft; the rear end of the first optical shaft is rotationally connected with the lower end of the soil returning crank; the upper end of the soil returning crank is fixedly connected with the front end of a third optical shaft, and the rear end of the third optical shaft rotatably penetrates through the lower end of the rack rod and is connected with an output shaft of the motor. Seedlings cannot be greatly influenced, and the soil returning process of humanoid soil gathering is efficiently completed.

title: Mechanical leg of biped robot and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mechanical leg of a biped robot and the biped robot, the mechanical leg is provided with a thigh, a shank and a sole, the thigh and the shank are hinged to each other, the sole is hinged to the lower end of the shank, the mechanical leg comprises a leg lifting driving assembly, a leg bending assembly and a sole action assembly, the driving assemblies are located on the front side and the rear side of the thigh and used for driving the thigh to swing front and back, the leg bending assemblies are located on the front side and the rear side of the thigh and used for driving the shank to conduct bending action, and the sole action assemblies are located on the rear side of the shank and used for driving the sole to pitch front and back. The action process is stable, through cooperation of the leg lifting driving assembly, the leg bending assembly and the sole action assembly, the walking requirement of the biped robot is met, the action is more accurate and stable, and control is easy.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT COMPRISING ARTICULATED LEGS WITH WHEELS OR TRACKS
abstract: The invention relates generally to a mobile robot, e.g. a humanoid robot, configured to provide reality capture and metrology grade geometric measurement, e.g. to generally support infrastructure surveillance and/or to support workflows in the field of metrology. Aspects of the mobile robot, inter alia, relate to providing increased accuracy of metrology grade devices to overcome deficiencies in mobile reality capture. On the other hand, benefits of mobility provided by mobile robots are transformed to the field of metrology while maintaining metrology grade accuracy.

title: ASSIGNING A TASK TO A REMOTELY LOCATED EXPERT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for determining and assigning a task to a remotely located expert (36), and to a corresponding computer program, a device (10) and a system (18). According to the invention, by means of a task creation from a request, a suitable expert (36) is searched for and found in an automated manner, wherein the expert (36) processes the task creation from a remote location in a virtual environment. For example, the machines (40) of a plant are monitored by an AI system (42) and a task to be carried out on the machines is stored in a backlog system or a memory (44). A further AI system (46) identifies a suitable expert (36), who then performs an activity (e.g. maintenance or error correction) on the machines (40) in a virtual environment, for example by means of a sensor glove (24), a VR input device or a sensor suit (38). The expert (36) can also control a humanoid robot (32) in order to perform the activity.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot with leg structure
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot with the leg structure. The leg structure of the humanoid robot comprises a joint driving module, a driving module and a driving module, the second joint fixing frame is connected with the first joint driving module; the cross shaft connecting piece is internally provided with a cavity, and the cross shaft connecting piece is rotatably arranged on the two-joint fixing frame; a frame thigh; a frame shank; a foot plate; the two-joint driving module is mounted on the two-joint fixing frame; the three-joint driving module is mounted on the cross shaft connecting piece; the four-joint driving module is mounted on the thigh of the frame and located below the three-joint driving module; and the five-joint driving module is mounted in the frame thigh. The leg structure of the humanoid robot has the advantages of being light in weight, concentrated in weight, low in tail end weight, small in rotational inertia and the like.

title: Series-parallel connection hybrid biped robot
abstract: A series-parallel connection hybrid biped robot comprises a hip connecting piece (1) and legs (100 and 101) on the left side and the right side. The left leg part (100) and the right leg part (101) comprise hip joints (2), thigh part driving branch chains (3), thigh part driven branch chains (4), shank parts (5), ankle joints (6) and foot parts (7); the hip joints (2) on the two sides are fixedly connected through the hip connecting piece (1), the hip platform (21) is fixedly connected with the driving sliding rail module (39), and the first connecting piece (22), the second connecting piece (24) and the third connecting piece (26) are hinged to the fourth connecting piece (44), the fifth connecting piece (45) and the sixth connecting piece (46) respectively. The two ends of the thigh driving branch chain (3) and the thigh driven branch chain (4) are hinged to the hip joint (2) and the shank part (5) respectively and control the hip joint (2) and the shank part (5) to rotate; the two ends of the ankle joint (6) are hinged to the shank part (5) and the foot part (7) respectively and control the shank part (5) and the foot part (7) to rotate. A single leg of the biped robot has six degrees of freedom, and the driving devices are all in linear driving.

title: Rotation driving knee joint of hydraulic biped robot
abstract: The hydraulic biped robot rotation driving knee joint comprises a driving mechanism, the top of the driving mechanism is fixedly connected with a thigh connecting plate, and the bottom of the driving mechanism is rotationally connected with a shank connecting plate; the driving mechanism comprises a packaging shell, and a front hydraulic cylinder and a rear hydraulic cylinder are installed on the front portion and the rear portion in the packaging shell respectively and form an integrated differential hydraulic cylinder. By adopting the integrated differential hydraulic cylinder and combining with the rotating piece and the rotating shaft, the front hydraulic cylinder and the rear hydraulic cylinder can move simultaneously to drive the rotating shaft to rotate, relative rotation of the thigh connecting plate and the shank connecting plate is achieved, a traditional knee joint can be replaced, bilateral driving is achieved through the integrated hydraulic cylinder, linear driving is converted into rotating driving, and the driving efficiency is improved. The occupied space of the knee joint can be greatly reduced, and compared with a traditional knee joint, the same action requirement can be met through smaller driving force of the front hydraulic cylinder and the rear hydraulic cylinder.

title: Humanoid robot variable load standing method based on model reference adaptive control
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot variable load standing method based on model reference adaptive control, which comprises the following steps of: constructing a three-connecting-rod model of a humanoid robot, deducing a kinetic equation of the three-connecting-rod model, and obtaining a joint torque expression of the three-connecting-rod model; the joint torque obtained through calculation serves as feed-forward torque, the feed-forward torque and the output quantity of a PD controller form joint torque control quantity, the joint torque control quantity is input into a control system of the humanoid robot, meanwhile, the updating rate of a kinetic parameter estimated value is calculated, and the feed-forward torque is updated till control errors of the joint angle and the joint angular speed are eliminated; building a model reference adaptive control algorithm under the condition that the two legs of the humanoid robot stand side by side; and carrying out variable-load standing debugging on the humanoid robot. Feedforward control is used, the joint torque needed for supporting the gravity load is calculated through a three-connecting-rod model kinetic equation when the two legs stand side by side, the joint torque is directly added to the output end of the PD controller, the control time is shortened, and the joint control precision is guaranteed.

title: Air-ground dual-purpose humanoid intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses an air-ground dual-purpose humanoid intelligent robot, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The variable aircraft is arranged on the back of the robot body, the variable aircraft comprises four shaft arms with adjustable angles, brushless motors are arranged at the tail ends of the shaft arms, and the brushless motors are in transmission connection with rotor wings. The air-ground dual-purpose humanoid intelligent robot provided by the invention not only can walk on both feet on the land, but also can fly in the air.

title: Shell assembly and chest of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of automobile test devices, and discloses a shell assembly and a chest of a humanoid robot, the shell assembly comprises a back shell and a front shell which are arranged in a split manner, and the front shell is connected with the back shell; wherein the front shell and the back shell define a mounting cavity, an upper mounting opening is formed in the tops of the front shell and the back shell, a lower mounting opening is formed in the bottoms of the front shell and the back shell, and side mounting openings are formed in the two sides of the front shell and the back shell respectively; the front shell is provided with a plurality of front installation openings, and the upper installation opening, the lower installation opening, the side installation openings and the front installation openings are all communicated with the installation cavity. title: SYSTEMS, METHODS AND APPARATUS FOR AUGMENTED ACTIVITY
abstract: Systems and methods for integrating bipedalism augmentation components are provided. A system can receive a request to modify a footwear, comprising a sole formed of an insole and an outsole. The system can select a footplate based on a size of the footwear. The footplate can include a first portion extending along at least a first portion of the sole, a second portion extending along at least a second portion of the sole, wherein the first portion of the footplate has greater rigidity than the second portion, and a mounting component connected to the first portion. The system can provide an indication of the selected the footplate for insertion between the insole and the outsole such that the first portion is located proximate to a heel of the footwear and the mounting component protrudes at least partially from the sole, the mounting component configured to couple to a bracket.

title: Double-joint under-actuated robot finger
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a double-joint underactuated robot finger which comprises a base, a first knuckle fixedly installed at the top of the base, a second knuckle hinged to the top of the first knuckle, a third knuckle hinged to the top of the second knuckle and a second knuckle hinged to the top of the third knuckle. A first joint shaft is arranged at the hinged position of the first knuckle and the second knuckle. Through the cooperation of the first transmission structure, the second transmission structure and the other structures, when rotation continues to be conducted, the third transmission structure moves, so that the third knuckle fixedly connected with the second joint shaft rotates, multi-joint coupling rotation grabbing is achieved, the multi-joint coupling rotation grabbing device is quite personified, and the multi-joint coupling rotation grabbing device is suitable for large-scale popularization and application. And meanwhile, objects can be grabbed in a holding mode, automatic resetting is achieved through the spring piece, the device is low in cost and easy to control, the appearance and action of the device are similar to those of a human hand, and the device is suitable for anthropomorphic robot hands.

title: TELEPRESENCE IN PERSON TO A ROBOT
abstract: This invention is about a robot at a remote location which is connected to a real person or a thing within a 3D-Modelling-System at a local place where the robot changes its shape to match exactly to the person(s) or things(s) at the local place. This innovation describes several technical solutions to make the robot change its shape to the person or the thing at the local site, for example via displayable surfaces of the robot, via projection on the surface of the robot, via inflatable mechanisms on the surface of the robot in a real environment.The invention also includes a virtual presentation of the person(s) and things(s) within a virtual or semi-real environment. Semi-real environment is a real environment information transferred to a virtual environment where person(s) or things(s) are presented as with their current, real environment.In a telepresence environment, persons or things in one place can be virtually presented at a remote place as holographic 3D presentation either in a task-ins-cubicle achieving full communication and interaction at the remote place as described in the following own patents.DE-Patent: DE 10 2012 007 441 B4PCT: EP2013/002769US-Patent: US 10,728,496 B2UK-Patent: GB2536370Indian Patent Application No. 201617012621The quality of the holographic view depends on the quality of the screens and the transmission. Blind people has no benefit from the holographic presentation. Both of these drawbacks can be solved and the telepresence can be brought to a more real situation, in case the person appears on the remote site as touchable real person. This can be achieved, in that the 3D modelling made at the local site, for example using task-ins-cubicle local version, the remote site can utilize a morphing of a preliminary setup, for example a humanoid robot, via inflatable modelling system to present this 3D model as close to the real one as possible. Another perfect setup would be to get the 3D Modelling of the person(s) from one or more 3D Modelling Systems for example task-ins-cubicles and then bring them together in a virtual or semi-virtual environment, with their real, current appearance of the persons and things modelled.Robot at the remote site has at least for the front view a multimedia-system, integrating video-audio and control information and sending these back to the local 3D-Modelling-System, for example task-ins.-cubicle-local at the local site, so the person there feels to be at the remote site and can move around walking for example on a mechatronic walking-band, and also can move the hands of the robot synchronised with own, can also see the actions locally of course. This applies both to real and to virtual environments.NeedIt is a very big advantage to make a near real presentation of the person that appears at the remote site, because it is not any more dependent on the quality of the transmission or on the quality of screens as in task-ins-cubicle. As the occupied space is also smaller, its usage is more practical.On the other hand, because it is considered a big advantage to introduce not only a static model, i.e. there is need to have walking and talking abilities. So a robotics system could be employed. But not a robotics system that is remotely controlled and have own intelligence, but instead a robotics system that is coupled to a 3D-Modelling-System, for example task-ins-cubicle local and can be used as a telepresence hardware, i.e. decision making actions can be directly made via the person(s) within connected 3d-modelling-system for example task-ins-cubicle local.On the other hand, the remote robot should resemble exactly to the person in task-ins-cubicle local. So it is a robot that morphs itself to the person situated at a remote place.By telepresence, a robotic presentation of the person at another site with many robotics abilities such as walking, moving functional arms, legs and hands and such as talking, with moving lips according to the spoken language, i.e. audible output would be a very big advantage for handling different tasks from a distance and for socialising.By telepresence, there is need that a local real person is connected to self as a hard duplicate but as own person with all actions and but also as important combines the advantages of task-ins-cubicle system, i.e. is able to feel himself/herself at the remote location.A hard appearance of the person makes it easier with blind people to interact too as they can not only hear the person at the remote site, but they can also feel the presence of the person.

title: Flexible redundant humanoid leg based on multi-state pneumatic muscle series-parallel connection
abstract: The invention relates to a flexible redundant humanoid leg based on multi-state pneumatic muscle series-parallel connection, a left leg and a right leg are arranged below a middle connecting plate, the left leg and the right leg are mirror images of each other, the left leg sequentially comprises a thigh joint, a knee joint and a shank joint from top to bottom, and a thigh bone of the thigh joint is rotatably connected with the middle connecting plate; the side face of the middle of the thigh bone and the middle connecting plate are rotationally connected with the two ends of the first inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the second inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the third inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the fourth inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the fifth inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the sixth inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the seventh inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the eighth inner-layer pneumatic muscle, the ninth inner-layer pneumatic muscle and the tenth inner-layer pneumatic muscle respectively. The device simulates coordinated contraction of multiple layers of muscles, the working states of the pneumatic muscles are diversified, and the degree of freedom of the joints is adjusted without changing the differential pressure of the pneumatic muscles.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a trunk unit, a head unit, an upper limb unit and a lower limb unit, a head steering engine set can drive a head mask to rotate through a head support, and therefore the up-down pitching action and the left-right turning action of a camera element are achieved; the upper limb unit comprises two sets of symmetrically-arranged arm mechanisms, and the arm mechanisms can achieve front-back and left-right arm swinging movement and can further achieve arm bending movement. Meanwhile, the lower limb unit comprises two sets of leg mechanisms, the leg mechanisms are movably connected with the trunk support to form a structure similar to a hip joint of a human body, the thigh support can swing front and back and left and right, the shank support can rotate relative to the thigh support to achieve leg bending movement, and the sole connected with the shank support can swing front and back. In addition, the foot soles can swing left and right, and the flexibility of the robot is comprehensively improved.

title: Method for realizing real-time mirroring behavior of robot based on lightweight neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a method for realizing a real-time mirroring behavior of a robot based on a lightweight neural network, and the method specifically comprises the steps: 1, carrying out the preprocessing of a sample face image, 2, building a lightweight deep neural network, and training the lightweight deep neural network through employing the sample face image; 3, extracting facial feature points in the current face image collected by the camera by using a lightweight deep neural network; 4, the face of the anthropomorphic robot is provided with a plurality of facial expression steering engines and head posture steering engines, and displacement of the corresponding facial expression steering engines is obtained according to the Euclidean distance between the facial feature points; a rotation matrix is obtained through calculation according to the conversion relation between the image coordinate system and the world coordinate system, the rotation matrix is converted into an Euler angle, and the displacement of a head posture steering engine is obtained according to the Euler angle; and finally, the anthropomorphic robot is controlled to realize anthropomorphic mirror image The method has the characteristics of high precision, real-time performance, high naturalness and the like.

title: Integrated hip joint of hydraulic biped robot
abstract: The hydraulic biped robot integrated hip joint comprises a waist truss, the waist truss is of a frame structure, and two yaw adjusting mechanisms used for controlling a left leg and a right leg of a robot respectively are installed in the inner space of the waist truss; each yaw adjusting mechanism is connected with a thigh structure of the robot through the corresponding rolling adjusting mechanism and the corresponding pitching adjusting mechanism in sequence. The rolling adjusting mechanism comprises a rolling hydraulic cylinder which is vertically arranged, a driving block which can move up and down is arranged in the rolling hydraulic cylinder, and through holes which are symmetrically formed are formed in the positions, corresponding to the driving block, of the side wall of the rolling hydraulic cylinder; a fixing hole is formed in the driving block, a rolling transverse shaft is installed in the fixing hole, the other end of the rolling transverse shaft extends out of the waist truss, and the other end of the rolling transverse shaft is rotationally connected with the pitching adjusting mechanism; the occupied space of the three-degree-of-freedom adjusting mechanism can be reduced, and the action space needed by the three-degree-of-freedom adjusting mechanism during leg action is reduced.

title: Full-digital flexible position sensing system for humanoid dexterous finger joints
abstract: The invention provides a full-digital flexible position sensing system for humanoid dexterous finger joints. The full-digital flexible position sensing system comprises Hall angular displacement sensors and a palm switching circuit module, wherein the Hall angular displacement sensors and the palm switching circuit module are integrally installed on the distal finger joint, the middle finger joint and the base finger joint of a finger respectively; the Hall angular displacement sensors of the far finger joints, the middle finger joints and the base joints of the fingers transmit information to one another in a daisy chain connection mode, and communication cables between the Hall angular displacement sensors of the far finger joints, the middle finger joints and the base joints of the fingers and between the angular displacement sensors and the palm switching circuit module are flexible circuit boards. A novel non-contact type small Hall angular displacement sensing system is adopted, and digital accurate measurement of the joint rotation angle of the humanoid dexterous finger is achieved.
abstract_en: The invention provides a full-digital flexible position sensing system for humanoid dexterous finger joints. The full-digital flexible position sensing system comprises Hall angular displacement sensors and a palm switching circuit module, wherein the Hall angular displacement sensors and the palm switching circuit module are integrally installed on the distal finger joint, the middle finger joint and the base finger joint of a finger respectively; the Hall angular displacement sensors of the far finger joints, the middle finger joints and the base joints of the fingers transmit information to one another in a daisy chain connection mode, and communication cables between the Hall angular displacement sensors of the far finger joints, the middle finger joints and the base joints of the fingers and between the angular displacement sensors and the palm switching circuit module are flexible circuit boards. title: Humanoid robot head
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot head. The humanoid robot head comprises a head skeleton, eye parts, a mouth part and an integral rotating structure, the eye parts are arranged on two sides of the upper part of the head skeleton; the mouth part is arranged on the lower side of the middle part of the head skeleton; the integral rotating structure is arranged at the lower part of the head skeleton; the mouth part comprises an electromagnet, a mouth part and a fixing part, the telescopic end of the electromagnet is connected with the mouth part to enable the mouth part to stretch out and draw back, and the fixing part is connected with the opposite side of the telescopic end of the electromagnet. The head of the humanoid robot can integrally simulate the movement of the head of a human body.

title: Non-disabled Vehicle Recognition Robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a non-disabled personal vehicle recognition robot, which has a robot body to be easily gripped with two hands, has robot wheels to easily move and arrive at a destination, and has a camera to identify a disabled personal vehicle registration card, thereby solving a problem of difficulty in identifying a disabled personal vehicle registration card when a non-disabled person's car is illegally parked in a parking area for the handicapped. Accordingly, it is possible to solve a conventional problem of difficulty in identifying a disabled personal vehicle registration card when a non-disabled person's car is illegally parked in a parking area for the handicapped. That is, the present invention relates to an illegal parking regulating CCTV which comprises: a robot body formed in the shape of a human body to be easily gripped with two hands; robot wheels shaped like a vehicle or bicycle to move easily and arrive at a destination; and a camera with a camera lens shaped like a human eye to identify a vehicle registration card for the handicapped.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid double-arm robot which comprises a supporting frame. The head mechanism comprises a head shell and a head driving assembly, and the head driving assembly drives the head shell to rotate around the Z-axis direction, the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction; the upper arm mechanisms are oppositely arranged on the two sides of the supporting frame, each upper arm mechanism comprises an upper arm shell and an upper arm driving assembly, and the upper arm driving assemblies drive the upper arm shells to rotate around the X-axis direction, the Y-axis direction and the Z-axis direction; the front arm mechanism comprises a front arm shell and a front arm driving assembly, and the front arm driving assembly drives the front arm shell to rotate around the X-axis direction and the Y-axis direction; the palm mechanism comprises a palm body and a palm driving assembly, and the palm driving assembly drives the palm body to rotate around the X axis and the Z axis. The humanoid double-arm robot provided by the utility model is simpler and lighter in structure and has multiple degrees of freedom, so that the driving operation of different actions is realized.

title: Leg device and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg device and a biped robot. The leg device comprises a shank mechanism and a thigh mechanism. The shank mechanism comprises a foot assembly and a shank transmission assembly. The foot assembly comprises a heel part, a toe part and a first connecting part, the toe part and the heel part are arranged at an interval, the first connecting part is arranged between the heel part and the toe part, and the heel part is provided with a second connecting part which is arranged at an interval with the first connecting part; the crus transmission assembly comprises a crus supporting rod, a crus driving rod and a crus transmission rod, the crus supporting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting part, one end of the crus driving rod is rotationally arranged on the crus supporting rod, and the other end of the crus driving rod is rotationally connected with one end of the crus transmission rod; and the other end of the shank transmission rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting part. The thigh mechanism comprises a thigh transmission assembly connected with the shank mechanism. The leg device is good in terrain adaptability, and the motion performance of the biped robot can be improved.

title: WEARABLE ROBOT INCLUDING SERIES ELASTIC ACTUATOR THAT ACTIVELY INTERVEN
abstract: The present invention relates to a wearable robot including a serial elastic actuator for active intervention, and more specifically, to a wearable robot including a serial elastic actuator for active intervention, which comprises: a body unit including a serial elastic actuating unit which is operated by the actuation of a motor unit; a leg unit which is connected to the body unit and is extended to the ground surface, while including at least one joint and being formed to correspond to the direction in which the leg of the user is extended; and a step unit which is formed at the lower end portion of the leg unit, and is disposed between the sole of the user and the ground surface. The step unit comprises at least one sensor unit which forms detection information by detecting the load generated by means of the user. The sensor unit is linked with the motor unit to deliver the detection information to the motor unit. The motor unit includes at least the detection information from at least one actuating condition. Therefore, the muscular strength of the user can be actively assisted.

title: Lightweight integrated biped robot thigh structure
abstract: The invention discloses a lightweight integrated biped robot thigh structure. The lightweight integrated biped robot thigh structure comprises a large hip motor a, a hip motor b, a knee motor and a thigh structure body, the thigh structure body comprises a leg shell, a hip motor a, a hip motor b and a knee motor; the shell surface of the thigh shell adopts a lightweight topological structure; a pair of mounting holes a1 is oppositely formed in the two sides of the upper part of the thigh shell, and the hip motor a is mounted in the mounting holes a1; a pair of mounting holes b1 are oppositely formed in the two sides of the middle of the thigh shell, and the hip motor b is mounted on the mounting holes b1; a pair of mounting holes c1 are oppositely formed in the two sides of the lower part of the thigh shell, and the knee motor is mounted on the mounting holes c1; the hole walls of the mounting hole a1, the mounting hole b1 and the mounting hole b1 are of a lightweight lattice structure. According to the method, two lightweight design means of topological optimization and dot matrix filling are fused, the weight reduction space of the thigh structure is fully excavated, and the structure is prepared by adopting a selective laser melting forming process.

title: Humanoid device suitable for cultural and creative performance
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid device suitable for cultural and creative performance, and relates to the field of cultural and creative performance, the humanoid device comprises a movable table, the bottom end of the movable table is connected with a connector through a transmission shaft, and a plurality of groups of branch joints distributed in an annular array are embedded in the upper surface of the movable table; eight driving mechanisms distributed in an annular array are arranged on the peripheral side of the movable table, a cable is arranged below the driving mechanisms, and moving assemblies are arranged on the driving mechanisms. Eight driving mechanisms are arranged on the peripheral side of a movable table, four long supporting rods and four short supporting rods are arranged on moving assemblies of the eight driving mechanisms, a plurality of first blades with different lengths are arranged on the long supporting rods, and a plurality of second blades with different lengths are arranged on the short supporting rods; the long supporting rods are matched with the first blades on the long supporting rods, the short supporting rods are matched with the second blades on the short supporting rods to form contours of different parts of a human shape, and the four long supporting rods and the four short supporting rods are gathered together to form a human-simulated structure.

title: Humanoid robot structure based on single-shaft steering engine
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot structure based on a single-shaft steering engine, the humanoid robot structure comprises a head and a thoracico-belly, a first mounting shaft is fixedly arranged on the lower side wall of the head, a first mounting hole is formed in the upper end of the thoracico-belly, the robot realizes a ninety-degree movement mode in a limited space, and the humanoid robot structure is simple in structure and convenient to use. According to the robot structure, the basic movement function of human beings can be simulated, movement and space are larger, dead angle and dead knot areas are compressed and reduced, the design of a control system can be simplified by combining the mode that power is input through a steering engine, and the steering engine, the four limbs and the trunk and other parts can be changed according to the actual requirements of different scenes. And the robot structure is high in reference performance and high in generalizability. In addition, the structure is convenient to modify and optimize, modular production can be achieved, the application range of the structure is widened, and the contradiction among multiple categories, small batch, long production period and high production cost in robot production is effectively solved.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom parallel driving humanoid ankle joint mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom parallel driving humanoid ankle joint mechanism, and relates to the technical field of biped humanoid robot ankle joints. The problems that an existing robot ankle joint is insufficient in driving force, small in rigidity and free of perception are solved, and meanwhile the problem that the structure is complex and heavy due to the complex structure of a multi-degree-of-freedom human leg ankle joint is solved. Piston rods in two ankle joint piston assemblies are hinged to the head ends of two ankle joint two-force rods through two two-force rod connecting hinges correspondingly, and the tail ends of the two ankle joint two-force rods are hinged to two two-force rod shaft seats through two two-force rod cross shaft hinges correspondingly. When the two hydraulic cylinders push the two piston rods to move synchronously, the humanoid foot rotates in the pitching direction, and when the two hydraulic cylinders push the two piston rods to move asynchronously, the humanoid foot rotates in the side-sway direction. According to the invention, the driving torque can be provided exponentially, and the advantages of high rigidity and large load are achieved.

The problems that an existing robot ankle joint is insufficient in driving force, small in rigidity and free of perception are solved, and meanwhile the problem that the structure is complex and heavy due to the complex structure of a multi-degree-of-freedom human leg ankle joint is solved. title: Rigidity-variable flexible humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of manipulators, in particular to a variable-rigidity flexible humanoid manipulator, which comprises a grabbing component, the grabbing component comprises a forearm, a palm, a first motor, a second motor, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger and an air pump, and the middle finger comprises a frame, an air bag with particles, a hose and a pressure sensor; the first motor drives the thumb to adjust the angle, the second motor drives the little finger to adjust the angle, so that the structure of the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger is closer to the structure of a human hand, the frame achieves the bending grabbing action, the air bag with particles is installed on the inner side of the end, away from the palm, of the frame, and the air pump can inflate the air bag with the particles. The pressure sensor is used for monitoring the grabbing force, the frame part is made of silica gel, the variable rigidity effect is achieved through the air bag with the particles and the frame, and therefore the rigidity of the mechanical arm can be adjusted.

title: HUMANOID HAND
abstract: To provide a humanoid hand capable of performing, with only one actuator, gripping and finger forming.SOLUTION: When a reference pin is positioned in a neutral position, a humanoid hand takes forms shown in Figs. 1 (b) to (a), where a thumb mechanism 2, in an extended state, is turned toward an inner side of a palm, while the other four finger mechanisms are in an extended state. title: Hip stabilizing structure and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The utility model provides a hip stabilizing structure and a humanoid robot with the same, the hip stabilizing structure comprises a mounting bracket, a steering engine, a U-shaped piece and a fixing piece, the mounting bracket is provided with a mounting port for mounting the steering engine; and the two steering engines are connected and fixed together by the mounting bracket and the fixing piece. title: Biped robot and upright balance control experiment platform
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot and an upright balance control experiment platform. The biped robot comprises a trunk support, two leg connecting pieces, thighs, shanks and foot plates which are arranged from top to bottom. Only the ankle joint of the biped robot can rotate freely, so that the structural complexity of the biped robot is reduced, and meanwhile, the upright balance control experiment at the ankle joint of the biped robot is not influenced. A motor of the experiment platform is controlled to output torque, the output torque is amplified through a transmission assembly, the amplified torque is transmitted to a connecting shaft of a shank at the right end, a body above ankles of the biped robot rotates around the connecting shaft, and ankle joints of the biped robot are adjusted to be upright and balanced in the rotating process. And the encoder detects the angle change generated by the movement of the biped robot so as to judge the upright balance state of the biped robot. If the ankles of the biped robot are in the upright balance state, the expected torque required for keeping the biped robot upright balance can be obtained by obtaining the amplified output torque of the motor.

title: Humanoid flexible dexterous hand and finger joints thereof
abstract: According to the humanoid flexible dexterous hand and the finger joint thereof, the finger joint comprises knuckles, spring steel sheets and a C-shaped cross section, the knuckles are provided with key rope groove holes for a bent key rope to penetrate through, the spring steel sheets are connected between every two adjacent knuckles and arranged on the end faces of the knuckles close to the finger back side, and the C-shaped cross section protrudes towards the finger back side; the first acting force is used for providing first acting force for the knuckles bent towards the finger pulp side to enable the knuckles to reset, or providing second acting force for the knuckles bent towards the finger back side to enable the knuckles to have supporting force; and the pins are arranged on the end surfaces of the knuckles close to the finger pulp side and are used for tensioning the bent key rope. The humanoid flexible dexterous hand comprises a palm and a plurality of fingers connected to the palm, and the finger joints are arranged in the fingers. The fingers of the humanoid flexible dexterous hand can be bent, the fingers have humanoid reverse supporting capacity, the structure is simple, the weight is small, and a fine grabbing task can be completed.

title: Lightweight human body power assisting device based on single-drive actuator
abstract: The invention discloses an efficient and rapid light-weight human body power assisting device based on a single-drive actuator, and provides the efficient and rapid light-weight human body power assisting device based on the single-drive actuator, the efficient and rapid light-weight human body power assisting device based on the single-drive actuator comprises the drive actuator, and a first drive rod and a second drive rod which are arranged on the two sides of the drive actuator respectively; the driving actuator comprises a stator shell and a rotor rotating shaft capable of rotating relative to the stator shell; the first driving rod rotates along with the stator shell; the second driving rod rotates along with the rotor rotating shaft; one side of the first driving rod is connected with a first driving tail end matched with one side leg of a human body; one side of the second driving rod is connected with a second driving tail end matched with the leg on the other side of the human body; when the actuator is driven to work, the stator shell and the rotor rotating shaft rotate back and forth within a certain angle, and the first driving rod and the second driving rod are driven to drive the legs on the two sides of the human body to swing back and forth relatively.

title: Design method for eye optical system of humanoid simulation robot
abstract: A design method of an eye optical system of a humanoid simulation robot is characterized in that a 3D structure in a PC and optical tracing design EDA software are adopted for design, the front portion of a simulation eyeball, a simulation cornea, a simulation crystalline lens, an iris and a corneal crystalline lens of the eye optical system are replaced by a front lens with curvature, and the front lens is provided with curvature. The iris is drawn on the frosted plane of the second surface of the front lens or the mounting plane of the front lens in a colored drawing manner, so that a more vivid effect is achieved; the design comprises five steps. According to the method, the design difficulty and the design cost are reduced, meanwhile, the adaptability to the boundary condition with the immutable appearance of the existing eye module is enhanced during design, the more perfect appearance can be achieved, meanwhile, the video collection function is considered, the technical progress of humanoid simulation robot products is achieved, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. title: Manipulator and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a manipulator and a robot. The manipulator comprises a palm part, mechanical fingers and a driving structure. The palm part comprises a palm plane and a palm side face perpendicular to the palm plane. The mechanical fingers are arranged on the palm side face. The driving structure is arranged between the palm part and the mechanical fingers so as to connect the mechanical fingers and the palm part in the connecting direction. Wherein the driving structure is used for driving the mechanical fingers to rotate around the rotating axis, and the rotating axis extends in the direction perpendicular to the connecting direction and is parallel to the palm plane. The driving structure is further used for driving the mechanical fingers to rotate around the swing axis, and the swing axis intersects with the palm plane. The swing axis is perpendicular to the rotation axis. The mechanical finger can rotate in two different directions, so that the mechanical finger has the motion freedom degree similar to that of a human finger, and the humanoid degree of the manipulator is improved. Besides, the arrangement mode of the mechanical arm can meet the requirement for the movement freedom degree of simple actions, so that the mechanical arm can be matched with the posture of the human hand, and the mechanical arm has enough simple hand actions.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm with integrated inner framework and outer framework
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid mechanical arm with integrated inner and outer skeletons, which utilizes a first steering engine, a shoulder joint structure, a big arm structure, a small arm structure and a wrist joint support to form an arm main body structure of a humanoid robot and simulates related arm actions through rotation of each steering engine, and is simple in structure, efficient in action and high in reliability. Meanwhile, the wiring position of the circuit and the arm main body structure are separately designed, so that the arm structure is convenient to maintain, the mass of the arm structure is reduced, the internal and external integrated design of arm design and purchase is realized, an inner framework and an outer framework are not distinguished, and the shape and size of the arm are simulated by adopting a shaping compensation plate; and the volume mass of the arm can be reduced. title: Humanoid robot arm structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot arm structure, and relates to the technical field of robot arms.
