The surface of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with first conical teeth, and the other side of the back plate is fixedly connected with a second motor. title: ROBOT HAND FOR HUMANOID
abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid robot hand. According to the present invention, the robot hand comprises a palm plate where a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, and a small finger are arranged at a predetermined position, and the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger, and the small finger are respectively formed in a finger assembly. Moreover, the robot hand is driven by a forward motor mounted in a shaft of a long joint frame since the finger assembly is composed of the long joint frame, a middle joint frame, and a short joint frame, and a fluid clutch and a pulley are installed in a shaft installed in each joint frame to automatically control power of the forward motor according to reaction force transmitted through the long joint frame, the middle joint frame, and the short joint frame.

title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid drive humanoid two-arm system
abstract: The invention discloses an electro-hydraulic hybrid drive humanoid double-arm system, and relates to the field of robot mechanical arms. The problems that an existing mechanical arm joint driven by a pure motor is insufficient in joint driving torque and small in load torque are solved. A purely hydraulically-driven mechanical arm joint has the problems that the rotation angle is limited, the movement is not flexible enough, most external hydraulic oil pipes are more, hydraulic pipelines are easy to wear, and the assembly, disassembly and maintenance are inconvenient. The head end of each shoulder Pitch rotating unit is connected with the end of a shoulder Roll swing unit, the tail end of each shoulder Pitch rotating unit is connected with the head end of a large arm Yaw rotating unit, the tail end of each large arm Yaw rotating unit is connected with the head end of a small arm Pitch swing unit, the tail end of each small arm Pitch swing unit is connected with the head end of a small arm Yaw rotating unit, and the tail end of each small arm Yaw rotating unit is connected with the head end of a small arm Yaw rotating unit. The tail end of each small arm Yaw rotating unit is connected with the head end of a wrist Pitch swing unit, and the tail end of each wrist Pitch swing unit is connected with a wrist joint. The rotating range of the mechanical arm is expanded, and the joint torque and the load capacity are improved.

title: Modularized neck of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a modularized neck of a humanoid robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a rope, a movable platform, a two-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism, a rope pre-tightening mechanism, a rotating platform, a first rope winding drum, a second rope winding drum, a shell and a driving mechanism, according to the neck device, three-degree-of-freedom neck movement can be achieved by combining the rope with the rotary drum and the kinematic chain set, the neck device of the robot can be modularized, and different robot heads can be connected through the movable platform; the kinematic chain group is arranged, the movable pulley principle is adopted, tension and rigidity are amplified in the two-degree-of-freedom motion direction, and the tension and rigidity are not lost while it is ensured that the mechanism is light in weight, compact and small; by arranging the rope pre-tightening mechanism, the problem that the rope is lengthened due to the characteristics of the rope after being stretched for multiple times is solved.

title: Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot dexterous hand control system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a Raspberry Pi-based humanoid robot dexterous hand control system and method, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, a collection layer (1) collects human arm myoelectricity information, carries out the data processing of the human arm myoelectricity information, and transmits the processed information to a transmission layer (2); 2, the transmission layer carries out data processing on the human arm myoelectricity information and then transmits the human arm myoelectricity information to a control layer (3); 3, the control layer analyzes the human arm myoelectricity information, selects a matched action model and transmits the action model to an execution layer (4); 4, outputting an action result corresponding to the action model to a physical layer (5) by the execution layer, and outputting data feedback information to the control layer at the same time; 5, the physical layer decomposes the action result and executes the action result, and meanwhile palm physical data are fed back to the execution layer. The dexterous hand control system of the humanoid robot is developed based on the Raspberry Pi, and overall control over palms of the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot head

title: Embedded battery mounting structure and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The utility model provides an embedded battery mounting structure and a humanoid robot with the same. title: Indoor inspection biped robot with parallelogram connecting rod mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses an indoor inspection biped robot with a parallelogram connecting rod mechanism, which is characterized in that a control circuit board is arranged in a robot main body frame, and an upper mounting plate is arranged above the robot main body frame; leg steering engines are further arranged in the robot body frame, the two sides of the robot body frame are connected with one ends of parallelogram connecting rod leg mechanisms respectively, wheel feet are arranged at the other ends of the parallelogram connecting rod leg mechanisms, and the output ends of the leg steering engines are connected with the parallelogram connecting rod leg mechanisms on the two sides respectively. Based on the cooperation of the parallelogram connecting rod leg mechanisms and the wheel feet, the robot can freely and rapidly walk in various types of sites, the jumping function is achieved, the robot can cross various obstacle road surfaces, the coupling of driving and jumping actions is eliminated, the robot can recover from various falling-down scenes, and the safety of the robot is improved. In addition, various external devices can be arranged, the expansibility is high, and certain popularization prospects are achieved.

title: Hydraulically-driven three-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist mechanism platform
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven three-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist mechanism platform, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. The problems that an existing humanoid mechanical arm cannot meet the requirement for integrated design of a plurality of hydraulic actuators so as to achieve compactness and light weight of the structure, and it is difficult to meet the requirements for the high load capacity, the large movement range and the compact structure function of a front arm tail end movement joint at the same time are solved. Three parallel hydraulic cylinders are evenly arranged on the periphery of a forearm framework, a connecting rod lower hooke joint machine base is installed at the end of a piston rod of each hydraulic cylinder, one ends of three connecting rods are connected with the three connecting rod lower hooke joint machine bases respectively, and the other ends of the three connecting rods are connected with three connecting rod connection decomposition spherical hinges respectively. The center of the end face of the wrist movable platform is provided with a movable platform rotation center decomposition spherical hinge connected with the middle guide rail installation base. The hydraulic actuator is used for meeting the integrated design of a plurality of hydraulic actuators so as to realize the compactness and light weight of the structure.

title: Balance control method and device and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a balance control method and device and a robot, motion state parameters of the wheeled biped robot are obtained, leg height adjusting parameters of the wheeled biped robot are determined according to the motion state parameters, and a hip joint module is controlled to be adjusted according to the leg height adjusting parameters. Therefore, the wheel type biped robot is kept balanced in the horizontal direction. And according to the motion state parameters, balance moment adjusting parameters of the wheeled biped robot are determined, and the power wheel module is controlled to adjust according to the balance moment adjusting parameters, so that the wheeled biped robot is kept balanced in the advancing direction. In the embodiment, the heights of the legs are adjusted through the hip joint modules, so that the robot body is kept balanced in the horizontal direction, and the rollover of the wheeled biped robot is avoided; the inertia force borne by the wheel type biped robot is controlled in an acceleration and deceleration mode by adjusting the torque of the power wheel module, and therefore the movement stability of the wheel type biped robot is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot based on pneumatic driver
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on a pneumatic driver, and belongs to the field of robots. A pneumatic driver is used for driving all joints to move, and the humerus-ulna combined pneumatic muscle device is mainly composed of a humerus, a radius, an ulna, pneumatic muscles, an air cylinder, a connecting piece, a control system and the like. The four shoulder joint pneumatic muscles connected in parallel drive the shoulder joint, the humerus is divided into two sections, and the two sections are connected through an air cylinder. The group of shoulder-elbow joint pneumatic muscles are respectively connected with the shoulder joint connecting piece, the radius and the ulna, can drive the elbow joint to move, and can also drive the shoulder joint together with the shoulder joint pneumatic muscles; the four driving forearms are connected in parallel, the radius and the ulna are connected with the wrist joint connecting plate, the radius and the ulna are designed into two sections, and the two sections are connected through an air cylinder. The device is driven by the pneumatic muscle and the air cylinder, has the characteristics of compact structure, large working space and multiple degrees of freedom of motion, and can be used for experiment teaching, cyclic demonstration and troubleshooting.

title: Anti-toppling humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an anti-toppling humanoid robot. The anti-toppling humanoid robot comprises a head and a base. Compared with an existing common humanoid robot, the anti-toppling humanoid robot has the advantages that the body is arranged at the lower end of the head, the arms are arranged on the two sides of the body, the rubber blocks are arranged on the sides, with the arms, of the body, the base is arranged at the lower end of the body, and the anti-toppling assembly is arranged in the base; the anti-toppling assembly comprises a universal ball, balls, balancing weights, a supporting plate, a pressing block, a spring and auxiliary wheels, the universal ball is arranged in the middle of the interior of the base, the balls are arranged on the periphery of the universal ball, the balancing weights are arranged at the lower end of the universal ball, the supporting plate is arranged at the lower end of the interior of the base, the pressing block penetrates through the supporting plate, and when the base inclines, the pressing block penetrates through the supporting plate. The balancing weight can drive the universal ball to rotate through the rolling ball, so that the balancing weight extrudes the pressing block, the spring extrudes and ejects the auxiliary wheel, auxiliary stabilization is carried out, the inclination degree is reduced, and toppling is avoided.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a biped robot. The biped robot comprises a trunk, a left leg part and a right leg part, wherein the left leg part and the right leg part are connected with the trunk; the trunk comprises a body shell and a head and neck connected with the body shell; the leg parts comprise thigh parts, knee joints, shank parts and foot parts; the thighs are connected with the head and neck through hip joints; the two ends of the knee joint are connected with the thigh part and the shank part correspondingly, and the knee joint is used for driving the leg part to be bent at the knee joint and further used for folding the leg part so that the robot can move in a wheel mode; the foot part is connected with the shank part; the trunk further comprises a first driving wheel and a second driving wheel which are located on the two sides of the lower portion of the body. The first driving wheel and the second driving wheel are used for driving the robot to move in a wheel mode after the legs are folded. The biped robot disclosed by the utility model can realize two modes of wheel type movement and biped advancing, and can well adapt to commercial application scenes according to different environment conditions.

title: Ein Computersystem von einer Künstlichen Intelligenz von einem Cyborg oder einem Android, wobei eine aufgenommene Signal-Reaktion des Computersystems von der Künstlichen Intelligenz von dem Cyborg oder dem Android, eine entsprechende Assoziation des Computersystems von der Künstlichen Intelligenz von dem Cyborg oder dem Android, und ein entsprechender Gedanke des Computersystems von der Künstlichen Intelligenz von dem Cyborg oder dem Android in dem Computersystem physisch gebaut werden, und ein Arbeitsverfahren von dem Computersystem von der Künstlichen Intelligenz von dem Cyborg oder dem Android.
abstract: A computer system of an artificial intelligence of a cyborg or an android, wherein the computer system assembles its own recorded signal reaction from sensor reactions, transforms the recorded signal reaction into a corresponding association, transforms the corresponding association into a corresponding thought, and a working method for cleaning up the corresponding associations that are built uniquely according to a signal phrase and a sense allocation of at least one sense, wherein the sense allocation is integrated into the signal phrase, or that are built uniquely according to the signal phrase and a specific main memory area. The computer system, consisting of the hardware assemblies 27, 28, 29, 30, 31, 32, the sensor groups 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, the interfaces 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 24, 25, the hardware modules of the sensory input receiver 34, the sensory output transmitter 33, the database 35, and the cyborg interpreter 36, wherein the sensor network combines all reactions of all sensors of all sensor groups of all sensory organs of all senses into the sensor reactions. The computer system includes at least five senses equipped with sensory organs, wherein the senses are a sense of sight, a sense of hearing, a sense of smell, a sense of touch, and a sense of taste. At least one sensor group is installed for each sensory organ. A natural language is interpreted in an object-oriented manner by this computer system. The system functionality is implemented on objects generated by the one natural language. For the working method in another language, the computer system uses the references to these objects.

title: Balanced meal delivery robot
abstract: The utility model provides a balanced meal delivery robot which comprises a walking unit and a humanoid robot body arranged on the walking unit, arms of the robot body stretch forwards, tray boxes are arranged at the front ends of the arms, water bags are arranged in the tray boxes, water bag pressing plates are arranged on the upper sides of the water bags, and the water bag pressing plates are arranged on the lower sides of the water bags. A water tank is arranged at the position, corresponding to the tray box, of the back side of the robot body, and the bottom of the water tank communicates with the bottom of the water bag through a water pipe. The meal delivery robot has the advantages that due to the adoption of the technical scheme, the overall balance stability of the meal delivery robot can be improved, and the obstacle crossing capacity of the meal delivery robot is improved.

title: Integrated humanoid parallel hip joint pelvis structure
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated humanoid parallel hip joint pelvis structure, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The problems that an existing humanoid robot pelvis is insufficient in degree of freedom, small in motion driving force and unstable in motion are solved, and meanwhile the problems that due to the complex structure of a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid joint, rigidity is low, and the structure is complex and heavy are solved. The front end of a first piston rod and the front end of a second piston rod are connected with two hip joints through a two-force rod connecting hinge, a two-force rod and a pelvis cross shaft hinge in sequence, and a first hydraulic cylinder and a second hydraulic cylinder drive the first piston rod and the second piston rod to push sliding blocks on guide rails to move correspondingly; the thighs rotate in the yawing direction; when the two sets of hydraulic cylinders push the piston rods to move asynchronously, the thighs rotate in the side-sway and transverse-rolling direction. The multi-degree-of-freedom hip joint simulation device is used for achieving the functions of multi-degree-of-freedom flexibility, compact structure, high rigidity, large driving force and the like of human hip joint simulation

title: MOTION CONTROL METHOD, ROBOT AND READABLE STORAGE MEDIUM
abstract: A motion control method includes: acquiring (S101) a current state parameter of a robot in response to determining that the robot is in a single-foot supporting state; and determining (S102), based on a first preset function and a preset angular momentum value, the position of the centroid of the robot relative to a swing foot at an end moment of the current single-foot supporting state according to the current state parameter of the robot, such that an angular momentum of the centroid relative to the support foot at an end moment of a next single-foot supporting state reaches the angular momentum value, and controlling (S103) the robot to walk according to the position of the centroid of the robot relative to the swing foot at the end moment of the current single-foot supporting state.
abstract_en: A motion control method includes: acquiring (S101) a current state parameter of a robot in response to determining that the robot is in a single-foot supporting state; and determining (S102), based on a first preset function and a preset angular momentum value, the position of the centroid of the robot relative to a swing foot at an end moment of the current single-foot supporting state according to the current state parameter of the robot, such that an angular momentum of the centroid relative to the support foot at an end moment of a next single-foot supporting state reaches the angular momentum value, and controlling (S103) the robot to walk according to the position of the centroid of the robot relative to the swing foot at the end moment of the current single-foot supporting state.

title: ANTI-EPIDEMIC ROBOT
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a disinfection robot which is used in a manufacturing factory. According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is the disinfection robot which comprises: a head unit capable of recognizing an image and a voice, carrying on a conversation with a user, and rotating in left and right sides; a body unit positioned on a lower side of the head unit and enabling a plurality of task menus to be displayed to allow the user to select the menus; a pair of arm units provided on both sides of the body unit; a movable driving unit positioned on a lower side of the body unit; and a control unit stored in the body unit and controlling the head unit and the body unit, the pair of arm units, and the driving unit.

title: Humanoid dexterous operation mobile robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid smart operation mobile robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the humanoid smart operation mobile robot comprises a supporting chassis, a moving unit, a camera shooting unit, a laser radar unit, a trunk unit and a control unit, the moving unit, the camera shooting unit, the laser radar unit and the trunk unit are all connected to the supporting chassis, and the trunk unit comprises a trunk body and humanoid arms; the humanoid arm is connected to the trunk body, and the humanoid arm comprises a hand assembly. The hand assembly comprises a palm base plate, a thumb mechanism, an index finger mechanism, a middle finger mechanism, a ring finger mechanism, a little finger mechanism and a driving device. The moving unit, the camera shooting unit, the laser radar unit and the trunk unit are all electrically connected with the control unit. Therefore, an operator can control the robot to flexibly execute various complex tasks. The robot has humanoid flexible operation capability and moving capability, is provided with a camera and a laser radar, and can assist or replace human beings to execute various dangerous tasks in a complex and dangerous environment.

title: Intelligent Robot for Moving and Transferring Articles in Manufacturing Process for Smart Factory
abstract: The present invention relates to an intelligent robot for transporting and conveying an article in a manufacturing process for a smart factory. In accordance with the present invention, the intelligent robot includes: a head part recognizing an article shape through a camera, having a voice recognition unit embedded therein to recognize voices of words and sentences on a simple work process and perform a simple conversation with a person, and capable of being rotated laterally; a body part coupled to a lower part of the head part, displaying a plurality of pieces of content which can be selected by a user, outputting an image or voice recognized by the head part, detecting an obstacle, and having arm parts provided on both sides; a driving part coupled to a lower part of the body part to avoid an obstacle, prevent the obstacle from colliding and falling, and move the head part, the body part, and the arm parts so as to autonomously sense a charging position and perform charging; and a control part embedded in the rear of the body part and collectively controlling the head part, the body part, the arm parts, and the drive part. In particular, a tool box for storing tools is also provided on one side of the head part. In accordance with the present invention, the intelligent robot can autonomously move closer while avoiding obstacles to have a simple conversation with a worker, and can improve process management and inspection and work efficiency in a manufacturing process and an enterprise through conversations with workers and document, article and tool conveyance.

title: Biped robot inverse kinematics solving method and device
abstract: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method and device for a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: converting a spatial inverse kinematics problem that three axes are not intersected and have parallel joints into a problem of solving a plane angle through a projection method and a mode of increasing angle constraint, and further listing an equation set for solving a joint angle through a geometric solution; the angle value of each active control joint is obtained by solving the equation set, and the analytical solution of the inverse kinematics of the leg joint can be obtained according to the angle value of each active control joint. The method can be used for inverse kinematics solution under the condition that three axes of the hip joint of the robot are not intersected and the robot has parallel joints.

title: Actuator and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an actuator and a robot. The actuator is suitable for driving the robot to execute actions and comprises a body and two driving mechanisms. The driving mechanisms are arranged on the two opposite sides of the body respectively, each driving mechanism comprises a planet wheel set, a power output assembly and a power source, and the power output assembly comprises a first power output ring and a second power output ring. Power output by the power source is output to a connecting rod mechanism of the robot through the planet wheel set and the power output assembly, so that the waist of the robot acts. Therefore, in the embodiment of the invention, through the driving change of the two driving mechanisms, the four power output rings can act synchronously or asynchronously, so that the waist of the robot generates actions close to the waist of a real human body, such as bending or swinging the waist.

title: Modular battery and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a modular battery and a humanoid robot, the modular battery comprises a plurality of battery monomers, the plurality of battery monomers are respectively used for being mounted on different parts of the humanoid robot, and the plurality of battery monomers are respectively detachably mounted on different parts of the humanoid robot. According to the modular battery provided by the invention, modular design is adopted, the whole battery is broken up into parts, and the plurality of battery monomers can be distributed at different parts of the robot body to provide power for actions of different parts; the plurality of battery monomers are detachably mounted on the humanoid robot and can be independently dismounted and mounted, the robot does not need to wait, the battery charging waiting time is saved, power failure is avoided in the battery replacement process due to continuous power supply of other battery monomers, normal work of the robot is not affected, and the battery replacement efficiency of the robot is improved; operation is simple and convenient.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robot design and manufacturing, and particularly relates to a humanoid dexterous hand and a robot. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a supporting bracket, a driving device and a control device, the driving mechanism is mounted on the supporting bracket, and the driving mechanism is provided with a power output end; the first end of the first connecting assembly is connected with the power output end; the first end of the second connecting assembly is movably connected to the supporting bracket; the thumb is provided with a connecting end, the connecting end is provided with a first connecting position and a second connecting position which are arranged in the extending direction of the thumb, the second end of the first connecting assembly is rotationally connected to the first connecting position, and the second end of the second connecting assembly is rotationally connected to the second connecting position. According to the technical scheme, the problems that according to finger design of a humanoid palm of a traditional robot, drivers are directly arranged at finger joints, movement joints are achieved through ball pairs, and consequently the size of the finger joints is large are solved.

title: Biped robot and leg structure thereof
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot and a leg structure thereof. The leg structure comprises a shank limb, and the first end of the shank limb is used for being connected with the thigh of the biped robot; a sole part; the driving assembly is fixedly mounted on the shank limb; the first output rotating shaft of the driving assembly is in driving connection with the first end of the first shank connecting rod, and the second end of the first shank connecting rod is rotationally connected with the sole part; the first shank connecting rod and the second shank connecting rod are arranged in parallel, a second output rotating shaft of the driving assembly is in driving connection with the first end of the second shank connecting rod, and the second end of the second shank connecting rod is rotationally connected with the sole part. By applying the technical scheme, the problems that the ankle joint is relatively bloated, the leg inertia is relatively large and the motion performance of the robot is influenced due to the fact that the crus mechanism of the current humanoid robot is mostly designed by adopting a serial mechanism are solved.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a leg structure and a biped robot. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the size of the knee part of any single leg of the biped robot is large due to the fact that a rotating motor, connected with the thigh limb and the shank part, of any single leg of the biped robot is directly assembled to the knee part is solved.

title: Biped robot and hip joint structure thereof
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot and a hip joint structure thereof. The hip joint structure comprises a hip transfer structure, the hip transfer structure comprises a first transfer part and a second transfer part which are fixedly connected with each other, and the second transfer part is used for being connected with a leg structure of the biped robot; the first driving mechanism is fixedly mounted on the second switching part, and the first driving mechanism is used for driving the leg structure to laterally swing; the second driving mechanism is fixedly connected with an output rotating shaft of the first driving mechanism, the end of the leg structure is connected with an output rotating shaft of the second driving mechanism, and the axis direction of the output rotating shaft of the second driving mechanism and the axis direction of the output rotating shaft of the first driving mechanism are orthogonally arranged; the second driving mechanism is used for driving the leg structure to rotate. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the hip joint of the biped robot is too large in size due to the fact that the structural design of the hip joint in an existing biped robot is complex is solved.

title: Dragon-shaped biped walking robot and walking method
abstract: The invention relates to a dragon-shaped double-foot walking robot and a walking method. The dragon-shaped double-foot walking robot comprises a head (20), a trunk (30), arms (40), hands (50), a tail (60), legs (70) and feet (80), and a tail supporting wheel (1) is arranged at the bottom of the tail (60); steering engines are arranged in the leg parts (70) and the foot parts (80). In order to add a supporting point for keeping balance on the tail (60), two front feet respectively support rollers on respective sides to enable the two front feet to move relatively, the feet on the other sides exert acting force backwards so as to enable the two front feet to move forwards as a whole, all actions are combined innovatively, and the function of moving forwards is achieved. Although the two feet in contact with the ground do not leave the ground, the machine can move forwards or backwards or turn to make various motions; the robot can move like a humanoid robot, the gravity center is stable in the moving process, and toppling is avoided.

title: Humanoid pneumatic dexterous hand based on composite corrugated pipe and soft robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of soft robots, and discloses a humanoid pneumatic dexterous hand based on a composite corrugated pipe and the soft robotic.The dexterous hand comprises fingers, a soft palm and the composite corrugated pipe, one end of each finger is connected to the soft palm, and a first notch is formed in the edge of the area, corresponding to the interval between the adjacent fingers, of the soft palm; composite corrugated pipes are arranged in the first notches, and the two opposite ends of the corresponding composite corrugated pipes are connected to the two opposite side walls of the first notches correspondingly. Second notches are formed in the areas, corresponding to the connecting positions of the fingers and the soft palm, of the side portion of the soft palm, composite corrugated pipes are also arranged in the second notches, and the two opposite ends of the corresponding composite corrugated pipes are connected to the two side walls, in the length direction of the corresponding fingers, of the second notches correspondingly. By adjusting the pressure state in each composite corrugated pipe, the flexion and extension movement and side-sway movement of fingers can be realized, and complex gestures such as dexterous palm surface depression and finger movement can be realized through the flexible palm.

title: Humanoid robot neck mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a neck mechanism of a humanoid robot. Comprising a neck ring, a connecting rod, an adjusting device A, an adjusting device B, an adjusting device fixing rod, an adjusting device push-pull rod and a bearing platform plate. The connecting rod is arranged in the neck ring, and two ends of the connecting rod are fixedly connected with the inner wall of the neck ring; the tops of the adjusting devices B are fixed with the connecting rod; the plurality of adjusting devices A are positioned below the adjusting device B and are sequentially arranged from top to bottom; the multiple adjusting devices A and the multiple adjusting devices B are arranged on the adjusting device fixing rod in a sleeving mode; the adjusting device push-pull rod is respectively connected with the adjusting device B and the plurality of adjusting devices A; a rotary stepping motor is arranged on the lower surface of the bearing platform plate; a linear stepping motor is arranged on the upper surface of the bearing platform plate and connected with an adjusting device push-pull rod. The utility model has the advantages of reasonable design and stable structure. The three-degree-of-freedom motion of the head and neck of the humanoid robot can be achieved, and a foundation is laid for artificial intelligence control.

title: Human-simulated spoon manipulator
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid spoon manipulator which comprises a manipulator assembly and a telescopic assembly, the manipulator assembly comprises a support plate, a first motor is arranged on the right end face of the support plate, a main swing arm installed at the left end of the support plate is arranged at the output end of the first motor, and a first installation rod is arranged on the left end face of the main swing arm. A connecting rod is rotationally connected to the outer wall of the first mounting rod, a second mounting rod is rotationally connected to the other end of the connecting rod, an auxiliary swing arm is arranged on the right end face of the second mounting rod, a spoon handle rotationally mounted in the support plate is arranged on the auxiliary swing arm, and a spoon body is arranged on the side, penetrating through the left end of the support plate, of the spoon handle. According to the utility model, the manipulator assembly is arranged, so that the spoon body can be driven to finish actions such as vertical or upside-down so as to achieve the function of loading and pouring food materials, and the manipulator assembly can move up and down through the telescopic assembly, so that the spoon body extends into and leaves a container filled with the food materials, and the food materials are taken out and poured into the container.

title: Novel high-simulation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a novel high-simulation robot. The novel high-simulation robot comprises a head device, the head device comprises a simulation head sleeve made of silica gel, the simulation head sleeve is sleeved with a head frame, and the head frame is provided with an eyebrow driving mechanism, an eye driving mechanism, a cheekbone driving mechanism, a mouth corner driving mechanism, an upper lip driving mechanism, a lower lip driving mechanism and a lower jaw driving mechanism. The problems of few expressions and poor simulation effect in the prior art are solved.

title: Connecting mechanism and foot type robot
abstract: The invention provides a connecting mechanism and a foot type robot. The connecting mechanism comprises a first connecting frame and a second connecting frame, the first connecting frame comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the first connecting part is used for being connected with the robot head, the second connecting part is fixedly connected to one side of the first connecting part, and a first through hole is formed in the first connecting part; the second connecting frame is used for being connected with a robot body, a second through hole is formed in the second connecting frame, the second through hole communicates with the first through hole, and the first connecting frame can rotate relative to the second connecting frame; the head driving device comprises a first motor body and a first output end, the first motor body is installed on the side, away from the first connecting part, of the second connecting part, the first output end is arranged on the first motor body, and the first output end is connected with the second connecting frame through a first matching assembly; the head driving device is used for driving the first connecting frame to rotate relative to the second connecting frame; wherein the first through hole and the second through hole are used for wiring harness wiring of the robot.

title: Mechanical arm wrist joint, mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm wrist joint, a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot. The mechanical arm wrist joint comprises a base, a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly and a joint output assembly. The first driving assembly and the second driving assembly are assembled on the base and can movably stretch out of the containing cavity or retract into the containing cavity. The joint output assembly comprises an output piece, a first movable connecting piece and a second movable connecting piece, wherein the first movable connecting piece and the second movable connecting piece are connected with the output piece. The output piece is movably connected with the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly through the first movable connecting piece. And the second movable connecting piece is connected with the base. When the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly movably extend out of the containing cavity or retract into the containing cavity relative to the base, the output piece is driven by the first movable connecting piece and the second movable connecting piece to do pitching motion and/or rotating motion. The two-degree-of-freedom coupling wrist joint is compact in structure, small in size and flexible in operation.

title: Frame structure oriented to unmanned equipment platform layered human-like control
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot motion control, and particularly relates to an unmanned equipment platform-oriented hierarchical humanoid control framework structure, which is divided into a sensing unit and a control unit, and is characterized in that a humanoid control framework establishes local elevation, semantics and environment models by acquiring positioning and depth sensing information; meanwhile, two services of coarse granularity and fine granularity are established under the driving of task instructions, selection and adjustment of control strategies and unit parameters in a control unit are completed, and comprehensive optimization of computing power and performance is achieved; and the control unit takes the planning of the sensing unit as an expected trajectory, realizes tracking control based on body stability and limb planning, and finally completes the calculation of a servo instruction. Compared with the prior art, the control architecture of the unmanned system and the platform is designed by adopting bionics of hierarchical driving and humanoid control, and the problems that a traditional control system is complex in design and difficult to couple, update and maintain and the like are solved.

title: Intelligent old-age care robot, robot system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent old-age care robot, a robot system and a control method thereof, and belongs to the field of old-age care auxiliary equipment. The intelligent old-age care robot comprises a robot head, robot ears, a robot neck, a loudspeaker, a robot body, a sensing device, a man-machine interaction display screen, a warning indicator, a medicine box, a main switch, a heat dissipation opening, a first wheel, a wheel shaft and a second wheel, and further comprises a wearable wireless physiological sensor device such as a bracelet, a wearable jacket and old-age shoes. The invention further provides an intelligent old-age care robot system. The invention further provides a control method of the intelligent old-age care robot and the system thereof. Compared with the prior art, the system has the beneficial effects that the system can monitor the health and safety conditions of the elderly, can move autonomously, prevents the elderly from getting lost, receives alarm information, can avoid misjudgment and false alarm conditions, is more scientific and humanized, and is good in adaptability. The method has wide market and application prospects.

title: Shock absorption and energy storage foot structure and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shock-absorbing and energy-storing foot structure and a biped robot, the foot structure comprises a shank, a support lug, a connecting rod, a universal joint, a foot supporting component and a shock-absorbing and energy-storing elastic component, the foot supporting component comprises an upper connecting plate, a lower connecting plate and an inclined connecting plate, the first connecting part of the shank is mounted in the first connecting hole of the universal joint; the first mounting part of the support lug is hinged to the support lug mounting part of the shank; a pin component at one end of the connecting rod is mounted on the second connecting part of the support lug, and the other end is mounted on the second mounting part of the upper connecting plate; the third mounting part of the upper connecting plate is mounted in the first connecting hole through a thread; and the damping and energy storage elastic components are respectively arranged on the inclined connecting plate and the lower connecting plate. The damping and energy storage elastic components are additionally arranged on the sole and the toes, so that the damping and energy storage capacity of the foot structure is achieved, large rigid impact between the foot structure and the ground in the movement process is avoided, and the movement performance of the biped robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot head and neck device with self-stabilizing function
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot head and neck device with a self-stabilizing function. The device is composed of a neck movement mechanism, a camera assembly and a control assembly. The camera assembly is installed above the neck movement mechanism, the control assembly comprises a processor, a controller and an inertial measurement unit IMU, and the IMU is installed below the neck movement mechanism; the neck movement mechanism is of a parallel connection structure with a plurality of drivers, and high-precision and rapid movement can be achieved. In the movement process of the humanoid robot, the posture change of the connecting position of the head and neck structure and the trunk of the humanoid robot is obtained through the IMU, the processor calculates the target posture and the movement track of the neck, and the controller controls the neck movement mechanism to reversely adjust the posture of the camera assembly. According to the method, frequent change of the pose of a camera caused by movement of the humanoid robot and the influence of inevitable low-frequency jitter and high-frequency vibration on a visual SLAM system in the movement process of the humanoid robot are reduced, and the mapping effect and stability of the visual SLAM are improved.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a humanoid robot head and neck device with a self-stabilizing function. The device is composed of a neck movement mechanism, a camera assembly and a control assembly. The camera assembly is installed above the neck movement mechanism, the control assembly comprises a processor, a controller and an inertial measurement unit IMU, and the IMU is installed below the neck movement mechanism; the neck movement mechanism is of a parallel connection structure with a plurality of drivers, and high-precision and rapid movement can be achieved. In the movement process of the humanoid robot, the posture change of the connecting position of the head and neck structure and the trunk of the humanoid robot is obtained through the IMU, the processor calculates the target posture and the movement track of the neck, and the controller controls the neck movement mechanism to reversely adjust the posture of the camera assembly. title: Humanoid dexterous hand and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot design and manufacturing, and particularly relates to a humanoid dexterous hand and a robot. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a supporting bracket, a driving device and a control device, the driving mechanism is mounted on the supporting bracket, and the driving mechanism is provided with a power output end; the first end of the first connecting assembly is connected with the power output end; the first end of the second connecting assembly is movably connected to the supporting bracket; the thumb is provided with a connecting end, the connecting end is provided with a first connecting position and a second connecting position which are arranged in the extending direction of the thumb, the second end of the first connecting assembly is rotationally connected to the first connecting position, and the second end of the second connecting assembly is rotationally connected to the second connecting position. According to the technical scheme, the problems that according to finger design of a humanoid palm of a traditional robot, drivers are directly arranged at finger joints, movement joints are achieved through ball pairs, and consequently the size of the finger joints is large are solved.

title: Semi-active exoskeleton robot adopting gear four-bar mechanism for transmission
abstract: The invention relates to a semi-active exoskeleton robot adopting a gear four-bar mechanism for transmission. The semi-active exoskeleton robot comprises a back frame mechanism, a hip joint connecting mechanism, a thigh mechanism, a shank mechanism and an ankle joint mechanism. An inertia measurement unit is arranged on the outer side of the back frame mechanism, and a thigh gyroscope and a shank gyroscope are arranged on the thigh mechanism and the shank mechanism respectively. The device has the beneficial effects that the thigh driving motor is connected with the transmission pinion, the transmission pinion is connected with the transmission bull gear, the fisheye bearing is mounted on the transmission bull gear, main components are intensively arranged at the thigh root and close to the gravity center of a human body, upward movement of the driving motor is achieved, and the rotational inertia of the thigh driving motor relative to the human body is greatly reduced; a driving link in traditional four-link synchronous transmission is replaced by the transmission bull gear, and the bull gear and the shank mechanism are connected through the fisheye bearing connecting rod, so that the motor rotates to drive the knee joint to rotate synchronously, the control performance is remarkably improved, and no dead point exists.

title: Online planning method for dynamic running motion of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an online planning method for dynamic running motion of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an expected ZMP track in a state switching process through nonlinear planning optimization in a switching process between a double-foot supporting state and a single-foot supporting periodic running state at a running starting stage and a running ending stage of the humanoid robot; smooth transition of the centroid track in the state switching process is achieved; and during periodic running motion, in the acceleration/deceleration switching process, an appropriate foothold is calculated through iterative optimization, and accurate tracking of the expected speed is achieved. According to the method, the expected speed can be accurately followed, online planning of the whole running process can be achieved, and the dynamic motion ability of the humanoid robot is remarkably improved.

title: Thumb mounting device and driver built-in dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of driver built-in type dexterous hand structures, in particular to a thumb mounting device and a driver built-in type dexterous hand. The thumb mounting device comprises a thumb mounting frame, a motor, a worm gear, a worm and a modular thumb, the thumb mounting frame comprises a connecting piece, a first mounting piece and a second mounting piece, the connecting piece is assembled on a palm mounting plate, and the first mounting piece and the second mounting piece are fixedly connected with the upper end and the lower end of the connecting piece respectively; the worm gear is fixedly connected with the second mounting piece, the worm is meshed with the worm gear, and the first mounting piece is fixedly connected with the modular thumb; the extension direction of the base joint of the modular thumb is parallel to the transverse direction of the palm mounting plate, and one end of the base joint of the modular thumb is fixedly connected with the first mounting piece. And the driving mechanism, the worm, the worm gear and the thumb mounting frame are arranged, so that the modularized thumb has the palmar freedom degree, the flexibility of the modularized thumb is improved, and the humanoid effect of the driver built-in dexterous hand is improved.

title: Humanoid robot action simulation method and device based on 3D human body posture estimation
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action simulation method and device based on 3D human body posture estimation, and the method comprises the steps: data collection and preprocessing: collecting a color image and a depth image through a color-depth camera, and obtaining the human body posture point cloud data of a demonstrator in a world coordinate system through data preprocessing; capturing human body limb actions: capturing human body joint three-dimensional coordinates based on a 3D human body posture estimation network according to the human body posture point cloud data; motion behavior mapping: based on coordinate conversion and space vector calculation, converting the obtained human body joint three-dimensional coordinates into joint angles of two arms of the humanoid robot; and mapping joint angle filtering: smoothing the joint angle through Kalman filtering, and performing limited output on the joint angle according to the movement range of each joint of the robot so as to realize simulation of the humanoid robot on the arm action of the demonstrator.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action simulation method and device based on 3D human body posture estimation, and the method comprises the steps: data collection and preprocessing: collecting a color image and a depth image through a color-depth camera, and obtaining the human body posture point cloud data of a demonstrator in a world coordinate system through data preprocessing; capturing human body limb actions: capturing human body joint three-dimensional coordinates based on a 3D human body posture estimation network according to the human body posture point cloud data; motion behavior mapping: based on coordinate conversion and space vector calculation, converting the obtained human body joint three-dimensional coordinates into joint angles of two arms of the humanoid robot; and mapping joint angle filtering: smoothing the joint angle through Kalman filtering, and performing limited output on the joint angle according to the movement range of each joint of the robot so as to realize simulation of the humanoid robot on the arm action of the demonstrator.

title: Hand structure of humanoid rope-driven dexterous robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a hand structure of a humanoid rope-driven dexterous robot, which comprises a palm mechanism, a finger mechanism, a wrist connecting part, a wrist steering engine, five finger driving ropes, five finger rope driving steering engines and a steering engine fixing shell, and is characterized in that the palm mechanism comprises a palm body, and the palm body is provided with the five finger connecting parts; the thumb comprises three knuckles, each of the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger comprises four knuckles, the knuckles close to the palm are defined as tail knuckles, the knuckles farthest from the palm are defined as head knuckles, the tail knuckles of each finger are correspondingly hinged with five finger connecting parts in the palm mechanism, adjacent knuckles in each finger are hinged, and the adjacent knuckles in each finger are hinged with the head knuckles. Each finger is fixedly connected with the first knuckle through one finger driving rope, sequentially penetrates through other knuckles and then is connected with one finger rope driving steering engine. Compared with other robot hands, the humanoid robot hand disclosed by the utility model is lighter, more flexible and more humanoid under the same volume.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid double-arm robot, which comprises a bottom plate part, a second layer part, a third layer part, a fourth layer part, a platform part, a chest part and a double-arm part, and is characterized in that the bottom plate part comprises a bottom plate; the second layer part comprises a second layer plate, and a laser radar, a plurality of wiring terminals, a driver, a step-down transformer and a gyroscope which are arranged on the second layer plate; the third-layer component comprises a third-layer plate and an industrial personal computer arranged on the third-layer plate; the fourth layer component comprises a fourth layer plate; the platform part comprises a platform plate, and the platform plate, the fourth layer plate, the third layer plate, the second layer plate and the bottom plate are connected through supporting rods; the thoracic cavity part comprises a thoracic cavity plate which is arranged on the platform plate; the double-arm component comprises a left arm and a right arm which are arranged on the two sides of the chest plate respectively. All the layers are connected through the supporting rods, the overall stability and portability can be improved, and the space utilization rate can be effectively improved by adopting the body structure that all the layer plates are combined.

title: Human-simulated spoon manipulator
abstract: The humanoid spoon manipulator comprises a manipulator assembly and a telescopic assembly, the manipulator assembly comprises a support plate, a first motor is arranged on the right end face of the support plate, a main swing arm mounted at the left end of the support plate is arranged at the output end of the first motor, and a first mounting rod is arranged on the left end face of the main swing arm; a connecting rod is rotationally connected to the outer wall of the first mounting rod, a second mounting rod is rotationally connected to the other end of the connecting rod, an auxiliary swing arm is arranged on the right end face of the second mounting rod, a spoon handle rotationally mounted in the support plate is arranged on the auxiliary swing arm, and a spoon body is arranged on the side, penetrating through the left end of the support plate, of the spoon handle. By arranging the manipulator assembly, the spoon body can be driven to complete actions such as vertical or upside-down so as to achieve the function of loading and pouring food materials, and by means of the telescopic assembly, the manipulator assembly can move up and down, so that the spoon body extends into and leaves a container filled with the food materials, and the food materials are taken out and poured into the container.

title: Immersive real-time remote operation platform based on exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides an immersive real-time remote operation platform based on an exoskeleton robot, and the platform comprises an upper limb exoskeleton which is divided into an operation end and a working end. The upper limb exoskeleton comprises joint motors, joints of the upper limb exoskeleton are driven by the joint motors, and each joint motor corresponds to the degree of freedom of one upper limb of the human body; the operation end joint motor collects interaction torque of an operator and generates a driving signal, and the operation end joint motor completes operation according to the driving signal; the sensing and detecting module comprises an image sensor and a laser radar, the image sensor collects visible light images and depth information, and the laser radar collects three-dimensional point cloud data; and the real-time network communication module of the operation end is in communication connection with the real-time network communication module of the working end. According to the invention, rich body feelings including visual sense and pressure touch sense are provided for operators based on high-bandwidth low-delay real-time network communication, and interactive and high-precision remote operation requirements are met.

title: Bowden line and binding fabric transmission control method
abstract: The invention provides a Bowden line and binding fabric transmission control method, which comprises the following steps that a processor adopts a mixed tension compensation model to obtain a mixed tension compensation value; performing summation calculation on the expected tension value and the mixed tension compensation value to obtain a final tension input value; the final tension input value is used as actual input of the system, a fuzzy active-disturbance-rejection controller is adopted, an input tension control signal of a driving motor is obtained, the driving motor is controlled, the driving motor acts on the legs of the human body through a steel wire rope, and the actual tension borne by the legs is the expected tension value. The Bowden thread and bound fabric transmission control method provided by the invention has the following advantage that the Bowden thread and bound fabric transmission control method provided by the invention can effectively improve the control precision of the Bowden thread and bound fabric in the transmission process.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom base joint structure of foot type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom base joint structure of a foot-type robot, and relates to the technical field of base joints of foot-type robots, and the multi-degree-of-freedom base joint structure of the foot-type robot comprises a machine body mounting plate, the leg lifting movable control unit comprises a fixed frame, a movable U-shaped seat, movable shafts, bearings, a leg lifting motor and a motor mounting assembly, the bottom of the boss is fixedly connected with the top of the fixed frame, and the middles of the two sides of the fixed frame are rotationally connected with one ends of the two movable shafts through the bearings correspondingly; the other ends of the two movable shafts are fixedly connected with the two sides of the movable U-shaped base respectively. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom base joint structure of the foot type robot, the leg angle limiting unit is adopted for physically limiting the movement angle of leg lifting, the load on the leg lifting motor is reduced, a wire for power supply control can be protected, the wire is prevented from being abraded when the base joint structure moves, and small-amplitude torsion of the lifting leg, the side leg or the thigh can be achieved; three-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved, and the flexibility is closer to that of human joints.

title: Manufacturing method and device of buffer assembly, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a manufacturing method and device of a buffer assembly, a storage medium and electronic equipment, the buffer assembly comprises a dot matrix composed of a plurality of cell elements, a material used for manufacturing the dot matrix and the cell element size are initialized, a preset load, the material and the cell element size are input into a pre-trained cell element orientation determination model, and the cell element orientation determination model is used for determining the cell element orientation. And determining the cell orientation required by the buffer assembly, judging whether the buffer assembly manufactured under the condition is uniform in an equivalent stress field generated by a preset load or not, if so, manufacturing the buffer assembly with the cell size and the cell orientation by using the material, and if not, adjusting the cell orientation. And the equivalent stress field is uniform. According to the method, the material, the cell orientation and the cell size required for forming the buffer assembly are determined by using the preset load as a limiting condition, so that the possibility that fragile parts of the humanoid robot are damaged is reduced by using the buffer assembly.

title: Six-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot arm
abstract: The utility model discloses a six-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot arm which comprises a shoulder mechanism, a big arm mechanism, a small arm mechanism and a palm mechanism which are connected in sequence. The shoulder mechanism, the big arm mechanism, the small arm mechanism and the palm mechanism are all of a modular structure, and each mechanism can be independently detached to be adjusted and maintained. According to the utility model, the gear reduction mechanism is adopted to solve the problem of motor offset in a small-size mechanical arm and the problem of difficult wiring of a traditional gear mechanism. Compared with other robot arms, due to the special structure and the modular design, the humanoid robot arm is lighter, easier to manufacture and easier to maintain in the later period.

title: Humanoid hugging assembly
abstract: A humanoid hugging assembly includes a humanoid animatronic that has a torso, a pair of arms and a pair of hands each is disposed on a respective one of the arms. The arms are positionable in a resting position having the arms extending downwardly along the torso and having a palm of each of the hands facing the torso. Each of the arms is positionable in a hugging position has each of the arms is crossed in front of the torso wherein the pair of arms is configured to embrace the user. A motion sensor is integrated into the humanoid animatronic to sense motion of the user approaching the humanoid animatronic. A motion unit is integrated into the humanoid animatronic and the motion unit actuates each of the arms into the hugging position when a predetermined duration of time has passed when motion sensor senses motion.

title: Biped robot landing detection device and method based on non-force sensing
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot landing detection device and method based on non-force sensing, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Wherein the six-connecting-rod transmission mechanism comprises a first rotating shaft, a second rotating shaft, a third rotating shaft, a fourth rotating shaft, a first motor, a second motor, a connecting rod 1, a connecting rod 2, a connecting rod 3, a connecting rod 4, a connecting rod 5, a connecting rod 6, a third rotating shaft encoder and a fourth rotating shaft encoder, the connecting rods are sequentially connected in pairs to form a closed chain structure, and the connecting rod 5 is designed into an elastic structure. Therefore, the service life of the robot is prolonged and the detection reliability is improved.

title: Tensioning system suitable for line-driven humanoid mechanical arm and mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a tensioning system suitable for a line-driven humanoid mechanical arm and the mechanical arm, the tensioning system can be used for a seven-degree-of-freedom line-driven mechanical arm, and the tensioning system comprises a synchronous tensioning device and a non-synchronous tensioning device which belong to passive tensioning types and are high in adaptability. The synchronous tensioning device comprises an upper plate, a lower plate, a tensioning shaft, a tensioning guide wheel, a flat-head cylindrical positioning bolt with a hole, a compression spring and the like; the asynchronous tensioning device comprises a tensioning guide wheel, a torsional spring, a rotating rod, a tensioning seat and the like. The rope tensioning device is applied to a motion joint of an on-line driving humanoid mechanical arm, a tensioning guide wheel is driven to move through tension of a compression spring and a torsion spring, and tensioning of a rope is achieved. The pre-tightening state of the rope can be kept all the time in the movement process of all the joints, and the movement precision and safety of the line-driven humanoid mechanical arm are remarkably improved.

title: Grabbed data rapid labeling method based on human experience learning
abstract: The invention discloses a grabbed data quick labeling method based on human experience learning, which comprises the following steps: building a simulation grabbed data acquisition scene, loading an object CAD model into a simulation environment and preprocessing the object CAD model, densely sampling a series of candidate grabs in a sampling space for the object CAD model which is loaded into the simulation environment and preprocessed, and the like. According to the method, a large-scale, high-quality and low-cost humanoid grabbing data set is automatically generated, the data set comprises 20000 scenes (depth maps) of 10000 objects, and 120000 positive samples and 120000 negative samples are grabbed. The quality of the data set is proved to exceed that of an existing recognized plane data set in data set cross validation, simulation and real object grabbing tests, the problem that positive and negative samples are unbalanced can be solved, the efficiency of grabbing sample labels is greatly improved, and the method can be popularized to other fields with large requirements for the data size. And the potential is huge under the application background of current deep learning.

title: Intelligent network connection accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot and system thereof
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent network connection accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot and a system thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical information. The system comprises a central information system (100), an accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) and an intelligent network connection system (300). The central information system (100) comprises a cloud server (110), edge servers (120) of all floors of a hospital and a group optimization scheduling algorithm operated on the cloud server (110) and the edge servers (120). The accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) provides an integrated service integrating multiple functions and comprises a man-machine interaction system (210), a walking posture self-stabilization system (220), a state monitoring and early warning system (230), a self-navigation obstacle avoidance system (240) and the like. The intelligent network connection system (300) is an information interaction platform of the central information system (100) and the accompanying diagnosis-assisting robot (200) and also provides an interface for access of a terminal client. The system integrates optimized scheduling, real-time monitoring and early warning, bidirectional information interaction and intelligent network connection, and can effectively relieve the problem that the aged society is insufficient in medical-seeking accompanying resources and the like.

title: Humanoid manipulator with variable finger length
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid manipulator with variable finger lengths, and relates to a robot gripper. The upper end of the palm is connected with other fingers except the thumb; the fingers are modularized fingers with variable knuckle lengths, one supporting rod of the L-shaped guide column is a round rod, the other supporting rod of the L-shaped guide column is a square rod, and the square guide column is inserted into the palm in a sliding mode, limited with the palm and detachably and fixedly connected with the palm; the square rod penetrates into the square guide column in a sliding manner and is limited and detachably and fixedly connected with the square guide column, the round rod penetrates into the thumb mounting seat in a sliding manner and is limited and detachably and fixedly connected with the thumb mounting seat, the thumb mounting seat is connected with the thumb metacarpal bone, and the thumb metacarpal bone is connected with the thumb. The length of the knuckles of the fingers can be changed, the advantage of finger modularization can be reserved, and the fingers can be replaced mutually to adapt to the difference of actual working conditions of different fingers. According to the mechanical hand thumb capable of adjusting the three-dimensional coordinates, the orientation and the knuckle length of the thumb base joint, the thumb can regenerate the optimal design parameters according to the grabbing working condition.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a leg structure and a biped robot. Wherein the leg structure comprises a shank part and a leg part; a sole part; the ankle connecting component is a cross-shaped adapter shaft, and the shank part is rotationally connected with the sole part through the cross-shaped adapter shaft. By means of the technical scheme, the problems that an ankle joint in an existing biped robot is complex in design structure and large in size are solved.

title: Dynamic modeling and control method for biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic modeling and control method for a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, and the method specifically comprises the steps of rigid-flexible coupling dynamic modeling and controller design, specifically, during rigid-flexible coupling dynamic modeling, firstly, a generalized coordinate system based on a floating base is established, and the equivalent moment of a plate spring is regarded as an external acting force; a complete dynamic model is established by combining foot-ground constraint of the supporting feet, and the dynamic model comprises establishment of models of active degrees of freedom of active joints of the two legs and passive degrees of freedom of passive joints of the two legs; according to the design of the controller, at least the roll and pitch angles of the trunk of the robot, the height of the center of mass and the position of a swing foot serve as control variables, compensation control is conducted on the height change of the center of mass based on the dynamic model, and therefore the accuracy of motion control of the biped robot is further improved.

title: Robot performing system including a performing robot and the performing robot
abstract: A performing robot according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a body unit having spine simulating joints and simulating a torso of a human body; a first arm simulating link having a first elbow simulating joint and connected to the body unit to simulate one of two arms of the human body; a second arm simulating link having a second elbow simulating link and connected to the body unit to simulate the other of the two arms of the human body; a leg simulating link having a knee simulating joint and connected to the body unit to simulate one of two legs of the human body; at least one driving unit for moving at least one among the body unit, the first arm simulating link, the second arm simulating link and the leg simulating link based on hydraulic pressure; and a fixed leg link connected to the body unit to simulate the other of the two legs of the human body, having a lower end mounted on an external structure, and connecting the driving unit and an external fluid tank to be able to fluidly communicate with each other so that hydraulic pressure can be provided to the driving unit. Therefore, provided is a large performing robot capable of simulating the motions of a human being.

title: Step height calculation method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a step height calculation method for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a depth image based on a visual sensor of the humanoid robot, automatically calculating the obtained height through an image processing means, and enabling the humanoid robot to carry out the real-time calculation, so as to adjust the height of a foothold, and achieve the autonomous and stable climbing of steps. Therefore, the method is a universal calculation method for completing the autonomous operation of the robot on various steps without depending on external assistance. The problem that when an existing humanoid robot climbs the steps, a fixed-height control algorithm is adopted, and real-time calculation according to the height of the steps cannot be conducted to adjust the height of the foothold when the existing humanoid robot climbs the steps is solved.

title: Modularized double-wheel-foot robot with spine and control method of modularized double-wheel-foot robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a modularized double-wheel-foot robot with parallel spines and a control method of the modularized double-wheel-foot robot. The overall structure of the modularized biped robot with the spine is composed of a spine assembly, a trunk assembly and mechanical leg assemblies. The control framework is composed of a spine control module, a wheel foot motion control module and a robot combination cooperative control module. The spine is composed of a parallel structure, the degree of freedom of the robot is increased, higher flexibility is achieved, meanwhile, the spine and the trunk can rotate around the mechanical legs, splicing of various forms of robots such as a double-wheel-foot robot, a bionic four-wheel-foot robot, a side-by-side four-wheel-foot robot and a multi-wheel-foot robot can be achieved, and the applicability of the robot is improved.

title: Robot
abstract: The robot comprises a head (10), a body (20), a right arm (30), a left arm (40), a right leg (60) and a left leg (70), the right arm (30) and the left arm (40) are located on the two sides of the body (20) and symmetrical to each other, the right leg (60) and the left leg (70) are located at the lower end of the body (20) and symmetrical to each other, and a plurality of steering engines are arranged in the body (20) and used for controlling the arms, the legs and the head to rotate; the lower end of the body (20) is further provided with a skirt armor structural part, the robot can walk with two feet vertically under the driving of a plurality of steering engines, and the robot can automatically execute work. title: Two-section type foot end and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a two-section type foot end which comprises a foot part and a shoe part, the shoe part is made of integrally-formed flexible materials and covers the bottom face of the foot part in a shoe sole mode, a groove is formed in the middle area of the shoe part, the shoe part is divided into a front section and a rear section through the groove, and the front section and the rear section are made of elastic materials. The groove of the shoe part simulates an arch, and the front section and the rear section of the shoe part simulate a two-section type foot end structure of a front sole and a rear sole; the invention further discloses a biped robot using the two-section type foot end. Human gaits can be better simulated, meanwhile, the size and mass of the foot end can be reduced, due to the fact that no active or passive joint is additionally arranged on the foot end, the complexity of the foot end and the difficulty of robot control are greatly reduced, and cost is reduced.

title: Calibration method for driving digital human based on iOS face capture
abstract: The invention provides a calibration method for driving a digital human based on iOS face capture. The calibration method comprises the following steps: acquiring minimum face data of a recording point; collecting maximum face data of the recording points; when minimum value calibration is carried out, facial expression data of a plurality of recording points are collected, calculation is carried out according to a minimum value calibration formula, and minimum value calibration results corresponding to the recording points are obtained; when maximum value calibration is carried out, facial expression data of a plurality of recording points are collected, calculation is carried out according to a maximum value calibration formula, and maximum value calibration results corresponding to the recording points are obtained; when actual face capture is carried out, facial expression data of a plurality of recording points are collected, calculation is carried out according to an expression calibration formula, and expression calibration results corresponding to the recording points are obtained; by means of the method, the calibration process is easy to operate, the execution efficiency is high, and the hardware cost is low.
