title: Robot door opening method and device, readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot door opening method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first movement radius of a hand of the robot around a door spindle, a second movement radius of a waist of the robot around the door spindle, and a body orientation adjustment angle required by a connecting line of centers of two feet of the robot to pass through the door spindle; determining a hand planning track and a waist planning track of the robot according to the first movement radius, the second movement radius and a preset door opening angle; and controlling the robot to perform door opening operation according to the hand planning track and the waist planning track. By means of the method, the hand track and the waist track of the robot can be planned at the same time according to the motion radius, the robot is controlled to conduct door opening operation according to the obtained hand planning track and the waist planning track, the motion coordination of the robot is improved, and accurate control over whole-body motion of the robot is achieved.

title: Intelligent robot walking control system based on bionic cooperation
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, and discloses an intelligent robot walking control system based on bionic collaboration, which effectively solves the problem that when one mechanical foot of an existing robot is lifted, the walking balance is easy to weaken, and the robot is unbalanced and topples, and comprises a trunk, and mechanical foot bodies are symmetrically mounted at the bottom end of the trunk; the mechanical foot body is divided into a left mechanical foot body and a right mechanical foot body, the left mechanical foot body corresponds to a left leg of a human body, and the right mechanical foot body corresponds to a right leg of the human body. Due to the fact that the screw rod is in threaded connection with the balancing weight, and the balancing weight is in sliding connection with the inner wall of the moving groove, the balancing weight moves downwards, the gravity center of the robot falls on the mechanical bottom foot of the supported mechanical foot body, and the walking stability of the robot is improved.

title: Leg and foot zero position calibration device for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot leg and foot zero position calibration device, which utilizes the configuration characteristics of a biped robot, automatically calculates and uses the calibration device to complete the calibration process of each joint after external zero position calibration related input is obtained. The calibration device has no requirements for leg and foot configuration, freedom degree configuration and the like of the to-be-calibrated robot, a fixed structural part does not need to be added for the specific appearance of the to-be-calibrated robot, and the full-automatic calibration process can be completed under the condition that the hardware structure of the to-be-calibrated robot is not affected. Besides, due to the fact that the device comprises the driving component and the sensing component, the calibration effect of the robot can be detected and adjusted in real time, the zero position of the robot can be changed at any time according to actual requirements, and the debugging efficiency of the robot prototype is remarkably improved.

title: Antiskid biped robot
abstract: An anti-skid biped robot comprises two anti-skid devices, each anti-skid device comprises a connecting plate fixedly connected with the foot bottom of the robot, two parallel side plates are fixedly connected to the lower surface of the connecting plate, an air pump fixedly connected with the connecting plate is arranged between the two side plates, and the air pump communicates with an air suction port and an air spraying port. The air suction port communicates with a ground suction mechanism used for sucking the ground, and the air spraying port communicates with an air blowing mechanism used for cleaning roads in front of feet of the robot. According to the anti-skid biped robot, the two side plates are installed on the foot bottom of the robot, the air pump is installed between the two side plates, the air pump is communicated with the air suction port and the air spraying port, the air suction port is communicated with the suction cup, the suction cup sucks the ground and improves the road holding force of the foot bottom of the robot, and the air spraying port is communicated with the air spraying pipe, so that roads in front of the feet of the robot can be cleaned; and the anti-skid mechanisms are arranged on the lower surfaces of the two side plates, so that the friction force between the side plates and the ground is increased, and the foot soles of the robot are prevented from slipping.

title: Dynamic target tracking method for foot-type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic target tracking method for a foot type robot. Firstly, images and videos of pedestrians wearing masks, not wearing masks and not correctly wearing masks in the walking process are collected, and a data set for pedestrian mask wearing detection is built. Secondly, a target recognition module based on a recurrent neural network is adopted to judge whether the pedestrian wears a mask or not, and facial position coordinates of the pedestrian not wearing the mask in the current frame are obtained; thirdly, a residual network is adopted as a reference network, the facial semantic features of the pedestrian without the mask in the current image frame are extracted, and the facial semantic features of the pedestrian in the next image frame are predicted; and finally, designing a target tracking module based on a twin network, and tracking the pedestrian without wearing the mask by calculating a correlation coefficient between the semantic feature mapping of the facial positions of the pedestrian in the current frame and the next frame, thereby realizing the tracking of the dynamic target by the foot robot. The method can be applied to the polling process of the foot-type robot under the epidemic prevention and control condition.

title: Humanoid robot foot structure passively adapting to uneven ground
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot foot structure passively adapting to uneven ground, the structure is divided into a half sole part and a waist heel part, one end of the half sole part is provided with three toes, and each toe is connected with a metatarsal bone through a two-degree-of-freedom elastic assembly; the metatarsal bone at the other end is rotatably connected with the scaphoid bone through a second connecting shaft and two torsional springs; the scaphoid bone and the heel bone of the waist and heel part are rotatably connected with two torsional springs through a third connecting shaft to form a first part of the arch structure; and the sole long ligament is connected with the scaphoid bone and the heel bone through two elastic elements respectively to form a second part of the arch structure. The foot structure adopts a three-section type design, in the moving process of the robot, the foot postures are passively adjusted through a plurality of torsional springs and elastic elements, the buffering effect is achieved when the foot is subjected to the ground acting force, self-adaption to the uneven ground is achieved, and the flexibility, stability and environment adaptability of the foot of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a three-degree-of-freedom biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The three-degree-of-freedom biped robot comprises a robot body, movement mechanisms and a balance mechanism, the movement mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the robot body correspondingly and rotationally connected with the robot body, the movement mechanisms and the robot body form a four-connecting-rod structure, and the balance mechanism is arranged on the robot body and suitable for applying balance torque to the robot body. According to the three-degree-of-freedom biped robot provided by the invention, the overall structure is optimized, the control difficulty can be reduced, the motion precision can be improved, and the cost can be reduced.

title: Humanoid robot trajectory tracking method and trajectory tracking system thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of pedestrian robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot trajectory tracking method and system, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a to-be-processed image, and carrying out the preprocessing of the image; performing region division on the image by adopting the roi region of interest, transversely dividing the image into five rectangular regions, and longitudinally dividing the image into three rectangular regions; respectively detecting color blocks of the image of which the areas are divided according to roi; performing weighting processing on the x-axis coordinates of the ABCDE region color blocks to obtain basic x-axis coordinates; judging the current route type according to the existence of color blocks in the FG area and the basic x-axis coordinates, so as to obtain a robot motion instruction according to the track type and the coordinate position of the track center point; and judging the correctness of the motion instruction so as to determine a final motion instruction of the robot. According to the method, the motion process of the humanoid robot is divided and stored according to periods, the historical instruction pool is used for calculating the instruction needed by the current robot, the resource utilization rate is greatly improved, and the tracing accuracy is improved.

title: Whole body compliance control method applied to quick walking of biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a whole-body compliance control method applied to quick walking of a biped robot, which comprises the following steps of: obtaining stress and torque of feet on the basis of information of a foot force sensor so as to estimate an actual ZMP position of the robot; a mass center compliance controller is designed based on the actual ZMP position of the robot to correct the acceleration of the mass center; a foot position compliance controller based on a double-spring-damping model is designed based on the stress of the sole, and the foot height is corrected; a foot posture compliance controller is designed based on the moment borne by the sole, and the foot posture is corrected; and adding the correction values of the center of mass and the foot to the original expected trajectory, and obtaining the motor angle of each joint through kinematics settlement. According to the method, the landing impact is reduced by using the foot position compliance controller; the foot posture compliance controller ensures that the robot flat plate touches the ground, and rollover is avoided; and the mass center compliance controller adjusts the position of the mass center, so that the body is prevented from bending forwards and backwards during rapid walking, and the stability of the biped robot during rapid walking is improved.

title: Hip joint composite joint motor structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a hip joint composite joint motor structure and a humanoid robot, the hip joint composite joint motor structure comprises a spinning motor module, a side swing motor module and a front swing motor module, the spinning motor module comprises a spinning motor and a first casing supporting the spinning motor; the side-sway motor module comprises a side-sway motor used for driving the self-spinning motor module to sway laterally, a second machine shell used for supporting the side-sway motor, and a first transmission frame used for bearing the torque of the side-sway motor and transmitting the torque to the first machine shell. The first transmission frame comprises a U-shaped support and a transmission ring, wherein the U-shaped support is rotatably supported on the side swing motor in the radial direction and used for being connected with the first machine shell, and the transmission ring is connected to the exterior of a motor shaft of the side swing motor in a sleeving mode and externally connected to the U-shaped support. The front swing motor module comprises a front swing motor used for driving the side swing motor module to rotate, and a motor shaft of the front swing motor is connected to the second machine shell in the radial direction. The driving modules of the hip structure are installed in a linear arrangement mode, space stacking among the modules is reduced, and the structure is more compact.

title: Humanoid robot waist limiting structure and robot framework with same
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot waist limiting structure and a robot framework, the waist limiting structure comprises a U-shaped seat arranged on a waist horizontal rotation driving part, and the U-shaped seat is provided with a first wing plate and a second wing plate which are oppositely arranged; the stooping movement driving part is mounted on the first wing plate and is transversely arranged; the inverted U-shaped plate is clamped on the second wing plate in a sleeving manner and is provided with a first side plate and a second side plate which are oppositely arranged, the first side plate is fixedly connected with the stooping movement driving part, and the second side plate is rotatably connected with the second wing plate; the adjusting hole is formed in the second side plate; the positioning rod is connected to the second wing plate, part of the positioning rod penetrates through the adjusting hole, and the positioning rod can be movably adjusted in the adjusting hole. The mechanical limiting structure of the adjusting hole and the positioning rod is adopted, the length of the adjusting hole can be used for limiting the motion range of the waist of the robot, the upper body of the robot does not collapse after the stooping motion driving part is powered off, the mechanical limiting structure is firm and reliable, and the cost can be reduced.

title: Humanoid robot storage control method and control system
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of data processing, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot storage control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining to-be-stored data which at least comprises scene data and control data; dividing the to-be-stored data into a plurality of action data sets according to the part division of the humanoid robot; querying a preset standard action database, and analyzing the action data set to obtain action difference data; and converting the to-be-stored data into a control action set, converting the scene data into scene features, and storing the control action set, the action difference data and the scene features. According to the method, the to-be-stored data is analyzed and converted into the multiple actions, the control difference between each action and the standard action is determined, and the control action set, the action difference data and the scene features are used as the basis for recovering the to-be-stored data for storage, so that the memory required for data storage is greatly reduced; and the data storage cost is reduced.

title: Wrist connecting rod transmission structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot wrist connecting rod transmission structure comprises a mechanical arm bone plate, the mechanical arm bone plate is provided with two opposite ends, a first shaft hole is formed in one end of the mechanical arm bone plate, a supporting shaft is rotatably installed in the first shaft hole, and the supporting shaft is connected with a coupling shaft; the two ends of the coupling shaft are rotationally sleeved with the shaft sleeves respectively; two lug plates which are oppositely arranged are formed on the side, away from the palm part, of the connecting piece, second shaft holes are formed in the lug plates, and shaft sleeves at the two ends of the coupling shaft are rotatably arranged in the second shaft holes of the two lug plates in a penetrating mode; and one ends of the two linear driving mechanisms are connected to the two opposite sides of the mechanical arm bone plate through spherical hinges correspondingly, the other ends of the linear driving mechanisms are hinged to adapters, the adapters are connected to the shaft sleeve, and the adapters form an actuating part used for shifting and rotating the lug plate. The problems that after a driving actuator is directly placed at the wrist joint of the humanoid robot, the wrist is bloated, and the overall proportion is not coordinated are solved.

title: Mouth corner structure with three degrees of freedom
abstract: The invention relates to a mouth corner structure with three degrees of freedom, which comprises three driving pieces mounted on a head framework of a robot, the three driving pieces are in driving connection with three corresponding connecting rods through three rocker arms, the three connecting rods are vertically connected with one another, the end part of one connecting rod is connected with a profiling mouth corner, and the other end part of the other connecting rod is connected with a connecting rod. According to the three-degree-of-freedom mouth corner structure provided by the invention, the three driving pieces are arranged to drive the profiling mouth corner so as to realize three-degree-of-freedom movement of the mouth corner, so that the mouth corner of a robot can finish expressions such as smile, beep and difficult, multi-angle and multifunctional movement of the profiling mouth corner is realized, and more and richer expressions are realized.

title: Humanoid chest position control method based on fuzzy PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid chest position control method based on a fuzzy PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a humanoid chest mathematical model; s2, designing a fuzzy controller; s3, designing a PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) controller; step S4, performing humanoid thoracic cavity position control based on the humanoid thoracic cavity mathematical model, the fuzzy controller and the PID controller, specifically comprising the following steps: step S41, setting a target position; step S42, obtaining an error and an error change rate according to the target position and the actual position; s43, the error and the error change rate are input into a fuzzy PID controller, and delta Kp, delta Ki and delta Kd are output; s44, inputting the three output quantities delta Kp, delta Ki and delta Kd into a PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) controller so as to control the position of the simulated human chest; and step S45, comparing the real-time position fed back by the simulated human chest with the target position, if the real-time position is smaller than an expected error, stopping, otherwise, continuing to execute the step S42. According to the humanoid chest position control method, the response speed of the system is increased, and the overshoot capability is greatly inhibited.

title: Robot control method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The control method of the robot comprises the steps that when the biped robot moves through mechanical feet, the mechanical foot supporting states corresponding to all time stages are determined, according to the mechanical foot supporting states corresponding to all the time stages, the moving track of a zero moment point ZMP corresponding to the biped robot between all the mechanical feet is determined, and the moving track of the biped robot between all the mechanical feet is determined. Determining pose information corresponding to each time stage when each mechanical foot is in a supporting state, determining a motion trail of the mass center according to the movement trail of the ZMP, and determining the motion trail of each mechanical foot, the motion trail based on the mass center and the motion trail corresponding to each mechanical foot according to the pose information; and determining a joint angle track corresponding to each target joint, and determining motion planning data for controlling the biped robot according to the joint angle track, so as to control the biped robot to move through each mechanical foot according to the motion planning data.

title: Multifunctional service robot for bank
abstract: The invention discloses a bank multifunctional service robot which comprises a robot body, a robot head and robot legs, the robot head and the robot legs are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the robot body respectively, a plurality of drawer grooves are formed in the robot body, and receipt storage drawers are placed in the drawer grooves. A receipt output device is arranged at the top of an inner cavity of the drawer groove and located on the upper side of the receipt storage drawer, mechanical arm lifting devices are symmetrically arranged on the side wall of the robot body, mechanical arms are installed on the mechanical arm lifting devices, and mechanical claws are installed at the front ends of the mechanical arms. According to the bank multifunctional service robot, user requirements are recognized through the voice recognition module, a user is guided, when filling is needed, the robot can directly take out receipts from the receipt storage drawer of the robot body according to the requirements and send the receipts to the user, the user does not need to go to a foreground to take the receipts, convenience is brought to the user, the situation of taking mistakes is avoided, and the user experience is improved. The working efficiency of banks is improved, and the burden of bank workers is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot arm structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot arm structure, and relates to the technical field of robot arms. The humanoid robot arm structure comprises a base, a driving mechanism and a supporting mechanism, a rotating plate is rotatably mounted at the top of the base, the supporting mechanism is arranged in the base and comprises a fifth motor, a second lead screw and a threaded plate, and the fifth motor is fixedly mounted on the outer surface of the rear side of the base. And a second lead screw is rotationally mounted between the front and rear inner walls of the base. According to the humanoid robot arm structure, through cooperation of the supporting mechanism, the hydraulic rod and the first supporting rod, when the gravity center is changed due to the fact that the operation position of the mechanical arm is changed in the operation process of the mechanical arm, the contact area of the mechanical arm and the working table top is increased, so that the base is assisted to more stably support the mechanical arm on the working table top; and the stability of the mechanical arm is improved, and the practicability of the mechanical arm is improved.

title: Light speed reducer and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a light speed reducer and a humanoid robot. The light speed reducer comprises a gear ring which can be elastically deformed, and the gear ring is arranged in a first shell to be meshed with the first shell; the eccentric shaft is used for driving the first harmonic rigid gear and the second harmonic rigid gear to rotate, a hollow cavity is formed in the eccentric shaft, and the hollow cavity penetrates through the eccentric shaft in the axial direction and is provided with two open ends; the central gear is used for driving the eccentric shaft to rotate; the flexible shaft connecting piece is used for being connected with an output shaft of the motor through a flexible shaft, the flexible shaft connecting piece is meshed with the central gear, and the flexible shaft connecting piece is provided with a flexible shaft connector for the end of the flexible shaft to be inserted in; the first harmonic rigid gear and the second harmonic rigid gear are both provided with second outer teeth capable of being meshed with the gear ring. The output flange is rotationally arranged in the first shell and connected with the first harmonic rigid gear and the second harmonic rigid gear. The light speed reducer is compact in structure and has the large design freedom degree.

title: Intelligent robot for financial consultation
abstract: The intelligent robot for financial consultation comprises a mechanical body part and a mechanical head part, the upper portion of the mechanical body part is rotationally connected with a rotating block for the mechanical head part to rotate, the top of the mechanical head part is provided with a spraying rod, and the top of the spraying rod is provided with an atomizing nozzle; a disinfection driver for driving the atomization nozzle to start is arranged in the mechanical body part; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the disinfection drive, the atomization nozzle and the screen disinfection assembly, the atomization nozzle can judge whether the man-machine interaction screen is in a use state and whether a human body stands in front of the robot at the moment through the automatic disinfection module; the atomizing nozzle can continuously spray disinfectant to the financial hall to disinfect the hall; and the screen disinfection assembly can automatically spray and disinfect the screen after the user uses the screen in a standby state, so that cross infection of the user is avoided.

title: Humanoid hip joint driven by dielectric elastomer
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot joints, and discloses a humanoid hip joint driven by a dielectric elastomer, the humanoid hip joint comprises a hip lifting mechanism, a driving mechanism and a thighbone part, the bottom of the driving mechanism is connected with the thighbone part, the thighbone part is driven by a dielectric elastomer driving device to swing universally and rotate, the hip lifting mechanism is fixedly arranged, and the hip lifting mechanism is connected with the driving mechanism. The bottom of the flexible driving unit is connected with the driving mechanism, and the flexible driving unit is used for lifting the driving mechanism and the thighbone part and electrifying different flexible driving units respectively, so that spatial three-axis rotation (flexion and extension, abduction and adduction and extorsion and intorsion) of the hip joint can be realized; hip lifting operation simulating human hip joints can be achieved through the hip lifting mechanism; and a buffer device is additionally arranged in the driving device, so that the vibration reduction performance of the whole mechanism is improved.

title: Autism Chinese functional language robot-assisted teaching method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an autism Chinese functional language robot-assisted teaching method, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a robot sign language gesture program of an autism Chinese functional language in an object Chinese context according to all object names and name pronunciation of a teaching language category; gesture language gesture actions made by a user are captured, and manual judgment and machine judgment are carried out; and sending a corresponding instruction to the user according to the judgment result, and completing one-time target gesture aided teaching. The humanoid robot is used for replacing the work content of a therapist. A plurality of objects are selected as target themes of language teaching, sign language gesture actions of the objects are expressed by a robot through an interactive robot platform, robot sign language gesture programs under Chinese context are constructed, each action program is independent, so that modularization of a teaching scheme can be realized, and then according to interest selection of autism users, the teaching efficiency is improved. And a customized training action system is formed for a subsequent teaching intervention process.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot which comprises a mounting part, leg structures are arranged on the two sides of the mounting part respectively, each leg structure comprises a first swing mechanism, a second swing mechanism and a foot mechanism which are connected in sequence, and a first connecting part is arranged between the first swing mechanism and the second swing mechanism; a second connecting piece is arranged between the second swinging mechanism and the foot mechanism; the first swing mechanism comprises at least two parallel X swing rods, the upper ends of all the X swing rods are hinged to the mounting piece, and the lower ends of all the X swing rods are hinged to the first connecting piece. The second swing mechanism comprises at least two parallel Y swing rods, the upper ends of all the Y swing rods are hinged to the first connecting piece, and the lower ends of all the Y swing rods are hinged to the second connecting piece. The foot mechanism includes a support. title: HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A humanoid robot includes a base, a robotic torso coupled to the base, at least one robotic arm, at least one robotic shoulder coupling the at least one robotic arm to the robotic torso, a robotic neck coupled to the robotic torso, and a plurality of actuators configured to move at least a portion of at least one of the robotic torso, the at least one robotic arm, the at least one robotic shoulder, and the robotic neck. title: Power Transmission Device Between Joints Of The Human Body
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a power transmission device between joints of a human body, which solves the problem of limited operation time of a wearable device or a wearable robot by proposing a lightweight wearable device to assist movements of a wearer without an actuator or a power source. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the power transmission device between joints of a human body comprises: a first wearing part worn on the distal part of one joint of the human body; a second wearing part worn on the distal part of another joint thereof; an input pulley connected to the first wearing part through a first flexible body; an output pulley connected to the second wearing part through a second flexible body; and a clutch assembly controlling the connection between the output pulley and the input pulley that are embedded and worn on the human body.

abstract: According to the present invention, a method for generating gesture visualization information for emotional expression of a human-friendly robot comprises: a step of defining at least one emotional expression item expressed by the human-friendly robot; a step of collecting gesture images visually representing each of the at least one emotional expression item; a step of extracting joint points from the collected gesture images; and a step of generating gesture visualization information that intuitively visualizes each of the at least one emotional expression item based on the extracted joint points.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR GENERATING FACIAL EXPRESSION DATA OF HUMAN-FRIENDLY ROBOT
abstract: A method for generating facial expression visualization information for emotional expression of a human-friendly robot according to the present invention comprises the steps of: defining at least one emotional expression item that can be expressed by a human-friendly robot; collecting facial expression images in which each of at least one emotional expression item is visually expressed; extracting feature points from the collected facial expression images according to predefined criteria; generating facial expression visualization information that intuitively visualizes each of at least one emotional expression item based on the extracted feature points; determining a facial expression tool according to the level of facial expression visualization information; and displaying at least one emotional expression item on the human-friendly robot using the determined facial expression tool. title: Robot humanoid impedance control method and system based on multi-modal signal fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a robot humanoid impedance control method and system based on multi-modal signal fusion, and the method comprises an imitation learning stage, a reinforcement learning stage, and a behavior control stage. The imitation learning stage is used for learning task-related stiffness geometry from human demonstration through a sensor; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, a robot task is migrated to a robot task by using a motion redirection method, then a learned trajectory contour and a rigidity contour reappear and are used for training a robot reinforcement learning model, the reinforcement learning stage is used for improving the online adaptation capability of a controller, and the task rigidity contour is provided for the robot in a self-adaptive optimal mode; and then humanoid impedance control is carried out on the joint position, the joint angle and the contact force of the robot. The self-adaption rate is set through the reinforcement learning model, the compliance relation between the contact force and the pose is established, the compliance behavior of the robot in the fine grabbing task is achieved, and the self-adaption of the robot to various objects in the grabbing force control process is achieved.

title: Robot control method and device, processor and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and device, a processor and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a visual coordinate system of visual acquisition equipment, a shaft joint coordinate system of a robot and a motion terminal coordinate system; on the basis of the conversion relation among the visual coordinate system, the shaft joint coordinate system and the motion terminal coordinate system, the to-be-calibrated parameters of the robot are calibrated, a calibration value is obtained, and the conversion relation comprises the relative position conversion relation and/or the posture conversion relation corresponding to the knee joint operation requirement information; performing iterative processing on the calibration value to obtain an iterative processing result; and based on an iterative processing result, controlling the robot to execute an execution behavior associated with the knee joint operation demand information. The technical problem that the robot meeting the knee joint operation requirement cannot be obtained through single calibration is solved.

title: Biped robot and hip joint structure thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot and a hip joint structure thereof. The hip joint structure comprises a hip transfer structure, the hip transfer structure comprises a first transfer part and a second transfer part which are fixedly connected with each other, and the second transfer part is used for being connected with a leg structure of the biped robot; the first driving mechanism is fixedly mounted on the second switching part, and the first driving mechanism is used for driving the leg structure to laterally swing; the second driving mechanism is fixedly connected with an output rotating shaft of the first driving mechanism, the end of the leg structure is connected with an output rotating shaft of the second driving mechanism, and the axis direction of the output rotating shaft of the second driving mechanism and the axis direction of the output rotating shaft of the first driving mechanism are orthogonally arranged; the second driving mechanism is used for driving the leg structure to rotate. According to the technical scheme, the problem that the hip joint of the biped robot is too large in size due to the fact that the structural design of the hip joint in an existing biped robot is complex is solved.

abstract: The invention discloses a biped walking robot ankle joint balance compensation mechanism which comprises a foot sole assembly, a containing cavity is formed in the foot sole assembly, the containing cavity and the foot sole assembly are arranged in the same direction, a strip-shaped hole communicated with the containing cavity is formed in the upper portion of the foot sole assembly, and the strip-shaped hole is communicated with the containing cavity. title: Biped robot uneven road walking planning and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses an uneven road walking planning and control method for a biped robot, which comprises the following steps of: 1, constructing a gait generator, activating the gait generator when a support phase is switched, and generating a mass center of a next support phase and an expected track of a swinging foot based on a simplified linear inverted pendulum model; and 2, constructing a whole body controller, activating the whole body controller in each control period, integrating task space targets such as the current center of mass, the expected state of the swinging foot and the expected posture of the body, and solving the optimal torque output. According to the method, the application of a stepping strategy in robot anti-interference is explored, and on the basis of optimizing the landing position, the landing time is fused into optimization, so that when the robot encounters large disturbance, the robot can recover balance by rapidly swinging legs, the anti-interference capability and robustness of the robot are improved, and the robot anti-interference capability is improved. And the planning method is combined with a whole-body motion controller to be successfully applied to walking on an uneven road surface.

title: Automatic leg stabilizing device for biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped robot leg automatic stabilizing device which comprises a mounting plate movably arranged in a robot leg, a movable opening is formed in the outward side of the robot leg, and a closing cover is hinged to the position, located at the upper end of the movable opening, of the robot leg; a pushing mechanism is arranged on the face, back to the movable opening, of the mounting plate and used for pushing the mounting plate to be close to or away from the movable opening, a stretching-out plate is hinged to the upper end of the face, facing the movable opening, of the mounting plate, and a driving mechanism used for controlling the inclination angle of the stretching-out plate is further arranged on the mounting plate. The robot is provided with the swing rod, the positioning pipe and the spine, when the robot stands at a certain position, the stability of the robot can be enhanced by extending the positioning pipe and enabling the spine to be inserted into the ground, and therefore the robot is prevented from shaking or toppling over.

title: Rigid and flexible pneumatic element hybrid drive robot joint system
abstract: The invention discloses a rigid-flexible pneumatic element hybrid drive robot joint system, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot has the whole-body joint movement function, and three air cylinders are connected in parallel to drive the waist joint to move. The cylinders of the waist joints and the pneumatic muscles of the pelvis drive the hip joints to move together; the pneumatic motor and the pneumatic muscle in the form of antagonistic muscle drive the knee joint to move together; the four pneumatic muscles are connected in parallel to drive the ankle joint to move, and the other two pneumatic muscles are connected with the lower ends of the feet through guiding of rear connecting shafts and drive the ankle joint together with the four pneumatic muscles of the ankle joint. The wrist joint-elbow joint and the shoulder joint-elbow joint are respectively provided with a group of antagonistic muscles to drive the elbow joint to rotate, the wrist joint-elbow joint and the wrist joint are provided with two groups of pneumatic muscles in the form of antagonistic muscles to drive the wrist joint to move, and the pneumatic claw has the effect of clamping articles. The joint is driven by the combination of pneumatic elements and mechanisms, and the joint has the advantages of being compact in structure, high in adaptability and flexible in working mode.

title: Humanoid robot teleoperation control method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot teleoperation control method which comprises the following steps: acquiring a first expected pose of the waist of a humanoid robot and a second expected pose of an end effector in a first reference coordinate system according to a control instruction; according to the first expected pose and the second expected pose, determining a target second expected pose corresponding to the second expected pose in a second reference coordinate; according to an inverse kinematics algorithm, by means of the target second expected pose, the expected pose of each joint of the mechanical arm in the second reference coordinate system is determined; and according to the first expected pose, the second expected pose and the expected poses of all the joints of the mechanical arm, a first control instruction is generated and sent. The posture of each joint of the mechanical arm can be correspondingly adjusted according to the change of the waist of the humanoid robot, and then it can be guaranteed that the end effector can move to the position indicated by the second expected posture.

title: Inverse kinematics solving method and device for legs of robot
abstract: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method and device for robot legs, and the method is mainly used for solving the inverse kinematics of the legs containing coupling driving parallelogram parallel joints in a biped robot, and due to the existence of coupling driving and the non-intersection of three axes of hip joint motor shafts at one point, the inverse kinematics analytical solution does not exist. According to the method, the position and the posture of an ankle joint are decoupled, and for the position, the initial position of a motor serves as an iteration initial value, and inverse kinematics solution is conducted through a numerical solution; for the posture, the angle relation of the ankle joint is directly obtained by adopting a geometric solution, so that the position and the posture are decoupled, and rapid solution is carried out.

title: Biped robot gait planning method and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait planning method and a biped robot, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining robot parameters, and building a motion model; s2, planning a gravity center projection trajectory by using a sine curve, obtaining gait trajectory planning parameters, and calculating a stability criterion; s3, judging whether the gait track planning parameters are stable or not based on a stability criterion; if the gait trajectory planning parameters are not stable, adjusting the gait trajectory planning parameters by using a speed switching method, and repeating the step S3; otherwise, entering step S4; and S4, a gravity center track meeting the stability requirement is obtained, and gait planning of the robot is conducted according to the gravity center track. According to the method, the gravity center trajectory meeting the stability requirement is obtained by obtaining the robot parameters, establishing the motion model, planning the gravity center projection trajectory by using the sine curve, calculating the stability criterion, obtaining the gait trajectory planning parameters and judging whether the gait trajectory planning parameters are stable or not based on the stability criterion; therefore, the robot is controlled to walk stably and quickly in the quasi-static gait.

title: Topology reconstruction method and model for shank of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a topology reconstruction method for a shank of a humanoid robot. The topology reconstruction method comprises the following steps: (1) designing an initial model; (2) carrying out topology calculation on the model; (3) analyzing the distribution characteristics of the material according to a topological calculation result; (4) dividing the initial model into block units; (5) removing the hollowed-out units according to material distribution characteristics; (6) modifying and repairing the units of the boundary area; (7) performing finite element calculation on the topological structure obtained by the removal method; and (8) supplementing units to the parts with larger stress, and carrying out secondary removal on the units in the areas with smaller stress. The invention further provides a shank model adopting the topology reconstruction method for the shank of the humanoid robot. According to the method, the design speed of the topological structure can be effectively reduced, the model reconstruction time of the shank topological model can be reduced by 20%, the material distribution characteristic retention rate of the model is 76%, and the integrity of the model is good.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a topology reconstruction method for a shank of a humanoid robot. The topology reconstruction method comprises the following steps: (1) designing an initial model; (2) carrying out topology calculation on the model; (3) analyzing the distribution characteristics of the material according to a topological calculation result; (4) dividing the initial model into block units; (5) removing the hollowed-out units according to material distribution characteristics; (6) modifying and repairing the units of the boundary area; (7) performing finite element calculation on the topological structure obtained by the removal method; and (8) supplementing units to the parts with larger stress, and carrying out secondary removal on the units in the areas with smaller stress. The invention further provides a shank model adopting the topology reconstruction method for the shank of the humanoid robot. According to the method, the design speed of the topological structure can be effectively reduced, the model reconstruction time of the shank topological model can be reduced by 20%, the material distribution characteristic retention rate of the model is 76%, and the integrity of the model is good.

title: Pneumatic transmission robot system based on multi-mode combination
abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic transmission robot system based on multi-mode combination, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The pneumatic muscles are used for driving the hip joints, the knee joints, the ankle joints, the shoulder joints, the elbow joints and the wrist joints of the robot to move, the air bag type air cylinders and air cylinder combinations are used for driving the waist joints, and the function of completely simulating joint movement of a person is achieved. The air bag type air cylinders and the waist joint air cylinders are connected in series to serve as branch chains, the three branch chains are connected in parallel to form a single-layer waist joint, and the six branch chains between two layers are evenly distributed on the circumference. One group of pneumatic muscles is combined with a guide wheel to drive the hip joint to rotate around the Z axis, the two pneumatic muscles are combined with a four-bar mechanism to drive the knee joint to bend and stretch, and the two groups of pneumatic muscles are rotatably connected with the second leg bone to serve as a support to be combined with a universal joint to realize bending, stretching and folding and unfolding of the ankle joint. The device is driven by the pneumatic muscle and the air cylinder, and has the characteristics of compact structure, rigid-flexible combination and good explosion-proof performance.

title: Shell structure for intelligent robot capable of walking with two upright feet

In addition, an ankle is arranged above the foot, an ankle soft rubber baffle (7) is arranged on the ankle, and the ankle ring soft rubber sleeve (6) and the ankle soft rubber baffle (7) are attached and overlapped to be matched with movement.

title: Inverse kinematics solving method for humanoid upper limb robot based on high-order differentiator
abstract: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method of a humanoid upper limb robot based on a high-order differentiator. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model with a time-varying linear equation set form; obtaining an error signal and an integral signal of the tail end position of the mechanical arm according to the mathematical model; solving a high-order derivative of the error signal according to a high-order differentiator, and establishing a dynamic error model; a time-varying linear equation set solver based on the dynamic error is designed, and the optimal action of the mechanical arm for the equation set is output; and establishing a state space model according to the optimal action to obtain a joint variable optimal solution. According to the method, the convergence speed is higher, the solving precision is higher, and when the method is applied to inverse kinematics solving of the mechanical arm, consumed energy is low, and the operability is higher.

title: Leg rod device for hip joint assisting exoskeleton robot

The leg supporting plate is arranged at the position, opposite to the front side of the leg of the human body, of the leg binding module. The clamping wheel is rotationally arranged on the supporting plate around a first axis, a multi-tooth clamping groove is formed in the clamping wheel, and meshing teeth protruding towards the first axis are arranged in the multi-tooth clamping groove; the latch assembly is provided with a latch structure which can protrude from the peripheral surface of the latch assembly, the latch structure is meshed with the meshing teeth, and the latch structure is arranged to be a structure which can stretch out and draw back in the length direction of the legs of the human body relative to the supporting plate; the circumferential multiple teeth of the clamping tooth assembly are meshed with the clamping wheel, so that connection looseness is avoided, and axial displacement and compensation of the adduction/abduction angle of the clamping wheel can be conducted through the flexibility and the rotating structure of the clamping wheel.

title: Exoskeleton robot for power-assisted driving of hip joint of human body
abstract: The exoskeleton robot comprises a waist assembly mechanism and two sets of leg mechanisms, each leg mechanism comprises a hip joint assembly, and each hip joint assembly comprises a servo motor, a motor flange, a swing arm head and a mounting base; a first adjusting screw hole is formed in the lower end of the telescopic waistband, and the position of the hip joint assembly can be adjusted through the first adjusting screw hole so as to adapt to different human bodies; a hinge is connected between the thigh swing rod and the swing arm head, a second adjusting screw hole is formed in the hinge, and the length of the thigh swing rod can be adjusted through the second adjusting screw hole so as to adapt to the leg lengths of different human bodies. title: Humanoid mechanical wrist
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid mechanical wrist which comprises a connecting framework, a transmission seat, two driving motors, two transmission mechanisms, two output connecting rod mechanisms, a bevel gear set, two connecting frames, an output connecting block, a vertical transmission bevel gear set arranged in the output connecting block and an output shaft head corresponding to a driving bevel gear. The rotating output shaft is coaxial with the driven bevel gear and used for being connected with the hand, the output connecting block is connected with the transmission base into a whole through two connecting frames, the two transmission mechanisms and the connecting rod output structure are matched with the output connecting block with the bevel gear set and the turnover output shaft head to be in linkage, and a universal planetary gear motor in the market can be adopted as a driving motor; the two sets of driving motors control the two sets of transmission mechanisms correspondingly, the mechanical wrist can move in the two-vertical-degree-of-freedom direction, cooperative angle compensation can be conducted on transmission in the overturning direction of the output connecting block under the condition that independent operation of the two-vertical-degree-of-freedom is not affected, and the structure of the mechanical wrist is simplified and shrunk.

title: Bionic hip joint
abstract: A bionic hip joint belongs to the technical field of bionic robots and is characterized in that a horizontal plane movement assembly, a coronal plane movement assembly and a sagittal plane movement assembly are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, and a hollow shaft I of a horizontal plane rotating shaft in the horizontal plane movement assembly is downwards inserted into a cylinder of a connecting piece I in the coronal plane movement assembly and fixedly connected through a bolt; a flat plate pair I of a coronal plane rotating shaft (B1) in the coronal plane movement assembly, a flat plate pair VI of a connecting piece II in the sagittal plane movement assembly and a flat plate pair V of a connecting piece III in the sagittal plane movement assembly are fixedly connected through bolts. Three degrees of freedom of the hip joint are decomposed into three components, each component realizes one-degree-of-freedom movement, and each component is controlled by an independent motor, so that the control becomes simpler and more reliable, the gait of a human being can be better simulated more easily, and the movement of the hip joint can be simulated more accurately. And a new scheme is provided for the design of the hip joint of the bionic robot.

title: Robot cloud control system and method based on motion capture equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot cloud control system and method based on motion capture equipment, the system comprises a robot main controller deployed at the cloud and a robot operating system at a robot end, the robot operating system communicates with the main controller through a network, and the motion capture equipment communicates with the main controller through the network; after the main controller obtains an action instruction of the automatic capturing device through the network, the action instruction is converted into a robot execution instruction and sent to the robot operation system through the network, and the robot hardware entity is controlled to execute the action of the execution instruction. According to the invention, the motion capture device can carry out Internet remote control on the humanoid robot through the cloud, and is not limited by geographic positions. The robot main controller deployed at the cloud end can have the computing power with higher configuration, can execute more and complex computing tasks, optimizes and corrects the motion capture data in real time, and converts the motion capture data into the motor data, thereby improving the control capability of the robot.

title: Under-driven bionic dexterous hand, system and control method of under-driven bionic dexterous hand
abstract: The invention provides an under-driven bionic dexterous hand and system and a control method of the under-driven bionic dexterous hand. The under-driven bionic dexterous hand comprises a palm, five fingers, a control panel and a steering engine installed on the back face of the palm through threaded holes, and a thumb comprises a joint, a tendon rope driving the fingers to bend, a metacarpal bone, a near-end phalanx and a far-end phalanx, wherein the metacarpal bone, the near-end phalanx and the far-end phalanx are sequentially connected through cylindrical pins; the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are the same in structure and each comprise a joint, a tendon rope driving the fingers to bend, a far-end knuckle, a middle knuckle and a near-end knuckle, and the far-end knuckles, the middle knuckles and the near-end knuckles are sequentially connected through cylindrical pins. Finger root stroke limiters are arranged at the metacarpophalangeal joints where the thumb is connected with the palm, and finger root stroke limiters are arranged at the metacarpophalangeal joints where the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are connected with the palm, the middle knuckles and the far-end knuckles. The humanoid degree is high, light and flexible, and the technical problems that a dexterous hand is too large in size, too complex in structure, rigid in action and not high in humanoid degree are solved.

title: Biped robot motion control method based on imitation learning and reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot motion control method based on imitation learning and reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a biped robot state observation value in a simulation environment, an expected action of a previous period and a command code into a neural network B, outputting and recording an expected action of a next period, and splicing the expected actions into a track, the tolerance value of the spliced trajectory and the extracted trajectory is calculated, whether a comprehensive reward for quantitatively evaluating the output of the neural network B is gained or broken is determined, then the comprehensive reward is used for optimizing the neural network B until convergence, and the control method at the moment is used for the biped robot in the actual environment to control the biped robot to complete specified movement; wherein the neural network B inherits weight parameters of the neural network A, the neural network A is trained by a heuristic track enabling the biped robot to stably move and a reference track, and the heuristic track is obtained by heuristically processing the reference track. According to the invention, the biped robot can fully move and explore within the range of capability of generating reasonable movement.

title: Humanoid piano playing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid piano playing robot which can comprise paws, arms, a waist, a neck, legs, a control system and a base, the neck corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, the waist corresponds to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch, and the legs correspond to two degrees of freedom to drive the head to rotate and pitch. Through the two degrees of freedom of the waist and the head and control over the poses of the two mechanical arms, the piano playing robot in the specification can play a piano skillfully and intelligently.

title: Substation maintenance robot and method for autonomously suspending grounding wire
abstract: The invention provides a transformer substation maintenance robot and an autonomous ground wire suspension method. The transformer substation maintenance robot comprises a mobile platform, a lifting platform, a control box and a humanoid robot. The grounding wire suspension actuator is composed of a rotating shaft, a clamp holder, a visual sensor and a torque sensor. The rotating shaft is driven by a direct-current brushless motor and is connected with a grounding wire clamping jaw during working, and the motor rotates forwards to enable the grounding wire clamping jaw to clamp, so that a grounding wire is connected with a high-voltage wire; the clamping device and the axis of the rotating shaft are coplanar, when the motor rotates forwards, the clamping device clamps the grounding wire clamping jaw, and the posture of the grounding wire is fixed; the visual sensor detects and positions the high-voltage line in real time; the torque sensor detects the torque of the tail end of the mechanical arm in real time after the mechanical arm reaches the target position. The ground wire hanging device can replace manpower to complete ground wire hanging work, greatly saves labor cost, and has far-reaching significance for guaranteeing safe and stable operation of a transformer substation.

title: Foot damping device of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robots, in particular to a biped robot foot damping device which comprises a foot body, the foot body comprises a foot upper portion and a foot lower portion which are arranged up and down, a foot front damping assembly and a foot rear damping assembly are arranged between the foot upper portion and the foot lower portion, and an edge warping portion is integrally formed at the front end of the foot lower portion; the foot front damping assembly comprises a supporting protruding block integrally formed with the upper portion of the foot, a supporting protruding ridge integrally formed with the lower portion of the foot, and a carbon plate fixedly arranged between the supporting protruding block and the supporting protruding ridge and connected with the edge warping portion in a clamped mode. The foot rear damping assembly comprises a first sleeve, a first limiting plate, a second sleeve, a second limiting plate and an elastic element. The damping foot is compact in structure, the front-foot damping assembly and the rear-foot damping assembly serve as elastic connection between the upper foot portion and the lower foot portion, the buffering and damping capacity of the foot body is remarkably improved, and the front-foot damping assembly and the rear-foot damping assembly are easy to install and maintain.

title: ANTHROPOMORPHIC METAMORPHIC DEXTEROUS HAND
abstract: An anthropomorphic metamorphic dexterous hand is disclosed, including a palm module and a plurality of finger modules. The finger module includes a finger back unit, a finger pulp unit and a finger driving unit. The finger back unit and the finger pulp unit are stacked, the finger pulp unit has a greater flexibility than the finger back unit, and the finger driving unit is configured to drive a finger back traction wire and a finger pulp traction wire to retract and extend to enable the finger module to bend towards the finger pulp unit or stretch away from the finger pulp unit. When executing a grabbing task, the finger pulp unit has a high degree of fit with an object to be grabbed, and can adapt to the shape of the object to be grabbed. The finger pulp unit and the finger back unit realize the combination of flexibility and hardness, and the finger back unit provides a certain degree of rigid support for the finger module. The finger pulp unit has higher flexibility, which facilitates the finger module to bend towards the finger pulp unit, and conforms to the characteristic that human fingers can only bend towards the palm center. Thus, the finger module has both rigidity and flexibility, and meets the requirements for rigidity and flexibility of a manipulator in different grabbing environments.

title: Humanoid robot non-grabbing type mobile pushing task control method and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot non-grabbing type mobile pushing task control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building a system interaction force model based on the pose information of the interaction among a humanoid robot, a target object and an environment, and then building the dynamics models of the humanoid robot and the target object; establishing a system speed constraint model and a system force constraint model based on speed and force constraint conditions satisfied by pairwise interaction among the humanoid robot, the target object and the environment; robot joint angular acceleration constraint conditions are obtained according to the established system speed constraint model, the established system force constraint model and the dynamical models of the humanoid robot and the target object; and obtaining a system motion boundary condition based on the established robot joint angular acceleration constraint condition, and executing a non-grabbing type mobile operation task according to the condition that the motion trail of the humanoid robot meets the system motion boundary condition.

title: Layered optimization control method for dynamic advancing of wheeled biped robot
abstract: ***The invention discloses a layered optimization control method for dynamic advancing of a wheeled biped robot, and the method specifically comprises the steps: obtaining an optimal reference forward position, an optimal reference forward acceleration, an optimal reference forward speed, an optimal reference forward acceleration and an optimal future trajectory gamma * through model prediction according to a target speed, a current speed, a target position and a current position; fitting an internal dynamic reverse mapping function through a nonlinear least square method by utilizing gamma * and the internal dynamic of a first-order trolley inverted pendulum model to obtain an optimal reference mass center inclination angle theta * ref matched with the internal dynamic reverse mapping function; and establishing a three-order trolley inverted pendulum model, constructing and solving a related QP optimization problem by utilizing multi-joint dynamics based on and solving an optimal reference joint angle, obtaining optimal control force and torque, and acting the optimal control force and torque on the biped robot for control. The method is small in computing power demand, and enables the robot to maintain self-balance and track the reference trajectory.

title: Humanoid manipulator device based on connecting rod mechanism and gear transmission
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid manipulator device based on a connecting rod mechanism and gear transmission. The humanoid manipulator device comprises a device base, a palm displacement mechanism, a left metacarpophalangeal connecting mechanism, a middle metacarpophalangeal connecting mechanism, a right metacarpophalangeal connecting mechanism, a left metacarpophalangeal mechanism, a middle metacarpophalangeal mechanism and a right metacarpophalangeal mechanism. A palm motor, a driving gear, a gear bearing, a gear set, a middle palm finger connecting mechanism and a middle finger mechanism are installed on the device base, a supporting shaft, a bearing, a driven gear, a left metacarpophalangeal connecting mechanism, a right metacarpophalangeal connecting mechanism, a left metacarpophalangeal mechanism and a right metacarpophalangeal mechanism are mounted on the palm displacement mechanism; each palm-finger connecting mechanism is provided with a finger motor and a driving gear which can be used for bending fingers. Each finger mechanism is provided with a half gear, an internal connecting rod mechanism is driven by a finger motor, and therefore bending is achieved. The humanoid manipulator device based on the connecting rod mechanism and gear transmission is used for solving the problems of high manufacturing cost, high maintenance difficulty and the like in the robot technology.

title: Rope-driven tensegrity joint seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a rope driving type tensegrity joint seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arms. The shoulder joint motor, the elbow joint motor and the wrist joint motor are all fixedly installed at the bottom in the console, the shoulder joint is fixedly installed on an upper platform of the console, the top end of the shoulder joint is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the supporting frame, the top end of the supporting frame is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the elbow joint, and the top end of the elbow joint is fixedly connected with the bottom end of the wrist joint through four second supporting columns; a shoulder joint driving rope of the shoulder joint is driven by a shoulder joint motor to realize three degrees of freedom of the shoulder joint; an elbow joint driving rope of the elbow joint is driven by an elbow joint motor to realize one degree of freedom of the elbow joint; a wrist joint driving rope of the wrist joint is driven by a wrist joint motor to achieve two degrees of freedom of the wrist joint. According to the mechanical arm, a rigid joint is replaced by the tensegrity joint, the mechanical arm has the advantages of high efficiency, impact resistance, environmental disturbance resistance, adjustable rigidity, small mass, low cost and the like, and the requirements under specific working conditions can be met.

title: Active and passive combined biped robot online foothold generation and adjustment method
abstract: The invention discloses an active and passive combined biped robot online foothold generation and adjustment method, which comprises the following steps: determining a planned zero moment point trajectory and a planned centroid trajectory, and designing a virtual inverted pendulum centroid tracking controller; the expected zero moment point trajectory is controlled, so that the expected mass center trajectory of the robot is tracked according to the actual zero moment point position, the external acting force is calculated, and the external acting force acts on the virtual inverted pendulum for state updating; and according to the estimated centroid trajectory in the estimated two steps in the future and the planned foothold position, the expected foothold position is optimized, and through online ankle trajectory tracking control, the expected ankle position of the robot follows and calculates the expected joint angle and acts on the biped robot. According to the method, the calculation real-time performance is guaranteed, meanwhile, a large and flexible foothold adjustment effect is generated, and better disturbance suppression and balance recovery are achieved.

title: Non-contact security robot device for dangerous operation area
abstract: The utility model discloses a non-contact security robot device in a dangerous operation area, and belongs to the technical field of security robots. The robot comprises a robot head, a limiting device, a steering speed distribution box, an audible and visual alarm, a human body induction radar sensor, a control box, a robot body, a one-way or two-way grating protective fence and a liquid crystal display screen, and the control box comprises a face recognition module, a motor driving module, a main control module, a wireless/wired integrated module and a voice module. The system comprises a human body induction module, an audible and visual alarm module, a grating module, a display screen module and a mainboard. According to the utility model, the humanoid robot device simulates guard standing and information registration, has the functions of probing action, visual identification, range perception, voice alarm, on-site sound-light alarm, access closed-loop management, traffic information recording and remote transmission and the like, and not only has humanized management, but also has the functions of real-time monitoring, real-time monitoring and the like. And the attention of the factory personnel on the management and control of the personnel in the dangerous area and the operation area can be aroused.

title: Humanoid double-arm nursing robot control method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic control, in particular to a control method and system of a humanoid double-arm nursing robot. Comprising the following steps: selecting an improved D-H modeling method to carry out modeling analysis on the humanoid double-arm nursing robot to obtain a modeling analysis result; according to the modeling analysis result, a connecting rod additional coordinate system of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot is established, and kinematics connecting rod parameters of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot are obtained; according to the kinematics connecting rod parameters of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot, a transformation matrix of the joints is obtained, and therefore forward kinematics analysis results of all the joints of the double arms and the waist joint of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot are analyzed. The control method of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot can be applied to the robot, control is accurate, movement of the humanoid double-arm nursing robot can be effectively analyzed, and use is safe and reliable. An improved D-H modeling method is adopted to establish a nursing robot mathematical model, and forward kinematics analysis of all joints of the two arms and the waist joint of the robot is completed.

title: Motion state switching device and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a motion state switching device and a biped robot. The motion state switching device comprises a shell, a movable part and a limiting mechanism; the shell is provided with a sliding channel and a containing cavity, and the sliding channel extends in the set direction; at least part of the movable part is arranged in the sliding channel in a sliding mode in the set direction, and at least part of the movable part is arranged in the containing cavity; the limiting mechanism is arranged in the containing cavity and used for limiting movement of the movable part in the sliding channel. The motion state switching device comprises a first working state and a second working state, and in the first working state, the limiting mechanism is separated from the movable part; and in the second working state, the limiting mechanism is in contact with the movable part, so that the relative positions of the movable part and the sliding channel are kept fixed. Thus, switching of the motion state switching device among different working states is achieved, the switching efficiency is high, the structure is simple, and the cost is low.

title: Palm of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a palm of a humanoid robot. The thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are arranged on the palm body, and the thumb comprises a fourth knuckle, a fifth knuckle and a rotating seat which are sequentially hinged from top to bottom; the driving mechanism is used for driving the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger; the palm has a fist-clenching state and a stretching state, when the palm is switched from the stretching state to the fist-clenching state, the driving mechanism drives the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger to bend towards the side close to the palm body, and the rotating seat rotates towards the side close to the palm body; when the palm is switched from the fist-clenching state to the stretching state, the driving mechanism drives the thumb, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger to stretch towards the side away from the palm body, and the rotating base rotates towards the side away from the palm body. The utility model has the advantages that the holding stability of the palm is good, and the control is convenient.

title: Thumb structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a thumb structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a mounting seat and a first driving part, and the first driving part is mounted on the mounting seat; the rotating seat is hinged to the mounting seat and connected with the first driving piece, and the first driving piece can drive the rotating seat to rotate relative to the mounting seat; the first knuckle, the second knuckle and the second driving piece are installed on the rotating base, one end of the first knuckle is hinged to the rotating base, the other end of the first knuckle is hinged to the second knuckle, and the second driving piece can drive the first knuckle and the second knuckle to be bent towards the rotating base. The thumb structure has the advantages that the thumb structure is simple, rotation and bending can be realized, and the simulation trueness is high.

title: Carrying exoskeleton robot with waist and hip integrated power-assisted motor and control method of carrying exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of exoskeleton robots, and particularly relates to a carrying exoskeleton robot of a waist and hip integrated power-assisted motor and a control method of the carrying exoskeleton robot. Comprising an adjustable back frame mechanism, two sets of passive upper limb assisting mechanisms and two sets of double-motor waist and hip assisting mechanisms, the passive upper limb mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the back frame mechanism, each passive upper limb mechanism comprises a shoulder joint forward flexion/backward extension mechanism, a shoulder inward rotation/outward rotation mechanism and a bandage mechanism, and a waist adjusting mechanism is connected with the waist and hip double-assisting motor mechanisms. Human body movement is used as hip joint and lumbar vertebra cooperative movement. Waist and hip double motors are adopted for assistance, the waist motor provides assistance for relative rotation of upper limbs and the waist, and the hip motor provides assistance for relative rotation and walking of hip joints, so that different human body carrying habits are adapted, and meanwhile the walking assistance problem is solved.
