title: Connecting assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a connecting assembly and a humanoid robot. The connecting assembly comprises a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, a second connector; the motion adjusting assembly is connected with the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece, the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece can swing in the first direction and the second direction, the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece can rotate relatively, and an included angle is formed between the first direction and the second direction; wherein in the first use state, one of the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece is detachably connected with the trunk of the humanoid robot, and the other one of the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece is detachably connected with the head of the humanoid robot; and in the second using state, one of the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece is detachably connected with the hand of the humanoid robot, and the other one of the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece is detachably connected with the arm structure of the humanoid robot.

title: Gait planning method, system and equipment for biped humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a gait planning method, system and equipment for a biped humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. According to the method, the swing leg and ankle joint track is planned through the third-order Bezier curve, so that the generated ankle joint track is smoother, and the generated track can be easily adjusted until the swing leg and ankle joint track which enables the biped humanoid robot to walk most stably is found; furthermore, the mass center track is planned based on a previewing control algorithm, and the planned mass center track is compensated by using a three-mass-center model, so that the mass center track of the biped humanoid robot in the walking process is closer to the actual situation, and the walking stability of the humanoid robot is improved; moreover, the calculation amount in the planning process is greatly reduced, and the method has a wide application prospect.

title: Movable hip joint assisting robot
abstract: The invention discloses a movable hip joint assisting robot. The robot comprises a waist device worn on the waist of the human body and two leg devices worn on the left thigh and the right thigh of the human body correspondingly, and the waist device is connected with the two leg devices through two inhaul cables correspondingly; each leg device comprises a thigh fixing plate, a tension sensor and a spring; the tension sensor is arranged on the thigh fixing plate and connected to the inhaul cable through a spring, and the other end of the inhaul cable is fixedly connected with a line wheel on the waist device; the waist device comprises a waist fixing plate worn on the waist of the human body, straps, a bottom plate installed on the back face of the waist fixing plate, two connecting rods, a motor base, a wire wheel, a motor, a motor controller, two tension sensor transmitters and a battery. When the lower limbs need assistance, the tension sensor detects the reduced tension, the motor controller controls the motor to rotate and drives the wire wheel to move, finally the tension is provided for the leg device through the connecting rod and the inhaul cable, and the assistance function is achieved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a movable hip joint assisting robot. title: Dynamic jumping and balance control method for humanoid robot, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic jumping and balance control method for a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a medium. The dynamic jumping and balance control method comprises the following steps: planning tracks of a mass center and a sole in a jumping process of the humanoid robot; a humanoid robot is modeled as a single rigid body, the position, angular deviation, linear speed and angular speed of the mass center of the robot are taken as state variables, ground contact force and ground contact torque are taken as control variables, a model prediction control problem is constructed and converted into a standard QP problem to be solved, and the optimal ground reaction force and acting torque are obtained; a whole body motion control model is constructed, and the joint position, speed and feed-forward joint torque are obtained by means of the expected tail end state and the optimal ground reaction force; controlling the humanoid robot to execute jumping motion according to the joint position, the joint speed and the joint torque; the joint torque is the sum of the feed-forward torque and the feedback torque, and the feedback torque is obtained through proportional differential control calculation; and after the humanoid robot lands, stable landing of the robot is realized by adopting a stepping strategy.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic jumping and balance control method for a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a medium. title: Humanoid robot shank optimization method and device based on field driving principle
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot shank optimization method based on a field driving principle, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an initial humanoid robot shank through three-dimensional modeling, and constructing a to-be-optimized feature size set based on the structure of the connection part between the initial humanoid robot shank and other parts; a plurality of detection points are arranged for all the joint structures, and stress field graphs of all the joint structures are obtained through finite element analysis; performing strength evaluation through the stress field graph, and adjusting when the structure of any joint does not meet the strength evaluation requirement; and repeating finite element analysis until a termination condition is met, outputting an optimized optimal feature size set, and adjusting the initial humanoid robot shank based on the optimal feature size set to obtain a humanoid robot shank design drawing. The invention further provides a humanoid robot shank optimization device. By means of the method, the design process of the shank of the humanoid robot can be effectively simplified, and meanwhile the strength and light weight of the final structure can be guaranteed.

title: Whole-body forward/inverse dynamic modeling method for humanoid robot with closed-loop constraint structure
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body forward/inverse dynamic modeling method for a humanoid robot with a closed-loop constraint structure, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a world coordinate system of the robot, a floating base and a local coordinate system of each joint, considering that knee joints and ankle joints of the robot are transmitted through a four-bar mechanism, and establishing an analytical expression of the closed-loop constraint; the independent generalized speed is determined; the method is further based on six-dimensional space vector description, a recursive hinged body algorithm is adopted to conduct dynamic modeling on the robot, equivalent processing is conducted on physical quantities such as space inertia, gyroscopic force and Coriolis space acceleration, components related to closed-loop constraint are combined into an aggregation node, and the robot is subjected to dynamic modeling. A forward/inverse dynamic model in a constraint embedding form is established. Different from a general series mechanism dynamics modeling method, the method can be used for performing forward/inverse dynamics solution on the humanoid robot comprising a knee joint and ankle joint four-bar linkage transmission mechanism, and a key basis is provided for whole-body force control of the humanoid robot.

title: Limb control calibration system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a limb control calibration system of a humanoid robot, which is used for respectively calibrating in different standard value intervals and fitting and calibrating the distance and the length exceeding the standard value range, so that the accuracy and the intelligent level of limb actions of the humanoid robot are improved. Comprising a robot body which is provided with a plurality of limbs and a monitoring part. The system further comprises a plurality of calibration blocks, a monitoring camera, a transmitter, a receiver and a contact calibration module, the joint arms of the limbs are each provided with two calibration blocks, the distance between the two calibration blocks on the same limb is a standard value, the monitoring camera is installed on the monitoring part, the transmitter and the receiver are installed on the monitoring part, and the contact calibration module is installed on the monitoring part. The transmitter irradiates the multiple calibration blocks, the reflection angles of the multiple calibration blocks are different, when the postures of the multiple limbs are calibration postures, light reflected by the multiple calibration blocks can be received by the receiver, and meanwhile the angles between the multiple joints of the multiple limbs are standard angles.

title: Knee joint clutch of exoskeleton robot
abstract: According to the exoskeleton robot knee joint clutch, a jaw clutch driving body and a transmission wheel are in coaxial transmission connection, and matched tooth structures are arranged on the opposite end faces of the jaw clutch driving body and a jaw clutch driven body correspondingly; the transmission wheel is in transmission connection with the stepping motor; the jaw clutch driving body is of a cylindrical cam structure, a curve groove is formed in the side surface of the jaw clutch driving body, the jaw clutch driving body and the cam follower are coaxially connected in a sleeved mode and can rotate relative to the cam follower, and a protruding column on the cam follower is matched with the curve groove of the jaw clutch driving body. When the jaw clutch driving body rotates, the protruding column of the cam follower can push the jaw clutch driving body to move in the axial direction of the cam follower by moving along the curve groove of the jaw clutch driving body, and therefore the tooth structure of the jaw clutch driving body and the tooth structure of the jaw clutch driven body are separated or meshed. The motion trail of the exoskeleton robot better conforms to gait motion of a human body, and more electricity is saved.

title: Human walking simulation type piezoelectric linear motor and driving method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid walking type piezoelectric linear motor and a driving method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of precise driving and positioning of piezoelectric linear motors, the humanoid walking type piezoelectric linear motor comprises linear guide rails and a mover arranged between the linear guide rails, the mover comprises a hinge mechanism, a piezoelectric linear feeding driver and an electromagnet, the piezoelectric linear feeding driver is fixed to the inner side of the hinge mechanism, the two ends of the outer side of the hinge mechanism are fixedly connected with the electromagnets, and in the driving process, stepping type displacement of the mover along the linear guide rail is achieved through alternate attraction of the electromagnets and the linear guide rail and telescopic movement of the piezoelectric linear feeding driver; and bidirectional displacement can be generated. Based on the humanoid walking type piezoelectric linear motor and the driving method thereof, high-frequency telescopic motion of the piezoelectric linear feed driver can be converted into bidirectional displacement of the rotor, and the humanoid walking type piezoelectric linear motor has the advantages of being large in stroke, high in positioning precision, compact in structure and large in thrust.

title: Robot for humanoid education
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid education, and discloses a robot for humanoid education, which comprises a shell, a circuit board is fixedly mounted in the shell, an intelligent education module and a power supply module are respectively mounted at the top and the bottom of the circuit board, and buffer blocks are movably inserted into the top and the bottom of the shell. According to the robot for humanoid education, when the robot falls down forwards or backwards, the buffer blocks make contact with the ground firstly, the situation that the trunk of the robot directly collides with the ground and is damaged is prevented, meanwhile, the two connectors and the conductive end of the intelligent education module can be cut off through the two insulating pieces, and the situation that after the robot falls down, mechanical arms still act is prevented; and when the back is collided, two conductive contact blocks move upwards to enable two through grooves to be aligned with two conductive rods of the power supply module, so that power supply of the power supply module to the intelligent education module is cut off, protection is cut off after the education robot falls down, and then protection use of the humanoid education robot is facilitated.

title: Heterogeneous exoskeleton robot
abstract: A heterogeneous exoskeleton robot comprises a back part and two leg parts, and the back part is rotationally connected with the two leg parts; the device further comprises an adjustable straddle bandage and an adjustable upper limb structure used for underarm supporting. Each leg part comprises a power driving structure, a telescopic leg, a grounding detection structure and a flexible pressure detection structure; the flexible pressure detection structure comprises a hydraulic detection module and a hydraulic sensor module; the power driving structure is rotationally connected with the back part; the upper end of the telescopic leg is connected with an output part of the power driving structure; the grounding detection structure is arranged at the lower end of the telescopic leg; and the hydraulic detection module is arranged on the ground contact detection structure and is connected with the hydraulic sensor module arranged on the telescopic leg. The device is compact in structure, reduces the weight of a human body, overcomes the influence of gravity on walking of the human body, achieves gait detection in a hydraulic mode, and is high in reliability.

title: Robot humanoid multi-finger joint tactile perception method, system and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot humanoid multi-finger joint tactile perception method, system and device, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the grabbing test of different types of objects through a multi-finger mechanical paw, sampling the tactile multidimensional information, obtaining a multidimensional time sequence, and marking the types of the objects; performing enhancement processing on the label sample; performing feature extraction and splicing on the multi-dimensional time sequence of each finger of each sample in the enhanced sample set to obtain feature vectors corresponding to different fingers; feature vectors corresponding to different fingers of each sample in the enhanced sample set are used as inputs, corresponding object categories are marked as outputs, and B-ELM networks corresponding to the fingers are trained to serve as classifiers; and for unknown classification objects in the multi-finger mechanical gripper, feature vectors corresponding to all fingers are extracted according to the sampling time sequence and input into the corresponding classifiers, finally, decision making is conducted on output of all the classifiers through a soft voting mechanism, and the classification of the objects in the multi-finger mechanical gripper is determined. The method provided by the invention has good classification accuracy and strong robustness.

title: Biped robot lower limb structure with passive soft shank
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a biped robot lower limb structure with passive soft shanks. Comprising a pelvis, a left leg and a right leg, the left leg and the right leg are the same in structure, each of the left leg and the right leg comprises a hip joint mechanism, a thigh mechanism, a knee joint mechanism, a shank mechanism, an ankle joint mechanism and a sole, the hip joint mechanisms are rotationally connected with the upper ends of the thigh mechanisms, and the hip joint mechanisms are used for driving the thigh mechanisms to do yawing, rolling and pitching movement; the lower end of the thigh mechanism is rotationally connected with the upper end of the shank mechanism through a knee joint mechanism; the knee joint mechanism is used for driving the shank mechanism to pitch; the lower end of the shank mechanism is connected with the sole through an ankle joint mechanism, and the ankle joint mechanism is used for driving the sole to do pitching and rolling movement. By means of the shanks with the passive compliance function, impact generated by the feet and the ground can be absorbed, meanwhile, the gravity center of the whole leg is moved upwards, and the stability of the robot in the walking process is improved.

title: Motion imitation robot control device and method based on artificial neural network and a computer-readable storage medium
abstract: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a method for controlling a behavior imitation robot based on an artificial neural network, and a computer-readable medium therefor. In accordance with the present invention, the apparatus includes: a storage part storing human behavior data representing a figure of human behavior; an input data generation part generating input data by combining human joint angle data about at least one human joint from the human behavior data; a behavior prediction part outputting robot joint angle data by inputting the input data into an artificial neural network trained with a dataset of the human behavior data and robot behavior correct-answer data; and a control part controlling the behavior of the robot through the robot joint angle data. Moreover, the method for controlling a behavior imitation robot based on an artificial neural network includes: an input step of inputting the input data into the artificial neural network by combining the human joint angle data about at least one human joint; an output step of predicting robot joint angle data from the input data; and a control step of controlling the behavior of the robot through the robot joint angle data. Therefore, the present invention enables a robot to imitate human behavior using an artificial neural network.

title: COGNITIVE LEARNING AND MEMORY MODELLING TOWARDS HUMAN LEVEL SYNTHETIC INTELLIGENCE
abstract: The present invention discloses an adaptive artificial intelligence system for cognitive learning of a humanoid robot (110) comprising a front-end neuromimetic sensorimotor perception module (100) for detecting sensory data from a plurality of sensors and translates the sensory data into computer language, a language-grounding module (200) for receiving human-language instructions and translates the instructions into computer language; and a processor for receiving and processing inputs from the front-end neuromimetic sensorimotor perception module and the language-grounding module; wherein the processor includes: a semantic memory (320); a episodic memory (310); a procedural memory (330); and a working memory (340); wherein the semantic memory (320) predicts events that may cease the operation of the humanoid robot (110) based on the temporal sequence of events encoded by the episodic memory (310) and then the procedural memory (330) generates a sequence of action plans to be executed by the humanoid robot (110) based on the prediction, and the interaction of the memories are facilitated by the working memory (340) which maintains all the necessary information online for use in executing the given instructions. title: Grasp Planning Of Unknown Object For Digital Human Model
abstract: An embodiment receives models of an object and an environment and an indication of position of a digital human model (DHM). An oriented bounding box (with a plurality of faces) surrounding the model of the object is determined and, for each of the plurality of faces, a candidate grasp location, a candidate grasp orientation, and a candidate grasp type is determined. From amongst the plurality of faces, one or more graspable faces is determined based on: the candidate grasp locations, the candidate grasp orientations, the environment model, and dimensions of each face. Then, an optimal graspable face is identified based on a hierarchy and the position of the DHM. An inverse kinematic solver determines position and orientation, i.e., grasp, of an end effector of the DHM grasping the object based on the candidate grasp location, candidate grasp orientation, and candidate grasp type of the optimal graspable face.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a leg structure and a biped robot. title: Humanoid waist structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid waist structure of a humanoid robot in the field of robots, and the humanoid waist structure comprises a robot waist supporting assembly, a first hip leg base and a second hip leg base are arranged below the robot waist supporting assembly, the first hip leg base is next to the second hip leg base, and a movable supporting seat is mounted on one side wall of the first hip leg base. title: Human body key point detection humanoid robot assisted fitness method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot assisted fitness method for human body key point detection, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a real-time motion video of a person; a YOLOV7 model with a MobileNetv3 network as a trunk is adopted, a Conv module of the YOLOV7 network model is improved by using a Ghost Conv module to obtain an improved YOLOV7 network model, and target detection is performed on a motion video to obtain a human body position; tracking a human body target by using a Centriod Tracking algorithm, and calculating a centroid coordinate of a human body; performing real-time detection on a human body by improving an Openpose network to obtain positions and numbers of key points of the human body; and calculating the angle, distance and displacement between the human body key points, and judging whether the action is standard or not. The method solves the problem that the existing method cannot give consideration to key point detection accuracy, real-time performance and light weight at the same time.

title: Robot real-time expression simulation method and device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a robot real-time expression simulation method and device. According to the method, key point positions on all faces in a to-be-detected face image can be obtained by recognizing the to-be-detected face image, a to-be-simulated face in the to-be-detected face image is determined according to the key point positions, a current frame and a previous frame of the to-be-detected face image are compared in real time, and the transformation trend and the transformation proportion of the to-be-simulated face can be obtained. The conversion trend is used for adjusting the head rotation angle of the robot, and the conversion proportion is used for calculating the rotation angles and the operation time of all steering engines of the robot, so that the steering engines of the robot can control the action of the robot and perform expression simulation on the to-be-simulated face. The key points are extracted by using the face key point detection model, so that the accuracy of the key point positions can be improved; by automatically obtaining the expression change of the to-be-simulated face, the real-time performance and intelligence of robot expression simulation can be improved, and the error of robot expression simulation is also reduced.

title: Method and device for capturing motion performance measurement data of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a capturing method and device for motion performance measurement of a humanoid robot. The capturing method comprises the following steps: acquiring attitude angle data and acceleration data of the humanoid robot during motion measured by an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) measuring instrument of a protection unit in real time; according to an infrared marking ball arranged on the protection unit, positioning information is displayed on an interface of the mobile terminal in real time through a corresponding infrared camera, and a pose plane of the protection unit is determined according to the positioning information; determining motion parameters of the corresponding protection unit according to the attitude angle data, the acceleration data and the pose plane; determining a rotation angle according to the pose planes measured by different protection units; determining a rotation speed according to attitude angle data and acceleration data measured by different protection units; and obtaining motion performance measurement data of the humanoid robot according to the motion parameters, the rotation angle and the rotation speed. The method can adapt to different humanoid robots, can measure various motion performances of the humanoid robot, can conveniently carry out motion capture, and is widely applied to various working scenes.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a capturing method and device for motion performance measurement of a humanoid robot. title: Humanoid robot thigh, humanoid robot and manufacturing method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot thigh, a humanoid robot and a manufacturing method of the humanoid robot thigh, the thigh is of an integrally-formed structure, all assemblies of the thigh are integrally formed through a selective laser melting process, and no mechanical connecting joint exists; the thigh comprises a skeleton, skin and a first equal-density dot matrix filled between the skeleton and the skin, the skeleton is of a structure of'local shell thickening + second equal-density dot matrix ', the skin is an equal-thickness thin shell, the skeleton and the skin are compounded into a whole, and the first equal-density dot matrix is added between the skeleton and the skin. Wherein the framework comprises a shell, a first reinforcing plate, a second reinforcing plate and a second equal-density dot matrix filled in the internal space of the framework. title: Method for realizing NAO robot health management by using KINECT
abstract: The invention discloses a method for realizing health management of an NAO robot by using KINECT, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and comprises the following steps: establishing a new coordinate system taking the NAO robot as the center by using a KINECT skeleton tracking technology, and obtaining three-dimensional space coordinate information of human body joint points; the obtained three-dimensional space coordinate information is subjected to mathematical operation, and the moving angle value of a rotating shaft of the NAO robot is obtained; transmitting the movement angle value to a rotating shaft corresponding to the NAO robot to form a movement action, and recording the movement action in a memory bank of the NAO robot to obtain a movement action bank; and matching corresponding motion actions in the motion action library according to the input human body indexes, and carrying out motion action demonstration. The problems that in the prior art, when health management is carried out through an NAO robot, movement actions are not accurately recognized, and movement teaching training is difficult to carry out are solved, standard action learning of the robot is achieved, the most appropriate fitness scheme and movement intervention are matched for a user, and effective health management is achieved.

title: Humanoid clamping type mobile operation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid clamping type mobile operation robot, and relates to the technical field of transfer robots. Comprising an autonomous moving chassis; the lifting module comprises a set of stand columns vertically arranged on the autonomous moving chassis and a lifting mechanism installed on the stand columns. The storage module is arranged above the autonomous moving chassis and located on the rear side of the lifting module, and the storage module comprises a plurality of vertically stacked temporary storage positions; and the automatic taking and placing module is installed on the lifting module, and the automatic taking and placing module comprises a rotating mechanism fixedly connected with the lifting mechanism and a clamping mechanism installed below the rotating mechanism. title: Multi-joint robot with embedded visual device
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-joint robot with an embedded visual device, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a crawler-type driving chassis, a base is fixedly mounted at the top of the crawler-type driving chassis, a robot body is arranged above the base, and a rotating structure is arranged between the robot body and the base. An embedded visual assembly is installed on one side of the robot body, and a multifunctional operation screen is installed on one side of the robot body and located below the embedded visual assembly. Through cooperative use of the first joint arm, the second joint arm, the operation end assembly, the first joint structure, the second joint structure and the rotating structure, the use flexibility of the operation end assembly can be improved, the operation end assembly can simulate human body movement according to human body kinematics, a joint design control mode with multiple degrees of freedom is adopted, and the flexibility is improved. title: Biped robot mass distribution method and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot mass distribution method. The biped robot mass distribution method comprises the steps that lower limb mass parameters are obtained; obtaining a first vector of the lower limb mass center relative to the waist center according to the lower limb mass parameters; determining a second vector of the upper limb centroid relative to the waist center according to the first vector of the lower limb centroid relative to the waist center; if the second vector meets the preset condition, obtaining upper limb longitudinal coordinates of the upper limb mass center relative to the waist center; the upper limbs are movably arranged relative to the waist center based on upper limb longitudinal coordinates of the upper limb mass centers relative to the waist center. By adopting the biped robot mass distribution method, the matching degree of the upper limbs and the lower limbs of the biped robot can be improved, and the balance control difficulty of the robot in the movement process is reduced. The invention further discloses the biped robot.

title: Moving target tracking and obstacle avoidance method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a moving target tracking and obstacle avoidance method for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, a moving target is identified through a visual sensor, the position of the moving target in space is obtained, and the robot is controlled to track the moving target according to a calculation result of a control algorithm; when a moving target is tracked, the distance between the robot and a surrounding object is sensed through an ultrasonic sensor, an obstacle avoidance algorithm is designed according to the position of the ultrasonic sensor and received data information, and the humanoid robot is controlled to perform an obstacle avoidance action according to a calculation result of the obstacle avoidance algorithm. The problem that in the prior art, a humanoid robot cannot accurately track the moving object in the environment and avoid the obstacle is solved, the NAO robot development platform is utilized, the visual sensor and the ultrasonic sensor are combined, accurate tracking of the humanoid robot on the moving object in the environment is achieved, and accurate obstacle avoidance is conducted in the tracking process.

title: Method, device and equipment for driving digital human body movement based on video
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a method, device and equipment for driving digital human body actions based on videos. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring video stream data, and decomposing the video stream data frame by frame into data of a plurality of pictures arranged according to a preset sequence; sequentially inputting the data of the plurality of pictures into a preset model according to the preset sequence, and sequentially generating three-dimensional attitude coordinates corresponding to the data of each picture; obtaining standard skeleton coordinates of the picture data based on the three-dimensional attitude coordinates of the picture data; obtaining a rotation quaternion of each joint of the digital human corresponding to each piece of picture data based on the standard skeleton coordinates of each piece of picture data; and according to the rotation quaternion and the preset sequence, driving the limb movement of the digital human. The problems that in a traditional limb movement capturing technology, professional equipment is many, cost is high, and skeleton capturing is not accurate are solved.

title: Bionic forearm exoskeleton assisting mechanism based on tensegrity structure
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic forearm exoskeleton assisting mechanism based on a tensegrity structure. title: Humanoid robot upper limb pitch motion control structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot upper limb pitch motion control structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises an upper limb big arm and an upper limb small arm, the upper limb big arm is arranged at one end part of the upper limb small arm, a force generating motor is arranged in the upper limb big arm, and a driving bevel gear is arranged on an output shaft of the force generating motor. The driving bevel gear can be driven to rotate through the force exerting motor, the transmission shaft and the transmission gear can be driven to rotate under transmission of the transmission bevel gear, throwing motion control over the upper limb and the forearm can be achieved under meshing of the transmission gear and the forearm transmission gear, the transmission direction is ingeniously changed through the bevel gear, and the throwing effect is achieved. The overall dimension of a transmission joint part is greatly reduced, the appearance is more attractive, and multi-stage gear transmission is adopted, so that the transmission torque can be greatly improved; and motor shafts of the force applying motor and the small arm rotating motor are arranged to be of hollow structures, so that hidden layout of connecting lines can be facilitated, and great convenience is achieved.

title: Lower limb assembly of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a lower limb assembly of a biped robot. The lower limb assembly at least comprises a hip joint, a knee joint, an ankle joint and a plurality of actuators; the first actuator is arranged at a preset position of the hip joint and used for driving the hip joint to move in series; the second actuator is arranged on the opposite side of the preset position of the hip joint and used for driving the knee joint to move in series; the third actuator is arranged between the knee joint and the ankle joint and used for driving the ankle joint to move in parallel; when the lower limb assembly is in a standing state, the longitudinal coordinates of the first actuator and the second actuator are higher than the longitudinal coordinates of the third actuator. The mass center of the lower limb assembly can be increased, and the control difficulty of the lower limb assembly is reduced.

title: Wheeled biped robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel type biped robot and a control method thereof, belongs to the technical field of biped wheel-leg robots, and solves the technical problems that in the prior art, the biped wheel-leg robot is short in continuous working time, single in function, low in moving efficiency and incapable of adapting to complex environments. The robot comprises a trunk part, a walking part and a working part, wherein the walking part and the working part are connected with the trunk part; the trunk part comprises a pair of middle plates, and a plurality of supporting rods are arranged between the middle plates; a battery assembly, a driver assembly, an encoder assembly and a main control assembly are arranged between the pair of middle plates. title: Double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes folding robot
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm humanoid intelligent clothes folding robot which comprises an integrated control unit, a visual identification unit, a task planning unit, a double-mechanical-arm control unit, a mobile platform control unit, a man-machine interaction unit and a power supply unit. The problem to be solved by the invention is that a robot identifies surrounding scenes by using an RGBD camera, generates names and corresponding coordinates of surrounding objects, performs visual classification on clothes in any shape, and calls a flattening algorithm to flatten the clothes by using a left mechanical arm and a right mechanical arm according to a classification result. After flattening, a folding algorithm is called, the clothes are folded through the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm, the clothes are placed in a designated area after being folded, the robot can automatically navigate to avoid obstacles in real time according to tasks in the running process, and when a battery is lower than a threshold value, the robot can autonomously find ways to be charged.

abstract: To provide a humanoid robot hand device that can grip an object in an attitude which has never been seen, by setting operation in a region exceeding a motion range of a human hand, and a robot hand operating method.SOLUTION: The humanoid robot hand device comprises: a joint mechanism 50 which has a plurality of fingers (a-e) rotatably connected through finger rotating shafts (m1, m2 and m3), where the plurality of fingers (a-e) constitute finger parts (1-5) and the finger parts (1-5) are rotatably connected through rotary support shafts (n1, n2 and n3) to a hand main body part 6; bending/driving means 51 that volar-flexes the fingers (a-e) of the joint mechanism 50 to a flat side or dorsiflexes the fingers to an arc-side, from a reference position O; and rotation range adjusting means 52, provided in rotation places of the fingers (a-e), which adjusts respective rotation ranges of the fingers (a-e) by the bending/driving means 51.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Self-selectivity and high-sensitivity humanoid mechanical receptor and construction method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a self-selectivity and high-sensitivity humanoid mechanical receptor and a construction method thereof, and relates to the technical field of bionic sensing. The structure of the humanoid mechanical receptor comprises a thin film layer, an upper island-shaped microstructure electrode, a hierarchical pore fiber spacing layer, a lower island-shaped microstructure electrode and a packaging layer from top to bottom, the edges of the upper-layer island-shaped microstructure electrode and the lower-layer island-shaped microstructure electrode are connected with conductive wires; and the island-shaped microstructures of the upper island-shaped microstructure electrode and the lower island-shaped microstructure electrode are oppositely arranged. The humanoid mechanical receptor disclosed by the invention shows continuous response to constant static stimulation, only responds at the moment of applying and releasing dynamic stimulation, and has extremely high sensitivity. The humanoid mechanical receptor is simple in preparation process, low in cost and suitable for large-scale preparation, provides a new direction for detection of complex stimulation, and has good application prospects in the fields of humanoid robots, artificial limbs and the like.

title: ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT HAND PROCESSING SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed is an anthropomorphic robot hand processing system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the anthropomorphic robot hand processing system comprises: a first learning processing device estimating an anthropomorphic robot hand pose based on a plurality of gripper-type robot hand poses for gripping an object, and extracting hand joint coordinates matching the palm center location of each of the plurality of gripper-type robot hand poses for gripping an object from a pre-built contact pose database, and generating an anthropomorphic robot hand pose; and a second learning processing device performing gripping and moving actions for a specific object by using the anthropomorphic robot hand based on the anthropomorphic robot hand pose acquired through the first learning processing device as well as the inputted object location information, and comparing the action results with the anthropomorphic robot hand pose, and performing the reinforced learning processing for the anthropomorphic robot hand pose applying a compensation value. Therefore, objects of various locations and shapes can be gripped.

abstract: The utility model provides a five-finger humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a palm as well as an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger which are connected to the palm and extend along a Z axis, and is characterized in that the thumb is provided with three actuators and four joint degrees of freedom and realizes grabbing based on a coupling structure; the index finger and the middle finger adopt the same structure and are respectively provided with three actuators and four joint degrees of freedom, and the middle knuckles of the index finger and the middle finger can actively bend and stretch; the ring finger and the little finger are of the same structure, each of the ring finger and the little finger is provided with two actuators and four joint freedom degrees, and the shape and the size of a grabbed object can be self-adapted. title: Lower limb exoskeleton driving method based on anthropomorphic nerve model
abstract: The invention provides a lower limb exoskeleton driving method based on a personalized anthropomorphic neural model, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: 1, constructing an anthropomorphic neural feedback model corresponding to a user according to personalized parameters of the user; 2, measuring muscle biomechanical characteristics through a sensor, and calculating muscle contraction speed and muscle force; 3, the muscle contraction speed is used as input, and the parameters of the step speed-like-as-a-step, the stride mu and the stride frequency omega of the anthropomorphic neural feedback model are optimized through the neural network model; step 4, calculating a gait recognition result, and outputting an optimized gait recognition result through a long and short term memory weight optimization method; 5, identifying corresponding events according to gait event scores, and predicting gait events to be reached; 6, the maximum torque compensation value is calculated, and the motor outputs assisting power; and step 7, after each time of assistance is completed, comparing the newly calculated corresponding muscle force with the muscle force of the normal human body gait event, and outputting an assistance effect.

title: Method and system for generating grabbing posture of dexterous hand guided by limited grabable area
abstract: The invention provides a dexterous hand grabbing attitude generation method and system guided by a limited grabbable area, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining the position attitude and shape information of a target object, converting the position attitude and shape information into object point clouds in a unified manner, calculating the normal vector corresponding to each point cloud, and setting the grabbable area of the target object; s2, inputting the object point cloud and the feature information of the object point cloud into an AI model grabbing attitude generation module to generate a grabbing attitude; s3, the generated grabbing posture is input into a fine adjustment improvement and scoring module, and a target grabbing posture is screened out; and S4, screening a grabbing posture based on the task and the intention, and carrying out post-processing optimization. According to the method, a given target object shape posture is mainly utilized to generate a humanoid dexterous hand grabbing posture which meets subsequent task requirements and conforms to human operation behavior habits, and batch candidate postures can be generated for AI auxiliary animation editing.

title: Slow start bleeder circuit for biped robot power supply
abstract: The invention discloses a slow start bleeder circuit for a biped robot power supply. The slow start bleeder circuit comprises a power circuit, a power supply circuit, a time delay circuit, a relay circuit and a bleeder circuit, aiming at the use scene of a biped robot power supply, a capacitor slow start framework is adopted, the slow start function is better achieved, and meanwhile low-power-consumption slow start is achieved through a low-power-consumption relay circuit and relay topology control. The invention also designs a stable and reliable time delay circuit to freely adjust the slow start time and a practical discharge circuit to realize charge discharge of the capacitor, thereby improving the safety and reliability degree of robot work. In addition, an MCU and a controller do not need to be used, delay is extremely low, the board distribution area is reduced, programming work is removed, and cost is greatly reduced.

title: Humanoid robot arm

title: Method for describing whole body posture of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a method for describing the whole body posture of a humanoid robot. According to the method, aiming at the problem that the whole body posture of the humanoid robot with large-inertia four limbs is difficult to accurately describe by a trunk posture, a set formed by mass centers of all rigid bodies of the robot is regarded as point cloud, the mass of each rigid body is regarded as a weight, and rotation of a mass part of the robot is calculated through a point cloud rotation algorithm; then according to the relation between the inertia tensor and the rotational inertia, rotation of the inertia tensor part of the robot is calculated through a Riemannian gradient descent algorithm; and finally, an angular displacement algorithm is provided based on point cloud rotation and rotation matrix averaging, and decoupling of mass part rotation and inertia tensor part rotation of the humanoid robot is achieved. By means of the method, high-dynamic movement such as jumping, running and backward somersault can be achieved on the real humanoid robot.

title: Robot waist
abstract: The invention relates to a robot waist which is generally applied to a biped robot and comprises a first supporting part, a second supporting part, a rotary joint motor, a first leg support and a second leg support. The power output end of the rotary joint motor extends to the containing space and controls the first supporting part or the second supporting part to rotate. The first leg support is connected with the first supporting part, and the second leg support is connected with the second supporting part.

title: Humanoid three-dimensional scanning motion control method and device based on point cloud
abstract: The invention provides a point cloud-based humanoid three-dimensional scanning motion control method and device. The point cloud-based humanoid three-dimensional scanning motion control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a camera viewpoint track and a mechanical arm end effector track of a to-be-detected object; obtaining a trajectory curved surface and a deformation energy function of the trajectory curved surface based on the camera viewpoint trajectory and the manipulator end effector trajectory; optimizing the trajectory curved surface based on the deformation energy function and the distance deviation function to obtain a motion planning trajectory curve of the to-be-detected object; and the motion planning track curve of the to-be-detected object is input into the multi-target motion control model to be solved, and a mechanical arm motion control optimal solution corresponding to the motion planning track is obtained. According to the method, continuous scanning of multiple components or structures is achieved, the scanning efficiency and accuracy are improved, the complex industrial environment and actual task requirements can be met, the method is more suitable for a multi-component discrete manufacturing scene, and wide industrial application prospects and objective economic benefits are achieved.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD TO EMULATE HUMAN COGNITION IN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE USING BIO-INSPIRED PHYSIOLOGY SIMULATION
abstract: An AI enabled human emulation system, a method, and a computer program product may be provided for embodied cognition with humanoid robot hardware (robot) to emulate human behavior. The system may include a memory configured to store computer program code and a processor configured to execute the computer program code to employ common sense reasoning, in much the same holistic way that humans do. The processor may be configured to obtain a trained AI model and sensor data from a surrounding environment of the robot. The AI model is trained using a brain emulation system and a human body physiology simulation system. The processor may be further configured to generate novel emergent pattern data to self-regulate the robot. The processor may also be configured to control the robot that interacts with a user by expressing a behavior to the user.

title: Joint with progressive deflection resistance and vibration damping
abstract: The subject of the application is a joint with progressive deflection resistance and vibration damping applicable in robotics, especially in humanoid robots, in manipulators and industrial robots, including assembly robots. The application is characterized in that it has a lower joint member (1) and an upper joint member (2), connected to each other via an elastic outer bellows (3) and an elastic inner bellows (4). The lower joint member (1) has a cylindrical seat (22) formed inside, in which a permanent magnet (10) is seated, which is pressed against the seat (22) via a plate (5) with an external thread screwed into the threaded seat (22). The outer bellows (3) is permanently connected to the inner bellows (4) via an upper spring clamp (12) seated in a circumferential groove (24) of the outer bellows by clamping the ends of the elastic outer bellows (3) and the elastic inner bellows (4) onto the surface of a cylindrical sleeve (13). The upper joint member (2) is screwed into a threaded hole of a thrust sleeve (8) and is fixed in a fitted hole (36) in the thrust sleeve (8), and an attachment piece (6) is screwed into the lower part of the upper joint member (2), which presses against the thrust sleeve (8) with a flat end face via a thrust ring (7); furthermore, the lower part of the outer bellows (3) forms a hermetic chamber.

title: Multipoint joint
abstract: The subject of the application is a multi-point joint for joints for multi-legged walking robots, humanoid robots, and the construction of kinematic nodes cooperating with exoskeleton elements. The multi-point joint is characterized in that the upper member (1) at the lower end is provided with a flexible shell (6), on the outer surface of which there are seats (15) for embedding balls (7) formed by elastic protrusions and recesses. The seats (15) are arranged along the circumference forming bands along the parallels of the flexible shell (6), and in each of the bands there is a specific number of seats (15) distributed evenly around the circumference. The bands in the axial sections of the joint passing through the centers of the seats (15) for embedding balls (7) are arranged within the range of angles ϕ<sub>g</sub> and ϕ<sub>d</sub>, wherein the angle ϕ<sub>g</sub> < ϕ<sub>d</sub>. The chamber of the flexible shell (6) is filled with a fluid (14) of increased viscosity. The balls (7) embedded in the recesses of the seats (15) of the shell (6) adjoin the inner surface of the dome shell (10) of the lower member (2) of the joint, after filling the flexible chamber with fluid and deforming it until the balls (7) come into contact with the inner surface of the spherical dome (10). Furthermore, a valve (13) for filling with fluid (14) and venting the chamber is placed in the upper part of the shell (6), and on the cylindrical outer surface of the spherical dome (10) a flexible protective bellows (4) is mounted, clamped with a lower spring band (19), and the upper part of the bellows (4) is mounted on the cylindrical outer surface of the sleeve (3) and clamped with an upper spring band (20).

title: Humanoid robot hip leg roll motion control structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot hip and leg roll motion control structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises a hip and leg joint seat, a spherical movable sleeve is arranged on the hip and leg joint seat, a rotating motor is arranged in the spherical movable sleeve, arc-shaped adjusting teeth are integrally formed on the outer wall of the spherical movable sleeve, and the arc-shaped adjusting teeth are arranged on the outer wall of the spherical movable sleeve. title: Roll direction motion structure for legs and feet of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot leg-foot roll direction motion structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises a knee joint seat, the bottom end of the knee joint seat is fixedly connected with a shank supporting block, the bottom end of the shank supporting block is fixedly connected with a robot shank, and the periphery of the bottom end of the robot shank is provided with a foot rotating seat. And a foot rotating shaft is mounted between the foot rotating seat and the robot shank. Through the arrangement of the foot rotating seat, the front rotating support and the rear rotating support, it can be ensured that the sole plate has the rotating freedom degree in the other direction while rotating, multi-freedom-degree control over the sole plate is facilitated, and stability of the robot is better facilitated; under the action of the limiting plate, elastic supporting force can be provided for the limiting plate through the torsional spring, so that the toe plate is tightly attached to the bottom face, meanwhile, the toe plate can rotate along the end of the foot sole plate, the action of toes of the human body can be simulated, and movement of the robot is more stable.

title: Single-foot balance training system of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a single-foot balance training system of a biped robot, which can train the balance of the biped robot and perform multiple trainings on the balance of a single foot, and has multiple functions and good practicability. Comprising a seat ring and a rotating table, the robot further comprises a safety frame, an annular frame, monitors, a safety sling, a supporting mechanism and an interference mechanism, the safety frame is installed on the rotating table, the annular frame is installed on a stand column of the safety frame, the monitors are installed on the annular frame, the safety sling is installed on a cross beam of the safety frame, the lower end of the safety sling is connected with the robot body, and the supporting mechanism is installed on the rotating table. The supporting mechanism supports the two feet or one foot of the biped robot, the supporting mechanism has the functions of simulating walking movement, height lifting and multi-direction inclination, the interference mechanism is installed on the seat ring, the interference mechanism actively interferes with the biped robot in training, and the anti-interference balance capacity of the biped robot is trained.

title: Design method for visual sensing system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a design method of a humanoid robot vision sensing system. The humanoid robot vision sensing system is composed of a calculation unit NVIDIA Jetson oriin, a sensing unit, a laser radar Livox Avia, a Lucid Helios 2ToF camera and a supporting plate made of a resin material, wherein the sensing unit is composed of a depth camera Intel real D455, a binocular camera StereoLabs ZED2i, the laser radar Livox Avia, the Lucid Helios 2ToF camera and the supporting plate made of the resin material. The sensing system aims to simulate the vision of human beings so as to complete required tasks such as map construction and target detection. In the moving process of the robot, D455 and Avia at the upper end of the system are jointly calibrated to complete mapping and positioning functions of the robot, StereoLabs ZED2i at the middle end of the system completes indoor and outdoor environment recognition, and a Lucid Helios 2ToF camera at the lower end of the support completes a target detection function. And a computing unit NVIDIA Jetson oriin at the tail part of the system provides computing power support for the system. The experimental device can effectively solve the problems of looseness and difficult fusion test of the humanoid robot in the motion process in the actual environment.

title: Humanoid robot falling and climbing control method based on force-position hybrid control
abstract: The invention discloses a force-position hybrid control-based fall-to-ground climbing control method for a humanoid robot. The robot is initially in a prone position and starts to move after receiving a climbing action instruction, the angle of each joint reaches the corresponding angle obtained through inverse kinematics calculation, then moment is applied to each joint of the upper body, and then the upper body is made to be separated from the ground; when foot bottom force enters the friction cone, the lower body is switched from a position control state to a force control state; after the state is switched to force control, PD control is carried out on ankles and linear secondary adjustment is carried out on the difference between plantar forces of the two feet until the pitch angle, the roll angle and the yaw angle of the upper body are all 0, and the squatting and standing state of the humanoid robot is achieved; and then the squatting and standing state is converted into the final standing state, virtual constraint is applied in the process, standing is completed through position control, and finally the humanoid robot can stand stably. A simplified model is adopted, the standing process is greatly simplified, a transition posture is designed, and the standing action of the robot is well achieved.

title: Joint control device for humanoid robot
abstract: The joint control device for the humanoid robot is applied to the technical field of robot joint assemblies, a support hinge is fixedly connected to the interior of the bottom end of a joint arm, a joint shaft is rotationally connected to the middle of the support hinge, and the two ends of the top of a rotating assembly part are fixedly connected with the two ends of the joint shaft correspondingly; a rotating disc is fixedly connected to the outer portion of one end of the joint shaft, the rotating disc rotates according to the rotating condition of the joint and is detected in real time through a rotary encoder, and the input voltage of the front clamping piece electromagnetic abutting block and the input voltage of the rear clamping piece electromagnetic abutting block are controlled to be gradually increased with the angle needing to rotate of the joint as a signal. By increasing the repulsive force between the front clamping piece electromagnetic abutting block and the rear clamping piece electromagnetic abutting block, the front friction clamping piece and the rear friction clamping piece gradually clamp the rotating disc, finally the rotating disc is clamped and locked, the joint rotating state is fixed, the precision of the joint rotating angle is effectively improved, rotation control over the joint is facilitated, and the joint rotating speed is increased. And the control process is smoother.

title: Humanoid robot upper limb yaw direction control structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot upper limb yaw direction control structure in the field of humanoid robots, which comprises a supporting back plate, a middle supporting plate is arranged below the supporting back plate, peripheral supporting rods are arranged on two sides of the upper part of the middle supporting plate and two end parts of the supporting back plate; a shoulder supporting shell is arranged on one side wall of the supporting back plate. title: Modularized humanoid dexterous hand driven by connecting rod

title: Humanoid robot foot mechanism with vibration reduction and profiling functions
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot foot mechanism with damping and profiling functions, which comprises a front foot bottom plate and a rear foot bottom plate which are hinged through a connecting shaft, a toe plate is arranged at the front end of the front foot bottom plate, a middle plate is arranged at the upper ends of the front foot bottom plate and the rear foot bottom plate, and the middle plate is connected with the front foot bottom plate and the rear foot bottom plate through eight springs. Six tension and pressure sensors are fixedly placed on the middle plate, an upper foot plate is fixed to the tension and pressure sensors, and the upper foot plate is connected with an ankle joint of the humanoid robot through a connecting flange. According to the foot mechanism, the foot sole contact area of the humanoid robot on the uneven ground can be increased, so that the walking stability of the humanoid robot is improved, and the function of reducing vibration and impact is achieved.

title: Lower limb knee joint power-assisted exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb knee joint assisting exoskeleton robot which comprises a waist supporting box, an energy mechanism, a control mechanism, a left leg structure and a right leg structure. The control mechanism controls the leg structures connected to the left side and the right side, and the energy mechanism is used for supplying power to all components needing electricity. Through organic combination of the jaw clutch and the cylindrical cam in the knee joint clutch, the motion trail of the exoskeleton robot better conforms to gait motion of a human body, and a user feels more comfortable. Meanwhile, the stepping motors used in the knee joint clutches are low in power, and only one stepping motor is needed for the leg structure on each side, so that more electric quantity is saved, and the cruising ability of batteries with the same capacity is doubled.

title: Behavior decision-making method and device for double mechanical arms and storage device
abstract: The invention provides a behavior decision-making method and device for double mechanical arms and a storage device.The method comprises the steps that a double-arm mechanical model is constructed according to human arm characteristics, the human-simulated track mapping process of the mechanical arms is determined according to the double-arm mechanical model, and distribution decision-making data of human double arms are obtained; and according to the distribution decision data and the anthropomorphic trajectory mapping process, an anthropomorphic decision result of the mechanical arm is determined. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a double-mechanical-arm model according to human arm characteristics; by classifying the operation selection results of the human arm and optimizing the existing greedy algorithm, the humanoid decision result of the mechanical arm with a stronger humanoid effect is determined, and the problem that the conventional decision algorithm generally optimizes the process of issuing a single instruction; and it is difficult to effectively optimize the whole process to cope with a complex and changeable behavior environment.

title: Biped robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising leg structures; the driving structures are arranged on the left side and the right side of the leg structure; the total mass of the driving structures on the left side of the leg structure is not smaller than 60% of the total mass of the driving structures on the right side of the leg structure and not larger than 140% of the total mass of the driving structures on the right side of the leg structure. title: Biped robot, humanoid robot, motion control method and system of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot, a humanoid robot, a motion control method and system of the humanoid robot and a medium, and the motion control method comprises the steps that according to a motion instruction of the biped robot, the joint torque value of a joint module when the biped robot completes motion indicated by the motion instruction is calculated; determining an input current value of a motor in the joint module according to the joint torque value and a current-torque mapping relation; and according to the input current value, the input current of a motor in the joint module is controlled, and then the output torque of a planetary reducer in the joint module is controlled, so that the biped robot completes the motion indicated by the motion instruction. According to the motion control method provided by the invention, the impact resistance of the joint module is improved, and the accurate output of the joint torque is controlled through the input current of the motor, so that a reliable hardware foundation and an accurate torque control scheme are provided for the biped robot, and the high-dynamic motion requirement of the biped robot is met.

title: Q- Method for controlling adaptive admittance based on fuzzy Q-learning apparatus and computer program for performing the method
abstract: In accordance with an advisable embodiment of the present invention, a method for controlling variable admittance based on fuzzy Q-learning, an apparatus and a computer program for performing the same, are provided to adaptively control admittance based on fuzzy Q-learning to guarantee a sensitive and safe collaboration for a wearable robot condition in which a human and a robot are always in contact, thereby enabling sensitive and safe collaboration control, responding to a dynamic change of a robot according to a load weight, optimizing an admittance parameter in accordance with different body characteristics by user, and also, assuring a time for the recognition of a human-robot collaboration state through a low operation quantity, having a high frequency resolution.

title: Humanoid redundant cooperative arm based on closed-loop rope driven parallel wrist and with inverse analytic solution
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid redundant cooperative arm based on closed-loop rope driven parallel wrists and with an inverse analytic solution, belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid mechanical arm. The robot specifically comprises a shoulder joint, a big arm, an elbow joint, a small arm, a wrist joint, a gripper, four pairs of driving ropes and a Bowden cable, the gripper and the elbow joint are each of a single-degree-of-freedom structure, and the wrist joint and the shoulder joint are each of a three-degree-of-freedom structure; the shoulder joint is driven by three robot joint modules, five motors are installed in the big arm, one ends of the four pairs of driving ropes are connected to output shafts of the four motors respectively, the other ends of the four pairs of driving ropes are connected with the wrist joint and the elbow joint to form closed-loop rope driving, one end of the Bowden cable is connected to an output shaft of one motor, and the other end of the Bowden cable is connected with the gripper. The device is multiple in degree of freedom, good in flexibility and low in manufacturing cost; the inverse kinematics of the cooperative arm has an analytic solution, complete passive decoupling is achieved through rope driving, and a mathematical model is simple and convenient to control; due to the special design of the wrist joint, a cable of the end effector can penetrate through the center of the wrist joint, and the attractiveness and safety of the mechanical arm are improved.

title: Power generation device for lower thigh area of running walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power generation device for a thigh lower area of a running and walking robot, and relates to various reciprocating motion rotating devices in the electromechanical field. A reciprocating motion rotating device is installed to drive a generator to achieve self-power-generation and self-charging of the lower thigh area power generation technology. According to the main technical scheme, one end of a connecting rod is sealed, a piston is installed at the other end of the connecting rod, a spring is installed in front of a closed leg pipe, and one-way air inlet, air outlet and liquid valves are installed outside the pipe and connected in a combined mode to be connected into an inlet and an outlet of a steam pump and a hydraulic pump to form closing. During walking, pressure generated by self-weight and tension of the springs and the shanks form reciprocating motion, gas and liquid enter the gas, and the hydraulic pump drives the gas and the liquid to rotate and then circularly reciprocate to drive the foot rear area generator to generate electricity. The robot is mainly used for realizing self power generation and charging by utilizing the gravity of the robot in the running and walking processes and driving the power generator through the reciprocating motion rotating device.

title: Leg structure, biped robot, humanoid robot, and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot leg structure which is provided with two leg assemblies, each leg assembly comprises a leg, each leg comprises a thigh, a thigh joint, a shank, a shank joint, a foot, a leg rotating joint used for driving the corresponding leg to rotate and a leg swinging joint used for driving the corresponding leg assembly to swing, the swing leg assembly is provided with a swing leg rotating shaft, the leg assembly is divided into an upper mass part with an upper mass point and a lower mass part with a lower mass point with the horizontal plane where the swing leg rotating shaft is located as the boundary, and the upper mass part and the lower mass part synchronously and reversely swing with the swing leg rotating shaft as the axis. At least part of the upper mass part is located on the horizontal plane where the swing leg rotating shaft is located in the swing process. title: Procedural animation engine and editor for sample-based design of stylized walking gaits for bipedal robots
abstract: A robot design and control system including a procedural animation engine and a graphical animation editor that enable animators to author stylized walking gaits achievable by physical robotic characters, including bipedal robots of varying design. The animation engine generates dynamically feasible reference trajectories for omnidirectional walking given a desired walking velocity that may be input from a joystick or an artificial intelligence (AI) planner. This allows a legged robot to walk along an arbitrary path while expressing a custom animation “style,” e.g., a happy walk, a sneaky walk, or other manner of walking. The stylized walking motion or gait is generalized by the animation engine from a small number of animation samples that are defined at key walking velocities and tracked using a whole-body controller. The set of samples that are used as input to define a walking style is authored by an animator using the animation editor.

title: Wheel type walking humanoid material carrying robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel type walking humanoid material carrying robot which comprises seven parts including a wheel type walking mechanism, an upper body supporting mechanism, a head system, an arm mechanism, a gripper mechanism, a carrying platform and a control system, and the wheel type walking mechanism comprises tires, a servo motor, a walking frame, a vehicle body protection cover and the like. The robot moves in the space; wherein the upper body supporting mechanism (body), the head system, the arm mechanism and the gripper mechanism jointly form the upper half part of the wheel type walking humanoid robot, the upper half body function of a human body is simulated, and tasks such as environment observation, object recognition, material carrying and tool operation are carried out; wherein the carrying platform is an optional part of the robot, can be mounted and dismounted at any time and is used for enhancing the carrying capacity of the robot. The bionic mechanism simulating the function of the upper part of the human body is selected, the action flexibility of the robot is enhanced, the robot can replace human to operate tools and carry materials in a severe and long-time working environment, the wheel type walking mechanism which is high in bearing capacity and flexible and stable in movement is selected, the mechanism complexity is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved. title: Full-automatic business process method integrating software robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a full-automatic business process method integrating a software robot and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of software, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an input task demand instruction based on the software robot, and converting the task demand instruction into an execution instruction of humanoid robot operation; the software robot comprises a presentation layer, a business layer, a data layer and an application layer; the presentation layer provides an external interaction window and displays the running state of the humanoid robot; the service layer is connected with the presentation layer and used for responding to a service request sent by the presentation layer and distributing services to the downstream; the data layer is connected with the business layer and is used for accessing and storing data; the application layer is connected with the data layer and used for outputting an execution instruction to the humanoid robot; and the humanoid robot completes operation based on the execution instruction and feeds back the operation state to the software robot. The problem that a traditional robot is low in automation degree is solved through fusion of a software robot and a humanoid robot, and the automation degree of the operation process is effectively improved.

title: Humanoid mechanical artificial hand

The proximity sensor is arranged in the fingertip of the finger structure, the distance between the fingertip of the finger and the fingertip of the target object is detected, the artificial hand control panel can adjust the positions of the five fingers according to the distance information detected by the proximity sensor, it is guaranteed that the five fingers grab the target object at the same time, grabbing is firm, and the target object is prevented from falling off; and the synchronism of the fingers of the humanoid manipulator is improved.

title: Real-time remote sensing control method for walking double-arm robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time remote sensing control method for a walking double-arm robot, and particularly relates to the technical field of remote sensing control, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: presetting a mimicry walking path of the double-arm robot in a background server, video data in the walking process of the double-arm robot is collected through an image collecting device, and state information is transmitted to a background server provided with an action real-time control program through the Ethernet to be comprehensively processed; the collected video data is automatically matched with a mimicry walking path; the current state of the double-arm robot is corrected by using an automatic correction program; and the action which should be executed by the double-arm robot in the next step is calculated by using an action real-time control program, and the control information of the action is transmitted back to the double-arm robot through the Ethernet. Real-time accurate control over the double-arm robot in the walking process can be achieved, and therefore the walking stability of the robot is ensured.

title: Creative welcome robot
abstract: The invention relates to a greeting robot, in particular to a creative greeting robot. The creative welcome robot capable of simulating bowing of people to welcome and improving the welcome effect needs to be designed. According to the robot, the robot is moved to a welcome position through rollers, then a telescopic rod of a hydraulic push rod is started to extend, a positioning plate drives an anti-abrasion base to move downwards to make contact with the ground, then the robot is jacked up, a servo motor is started to rotate forwards and backwards alternately, and a human-shaped robot body starts to swing up and down to simulate bowing for welcome; bowing and greeting are conducted through up-down swinging of the humanoid machine body, and the greeting effect can be improved.

title: Intelligent human motion planning system based on conditional generative adversarial network
abstract: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and robots, in particular to a human body action intelligent planning system based on a conditional generative adversarial network.
