Through the system, the problems of huge teaching action cost, complicated track generation program, low action acquisition efficiency and the like in the existing humanoid action planning technical process can be solved, the diversity of robot action planning is greatly enriched, and an action generation model is provided for subsequent intelligent action planning in each field.

title: Wrist structure of humanoid robot

The hinge shafts on the two limiting plates are vertically arranged; and the pushing piece is used for driving the limiting plate and is mounted on the base. The problems that an existing wrist structure of the humanoid robot is low in rigidity and poor in structural stability are solved.

title: Hitting force-measuring humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of striking force measurement, in particular to a striking force-measuring humanoid robot, which realizes the design of the same horizontal line height of two upper cone frustum arms through stepped arrangement of cone frustum arm connecting pieces. In this way, the problem that two hands, located on the uppermost face of a column body, of an existing force measuring device are integrally designed in a high-low distribution mode and cannot simulate the design that the heights of two arms of a person are the same in the horizontal line is solved. Moreover, through the arrangement of the non-elastic hammer structure, multiple groups of spatial circumferential distribution are attached to the middle supporting column, shaking of the column body in any direction can be eliminated in time, and the problems that in the prior art, in the hitting process of an existing force measuring device, the column body shakes and deviates from the axis position, and the column body shakes and deviates from the axis position are solved. And the gravity component of the stress end of the sensor is changed to cause the error detection of the force measuring sensor.

title: Force feedback type controller of biped walking robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped walking robot force feedback type controller which comprises a chassis and two rocker mechanisms symmetrically arranged on the chassis, and each joint of a rocker is controlled and connected by an FOC motor and used for reading the position and controlling the output torque. According to the invention, the motor magnetic field guiding control technology is utilized to simultaneously know the motor position and control the torque output to reach the reading position and generate the force feedback effect; two sets of six-degree-of-freedom space information can be generated by reading the positions and the orientations of the two rocker handles through robot kinematics and are used for controlling other biped robots. Some algorithm requirements are avoided, and the robot is directly controlled to walk through human perception.

title: Planetary reducer and integrated joint
abstract: The invention provides a planetary reducer and an integrated joint. The planetary reducer comprises a first sun gear, a second sun gear, a first inner gear ring and a second inner gear ring. The first sun gear and the second sun gear are connected in parallel, the first inner gear ring is arranged on the peripheries of the first sun gear and the second sun gear, the first planet gear is connected between the first sun gear and the first inner gear ring in a meshed mode, and the second planet gear is connected between the second sun gear and the first inner gear ring in a meshed mode. Moreover, a third planet gear and a fourth planet gear are arranged on one side of the first planet gear, the third planet gear is synchronously and fixedly connected with the first planet gear, the fourth planet gear is synchronously and fixedly connected with the second planet gear, and the third planet gear and the fourth planet gear are both meshed with the second inner gear ring. The planetary reducer provided by the invention can solve the problem that a planetary reducer in an integrated driving joint of an existing humanoid robot has a transmission gap.

title: Quick wrist connecting structure of humanoid robot
abstract: According to the rapid wrist connecting structure of the humanoid robot, a socket disc is installed on a palm structure of the robot, a connecting plug is installed on an arm of the robot, and after the connecting plug is directly inserted into a first groove of the socket disc, the connecting plug is prevented from retreating from the first groove under locking of a locking assembly; and therefore, the palm connecting structure and the arm structure of the robot can be quickly connected. When the palm structure is quickly connected with the arm structure, the elastic damping ball of the connecting plug is in limiting fit with the limiting groove channel of the socket disc, so that the palm structure and the arm structure are accurately and quickly positioned. The problems that in the existing robot assembling process, when a palm structure and an arm structure are installed in a matched mode, positioning is difficult, and rapid installation and disassembly cannot be achieved are solved.

title: Humanoid multi-finger hand with adjustable form and joint rigidity
abstract: A humanoid multi-finger hand with adjustable form and joint rigidity belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a metacarpal bone part and a four-finger part which is connected with the metacarpal bone part and can adjust the mounting position, and the metacarpal bone part is slidably connected with a thumb part. Each finger structure of the four-finger part and the finger structure of the thumb part comprise a far-end knuckle, a middle knuckle and a near-end knuckle, the far-end knuckles, the middle knuckles and the near-end knuckles each comprise a knuckle support and a knuckle shell connected to the outer portion of the knuckle support in a sliding mode, and the knuckle supports are connected with elastic flexion and extension joint mechanisms in a sleeved mode. The knuckle supports of the far-end knuckles are hinged to the knuckle shells of the middle knuckles, the elastic flexion and extension joint mechanisms of the far-end knuckles are inserted into the knuckle shells of the middle knuckles, the knuckle supports of the middle knuckles are hinged to the knuckle shells of the near-end knuckles, and the elastic flexion and extension joint mechanisms of the middle knuckles are inserted into the knuckle shells of the near-end knuckles; the rigidity of all knuckles and the shape of the whole hand can be adjusted, modular design is adopted, and maintenance and installation are facilitated.

title: Intelligent biped humanoid robot based on Jetson nano
abstract: The intelligent humanoid robot comprises a head mechanism, a thoracic cavity mechanism, arm mechanisms and leg mechanisms, the head mechanism is rotationally connected to the thoracic cavity mechanism, the arm mechanisms are rotationally connected to the two sides of the thoracic cavity mechanism, the leg mechanisms are rotationally connected to the lower end of the thoracic cavity mechanism, the arm mechanisms are rotationally connected to the two sides of the thoracic cavity mechanism, and the leg mechanisms are rotationally connected to the lower end of the thoracic cavity mechanism. And the thigh cross-shaped keys are fixed on the crotch steering engines. title: Three-axis intersecting motor direct-driven multi-degree-of-freedom wrist joint mechanism and humanoid artificial limb
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of humanoid prostheses, and discloses a three-axis intersecting motor direct-driven multi-degree-of-freedom wrist joint mechanism and a humanoid prosthese.The wrist joint mechanism comprises a palm module, a wrist joint metacarpal flexion and extension module, a wrist joint radialis-ulnar deviation module and a wrist joint internal and external rotation module; the wrist joint radioulnar deviation module is connected with the wrist joint internal and external rotation module and the wrist joint metacarpal flexion and extension module, and one end, far away from the wrist joint radioulnar deviation module, of the wrist joint flexion and extension module is connected to the palm module; the wrist joint internal and external rotation module provides a wrist joint internal and external rotation freedom degree, and the wrist joint radioulnar-ulnar deviation module provides a wrist joint radioulnar-ulnar deviation freedom degree; the wrist joint metacarpal flexion and extension module provides a wrist joint metacarpal flexion and extension freedom degree; the rotation axis of the wrist joint internal and external rotation freedom degree, the rotation axis of the wrist joint radioulnar deflection freedom degree and the rotation axis of the wrist joint metacarpal flexion and extension freedom degree intersect at one point. According to the invention, active compliant control of three degrees of freedom of motion of the wrist joint is realized, and the motion of the wrist joint structure has extremely high humanoid property.

title: Work robot and work vehicle
abstract: The invention relates to an operation robot and an operation vehicle, the operation robot comprises a trunk part, the trunk part comprises a first trunk block, a second trunk block and a waist joint, and the first trunk block and the second trunk block are rotatably connected through the waist joint; the mechanical arm part is connected to the first trunk block; the head is provided with a sensing module, and the sensing module is used for detecting information in the operation process; the neck part is connected with the first trunk block and the head part, and the head part can move relative to the first trunk block through the neck part; the driving module is used for driving joints in the trunk part, the mechanical arm parts and the neck part to move; and the control module is connected with the sensing module and the driving module. The operation robot can execute various postures which can be achieved by various human bodies, automatic operation of the operation robot is facilitated, and the working efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Inverse kinematics solving method and device for ankle joint control of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method and device for ankle joint control of a biped robot, the biped robot is controlled through a parallel crank connecting rod and a joint motor, and a pitch angle and a roll angle required by ankle joint rotation of the biped robot can be obtained; determining coordinates of a lower spherical hinge point of the connecting rod in a shank coordinate system according to the pitch angle and the roll angle, and determining a relative position vector between the association point and the lower spherical hinge point of the connecting rod by taking the shank coordinate system as a reference coordinate system; then, according to the relative position vector, the length of the crank between the association point and the upper spherical hinge point of the connecting rod and the length of the connecting rod, the angle needed by rotation of the joint motor is determined; further determining the angular velocity required by the rotation of the joint motor according to the pitch angular velocity and the roll angular velocity required by the rotation of the ankle joint; and finally, the joint motor is controlled according to the angle and the angular speed. According to the method, the required rotating angle of the joint motor can be rapidly solved through the geometrical relationship, and then the motor is controlled.
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inverse kinematics solving method and device for ankle joint control of a biped robot, the biped robot is controlled through a parallel crank connecting rod and a joint motor, and a pitch angle and a roll angle required by ankle joint rotation of the biped robot can be obtained; determining coordinates of a lower spherical hinge point of the connecting rod in a shank coordinate system according to the pitch angle and the roll angle, and determining a relative position vector between the association point and the lower spherical hinge point of the connecting rod by taking the shank coordinate system as a reference coordinate system; then, according to the relative position vector, the length of the crank between the association point and the upper spherical hinge point of the connecting rod and the length of the connecting rod, the angle needed by rotation of the joint motor is determined; further determining the angular velocity required by the rotation of the joint motor according to the pitch angular velocity and the roll angular velocity required by the rotation of the ankle joint; and finally, the joint motor is controlled according to the angle and the angular speed. According to the method, the required rotating angle of the joint motor can be rapidly solved through the geometrical relationship, and then the motor is controlled.

title: Robot foot structure and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot foot structure and a robot. The robot foot structure comprises a bottom plate; the two side plates are oppositely arranged on the bottom plate in a spaced mode; the connecting assembly is arranged on the sides, back on to the bottom plate, of the side plates and is connected with the two side plates, and the bottom plate, the side plates and the connecting assembly form a foot frame structure with a cavity. According to the robot foot structure, by arranging the bottom plate, the side plates and the connecting assemblies, the foot frame structure with the cavity is formed, the humanoid foot structure is formed, a shaft type supporting structure with large weight is omitted, the overall weight of the robot foot structure is effectively reduced, and flexible walking of the foot structure is facilitated; and meanwhile, the stability and the impact load resistance of the foot structure are ensured. The robot foot structure is internally provided with the cavity, so that wiring of internal devices is facilitated, wiring harnesses are prevented from being exposed, and the attractiveness of the appearance is guaranteed.

title: Method and system for estimating mass center state of biped robot in real time
abstract: The invention relates to a method and system for estimating the mass center state of a biped robot in real time, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the stress information of the two feet of the biped robot and the IMU information of the biped robot through a six-dimensional torque sensor and an IMU, and obtaining the mass center state of the biped robot according to the stress information and the IMU information; calculating to obtain COP point information and centroid information of the biped robot under different supporting legs; according to the IMU information, the position and speed of the mass center under the COP points corresponding to different supporting legs are obtained through calculation, and according to the optimal estimated value of the mass center state obtained through previous prediction, the current position and speed of the mass center are predicted through a linear inverted pendulum model, and prediction data are obtained; through Kalman filtering, the calculated positions and speeds of the center of mass at the corresponding COP points of different supporting legs are fused with prediction data, the optimal estimation value of the current center of mass state is obtained, and through the method, accurate center of mass state information can be obtained to be used for controlling the biped robot.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and system for estimating the mass center state of a biped robot in real time, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the stress information of the two feet of the biped robot and the IMU information of the biped robot through a six-dimensional torque sensor and an IMU, and obtaining the mass center state of the biped robot according to the stress information and the IMU information; calculating to obtain COP point information and centroid information of the biped robot under different supporting legs; according to the IMU information, the position and speed of the mass center under the COP points corresponding to different supporting legs are obtained through calculation, and according to the optimal estimated value of the mass center state obtained through previous prediction, the current position and speed of the mass center are predicted through a linear inverted pendulum model, and prediction data are obtained; through Kalman filtering, the calculated positions and speeds of the center of mass at the corresponding COP points of different supporting legs are fused with prediction data, the optimal estimation value of the current center of mass state is obtained, and through the method, accurate center of mass state information can be obtained to be used for controlling the biped robot.

title: Lift-assisted exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lifting assisting exoskeleton robot which comprises a back frame module, a first arm module and a second arm module. The first arm module comprises a first mounting seat, a shoulder motor, a first rotating part, a large arm part, an elbow motor, a second rotating part and a small arm part, and is used for completing lifting assistance of a right arm; the second arm module comprises a second arm motor, a driving rod, a second mounting seat and a second arm rod and is used for completing pressing assistance of the left arm; the long rod is lifted through cooperation of downward pressing and lifting, the possibility of single-person operation is achieved, and operation convenience and safety are improved.

title: Terrain adaptive identification method based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-terrain adaptive identification method based on multi-sensor fusion. The method comprises the following steps of: constructing a set of multi-sensor human body posture recognition system based on multiple IMU module nodes, and designing a terrain switching rapid recognition algorithm according to the multi-sensor human body posture recognition system. By arranging the wireless IMU modules at all positions of the body, various data such as the posture angle, the angular velocity and the angular acceleration of each limb of the human body at present can be obtained in real time. And based on the data, judging the moment that the foot bottom touches the ground in the walking process, modeling the posture of the lower limbs of the human body at the moment that the foot bottom touches the ground, and finally judging the current terrain according to the posture of the lower limbs of the human body. According to the method, the current terrain can be judged at the moment of touching the ground in real time.

title: Humanoid waist structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an anthropomorphic waist structure of a humanoid robot in the field of robots, which comprises a robot waist support component, a hip leg base I and a hip leg base II are arranged below the robot waist support component, the hip leg base I is close to the hip leg base II, and the hip leg base II is close to the hip leg base II. A movable supporting seat is installed on one side wall of the first hip-leg base. title: Roll direction control structure for upper limbs of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot upper limb roll direction control structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises a robot big arm, one end part of the robot big arm is fixedly connected with a rotary support seat, one side wall of the rotary support seat is provided with a forearm rotating motor, and the forearm rotating motor is fixedly connected with the forearm rotating motor. And a throwing power motor is connected to the interior of the robot big arm through a screw. The small arm rotating motor is arranged on one side of the throwing power motor, the power gear is driven to rotate through the small arm rotating motor, then the rotating execution gear can be driven to rotate under transmission of the transmission gear, the transmission inner sleeve, the limiting supporting ring and the throwing transmission mechanism can be driven to rotate, and then the small arm can be controlled to rotate; by means of the arrangement, rotation control and throwing control of the small arm are integrated, rotation control over the small arm can be achieved, the space occupied by independent execution of rotation control is greatly reduced, independent transmission does not interfere with one another, and the executability is extremely high.

abstract: The utility model discloses a rotary actuator, a middle connecting assembly and a humanoid robot. The rotary actuator comprises a rotary actuating main body and a rotary power output part which rotate relatively, wherein in a first use state, one of the rotation execution main body and the rotation power output part can be detachably connected with a trunk of the humanoid robot, and the other one of the rotation execution main body and the rotation power output part can be detachably connected with a waist frame of the humanoid robot; and in the second use state, one of the rotation execution main body and the rotation power output part can be detachably connected with the waist frame of the humanoid robot, and the other one of the rotation execution main body and the rotation power output part can be detachably connected with the leg limbs of the humanoid robot.

title: Simulated human hand interaction control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid hand interaction control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of automatic control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial state information, an original control instruction and an acting force parameter when an action skill primitive is executed by simulating a human hand, and constructing a target control optimization model according to the initial state information, the acting force parameter, the original control instruction and an original interaction control model, and then carrying out iterative solution on the target control optimization model to obtain a target control instruction and current state information of the simulated human hand, and finally controlling the simulated human hand to execute an operation corresponding to the action skill primitive according to the target control instruction, so that the initial state information of the simulated human hand is switched to the current state information. Therefore, the target control optimization model can be constructed according to the initial state information and the acting force parameters of the simulated hand, and the target control instruction is solved by the model to control the simulated hand, so that the operation of the simulated hand in an interaction environment is more accurate.

title: Telescopic moving structure for bionic robot
abstract: A telescopic moving structure for a bionic robot comprises a foot type assembly, a wheel type assembly and a driving assembly connected with the foot type assembly and the wheel type assembly. The foot type assembly comprises a foot end part which is driven by the driving assembly to rotate around a preset rotating axis, and an open slot which is formed in one side, close to the wheel type assembly, of the foot end part; the wheel type assembly comprises a fixing block which is driven by the driving assembly to do reciprocating rectilinear motion in the preset direction, a fixing base rotationally connected to the lower end of the fixing block, and a wheel body rotationally connected to the fixing base. Through the arrangement of the foot-type assembly and the wheel-type assembly, especially the structural design of the wheel-type assembly, the effect that the foot-type assembly can be shut down when the wheel-type assembly works is achieved, and the purpose of reducing energy consumption is achieved; and meanwhile, the wheel type assembly can achieve a self-locking or fixed standby mode, the application scene of the robot is widened, and the robot has the advantages of being good in flexibility and high in practicability.

title: High-resolution distributed pressure sensor and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a high-resolution distributed pressure sensor and a preparation method and application thereof, and the method comprises the steps: preparing a sensitive layer precursor solution and a stretchable electrode precursor solution, and then taking a stretchable porous material as a substrate; the sensitive layer and the stretchable electrode are respectively modified on the bulk phase and the surface of the porous material substrate in an array form through a printing method, and finally the stretchable porous material is used for packaging to obtain the distributed pressure sensor. The distributed pressure sensor provided by the invention has the characteristics of good stretchability, good air permeability, high spatial resolution and large sensing area array, and can be used for realizing high-resolution pressure imaging; the distributed pressure sensor provided by the invention can accurately convert a pressure signal into an electric signal, is not affected by tensile crosstalk, and is suitable for application scenes such as motion capture, humanoid robots, intelligent prostheses and the like.

title: Track generation and tracking control method and system for dancing of leg-arm collaborative robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of leg-arm collaborative robots, and provides a leg-arm collaborative robot dancing track generation and tracking control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a dancing motion of a leg-arm collaborative robot animation model in animation software; performing trajectory extraction and trajectory optimization on the dance movement to obtain a trunk, a mechanical arm, a mechanical leg foot end trajectory and a sole force which accord with robot dynamics; after the tasks of the trunk, the mechanical arms and the mechanical legs are subjected to priority grading, through null-space mapping, the positions, the speeds and the accelerated speeds of the tasks of all levels are calculated; based on the acceleration of each level of task and the sole force of the mechanical leg end, after relaxation optimization of a trunk kinetic equation of the leg-arm collaborative robot, joint torque is obtained through a whole-body kinetic equation of the robot, the control rate of the joint torque is obtained in combination with the position and speed of each level of task, and dance motion reproduction is completed. The trajectory generation efficiency is improved, and the robot can reproduce the dance action as much as possible on the premise of being stable.

title: Balance control method of biped robot and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a biped robot balance control method and a biped robot. The balance control method of the biped robot comprises the steps that when the ground inclines, head IMU information, shank IMU information and hip IMU information of the biped robot are obtained, and then front-back balance adjustment and left-right balance adjustment are conducted on the biped robot at the same time according to the obtained IMU information of the biped robot. The biped robot applies the balance control method of the biped robot. Through simultaneous front-back balance control and left-right balance control, the balance of the biped robot in the front-back direction and the left-right direction can be ensured, so that the biped robot reaches a new balance state when standing and walking on various uneven grounds; therefore, the positions of the COM and the ZMP are always located in a polygonal area defined by the contact of the foot surfaces of the biped robot and the ground, and the walking stability and the environment adaptability of the biped robot are effectively improved.

title: Biped robot gait generation method and device, instruction generation method and device and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a biped robot gait generation method, a biped robot instruction generation method, a biped robot gait generation device and a biped robot. The biped robot gait generation method comprises the steps of determining key points of a stepping track of the robot; for each motor involved in the stepping process, determining motion parameters of the motor at each key point; based on the motion parameters, determining a motion track of each motor between two adjacent key points; and generating the gait of the stepping process of the robot based on the motion trails among the key points. The workload is reduced, and the planning efficiency is improved.

title: Multi-mode man-machine interaction control system and method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal man-machine interaction control system of a humanoid robot. title: Virtual human semi-autonomous motion control method and system based on physical simulation
abstract: The invention discloses a virtual human semi-autonomous motion control method and system based on physical simulation. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out reverse dynamics strategy embedding, motion physics, reverse kinematics priority reduction and elastic constraint on a physical virtual human to obtain a virtual human based on physical simulation; controlling the posture of the virtual human based on physical simulation by using an inverse kinematics algorithm to generate an initial action posture; modifying the position of the expected position in the Cartesian space by utilizing interaction between a physical modifier and the environment; and iteratively solving the action posture of the virtual human based on physical simulation again through an inverse kinematics algorithm. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problem of poor controllability and flexibility of generated action postures when motion control is carried out on the virtual human in the prior art, action data needing to be input can be optimized while actions are simply and conveniently generated, and the actions of the virtual human can be better controlled.

title: Flexible cable full-drive humanoid dexterous hand finger mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible cable full-drive humanoid dexterous hand finger mechanism which comprises a base, a first knuckle, a first joint, a second knuckle, a second joint, a third knuckle, a third joint, a fourth knuckle and a fourth joint. The first knuckles are connected with the base through first joints, the second knuckles are connected with the first knuckles through second joints, the third knuckles are connected with the second knuckles through third joints, and flexible cable pulley mechanisms are arranged at the second joints and the third joints. The flexible cable pulley mechanism drives the third knuckle to rotate around the third joint, the second knuckle to rotate around the second joint, and the first knuckle to swing around the first joint; the fourth knuckle is connected with the third knuckle through a fourth joint, and the third knuckle drives the fourth knuckle to rotate around the fourth joint through a four-bar mechanism. The humanoid dexterous finger is anthropomorphic and modularized, and the requirement of dexterous operation for the tail end movement capacity is met.

title: HUMANOID TOY
abstract: To improve flexibility of a movable part of a humanoid toy.SOLUTION: A humanoid toy includes: upper parts and lower parts in a positional relationship of being vertically adjacent in an erect posture; and a joint structure to connect these. The upper joint is provided at the side of the upper parts and enables the longitudinal swing of the upper parts to the lower parts by the swing to the longitudinal direction. title: Biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the robot comprises a robot body, two leg assemblies arranged on one side of the robot body and a swing leg joint fixed on the other side of the robot body, the swing leg joint is provided with a swing leg rotating shaft in the horizontal direction, and the swing leg joint is used for driving the leg assemblies to swing around the swing leg rotating shaft; the leg assembly comprises a leg structure and a leg rotating joint, the leg rotating joint is provided with a leg rotating shaft in the vertical direction, and the leg rotating joint is used for driving the leg structure to rotate around the leg rotating shaft; the leg structure comprises a thigh, a thigh joint for driving the thigh to rotate, a shank, a shank joint for driving the shank to rotate, a foot and a foot joint. According to the biped robot, through reasonable arrangement of the robot body, the leg assemblies and all the joint modules, the overall structure is simple and light, control is easy during walking, energy consumption is low, and dismounting and later maintenance are also facilitated.

title: Method and device for controlling biped robot to go up and down steps
abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for controlling a biped robot to go up and down steps, and the method and the device are used for determining that a moving track of a swinging foot of the biped robot in a vertical direction in the process of going up and down the steps takes an expected curve as a constraint condition. The expected curve can ensure that the swing feet of the biped robot cannot be lifted too high in the process of going up and down the steps and cannot collide with the edges of the steps, and therefore it can be ensured that the biped robot can stably advance in the process of going up and down the steps.

title: Decoupling biped robot
abstract: The decoupling biped robot comprises a mounting frame, leg structures are arranged on the two sides of the mounting frame, and each leg structure comprises a thigh module, a knee joint module, a shank module, an ankle joint module and a sole module; the thigh module comprises a first driving motor, a second driving motor and a thigh connecting rod mechanism, and the first end of the thigh connecting rod mechanism is connected with the mounting frame; the knee joint module comprises a first connecting part, a second connecting part and a connecting plate, the first end of the connecting block is hinged to the first connecting part, the second end of the connecting block is hinged to the second connecting part, and the first connecting part and the second connecting part are hinged to the second end of the thigh connecting rod mechanism; the shank module comprises a third driving motor and a shank connecting rod mechanism, the first connecting part and the second connecting part are hinged to the first end of the shank connecting rod mechanism, and the second end of the shank connecting rod mechanism is hinged to the ankle joint module. According to the decoupling biped robot, rotational coupling of robot joints can be avoided, and the control difficulty of the robot is lowered.

title: HUMANOID FIVE-FINGER DEXTEROUS HAND
abstract: A humanoid five-finger dexterous hand, comprising a palm unit (600), and a thumb (1), an index finger (2), a middle finger (3), a ring finger (4) and a little finger (5), which are respectively connected to the palm unit (600), wherein a first thumb joint (113) and a third thumb joint (133) of the thumb (1) have rotational degrees of freedom, and a second thumb joint (123), a fourth thumb joint (143) and a fifth thumb joint (153) of the thumb (1) have flexion-and-extension degrees of freedom; and first finger joints (2131) of the index finger (2), the middle finger (3), the ring finger (4) and the little finger (5) have side-swing degrees of freedom, and second finger joints (2132), third finger joints (223) and fourth finger joints (233) thereof have flexion-and-extension degrees of freedom. The humanoid five-finger dexterous hand not only surpasses existing dexterous hands in terms of dexterity, but can also realize some actions that cannot be realized by human hands. Further provided is a dexterous hand robot comprising the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand.

title: Robot motion swing-up method and device, robot, storage medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a motion swing-up method and device of a robot, the robot, a storage medium and a product, and relates to the field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a motion swing-up instruction; in response to the motion swing-up instruction, a first leg of the robot is controlled to be in a suspended state, a leg retracting action of the first leg is executed, and a first mechanical wheel at a knee joint of the first leg is supported on the ground when the suspended state is ended; and the second leg of the robot is controlled to be suspended by taking the first mechanical wheel as a balance stress point. By means of the mode, the first leg can be controlled to conduct the leg folding action in the suspended state under the condition that the area where the legs of the robot can move is small, the first mechanical wheel after leg folding serves as a ground supporting component, the swing starting process conducted only through foot inertial motion is avoided, and the problem that the requirement for the operation area is large is effectively solved. The method can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence and intelligent transportation.

title: Moving track determination method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a moving track determination method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps that first relation data, second relation data and third relation data are created, the first relation data indicate the relation between the trunk position of the foot type robot and the movement duration, and the second relation data indicate the relation between the movement duration and the acting force borne by the feet of the foot type robot when making contact with the ground; the third relation data indicates the relation between the predicted rotation angle and the acting force when the foot-type robot moves to the target position after the target movement duration; and creating fourth relational data based on the third relational data, determining the value of the constant C when the target value J is the minimum value based on the second relational data and the fourth relational data, and obtaining the first relational data corresponding to the constant C with the determined value. The invention provides a mode for determining the moving track, and the feasibility and the accuracy of the determined moving track are ensured.

title: Robot lower limb assembly, humanoid robot and quadruped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a robot lower limb assembly, a humanoid robot and a quadruped robot, the robot lower limb assembly comprises: a thigh assembly provided with a hollow inner cavity; the knee joint actuator is arranged at the upper part of the thigh assembly; the upper end of the shank assembly is connected with the lower end of the thigh assembly; the double-connecting-rod assembly is arranged in the hollow inner cavity, the first end of the double-connecting-rod assembly is connected with the driving end of the knee joint actuator, and the second end of the double-connecting-rod assembly is connected with the upper end of the shank assembly so as to drive the shank assembly to swing relative to the thigh assembly. The two connecting rods of the double-connecting-rod assembly can transmit the driving force of the knee joint actuator, and the bearing capacity of the double-connecting-rod assembly is improved, so that the driving force to the shank assembly is improved, the swing angle of the shank assembly relative to the thigh assembly is guaranteed, and the operation stability and reliability of the shank assembly are improved; therefore, the operation stability of the robot lower limb assembly is improved.

title: Lower limb assembly of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a lower limb assembly of a biped robot. The lower limb assembly at least comprises a hip joint, a knee joint, an ankle joint and a plurality of actuators; the first actuator is arranged at a preset position of the hip joint and used for driving the hip joint to move in series; the second actuator is arranged on the opposite side of the preset position of the hip joint and used for driving the knee joint to move in series; the third actuator is arranged between the knee joint and the ankle joint and used for driving the ankle joint to move in parallel; when the lower limb assembly is in a standing state, the longitudinal coordinates of the first actuator and the second actuator are higher than the longitudinal coordinates of the third actuator. The mass center of the lower limb assembly can be increased, and the control difficulty of the lower limb assembly is reduced.

title: Biped walking robot
abstract: The biped walking robot comprises a robot body, supporting legs, swing arms and a head, the robot body is composed of an upper body and a lower body, the upper body is in circumferential rotating connection with the top of the lower body through a first motor, the swing arms are in circumferential rotating connection with the side portion of the upper body through a second motor, and the head is in circumferential rotating connection with the top of the upper body through a third motor; a transmission mechanism is arranged in the lower body, a fourth motor is arranged on the side edge of a bottom frame of the lower body, a linkage arm is arranged at the side end of the transmission mechanism and close to the outer wall of the lower body, and the other end of the linkage arm is connected with the supporting leg. The robot has the advantages that when the robot walks, the head, the arms and the like can be required to have certain matched movement, smiling faces at the two ends of the head are adopted, interestingness and humanization of the robot are improved, four pairs of transmission mechanisms of the motor are linked with the supporting legs to reciprocate up and down, and therefore the posture similar to human walking can be simulated; the robot can walk stably, so that the purpose of walking of the biped robot is achieved.

title: Robot hip structure and biped walking robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot hip structure and a biped walking robot. The robot hip structure comprises a hip joint base and two hip joint mechanisms. The hip joint mechanisms in the two hip joint mechanisms are symmetrically mounted on the two sides of the hip joint base; the hip joint mechanism comprises a first motor, a first telescopic rod, a second motor, a second telescopic rod, a connecting assembly, a hip joint tooth piece assembly, a differential tooth piece assembly, a hip joint connecting rod, a thigh supporting column, a hinge part and a four-connecting-rod assembly. The first telescopic rod is controlled by the first motor to do linear motion, and front-back swing of the thigh supporting column can be achieved; a second telescopic rod is controlled by a second motor to do linear motion, so that a hip joint connecting rod rotates under the action of the second motor, the hip joint connecting rod rotates to drive a differential tooth piece assembly to rotate, the degree-of-freedom motion of the hip in two directions can be achieved, and meanwhile the hip structure can adapt to various complex terrains.

title: Servo electric cylinder suitable for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a servo electric cylinder suitable for a humanoid robot. The servo electric cylinder solves the technical problems that an existing servo electric cylinder is high in integration level and not easy to maintain and replace parts. Comprising a servo motor with a rotationally arranged motor shaft, one end of the servo motor is coaxially connected with a sleeve body, a lead screw body is arranged in the sleeve body in a penetrating mode, the lead screw body is detachably connected with the motor shaft, a lead screw nut in threaded connection with the lead screw body is movably arranged in the sleeve body, and one end of the lead screw nut extends to the outer side of the sleeve body. A spherical hinge assembly is arranged at the end, extending to the outer side of the sleeve body, of the lead screw nut and/or the end, away from the sleeve body, of the servo motor. The device has the advantages that the device adopts a split structure, the screw rod body is connected with the servo motor through the crossover flange, the heat dissipation capability is improved, the flexibility is also improved, meanwhile, the motor stator and the cylinder body are integrally designed, the compactness of the mechanical size is ensured, the design of the spherical hinge assembly can be used for linear push-pull scenes, and the service life is prolonged. The method is suitable for muscle bionic simulation of the humanoid robot.

title: Digital human materialized robot system and interactive driving method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a digital human materialization robot system and an interactive driving method thereof.The digital human materialization robot system comprises a sensing unit, a control module, a communication unit, a storage unit, a power connection module and a mechanical unit, the mechanical mechanism comprises a machine main body, extensible leg parts, extensible foot parts, extensible mechanical arms and a rotatable human-shaped face shell; the sensing unit, the control module, the communication unit, the execution assembly and the power supply connection module are all installed on the machine body, and external environment information sensed by the sensing unit and obtained instruction information sent by an interaction object are transmitted to the machine body through the power supply connection module. title: Model training method and device, virtual human hand action control method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method and device, a virtual human hand action control method and device and a storage medium end, and the training method comprises the steps: obtaining a human hand action data set collected by a preset sensor system, and generating a hand joint point rotation degree data set based on the human hand action data set; generating a hand image set based on the hand joint point rotation degree data set, and identifying hand images in the hand image set to obtain a hand key point data set; and generating a training data set based on the hand key point data set and the hand joint point rotation degree data set, training a preset neural network model based on the training data set, and obtaining a hand action recognition model. According to the method, the hand posture of the virtual human can be accurately and well controlled, and the problem that the existing human hand recognition accuracy is not high is solved.

title: Robot leg ankle structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot leg ankle structure and a humanoid robot. The robot leg ankle structure comprises a first motor, a second motor, a first telescopic rod, a second telescopic rod, a sole, a buckling movement mechanism and a side-sway movement mechanism. The first telescopic rod is mounted on the first motor; the second telescopic rod is mounted on the second motor; one end of the buckling movement mechanism is movably connected with the first telescopic rod, and the other end of the buckling movement mechanism is movably connected with the sole; one end of the side-sway movement mechanism is movably connected with the second motor and the second telescopic rod, and the other end of the side-sway movement mechanism is fixedly connected with the sole; through the direct driving mode of the first telescopic rod and the second telescopic rod, the precision of controlling the foot sole is greatly improved, and meanwhile, the motion direction adjustment of two degrees of freedom of pitching and side swaying of the foot sole can be achieved by controlling the buckling motion mechanism and the side swaying motion mechanism.

title: Oral movement assembly
abstract: The invention discloses an oral cavity movement assembly which comprises an upper jaw plate, a left driving movement block, a left driven movement block, a left front-back movement driving module, a right driving movement block, a right driven movement block, a right front-back movement driving module and an internal and external linkage movement driving module. When the left front-and-back movement driving module works, the left driving movement block is driven to move front and back, the right driven movement block is fixedly connected with the right driving movement block, when the right front-and-back movement driving module works, the right driving movement block is driven to move front and back, and the inner-and-outer linkage movement driving module is in transmission connection with the left front-and-back movement driving module and the right front-and-back movement driving module. When the internal and external linkage motion driving module works, the left active motion block and the right active motion block are driven to synchronously move inwards or outwards. Movement of the inner wall of the oral cavity is achieved, and the richness degree of facial expressions of the bionic robot is improved.

title: Dynamic balance recovery control method based on three-dimensional balance state manifold guidance
abstract: The invention relates to a dynamic balance recovery control method and device based on three-dimensional balance state manifold guidance, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sensor signal based on an exoskeleton sensor, calculating a multi-order derivative, and generating a system centroid motion state; fitting forward and backward instability boundary functions of the three-dimensional equilibrium state manifold based on the centroid position, the centroid velocity and the pendulum length of the inverted pendulum; calculating a target transient capture point corresponding to the optimal regression motion state point; based on a preset balance constraint relation among the transient capture point, the centroid state point and the pressure center point, calculating a horizontal dynamic balance correction force acting on the centroid position; and according to the gait phase and the dynamic balance correction force distributed to each joint of each leg of the exoskeleton under the balance adjustment effect, generating balance recovery correction torque mapped to each joint. According to the invention, the ability of the lower limb exoskeleton to detect the balance state of the expected target and adjust the anthropomorphic dynamic balance can be improved.

title: Driving, transmission and control highly-integrated multifunctional five-finger humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention provides a driving, transmission and control highly-integrated multifunctional five-finger humanoid dexterous hand. The problems that an existing multi-connecting-rod type dexterous hand mechanism is small in freedom degree and cannot completely simulate a human hand movement mode, and a flexible cable transmission type dexterous hand is low in precision, small in load capacity and the like are solved. The five-finger humanoid dexterous hand comprises two kinds of fingers, the thumb and the index finger are fully-driven fingers, and the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are under-actuated fingers. The two full-drive fingers are used for flexible operation, rotation, pinching and other actions of the two fingers can be achieved, the three under-drive fingers are used for large-gripping-force gripping, and the overall weight is reduced while the requirement for manual operation is met. The driver and the motor lead screw driving assembly are installed on the back and the center of the palm respectively, the fingers are each of a connecting rod structure and are provided with a plurality of limiting structures, and the structure is large in load capacity and high in reliability. Electronic skin is attached to the fingertips and the center of the palm, and the grabbed object and the external environment can be perceived.

title: Small sample digital human voice driven action replay method based on gesture action graph
abstract: The invention provides a small sample digital human voice-driven action replay method based on a gesture action graph, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the rhythm point detection, keyword detection and motion continuity detection of reference speech data, and obtaining the position of a first rhythm point, a first keyword, a corresponding position and an unnatural inter-frame continuous relation; constructing a gesture motion diagram based on the first rhythm point position, the first keyword, the corresponding position and the non-natural inter-frame continuous relation; performing rhythm point detection and keyword detection on the test speech data to respectively obtain a second rhythm point position, a second keyword and a corresponding position; determining a search segment based on the second rhythm point position, the second keyword and the corresponding position, and obtaining a replay gesture based on the search segment; the fusion gesture is output based on the gesture style fusion network, the final gesture is determined based on the fusion gesture and the rhythm gesture, the digital human action replay is driven based on the final gesture, and the accuracy and reliability of the action replay are improved.

title: Exoskeleton robot hip joint direct-drive power assisting device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, in particular to an exoskeleton robot hip joint direct-drive power assisting device which comprises a waist and back assembly, a connecting assembly and a hip assembly, the waist and back assembly comprises a bearing unit, the bearing unit comprises a waist plate, the connecting assembly is arranged on the lower portion of one side of the waist plate, and the hip assembly is arranged on the lower portion of the other side of the waist plate. title: Flexible humanoid three-finger manipulator based on graphene enhanced dielectric elastic arch
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible humanoid three-finger manipulator based on a graphene enhanced dielectric elastic arch, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the flexible humanoid three-finger manipulator comprises a mechanical palm body, three mechanical fingers, a dielectric arch, a control module and an energy storage battery, the mechanical palm body is uniformly provided with the three mechanical fingers, and the mechanical fingers are detachably connected with the mechanical palm body; dielectric arches are fixedly arranged at finger pulps of the mechanical fingers, a control module and an energy storage battery are further fixedly arranged at the bottom of the mechanical palm body, the dielectric arches are electrically connected with the control module, and the energy storage battery is used for supplying power to equipment. The dielectric arches are controlled to bend and arch towards the center of the mechanical palm body through on-off of current, then the action of clamping objects is achieved, and the mechanical palm is simple in structure, convenient to machine and capable of being used and popularized.

title: Speed regulation control method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a speed regulation control method, device and equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a kinetic model for speed regulation of a wheel-legged biped robot is determined; determining a speed adjusting posture of the wheel-legged biped robot, wherein the speed adjusting posture is used for enabling the wheel-legged biped robot to keep body balance in the speed adjusting process; according to the method, firstly, a kinetic model for speed adjustment is established, then, a proper speed adjustment posture is designed, finally, a proper controller is designed to conduct tracking control on the adjustment posture, and by means of the method, the robot can keep balance of the body posture while conducting speed adjustment; therefore, the method can be effectively used for actual control of the wheel-legged biped robot.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand finger adopting space series-parallel spherical hinge multi-rod coupling transmission
abstract: The invention discloses a space series-parallel spherical hinge multi-rod coupling transmission three-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand finger. The problems that an existing multi-connecting-rod type dexterous hand finger mechanism is low in integration level, small in degree of freedom and incapable of completely simulating a human hand movement mode, and a flexible cable transmission type dexterous hand finger is low in precision, small in load capacity and the like are solved. The finger mechanism comprises the three bending joints and the side-sway joint and is driven by the three independent motor lead screw assemblies so as to meet the requirements for the bending and side-sway movement functions of the fingers of the human hand, and the finger mechanism has the same movement freedom degree and dexterous operation capacity of the fingers of the human hand. The motor lead screw assembly is located at the root of the finger and can be easily integrated in the palm envelope of the dexterous hand. Position sensors do not need to be installed at finger joints, the structure size can be optimized to the maximum degree, and the number of cables can be reduced to the maximum degree.

title: Biped bionic mechanical chicken
abstract: The invention discloses a biped bionic mechanical chicken which comprises a part above a body, the body and a part below the body. Multi-space and multi-angle object clamping and image information acquisition of the bionic mechanical chicken are realized on the part above the body through multi-axis movement of a mechanical arm, and the functions of object taking and unmanned environment monitoring are realized; the body part is provided with a distance measuring module, a voice broadcasting module, a data transmission module and the like and an intelligent household appliance control unit, so that diversified functions are realized, and multi-aspect application requirements of intelligent home and the like are met; the momentum wheel is arranged on the part below the body, the posture balance of the whole machine in the advancing process can be adjusted only by changing the rotating direction and speed of the momentum wheel, and the balance condition of the biped system is simplified; the mechanical claws are arranged on the portion below the body and can be freely opened and grabbed, the obstacle avoiding and crossing capacity of the whole machine is greatly improved in combination with contraction of the mechanical legs, the adaptability to different application scenes is enhanced, and therefore the robot has wide application prospects.

title: Human body walking lower limb muscle strength solving device and method based on generative adversarial network and reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a human body walking lower limb muscle strength solving device and method based on a generative adversarial network and reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: importing a joint angle of a model and a joint angle of human body walking into the generative adversarial network for training, and outputting a part of reward functions needed by reinforcement learning through the generative adversarial network; obtaining a partial reward function related to a human body movement effect through kinematics data and dynamics data generated by the musculoskeletal model; analyzing dynamic data obtained by the surface electromyogram signals and the musculoskeletal model to obtain a partial reward function related to muscle collaboration; and importing the three parts of reward functions into a strategy network for training to obtain a muscle force calculation result capable of reflecting a muscle cooperation relationship. According to the invention, the muscle strength of the main muscles of the lower limbs of different individuals in the walking process can be calculated, and a theoretical basis is provided for understanding of human body movement rules, development of movement rehabilitation and medical equipment, control of humanoid robots and the like.

title: Mechanism for realizing curvilinear motion through differential motion of multiple connecting rods
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomimetic robots, and particularly relates to a mechanism for realizing curvilinear motion through multi-connecting-rod differential motion, which comprises a hip joint frame, two waist driving power sources are mounted on the hip joint frame, the output ends of the waist driving power sources are connected with swing assemblies, the hip joint frame is rotatably connected with a main shaft, and the main shaft is rotatably connected with the hip joint frame. The spindle is fixedly connected with a shaft sleeve, the end, away from the waist driving power source, of the swing assembly is connected with the shaft sleeve, the spindle is rotationally connected with a swing rod, and the other end of the swing rod is rotationally connected with the hip joint frame. A supporting fixing fork is fixed to the other end of the main shaft, a cross ring is rotationally connected to the supporting fixing fork, trunk rotating power sources are rotationally connected to the two sides of the cross ring, supporting assemblies are rotationally connected between the output ends of the trunk rotating power sources and the supporting fixing fork, and a trunk structure is connected between shells of the two trunk rotating power sources. The invention provides a mechanism for simulating human waist actions through multi-connecting-rod differential motion.

title: Motion data generating system for robot, motion data generating method for robot, and storage medium
abstract: A motion data generating system for a robot including a waist and a leg, comprising: a test subject motion data acquiring unit that acquires captured waist motion data from motion of a leg separated from motion of a test subject; a representative point extracting unit that performs peak detection by smoothing the captured leg motion data; a scale converting unit that converts the capture leg motion data and the capture waist motion data at a representative point into a scale of the robot; a ZMP setting unit that sets a target zero moment point (ZMP of the robot; an interpolation generating unit that generates an attitude of the leg and the waist of the robot by interpolation; and a motion data generating unit that generates motion data in which the attitude of the leg and the waist is corrected so as to satisfy a target ZMP.
abstract_en: A motion data generating system for a robot including a waist and a leg, comprising: a test subject motion data acquiring unit that acquires captured waist motion data from motion of a leg separated from motion of a test subject; a representative point extracting unit that performs peak detection by smoothing the captured leg motion data; a scale converting unit that converts the capture leg motion data and the capture waist motion data at a representative point into a scale of the robot; a ZMP setting unit that sets a target zero moment point (ZMP of the robot; an interpolation generating unit that generates an attitude of the leg and the waist of the robot by interpolation; and a motion data generating unit that generates motion data in which the attitude of the leg and the waist is corrected so as to satisfy a target ZMP.

title: Linear driving equipment and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to robot equipment, and particularly relates to linear driving equipment and a humanoid robot. The linear driving equipment comprises a machine shell, a driving mechanism, a driving mechanism and a driving mechanism, the motor is installed in the assembly space, the motor comprises a stator and a rotor, the rotor is sleeved with the stator, and the stator is provided with a through hole; the nut is rotationally installed on the machine shell, the nut is fixed in the through hole so as to synchronously rotate along with the rotor, and the nut is provided with a threaded through hole; the lead screw is arranged in the threaded through hole, the lead screw is provided with an external threaded section, and the output end of the lead screw penetrates out of the threaded through hole; and the roller lead screw assembly comprises a plurality of threaded rollers, the threaded rollers are arranged in the threaded hole at intervals around the lead screw, external threads of the threaded rollers are meshed with internal threads of the threaded through hole, and the external threads of the threaded rollers are meshed with external threads of the external threaded section. According to the technical scheme, the problem that rotation driving force adopted by the joint parts of an existing humanoid robot cannot meet the movement explosive force needed by the joint parts easily is solved.

According to the technical scheme, the problem that rotation driving force adopted by the joint parts of an existing humanoid robot cannot meet the movement explosive force needed by the joint parts easily is solved.

title: Bionic robot expression generation method based on emotion detection
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot expression generation method based on emotion detection. A system comprises an interaction user, a bionic robot head, a computer terminal and a voice acquisition and playing device. The whole system can be divided into a micro-expression control instruction generation part and a micro-expression action execution part, and in the man-machine conversation process, the bionic robot head obtains text information input by a user through the voice acquisition device and the voice recognition module; then the input text information passes through a text dialogue module and a text emotion detection TSDM module to obtain generated text information, a user inputs emotion, and then the generated text information passes through the text emotion detection TSDM module and a text-to-audio module to obtain generated emotion and generated audio information of the bionic robot head; finally, a bionic machine head expression control instruction is obtained according to the input emotion and the generated emotion of the user, and then a machine head steering engine is controlled to rotate to achieve micro-expression actions, and the method has the characteristic of spontaneity.

title: NAO robot object grabbing training method based on direct preference optimization
abstract: The invention discloses an NAO robot object grabbing training method based on direct preference optimization. The NAO robot object grabbing training method comprises the following steps of (1) collecting and storing human expert data, simulation data and track data of interactive grabbing actions in a robot simulator by using a reinforcement learning strategy; (2) scoring state action trajectory sequence data in the trajectory data by a human annotator to obtain a trajectory data set based on human preference; (3) designing a reference strategy network by using the human preference data set, designing a parameterized strategy network, constructing a maximum likelihood target in combination with the reference strategy network, and performing gradient descent on a target function to obtain an optimal strategy; (4) training a target object recognition model, deploying the object recognition model and the optimal strategy to a real NAO robot, and evaluating the grabbing action of the robot; and (5) iterating the training process and the evaluation process until the robot can smoothly grab the target object.

abstract: The invention discloses a robot social behavior control method based on a comprehensive evaluation and optimal control principle, and the method comprises the steps: collecting external multi-modal information, carrying out the comprehensive decision of a social object, carrying out the modeling of a robot eye-head actuator, solving a motion track with the minimum nerve conduction noise, and carrying out the optimal control through an MPC controller. abstract: According to the stay wire puppet type humanoid robot driving structure, the layout of original robot motors is changed, some motors needing large torsion are placed outside the joints, the joints are driven by stay wires to rotate, limitation of the sizes of the joints is avoided under the condition that larger torque is provided, and therefore the bottleneck that the joints of a humanoid robot are small in strength is broken through.

title: Connecting rod type shoulder action mechanism
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a connecting rod type shoulder action mechanism. title: Hip and leg pitch motion structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot hip leg pitch motion structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises a motion support base, two sides of the bottom end of the motion support base are fixedly provided with bottom transmission support box bodies, the bottom transmission support box bodies are internally provided with hip leg rotating seats through bearings, the hip leg rotating seats are of Y-shaped structures, and the hip leg rotating seats are connected with the bottom transmission support box bodies through bearings. And a spherical sleeve is arranged on the hip and leg rotating seat. According to the hip and leg rotating device, the rotating motor is installed on the spherical sleeve capable of rotating along the hip and leg rotating shaft on the hip and leg rotating base, multi-direction rotating motion control over the hip and the leg can be facilitated, and the hip and leg rotating device is small in structure, flexible and practical; the front-end transmission shaft can bear large transmission force, meanwhile, transmission between the power output bevel gear and the transmission bevel gear can be protected, great convenience is achieved, and the problem that fatigue of the front-end transmission shaft is accelerated when the two ends of the front-end transmission shaft are stressed can be effectively solved.

title: Three-joint humanoid limb
abstract: A three-joint humanoid limb comprises a foot, a shank and a thigh. The foot is connected with the shank through an ankle joint, the thigh is connected with the shank through a knee joint, and a hip joint is arranged at the top of the thigh; the ankle joints, the knee joints and the hip joints provide three degrees of freedom for the limbs; the shank and the thigh are of a length-adjustable structure. The humanoid mechanical leg has three degrees of freedom and comprises the thigh, the shank and the foot, joints are driven by the servo motor, the three degrees of freedom are mutually independent and do not interfere with each other, the mechanical leg can adjust the lengths of different limbs, the length of the humanoid mechanical leg can be adjusted according to lower limb parameters of different people, and the humanoid mechanical leg is more flexible to use. And different gait movement tracks are realized.

title: Multi-posture humanoid robot environment navigation method based on binocular and three-dimensional point cloud
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-posture humanoid robot environment navigation method based on binocular and three-dimensional point cloud. The method comprises the following steps: S1, inputting scene reconstruction point cloud; s2, point cloud preprocessing is carried out, after point cloud preprocessing, information of the humanoid robot is input, and an area where the humanoid robot can pass is calculated by combining the information of the humanoid robot; s3, extracting point clouds of the ground, sparsifying the point clouds, and mapping the point clouds into a navigation matrix; and S4, realizing complex environment navigation of the multi-posture humanoid robot in the navigation matrix. The multi-posture humanoid robot environment navigation method based on the binocular and three-dimensional point cloud is reasonable in design, under the condition that the humanoid robot is only provided with a binocular depth camera, the problem of path generation of the multi-posture humanoid robot in a complex and private environment is solved by adopting machine learning and the three-dimensional point cloud, and the navigation efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved. And the method has good developability and expansibility.

title: Ventilation and heat dissipation system for humanoid robot with flexible shell
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and discloses a flexible shell humanoid robot ventilation and heat dissipation system. The ventilation and heat dissipation system of the humanoid robot with the flexible shell comprises an air inlet, a ventilation pipe, a motor inflation pump, an air path block, a heating device and an air outlet. In order to prevent an object from being sucked into the system component from the air inlet or the air outlet, the air inlet and the air outlet are provided with detachable screw filter screens. The ventilation pipe is a hollow hose and is connected with other components of the system to form a smooth air path, cold air outside the humanoid robot with the flexible shell is sucked into the motor inflation pump through the air inlet, pressure is conveyed into the heating device through the air path block, and heat generated by the heating device is discharged into air outside the body through the air outlet through the air path block. Compared with a heat dissipation scheme that heat dissipation parts are installed on all heating devices of the humanoid robot, the maintenance cost of the heat dissipation device can be reduced.

title: Humanoid robot reading system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot reading system and method. The humanoid robot reading system comprises cameras (3) arranged on eyes (2) of a humanoid robot (1), loudspeakers (5) arranged on lips (4) of the humanoid robot (1), an information processing module (6) and a lip synchronization module (7). The information processing module (6) receives an original image acquired by the camera (3), processes the original image, outputs text information to the lip synchronization module (7) and outputs voice information to the loudspeaker (5), and the loudspeaker (5) outputs voice according to the voice information; and the lip synchronization module (7) processes the acquired character information into lip action information, and controls the lip (4) of the humanoid robot (1) to execute corresponding actions according to the voice output progress of the loudspeaker (5). Compared with the prior art, the character information can be converted into the voice information, and the lips of the humanoid robot can cooperate with the voice information to move.

title: Human body parameter-based passive walking robot motion control algorithm
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a passive walking robot motion control algorithm based on human body parameters, and the algorithm comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a passive walking robot model in combination with a human body parameter model; s2, dividing the walking process into a plurality of phase states; s3, performing dynamic modeling by adopting a space operator algebra method, and constructing a coordinate system according to a D-H modeling method; s4, according to a space operator algebraic correlation theory, introducing a recursive algorithm into a dynamic modeling process; s5, establishing a kinetic model of a collision phase state by using an angular momentum conservation law; and S6, carrying out motion characteristic analysis. According to the method, a passive walking robot model based on human body parameters is adopted, a high-humanoid passive walking robot three-dimensional model is obtained, and local steady-state analysis is performed by using a floquet multiplier method, so that the research result of the method can be helpful for realizing efficient, energy-saving and simple and convenient walking assisting equipment.

title: Action control method and system of digital human
abstract: The invention discloses an action control method and system for a digital human. The action control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a user action interaction video acquired by a camera; performing feature extraction on the user action interaction video to obtain a context action time sequence semantic feature vector; and based on the context action time sequence semantic feature vector, generating an action control instruction aiming at the digital human. In this way, the accuracy of recognition of the operation intention of the user can be enhanced, and then more accurate and convenient digital human action control is achieved.
