title: Humanoid robot control method and system capable of automatically hooking and unhooking grounding wire
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system for automatically hooking and unhooking a ground wire. The method comprises the steps that an operator fixes a ground wire clamp to an end effector of a mechanical arm of a robot; a robot head depth camera positions the high-voltage line; fitting a curvilinear equation of the high-voltage line under a robot base mark through visual information; calculating a closest point from the curve of the high-voltage line to the origin of the coordinate system of the end effector of the mechanical arm; determining a target pose based on the origin of the coordinate system at the tail end of the mechanical arm and the tangential direction of the high-voltage line curve at the target point; integrating the target point and the target pose; planning a mechanical arm joint space trajectory through a primal-dual neural network; the mechanical arm joint motion controller controls each joint to reach a target position; an end effector of the mechanical arm works to tighten the grounding wire clamp; the mechanical arm moves in the direction opposite to the Z axis of the mechanical arm tail end coordinate system. According to the invention, the problems of low working efficiency and low intelligent degree due to the fact that grounding wire hanging and picking are generally completed manually by workers at present are effectively solved.

title: Humanoid robot waist mechanism
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot waist mechanism which comprises a waist plate and a turnover mechanism arranged outside the waist plate, and the turnover mechanism comprises a sliding assembly, a first connecting assembly and a second connecting assembly. The sliding assembly comprises a working motor, a threaded rod, a connecting sliding block and a limiting groove, the working motor is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the waist plate, the threaded rod is installed at the output end of the working motor, the connecting sliding block is arranged and slides to drive a machine body connecting plate to rotate through a first connecting rod, and the machine body connecting plate rotates to drive a machine body frame to rotate synchronously; meanwhile, the connecting sliding block slides to drive the hip connecting plate to rotate through the second connecting rod, overturning operation on the waist plate is achieved through relative rotation of the hip connecting plate and the machine body connecting plate, meanwhile, by arranging the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod, supporting operation on the machine body frame is achieved when the waist plate rotates, and the machine body frame is prevented from toppling over.

title: Apparatus and Method for analysising Motion of robots
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for analyzing the motion of an ergonomics-based humanoid robot, the method comprising the steps of: collecting human behavioral data; analyzing and modeling human kinematic characteristics based on the collected behavioral data; monitoring the motion data of an ergonomic robot; and analyzing the monitored motion data based on the modeled kinematic characteristics, the monitored motion data being analyzed if some data among the monitored motion data correspond to some data among pre-stored motion data. According to the method for analyzing the motion of a robot, motion data determined to have been mismeasured among the monitored motion data are filtered, and the motion analysis of a humanoid robot can be performed more accurately.

title: Apparatus and Method for analysising Motion of ergonomic-based humanoid robots
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and a method for analyzing the motion of an ergonomics-based humanoid robot, the method comprising the steps of: collecting human behavioral data; analyzing and modeling human kinematic characteristics based on the collected behavioral data; monitoring the motion data of an ergonomic robot; determining whether the motion data are normal by determining whether the movement range of the ergonomic robot is within a normal range based on the modeled kinematic characteristics according to the monitored motion data; and analyzing the motion data of the robot according to which the motion range of the robot has been determined to be within a normal range. title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR STABILIZATION OF MOVEMENTS IN AN ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT FOR AMBIENT NAVIGATION
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for stabilization of movements in an anthropomorphic robot for ambient navigation. According to the invention, the method consists of eight production stages namely, making a pelvic assembly (AB), a hip joint assembly (AŞ), a thigh joint assembly (AC), a knee joint assembly (AG), a leg joint assembly (AM), an ankle joint assembly (AL), a foot assembly (LP) and a control system (SCR) of an anthropomorphic robot. title: Pedestrian navigation system based on ground touching mechanical feedback and walking trajectory tracking control method
abstract: The invention discloses a pedestrian navigation system based on ground touching mechanical feedback and a walking trajectory tracking control method, the system comprises an environment information acquisition module, a positioning module, an environment perception and exploration module, a gait planning module and a force feedback control module, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an initial state and a termination state of a walking trajectory, constructing a discretization difference model of a human body walking kinematics model, performing optimal control on an initial state and a termination state which are obtained in real time, performing optimal solution by combining a target function and a constraint condition to obtain an optimal track of human body walking before the two states, and taking a solved optimal course angle as a control input sequence, and the driving force feedback controller tracks the optimal course angle and guides the pedestrian along a planned path. Under the constraints of a human body kinematics model, a dynamic environment, an obstacle and the like, the force feedback mechanism can be controlled through a walking trajectory tracking control method to realize autonomous guidance for special people with visual impairment, intellectual disability and the like.

title: Humanoid robot position confirmation method based on three-dimensional point cloud and binocular vision
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot position confirmation method based on three-dimensional point cloud and binocular vision. The method comprises the following steps: S1, inputting a scene to reconstruct the three-dimensional point cloud; s2, point cloud segmentation is carried out, and coordinates of all objects in the scene under a point cloud coordinate system are calculated; s3, calculating coordinates of an object in a real space coordinate system according to the size of the scene; s4, the objects in the scene correspond to the objects in the point cloud in a one-to-one mode, the humanoid robot corresponds to the objects in the point cloud coordinate system through object recognition, the coordinates of the recognized objects in the real space coordinate system are obtained, then the coordinates of the humanoid robot are obtained, and position confirmation of the humanoid robot and all the objects in the scene is achieved. According to the humanoid robot position confirmation method based on the three-dimensional point cloud and the binocular vision, under the condition that the humanoid robot is only provided with a depth camera, no sensor is needed, and confirmation of information of the whole scene inside and outside the view field and position information of the humanoid robot can be achieved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot position confirmation method based on three-dimensional point cloud and binocular vision. title: Robot gait training method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention provides a robot gait training method and system based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the state of a biped robot at each moment in the gait training process according to a constructed simulation model of the biped robot; and executing at least one first training process until the total reward converges at the maximum value, and the total reward is determined according to the reward obtained by executing each second training process. The invention provides a new reward calculation method, so that the biped robot can complete correct gait training through single reinforcement learning training on the premise of no reference trajectory, and parameterized fine control on the gait training process can be realized only by modifying the target binary functions for respectively describing the ground contact states of the two feet. Dependence on a biped robot structure is reduced, and description and training of most biped periodic gaits are achieved.

title: Data processing method and device for biped robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and device for a biped robot and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining the kinematics data of a previous moment, the kinematics data of a current moment and the inertial measurement data from the previous moment to the current moment of the biped robot, and obtaining a previous moment image and a current moment image shot by a camera; then, acquiring an initial pose of the camera at the current moment; and then, according to the kinematics data of the previous moment, the kinematics data of the current moment and the initial pose, calculating to obtain a kinematics residual error of the camera, and according to the kinematics residual error, the inertial measurement data, the image of the previous moment and the image of the current moment, calculating to obtain a target pose of the camera at the current moment. According to the embodiment of the invention, the influence of image motion blur can be reduced, and the robustness of pose estimation is improved, so that more accurate pose information can be obtained.

title: Point-foot type biped robot and robot

According to the biped robot, the two symmetrically-arranged leg structures are arranged, each leg structure only comprises three degrees of freedom, walking can be achieved through cooperation of joints of the three degrees of freedom, the design of the leg structures is simplified, the control data volume is remarkably reduced, the control instruction response speed is increased, and the control difficulty is remarkably reduced; and no sole or driving device for driving the sole is arranged on the foot of the robot, and the mass of the leg structure is basically concentrated at the upper end of the leg structure, so that the lower limb mass of the robot is less, the walking inertia is small, the control difficulty is favorably reduced, and the advantages of reducing the energy consumption and the manufacturing cost are achieved.

title: Humanoid material carrying robot
abstract: The humanoid material carrying robot comprises a chassis, moving wheels are arranged on the two sides of the two ends of the chassis, two oppositely-distributed supporting plates are arranged on the upper surface of one end of the chassis, a body part capable of rotating up and down is arranged between the two supporting plates, and a head part capable of rotating by 360 degrees is arranged at the top end of the body part. Bendable mechanical arms are arranged on the two sides of the top end of the body part correspondingly, and clamping mechanisms used for carrying materials are arranged at the ends of the two mechanical arms correspondingly. According to the robot, each moving wheel corresponds to one servo motor, flexible walking of the robot can be achieved, through cooperation of the first motor, the rotating shaft and the connecting plate, when the first motor is started, the connecting plate can rotate with the axis of the rotating shaft as the circle center, so that the bowing action of the body part is achieved, and the robot can take and place materials conveniently.

title: Humanoid robot leg and foot pitch direction movement structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot leg-foot pitch direction movement structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises a knee joint support, the bottom end of the knee joint support is fixedly connected with a shank support rod, and the periphery of the bottom end of the shank support rod is provided with a cross hinge seat. According to the utility model, the driving bevel gear I and the driving bevel gear II can be driven to rotate by rotating the driving pull block, so that the transmission bevel gear can be driven to rotate, the foot plate can be pulled to rotate along the cross hinge seat under the transmission of the driving connecting rod, and the pitch movement direction of the foot plate can be controlled; the two driving connecting rods, the first spherical hinge base, the second spherical hinge base, the cross-shaped hinge base and the driving base form a parallelogram structure, when the foot plate pitch is driven to move, the two driving connecting rods are evenly stressed and can bear pulling force and pressure, and it can be ensured that the robot walks more stably and reliably.

title: Humanoid robot emotion recognition and facial expression generation method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot emotion recognition and facial expression generation method based on deep learning. The invention aims to solve the problem that the emotional state of a user cannot be recognized and the corresponding facial expression cannot be generated according to the emotional state in the prior art. By using the method based on deep learning, the dialogue between the user and the humanoid robot can be automatically learned, the emotion information is extracted from the dialogue, and then the corresponding facial expression is generated. Compared with the prior art, the emotional state of the user can be recognized more flexibly and adaptively, and the corresponding facial expression is generated, so that the emotional interaction effect between the humanoid robot and the user is improved. Therefore, the technical problem to be solved by the invention is to improve the emotion interaction effect of the humanoid robot and realize more natural, intelligent and humanized man-machine interaction.

title: Biped robot

title: Three-dimensional point cloud map reconstruction method for humanoid robot in closed environment
abstract: The invention discloses a three-dimensional point cloud map reconstruction method for a humanoid robot in a closed environment. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting information in a real scene by the humanoid robot; processing the collected information to obtain a three-dimensional point cloud model of the real scene; s2, performing point cloud segmentation on the three-dimensional point cloud model, and then obtaining a point cloud model of each object in the real scene; s3, calculating coordinates of each object in the real scene in the point cloud coordinate system; s4, when the size of the real scene is unknown, calculating the size of the real scene; s5, calculating coordinates of all objects in the real scene in the real scene coordinate system; and S6, ground detection is carried out, and map reconstruction is completed. According to the method for reconstructing the three-dimensional point cloud map in the closed environment of the humanoid robot, point cloud three-dimensional reconstruction is adopted, so that the humanoid robot adopts a mode which is more flexible and needs less hardware, and construction of an environment map and understanding of environment information in the closed environment are automatically completed.

title: AUTOMATED SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR THE HANGING OF LIVE BIRDS TO SLAUGHTER
abstract: The present invention regards an automated equipment and method for the hanging of live birds to slaughter where, notably, said method consists of the association of a novel anthropomorphic robot system endowed with a thermal vision system that promotes the automation of the stage of hanging of live birds, thereby dispensing with human participation and handling, thus allowing conformity with the humane slaughter of birds, in addition to enabling improvement in production control and planning. More precisely, this regards an automated equipment and method for the hanging of live birds (av) in equipment (E) of the noria type for slaughter, comprising a set of interdependent elements (CEI) and the respective automated method (10) that configure a correlated organization for the hanging of live birds (av) on conventional noria equipment (E).

title: Dynamic multi-obstacle avoidance method for humanoid robot based on bidirectional A* and local perception
abstract: A dynamic multi-obstacle avoidance method for a humanoid robot based on bidirectional A * and local perception comprises the following steps: S1, overall path planning: based on initial basic map information, determining an optimal path of the humanoid robot by using a bidirectional A * search algorithm; s2, local obstacle avoidance: when the position of the humanoid robot about to move coincides with the position of the dynamic obstacle, executing a local sensing algorithm; and S3, optimizing the path planning of the humanoid robot in the dynamic multi-obstacle environment in combination with the overall path planning and local obstacle avoidance. According to the humanoid robot dynamic multi-obstacle avoidance method based on bidirectional A * and local perception, the overall path is assisted by a bidirectional A * planned path, local obstacle avoidance is optimized mainly according to dynamic real-time obstacle avoidance, single perception is changed into bidirectional A * and local perception, exits are found from the two sides of the obstacle, the calculation amount is reduced, and the efficiency is improved. The problem that an A * algorithm is not applicable in a dynamic multi-obstacle environment is solved, and the method has a good application effect on scenes such as unknown forest crossing and cooperative combat.

title: 3 DEVICE METHOD AND PROGRAM RECORDING MEDIUM FOR IDENTIFYING HUMAN 3D WHOLE-BODY POSE/MOTION
abstract: The present invention relates to a device and method for identifying a three-dimensional whole-body pose of a subject, capable of providing a function of identifying a strong pose by using a human model configured based on a humanoid robot. The device comprises: an image acquisition unit in which one or more processors of an electronic device acquire an image of a subject through a camera connected to a robot device; a human body frame information generation unit generating human body frame information from the acquired image; an optimization unit executing an optimization algorithm which explores a photographing angle of the camera, a distance value between the camera and the subject, and the angle of whole-body joints in order to minimize an error in a distance between a two-dimensional pixel coordinate of major joints of a generated human body frame and a two-dimensional coordinate of a relevant joint in the human model when viewed from a front side or a side surface; and an identification unit executing human model pose simulation based on estimated joint angle information to identify the type and status of pose or motion of the subject.

title: Robot, control method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot, a control method and device of the robot and a storage medium. The control method comprises the steps that when the robot executes a first task, it is detected that a second task located on the upper layer of the first task is triggered, all task processes under the level where the second task is located are stopped, and the task process corresponding to the second task is executed. In the embodiment of the invention, the multiple tasks of the robot are divided into the multi-level structure, and the multi-task control is realized according to the priority of the multi-level structure, so that the multi-task capability of the bionic robot is improved, the automation requirement of the bionic robot in a living scene is met, and the bionic attribute and family attribute of the robot are improved.

title: Mouth structure of robot and robot
abstract: The invention provides a mouth structure of a robot and the robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The upper lip control assembly comprises a first upper lip peak control device, a second upper lip peak control device and an upper lip valley control device; the lower lip control assembly comprises a first lower lip peak control device, a second lower lip peak control device and a lip groove control device; the mouth corner control assembly comprises a first mouth corner control device and a second mouth corner control device. title: Mechanism for differentially driving shanks and soles to act through multiple connecting rods
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a multi-connecting-rod mechanism for differentially driving shanks and soles to act. According to the technical scheme, the mechanism comprises a thigh base body, the thigh base body is connected with a shank base body through a rotating shaft, the shank base body is rotationally connected with a cross beam rod, and driving mechanisms are connected between the two ends of the cross beam rod and the thigh base body; the end, connected with the cross beam rod, of the driving mechanism is connected with a steel wire rope, an ankle joint lever is rotationally connected to the shank base body, one end of the ankle joint lever is connected with the other end of the steel wire rope, and a sole assembly is rotationally connected to the lower end of the shank base body and connected with a sliding sleeve through a spline. And the other end of the ankle joint lever is rotationally connected with the side edge of the sliding sleeve. According to the multi-connecting-rod differential mechanism, a driving mechanism drives a shank base body to bend and a foot sole to twist.

title: Dynamic model modeling method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic model modeling method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly building a generalized coordinate system based on a floating base, so as to represent the motion of a three-dimensional space, enabling a wheel to be equivalent to a connecting rod, building an unconstrained dynamic model, building a constraint equation based on the instantaneous contact point constraint, and finally, carrying out the modeling of a dynamic model. An unconstrained dynamic model and a constraint equation are fused to establish a complete dynamic model, and based on the dynamic modeling method, the left leg and the right leg of the wheel-legged biped robot can realize different attitude control, so that real three-dimensional space motion can be realized.

title: Hip joint structure, leg structure and six-degree-of-freedom low-inertia robot bionic leg
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint structure, a leg structure and a six-degree-of-freedom low-inertia robot bionic leg, and belongs to bionic legs. The problems that an existing human-shaped bionic leg cannot achieve the purposes of multiple degrees of freedom, compact layout, light weight and low inertia at the same time are solved. The device comprises a hip joint structure and a leg structure; the leg structure comprises a thigh, a knee joint connecting shaft, a shank, an ankle joint universal joint assembly, a foot, a knee joint crank rocker driving assembly and an ankle joint crank rocker driving assembly; the thighs are rotationally connected with the shanks, and the shanks are rotationally connected with the feet through ankle joint universal joint assemblies; the fixed end of the knee joint crank rocker driving assembly is installed on the thigh, and the driving end is hinged to the shank and drives the shank to swing front and back, so that the pitching action of the shank is achieved. The fixed end of the ankle joint crank rocker driving assembly is installed on the thigh, and the driving end of the ankle joint crank rocker driving assembly is connected to the ankle joint universal joint assembly so that the pitching action and the side-sway action of the foot can be achieved. The robot leg is mainly used for design of robot legs.

The fixed end of the ankle joint crank rocker driving assembly is installed on the thigh, and the driving end of the ankle joint crank rocker driving assembly is connected to the ankle joint universal joint assembly so that the pitching action and the side-sway action of the foot can be achieved. The robot leg is mainly used for design of robot legs.

title: Mouth transmission mechanism, face structure and robot
abstract: The invention provides a mouth transmission mechanism, a face structure and a robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The mouth transmission mechanism comprises a fixing assembly; a lower jaw assembly; the transmission assembly comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod and a third connecting rod, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are rotationally arranged on the fixing assembly, and the third connecting rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting rod; and the driving assembly comprises a first driving part and a second driving part. In the mouth transmission mechanism, a first connecting rod, a lower jaw assembly, a third connecting rod and a second connecting rod are rotationally connected in sequence to form a multi-connecting-rod structure. During use, the first driving part acts on the first connecting rod to drive the lower jaw assembly to move so as to simulate stretching of the jaw. The second driving part acts on the second connecting rod to drive the lower jaw assembly to rotate so as to simulate opening and closing of the mouth. Compared with an existing humanoid robot which can only complete mouth opening and closing actions, the mouth transmission mechanism is higher in imitation degree and better in humanoid effect.

title: VR smart home robot
abstract: The invention provides a VR smart home robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the VR smart home robot comprises a robot shell, a recognition device is mounted above the trunk part of the robot shell, first transmission devices are connected to the two opposite sides of the trunk part respectively, and the working ends of the first transmission devices are connected with hand working devices through second transmission devices; a connecting device is installed below the trunk part, a walking seat is arranged at the bottom of the connecting device, the robot shell is further provided with a first controller, the first controller is electrically connected with a second controller through a wireless communication module, and the second controller is electrically connected with VR glasses. The first controller is electrically connected with the recognition device, the first transmission device, the second transmission device, the hand working device, the connecting device and the walking base. The robot is remotely controlled through the VR glasses to complete simple housework, the robot can restore actions made by people through the interaction handle to the maximum extent, and some complex hand actions can also be easily completed.

title: Humanoid sole structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid sole structure. According to the technical scheme, the humanoid sole structure comprises a rear sole, the front end of the rear sole is rotationally connected with a front sole, the front end of the rear sole and the rear end of the front sole are mutually pressed through a plate spring, and the rear sole is provided with a detection sensor. The humanoid sole structure provided by the invention can detect the stress condition of the sole in real time and simulate the rotation of the forefoot when the forefoot is subjected to external force.

title: Robot turning and squatting stable standing control method and device and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot turning and squatting stable standing control method, device and equipment and a storage medium, body sensing information of a target humanoid robot is obtained, and the body sensing information comprises a target rotation angle when a turning task is executed and a target pelvis height when a squatting task is executed; the ontology sensing information is input to a strategy network to obtain an output action, and the strategy network adopts reinforcement learning training in a simulator; the reward function comprises a first function for encouraging the robot to squat to a specified pelvis height, a second function for encouraging the movement speed of the pelvis in the z-axis direction to be close to an expected squatting speed in the squatting process of the robot, and a third function for encouraging the robot to turn to a specified angle; and the output action is converted into joint torque through the controller so as to control the robot to act. Loss of robot hardware equipment is avoided through simulation training. Reinforcement learning training is adopted, a strategy network with better performance can be obtained, and stable standing control over the robot in the turning and squatting process is achieved.

title: Upper limb structure device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an upper limb structure device of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, the upper limb structure device of the humanoid robot comprises a mechanical arm shoulder joint component mounted on the shoulder of the humanoid robot, and the upper limb structure device of the humanoid robot further comprises a connecting mechanism and four switching mechanisms, the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting seat, a middle groove penetrates through the middle part of the connecting seat, four equidistant mounting grooves are formed in the annular side wall of the connecting seat, the four switching mechanisms are located in the four mounting grooves correspondingly, the four switching mechanisms are arranged in an annular array with the middle groove as the axis, and a pull rod is pulled so that a short rod can be separated from a circular groove; then the pull rod is rotated to drive the rotating stand to rotate, so that a tool needing to be used rotates out of the mounting groove and rotates out of the rotating stand by 180 degrees to reach a vertical state, at the moment, the pull rod is reset to enable the short rod to be inserted into the circular groove again, the effect of fixing the positions of the rotating stand and the connecting frame is achieved, and the four rotating stands are convenient to adjust and rapid to switch.

title: Connecting rod type wrist action mechanism
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic wrists, and particularly relates to a connecting rod type wrist action mechanism. According to the technical scheme, the connecting rod type wrist action mechanism comprises a small arm structure, a cross shaft and a wrist rotating mechanism, the small arm structure is rotationally connected with the cross shaft, the wrist rotating mechanism is rotationally connected with the two sides of the cross shaft respectively, and a rotating shaft between the small arm structure and the cross shaft and a rotating shaft between the cross shaft and the wrist rotating mechanism are perpendicular to each other; two rotating power devices are installed on the small arm structure, the outer edges of the output ends of the rotating power devices are rotationally connected with connecting rods, the other ends of the connecting rods are connected with the corresponding sides of the wrist rotating mechanism through spherical hinges, and the connecting points of the connecting rods and the wrist rotating mechanism are staggered from a rotating shaft of the wrist rotating mechanism. The invention provides a connecting rod type wrist action mechanism capable of simulating up-and-down swing and left-and-right swing of a wrist of a human body.

title: Deformable humanoid intelligent robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of assistance for old people, in particular to a deformable humanoid intelligent robot. A deformable humanoid intelligent robot comprises a humanoid robot body, the humanoid robot body comprises a head assembly, a trunk assembly, two hand assemblies and two leg assemblies, the trunk assembly comprises a trunk shell, a reversible front chest plate is arranged on the front side of the trunk shell, a control handle is fixed to one side of the front chest plate, and the control handle is fixed to the other side of the trunk shell. The control handle is connected with the first MCU controller, two front wheel supports which are oppositely arranged are arranged in the trunk shell, the front wheel supports are movably connected with the front chest plate, and pedals and front wheels are arranged on the front wheel supports. The humanoid robot can be converted into an electric four-wheel walking-assistant wheelchair according to requirements, services can be conveniently provided for old people, the humanoid robot is also suitable for other people, and the humanoid robot body can carry a user, so that the user can be helped to carry articles on the back or support the user when needed, and then comfortable and intimate services are provided for the user.

title: Bidirectional transmission device and exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and provides a bidirectional transmission device and an exoskeleton robot, the bidirectional transmission device comprises a shell, a driving wheel, a line wheel assembly and a clutch assembly, and the driving wheel is in transmission connection with an external driving device; the line wheel assembly is rotatably arranged in the shell, the line wheel assembly comprises a first line wheel, a second line wheel, a first tensioning device and a second tensioning device which are oppositely arranged, the first tensioning device is in transmission connection with the first line wheel, and the second tensioning device is in transmission connection with the second line wheel; the clutch assembly comprises an offset cam and a driven wheel, the driven wheel is in transmission connection with the driving wheel, and the driving wheel can drive the driven wheel to rotate around the axis of the driven wheel. The invention further discloses the exoskeleton robot. According to the bidirectional transmission device, the first tensioning device and the second tensioning device are arranged on the first line wheel and the second line wheel correspondingly, so that when the joints of people apply force, instant assistance from the bidirectional transmission device is obtained.

title: Intelligent humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The intelligent humanoid mechanical arm is characterized in that a big arm structure is connected with a mounting rack through an angle adjusting mechanism which is connected with the big arm structure in a matched mode, the top end of a small arm structure is hinged to the bottom end of the big arm structure, and a hand structure is connected with the bottom end of the small arm structure in a matched mode through a connecting mechanism; the connecting mechanism comprises a connecting block fixedly connected to the hand structure, a connecting ball which is installed at the bottom end of the small arm structure in a nested mode and is combined with the small arm structure to form a spherical hinge structure, a connecting rod with the two ends fixedly connected with the connecting block and the connecting ball correspondingly, and a plurality of sets of electric telescopic rods evenly distributed on the periphery of the connecting ball. The two ends of the electric telescopic rod are hinged to the small arm structure and the connecting block correspondingly. The posture of the mechanical arm can be adjusted in a simple and efficient mode, the movement range of the mechanical arm can be effectively enlarged, and it is guaranteed that the degree of freedom of the mechanical arm is close to the degree of freedom of a human arm as much as possible.

title: Peripheral-central sensitization tactile sensing device based on double electric layer theory
abstract: The invention discloses a peripheral-central sensitization touch sensing device based on an electric double layer theory. The sensing device is mainly formed by combining an ionization sensor, an LM sensor and a synaptic transistor. Wherein the ionization sensor is connected in series with the grid electrode of the synaptic transistor, and the voltage input of the grid electrode of the synaptic transistor is adjusted through the ionization sensor so as to indirectly realize the regulation and control of the synaptic stimulation excitation current EPSC; and the LM sensor is connected in series with the source and drain electrodes of the synaptic transistor to directly regulate and control the synaptic stimulus excitation current EPSC between the source and drain electrodes. The characteristics of the ionization sensor, the LM sensor and the synaptic transistor are fully combined, the plastic characteristic and the sensitization characteristic are combined at the same time, and the humanoid robot can be endowed with the acute sensing ability and the injury stimulation prevention ability.

title: Bionic housekeeping robot and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic housekeeping robot and a control method. The robot comprises a bottom moving mechanism, a robot body, a head mechanism, a mechanical arm mechanism and a control module. The control module is used for processing the task instruction, so that the head mechanism is controlled to obtain the target object image information and the robot positioning information to simulate the visual function of the human brain, and then the actions of the bottom moving mechanism and the mechanical arm mechanism are correspondingly controlled according to the visual environment information; coordinated movement between hands, feet and eyes of the bionic housekeeping robot is achieved, and various housekeeping tasks including object grabbing, cleaning, even cooking, cleaning, nursing and the like can be completed. Therefore, according to the bionic housekeeping robot, the life quality can be improved, the labor burden of people can also be relieved, and the problem that at present, similar housekeeping robots are lacked to promote economic development and liberate labor force to meet the labor post requirement is solved.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a trunk assembly, arm assemblies are arranged on the two sides of the upper portion of a driving rod assembly, a waist-hip assembly is arranged at the bottom of the driving assembly, and leg assemblies are arranged on the two sides of the bottom of the waist-hip assembly; the waist-hip assembly comprises a trunk seat plate and a waist seat plate, and an electric push rod is arranged between the trunk seat plate and the waist seat plate; hip bone sleeves are rotationally arranged on the two sides of the bottom of the waist seat plate, hip bone joint frames are arranged at the ends of the hip bone sleeves, hip bone joint seats are rotationally arranged in the hip bone joint frames, and a first hip bone driving assembly and a second hip bone driving assembly are arranged on the surface of the waist seat plate. The robot has the beneficial effects that the whole robot is of a human-shaped structure, the driving assembly, the arm assemblies and the leg assemblies are driven by the waist-hip assembly to move integrally, and all parts of the robot can move integrally and partially at multiple degrees of freedom in cooperation with independent movement of the arm assemblies and the leg assemblies, and complex movement can be achieved.

title: Robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic products, and provides a robot and a control method thereof. The robot comprises a head, a main body, a man-machine interaction assembly and a controller. The head is rotatably arranged on the main body, and a rotation driving mechanism is arranged between the head and the main body; the man-machine interaction assembly is connected with the controller, and the controller is connected with the rotation driving mechanism. The man-machine interaction assembly is used for receiving input information of a user; the controller is used for determining the emotion type represented by the input information according to the input information and controlling the operation state of the rotary driving mechanism according to the emotion type so as to control the head to complete the pitching action corresponding to the emotion type. The robot disclosed by the invention can correspondingly express own emotions in a behavior action manner according to the emotions of the user, so that the man-machine interaction effect between the robot and the user is enhanced, the interestingness of the robot in practical application is ensured, and a relatively high personification degree is achieved.

title: Anthropomorphic motion planning method and device based on action primitives and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic motion planning method and device based on action primitives and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the subtask division of a to-be-executed task, and planning the execution sequence of the subtasks according to the task demands; capturing motion data of human arms when each subtask is executed, and constructing an action primitive library of each subtask through extraction and fitting quantification of action primitives under each task; and the motion primitive library of each subtask serves as a carrier to transfer the motion skill of the human arm to the anthropomorphic arm, and anthropomorphic motion planning of the redundant mechanical arm is achieved. The adaptive capacity of the robot to tasks can be improved while the data volume can be greatly reduced.

title: Test platform for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a test platform for a humanoid robot. The test platform comprises a manipulator (10), a positioning member (20), a holder (30), a depth camera (40), a laser radar (50), a control assembly (60), a power supply (70), a fixed frame (80) and a mobile platform (90). The fixed frame (80) is fixedly connected to the movable platform (90), and the positioning component (20) is fixedly connected to the fixed frame (80), so that a basic structure of the test platform is formed; the control assembly (60) and the power supply (70) are arranged in the fixed frame (80); the holder (30) is arranged at the top of the positioning component (20) and is provided with a depth camera (40); the manipulator (10) and the laser radar (50) are arranged around the positioning component (20); the control assembly (60) is electrically connected with the manipulator (10), the holder (30), the depth camera (40), the laser radar (50) and the power supply (70). The system has the advantages that the development period is shortened, and updating iteration is accelerated.

title: Variable stiffness driver based on magnetorheological elastomer
abstract: The invention discloses a variable-stiffness driver based on a magnetorheological elastomer. The variable-stiffness driver comprises an input connecting rod frame, a lever arm, an output connecting rod and a variable-stiffness mechanism, the input connecting rod frame forms a driver outer frame, provides space and positions for installation of other parts, and is provided with a driving motor. One end of the lever arm is fixedly connected with the driving motor and serves as a bridge for changing the balance position and arranging the variable stiffness mechanism; one end of the output connecting rod is mounted on the input connecting rod frame in a position coaxial with the driving motor through a rotating pair; the variable stiffness mechanism is composed of a spring-like mechanism and a push rod motor, the stiffness of the magnetorheological elastomer is influenced by changing an external magnetic field, and the change of the joint stiffness is realized by pre-tightening the spring-like mechanism through the push rod motor. Compared with a traditional variable-rigidity driver achieved through a pre-tightening spring, the variable-rigidity driver is larger in rigidity change range, more in change mode and higher in change speed, and application of the variable-rigidity driver in scenes such as biped robots is facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot somatosensory control method and control system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot somatosensory control method and a humanoid robot somatosensory control system. The humanoid robot somatosensory control method comprises the humanoid robot somatosensory control method and the humanoid robot somatosensory control system. The control method comprises the steps of human body image segmentation, joint part segmentation, decision tree classification, human body joint skeleton diagram construction, human body skeleton diagram recognition closest to a camera, calculation of the spherical coordinate offset of each joint of the skeleton diagram at the previous moment, calculation of angle transformation, and output of the offset of each joint. The control system comprises a human body depth map acquisition module, a Bluetooth serial port configuration module, a depth map image segmentation module, a joint point recognition module, a human body skeleton map construction module, a human body module which is closest to a camera, an angle calculation module, an angle output module, a human body real-time skeleton map drawing and outputting module and a downloading instruction module. By means of the method, wearable-free somatosensory control can be conducted on the 16-18-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot, and the real-time performance and accuracy of somatosensory control are effectively improved.

title: Modularized linear driving humanoid robot leg system with six degrees of freedom
abstract: The invention discloses a modular linear driving humanoid robot leg system with six degrees of freedom, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The problems that due to the fact that all joints of an existing humanoid robot are driven through rotating motors, the overall structure is complex, the total weight is large, and the bionic degree of a leg structure is not high are solved. The robot leg is mainly used for design of robot legs.

title: Six-degree-of-freedom parallel leg type biped robot
abstract: A six-degree-of-freedom parallel leg type biped robot comprises a common platform, the common platform is of a regular hexagon structure, six sets of motion units are evenly distributed on the edge of the common platform in a hinged mode, and three sets of motion units which are not adjacent to each other are connected with three ends of an upper arch to form outer legs; the other three groups of motion units are connected with three end parts of the lower arch to form inner legs; each moving unit comprises two electric cylinders, and the top of each electric cylinder is connected with the public platform through a hooke joint; and the bottom is in bolted connection with the end part of the upper arch/lower arch through a universal joint.

title: ROBOT AND ROBOT CONTROL METHOD
abstract: The present technology pertains to a robot and a method for controlling the robot, which enable the robot to hold smooth conversation with a user. This robot comprises: a head; a trunk including a waist equipped with a waist joint shaft that is capable of rotating at least in a pitch direction; a neck that is provided between the head and the trunk and that is equipped with a neck joint shaft that is capable of rotating at least in the pitch direction; a base that supports the trunk; and a behavior control unit that controls a peering motion which is a motion of peering into the face of a user by controlling the neck joint shaft and the waist joint shaft. The present technology is applicable to, for example, a nursing-care robot that implements care for a care receiver.

title: Human-simulated viscoelasticity compliance control method for lower limb exoskeleton
abstract: The invention provides an anthropomorphic viscoelastic compliance control method of a lower limb exoskeleton, comprising: combining a gait generator and a simulation previewing controller to obtain a gait and track generator, the gait generator being used for generating a sole desired track and a zero moment point desired track, and the track generator being used for generating a sole desired track and a zero moment point desired track; the simulation previewing controller is used for determining a mass center expected track according to the sole expected track and the zero moment point expected track; the viscoelastic compliance control frame corrects each mass center expected position in the mass center expected trajectory based on the mass center expected trajectory and the impact force between the sole and the ground to obtain a mass center corrected position; the inverse kinematics solver calculates the joint position according to the mass center correction position and the corresponding sole position; and the lower limb exoskeleton robot executes walking and standing tasks based on the joint positions. According to the humanoid viscoelasticity compliance control method for the lower limb exoskeleton, the walking stability of the robot is improved.

title: Motion control method and device, foot type robot and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to a motion control method and device, a foot type robot and electronic equipment. The motion control method comprises the steps that under the condition that the foot type robot is in a standing state, a control instruction is received; wherein the control instruction is used for controlling the foot type robot to move to a target position in one step, the distance between the target position and the standing position of the foot type robot is a target distance, and the target position is located in the target direction of the standing position; in response to the control instruction, determining a target correction parameter based on the target distance; and controlling a lower limb assembly of the foot type robot to move to the target position in one step according to the target correction parameter. By adopting the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the walking process of the robot can be effectively simplified, and the walking efficiency of the robot is improved.

title: Motion control method and system for wheeled biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method and system for a wheeled biped robot. The motion control method comprises the steps that a model prediction controller outputs generalized force spinor F needing to be applied to a trunk based on an input motion control instruction; the distance delta x between the trunk mass center of the robot and the wheel center point in the x-axis direction is solved; calculating a trunk roll angle based on a centrifugal force compensation strategy, and calculating wheel positions under a trunk coordinate system based on a terrain adaptation strategy; the expected leg joint angle, leg joint speed and swing rod pitch angle are obtained through inverse kinematics solution and serve as state input; the whole body controller is based on the generalized force spinor F obtained through solution of the model prediction controller and state input obtained through solution of inverse kinematics, dynamic feedforward and joint feedback are fused, and finally leg joint torque and wheel joint torque for controlling robot motion are obtained. The robustness of the robot during high-speed steering is enhanced, and rollover is prevented.

title: Mechanical leg and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a mechanical leg and a biped robot. The mechanical leg comprises a hip joint part, a thigh part, a knee joint part, a shank part and a foot part, the thigh part comprises a thigh front part and a thigh rear part, the upper end is rotationally connected to the hip joint part, and the lower end is rotationally connected to the knee joint part; the shank part comprises a shank front part and a shank rear part, the upper end is rotationally connected to the knee joint part, and the lower end is rotationally connected to the foot part; wherein the hip joint part, the thigh front part, the knee joint part and the thigh rear part form a first parallel connecting rod mechanism, the knee joint part, the shank front part, the foot part and the shank rear part form a second parallel four connecting rod mechanism, and the first parallel four connecting rod mechanism and the second parallel four connecting rod mechanism are matched to enable the foot part to be in a horizontal state when the foot part stands upright and moves. The control difficulty of the mechanical legs is reduced, and low-power-consumption gait walking of the robot is achieved; freedom degrees do not need to be set for the feet, the shank parts can be made thinner, and the weight, the cost and the control difficulty of the mechanical legs are reduced.

title: Information processing device, robot, and mobile terminal device
abstract: Provided is an information processing device that controls a motion of a robot having a torso and a head. title: Humanoid robot with subtemporal joint movement function
abstract: The humanoid robot with the subtemporal joint movement function comprises a trunk frame, a neck frame capable of rotating left and right is arranged at the upper end of the trunk frame, and a jaw bone mounting plate capable of moving up and down is arranged on the neck frame. An upper jawbone skeleton and an adjustable lower jawbone skeleton are arranged at the lower end of the jawbone mounting plate, a mounting opening is formed in the middle of the jawbone mounting plate, and a driving mechanism used for controlling the lower jawbone skeleton to move is arranged in the mounting opening. The two movable blocks are symmetrically arranged, the mandible skeleton is connected with the movable blocks, and the position of the mandible skeleton is adjusted by controlling the movable blocks to rotate, so that the angle of the mandible condylar tract is adjusted, the mandible of a human being in different states is simulated, the functionality of the robot is greatly improved, and the robot is suitable for popularization and application. In addition, people can observe the position of the mandible more directly when the angle of the condylar tract changes, and great convenience is brought to medical training items.

title: Biped robot anti-interference robust control method
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-interference robust control method for a biped robot, and the method combines a foothold adjustment method based on a capture point with a gait planning method based on virtual constraint, designs a feedback controller based on a linearization feedback control method, and achieves the stable walking of the biped robot under external interference. The positions of the foothold and the mass center of the biped robot can be dynamically adjusted in the walking process based on the track adjustment strategy of the capture point. And the positions of the foothold and the mass center are mapped into virtual constraints, and stable walking of the biped robot under disturbance can be achieved by accurately tracking the adjusted tracks of the mass center and the foothold. The method can adapt to different external disturbances, so that the robustness is high.

title: Exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides an exoskeleton robot which comprises a waist structure and a pair of leg structures, the leg structures are connected with the waist structure, the waist structure comprises a waist fixing part, a first sliding assembly, a pair of second sliding assemblies and a first rotating assembly, and the waist fixing part is used for being worn on the waist of the human body; the first sliding assembly is connected with the waist fixing piece; the pair of second sliding assemblies is connected with the first sliding assembly; the first rotating assembly is connected with the pair of second sliding assemblies, the first rotating assembly is connected with the pair of leg structures, and the first rotating assembly can rotate on the sagittal plane of the human body to provide assistance for abduction or adduction movement of the hip joint of the human body. title: Multifunctional biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to different working states
abstract: The invention relates to a multifunctional biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to different working states, the whole foot structure is designed in a functional modularization mode, when walking is needed, the foot structure obtains information of a foot sole sensor in real time, self-adaptive posture adjustment of a biped robot on the uneven and smooth ground is achieved through two stages, and the function of the biped robot is achieved. The two stages comprise preliminary fine adjustment of an anti-skid air cushion and torsional springs on the two sides and comprehensive adjustment of five toe joints and two foot side plates controlled by a pneumatic driving mechanism; when the biped robot is in the state that the foot structure needs to be fixed such as grabbing, the multiple pneumatic driving devices are driven to lift the toes and the side foot plates, the vacuum generator is driven, air in the self-adaptive suction cup mechanism is extracted, and the foot structure of the biped robot is firmly adsorbed to the ground. By means of the torsional spring characteristics and the pneumatic control technology, mechanisms such as toes and side foot plates are cooperatively controlled, and the adaptive capacity of the robot foot to the ground in different working states is achieved.

title: Wearable exoskeleton robot for reducing load below knee joint
abstract: The wearable exoskeleton robot comprises a receiving cavity for accommodating and connecting lower limbs of a human body, a parallel load module is arranged on the outer wall of the receiving cavity, the lower end of the parallel load module is connected with an ankle joint driving module, and a sole damping device is arranged in the ankle joint driving module. And the ankle joint driving module drives the human ankle joint and the sole damping device to rotate. Through the ankle joint driving module, human ankle joint movement is assisted, the influence of muscle force on loads borne by limbs below knee joints is reduced or eliminated, the parallel load module controls pressure borne by the limbs below the knee joints in the movement process, and the plantar damping device reduces impact force brought by the ground in the human movement process; the stored spring potential energy is converted into plantar flexion torque for assisting ankle joints in the supporting stage of the last walking stage, energy consumption of a main motor is reduced, and various patients needing to relieve loads of limbs below knee joints are helped to achieve normal walking and rehabilitation training.

title: Transmission structure, shank and foot driving mechanism, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a transmission structure, a shank and foot driving mechanism, a humanoid robot and a robot, the transmission structure comprises a crank, a rocker and a joint module for driving the crank and the rocker, the crank is provided with a flange plate and a supporting end which are coaxially arranged, and the joint module comprises a speed reducer with an output flange and a supporting piece. The supporting piece and the joint module are oppositely and fixedly arranged, the flange plate is fixedly connected with the output flange, and the supporting end is rotatably and fixedly connected with the supporting piece. title: Drive and control modularized direct current brush motor system
abstract: A drive and control modularized direct current brush motor system comprises a direct current power supply, a master controller, a motor controller, a driver and a direct current brush motor. The driver takes an H-bridge circuit as a core circuit; the master controller and the motor controller take a single-chip microcomputer as a core circuit, and the master controller communicates with the motor controller. One driver and one direct-current brush motor form a group of terminal modules; there are multiple groups of terminal modules. The motor controllers are located at the terminal modules, and one motor controller correspondingly controls one or more terminal modules. The structure of the utility model can reduce the number of internal leads of the humanoid robot and other structures, reduce physical interference and improve reliability, and the terminal module can be expanded.

title: Biped robot structure parameter optimization method based on fast Fourier transform
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot structure parameter optimization method based on fast Fourier transform, which comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional robot walking motion simplified model, performing numerical simulation, and extracting leg joint angle data; introducing a fast Fourier transform method to process the angle data, and decomposing the angle data into a plurality of groups of vectors; reconstructing and synthesizing different numbers of component groups into an angle curve through inverse fast Fourier transform; establishing a relation between the walking stability of the robot and the particle spatial characteristics, verifying the relation, and determining an optimal stability parameter by analyzing the particle spatial characteristics; aiming at a complex and compact mutual restriction relationship among robot structure parameters, the two structure parameters are changed at the same time, particle changes are observed, particle space features are analyzed, then the walking stability of the robot is evaluated and verified through a traditional method, and finally optimization of two-dimensional parameter combination of the robot is achieved. Optimized design of the leg structure parameters of the robot is achieved, and the walking stability is further improved.

title: Robot assembly and humanoid robot

title: Battery management system and method for biped robot

title: Bionic robot face tracking method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot face tracking method and device, and the method comprises the following steps: a robot periodically collects a picture image, carries out the detection of the collected picture image, and judges whether a target face exists or not; calculating position information of a target face relative to a specified point of the head of the robot, judging whether the position information is within a preset range, and if not, determining rotation information required by the head of the robot to rotate to the preset range; and driving the robot head to rotate according to the rotation information so as to track the face. According to the invention, face recognition and automatic tracking are combined together, so that the robot is more vivid and intelligent when interacting with the user.

title: Mechanical arm self-weight balance mechanism arranged in arm length direction
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical arm self-weight balance mechanism arranged in the arm length direction, and the mechanical arm self-weight balance mechanism is composed of a first mechanical arm (1), a base body (second mechanical arm) (11), a clockwork spring cavity (5), a clockwork spring (3), a distribution pinion shaft (4), a rack (9) and the like. Torque brought by the clockwork spring is transmitted through the rack and the gear, the torque brought by the gravity of the mechanical arm can be partially or completely overcome, and the driving torque or driving force needed by the mechanical arm is reduced. The mechanical arm is suitable for crane mechanical arms, engineering excavators, loader mechanical arms, concrete pump truck output mechanical arms, industrial production line robot mechanical arms, marine loading mechanical arms and airport loading mechanical arms, is particularly suitable for mechanical arms of vehicle-mounted cranes and humanoid robots, and is wide in application range and high in practicability.

title: Humanoid robot heat dissipation flexible shell structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a radiating flexible shell structure of a humanoid robot. The heat dissipation flexible shell structure of the humanoid robot comprises humanoid robot skin, a heat dissipation layer, humanoid robot body, a heat absorption layer and a heat conduction piece. The heat absorption layer absorbs heat generated by a heating device in the humanoid robot body through air and a direct contact mode, the heat absorbed by the heat absorption layer is conducted into the heat dissipation layer through the heat conduction pieces and then dissipated out through the skin, tightly attached to the heat dissipation layer, of the humanoid robot and the tiny heat dissipation holes, and therefore the heat dissipation capacity of the flexible shell of the humanoid robot is improved. The skin of the humanoid robot is made of a simulated skin material with silica gel as a base material, the body of the humanoid robot is made of a rubber composite material with good elasticity, the heat absorption layer and the heat dissipation layer are metal foils with rough surfaces, the heat conduction sheet is a copper foil with high heat conductivity, and when the foils are very thin, the flexibility similar to that of paper can be shown. In conclusion, the purpose of good flexibility of the shell of the humanoid robot can be achieved.

title: Method for chess playing recognition based on humanoid robot
abstract: The present invention provides a method for chess playing recognition based on humanoid robot, which conducts the following steps through the loading of a robot: capturing an image of a checkerboard from at least a photographic apparatus the robot configured; obtaining the intersection of the image by point detection; processing binarization on the image; obtaining the two-dimensional coordinate of the said intersection via a calibration function. Therefore, the present invention can detect the actual position of each points of the checkerboard by letting robot capture an image of a checkerboard, which is helpful for follow-up processing. The robot can plan strategy for chess playing accordingly and process control of its motion mode that can move and place the corresponding chess piece to specified position. The robot can thereby play chess interactively with a user or other robot.

Therefore, the present invention can make a robot recognize color and shape of a target object on the captured image, which is helpful for robots to simulate humanity's visual perception and promote related applications on vision.

title: Flow and flow direction control system suitable for joint swing of hydrodynamic humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of valve control, and discloses a flow and flow direction control system (control system for short) suitable for joint swing of a hydrodynamic humanoid robot. According to the control system, a rotary flow control valve technology is applied, and the flow and the flow direction of joint swing of the hydrodynamic force humanoid robot are controlled by controlling the rotating direction and the rotating angle of a stepping motor of a rotary flow control valve. The control system mainly comprises a stepping motor of the rotary flow control valve, a driver, a single-chip microcomputer controller, a rotation angle position signal device and a humanoid robot computer control center. According to the control system, the rotating angle range of the stepping motor is controlled to swing between the center of the opening D and the center of the opening F in the center of the outlet B by utilizing the position characteristics of the opening and the outlet of the rotary flow control valve and the rotating characteristic of the stepping motor, grading is carried out according to the flow change, and the control program is simplified. The control system adopts a rotation angle position signal device to carry out closed-loop control.

title: Social robot and interaction method

title: Humanoid gait walking control method for wheel-foot robot based on position compensation
abstract: The invention relates to a position compensation-based humanoid gait walking control method for a wheel-foot robot, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, calculating an included angle between a connecting line of a dynamic platform and a static platform and a vertical Z direction according to coordinates of a foot end expected position given by a Bezier curve and the structural size of the wheel-foot robot; then the position compensation amount of the supporting phase movement platform and the position compensation amount of the swinging phase movement platform are calculated; and finally, obtaining the expansion and contraction quantity of the swing phase electric cylinder and the expansion and contraction quantity of the support phase electric cylinder through inverse kinematics, taking the expansion and contraction quantity of the swing phase electric cylinder as an expected value, and executing by an executing mechanism of the current wobble wheel foot to complete corresponding swing leg stretching actions. The expansion amount of the electric cylinder of the supporting phase serves as an expected value and is executed by an executing mechanism of the current supporting wheel foot to complete corresponding supporting actions; each wheel foot of the wheel foot robot alternately performs actions of a supporting phase and a swinging phase, so that humanoid gait walking is completed.

title: Humanoid robot leg linear actuator
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of transmission devices and humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot leg linear actuator. The actuator comprises a shell and joint output ends arranged at the two ends of the shell correspondingly. A motor unit for converting electric energy into rotating kinetic energy, a planetary roller screw pair unit for converting the rotating kinetic energy into linear kinetic energy, and a first-stage angle detection unit and a second-stage angle detection unit for jointly determining the position of the planetary roller screw pair unit are arranged in the shell. And installation, disassembly and maintenance are easy.

title: Biped robot motion control method and system and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot motion control method and system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that a strategy network is obtained through auxiliary reward training; the strategy network generates a control signal according to the received control instruction and the current state of the biped robot; the control assembly controls the biped robot to move based on the control signal; wherein the auxiliary reward is used for feeding back training actions of the biped robot and optimizing a strategy network in training; the strategy network obtains a current state based on the control instruction; and the control assembly drives the joints of the biped robot to rotate so that the biped robot tends to the state required by the control instruction from the current state. According to the control method of the biped robot provided by the invention, the rotation of the joints of the biped robot is controlled through the strategy network which assists in reward pre-training, so that the motion fluency of the biped robot is improved, and the consistency of the trunk and the four limbs of the biped robot is improved.

title: Unidirectional swinging structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot one-way swing structure which comprises a power device fixing frame used for fixing a power device, and one end of the power device fixing frame is connected with a swing part fixing rod through a hinge C; one end of the power device is connected with the power device dowel bar, the power device provides motion power for the power device dowel bar, and the motion power of the power device dowel bar is transmitted to the power connecting rod through the hinge A and then transmitted to the swing part fixing rod through the hinge B, so that the swing part fixing rod rotates around the central axis of the hinge C, and the swing part fixing rod and the swing part are fixed. Therefore, the purpose that the swing part swings around the central axis of the hinge C is achieved. The hinge can be used for knee joints, elbow joints and finger joints of a humanoid robot, and the vertical distance between the hinge A and the hinge C is larger than the distance between the hinge A and the section centroid of the swing part, so that compared with a component with the section centroid of the swing part as the rotating axis, the output rotating torque is large under the same power.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The biped robot comprises first hip joint driving modules, second hip joint driving modules, a crotch part and two leg parts located on the left side and the right side of the crotch part, and the left side and the right side of the crotch part are each provided with one first hip joint driving module and one second hip joint driving module. title: Progressive humanoid robot simulation and control algorithm under constraint of ill-conditioned data
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a progressive humanoid robot simulation and control algorithm under ill-conditioned data constraint, and the algorithm comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out the pre-training of an underlying strategy model based on a constrained progressive simulation learning algorithm and an unsupervised reinforcement learning algorithm, and obtaining a plurality of general skills; then, all parameters of the underlying strategy model are frozen, a task strategy is trained, and various general skills are combined to complete a specific complex task; and finally, verifying the trained task strategy in a simulation environment. According to the method, firstly, a large number of unstructured motion editing data sets are utilized, a series of reusable general skills are obtained by pre-training an underlying strategy, then the task strategy is trained after the parameters of the underlying strategy are frozen, and the humanoid robot can make coherent humanoid actions while executing complex motion skills.

title: Biped robot motion planning method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot motion planning method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a discrete map with topographic information corresponding to a to-be-walked region, determining topographic points representing that a biped robot is allowed to pass through in the discrete map, and generating a preliminary foothold point sequence; generating a preliminary motion track of the biped robot based on the discrete map; and based on a preset objective function, optimizing the preliminary foothold sequence according to the preliminary motion track and a preset kinematics model of the biped robot, and generating a target foothold sequence, so that the biped robot executes the target foothold sequence to complete motion. The method comprises the following steps of: judging whether a position can pass or serve as a foothold of the biped robot according to gradient information of ground height in a discrete map by utilizing kinematics characteristics of the biped robot, and performing parameter optimization on the foothold to obtain a target foothold sequence; therefore, the biped robot can complete the crossing task more efficiently in combination with the topographic characteristics.

title: Humanoid robot real-time control system and method integrating electroencephalogram, myoelectricity and monocular vision
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot real-time control system and method fusing brain myoelectricity and monocular vision, and relates to the technical field of multi-mode and multi-mode humanoid robot control. The system comprises a posture data acquisition system, a myoelectricity data acquisition system, an electroencephalogram data acquisition system, a computer system, a data transmission module and a humanoid robot, the posture data acquisition system is used for acquiring a two-dimensional motion video of the whole body of the user; the myoelectricity data acquisition system is used for acquiring arm action myoelectricity signals of a user; the electroencephalogram data acquisition system acquires motor imagery electroencephalogram signals of a user; and the computer system converts the received two-dimensional motion videos, the arm motion electromyographic signals and the motion imagination electroencephalogram signals into corresponding control instructions to control the humanoid robot to make corresponding motions. According to the system and the method, various kinds of information are fused, monocular vision information is used for controlling actions of a large joint body of the humanoid robot, and myoelectricity information is used for finely controlling actions of hands and wrists of the humanoid robot.
