title: Thigh plate of hydraulic biped robot and hydraulic biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of hydraulic robot body structure design, and discloses a hydraulic biped robot thigh plate and a hydraulic biped robot, a hydraulic oil transmission channel is formed in the thigh plate, and the hydraulic oil transmission channel is embedded in the thigh plate; a plurality of heat dissipation through holes are formed in the thigh plate at intervals, so that a heat dissipation grid is formed in the area, where the heat dissipation through holes are formed, of the thigh plate. title: Artificial muscle fiber bundling device with multiple motion modes and method
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial muscle fiber bundling device with multiple motion modes and a method. The artificial muscle fiber bundling device comprises a spiral artificial muscle fiber basic unit, a packaging material, an electrode interface and a driving control system, the artificial muscle fiber basic units can extend or contract in response to an external electric field; a plurality of artificial muscle fiber basic units are bundled in a parallel connection or series connection combination mode or a parallel connection and series connection combination mode, two leads of each basic unit are connected into an electrode interface, and finally the artificial muscle fiber bundling device is prepared through overall packaging. According to the artificial muscle fiber bundling device, cooperative control over a single fiber basic unit can be completed through the driving control system, stretching, contracting, bending and twisting motion modes of a bundle are achieved, and meanwhile the characteristics of strain self-sensing, high electrical stability and the like are achieved; the method is suitable for application scenes such as flexible robots, humanoid robots, intelligent prostheses, pipeline robots and underwater robots.

title: Strategy network training method and humanoid biped robot gait control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot automation, and provides a strategy network training method and a humanoid biped robot gait control method.According to the training method, a target strategy network is obtained through a deep reinforcement learning method, a complex gait library does not need to be constructed, additional data collection cost and calculation cost do not need to be increased, and the training efficiency is improved. The target strategy network can have the function of controlling the humanoid biped robot to realize natural, stable, symmetrical and coordinated walking gaits, and the robustness and anti-interference performance of the target strategy network are improved.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. title: Cooperative driving terrain self-adaptive bionic ankle joint exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides a synergistically-driven terrain self-adaptive bionic ankle joint exoskeleton robot. The robot comprises a supporting structure; the supporting structure comprises a stand column, a support and a bottom plate. The stand column is vertically arranged, the upper end of the stand column is connected with the support, and the lower end of the stand column is rotationally connected with the bottom plate. abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. title: Biped robot gait control method and device, storage medium and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait control method and device, a storage medium and equipment. The method comprises the steps that firstly, body information of a target biped robot is obtained; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring ontology information of a target biped robot, generating a task label and a speed instruction input by a user in response to a triggering operation of a target user on the target biped robot, inputting the ontology information, the task label and the speed instruction into a pre-constructed gait control model, and predicting to obtain a gait action track of the target biped robot; and then the gait motion track is utilized to carry out gait motion control on the target biped robot so as to realize stable switching among various gaits of the target biped robot. According to the method, the simulation ontology information of the biped robot is firstly utilized, and the gait control model is obtained through training in a deep reinforcement learning and imitation learning combined training mode, so that the gait control model can realize control generation of various gait action tracks; and therefore, stable switching among various gaits of the target biped robot can be controlled.

title: Integrated linear driving electric cylinder integrating driving, sensing and control
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated linear driving electric cylinder integrating driving, sensing and control, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problems that an electric cylinder has certain disadvantages in power output, integration level, light weight, structural strength, power consumption and movement speed are solved. An electric cylinder transmission module and a direct-current brushless motor are arranged in an electric cylinder shell; the electric cylinder transmission module is rotationally connected with the electric cylinder shell; the power-off braking module, the tension/pressure stress sensor and the electromagnetic encoder are arranged at one end of the electric cylinder transmission module and are connected with the drive control integrated circuit board; one end of the electric cylinder transmission module is connected with the power-off braking module, and the other end is connected with the power output module; the power output module is slidably connected with the outer wall of the electric cylinder shell. The drive control integrated circuit board is installed on the outer side wall of the electric cylinder shell and connected with the direct-current brushless motor. The potentiometer displacement sensor and the Hall limiting sensor are installed on the power output module and connected with the drive control integrated circuit board. The driving device is used for driving the joints of the humanoid robot.

title: Walking control method and device based on complex terrain and biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a walking control method and device based on complex terrains and a biped robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring topographic information of a current road surface, and determining topographic fitness according to the topographic information; determining an adaptable area in the current road surface based on the terrain fitness; on the basis of walking parameters of the biped robot, in the adaptable area, selectable footholds are determined; determining a target foothold of the biped robot based on the selectable foothold; generating a walking path based on the target foothold; and based on the walking path, controlling the biped robot to walk to a target site. By means of the mode, in the complex terrain, the biped robot is controlled to walk stably, the falling phenomenon is avoided, and the biped robot can pass rapidly and stably.

title: Humanoid robot based on visual identification and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on visual recognition and a working method thereof, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and a camera needs to be installed to collect images for movement of the humanoid robot. In order to solve the problems that high light of the sun or a high-energy light beam generated by laser may cause heat accumulation on a photosensitive element in a camera and causes element failure or burnout, a trunk area is arranged in the middle of a humanoid robot body, a head area is arranged above the trunk area, and a camera is arranged above the head area. Arm areas are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the trunk area, leg areas are symmetrically arranged below the trunk area, camera shooting protection glass is arranged in the middle of the front end of the head area, a light filtering film winding drum is arranged above the camera shooting protection glass, and a light filtering film is wound in the light filtering film winding drum.

title: Integrated seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm which is characterized in that the humanoid mechanical arm (1) comprises an upper arm module (2) and a front arm module (3), and the upper arm module (2) is connected with the front arm module (3); the upper arm module (2) comprises a shoulder joint two-degree-of-freedom integration module (4), an upper arm rotation degree-of-freedom and electric speed controller installation module (5), an upper arm main control core module (6) and an elbow joint integration module (7); the forearm module (3) comprises a forearm wrist rotating module (27), a wrist cutting connecting rod system, a wrist turning module and a humanoid shell. According to the invention, the proper motor rotor and harmonic reducer are selected, and more reasonable and more compact driver arrangement is carried out on the key wrist joint and shoulder joint, so that the system is more compact and has a proper joint limit angle. The invention provides a layout structure suitable for the humanoid mechanical arm, so that the layout of the system is more reasonable and natural on the premise of ensuring that the strength and moment performance of the system are stable and reliable.

title: Multi-mode intelligent sensing and interaction service robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-mode intelligent sensing and interaction service robot which is characterized by comprising a robot body of a humanoid vertical structure, the bottom of the robot body is connected with a walking device, and a plurality of functional modules are installed on the robot body. The function module at least comprises a motor driving module, a power supply module, a sensing module, an interaction module and a communication module; the robot body is further provided with a main controller connected with all the function modules, and the main controller is connected with a cloud database and controls all the function modules to work. The motor driving module is connected with the walking device, drives the walking device to move and drives the robot body and the walking device to move synchronously; the power supply module is used for supplying power to other functional modules and the main controller. According to the utility model, data perception, intelligent interaction and remote control in remote monitoring can be realized, the workload of monitoring personnel is reduced, the direct contact between the monitoring personnel and monitored personnel is reduced, and the system can be widely applied to epidemic situation prevention and control and intelligent health monitoring.

title: Joint module motor and joint module for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a joint module motor for a humanoid robot and a joint module, and relates to the technical field of motors, the joint module motor comprises an upper positioning iron core and a lower positioning iron core, one side of the upper positioning iron core and one side of the lower positioning iron core are both provided with limiting grooves, the limiting grooves are arranged to be semicircular, the two limiting grooves define a limiting cavity, and the limiting cavity is provided with a limiting groove. A winding is mounted on the inner wall of the limiting cavity, a driving shaft is slidably mounted in the winding, a permanent magnet is fixedly mounted on the outer wall of the driving shaft, and the driving shaft is arranged to be annular; according to the designed motor structure, through the iron core and the limiting grooves, the winding units are annularly arranged and installed, the driving shaft of the annular structure is arranged in the winding, and the permanent magnet is fixed to the driving shaft, that is, the permanent magnet of the motor is located in the winding coil, so that end magnetic leakage cannot be generated in the working process, and the service life of the motor is prolonged. And the magnetic performance of the permanent magnet can be fully utilized.

title: HUMANOID VISION MODULE BASED ON THE CENTRAL PROJECTION ALLOWING THE DETERMINATION OF SPATIAL LOCATION AND THE MEASURING OF DISTANCES
abstract: The characteristic of the present invention is that it enables spatial position determination and distance measurement according to the laws of central projection. The panoramic peripheral field of view created in this way provides a two-dimensional skeleton of the three-dimensional space, and inside the circular field located inside the ring image appearing at this time, according to the principle of looking through a window, an arbitrary segment of the peripheral field of view appears at an arbitrary reduction/magnification scale. The simultaneous mapping of three-dimensional space based on the central principle and on the principle of looking through a window, which is a feature of this humanoid vision module, enables the spatial position and distance from each other of the points thus displayed to be determined using simple trigonometric relationships.

title: Biped bionic robot dynamics modeling method and device and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a biped bionic robot dynamics modeling method and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: abstracting a biped bionic robot into a multi-link rigid body system comprising a trunk, a right thigh, a right shank, a left thigh, a left shank, a right upper arm, a right small arm, a left upper arm and a left small arm; establishing a coordinate system by taking the tail end of the supporting leg as an original point, and constructing a dynamic model of each subsystem and a constraint relationship between the subsystems when the single-leg supporting phase and the double-leg supporting phase are carried out; and according to the constructed dynamic model of each subsystem and the constraint relationship among the subsystems, a constraint dynamic system is constructed in a hierarchical manner based on a UK equation, and a complete dynamic model of the biped bionic robot is obtained. The method has the advantages of being simple in implementation method, small in calculation amount, high in modeling efficiency and precision and the like.

title: Humanoid manipulation type robot heavy load transporter and transporting method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid manipulated robot heavy-load transporter calibrated by means of machine vision and a transporting method. The humanoid manipulation type robot heavy load transporter comprises a power-assisted transporting unit, a feeding station unit arranged on the feeding side of the power-assisted transporting unit, a moving platform unit arranged on the discharging side and a double-arm robot unit. And the double-arm robot unit executes automatic operation and manipulates the power-assisted carrying unit to complete the full-automatic conveying and positioning function of the heavy-load workpieces from the feeding station to the moving platform. The power-assisted carrying unit is composed of a power-assisted carrying device and a lifting device matched with the power-assisted carrying device. The feeding station unit is composed of a material frame body, a base, a material frame clamping and positioning device and a workpiece positioning device. The moving platform unit is composed of a moving platform body, walking wheels, a latent AGV, a magnetic strip, a workpiece positioning device, a workpiece clamping device and the like. The double-arm robot unit is composed of a double-arm robot operation machine, a workpiece picking device, a machine vision positioning device and a tightening operation tool.

title: Novel humanoid flexible parallel wrist joint with redundant drive
abstract: The invention discloses a novel humanoid flexible parallel wrist joint with redundant drive, which is characterized by comprising a movable platform (1), a middle branch chain (2), a first drive branch chain (3-1), a second drive branch chain (3-2), a third drive branch chain (3-2) and a base (4). Based on bionics, a bony structure and a muscle system of the wrist joint of the human body are subjected to bionic design, rope driving is adopted, the high-rigidity bearing ratio is achieved, driving redundancy is achieved, and the good man-machine interaction performance is achieved. An external rope can be pulled through three motors, rotation of the motors is converted into movement of the rope through a movable pulley, and therefore two-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved, and the robot is suitable for industrial robot tail end wrist joints, humanoid arm wrist joints, intelligent artificial limbs and other occasions.

title: Humanoid robot gait disturbance recovery control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait anti-interference recovery control algorithm, which is characterized in that a new simplified model, namely a three-mass flywheel linear inverted pendulum model, is adopted to describe the kinematics of a robot, and a motion divergence algorithm is improved on the model. Stable walking can be realized only by controlling the essentially unstable part of the movement divergence; when the robot is interfered by external force, compensation torque is deduced through movement divergence deviation, the torque is applied to the hip joint of the robot, the mass center of the robot and the track of the movement divergence can be corrected in time in a walking period after collision, and stable walking in the collision environment is achieved. According to the method, the problem that the motion range of a traditional zero moment point or a pressure center of the robot is limited is fully considered, a control target is transferred to the hip joint of the robot, the anti-interference performance of the robot is improved, and walking of the robot is more intelligent.

title: Motion control method, motion control device, humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method and device, a humanoid robot and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps that for each video frame in a teaching video, three-dimensional coordinates of key points are extracted from the video frame, and the teaching video comprises human body teaching motion information; according to the three-dimensional coordinates and a preset robot skeleton, relative position coordinates of a target key point pair are obtained, and the robot skeleton is constructed based on the humanoid robot; the number of the target key point pairs is multiple, and two key points in each target key point pair are directly associated; based on the relative position coordinates of the target key point pairs, joint angles of all joints of the humanoid robot are obtained through inverse kinematics solution; and each joint of the robot is controlled to move based on the corresponding joint angle. By means of the scheme, action teaching based on visual recognition can be achieved, and the similarity and stability of robot movement can be guaranteed.

title: Silica gel robot head maintenance support
abstract: The utility model discloses a silica gel robot head maintenance support, and particularly relates to the field of humanoid robots, the silica gel robot head maintenance support comprises a base sliding rail, a base stand column is fixedly arranged on one side of the base sliding rail, a sliding rail sleeve is arranged on the base sliding rail in a sliding mode, and a first bearing beam is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the sliding rail sleeve; a base sleeve is fixedly arranged at the upper end of the first bearing beam, a second bearing beam is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the base stand column, the base stand column is sleeved with a locking sleeve, and a locking beam is fixedly arranged on the inner side of the locking sleeve. According to the device, only the afterbrain part of the scalp is opened and fixed through the maintenance support so that local uncovering maintenance can be conveniently conducted on the afterbrain, meanwhile, the cheek part is not dragged, high-elasticity face skin with the afterbrain stripped is bound through the second bearing beam and the locking beam on the maintenance support, and maintenance can be independently completed by one maintenance worker after the two hands of the maintenance worker are vacated.

title: Biped robot balancing method, device and equipment based on flywheel and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot balancing method and device based on a flywheel, electronic equipment and a storage medium, the method comprises the following steps: when it is monitored that a single foot of a biped robot stands, carrying out roll detection on the biped robot to obtain a roll angle; calculating the robot angular momentum of the biped robot according to the roll angle; calculating flywheel angular momentum required by a flywheel of the biped robot according to the robot angular momentum; according to the flywheel angular momentum, the rotating speed and the rotating direction of a flywheel of the biped robot are determined; and controlling the flywheel to rotate according to the rotating speed and the rotating direction. The stability and balance capacity of the biped robot in the movement process can be improved.

title: Hydraulically-driven lower limb mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven humanoid robot lower limb mechanism which comprises two sets of leg structures arranged below a hip mechanism G. Each leg structure comprises a foot mechanism A, an ankle driving mechanism B, a shank mechanism C, a knee driving mechanism D, a thigh mechanism E and a hip driving mechanism F. Each leg structure has six degrees of freedom. The six degrees of freedom of the right leg comprise the hip rotation degree of freedom Rj0, the hip side-sway degree of freedom Rj1, the hip pitching degree of freedom Rj2, the knee pitching degree of freedom Rj3, the ankle pitching degree of freedom Rj4 and the ankle side-sway degree of freedom Rj5. The leg structure of the humanoid robot is light and flexible, the power density of the robot is improved, the operation efficiency of the robot is enhanced, and the working time of the robot is prolonged.

title: Leg driving structure of biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg driving structure of a biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot. The thigh joint module comprises a speed reducer with a second output flange; a hip supporting piece, a leg swinging supporting piece, a thigh supporting piece and a thigh; and a first bearing and a second bearing. The first output flange of the swing leg joint module drives the swing leg supporting piece to rotate and supports the swing leg supporting piece to rotate through the first bearing, and the second output flange of the thigh joint module drives the thigh to rotate and supports the thigh to rotate through the second bearing. The axial torque of the rotating shaft which at least partially deviates from the first output flange or at least partially deviates from the second output flange can be offset, the problems that due to long-term existence of the torque, gear abrasion is caused, and then abnormal heating and abnormal sound are caused when a speed reducer works are solved, the effective working life of the joint module is prolonged, and the structural strength is improved; and the maximum load capacity of the robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid model arm
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid model arm which comprises a palm and an arm body, the palm is rotationally connected with the arm body, a locking plate is fixedly arranged at the end, facing the arm body, of the palm, a fixing plate is fixedly arranged at the end, facing the palm, of the arm body, and a protruding column is axially connected to the fixing plate in a telescopic mode. The locking plate is provided with a through hole allowing the protruding column to penetrate, a clamping column is arranged on the side wall of the protruding column in a protruding mode, a notch allowing the clamping column to pass through is formed in the side wall of the through hole, a distance exists between the clamping column and the fixing plate and is equal to the thickness of the locking plate, and when the arm body and the palm are installed, the clamping column is aligned with the notch, so that the clamping column and the palm can be locked. The clamping column enters the palm through the notch, then the palm is rotated, dislocation of the notch and the clamping column can be achieved, at the moment, the palm is installed, detachable connection of the palm and the arm body is achieved in a rotary clamping mode, and installation and disassembly operation is convenient and fast.

title: Dynamic eyelid device of humanoid simulation robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid simulation robot dynamic eyelid device, and particularly relates to the humanoid robot expression modeling field, the humanoid simulation robot dynamic eyelid device comprises a base, the upper end of one side of the base is fixedly provided with a support frame, and the upper end of the support frame is provided with a rotatable extension shaft in a penetrating manner; an extending shaft is fixedly arranged on the base, an eyelid rotating base plate is fixedly arranged in the middle of the extending shaft, the eyelid rotating base plate is connected with an up-down stay wire rotating mechanism, the two ends of the extending shaft are fixedly connected with the inner side wall of the eyelid, and an eyeball is fixedly arranged at one end of the base; according to the device, the compensation straightening design for assisting knotting of the stay wire is adopted, redundant looseness after the stay wire is knotted is compensated and straightened through the binding belt, finally, the stay wire is straightened through the combined effect of the stay wire and the binding belt, the cost and assembly advantages of the stay wire structure are reserved, meanwhile, the original defects of the stay wire structure are overcome, and the structure is simple and convenient. Finally, the convenient stay wire control structure can be realized on the ground, and the consistency requirement of mass production is met.

title: Humanoid robot heat dissipation flexible shell structure
abstract: The invention discloses a heat dissipation flexible shell structure of a humanoid robot. The heat dissipation flexible shell structure of the humanoid robot comprises humanoid robot skin, a heat dissipation layer, humanoid robot body, a heat absorption layer and a heat conduction piece. The heat absorption layer absorbs heat generated by a heating device in the humanoid robot body through air and a direct contact mode, the heat absorbed by the heat absorption layer is conducted into the heat dissipation layer through the heat conduction pieces and then dissipated out through the skin, tightly attached to the heat dissipation layer, of the humanoid robot and the tiny heat dissipation holes, and therefore the heat dissipation capacity of the flexible shell of the humanoid robot is improved. The skin of the humanoid robot is made of a simulated skin material with silica gel as a base material, the body of the humanoid robot is made of a rubber composite material with good elasticity, the heat absorption layer and the heat dissipation layer are metal foils with rough surfaces, the heat conduction sheet is a copper foil with high heat conductivity, and when the foils are very thin, the flexibility similar to that of paper can be shown. In conclusion, the purpose of good flexibility of the shell of the humanoid robot can be achieved.

title: Method for remotely operating humanoid robot by identifying hand postures through virtual reality glasses
abstract: The invention relates to a method for remotely operating a humanoid robot by identifying hand postures through virtual reality glasses, which can enable an operator only to wear one virtual reality glasses, map information such as head postures, external environment and limb movement of the operator sensed by the virtual reality glasses to an entity humanoid robot, and realize remote control of the humanoid robot. Therefore, the teleoperation control of the humanoid robot can be realized. And moreover, the operation immediacy and transparency can be improved, and the operation complexity is simplified.

title: Shank structure and leg structure of biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a shank structure of a biped robot, a leg structure, a humanoid robot and a robotic.The shank structure of the biped robot comprises a shank, the two ends of the shank are each provided with a position where a bearing can be installed, the upper end of the shank is hinged to a thigh, and the lower end of the shank is hinged to a foot; therefore, the main structure of the leg structure of the biped robot is formed, the leg structure composed of the thighs, the shanks and the feet can be conveniently disassembled, assembly and disassembly of the shanks, the thighs and the feet can be rapidly completed, the process is simple and convenient, the convenience of production and application is improved, and therefore the production efficiency is improved.

title: Humanoid robot and humanoid robot control method
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of lighting equipment, and provides a humanoid robot and a humanoid robot control method.The humanoid robot comprises a main body, an electric power storage part is arranged in the main body; the manipulator is mounted on the main body, the manipulator comprises a holding part, a solar charging part is mounted on the holding part in a covering manner, the solar charging part is electrically connected with the power storage part, and the holding part has an unfolding position and a holding position; and the control part is mounted on the main body, is electrically connected with the electric power storage part and the manipulator, and is used for controlling the holding part to be switched from the holding position to the unfolding position so as to increase the solar energy receiving area.

title: Rotary actuator for humanoid robot joint based on roller lead screw pair
abstract: The utility model provides a rotary actuator for a humanoid robot joint based on a roller lead screw pair, which belongs to the field of robots and comprises a long nut, a lead screw, a plurality of first rollers, a plurality of second rollers and an output nut. The outer surface of the other end of the lead screw is in threaded connection with the second pin rollers parallel to the axial direction of the lead screw. The interior of the long nut is through in the axial direction, the long nut is connected with a driving mechanism used for driving the long nut to rotate, and the inner surface of the long nut is in threaded connection with the first pin rollers. The interior of the output nut is through in the axial direction, the inner surface of the output nut is in threaded connection with the second pin rollers, and one end of the output nut is rotationally connected with the long nut through a rotating piece. The problem that in the prior art, input rotation of a lead screw cannot be converted into output rotation motion of non-linear motion of a nut at joints of a humanoid robot through a driving mechanism of a roller lead screw pair is solved.
abstract_en: The utility model provides a rotary actuator for a humanoid robot joint based on a roller lead screw pair, which belongs to the field of robots and comprises a long nut, a lead screw, a plurality of first rollers, a plurality of second rollers and an output nut. title: Biped robot walking planning and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot walking planning and control method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring current state information of a robot, and acquiring a motion trend of the robot in a future period of time according to the current state information and an original operation program of the robot; after the motion trend is obtained, a real-time environment point cloud picture in the range of the motion trend is obtained according to a camera module and a laser sensor module configured by the robot; generating a plurality of candidate walking planning schemes according to the real-time environment point cloud atlas; synchronously acquiring stability deviation values corresponding to the plurality of candidate walking planning schemes; comparing the plurality of stability deviation values to obtain a candidate walking planning scheme with the minimum stability deviation value; obtaining the step length and angle of the current candidate walking planning scheme; the robot is controlled to perform the next action according to the obtained step length and angle, real-time performance is achieved, the change of the current state of the robot can be quickly responded, and the smoothness and stability of a walking path are improved.

title: Biped robot with anti-toppling function
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of biped robots, and discloses a biped robot with an anti-toppling function, which comprises a biped robot body, and the biped robot body comprises a rack. According to the biped robot with the anti-toppling function, a supporting plate drives an adjusting seat to move, the adjusting seat drives a connecting screw rod to be inserted into a slot, then a locking nut is in threaded connection with the surface of the connecting screw rod, so that the position of the adjusting seat is limited, and then the supporting plate is in an inclined state; when the two-legged robot walks, the rubber cylinder contacts with the ground or other objects to prevent the rack from inclining, so that the problem that the side surface of the existing two-legged robot lacks a protection structure in the walking process, so that the existing two-legged robot inclines left and right due to an uneven road surface or the action of a driving part in the walking process, and the two-legged robot topples over towards the side surface is solved. And the driving part is damaged due to falling.

title: Biped robot walking control method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot walking control method and device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that a plurality of selectable points are determined on a target plane according to a first projection point, currently on the target plane, of the mass center of the biped robot, and the target plane is constructed in the advancing direction and the height direction of a robot body of the biped robot; according to the projection information of the target leg on the target plane, the length of a first force arm corresponding to each selectable point is calculated, and the target leg is one leg of the biped robot and is a supporting leg; taking the selectable point corresponding to the smaller first moment arm length in the plurality of first moment arm lengths as a target point; according to the mass center height corresponding to the target point, the biped robot is controlled to walk straight legs. Thus, by controlling the position of the waist of the biped robot in the height direction, the biped robot can move in the mode close to the straight leg of the human as much as possible, and meanwhile the energy utilization efficiency of the knee joint motor of the robot is effectively improved.

title: Hybrid drive omni-directional motion actuator based on paper folding structure
abstract: The invention provides a hybrid drive omni-directional motion actuator based on a paper folding structure, the actuator comprises at least one actuating module, and the actuating module comprises a columnar shell capable of deforming based on the paper folding structure, an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate. The columnar shell is of a paper folding structure derived on the basis of a Waterbomb crease, a cavity for containing gas is formed in the shell, the two ends of the cavity are open, the openings are connected with an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate used for blocking the openings respectively, vent holes communicated with the cavity are formed in the lower cover plate, the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate are pulled through driving ropes arranged in a crossed mode, and through cooperation of gas and line driving, the gas and the line are driven to be in a closed state. The columnar shell can generate contraction, bending and torsional deformation, so that the single actuating module has the omni-directional movement capacity. The motion modes are rich, the number of the actuating modules included in the actuator can be adjusted according to requirements, modularization and reconstruction are easy, and high practical value and application prospects are achieved in the fields of soft robots, humanoid robot arms and the like.

title: Humanoid arm joint based on pneumatic tendon
abstract: The utility model is applicable to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid arm joint based on a pneumatic tendon, the humanoid arm joint based on the pneumatic tendon comprises a connecting part, a big arm joint, a small arm joint and a hand part, the big arm joint and the small arm joint respectively comprise a connecting rod and connecting plates arranged at the two ends of the connecting rod; a universal joint is arranged between the two connecting plates close to each other in the big arm joint and the small arm joint, and universal joints are also arranged on the two connecting plates far away from each other and used for being connected with the connecting part and the hand part; a shoulder joint pneumatic tendon group and an elbow joint pneumatic tendon group are arranged between two connecting plates of the big arm joint, and the shoulder joint pneumatic tendon group and the elbow joint pneumatic tendon group are annularly arranged in an array shape; the large arm joint and the small arm joint are driven to move through the pneumatic tendons which are connected in a crossed and series-parallel mode, and the mechanical arm has the advantages that the structure is compact, flexibility is good, and the pneumatic tendons play the advantages of themselves.

title: ROBOT, ROBOT CONTROL METHOD AND RECORDING MEDIUM
abstract: A robot imitating a living thing, includes a body, a head connected to a front end of the body, a movable portion for moving the head relative to the body, and a controller. In a state in which the body is placed on a mounting surface, the controller executes a first control that controls the movable portion to change a distance between the front end of the body and the mounting surface alternately between a first distance and a second distance by moving the head so that a state of the head pressing the mounting surface changes.

title: Robot movement control method and device, humanoid robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot movement control method and device, a humanoid robot and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. According to the current actual riding speed and the expected riding speed of the humanoid robot in the advancing direction of the balance vehicle, and the current centroid pitch angle and the centroid pitch angular speed of the humanoid robot, the expected waist position required by the humanoid robot for driving the target two-wheel balance vehicle to keep balance at the expected riding speed is calculated; on the basis of the actual waist position and the actual riding speed of the humanoid robot in the advancing direction of the balance car, the expected waist position is subjected to compliance adjustment treatment, and the target waist position needed by the humanoid robot for maintaining the stable standing state on the target double-wheel balance car is obtained; and then the humanoid robot is controlled to conduct pose adjustment based on the target waist position, so that the two-wheel balance car is driven to carry the humanoid robot in the advancing direction to achieve the stable front-back movement effect or the static stopping effect.

title: Clothes folding method and system for double-arm humanoid robot based on clothes posture estimation
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm humanoid robot clothes folding method and system based on clothes posture estimation. The method comprises the steps that a clothes image is obtained and segmented; clothes contour extraction is carried out on the segmented image; performing simplified polygon fitting on the extracted clothes contour graph to obtain a simplified fitting polygon; modeling by using a Gaussian model to obtain a clothes polygon model database; the polygon model corresponding to the clothes in the current image represents the posture corresponding to the current clothes; according to the posture corresponding to the current clothes and the specific clothes folding operation steps, the next posture is obtained according to the time sequence; updating the parameters of the next attitude to obtain an updated attitude; and the double-arm robot uses an obstacle avoidance motion planning algorithm to complete obstacle avoidance motion planning from the posture operation corresponding to the current clothes to the updated posture. Robot operation planning and control are carried out according to the posture of the clothes.

title: Biped robot control method and device, biped robot and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a biped robot control method and device, a biped robot and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining any group of initial torque input quantities enabling the biped robot to temporarily and normally drive a double-wheel platform; according to the initial torque input quantity, training is carried out through a value iteration self-adaptive dynamic programming algorithm based on data driving, so that a stable controller enabling the biped robot to continuously and stably drive the double-wheel platform is obtained; and torque control is conducted on the biped robot and the double-wheel platform through the stable controller. According to the method, a precise dynamic model and an initial stability controller of a biped robot-two-wheel platform system are not needed, and only one input quantity capable of enabling the system to keep not falling down in a short time needs to be input, so that the subsequent optimal balance control of the system can be realized.

title: Robotic motion coach
abstract: The invention provides a robot motion coach. title: Robot leg connecting structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot leg connecting structure and a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising a fixing frame, a leg swinging joint module and a connecting piece, and the leg swinging joint module is fixedly installed on one side of the fixing frame; one end of the connecting piece is connected with a robot leg, and the other end is provided with a connecting shaft; a first connecting hole corresponding to the position of an output flange of the swing leg joint module is formed in the fixing frame, and the connecting shaft extends into the first connecting hole and then is fixedly connected with the output flange of the swing leg joint module; a bearing is arranged in the first connecting hole, the connecting shaft penetrates through an inner ring of the bearing, and then the connecting shaft is rotatably connected with the fixing frame through the bearing. The fixing frame and the connecting piece are rotatably connected through the bearing, the bearing is used for bearing gravitational torque borne by the legs of the robot when the robot lifts the legs, the problem that the swing leg joint module is damaged due to the fact that the swing leg joint module bears large radial torque in the advancing process of the robot is solved, and the running stability of the swing leg joint module is guaranteed.

title: Joint module connecting piece and limiting assembly of biped robot, biped robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a joint module connecting piece and a limiting assembly of a biped robot, the biped robot and the robot, the joint module connecting piece comprises a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, the first connecting piece comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part which are integrally formed, and the first connecting part is used for being connected with a swing leg joint of the robot; the second connecting part is used for installing a rotating leg joint of the robot and comprises an upper connecting part and a lower connecting part which are integrally formed, the upper connecting part is used for being connected with an output flange of the rotating leg joint of the robot, the lower connecting part is used for being connected with a part of leg structures of the robot, and the upper connecting part is embedded into the through hole and is coaxially arranged with the through hole; and the limiting part is embedded into the limiting groove. According to the limiting assembly, when the leg rotating joint of the biped robot drives the leg to rotate, the limiting effect is achieved in the leg rotating process, the problem that the leg of the robot is damaged due to excessive rotation under the abnormal condition is avoided, and the reliability of the robot structure is guaranteed.

title: Limiting piece, shank rotation limiting structure, biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a limiting part, a shank rotation limiting structure, a biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising thighs, shanks and limiting pieces, receding grooves and first limiting faces are constructed on the limiting pieces, end faces and second limiting faces located on the two sides of the end faces are constructed at the lower ends of the thighs, the limiting faces are fixedly arranged at the top ends of the shanks, and the end faces of second connecting parts correspond to the receding grooves of the first limiting parts on the same sides. When the shank rotates forwards or backwards around a hinged shaft to a limited angle, the adjacent first limiting face and the second limiting face on the same side can abut against each other, so that the rotation angle range of the shank is limited, and the situation that the shank rotates excessively under the abnormal condition of the robot is avoided; and therefore, the smooth walking of the robot is ensured.

title: Leg wiring structure of biped robot, biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg wiring structure of a biped robot, the biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot, the leg wiring structure comprises a first wiring frame, and the first wiring frame comprises a first frame body, a first fixing part and an upper supporting part; the first fixing part is installed on a thigh joint shell of the robot, and the first wiring frame can rotate along with legs. The robot further comprises a second wiring frame, the second wiring frame comprises a second wiring frame body, an avoiding part and a second fixing part, the second fixing part is installed on the thigh of the robot, and the second wiring frame can rotate along with the thigh. Part of cables of the legs of the robot are arranged along the outer surfaces of the first wiring frame and the second wiring frame and fixed through fasteners. The robot leg cable can be reasonably arranged and effectively fixed, the problem that the cable swings or moves when the robot walks is solved, interference with moving parts of the robot or the outside is not likely to happen, and the robot is higher in safety and better in stability.

title: Leg-foot structure, biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a leg-foot structure of a biped robot, the biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising a shank and a foot, the foot is provided with a heel part and a toe part, and the lower end of the shank is hinged to the heel part; the joint module is fixedly arranged on the outer side surface of the upper end of the shank; the crank is fixedly connected with the output flange of the joint module and is embedded in the first cavity of the shank structure; the upper end of the rocker is hinged to the crank, and the hinge point and the rotating shaft of the joint module are eccentrically arranged; the lower end of the rocker is hinged to the toe part. The joint module is arranged on the outer side face of the shank, and the crank is embedded in the first cavity of the shank structure, so that the crank is hidden in the shank, the problem that the crank interferes with the outside in the walking process of the robot is effectively avoided, and the walking stability of the robot is improved.

title: Wireless charging structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a biped robot wireless charging structure, comprising a transmitting end structure comprising a transmitting end coil which is laid in a floor where a biped robot stands and/or in a seat backrest where the biped robot sits; the receiving end structure comprises a receiving end coil, the receiving end coil is laid on the foot bottom of the biped robot in the state that the transmitting end coil is laid in the floor, and the receiving end coil is laid on the back of the biped robot in the state that the transmitting end coil is laid in the seat backrest. According to the utility model, the biped robot has a large degree of freedom during wireless charging, the alignment precision requirement is low, and the charging efficiency is improved.

title: Gear and gear reducer for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gear speed reduction equipment, in particular to a gear for a humanoid robot and a gear reducer, and the key points of the technical scheme are that the gear comprises a machine shell, a first transmission shaft, a second transmission shaft, a first gear set, a second gear set and an adjusting mechanism, and the first transmission shaft and the second transmission shaft are connected to the machine shell; the first gear set comprises a first driving gear and a first driven gear, the second gear set comprises a second driving gear and a second driven gear, the adjusting mechanism is used for driving the second transmission shaft to move, and when the second transmission shaft moves to the position right opposite to the first driving gear and the first driven gear, the first driving gear is meshed with the first driven gear; when the second transmission shaft moves to the position right opposite to the second driving gear and the second driven gear, the second driving gear is meshed with the second driven gear. The effect of improving the working flexibility of the robot is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot folding joint and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot folding joint and a humanoid robot. The robot folding joint is characterized in that a movable arm is rotationally connected with a fixed arm through a rotating shaft; the driving motor comprises a joint driving control circuit board, a motor assembly, a first straight gear and a second straight gear which are all assembled in a motor base in sequence, the motor assembly is fixedly connected with the first straight gear through a motor shaft, and the first straight gear is meshed with the second straight gear; according to the speed reducer, a bevel gear shaft is assembled in a first shell through hole of a speed reducer shell through a bevel gear shaft supporting bearing assembly, a rotating shaft is assembled in a second shell through hole of the speed reducer shell through a rotating shaft supporting bearing assembly, and the long axis direction of the bevel gear shaft is perpendicular to the long axis direction of the rotating shaft; the first end of the bevel gear shaft is sleeved with a second straight gear, the second end of the bevel gear shaft is meshed with a bevel gear, the bevel gear is arranged on the periphery of the rotating shaft in a sleeving mode, and the bevel gear is in key connection with the rotating shaft. Composite joint movement can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot real-time grabbing path planning method based on multi-modal model
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot vision, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot real-time grabbing path planning method based on a multi-modal model, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, employing a multi-modal deep learning model to carry out zero sample instance segmentation on an environment scene, and enabling the input parameters of the model to have an original point cloud, the point cloud and the two-dimensional picture which are subjected to BEV and post-processing also have semantic features from the word embedding model; the four modal features interact, and final three-dimensional instance segmentation is generated by combining an instance center of a two-dimensional segmentation result; s2, calculating coordinates and a rotation pose of an object by using an instance obtained after three-dimensional instance segmentation, performing input by using semantics and the instance of the object to generate a rotation vector of the object, and then performing quaternion calculation; s3, adopting a quadtree lifting sampling algorithm and an octree point cloud slicing algorithm to accelerate point cloud processing; s4, performing real-time path planning; according to the method, zero sample segmentation is adopted, the three-dimensional point cloud marking difficulty is reduced, and the model has strong generalization ability.

title: Large-torque frameless motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The large-torque frameless motor for the humanoid robot comprises a frameless motor body, a fixing mechanism and a speed reducing mechanism, the input end of the speed reducing mechanism is connected with the output end of the frameless motor body, and the output end of the speed reducing mechanism is connected with the fixing mechanism; the motor is an inner rotor frameless motor and comprises a stator, a limiting frame is fixedly arranged on the stator, and a rotor coaxial with the stator is rotationally installed in the stator. The speed reducing mechanism comprises a driving wheel, a transmission chain, a driven wheel and a gear ring, and the driving wheel is oval and fixedly installed on the rotor. The driving wheel is installed on the rotor of the inner rotor frameless motor, the rotor is connected with the driven wheel and the fixing structure through the bearing, the driven wheel can be fixedly connected with the input shaft of the load through the fixing mechanism, and speed reduction transmission can be achieved through mutual meshing of the transmission chain, the driving wheel and the driven wheel. And the torque of the motor is increased by reducing the rotating speed.
abstract_en: The large-torque frameless motor for the humanoid robot comprises a frameless motor body, a fixing mechanism and a speed reducing mechanism, the input end of the speed reducing mechanism is connected with the output end of the frameless motor body, and the output end of the speed reducing mechanism is connected with the fixing mechanism; the motor is an inner rotor frameless motor and comprises a stator, a limiting frame is fixedly arranged on the stator, and a rotor coaxial with the stator is rotationally installed in the stator. title: Head structure of robot
abstract: The invention relates to a head structure of a robot. The robot comprises a head (1), a trunk (2), a right arm (5), a left arm (6), a right leg (3) and a left leg (4), wherein the right arm (5) and the left arm (6) are located on the two sides of the trunk (2), and the right leg (3) and the left leg (4) are symmetrically distributed below the trunk (2). The main parts of the robot are provided with a plurality of steering engines, it is guaranteed that the whole robot can move flexibly, and man-machine interaction can be conducted; wings (8) and a backpack (7) are arranged on the back of the trunk (2); the head (1) is provided with a three-connecting-rod (142) driving the mouth structural part (19) to be closed up and down, and the mouth of the robot can be flexibly closed up and down. title: Robot control method, robot control system and computer readable medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot control method, a robot control system, and a computer readable medium. A robot control method includes inputting operator posture information indicating a posture of an operator, and performing motion control of a biped walking robot capable of switching between a walking mode and a standing mode based on the operator posture information. In the operation control, when switching from the walking mode to the standing mode, the operation of the walking robot is controlled on the basis of initial posture information indicating the initial posture of the walking robot corresponding to the initial posture of the operator and foot position information indicating the current position of the feet of the walking robot. Reference posture information indicating a reference posture of the biped walking robot is calculated, and the posture of the biped walking robot is controlled on the basis of the operator posture information and the calculated reference posture information.

title: Force feedback type controller of biped walking robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped walking robot force feedback type controller, which comprises a chassis and two rocker mechanisms symmetrically arranged on the chassis, and each joint of a rocker is controlled and connected by an FOC motor and is used for reading the position and controlling the output torque. According to the utility model, the motor magnetic field guiding control technology is utilized to simultaneously know the motor position and control the torque output to reach the reading position and generate the force feedback effect; two sets of six-degree-of-freedom space information can be generated by reading the positions and the orientations of the two rocker handles through robot kinematics and are used for controlling other biped robots. Some algorithm requirements are avoided, and the robot is directly controlled to walk through human perception.

title: Life test platform for lead screw transmission device for humanoid robot joint
abstract: The utility model discloses a life test platform for a lead screw transmission device for a humanoid robot joint, which belongs to the technical field of planetary roller lead screw tests and is technically characterized by comprising a workbench, a fixed rod and a test mechanism, and the fixed rod is fixedly connected to the upper end of the workbench. The testing mechanism comprises a supporting plate, a hydraulic cylinder, a motor, a fixing table, a planetary roller lead screw pair, C-shaped clamping rings, fixing blocks and a sliding plate, wherein the number of the C-shaped clamping rings is two, and the number of the fixing blocks is two. According to the service life test platform for the lead screw transmission device for the humanoid robot joint, a fixing block in the test mechanism is inserted into a C-shaped clamping ring, the stability of a planetary roller lead screw pair is kept, a hydraulic cylinder pushes a motor to move forwards, an output shaft part is located in an arch-shaped notch, butt joint of the motor and the planetary roller lead screw pair is achieved, and motor operation is achieved; the device can detect whether all parts are matched or not, detect the flatness and the running-in degree of the lead screw in the planetary roller lead screw pair, pick out defective products, and protect the safe use of the planetary roller lead screw pair.

title: Human body lower limb motion environment identification method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a human lower limb movement environment recognition method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: converting first environment terrain point cloud data into a world coordinate system according to the first environment terrain point cloud data returned by a depth camera and the Euler angle data returned by an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit); after conversion, for the first environmental terrain point cloud data, removing point cloud data outside a preset target range to obtain second environmental terrain point cloud data; projecting the second environmental terrain point cloud data to a sagittal plane of anatomy to obtain a binary image; performing morphological processing and feature extraction on the binary image to obtain a plurality of features; and on the basis of the multiple features, using an SVM classifier to realize on-line identification of a flat ground, an obstacle, an ascending stair, a descending stair, an ascending slope and a descending slope in front of the human body. By implementing the method, the complexity of the algorithm can be reduced, and the portability, the wearing performance and the applicability of the system can be improved.

title: Arm structure and bionic robot
abstract: The invention provides an arm structure and a bionic robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The arm structure comprises a driving part, an upper arm part, a front arm part and a palm part, the upper arm part is rotationally connected with the driving part, the front arm part is rotationally connected with the end, away from the driving part, of the upper arm part, the palm part is rotationally connected with the end, away from the front arm part, of the upper arm part, the driving part is provided with a first limiting part, and the driving part is provided with a second limiting part. The arm structure comprises an upper arm part and a front arm part, the upper arm part is provided with a second limiting part, the front arm part is provided with a third limiting part, the first limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the arm structure, the second limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the upper arm part, and the third limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the front arm part. The rotation operation angles of the upper arm part, the front arm part and the palm part can be limited, the maximum movement range of human body parts is simulated, and the anthropomorphic effect of the arms is further improved.

title: Intelligent welcome interaction robot with emergency rescue device
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent welcome interaction robot with an emergency rescue device. title: Three-dimensional passive walking robot
abstract: A bipedal walking robot uses a quasi-passive control scheme and a simplified mechanical design. The walking robot has a pair of legs connected to a body through a passive hip joint, which is offset from a center of gravity of the walking robot. A nonconcentric, curved foot is attached at to each leg by a prismatic joint. Extension and retraction of the prismatic joint initiates the walking sequence of the robot, with each foot retracted during the swing phase and extended during the stance phase. Directional changes are controlled by changing a phase offset in the actuation of each foot.

title: Battery disassembly and assembly structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a battery disassembling and assembling structure and a humanoid robot, the battery disassembling and assembling structure comprises a battery holder and a battery monomer detachably installed in the battery holder, the battery holder is used for being fixed to the robot and is provided with an opening exposed out of the body surface of the robot, and the battery monomer is detachably installed in the battery holder. A locking mechanism and a pop-up mechanism are arranged between the battery holder and the single battery, and the battery disassembly and assembly structure is configured as follows: the single battery is limited by the locking mechanism and fixed in the battery holder by overcoming the acting force of the pop-up mechanism; and the locking mechanism is unlocked, and the pop-up mechanism pops up the single batteries outwards. Therefore, the battery monomers are replaced by utilizing the grabbing and dismounting capabilities of the arms of the robot, the robot does not need to wait for charging at the charging pile for a long time, the humanoid robot operates autonomously in the replacement process, and the locking mechanism and the ejection mechanism are arranged between the battery holder and the battery monomers, so that the self-battery-replacement of the robot is simpler, more convenient and easier.

title: Bionic robot in aspect of voice recognition control
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of voice recognition control, in particular to a bionic robot in the aspect of voice recognition control. The bionic robot in the aspect of voice recognition control comprises a voice recognition module, a user intention analysis module, a behavior pattern recognition module, a security enhancement module, a task priority adjustment module, an abnormal state recognition module, a decision support module and a response execution module. According to the method, the convolutional neural network and the long-short-term memory network are adopted to deeply analyze voice signals, the recognition accuracy is improved, bidirectional encoder representation is performed from a converter model, text semantics are deeply analyzed, user intentions are accurately grasped, a hidden Markov model and a voiceprint recognition technology are adopted, behavior pattern recognition and safety are optimized, and the recognition accuracy is improved. According to the method, resource optimization and anomaly detection are realized through a genetic algorithm and an isolation forest algorithm, system response and stability are enhanced, risk income analysis is performed through a decision tree and a Bayesian network, and execution accuracy is improved by using a state machine model and a rule engine.

title: Intelligent attitude control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent attitude control method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent control, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the change attitude planning through the initial attitude information of a target humanoid robot, generating a first attitude stability coefficient, sensing the real-time attitude information of the target humanoid robot in real time through an inertial measurement unit, and generating a second attitude stability coefficient; generating a second attitude stability coefficient, comparing the second attitude stability coefficient with the first attitude stability coefficient, generating adjustment amplitude data, performing simulation training on attitude control of the target humanoid robot based on the adjustment amplitude data through a virtual simulation environment, generating an attitude simulation training result, and formulating an attitude control strategy. The attitude of the target humanoid robot is intelligently controlled, the technical problem that in the prior art, control over the attitude of the robot is lacked, and consequently the task completing efficiency of the robot is low is solved, the operation accuracy of the robot is improved, and work tasks in the complex environment can be better coped with.

title: Humanoid robot dynamic sensing method and computing system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot dynamic sensing method and a computing system, and aims to solve the problems that indoor and outdoor environment sensing precision is low and navigation path planning cannot meet kinematics constraints of a humanoid robot in a complex path scene in the prior art in environment sensing of the humanoid robot in an indoor and outdoor complex environment. title: Limiting piece, connecting piece, limiting assembly, biped robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a limiting piece, a connecting piece, a limiting assembly, a biped robot and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising a connecting piece and a limiting piece, the end of a first connecting part is embedded in an avoiding groove of the limiting piece, so that the two first limiting faces of the connecting piece can be matched with the two second limiting faces of the limiting piece, and when the connecting piece is driven by a leg swinging joint module to rotate leftwards or rightwards to a limited angle, the limiting piece can rotate leftwards or rightwards. When the swing leg joint module drives the connecting piece to rotate, the adjacent first limiting face and second limiting face abut against each other, and therefore the rotation angle range of the swing leg joint module driving connecting piece is limited. The problem that the structure of the robot is damaged due to the fact that the swing leg joint module rotates excessively and exceeds the designed movement range under the abnormal condition can be effectively solved.

title: Ventilation and heat dissipation system for humanoid robot with flexible shell
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and discloses a ventilation and heat dissipation system of a humanoid robot with a flexible shell. The ventilation and heat dissipation system of the humanoid robot with the flexible shell comprises an air inlet, a ventilation pipe, a motor inflation pump, an air path block, a heating device and an air outlet. In order to prevent an object from being sucked into the system component from the air inlet or the air outlet, the air inlet and the air outlet are provided with detachable screw filter screens. The ventilation pipe is a hollow hose and is connected with other components of the system to form a smooth air path, cold air outside the humanoid robot with the flexible shell is sucked into the motor inflation pump through the air inlet, pressure is conveyed into the heating device through the air path block, and heat generated by the heating device is discharged into air outside the body through the air outlet through the air path block. Compared with a heat dissipation scheme that heat dissipation parts are installed on all heating devices of the humanoid robot, the maintenance cost of the heat dissipation device can be reduced.

title: MANAGING ROBOTS IN WORKFLOWS
abstract: Robotic systems and methods include one or more humanoid robots configured to move within a commercial environment that includes a plurality of commercial products supported by a plurality of donor pallets; one or more autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) configured to move within the commercial environment; and a control system communicably coupled to the one or more humanoid robots and the one or more AMRs. title: SSVEP-based man-machine sharing time domain cooperative control device

And the electroencephalogram acquisition unit adopts a wireless electroencephalogram cap, so that the comfort and portability of the user are improved. The robot is provided with multiple functions, more complex tasks and actions are achieved, and the application field and functions are expanded. Through the advantages, the device can realize highly flexible, stable and reliable man-machine interaction, and provides comprehensive control experience for users.

title: Arm exoskeleton system
abstract: The invention relates to an arm exoskeleton system which comprises an upper arm unit, an elbow joint unit and a front arm unit. The upper arm unit, the elbow joint unit and the front arm unit are mechanically connected in sequence, and a Bowden steel cable connected with a motor, a guide assembly and a guide pulley on the front arm unit are combined to form a first torque transmission unit; a driving rod in the front arm unit is connected with at least two sets of first torque transmission units and pulled by the first torque transmission units from two opposite directions, and under the condition that the at least two sets of first torque transmission units transmit different torques, the driving rod is twisted based on the traction effect of a steel cable in Bowden steel cables. Therefore, the wrist restraining assembly arranged on the driving rod adaptively rotates inwards or outwards along with the driving rod. Aiming at the defect that the forearm cannot flexibly rotate inwards or outwards, the invention provides an arm exoskeleton system with a smart structure, which can accurately drive the forearm of a human body to rotate inwards and outwards.

title: Exoskeleton device and system for teleoperation of humanoid robot and teaching method
abstract: The invention discloses an exoskeleton device and system for humanoid robot teleoperation and a teaching method. Encoders used for detecting the rotating angles of the rotating joints are arranged in the rotating joints; a data glove is arranged at the end, away from the exoskeleton arm, of the exoskeleton arm, and a sensing assembly used for detecting hand actions is integrated in the data glove. An operator wears the exoskeleton device for action demonstration, an encoder and a sensing assembly in the device detect and record the arm swing angle and hand actions of the operator in real time, then the actions are accurately converted into control instructions, the control instructions are directly transmitted to the humanoid robot, the accuracy and efficiency of the demonstration process are improved, and the demonstration effect is improved. title: Three-axis parallel large-attitude space humanoid wrist capable of being driven by closed-loop rope of fixed-length cable
abstract: The invention provides a three-axis parallel large-attitude space humanoid wrist capable of being driven by a closed-loop rope of a fixed-length cable, belongs to the field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid wrist robot. The device specifically comprises three motors, a static platform, a movable platform, three driving rods, three driven rods, three groups of guide assemblies and three pairs of driving ropes, wherein the three driving rods and the three driven rods are connected between the static platform and the movable platform in parallel; one ends of the three pairs of driving ropes are connected to output shafts of the three motors correspondingly, the other ends of the three pairs of driving ropes are fixedly connected with the three driving rods through the three sets of guiding assemblies correspondingly, closed-loop rope driving is formed, and due to the fact that the wrist can keep the length of a cable passing through the wrist unchanged in the movement process, the safety and attractiveness of cable arrangement are greatly improved. The scheme of the invention can simultaneously meet the advantages of simple structure, three-axis rotation, large attitude space, closed-loop rope driving, simple mathematical model and the like.

title: 18-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an 18-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot, and relates to the related field of humanoid robots. The robot structurally comprises a robot foot joint, a robot first leg joint rotationally arranged at the upper end of the robot foot joint, a robot second leg joint rotationally arranged at the upper end of the robot first leg joint and a robot third leg joint rotationally arranged at the upper end of the robot second leg joint. title: Humanoid welding robot based on cleaning welding double mechanical arms
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid welding robot based on double cleaning and welding mechanical arms. The humanoid welding robot comprises a robot body, the cleaning mechanical arm and the welding mechanical arm, wherein the cleaning mechanical arm and the welding mechanical arm are connected to the two sides of the robot body; each of the cleaning mechanical arm and the welding mechanical arm comprises more than two sections of arm bodies which are connected in sequence; the tail end arm body is connected with an executing mechanism; the starting end arm body and the robot trunk, the adjacent arm bodies and the tail end arm body and the executing mechanism are connected through joints respectively; a permanent magnet synchronous motor is arranged at each joint; target tracks of the cleaning mechanical arm and the welding mechanical arm are planned, so that target angles of all joints are set; and the permanent magnet synchronous motor of each joint adopts a rapid prediction model to set output, so that the joints move according to a target angle. The humanoid robot has the cleaning and welding functions, surface cleaning before welding and weld joint treatment after welding can be carried out, the welding quality is effectively improved, cleaning and welding operations are closely linked, and the welding efficiency is effectively improved.
