title: Four-limb cooperative balance control method and device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot automatic control, in particular to a humanoid robot four-limb cooperative balance control method and device, and the method comprises the steps: employing a multi-source state information fusion method, and obtaining the three-dimensional motion state information of four limbs and a trunk of a humanoid robot; according to the three-dimensional motion state information, a motion coordination model between four limbs and the trunk of the humanoid robot is established; according to the motion coordination model, a balance control strategy based on four-limb coordination is established to coordinate and plan four-limb motion, and the balance control strategy comprises a sweepback control strategy, a crossing control strategy and a virtual model control strategy; according to the robot four-limb cooperative balance control method, the problems of modeling, feedback and control strategies of an existing method are solved, the problems existing in existing four-limb cooperative balance control are effectively solved, and the accurate and robust control effect is achieved.

title: Intelligent carrying device for complex environment, cooperative control system and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent carrying, and particularly relates to an intelligent carrying device for a complex environment, a cooperative control system and a control method. The intelligent carrying device comprises a rack, a posterior limb walking mechanism and a forelimb walking mechanism, wherein the posterior limb walking mechanism and the forelimb walking mechanism are installed on the rack. The fore limb walking mechanism comprises a power mechanism mounted on the rack and two balance walking legs which are in transmission arrangement with the output end of the power mechanism; wherein the balance walking leg comprises an upper rotating frame and a lower rotating frame which are rotatably arranged with the output end of the power mechanism; a triangular rotating frame; a first balancing stand; a second balancing stand; a Y-shaped supporting leg; during walking, the lower ends of the Y-shaped supporting legs are supported on the ground, the two balance walking legs can adapt to the gravity center position of the intelligent carrying device in real time, three-point contact with the ground is kept all the time in the walking process, and the adaptability and stability of the intelligent carrying device are effectively improved; the problem that in the prior art, a carrying device in a complex environment topples over due to gravity center position changes is solved.

title: Motion posture learning method and device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motion posture learning method and device of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring posture information and environment information of a real human in a preset time period; determining a motion mode of the humanoid robot according to the attitude information and the environment information; obtaining at least one motion posture evaluation strategy corresponding to the motion mode; calculating the attitude information according to the motion attitude evaluation strategy to obtain at least one motion attitude evaluation value; matching the motion mode with a motion posture strategy library to obtain a matching evaluation value; performing weighted calculation according to the motion attitude evaluation value and the matching evaluation value to obtain a comprehensive motion attitude evaluation value, and calculating a loss function value by combining the real human motion space attitude measurement value and the comprehensive motion attitude evaluation value; and performing deep learning model training based on the loss function value. The humanoid robot can autonomously learn a human motion posture control strategy, and the comprehensive performance and adaptability of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Joint structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The joint structure of the humanoid robot comprises a supporting frame and further comprises a rotating shaft connected with a driving motor structure, a shaft core of the supporting frame is provided with a containing space, and the rotating shaft is arranged in the containing space of the supporting frame. The rotating shaft is rotationally connected with the support frame, so that the rotating shaft and the support frame can rotate mutually under the driving of the driving motor structure; the outer wall, in the radial direction, of the supporting frame is provided with a first connecting section used for being connected with a first server, and the outer wall, in the radial direction, of the rotating shaft is provided with a second connecting section used for being connected with a second server. According to the humanoid robot joint, the integrated design of the server and the joint is adopted, the purposes of improving the motion intensity of the humanoid robot joint, simplifying the installation process of the joint and achieving the overall light weight of the humanoid robot joint are achieved through a simple and reliable structural mode, and the humanoid robot joint has good feasibility and practicability.

title: Upper body skeleton of humanoid robot, connecting piece and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an upper body skeleton of a humanoid robot. A first connecting structure is arranged at the position, corresponding to each groove wall of each first containing groove, of the first local body, and each first connecting structure is used for being connected with a second connecting structure of the outer ring of the annular body of the connecting piece in a matched mode. The extending length of the first connecting structure in the bottom direction of the first containing groove is smaller than the groove depth of the first containing groove. After the first connecting structure and the second connecting structure are connected in a matched mode, the bottom of the actuator protruding out of the inner ring of the connecting piece is contained in the bottom space of the first containing groove. By means of the upper body skeleton of the humanoid robot, the contradiction between the requirement for the installation space of the robot and the bionic requirement of the robot can be balanced. The utility model further discloses a connecting piece and the humanoid robot.

title: Fish hook wire binding machine with humanoid robot arm
abstract: The present invention relates to a fish hook wire binding machine with a humanoid robot arm, which comprises a clamping mechanism, a wire feeding mechanism and a winding mechanism. The wire feeding mechanism is provided with a movable rail on which a wire guide unit is assembled. The wire guide unit is provided with a detachable threading seat at the front end thereof, as concurrently as with a lifting pneumatic shear, wherein the threading seat has a wire hole and is exchangeable depending on fishing lines with various thicknesses. The winding mechanism is erected with a rotary connector for assurance of power supply by rotation. In such a case, the winding mechanism can remain in a state of uninterruptible power while rotating a fishing line loop, and the pneumatic shear can further move upwards to cut the fishing line after tightening the fishing line loop and forming a knot, so as to complete the fish hook wire binding process by use of the present invention with a humanoid robot arm.

title: Androider Brillenanpasskopf
abstract: The invention relates to an android spectacle fitting head (1) comprising a housing (30) with a control unit and operating panel (45) which is connected via a base (70,71,71') to a humanoid head, which is divided into a neck-jaw region (26), a temple region (24,24'), an eye-cheek region (25,25'), a nose (200), a back of the head (23), a skull (20,21) and an ear region (22). By numerical input via the operating panel (45) and driven by stepper and servo motors (40), the spectacle fitting head (1) can variably simulate the head width relative to the temple region, the distance between the pupil centers (29,29') as well as their vertical offset relative to the center of the root of the nose, the distance of the ear attachment (28) as well as its vertical offset relative to the root of the nose, the head tilt, and the height of the root of the nose, in order to optimally adapt any spectacle frame in size and shape without requiring the spectacle wearer to be physically present. Laser diodes (44,44') are arranged in the pupil centers (29,29'), which project the line-of-sight point of the spectacle wearer at the reflection point in the spectacle lens in order to check the correct centering of the spectacle lenses.

title: Auxiliary traction device for electromagnetic compatibility test of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides an auxiliary traction device for an electromagnetic compatibility test of a humanoid robot. The auxiliary traction device comprises a fixed rod, a fixed belt, a hanging ring, an adjusting belt, a shell, a spring, a shaft pin, a winding rod and a stop pin, by winding the adjusting belt on the winding rod, when the height of the hanging ring needs to be adjusted, an operator can conveniently pull the stop pin downwards, in the downward moving process of the stop pin, the stop pin is separated from gear teeth in the gear on the winding rod, and then the winding rod rotates under the action of the spring, so that the height of the hanging ring is adjusted. The winding rod in the rotating state further enables an adjusting belt on the winding rod to roll, so that the height position of the hanging ring is lowered, after the hanging ring is lowered to a proper height, an operator loosens a stop pin, and the stop pin automatically jacks up and is clamped in gear teeth of a gear under the action of a compression spring to limit rotation of the gear; the auxiliary traction device in the scheme is convenient to adjust, and more time and labor are saved compared with a traditional manual adjusting mode.

title: High-agility humanoid target and action simulation method thereof
abstract: The high-agility humanoid target comprises a human body model and further comprises a flight rotor wing system, a flight control system, a position sensing device and a power supply system. The human body model comprises a head, a trunk, upper limbs and lower limbs; the lower limbs comprise thighs and shanks, the thighs are rotatably connected with the trunk, and the shanks are rotatably connected with the thighs; the flight rotor wing system comprises a first rotor wing and a second rotor wing which are the same in structure; the first rotors are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the upper shoulder and the two sides of the crotch of the trunk. title: Humanoid robot capable of simulating actions such as stepping and walking of human beings
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot capable of simulating human to do actions such as stepping and walking, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot manufacturing, and provides a humanoid robot according to the working principle and natural law of human walking aiming at the technical problem that the walking of the currently applied humanoid robot cannot really simulate human walking. title: Rigid-flexible coupling bionic mechanical foot with buffering and anti-subsidence functions
abstract: The invention discloses a rigid-flexible coupling bionic mechanical foot with buffering and anti-subsidence functions, which belongs to the technical field of bionic robots and comprises a mounting interface module, a ground contact pressing module, a sand stabilization and flow limiting module and an anti-slip buffering module. The installation interface module is fixedly connected to the upper end of the support pressing plate, three guide holes are formed in a non-load area of the support pressing plate, the left side and the right side of the bottom of the support pressing plate are symmetrically and rotationally connected with side connecting rods and front connecting rods through small cylindrical pins, and the lower ends of the two side connecting rods are rotationally connected with side foot bottom plates through small cylindrical pins. The lower ends of the two front connecting rods are rotationally connected with a left flipper and a right flipper through small cylindrical pins respectively; when the legs of the robot fall, the bionic mechanical feet can gather and press the loose sand base, and sinking and slipping of the bionic mechanical feet are avoided; after the legs of the robot are lifted, the support pressing plate can automatically move upwards to drive the left flipper, the right flipper and the side foot bottom plate to reset, the mobility of the sand is recovered again, and the bionic mechanical foot can be smoothly lifted off the ground.

title: Humanoid robot object grabbing method and device based on reinforcement learning control
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot object grabbing method and device based on reinforcement learning control, and the method comprises the steps: introducing a first reward for enabling a robot to stably stand and a second reward for enabling the robot to grab an object to reach a target posture in a reward through a reinforcement learning training mode, training an end-to-end strategy model, and carrying out the training of an end-to-end strategy model; and meanwhile, the self-adaptive task requirement and the grabbing task requirement of standing balance of the robot are met. In the execution process of the actual grabbing task, the method that the trained strategy model is used for direct control replaces the steps of grabbing point detection and whole body motion coordination planning in a conventional grabbing method, the planning process of the grabbing task is simplified, the planning time is shortened, and the implementation efficiency of real-time grabbing of the robot is improved.

title: High-precision stair obstacle recognition and elimination method
abstract: The invention discloses a high-precision stair obstacle recognition and elimination method, belongs to the field of stair perception in humanoid robot environment perception, and solves the problem that stair obstacles destroy stair plane features. Therefore, the problem that the humanoid robot misses steps and tumbles due to inaccurate stair parameters obtained by the humanoid robot is solved. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, pre-processing point cloud data by combining voxel filtering and straight-through filtering; secondly, establishing a point cloud data topological structure according to a KD-Tree algorithm, estimating a point cloud normal vector by utilizing a principle that the sum of projections of adjacent points is minimum, and accurately completing extraction of the stair horizontal plane; thirdly, the stair obstacle clustering condition is judged according to a region growing algorithm, a plane is constructed, and the number of points in the plane is analyzed to complete rapid obstacle recognition and elimination work; and finally, carrying out stair three-dimensional parameter estimation on the stairs with the obstacles and the stairs without the obstacles. The sensing ability of the humanoid robot in a complex stair environment is improved.

title: Four-limb auxiliary movement device of humanoid back-embracing type transfer nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a four-limb auxiliary movement device of a humanoid back holding type transfer nursing robot, which comprises an upper limb auxiliary movement mechanism and a lower limb auxiliary movement mechanism, the upper limb auxiliary movement mechanism is used for assisting human arm movement, and the lower limb auxiliary movement mechanism is used for assisting human leg movement; the lower limb auxiliary movement mechanism comprises a knee supporting mechanism and a shank movement mechanism, the knee supporting mechanism provides support for knees of a human body, the shank movement mechanism comprises two shank movement modules, and the distance between the two shank movement modules is adjusted through a lead screw sliding block module; the shank movement module comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a fourth connecting rod, a fifth connecting rod, a sixth connecting rod, a driving motor, a shank supporting seat and a shank supporting piece, the driving motor drives the first connecting rod to rotate, then other connecting rods are driven to be linked, the shank supporting piece is made to rotate, and bending and stretching movement of the shank is achieved. In the patient transfer process of the humanoid back-holding transfer nursing robot, the device assists the patient in arm and leg movement, and the aim of moving the four limbs is achieved.

title: Active and passive hybrid drive type humanoid robot lower limb structural body
abstract: An active and passive hybrid drive type lower limb structure of a humanoid biped robot comprises a hip R, a hip joint R, a knee joint R, a hip joint R, a hip L, a hip joint L, a knee joint L and an ankle joint L. The problems that an existing motor and hydraulic drive type humanoid robot cannot give consideration to portability, compactness, high efficiency and long endurance performance, and a passive humanoid robot does not need to be driven by external energy, but is single in gait and low in sensitivity are solved. According to the lower limb structural body of the active and passive hybrid drive biped humanoid robot, through the adjustable pre-tightening force springs embedded in the thighs and shanks of the lower limbs and the back connecting rods and in combination with a gear mechanism, corresponding torque is formed in the movement process to balance the gravity torque of the robot. On the basis, disc type motors are installed on the joints, and joint driving of the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Hand device of humanoid intervention robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of minimally invasive vascular interventional operations, and discloses a hand device of a humanoid interventional robot, comprising: a left hand device for clamping and fixing surgical instruments; the right hand device is used for pushing and rotating the surgical instruments; and a disposable consumable. Through cooperative action of the left hand device and the right hand device, catheter and guide wire pushing rotation, contrast agent injection and pressure pump pressurization and release of a balloon and a stent catheter in an interventional operation can be completed. When a medical instrument in an operation is clamped, the robot can also sense the clamping force, can sense the real-time pushing resistance in the process of pushing a catheter and a guide wire, and can complete main operation actions in interventional operation treatment.

title: Knee control structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot knee control structure in the humanoid robot field, which comprises two thigh side plates and a shank, the number of the thigh side plates is two, the two thigh side plates are arranged on the two sides of the top end of the shank, the thigh side plates are rotatably connected with the shank through installed rotating assemblies, and the thigh side plates are connected with the shank through the rotating assemblies. Wherein a rotating control motor is installed in the middle of one side wall of one thigh side plate through a screw, an output shaft of the rotating control motor penetrates through the thigh side plate and then is provided with a rotating disc, a hinge seat is integrally formed on one side wall of the shank, and a rotating pull rod is arranged between the hinge seat and the side wall of the rotating disc. According to the utility model, the spherical hinge assembly adopts the snap spring to fix the spherical cavity sleeve, the installation and the disassembly are more convenient and faster, and the spherical hinge connection ensures that the shank has larger degree of freedom and activity, so that the pitch balance control of the shank can be facilitated, and the leg balance mechanism is extremely practical.

title: Design method for energy-saving and vibration-reducing knee joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an energy-saving and vibration-reducing knee joint design method for a humanoid robot. The knee joint of the humanoid robot is designed in combination with research of human knee joints. Comprising the following steps: step 1, mechanical design of the energy-saving damping knee joint; step 2, key parameter calculation; and step 3, vibration reduction analysis of the knee joint. In the step 1, the energy-saving vibration reduction structure of the knee joint of the humanoid robot is designed by analyzing the main composition structure of the human knee joint; in the second step, the dynamic model of the swing leg in the swing stage when the humanoid robot walks is analyzed; and in the step 3, shock absorption analysis of knee joints is carried out on impact force from the ground when the humanoid robot walks. The energy-saving and vibration-reducing knee joint structure of the humanoid robot is designed by simulating structures of anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments and meniscus of a human knee joint. The impact of the humanoid robot in the sole contact stage is effectively reduced, the walking stability is improved, and the peak driving torque in the swing stage is reduced.

title: Autonomous welding operation and planning method of humanoid welding robot based on camera
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid welding robots, and particularly provides a camera-based autonomous welding operation and planning method of a humanoid welding robot, which is realized based on the humanoid welding robot. Comprising the following steps: respectively calibrating an internal parameter and an external parameter; estimating the pose of the humanoid robot on the basis of data fusion; performing visual three-dimensional reconstruction based on data fusion to obtain a three-dimensional reconstruction point cloud of the motion scene of the humanoid welding robot, and identifying an obstacle; searching an area to be welded; the humanoid welding robot is controlled to move to the to-be-welded area; in the process of controlling the humanoid welding robot to move, the humanoid welding robot path planning method based on the improved RRT algorithm is operated; and welding operation is carried out. According to the method, human vision is simulated through a camera, autonomous welding operation is achieved through humanoid vision pose estimation and scene and humanoid structure collaborative path planning, and compared with manual welding, time cost and labor cost can be greatly saved.

title: Anthropomorphic joint and robot
abstract: The invention provides an anthropomorphic joint and a robot. The anthropomorphic joint comprises: a base body; a first joint section; the swinging and rotating piece is connected with the first joint section, and the swinging and rotating piece can rotate around the first direction and the second direction; the first driving assembly is arranged in the base body and is in driving connection with the swinging part so as to drive the swinging part to rotate around the first direction or the second direction; the second joint section is rotatably connected with the first joint section; the third joint section is rotatably connected with the second joint section; the two ends of the connecting rod are rotationally connected with the first joint section and the third joint section correspondingly; and the second driving assembly is located in the first joint section and is in driving connection with the second joint section so as to drive the second joint section to rotate relative to the first joint section, and the third joint section rotates relative to the second joint section under the action of the connecting rod. The problem that in the prior art, the humanoid degree of robot finger joints is low is solved.

title: Composite satellite speed reducer
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of planetary speed reducers, in particular to a composite satellite speed reducer. According to the composite satellite speed reducer, a small planet gear 5 of a duplex planet gear is meshed with a large satellite gear 9 of an adjacent duplex satellite gear at the same time, a small satellite gear 8 of the duplex satellite gear is meshed with an adjacent satellite gear 2 at the same time, the number of meshed teeth is six, and the number of overlapped teeth is doubled; the output torque is increased; the duplex planet wheel, the duplex satellite wheel and the satellite wheel share one bracket, so that transmission chains are shortened, and accumulated errors among the transmission chains are reduced; the gear support and the crossed roller bearing inner ring are integrated together, the number of parts is reduced, the size is reduced, the structural rigidity is improved, the problem of large accumulative errors caused by the large number of parts is solved, and a key step is made for application to the high-end fields of medical robot joints, humanoid robot joints and the like.

title: Bionic monkey robot
abstract: The bionic monkey robot comprises a spine rack, a mechanical arm and a walking mechanism, the spine rack is provided with a plurality of rotating parts, and the rotating parts of the spine rack can be driven to rotate to achieve bending and stretching adjustment of the whole spine rack; the mechanical arm is arranged on the spine rack, and a working part used for completing work tasks is arranged on the mechanical arm; the walking mechanism is arranged on the spine rack and used for driving the spine rack to move or jump. The invention provides the hand-foot wheel-leg composite bionic monkey robot which is used for unstructured terrain operation, is compact in structure, diversified in mode and reliable in operation and has a gravity center adjusting function, the spine rack is subjected to flexion and extension adjustment so as to achieve the overall gravity center adjusting function, and the walking mechanism realizes bending and swinging of the legs and movement of the whole robot.

title: Back-holding power assisting device for humanoid back-holding transfer nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a back-holding power assisting device for a humanoid back-holding transfer nursing robot. The back-holding power assisting device comprises an upper limb power assisting assembly and a lower limb power assisting assembly. The upper limb assisting assembly comprises a left arm supporting module, a right arm supporting module and a distance adjusting module, and the left arm supporting module and the right arm supporting module are symmetrically distributed on the two sides of the distance adjusting module; the lower limb assisting assembly is used for supporting and assisting the two legs of the nursed person in the transferring process; the left arm supporting module and the right arm supporting module each comprise a connecting base, a first lead screw sliding table module, a guide rail, a second lead screw sliding table module, a first electric push rod and an armpit supporting module, the vertical position of the armpit supporting module is adjusted through the first lead screw sliding table module, and the front-back position of the armpit supporting module is adjusted through the second lead screw sliding table module. And when the second lead screw sliding table module slides towards the chest leaning direction of the robot, the robot is assisted to complete the back holding action. According to the device, strain possibly caused by fixing of the arm supporting module in the back holding process is avoided, and meanwhile consumption of physical strength of a nursed person in the transferring process is reduced.

title: Intelligent welding method of humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic welding, and particularly provides an intelligent welding method for a humanoid welding robot, which comprises the following steps of: recording regional image data of a welding workbench, operating a three-dimensional measurement algorithm, and determining a to-be-welded regional position and a contour three-dimensional point set of a to-be-welded workpiece; the humanoid welding robot is controlled to move to a welding workbench along a set walking route; based on a welding process parameter library, process parameters are determined according to the to-be-welded workpiece material; according to the position of the to-be-welded area, the contour three-dimensional point set and the position of the humanoid welding robot, movement tracks of welding mechanical arms on the two sides of the humanoid welding robot are planned correspondingly; and welding mechanical arms on the two sides of the humanoid welding robot are controlled to move along the planned track, and welding work is conducted. According to the method, high-precision recognition and three-dimensional measurement of the to-be-welded area can be achieved, the automation degree and the intelligent degree of a welding system can be remarkably improved, the welding intelligent degree can be greatly improved, the welding time cost is reduced, and therefore the welding yield is improved.

title: Robot leg device and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robots, in particular to a robot leg device and a humanoid robot with the same. The robot leg device comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, a knee joint driving part is installed at the end, close to the hip joint assembly, of the thigh assembly, a knee joint rocker arm is eccentrically installed at the output end of the knee joint driving part, and a shank pull rod is rotationally installed on the knee joint rocker arm; the connecting line of the rotating shaft of the shank pull rod swinging around the shank assembly and the rotating shaft of the shank assembly swinging around the thigh assembly is not collinear with the shank pull rod. When being subjected to impact force from the sole, the impact force can be transmitted to the knee joint driving piece through the position between the shank assembly and the shank pull rod and then transmitted to the hip joint assembly, a rotating shaft between the shank assembly and the thigh assembly cannot be driven to rotate, and the overall stability of the shank assembly and the thigh assembly during external force impact is improved; and the possibility that the leg device of the robot overturns during working can be greatly reduced.

title: Robot, motion control method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly provides a robot, a motion control method and device thereof and a storage medium. The robot motion control method comprises the steps that expected motion information corresponding to at least one active joint is determined according to actual state information and target state information of a robot, and target torque corresponding to the active joint is determined according to the corresponding expected motion information for the active joint; and joint motors of the active joints are controlled to work according to the target torque. According to the embodiment of the invention, an off-line track library does not need to be established in advance, online control is adopted, the algorithm cost is lower, the control algorithm is simple, the calculated amount is small, the requirement for computing power is not high, more computing power can be saved and distributed to upper limbs or other controls, and the control effect of the robot is improved.

title: Robot, motion control method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly provides a robot, a motion control method and device thereof and a storage medium. The robot motion control method comprises the steps of obtaining plantar force of a supporting leg when the robot moves, determining the deformation quantity of a leg elastic piece of the robot according to the plantar force, determining the knee joint compensation amount for robot mass center height compensation according to the deformation quantity, and controlling a knee joint motor of the robot according to the knee joint compensation amount. In the embodiment of the invention, the knee joint motor is subjected to compensation control through the deformation quantity of the leg elastic piece of the supporting leg of the robot, so that the control precision of the supporting leg is effectively improved, the problem of body height reduction caused by deformation of the supporting leg elastic piece in the walking process of the robot is eliminated or relieved, and the body height of the robot is kept constant; and the walking stability of the biped robot is improved.

title: Hip supporting and flexible handheld device of humanoid back holding transfer robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip supporting and flexible handheld device of a humanoid back holding transfer robot. The hip supporting module comprises a supporting mechanism, a sliding mechanism and a cushion; the lifting mechanism comprises a connecting plate, a tail end support and a multi-connecting-rod mechanism. The cushion is located on the tail end support, and reciprocating sliding of the cushion on the tail end support is achieved through the sliding mechanism. The two connecting plates are symmetrically installed on a main frame body of the humanoid back holding transfer robot and connected with the left side and the right side of the tail end support through the multi-connecting-rod mechanisms correspondingly, and folding and unfolding of the tail end support are achieved through the multi-connecting-rod mechanisms. The two flexible handheld modules are symmetrically installed on the left side and the right side of a chest rest of the humanoid back holding transfer robot, and the hands of a nursed person are flexibly supported through the flexible handheld modules. The hip supporting module enables a nursed person and a chest rest of the humanoid back holding transfer robot to keep a proper distance, and comfort and safety are improved; the flexible handheld module provides a certain buffering and moving space for the hand, hand discomfort caused by long-time grabbing is avoided, meanwhile, impact caused by jolting, vibration and the like is flexibly buffered, and the hand is prevented from being injured.

title: Wearable control device and system for large mimicry bionic robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mimicry bionics, in particular to a wearable control device and system for a large mimicry bionic robot, and the system comprises a limb motion capture module, an electromyographic signal processing module, a posture reconstruction optimization module, a pressure distribution optimization module, a tactile feedback module, a behavior learning module and a system integrated control module. In the invention, advanced technologies of a deep learning network, multi-body dynamics simulation and a deep reinforcement learning strategy are adopted to improve the capture precision and response speed of the robot to human body actions, so that the robot can more naturally and accurately simulate human actions; a time-frequency analysis and wavelet transform method is used for processing electromyographic signals to enhance the analysis capability of fine action intentions, a genetic algorithm and a multi-modal fusion algorithm are applied to optimize posture adjustment and pressure distribution of a robot, the comfort and safety during interaction with a user are ensured, and by means of construction of a behavior pattern library and implementation of real-time feedback control, the user experience is improved. And the learning ability and adaptability of the system are further enhanced.

title: Electric linear actuator
abstract: The invention discloses an electric linear actuator which comprises a shell, a reverse circulation ball screw pair assembly arranged in the shell and a motor assembly arranged in the shell. The reverse circulation ball screw assembly comprises a ball nut, a ball screw serving as an output shaft and balls. The motor assembly comprises a motor stator and an armature assembly embedded with a permanent magnet material, the armature assembly is mounted on the periphery of the ball nut, and the motor stator is fixed on the inner wall of the shell; a motor interface for electrifying the motor assembly is reserved on the shell; the reverse circulation ball screw pair is adopted as a core part of the actuator, a circulation structure of the reverse circulation ball screw pair is arranged on the lead screw, the nut is directly driven by the motor during operation, the rotary motion of the nut is converted into the linear motion of the lead screw, the ball screw pair can be integrated into a driving system in a limited space, and the operation efficiency is improved. The device is especially suitable for application scenes such as humanoid robots which are limited in installation space but need long service life and continuous work.

title: Transformation robot and transformation method
abstract: The invention relates to a transformation robot and a transformation method. The robot comprises a head (1), a trunk (6), a left arm (2) and a right arm (3), wherein the left arm (2) and the right arm (3) are located on the two sides of the trunk (6). The left leg (4) and the right leg (5) are located on the two sides of the lower end of the trunk (6), and the robot is driven by the head (1), the left arm (2), the right arm (3), the left leg (4), the right leg (5) and the trunk (6) through 13 different types of steering engines, namely 36 steering engines in total to complete full automatic deformation from a human form to a tank form and from the tank form to the human form. Independent movement in a human shape and a tank shape is achieved, and various actions in different shapes are completed; and the back of the trunk (6) is symmetrically provided with a left backpack (7) and a right backpack (8) which can be folded and unfolded in a tank form and a human form. According to the robot deformation method, automatic deformation can be achieved under interference of non-human factors, and the playability and operability of the robot are greatly improved.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on high-order all-drive theory
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot control method based on a high-order all-drive theory. Comprising the steps that an error dynamic model of the humanoid robot is established according to an MDH parametric method and Lagrange dynamics; according to the type of the used motor, a mathematical model of the motor is introduced into the error dynamic model, and a high-order system model of the humanoid robot is established; designing internal and external uncertainty of a nonlinear disturbance observer compensation system; and designing a trajectory tracking controller by using a parameterization method in a high-order all-drive theory. The controllable degree of freedom is rich and flexible, and the control precision is high.

title: Knee joint structure, mechanical leg and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a knee joint structure, a mechanical leg and a biped robot. The knee joint structure comprises a knee joint structural part which is provided with a first connecting point, a second connecting point, a third connecting point and a fourth connecting point; the first connection point and the second connection point are located on a first straight line L1, the third connection point and the fourth connection point are located on a second straight line L2, and the first straight line L1 and the second straight line L2 intersect at one point; the knee joint structural part is rotationally connected with the thigh part at the first connecting point and the second connecting point, and the knee joint structural part is rotationally connected with the shank part at the third connecting point and the fourth connecting point. The knee joint structural member serves as a structural member for connecting the thigh and the shank, two connecting points rotationally connected with the thigh are located on a first straight line L1, two connecting points rotationally connected with the shank are located on a second straight line L2, and the first straight line L1 and the second straight line L2 intersect, so that complex structural design is not needed; and the leg weight and the production difficulty of the mechanical leg can be obviously reduced.

title: Crus structure, mechanical leg and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a shank structure, a mechanical leg and a biped robot. The shank structure comprises a shank part and a foot part; the upper end and the lower end of the shank front part are rotationally connected with the front side of the knee joint part and the front side of the foot part respectively; the upper end and the lower end of the shank rear part are rotationally connected with the rear side of the knee joint part and the rear side of the foot part respectively; and the knee joint part, the shank front part, the shank rear part and the foot part form a parallel four-bar linkage structure. The shank structure comprises a shank part and a foot part, the shank part is designed to be of a split type structure comprising a shank front part and a shank rear part, through the split type structure design, on one hand, the weight of the shank structure can be reduced, on the other hand, the knee joint part, the shank front part, the foot part and the shank rear part form a parallel four-connecting-rod structure, and control over the shank structure is conveniently achieved.

title: Emergency stop device for biped robot and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides an emergency stop device for a biped robot and the biped robot. The emergency stop device for the biped robot comprises a plurality of joint motors and an emergency stop switch, each joint motor is used for being arranged at one joint of the biped robot, and each joint motor is provided with an enabling port; the emergency stop switch is used for being arranged on a main body part of the biped robot and is electrically connected with the enabling port; the emergency stop switch has an on state and an off state, when the emergency stop switch is in the on state, the multiple joint motors are in a normal operation state, and when the emergency stop switch is in the off state, the multiple joint motors are in a power-down state. According to the emergency stop device for the biped robot, when the emergency stop switch is in the closed state, large current on-off is avoided, and therefore electric arcs are prevented from being generated when the joint motors are shut down, and the situation that the electric arcs injure operators and the biped robot is avoided.

title: Thigh structure, mechanical leg and biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a thigh structure, a mechanical leg and a biped robot. The thigh structure comprises a hip joint part and a thigh part; the thigh part comprises a thigh front part, a thigh rear part and a first push rod device; the thigh front part is a driving part, the thigh rear part is a driven part, and the thigh front part can rotate relative to the hip joint part under the driving of the first push rod device and drives the thigh rear part to synchronously rotate relative to the hip joint part. Through the split type structural design, the weight of the thigh structure can be reduced, the hip joint part, the thigh front part, the knee joint part and the thigh rear part form a parallel four-connecting-rod structure, under driving of the first push rod device, the thigh front part serves as a driving part, the thigh rear part serves as a driven part, and synchronous movement of the thigh front part and the thigh rear part can be achieved; the whole thigh part can swing back and forth relative to the hip joint part, and the control difficulty of the thigh structure is lowered. The first push rod device is adopted for driving, the weight of the thigh structure is reduced, and the stability of the thigh structure is enhanced due to the fact that the first push rod device is obliquely arranged.

title: Robot having a plurality of legs and method for determining touchdown position thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a method for determining a touchdown position of a robot performed by a computing device, the method comprising the steps of: detecting a disturbance during swing of a first leg of the robot toward a first touchdown position, calculating a second touchdown position based on a dynamic state of the robot in response to the detection of the disturbance, identifying a step obstacle region based on terrain information of the robot and determining whether the second touchdown position belongs to the step obstacle region, and determining a third touchdown position out of the step obstacle region as the touchdown position of the first leg, in a case in which the second touchdown position belongs to the step obstacle region.

title: GAIT TRAJECTORY CONTROL METHOD AND GAIT TRAJECTORY SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed herein is a gait trajectory system and a gait trajectory control method. The gait trajectory system, comprises: a controller configured to: for a step of a user: using a dynamic movement primitives-based trajectory generation module, determine a reference trajectory based on a set of initial joint angles, a goal offset, and a forcing term; update a vector table based on the reference trajectory, wherein the vector table includes multiple sets of joint angles corresponding to at least one leg of the user; determine from the vector table a set of closest joint angles closest to a set of current joint angles; and determine from the vector table a set of target joint angles based on the set of current joint angles and a predetermined angular distance.

title: Universal humanoid bionic robot eye based on stepping motor driving
abstract: The utility model provides a universal humanoid bionic robot eye based on stepping motor driving. According to the universal humanoid bionic robot eye based on stepping motor driving, up-down and left-right rotation of eyeballs of the two eyes and opening and closing of eyelids are achieved through four sets of motors, the structure is precise, the eye movement is flexible, the height and the left-right distance of the eyeballs of the two robot eyes can be adjusted, and the universality is high. The system can stably run for a long time, can work in a silent mode, and has better display performance, flexibility and universality.

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid gymnastic robot which comprises a head-shaped battery piece, a controller, a steering engine, a long u-shaped piece, a short u-shaped piece, a narrow u-shaped piece and four-limb u-shaped pieces. title: Wheel type magnetic adsorption chassis for multifunctional operation humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a wheel type magnetic adsorption chassis for a multifunctional operation humanoid robot. The wheel type magnetic adsorption chassis comprises a movable chassis with Mecanum magnetic wheel sets, a chassis power source and a servo motor. The Mecanum magnetic wheel group comprises four Mecanum magnetic wheels; each Mecanum magnetic wheel comprises a permanent magnet wheel body, a right magnetic conductive wheel, a left magnetic conductive wheel and a Mecanum wheel type movement mechanism; the permanent magnet wheel body, the right magnetic conductive wheel and the left magnetic conductive wheel are coaxially arranged; the right magnetic conductive wheel and the left magnetic conductive wheel are fixedly connected to the two sides of the permanent magnet wheel body respectively. An annular mounting space is formed between the right magnetic conductive wheel and the left magnetic conductive wheel; and the Mecanum wheel type movement mechanism is arranged in the annular mounting space. According to the magnetic adsorption chassis, the Mecanum wheels are embedded into the magnetic wheels, the magnetic adsorption chassis has the magnetic adsorption capacity and the omnidirectional moving function at the same time, movement operation can be automatically completed in the harsh environment, and the problems that manual operation is high in danger, low in efficiency and high in cost are solved.

title: Trunk assembly of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a trunk assembly of a humanoid robot. The trunk assembly of the humanoid robot comprises a waist structural part and a back structural part, and a first lower connecting part of the waist structural part is used for being connected with a lower limb assembly of the humanoid robot in a matched mode; the back of the back structural member is used for mounting a battery, and the second lower connecting part of the back structural member is adaptively connected with the upper connecting part of the waist structural member; relative to the position of the upper connecting part, the first lower connecting part extends towards the back direction of the back structural part, so that when the trunk assembly is in an installation state, the projection position of the gravity center of a whole formed by the waist structural part, the back structural part and a battery installed on the back of the back structural part on the horizontal plane is larger than the projection position of the gravity center; and the projection position of the first lower connecting part on the horizontal plane is approached. By the adoption of the trunk assembly of the humanoid robot, the balance capacity of the humanoid robot after the battery is installed can be improved. The embodiment of the utility model further discloses the humanoid robot comprising the trunk assembly.

title: APPARATUS FOR UPPER LIMB WEARABLE ROBOT AND METHOD OF CONTROLLING APPARATUS FOR UPPER LIMB WEARABLE ROBOT
abstract: An apparatus for an upper limb-wearing robot comprises: a body disposed on the back of a user; a power unit installed in the body and providing a driving force for moving the lower arm of the user upward; a wire connected between the power unit and the lower arm to transmit the driving force of the power unit to the lower arm; and a support unit installed in the body and configured to be movable rearward of the upper arm of the user to support the upper arm of the user in the body in conjunction with the driving of the power unit.

title: Casting device for transfer joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot switching joint casting device which comprises a shaping component, traction components are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the shaping component, a fixing frame is arranged in the middle of the shaping component, and a section shell is arranged at the bottom of the shaping component. Penetrating inserting openings are evenly formed in the top of the inner wall of the section shell, a modified sliding plate is slidably connected to the surface of the section shell, and a feeding part is fixedly connected to the bottom of the modified sliding plate. According to the device, the shaping inserting rod and the section shell are assembled in a distributed mode, after the joint shell is formed, the shaping inserting rod can be pulled out firstly, and the shaping inserting rod can vertically slide upwards under the guiding effect of the penetrating inserting opening of the section shell, so that the shaping inserting rod is not prone to being bent and broken at the moment, and then the section shell and the joint shell are subjected to rapid demolding treatment; and therefore, the problem that the shaping insertion rod is broken in the internal meshes of the joint shell is avoided.

title: Visual mapping method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a visual mapping method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method is applied to the humanoid robot, the humanoid robot is provided with a first camera and a second camera, the height from the first camera to the ground is larger than the height from the second camera to the ground, the first camera is used for collecting a first image in front of the moving direction of the humanoid robot, and the second camera is used for collecting a second image in front of the moving direction of the humanoid robot. The second camera is used for collecting a second image of the ground in the moving direction of the humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that a 3D occupied grid map is generated according to the first image; generating a first 2D grid map according to the 3D occupied grid map; fusing the pose of the humanoid robot, the first image and the second image to generate a 3D dense point cloud map; and generating a second 2D grid map according to the 3D dense point cloud map and the first 2D grid map. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the processing speed, the real-time performance and the accuracy of visual mapping can be considered.

title: Humanoid finger and humanoid hand based on tendon rope and connecting rod hybrid transmission
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of design and manufacturing of dexterous hands, and provides a humanoid finger and a humanoid hand based on tendon rope and connecting rod hybrid transmission. The humanoid finger comprises a driving mechanism, a connecting rod structure, a plurality of tendon ropes, a springback mechanism, a DIP knuckle, a PIP knuckle, an MCP knuckle and an MCPBottom knuckle, wherein the DIP knuckle, the PIP knuckle, the MCP knuckle and the MCPBottom knuckle are arranged in the direction from the fingertip to the palm. The finger has high humanoid property and flexibility, which are reflected in the aspect of finger knuckle length and the aspect of finger joint degree of freedom; and a mounting position of the FSR is reserved at the fingertip so as to provide force feedback for the finger. According to the pre-tightening mechanism, a convenient tendon rope pre-tightening mode is achieved while it is guaranteed that the size of the fingers is small. According to the MCP joint decoupling method, decoupling of the buckling/stretching freedom degree and the adduction/abduction freedom degree of the MCP joint of the full-drive finger is achieved through different transmission modes, and therefore the simulated human hand can conduct multiple kinds of dexterous operation.

title: Bionic tibia structure of space gradient humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a space gradient humanoid robot bionic tibia structure, and relates to the technical field of high-performance bionic structures, the space gradient humanoid robot bionic tibia structure comprises two cylindrical stress parts and a space gradient bearing part, the space gradient humanoid robot bionic tibia structure is internally provided with two groups of reinforcing elements which have the same shape with an external shell and are spaced at the same distance, and the six reinforcing ribs extending outwards from the innermost element are connected with each other. Compared with a traditional cylindrical humanoid robot supporting leg, the space gradient humanoid robot bionic tibia structure provided by the invention shows smoother platform stress under the same quasi-static compression, and the overall stress is more uniform.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. The humanoid robot comprises a crotch supporting piece, a waist supporting piece, a fixing piece, a rotary driving piece and a linear driving piece. A limiting hole is formed in the waist supporting piece; the limiting part of the fixing piece penetrates through the limiting hole and can move along the limiting hole, the rotary driving piece is arranged on the fixing piece, the output end of the rotary driving piece is connected with the waist supporting piece, and the rotary driving piece is used for driving the waist supporting piece to rotate; at least two linear driving pieces are arranged, one end of each linear driving piece is connected with the fixing piece through a centripetal spherical plain bearing, and the other end of each linear driving piece is connected with the crotch supporting piece through another centripetal spherical plain bearing; the first side and the second side of the fixing piece are each provided with at least one linear driving piece. According to the humanoid robot provided by the invention, various actions of the waist, such as waist rotation, forward leaning, backward leaning, left leaning, right leaning, left-side forward leaning and right-side forward leaning, can be realized, and the expected effect of bionic actions of the humanoid robot is met.

title: Wire feeding and straightening integrated welding gun device for humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention provides a wire feeding and straightening integrated welding gun device for a humanoid welding robot. The wire feeding and straightening integrated welding gun device comprises a welding gun body, a welding wire reel frame, a wire feeding mechanism assembly, a straightening mechanism assembly and a main controller. The welding wire reel frame, the straightening mechanism assembly, the wire feeding mechanism assembly and the welding gun body are sequentially arranged along a welding wire conveying path. The straightening mechanism assembly comprises a straightening mechanism shell, a straightening driving wheel, a straightening driven wheel, a driving wheel position adjusting module and an allowance detecting module. According to the residual welding wire amount, detected by the allowance detection module, of the welding wire reel frame, the driving wheel position adjusting module adjusts the position of the straightening driving wheel so as to adjust the distance between the straightening driving wheel and the straightening driven wheel, and therefore the welding wire straightening strength is adjusted. The device integrates a welding gun, a wire feeder and a welding wire straightening mechanism into a whole, is mounted at the executing tail end of a mechanical arm of the humanoid welding robot for use, and performs self-adaptive welding wire straightening adjustment along with the reduction of the residual welding wire amount in the welding operation process.

title: FINGER JOINT TRANSMISSION STRUCTURE OF ANTHROPOMORPHIC ROBOT HAND
abstract: A finger joint transmission structure of an anthropomorphic robot hand includes a first finger segment and a second finger segment that are pivotally connected to each other. A toothed rack in an arc shape is provided at the joint of the first finger segment and the second finger segment. The second finger segment has a speed reducer and a motor connected to the speed reducer therein. The speed reducer has a transmission shaft extending toward the toothed rack. A transmission gear meshing with the toothed rack is provided on the transmission shaft. When the motor drives the transmission shaft to rotate via the speed reducer, the transmission gear is synchronously driven to move along the toothed rack, so that the second finger segment is driven to be pivoted upward or downward at a predetermined angle relative to the first finger segment.

title: Motion recognition method based on semantic exploration
abstract: The invention discloses a semantic exploration-based action recognition method, which comprises the following steps of: determining first semantic information and first intention information according to first text information input by a user; generating second text information replied by the AI digital person according to the first semantic information and the first intention information; according to the second text information, determining an emotion representation label and an action guide label; associating the emotion characterization label with an action guide label, and matching a corresponding target action in a preset action library; controlling the AI digital human to execute a target action through an action controller and playing target voice information corresponding to the second text information at the same time; wherein the target action comprises a facial action and a limb action, the facial action is determined according to the emotion characterization label, and the limb action is jointly determined according to the emotion characterization label and the action guide label. Therefore, the experience and the quality of the interaction between the user and the AI digital human are enhanced, and the fidelity and the naturalness of the interaction between the AI digital human are improved.

title: Motion control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a motion control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the motion data of a robot and the state of at least one leg joint in the motion process of the robot, and determining whether a swing foot of the robot falls to the ground or not based on the state of the at least one leg joint; in response to landing of a swinging foot of the robot, determining a relative position between the swinging foot and a supporting foot of the robot according to the motion data and the state of the at least one leg joint; and determining topographic conditions of the environment where the robot is located according to the relative positions between the swinging feet and the supporting feet of the robot, and controlling the robot to move according to the topographic conditions.

title: Finger rotating mechanism and simulated hand
abstract: The invention provides a finger rotating mechanism and a humanoid hand, and relates to the technical field of humanoid manipulators, the finger rotating mechanism comprises a base joint, a near knuckle and two driving assemblies, the two driving assemblies are used for driving the near knuckle to rotate around a first axis or a second axis relative to the base joint, and the first axis intersects with the second axis; each driving assembly comprises a motor, a ball screw pair and a universal coupling, and the motor is arranged in the base joint; the ball screw pair is arranged in the near knuckle and comprises a lead screw and a nut which are in threaded fit, and the nut is fixedly connected with the near knuckle. One end of the universal coupling is connected with an output shaft of the motor, and the other end is connected with the lead screw. According to the finger rotating mechanism and the imitated hand, the motor and the transmission part of the driving assembly are arranged in the base joint and the near knuckle correspondingly, the internal space of the fingers is reasonably and fully utilized, multi-degree-of-freedom rotation of the fingers of the imitated hand is achieved, meanwhile, the size of the imitated hand can be smaller, and the bearing capacity is higher.

title: Humanoid robot head motion control system driven by VR head-mounted equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot head motion control system driven by VR head-mounted equipment, which comprises VR head-mounted motion control equipment and a humanoid robot body, the VR head-mounted motion control device comprises an IMU used for accurately capturing the head of a user, a high-performance eye tracker used for accurately capturing eyeball motions of the user, a visual adjustment unit adopting a variable focus display technology, and a brain wave analysis unit. The system has an adaptive visual adjustment function of far and near vision and astigmatism, the naturalness and comfort of VR experience are greatly improved through advanced image processing and eye movement tracking technologies, in addition, various sensor data are fused, a decoupling control method and a particle filtering and Kalman filtering technology are adopted, and the system has a good application prospect. And the precision and interactivity of remote control are obviously improved.

title: Lumbar bionic ligament and weaving method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic lumbar ligament and a weaving method thereof. The bionic ligament is prepared from traditional wires in different weaving modes. The knitting modes comprise double-knot knitting, single-knot knitting and knitting; the bionic ligament obtained through the bionic ligament weaving method has good mechanical properties and morphological simulation, the mechanical properties of the bionic ligament are close to those of anterior longitudinal ligament, posterior longitudinal ligament, interspinous ligament and intertransverse ligament in the normal physiological state of people, and meanwhile the bionic ligament can meet the morphological characteristics of the thickness, the width and the like corresponding to the ligament of the human body; the bionic ligament woven structure for the lumbar vertebra can provide passive constraint for the lumbar vertebra part of the humanoid robot, and then motion constraint and load of anterior longitudinal ligament, posterior longitudinal ligament, interspinous ligament, intertransverse ligament and the like under real physiological motion of the lumbar vertebra of the human body are simulated and reproduced.

abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode intelligent identification and behavior control method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot manufacturing control, the system comprises a driving machine body, an axis angle adjusting assembly is installed at the top of the driving machine body, and an upper limb frame center console is installed at the top of the axis angle adjusting assembly; a signal control adjusting assembly is installed at the bottom end of the driving machine body, through cooperation of the signal control adjusting assembly, a lower limb frame forefoot adjusting assembly, a lower limb frame compensation adjusting assembly, an integrated single-chip microcomputer, an axis angle adjusting assembly and an upper arm adjusting assembly, the whole device achieves accurate environment perception and navigation control, accurate control is formed, and the navigation precision is improved. title: Three-dimensional digital human-oriented collision detection model training method
abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional digital human-oriented collision detection model training method, which comprises the steps that a collision detection model constructed by adopting a tree convolution structure is acquired, the tree convolution structure depends on the topological level of nodes of a three-dimensional digital human, and the nodes correspond to movable joints of the three-dimensional digital human; a training set constructed according to the posture data and skin data of the three-dimensional digital person is obtained, the training set comprises a plurality of 3D posture samples and collision state labels corresponding to the 3D posture samples, and the 3D posture samples comprise posture data of all nodes of the three-dimensional digital person; training a collision detection model by using the training set and a preset loss function, and detecting a collision state according to the 3D attitude sample to obtain a trained collision detection model; the constructed collision detection model is more in line with the hierarchical structure of the data of the three-dimensional digital human, is closer to the distribution rule of the attitude data, can assist in efficiently detecting the collision state, and improves the detection efficiency and accuracy.

title: Wire clamping structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence equipment, and discloses a wire clamping structure of a humanoid robot. title: AUTONOMOUS HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: An autonomous humanoid robot configured to overcome limited maneuvering issues by offering a more efficient autonomous humanoid robot that autonomously operates to interact with users and interact with other robots, and includes a computing system configured to provide instruction and programming for estimating and controlling pivotal movement of body components involving arms, legs and a waist module which are configured to support the body and reposition the body such that the autonomous humanoid robot can step, walk, roll or skate or perform various handling maneuvers to complete tasks.

title: Humanoid lower limb rehabilitation robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid lower limb rehabilitation robot, and relates to the technical field of medical rehabilitation robots, the humanoid lower limb rehabilitation robot comprises a support base, a longitudinal steel plate and a leg walking-assisting mechanical body, the longitudinal steel plate is fixedly connected to the support base; the walking aid further comprises a waist lifting assembly, an upper limb wearing assembly and a wearing auxiliary seat, the waist lifting assembly comprises a waist plate and a lifting driving mechanism, the lifting driving mechanism is installed on the longitudinal steel plate, the waist plate is connected to the lifting end of the lifting driving mechanism, and the tops of the two leg walking aid mechanical bodies are connected with the waist plate. The upper limb wearing assembly is arranged on the waist plate; according to the rehabilitation training robot, the labor intensity of medical auxiliary personnel in the wearing process is reduced by means of supporting of the arranged seat plate, the wearing operation convenience of the rehabilitation training robot is improved, and meanwhile possible injuries to a user in the wearing process can be avoided.

title: Flexible control method and device for double upper limb mechanical arms of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a compliance control method and device for double upper-limb mechanical arms of a humanoid robot, and the compliance control method comprises the steps: S1, building a closed-chain kinematic model based on a closed kinematic chain composed of the double upper-limb mechanical arms and an operation object, and building a combined kinetic model for the double upper-limb mechanical arms; s2, designing a double-arm cooperation controller and a cooperation process of the upper limb double mechanical arms; and S3, with the minimum internal force in the operation process of the upper limb double mechanical arms as a control target, motion control is conducted on the upper limb double mechanical arms on the basis of the closed-chain kinematics model, the combined kinetic model, the double-arm cooperative controller and the cooperative process. According to the method, the stability, robustness and efficiency of the mechanical arm on the operation of the steering wheel are effectively improved.

title: Rope-driven simulated human body upper limb based on self-similar stretch-draw integral joint
abstract: The invention provides a rope-driven simulated human body upper limb based on self-similar stretch-draw integral joints, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The simulated human body upper limb comprises a tensioning integral type joint, an upper arm, a front arm, a mechanical arm and a driving rope, the tensioning integral type joint is composed of an extension spring and a double-end spherical hinge or a connecting rod and other connecting pieces, and the deformation effects of bending, twisting and the like are achieved by designing a rope threading mode. The tensioning integral joint comprises a shoulder joint, an elbow joint and a wrist joint which are self-similar, the lower end of the shoulder joint is connected with the upper arm, the two ends of the elbow joint are connected with the upper arm and the front arm respectively, the upper end of the wrist joint is connected with the front arm, and the lower end of the wrist joint is connected with the manipulator. And the whole movement of the upper limbs can be realized. Compared with a rigid mechanical upper limb, the rope is adopted to simulate human arm tendons, and the designed joints have high self-similarity characteristics and are high in degree of freedom, light in weight, simple in structure and easy to install.

title: Humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid manipulator. A motor I and a driving shaft I, a motor II and a driving shaft II, and a motor III and a driving shaft III in a cavity form corresponding driving connection; each finger is connected with the driving shaft I through a traction rope I; connecting pieces correspondingly connected with the fingers are arranged in the cavity, and a fixing block is arranged between every two adjacent connecting pieces. One end of the rotary connecting piece is fixedly connected with the root of the corresponding finger and is arranged on a hinge shaft I fixed in the cavity in a sleeving manner, a transverse long hole is formed in the lifting connecting piece, and a hinge shaft II is arranged at the other end of the rotary connecting piece and is arranged in the transverse long hole in a sliding manner; the fixed block is connected with one end of a lifting connecting piece through a spring I, and the other end of the lifting connecting piece is connected with a driving shaft II through a traction rope II; when the traction rope II is controlled to be retracted and released, the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger synchronously execute transverse retraction and abduction movement, and when the motor III drives the driving shaft III to rotate, the upper part and the lower part of the palm are bent, so that the flexibility of the hand can be remarkably improved, and the structure is simple.

title: Emotional chatting robot based on expression recognition
abstract: The invention relates to an emotion chatting robot based on expression recognition, which comprises a base, a robot body part fixedly mounted at the top of the base, a robot head rotationally mounted at the top of the robot body part and a moving mechanism arranged at the bottom of the base, and is characterized in that a controller is fixedly mounted in the robot body part; robot hands are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the robot body, disinfection mechanisms extending into the robot hands are arranged in the robot body, and a rotating mechanism extending into the robot head is arranged in the robot body. According to the emotion chat robot based on expression recognition, the controller controls the water pump to start pressurization, disinfectant fluid in the medicine storage box is conveniently conveyed into the water conveying pipe, then the disinfectant fluid is conveyed into the atomization spray head through the water conveying pipe, then the periphery of a patient seeing a doctor is disinfected through the atomization spray head, and the advantage of being good in disinfection effect is achieved.

title: Thigh assembly of biped robot
abstract: The thigh assembly of the biped robot comprises a first thigh side plate, a first linear motor, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod and a thigh connecting base capable of being connected with the hip and the waist, and one end of the thigh connecting base is rotationally connected with the upper end of the first thigh side plate; one end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the lower end of the first thigh side plate, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the head end of the first connecting rod, the tail end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the output end of the first linear motor, the tail of the first linear motor is rotationally connected with the lower end of the first thigh side plate, and the lower end of the first thigh side plate is rotationally connected with the shank; the tail end of the first connecting rod, the head end of the second connecting rod and the output end of the first linear motor are coaxially and rotationally connected, and the tail end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first thigh side plate. All parts in the thigh assembly are fully utilized, the total part number of the thigh assembly is reduced, and the weight of the thigh assembly is reduced.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom biped robot lower limb mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom biped robot lower limb mechanism which comprises a thigh rack, a first connecting rod mechanism, a second connecting rod mechanism, a multi-connecting-rod coupling mechanism and a sole, the first connecting rod mechanism is rotationally connected with the thigh rack, one end of the second connecting rod mechanism is rotationally connected with the thigh rack, and the other end of the second connecting rod mechanism is rotationally connected with the sole. One end of the first connecting rod mechanism is rotationally connected with the foot sole, the other end of the first connecting rod mechanism is rotationally connected with the upper end of the multi-connecting rod coupling mechanism, the lower end of the multi-connecting rod coupling mechanism is rotationally connected with the foot sole in a cross shape, and the first connecting rod mechanism can be connected with an output shaft of a waist hip joint and can drive the biped robot lower limb mechanism to do pitching motion. The second connecting rod mechanism can drive the shanks of the biped robot to do pitching motion, and the multi-connecting-rod coupling mechanism can drive the soles to do pitching motion and side-sway motion. The lower limb mechanism adopts the connecting rod mechanism as a transmission part, the whole structure is simpler, and the control difficulty of the lower limb mechanism can be reduced.
