title: Dynamic obstacle speed measurement method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a dynamic obstacle speed measurement method for a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring real-time RGB (Red, Green and Blue) images and depth information, and detecting a dynamic obstacle by using a dynamic obstacle detection network; obstacle target tracking is carried out; measuring the speed of the obstacle; and real-time visualization of obstacles and obstacle data storage are carried out. The invention provides a method for measuring the speed of a dynamic obstacle of a humanoid robot. The method solves the problems that an existing obstacle detection and tracking solution is insufficient in specific environment adaptability, insufficient in dynamic obstacle processing, poor in speed measurement precision and insufficient in response speed. According to the invention, efficient and accurate detection and rapid tracking of dynamic obstacles in variable indoor and outdoor environments are realized, and accurate speed information is provided, so that the autonomy and safety of the humanoid robot are remarkably improved.

title: Flat ground gait optimization method and system of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a flat ground gait optimization method and system for a biped robot, and aims at optimizing the flat ground gait of the biped robot by determining the zero moment point position of the biped robot during the single-foot supporting period, constructing a target function for keeping the stability of the robot and considering the maximum time for the robot to complete a walking target and the total time for keeping standing. The method comprises the following steps of: constructing a corresponding target function according to the target distance and the walking speed of a robot, carrying out weighting processing, and modeling a gait optimization problem of the robot into a multi-target optimization problem with a plurality of local optimal values according to the target function by utilizing the parameterization characteristic of a CPG network; an improved strategy of a particle swarm optimization algorithm is established, iterative optimization is performed based on the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, and a robot walking task is simulated once in each iteration until a parameter set of a CPG network-based biped gait controller corresponding to an optimal particle is obtained. And higher solving precision can be obtained with a smaller population scale and lower calculation cost.

title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM, ROBOT HAND, ROBOT CONTROL PROGRAM, INFORMATION MANAGEMENT PROGRAM, AND INFORMATION PROCESSING PROGRAM
abstract: According to the present invention, three finger parts are provided on a gripping part. A plurality of suction pads are attached to a palm side of the gripping part and the three finger parts. The suction pads have an air suction structure, for example. The suction pads suck a package, and the three finger parts are bent, thereby making it possible to grab the package. A high resolution camera and a palm sensor including MoPU are attached to the palm side, and the gripping part, which has the above-described structure, is mounted on an arm part of a humanoid robot, thereby making it possible to reliably pick up an object with suction surfaces and to carry a package without dropping the package from the gripping part even when the humanoid robot moves fast.

title: Humanoid robot and lower limb device thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a lower limb device thereof. The lower limb device comprises a hip joint; the first joint motor module, the second joint motor module and the third joint motor module are used for driving the hip joints, and the first joint motor module, the second joint motor module and the third joint motor module are installed on a waist structure of the humanoid robot; the included angle between a first motor shaft of the first joint motor module and a second motor shaft of the second joint motor module is larger than 0 degree, and a third motor shaft of the third joint motor module is perpendicular to the first motor shaft and the second motor shaft. According to the humanoid robot and the lower limb device thereof, by optimizing the layout and angle distribution of the first joint motor module, the second joint motor module, the third joint motor module and the third joint motor module, the torque requirement of a thigh structure for a single joint motor module is lowered, the precision of leg motion control of the humanoid robot is improved, and by improving the distribution of the mass center, the leg motion control precision is improved. The mass center moves upwards, and the motion control difficulty is reduced.

title: Humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot
abstract: The humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot comprises a robot body, the robot body is composed of an upper machine body and a lower machine body, an auxiliary clamping unit is arranged on the upper machine body, the bottom of the lower machine body is hollow, a moving unit is arranged at the bottom of the lower machine body, a meal delivery unit is arranged on the upper portion of the lower machine body, and the meal delivery unit comprises a meal delivery mechanical arm. The two meal delivery mechanical arms are connected with the lower machine body through connecting discs, meal delivery universal balls are arranged at the joints of the meal delivery mechanical arms and the connecting discs, and meal delivery boxes are arranged at the other ends of the meal delivery mechanical arms. According to the humanoid trackless automatic meal delivery robot, by arranging the meal delivery unit, when a user controls the lifting height of a meal delivery box, only a second meal delivery mechanical arm needs to be adjusted for fine adjustment of the lifting height, a first meal delivery mechanical arm needs to be adjusted for adjustment of the overall height, and the meal delivery angle of the meal delivery robot is adjusted more conveniently; during early-stage installation and later-stage maintenance, the task load is small, and maintenance is convenient.

title: Joint module, biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of joint modules, and discloses a joint module, a biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot. title: Robot with emotion accompanying function
abstract: The robot with the emotion accompanying function comprises a robot lower body and a head, a circuit board is arranged in the robot lower body, the head is arranged at the top end of the robot lower body, a display screen is arranged at the top end of the front end of the head, and an eye display position is arranged in the display screen. title: Humanoid robot leg structure and robot

title: Humanoid robot gate passing method based on deep reinforcement learning and image processing
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gate passing method based on deep reinforcement learning and image processing, and the method comprises the following steps: firstly, guaranteeing that a robot successfully walks near a gate through a target detection technology; secondly, when approaching the gate, the robot uses a real-time image captured by a camera to carry out deep reinforcement learning, the image is input into a DQN algorithm, and real-time environment information is provided for the robot; and finally, selecting actions, such as left turning, right turning or crawling, through the value network so as to realize the goal of passing through the gate. A deep reinforcement learning algorithm DQN is applied, and a robot learns a parameter set for making an optimization decision under different scenes through iterative training. By integrating a target detection technology, a DQN algorithm and visual perception, the method enables the robot to adapt to different environments and challenges, and improves the flexibility and success rate in a specific task scene. The innovative method provides a reliable solution for intelligent navigation of the humanoid robot in a complex environment, and has remarkable practical application potential.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR UNDRESSING A PALLET
abstract: System (100) for undressing a pallet (500) of products (510), preferably arranged in layers on a base (520) or plate, said pallet (500) being coated with a protective film (550) for retaining and protecting the products (510) themselves, said film (550) adapted to cover the upper surface (501) and the side surface (502) of the pallet (500) preferably up to the base (520); said system (100) comprises cutting means (110) installed on an anthropomorphic robot (201) for cutting said protective film (550) so as to separate the film into two segments (550s), each comprising an upper flap (551s) of an upper portion (551) of film (550) at the upper surface (501) of the pallet (500) and a lower flap (552s) of a side portion (552) of film (550) at the side surface (502) of the pallet (500); the system (100) further comprises means for withdrawing (120) the protective film (550) and the withdrawing means are installed on the anthropomorphic robot (201) to distance said two segments (550s) from the pallet (500); characterised by comprising pressing means (130) adapted to be positioned on the upper surface (501) of the pallet (500) and exert a force which is directed orthogonally to said upper surface (501) of the pallet (500) and is carried out on a first or second portion (501a, 501b) of said upper surface (501), so as not to come into contact with the upper flap (551s) of the upper portion (551) of film (550) of the segment (550s) that is being withdrawn.

title: Built-in battery structure for chest of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot chest built-in battery structure in the field of humanoid robots, which comprises a waist middle plate, a vertical middle limiting reinforcing rib is fixedly connected to the middle of the upper part of the waist middle plate, the middle limiting reinforcing rib is I-shaped steel, the top end of the middle limiting reinforcing rib is fixedly connected with a top supporting block, and the top supporting block is fixedly connected with the waist middle plate. A middle battery box body is arranged at the position, located on the periphery of the middle limiting reinforcing rib, above the waist middle plate, a limiting strip is arranged in a square hole formed in the middle of the middle battery box body, an I-shaped limiting groove is formed in the middle in the limiting strip, the limiting groove is matched with the middle limiting reinforcing rib, and the limiting strip is made of a graphene heat dissipation material. The middle limiting reinforcing ribs used for limiting are arranged in the middle of the middle battery box body, the requirement for middle battery limiting installation can be met, the firmness of battery installation can be greatly improved, in addition, the middle limiting reinforcing ribs can also greatly improve the rigidity of waist connection of the robot, the graphene limiting strips are arranged, and the service life of the robot is prolonged. The double effects of shock resistance and heat dissipation can be achieved, and the device is extremely practical; the back counterweight battery box body is arranged on the back to play a counterweight role, on one hand, the storage capacity of the robot can be increased, on the other hand, the counterweight effect can be achieved, and double purposes are achieved through one stroke.

title: Robot bionic mouth movement control device and control system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a robot bionic mouth movement control device and control system.The robot bionic mouth movement control device comprises a robot head body, a connecting hole is formed in the bottom of the surface of the robot head body, and a bionic mouth is fixedly connected to the surface of the connecting hole; through the arrangement of the bionic mouth, the first electric sliding rail, the second electric sliding rail and the extrusion plate, the first electric sliding rail and the second electric sliding rail are electrically connected with the rectifier bridge, the power amplifier sound box outputs current and is electrically connected with the rectifier bridge to become direct current, and audio signals are different in length after passing through the electric sliding rails; therefore, a first electric sliding rail and a second electric sliding rail respectively drive a first limiting sliding block and a second limiting sliding block which are slidably connected with the inner wall to adjust the height, so that an extrusion plate drives a corresponding connecting rod to adjust, the connecting rod drives a rubber ring on one side to adjust the shape, and the rubber ring drives a bionic mouth on the surface to adjust the shape; therefore, the effect of controlling the shape of the bionic mouth is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot gait control method and device based on tumble judgment
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot gait control method and device based on tumble judgment, and is applied to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion analysis data of the humanoid robot; according to the motion analysis data, the tumbling state and the tumbling reason of the humanoid robot are judged, the tumbling state comprises stable walking, critical tumbling and tumbling, and the tumbling reason comprises environment interference and hardware errors; calculating the falling probability of the humanoid robot based on the falling state; and correcting the walking gait and the control quantity of the humanoid robot according to the falling probability and the falling reason.
abstract_en: The invention provides a humanoid robot gait control method and device based on tumble judgment, and is applied to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring motion analysis data of the humanoid robot; according to the motion analysis data, the tumbling state and the tumbling reason of the humanoid robot are judged, the tumbling state comprises stable walking, critical tumbling and tumbling, and the tumbling reason comprises environment interference and hardware errors; calculating the falling probability of the humanoid robot based on the falling state; and correcting the walking gait and the control quantity of the humanoid robot according to the falling probability and the falling reason.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid mechanical arm and a robot. The humanoid mechanical arm comprises a shoulder module, an upper arm, an elbow module, a front arm and a wrist module. The shoulder module is configured to be arranged between the carrying platform and the upper end of the upper arm, and has a forward flexion/backward extension degree of freedom, an adduction/abduction degree of freedom and an inward rotation/outward rotation degree of freedom; the elbow module is configured to be arranged between the lower end of the upper arm and the rear end of the front arm and has a bending freedom degree; the wrist module is configured to be arranged between the front end of the forearm and the dexterous hand and has an inward rotation/outward rotation freedom degree and a palmar flexion/dorsal extension freedom degree. The motion range of the humanoid mechanical arm can cover the motion range of a human arm, humanoid flexibility is achieved, various actions of the human arm can be completed, the humanoid mechanical arm is simple in structure, modular design is achieved, good universality and adaptability are achieved, and the humanoid mechanical arm can be suitable for various different application scenes.

title: Robot neck telescopic structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a robot neck telescopic structure which comprises a neck structure, a body structure is mounted at the bottom of the neck structure, a head structure is mounted at the top of the neck structure, the neck structure comprises a neck shell, and an upper driving structure is arranged in the neck shell. The upper driving structure is fixedly installed in the head structure, the bottom of the upper driving structure is rotationally connected with a universal connecting shaft, the bottom of the universal connecting shaft is fixedly connected with a base, the base is installed in the body structure, and the interior of the neck structure is further fixedly connected with two symmetrically-distributed lower driving structures. Under the action of the rear spring, the side spring and the elastic connecting belt, when the robot neck structure acts, the movement is more balanced and smooth due to auxiliary tension, and the robot neck structure can restore the human form better.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot leg structure and a robot, the humanoid robot leg structure comprises a connecting piece, the connecting piece comprises a supporting part, a first fixing part and a second fixing part, the first fixing part and the second fixing part are arranged on the two sides of the supporting part, and the first fixing part and the second fixing part are arranged in a spaced mode in the horizontal direction to define the space interval between the first fixing part and the second fixing part as a first cavity; the first fixing part is provided with a second cavity which is approximately in a hollow annular shape, and the second fixing part is provided with a third cavity which is approximately in a hollow annular shape; comprising an upper connecting end, the upper connecting end is provided with a fourth cavity which is roughly in a hollow annular shape, and the upper connecting end is provided with a notch; a thigh joint module, a shank joint module, a crank and a rocker; according to the leg structure, the size of the lower limb of the robot in the horizontal direction is reduced, the lower limb structure of the robot is more compact and small in size, all the joint modules rotate stably, the structure is firm, and stress dispersity is good.

title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM AND ROBOT CONTROL PROGRAM
abstract: To perform a series of work of checking a position of a package, gripping, and holding by a gripping part quickly and reliably.SOLUTION: Three finger parts 22A, 22B, 22C are provided at a gripping part 20. A plurality of suction pads 24 is attached to a palm side 20A of the gripping part 20 and the finger parts 22A, 22B, 22C. The suction pads 24 suck a package 100 with, for example, an air suction structure, and the finger parts 22A, 22B, 22C are bent, thereby making it possible to grab the package 100. A robot control system classifies the package 100 on the basis of its characteristics (a shape and a weight etc.) and selects the gripping part 20 and the suction pad 24 on the basis of the classified result to allow a single humanoid robot 1 to pick up various types of packages 100. In other words, it is not necessary to select a different robot to match for the characteristics of the package 100 and thus efficiency of picking work can be improved.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Transmission structure of biped robot, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a transmission structure of a biped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot, and the transmission structure comprises a flange plate, a connecting rod section and a crank of a supporting end which are integrally formed; wherein the flange plate is used for being fixedly connected with an output flange of the joint module, the connecting rod section is used for being hinged to the rocker, and the supporting end is coaxial with a rotating shaft of the flange plate. The side support coaxial with the rotating shaft is provided for the crank, torque deviating from the center shaft of the output flange of the speed reducer can be prevented from being generated when the crank is in transmission or stressed, then the situation that a bearing connected with the output flange and a gear of the speed reducer are damaged is avoided, noise generated when the speed reducer rotates is reduced, and the service life of the speed reducer is prolonged. And the service life of the joint module is prolonged.

title: Self-supporting spine of a humanoid robot
abstract: The subject of the application shown in the drawing is a self-supporting spine of a humanoid robot intended for constructing a load-bearing system and connecting its functional elements. The essence of the solution is a self-supporting spine of a humanoid robot, which comprises at least one intermediate member assembly and a lower member assembly and an upper member assembly. Adjacent member assemblies are connected to each other by means of a spherical joint. The intermediate member assembly has an intermediate pin, which at one end is terminated with a dome. Mounted on the cylindrical part of the intermediate pin is a socket, the inner cylindrical surface of which is fitted with the outer cylindrical surface of the intermediate pin. The socket has a deformable dome made of plastic. The upper member assembly consists of an upper member and a socket. The inner cylindrical surface at the base of the socket is mounted on the outer cylindrical surface of the upper member, and the inner end surface at the base of the socket rests on the end surface of the flange of the pin of the upper member assembly. The lower member assembly consists of a lower pin, a deformable ring having a torus shape, and an elastic band. The lower pin is terminated with a spherical dome on which a sleeve is mounted and fixed.

title: Gear and speed reducer for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of transmission devices, in particular to a gear and speed reducer for a humanoid robot, which comprises a shell, a driving mechanism and a first output shaft, the first output shaft penetrates through the shell, and the first output shaft is rotatably connected with the shell; the driving mechanism is arranged on the shell and used for driving the first output shaft to rotate. The service life of the gear and the speed reducer is prolonged.

title: Hotel guest room intelligent AI interaction robot and interaction method
abstract: The invention discloses a hotel guest room intelligent AI interaction robot and an interaction method. The hotel guest room intelligent AI interaction robot comprises a voice recognition module which receives a voice instruction of a user and converts the voice instruction into a text form; the facial expression generation module is used for generating corresponding facial expression feedback of the robot according to the voice instruction of the user; the natural language processing module is used for understanding a voice instruction and text content of the user, analyzing the intention of the user and generating a response; the action control module is used for controlling actions, including head actions and hand actions, of the robot; the cloud data processing module is used for transmitting the voice and data of the user to a cloud for processing; according to the intelligent AI interaction robot and the interaction method for the hotel guest room, the user experience can be effectively improved, the interactivity can be enhanced, the intelligent personalized service can be realized, and more advantages and values can be brought to hotel businesses.

title: INTELLIGENT ROBOT
abstract: An intelligent robot according to an embodiment is disclosed. The intelligent robot according to an embodiment includes at least one processor and a memory configured to store instructions for executing the at least one processor, wherein the intelligent robot includes a plurality of members stacked with gaps to form a shape of a face, and at least one flexible structure disposed in at least one of the gaps, and wherein when the instructions are executed by the at least one processor, the instructions cause the at least one processor to control a motion of the face by applying a force to a power transmission element connected to at least one of the plurality of members based on an audio input.

title: Robotic torso
abstract: A robotic torso for a humanoid robot includes a first torso member having an axial axis aligned with a reference axis and a second torso member having at least one mounting portion for at least one humanoid component. The robotic torso includes a series of actuators arranged in a column between the first torso member and the second torso member and coupling the first torso member to the second torso member. Each of the actuators has a rotatable member defining a rotational axis. The rotational axes of each adjacent pair of actuators in the series of actuators are orthogonal to each other.
abstract_en: A robotic torso for a humanoid robot includes a first torso member having an axial axis aligned with a reference axis and a second torso member having at least one mounting portion for at least one humanoid component. The robotic torso includes a series of actuators arranged in a column between the first torso member and the second torso member and coupling the first torso member to the second torso member. Each of the actuators has a rotatable member defining a rotational axis. The rotational axes of each adjacent pair of actuators in the series of actuators are orthogonal to each other.

title: CONTROL SYSTEM AND CONTROL METHOD FOR WALKING ROBOT
abstract: Provided is a control system for a walking robot in which, when the walking robot falls over, a spring prevents the orientation of leg parts of the walking robot from suddenly changing. A control system for a walking robot provided with an actuator (12a) that drives joints, and springs that cause spring force to act on the joints, wherein the control system comprises a motor control device (8) that drives the actuator (12a), and a controller (7) that transmits a command signal for controlling the motor control device (8), and when the controller (7) determines that the walking robot has fallen over, the motor control device (8) brakes the actuator (12a).

title: Motor module and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of humanoid robot body structures, and discloses a motor module and a humanoid robot, the motor module comprises a motor, a fixed gear ring, a planetary gear, a sun gear, an input disc, an input shaft and an output flange, the motor comprises a motor stator and a motor rotor, the motor rotor is arranged in the motor stator, and the output flange is arranged in the motor stator. The motor rotor is arranged in the input disc and fixedly connected with the input disc, the motor rotor is arranged outside the input disc in a sleeving mode, and the fixed gear ring is arranged in the input disc; the planetary gear is connected with the sun gear and the fixed gear ring in a meshed mode, and the sun gear and the planetary gear are located in the fixed gear ring. The planetary gear is connected to the output flange; the sun gear is fixedly connected with the input shaft, and the input shaft is fixedly connected with the input disc. The planetary gear assembly is embedded in the motor, the height of the motor module is reduced, and the integration level and the space utilization rate of the motor module are improved.

title: Deepwater cable sealing and plugging device and method
abstract: The invention provides a deep-water cable sealing and plugging device and method, and relates to the technical field of high-performance bionic structures, the deep-water cable sealing and plugging device comprises two cylindrical stress parts and a space gradient bearing part, two groups of reinforcing elements which have the same shape as an external shell and are spaced at the same distance are arranged in a bionic tibia structure of a space gradient humanoid robot, and the six reinforcing ribs extending outwards from the innermost element are connected with each other. Compared with a traditional cylindrical humanoid robot supporting leg, the space gradient humanoid robot bionic tibia structure provided by the invention shows smoother platform stress under the same quasi-static compression, and the overall stress is more uniform.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot
abstract: The humanoid double-arm robot comprises a supporting stand column and a base which are arranged in the Z-axis direction, a first multi-axis mechanical arm and a second multi-axis mechanical arm are arranged on the two sides of the top end of the stand column respectively, and the first multi-axis mechanical arm and the second multi-axis mechanical arm are symmetrically arranged with the stand column as the center; the first multi-axis mechanical arm comprises a chest part, a shoulder part and an arm assembly, the chest part is provided with a chest steering engine, and the shoulder part is provided with a shoulder steering engine; the arm assembly comprises an upper arm, an elbow and a front arm, and arm steering engines are arranged in the upper arm, the elbow and the front arm respectively. The second multi-axis mechanical arm is the same as the first multi-axis mechanical arm; a head and neck part is arranged at the top end of the stand column and can rotate in the Y-axis, X-axis and Z-axis directions; and grabbing assemblies are arranged at the tail ends of the first multi-axis mechanical arm and the second multi-axis mechanical arm. The humanoid double-arm robot provided by the utility model has multiple degrees of freedom, improves the humanoid action execution capability, and can meet different humanoid action requirements.
abstract_en: The humanoid double-arm robot comprises a supporting stand column and a base which are arranged in the Z-axis direction, a first multi-axis mechanical arm and a second multi-axis mechanical arm are arranged on the two sides of the top end of the stand column respectively, and the first multi-axis mechanical arm and the second multi-axis mechanical arm are symmetrically arranged with the stand column as the center; the first multi-axis mechanical arm comprises a chest part, a shoulder part and an arm assembly, the chest part is provided with a chest steering engine, and the shoulder part is provided with a shoulder steering engine; the arm assembly comprises an upper arm, an elbow and a front arm, and arm steering engines are arranged in the upper arm, the elbow and the front arm respectively. title: Trajectory tracking method for multi-contact low-centroid crawling motion of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a trajectory tracking method for multi-contact low-centroid crawling motion of a humanoid robot. The invention can be used. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a local contact condition between the humanoid robot and the ground in a low-mass-center crawling movement process, then establishing a robot kinematics and dynamics model, and obtaining a movement track; in the control process of executing the actual crawling movement track of the humanoid robot by adopting the QP algorithm, smooth generation and release between contact points are realized in combination with a multi-contact-point switching algorithm, the body damage of the robot in the complex terrain crawling process is reduced, the smooth degree of contact point switching in the crawling process is improved, and the safety of the robot is improved. And finally, the stable low-centroid crawling of the humanoid robot in a complex terrain is realized.

title: Ground type identification device and method for foot type robot
abstract: The invention relates to a ground type recognition device and method for a foot type robot, and belongs to the field of robot environment perception. The device comprises a robot body, recording modules installed on the feet of the robot body and a microcomputer carrying a trained lightweight recognition model, and the recording modules comprise directional microphones and a plurality of damping structures installed on the feet of the robot body to form a microphone array. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an audio signal that the foot end of the robot touches the ground in indoor and outdoor ground environments based on the device; an improved audio signal processing method is adopted to obtain MFCC features, and a spectral subtraction method is adopted to eliminate noise interference generated during operation of the robot in the processing process; and taking the improved MFCC features as input of a convolutional neural network, and training to obtain a lightweight recognition model. And during identification, the MFCC features are also extracted and input into the trained lightweight identification model to obtain an identification result.

title: Robot control circuit and desktop humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot control circuit and a desktop humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The circuit comprises a lifting detection module, a main control module and a steering engine control module, the lifting detection module comprises a double-foot stroke limiting switch, and if the switching state of the double-foot stroke limiting switch is off, the lifting detection module sends an abnormal signal to the main control module; the main control module is used for sending a closing signal to the steering engine control module when receiving the abnormal signal; and the steering engine control module is used for controlling the power supply loop between the steering engine and the battery to be disconnected when receiving the closing signal. The protection circuit has the advantages of simple circuit, low cost, quick protection response and the like.

title: Robot control method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, in particular to a robot control method and device and a storage medium. The robot control method comprises the steps that a robot supporting leg knee joint angle and a swinging leg knee joint angle are obtained; determining a support leg knee joint angle and a swing leg knee joint angle; determining a target discrete support leg knee joint angle and a target discrete swing leg knee joint angle based on the support leg knee joint angle interval and the swing leg knee joint angle interval; based on the target kinetic parameters corresponding to the target discrete support leg knee joint angle and the target discrete swing leg knee joint angle, generating a joint torque control instruction for performing whole-body control on the robot; and performing whole-body control on the robot based on the joint torque control instruction. According to the invention, the dependence on the computing power of control hardware is reduced, and the response speed and the control precision of the joint are improved.

title: High-speed self-adaptive humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a high-speed self-adaptive humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a palm assembly, a finger assembly and a finger driving assembly, the palm assembly comprises a palm base, the finger assembly comprises a plurality of finger units, at least one finger unit is arranged in the palm center of the palm base, and the other finger units are arranged at the front end of the palm base; each finger unit comprises a first knuckle, a second knuckle and a third knuckle; the finger driving assembly comprises a driving device and a plurality of flexible units in one-to-one correspondence with the finger units, each flexible unit comprises a tendon rope and a flexible mechanism, each flexible mechanism comprises an elastic part, the elastic parts are arranged on the tendon ropes, the first ends of the tendon ropes are connected with the driving device, and the second ends of the tendon ropes are connected with the second knuckles. The high-speed self-adaptive humanoid dexterous hand is used for overcoming the defects that in the prior art, when a five-finger dexterous hand works, the grabbing speed is low, the action lacks flexibility, the effective grabbing effect on objects in different shapes is difficult to achieve, and the use flexibility is poor.

title: Leg swinging control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a swing leg control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and is applied to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring state data and joint angle data of the humanoid robot; determining pose state information of the humanoid robot according to the state data, and determining sole information of the humanoid robot according to the joint angle data and forward kinematics; predicting centroid angular momentum at the end of the current gait according to the pose state information and the sole information; constructing a trigger type sampling mechanism to regulate and control prediction calculation of the centroid angular momentum, and obtaining a trigger type angular momentum prediction value; determining expected angular momentums corresponding to different motion instructions; and calculating the foothold position of the humanoid robot according to the trigger angular momentum predicted value and the expected angular momentum.

title: Biped robot state estimation method and system based on multi-sensor information fusion
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot state estimation method and system based on multi-sensor information fusion, and relates to the technical field of biped robot state estimation. Comprising the steps of solving positions and speeds of foot ends of the biped robot relative to a fuselage system; iMU data carried by the biped robot is obtained, and a rotation matrix from a fuselage system to a world system is obtained; defining a state quantity of the biped robot, and constructing a state equation of a Kalman filter based on a rotation matrix from a fuselage system to a world system and a three-axis acceleration value of the fuselage; constructing an observation equation of a Kalman filter based on the position and speed of the foot end relative to the fuselage system in combination with a rotation matrix from the fuselage system to a world system and the three-axis angular velocity of the fuselage; and estimating the state of the biped robot at the next moment by adopting a Kalman filtering method based on the constructed state equation and observation equation. According to the method, the encoder and the IMU are comprehensively used, the limitation of a single sensor is overcome, and more reliable robot motion state estimation is achieved.

title: Arm pathological tremor simulation system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and medical instruments, in particular to an arm pathological tremor simulation system which comprises a mechanical system, an excitation system, a control system and a detection system. The mechanical system comprises an upper arm frame and a front arm frame, and the upper arm frame and the front arm frame are movably connected with each other; the excitation system comprises motors, the motors are arranged on the upper arm frame and the front arm frame through motor support mounting plates respectively, and the output ends of the motors are connected with balance weight levers. The control system controls the movement of the mechanical system and the excitation system; and the detection system collects tremor simulation data in the mechanical system for analysis and detection. Compared with the prior art, synchronous movement of the shoulder joint and the elbow joint is achieved, any initial posture of the arm in the plane can be simulated, and compared with a traditional tremor simulation robot, the humanoid arm simulation effect is better.

title: Leg power structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a leg power structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The leg power structure of the humanoid robot comprises a stepping driving unit, a thigh body assembly, a shank body assembly and a foot assembly which are arranged on the waist of the humanoid robot and connected in sequence, and the stepping driving unit is used for driving the whole leg power structure to swing front and back; the thigh body assembly comprises a first thigh body and a second thigh body, the shank body assembly comprises a shank body, and the foot assembly comprises a foot supporting piece; a hip joint driving unit is arranged at the upper part of the first thigh body to drive the whole leg power structure to swing left and right; a first driving unit is arranged between the first thigh body and the second thigh body so that the first thigh body and the second thigh body can rotate in the relative circumferential direction. The whole leg power structure is reasonable in design and compact in structure, and the requirement for achieving various action postures of the humanoid robot is well met.

title: Shank joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of knee joints of humanoid robots, in particular to a shank joint of a humanoid robot. A plurality of roller assemblies are arranged at the other end of the lead screw body, and the roller nuts are connected to the peripheries of the roller assemblies in a meshed mode. The inverted planetary roller screw rod for the robot has the advantages that the number of mechanical parts is small, the cost is reduced, the processing property is optimal, the practicability is high, and the like.

title: Robot system that tracks a specific person
abstract: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a robot system which controls the direction of the head or body of a robot by using the position coordinates of the face of a specific person and outputs an appropriate facial expression corresponding to the facial expression of the specific person through a beam projector. A robot system tracking a specific person comprises a camera, a face recognition unit, a specific person designation unit, a face coordinate acquisition unit, a head control unit, a motor control unit, and a screen control unit. The robot system tracks the face of the specific person and moves the robot head to a position facing the face of the specific person by controlling the robot head. The present invention converts a facial expression of a robot into a beam projector in real time and provides an effect of talking through a specific person tracking and eye contact even during motion.

abstract: The present invention relates to a training simulator required to control a humanoid robot in a remote place. an operator receives image information from a robot field of view in a virtual environment, converts raw data generated by using an hmd, an imu, and a pedal, which are operation devices, into motion information, and transmits the converted data to a robot of the simulator to operate the robot in the virtual environment.

title: Planetary roller screw system dynamics modeling method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic modeling method of a planetary roller screw system for a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: (1) establishing a planetary roller screw mechanical model, and solving contact force and friction force; (2) establishing a time-varying meshing stiffness calculation model of the system; (3) establishing a displacement equation of meshing points of the planetary roller screw gear pair; (4) establishing a nonlinear dynamic differential equation set of the planetary roller screw transmission system; (5) reasonable parameters are selected to solve nonlinear response of the system; the method has the beneficial effects that the dynamic response of the planetary roller screw system for the humanoid robot can be solved, the vacancy of the dynamic modeling method of the planetary roller screw system for the humanoid robot at present is filled, and the method has good universality.

title: Balance control method and system for double-wheel-leg robot
abstract: The invention provides a balance control method and system for a double-wheel-leg robot, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the analysis according to the current load data of the double-wheel-leg robot, and obtaining a state data array for reconfiguration analysis; querying a balance control library according to the state data array to obtain a reconfiguration parameter data set; and according to the reconfiguration parameter data set, the balance control parameters are reconfigured. According to the balance control method and system for the double-wheel-leg robot, balance control parameters are reconfigured according to the load condition so as to adapt to effective control over the balance of the robot under different working conditions.

title: Biped robot optimal gait control method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot intelligent control, and discloses a biped robot optimal gait control method, system and device and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the walking demand of a biped robot; based on walking requirements of the biped robot, a plurality of optimization gait parameters of the biped robot are obtained through a particle swarm method in combination with a local search mechanism in different walking modes; training a generative adversarial network through the plurality of optimized gait parameters to obtain a gait parameter generation model; and generating control gait parameters of the biped robot through the gait parameter generation model, and controlling the biped robot to walk according to the control gait parameters of the biped robot. The problem that an intelligent algorithm is prone to falling into a local optimal solution is effectively avoided, effective control over different walking modes can be achieved, the walking modes of the biped robot can be freely switched, the biped robot can be suitable for moving in a changing state, and the self-adaptive walking effect is achieved.

title: Clutch type parallel elastic driver for leg-foot type robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of leg-foot type robots, in particular to a clutch type parallel elastic driver for a leg-foot type robot, which comprises a parallel elastic mechanism arranged on a knee connecting shaft at the joint of a thigh arm and a shank arm, and the parallel elastic mechanism comprises a shell arranged outside the knee connecting shaft in a sleeving manner; a front planet carrier and a rear planet carrier are arranged on the two sides in the shell respectively, a front sun gear and a rear sun gear are arranged on the front planet carrier and the rear planet carrier respectively, at least one front planet gear is arranged on the front planet carrier and connected with the inner side wall of the front sun gear in a meshed mode, and at least one rear planet gear is arranged on the rear planet carrier and connected with the inner side wall of the rear sun gear in a meshed mode. The rear planet gears are connected with the inner side wall of the rear sun gear in a meshed mode, a torsion spring is connected between the front sun gear and the rear sun gear, and a front brake piece and a rear brake piece which are used for braking the front sun gear and the rear sun gear are arranged on the shell. According to the invention, the parallel elastic mechanism can be effectively controlled to intervene in rotation control of the knee connecting shaft, so that the flexibility of the robot in a non-jumping gait is not influenced.

title: Teleoperation control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a teleoperation control method and system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that an operation end encodes received action data and transmits a generated action sequence to a robot end, the robot end performs timestamp and security value verification on the action sequence, and a party passing the verification executes the action sequence. Through verification of the received timestamp and the safety value of the action sequence to be executed, the operation safety of the robot and the action execution smoothness are guaranteed, the situation that the robot exceeds the motion range is avoided, and the safety of the robot and the surrounding environment of the robot is guaranteed; the human body model is generated according to the figure of the operator, and the human body model and the preset robot model are compared and displayed, so that the intuition and the matching degree of operation are improved, and the operator is helped to better judge and control the state of the robot.
abstract_en: The invention provides a teleoperation control method and system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that an operation end encodes received action data and transmits a generated action sequence to a robot end, the robot end performs timestamp and security value verification on the action sequence, and a party passing the verification executes the action sequence. Through verification of the received timestamp and the safety value of the action sequence to be executed, the operation safety of the robot and the action execution smoothness are guaranteed, the situation that the robot exceeds the motion range is avoided, and the safety of the robot and the surrounding environment of the robot is guaranteed; the human body model is generated according to the figure of the operator, and the human body model and the preset robot model are compared and displayed, so that the intuition and the matching degree of operation are improved, and the operator is helped to better judge and control the state of the robot.

title: Leg protection structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of biped robots, in particular to a biped robot leg protection structure which comprises a connecting rack, a movable arm and a bottom plate and further comprises a protection assembly, and the protection assembly comprises a connecting base, a first connecting belt, a protection cover, a second connecting belt, a connecting block, a movable plate, a fixed plate, a hook, a hanging ring and a telescopic spring. The connecting base is fixedly connected with the bottom plate, the first connecting belt is fixedly connected with the connecting base, the protective cover is fixedly connected with the first connecting belt, the second connecting belt is fixedly connected with the protective cover, the connecting block is fixedly connected with the second connecting belt, the movable plate is connected with the connecting block through the telescopic spring, and the fixed plate is fixedly connected with the movable arm. The hook is fixedly connected with the fixed plate, the hanging ring is fixedly connected with the movable plate, the telescopic spring is arranged on the connecting block and connected with the movable plate, and the fragile joint connecting position of the biped robot is prevented from being damaged through shielding protection of the protective cover.

title: AI digital human control method and device
abstract: The invention provides an AI digital human control method and device. The method comprises the steps that corresponding non-contact operation is determined according to an interaction page; training and improving the recognition rate of non-contact operation based on a deep learning model; and in response to a non-contact operation matched with the current interaction page, executing a control operation of the AI digital human corresponding to the interaction page. The device is used for implementing the method. According to the embodiment of the invention, by establishing the matching relationship between the interactive page and the non-contact operation, a large amount of invalid non-contact operation can be eliminated, the method is more suitable for complex scenes such as exhibition sites, the influence of environment variables and background sound is effectively reduced, the reliability is higher, the user experience is improved, and the user experience is improved. title: Reactive footstep planning and motion control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot reactive footstep planning and motion control method and system, and relates to the technical field of robot disturbance control. The method includes: acquiring external control speed, and calculating motion step length and direction of the humanoid robot; a linear inverted pendulum model of the humanoid robot is established, and footprint compensation of the humanoid robot after disturbance is obtained; based on the motion step length and direction of the humanoid robot, generating a plurality of foothold points of the humanoid robot in combination with footprint compensation, and based on the plurality of foothold points, obtaining a reference zero moment point planning trajectory; predicting an expected zero moment point planning trajectory based on the reference zero moment point planning trajectory in combination with a zero moment point planning trajectory fed back by the humanoid robot; and based on the expected zero moment point planning trajectory, joint angles required by all joints of the humanoid robot are obtained in combination with inverse kinematics, and motion control is performed on the disturbed humanoid robot. According to the invention, the robustness of the motion of the humanoid robot against external interference is enhanced.

title: Local terrain map construction method in biped robot navigation process
abstract: The invention discloses a local terrain map construction method in a biped robot navigation process, and belongs to the field of biped robot mapping and autonomous navigation. A depth camera continuously collects point cloud data of a terrain, the point cloud data is preprocessed by a sensing calculation unit and then is registered with a previous frame of point cloud, and an accurate inter-frame relative pose is obtained; updating the elevation map according to the relative pose to obtain a local terrain map; during registration, the initial value of the relative pose of the two registered point clouds is obtained by using the positioning information of the robot. According to the method, the elevation map is used for constructing the local terrain map, and the current frame data and the previous elevation map are fused, so that the problem that a local map with sufficient information cannot be constructed by the current frame data due to knee shielding is solved.

title: Reinforcement learning method and program product for controlling motion of biped robot based on track self-correction
abstract: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning method for controlling motion of a biped robot based on track self-correction. The method comprises the following steps: outputting a decision action by using a strategy model, and performing online interaction with the biped robot to obtain a real environment sample; simulating the motion state of the biped robot by using an environment dynamic model, and training the environment dynamic model by using the obtained real environment sample and a supervised learning method; then interacting with the strategy model to obtain a virtual sample, aligning the real sample and the virtual sample to carry out track self-correction, filtering the virtual sample by adopting error control, and after the environment dynamic model is updated, interacting with the environment dynamic model by utilizing a strategy to generate a new more accurate training virtual sample; and jointly training the strategy model by using the real environment sample and the new training virtual sample. According to the method, accumulated rewarding similar to model-free reinforcement learning can be achieved only through little interaction between the robot and the environment, and the learning efficiency and accuracy of the biped robot motion strategy are improved.

title: Extensible robot humanoid precise grabbing skill learning method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an extensible robot humanoid precise grabbing skill learning method and system, and relates to the crossing field of artificial intelligence and robotology, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the grabbing motion track of a robot imitation demonstrator; a robot grabbing skill model is established according to the grabbing motion trail of the simulation demonstrator; learning and optimizing parameters of the robot grabbing skill model to obtain a grabbing reference track guided by experience knowledge of the demonstrator; the grabbing reference track is converted into a linear dynamic system, and parameter optimization is conducted on the linear dynamic system so that global convergence of the robot grabbing skill can be achieved; and reconstructing the robot grabbing skill model by using the intermediate point so as to realize rapid expansion of the robot grabbing skill. According to the method, the problems of poor expansibility and low accuracy in a robot grabbing path planning process in an unstructured environment can be solved.

abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical joints, in particular to a novel ankle joint which is respectively connected with a mechanical leg and a mechanical sole through a supporting device, and the mechanical sole connected with the supporting device can change the angle formed between the mechanical sole and the mechanical leg through a connecting device. title: Robot waist rotating base
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot waist rotation, in particular to a robot waist rotation base which comprises a front shell and a rear shell, the outer wall of one third shaft rod is fixedly connected with two symmetrically-distributed traction mechanisms, and the outer wall of the first shaft rod is provided with a front-back reset mechanism. According to the humanoid robot, the shell of the waist of the humanoid robot adopts a falling structural design of a high-toughness PP material, and through the structural deformation of the material and the structural design of reasonable configuration of a motor, the waist can do various actions like people in the upper, lower, left, right, front and back directions, and the actions are mutually connected and do not interfere with each other; and the front-back resetting mechanism and the lateral resetting mechanism are arranged in the corresponding rotating direction, so that the shell can be assisted to recover to a normal state after deformation such as stooping.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure based on line driving and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg structure based on line driving and a robot. The invention aims to solve the problems of low bionic degree and high inertia of a leg structure caused by the fact that a humanoid robot is directly driven by a rotating motor. The method is mainly used for leg structure design of the humanoid robot. The drivers at the leg joints are uniformly distributed on the thighs, the knee joints are driven by lines, and the pulley blocks are combined, so that contraction and relaxation of muscles are better simulated, and the bionic degree is improved; the ankle joint adopts four-connecting-rod transmission and belt transmission, and the power of the servo motor is transmitted to the ankle joint from the thigh, so that the inertia is reduced, and the dynamic response capability is improved.

title: Biped robot passive walking control method based on target dynamics
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot passive walking control method based on target dynamics. The biped robot passive walking control method comprises the following steps that the two-leg oscillation frequency and expected energy of expected passive walking and the actual robot two-leg included angle, angular velocity and actual energy are obtained; based on the expected double-leg oscillation frequency, the actual double-leg included angle, the actual double-leg angular velocity and the energy error, a control algorithm is applied, and the conditions met by the torque of the two joints are determined; selecting an ankle joint torque setting method, and determining explicit expressions of two joint torques in combination with conditions that the joint torques should meet; hip joint moment limitation is considered, ankle joint moment compensation is adopted for hip joint moments exceeding the limitation range, and final joint moments are obtained and output to the robot. By means of system dimension reduction and input and output linearization, through an expected target power system, the system tracks inherent dynamics of the system, energy feedback control is achieved at the same time, and the robot can generate natural, stable and efficient expected gaits.

title: Wearable and size-adjustable steel wire rope driven lower limb exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wearable robots, in particular to a wearable size-adjustable steel wire rope driven lower limb exoskeleton robot which comprises a back plate, a hip joint mechanism, a thigh mechanism, a knee joint mechanism, a shank mechanism, an ankle joint mechanism and a foot mechanism. The hip joint mechanism is provided with an active degree of freedom for bending forwards and stretching backwards and two passive degrees of freedom, the knee joint is provided with an active degree of freedom for stretching forwards and bending backwards, the ankle joint is provided with two passive degrees of freedom, and the dead weight of the lower limb exoskeleton robot is transmitted to the ground through the foot mechanism. The active degree of freedom of the lower limb exoskeleton robot is driven by the steel wire rope, the structure is compact, flexibility is good, and mechanism rotational inertia is reduced; the size of the exoskeleton robot can be automatically adjusted, the steel wire rope is arranged in the thigh mechanism, and normal activities of the human body are prevented from being interfered. Bionic design is adopted for the knee joint part of the exoskeleton robot, and the problem that the rotation center of the knee joint of the exoskeleton robot is inconsistent with the human body is solved.

abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical joints, in particular to an adjustable ankle joint which is characterized in that a mechanical leg and a mechanical sole are connected through a connecting device, and the upper part and the lower part of the connecting device can relatively rotate through a rotating device; the rotation angle of the connecting device is limited through the limiting device; vibration generated by the connection device in the walking process of following the humanoid robot is reduced through the protection device, and the practicability of the device is improved; comprising a connecting device, a rotating device, a limiting device and a protecting device, the rotating device is installed on the connecting device, the limiting device is installed on the connecting device, and the protecting device is installed on the connecting device.

title: Mouth transmission mechanism, face structure and robot
abstract: The utility model provides a mouth transmission mechanism, a face structure and a robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The mouth transmission mechanism comprises a fixing assembly; a lower jaw assembly; the transmission assembly comprises a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod and a third connecting rod, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are rotationally arranged on the fixing assembly, and the third connecting rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting rod; and the driving assembly comprises a first driving part and a second driving part. In the mouth transmission mechanism, a first connecting rod, a lower jaw assembly, a third connecting rod and a second connecting rod are rotationally connected in sequence to form a multi-connecting-rod structure. During use, the first driving part acts on the first connecting rod to drive the lower jaw assembly to move so as to simulate stretching of the jaw. The second driving part acts on the second connecting rod to drive the lower jaw assembly to rotate so as to simulate opening and closing of the mouth. Compared with an existing humanoid robot which can only complete mouth opening and closing actions, the mouth transmission mechanism is higher in imitation degree and better in humanoid effect.

title: Finger push rod, manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a finger push rod, a manipulator and a humanoid robot. The finger push rod comprises a first assembly body and a second assembly body, wherein the first assembly body comprises a shell and a motor outer stator of a brushless motor arranged in the shell; the second assembly body comprises a motor inner rotor which is rotatably arranged in the motor outer stator; the ball screw is provided with a first part located in the shell and a second part extending out of the shell; the first part is arranged in a motor inner rotor of the brushless motor in a penetrating manner and is driven by the motor inner rotor to rotate; and the ball screw nut is sleeved on the second part and is connected with the mechanical finger. A ball screw pair is adopted as a transmission device, and the ball screw pair and a motor can be designed on the same straight line, so that the radial size of the finger push rod at the motor is reduced; the split type brushless motor is adopted, the ball screw is arranged in the rotor in the motor in a penetrating mode, other connecting structures are not needed, the number of parts is reduced, the system integration degree is high, and the axial size of the finger push rod can be reduced.

title: Connecting rod parallel wrist joint for mechanical arm, seven-degree-of-freedom high-load mechanical arm and electro-hydraulic hybrid drive humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a connecting rod parallel wrist joint for a mechanical arm, a seven-degree-of-freedom high-load mechanical arm and an electro-hydraulic hybrid drive humanoid robot. The robot comprises an upper limb driven by an electric actuator and a lower limb driven by a hydraulic actuator. The upper limb is mainly composed of a head, two seven-degree-of-freedom high-load mechanical arms and a trunk, a novel connecting rod parallel mechanism is adopted, motor power can be gathered, and the load capacity of wrist joints is improved; the lower limb is mainly composed of a two-leg system. The head, the two arms and the two legs are installed on the top, the two sides and the bottom of the trunk respectively, and the whole robot is of a bilateral symmetry structure. The multi-degree-of-freedom joints in the mechanical arm disclosed by the invention are driven by parallel mechanisms, so that the upper limbs have high load capacity, and meanwhile, electric driving and hydraulic driving are respectively adopted according to different requirements of tasks borne by the upper limbs and the lower limbs on force application and response, so that the whole robot has high load and high-speed and high-dynamic movement capacity at the same time.

title: Double-arm intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm intelligent robot which comprises a mobile machine body, a double-arm base, a multi-degree-of-freedom anthropomorphic arm, a dexterous hand, a holder, a binocular vision device, a control system module and a walking camera module, and the double-arm base is fixed to the mobile machine body; the multi-degree-of-freedom anthropomorphic arm is connected to the double-arm base; the dexterous hand is connected to the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm; the holder is fixed on the double-arm base; the binocular vision device is fixed on the holder; the control system module is arranged in the mobile machine body; the walking camera module is arranged in the mobile machine body, and the binocular vision device is electrically connected to the walking camera module. According to the technical scheme, the strength and precision of the robot are combined with judgment and originality of human beings, and incomparable productivity and safety are achieved in the dangerous, complex and unstructured environment. The double-arm intelligent robot provides a safer and more effective way to simulate the flexible operation capability of human beings under challenging and dangerous conditions.

title: Differential transmission device and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a differential transmission device and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the differential transmission device comprises a first driving unit, a second driving unit and a supporting unit, the first driving unit and the second driving unit each comprise a transmission assembly and a gear output part, and the transmission assemblies are in driving connection with the gear output parts; the two gear output parts are oppositely arranged, the supporting unit comprises a driven gear part, the driven gear part is connected with the two gear output parts in a meshed mode, the gear output parts are directly used as power output ends or planet carriers, extra structural components needed by connection are greatly reduced, and under the condition that movement of the gear output parts is not affected, the gear output parts can be connected with the gear output parts in a meshed mode. abstract: The invention provides a biped robot climbing method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robotics.The method comprises the steps that a dynamical model of a biped robot is determined, a target function is constructed based on the dynamical model and a model prediction control algorithm, and constraint conditions corresponding to the target function are determined; solving the target function to obtain an optimal solution of a climbing footstep position sequence of the biped robot; based on the optimal solution of the footstep position sequence and an overall control algorithm, determining a joint position expected value and an expected attitude angle of each footstep, and based on the expected attitude angle, obtaining a joint speed expected value and a joint acceleration expected value of each footstep; based on the joint position expectation value, the joint speed expectation value and the joint acceleration expectation value of each foot step, the control torque of each foot step is calculated, and the biped robot is controlled to climb and walk according to the control torque of each foot step. The adaptability and stability of the biped robot in the climbing walking process are improved.

title: Hip and waist joint of biped robot
abstract: The hip and waist joint of the biped robot comprises a support assembly, a first rotating motor set and two second rotating motor sets, one end of the first rotating motor set is connected with the support assembly, and the other end of the first rotating motor set is rotationally connected with the support assembly. The first rotating motor set is used for controlling the movement of the waist, one ends of the two second rotating motor sets are connected with the two sides of the support assembly, the other ends of the two second rotating motor sets are rotationally connected with the two sides of the support assembly, and the two second rotating motor sets are used for controlling the movement of the hip. The first rotating motor set is located between the two second rotating motor sets, and the first rotating motor set and the second rotating motor sets both have autorotation freedom degrees and side-sway freedom degrees. According to the utility model, the flexibility of hip and waist joints can be improved, and complicated lower limb actions such as lateral bending and lateral leg swinging can be carried out.

title: Omnidirectional impact-resistant parallel coupling waist mechanism of humanoid robot and application of omni-directional impact-resistant parallel coupling waist mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an omni-directional impact-resistant parallel coupling waist mechanism of a humanoid robot and application of the omni-directional impact-resistant parallel coupling waist mechanism. The waist structure comprises a push rod device and a rotating device. The two push rod devices are connected in parallel; the upper ends of the push rod devices are connected with the upper half robot body through revolute pairs, the lower ends of the push rod devices are connected with the rotating devices through revolute pairs, and the two push rod devices work differently to enable the upper half robot body to swing towards the two sides of the body; the bottom of the upper half robot body is rotatably connected with the rotating device; the rotating device is rotatably connected to the waist joint, transmission between the main joint motor and the rotating device is achieved through the transmission mechanism, and the upper half robot body of the robot is driven to rotate. According to the waist structure, swing control over the waist joints is achieved through the push rods connected in parallel, the waist structure is independent of the degree of freedom of rotation and has the advantages of being high in load driving capacity and quick in response, and impact on the waist can be effectively relieved through the waist structure.

title: Pose self-adaptive control method for multi-joint double-foot cooperative robot
abstract: The invention relates to a pose self-adaptive control method and device for a multi-joint double-foot cooperative robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a multi-joint double-foot coordination robot model comprising a central platform, a robot hip joint, a robot length-adjustable leg rod, a robot ankle joint and a robot foot plate; respectively generating a target body pose by calculating a pose error under the condition that two feet of the multi-joint two-foot cooperative robot model stand and no interaction exists, or generating a target interaction force based on a target impedance characteristic by calculating the pose error and calculating the target body pose under the condition that interaction exists; and calculating a target angle based on the target body pose to generate a control instruction, controlling a joint driver based on the control instruction, and correcting the length parameter of the central platform based on the tension and pressure of the central platform. According to the invention, natural and efficient interaction behaviors are provided, and the accuracy of attitude adjustment and the flexibility and robustness to the environment are ensured.

title: Variable reduction ratio-variable rigidity coupled humanoid robot knee joint
abstract: The invention discloses a variable reduction ratio-variable rigidity coupled humanoid robot knee joint which comprises a motor module, a push rod module, a variable structure four-bar linkage gear ratio module, a variable rigidity elastic unit, a rope and a bottom plate. The variable-structure four-connecting-rod gear ratio module adjusts a reduction ratio curve by changing the distance between an input shaft and an output shaft of a four-connecting-rod mechanism, and the variable-rigidity elastic unit, the rope, a motor end rope wheel in the motor module and a rope wheel in the variable-structure four-connecting-rod gear ratio module form an antagonism type variable-rigidity mechanism. The rigidity of the mechanism is changed by changing the pre-stretching amount. The variable-structure four-connecting-rod gear ratio module and the antagonism type variable-rigidity mechanism are coupled, the high explosion capacity and the mechanical buffering capacity are both considered, jumping motion of the robot is facilitated, in addition, the reduction ratio changing curve and the joint rigidity of the joint can be adjusted at the same time through one push rod, and use of a driving assembly is saved.

title: Humanoid artificial hand control mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of artificial limb manufacturing, in particular to a humanoid artificial hand control mechanism which comprises an arm sensing assembly, and a data hole is formed in the middle of the upper end face of the arm sensing assembly. A plurality of clamping slots are uniformly formed in the outer side of the upper end of the arm sensing assembly in a circumferential array mode, buckle sleeve grooves are formed in the lower ends of the clamping slots, and the outer sides of the buckle sleeve grooves are sleeved with connecting devices convenient to disassemble; a plurality of clamping insertion blocks are fixedly connected to the outer side of the lower end face of the hand base in a circumferential array mode, and buckling grooves are formed in the inner ends of the clamping insertion blocks; the beneficial effects of the utility model are that the sensing assembly and the movable assembly are convenient to disassemble and assemble at the joint through the arrangement of the convenient-to-disassemble connecting device, the space occupied during carrying and transportation is reduced, the carrying convenience is improved, and when part of the assemblies are detected, only the assemblies need to be disassembled and the part of the assemblies are respectively placed on the detection device, so that the detection efficiency is greatly improved. And the convenience and the fineness of the detection work are improved.

title: ROBOT, CONTROL METHOD FOR ROBOT, AND RECORDING MEDIUM
abstract: A robot includes a torso, a head coupled to the torso so as to be rotatable with respect to the torso, and at least one processor. The at least one processor determines whether the torso is inclined from a horizontal direction and, in a case where a determination is made that the torso is inclined from the horizontal direction, controls an actuator to rotate the head with respect to the torso such that the head faces the horizontal direction.
