title: Foot sensing structure, foot structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a foot sensing structure, a foot structure and a humanoid robot, and solves the problem that the control capability is poor when the robot walks or executes high-difficulty actions on complex terrains due to the fact that the detection precision of the stress condition of soles is poor. The foot sensing structure comprises a strain layer and at least four sets of sensor assemblies, the at least four sets of sensor assemblies are arranged on the toe left portion, the toe right portion, the heel left portion and the heel right portion respectively, so that stress detection is conducted on all parts of the foot, the toe portion is divided into the toe left portion and the toe right portion through a first partition groove of the toe portion, and the toe portion is divided into the toe left portion and the toe right portion through a second partition groove of the toe portion. The heel part is divided into a heel left part and a heel right part by the second partition groove of the heel part, so that the mutual influence on the stress detection of the toe left part, the toe right part, the heel left part and the heel right part is reduced, and the detection precision of the stress condition of the foot is improved; therefore, the control capability of the robot when walking on a complex terrain or executing high-difficulty actions is improved.

title: Accompanying robot for patient with mental and psychological diseases at home
abstract: The invention discloses a household mental and psychological disease patient accompanying robot which comprises a robot lower body and a robot upper body, an adjusting assembly is installed on the inner wall of the robot lower body, a second auxiliary assembly is arranged on the inner wall of the robot upper body, and a monitoring assembly and an interaction assembly are installed on one side of the robot upper body. An anti-falling assembly is installed on the robot upper body, through the adjusting assembly arranged on the robot lower body, the height and angle can be conveniently adjusted according to the use condition when a patient uses the household mental and psychological disease patient accompanying robot, and meanwhile the monitoring assembly and the interaction assembly are arranged on the robot upper body; facial expression and heart rate of a patient can be monitored, mental emotion of the patient can be better known, impurities or dust attached to the interactive display screen can be cleaned in an auxiliary mode, and follow-up use of the patient is facilitated.

title: Variable-form humanoid robot balance control method based on unified model and multi-control-point model prediction
abstract: The invention discloses a unified model and multi-control-point model prediction-based variable-form humanoid robot balance control method, which is characterized in that common external disturbance suffered by a robot is unified into virtual force/torque, an upper controller adopts model prediction control based on the virtual force/torque, and expected contact force and torque are calculated and distributed; the lower-layer controller distributes the acting force of each contact point of the robot based on the expected contact force and moment, and meanwhile, the lower-layer controller further designs a bidirectional coupling heuristic admittance control strategy and a hip-knee composite heuristic posture control strategy, so that stable control over the posture of the upper body of the robot is achieved, and the purpose of stable control over the posture of the upper body of the robot is achieved. And a whole-body motion trail optimization problem is established based on the acceleration of the actual control point, an expected whole-body joint angle of the robot is solved, and the motion trail is generated. The stable traffic capacity of the robot on an uneven road surface and under disturbance of external force is improved.

title: Full-size rigidity-variable humanoid dexterous manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a full-size variable-rigidity humanoid dexterous manipulator, and relates to the technical field of manipulators. The five fingers are installed at the top of the base, each finger is composed of a finger root part, a finger middle part and a fingertip part, three connecting blocks are fixed to the top of each finger root part through three springs, the three connecting blocks are connected with three motor winding rods through stay wires, a positioning hole is formed in the rear side of the top of each finger root part, and the bottom of each finger middle part is connected with the three connecting blocks through three spherical hinge connecting rods; a fingertip supporting rod is arranged in the middle of the top, two inverted-T-shaped connecting frame rods are arranged on the two sides of the top and connected through a movement balancing frame, an overturning balancing frame is installed at the rear ends of the two inverted-T-shaped connecting frame rods and provided with positioning pins matched with positioning holes in an inserted mode, and a fingertip part is installed at the upper end of the fingertip supporting rod and the upper ends of the two inverted-T-shaped connecting frame rods. Complex actions such as front-and-back bending and left-and-right swinging of fingers in different dimensions can be achieved at the same time, the variable rigidity capacity and the self-adaption function are achieved, and the grabbing action can be executed more flexibly and stably.

title: Humanoid robot based on pneumatics
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of robots, and provides a pneumatic-based humanoid robot which comprises a waist joint, the waist joint is rotationally connected with an upper limb joint through an upper side plate, and the waist joint is rotationally connected with a lower limb joint through a lower side plate; the waist joint is at least provided with an executive component group and a middle plate, the executive component group comprises a plurality of identical executive components, the executive components are rotationally connected between the upper side plate and the middle plate and between the middle plate and the lower side plate, and each executive component comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, an air cylinder and a pneumatic muscle; the pneumatic muscle is parallel to the air cylinder, one end of the pneumatic muscle is hinged to the first connecting plate, and the other end of the pneumatic muscle is hinged to the second connecting plate. The air cylinders and the pneumatic muscles are connected in parallel to form execution elements, firm supporting is provided, the requirement for the environment is well met, the upper execution element and the lower execution element are arranged, and the motion range and the load capacity of the waist joint are guaranteed.

title: Humanoid bionic robot head capable of displaying expression and dialogue function
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid bionic robot head capable of displaying expressions and having a dialogue function. The humanoid bionic robot head comprises a supporting frame; the bionic head shell is arranged at the top of the outer surface of the supporting frame, a mouth device is installed at the bottom of one side of the bionic head shell, and an eye device is arranged in the middle of the interior of the bionic head shell; and the eyebrow device is arranged at the top in the bionic head shell. According to the humanoid bionic robot head with the expression displaying and dialogue functions, the first double-shaft servo motor, the second double-shaft servo motor, the third double-shaft servo motor, the rotating motor and the single-shaft servo motor are matched with one another, opening and closing of the mouth and movement of eyeballs and eyebrows on the surface of the head are controlled respectively, speaking and expression activities are simulated, and the effect of displaying the expression and dialogue is achieved. Therefore, the five sense organs on the surface of the bionic robot head can display expressions and dialogue functions, and the simulation capability of the bionic robot is improved.

title: Robot control circuit and desktop humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a robot control circuit and a desktop humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The circuit comprises a lifting detection module, a main control module and a steering engine control module, the lifting detection module comprises a double-foot stroke limiting switch, and if the switching state of the double-foot stroke limiting switch is off, the lifting detection module is used for sending an abnormal signal to the main control module; the main control module is used for sending a closing signal to the steering engine control module when receiving the abnormal signal; and the steering engine control module is used for controlling the power supply loop between the steering engine and the battery to be disconnected when receiving the closing signal. The protection circuit has the advantages of simple circuit, low cost, quick protection response and the like.

title: Human-simulated preview distance estimation method and system for path tracking control, and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid preview distance estimation method and system for path tracking control, and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a local planning path model; constructing a preview distance model, wherein the model outputs a preview distance; constructing a driving group correction factor model, wherein the model obtains a driving group correction factor; and correcting the preview distance output by the preview distance model according to the driver group correction factor, and reconstructing a local planning path model according to the corrected preview distance. According to the method, the preview habit of a driving group is considered, the preview distances in different driving environments are output through the preview distance model, and the path tracking precision and the vehicle driving stability are both considered.

title: Robot motion trail generation method and device, medium and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a robot motion trail generation method and device, a medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: determining an initial movement track of the robot under the condition that upper limbs are fixed; and according to the initial movement track, determining a target movement track of the robot under the condition that the upper limbs and the lower limbs are not fixed, so that the robot moves according to the target movement track. Therefore, the initial movement track of the robot under the condition that the upper limbs are fixed is determined firstly, only the degree of freedom factor of the lower limbs of the robot is considered, then the target movement track of the robot under the condition that the upper limbs and the lower limbs are fixed is determined according to the initial movement track, and the degree of freedom factor of the upper limbs and the lower limbs of the robot is considered. Therefore, the target motion track for coordinating the upper and lower limbs can be quickly obtained.

title: Human-like intelligent decision-making method, device and system and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid intelligent decision-making method, device and system and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: recognizing a memory prototype to which a current scene belongs based on the feature information of the current scene; extracting event information from a memory prototype to which the current scene belongs; if the extracted expectation violates the expectation of the current scene, the feature information of the current scene is obtained again, and otherwise, the extracted action is simulated and executed in the current scene; if the extracted action is judged to be executable according to a simulation execution result, outputting an execution decision, otherwise, extracting a next action from a memory prototype to which the current scene belongs to perform simulation execution; wherein the memory prototype is constructed by storing experienced event information according to a preset storage mode, automatically determining model parameters by using a parameter self-learning method and performing feature optimization by using a feature optimization method. According to the method, errors caused by human experience and redundant features can be avoided, and the accuracy of decision making is improved.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of exoskeleton and humanoid robots, and particularly discloses a robot device based on exoskeleton and humanoid robot function conversion, the robot device comprises a wrist mechanism, upper limbs, a trunk skeleton, lower limbs and foot mechanisms, and the upper limbs and the lower limbs have exoskeleton following working modes and robot self-driving working modes; the lower limb legs are rotationally mounted on the trunk framework, and the trunk framework is provided with lower limb reversing driving parts which are in driving connection with the lower limb legs; the wrist mechanism is provided with a holding mechanism, and the foot mechanism is provided with a bearing mechanism. The robot device can be freely switched between two different working modes of an exoskeleton robot and a humanoid robot, the purpose that the humanoid robot independently executes multi-scene tasks can be achieved, and the requirement for assisting people to accurately and efficiently execute the working tasks can be met; and meanwhile, the learning efficiency and the action execution accuracy of the robot can be improved, and the method can be suitable for various different application scenes or work tasks.

title: Method for planning operation station of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot operation station planning method, which comprises the following steps: defining a robot operation action template, and designing a series of expected operation actions specifically to be executed by a robot according to the robot operation action template; constructing an automatic operation track generator, and automatically generating a virtual motion track of the robot according to the expected operation action; a plurality of robot virtual stations are randomly generated to serve as particles, a virtual motion trail is executed on each virtual station, a corresponding pose is obtained, the error between the pose and the expected pose participates in calculation of particle values, then particle parameters are updated, and after multiple iterations, the particle parameters are calculated; and the calculated optimal virtual station is used as an actual operation station of the robot, and the robot moves to the actual operation station and executes corresponding operation. According to the method, the situation that the robot adjusts the position due to the fact that the arm cannot reach when executing multiple operation tasks is reduced, and the overall operation efficiency is improved.

title: Humanoid robot visual image processing method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot visual image processing method, device and equipment and a storage medium, the head of a humanoid robot is provided with a plurality of fisheye cameras and a depth camera, the method comprises the steps that a plurality of first images shot by the fisheye cameras are acquired, and each fisheye camera corresponds to one first image; acquiring a second image shot by the depth camera; performing distortion correction on the plurality of first images to form a plurality of third images; and splicing the second image and the plurality of third images to obtain a panoramic image. The method can correct the distortion of the fisheye image, improves the precision of the panoramic image, and improves the visual perception accuracy of the humanoid robot.

title: Human-shaped nursing robot obstacle avoidance method based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid nursing robot obstacle avoidance method based on artificial intelligence. Relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a Petri net of motion of the humanoid nursing robot; s2, calculating optimal path configuration according to the Petri net of the motion of the humanoid nursing robot obtained in the S1; and S3, establishing a dipole field of robot motion according to the path configuration of the robot obtained in S2, and performing dynamic window obstacle avoidance. According to the method, the travel time of the robot on different paths is analyzed by using a Petri network, the optimal configuration of the paths is selected, and an alternative path leading to a target is realized; in order to avoid collision with human beings and other moving objects, a dipole field combined with a dynamic window method is further provided, the speed and direction of a dynamic obstacle are regarded as the source of virtual magnetic dipole moment, repulsive force proportional to the speed is generated through dipole and dipole interaction between different moving objects, and the repulsive force is generated. And collision is prevented.

title: Human exoskeleton power-assisted robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of exoskeleton power-assisted robots, in particular to a human body exoskeleton power-assisted robot which is a fixing mechanism used for providing support and assistance for a human body. The power mechanism is used for providing power, the buffering mechanism is used for providing friction buffering for all joint parts of the fixing mechanism, the eliminating mechanism is used for providing stress elimination for the joint parts, and the fixing mechanism comprises a main support, a thigh fixing frame and a shank fixing frame. The power mechanisms and the buffering mechanisms are arranged at the joint positions between the main support and the thigh fixing frame and the joint positions between the thigh fixing frame and the shank fixing frame correspondingly, and the eliminating mechanisms are installed in the buffering mechanisms. The technical problem that the stability of equipment is affected due to eccentric friction of two end faces caused by eccentric torsion provided by legs during joint movement is solved.

title: Bionic biped robot based on pneumatic soft body structure and control method
abstract: According to the bionic biped robot based on the pneumatic soft body structure and the control method, the pneumatic soft body structure made of the soft body variable materials is adopted, and pneumatic driving is achieved through the cooperation of inflation and deflation of the inflation bags in all the inflation areas by means of the air source supply system through the air pressure control system, so that the robot has the larger degree of freedom; gaits and actions of human beings can be better simulated; meanwhile, a bending angle signal monitored by a bending sensor is collected in real time through a data collection card, and then the bending angle is optimized by an upper computer through a PID control algorithm, so that the input air pressure, the inflation and deflation time length and the interval of each inflation area are controlled, and each part of the robot is regularly expanded or contracted; on this basis, four limbs of the robot are controlled to achieve expected angle cooperation until the robot reaches an expected position, so that closed-loop control is formed; and finally, the robot collects environment information through a camera and feeds back the environment information to an upper computer, and then tasks can be completed in a complex environment.

title: Lower limb mechanism and bionic robot
abstract: The invention provides a lower limb mechanism and a bionic robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The lower limb mechanism comprises a shank assembly, a foot assembly, a universal connecting assembly and a driving assembly; the universal connecting assembly is connected with the shank assembly and the foot assembly. The driving assembly comprises a first linear driving piece and a second linear driving piece which are arranged in the width direction of the foot assembly, and the first linear driving piece and the second linear driving piece are hinged to the shank assembly and the foot assembly respectively. The first linear driving piece and the second linear driving piece stretch out and draw back synchronously and can drive the foot assembly to swing up and down relative to the shank assembly. When one of the first linear driving piece and the second linear driving piece stretches out and the other one retracts, the foot assembly swings left and right relative to the shank assembly. The first linear driving part and the second linear driving part can realize complex driving of the foot assembly, and the ankle-rotating simulation device has the advantages of simple structure, smaller weight and occupied volume and lower cost while simulating flexible rotation of the ankle.

title: Rigid-flexible mixed humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a rigid-flexible mixed humanoid manipulator which comprises whisker-shaped fingers and a palm. The whisker-shaped fingers are divided into a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger according to the functions of the whisker-shaped fingers, each whisker-shaped finger comprises a finger tip, a first alloy rod and a bending restraining piece, the first alloy rod is located in the bending restraining piece, and the bending restraining piece is provided with a plurality of restraining holes; the palm part comprises a palm part shell, a finger base and a side swing mechanism, and a gap between every two adjacent whisker-shaped fingers is adjustable; the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are each provided with a driving steel wire I, one end of each driving steel wire I penetrates through the corresponding restraining hole to be connected with the finger tip, the other end of each driving steel wire I is connected with a second alloy rod, the lengths of the two ends of each driving steel wire I can be synchronously adjusted, and the length of each second alloy rod is adjustable; and a driving steel wire II with adjustable length is arranged in the thumb. The device is stable in operation, safe, reliable, adjustable in rigidity and wide in application range.

title: Biped robot control method and related device
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot control method and a related device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first motion data of a biped robot, the first motion data being motion data of the biped robot at the beginning of a current gait cycle; calculating according to the first motion data and the expected motion data to obtain second motion data so as to compensate a measurement error generated by an inertial measurement unit of the biped robot; determining gait control parameters of the biped robot in the current gait cycle according to the first motion data and the second motion data; and controlling the biped robot to move in the current gait cycle according to the gait control parameters. Thus, the motion data of the biped robot at the beginning of the current gait cycle is adjusted through the expected motion data, compensation and optimization of the motion data of the biped robot are achieved, errors caused by inaccurate measurement data of the IMU when the biped robot walks in a real environment are corrected, and the control precision of the biped robot is improved.

title: Chain transmission humanoid tracked robot chassis device
abstract: The utility model discloses a chain transmission humanoid tracked robot chassis device which comprises a robot chassis body and a track arranged at the bottom end of the robot chassis body, the inner wall of the robot chassis body is connected with a moving plate through an adjusting mechanism, and the bottom end of the moving plate is connected with a cleaning plate in a clamped mode. title: Robot with voice interaction function

title: Humanoid robot control method and related device
abstract: The invention provides a control method of a humanoid robot and a related device, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining vehicle self-inspection data and environment data, the environment data being data related to a vehicle dangerous state monitored by the humanoid robot; the vehicle self-inspection data refers to data which is sent by the target vehicle and is related to a vehicle danger state, credibility weight calculation is carried out based on the multiple pieces of environment data and the vehicle self-inspection data to obtain a danger coefficient, an execution strategy is determined according to the danger coefficient and multiple danger coefficient thresholds, and the humanoid robot is controlled to execute control operation according to the execution strategy. Based on the flexibility of the rotary joints, the humanoid robot can be placed in the vehicle in the storage state, in this scene, a controller of the humanoid robot can predict the dangerous situation in the vehicle in advance, emergency measures are rapidly taken from the storage state to the stretching state when danger occurs, and the safety of the vehicle is improved. Therefore, people in the vehicle are warned to escape or directly assisted to escape, and the possibility of casualties is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot capable of switching forms
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a robot set, the robot set comprises a robot body, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, the thigh assembly moves below the robot body, the shank assembly moves below the thigh assembly through a mechanical joint assembly, and a guide wheel is movably arranged on the lower side of the thigh assembly; a friction wheel is arranged on an output shaft of the low-speed motor, and the low-speed motor drives the driving wheel to rotate on the lower side of the shank assembly through the friction wheel; the switching mechanism is arranged at the connecting position of the thigh assembly and the shank assembly, and the switching mechanism drives the guide wheel to swing on the lower side of the thigh assembly. Through the arranged switching mechanism, the robot can perform form switching of motion modes in different environments, so that the robot is suitable for transportation operation in various environments, and the overall transportation speed is increased.

title: Robot bionic foot with humanoid foot arch structure
abstract: The robot bionic foot simulating the human arch structure comprises a foot sole mechanism, the foot sole mechanism comprises a front foot sole, a middle foot sole and a rear foot sole which are movably connected front and back in sequence, and the bottom of a shank rod is movably connected with the middle foot sole of the foot sole mechanism through an ankle ball joint; the front end of the rear sole is rotationally connected to the rear end of the middle sole through a rear rotating shaft, the bottom of the rear sole is elastically connected with the bottom of the middle sole through a rear extension spring, and the rear sole is elastically pulled up through a rear elastic supporting mechanism rotationally connected with the shank rod; the front sole comprises a left front fork and a right front fork, the rear ends of the two front forks are rotationally connected to the front end of the middle sole through front rotating shafts respectively, the two front forks are elastically connected through a front extension spring, and the tops of the two front forks are connected with the shank rod through a front elastic supporting mechanism. The two front forks of the front foot sole are driven by the front elastic supporting mechanism to achieve opening and closing movement. The robot has the advantages that the robot can adapt to complex changing terrains and can walk more stably in a human-simulated gait mode.

abstract: The invention provides an output assembly of a joint module of a robot, the joint module, fingers and a dexterous hand, and the joint module comprises a motor assembly, the output assembly and a shell for packaging the motor assembly and the output assembly. Wherein the output assembly is connected with a driving rotating shaft of the motor assembly. According to the joint module, based on the motor assembly, different types of output assemblies are combined, and different types of joint modules can be formed. The joint modules are mutually independent and can be respectively controlled, and the dexterous hand can be controlled to make various actions by inputting different signals, so that the complex actions of the human hand can be accurately simulated.

title: Control method based on humanoid robot assisted medication and related device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a control method based on humanoid robot assisted medication and a related device. The method comprises the steps that a humanoid robot is controlled to reach a first target position; controlling a first robotic arm to support the medicine tray in a first preset posture; the image features of the drugs are analyzed, and a second robotic arm is controlled to grab target drugs in the drugs according to the image features; analyzing the type of a first continuous step section in the first route; determining a first motion control strategy according to the type of the first continuous step; determining a second motion control strategy according to the first flat road section; and controlling the humanoid robot to reach a second target position along the first route according to the first preset posture, the first motion control strategy and the second motion control strategy. Thus, the stable medicine taking posture of the humanoid robot is guaranteed, the humanoid robot can stably advance on different road sections when passing through the upper and lower steps and the flat road sections in the medicine feeding process, and the reliability and comprehensiveness of assisting a user in medicine taking are improved.

title: Data processing method and device for assisting medicine taking
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and device for assisting medicine taking. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic medicine taking information of a target user; determining a target medicine taking time range of the target user according to the basic medicine taking information; when the current system time is the earliest medicine taking time point in the target medicine taking time range, a target posture is determined; determining a current state of the target user through the target posture, wherein the current state comprises a sleep state and a non-sleep state; when it is detected that the current state is the sleep state, a first medicine taking reminding strategy is executed. After the target medicine taking time range of the target user is determined, when the current system time falls into the target medicine taking time range, the biped robot determines the current state of the target user according to the target posture, and the corresponding first medicine taking reminding strategy is executed when the target user is in the sleep state. The corresponding medicine taking reminding strategy can be executed according to the state of the user when the medicine taking time arrives, and the intelligent and humanized degree of auxiliary medicine taking is improved.

title: Lower limb structure of biped walking robot capable of standing vertically
abstract: The invention provides a lower limb structure of a biped walking robot capable of standing vertically, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises two leg mechanisms, namely a right leg mechanism and a left leg mechanism; the leg mechanism comprises a thigh assembly, a shank assembly, a leg motor assembly, a hip joint mechanism and a knee joint mechanism; the thigh assemblies are connected with the body through hip joint mechanisms and connected with the shank assemblies through knee joint mechanisms. The thigh body, the first thigh crank, the thigh main connecting rod and the shank body form a first parallel four-bar mechanism; the first thigh crank, the second thigh crank, the thigh auxiliary connecting rod, the third thigh crank and the shank body form a second parallel four-bar mechanism; in the movement process of the lower limb mechanism, under the condition that the first parallel four-bar mechanism moves to the singular position, the second parallel four-bar mechanism moves to drive the first parallel four-bar mechanism to pass through the singular position. The movable range of the shanks can be widened, and the stability and flexibility of robot movement are improved.

title: METHODOLOGY FOR SAFE REMOTE HUMANOID TAKEOVER FOR MULTI-USER TELEXISTENCE WITH MINIMAL HARDWARE USER REQUIREMENTS
abstract: A method for performing telexistence, which may include receiving, by a processor, a request to control a humanoid from a remote user; determining, by the processor, acceptance of the request by a host; for the request being determined as accepted, verifying, by the processor, receipt of a set of initiating signals; for the set of initiating signals being received: receiving a humanoid mapping method chosen by the remote user, and controlling the humanoid based on the humanoid mapping method determined by the remote user; and for the set of initiating signals not being received, terminating, by the processor, the request to control the humanoid.

title: Driving and control integrated joint module for robot
abstract: The invention provides a driving and control integrated joint module for a robot. The driving and control integrated joint module comprises a driving control module, a torque motor module, a speed reduction transmission module and a fixed holding module. The driving control module and the torque motor module are arranged in the fixed holding module, and the torque motor module is connected with the fixed holding module; the speed reduction transmission module is connected with the fixed holding module, and the speed reduction transmission module is connected with the output end of a motor; the fixed holding module is internally provided with a band-type brake device which is in the form of an arc-shaped brake shoe and is automatically controllable in power-on and power-off. According to the drive and control integrated joint module, the problem that a joint system which is only assembled through a traditional motor, a speed reducer, a servo driver and an encoder arranged outside the output end in a combined mode is complex and heavy can be effectively solved, joints of the humanoid robot are easily deployed, and efficient distributed cooperative control and efficient power output are provided.

title: Linear joint for humanoid robot
abstract: According to the linear joint for the humanoid robot, a tension and pressure sensor (1) serves as an end cover, and the functions of two parts are achieved through one part, so that the number of the parts is reduced, the compactness of the mechanism is improved, and the weight of the whole machine is reduced; a bearing gland (14) is arranged at the right end of the planetary roller screw shaft (13) and is sealed through a sealing piece, and an end cover seals the left end of the planetary roller screw shaft, so that the sealing of the whole planetary roller screw shaft can be realized; the encoder rotor (3) is directly fastened on the planetary roller lead screw nut (8) through the encoder screw (4), the planetary roller lead screw nut is fixedly connected with the motor rotor (5), the motor rotor drives the planetary roller lead screw nut to rotate, and the planetary roller lead screw nut drives the encoder rotor to rotate, so that the transmission gap of middleware is reduced, and the transmission efficiency is improved. And better rotation precision and rotation coaxiality are realized, so that the position precision of the linear joint is improved.

title: Robot alignment effect processing method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a robot viewing effect processing method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a face image of a target user, positioning the space coordinates of the eyeballs of the target user, calculating the space coordinates of a watching focus of the target user, and obtaining the viewing effect of the robot based on the position relation between the target user and the robot and the posture of a robot body. The space coordinates of the robot eyes and the offset route of the current space coordinates of the robot eyes and the space coordinates of the eyeballs of the two eyes of the target user are calculated, so that the corresponding layers of the eyeballs of the robot are controlled to perform offset processing, the robot and the target user form an eye-to-eye effect, the interaction expression mode of the robot is enriched, and the interaction efficiency is improved. The technical problems that a current robot cannot effectively form a watching focus and cannot achieve eye contact with a user, so that the user experience is low, and the robot is not high in bionic performance are solved.

title: Route planning method and system for multi-form machine humanoid quantitative slitting of raw meat
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a path planning method and system for multi-form machine humanoid quantitative slitting of raw meat, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-dimensional information of raw meat products in response to a raw meat slitting signal; based on the meat product multi-dimensional information and a big data prediction model, density distribution characteristics of the raw meat in the transportation direction are determined, and the big data prediction model is obtained based on meat slice sample training; and generating a slitting path planning model of the raw meat based on the meat multi-dimensional information and the density distribution characteristics. According to the method, food processing, an artificial intelligence algorithm and the cutting experience of cooks in the Chinese dish cooking process are combined, and the planning of the cutting path of the multi-form raw meat is formulated, so that humanoid cutting of the machine is realized, technical support is provided for accurate, quantitative and high-precision cutting of slices, strips and dices of the raw meat, and the cutting efficiency of the raw meat is improved. The loss in the primary processing link of meat is effectively reduced, and an intelligent solution is provided for industrial processing of dishes, quality and efficiency improvement and formation of novel productivity.

title: Biped robot stable motion planning method based on motion state classification
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot stable motion planning method based on motion state classification, and the method comprises the steps: collecting data through a robot body sensor, and determining the body mass center position and speed; calculating a limit speed and a stability coefficient according to the fuselage centroid motion state; performing motion state classification and stability analysis according to the walking speed of the robot and the combined external force state; the method comprises the following steps: establishing a landing point gait plan, determining parameters of the step length and the movement time of the leg swinging in the next step so as to plan that the stability coefficient is within a stable range, and then circularly repeating the steps to achieve the purpose of stable movement. According to the method, the motion states of the biped robot are classified by constructing the stability coefficient, the influence of external disturbance force on the motion law of the robot can be considered, the gait parameters are planned to achieve stable motion, and the stability of motion planning of the biped robot is improved.

title: Portraying robot control method, system, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a portraying robot control method and system, a medium and equipment. The portraying robot control method comprises the following steps that S100, an intelligent paintbrush is calibrated, wherein the ends of the intelligent paintbrush sequentially move to calibration points at the four corners of an operation calibration table for position calibration; s200, the robot simulates the human arm to conduct calibration, wherein the robot simulates the human arm to drive the paintbrushes to sequentially move to calibration points at the four corners of the drawing table for position calibration; s300, the robot humanoid arm is operated for drawing, drawing is conducted on the operation calibration table through an intelligent paintbrush, the robot controller calculates all joint angles of the robot humanoid arm according to data and sends the joint angles to all joints of the robot humanoid arm, and the robot humanoid arm drives the paintbrush to draw an image on a drawing operation table; according to the method, an operator can control the intelligent paintbrush to draw or write on the operation calibration table so as to control the robot to draw or write on the drawing operation table, and then remote drawing or writing control is achieved.

title: Biped robot motion planning method and device based on linear sequential logic
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot motion planning method and device based on linear sequential logic, and the method comprises the steps: S1, carrying out the modeling of a map environment where a biped robot moves according to an adjacent matrix and an attribute matrix, and obtaining a directed graph of the map environment; s2, based on the directed graph, searching a trajectory of a target function meeting the minimum energy and time consumed by the biped robot to reach the target position; and S3, determining a linear sequential logic specification of the biped robot based on the trajectory, and outputting a motion sequence ms of the biped robot. The problems that in the prior art, an algorithm for solving the motion trail of a robot is complex and low in efficiency are solved.

abstract: The invention provides a full-flexible multi-mode high-temporal-spatial-resolution visual tactile sensor. The full-flexible multi-mode high-temporal-spatial-resolution visual tactile sensor has multi-mode and high-temporal-spatial-resolution tactile sensing capacity and full-flexible contact and flexible operation capacity. The structure mainly comprises a flexible sensing module with integrated structure sensing, a lighting module, a wireless module, a mechanical connection module, a battery module and the like. According to the invention, a full-flexible sensing structure integrated structure design is adopted, and the advantages of high compliance, convenient operation, high integration level and the like are realized; meanwhile, the multi-modal tactile perception capability integrating piezoelectricity and vision can provide the multi-modal tactile perception capability with high temporal-spatial resolution for the robot, and the perception of surface texture, contact force and vibration can be realized; due to the design of wireless transmission and a built-in power supply, the integration level and the use convenience of the sensor are further improved, and the sensor can be widely applied to various robot end effectors including humanoid robot hands.

title: Foot structure of humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a foot structure of a humanoid robot and the robot. The foot structure comprises a foot bone, a data processing circuit board and a sole. The foot bone comprises a skeleton, four one-dimensional force sensors and a fixing plate, and the four one-dimensional force sensors are fixed on the main skeleton through the fixing plate; the data processing circuit board is used for acquiring and processing information of the one-dimensional force sensor and predicting the ZMP; the sole comprises an aluminum substrate, an EVA buffer layer and a rubber anti-skid sole. The foot bone part is optimally designed by referring to a human-simulated foot skeleton structure, so that the weight of the whole foot is effectively reduced while the strength and attractiveness of the foot are ensured; a one-dimensional force sensor is selected and reasonably fixed in a foot, and an independent data processing circuit board is designed, so that efficient foot pressure information acquisition is ensured, the manufacturing cost is effectively reduced, and the maintainability of a circuit system is improved; the three-layer brand-new sole effectively improves the impact resistance and stability of the robot, protects the sensor, and reduces the maintenance cost at the same time.

title: Multi-purpose test platform for robot
abstract: The invention provides a multi-purpose test platform for a robot. The method is suitable for various leg-foot type humanoid robot structures, is high in universality, is easy to construct, is simple to operate, can flexibly adjust the posture of the robot according to actual demands, can carry out rapid testing and verification at the early development stage of the humanoid robot, and provides a convenient and reliable solution for performance evaluation.

title: Humanoid robot gait analysis and recognition and robot control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait analysis and robot control method, and relates to the technical field of robot control. A gait analysis and recognition model is pre-trained through the collected gait data, the gait analysis and recognition model is used for evaluating gait parameters of the humanoid robot, and the gait parameters comprise gait symmetry, gait consistency, actions, gait phases and gait health degrees; and estimating gait parameters in real time based on a pre-trained gait analysis and recognition model. Then deploying a pre-trained gait analysis and recognition model into a humanoid robot control strategy; gait parameters estimated by the gait analysis and recognition model in real time are added into a state space of a humanoid robot control strategy, and corresponding behavior actions are generated and executed through the control strategy. According to the invention, the gait parameters of the robot are quantified by evaluating the symmetry and consistency of the humanoid robot during movement and identifying the action and gait phase of the robot, so that the performance of the robot in the learning process is improved.

title: Self-adaptive damping sole of biped robot
abstract: The self-adaptive damping sole of the biped robot comprises a sole body, and the front end and the rear end of the sole body are movably connected with a front toe and a rear toe respectively. The left side and the right side of the sole body are movably connected with a left sole and a right sole respectively. A plurality of transverse through holes and a plurality of longitudinal through holes are formed in the sole main body; springs are mounted in the transverse through holes and the longitudinal through holes; one end of the spring in the transverse through hole is connected to the left sole, and the other end is connected to the right sole; one end of the spring in the longitudinal through hole is connected to the front toe, and the other end of the spring is connected to the rear toe; when the front toes, the rear toes, the left sole or the right sole and the sole body are kept horizontal, the corresponding springs are in a compressed state. The mechanism is exquisite in design and simple in structure, the adaptive capacity of the biped robot to different forms of grounds during walking can be improved, and meanwhile the walking stability of the robot is improved through spring damping.
abstract_en: The self-adaptive damping sole of the biped robot comprises a sole body, and the front end and the rear end of the sole body are movably connected with a front toe and a rear toe respectively. The left side and the right side of the sole body are movably connected with a left sole and a right sole respectively. A plurality of transverse through holes and a plurality of longitudinal through holes are formed in the sole main body; springs are mounted in the transverse through holes and the longitudinal through holes; one end of the spring in the transverse through hole is connected to the left sole, and the other end is connected to the right sole; one end of the spring in the longitudinal through hole is connected to the front toe, and the other end of the spring is connected to the rear toe; when the front toes, the rear toes, the left sole or the right sole and the sole body are kept horizontal, the corresponding springs are in a compressed state. The mechanism is exquisite in design and simple in structure, the adaptive capacity of the biped robot to different forms of grounds during walking can be improved, and meanwhile the walking stability of the robot is improved through spring damping.

title: Humanoid robot joint
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid robot joint which comprises a shell used for installing all parts. The mounting assembly is used for mounting the driving assembly; the mounting assembly is movably arranged in the shell; the power assembly is used for providing power for the driving assembly; the power assembly is arranged in the shell; the driving assembly is used for driving the moving assembly to move; the driving assembly is arranged in the mounting assembly and is connected with the power assembly; the encoder assembly is used for reading motion parameters of the driving assembly; the encoder assembly is arranged on the mounting assembly; the moving assembly is used for being driven by the driving assembly to move; the moving assembly is arranged in the shell and connected with the driving assembly. title: Method apparatus and computer program for control robot suit safety operation
abstract: The present invention relates to a safe operation control method of a robot suit, which is performed by a computing device. The safe operation control method of a robot suit comprises the steps of: collecting a walking variable of a robot suit; obtaining a walking abnormality score based on the walking variable; and controlling assistive force and driving of the robot suit based on the walking abnormality score. According to the present invention, it is possible to predict and respond to an accident such as a fall that may occur due to a user's walking abnormality or the like in advance, thereby easily securing safety for a user who can slightly reduce the degree of freedom related to movement by the robot suit.

title: Miniaturized hydraulic power system of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot miniaturized hydraulic power system which comprises an oil supply integrated oil path block, an environment sensing module, a hydraulic power source controller, a main controller and a driver. The oil supply integrated oil path block comprises a servo motor, a plunger pump and a pressurization oil tank. The main controller collects sensing information of the environment sensing module and transmits the sensing information to the hydraulic power source controller, and the hydraulic power source controller calculates the oil supply flow and pressure needed by the power system under the current working condition according to the walking speed and posture information, measured by the environment sensing module, of the robot and transmits a driving signal to the driver. And the servo motor is controlled to drive the plunger pump to rotate, high-pressure oil is output from an oil outlet of the plunger pump to flow to the actuator, and low-pressure oil returned from the actuator flows back to the pressurizing oil tank. The device is simple and compact in structure, few in pipeline connection, light in weight, good in dynamic performance, long in cruising power, high in power density ratio and convenient to install and maintain.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method and system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining collection data; wherein the collected data comprises controller data, IMU data and pressure sensor data; according to the collected data, specific pose data of the foot ends of the two legs and the tail ends of the arms of the robot in a world coordinate system are obtained through calculation; according to the specific pose data, the IMU data and the pressure sensor data, the next target pose of the robot is calculated through a robot dynamic model; and generating a control instruction according to the next target pose of the robot, and sending the control instruction to the robot to enable the robot to move. According to the invention, all joints and parts of the humanoid robot can be accurately controlled. title: Bistable electromagnetic brake and humanoid robot joint
abstract: The invention discloses a bistable electromagnetic brake and a humanoid robot joint. The bistable electromagnetic brake comprises an electromagnetic coil, an annular permanent magnet, a brake shaft, a brake disc, a steel ball, a supporting shaft, a spline shaft, an electric cover, a cycloid speed reducer motor cam shaft and a first elastic piece. When the brake is powered off, the electromagnetic coil is reversely powered on, braking of the brake is achieved, and the steel ball can abut against the second positioning groove; when the brake is powered on, the electromagnetic coil is powered on in the forward direction, the brake shaft is released, and the steel ball can abut against the first positioning groove. The humanoid robot joint comprises a bistable electromagnetic brake and further comprises a cycloid speed reducer shell, and the cycloid speed reducer shell is made of a carbon fiber reinforced composite material. The problems that an electromagnetic brake in a joint module of the humanoid robot is large in energy loss, and the joint module is large in mass and inconvenient to use on the humanoid robot are solved, and the technical effects of reducing the energy loss of the electromagnetic brake and achieving the light weight of the humanoid robot are achieved.

title: Humanoid robot

title: Biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped robot which comprises a movable arm and mechanical claws, the movable arm comprises a flexible body and a control mechanism, the control mechanism drives the flexible body to bend, and the two mechanical claws are installed at the two ends of the flexible body respectively. Each mechanical claw foot comprises a shell, an adsorption part, a spiral claw and a rotary jacking mechanism, the shells are connected with the flexible body, the adsorption parts, the spiral claws and the rotary jacking mechanisms are all installed on the shells, the positions of the spiral claws correspond to the positions of the adsorption parts, and the rotary jacking mechanisms drive the spiral claws to act in the direction away from the flexible body. According to the biped robot, the spiral jacking mechanism is adopted to control the spiral claws to act in the direction away from the flexible body, and the mechanical claws on the two biped robots can be screwed together through the spiral claws, so that the attachment stability of the two biped robots is improved; and the purpose of improving the adaptability of the biped robot in a collaborative operation scene is achieved.

abstract: Provided is a human and wearable robot kinetic energy recovery device equipped with a rope stretching amplifier, which comprises the following operations of: pressing a rope (1-R) with pressure from a pressing rod coupled to a pressing member; stretching and amplifying the rope with the pressure and an elastic member provided on one side of the other end of the pressing rod; installing a one-way power transmission means; driving the one-way power transmission means using the stretched and amplified rope; causing a power generation means to be driven due to the driving; installing the elastic member on one side of the other side of the rope (1-R) provided in the one-way power transmission means; and fixing the other end of the rope using a rope fixing unit (6). According to the present invention, when a human and wearable robot walks or runs, electricity is generated using robot leg position displacement, and the generated electricity is stored in a battery and then supplied to various motors of the robot.

title: Biped robot landing point planning method and device based on continuous optimization
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robot landing point planning, and discloses a biped robot landing point planning method and device based on continuous optimization, and the method comprises the following steps: (1) extracting a landing foot convex region according to the external environment information of a biped robot, whether the biped robot needs to bypass when arriving at the terminal point is judged based on the external environment information and the starting point and terminal point positions of the biped robot; (2) constructing an environment falling foot convex region constraint based on the information of the falling foot convex region; meanwhile, self-adaptive reachable domain constraints are constructed on the basis of the judgment result of whether the biped robot needs to bypass or not and the step length needed by the robot and obtained according to the external environment information; and (3) planning a three-dimensional landing point of the biped robot based on the environmental landing convex region constraint and the adaptive reachable region constraint. According to the method, the solving time is effectively shortened, and energy loss caused by unreasonable angle change is avoided.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the robot. The leg structure comprises thighs, shanks, knee joints, ankle joints and feet. The thigh comprises four servo motors, a thigh bracket, a main control cabin and two groups of primary belt transmission structures; the shank comprises a shank bracket, a data processing circuit board, a secondary belt transmission output synchronous wheel shaft and a secondary belt transmission structure; the knee joint comprises two groups of connecting rods and a knee joint shaft; the ankle joint is a group of 2RSU-U mechanisms, and each 2RSU-U mechanism comprises two groups of RSU mechanisms and an ankle joint shaft; the foot is provided with at least two bearing seats which are symmetrical left and right, and the bearing seats are connected with the single ends, perpendicular to the transverse direction, of the T-shaped shafts on the left side and the right side respectively. The inertia of the whole leg is effectively reduced, so that the dynamic response of the humanoid robot leg is improved. In addition, according to the leg, a four-connecting-rod structure is ingeniously designed to achieve movement of the knee joint, and movement of the ankle joint on the sagittal plane and the coronal plane is achieved through two-stage belt transmission and a 2RSU-U mechanism.

title: Intelligent old-age care health data acquisition method and humanoid old-age care robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent old-age care health data acquisition method and a humanoid old-age care robot, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring physiological data of a user; obtaining current physiological change data of the user based on the physiological data of the user; based on the second physiological change data, performing time sequence clustering on the current physiological change data of the user to obtain a cluster; obtaining similarity evaluation data of the first physiological change data based on the clustering cluster; and based on the similarity evaluation data, judging an abnormal condition of the physiological data of the user. According to the method, the trend of user out-of-range data changes is analyzed and compared with the synchronism of changes of other user data of the same type. Compared with the prior art that the physical health state of the user is judged only from the out-of-range change of one-dimensional data, the judgment method is more accurate.

title: Running and jumping type humanoid robot with adjustable aerial posture and motion control method
abstract: The invention provides a running and jumping type humanoid robot with an adjustable aerial attitude and a motion control method. The running and jumping type humanoid robot comprises a double-leg adjusting mechanism, a jumping connecting rod mechanism, a driving mechanism, a four-rotor attitude control mechanism, a sensing control module and the corresponding motion control method. The double-leg adjusting mechanism comprises a gear motor and a transmission structure composed of three bevel gears, and the double-leg adjusting mechanism is connected with the machine frame. The bouncing connecting rod mechanism is a plane eight-connecting-rod mechanism. The driving mechanism comprises a bouncing motor and a gear set; the posture control mechanism comprises four groups of hollow cup motors, spiral wings and corresponding connecting pieces; the sensing control module comprises an encoder, an attitude sensor and a control processing unit. The bouncing mechanism, the double-foot adjusting mechanism and the posture control mechanism are combined with one another, continuous running and jumping motion with the controllable height and distance is achieved, and the humanoid robot has important significance in improving the flexibility of the humanoid robot and being applied to the complex environment.

title: Connecting piece, crotch assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the connecting piece, the crotch assembly and the humanoid robot, a barrel of the connecting piece is provided with a containing cavity, the containing cavity is used for containing a waist driving piece, and the containing cavity is provided with a first axis extending in the first direction; the first connecting plate is connected to the peripheral surface of the cylinder body, the first connecting plate comprises a first surface back to the cylinder body, and the first surface is used for being connected with a first pitching driving part; the second connecting plate is connected to the peripheral face of the side, opposite to the first connecting plate, of the barrel, the second connecting plate comprises a second surface opposite to the barrel, the second surface is used for being connected with a second pitching driving piece, and the first surface and the second surface both incline relative to the first axis. title: Lower limb exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb exoskeleton robot which is composed of a waist adjusting module, a thigh adjusting module, a shank adjusting module, an ankle joint height adjusting module, a foot adjusting module, a power device and a fixing device, and the waist adjusting module is connected with the thigh adjusting module through the power device; the thigh adjusting module and the shank adjusting module are connected through a power device, and the lower end of the shank adjusting module is connected with the foot adjusting module after passing through the ankle joint adjusting module and the air spring power assisting device. The device is mainly used for people with different leg types (such as O-shaped legs and X-shaped legs), ankle joint heights and foot sizes, the difference existing in the leg types is met through adjustment of the deflection device, meanwhile, the slippage error in the knee joint movement process can be compensated in cooperation with the knee joint floating device, better man-machine coordination can be achieved, and the human-computer interaction effect is improved. And the application range of the exoskeleton robot is widened.

title: Hip joint support, crotch assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint support, a crotch assembly and a humanoid robot, the hip joint support is used for the crotch assembly of the humanoid robot, and the hip joint support comprises a first support and a second support; the first support comprises a first plate, a second plate and a third plate, the first plate and the third plate are connected to the two ends of the second plate respectively, and the first plate and the third plate are oppositely arranged; the second support is arranged between the first plate and the third plate to be contained in the first support, and one end of the second support is rotationally connected with the first plate; wherein the second plate is used for being fixedly connected with a rotor of a pitching driving part, the third plate is used for being fixedly connected with a stator of a transverse rolling driving part, the second support is used for being fixedly connected with a rotor of the transverse rolling driving part, and the second support is further used for being fixedly connected with a stator of a yaw driving part. The hip joint support is compact in arrangement.

title: Biped robot based on electro-hydraulic servo drive and advancing method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot based on electro-hydraulic servo drive and an advancing method thereof, the robot comprises a trunk, upper limbs with motor drive joints and lower limbs with hydraulic drive joints, and the lower limbs are composed of leg assemblies and foot assemblies. The upper limb, double arms and the dexterous hand part use electric mechanical arms to complete specified actions, high flexibility is achieved, the lower limb part is driven by a high-power-density hydraulic oil source, strong explosive force and support can be provided for movement of the whole robot, and the lower limb of the robot obtains stronger power and meanwhile can be driven by the hydraulic oil source. Under the load that the upper limbs are heavy, stronger supporting force and pressure resistance are provided, due to the fact that electro-hydraulic cooperative driving is adopted, overall performance optimization is achieved according to different component requirements, more efficient and more flexible robot design is achieved, and the overall movement ability of the robot is enhanced while the overall performance and adaptability are improved.

title: Robot joint safety control method and system and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a joint safety control method and system of a robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that motor parameter values monitored by a sensor are obtained; the motor parameter value is compared with a target parameter value configured in an instruction issued by a mainboard, and if a real-time deviation value between the motor parameter value and the target parameter value exceeds a preset deviation value, it is judged that the robot is in an abnormal state; and under the condition that the robot is in the abnormal state, a robot joint safety control mechanism is started, and joint safety control is conducted on the robot according to a preset safety strategy. Based on the method, the running safety of the humanoid robot can be improved through a robot joint safety control mechanism.

title: Humanoid omni-directional movement arm-carrying operation robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid omni-directional motion arm operation robot, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises an omni-directional motion chassis, a robot body frame, a head assembly, a mechanical arm and a double-light shooting device. The robot body frame is fixedly mounted at the top of the omni-directional movement chassis; the head assembly is fixedly mounted at the top of the robot body frame; the mechanical arm is fixedly mounted on the side wall of the robot body frame; the dual-light shooting device is fixedly mounted at the tail end of the mechanical arm; according to the utility model, the movement in any direction and angle in a narrow space can be realized through the Mecanum wheels; a narrow and low space can be shot through a visual camera and a mechanical arm, and the inspection function is achieved through visual analysis and real-time detection; detection can be assisted through rotation and pitching of the head assembly and a visual camera function, so that the inspection efficiency is improved; the robot can carry out transmission in real time through wifi or 5G, and when an abnormal place is encountered, the system can give an alarm, record the current position and feed back the current position to a worker.

title: Method for generating motion skill of humanoid robot based on explicit and implicit hybrid estimation
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion skill generation method based on explicit-implicit hybrid estimation. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an explicit-implicit hybrid estimation neural network, a motion strategy neural network and a composite loss function; constructing a motion skill training environment of the humanoid robot; in a motion skill training environment, iteratively and jointly training an explicit and implicit hybrid estimation neural network and a motion strategy neural network based on a composite loss function; in the training process, parameters of the neural network are continuously adjusted according to the gradient of the composite loss function so as to optimize a motor skill strategy; through multiple rounds of iterative training, a trained sports skill strategy is obtained; and finally, the trained motion skill strategy is migrated to the physical robot. The motion skill strategy generated by the method has higher stability and adaptability, and can better adapt to different environments and task requirements.

title: Underwater webbed humanoid robot based on pneumatic buoyancy control
abstract: The invention relates to an underwater webbed humanoid robot based on pneumatic buoyancy control. The underwater webbed humanoid robot comprises an inflation bottle, a trunk module, arm modules, leg modules, flippers, a buoyancy adjusting module, a sensing module and a control module. The inflation bottle is fixedly mounted on the trunk module; the arm modules and the leg modules are connected to the trunk module, and flippers are connected to the bottoms of the leg modules; the buoyancy adjusting module comprises a buoyancy air bag set and an inflation and deflation control mechanism, the buoyancy air bag set is installed on the trunk module and comprises at least three air bags, the inflation and deflation control mechanism controls inflation and deflation of the air bags, and when the air bags are inflated and deflated, the total buoyancy center of the buoyancy air bag set can change in the space; the sensing module comprises an inertial measurement sensor, a water environment detection assembly, a leg movement detection assembly and an arm movement detection assembly; the control module is in communication connection with the sensing module, and the control module is in control connection with the arm module, the leg module and the buoyancy adjusting module.
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underwater webbed humanoid robot based on pneumatic buoyancy control. title: Method for generating multi-contact-point motion of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot multi-contact motion generation method, which comprises the following steps of: describing a motion state of a limb tail end of a multi-contact leg-foot robot, and constructing a mathematical description of a motion mode of the limb tail end of the robot; and converting the mathematical description into a reward function for reinforcement learning and training of sports skills, and finally migrating to a physical robot. The method has the advantages that comprehensive and accurate mathematical description of the tail end motion mode of the multi-contact-point robot is provided, a continuous reward function is constructed to improve the continuity of a parameter space, the algorithm is effectively guided to rapidly converge to an expected state, and the method is particularly suitable for motion skill generation based on reinforcement learning.

title: Double-wheel-foot robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robots, and provides a double-wheel-foot robot and a control method thereof.The double-wheel-foot robot comprises a trunk support, wheel foot assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the rear end of the trunk support, and mechanical arm assemblies are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the front end of the trunk support; leg driving mechanisms of the wheel and foot assemblies are connected with the two sides of the rear end of the trunk support, leg driving motors in the leg driving mechanisms are fixed to the supporting plate, and first gears are installed at the tail ends of the leg driving motors; the supporting plate is rotationally connected with the thigh connecting rod through a first bearing shaft, and the supporting plate is rotationally connected with the gear fixing plate through a second bearing shaft. The thigh connecting rod is connected with the second gear, a third gear and a fourth gear are installed on the gear fixing plate, the leg driving motor is in internal meshing transmission with the third gear through the first gear, and the thigh connecting rod is in external meshing transmission with the fourth gear through the second gear. The overall installation size is reduced, meanwhile, the output torsion is increased, and the leg output strength is improved.

title: Gait control method for quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot gait control method, and belongs to the field of robot gait control, and the method comprises the steps: building dynamic models of a quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot in a swing stage and a collision stage; a Newton-Raphson iteration method and a variable perturbation method are combined, and the fixed point state of the quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot is obtained through quick searching; the specific multi-stage gait characteristics of the quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot and a deep reinforcement learning algorithm are combined, a quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot gait control strategy based on deep reinforcement learning is obtained, and torque values needed by all joints of the robot in different states are estimated. The problems that the quasi-passive biped robot is poor in walking stability and weak in disturbance suppression capacity are solved, the walking stability and the disturbance suppression capacity of the quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot are improved, and the quasi-passive seven-connecting-rod biped robot has important significance in the aspects of high-precision kinetic model building, humanoid biped robot development, rehabilitation instrument design and the like.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb configuration based on active and passive hydraulic actuators
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb configuration based on active and passive hydraulic actuators, which comprises a rotational degree of freedom Rj1 and a side-sway degree of freedom Rj2 of a hip joint, a pitching degree of freedom Rj3 of the hip joint, a pitching degree of freedom Rj4 of a knee joint, and a pitching degree of freedom Rj6 and a side-sway degree of freedom Rj5 of an ankle joint, the rotational degree of freedom Rj1 of the hip joint is differentially driven by an actuator A1 and an actuator A2 which are connected in parallel, the pitching degree of freedom Rj3 of the hip joint is driven by a slider-crank mechanism including an actuator A3, and the pitching degree of freedom Rj4 of the knee joint is driven by a triangular mechanism including an actuator A4; and the pitching degree of freedom Rj6 and the side-sway degree of freedom Rj5 of the ankle joint are differentially driven by two actuators A5 and A6 which are connected in parallel. The humanoid robot has various working mode combinations such as complete active, complete passive and active-passive combination, and has an extremely high upper limit of movement ability and an extremely high upper limit of cruising ability.

title: Bionic biped robot balance control method and humanoid robot system
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic biped robot balance control method and a humanoid robot system, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the kinetic analysis of a biped robot, and constructing a simplified kinetic model; predicting the state of the biped robot in a future time domain by using the simplified dynamic model to obtain a predicted state of the robot; setting an expected state of the biped robot in a future time domain, and correcting the expected state by using a bionic ankle joint strategy and a hip joint strategy to obtain a target expected state; and solving the constructed optimization model to obtain an optimal foot end three-dimensional force, so that the system state of the robot reaches a target state. The method has the advantages of higher control reaction speed, higher self-recovery capability, higher impact resistance and wide application range.

title: Humanoid robot inclined ladder climbing method and system based on deep reinforcement learning and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot inclined ladder climbing method based on deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the field of deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: dividing stages of the inclined ladder climbing process of the humanoid robot, carrying out decision model training on motion control of the humanoid robot in each stage by utilizing a deep reinforcement learning technology, and carrying out motion decision by the humanoid robot by utilizing the trained model to complete inclined ladder climbing. According to the invention, the humanoid robot can combine the image acquired by the camera with the angle of the steering engine of the humanoid robot, and makes the current optimal action adaptively, so that the humanoid robot can complete the inclined ladder climbing task more intelligently.
