title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR A MOBILE ROBOT SYSTEM
abstract: A mobile robot system includes a mobile base and a humanoid robot. The mobile base includes a chassis having a platform. The mobile base includes a propulsion system that is coupled to the chassis and operable to propel the chassis within an environment. The humanoid robot includes a torso and two robotic legs. The humanoid robot has a first locomotion mode in which the humanoid robot is supported on the platform and travel of the humanoid robot within the environment is by movement of the mobile base within the environment. The humanoid robot has a second locomotion mode in which the humanoid robot is not supported on the platform and travel of the humanoid robot within the environment is by movement of the two robotic legs.

title: SYSTEMS, DEVICES, AND METHODS FOR A MOBILE ROBOT SYSTEM
abstract: A mobile robot system has a robot body attached to a mobile base. The robot body has a torso, a first robotic arm mechanically coupled to the torso, a first robotic leg, and a second robotic leg. The first robotic leg and the second robotic leg are controllably actuatable to enable the robot body to execute bipedal walking. The mobile base has a platform to receive a lower end of the first robotic leg and a lower end of the second robotic leg, at least one wheel and a controllable steering mechanism to enable the mobile base to travel both while the robot body is positioned on the platform and while the robot body is not positioned on the platform. The mobile base also has a plurality of components, at least one of which operable to support at least one function of the robot body.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, in particular to a human-shaped mechanical arm which comprises a shoulder joint assembly, an elbow joint assembly and a wrist joint assembly. The second shoulder rotating module is connected to the output end of the first shoulder rotating module; the third shoulder rotating module is connected to the output end of the second shoulder rotating module; the elbow joint assembly comprises a large arm rotating connecting piece connected to the output end of the third shoulder rotating module, an elbow connecting piece rotationally connected with the large arm rotating connecting piece and a front arm rotating module installed on the elbow connecting piece. And the wrist joint assembly comprises a forearm rotating connecting piece installed at the output end of the forearm rotating module, a wrist connecting piece and a mechanical arm adapting piece rotationally connected with the wrist connecting piece, a mechanical arm driving mechanism for driving the mechanical arm adapting piece to rotate is installed on the wrist connecting piece, and the humanoid mechanical arm is similar to a human body and good in flexibility.

And the wrist joint assembly comprises a forearm rotating connecting piece installed at the output end of the forearm rotating module, a wrist connecting piece and a mechanical arm adapting piece rotationally connected with the wrist connecting piece, a mechanical arm driving mechanism for driving the mechanical arm adapting piece to rotate is installed on the wrist connecting piece, and the humanoid mechanical arm is similar to a human body and good in flexibility.

title: Variable-rigidity bionic robot foot based on low-melting-point alloy
abstract: The invention discloses a rigidity-variable bionic robot foot based on a low-melting-point alloy. The invention relates to the technical field of robots. The bottom of a bionic robot shank is rotatably arranged in the middle of a bionic robot foot bottom through a first connecting shaft, and two connecting columns are rotatably arranged on the two sides of the middle of the bionic robot shank through second connecting shafts; the two variable elastic assemblies are rotatably arranged at the rear end of the foot bottom of the bionic robot through third connecting shafts; the variable elastic assembly comprises a base, a low-melting-point alloy variable rigidity layer, an elastic piece, a top plate and at least two guide columns. According to the invention, simulation work of human ankle and foot joints can be effectively realized, and good cushioning and supporting effects are provided for walking and movement of the robot. Wherein the elastic coefficient of the variable elastic component can be adjusted in real time by controlling the temperature of the low-melting-point alloy variable rigidity layer, so that the requirements under different working conditions are met.

title: Upper limb device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot upper limb device which comprises a shoulder, a big arm and a small arm, and the small arm is connected with the shoulder through the big arm. The shoulder part comprises a rotary actuator assembly and a shoulder part linear actuator, and the linear actuator is installed at the movable end of the rotary actuator assembly through a fixed connecting piece; the large arm comprises a first connecting assembly and a small arm rotating actuator assembly, the first connecting assembly is connected with the fixed connecting piece, and the small arm rotating actuator assembly is arranged at one end of the first connecting assembly; the forearm comprises a second connecting assembly, a wrist joint linear actuator assembly and a humanoid dexterous hand, the second connecting assembly is connected to the movable end of the forearm rotating actuator assembly, the humanoid dexterous hand is connected with the second connecting assembly, and the wrist joint linear actuator assembly is arranged between the second connecting assembly and the humanoid dexterous hand. According to the arrangement, the upper limbs of the humanoid robot are designed into the modular components, and the components can be quickly connected through the connecting components, so that modular quick assembly or disassembly is realized.

title: Caring type humanoid robot based on multi legged walking
abstract: The present invention relates to a caregiving type humanoid robot for providing a customized service for a to-be-cared subject through multi-legged walking, which comprises: a robot body unit (100); and a service control unit (200) provided in the body and providing a customized service for the to-be-cared subject. The service control unit (200) includes: an image recognition module (210) for recognizing a to-be-cared subject through an input image of a camera; a voice recognition module (220) for recognizing a voice of the to-be-cared subject through a speaker; a to-be-cared subject behavior pattern analysis module (230); and an IoT connected unit (240) connected to a smart home system. Accordingly, a customized care service can be provided for a to-be-cared subject.

title: Planetary gear motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of speed reducers, in particular to a planetary speed reduction motor for a humanoid robot, which comprises a push rod, a motor, a first planetary speed reducer and a second planetary speed reducer, the motor is provided with an input shaft; the first planetary reducer comprises a first sun gear and a first planet carrier rotationally arranged outside the first sun gear in a sleeving mode. The second planetary reducer comprises a second sun gear and a second planet carrier rotationally arranged outside the second sun gear in a sleeving mode. The first sun gear is connected with the input shaft; the second sun gear is rotationally connected with the first planet carrier; the push rod is provided with a control rod; the control rod is connected with the input shaft profile; a locking assembly is arranged among the control rod, the first sun gear, the first planet carrier, the second sun gear and the second planet carrier. According to the control rod, transmission or separation among the first sun gear, the first planet carrier, the second sun gear and the second planet carrier can be achieved through the locking assembly, and therefore the planetary gear motor for the humanoid robot can adjust and output different reduction ratios.

title: Stay puppet type humanoid robot driving structure
abstract: According to the stay wire puppet type humanoid robot driving structure, the layout of an original humanoid robot motor is changed, the motor is placed outside the joint, the motor pulls the stay wire, and then the stay wire drives the joint to rotate, for example, the motor on the arm is moved to the chest, and the motor is not loaded when the hand acts; and the motor for driving the hand is not limited by the size of the joint any more, and a larger motor can be used, so that the bottleneck of small strength of the joint of the humanoid robot is broken through. Meanwhile, a combination formed by the motor and the electromagnetic clutch connected with the motor can be matched with other combinations in various forms to generate force to act on joints, the effect of distributing the motors according to needs is achieved, and therefore the use efficiency of the motors is improved, and use of the motors is reduced; the self weight of the humanoid robot is reduced, the joints have large output torque under the condition that the sizes of the joints are not increased, and the humanoid robot can have more joints and is more flexible.

title: Method, device and equipment for laterally grabbing box body based on double-arm robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides a method for laterally grabbing a box body based on a two-arm robot, a two-dimensional code is arranged on the box body, the box body is grabbed by a humanoid two-arm robot through a mechanical arm, and the method comprises the following steps that the box body is shot through a camera, and a shot image and a point cloud image of the box body are obtained; obtaining the pose of the two-dimensional code in the shot image; according to the pose of the two-dimensional code, the pose of the mechanical arm for grabbing the box body is calculated; determining coordinates of a central point of the two-dimensional code in the point cloud image in a camera coordinate system; according to the coordinate of the center point of the two-dimensional code in the point cloud image under the camera coordinate system, calculating a grabbing point of the box body; according to the box body grabbing posture of the mechanical arm and the grabbing point of the box body, the inclined posture of the box body can be rapidly and accurately detected, the grabbing posture of the tail end of the mechanical arm is automatically adjusted according to the inclined situation of the box body, and the grabbing success rate is greatly increased.

title: Welding method based on amphibious humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention provides a welding method based on an amphibious humanoid welding robot. The welding method comprises the following steps that the surface of a pan-steel structure, a target welding area and the initial position of the amphibious humanoid welding robot are mapped to a world three-dimensional coordinate system; then mapping to a world two-dimensional coordinate system; the surface of the pan-steel structure is divided into grids; calculating the cost value of each grid to form a cost map; a minimum-cost route from the initial position of the amphibious humanoid welding robot to the target welding area is planned; constructing a third-order Bezier curve to obtain a smooth planning route; moving to a target welding area according to a planned route; and tracks of the two mechanical arm modules are planned, and welding work is completed according to the planned tracks. The method is closer to the working habits of human beings, simulates the actions of the human beings to carry out welding operation, and has better flexibility and operability; and the welding path can be autonomously planned, autonomous navigation and accurate positioning are realized, and the intelligent level is high.

title: Multi-modal feature fusion image classification method and application in humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image recognition and understanding, and particularly relates to a multi-modal feature fusion image classification method and application in a humanoid robot. According to the multi-modal feature fusion image classification method provided by the invention, partitioning and filling preprocessing is performed on a depth image and a radar image, and then a depth image feature extraction module combining three-dimensional convolution and heterogeneous kernel convolution and two-dimensional convolution are utilized to process the radar image; fusing the features of the depth image and the radar image by using a Transform network based on cross attention; deep feature extraction and fusion are carried out through a multi-scale Transform network; and inputting the fused features into a classifier to complete object recognition. According to the method, the advantages of CNN and Transform are effectively fused, the classification and recognition capability is improved through multi-scale processing and cross-modal feature fusion, and the method is further used for improving the environmental adaptability and navigation precision of the humanoid robot.

title: Robot control method and device and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot control method and device and a robot. The method comprises the steps that in a man-machine interaction scene, a first foot end of a first limb and a second foot end of a second limb of the robot are controlled to reach corresponding supporting positions respectively; a first limb and a second limb of the robot are controlled to execute a half-lying action until a second joint of the second limb and a second foot end fall to the ground, a first joint of the first limb falls to the ground, and a first structural part of the first limb is perpendicular to the ground at a side view angle; wherein the landing point of the second foot end is the supporting position corresponding to the second foot end, and the landing point of the first joint is under a third joint rotating shaft of the first limb when the robot is in a half-lying state; and the output torque of the joint motor of each joint of the robot is reduced to control the robot to keep a semi-lying state. The method can be applied to a long-time man-machine interaction scene.

title: Reverse circulation ball screw assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a reverse circulation ball screw assembly which comprises a nut, a lead screw, a circulator and a steel ball arranged between the nut and the lead screw. An open type spiral nut raceway is arranged on the inner surface of the nut, and the nut is arranged on the lead screw in a sleeving manner; a spiral bearing raceway is arranged on the outer surface of the rear end of the lead screw, and a circulating inlet and a circulating outlet of the steel balls are formed in the two ends of the bearing raceway respectively; the circulator is arranged in the lead screw and is in butt joint with the circulating inlet and the circulating outlet in the bearing raceway; the steel balls are evenly arranged between the nut roller path and the bearing roller path of the lead screw in the circumferential direction. According to the reverse circulation ball screw pair, the circulator is installed on the lead screw, the operation principle is that the motor directly drives the nut to rotate to do work, the work acts on the lead screw through the rotating motion of the nut, and therefore linear motion of the lead screw is achieved. The device is especially suitable for application scenes such as humanoid robots which are limited in installation space but need long service life and continuous work.

title: Reverse self-circulation ball screw assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a reverse self-circulation ball screw assembly. The reverse self-circulation ball screw assembly comprises a nut, a lead screw and balls arranged between the nut and the lead screw. An open spiral nut raceway is arranged on the inner surface of the nut, and the nut is arranged on the lead screw in a sleeving manner; a circulating mechanism is arranged on the outer diameter of the rear end of the lead screw; the balls are evenly arranged between the nut raceway and the lead screw circulating mechanism in the circumferential direction to form a ball thread reciprocating transmission mechanism. In the working process, the nut rotates in the circumferential direction to drive the balls to operate in the lead screw circulating mechanism, and then the lead screw is driven to move in the axial direction. According to the reverse circulation ball screw, a circulation mechanism is manufactured on the screw and is similar to the reverse circulation ball screw during operation, the nut is directly driven by the motor, rotary motion of the nut is converted into linear motion of the screw, and the reverse circulation ball screw is simple in structure, convenient to machine, small in design size and high in efficiency. And the device is particularly suitable for application scenes such as humanoid robots which have limited installation spaces and need long service life and continuous work.

title: Humanoid robot joint connecting component
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint connecting part of a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of connecting parts, and comprises an upper arm, a lower arm is arranged on the front side of the upper arm, a dismounting and mounting assembly is arranged in the lower arm, and the dismounting and mounting assembly is used for dismounting and mounting parts of a joint part. A worker stretches fingers into a gap of a supporting plate in the dismounting and mounting assembly, the supporting plate is rotated to drive a threaded ring to rotate and be dismounted, the motor is grabbed to move in the direction away from a fixed plate, the motor is dismounted, the upper arm and the lower arm are separated, and the lower arm is convenient to dismount and mount.

title: Article carrying method and device for controlling humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an article carrying method and device for controlling a humanoid robot and related equipment. An environment space interface is displayed; in response to a first operation on the environment space interface, determining a to-be-carried target article, a first initial position corresponding to the target article and a target carrying position; acquiring a second initial position of the humanoid robot; determining a target carrying route based on the first initial position, the target carrying position and the second initial position; in response to a second operation on the environment space interface, sending an article carrying instruction to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot carries the target article to a target carrying position according to the target carrying route; if there is an obstacle on the target carrying route, acquiring obstacle information of the obstacle; and generating an obstacle avoidance instruction according to the obstacle information, and sending the obstacle avoidance instruction to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot adopts an obstacle avoidance strategy to avoid the obstacle. According to the embodiment of the invention, the carrying efficiency of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot and variable-rigidity variable-reduction-ratio ankle joint device thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a variable-rigidity variable-reduction-ratio ankle joint device of the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot comprises a linear actuator, a special-shaped rocker, a rocker rotating shaft, an ankle joint rotating shaft, a variable-rigidity mechanism, a rocker output rotating shaft and a transmission connecting rod, the upper end of the linear actuator is rotationally connected with the top of a shank structural part, and the lower end of the linear actuator is connected with a rocker input rotating shaft; the rocker input rotating shaft is fixedly connected with one end of the special-shaped rocker, the other end of the special-shaped rocker is rotationally connected to the rocker rotating shaft, the rocker rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the lower portion of the shank structural part, the special-shaped rocker is further fixedly connected with the rocker output rotating shaft, and the rocker output rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the upper end of the transmission connecting rod. The variable-rigidity mechanism input rotating shaft is rotationally connected to the variable-rigidity mechanism, the variable-rigidity mechanism is rotationally connected to the ankle joint rotating shaft, and the ankle joint rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the bottom of the shank structural part. The coupling relation between the reduction ratio and the joint can be flexibly designed, and the change from low rigidity to infinite rigidity can be achieved.

title: Camping article carrying method based on humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot-based camping article carrying method and a related device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a camping article information list and a target carrying position; m target articles successfully matched with the camping article information list in all articles of the target vehicle are determined; the m target objects are moved into a camping cart according to a preset object loading scheme; initial gait parameters are determined according to the target carrying position; acquiring the current weight of the camping cart; adjusting the initial gait parameter according to the current weight to obtain a first gait parameter; the humanoid robot is controlled to push the camping cart to carry out article conveying according to the first gait parameter, and ground environment information of a preset sensing range is obtained in the conveying process; adjusting the first gait parameter according to the ground environment information to obtain a second gait parameter; and controlling the humanoid robot to push the camping cart to carry out article transportation according to the second gait parameter so as to reach the target carrying position.

title: Rapid fire extinguishing method based on humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention provides a rapid fire extinguishing method based on a humanoid robot and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: determining a first fire behavior degree of a target fire source at a target position at a first moment; determining the target terrain complexity of the target position; determining a first moving speed corresponding to the first fire behavior degree according to a preset mapping relation between the fire behavior degree and the moving speed; the larger the fire behavior degree is, the higher the moving speed is; determining a first adjustment parameter according to the target terrain complexity; adjusting the first moving speed according to the first adjusting parameter to obtain a second moving speed; controlling the humanoid robot to move according to the second moving speed, and acquiring obstacle information of the target obstacle in the preset sensing range in the moving process; controlling the humanoid robot to perform automatic obstacle avoidance operation in the moving process according to the obstacle information; and when the humanoid robot reaches the target position, the humanoid robot is controlled to conduct fire extinguishing operation on the target fire source according to a preset fire extinguishing scheme.

title: Factory patrol disaster relief method based on humanoid robot and related products
abstract: The invention discloses a factory patrol and disaster relief method based on a humanoid robot and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target map data and equipment distribution data corresponding to a target factory; acquiring an initial position corresponding to the humanoid robot; generating a target patrol path based on the target map data and the initial position; controlling the humanoid robot to patrol based on the target patrol path, and performing disaster situation inspection on the target factory in the patrol process to obtain target disaster situation data; determining n disaster relief devices and m factory devices existing in a preset distance around the humanoid robot based on the device distribution data; generating a target disaster relief scheme according to the target disaster situation data, the n disaster relief devices and the m factory devices; and controlling the humanoid robot to perform disaster relief on the target factory according to the target disaster relief scheme so as to protect the production safety of the target factory. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the safety of a factory is improved.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot

title: Manipulator self-adaptive control system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the field of manipulator control, in particular to a manipulator self-adaptive control system and method. A camera is used for collecting a surface state image of a to-be-grabbed object, and an image processing and analysis algorithm based on artificial intelligence and machine vision is introduced at the rear end to analyze the surface state image, so that the surface state semantics of the to-be-grabbed object is recognized, and the hardness of the object is recognized. Therefore, the hardness of the object grabbed by the humanoid manipulator can be detected by utilizing an image processing technology, so that the problems that the hardness of the object grabbed by the humanoid manipulator is easily influenced by environmental factors and some sensitive or fragile objects are possibly damaged by utilizing a sensor and a contact mode are solved.

According to the method, the naturalness and diversity of facial expressions of the bionic robot can be improved, and the matching degree of the expressions and interaction contents is enhanced.

title: Robot-based interactive exhibition and sale method and system

title: Humanoid robot gait imitation learning method combined with periodic reward
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait imitation learning method combined with periodic rewards, relates to the technical field of robot motion control, and aims to solve the problem that in the prior art, when a humanoid robot walks in a human-like posture in a plane, the posture is unstable. And as a reference to the imitation reward item and the periodic contact reward item. According to the method, a comprehensive reference action library is created for the basic actions and the periodic contact information corresponding to the basic actions. According to the strategy, the style of the reference action and the contact information of the reference action are simulated, a periodic reward item is introduced, the fidelity and style consistency of the robot action are improved, attention to interaction details of the feet and the ground in the action execution process is enhanced, and therefore it is guaranteed that the posture is stable when the humanoid robot walks in a human-like posture in the plane.

title: Biped robot multi-mode adaptive gait generation method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a biped robot multi-modal adaptive gait generation method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing multi-modal walking tasks including a simple plane task and a complex non-plane task; then, based on the course learning thought, strategy training is carried out on the gait generator, and meanwhile, different reward function excitation strategy training is used according to different multi-mode gait tasks, so that the optimal parameters of the gait generator are obtained; the gait generator is designed to be a reinforcement learning framework jointly constructed by using a dominant actor-commentator framework, namely an AC network and a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, namely a PPO algorithm; and finally, generating a biped robot gait meeting an actual walking task by utilizing the trained gait generator.

title: Robot leg device and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of bionic robots, in particular to a robot leg device and a humanoid robot with the same. The robot leg device comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, a knee joint driving part is installed at the end, close to the hip joint assembly, of the thigh assembly, a knee joint rocker arm is eccentrically installed at the output end of the knee joint driving part, and a shank pull rod is rotationally installed on the knee joint rocker arm; the connecting line of the rotating shaft of the shank pull rod swinging around the shank assembly and the rotating shaft of the shank assembly swinging around the thigh assembly is not collinear with the shank pull rod. When being subjected to impact force from the sole, the impact force can be transmitted to the knee joint driving piece through the position between the shank assembly and the shank pull rod and then transmitted to the hip joint assembly, a rotating shaft between the shank assembly and the thigh assembly cannot be driven to rotate, and the overall stability of the shank assembly and the thigh assembly during external force impact is improved; and the possibility that the leg device of the robot overturns during working can be greatly reduced.

title: Lower limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a lower limb assembly and a humanoid robot. The first rocker arm is connected with the first power structure which drives the first rocker arm to swing; the second rocker arm is connected with a second power structure which drives the second rocker arm to swing; the first rod piece is connected with the first rocker arm; the first rod piece is connected with the side, close to the heel, of the foot structural piece. title: Wiring structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a routing structure and a humanoid robot, the routing structure is applied to the trunk of the humanoid robot, the routing structure comprises a mounting cavity, and the mounting cavity is used for penetrating in the trunk along the width direction; a wiring piece is arranged in the mounting cavity in the width direction, a wiring groove is concavely formed in the opposite upper end of the wiring piece in the height direction, the wiring groove penetrates through the wiring piece in the width direction, and the wiring groove is used for embedding a wiring harness. title: CORDING ROBOT AND CONTROL METHOD OF THE ROBOT
abstract: The present invention relates to a robot-type toy for controlling a motion by inputting the motion in a program form in advance. In addition, the method for controlling a coding robot comprises: (a) a template providing step of providing each motion of a coding robot corresponding to a human motion in the form of an icon; (b) a coding step of receiving a selection of a user by the template providing unit and combining the same as a continuous motion command; and (c) a simulation providing step of simulating the command combined in the coding step and implementing the same on a display screen of the coding smartphone in advance.

title: Humanoid robot high-dynamic jumping motion control method based on online centroid trajectory optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot high-dynamic jumping motion control method based on online centroid trajectory optimization, and belongs to the field of robot technologies and artificial intelligence. The method aims at solving the problems that in jumping motion control of an existing humanoid robot in a complex environment, the motion track cannot be optimized online, the real-time performance is poor, and the control precision is affected. Comprising the following steps: obtaining a heart dynamic model based on a humanoid robot dynamic model, and converting to obtain a single rigid body model; constructing a single rigid body model constraint condition, and optimizing and solving an expected jumping motion centroid trajectory of the humanoid robot; a model prediction controller is used for tracking the expected jumping motion mass center track, and the sole contact force of the humanoid robot in the tracking process is calculated; and calculating by using a whole body controller to obtain an expected position, an expected speed and an expected driving torque of a whole body driving joint of the humanoid robot in the tracking process, and carrying out jumping motion control on the humanoid robot through an executing mechanism. The method is used for high-dynamic jumping motion control of the humanoid robot.

title: Waist and hip assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a waist and crotch assembly and a humanoid robot. The first waist supporting piece is used for rotating around a first axis; the second waist supporting piece and the first waist supporting piece are rotationally connected around a second axis and a third axis; the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are both arranged on the second waist supporting piece and are both connected with the first waist supporting piece; the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are used for working at the same time to drive the second waist supporting piece to rotate around the second axis or the third axis relative to the first waist supporting piece. According to the invention, the waist and crotch assembly can realize bending actions such as forward leaning, backward leaning, left leaning and right leaning rotation, so that the flexibility of the waist is improved; the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are both arranged on the second waist supporting piece and are directly connected with the first waist supporting piece used for rotating around the first axis, and the overall occupied space of the waist and crotch assembly is reduced.

title: Fixing structure of high-power frameless motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-power frameless motor fixing structure for a humanoid robot, which comprises a fixing frame and a mounting frame, a connecting beam is arranged on the fixing frame, a fastening adjusting device is further arranged on the connecting beam, and at least three fixed core rods are arranged on each of the fixing frame and the mounting frame. The position of the fixed core rod on the fixed frame is opposite to the position of the fixed core rod on the mounting frame, and the fixed core rod on the fixed frame is connected with a fastening adjusting device. By designing the embedded fixing bracket which can be matched with the structure of the frameless motor, the stator of the frameless motor can be inserted from the two ends of the frameless motor, and the installation is simple and convenient; by rotating the bolt, the concentricity of the axes of the stator and the rotor of the motor can be adjusted and positioned through the mutual matching of the plurality of fixed core rods; and clamping teeth arranged on the fixing bracket can be pushed while the concentricity of the axes of the stator and the rotor is adjusted, so that the fixing effect on the motor is further improved, and the fixing requirement of the high-power frameless motor mounted in an embedded manner is met.

title: Robot leg mechanism and humanoid robot thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a robot leg mechanism and a humanoid robot thereof, and particularly relates to the field of bionic robotics.The robot leg mechanism comprises a trunk assembly and full-leg assemblies, the trunk assembly and the full-leg assemblies are connected through a pelvic bone simulation frame, each full-leg assembly comprises the pelvic bone simulation frame, and the full-leg assemblies are arranged at the bottoms of the two ends of the pelvic bone simulation frame; the two full-leg assemblies are symmetrically arranged along the longitudinal center line of the pelvis simulation frame. Two quadrilateral connecting rod structures of the upper leg strong stress mechanism and the lower leg strong stress mechanism are arranged in the whole leg assembly, so that the knees and the ankles can be bent, the design of the knees and the ankles can become smoother, the torque is larger, motors at the knees are lifted to thighs, and therefore the thighs can be driven to move more stably. The motors at the ankles are lifted to the shanks, compared with a traditional mode that motors are directly connected with the framework, the problem that only small-size motors can be selected at the joints is solved, motors of larger sizes can be selected, and the problem that existing leg structures of bionic robots in the market are unstable is solved.

title: Waist and hip limiting structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist and crotch limiting structure and a humanoid robot. The waist and crotch limiting structure comprises a first driving component and a second driving component which are connected. A first calibration part and two first limiting parts are arranged on the first driving component, and the first driving component is used for driving the leg structure to rotate in the vertical direction of the humanoid robot; a second calibration part and a second limiting part are arranged on the second driving component, and the second driving component is used for driving the leg structure to rotate in the left-right direction of the humanoid robot; the two first limiting parts are matched with the second limiting part so as to limit the rotating angle of the second driving component relative to the first driving component; when the first calibration parts are aligned with the second calibration parts, the second limiting parts are located between the two first limiting parts. According to the waist and crotch limiting structure and the humanoid robot, the second driving component can be prevented from interfering with surrounding parts in the rotating process, and the program algorithm design of the rotating angle of the second driving component can be simplified conveniently.
abstract_en: The invention provides a waist and crotch limiting structure and a humanoid robot. The waist and crotch limiting structure comprises a first driving component and a second driving component which are connected. A first calibration part and two first limiting parts are arranged on the first driving component, and the first driving component is used for driving the leg structure to rotate in the vertical direction of the humanoid robot; a second calibration part and a second limiting part are arranged on the second driving component, and the second driving component is used for driving the leg structure to rotate in the left-right direction of the humanoid robot; the two first limiting parts are matched with the second limiting part so as to limit the rotating angle of the second driving component relative to the first driving component; when the first calibration parts are aligned with the second calibration parts, the second limiting parts are located between the two first limiting parts. According to the waist and crotch limiting structure and the humanoid robot, the second driving component can be prevented from interfering with surrounding parts in the rotating process, and the program algorithm design of the rotating angle of the second driving component can be simplified conveniently.

title: Humanoid robot arm assembly
abstract: The humanoid robot arm assembly comprises a first joint mechanism, a second joint mechanism and a push-pull rod joint mechanism, the first joint mechanism comprises a first connecting support, a joint motor module and a second connecting support, and the first connecting support comprises two fixing discs; the output ends of the two joint motor modules are fixed to the two fixing discs respectively, the second connecting support comprises a connecting disc and a fixing ring B, the fixing ring B is fixedly arranged on one shutdown motor module in a sleeving mode, and the connecting disc is fixed to the output end of the third joint motor module; the push-pull rod joint mechanism comprises joint motor modules, a pull rod and a suspension support assembly, the suspension assembly enables the two joint motor modules to be perpendicular to each other, and the two ends of the pull rod are connected with the two joint motor modules correspondingly; the joint motor module comprises a motor, a harmonic reducer and a controller assembly, and the assembly is good in heat dissipation effect; installation is convenient, and the whole arm moves more flexibly.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system based on ROS
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and system based on an ROS. The method comprises the steps that motion state data of a humanoid robot are collected in real time; acquiring original image data around the humanoid robot and performing segmentation processing to obtain an independent left eye image and an independent right eye image; performing three-dimensional correction on the independent left eye image and right eye image to enable the left eye image and the right eye image to be aligned on the same plane to obtain a corrected left eye image and a corrected right eye image; according to the corrected left eye image and the corrected right eye image, identifying a target object and measuring the distance of the target object; controlling the humanoid robot to execute the planned gaits and various predefined actions; and outputting preset voice information to the outside through the loudspeaker equipment. The system comprises a motion state data acquisition module, a vision module, a correction module, a target recognition module, a motion control module and a voice module. According to the invention, accurate target object identification and distance measurement can be realized, and the behavior planning and execution capability of the robot in a complex environment is improved.

title: Bionic service type humanoid robot perception control system
abstract: The invention provides a bionic service type humanoid robot perception control system comprising a control center which comprises a signal processing module and is used for receiving detection signals sent by a plurality of sensors of a robot, adjusting, filtering and denoising the detection signals and improving the processing efficiency and accuracy of data captured by the sensors; the data processing module comprises a plurality of processors, divides a signal detection task into a plurality of sub-tasks by adopting a multi-thread technology, and controls the plurality of processors to process the tasks in parallel; the processor adopts a real-time operating system to complete task scheduling, so that the overall running speed and the response capability of the robot are effectively improved; and the fault processing module optimizes the fault tolerance of the robot, monitors and analyzes the behavior and state data of the robot through a fault detection algorithm to identify potential problems, and automatically switches to a standby system or adjusts operation parameters through a self-repairing mechanism under the condition that main functions of the robot are not affected when the robot breaks down. Therefore, the current working state is adapted.

title: Mechanical finger, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical finger, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The mechanical finger comprises a first knuckle structure, a second knuckle structure and a driving assembly, the driving assembly comprises a driving mechanism and a locking mechanism, the driving mechanism is used for being rotationally connected with the palm structure, the driving assembly is used for driving the first knuckle structure and the second knuckle structure to rotate, and the locking mechanism has a first state and a second state. When the locking mechanism is in the first state, the first knuckle structure and the second knuckle structure are rotationally connected, so that the first driving assembly, the first knuckle structure and the second knuckle structure form a connecting rod transmission system, and accurate grabbing and operation are achieved. And the workpiece can be pushed or positioned through the back of the first knuckle structure, so that the diversity of operation is improved. And when the locking mechanism is in the second state, the backs of the first knuckle structure and the second knuckle structure can be passively bent under the impact of external force, the driving mechanism is prevented from being stuck or damaged, and various complex operation environments and task requirements are met.

title: Thumb structure, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a thumb structure, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The thumb structure comprises a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the second knuckle comprises a knuckle body and a connecting base, the connecting base is rotationally connected with the first knuckle, the knuckle body is rotationally connected with the connecting base, and at least part of the knuckle body is detachably connected with the connecting base. The part, detachably connected with the connecting base, of the knuckle body is used for being separated from the connecting base when the back of the knuckle body is pressed. The knuckle body is connected with the connecting seat through two connecting points: one connecting point is a rotating connecting point for realizing the rotation of the joint; one of the two knuckles is a connecting point, the other one is a detachable connecting point, the detachable connecting point is used for releasing connection when the back of the knuckle body is pressed, after the detachable connecting point is released, only a rotating connecting point exists between the knuckle body and the connecting base, and the knuckle body can freely rotate around the rotating connecting point, so that excessive acting force is prevented from being transmitted to the first knuckle, and the joint structure is protected; and the impact resistance and the safety of the thumb structure are improved.

title: Mechanical thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. title: Dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The dexterous hand comprises a palm shell, a control piece and mechanical fingers. The containing cavity is formed in the palm shell, the driving assembly is mainly arranged in the containing cavity in the palm shell, and therefore most of the cables are limited in the containing cavity. The cables connected with all the driving assemblies are connected to the control piece and are in butt joint with the signal terminals of the wrist joint structure through the plug-in terminals, so that exposed cables are reduced, direct contact and friction between the cables and mechanical moving parts (such as finger joints) are reduced, the service life of the cables can be prolonged, and the service life of the cables is prolonged. And the signal interruption or fault risk caused by cable wear is also reduced. And the cables are hidden in the accommodating cavity, so that the cables are prevented from being disorderly distributed outside, and the appearance of the dexterous hand is tidier and more attractive.

title: High-agility humanoid target
abstract: The utility model discloses a high-agility humanoid target, which comprises a human body model, a flight rotor system, a flight control system, a position sensing device and a power supply system, the human body model comprises a head, a trunk, upper limbs and lower limbs; the lower limbs comprise thighs and shanks, the thighs are rotatably connected with the trunk, and the shanks are rotatably connected with the thighs; the flight rotor wing system comprises a first rotor wing and a second rotor wing which are the same in structure; the first rotors are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the upper shoulder and the two sides of the crotch of the trunk. The second rotors are symmetrically arranged at the upper parts of the joints of the thighs and the shanks; the first rotor wing is rotatably connected with the shoulder and the crotch; the first rotor wing and the second rotor wing are connected with the flight control system; the flight rotor system, the flight control system and the angle adjusting system are used for controlling the human body model, so that the human body model can flexibly simulate various postures, the simulation degree is high, and the movement agility of the human-shaped target is high.

title: Waist and hip mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a waist and crotch mechanism and a humanoid robot. The waist and crotch mechanism comprises a first waist supporting piece, a first driving piece, a mounting frame and a crotch supporting piece. The first waist supporting piece comprises a first part and a second part which are connected, and the first part is provided with a first axis; the first driving piece is connected with the first part and drives the first waist supporting piece to rotate around the first axis; the mounting frame is connected with the first driving piece and provided with a first limiting part, and the first limiting part is used for limiting the rotation range of the first waist supporting piece; the crotch supporting piece is connected with the mounting frame and used for supporting the second part when the offset of the gravity center above the first waist supporting piece from the first axis to the second part is larger than a first preset value. In the application, the first limiting part can limit the rotation range of the first waist supporting piece, so that the crotch supporting piece can support the first waist supporting piece all the time, heeling or unbalance caused by unstable gravity center of the first waist supporting piece can be inhibited, and the stability is improved.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot which comprises a trunk assembly, a sacral joint assembly, a leg assembly and a hip joint assembly, and the hip joint assembly comprises a pitching driving part and a hip joint support; the trunk assembly, the sacral joint assembly, the pitching driving piece, the hip joint support and the leg assembly are sequentially connected, the sacral joint assembly drives the trunk assembly to rotate around a first axis, and the pitching driving piece drives the leg assembly to rotate around a second axis; the first axis and the second axis intersect and form an inclined included angle; a first calibration part is arranged on the pitching driving piece, and a second calibration part is arranged on the hip joint support; under the condition that the first calibration part and the second calibration part are aligned, the hip joint support is located at a first initial position relative to the pitching driving piece, and the first initial position is used as a zero point of swinging of the leg assembly in the front-back direction of the humanoid robot. According to the humanoid robot provided by the invention, the algorithm program of swinging the leg assemblies in the front-back direction of the humanoid robot is simpler, and the stability in the running process is better.

title: Trunk assembly and humanoid robot

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot. The mechanical arm comprises a plurality of structural parts which are sequentially connected, in any two adjacent structural parts, one structural part is provided with a driving part, the other structural part is connected with an output shaft of the driving part, the driving part is used for driving the two adjacent structural parts to rotate relatively, and the extending directions of the rotating axes of any two adjacent driving parts are perpendicular to each other; the multiple structural parts comprise a shoulder connecting frame, a large arm shell, a first connecting arm, a small arm shell, a connecting sleeve and a second connecting arm which are sequentially arranged, the shoulder connecting frame is used for being connected with a shoulder structure, and the second connecting arm is used for being connected with a dexterous hand. In the invention, each motor of the mechanical arm is independently controlled, so that the problem of motion interference caused by inharmonious driving of the motors is reduced. Under the condition that the series drive design is adopted, a complex transmission mechanism and a complex control system are not needed to coordinate synchronous movement of a plurality of motors, and the risk that due to the fact that the transmission mechanism is complex, different points are stuck is reduced.

title: Shoulder joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a shoulder joint structure and a humanoid robot. The shoulder joint structure comprises a mounting shell, a driving piece and a connecting frame, and the mounting shell is used for being connected with a shoulder structure of the humanoid robot; the first connecting arm is directly connected with the rotor, exposed out of the mounting shell, of the driving part and is responsible for receiving power from the driving part. And the second connecting arm is rotationally connected with the mounting seat, so that double supporting points are formed. When the large arm structure performs opening and closing actions, a rotary connecting point formed between the mounting seat and the second connecting arm serves as a rotary axis of the opening and closing actions of the large arm structure, and stable support is provided. The generated lateral force and torque are effectively dispersed to the mounting base, the lateral force directly acting on the output shaft of the driving piece is reduced, and the risk that the driving piece is damaged or the output shaft of the driving piece deforms due to stress concentration is reduced. Through the combined action of stable connecting points and a stress dispersion mechanism, vibration and shaking of the large arm structure in the movement process are reduced, and the movement stability and action precision are improved.

And the second connecting arm is rotationally connected with the mounting seat, so that double supporting points are formed. The generated lateral force and torque are effectively dispersed to the mounting base, the lateral force directly acting on the output shaft of the driving piece is reduced, and the risk that the driving piece is damaged or the output shaft of the driving piece deforms due to stress concentration is reduced. Through the combined action of stable connecting points and a stress dispersion mechanism, vibration and shaking of the large arm structure in the movement process are reduced, and the movement stability and action precision are improved.

title: Arm assembly and humanoid robot

title: Linear joint of humanoid robot and performance test platform thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a linear joint of a humanoid robot and a performance test platform of the humanoid robot, the linear joint comprises a shell assembly, a motor, a reverse planetary roller screw rod and a tension-torsion composite force sensor, the motor is located in the shell assembly and is used for generating radial rotation motion; the reverse planetary roller screw rod is arranged on the inner side of the motor and is used for converting rotary motion of the motor into axial linear motion; the tension-torsion composite force sensor is used for measuring the push-pull force of the output end and the torque of the input end of the reverse planetary roller screw rod in real time, so that the transmission efficiency of the screw rod is calculated in real time. According to the linear joint of the humanoid robot provided by the invention, the push-pull force of the output end of the lead screw can be detected by adopting the tension-torsion composite force sensor in a counter-acting force measuring manner, and the torque of the input end of the lead screw can also be detected, so that the lead screw transmission efficiency of the linear joint can be calculated in real time; the method is of great significance to optimization of the optimal gait of the humanoid robot.

title: Hip joint assembly, waist and hip mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint assembly, a waist and hip mechanism and a humanoid robot. The hip joint assembly comprises a support, a pitching driving part, a rolling driving part and a yawing driving part. The support is provided with an avoiding groove, the pitching driving part is connected with the support and used for driving the support to rotate around a first axis, the transverse rolling driving part is connected with the support, and the yaw driving part is connected with the transverse rolling driving part and used for driving the lower limb mechanism to rotate around a second axis. The transverse rolling driving part is used for driving the lower limb mechanism to swing around a third axis so as to drive the lower limb mechanism to swing in the left-right direction of the humanoid robot, and when the lower limb mechanism swings inwards to the limiting position, at least part of the yaw driving part is contained in the avoiding groove. According to the technical scheme, the avoiding groove is formed, movement of the yaw driving part can be further avoided through the avoiding groove, and therefore the swinging angle of the lower limb mechanism in the left-right direction is further increased, and the humanoid degree of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Biped robot with quick-change hand and motion analysis method thereof under special working conditions
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot with quick-change hands and a motion analysis method thereof under special working conditions. The biped robot comprises a trunk unit, arm units, hip joint units and leg units. The arm unit is provided with manipulators through a quick change structure, and the manipulators comprise a clamping manipulator, a scissor manipulator and a screwing and locking manipulator. Module design is adopted for all movable joints of the robot, and integration and modularization of the robot are greatly improved; a connecting rod mechanism is adopted on the rear side of the knee joint, the design that the hinge point moves outwards is adopted, the motion dead point of the knee joint deviates, the joint module can apply acting force more smoothly, and meanwhile the complexity of the joint connecting position can be reduced.

title: Waist and hip structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist and crotch structure and a humanoid robot, the waist and crotch structure comprises a supporting assembly, two first actuators, a second actuator and a detector, and the supporting assembly comprises a first surface and a second surface which are arranged back to back; the two first actuators are installed on the first surface, penetrate through the supporting assembly and extend out of the second surface, and the two first actuators are arranged in the left-right direction of the humanoid robot in a spaced mode; the first actuator is used for connecting and driving the leg structure to act; the second actuator is mounted on the second surface and is arranged between the two first actuators; the second actuator is used for connecting and driving the waist structure to act; the detector is mounted on the second surface, is opposite to the second actuator in the vertical direction of the humanoid robot, and is used for identifying the external environment; wherein the waist and crotch structure is a symmetrical structure, and the two first actuators are symmetrical relative to the second actuator. title: Vision-based multi-mode teleoperation grabbing method and system for humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode teleoperation grabbing method and system for a humanoid mechanical arm based on vision. The method comprises the steps that dexterous hand control data and mechanical arm control data are determined according to each frame of hand action image of an operator; in the full teleoperation control mode, the mechanical arm control data are mapped to the whole mechanical arm, and the whole mechanical arm is controlled to execute a second action; the second action is determined according to the palm pose of the operator; in the semi-automatic operation control mode, the whole mechanical arm is controlled to execute a third action according to the first coordinate of the object to be grabbed relative to the mechanical arm base; mapping the mechanical arm control data to the tail end of the mechanical arm, and controlling the tail end of the mechanical arm to execute a fourth action; and through cooperation of the first action and the second action or cooperation of the first action, the third action and the fourth action, teleoperation grabbing is completed. According to the overall steps of the embodiment of the invention, the teleoperation grabbing efficiency and performance of the humanoid mechanical arm are improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title: Humanoid robot based on projection and man-machine interaction method
abstract: The invention provides a projection-based humanoid robot and a man-machine interaction method, and the projection-based humanoid robot comprises a multimedia input module which is used for collecting audio and video information and/or instruction information; the generative large language model processing module is connected with the multimedia input module and is used for generating multimedia feedback information, and the multimedia feedback information comprises audio information, visual information and limb instruction information; the multimedia output module is connected with the generative large language model processing module, the multimedia output module is used for outputting multimedia feedback information, the multimedia output module comprises a planar projection system, and the planar projection system is used for visually displaying the multimedia feedback information. And the multimedia output module is used for outputting multimedia feedback information. According to the multimedia man-machine interaction method and device, information is displayed through projection, and more flexible and efficient multimedia man-machine interaction is achieved.

title: Multifunctional humanoid robot foot end
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional humanoid robot foot end, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The foot end comprises a carbon fiber sole elastic piece, a carbon fiber heel elastic piece, a fixing gasket, an elastic piece connecting base and an ankle joint assembly. The carbon fiber heel elastic piece is fixed to the bottom face of the elastic piece connecting base, after the front end of the carbon fiber sole elastic piece penetrates through a limiting groove in the elastic piece connecting base in the horizontal direction, the rear end of the carbon fiber sole elastic piece is fixedly connected with the elastic piece connecting base through a fixing gasket, and an included angle is formed between the carbon fiber sole elastic piece and the horizontal plane. The double-front sole elastic sheet structure at the front end of the carbon fiber sole elastic sheet is in contact with the ground, and the rear part of the carbon fiber heel elastic sheet is in contact with the ground, so that three-point support for the foot end is formed; the ankle joint assembly is installed in an installation groove in the upper surface of the elastic piece connecting base and can achieve multi-degree-of-freedom movement simulating the ankles of people. Certain elastic deformation is provided while the structural strength is met, so that the foot end has good pavement adaptability and stability.

title: High-precision map construction and navigation method for humanoid robot in multiple scenes
abstract: The invention discloses a high-precision map construction and navigation method for a humanoid robot under multiple scenes, which comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a hardware part through an inertial measurement unit (IMU) and a depth camera; then a network model comprising a visual network and a natural language processing module is constructed, the visual network is used for achieving semantic segmentation and instance segmentation of the two-dimensional picture and classification of the whole scene, and the natural language processing module is used for extracting object features from the description and aligning the object features with the visual features; then, a high-precision topological map is constructed, and moving paths of the robot among different small scenes are recorded; and finally, performing navigation based on natural language description, determining the position of a target object or scene by calculating the similarity between the object or scene features and the features recorded in the map, searching boundary point pairs in sequence, and gradually navigating to a target location. According to the invention, the precision of map construction and navigation is improved, the storage cost is reduced, and intelligent man-machine interaction and efficient navigation capability are realized.

title: Humanoid robot finger
abstract: A humanoid robot finger belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a palm, fingers, a hollow cup motor, a miniature roller chain, a tendon rope and a tensioning part, the fingers are formed by hinging a plurality of knuckles, the knuckle end close to one end of the palm is hinged to the palm, the hollow cup motor is arranged in the palm, guide wheels are distributed on the side face of each knuckle, the tendon rope bypasses the guide wheels, and the miniature roller chain is connected with the tensioning part. The tendon rope is connected with a tensioning piece in series, the two ends of the tendon rope are connected with the two ends of the miniature roller chain, an output shaft of the hollow cup motor is fixedly connected with a chain wheel, the miniature roller chain is connected with the chain wheel in a meshed mode, and the fingers are straightened and bent through forward and reverse rotation of the hollow cup motor. Through the driving mode that micro chain transmission and tendon ropes are combined, the bending action and the straightening action of the fingers can be achieved through a single motor, the reversing process depends on a chain transmission meshing mechanism, operation is stable and reliable, action delay is avoided, the whole operation track can be controlled within the expected range, and the flexibility of the fingers is effectively guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot control device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robot control devices, in particular to a humanoid robot control device which comprises a robot control device body and a cover plate, the right side of the robot control device body is attached to the cover plate, and the bottom of the right end of the cover plate is fixedly connected with a plurality of supporting blocks. title: Method for cooperatively controlling wheeled humanoid robot by hands and feet
abstract: The invention discloses a method for cooperatively controlling a wheeled humanoid robot by hands and feet. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring limb movement data of a user through intelligent gloves, exoskeleton movement capturing arm wearing equipment and intelligent shoes: capturing hand movement data through the intelligent gloves; s2, integrating data from the intelligent gloves, the exoskeleton motion capture arm wearable device and the intelligent shoes, and smoothing and calibrating the data by using Kalman filtering and a low-pass filter; s3, generating a control signal according to the integrated data so as to control the movement of the wheeled humanoid robot; and S4, a visual man-machine interaction interface is provided for an operator to monitor and adjust the movement of the robot. title: Autonomous motion planning method for legs of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot leg autonomous motion planning method. The humanoid robot leg autonomous motion planning method comprises the steps of S1, expressing a leg task in a world coordinate system when a robot acts; s2, defining a solving problem, and deducing a kinetic equation of the human leg-like two-link model; s3, a b spline polynomial with a time scale factor is used for representing a robot joint torque track, and the physical limitation of the robot joint torque track is incorporated into a formula; s4, on the basis of the torque curve formula, a torque curve planning problem is converted into a multi-objective function optimization problem with constraints by constructing multiple objective functions; s5, solving the multi-objective optimization problem on the basis of the standard kinetic model, and optimizing a plurality of objectives at the same time to obtain an optimal torque curve; and S6, on the basis of the existing torque curve, a closed-loop control system is designed to track the torque curve in the joint space. The motor capacity of the robot can be expanded, and meanwhile energy consumption is reduced.

title: Burst type jumping hydraulic wheel-legged biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses an explosive type jumping hydraulic wheel-legged biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The problems that an existing humanoid robot is large in mass, miniaturization and integration of a hydraulic power system cannot be achieved, and the jumping ability of the robot is poor are solved. Movement of knee joints is achieved under driving of two knee joint hydraulic driving assemblies installed on the rear sides of the two thigh supporting frameworks. The method is used for optimizing the jumping ability of the robot.

title: Human-shaped pelvis and waist integrated mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid pelvis and waist integrated mechanism, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. The defects that an existing humanoid robot driven by a motor is insufficient in pelvis freedom degree, small in driving force, unstable in movement and the like are overcome, and the problems that a multi-freedom-degree humanoid joint is low in rigidity and heavy due to a complex structure are solved. The device is provided with two hip joints symmetrically distributed left and right and a waist joint located in the middle of the pelvic bone, the hip joint on each side is driven by two hydraulic cylinders in series, the pelvic bone is connected with the hip joints, and the hip joints are connected with thighs. Two degrees of freedom of the waist joint are independently driven by two hydraulic cylinders on the pelvis; the two hydraulic cylinders push the sliding blocks on the guide rails through the piston rods, and then the hip joint is pushed through the two-force rod to achieve rolling and yawing movement. The two hydraulic cylinders push the sliding blocks on the guide rails through the piston rods, and then the waist joint is pushed through the two-force rod to achieve rotation and pitching movement. The method is used for improving the torque-to-volume ratio and locked-rotor resistance of the humanoid pelvis and improving the loading capacity of the humanoid robot.

title: Five-degree-of-freedom hydraulically-driven human-shaped leg mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a five-degree-of-freedom hydraulically-driven human-shaped leg mechanism, and relates to the technical field of hydraulically-driven robots. The problems that an existing hydraulically-driven joint leg is small in freedom degree, and complex actions cannot be achieved; a buffer device is lacked, and landing impact is large; the dynamic performance is poor, and high-speed movement of the joint cannot be achieved. A hip part is horizontally arranged, one end of the hip part is rotatably connected with the upper portion of a thigh part, the upper portion of a shank part is rotatably connected with the lower portion of the thigh part through a knee joint shaft, a knee torsional spring sleeves the knee joint shaft, the two ends of the knee torsional spring are located on the thigh part and the shank part respectively, and an ankle part is connected with the lower portion of the shank part. The foot part is rotatably connected with the ankle part through the ankle joint shaft, the ankle joint shaft is sleeved with the ankle torsion spring, and the two ends of the ankle torsion spring are located on the ankle part and the foot part respectively. The invention is used for satisfying the jumping and landing buffering of the hydraulically driven joint leg, and can also be used for the leg structure design of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot control system, control method and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control system, a control method and a storage medium, the humanoid robot control system comprises a joint controller and a learning forward model comprising a plurality of module units, each module unit comprises a state estimator, a responsibility predictor, a value function estimator, an expectation controller and a responsibility predictor, the state estimator estimates potential state information of the robot at the next moment; the responsibility predictor distributes the control contribution rate of each module unit; the value function estimator is used for evaluating the next execution action of the robot; establishing an expected controller of each module unit through a value function and the currently estimated potential weighted state information; and the joint controller combines the final output and the action track instruction to generate torque output, and each joint of the robot is controlled to operate according to the corresponding sequence and amplitude. According to the method, the control robustness of large observation noise and partial observation systems is improved, and the system control performance is relatively good.

title: Dexterous hand and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand and a robot, and solves the problem that the dexterous hand cannot give consideration to both dexterous property and anthropomorphic property at the same time. The dexterous hand comprises a palm base plate, a metacarpal bone driving assembly, a metacarpal finger driving assembly, a first thumb knuckle, a second thumb knuckle, a first tendon rope, a first tendon rope driving assembly, a plurality of side swing assemblies, a plurality of first knuckles, a plurality of knuckle assemblies, a side swing driving assembly, a plurality of bending driving assemblies, a plurality of second tendon ropes and a plurality of second tendon rope driving assemblies. Under the condition that the dexterous hand is provided with five fingers consistent with a human hand, the dexterous hand can have at least 12 active degrees of freedom, belongs to dexterous hands with medium and high degrees of freedom, and is high in dexterous performance. title: ROBOT NECK STRUCTURE
abstract: The present utility model relates to the technical field of robots. Disclosed is a robot neck structure, comprising a rotating frame, a support base, a support configured to be connected to a robot trunk, and a fixing plate configured to be connected to a robot head, wherein the support base is connected to the upper end of the rotating frame; the fixing plate is rotatably articulated with the support base, so as to enable the pitch motion of the robot head; and the lower end of the rotating frame is rotatably connected to the support, so as to enable the yaw motion of the robot head. According to the present utility model, the support base is connected to the upper end of the rotating frame, and the fixing plate configured to be connected to the robot head is rotatably articulated with the support base, so that the pitch motion of the robot head is achieved; and the lower end of the rotating frame is rotatably connected to the support, and when the rotating frame rotates relative to the support, the fixing plate is driven to move left and right, so that the yaw motion of the robot head is achieved, thereby enabling the robot neck to drive the robot head to achieve motions of two degrees of freedom, i.e., pitch motion and yaw motion, thus fully replicating or achieving a human-like motion pattern.

title: Cross-joint transmission mechanism and mechanical finger
abstract: The invention provides a cross-joint transmission mechanism and a mechanical finger, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the cross-joint transmission mechanism is used for driving a fingertip joint to bend or stretch, the cross-joint transmission mechanism comprises a base joint rack and a near knuckle rack which are arranged in sequence, and the near knuckle rack is rotatably connected with the base joint rack; the first universal joint coupler is arranged between the base joint rack and the near knuckle rack; the first lead screw pair comprises a first lead screw and a first nut which are in threaded fit, the first nut is fixedly connected with the near knuckle rack, one end of the first lead screw is in sliding connection with the output end of the first universal joint coupler, and the other end of the first lead screw is in sliding connection with the output end of the second universal joint coupler. And the input end of the first universal joint coupling is in driving connection with the first rotating driving piece. According to the invention, the size of the fingertip joint can be reduced as much as possible, the adaptability of the fingertip joint to the humanoid robot is improved, and the influence of pitching or side swinging of the near knuckle on the angle of the fingertip joint is avoided.
