title: Lifting mechanism for humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a lifting mechanism for a humanoid robot and the robot. The lifting mechanism comprises a lifting body, a driving device and a multistage belt transmission device, the lower end of the lifting body is rotatably connected with the base, the upper end of the lifting body is provided with the mounting seat, the driving device is used for providing power, the multistage belt transmission device transmits the power provided by the driving device to the lifting body, and the lifting body is driven by the multistage belt transmission device. And the mounting seat is kept horizontal in the vertical lifting process. Power of the driving device is transmitted to the lifting body through the multi-stage belt transmission device, and compared with other transmission structures, the design of multi-stage belt transmission has the advantages of being high in stability, small in transmission error and low in control difficulty. When the lifting mechanism is used for the humanoid robot, it can be ensured that the humanoid robot body vertically ascends and descends, the humanoid robot body can be kept horizontal all the time in the ascending and descending process, and therefore the humanoid robot can be kept stable in the operation process.

title: ROBOT, ROBOT CONTROL PROGRAM, INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, TRAINING DATA GENERATION METHOD, OPERATION PARAMETER GENERATION METHOD, PROGRAM, AND TRAINED MODEL GENERATION METHOD
abstract: A humanoid robot (robot) comprises: a grip part which includes a palm part serving as a base for holding a cloth (work object) and a plurality of finger parts radially extending from the palm part; a palm sensor part which is provided in the palm part and detects work object information including the shape and disposition of the work object; and a control part which inputs a detection result of the palm sensor part to a trained learning model trained using training data representing a combination of an operation of a hand of an experienced worker during work and an operation of a sewing machine, and controls the holding and manipulation of the work object by the grip part on the basis of operation parameters obtained by executing arithmetic processing of the learning model.

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot. The leg mechanism comprises a thigh structural part, a foot plate structural part, a shank structural part and an ankle steering engine. The upper end of the shank structural member is rotatably connected to the thigh structural member, and the lower end of the shank structural member is rotatably connected to the foot plate structural member. The ankle steering engine is installed on the thigh structural part and located on the upper side of the rotating connecting position of the thigh structural part and the shank structural part, and the output end of the ankle steering engine is connected with the foot plate structural part through the connecting rod assembly. According to the leg mechanism, the gravity center of the ankle steering engine can be lifted to the thigh structural part, particularly to the position above the anterior knee joint, on the basis, the overall gravity center of the leg mechanism can be improved, the rotational inertia of the leg mechanism can be reduced, and therefore the torque requirements of the anterior hip steering engine and the anterior knee steering engine can be reduced; the control response speed of the leg mechanism and the humanoid robot can be increased.

title: Humanoid robot applied to high altitude
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot applied at high altitude, which is composed of a head and neck mechanism, a body mechanism, arm mechanisms, leg mechanisms, a control system, a lifting mechanism, a sucker device and the like, and is made of light materials. The robot is of a human-shaped structure composed of the head, the neck, the arms and the two legs, is provided with limbs, joints and freedom degrees corresponding to a person to achieve dexterous actions, has autonomous navigation and positioning capacity, is an artificial intelligence robot with man-machine interaction, deep learning, environment perception and decision-making capacity, and is combined with a lifting mechanism and a suction cup device, and the robot is more intelligent. The robot can move in various environments (ground and wall), and remote autonomous operation or man-machine cooperation is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot torque control method based on position ring pre-training
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot torque control method based on position ring pre-training, relates to the humanoid robot torque control method based on position ring pre-training, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot motion control. The objective of the invention is to solve the problem that the existing method is difficult to maintain robustness and universality in a dynamic environment in robot control. The method comprises the following steps: determining a state space and an action space according to the structure of the humanoid robot; determining network structures of a position control strategy network, a moment control strategy network and a value network; training related parameters are set; constructing a reward function of the position control strategy network; the reward function is composed of a style item, a task item and a regularization item; obtaining a trained position control strategy network and a moment control strategy network; the current state of the robot is input into the trained torque control strategy network, the trained torque control strategy network outputs torque, and the humanoid robot is controlled in real time according to the torque.

title: Humanoid robot trunk motion planning method
abstract: A humanoid robot trunk motion planning method belongs to the humanoid robot technical field, and comprises the following steps: using a human body skeleton point identification technology to identify human body demonstration motions; constructing a skeleton identification point set; establishing a mapping relation from a Cartesian space of the skeleton identification point set to a joint space of a robot trunk, and obtaining a trunk joint angle data set of the robot; training the relationship between the coordinate position in the skeleton identification point and the trunk joint angle data by adopting a neural network based on imitation learning; and taking the output obtained by neural network training as the input of a second-order system model, and calculating through the second-order system model to obtain the expected trunk joint angle and angular velocity, thereby completing the motion planning of the humanoid robot trunk. The method is applied to the humanoid robot, has the advantages of energy conservation and flexible operation, and realizes the motion planning effect that the trunk adapts to the positions of the two arms.

title: Lower limb mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb mechanism and a humanoid robot. The lower limb mechanism comprises a shank part, a sole part, a first driving structure and a second driving structure. The sole part comprises a first support and a second support, the first support and the shank part are rotationally connected around a first axis and a second axis, and the first axis intersects with the second axis; the first driving structure is arranged on the shank part, is rotationally connected with the first bracket, and drives the shank part to rotate around a first axis relative to the sole part; the second driving structure is arranged on the shank part, rotationally connected with the second support and used for driving the shank part to rotate around the second axis relative to the sole part. According to the lower limb mechanism, the shank part rotates around the first axis relative to the sole part and is driven by the first driving structure, the shank part rotates around the second axis relative to the sole part and is driven by the second driving structure, rotation of the shank part around the first axis and the second axis relative to the sole part is independently controlled, and the complexity of an overall control strategy of the lower limb mechanism is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot multi-modal training method and system based on augmented reality
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot multi-modal training method and system based on augmented reality, and aims at solving the problems that a traditional humanoid robot training method is mostly based on single sensor data judgment, the monitoring range is limited, and the accuracy is not high. And high-efficiency training is difficult to realize in a complex and changeable scene. According to the method, a multi-mode virtual training environment is constructed by adopting an augmented reality technology, diversification and customization of robot training scenes are realized, data acquisition and analysis are carried out on the training operation process, the training operation state of the humanoid robot can be comprehensively reflected, the accuracy and comprehensiveness of anomaly monitoring are improved, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. According to the method, the training operation abnormal condition can be found in time, the overall evaluation of the multi-mode virtual training environment is realized, the training efficiency and accuracy are improved, and the comprehensive improvement of the training ability of the humanoid robot is realized.

title: Humanoid robot joint motor torque, speed and angle parameter evaluation method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for evaluating torque, speed and angle parameters of a joint motor of a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of electric transmission control equipment.The method for evaluating the torque, speed and angle parameters of the joint motor of the humanoid robot is divided into two actions of migration and attack by simulating the characteristics of a sea gull, and the sea gull is randomly selected from a sea gull group; a migration search strategy and an attack strategy are applied, according to a multi-target sea gull algorithm related to the torque, the speed and the angle, the flight end point of each sea gull is obtained, and therefore parameter evaluation of the torque, the speed and the angle of the corresponding joint motor is completed. The evaluation results of the torque, speed and angle performance of the joint motor of the humanoid robot show that the multi-target sea gull algorithm can improve the target tracking quality, and the tracking enables the performance to be optimized more easily.

title: Biped humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of robots, and solves the problems that an existing biped robot is low in motion freedom degree, large in weight and high in cost. The robot comprises a pelvis structure and two leg structures, hip joint motors, thigh motors and thigh motors are arranged at the two ends of the pelvis structure, the hip joint motors drive the legs to conduct opening and closing actions, the thigh motors drive the legs to conduct rotating actions, and the thigh motors drive the legs to swing front and back; the leg structure comprises thighs, shanks and foot plates, and the thighs, the shanks and the foot plates are rotationally connected in sequence; knee joint motors and knee joint rotating connecting rods are arranged on the thighs; the output ends of the knee joint motors drive the shanks to swing through the knee joint rotating connecting rods; a shank motor and an ankle joint rotating connecting rod are arranged on the shank, and the shank motor drives the foot plate to rotate through the ankle joint rotating connecting rod. A plurality of motors are arranged to simulate six degrees of freedom of legs of a human body, so that actions such as walking, jumping and running are realized.

title: Humanoid robot visual identification and action control method based on machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot visual recognition and action control method based on machine learning, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment data, and building a three-dimensional environment model; the obstacles are analyzed, and types are determined; selecting a control mode according to the type of the obstacle; in the control mode, acquiring real-time height data of the foot; determining whether the real-time height data reaches the standard height data or not, and if yes, obtaining foot contact data; and determining whether the foot is in contact with the ground or not according to the contact data, if not, lowering the height of the lower limb in the stable state, and meanwhile, continuously lowering the foot until the foot is in contact with the ground. Compared with the prior art, the obstacle is recognized through the machine learning model so as to select the appropriate control mode, refined action control is conducted through the local processing capacity of the humanoid robot in the execution process, the requirement for the real-time calculation capacity of the humanoid robot is not high, and the cost of mass use of the humanoid robot is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model is suitable for the technical field of lighting equipment, and provides a humanoid robot which comprises a main body, an electric power storage part, a power supply part and a control part, the manipulator is mounted on the main body, the manipulator comprises a holding part, a solar charging part is mounted on the holding part in a covering manner, the solar charging part is electrically connected with the power storage part, and the holding part has an unfolding position and a holding position; and the control part is mounted on the main body, is electrically connected with the electric power storage part and the manipulator, and is used for controlling the holding part to be switched from the holding position to the unfolding position so as to increase the solar energy receiving area.

title: High-DOF humanoid robot system
abstract: An object of the present invention is to provide a high-degree-of-freedom leg drive system of the walkable robot having the structure and the mechanism which is suitable for the walk. The high-degree-of-freedom leg drive system of the walkable robot comprises: a hip joint unit; a thigh unit connected to the lower side of the hip joint unit and integrally operated according to the operation of the hip joint unit; a knee joint unit coupled to the lower end of the thigh unit; a calf unit coupled to the knee joint unit and integrally operated according to the operation of the knee joint unit; a foot body unit coupled to the lower end of the calf unit and provided to be rotatable about a pitch axis and a roll axis; and a toe unit coupled to the other side of the foot body unit and provided to be rotatable about the pitch axis. According to the high-degree-of-freedom leg drive system of the walkable robot according to the present invention, the high-degree-of-freedom leg drive system of the walkable robot has a knee joint, an ankle joint, and a toe joint, thereby having a wide operating angle and a joint degree of freedom similar to that of human walking.

title: Facial recognition type artificial intelligence humanoid robot and commuting to school management system and method using the same
abstract: The present invention relates to an AI-powered humanoid greeting robot with facial recognition for school attendance guidance and school drop-off management, and a school attendance management system and method using the same. Children greet the humanoid robot in a lively and dynamic manner, such as a high five, hug, or a large, face-to-face greeting, at the classroom or school gate when entering or leaving school. Therefore, this system creates a sense of intimacy, happiness, excitement, and mystery, while also creating a more enjoyable and energetic school commute, potentially leading to more proactive morning attendance guidance. The school attendance management system using an AI-powered humanoid greeting robot with facial recognition for school attendance guidance and school drop-off management according to the present invention comprises: a humanoid robot; a school attendance information database server; a school attendance integrated management server; a user smart mobile device; and facial recognition module.

title: Block coding system and operating method for artificial intelligence humanoid robot
abstract: A dedicated block coding system and operating method for controlling the functions of an artificial intelligence humanoid robot are provided. The present invention enables not only developers or general programmers of AI humanoid robot manufacturers, but also users of AI humanoid robots to perform various control coding tasks for AI humanoid robots through a visual-based intuitive block coding service platform, regardless of the manufacturer and model of the AI humanoid robot. The dedicated block coding system for controlling the functions of an artificial intelligence humanoid robot according to the present invention comprises a block coding service platform, a first database server, a code conversion unit, a second database server, and a control unit. The control unit comprises a category display module, a coding block combination module, a simulation module, a coding block modification/addition processing module, and a coding file output module.

title: SDK Interpreter system and operating method for control of artificial intelligence humanoid robot
abstract: The present invention relates to an SDK for controlling an artificial intelligence humanoid robot, an interpreter system for executing a program, and an operating method thereof, which enable control in a manner in which the same coding source is executed regardless of the manufacturer or model of the artificial intelligence humanoid robot by installing an interpreter-based program based on an SDK capable of interpreting and executing a block coding file regardless of the manufacturer or model of the artificial intelligence humanoid robot. The SDK for controlling an artificial intelligence humanoid robot and the interpreter system for executing a program according to the present invention includes an interpreter installed in an artificial intelligence humanoid robot, a coding file receiving module, a coding file storage unit, and a control unit, and at the same time, include a user smart mobile device.

title: Coding source and library sharing system for artificial intelligence humanoid robot and operating method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a coding source and library management sharing system for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot linked to a block coding program for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot and an operating method thereof, wherein a coding source and library of content and an application program for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot are more easily shared not only among development programmers in the field but also among programmers in other fields or general users, so that the original use or application of the corresponding coding source or library can be actively performed, thereby facilitating the provision of more various functions and forms of artificial intelligence humanoid robots. The coding source and library management sharing system for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot linked to a block coding program for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot according to the present invention includes a block coding service operation server, a block coding data management server, a user terminal, a coding source/library sales value evaluation server, and an evaluation data support means.

title: Remote management system and operating method for artificial intelligence humanoid robot
abstract: The present invention relates to a remote management control system for an artificial intelligence humanoid robot and an operating method thereof, which can remotely access and control the function of the artificial intelligence humanoid robot through a mobile device such as a smartphone, a tablet PC, or a PC such as a desktop PC, and to this end, various state data for monitoring and controlling the operation or specific operation or operation state of the artificial intelligence humanoid robot in real time can be collected from the artificial intelligence humanoid robot and transmitted to an operator of a corresponding service in real time. The remote management control system of the artificial intelligence humanoid robot according to the present invention includes a humanoid robot remote service providing server, an artificial intelligence humanoid robot, a user terminal, and a wireless AP module.

title: Control system of several type humanoid robot based on AI with specified program and operating method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a system for controlling various artificial intelligence humanoid robots with a specific program which controls and operates the same with one program even when manufacturers of humanoid robots are different or models are different, and an operating method thereof. The system comprises: a humanoid robot (100) that outputs a multimedia signal or operates corresponding to a recognized object and a driving command; a robot remote driving server (300) that records and manages the driving command driving the humanoid robot, converts the driving command into a reference driving command, records the reference driving command in a command conversion table unit, searches the command conversion table unit for the driving command corresponding to the inputted control command, transmits the driving command to the humanoid robot, and controls and monitors the humanoid robot; and a robot control terminal (400) that remotely drives the humanoid robot by the built-in control command.

title: IN-VEHICLE INTERFACE ARRANGEMENT FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: An interface arrangement for a vehicle connects a humanoid robot to the vehicle. The interface arrangement is equipped and designed to be connected in the vehicle, respectively to a positioning device, an energy source, a communication device, and a sensor unit of the vehicle. The interface arrangement has a first interface equipped and designed to transmit current position data of the positioning device of the vehicle to the humanoid robot. A second interface transmits energy from the energy source of the vehicle to the humanoid robot. A third interface transmits network data from the communication device of the vehicle to the humanoid robot. A fourth interface transmits sensor data from the sensor unit of the vehicle to the humanoid robot.

title: Four-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot bionic leg
abstract: The invention discloses a four-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot bionic leg which comprises a base, a thigh module, a knee joint module, a shank module, an ankle joint module and a foot module. Thigh modules are arranged at the bottom of the base, knee joint modules are arranged at the bottoms of the thigh modules, shank modules are arranged at the bottoms of the knee joint modules, ankle joint modules are arranged at the bottoms of the shank modules, and foot modules are arranged at the bottoms of the ankle joint modules; the technical problems that the joint is bloated due to the fact that a motor is installed and large rotational inertia needs to be borne are solved.

title: Family nursing doctor humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of household robots, and particularly relates to a household nursing doctor humanoid robot and a control method thereof. The family nursing doctor humanoid robot comprises a wheel type chassis, a rehabilitation supporting frame slidably mounted on the wheel type chassis through a moving module, a folding seat mechanism mounted on the rehabilitation supporting frame, upper limb rehabilitation arms symmetrically mounted at the upper end of the rehabilitation supporting frame and nursing hands mounted at the tail ends of the upper limb rehabilitation arms. The upper limb rehabilitation arms are installed on the wheel type chassis, the babysitter hands used for achieving the babysitter function are installed at the tail ends of the upper limb rehabilitation arms, the multi-degree-of-freedom rehabilitation arms can achieve the upper limb rehabilitation function of a patient and can also be used as mechanical arms, and in other words, family babysitters and family doctors are ingeniously combined; the advanced upper limb rehabilitation technology is fused, the patient is helped to recover and enhance muscle strength and activity ability, and various tasks from simple housework to fine control can be executed.

title: Humanoid robot obstacle avoidance path planning method based on generative adversarial network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot path planning, in particular to a humanoid robot obstacle avoidance path planning method based on a generative adversarial network. Different from methods for directly measuring the distance between the robot and the obstacle through a laser radar, an SLAM ranging algorithm and the like, the generative adversarial network can generate image data, when the image data generated by the generator coincides with the real image data, that is, when the distance between the robot and the obstacle is equal, the robot executes obstacle avoidance operation, and the obstacle avoidance efficiency is improved. A complete path plan can be obtained by combining the generated image data and the walking process recorded by the depth camera; the generative adversarial network can simulate various complex scenes and conditions for distance measurement instead of simply obtaining distance information through physical means, is not limited by physical factors, can learn complex distribution and modes of data through training, has high adaptability and generalization ability, and can adapt to different scenes and tasks.

title: Humanoid robot bottom layer anti-interference method, device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a bottom-layer anti-interference method for a humanoid robot. The bottom-layer anti-interference method comprises the following steps: establishing a joint control system of the humanoid robot; minimizing an H-infinity norm of a closed-loop transfer function Tzomega (s) from exogenous input to generalized performance output of the joint control system; establishing a robust controller according to the closed-loop transfer function Tzomega (s); the external source input is received through the joint control system and the robust controller, generalized performance output is output, interference caused by system reasons such as model uncertainty can be resisted, and high-performance control output is achieved.

title: Simulated hand based on multi-stage flexible air bag and motor driving and control system of simulated hand
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid hand based on multistage flexible air bags and motor driving and a control system thereof.The humanoid hand comprises a bottom plate, a base is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the bottom plate, a supporting block is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, and a first motor is fixedly connected to the outer wall of the supporting block; the output end of the first motor is fixedly connected with a first rotating shaft, the outer wall of the first rotating shaft is fixedly connected with a first adjusting plate, the outer wall of a second adjusting plate is fixedly connected with a mounting assembly, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with a control panel, and the output end of the control panel is fixedly connected with a connecting wire. The output end of the connecting line is fixedly connected with a control line. Natural bending and deformation of a human hand can be simulated through the multi-stage flexible air bag, the simulated human hand can execute complicated and fine actions similar to the human hand, and compared with a simulated human hand and air bag system of a pure mechanical structure, the simulated human hand and air bag system provides higher flexibility and adaptability, and is particularly suitable for grabbing objects in irregular shapes.

title: Leg mechanism and biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg mechanism and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg mechanism comprises a shank skeleton, a foot movably connected to one end of the shank skeleton, a thigh skeleton movably connected to the other end of the shank skeleton, a hip assembly, a knee assembly, a leg rotating assembly and a leg swinging assembly. The swing leg assembly comprises a first joint and a swing leg connecting piece; the rotating leg assembly comprises a second joint and a rotating leg connecting piece; the hip component comprises a third joint and a hip connecting piece; the knee component comprises a fourth joint and a knee connecting piece; the leg swinging connecting piece is fixedly connected with the second joint, the leg rotating connecting piece is fixedly connected with the third joint, the hip connecting piece is relatively fixed to the fourth joint and the thigh skeleton, the knee connecting piece is in transmission connection with the shank skeleton, and the rotating axis of the hip connecting piece and the rotating axis of the knee connecting piece are collinear. The leg mechanism can reduce the weight of the tail end, so that the inertia of the leg is reduced, and the power consumption is reduced.

title: Novel frameless torque motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a novel frameless torque motor for a humanoid robot. The novel frameless torque motor comprises a supporting structure, the stators are used for generating a rotating magnetic field, the stators are evenly distributed, and the sides, close to the supporting structure, of the stators are fixedly connected with the inner ring of the supporting structure; and the rotor is used for generating rotary motion under the influence of the magnetic field generated by the stator, and the rotor is located at the axis of the supporting structure. By arranging the supporting structure, the stator, the rotor, the connecting column, the cooling structure, the heat dissipation structure and the connector, current can be input to the stator through the connector, so that the stator generates a rotating magnetic field, the rotor is influenced by the magnetic field generated by the stator to generate rotating motion, the cooling structure can cool the stator, and the heat dissipation structure can assist in heat dissipation; the heat dissipation structure can drive liquid in the cooling structure to move, and the problem that an existing frameless torque motor of the humanoid robot is poor in heat dissipation effect is solved.

title: Simulated meat high polymer material for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a simulated meat high polymer material for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of high polymer materials. The invention comprises the following components in percentage by mass: 30-50% of matrix material which is a high-molecular polymer with flexibility and biocompatibility; the plasticizer is used for improving the flexibility and machinability of the material, and the mass percent of the plasticizer is 10-20%; the filler is used for adjusting the physical property of the material and reducing the cost, and the mass percent of the filler is 10-30%; the pigment and/or the dye is used for endowing the material with specific color and appearance, and the mass percentage of the pigment and/or the dye is 1-5%; and an additive accounting for 1-5% by mass. The simulation meat high polymer material has high simulation degree, and can simulate the appearance and touch of human beings; the material has good biological compatibility and mechanical performance, and is suitable for a skin covering layer of a humanoid robot; the stability and durability of the material are high, and the requirement for long-term use can be met.

title: Speed sensorless control method of humanoid robot joint memory motor
abstract: The invention discloses a speed sensorless control method for a joint memory motor of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of electric transmission control equipment.The speed sensorless control method comprises the steps that firstly, the d-axis stator current component and the q-axis stator current component of the joint memory motor of the humanoid robot are observed; a rotating speed, an electromagnetic torque, a flux linkage, a d-axis stator voltage component and a q-axis stator voltage component are designed, a relationship between a current and an electrical angle of a joint motor is established, then an observation value of the electrical angle is obtained according to an equivalent control principle, a sliding mode surface is defined by the observation value of the electrical angle, and a controller structure is designed through a second-order generalized integral sliding mode control strategy. According to the method, a human-shaped robot joint memory motor is optimized, a proper self-adaptive sliding mode gain coefficient is added to ensure the accuracy of a control system, good performance is achieved at different rotating speeds, finally, stability analysis is completed according to the Lyapunov theorem, and it is proved that the estimated electric angle observation value enables the human-shaped robot joint memory motor to operate stably.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot which comprises a chest mechanism, a head mechanism, an upper limb mechanism and a lower limb mechanism. Wherein the chest mechanism adopts a supporting framework with a hollow structure, a control module and a power supply module are integrated in the supporting framework, the layout is reasonable, and meanwhile, the working temperature of the power supply module and the control module is prevented from being too high; visual sensors are arranged at the front end of the head mechanism and the front end of the supporting framework and used for detecting the environment and improving the motion precision of the robot. The upper limb mechanism is provided with a shoulder joint mechanism and an elbow joint mechanism, four-axis movement of robot arms is driven, the working requirement is met, meanwhile, a direct drive structure of a motor and a connecting rod is adopted, and the transmission efficiency is high. The lower limb mechanism is provided with a hip transmission mechanism and a leg transmission mechanism, the hip transmission mechanism is designed in an orthogonalization mode and an oppositely-arranged structure, so that the transmission mechanism is highly integrated and compact in structure, and miniaturization of the robot is achieved.

abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid gate sentry guarding robot system, and belongs to the field of robots. The robot system comprises a reconnaissance load, a strong light load, a mechanical arm, a gas detection load, a waist rotary table and a wheel type chassis. According to the invention, 24-hour duty of an important target, personnel and vehicle target detection, target tracking and target abnormal behavior analysis can be realized through reconnaissance load; chemical gases such as gasoline, alcohol and the like are detected through the gas detection load; a hard light warning is given out when danger is found through the hard light load; man-machine interaction is achieved through the mechanical arm, and gestures such as denial, passing and greeting are made.

title: 10-degree-of-freedom two-foot robot
abstract: The invention discloses a 10-degree-of-freedom robot with two feet. The left leg and the right leg drive the feet connected with the left leg and the right leg to swing back and forth around knee joints and to swing back and forth, swing left and right and rotate inside and outside around hip joints in a series-parallel connection mode. A third hip joint motor for driving a leg to swing back and forth and a knee joint motor are coaxially arranged, an ankle joint motor is fixed on a thigh and is adjacent to the knee joint motor, and the ankle joint motor and the knee joint motor form a parallel mechanism to drive a foot to move; the robot with the layout is compact in overall structure, the driving motors of the joints serve as high-density components of the robot and are concentrated in the hip area, the mass of the legs is distributed on the upper sides of the thighs in a concentrated mode, the mass of the tail ends is light, the rotational inertia of the overall legs is small, and therefore the movement performance of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot heat dissipation flexible shell structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot shells, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot heat dissipation flexible shell structure which comprises two manipulator shells arranged left and right in a spaced mode, a connecting movable part is arranged between the two manipulator shells, and outer wrapping grooves are formed in the peripheral faces of the two manipulator shells. An outer wrapping groove is formed in the manipulator shell, a plurality of rhombic heat dissipation holes which are evenly distributed in an array mode are formed in the inner wall of the outer wrapping groove, a rubber outer wrapping layer is arranged at the position, on the manipulator shell, of the outer wrapping groove in an attached and sleeved mode, a snakelike hose is embedded in the inner wall of the rubber outer wrapping layer, and the two ends of the snakelike hose extend out of the rubber outer wrapping layer. The cooling device for the humanoid robot has the advantages that heat generated in the robot is circularly cooled through cooling liquid, the cooling effect of the humanoid robot is effectively guaranteed, meanwhile, the use amount of fans is reduced, the working noise of the robot is lowered, dust accumulation is avoided, and the service life of all elements in the robot is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system based on hollow joint coordination
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method based on hollow joint coordination. Obtaining an upper limb rotation instruction of the robot, and analyzing the upper limb rotation instruction to obtain a first target angle of a shoulder joint of the robot and a second target angle of an elbow joint of the robot; whether the first target angle is larger than 90 degrees or not is judged, if the first target angle is smaller than 90 degrees, the shoulder joint is directly driven to rotate to the first target angle, and the elbow joint is driven to rotate to the second target angle again; if the angle is larger than 90 degrees, whether the weight of the object grabbed by the hand of the robot is larger than the threshold weight or not is judged, and if not, the shoulder joint is driven to rotate to the first target angle, and the elbow joint is driven to rotate to the second target angle again; the stress of the shoulder joint is effectively reduced, and the joint injury caused by overlarge torque is avoided, so that the service life of the hollow joint is prolonged.

title: Tactile humanoid finger for plugging operation and manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a tactile humanoid finger for plugging operation and a manipulator, and the novel tactile humanoid finger can be mounted on an existing mechanical clamping jaw to obtain a tactile manipulator for plugging operation. The humanoid finger is subjected to high bionic design from the three aspects of structure, function and appearance, and is composed of a 3D printing rigid bionic phalanx located in the center of the finger, a rigid bionic fingernail at the tail end of the phalanx, peripheral pouring flexible bionic skin, four embedded touch sensing elements and a connecting structure. The bionic finger is simple in structure and low in cost, not only has a tactile perception function, but also can improve the finger rigidity through the rigid bionic phalanx and the fingernail, so that the operating force requirement of the finger in the insertion and extraction operation is ensured. According to the invention, plugging operation in various occasions can be realized, static/dynamic tactile information in the operation process can be acquired in real time, closed-loop control is formed, and flexible operation on an operated object is realized.

title: Robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot which comprises a trunk part, a head and neck part, two mechanical arms and two lower limbs, the head and neck part comprises a head structure and a neck structure, the neck structure is connected between the head structure and the upper portion of the trunk part, and the neck structure provides freedom for movement of the head structure; the two mechanical arms are located on the two sides of the trunk part correspondingly, each mechanical arm comprises a shoulder joint structure and an upper arm structure, the shoulder joint structures are connected between the upper arm structures and the trunk part, and the shoulder joint structures provide freedom degrees for movement of the upper arm structures; the two lower limbs are respectively connected to the lower part of the trunk part, each lower limb comprises a hip joint structure and a leg structure, each hip joint structure is connected between the corresponding leg structure and the trunk part, multi-degree-of-freedom design is carried out, the flexibility is improved, and in addition, through reasonable layout of all key parts, the flexibility is improved. title: Rope-driven high-load-ratio seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid agile mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to a rope-driven high-load-ratio seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid agile mechanical arm. The mechanical arm comprises a fixed base, a shoulder joint, a first decoupling mechanism, a first arm rod, an elbow joint, a second arm rod and a wrist joint which are connected in sequence. The rope-driven high-load-ratio seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid agile mechanical arm is a rope-driven multi-joint passive decoupling series-connection shoulder joint mechanism, on the premise that the size of a movable part of the mechanical arm is not increased, decoupling of a series-connection multi-joint rope can be achieved, a shoulder joint driving motor and a rear-end joint driving motor are placed on a fixed base, and the mechanical arm is driven by the fixed base. And the weight and inertia of the mechanical arm are reduced, and the dexterity requirement of the agile mechanical arm is met.

title: Riveting type permanent magnet brake
abstract: The invention provides a riveting type permanent magnet brake which comprises an armature, a magnet yoke and an iron core are arranged on the side portion of the armature in parallel, the magnet yoke and the iron core are riveted and fixed through riveting points, and a coil and magnetic steel are arranged between the magnet yoke and the iron core. The magnetic steel is arranged at the end close to the armature, closing of a magnetic circuit is achieved in an extremely short distance, the magnetic circuit of magnetic force lines of the magnetic steel is greatly shortened, magnetic resistance is reduced, the multi-point riveting technology of the magnet yoke and the iron core is adopted, the screw head does not need to be abdicated, the wall thickness of the suction cup can be greatly reduced, meanwhile, the center hole of the armature is enlarged, and the rotational inertia of the armature can be reduced. According to the invention, the performance of the brake is improved, full-automatic production is easy to realize, the beneficial effects of small size, large suction force, small heating power, large mesopore and low rotational inertia are achieved, and the brake is especially suitable for a universal servo motor and a humanoid robot joint servo motor.

title: Forest rescue method and device based on trees, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a tree-based forest rescue method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring forest monitoring data of a target forest through a forest monitoring system; determining a target fire area based on the forest monitoring data; dividing the target fire area into n target areas; obtaining temperature data and smoke concentration data of each target area in the n target areas in a preset time period, and obtaining n pieces of target temperature data and n pieces of target smoke concentration data; determining n target rescue priorities according to the n target temperature data and the n target smoke concentration data; the current position of the humanoid robot is obtained, and a target rescue route is determined based on the n target rescue priorities and the current position; and controlling the humanoid robot to rescue trees in the target fire area based on the target rescue route. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the rescue efficiency when the forest fire occurs is improved.

title: Vision-based humanoid robot double-arm follow-up control method and system and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot two-arm follow-up control method and system based on vision and a robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the spatial position information of human body joint points based on collected human body real-time image data; according to the position information of the articulation points, respectively calculating rotational degrees of freedom of shoulder joints of left and right big arms of the human body, included angles of elbow joints of left and right hand arms and axial rotation angles of the left and right big arms; and performing linear interpolation on the obtained parameter values, and sending the parameter values to a robot control module at a set frequency so as to realize follow-up control of the two arms of the humanoid robot. Two-arm follow-up control of the humanoid robot is achieved through vision, and compared with a traditional direct inversion solution, the problem of multiple solutions does not exist; the real-time performance is good and can reach 25fps, and the method has a wide application prospect in visual follow-up control of the teleoperation robot; and the data synchronization frequency is greater than the visual detection frequency, so that the humanoid robot has better smoothness in the visual follow-up process.

title: Quick object searching method based on humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention provides a quick object searching method based on a humanoid robot and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target feature information and historical object searching data of a target object; determining target object searching data corresponding to the target feature information in the historical object searching data; sorting the historical places from high to low according to the historical frequency to obtain a first object searching place list, and searching objects according to the first object searching place list; acquiring a first image of a first object searching place; if the target object does not exist in the first image, a view blind area of the first object searching place is obtained, and the humanoid robot is controlled to move to the view blind area; if the view blind area can be directly observed, acquiring a second image; if not, controlling the humanoid robot to execute a posture adjustment strategy, and acquiring a third image; if the target object does not exist in the second image or the third image, the humanoid robot is controlled to move to the second object searching place to continue to search for the target object.

title: Humanoid robot movement mechanism, control method and equipment and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot movement mechanism, a control method and equipment and a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot movement mechanism comprises a frame, two control moment gyroscopes, a servo motor, two wheels and hub motors thereof, legs, a speed sensor, a tilt angle sensor, a steering angular velocity sensor, a speed closed-loop controller, a control moment gyroscope closed-loop controller, an upright closed-loop controller and a steering closed-loop controller. The control moment gyroscopes are arranged in bilateral symmetry, are parallel to the vertical direction when the axis of the internal flywheel is balanced, and rotate in opposite directions. The speed closed-loop controller determines a target inclination angle; the vertical closed-loop controller determines the control torque of the hub motor; the steering closed-loop controller determines the correction torque of the hub motor; and the control moment gyroscope closed-loop controller determines the control torque of the servo motor according to the current inclination angle, the mechanical zero point and the target inclination angle. The stable posture control of the robot can be realized.

title: Mine greening humanoid robot system based on terrain adaptation and ecological restoration
abstract: The invention discloses a mine greening humanoid robot system based on terrain adaptation and ecological restoration, which comprises a robot body, the robot body comprises a moving system and an action system, and the robot body is used as a mounting platform of a terrain adaptation system, an ecological restoration system and a control system; a terrain adaptation system; the ecological restoration system comprises a vegetation planting assembly, a soil improvement assembly and a water supply assembly, the vegetation planting assembly is used for carrying plant seeds or seedlings suitable for ecological restoration of the mine, and the soil improvement assembly is used for improving soil in the regreening area; the control system is used for controlling the robot body and the ecological restoration system to move, avoid obstacles, plant planting, improve soil and irrigate plants, the system is based on a robot platform, the mine green restoration efficiency can be greatly improved, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, and meanwhile the consistency and stability of the green restoration effect are guaranteed.

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot four-limb trunk driver and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of motor control, the drivers are installed at joints of four-limb trunks or replace a skeleton of a robot, and each driver comprises a motor, a first tooth column, a second tooth column, a first inner gear ring and a second inner gear ring; a rotor of the motor is internally connected with a hollow motor shaft; the first inner gear ring and the second inner gear ring are arranged in the motor shaft; the first tooth column and the second tooth column are engaged with the first inner gear ring and the second inner gear ring correspondingly. title: Distributed agent system and method for realizing human-like agent based on large language model
abstract: The invention discloses a distributed agent system and method for realizing a humanoid agent based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of humanoid agents. title: Split type humanoid robot
abstract: The split type humanoid robot comprises a humanoid robot body and a mobile power source, the humanoid robot body is provided with at least one power interface, the mobile power source is provided with a power data line, and the power data line is provided with a power plug matched with the power interface; and at least two driving wheels are arranged below the mobile power supply and are respectively driven by independent motors. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the battery with a large weight ratio is independent and the driving wheel is added, so that the cruising ability is improved; the humanoid robot is more flexible and lighter due to weight reduction, and the working efficiency is higher; the vacant space and quality can be used for better perfecting functions and improving performance, and the battery replacement process is more convenient and faster.

title: Parasitic mechanism type robot with gravity balancing and parallel folding and unfolding functions
abstract: The parasitic mechanism type robot with the gravity balancing and parallel folding and unfolding functions comprises leg structures, a waist structure, a chest structure, arm structures and a head structure, the chest structure is arranged at the upper end of the waist structure, and the head structure is arranged at the upper end of the chest structure; the arm structures are arranged on the two sides of the chest structure, the leg structures are arranged on the two sides of the lower end of the waist structure, crawler feet are arranged at the lower ends of the leg structures, and the two leg structures, the waist structure and the two arm structures adopt parasitic decoupling folding and unfolding mechanisms. Parasitic decoupling folding and unfolding mechanisms are adopted for leg structures, arm structures and a waist structure of the robot, the robot has the large movement range of a series mechanism and also has the high strength of a parallel mechanism, high movement precision and high effective load of all movement joints of the robot are achieved, and the functions of gravity balance and parallel folding and unfolding are achieved.

title: Humanoid robot joint module with limit protection device
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint module with a limit protection device, which comprises a joint shell, a driving motor fixedly mounted in the joint shell, a connecting disc fixedly mounted at the output end of the driving motor, a locking limiting ring movably sleeving the bottom of the surface of the connecting disc, and a circulating water tank fixedly mounted on one side of the joint shell, the bottom of the locking limiting ring and the top of the joint shell are fixedly installed, and a protective shell is detachably installed on one side of the joint shell. According to the joint module, locking protection can be conducted on the extreme position, synchronous efficient heat dissipation can be conducted in an integrated mode, and the problems that an existing joint module cannot conduct locking protection on the extreme position, so that a motor bears large torsion, higher power is needed to counteract the load force, then the motor is burnt down, and the service life of the motor is prolonged are solved. And high-performance heat dissipation is not realized.

title: Roller screw motor control method and device of humanoid robot joint, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a roller screw motor control method and device of a humanoid robot joint, computer equipment and a storage medium. The humanoid robot joint comprises at least two connecting rods, the length of each connecting rod is fixed, the humanoid robot joint further comprises a roller lead screw motor, the roller lead screw motor comprises a lead screw, and the lead screw can stretch out and draw back along a straight line. The method comprises the steps that preset values of joints of the humanoid robot are obtained; acquiring current values of joints of the humanoid robot; acquiring expected values of joints of the humanoid robot; according to the preset value, the current value and the expected value, target values are obtained, and the target values comprise a target lead screw length curve, a target lead screw linear speed curve, a target lead screw linear acceleration curve and a target lead screw torque curve; and motor control parameters are obtained according to the target value, so that the roller screw motor controls the screw according to the motor control parameters. The energy consumption of the joint of the humanoid robot can be reduced, and the cruising ability of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Leg power structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a leg power structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The leg power structure of the humanoid robot comprises a stepping driving unit, a thigh body assembly, a shank body assembly and a foot assembly which are arranged on the waist of the humanoid robot and connected in sequence, and the stepping driving unit is used for driving the whole leg power structure to swing front and back; the thigh body assembly comprises a first thigh body and a second thigh body, the shank body assembly comprises a shank body, and the foot assembly comprises a foot supporting piece; a hip joint driving unit is arranged at the upper part of the first thigh body to drive the whole leg power structure to swing left and right; a first driving unit is arranged between the first thigh body and the second thigh body so that the first thigh body and the second thigh body can rotate in the relative circumferential direction. The whole leg power structure is reasonable in design and compact in structure, and the requirement for achieving various action postures of the humanoid robot is well met.

title: Work and rest assisting method, humanoid robot control device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a work and rest assisting method, a humanoid robot control device, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: determining a target time range of a target user for carrying out a target work and rest behavior based on historical work and rest data and a schedule plan of the target user; if the current moment is within the target time range, acquiring a first user video for the target user; determining a first behavior of the target user according to the first user video; if the first behavior is matched with the target work and rest behavior, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute a first behavior auxiliary strategy; if the first behavior is not matched with the target work and rest behavior, controlling the humanoid robot to play a first inquiry voice; obtaining feedback content of the target user for the first inquiry voice; sending confirmation information to the parent terminal; and if the response information indicates agreement of the first behavior, controlling the humanoid robot to execute a second behavior assistance strategy. The personalized work and rest assistance requirements of the target user can be met, and the user experience is improved.

title: Robot head movement mechanism and robot head
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot head movement mechanism and a robot head. The device comprises a pitching unit and a rotating unit. The pitching unit comprises a worm and gear speed reducer, a pitching motor and a head connecting piece; the worm and gear speed reducer comprises a speed reducer shell, a worm gear and a worm, wherein the worm gear and the worm are arranged in the speed reducer shell. The worm is in meshing transmission connection with the worm gear. The directions of the two ends of the worm are consistent with the front-back direction of the robot head, and the rear end is connected with the output end of the pitching motor. Output shafts are arranged at the two ends of the worm gear, are connected with the speed reducer shells on the corresponding sides respectively and penetrate through the speed reducer shells to be connected with the head connecting piece; the pitching motor is used for providing power for the pitching unit; the rotating unit is connected with the speed reducer shell and used for driving the robot head to rotate horizontally. The motion structure has the characteristics of compact structure and small size, and is particularly suitable for the head of the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot has two degrees of freedom of pitching and horizontal rotation.

title: Robot leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a robot leg structure and a humanoid robot, and the robot leg structure comprises a hip joint fixing seat, thighs, shanks and a simulated foot plate; wherein the thigh part comprises a thigh body and a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism which are arranged on the front portion and the rear portion of the thigh body, the shank part comprises a shank body and a third driving mechanism, the hip joint fixing base, the thigh body, the shank body and the simulated foot plate are sequentially hinged, and the three driving mechanisms are used for driving the thigh part, the shank part and the simulated foot plate to rotate. The driving mechanism is used for driving the shank part and the simulated foot plate to rotate and used for driving the simulated foot plate to rotate, the driving mechanism and the simulated foot plate have the self-locking function so as to achieve the purpose of standing under the power-off condition, meanwhile, the driving mechanism and the hinged object are connected through a quick-release structure, and follow-up maintenance and replacement are facilitated. title: Robot leg electric push rod structure
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical driving, and relates to an electric push rod, in particular to an electric push rod structure for robot legs. According to the utility model, the electric push rod structure is optimally designed, so that the manufacturing cost of the humanoid robot can be reduced; by arranging a band-type brake structure, the push rod has the self-locking function under the power failure condition, and the stability of the push rod in the walking process of the robot is improved; the encoder structure and the band-type brake structure are integrated in the rear cover, and the hollow rotating shaft design is adopted, so that space is saved, the size of the electric push rod structure is reduced, and interference with other matched devices can be effectively avoided; the electric push rod structure further has the advantages of being economical in cost, stable in operation, compact in structure, integrated in function and easy to maintain.

title: Robot leg push rod based on lead screw nut
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical driving, and relates to a robot leg push rod, in particular to a robot leg push rod based on a lead screw nut. By adopting the lead screw nut transmission mechanism, the stability of the push rod in the walking process of the robot is improved; multiple matched devices are integrated in the push rod, the size is reduced, interference with other devices is reduced, and flexible arrangement in the limited space of the robot is facilitated; transmission parts such as a ball screw or a planetary roller screw are selected, so that the energy consumption is effectively reduced while the transmission efficiency of the push rod is ensured, and the cruising ability of the humanoid robot in the using process is improved; meanwhile, the good matching and bearing capacity between the lead screw nut and the stepped shaft is guaranteed through the installation mode of the lead screw nut; and a band-type brake is arranged in the push rod, so that the push rod has a self-locking function under the condition of power failure.

title: Humanoid lower limb biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid lower limb biped robot which comprises a waist structure and a leg structure, and the waist structure comprises a waist support; the at least two first rotary drivers are arranged in the waist bracket; the at least two first joints are respectively connected with the two first rotary drivers; the at least two second rotary drivers are respectively arranged in the two first joints; the at least two adapters are respectively connected with the two second rotary drivers; the at least two third rotary drivers are arranged on the two adapters respectively, and the third rotary drivers are connected with the two leg structures; and the first rotary driver, the second rotary driver and the third rotary driver drive the leg structure to move in three degrees of freedom in space. The humanoid lower-limb biped robot has the advantages of being stable in structure, high in bearing capacity and high in impact resistance on the basis of achieving bionic autonomous walking, is suitable for the industrial field and can complete heavy-load carrying actions.

title: Variable-rigidity buffer structure and bionic biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a variable-rigidity buffer structure and a bionic biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The existing legged robot has the problems of poor impact resistance and poor terrain adaptability. The device comprises buffer elastic pieces, tendons and steering supporting assemblies, the steering supporting assemblies are installed on the legs of the robot and can deflect, and the buffer elastic pieces are installed on the steering supporting assemblies and can deflect along with the steering supporting assemblies; the tendon is connected with the buffering elastic piece and the foot of the robot and is tensioned; when the foot of the robot makes contact with the ground, the foot of the robot turns over around the ankle joint and pulls the tendon, the buffering elastic piece deforms through stretching of the tendon, and when the foot of the robot is lifted, the foot of the robot resets under rebounding of the buffering elastic piece. Along with deflection of the steering supporting assembly, the included angle between the buffering elastic piece and the tendon changes while the buffering elastic piece deflects, the resultant force in the tendon direction changes, and the rigidity of the rigidity-variable buffering structure is changed. The method is mainly used for design of robots.

title: Leg-foot type robot sensing system based on multi-mode visual large model and robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg-foot type robot sensing system based on a multi-mode visual large model, and the system comprises a sensor unit which is disposed on a leg-foot type robot and is used for obtaining image data and various sensing data in an environment; the target detection unit is connected to the sensor unit and is used for identifying a target object in the environment based on the image data and outputting a target object enhanced feature map; the semantic segmentation unit is connected to the target detection unit and is used for carrying out contour segmentation on the target object enhanced feature map and outputting a segmentation mask with the same size as the image data; the perception data processing unit is connected to the semantic segmentation unit and is used for receiving and processing various perception data and segmentation masks acquired by the sensor unit; and the intelligent control unit is connected to the sensing data processing unit and is used for generating a corresponding control instruction according to a processing result of the sensing data processing unit. According to the invention, the environment perception, object recognition and interaction capabilities of the leg-foot type robot can be effectively improved.

title: Height-variable and foot wheel conversion humanoid robot mechanism and information processing control method
abstract: The invention provides a height-variable and foot wheel conversion humanoid robot mechanism and an information processing control method. A robot body and the information processing control method are included. The robot body is composed of a body, legs, feet, arms, a height adjusting mechanism, a sensor unit and a control system. The height adjusting mechanism is composed of a contraction mechanism and a rotating mechanism, the contraction mechanism comprises a paper folding structure, a torsion spring, a folding motor and a pull rope, and the rotating mechanism comprises a rotating motor and a motor base; the legs and the arms are each provided with a structure multiplexed with a knee joint driving motor and an elbow joint driving motor, each structure comprises a coupler, an electromagnetic clutch and a wheel, and coupling and switching of foot type movement and wheel type movement are achieved. The information processing control method comprises a foot-wheel conversion control method and a height adjustment control method, and information acquisition processing and motion control are realized through the sensor unit and the control system. According to the invention, active height control and foot-wheel movement switching can be realized, and the information perception, obstacle crossing and movement capabilities of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Multi-modal fusion and control platform and system for interaction of human and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal fusion and control platform and system for interaction of a person and a humanoid robot, and the platform comprises a human body signal fusion sensing platform and a double-arm robot mirror image control platform, and is technically characterized in that the multi-modal fusion platform system for interaction of the person and the humanoid robot is provided; through arrangement and fusion of multiple sensors, in combination with a stable multi-sensor coordinate calibration system, an adaptive filtering technology and a generalized intelligent man-machine interaction algorithm model, the interaction quality of a person and a humanoid robot in the aspects of action recognition, prediction and tracking is improved; the platform can effectively capture and analyze human actions, and through accurate classification and regression algorithms, the response speed and accuracy of the humanoid robot to the human actions are improved, so that the naturalness and fluency of human-computer interaction are enhanced; in addition, the invention also pays attention to the stability and reliability of the system, and ensures that the interaction quality and experience can be provided in various complex environments.

title: Humanoid robot motion debugging protection device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion debugging protection device and method, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the interior of a protection supporting frame in the device forms a motion debugging area of a humanoid robot. The depth camera collects first pose information of the humanoid robot in the motion debugging process of the humanoid robot and sends the first pose information to the protection controller; the protection controller controls the first guide rail pulley controller, the second guide rail pulley controller and the third guide rail pulley controller to move according to the first pose information, so that the safety traction rope and the humanoid robot are located on the same vertical plane; therefore, the safe traction rope can automatically track the movement of the humanoid robot in the debugging process of the humanoid robot. And when it is determined that the motion debugging has a safety risk according to the first pose information, controlling the safety traction rope constraining device to adjust the safety traction rope to be shortened to a preset length. The damage probability of the humanoid robot is reduced, the debugging efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved, and the personnel safety is improved.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot navigation method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a semantic map; obtaining a passable area and an impassable area according to the map block information of each map block; acquiring an operation task, a navigation starting point and a navigation ending point of the humanoid robot; dividing the job task into a plurality of sub-tasks; planning a plurality of reference operation flows according to the passable area, the impassable area, the navigation starting point, the navigation ending point and the plurality of subtasks; each reference operation process is scored; obtaining an optimal operation flow according to the score; according to the passable area, the impassable area and the real-time map, planning a path between adjacent optimal operation points as an optimal moving path; and enabling the humanoid robot to navigate according to the optimal operation process and the optimal moving path. According to the method, the navigation path of the humanoid robot can be more reasonable, and the efficiency of the humanoid robot for completing the operation task is higher.

title: Modularized docking mechanism and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a modular docking mechanism and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The problems that at the present stage, a biped robot is poor in running stability in complex terrains, and the loading capacity of the biped robot is poor are solved. The clamping device comprises a middle connecting block and clamping structures, the middle connecting block is provided with two clamping ends, and each clamping end corresponds to one clamping structure and is clamped; a middle driving unit in the clamping structure comprises a middle driving shaft and a driving cam, and the driving cam is arranged on the middle driving shaft in a sleeving mode and can rotate along with the middle driving shaft. Each finger unit corresponds to one driving cam; the finger unit comprises a feeler lever, fingers, a pin shaft I and a return spring; the fingers are hinged to one sides of the driving cams through first pin shafts, one ends of the feeler levers make contact with the surfaces of the corresponding driving cams, and the other ends of the feeler levers are connected to the tail ends of the fingers and can rotate. One end of the return spring is connected to the finger, and the other end is fixed and stretched. The modular connection device is mainly used for modular connection of the biped robot.

title: Self-adaptive gait conversion method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot self-adaptive gait conversion method, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, calculating a joint position of a target robot by using inverse kinematics, setting a reference position and a direction of the target robot in each frame as a reference position and a direction of source motion data after zooming, and then, building a humanoid motion learning framework, according to the method, a uniform motion redirection technology and an asymmetric motion-comment framework are adopted, a WGAN-div discriminator is combined, smooth transition from walking to running of the robot is achieved, interruption is not needed, and the method is suitable for being popularized and applied. The method not only promotes the development of the humanoid robot technology, but also provides a new possibility for the application of the robot in a wider field, especially in a scene where the robot needs to closely interact with human beings.

title: Walking mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a walking mechanism and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The walking mechanism comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly. The hip joint driving motor and the knee joint driving motor are coaxially arranged; one end of the thigh body is connected with the hip joint driving motor, and the hip joint driving motor is used for driving the thigh body to swing; the first ankle joint rotating motor is arranged at one end of the shank body and connected with the knee joint driving motor through a knee joint pull rod, and the knee joint driving motor is used for driving the shank body to swing. One end of the shank body is connected with the other end of the thigh body through a first ankle joint rotating motor, the first ankle joint rotating motor serves as a knee joint rotating shaft, the first ankle joint rotating motor is connected with the foot through a first pull rod, and the first ankle joint rotating motor is used for driving the foot to swing. According to the method, the transmission conversion complexity of the legs of the humanoid robot is reduced, the algorithm solution is simplified, and the segmentation boundary of the rod piece is clearer.

title: Model predictive control-based humanoid robot obstacle avoidance method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot obstacle avoidance method based on model prediction control. Scanning a road in front of the humanoid robot through a laser scanner arranged at the head of the humanoid robot, forming a coordinate point cloud according to a scanning result, and drawing a terrain map of the road in front of the humanoid robot; the height of the obstacle is calculated through a depth camera arranged on the humanoid robot part; and when the height of the obstacle is smaller than the leg length of the humanoid robot, the humanoid robot is controlled to walk to the front of the obstacle, and upside-down overturning obstacle crossing operation is executed. According to the method, a forward upside-down obstacle crossing mode is combined with a model-based prediction algorithm, so that the working efficiency and the stability are improved while a specific environment task can be completed, and the application prospect is wide.
