title: Multi-gait biped motion control method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention provides a multi-gait biped motion control method and device based on deep reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: determining a state vector of a current humanoid robot, the state vector comprising a joint parameter, a hip parameter and a biped phase parameter; calling a preset control strategy neural network in a simulation environment, and determining an output vector of the preset control strategy neural network based on the state vector; performing linear transformation based on the output vector to obtain an expected joint angle; a proportional differential controller is called based on the expected joint angle, and the output torque is determined; simulating the trajectory motion of the humanoid robot in a simulation environment based on the output torque to obtain sample data of the trajectory data; and when the number of the sample data is greater than a preset minimum sample value, updating a network weight of a preset control strategy neural network based on the trajectory data to obtain an updated control strategy neural network so as to control the humanoid robot to perform expected gait motion.

title: Robot joint module health state monitoring device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot joint module health state monitoring device and method, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, and the device comprises a vibration temperature sensor which is arranged on a housing of a robot joint module, the sensor is used for collecting a vibration signal and a temperature signal of a robot joint in real time when the robot joint module operates in a health detection mode; the robot joint module driving plate is used for collecting a current signal, a voltage signal and a position signal of a robot joint; the microcontroller is connected with the vibration temperature sensor and the robot joint module driving plate, and is used for storing and transmitting the signal data of the robot joint; the signal data comprises a vibration signal, a temperature signal, a current signal, a voltage signal and a position signal; the upper computer is connected with the microprocessor and used for monitoring the health state of the robot joint module according to the signal data. According to the method, the health state of the robot joint module can be determined, so that the abnormal condition in the operation of the robot joint module is identified.

title: Humanoid mechanical foot for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical foot for a humanoid robot. Comprising a foot frame connecting shanks and other foot parts of the humanoid robot, a split type foot arch, an elastic buffer assembly forming a three-connecting-rod with the foot arch, a heel, an elastic buffer assembly forming a three-connecting-rod with the heel, two-degree-of-freedom toes with an automatic reset function and a ground contact detection sensor. By designing the toes with pitch degrees of freedom, the forefoot of the robot integrally rotates relative to the foot, so that a human-simulated gait can be realized; by designing toes, arch elastic buffering assemblies and heel elastic buffering assemblies with roll freedom degrees, the capacity of the foot of the robot for adapting to different terrains is enhanced; by designing a contact sensor at the foot, the foot-to-ground sensing ability of the robot is improved, so that the robot has the ability of realizing static gait. According to the invention, the robot can be more energy-saving and lower in noise, and more simulates the straight knee and toe-following gaits of people; the capacity of buffering foot impact and adapting to the unstructured ground is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot wrist and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot wrist and a control method thereof.The humanoid robot wrist comprises a connecting disc, a universal joint mounting disc and a power source fixing frame, a reset mechanism and a universal ball joint are arranged between the connecting disc and the universal joint mounting disc, one end of the universal ball joint is rotationally connected with the connecting disc, and the other end of the universal ball joint is connected with the universal joint mounting disc; a power source is fixed to the power source fixing frame and fixed to the lower end of the universal joint mounting disc, a connecting rod is arranged between the power source and the connecting disc, and the two ends of the connecting rod are connected with the power source and the connecting disc respectively. By introducing the universal ball joint and a connecting rod mechanism, the degree of freedom of the wrist is remarkably increased, the wrist can perform more complex and diversified actions, it is ensured that power transmission is more direct and higher in efficiency, and the response speed and motion precision of the wrist part are improved. And the reset mechanism can automatically reset the wrist part to the original or preset position after any external force is eliminated, so that the repeatability and the accuracy of operation are enhanced.

title: Parallel coupling type hydraulically-driven robot joint
abstract: The invention discloses a parallel coupling type hydraulically-driven robot joint, and relates to the field of hydraulically-driven robot joint structures. The problems that an existing humanoid robot is small in side swing joint rotation angle, complex in transmission, small in motion driving force and unstable in motion are solved. A hydraulic cylinder barrel is of an upper-lower double-cylinder-barrel structure, two pistons are slidably inserted into an upper side cylinder barrel and a lower side cylinder barrel of the hydraulic cylinder barrel in a sealed mode respectively, and one ends of two transmission rods are rotationally connected with the two pistons through two rotating shafts respectively. The output shaft is a spline shaft, the middle portions of the two rotating rods are installed in the middle of the output shaft through two spline sleeves, two cylinder body shaft sleeves which are coaxially arranged are arranged on the two sides of the front end of the hydraulic cylinder barrel respectively, and the two cylinder body shaft sleeves are arranged on the two sides of the front end of the hydraulic cylinder barrel respectively. The two ends of the output shaft are rotationally connected with the two cylinder body shaft sleeves correspondingly. The invention is used for realizing the side-sway degree of freedom of the legs of the robot.

title: Walking mechanism of intelligent service robot
abstract: The invention discloses a walking mechanism of an intelligent service robot, and relates to the technical field of service robots, the walking mechanism comprises a double-rod adjusting base, and the double-rod adjusting base is composed of a sliding groove, a bidirectional pneumatic guide rod, a base and a displacement saddle; under the cooperation of the multi-adaptive adjusting assembly and the anti-rollover assembly, the position of the walking bottom foot with the micro adsorption disc is adjusted to adapt to the ground gradient or unevenness, when the whole lower limb structure walks on a slope or a stair, the stability of the whole operation displacement can be guaranteed, the whole single position adjustment of the whole lower limb structure is achieved, and the whole lower limb structure can be adjusted by adjusting the distance. title: Inverse kinematics solving method of humanoid upper limb robot based on virtual dynamics constraint
abstract: A virtual dynamics constraint-based inverse kinematics solving method for a humanoid upper limb robot belongs to the technical field of humanoid upper limb robots, and comprises the following steps: establishing a connecting rod coordinate system of the humanoid upper limb robot, and obtaining a forward kinematics equation through parameter modeling; solving a fourth-order derivative of the forward kinematics equation to obtain a fourth-order forward kinematics model; virtual flexible joint dynamic constraint is introduced; the dynamic constraint of the virtual flexible joint is substituted into the fourth-order forward kinematics model, and a state-space equation about an inverse kinematics solving problem is obtained; a control law is designed, so that state variables in the obtained state-space equation converge to zero; and according to the designed control law, solving and obtaining the value of the joint angle trajectory of the two arms by utilizing the dynamic constraint of the virtual flexible joint. The method has the advantages that the convergence speed is high, the obtained angle and angular velocity curve is smooth, and the noise is inhibited, the method is applied to inverse kinematics calculation of the humanoid upper limb robot, and the robot has more excellent kinematics performance.

title: Low-calculation-amount method and system for simulating human body actions by robot
abstract: The invention discloses a low-calculation-amount method and system for simulating human body actions by a robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a human body posture video, and determining a reference point and a reference line in each frame of image; acquiring an included angle between a connecting line of the plurality of key points and the datum point of each frame and the datum line; calculating the difference value between the included angle of each key point in each frame of image and the included angle of the key point corresponding to the previous frame as the angular velocity of the key point, calculating the difference value between the angular velocity of each key point in each frame and the angular velocity of the key point corresponding to the previous frame as the angular acceleration of the key point, and acquiring the angular velocities of all the key points as 0 and 0; taking the human body posture image of which the angular acceleration of at least one key point is not 0 as a frame containing the key posture; obtaining a human body posture image of which the time sequence is in the middle position in the static video clip as a frame containing the key posture; and adjusting the posture of the robot according to the posture in the human body posture image corresponding to the frame of the key posture. According to the invention, the computing power, the power consumption and the time delay can be reduced.

title: Bionic service type humanoid robot head structure

title: Pull-type movable joint leg structure of bionic robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biomimetic robots, and discloses a traction type movable joint leg structure of a biomimetic robot, which comprises a hip joint ball movably connected with a hip joint groove of the biomimetic robot, and further comprises a leg bone joint ball, a thigh bone, two knee joint balls and a shank bone, the hip joint ball, the shank joint ball and the two knee joint balls are connected with the thigh bone and the shank bone, the first traction hole and the second traction hole are formed in the middle of the thigh bone and the middle of the shank bone, and movement of the thigh bone and the shank bone is achieved through traction of the two traction devices; according to the bionic robot, the traction device is arranged, so that the overall movement of the legs of the robot is achieved, the traction device can simulate the movement effect of human tendon connection, the bionic robot can be closer to the movement posture of the human in the movement process, and the movement action of the bionic robot is smoother and not rigid.
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of biomimetic robots, and discloses a traction type movable joint leg structure of a biomimetic robot, which comprises a hip joint ball movably connected with a hip joint groove of the biomimetic robot, and further comprises a leg bone joint ball, a thigh bone, two knee joint balls and a shank bone, the hip joint ball, the shank joint ball and the two knee joint balls are connected with the thigh bone and the shank bone, the first traction hole and the second traction hole are formed in the middle of the thigh bone and the middle of the shank bone, and movement of the thigh bone and the shank bone is achieved through traction of the two traction devices; according to the bionic robot, the traction device is arranged, so that the overall movement of the legs of the robot is achieved, the traction device can simulate the movement effect of human tendon connection, the bionic robot can be closer to the movement posture of the human in the movement process, and the movement action of the bionic robot is smoother and not rigid.

title: Hollow encoder for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hollow encoder for a humanoid robot, which comprises a hollow encoder main body, a gear ring I fixedly connected to the front side of the surface of the hollow encoder main body, a mounting ring arranged on the front side of the hollow encoder main body, a cooling fan rotationally connected to the surface of the mounting ring, and a gear ring II fixedly connected to the rear side of the cooling fan, the kinetic energy transmission mechanism is rotationally mounted on one side of the surface of the hollow encoder main body and is used for providing sufficient rotating kinetic energy for the cooling fan; the control clutch mechanism is rotationally mounted in the kinetic energy transmission mechanism and used for controlling connection and disconnection of kinetic energy of the cooling fan; according to the invention, the frameless torque motor drives the rotating force of the hollow encoder main body to be converted, so that the rotating force of the hollow encoder main body is transmitted to the heat dissipation assembly, the kinetic energy of the hollow encoder main body drives the heat dissipation assembly to rotate, the heat dissipation assembly does not need to rotate by means of external kinetic energy equipment, and the use energy-saving and environment-friendly effects of the hollow encoder main body are improved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hollow encoder for a humanoid robot, which comprises a hollow encoder main body, a gear ring I fixedly connected to the front side of the surface of the hollow encoder main body, a mounting ring arranged on the front side of the hollow encoder main body, a cooling fan rotationally connected to the surface of the mounting ring, and a gear ring II fixedly connected to the rear side of the cooling fan, the kinetic energy transmission mechanism is rotationally mounted on one side of the surface of the hollow encoder main body and is used for providing sufficient rotating kinetic energy for the cooling fan; the control clutch mechanism is rotationally mounted in the kinetic energy transmission mechanism and used for controlling connection and disconnection of kinetic energy of the cooling fan; according to the invention, the frameless torque motor drives the rotating force of the hollow encoder main body to be converted, so that the rotating force of the hollow encoder main body is transmitted to the heat dissipation assembly, the kinetic energy of the hollow encoder main body drives the heat dissipation assembly to rotate, the heat dissipation assembly does not need to rotate by means of external kinetic energy equipment, and the use energy-saving and environment-friendly effects of the hollow encoder main body are improved.

title: Humanoid robot finger
abstract: The humanoid robot finger comprises a fixed base, a linear driver, a swing base and a connecting rod type mechanical finger body, wherein the linear driver and the swing base are installed on the fixed base, and the connecting rod type mechanical finger body is installed on the swing base. The linear driver comprises a cylindrical shell, a motor coil and a motor magnet of a driving motor arranged in the shell, and a reverse circulating ball screw system; the periphery of the motor coil is fixed on the inner wall of the shell and is connected with a power supply and a signal line; the motor magnet is inserted into the motor coil; the reverse circulation ball screw system comprises a ball screw, a ball nut and balls arranged between the ball screw and the ball nut. Stretching, bending and swinging of the humanoid robot fingers are achieved through the linear drivers, high precision, high efficiency and high load capacity are achieved, and the flexibility and reliability of the humanoid robot fingers are improved.
abstract_en: The humanoid robot finger comprises a fixed base, a linear driver, a swing base and a connecting rod type mechanical finger body, wherein the linear driver and the swing base are installed on the fixed base, and the connecting rod type mechanical finger body is installed on the swing base. The linear driver comprises a cylindrical shell, a motor coil and a motor magnet of a driving motor arranged in the shell, and a reverse circulating ball screw system; the periphery of the motor coil is fixed on the inner wall of the shell and is connected with a power supply and a signal line; the motor magnet is inserted into the motor coil; the reverse circulation ball screw system comprises a ball screw, a ball nut and balls arranged between the ball screw and the ball nut. Stretching, bending and swinging of the humanoid robot fingers are achieved through the linear drivers, high precision, high efficiency and high load capacity are achieved, and the flexibility and reliability of the humanoid robot fingers are improved.

title: Hydraulically-driven large-swing-angle transmission mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven large-swing-angle transmission mechanism, and relates to the technical field of hydraulically-driven robots. The problems that an existing hydraulically-driven humanoid robot shoulder joint is small in working range, and complex actions cannot be achieved; the size is large and the space utilization rate is low; the bearable load is small, and the completed work task is limited. Under the action of the rotating hydraulic cylinder, the swing guide rail base rotating support can rotate by a certain angle, when the swing hydraulic cylinder acts, the swing rod can swing by a certain angle through the sliding block assembly, the swing guide rail and the swing two-force rod, and under the action of the swing hydraulic cylinder, the swing rod can swing by a certain angle; and under the action of the rotating hydraulic cylinder, the oscillating rod can rotate by a certain angle. The swing mechanism is used for achieving the swing action and the large-range rotation action of the swing rod, the integration degree and the space utilization rate of the robot are increased, the structure of the robot is more compact, and the robot can bear high loads through hydraulic driving.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven large-swing-angle transmission mechanism, and relates to the technical field of hydraulically-driven robots. The problems that an existing hydraulically-driven humanoid robot shoulder joint is small in working range, and complex actions cannot be achieved; the size is large and the space utilization rate is low; the bearable load is small, and the completed work task is limited. Under the action of the rotating hydraulic cylinder, the swing guide rail base rotating support can rotate by a certain angle, when the swing hydraulic cylinder acts, the swing rod can swing by a certain angle through the sliding block assembly, the swing guide rail and the swing two-force rod, and under the action of the swing hydraulic cylinder, the swing rod can swing by a certain angle; and under the action of the rotating hydraulic cylinder, the oscillating rod can rotate by a certain angle. The swing mechanism is used for achieving the swing action and the large-range rotation action of the swing rod, the integration degree and the space utilization rate of the robot are increased, the structure of the robot is more compact, and the robot can bear high loads through hydraulic driving.

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg mechanism comprises a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton, a hip assembly, a knee assembly, an adapter, a first assembly and a second assembly; the hip component comprises a hip fixing piece fixedly connected with the adapter and a hip joint output end fixedly connected with the thigh skeleton; the knee component comprises a knee fixing piece fixedly connected with the hip fixing piece and movably connected with the thigh skeleton, and a knee joint output end in transmission connection with the shank skeleton; the first assembly comprises a first fixing piece and a first joint output end, and the first joint output end is fixedly connected with the adapter piece; the second assembly comprises a second joint output end fixedly connected with the first fixing piece. The rotation axes of the hip joint output end and the knee joint output end are collinear, and the rotation axes of the first joint output end, the second joint output end and the hip joint output end are perpendicular in pairs. The humanoid robot includes a leg mechanism. The leg mechanism can reduce the inertia of the leg.
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg mechanism comprises a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton, a hip assembly, a knee assembly, an adapter, a first assembly and a second assembly; the hip component comprises a hip fixing piece fixedly connected with the adapter and a hip joint output end fixedly connected with the thigh skeleton; the knee component comprises a knee fixing piece fixedly connected with the hip fixing piece and movably connected with the thigh skeleton, and a knee joint output end in transmission connection with the shank skeleton; the first assembly comprises a first fixing piece and a first joint output end, and the first joint output end is fixedly connected with the adapter piece; the second assembly comprises a second joint output end fixedly connected with the first fixing piece. The rotation axes of the hip joint output end and the knee joint output end are collinear, and the rotation axes of the first joint output end, the second joint output end and the hip joint output end are perpendicular in pairs. The humanoid robot includes a leg mechanism. The leg mechanism can reduce the inertia of the leg.

title: Quick nodding and shaking movement mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot rapid nodding and shaking movement mechanism which comprises a rack, a shaking assembly enabling a robot to rapidly shake is arranged in the rack, and a first driving assembly for driving the shaking assembly is arranged on one side of the shaking assembly. A nodding assembly for driving the robot to nodding quickly is arranged on one side of the rack, and a second driving assembly for driving the nodding assembly is arranged on one side of the nodding assembly; by arranging the head shaking assembly, the nodding assembly, the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly, when the robot needs to shake the head, the first driving assembly controls the head shaking assembly to shake the head, and when the second driving assembly needs to nodding, the second driving assembly controls the nodding assembly to nodding; the effect that the nodding and shaking functions of the humanoid robot can be achieved only through a simple mechanical mechanism is achieved.
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot rapid nodding and shaking movement mechanism which comprises a rack, a shaking assembly enabling a robot to rapidly shake is arranged in the rack, and a first driving assembly for driving the shaking assembly is arranged on one side of the shaking assembly. A nodding assembly for driving the robot to nodding quickly is arranged on one side of the rack, and a second driving assembly for driving the nodding assembly is arranged on one side of the nodding assembly; by arranging the head shaking assembly, the nodding assembly, the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly, when the robot needs to shake the head, the first driving assembly controls the head shaking assembly to shake the head, and when the second driving assembly needs to nodding, the second driving assembly controls the nodding assembly to nodding; the effect that the nodding and shaking functions of the humanoid robot can be achieved only through a simple mechanical mechanism is achieved.

title: Upper limb structure device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, and discloses an upper limb structure device of a humanoid robot, which comprises a mounting seat, a hinge seat and an upper limb arm, the hinge seat is fixedly mounted on the front side of the mounting seat, a hinge shaft penetrates through the hinge seat, and a lubricating mechanism is arranged between the upper limb arm and the hinge seat; by arranging the lubricating mechanism, lubricating oil in the oil cavity can be extruded out through the oil outlet pipe, the extruded lubricating oil drips at the hinged position of the upper limb arm and the hinged base, then the upper limb arm can be lubricated in time, and the situation that the normal operation of the robot is affected due to the fact that the upper limb of the robot is jammed during operation is avoided; the problem that after an existing robot upper limb structure is used for a long time, workers need to manually smear and lubricate the robot upper limb structure in time, and the jamming phenomenon is avoided is solved.
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, and discloses an upper limb structure device of a humanoid robot, which comprises a mounting seat, a hinge seat and an upper limb arm, the hinge seat is fixedly mounted on the front side of the mounting seat, a hinge shaft penetrates through the hinge seat, and a lubricating mechanism is arranged between the upper limb arm and the hinge seat; by arranging the lubricating mechanism, lubricating oil in the oil cavity can be extruded out through the oil outlet pipe, the extruded lubricating oil drips at the hinged position of the upper limb arm and the hinged base, then the upper limb arm can be lubricated in time, and the situation that the normal operation of the robot is affected due to the fact that the upper limb of the robot is jammed during operation is avoided; the problem that after an existing robot upper limb structure is used for a long time, workers need to manually smear and lubricate the robot upper limb structure in time, and the jamming phenomenon is avoided is solved.

title: Variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm based on bevel gear transmission mechanism
abstract: The utility model provides a variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm based on a bevel gear transmission mechanism, which comprises a mounting frame, a first driving device arranged on the mounting frame, a shoulder frame arranged on one side of the first driving device, a first big arm arranged below the shoulder frame, a second big arm arranged at one end of a positioning frame, and a second big arm arranged on the other end of the positioning frame. The third driving device is arranged in the second large arm, the first small arm is arranged at one end of the second large arm, the rotating device is arranged in the first small arm, the second small arm is arranged at one end of the first small arm, the fourth driving device is arranged in the second small arm, and the connecting frame is arranged at one end of the second small arm. According to the variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm based on the bevel gear transmission mechanism, the structure is more durable, the situation that joints are damaged due to the fact that the output end is displaced when external force acts on the output end can be avoided, a speed reduction stepping motor is used for driving, and the service life of the variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm is far longer than that of a steering engine and other driving schemes.
abstract_en: The utility model provides a variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm based on a bevel gear transmission mechanism, which comprises a mounting frame, a first driving device arranged on the mounting frame, a shoulder frame arranged on one side of the first driving device, a first big arm arranged below the shoulder frame, a second big arm arranged at one end of a positioning frame, and a second big arm arranged on the other end of the positioning frame. The third driving device is arranged in the second large arm, the first small arm is arranged at one end of the second large arm, the rotating device is arranged in the first small arm, the second small arm is arranged at one end of the first small arm, the fourth driving device is arranged in the second small arm, and the connecting frame is arranged at one end of the second small arm. According to the variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm based on the bevel gear transmission mechanism, the structure is more durable, the situation that joints are damaged due to the fact that the output end is displaced when external force acts on the output end can be avoided, a speed reduction stepping motor is used for driving, and the service life of the variable-degree-of-freedom humanoid bionic robot arm is far longer than that of a steering engine and other driving schemes.

title: Humanoid robot with anti-collision function
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of man-machine interaction equipment, and discloses a humanoid robot with an anti-collision function, which comprises electric control equipment, the electric control equipment comprises an electric control box main body, the outer side wall of the front end of the electric control box main body is fixedly connected with a buffer rubber block, and the middle part of the rear end of the bottom of the electric control box main body is provided with a groove; an interaction mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the electric cabinet body, self-walking mechanisms are arranged at the two ends of the electric cabinet body, a power source is arranged at the front end in the groove, and a rotation protection mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the electric cabinet body and located at an opening of the groove. According to the utility model, a multi-surface anti-collision structure design is adopted as a whole, that is, the power supply part of the electric control box main body is provided with the protective cover plate which is rotatably designed, the front end of the electric control box main body is provided with the buffer rubber block, and the annular outer side wall of one end, which is separated from the loudspeakers at the two ends above, is fixedly sleeved with the rubber sleeve; when the whole humanoid robot is used for visitor reception work of a hotel, the whole humanoid robot is not prone to being damaged due to collision of articles.
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of man-machine interaction equipment, and discloses a humanoid robot with an anti-collision function, which comprises electric control equipment, the electric control equipment comprises an electric control box main body, the outer side wall of the front end of the electric control box main body is fixedly connected with a buffer rubber block, and the middle part of the rear end of the bottom of the electric control box main body is provided with a groove; an interaction mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the electric cabinet body, self-walking mechanisms are arranged at the two ends of the electric cabinet body, a power source is arranged at the front end in the groove, and a rotation protection mechanism is arranged at the rear end of the electric cabinet body and located at an opening of the groove. According to the utility model, a multi-surface anti-collision structure design is adopted as a whole, that is, the power supply part of the electric control box main body is provided with the protective cover plate which is rotatably designed, the front end of the electric control box main body is provided with the buffer rubber block, and the annular outer side wall of one end, which is separated from the loudspeakers at the two ends above, is fixedly sleeved with the rubber sleeve; when the whole humanoid robot is used for visitor reception work of a hotel, the whole humanoid robot is not prone to being damaged due to collision of articles.

title: Arm and claw cooperative control method, device and equipment of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides an arm and claw cooperative control method for a humanoid robot. The arm and claw cooperative control method comprises the steps that the motion type of a mechanical arm and the initial pose and the target pose of the tail end of the mechanical arm are obtained; according to the motion type of the mechanical arm and the initial pose, the target pose, the initial speed and the target speed of the tail end of the mechanical arm, the angle of each joint of the mechanical arm in the motion process is calculated; according to the triggering condition, the initial position, the target position, the initial speed and the target speed of the dexterous gripper, the motion trail of the dexterous gripper is calculated; according to the invention, a motion control instruction of an arm and claw system is designed, the motion of the mechanical arm and the motion of the dexterous claw do not need to be separated for respective control in a scene requiring cooperative control of the arm and the claw, and the control method is simple and convenient to operate and high in control efficiency, and can be widely applied to the field of cooperative control of the mechanical arm and the dexterous claw. Movement of the mechanical arm and movement of the dexterous gripper can be associated and controlled through a common time axis.
abstract_en: The invention provides an arm and claw cooperative control method for a humanoid robot. The arm and claw cooperative control method comprises the steps that the motion type of a mechanical arm and the initial pose and the target pose of the tail end of the mechanical arm are obtained; according to the motion type of the mechanical arm and the initial pose, the target pose, the initial speed and the target speed of the tail end of the mechanical arm, the angle of each joint of the mechanical arm in the motion process is calculated; according to the triggering condition, the initial position, the target position, the initial speed and the target speed of the dexterous gripper, the motion trail of the dexterous gripper is calculated; according to the invention, a motion control instruction of an arm and claw system is designed, the motion of the mechanical arm and the motion of the dexterous claw do not need to be separated for respective control in a scene requiring cooperative control of the arm and the claw, and the control method is simple and convenient to operate and high in control efficiency, and can be widely applied to the field of cooperative control of the mechanical arm and the dexterous claw. Movement of the mechanical arm and movement of the dexterous gripper can be associated and controlled through a common time axis.

title: Lightweight robot limb and leg structure simulating shallot tibia
abstract: The invention provides a robot limb and leg lightweight structure simulating the tibia of a rock sheep, and relates to the technical field of high-performance bionic structures, the robot limb and leg lightweight structure comprises two triangular prism stress parts and a triangular prism bearing part, the upper end and the lower end of the triangular prism bearing part are smoothly connected with the triangular prism stress parts respectively, and the interior of the triangular prism bearing part is a triangular hollow cavity; other materials can be used for filling. The distances from all the edges of the triangular hollow cavity to the outer surface are equal, the whole triangular prism bearing part is bent in a slight S shape, and the cross sectional area of the two ends is larger than that of the middle of the triangular prism bearing part. Compared with a traditional straight cylindrical humanoid robot supporting leg, the robot limb and leg lightweight structure simulating the rock sheep tibia, provided by the invention, shows higher buffering capacity and more uniform overall stress under the same impact force.
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot limb and leg lightweight structure simulating the tibia of a rock sheep, and relates to the technical field of high-performance bionic structures, the robot limb and leg lightweight structure comprises two triangular prism stress parts and a triangular prism bearing part, the upper end and the lower end of the triangular prism bearing part are smoothly connected with the triangular prism stress parts respectively, and the interior of the triangular prism bearing part is a triangular hollow cavity; other materials can be used for filling. The distances from all the edges of the triangular hollow cavity to the outer surface are equal, the whole triangular prism bearing part is bent in a slight S shape, and the cross sectional area of the two ends is larger than that of the middle of the triangular prism bearing part. Compared with a traditional straight cylindrical humanoid robot supporting leg, the robot limb and leg lightweight structure simulating the rock sheep tibia, provided by the invention, shows higher buffering capacity and more uniform overall stress under the same impact force.

title: Intelligent humanoid robot scene understanding method based on laser point cloud
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot scene intelligent understanding method based on laser point cloud, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the autonomous navigation of a humanoid robot, carrying out the collection of three-dimensional real scene data through a laser radar scanning system, and obtaining scene point cloud data; processing the obtained scene point cloud data by using an adaptive radius sampling module; performing RPV-Net-based point cloud semantic feature extraction on the extracted effective point cloud data to obtain a 3D bounding box and a semantic tag of the point cloud data; processing the point cloud data by using a channel attention module, acquiring integral features of the point cloud by using an average pooling method, extracting individual features by using a maximum pooling method, performing feature aggregation, and acquiring global features of the point cloud; and constructing a scene understanding Bert pre-training model and a multi-modal hybrid model of an encoder-decoder model, and processing global features of the point cloud. According to the method, real-time and high-precision three-dimensional point cloud data are provided for the humanoid robot by using a laser radar technology, and depth perception and intelligent understanding of the environment can be realized.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot scene intelligent understanding method based on laser point cloud, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the autonomous navigation of a humanoid robot, carrying out the collection of three-dimensional real scene data through a laser radar scanning system, and obtaining scene point cloud data; processing the obtained scene point cloud data by using an adaptive radius sampling module; performing RPV-Net-based point cloud semantic feature extraction on the extracted effective point cloud data to obtain a 3D bounding box and a semantic tag of the point cloud data; processing the point cloud data by using a channel attention module, acquiring integral features of the point cloud by using an average pooling method, extracting individual features by using a maximum pooling method, performing feature aggregation, and acquiring global features of the point cloud; and constructing a scene understanding Bert pre-training model and a multi-modal hybrid model of an encoder-decoder model, and processing global features of the point cloud. According to the method, real-time and high-precision three-dimensional point cloud data are provided for the humanoid robot by using a laser radar technology, and depth perception and intelligent understanding of the environment can be realized.

title: Power joint mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power joint mechanism for a humanoid robot, which can simultaneously solve the problems of high-explosion high-torque overload heat dissipation and easy saturation of a stator yoke magnetic circuit and improve the continuous high-torque capacity, explosion and overload capacity, and the size of a heat dissipation device is relatively small. The device comprises a speed reducer (1), a transmission shaft (2), a motor rotor (3), a motor stator (4), a stator yoke part (5) and a joint component (6), the motor and the speed reducer are in linkage transmission through a transmission shaft, a motor stator and a joint are installed together through the joint component, a stator yoke part on the periphery of the motor stator extends along the periphery to form a plurality of installation position protrusions (51), and heat conduction heat pipes (7) matched with the installation position protrusions are welded to grooves between every two adjacent protrusions.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power joint mechanism for a humanoid robot, which can simultaneously solve the problems of high-explosion high-torque overload heat dissipation and easy saturation of a stator yoke magnetic circuit and improve the continuous high-torque capacity, explosion and overload capacity, and the size of a heat dissipation device is relatively small. The device comprises a speed reducer (1), a transmission shaft (2), a motor rotor (3), a motor stator (4), a stator yoke part (5) and a joint component (6), the motor and the speed reducer are in linkage transmission through a transmission shaft, a motor stator and a joint are installed together through the joint component, a stator yoke part on the periphery of the motor stator extends along the periphery to form a plurality of installation position protrusions (51), and heat conduction heat pipes (7) matched with the installation position protrusions are welded to grooves between every two adjacent protrusions.

title: Sign language teaching method based on humanoid robot and related products
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a sign language teaching method based on a humanoid robot and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sign language teaching instruction; determining first relative position information; adjusting an initial position, an initial posture and an initial orientation of the humanoid robot based on the first relative position information, so that the humanoid robot interacts with the user in a first position, a first posture and a first orientation; when the target scene mode is a teaching mode, determining a first sign language action corresponding to the target learning content; adjusting a first position, a first posture and a first orientation of the humanoid robot based on the first sign language action, so that the humanoid robot interacts with the user in a second position, a second posture and a second orientation; demonstrating the first sign language action, and acquiring a second sign language action of the user; determining the similarity between the first sign language action and the second sign language action to obtain a first similarity; and determining the sign language accuracy of the second sign language action based on the first similarity, and feeding back the sign language accuracy to the user.
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a sign language teaching method based on a humanoid robot and a related product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a sign language teaching instruction; determining first relative position information; adjusting an initial position, an initial posture and an initial orientation of the humanoid robot based on the first relative position information, so that the humanoid robot interacts with the user in a first position, a first posture and a first orientation; when the target scene mode is a teaching mode, determining a first sign language action corresponding to the target learning content; adjusting a first position, a first posture and a first orientation of the humanoid robot based on the first sign language action, so that the humanoid robot interacts with the user in a second position, a second posture and a second orientation; demonstrating the first sign language action, and acquiring a second sign language action of the user; determining the similarity between the first sign language action and the second sign language action to obtain a first similarity; and determining the sign language accuracy of the second sign language action based on the first similarity, and feeding back the sign language accuracy to the user.

title: Shank structure, lower limb assembly, robot, biped robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shank structure, a lower limb assembly, a robot, a biped robot and a humanoid robot, the shank structure comprises a shank provided with a first mounting cavity and a second mounting cavity penetrating in the thickness direction of the shank, a first mounting seat arranged on one side of the shank, and a second mounting seat arranged on the other side of the shank; the first mounting seat is provided with a third mounting cavity and a fourth mounting cavity; the second mounting seat is arranged on the other side of the shank, a fifth mounting cavity and a sixth mounting cavity are formed in the second mounting seat, the third mounting cavity and the fifth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the first mounting cavity, and the fourth mounting cavity and the sixth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the second mounting cavity. Therefore, the area, occupied by the first foot joint module and the second foot joint module, of the shank body can be reduced, the radial size of the shank can also be reduced, and the situation that large space of the shank in the radial direction is occupied can be avoided.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shank structure, a lower limb assembly, a robot, a biped robot and a humanoid robot, the shank structure comprises a shank provided with a first mounting cavity and a second mounting cavity penetrating in the thickness direction of the shank, a first mounting seat arranged on one side of the shank, and a second mounting seat arranged on the other side of the shank; the first mounting seat is provided with a third mounting cavity and a fourth mounting cavity; the second mounting seat is arranged on the other side of the shank, a fifth mounting cavity and a sixth mounting cavity are formed in the second mounting seat, the third mounting cavity and the fifth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the first mounting cavity, and the fourth mounting cavity and the sixth mounting cavity are connected to the two opposite sides of the second mounting cavity. Therefore, the area, occupied by the first foot joint module and the second foot joint module, of the shank body can be reduced, the radial size of the shank can also be reduced, and the situation that large space of the shank in the radial direction is occupied can be avoided.

title: Lower limb system of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb system of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The lower limb system of the humanoid robot comprises a hip mechanism, a left thigh mechanism, a right thigh mechanism, a left shank mechanism and a right shank mechanism, wherein the hip mechanism can be used for supporting the upper trunk of the humanoid robot; the left thigh mechanism comprises a thigh main body, an upper connecting frame, a lower connecting frame, a first linear actuator, a second linear actuator, a first double-crank mechanism and a second double-crank mechanism; the upper end of the thigh body is rotationally connected with the hip mechanism through an upper connecting frame, the lower end of the thigh body is rotationally connected with the left shank mechanism through a lower connecting frame, and the first linear actuator and the second linear actuator can extend or retract in the length direction of the thigh body, so that the left thigh mechanism can rotate relative to the hip mechanism and the left shank mechanism; the structure of the right thigh mechanism is the same as that of the left thigh mechanism. According to the lower limb system, the load capacity of the humanoid robot can be improved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lower limb system of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The lower limb system of the humanoid robot comprises a hip mechanism, a left thigh mechanism, a right thigh mechanism, a left shank mechanism and a right shank mechanism, wherein the hip mechanism can be used for supporting the upper trunk of the humanoid robot; the left thigh mechanism comprises a thigh main body, an upper connecting frame, a lower connecting frame, a first linear actuator, a second linear actuator, a first double-crank mechanism and a second double-crank mechanism; the upper end of the thigh body is rotationally connected with the hip mechanism through an upper connecting frame, the lower end of the thigh body is rotationally connected with the left shank mechanism through a lower connecting frame, and the first linear actuator and the second linear actuator can extend or retract in the length direction of the thigh body, so that the left thigh mechanism can rotate relative to the hip mechanism and the left shank mechanism; the structure of the right thigh mechanism is the same as that of the left thigh mechanism. According to the lower limb system, the load capacity of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Hydraulically-driven humanoid robot pelvis
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven humanoid robot pelvis, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. The hip joint pelvic bone structure solves the problems that an existing hip joint pelvic bone structure is complex in structure and large in size. A hydraulic oil way is integrally printed on a pelvic bone protection frame, a waist joint base is installed on one side of the pelvic bone protection frame in the length direction, two hip joint installation frames are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the pelvic bone protection frame in the width direction in the left-right direction, and the axes of the hip joint installation frames are the same as the width direction of the pelvic bone protection frame. title: Humanoid robot joint motor overload protection method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention provides an overload protection method for a joint motor of a humanoid robot. The overload protection method comprises the following steps: acquiring current of the joint motor; performing linear processing on the current of the joint motor to obtain a first current processing result; predicting the first current processing result through a current prediction module to obtain a current prediction value; the current prediction value is compared with an overload threshold value of the current of the joint motor, and a residual value is calculated; processing the residual value through a compensation value calculation module to obtain a current compensation value; the control quantity of a current loop of the joint motor is compensated according to the current compensation value, the change of the current can be pre-judged in advance through the predicted value, based on the prior state, of the Kalman filter, and therefore the system can respond to possible current overload in the future in advance; meanwhile, the multi-layer perceptron is used for integrating the currents of a plurality of motors, so that the judgment of one current can be associated with other currents.

title: Electric drive joint based on 3K planetary mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an electric drive joint based on a 3K planetary mechanism. The electric drive joint highly integrates a drive motor, a motor driver, the 3K planetary mechanism with the large reduction ratio and a position encoder. Due to the fact that the 3K planetary mechanism belongs to a compound planetary mechanism, the reduction ratio within the range of 30-200 can be achieved through several simple transmission elements, the theoretical forward transmission efficiency can reach 92%, the theoretical reverse transmission efficiency can reach 90%, and the electric drive joint has the advantages of being compact in structure, light in weight, capable of easily achieving high transmission efficiency, capable of achieving reverse drive capacity and high in torque density. In addition, torque control without a sensor can be achieved through current estimation of the driving motor, the cost is saved, and the reliability of the joint module is improved. The electric drive joint can be used for driving arm and leg joints of a four-footed or humanoid robot.

title: Target identification and positioning method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a target identification and positioning method and system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a three-dimensional position of a to-be-identified target by using a double-view-angle monocular vision positioning method; performing preliminary detection and classification on a recognized target by using an image feature extraction and support vector machine classifier based on direction gradient; tracking the identified target by using a random sampling filtering algorithm; positioning the humanoid robot by using a position algorithm based on gait detection to obtain a motion track of the humanoid robot; and correcting the motion track of the humanoid robot through a sensor fusion algorithm. The system comprises a target positioning module, a target classification module, a target tracking module, a positioning module and a positioning correction module. According to the method, target identification and positioning and self-positioning of the humanoid robot can be completed, the humanoid robot is helped to complete environment understanding and identification, the relative position of the humanoid robot and the target object is obtained, and follow-up work can be conveniently carried out.

title: Rotary actuator for flat and thin type combined bearing
abstract: The utility model discloses a flat and thin combined bearing rotary actuator and relates to the technical field of driving equipment. Comprising a speed reducer, the speed reducer comprises a cylindrical shell with the two ends open, a crankshaft is arranged at the center position in the shell, a gear rotating pipe piece is movably arranged between a gear and a rear cover, the crankshaft is sleeved with the gear rotating pipe piece, and the gear rotating pipe piece and the crankshaft are in clearance fit; the arrangement directions of the first sliding groove and the second sliding groove are perpendicular to each other, a first guide block in sliding fit with the first sliding groove is arranged on the gear, a second guide block is arranged on the rear cover, and the gear rotating pipe piece is in sliding fit with the second guide block through the second sliding groove. abstract: The invention provides a shield tunneling machine tool changing method and device based on a humanoid robot and a related product. title: Humanoid robot control method based on clothes storage and related products
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid robot control method based on clothes storage and a related product. title: Assembly structure of elbow joint of humanoid robot, arm structure and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an assembling structure of an elbow joint of a humanoid robot, an arm structure and the robot. The assembling structure of the elbow joint mainly comprises a joint module, a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a third connecting piece and a bearing; the joint module is arranged among the first connecting piece, the second connecting piece and the third connecting piece, one end of the joint module is fixed to the third connecting end through an output flange, the other end of the joint module is fixed to the third connecting piece through a bearing, the two ends of the joint module are both supported, and the conditions of abrasion and even damage caused by main shaft bias pressure are avoided; and bias damage of a transmission gear or a rotating piece can be avoided.

title: Bionic driving device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a bionic driving device of a humanoid robot, belongs to the technical field of robots, and is used for solving the problems of single driving mode and poor environment adaptability of a humanoid robot driving device in the prior art. Comprising a bionic footstand, a propeller driving system, a bionic driving system and a sensing monitoring system, and a through hole is formed in the bionic footstand; the propeller driving system comprises a first propeller assembly, and the first propeller assembly is arranged in the through hole; the bionic driving system comprises two sets of bionic power driving assemblies, and the two sets of bionic power driving assemblies are arranged at the bottom of the bionic footstand and located on the two sides of the through hole correspondingly; due to the fact that the bionic driving system is arranged, continuous wriggling of animals such as caterpillars can be simulated, the whole device is driven to advance, and when the propellers of the first propeller assembly directly face the ground, the road holding force of the whole device to the ground can be increased or reduced by changing the rotating directions or the rotating speeds of the propellers.

title: Arm joint assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an arm joint assembly and a humanoid robot. The arm joint assembly comprises a shell. The hollow transmission shaft is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor; restraint rings are fixedly arranged at two ends of the inner wall of the hollow transmission shaft; the restraint ring comprises an inner ring, an outer ring and spiral arc rods which are arranged on the restraint ring in a circumferential array mode and used for connecting the inner ring and the outer ring. According to the arm joint assembly and the humanoid robot, through the structural design of the spiral arc rod and the S-shaped elastic piece, supporting acting force in the tangential direction exists between the spiral arc rod and the inner ring, part is counteracted by the supporting acting force in the torque transmission process, and the torque is reduced again through the elastic tension of the S-shaped elastic piece; the torsion transmitted to the cable is weakened, the torsion angle generated by the cable is smaller than the rotation angle of the joint, the spiral arc rod has certain flexibility in the horizontal direction, and it is guaranteed that the cable is always in a straightened state and does not make contact with the inner wall of the hollow transmission shaft.

title: Upper body structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses an upper half body structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a base, a bearing body with a cavity structure is fixedly arranged on the base, mounting supports are arranged on two sides of the top of the bearing body, each mounting support is hinged with a shoulder connected with an arm, and the shoulder is connected with the upper half body of the humanoid robot. The inner side of each shoulder is connected with one end of an electric push rod, the other end of each electric push rod is hinged to the base, and the electric push rods are used for driving the corresponding arms to perform lifting or falling actions by pushing/pulling the shoulders; wherein the two mounting supports, the shoulders and the electric push rods are symmetrically arranged by taking the middle vertical plane of the bearing body as the center, and the two electric push rods form an inverted V-shaped structure. Through reasonable design and optimization of the structure of the electric push rod, the whole layout is more compact, more space is saved, the battery capacity can be increased, and the weight of the upper half body of the robot is reduced, so that the endurance time of the humanoid robot is prolonged.

title: Foot sole supporting structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot sole supporting structure which comprises a leg device and a sole device, and further comprises supports which are oppositely arranged on the leg device, and each support is provided with a first electric rod; the first guide seats are obliquely and oppositely arranged on the sole device, and each first guide seat is connected with a first roller in a sliding manner; and the second guide seats are vertically arranged between the first guide seats. According to the foot sole supporting structure of the humanoid robot, the first electric rod is started to enable the output end of the first electric rod to extend, the bearing disc is in linkage with the connecting rod component to push the rolling wheels to move to the outer side of the foot sole device on the guide seat, and the leg device is supported; at the moment, the humanoid robot starts the driving mechanism to drive the rolling wheels to rotate, so that the robot rapidly moves through the rolling wheels, all the first rolling wheels move oppositely in the moving process, and therefore the distance between the rolling wheels is increased, the length of a chassis of the leg device is increased, and the stability of the sole device is improved.

title: Finger push rod of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of mechanical driving, and relates to a push rod, in particular to a finger push rod of a humanoid robot. By designing an integrated structure comprising the motor, the lead screw, the magnetic ring and the encoder, the overall size of the driving assembly is effectively reduced, and the applicability of the motor in the narrow space of the humanoid robot finger is improved; the bearing is arranged, and the shaft sleeve is combined to effectively support the lead screw, so that the stability and durability of the lead screw under the condition that the lead screw bears a large load are enhanced; and the connecting part is detachably connected with the fixing block, so that the finger part is convenient to assemble and replace, and the maintenance cost is reduced. The finger push rod of the humanoid robot is ingenious in structural design, the existing technical problems are solved, the performance of a driving device is improved, the service life of the driving device is prolonged, and the operation flexibility of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Flexible humanoid manipulator and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a dexterous humanoid manipulator and a robot, the dexterous humanoid manipulator comprises a palm base body and five fingers connected with the palm base body, and the five fingers sequentially comprise a little finger, a ring finger, a middle finger, an index finger and a thumb; wherein the little finger, the ring finger, the middle finger and the index finger are the same in structure, each five-connecting-rod structure is formed by three knuckles and two connecting rods, and each five-connecting-rod structure is driven by a corresponding first driving mechanism and used for enabling the fingers to conduct bending and stretching actions; and the thumb can realize three actions through the second driving mechanism, the rotary driving mechanism and the third driving mechanism, namely bending and stretching actions as well as up-and-down rotating actions and left-and-right swinging actions relative to the palm base body. According to the humanoid manipulator, the seven driving mechanisms are cooperatively controlled, various purposes of fist clenching, palm stretching or grabbing of different objects can be achieved through the five fingers, and meanwhile the humanoid manipulator has the advantages of being multiple in freedom degree, small, exquisite, flexible, similar to a human hand in size, easy to control and the like.

title: Thumb structure capable of executing various actions and humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a thumb structure capable of executing various actions and a humanoid manipulator. The thumb structure comprises a fixed base plate, a swing frame hinged to the fixed base plate, a thumb body, a first driving mechanism hinged to a connecting rod structure in the thumb body, a second driving mechanism for fixedly arranging the thumb body and the first driving mechanism on the swing frame and a third driving mechanism hinged to the side portion of the fixed base plate, and the telescopic end of the third driving mechanism is hinged to the swing frame. Wherein the first driving mechanism, the second driving mechanism and the third driving mechanism can respectively realize the flexion and extension actions of the knuckles of the thumb and the up-and-down rotation actions and the left-and-right swinging actions of the whole thumb relative to the fixed base plate, and the three actions are mutually independent and can be performed simultaneously or independently or in any two manners. The thumb structure has three degrees of freedom, is convenient to operate and control, improves the degree of simulating a human hand, can be matched with other fingers to replace the human hand, and is novel in design, reasonable and compact in layout and small in occupied space.

title: Humanoid robot body turning mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot body turning mechanism which comprises a supporting bottom plate, a robot body assembly is arranged on one side of the supporting bottom plate, and a platform assembly for a robot to stand is arranged on one side of the supporting bottom plate. Through the arrangement of the platform assembly, the connecting assemblies, the movable assembly and the turning assembly, when the robot needs to rotate the upper half body, two pushing air cylinders conduct pushing of different lengths, then the two connecting assemblies are pushed, the two connecting assemblies are matched with the movable assembly and the turning assembly, and therefore the robot can rotate the upper half body. When the robot turns around, the body connecting rods of the two connecting assemblies can swing in different amplitudes, the front-back staggered effect is achieved, the robot turns around due to the staggered twisting effect of the upper body connected with the robot, and therefore the robot can turn around rapidly, assistance of equipment such as a motor is not needed, and the effect that the size of the robot is too large is achieved.

title: Finger structure of humanoid robot and humanoid hand
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a finger structure and a humanoid hand, in particular to a finger structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid hand. Comprising a three-finger section, the three-finger section is hinged and fixed to a base plate through a first fixing part (8), and the three-finger section, a first connecting rod (4) and a second connecting rod (5) form a five-connecting-rod structure; the driving unit comprises a lead screw motor unit (7) and a connecting part (6) which are connected with each other, and based on the lead screw nut transmission principle, the connecting part (6) is driven by the lead screw motor unit (7) to do linear reciprocating motion and drives the five-connecting-rod structure to rotate around the first fixing part (8), so that the bending and stretching actions of the three finger sections are achieved. According to the finger structure, by arranging the five-connecting-rod transmission structure, the flexibility of the finger structure is effectively improved, the bending angle of the finger structure is also improved, and the use range of the finger structure is widened; and a ball screw motor is adopted as a driving mechanism, so that the load capacity of the finger structure is improved.

title: Lightweight small-inertia humanoid robot leg structure
abstract: The invention provides a light small-inertia humanoid robot leg structure, and belongs to the field of humanoid robot leg structures. The problems that an existing humanoid robot is not compact enough in leg layout, high in structural complexity and large in total weight are solved. The robot comprises a hip joint structure, a knee joint structure and an ankle joint structure, the motion end of a joint, responsible for pitching motion, of the hip joint structure is connected with the fixed end of a joint, responsible for rolling motion, of the hip joint structure through a special-shaped connecting plate, and the motion end of the joint, responsible for rolling motion, of the hip joint structure is connected with the fixed end of a joint, responsible for yawing motion, of the hip joint structure through an open type connecting plate. A knee joint fixing end of the knee joint structure is connected with a joint movement end responsible for yawing movement through a thigh connecting plate, and the knee joint movement end is connected with a shank connecting plate. Only two joints are arranged, modular design is achieved, the structure is simple, the effect of reducing the production cost and the design cost can be achieved, meanwhile, the joints can be freely replaced, the control difficulty is greatly reduced, and the error-tolerant rate of leg movement is increased.

title: Underwater biped walking robot and motion control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an underwater biped walking robot and a motion control method. The underwater biped walking robot comprises a driving unit, a head unit, a walking unit and a control unit, the driving unit is bullfrog muscles which are naturally shrunk to be in a hook shape after being dissociated, the head unit is connected with one end of the driving unit, the walking unit is connected with the hook portion of the driving unit, and the walking unit comprises feet distributed on the two sides of the driving unit. The control unit comprises a signal generator and an electrode and is used for responding to the square wave signal to generate an electric field in the conductive solution environment and controlling the driving unit to drive the walking unit to do straight movement or steering movement in different bending modes. The contraction state of bullfrog muscles is controlled through square wave signal stimulation, one bullfrog muscle can execute two movement modes of advancing and steering at the same time, the movement speed and the movement mode are controllable, and the higher movement speed is achieved.

title: Intelligent nursing robot based on medical large model
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing robot based on a large medical model, which comprises a robot main body, a rotating mechanism, a walking mechanism, a head and a control system, and can be used for providing health problems to be inquired by old people, recognizing the health problems by a voice recognizer, and transmitting the health problems to a large cloud medical model through an analysis processing control module for content generation. Dialogue communication with the elderly is carried out through the loudspeaker, and healthy life of the elderly is accompanied. And music and opera can be played through a touch screen or voice control, and a call can be dialed through a camera, a microphone and a wireless receiving and transmitting module, so that communication between the old and others is facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system, humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and system, a humanoid robot and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring walking parameters of the humanoid robot; according to the walking parameters, whether the humanoid robot resonates or not is determined; if the humanoid robot resonates, adjusting gait parameters of the humanoid robot; the motion state of the humanoid robot is obtained; if it is determined that the lateral stability of the humanoid robot cannot meet the safe walking requirement based on the motion state, the gait parameters of the humanoid robot are updated. According to the embodiment of the invention, the resonance phenomenon can be detected, the stability and walking efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Humanoid robot emotion design method and system based on neural network model
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot emotion design method and system based on a neural network model. The method comprises the following steps: generating a speech emotion evaluation word sample and a combined emotion evaluation word sample; the speech emotion evaluation word samples and the combined emotion evaluation word samples are studied and experimented, and feature elements are extracted; carrying out an orthogonal test, and designing and generating a scheme of appearance and voice combination elements; adopting a feedforward neural network and a back propagation algorithm to construct a neural network model of the relation between the subjective emotional response of the user to the humanoid robot and the appearance and voice combined elements; and optimizing the neural network model by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The system comprises a sample collection module, a feature element extraction module, a scheme design module, a neural network model construction module and a model optimization module. According to the method, the appearance and voice combination of the humanoid robot can be optimally designed by constructing the comprehensive relation model.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot emotion design method and system based on a neural network model. The method comprises the following steps: generating a speech emotion evaluation word sample and a combined emotion evaluation word sample; the speech emotion evaluation word samples and the combined emotion evaluation word samples are studied and experimented, and feature elements are extracted; carrying out an orthogonal test, and designing and generating a scheme of appearance and voice combination elements; adopting a feedforward neural network and a back propagation algorithm to construct a neural network model of the relation between the subjective emotional response of the user to the humanoid robot and the appearance and voice combined elements; and optimizing the neural network model by adopting a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The system comprises a sample collection module, a feature element extraction module, a scheme design module, a neural network model construction module and a model optimization module. According to the method, the appearance and voice combination of the humanoid robot can be optimally designed by constructing the comprehensive relation model.

title: Shoulder assembling structure, arm structure, humanoid robot and robot

title: Humanoid robot gait control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait control method, and relates to the technical field of robot adaptive control, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the lifting height of a front foot; all joints of the rear legs are controlled to rotate, so that the rear feet are located under the gravity center of the humanoid robot; after the forefoot makes contact with the object, the pressure distribution condition of the forefoot is collected; whether the forefoot state is stable or not is judged, and if not, the rotation angle of the forefoot is collected; if the rotating angle is smaller than the angle threshold value, the front leg and the rear leg are converted, otherwise, the front foot is lifted, the joint angle of the front leg is adjusted, so that the object making contact with the front foot is changed, and the pressure distribution condition of the front foot is collected again. The walking stability is improved through inward rotation of the rear legs and reverse bending of the knee joints, the front feet can feel the pressure distribution condition of the contact surface, and when environment information detected by the sensing unit is not very accurate, the adaptability of gaits to the environment is improved through pressure sensing of the front feet, and the walking stability is improved. And the walking stability of the humanoid robot is further improved.
