title: Path planning method and system for obstacle avoidance of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a path planning method and system for obstacle avoidance of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an environment image of the humanoid robot, and processing the environment image by using a self-adaptive threshold segmentation method to obtain an obstacle area and a barrier-free area; using an obstacle segmentation algorithm based on region growing to identify and obtain an obstacle contour frame; a double-view-angle monocular vision positioning method is used, and position coordinates of the obstacle in the space are obtained through calculation; and obtaining a path planning result by using a dynamic detection and branch expansion path planning algorithm. The system comprises an environment image processing module, an obstacle contour frame segmentation module, an obstacle positioning module and a path planning module. By integrating various advanced algorithms, the precision of obstacle recognition and environmental perception is improved, and efficient obstacle avoidance and stable walking of the humanoid robot in a complex environment are realized by comprehensively considering factors in multiple aspects such as environmental perception, path planning and motion control.

title: Remote rescue remote sensing information processing method of biped rescue robot and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a remote rescue remote sensing information processing method of a biped rescue robot and a related device, the method is applied to a teleoperation system terminal, and the method comprises the steps that first information of a disaster area is acquired, and the first information comprises the temperature of the disaster area, the smoke concentration of the disaster area, the video information of the disaster area and the audio information of the disaster area; determining a first index for measuring the disaster degree of the disaster area according to the first information; according to the first information, whether there is a person to be rescued in the affected area is judged; determining a target rescue measure according to the first index and a preset disaster degree threshold if it is detected that there is a person to be rescued in the disaster area; and rescuing the to-be-rescued person according to the target rescue measure. title: Humanoid robot charging control method, system and device, medium and charging pile
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot charging control method, system and device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a charging request of a humanoid robot in a preset charging area; determining a current pose of the humanoid robot according to the charging request; judging whether the current pose is the same as a preset pose or not; if yes, the charging gun is controlled to move towards the humanoid robot, and when the distance between the charging gun and the humanoid robot is equal to a preset threshold value, a first control instruction is sent to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot opens the charging cover by a preset angle, and the charging gun is continuously controlled to be inserted into the humanoid robot for charging; if not, a second control instruction is sent to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot leaves the preset charging area, after the humanoid robot adjusts the current pose to the preset pose, the humanoid robot is controlled again to enter the preset area, and the step of receiving the charging request of the humanoid robot in the preset charging area is executed again. title: Robot humanoid behavior planning and control method facing close physical interaction
abstract: The invention relates to a close physical interaction-oriented robot humanoid behavior planning and control method. The method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring demonstration data of close interaction between a robot and a human through motion capture; s2, based on the demonstration data, obtaining a plurality of human behavior pattern categories by using priori knowledge and clustering analysis; s3, on the basis of human behavior pattern categories, segmenting and calibrating demonstration data to obtain multiple groups of motion primitive sequences comprising class behavior pattern labels, constructing a hierarchical directed graph, and training to obtain a robot behavior planner; and S4, constructing a dynamic consistent mapping model between the target trajectory and the action space, and realizing robot humanoid behavior planning and control based on the mapping model and the planner. abstract: The invention discloses a sensing system and method for humanoid robot joints, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the system comprises humanoid robot four limbs and joints, a camera, a processor and a calibration board, the joints comprise shoulder joints, elbow joints, wrist joints and end actuators, and/or hip joints, knee joints, ankle joints and end actuators; the camera is composed of a binocular camera module and a TOF module, the camera and the processor are located on joints of the humanoid robot, and the processor calibrates the position, processes data obtained by the camera and outputs a control instruction to control the end effector. title: Biped robot landing point planning method based on NURBS curve, computer readable storage medium and foot device
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot landing point planning method based on an NURBS curve, a computer readable storage medium and a foot device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a foot starting point, a foot falling point and a leg swinging height of the biped robot as control points of an NURBS curve; generating an initial landing point trajectory curve based on the control point, and solving a first-order derivative of the initial landing point trajectory curve to obtain the speed of an actual landing point; the speed of the actual landing point is compared with the speed of an expected landing point, and when the absolute value of the error between the speed of the actual landing point and the speed of the expected landing point is smaller than or equal to a preset value, a control landing point track curve is obtained; and according to the control landing point track curve, the swing of the swing legs of the biped robot is controlled. The speed of the foothold relative to the ground is matched with the speed of the robot relative to the ground, and the swinging state and the supporting state of the motion of the foot type robot are combined, so that the switching of the motion states is smoother, and the walking speed of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot doubly salient memory motor optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot doubly salient memory motor optimization method, relates to the technical field of electric transmission control equipment, and aims to solve the problems that high-coercive-force permanent magnets, low-coercive-force permanent magnets and windings of a humanoid robot doubly salient memory motor are all arranged on a stator side, and the two permanent magnets interfere with each other, so that the space in a stator slot is limited, and the stability of the humanoid robot doubly salient memory motor is influenced. The stator slot area needs to be optimized. The method comprises the following steps: starting from meeting the requirements of magnetic load and torque density performance indexes of the doubly salient memory motor, giving the magnetic load and torque density indexes, and proposing a Pareto weighted objective function to quantify a sample database in multi-attribute decisions of the two indexes so as to obtain an optimal solution; a linear relation between a doubly salient memory motor structure parameter and an optimization performance index is measured through a Pearson coefficient, and sensitivity is introduced to evaluate the comprehensive influence of two permanent magnets on a magnetic load and a torque density optimization target. And finally, the sine performance effect of the no-load back electromotive force after optimization of the doubly salient memory motor is better than that of the no-load back electromotive force before optimization.

title: Humanoid robot mass center smooth curve generation method, storage medium and generator
abstract: The invention provides a method for generating a smooth curve of the center of mass of a humanoid robot. The generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring the accelerated speed of the humanoid robot along with the time change in the walking process; obtaining first position data of the humanoid robot through integral calculation according to the acceleration; discretizing the first position data to obtain second position data corresponding to a plurality of time points at equal intervals; defining a basic spline primary function, and obtaining a high-order basic spline primary function through recursive calculation; fitting according to the high-order basic spline primary function and the second position data to obtain a basic spline function curve; according to the curve derivative of the basic spline function curve, a second spline coefficient is obtained, the second spline coefficient is substituted into the basic spline curve, the final mass center track is obtained, it is guaranteed that the mass center track of the humanoid robot in the walking process is smooth and continuous, the impact force of the robot in the double-foot switching process is reduced, and the walking efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved. And the movement stability and reliability are improved.

title: Multi-dimensional tactile perception humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The humanoid dexterous hand is composed of a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger, a little finger, an intra-palm sensor and a finger surface sensor, wherein the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are similar in structure. The thumb is provided with two knuckles, and the thumb base has one degree of freedom and can move transversely; each of the other fingers is provided with three knuckles. And each finger is driven by a rope driving device and is reset by a built-in spring mechanism. Each finger surface is provided with a finger surface sensor, the in-palm sensor is an array sensor, and the in-palm sensor and the finger surface sensors are magnetic multi-dimensional sensing films.

title: High-load human-shaped finger joint mechanism
abstract: The invention provides a high-load human-shaped finger joint mechanism, and relates to the technical field of human-shaped finger joints, the high-load human-shaped finger joint mechanism comprises a first finger section, a second finger section and a cycloidal speed reducer, a motor is arranged in the first finger section or the second finger section, and the axis of the motor is parallel to the axis of the cycloidal speed reducer; the cycloidal speed reducer comprises a pin wheel housing connected with the first finger section, and an input eccentric shaft driven by a motor through gear transmission is arranged in the pin wheel housing. Two cycloidal gears are installed outside the input eccentric shaft, a plurality of roller pins are arranged between the two cycloidal gears and the pin wheel housing, and an output shaft and a shaft cover are installed at the two ends of the input eccentric shaft. A plurality of pin holes are formed in the two cycloidal gears in a circumferential array mode, pins are arranged in the pin holes in one-to-one correspondence in the two cycloidal gears in a penetrating mode, one ends of the pins penetrate through the output shaft to be in interference fit with the second finger section, and the other ends of the pins penetrate through the shaft cover to be connected with nuts; pin sleeves coaxial with the pins are arranged outside the pins, the axes of the two pin holes through which the pins penetrate and the axis of the pins are eccentrically arranged and are always symmetrical about the axis of the pins, and the pin sleeves are always in symmetrical contact with the inner walls of the two corresponding pin holes.

title: Head and neck assembly and humanoid robot

title: INTEGRATED POWER SYSTEM BASED ON TOOTHED BELT STRUCTURE AND EXOSKELETON ROBOT
abstract: An integrated power system based on toothed belt structure includes a base plate, and a drive motor, a reduction gear mechanism, a synchronous belt mechanism for power transmission and a torque output mechanism sequentially arranged on the base plate, the reduction gear mechanism includes a first gear set and a second gear set to reduce an output rotation speed of the drive motor respectively located on two sides of the base plate. An exoskeleton robot includes the above integrated power system, a back structure of main body, a leg structure of femur portion hinged with a waist portion of the back structure of main body, and a leg structure of fibula portion coupled with a base body fastener, the leg structure of fibula portion is coupled with the actuator.

title: Method for avoiding autologous interference of hip joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot hip joint autologous interference avoidance method, which effectively solves the problem that autologous interference is easy to occur when a humanoid robot hip joint executes large-amplitude or complex actions by arranging a data communication layer, an interference inspection layer and a joint execution layer, the data communication layer is used for acquiring the position, speed and torque measured values of a hip joint motor through a bottom-layer hip joint motor communication module and acquiring the position, speed and torque expected values of the hip joint motor through a high-layer operation control algorithm module; the interference inspection layer is used for comprehensively solving the self-interference problem of the hip joint and improving the movement efficiency and flexibility of the humanoid robot through single-side working space planning, three-dimensional safety boundary establishment and real-time dynamic monitoring, and the joint execution layer is used for generating hip joint position, speed and torque instructions in real time through dynamic monitoring and transmitting the hip joint position, speed and torque instructions to a hip joint PD controller. And the hip joint PD controller generates a hip joint motor torque instruction and controls the tail end of the hip joint to generate interference-free motion.

title: Humanoid robot multi-modal interaction method and device based on large language model
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot multi-mode interaction method and device based on a large language model, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the voice of a user, and converting the voice into an original input text in response to a received user output voice command which is matched with a preset wake-up instruction of a humanoid robot; based on the original input text, generating a text matched with the current situation by utilizing a large language model, and for an output text corresponding to the text matched with the current situation, converting the output text into voice and outputting the voice; the method comprises the following steps: analyzing interaction contents of a large language model, and selecting a continuous human shape action sequence with the highest matching degree from a plurality of preset candidate human shape action sequences; on the premise of considering the size difference between the virtual human body and the actual robot and the joint angle error, the generated humanoid action sequence is mapped to the humanoid robot, and multi-modal interaction is achieved. The method has the advantages of high-precision low-delay real-time voice recognition, high voice action matching degree and the like.

title: Shoulder joint structure and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention discloses a mounting cabinet, a battery module, a trunk assembly and a humanoid robot, the mounting cabinet is used for the humanoid robot, and the mounting cabinet comprises a mounting plate, a buffer structure and a plug connector; the mounting plate comprises a first surface and a second surface which are opposite in a first direction; the buffer structure is arranged on the mounting plate and protrudes out of the first surface, the buffer structure comprises a boss and an elastic piece, the boss is arranged on the first surface, the boss and the mounting plate are provided with containing holes extending in the first direction and penetrating through the boss and the mounting plate, at least part of the elastic piece is contained in the containing hole, and one end of the elastic piece extends out of the boss from the containing hole; the elastic piece extends out of the end face of the boss and is elastically abutted against the battery assembly. title: Wearing equipment, control method and control device of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides wearable equipment of a humanoid robot, a control method and a control device. The wearable device comprises a covering and a pressure sensing module, the covering can cover at least part of the area of the body of the humanoid robot, the pressure sensing module is arranged on the surface of the covering, and the pressure sensing module can collect multiple real-time pressure values of different areas of the surface of the body of the humanoid robot when the humanoid robot wears the wearable device. And transmitting the plurality of real-time pressure values to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot determines whether a collision occurs at present according to the plurality of real-time pressure values, and stops moving under the condition of determining that the collision occurs at present. Therefore, the humanoid robot can stop moving immediately when collision occurs, so that injury to personnel is avoided, and the safety of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Foot lifting movement training method and device for humanoid robot, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid robot foot lifting movement training method and device, electronic equipment and a medium. A specific embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring current observation sample information; generating simulated elevation terrain information; inputting the current observation sample information into an action network to obtain an action probability distribution value set; inputting the current observation sample information into a strategy network to obtain an action evaluation value set; generating a target joint position set according to the action probability distribution numerical value set and the action evaluation value set; inputting the target joint position set into a joint response controller to generate a joint torque set; controlling the humanoid robot to carry out foot lifting and moving training; and ending the training of the motor position control network. According to the embodiment, the humanoid robot is controlled to carry out foot lifting movement training on the rough ground through the motor position control network and the joint response controller, and the movement stability of the humanoid robot and the performance and pertinence of the motor position control network can be improved.

title: Self-adaptive control method for hand joints of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive control method for hand joints of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a position vector of a geometric center point of a grabbing surface by using pressure sensors mounted at the tail ends of fingers; calculating expected pressure and actual pressure vectors of the tail ends of the fingers; and calculating a finger end point position correction vector by using the contact elastic coefficient matrix to realize self-adaptive correction of the end point position. The method has the advantages that objects can be grabbed in a self-adaptive mode according to the set contact elastic coefficient only through the pressure sensors installed at the tail ends of the fingers, the flexibility is adjustable, the algorithm is simple, and the method is suitable for various humanoid robots with different finger numbers.

title: Modularized humanoid mechanical arm with flexible touch sensor

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises a small arm assembly, the small arm assembly comprises a small arm, a wrist framework, a first wrist joint driving piece and a second wrist joint driving piece, the small arm is provided with an elbow joint end and a wrist joint end, and the first wrist joint driving piece, the wrist framework, the second wrist joint driving piece and the wrist joint end are sequentially connected. The first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially arranged in the axial direction of the forearm, the first wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the hand assembly to rotate around a first reference axis, and the second wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the wrist skeleton to rotate around a second reference axis; the first reference axis, the second reference axis and the axis of the small arm are perpendicular to one another. According to the mechanical arm, the mode that the first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially connected in series is adopted to replace a traditional motor parallel connection and connecting rod transmission matching scheme, the structure of the small arm assembly is simplified, and the weight of the mechanical arm is reduced.

title: Biped robot intelligent control method based on attitude synthesis control network
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot intelligent control method based on a posture synthesis control network. The biped robot intelligent control method comprises the steps that S1, three kinds of 3D human body posture data of walking, jumping and turning are collected, data are marked, and a data set is generated; s2, setting an attitude constraint reward function and a task reward function; s3, constructing a state variation auto-encoder which comprises an encoder, a state network and a decoder, setting a loss function of the state variation auto-encoder, and training the state variation auto-encoder to obtain a pre-training model; and S4, constructing and training a posture synthesis control framework, synthesizing a posture sequence through the posture synthesis control framework, performing biped robot joint adaptation on postures, and deploying the postures into the biped robot to realize intelligent control of the biped robot. According to the method, the utilization rate of the motion data is improved, and the performance of the biped robot in the aspect of coping with complex tasks is improved.

title: Bionic femur and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic femur and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of bionic robotics.The bionic femur comprises a first beam body, a first butt joint structure is arranged at one end of the first beam body and used for connecting knee joints, and a second butt joint structure is arranged at the other end of the first beam body and used for connecting a driving source; the outer surface of the first beam body is provided with multiple sections of continuous cambered surfaces, the cambered surfaces protrude outwards, and the curvature values of the multiple sections of cambered surfaces are gradually increased from the first butt joint structure to the second butt joint structure. Different arc-shaped sections are arranged on the outer surface of the first beam body to simulate natural bending of the thighbone of the human body, received impact force or load can be better absorbed and dispersed, direct impact on the bionic thighbone is reduced, the service life is effectively prolonged, and the probability of fatigue damage under high-strength dynamic response is reduced.

title: Depression identification method and device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a depression identification method and device and a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal time sequence data of a depression patient acquired by acquisition equipment; performing depression identification preprocessing operation according to the multi-modal time sequence data to obtain a first feature vector matrix; extracting the first feature vector matrix to obtain a spatial proximity matrix and a pixel value similarity matrix; inputting the spatial proximity matrix and the pixel value similarity matrix into a pre-configured bilateral filter for noise reduction and smoothing to obtain a second feature vector matrix; setting identification priorities for feature vectors in the second feature vector matrix to obtain a third feature vector matrix; inputting the third feature vector matrix into a pre-configured LSTM recognition model to obtain a recognition result; according to the invention, depression identification is carried out by using the bilateral filter and priority setting, so that the automatic identification accuracy of depression is improved.

title: Electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses an electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand, which belongs to the technical field of robots, and comprises a palm and three fingers, namely a thumb, an index finger and a self-adaptive flexible finger; the thumb and the index finger are of three-degree-of-freedom structures and can be bent; the finger root part of the self-adaptive flexible finger is driven to rotate through the driving unit so as to be matched with the thumb and the index finger to grab an object, and the self-adaptive flexible finger can adapt to the shape of the object. The electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand adopts less active degrees of freedom, and more active degrees of freedom are distributed to the index finger and the thumb, so that the problem that the cost and the dexterous operation capability are difficult to balance due to the selection and distribution of degrees of freedom of the existing humanoid dexterous hand is solved.

title: Biped robot with anti-motion joint legs, humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot with reverse motion joint legs, a humanoid robot and a robot. The shank is only provided with an upper connecting end, an extending section and a lower connecting end; a sole; and a joint module. Wherein the thigh is hinged to the upper connecting end, no driving element is arranged on the extending section, the joint module is fixedly connected with the lower connecting end, and an output flange of the joint module is fixedly connected with the sole. The biped robot with the anti-motion joint legs is provided with the foot soles, the foot soles are directly driven by the joint modules, so that the requirements of various walking postures of the robot are met, light weight and miniaturization of the robot are considered, the robot can still keep the motion ability after being provided with the foot soles, and the requirements of current teaching experiments and engineering tests are met.

title: Intelligent voice noise reduction interaction method and system of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent voice noise reduction interaction method and system of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of collecting sound source information; obtaining target sound source position information according to the sound source information; collecting audio data; obtaining target audio data according to the target sound source position information and the audio data; and completing noise reduction processing according to the target audio data. The voice recognition accuracy of the humanoid robot in a complex acoustic environment can be improved.

title: Wearable man-machine co-fusion wheel-foot robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots, and particularly relates to a wearable man-machine co-fusion wheel-foot robot which comprises a connecting platform, a left wheel leg, a right wheel leg, a butt joint module, a connecting spine and a lock catch. The left wheel leg comprises a thigh, a transmission connecting rod group, a shank and a wheel group; the shank comprises an ankle joint motor layout assembly, two ankle joint connecting rod lead screws and carbon tubes, a shank carbon tube, a knee-shank connecting plate and an ankle joint assembly; the thigh and the transmission connecting rod group are movably connected with the knee-shank connecting plate and the swinging motor; the shank carbon tube is connected with the knee-shank connecting plate, and the other two ends of the shank carbon tube are connected with the wheel set and the ankle joint motor layout assembly respectively; the two ankle joint connecting rod lead screws and the carbon tube are movably connected with the ankle joint motor layout assembly and the wheel set respectively; by driving the two ankle joint connecting rod lead screws and the carbon tubes to move, stable switching of the wheels and the feet is achieved; through the butt joint module, the spine and the lock catch, butt joint with the human body is achieved, left-right translation and swinging of the spine are achieved, and the wearing restraint feeling is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot wireless charging system and charging method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot wireless charging system and a charging method thereof, and the charging system comprises a wireless charging blanket composed of a base blanket, a ferrite, a wireless electromagnetic flow beam transmitting coil, a pressure sensor, a photoelectric sensor and a visual beacon, and a visual camera and a wireless electromagnetic flow beam receiving converter which are disposed on a humanoid robot. The system further comprises a wireless communication server and a processor. When the humanoid robot is located on the wireless charging blanket, the pressure sensor, the photoelectric sensor and the visual camera correspondingly obtain the instant pressure and position posture of the humanoid robot on the wireless charging blanket and the rechargeable battery information of the humanoid robot. The processor processes the information and then carries out electromagnetic flow beam emission switch, intensity and direction regulation and control on a wireless electromagnetic flow beam emission unit which is composed of at least one wireless electromagnetic flow beam emission coil and ferrite and is located nearby the wireless electromagnetic flow beam receiving converter. And dynamic wireless charging under all working conditions is carried out on the humanoid robot in standing or advancing operation.

title: Humanoid robot hand
abstract: The present invention provides a humanoid robot hand that is improved so that the motion of flexing and extending the finger joints of the robot hand resembles the motion of actual muscles. The robot hand of the present invention comprises a palm plate (1) on which a thumb (2), an index finger (3), a middle finger (4), a ring finger (5), and a little finger (6) are arranged at predetermined positions. The thumb (2), index finger (3), middle finger (4), ring finger (5), and little finger (6) are each formed by a finger assembly (7). Furthermore, the long joint frame (8), the middle joint frame (9), and the short joint frame (10) of the finger assembly (7) are axially connected by first to third central two-row pulleys (12), (14), and (16), which are axially supported by first to third pivot axes (13), (15), and (17).

title: Method and system for teleoperation of humanoid robot through tracker and data glove
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for remotely operating a humanoid robot through a tracker and a data glove, and the method comprises the following steps: capturing the position and posture of a hand in a three-dimensional space based on the tracker, and taking the posture information of the tracker as the expected posture of the tail end of the humanoid robot; each joint angle of the mechanical arm is solved based on a Cartesian motion control inverse kinematics method, and the humanoid robot mechanical arm is controlled to move to the expected position and posture; the motion of the fingers is captured based on the data glove, the finger joint bending angle captured by the data glove is mapped to the manipulator joint of the humanoid robot, the joint angle of the manipulator is obtained, and the fingers of the manipulator of the humanoid robot are controlled to move to the specified angle position based on the joint angle of the manipulator. The posture of the hand and the movement of the fingers are mapped to the real humanoid robot on the basis of the tracker and the data glove, the flexible operation task of the two hands is completed, the intuition of remote operation is improved, and meanwhile the burden of a user is reduced.

title: Robot-perceived terrain recognition gait control method, system, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention provides a robot sensing terrain recognition gait control method and system, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot sensing. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pitch angle data and plantar force data of the biped robot on the basis of optimal plantar force; inputting the pitch angle data and the plantar force data into a trained KNN model, and identifying the current walking terrain of the robot to obtain a terrain identification result; the training process of the KNN model comprises the steps that the biped robot is driven to pass through a rugged terrain and a flat terrain in a fixed stride frequency gait mode, pitch angle sample data and plantar force sample data passing through different terrains are collected and input into the KNN model, and the KNN model is used for conducting terrain classification; and the robot controller receives a terrain recognition result, and adjusts the stride frequency and the gait of the robot according to a preset gait control strategy based on the result. According to the method, an additional sensor does not need to be added to the robot, and the terrain can be identified only through state feedback of the robot.

title: Motion recognition and simulation method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an action recognition and imitation method and system of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a static scene view containing a to-be-recognized moving target from an original moving video; separating from the static scene view to obtain a moving target; tracking the motion trail of the moving target; performing fusion action feature extraction on the moving target to obtain a moving target fusion action feature vector; training the training data set by adopting the target fusion action feature vector, and combining static recognition and dynamic recognition to obtain action description of the moving target; and sending the action description to the humanoid robot for action simulation. The system comprises a static scene view extraction module, a moving target separation module, a motion trajectory tracking module, a feature vector extraction module, a label labeling module, a 3D convolution space-time network model establishment module and an action execution module. By fusing static recognition and dynamic recognition, more accurate action description and more efficient action simulation are realized.

title: End-to-end humanoid robot operation behavior and skill training method and digital simulation system
abstract: The invention discloses an end-to-end humanoid robot operation behavior and skill training method and a digital simulation system, by developing a humanoid robot in the digital simulation system, efficient generalization learning, skill training and migration capabilities are obtained, various non-preset task scenes are quickly adapted, and the training efficiency is improved. The problems that the humanoid robot is complex in development environment and high in development cost are solved. The method comprises the following steps: creating a humanoid robot digital prototype model based on a simulation engine; collecting data and generating a data set through the humanoid robot digital prototype model; constructing a learning algorithm library of operation behaviors of the humanoid robot; based on the learning algorithm library, designing an operation behavior and skill model of the humanoid robot; based on the simulation data set and the learning algorithm library, training operation behaviors and skill models of the humanoid robot, and creating skill libraries of different tasks and scenes; and calling the skill library, executing tasks of the humanoid robot, and performing iterative optimization on the skill library.

title: Hydraulic power autonomous wheel-legged humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic power autonomous wheel-legged humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The problems that an existing humanoid robot is weak in maneuverability and poor in load bearing capacity, a hydraulic driving unit and a power unit are connected through a rubber hose, and the flexibility of joint movement and robot movement is affected are solved. A shoulder part is installed at the top end of a trunk, two electro-hydraulic hybrid drive operation arms are arranged on the two sides of the shoulder part respectively, a big arm connecting part is movably connected with the shoulder part, the big arm connecting part is movably connected with a big arm moving part, a small arm connecting part is movably connected with the big arm moving part, and the small arm connecting part is movably connected with a small arm moving part. The forearm movable part is movably connected with the hydraulic manipulator, the trunk is movably connected with the waist part, two wheel legs are arranged on the two sides of the waist part respectively, and the thighs are movably connected with the waist part and the shanks. The maneuverability, the load bearing capacity and the movement flexibility of the robot are improved.

title: Humanoid intelligent driving track planning method based on RCSM-PL network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent driving track prediction, in particular to a humanoid intelligent driving track planning method based on an RCSM-PL network. Comprising the following steps of 1, collecting driving control track data, 2, analyzing the driving control track data collected in the step 1, 3, extracting track data characteristics in a radar map processed in the step 2 and an original image, and 4, extracting track data characteristics in the radar map and the original image processed in the step 2. Step 5, according to the fact that future track points, electric quantity and dynamic characteristic parameters output by the compensation network obtained in the step 4 have relatively strong correlation in time, a multi-head attention mechanism is used for learning the space characteristics of the driving track extracted in the step 3 through linear transformation of different dimensions, so that the mapping capability of the network is enhanced; the LSTM network is used as a basic structure to capture and memorize a long-term dependency relationship in a time sequence.

title: Method and system for assisting walking of biped robot by using vacuum adsorption device
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for assisting a biped robot to walk by using a vacuum adsorption device. The method and the system aim at providing an effective mode, so that the biped robot walks more stably and efficiently in an uneven environment or an environment with a low-friction surface. By means of the vacuum adsorption device, the adhesive force between the biped robot and the ground can be increased in the walking process, and therefore the stability is enhanced, and the slipping risk is reduced.

abstract: The invention discloses a digital human action driving method and device, and relates to the technical field of computer vision. According to the method and the device, the voice information is processed by using the first model subjected to common sense training and emotion training, and the emotion is judged by using common sense in the processing process, so that the recognition of the model on the emotion in the voice information in a use scene without context semantic support can be remarkably improved. After emotion parameters are obtained, the emotion parameters are sent to the second model to be processed, action parameters are obtained, and finally digital human action driving is carried out based on the action parameters.

title: Hand-imitated two-finger grabbing multi-mode mechanism for multi-mode movement of grabbed object

title: Flow and flow direction control system suitable for joint swing of hydrodynamic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of valve control, and discloses a flow and flow direction control system (control system for short) suitable for joint swing of a hydrodynamic humanoid robot. According to the control system, a rotary flow control valve technology is applied, and the flow and the flow direction of joint swing of the hydrodynamic force humanoid robot are controlled by controlling the rotating direction and the rotating angle of a stepping motor of a rotary flow control valve. The control system mainly comprises a stepping motor of the rotary flow control valve, a driver, a single-chip microcomputer controller, a rotation angle position signal device and a humanoid robot computer control center. According to the control system, the rotating angle range of the stepping motor is controlled to swing between the center of the opening D and the center of the opening F in the center of the outlet B by utilizing the position characteristics of the opening and the outlet of the rotary flow control valve and the rotating characteristic of the stepping motor, grading is carried out according to the flow change, and the control program is simplified. The control system adopts a rotation angle position signal device to carry out closed-loop control.

title: Humanoid robot flexible assembly method and system based on thinking chain and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot flexible assembly method and system based on a thinking chain and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. title: MPC-based biped robot standing balance control method
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot standing balance control method based on MPC, and relates to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring an external reference signal in a future T time interval; s2, acquiring a current robot state through state estimation; s3, constructing a robot centroid dynamics prediction model based on a single rigid body model, setting a grounding sliding constraint and a sole overturning constraint, and converting a problem into a QP problem for solving; s4, solving an optimal input sequence according to an external reference signal and a robot state; s5, retaining the first-step supporting force and the moment of force of the optimal sequence, and abandoning the predicted values of the remaining steps; s6, calculating a force jacobian matrix of the robot; and S7, the supporting force and the torque are mapped to the joints and issued to all motors. The ground reaction force during standing is directly calculated through the MPC, the supporting force and torque distribution of the two feet are optimized, the precision and stability of balance control are improved, frequent state switching is avoided, foot sole overturning is effectively prevented, and the safety and reliability of the system are enhanced.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system, a storage medium and a program product, and belongs to the field of computer vision. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing expert action data, and processing the expert action data into expert data equivalent to a skeleton architecture of a target robot; in a simulation environment, a humanoid structure is adopted to build a robot, joint parameters of the robot are configured, and the degree of freedom of each joint is controlled by an independent physical control module; constructing a strategy representation method of the robot, wherein the strategy representation method comprises a state space, an action space, a reward function and a multi-frame control mode; the robot is initialized; and the difference between the robot action and the expert action on each frame is minimized, the reward function is maximized, and the robot is driven to learn. The method can assist the learning process of the humanoid robot, so that the robot can be personified while completing tasks, and the training speed is improved.

title: Humanoid expression robot head
abstract: The invention provides a human expression simulation robot head which comprises a head frame, an eye platform is arranged in the head frame, eyeball bodies are connected between the eye platform and the head frame through elastic limiting pieces, and the two sides of the head frame in the width direction are each provided with one eyeball body; an operation connecting rod is arranged on the eye platform and arranged in the direction of the connecting line of the two eyeball bodies. A parallelogram-like mechanism is formed by the head, the operation connecting rod, the transmission connecting rod and the rack of the humanoid expression robot, the parallelogram-like mechanism plays a role in transmission and stable supporting in the movement process of the two eyeball bodies, and on the premise that only the operation connecting rod is operated and controlled, the movement of the two eyeball bodies is facilitated. Synchronous movement of the two eyeball bodies in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction is achieved, and compared with a complex multi-joint control mode, the control difficulty is lowered through the design, and the reliability of the system is improved.

title: Five-degree-of-freedom leg for amphibious humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of foot type robots, in particular to a five-degree-of-freedom leg for an amphibious humanoid robot. The rehabilitation training device comprises a waist assembly, hip assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the waist assembly respectively, thigh assemblies are arranged on the two hip assemblies, shank assemblies matched with the thigh assemblies are arranged on the thigh assemblies, and foot assemblies are arranged on the shank assemblies. The humanoid robot is compact and reasonable in structural design, a five-degree-of-freedom driving mode is adopted, the problem of convenient underwater movement of the humanoid robot is effectively solved, the angle of the humanoid robot can be adjusted at will underwater so that the upper body of the humanoid robot can execute commands conveniently, the humanoid robot is suitable for amphibious working scenes, the universality of the humanoid robot is improved, and the humanoid robot is suitable for popularization and application. The problems in the prior art are solved.

title: Humanoid robot complete machine performance testing device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of measurement and testing, in particular to a humanoid robot complete machine performance testing device, which comprises a testing assembly, a testing assembly and a testing assembly, and is characterized in that the testing assembly comprises an experiment table and an analyzer main body, and the analyzer main body is placed in the middle of the upper surface of the experiment table; the limiting assembly comprises an L-shaped connecting plate, a round through hole, a locking rod, an adjustable connecting rod, a baffle, a first groove, a spring column and a pressing plate, the adjustable connecting rod is fixed to the two sides of the experiment table, the middle of the side edge of the baffle is fixed to one end of the adjustable connecting rod, the first groove is formed in the middle of the upper end of the baffle, and the lower end of the spring column is fixed to the inner bottom face of the first groove; one end of the lower surface of the pressing plate is fixed to the upper end of the spring column and movably connected to the upper end of the baffle. The problem that when an existing plantar pressure analyzer is used and placed on an experiment table, when a robot walks, an analyzer body slightly slides, and then the pressure receiving precision of a pressure sensor is affected is solved.

title: Assembly type decoupling six-dimensional force measuring platform
abstract: The invention discloses an assembly type decoupling six-dimensional force measuring platform. The force measuring platform comprises an upper elastic force measuring body, a lower elastic force measuring body, an elastic column and an elastic motion branch chain. The upper elastic force measuring body comprises an upper center block, a vertical double-connecting-hole structure, an elastic beam and an angle block, the lower elastic force measuring body comprises a lower center block and a horizontal double-connecting-hole structure, the upper center block and the lower center block are connected through an elastic column, one end of the vertical double-connecting-hole structure is connected with the upper center block, and the other end of the vertical double-connecting-hole structure is connected with the angle block through the elastic beam. One end of the horizontal double-connecting-hole structure is connected with the end block of the lower center block, the other end of the horizontal double-connecting-hole structure is connected with the angle block through the elastic movement branch chain, and the vertical double-connecting-hole structure and the horizontal double-connecting-hole structure are both provided with strain gauges. According to the invention, detection and sensing of forces and moments in three orthogonal directions can be realized at the same time, coupling crosstalk among components is avoided, the difficulty of a decoupling algorithm is effectively reduced, and the method is suitable for application occasions of gait force sensing of humanoid and wheel-foot robots, biomechanical test platforms, high-end manufacturing equipment and the like.

title: Temperature control heat consumption balancing device and system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot temperature control heat consumption balancing device and system.The device comprises a humanoid robot, and digital temperature sensors are arranged on a CPU, a battery pack and driving motors at joint positions in the humanoid robot; a trunk and four limbs in the humanoid robot are each provided with a programmable cooling fan for active cooling and cooling fins for passive cooling, and the trunk and the four limbs in the humanoid robot are each provided with an efficient and low-noise air duct. The system comprises the device, an acquisition module, a monitoring module, a planning module and a control module. According to the method, the accuracy of temperature prediction of the humanoid robot parts is improved, and equipment damage caused by abnormal temperature is effectively prevented; temperature data with tendency and seasonal fluctuation can be processed, and the applicability of the model is improved; integration and application in an existing robot system are easy; temperature abnormity can be found in time, and stable operation of the humanoid robot is guaranteed.

title: Anti-shake semantic SLAM method and device for biped humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-shake semantic SLAM method and device for a biped humanoid robot and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of semantic map construction. The anti-jitter semantic SLAM method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring continuous video frames captured by a camera, and performing semantic segmentation based on an open vocabulary on each video frame to obtain a segmentation instance result of each frame; s2, constructing a Gaussian ball in a three-dimensional space based on continuous video frames captured by a camera, and carrying out initialization processing on the Gaussian ball; and S3, performing optimization processing on the preliminarily estimated six-degree-of-freedom pose of the biped humanoid robot and the initially constructed three-dimensional scene semantic map, and outputting the optimized six-degree-of-freedom pose and three-dimensional scene semantic map. Through semantic understanding and the semantic segmentation method based on the open vocabulary, the positioning precision and the map construction quality are improved, and the flexibility and generalization ability of the method in real world application are enhanced.

title: Fingerprint-imitating high-sensitivity flexible sensor capable of identifying direction and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a fingerprint-imitating high-sensitivity flexible sensor capable of identifying directions and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of flexible sensors. The capacitive pressure sensor array and the CPU connected with the capacitive pressure sensor array are used for detecting the magnitude and direction of the acting force between the pre-recognition material and the fingerprint bionic texture, and the periodic surface texture information of the pre-recognition material is detected. According to the capacitive pressure sensor, the strip-shaped air gaps are formed in the dielectric layer, so that the insulativity of the capacitive pressure sensor can be improved, and the capacitive pressure sensor can recognize the direction more accurately. Meanwhile, the strip-shaped air gap can significantly enhance the deformation and pressure response of the sensor, thereby improving the sensitivity of the sensor, preventing the material from being broken, and prolonging the service life. The fingerprint bionic texture has a ridge line structure, and each fingerprint is equivalent to an amplification lever, so that the sensitivity of the sensor is further enhanced. According to the method, a new research direction is provided for restoring the perception ability of the handicapped and researching the humanoid tactile receptor applied to the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot action training method based on wearable limb action recognition
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action training method based on wearable limb action recognition, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. A whole body dynamic capturing device based on an MEMS is utilized, an action training engineer wears the whole body dynamic capturing device based on the MEMS, wireless connection with a humanoid robot is established, and all action data of the action training engineer are obtained; all the captured action data are transmitted to a joint control system lower computer of the humanoid robot in real time, and the joint rotation action data drive all joints to move; and the joint control system stores the action data to an action database, and performs action data training by using a large language model (LLM) to obtain a motor nerve center system of the humanoid robot. According to the method, the action data acquisition efficiency is improved, the acquisition cost is reduced, a massive action database better conforming to ergonomics is obtained, a humanoid robot movement nerve center system is trained in combination with a large model, and various subdivision application scene databases are formed. And the humanoid robot can serve human beings in various fields earlier and faster.

title: Humanoid robot joint module performance test system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of measurement and testing, in particular to a humanoid robot joint module performance testing system which comprises a testing frame and a top frame fixed to the surface of the testing frame and further comprises a compression resistance testing assembly arranged above the testing frame. The stress condition in an actual working state can be better simulated, accurate data support is provided for performance test and optimization of the joint module, the required pressure can be accurately applied under different test conditions by adjusting the output pressure of the loading hydraulic cylinder, the joint module is positioned by the positioning claw and the positioning block, and the test efficiency is improved. The pressure resistance and stability of the joint module in actual use can be better known, accurate data support is provided for design and optimization of a robot, deviation of measured data such as pressure and deformation caused by deviation of the joint module in the testing process is avoided, and therefore accurate performance testing data are obtained.

title: Humanoid robot joint wire harness connecting structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint wire harness connecting structure, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and provides the following scheme that the humanoid robot joint wire harness connecting structure comprises a robot joint structure, and the robot joint structure is arranged in a cavity defined by two rubber air bag structures; the rubber sleeve is tightened on the elastic connecting hoop through the tightening iron wire, so that the rubber air bag structures can be fixed, the connecting position of the two rubber air bag structures can be tightened through the two fixed sealing hoops and the bolts, and after the two rubber air bag structures are closed, the rubber air bag structures can be fixed. The robot joint structure can be protected and prevented from dust, the use performance of the robot joint structure is improved, the maintenance period is shortened, when the rubber air bag structure is collided, the rubber air bag structure is extruded to discharge air into the sealing cylinder, the sealing cylinder can drive the switch to make contact with the fixing block, and therefore the alarm can be controlled to send out an early warning signal. Therefore, the warning and reminding effects can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot head
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot head which comprises a humanoid robot body, the humanoid robot comprises eyes, ears, a nose and mouth organs of the face, and the humanoid robot further comprises a face blinking transmission mechanism which comprises silica gel eyelids and a controller for driving the eyelids to move up and down; the eye driving mechanism comprises a rotating eyeball mechanism and a columnar shell, the columnar shell is connected with an eye hemisphere through an eye body, the inner side of the eyeball mechanism comprises a camera device, the columnar shell comprises a first control device and a second control device, eyeballs are controlled to rotate all around, and meanwhile the structure is compact, the control precision is high, friction is small, and the response speed is high. According to the humanoid robot head, through the corresponding design of the traction rope, the first control device, the second control device, the camera, the motor and the like, rotation of the eyes of the robot in the up-down direction, the left-right direction and the like can be achieved, good control can be achieved, the structure is compact, and practicability is high.

title: Biped humanoid robot stepping time regulation and control method and device, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a biped humanoid robot stepping time regulation and control method and device, a terminal and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: simulating the movement of a biped humanoid robot through an equivalent order reduction model, and building an equivalent order reduction model based on a foot end Cartesian coordinate system; calculating the actual position of the centroid relative to the landing foot and the actual system angular momentum at the current moment according to the current state of the system; acquiring an expected forward speed and an expected lateral speed at the current moment based on a robot motion path, and calculating an expected angular momentum according to the equivalent reduced-order model; according to the actual angular momentum and the expected angular momentum numerical value, the residual stepping time is solved; and determining the final stepping time according to the system stepping time constraint, and analyzing and calculating the final landing point position according to the final stepping time. According to the stepping time regulation and control method, stepping deviation of the humanoid biped robot can be prevented, and the tracking reliability and stability of the humanoid biped robot along the given motion path are improved.

title: Point cloud feature extraction method, device and system based on inspection humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a point cloud feature extraction method, device and system based on an inspection humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring point cloud data of an underground space; performing denoising, filtering and normalization processing; local features and global spatial enhancement features of the point cloud data are extracted, the local features comprise geometric structure, curvature and boundary features, curvature feature transformation is carried out, and the global spatial features comprise extracted global spatial features and global features for enhancing spatial attention obtained through convolution; and feature information is extracted and classified based on the local features and the global spatial enhanced features. According to the method, efficient extraction and enhancement of global features are realized in a sparse point cloud semantic segmentation task, and the classification precision and robustness of the model in a complex scene are remarkably improved; according to the method, the semantic segmentation precision is remarkably improved.

title: Real-time ladder environment segmentation and mapping method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time ladder environment segmentation and mapping method for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a ladder environment image in real time; wherein the ladder environment image is a depth image; based on an anisotropic diffusion filtering algorithm, filtering the stepped environment image by using an image gradient and a diffusion coefficient, and extracting a planar polygon contour in the filtered stepped environment image; performing plane fitting on the plane polygon contour through a random sampling iterative algorithm to obtain a perceived polygon; and sequentially carrying out overlapping judgment on all the perceived polygons and existing polygons of the map, and updating and combining the existing polygons of the map according to a judgment result to obtain a real-time constructed ladder environment map. According to the method, the anisotropic diffusion filtering and the random sampling iterative algorithm are combined, efficient plane extraction of the depth image and rapid construction of the polygonal semantic map are realized, and the stability and the safety of the humanoid robot in actual operation are ensured.

title: Sliding type follow-up switch
abstract: The invention discloses a sliding type follow-up switch (10), which mainly improves the sliding type of a core part follow-up switch used by a pioneering invention follow-up motor (motor) of the inventor, and when the follow-up switch is designed, the overall size of the follow-up switch is large due to the fact that existing electronic switch components are often adopted. title: Rotary clamping mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a rotary clamping mechanism and a humanoid robot, the rotary clamping mechanism comprises a bearing piece, a driving assembly fixed to the bearing piece, a first clamping piece and a second clamping piece, one side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the bearing piece, the other side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the second clamping piece, and the driving assembly is fixed to the bearing piece. The driving assembly is used for driving the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece to rotate, the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece can clamp the upper edge structure in an included angle shape, and the bearing piece is provided with a second bearing face used for abutting against the first bearing face. According to the rotary clamping mechanism and the humanoid robot, the upper edge structure of the box body is clamped while the box body is supported, so that the box body is kept stable in the carrying state, and the rotary clamping mechanism and the humanoid robot can be suitable for box bodies of different specifications.

abstract: The invention discloses a bionic service type humanoid robot eye structure which is installed on a head structure and comprises a sensory system and a visual system, the sensory system comprises a sensing center, a sensor network, a signal processing unit and an execution unit, the sensor network is connected with the signal processing unit, the signal processing unit is connected with the sensing center, and the execution unit is connected with the sensing center. title: Humanoid robot motion control method, system, medium, product and equipment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control. The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system, a medium, a product and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: taking a forward observation point of a humanoid robot as a centroid projection expected pose, obtaining the slope of the forward observation point according to the difference value between the centroid projection expected pose and the centroid projection actual pose, and calculating the motion of the humanoid robot. The forward linear speed of the humanoid robot is obtained according to the slope of the forward observation point, and the humanoid robot is controlled according to the forward linear speed to reach the position of the forward observation point; according to the method, an off-line track library does not need to be established, online control is achieved, the calculated amount is small, the requirement for calculation power is low, the influence of modeling errors of a motion model on robot control is reduced, the pose of the robot can be controlled more accurately, and the control precision and stability are improved.

title: Human-simulated five-finger dexterous hand with modularized fingers
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand with modularized fingers, which comprises continuous fingers, a side-sway mechanism and a bending driving mechanism, the five continuous fingers are hinged with the side-sway mechanism, and each finger comprises a front end, a nickel-titanium alloy rod, a constraint disc, a finger tip base, a driving steel wire and a finger base. The front end of the finger base is rotationally connected with the base, the base is fixed to the nickel-titanium alloy rod, the rod penetrates through the restraining disc, a limiting hole is formed in the disc, the driving steel wire penetrates through the restraining hole, the nickel-titanium alloy rod is connected with the finger base and the finger tip base, and the finger base is rotationally connected with the side swing mechanism. By means of the modular design, the flexibility of the finger is higher, the finger can better adapt to objects in irregular shapes, the grabbing flexibility and adaptability are improved, the manufacturing process is simplified through the modular design, the finger design complexity and manufacturing cost are reduced, in addition, the finger is easier and more convenient to maintain through the modular design, and the flexibility and adaptability of grabbing are improved. And the maintenance cost and the maintenance difficulty are reduced.

title: Robot trajectory determination method and device, robot, medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot track determining method and device, a robot, a medium and a program product, the robot comprises a robot body, robot feet and a mechanical arm, and the robot feet and the mechanical arm form motion branch chains with the robot body respectively; the method comprises the steps that a state variable, a control variable and state information of the tail ends of all motion branch chains and a target object in the process that a robot is expected to complete a target task are obtained, and the state information is used for representing whether the tail ends of the motion branch chains make contact with the target object or not; constructing an evaluation model according to the state variable, the control variable and the state information; according to the evaluation model, a reference track meeting preset constraints is determined, the reference track is used for controlling the robot to complete the target task, the current situation of leg-arm separation control is broken through, and therefore the whole-body coordination of the robot is improved when the robot is controlled to complete the target task according to the reference track.

title: Explosion-proof humanoid double-arm robot obstacle avoidance path planning method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot obstacle avoidance, and particularly relates to an anti-explosion humanoid double-arm robot obstacle avoidance path planning method which comprises the following steps: acquiring a three-dimensional model of double mechanical arms; the joints, the connecting rods and the environmental obstacles of the double mechanical arms are enveloped by the spheres; the improved Bi-RRT algorithm is adopted to conduct global path planning on the double mechanical arms; whether the double-mechanical-arm global planning path collides or not is judged, if yes, the path is planned again, the master arm and the slave arm are determined, and if not, the global planning path is executed; and whether the distance between the obstacle and the joint or the connecting rod of any mechanical arm is smaller than a set safety threshold value or not is judged, if yes, an artificial potential field local obstacle avoidance mode is started, and if not, the steps are repeatedly executed till the double mechanical arms complete path planning and reach the target point. According to the invention, the obstacle avoidance of static and dynamic obstacles in a working space can be realized, and meanwhile, the collision problem existing in the local obstacle avoidance process between the two arms is solved.

title: Underwater humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention provides an underwater humanoid dexterous hand, and particularly relates to the technical field of bionic machinery, according to the underwater humanoid dexterous hand, a spring electromagnet is used for locking a corresponding tendon rope group, then a soft body is driven to be connected into liquid, a sliding block slides on a sliding rod, the corresponding tendon rope group is pulled, and the tendon rope group is driven to rotate; the tendon rope set is driven to operate corresponding to the palm assembly or the finger assembly, object grabbing and other work are completed, the driving soft body is matched with hydraulic pressure to pull the tendon rope set to operate, and the robot can adapt to a deep water area and resist large water pressure.

title: High-precision human-shaped finger joint structure
abstract: The invention provides a high-precision human-shaped finger joint structure, and relates to the technical field of human-shaped finger joints, the high-precision human-shaped finger joint structure comprises a first finger section and a second finger section, and a joint rotating structure is arranged between the first finger section and the second finger section; the joint rotating structure comprises a joint rotating shaft arranged in the width direction of the first finger section, harmonic speed reducers coaxial with the joint rotating shaft are installed at the two ends of the joint rotating shaft correspondingly, and the fixed ends and the output ends of the two harmonic speed reducers are connected with the first finger section and the second finger section correspondingly. A motor with the axis arranged in the length direction of the first finger section or the second finger section is installed in the first finger section or the second finger section, an output bevel gear coaxial with the motor is installed at the end, close to the joint rotating shaft, of the motor, an input bevel gear coaxial with the joint rotating shaft and located between the two harmonic speed reducers is further installed on the joint rotating shaft, and the output bevel gear is meshed with the input bevel gear. Input is achieved through the bevel gears, output is achieved through the double-harmonic speed reducers on the two sides of the finger joints, the transmission precision, rigidity and impact resistance of the joints are greatly improved, and the performance requirement for a motor is lowered.

title: Non-contact wearable humanoid robot based on virtual reality and brain-like prediction control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a non-contact wearable humanoid robot based on virtual reality and a brain-like prediction control method thereof. According to the robot, the body device, the hand devices and the leg devices are controlled to work through the console in combination with a brain-like prediction algorithm, so that efficient humanoid motion control is completed; through the virtual reality suit and the sensor, non-contact control of the exoskeleton armor and controllability and adjustability of feedback force and assisting force are achieved, virtual reality of the control feeling of an operator is achieved, and the same effect of controlling the exoskeleton armor in virtual reality is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot whole body control method based on human body action collection
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot whole body control method based on human motion collection. The humanoid robot whole body control method comprises the steps of 1, collecting multi-modal human motion data; step 2, carrying out format standardization on the acquired multi-modal human body motion data; and step 3, a repositioning method of reference motion data of the humanoid robot. Human body motion data sequence input is utilized, key motion information is extracted from the human body motion data sequence, the information is repositioned to the humanoid robot, human body motion data of different modes can be fully adapted, information such as corresponding joint positions and rotation can be analyzed, a reference data set for simulating human motion by the humanoid robot is generated, and a reinforcement learning algorithm is deployed. The robot can realize robust whole-body control in diversified and dynamically changing environments, so that the control robustness is improved, and various human motion data paradigms acting on humanoid robot learning are effectively unified.

title: Angular velocity measuring device of humanoid five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses an angular velocity measuring device for a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand, and relates to the technical field of testing equipment, non-contact measurement is adopted, an infrared sensor can perform measurement under the condition that the infrared sensor is not in contact with a mechanical structure of the five-finger dexterous hand, interference and abrasion to the mechanical structure are avoided, and meanwhile, the complexity of installation and maintenance is also reduced. The infrared sensor generally has higher measurement precision and fast response time, and can accurately capture the fast movement of the five-finger dexterous hand, thereby providing accurate angular velocity measurement. The installation of the infrared sensor is relatively simple, large-scale transformation of the five-fingered dexterous hand is not needed, and additional weight or volume on the manipulator is not needed, which is very important for maintaining the performance and flexibility of the manipulator. Because infrared measurement is not influenced by mechanical vibration and noise, more stable and reliable data can be provided, which is crucial to dynamic performance analysis and control.
