title: Humanoid robot capable of performing amphibious operation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of foot type robots, in particular to a humanoid robot capable of performing amphibious operation. The invention relates to a pair of health-care underwear which comprises an upper body structure and a lower body structure, the upper body structure is connected with the lower body structure through a waist assembly, the upper body structure comprises a chest assembly connected with the waist assembly, arm assemblies are arranged on the left side and the right side of the chest assembly respectively, and all the arm assemblies are connected with the chest assembly through shoulder assemblies. The front end of each arm assembly is provided with a hand assembly. The upper half body collects information through visual sense and auditory sense, and executes commands through the control mechanism to carry out processing tasks of related operations. The lower half body adopts a five-degree-of-freedom driving mode, so that the problem of convenient underwater movement of the humanoid robot is effectively solved, the angle of the humanoid robot can be adjusted at will underwater, the upper half body of the humanoid robot can execute commands conveniently, meanwhile, the robot can be suitable for amphibious working scenes, the universality of the robot is improved, and the application range of the robot is widened. The problems in the prior art are solved.

title: Hybrid power type underwater humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a hybrid power type underwater humanoid robot which comprises a trunk module, leg modules, flippers, a buoyancy adjusting module, an inflation bottle, a sensing module and a control module. The leg modules can swing in the left-right direction and the front-back direction of the trunk module relative to the trunk module. The buoyancy adjusting module comprises a buoyancy air bag set and an inflation and deflation control mechanism. The robot further comprises an underwater propelling module, the underwater propelling module comprises an upper propeller and a lower propeller, the upper propeller is installed on the trunk module, and the lower propeller is installed on the leg modules. The control module is in control connection with the upper thruster and the lower thruster. A leg motion detection assembly in the sensing module is arranged on a leg module, can obtain the motion condition of the leg module and can obtain the angle relation of the propelling force of a lower propeller relative to the trunk module; and the total buoyancy center of the buoyancy air bag group is always in a buoyancy center fluctuation space range when the buoyancy air bag group is inflated and deflated.

title: Humanoid robot and four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating human shoulder and elbow joints thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating human shoulder and elbow joints thereof, and the four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm comprises a first joint module, a second shoulder joint module, a third shoulder joint module, a big arm module and a small arm module which are connected in sequence; the first shoulder joint module achieves the pitching freedom degree of the shoulder, the second shoulder joint module achieves the rolling freedom degree of the shoulder, the third shoulder joint module achieves the yawing freedom degree of the shoulder, and the pitching freedom degree of the elbow is achieved through a fourth joint installed in the large arm module and connected with the small arm module. A first joint in the first shoulder joint module, a second joint in the second shoulder joint module and a third joint and a fourth joint in the third shoulder joint module are respectively controlled by an external driver and an industrial personal computer, so that the three-degree-of-freedom movement of the shoulder and the one-degree-of-freedom movement of the elbow of the mechanical arm are realized. The device has the characteristics of high bionics, inertia upward movement and module integration, can meet the basic movement requirements of the upper limbs of the humanoid robot, and is convenient to control, low in energy consumption and convenient to disassemble.

title: Leg structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure of a biped robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises supporting legs, a first rectangular cylinder and a second rectangular cylinder, rectangular plates are sleeved on the outer walls of the first rectangular cylinder and the second rectangular cylinder, canvas is fixedly connected between the two rectangular plates, and the canvas is fixedly connected with the supporting legs. title: Bionic biped robot with variable-rigidity joints and double-joint flexibility
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic biped robot with variable rigidity joints and double-joint flexibility, which comprises a trunk, thighs, variable rigidity knee joints, shanks and feet, and the double-joint flexible part of each leg is driven by three elastic drivers connected in series; a front-side linear motor of the rigidity-variable knee joint is rotationally connected to a mounting frame at the lower end of the thigh, and an output shaft of the front-side linear motor is connected with one end of an L-shaped connecting piece; the rear-side linear motor is mounted on the mounting frame, an output shaft of the rear-side linear motor is sequentially sleeved with a rear-side shell, a rear-side spring and a front-side shell and then fixed to the output end connecting piece, and the two sides of the rear-side spring make contact with the rear-side shell and the output end connecting piece respectively; a rope is led out from the tail end of the front side shell, is wound on a rear side shaft and a knee joint shaft in sequence, penetrates through two pairs of rollers and is fixed on a knee joint output shaft; the rollers are installed at the other ends of the L-shaped connecting pieces, and the knee joint shaft is connected with the switching parts of the two L-shaped connecting pieces through bearings. The robot has good stability, flexibility and adaptability.

title: Humanoid robot bending joint structure
abstract: The invention discloses a bending joint structure of a humanoid robot. The bending joint structure comprises a power device, a power device dowel bar, a power device fixing rod, a bending component, a swing rod, a sliding device, a hinge A and a hinge B, the power device fixing rod is connected with the swing rod through a hinge A. The swing rod is fixed to the slope of the bending component, and the power device fixing rod fixes the power device. The power device pushes (pulls) the power device dowel bar, pushing (pulling) force is transmitted to the sliding device through the hinge B, the sliding device rotates with the hinge B as the center and slides along the swing rod, the swing rod and the bending component are forced to rotate with the hinge A as the center, and the bending function of the bending joint is achieved. The one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot is simple in structure, the joint bending center of the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot is located on the outer side of the bending joint, and compared with the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot with the patent number of 2023218600601, the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot has the advantage that the similarity between the bending joint and human joint movement is improved.

title: Lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises a hip joint assembly worn at a hip joint of a human body, a left leg assembly which is positioned on two sides of the hip joint assembly and is worn on a left leg, and a right leg assembly which is worn on a right leg, each of the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly comprises a thigh connecting rod, a shank connecting rod and a shoe body assembly which are sequentially hinged, the upper end of the thigh connecting rod is hinged to the side face of the hip joint assembly, and a first driving mechanism for driving the thigh connecting rod to rotate is arranged on the side face of the hip joint assembly; inclined driving pieces for driving the shank connecting rods to move are arranged between the hip joint assemblies and the shank connecting rods, the upper ends of the inclined driving pieces are hinged to the side faces of the hip joint assemblies, and the lower ends are hinged to the middles of the shank connecting rods; the lower limb power-assisted exoskeleton robot further comprises a sensor used for detecting uplifting of the thighs and/or the shanks. The power assisting device is simple in structure, reasonable in layout, low in cost and good in power assisting effect.

title: Multi-style parallel intelligent strategy learning method for wheel-legged humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-style parallel intelligent strategy learning method for a wheel-legged humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out robot simulation training on a computer, training parallel strategies A and B through independent customized observation values A and B and customized rewards A and B, and obtaining optimal parallel strategies A and B through parallel reinforcement learning processes A and B; the optimal parallel strategies A and B are implanted into a robot industrial personal computer in a neural network mode, forward propagation operation is carried out, local skills A and B cooperating with each other are generated respectively, and after the local skills A and B are converted through an arm joint PD controller and a wheel-leg joint PD controller, the robot obtains an agile auxiliary arm skill A and a basic robustness wheel-leg skill B. A special exploration space is provided for the arm, the defect of over-fitting of the arm can be effectively avoided, and consumption and conflicts among different targets can be avoided.

title: Thermal-pressure pain sense sensing device simulating human nerve synaptic function
abstract: The invention discloses a heat-pressure pain sense sensing device simulating a human nerve synaptic function. The sensing device is mainly composed of a triboelectric sensor, a resistance-type temperature sensor and an electrochemical transistor. The triboelectric sensor is used as a pressure sensor and can output different voltages when being pressed, the triboelectric sensor is connected with the grid electrode of the electrochemical transistor, and the grid electrode voltage of the electrochemical transistor is regulated and controlled through the triboelectric sensor to realize regulation and control on the source drain current IDS of the transistor; the resistive temperature sensor is connected in series with the source and drain electrodes of the electrochemical transistor, and regulation and control of source and drain loop current IDS are realized through resistance change. According to the invention, simulation perception of heat pain and pressing pain is realized, stimulation modes can be distinguished according to different IDS linear shapes, and two pain sense signals can be integrated and distinguished when pressure stimulation and temperature stimulation are carried out at the same time. And the humanoid skin or humanoid robot is endowed with various injury perception capabilities and more efficient injury prevention capability.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a wheeled humanoid robot which comprises a wheeled chassis walking mechanism, a robot trunk mechanism is arranged above the wheeled chassis walking mechanism, a robot head mechanism is mounted on the robot trunk mechanism, and robot arm mechanisms are mounted on the two sides of the robot trunk mechanism. The end, away from the robot trunk mechanism, of each robot arm mechanism is provided with a clamping jaw. A robot lower limb waist mechanism is arranged between the robot trunk mechanism and the wheel type chassis walking mechanism, and the robot trunk mechanism and the wheel type chassis walking mechanism are connected through the robot lower limb waist mechanism. Through cooperative arrangement of all the structures and arrangement of the wheeled humanoid robot, the problem that in the prior art, a foot type humanoid robot is low in moving speed under the flat ground environment is effectively solved, the degree of freedom of the whole robot is high, the robot can adapt to various working environments, and popularization is facilitated.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot. The robot specifically comprises at least one joint actuator and at least one connecting piece, the output end of the joint actuator is connected with the first end of the connecting piece, and the other end of the joint actuator is connected with the second end of the connecting piece; a containing space is formed between the first end of the connecting piece and the second end of the connecting piece, and the joint actuator is rotatably arranged in the containing space. The connecting piece of the actuator is designed to be of the structure with the containing space between the two ends, the output end and the other end, away from the output end, of each joint actuator are connected with the two ends of the connecting piece correspondingly, so that the two ends of each joint actuator are fixed, stress on the two ends is more balanced in the rotating process of the joint actuators, and the stability of the joint actuators is improved. The stability of the mechanical arm in the moving process is improved, and the structure is simple and compact.

title: Multistage linear lifting mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a multistage linear lifting mechanism and a humanoid robot. The first-stage column body is fixedly connected with the bottom mounting piece; the second-stage column body is arranged on the first-stage column body in a sliding manner; the third-stage column body is arranged in the second-stage column body in a sliding manner; the driving device comprises an electric cylinder fixed on the bottom mounting piece and a servo motor connected with the electric cylinder, and the output end of the electric cylinder is connected with the second-stage column body through an electric cylinder connecting piece and a second-stage column connecting piece; the driving device drives the second-stage column body to move relative to the first-stage column body, and drives the third-stage column body to move at the speed twice the moving speed of the second-stage column body through the transmission mechanism. The novel structural layout is adopted, the dynamic upsetting moment resistance of the mechanism is greatly improved, the occupied space of the mechanism is reduced, and the operation speed of the mechanism during action execution is increased.

title: Double-arm self-adaptive force control operation method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot two-arm self-adaptive force control operation method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building a coordinate conversion algorithm between a world coordinate system and a left arm base coordinate system, a right arm base coordinate system, a left arm tail end coordinate system, a right arm tail end coordinate system and an operation target coordinate system; six-dimensional force data and torque data collected by six-dimensional force sensors at the tail ends of the left mechanical arm and the right mechanical arm are obtained, and gravity compensation and conversion are conducted; defining a grasping matrix to decompose the six-dimensional force data and the torque data into internal force and external force; dividing the cooperative task into a free motion stage, a constraint establishment stage and a constraint motion stage, and generating a corresponding control instruction in each stage; and the generated control instruction is input into a double-arm robot system, and coordinated motion control of the double-arm robot in different stages is achieved. According to the invention, coordination work can be completed and anti-interference capability is possessed.

title: Human arm impedance measuring method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a human arm impedance measurement method and device, and the method comprises the steps: 1, designing a double-arm humanoid robot, constructing a kinetic model, and collecting the operation data of the interaction between a measured human arm and the two arms of the robot through the robot; step 2, carrying out preprocessing operations of denoising, numerical derivation, data synchronization and mean value calculation on the operation data; 3, establishing a human body impedance model through a linear regression method by using the preprocessed data, calculating impedance parameters based on mass, damping and rigidity under the condition of different arm angles and interaction forces, and minimizing a loss function to optimize model parameters; and step 4, according to the impedance parameters obtained by calculation, fitting and drawing a three-dimensional curved surface by using a B-spline curved surface equation, and displaying impedance characteristics under different arm angles and interaction force conditions. According to the invention, comprehensive analysis of the impedance characteristic of the arm of the human body in the anthropomorphic operation process can be realized, and cooperative work of robots and human beings and application in the fields of biomechanical research and the like are facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot integrated joint anti-disturbance control method and control system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot integrated joint anti-disturbance control method and system, the control method controls a permanent magnet synchronous motor of a humanoid robot through a current loop vector control algorithm, and the control method specifically comprises the following steps: normalizing each step of the current loop vector control algorithm; solving the trigonometric function in the calculation formula of each step after normalization processing through a table look-up assisted numerical fitting method; the conventional operation processing of a trigonometric function occupying relatively large hardware resources is improved into a value fitting method assisted by table lookup, so that the solving speed and the solving precision can be improved to the greatest extent, and meanwhile, the table lookup depth and the table lookup breadth are reduced; therefore, the occupation of hardware resources is reduced as much as possible while the trigonometric function is rapidly and accurately solved, and the high-speed operation of the current loop vector control algorithm is realized to meet the performance requirement of high-dynamic disturbance resistance of the integrated joint of the humanoid robot.

title: Wheel-foot robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the wheel-foot robot comprises a head and neck assembly, a trunk assembly, two groups of upper limb assemblies, two groups of lower limb assemblies and two groups of wheel-foot moving bases, the wheel-foot robot is provided with stereoscopic vision, can sense the environment and recognize human beings, and two hands cooperatively execute operation tasks; precise torque sensors in the arm joints facilitate safe and sensitive interaction when physically cooperating with humans. The trunk is telescopic, and the working height can be increased. The whole robot has more than twenty degrees of freedom, has the movement functions of fast movement, agile obstacle avoidance, steady uphill and downhill, impact interference resistance and the like, is an ideal carrier for general artificial intelligence, and when the robot works in place, the jacking mechanism at the bottom of the wheel foot base can support the robot body, so that the robot can bear high-load or high-dynamic operation. The robot can be switched among a plurality of modes which are not limited to standing, squatting, moving and the like, and is suitable for a plurality of application scenes.

title: Manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a manipulator and a humanoid robot, the manipulator comprises an arm mechanism and a clamping mechanism, the clamping mechanism comprises a fixing seat, a clamping piece, a bearing piece, a first elastic piece and a second elastic piece, the fixing seat is connected with the arm mechanism, the clamping piece is movably connected with the fixing seat, and the bearing piece is movably connected with the fixing seat. The bearing part comprises a connecting body and a bearing main body, the bearing main body comprises a limiting part facing the clamping part, the connecting body is movably connected with the fixing seat, and the clamping part and the bearing main body jointly form a clamping space; the first elastic piece applies elastic force towards the second side of the first direction to the clamping piece; when the second elastic piece is in an elastic deformation state, the bearing piece is kept in a bearing state; when the bearing piece is in the bearing state, the limiting part abuts against the fixing base. In the process that the humanoid robot carries the box, if the gravity center of the box is offset, the clamping piece and the bearing piece can always clamp one part of the box, and the risk that the box swings is reduced.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR AUTOMATICALLY GENERATING DRUM PLAY MOTION OF ROBOT
abstract: A method of generating a drum play motion of a robot includes generating a plurality of rhythms of a melody, assigning each of a plurality of notes forming a rhythm of each part to one of the right hand and the left hand of the robot, scheduling swing time of each of the right hand and the left hand to which each note is assigned, and generating a trajectory of each of a plurality of joints of the robot for playing the rhythm of each part based on the swing time of each of the right hand and the left hand, and by controlling a motion of each of the plurality of joints according to the trajectory of each of the plurality of joints generated in this way, creative drum play of a humanoid robot may be done when only a melody is input.
abstract_en: A method of generating a drum play motion of a robot includes generating a plurality of rhythms of a melody, assigning each of a plurality of notes forming a rhythm of each part to one of the right hand and the left hand of the robot, scheduling swing time of each of the right hand and the left hand to which each note is assigned, and generating a trajectory of each of a plurality of joints of the robot for playing the rhythm of each part based on the swing time of each of the right hand and the left hand, and by controlling a motion of each of the plurality of joints according to the trajectory of each of the plurality of joints generated in this way, creative drum play of a humanoid robot may be done when only a melody is input.

title: Expression robot with changeable skin color and facial form
abstract: The invention discloses a skin color and facial form variable expression robot. The eyebrow mechanism and the eye mechanism are fixedly connected, the eyebrow mechanism, the eye mechanism and the mouth mechanism are all connected with the deformation mechanism, the eyebrow mechanism, the mouth mechanism and the deformation mechanism are all installed on the head shell mechanism, the neck mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom end of the mouth mechanism, and the skin color changing mechanism is attached to the head shell mechanism and used for achieving replacement of the skin color of the robot. The deformation mechanism is mainly driven by a worm and gear structure, and deformation of the eyebrow and the mouth of the robot is achieved through the worm and gear structure. According to the machine, self-adaptive face transformation according to human face characteristics is achieved, the face shape, the skin color and the pupil color can be rapidly changed according to different application scenes, rich mouth shapes can be achieved, and the requirement for real-time dialogue is met.

title: Humanoid dexterous finger, humanoid dexterous hand adopting same and humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid dexterous finger comprises a single-finger base, a fingertip, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the fingertip, the first knuckle and the second knuckle are sequentially hinged from top to bottom, the bottom end of the second knuckle is rotationally connected with the single-finger base through a swing part, and the rotating plane, relative to the swing part, of the second knuckle is not parallel to the rotating plane, relative to the single-finger base, of the swing part; the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles are respectively connected with at least one group of connecting rod driving mechanisms for driving the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles to independently act; each connecting rod driving mechanism comprises a main connecting rod and a driving assembly driving the main connecting rod to move, each driving assembly comprises a power piece, and the power pieces drive the connecting seats to slide back and forth along the sliding rails through pull ropes. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a palm and the humanoid dexterous finger which is arranged on the palm and adopts the scheme. The humanoid robot adopts the humanoid dexterous hand. The dexterous finger has four active degrees of freedom and higher response speed, and hand actions closer to a real person are realized.

title: Human-machine-data three-element integrated robot teleoperation and data acquisition system and method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a man-machine-data three-element integrated robot teleoperation and data acquisition system and method, and the system comprises a man-machine interaction module, a physical robot, a prediction simulation module, a digital robot, a virtual environment and a data management module. Wherein the prediction simulation module is used for aligning information of a natural person to execution action information of the physical robot, predicting an action instruction sequence and correcting the state of the digital robot in real time according to state information fed back by the physical robot; the digital robot is used for executing a corresponding action in the virtual environment according to the combined action instruction sequence, if a safety problem exists in the execution process, execution is stopped, and otherwise, the combined action instruction sequence is sent to the physical robot; the data management module is used for collecting data in the system operation process. The technical problems of operation delay and lack of humanoid robot training data in a traditional teleoperation system are solved.

title: Biped robot robust constraint tracking control method based on parameter optimization
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robot control, in particular to a biped robot robust constraint tracking control method based on parameter optimization. According to the method, the improved inverted pendulum model is adopted, the important characteristics of the biped robot can still be reflected while the advantages of a single mass model are fully utilized, and a series of errors and interference problems generated due to the fact that the model is too simplified are avoided. Key parameters of the improved inverted pendulum model are set to be variable, and the dynamic characteristics of the improved inverted pendulum model are convenient to adjust. The robust constraint control method is designed, motion equations of a limited mechanical system of equality constraint and inequality constraint are considered at the same time, control input meets the Gaussian principle and the Alembert principle, and therefore moderate control force is generated in the real world to meet the system performance.

title: Object three-dimensional information reconstruction method with body perception based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to an object three-dimensional information reconstruction method based on humanoid robot body perception, and the method comprises the steps: 1, obtaining a single-visual-angle depth image collected by a humanoid robot body, carrying out the preprocessing, and obtaining a single-visual-angle three-dimensional point cloud of an object, and taking the single-visual-angle three-dimensional point cloud as an initial object surface point cloud; step 2, inputting the initial object surface point cloud into the visual touch fusion object reconstruction network to obtain an initial object shape estimation result; and step 3, performing active exploration on the object by adopting a double-arm active tactile exploration strategy to obtain tactile data and further refined object surface point cloud, adding the further refined object surface point cloud into an initial object shape estimation result, and jointly inputting the further refined object surface point cloud and the tactile data into a visual touch fusion object reconstruction network to perform further object reconstruction. And obtaining a further refined object shape estimation result, and repeating the step 3 until the reconstruction is finished. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing refined shape reconstruction of the object under the condition of single view angle of the robot in a complex scene and the like.

title: Multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of humanoid robot to swing
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of a humanoid robot to swing. The multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure comprises a cylinder body, a cylinder liner, a piston, a cylinder stroke control ring, a stay wire, a stay wire restraining device and a wire collecting pipe. The air cylinder body comprises a shell and cover plates, the cover plates seal the two ends of the shell, the shell is in a hollow cylinder shape, a hollow shaft is sleeved with a line concentration pipe, the two ends of the shell are provided with a plurality of air cylinder holes symmetrical to the center section of the shell, air cylinder inner containers and piston plates are installed in the holes, piston plate faces are fixed to the air cylinder inner containers, and piston rods are fixed to the other faces of the piston plates. When the air cylinder inner container is inflated or deflated, the piston does reciprocating linear motion, the two stay wires fixed on the piston rod turn to enter the wire collecting pipe through the stay wire restraining device at the center position of the shell, then turn to penetrate out of the wire collecting pipe to be connected with the finger joints, and therefore the finger joints are driven to swing, and the function of the multi-cylinder pneumatic machine is achieved. The cylinder stroke control ring is installed at a cylinder port to control the maximum stroke of the cylinder.

title: Mining humanoid robot cluster scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a mining humanoid robot cluster scheduling method, and relates to the technical field of resource scheduling, and the method comprises the steps that a scheduling platform solves a task allocation model with the shortest time as a target, obtains an optimal task allocation scheme, and schedules mining humanoid robots; after the mining humanoid robot arrives underground, the mining humanoid robot receives command information of the control equipment, extracts destination information in the command information and sends the destination information to the dispatching platform; and the scheduling platform reformulates a new task allocation scheme according to the updated task, and schedules each mining humanoid robot according to the new task allocation scheme. According to the invention, when an emergency occurs underground, the mining humanoid robot is manually commanded on site, and the scheduling platform regenerates the task allocation scheme according to the information of the on-site commanding, so that the new task allocation scheme can avoid a place where a fault occurs, and the rationality of the task allocation scheme is improved.

title: Biped robot adopting wheel-track transformation wheel system and working method of biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biped robots, and particularly relates to a biped robot adopting a wheel-track transformation wheel system and a working method thereof.The biped robot adopting the wheel-track transformation wheel system comprises a robot body and mechanical legs arranged on the two sides of the robot body; the mechanical leg comprises a rotating arm I, a rotating arm II and a wheel-track deformation wheel system, according to the biped robot adopting the wheel-track deformation wheel system, the wheel-track deformation wheel system is arranged at the end of the rotating arm II, wheel-track deformation wheels are well fused with the two feet of the biped robot, and therefore the wheel-track deformation wheel system is formed; five working modes including a deformation rim revolution driving mode, a caterpillar band driving mode, a self-adaptive driving mode, a braking mode and a leg type driving mode can be switched.

title: Biped robot control method, electronic device, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a biped robot, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps that in response to a received control instruction of the biped robot, the current posture of the biped robot is collected, and the control instruction carries the expected posture of the biped robot; the relative movement position and the relative swing angle of the biped robot are determined based on the current posture and the expected posture, the relative movement position is used for representing the stepping relative position of the supporting foot and the swing foot on the plane where the biped robot is located, and the relative swing angle is used for representing the stepping relative angle of the supporting foot and the swing foot on the plane; the supporting legs are used for supporting the biped robot to be in a stable state, and the swinging legs are used for controlling the biped robot to reach an expected posture; and controlling the biped robot to operate based on the relative movement position and the relative swing angle. The technical problem that the control effect on the biped robot is poor in the prior art is solved.

title: Hip structure of bionic robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of biomimetic robots, and discloses a hip structure of a biomimetic robot, which comprises a pelvic bone supporting frame, the middle of the pelvic bone supporting frame is mounted on a waist structure, motor seats are arranged on the back of the pelvic bone supporting frame and close to two ends, and the motor seats are fixedly mounted on shells of side leg lifting motors. According to the hip structure of the bionic robot, the hip structure of the bionic robot can freely move in the X-degree-of-freedom direction, the Y-degree-of-freedom direction and the Z-degree-of-freedom direction through a connecting structure in which the two sets of side leg lifting motors, the two sets of front leg lifting motors and the two sets of leg rotating motors are in linkage step by step, and therefore the hip structure of the bionic robot can freely move in the X-degree-of-freedom direction, the Y-degree-of-freedom direction and the Z-degree-of-freedom direction; therefore, the hip motion state of the bionic robot is closer to the natural motion posture of human beings; and meanwhile, the balance of the bionic robot in the walking state and the standing state is greatly improved through the rotation action of the leg rotating motors on the legs.

title: Bionic robot with single power source
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot bionics, in particular to a bionic robot with a single power source. The device comprises an abdomen mechanism, a hip mechanism is arranged on one side of the abdomen mechanism, and rear leg mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the hip mechanism. Through rotation of a body fixing crankshaft and a hip connecting crankshaft on the power mechanism, the abdomen mechanism and the hip mechanism swing on the power mechanism, and meanwhile the power mechanism and the hip mechanism are matched to drive the front leg mechanism and the rear leg mechanism to stretch backwards and bend forwards; meanwhile, when the abdomen mechanism swings up and down, the head mechanism is driven to swing up and down, so that the head mechanism performs bionic actions of swinging ears, opening the mouth and spitting the tongue, and the power mechanism uniformly conveys power to the abdomen mechanism, the hip mechanism, the rear leg mechanism, the front leg mechanism and the head mechanism, so that the actions of the whole device are uniform; and the inharmony of movement among limbs caused by adopting a plurality of power sources is avoided.

title: Seven-axis humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a seven-axis humanoid mechanical arm, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The mechanical arm comprises seven joint modules, four connecting pieces, a load support and two connecting rods. The output end of the first joint module and the second connecting piece, the output end of the second joint module and the third connecting piece, the output end of the third joint module and the first connecting rod, and the output end of the fourth joint module and the fourth connecting piece are connected through jaw profiles. The first joint module, the second joint module and the third joint module are arranged in a three-axis orthogonal mode, the fifth joint module, the sixth joint module and the seventh joint module are arranged in a three-axis orthogonal mode, the axis of the third joint module coincides with the axis of the fifth joint module, the axis of the fourth joint module is offset, and it is guaranteed that the rotating motion range of the fourth joint module is 0-170 degrees through the offset amount of the fourth joint module. The problems that an existing mechanical arm modular joint shell and connecting rod structure is not high in reuse degree, installation is tedious, a tail end joint is not tight and reachable, and the working space is small can be solved.

title: Personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot and manufacturing method of application scene thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot and a manufacturing method of an application scene of the personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot, and the application scene of the personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot is an Internet three-dimensional electronic map and takes data of a specific natural person as raw materials. The invention relates to a personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent humanoid robot with a voice chat function, which can automatically generate an intelligent identification mark. The bionic specific natural person artificial intelligence comprises an exclusive personalized program, and provides intelligent support for the personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot to think questions, judge decisions and voice chat; the intelligent identification identifier intelligently matches information of supply and demand of a user and presents the information as required, so that each personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot creates a personalized virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot within a user authorization range; and each natural person can enjoy an exclusive virtual three-dimensional intelligent robot automatic innovative product which can be endowed through the Internet.

title: Full-scale humanoid robot coordination control method and system
abstract: The invention provides a full-scale humanoid robot coordination control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: building a nonlinear model prediction controller, carrying out the optimization solution through sequential quadratic optimization, and optimizing the system input and system state; a trunk pose task, a swing leg and support leg task and an arm task are extracted from the optimized trajectory, and a plurality of tracking tasks are mapped to a joint space according to an allocated priority weight by using a high-frequency hybrid whole body motion control HWBC algorithm, so that the robot can coordinately process the motions of the arms and the feet, the system response is improved, and the system reliability is improved. The method has the ability of multi-gait robust motion.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device, robot and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a control method and device of a humanoid robot, the robot and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that after the whole body state of the humanoid robot is updated, the target position of an operation object in whole body reachability space information of the humanoid robot is acquired; determining a target motion mode according to the target position and the reachability subspace information of each movable part; according to the target motion mode, the target movable part is controlled to execute the target operation, efficient decision making is conducted on the motion modes of the humanoid robot, the ability of the humanoid robot to flexibly switch the motion modes in the factory environment is improved, and the control accuracy of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Hierarchical AI navigation obstacle avoidance method for humanoid robot based on depth information
abstract: The invention provides a hierarchical AI navigation obstacle avoidance method for a humanoid robot based on depth information, and the method comprises the steps: taking various information of the humanoid robot as input through an upper-layer reinforcement learning model, outputting a speed instruction, enabling the speed instruction to serve as one of the inputs of a lower-layer reinforcement learning model, outputting the torque of each joint through the lower-layer reinforcement learning model, and controlling the movement of the robot, the current speed and angular speed of the humanoid robot are estimated through the estimation network, fusion with humanoid robot body information is carried out during deployment, the real-time position of the humanoid robot is estimated, the navigation obstacle avoidance ability of the humanoid robot can be almost decoupled from the motion ability by setting a layered architecture, the network can also be trained separately, and the real-time position of the humanoid robot can be obtained. The lower-layer reinforcement learning model estimates the speed, the estimation precision is very high, the speed and the position of the fuselage can be estimated without external positioning, and the upper-layer reinforcement learning model adjusts the speed by analyzing a visual image to finally realize obstacle avoidance.

title: Depression diagnosis and treatment integrated humanoid robot based on multi-source information perception
abstract: The invention discloses a depression diagnosis and treatment integrated humanoid robot based on multi-source information perception, and belongs to the field of medical instruments. The depression diagnosis and treatment integrated humanoid robot comprises a head module, a trunk module and a limb module which are worn outside a human body; a high-resolution camera, a small integrated microphone array, a gas sensor, a photoelectric sensor, a pressure sensor, an infrared sensor and a numerical control chip are arranged in the head module; the high-resolution camera is used for collecting facial recognition and eyeball movement features of a user; the small-sized integrated microphone array is used for dynamically collecting human body sound. According to the method, early warning, accurate diagnosis, personalized treatment and effective accompanying of depression can be realized, the accuracy and objectivity of depression diagnosis are improved, the illness state of a patient is comprehensively evaluated through multi-source information perception, all-weather emotion accompanying is provided, the psychological state of the patient is improved, the treatment compliance is improved, the problem of uneven distribution of medical resources is relieved, and the treatment effect is improved. And patients in remote areas can obtain high-quality diagnosis and treatment services.

title: Humanoid robot step terrain walking method based on whole-body dynamic model
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot step terrain walking method based on a whole-body kinetic model, and the method comprises the steps: designing a nonlinear model prediction control problem oriented to the walking of a humanoid robot, and reasonably planning a system state, input and a reference track of a foot end; equality constraints and inequality constraints which are necessary for walking of the robot are designed, and the constraint that a landing point of the robot needs to fall in a landing area is taken as one of the inequality constraints, so that the humanoid robot is capable of walking on a step terrain; and finally, solving a nonlinear model predictive control problem in real time by utilizing a solver, and issuing a robot joint torque according to an inverse kinetic equation of the whole-body kinetic model and PD in combination with a feedforward controller, so that the robot is better in control effect and more stable in walking.

title: Facial form variable expression robot
abstract: The invention discloses an expression robot with variable facial forms. The eyebrow mechanism and the eye mechanism are fixedly connected, the eyebrow mechanism, the eye mechanism and the mouth mechanism are all connected with the deformation mechanism, the eyebrow mechanism, the mouth mechanism and the deformation mechanism are all installed on the head shell mechanism, the neck mechanism is fixedly installed at the bottom end of the mouth mechanism, and switching of multiple states of four freedom degrees of neck stretching, nodding, head shaking and head turning is achieved. The skin color changing mechanism is attached to the head shell mechanism and used for changing the skin color of the robot, the deformation mechanism is mainly driven by a worm and gear structure, and deformation of eyebrows and the mouth of the robot is achieved through the worm and gear structure. According to the machine, self-adaptive face transformation according to human face characteristics is realized, the face shape, pupil color and neck length can be quickly changed according to different application scenes, abundant mouth shapes can be realized, and the requirement of real-time dialogue is met.

title: Robot motion control method and device, robot, medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a robot motion control method and device, a robot, a medium and a program product, the robot comprises a robot body, robot feet and mechanical arms, and the robot feet and the mechanical arms form motion branch chains with the robot body respectively; the method comprises the steps that second reference data are determined through a first controller according to obtained first reference data and current actual state estimation of the robot, the first reference data are used for representing an estimated expected state of the robot for executing a target task, and the second reference data are used for representing an actual expected state of the robot for executing the target task; according to the second reference data and the current actual state estimation of the robot, a control instruction of the joints of the motion branch chains is determined through a second controller; the robot is controlled to move according to the control instruction, the current situation of leg-arm separation control is broken through, control logic of a double-layer controller is adopted, and therefore the robot has high robustness and environment anti-interference capacity in the process of controlling the robot to execute a target task.

title: Robot and behavior planning method and control method thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a robot and a behavior planning method and control method thereof, and the behavior planning method of the robot comprises the steps: determining a target grabbing pose of the robot for grabbing a target object based on an object pose of the target object; the target grabbing pose comprises a target base pose and a target gripper pose; based on the target base posture and the current base posture of the robot, a motion control strategy of mechanical legs of the robot is determined; the motion control strategy is used for controlling the mechanical legs to drive the robot to move, so that a base of the robot reaches a target base posture; on the basis of the target gripper pose and the current gripper pose of the robot, a gripping control strategy of a mechanical arm of the robot is determined; the grabbing control strategy is used for controlling the mechanical arm to drive the gripper of the robot to grab the target object at the target gripper pose under the condition that the base reaches the target base seat pose.

title: Bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms and solves the problem that an existing dexterous hand is low in response speed, according to the technical scheme, the bionic mechanical arm mainly comprises an arm and the dexterous hand, the dexterous hand comprises a palm and at least two fingers, and each finger comprises a finger base, a finger body and a driving mechanism; the driving mechanism comprises a driving motor, a transmission mechanism is arranged on the finger base and comprises a guiding piece and a sliding block installed on the guiding piece in a sliding mode, an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with two pulling ropes wound in opposite directions, and the driving motor is in transmission connection with the sliding block through the pulling ropes. The sliding block is connected with a cross shaft in transmission connection with the finger body, the driving motor controls the output shaft to rotate forwards and backwards so as to drag the sliding block to slide back and forth along the guiding piece through the traction rope, and then the finger body is driven to bend and/or swing. The finger is mainly used for improving the response speed of the finger body.

title: Leg-foot device of biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg-foot device of a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The invention provides a leg-foot device of a biped robot. The leg-foot device comprises a hip connecting plate, the hip joint driving module is fixed on the hip connecting plate; the foot module can move relative to the hip connecting plate under the driving of the hip joint driving module; the leg module comprises at least two sets of leg connecting rod mechanisms, and each leg connecting rod mechanism comprises a thigh frame, a knee joint, a shank frame and an energy storage and release elastic assembly. The buffering capacity of the leg and foot device is improved through the energy storage and release elastic assembly, energy is stored when the leg and foot device is in the squatting posture, and the leg and foot device exerts force to the ground under the combined action of the energy storage and release elastic assembly and the hip joint driving module when doing explosive movement, so that larger pushing force is provided for explosive movement, and the driving effect of the leg and foot device is improved. Therefore, the explosion capacity is improved.

title: Body movement emotion recognition method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot body movement emotion recognition method, which comprises the following steps of: (1) emotion and body movement coding: respectively carrying out category coding, region coding, direction coding and mode coding on an emotion state and a humanoid robot body movement; a binary trigger mechanism is adopted to generate binary codes of the emotional state and the limb movement of the humanoid robot; (2) constructing a back propagation neural network topological structure; determining an activation function; obtaining a weight and an offset optimal solution of the neural network; training a neural network by taking the binary code of the limb action of the humanoid robot as neural network input and the binary code of the emotional state as neural network output; and (3) binary coding of predicted humanoid robot limb actions, binary coding input limb action emotion recognition and prediction emotion output. According to the nonlinear mapping calculation model method for the limb movement and the emotional state of the humanoid robot, the defects in the prior art are overcome, and emotional interaction between people and the robot can be further improved.

title: Flexible joint mechatronics mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a flexible joint mechatronics mechanism of a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of robots and is provided with a motor protecting sleeve, a first rotating wheel, a second rotating wheel, a first mechanical arm and a second mechanical arm. A first motor and a second motor in a motor protecting sleeve can drive a first rotating wheel and a second rotating wheel to rotate correspondingly, so that a rotating support is driven to rotate, the rotating support rotates to drive a first mechanical arm to rotate, the first mechanical arm can rotate normally, an adjusting support can rotate on a fixed support, and the inclination angle of a second mechanical arm is changed; the second mechanical arm not only can rotate, but also can incline at will, so that human joints can be better simulated, adjustment is more flexible, in addition, telescopic protective sleeves are arranged on the outer sides of the protective sleeves and the rotary supports, joint mechanical parts can be shielded, dust or impurities are prevented from being clamped on rotating parts, and the robot is more clean, tidy and attractive.

title: Portable disassembly and assembly flexible joint actuator for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot portable disassembly and assembly flexible joint actuator which comprises a large mechanical arm and a small mechanical arm, a driver is installed in the small mechanical arm, an output shaft is installed on the driver, a mounting plate is arranged at the other end of the output shaft, and the mounting plate is connected with the large mechanical arm and the small mechanical arm. title: Anti-yaw device for robots and robot walking test apparatus equipped with the same
abstract: The present invention relates to a yaw prevention device for a robot and a robot walking experiment apparatus equipped therewith, and more particularly, to a yaw prevention device for a robot, which has a concise and simple structure during a two-dimensional walking experiment of a bipedal walking robot, can effectively block yawing of the robot, can perform a walking experiment quickly and conveniently, and can be used compatibly with various robots, and a robot walking experiment apparatus equipped therewith. The yaw prevention device for a robot according to the present invention is a yaw prevention device for a robot for restricting yawing during walking of the robot, characterized in that it comprises: a robot-side binding part connected to the robot; a rod part having one side connected to the robot-side binding part and installed to be movable in a lateral direction; and a support seating part coupled to the other side of the rod part and seated on a supported part.

title: ROBOT, ROBOT CONTROL METHOD, AND PROGRAM
abstract: Provided is a robot capable of controlling a hugging action with respect to a user according to the state of communication with the user. This robot is capable of communicating with a user and includes: a torso part; two arm parts connected so as to be displaceable relative to the torso part; an attitude detection part for acquiring information on an attitude angle of the torso part; and a control part for controlling opening/closing operation of the two arm parts on the basis of the information on the attitude angle of the torso part acquired by the attitude detection part.

title: Industrial-grade heavy-load humanoid robot arm, double-arm system and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an industrial-grade heavy-load humanoid robot arm, a double-arm system and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The industrial-grade heavy-load humanoid robot arm comprises a first driving joint, a second driving joint, a third driving joint, a fourth driving joint, a fifth driving joint, a sixth driving joint and a seventh driving joint; the mounting parts comprise a first mounting part, a second mounting part, a third mounting part, a fourth mounting part, a fifth mounting part, a sixth mounting part, a six-dimensional force sensor and an end effector; according to the double-arm system and the humanoid robot composed of the double-arm system, the joints and the installation parts are separated and connected in sequence, modular design can be achieved, and maintenance and upgrading are convenient, a single arm has seven degrees of freedom, complex motion trail and posture adjustment can be achieved in a three-dimensional space, and meanwhile, the robot is convenient to use. The loading and working capacity of the arm is greatly improved, the space of a driving mechanism is reduced, and the running speed during action execution is increased.

title: Bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problems that an existing dexterous hand is low in response speed and short in service life, and adopts the technical scheme that the bionic mechanical arm mainly comprises an arm, the dexterous hand and a driving device, and the driving device comprises a driving motor and a transmission mechanism; the transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block, the sliding block is in transmission connection with fingers of the dexterous hand, the transmission mechanism further comprises two traction ropes wound on the output shaft in opposite directions, at least two rope grooves are formed in the peripheral side surrounding the output shaft, and the two traction ropes are wound in the two rope grooves respectively. The bionic mechanical arm further comprises a guide mechanism arranged between the driving motor and the sliding block, the guide mechanism comprises a guide piece used for enabling the two traction ropes to keep a distance in the axial direction of the output shaft of the driving motor, and the traction ropes are wound around the output shaft after being guided by the guide piece. The finger is mainly used for improving the response speed of the finger body.

title: ADAMS-based method for establishing biped robot parameterized model
abstract: The invention discloses a method for establishing a biped robot parameterized model based on an ADAMS, which comprises the following steps: S1, creating a global coordinate system MARKERG on a GROUND layer of ADAMS software, and setting an initial position as (0, 0, 0), and S2, constructing basic parts of a biped robot; s3, setting parameters for the design variable of each component in ADAMS software; s4, a LOCRELATIVETO function is used for defining the spatial position relation of all the components relative to the superior component; s5, the components are subjected to linkage adjustment; s6, creating rotation pair connection at key joint positions of the biped robot model; s7, motion planning of the biped robot is completed; s8, developing a user interaction interface; and S9, integrating the final model to a main menu of the ADAMS, and performing function closed loop of parameter input, simulation execution and real-time monitoring. According to the invention, stable operation of the biped robot in a complex motion environment is realized.

title: Biped robot capable of realizing operation dimension conversion based on single motor
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot capable of realizing operation dimension conversion based on a single motor, the biped robot comprises a robot leg structure, a leg pulling assembly and a motor structure, the robot leg structure comprises a hip joint shaft, a thigh part, a knee joint shaft, a shank part, an ankle joint shaft and a foot part; the thigh part is connected with the shank part through a knee joint shaft; the shank part is connected with the foot part through an ankle joint shaft; the motor structure is arranged in the hip joint shaft; the leg pulling assembly comprises a first pulling piece and a second pulling piece; one end of the first pulling piece is connected to the motor structure, and the other end is connected to the knee joint shaft; one end of the second pulling piece is connected to the motor structure, and the other end is connected to the ankle joint shaft; and rotation of the motor structure enables common pulling action of the first pulling piece and the second pulling piece to drive the thigh part and the shank part to generate linear movement of the robot. The multiple joints of the whole leg can be driven only through one motor structure and the multiple stretching pieces, the complexity and weight of the mechanical structure are greatly reduced, meanwhile, energy consumption and heat loss are reduced, and the energy utilization efficiency is improved.

title: Humanoid dexterous finger, humanoid dexterous hand adopting same and humanoid robot

title: Spring torque-increasing Z-shaped lifting module for anti-explosion humanoid robot and anti-explosion humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a spring torque-increasing Z-shaped lifting module for an anti-explosion humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the spring torque-increasing Z-shaped lifting module comprises a base, a first rotating joint, a second rotating joint and a third rotating joint, and further comprises a spring torque-increasing mechanism, and the spring torque-increasing mechanism comprises a first tension spring and a second tension spring; through cooperative work of a first tension spring and a second tension spring, the designed spring torque increasing mechanism can remarkably reduce loads of the first rotating joint and the second rotating joint, so that the joints are allowed to drive larger loads, and the working efficiency and the load capacity of the robot are improved; in addition, the invention further provides the anti-explosion humanoid robot which comprises the spring torque-increasing Z-shaped lifting module, better balance and flexibility can be provided by installing the spring torque-increasing Z-shaped lifting module, and the stability and adaptability of the robot in the complex environment are enhanced.

title: Multi-layer tail end quick-change system of anti-explosion humanoid robot, tail end executor and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a multi-layer tail end quick-changing system of an anti-explosion humanoid robot, a tail end executor and the humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robotics.The multi-layer tail end quick-changing system comprises a quick-changing device, a quick-changing tool motor side, a quick-changing tool disc and a quick-changing tool side which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; a quick-change tool motor side is mounted below the quick-change device through a mounting piece and comprises a motor mounting piece, a motor controller, a motor rotor mounting piece, a motor rotor, a motor stator, a motor stator circumferential positioning pin, a motor stator mounting piece, a left positioning bush and a right positioning bush; a tool is installed on the side of the quick-change tool through a clamping installation piece to form an end effector, and the end effector is installed on an arm of the humanoid robot to form the anti-explosion humanoid robot. According to the quick change system, through the high-precision positioning and locking mechanism, it is ensured that the clamp replaced every time can be accurately installed at the tail end of the robot, and the replacement precision and repetition of the clamp are ensured.

title: Joint module and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a joint module and a robot, and solves the problem that the torque of the joint module is still small under certain size limitation. The joint module comprises a motor shell, a center shaft, a first sun gear, a plurality of first planet gears, an inner gear ring, a first planet carrier, a rotor, a connecting sleeve and a stator. The rotor is arranged on the inner ring of the stator, the stator is fixedly connected with the motor shell, only a gap needs to be reserved between the rotor and the stator, and the radial size of the joint module is reduced. In addition, the rotor is arranged on the outer sides of the first sun gear and the first planet gear in a sleeving mode, the rotor and the first sun gear are connected through the connecting sleeve, and the axial size of the joint module is reduced. Namely, the radial size and the axial size of the joint module are reduced, and the torque capable of being borne by the joint module can be increased under the condition that the space of the joint position of the humanoid robot is limited.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb structure and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot lower limb structure and a robot. The lower limb structure comprises a hip unit, a thigh unit, a shank unit and a foot unit. The hip unit comprises a hip seat body, a first joint structure, a thigh swing drive, a thigh rotation drive and a thigh side-sway drive; the first joint structure comprises a first movable seat and a second movable seat; the thigh swing drive is mounted on the inner side of the hip seat body, and an output rotating shaft of the thigh swing drive is connected with the first movable seat; the thigh rotation drive is fixedly connected with the second movable seat, and an output rotating shaft of the thigh rotation drive is connected with the upper end of the thigh unit; the thigh side-sway drive is fixedly connected with the first movable seat, and an output rotating shaft of the thigh side-sway drive is connected with the second movable seat; the axial direction of a rotating shaft driven by thigh swing is parallel to the first direction; the axial direction of a rotating shaft of the thigh side-sway drive is perpendicular to the first direction; the axial direction of the rotating shaft of the thigh rotation drive is perpendicular to the first direction and the axial direction of the rotating shaft of the thigh side-sway drive.

title: Lower limb structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a lower limb structure of a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The biped robot lower limb structure comprises two walking foot devices installed at the bottom end of a biped robot, each walking foot device is composed of a quick release mechanism, a reinforcing part, a base mechanism and a foot sole, the bottom end of each quick release mechanism is fixedly connected with the top end of the corresponding base mechanism, the top end of each quick release mechanism is fixedly connected with the corresponding foot sole, and the reinforcing parts are installed between the quick release mechanisms and the foot sole connecting positions. The surface of the base mechanism is tightly attached to the bottoms of soles, and the soles are installed at the foot ends of the biped robot. Through the design of the walking foot device, when the base mechanism is damaged, the whole lower limb structure does not need to be replaced, only damaged parts need to be replaced, and the maintenance cost and time are reduced. Meanwhile, the biped robot is endowed with excellent terrain adaptability. The biped robot can easily cope with complex and changeable terrain environments by quickly detaching and replacing the foot ends with different functions.

title: Lower limb structure of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of biped humanoid robots, in particular to a biped robot lower limb structure which comprises a hip joint assembly 2, a thigh assembly 3 and a shank and foot assembly 4 which are sequentially connected, the hip joint assembly 2 comprises a left hip joint and a right hip joint which are symmetrical, and the thigh assembly 3 comprises two symmetrical thighs. The shank and foot assembly 4 comprises two sets of symmetrical shanks and feet, the left hip joint and the right hip joint are each provided with an integrated joint motor with the freedom degree in the three-dimensional direction, each thigh is provided with a knee joint motor with the freedom degree, and each shank and foot is provided with shank motors with the two freedom degrees. The lower limb structure of the biped robot has the advantages of being simple in structure, flexible to control, stable in dynamic performance and the like, can quickly respond to humanoid leg movement, and can be used in the lower limb structure of the humanoid robot through walking gait planning of the biped robot so as to promote technical development of the humanoid robot.

title: Anthropomorphic joint and robot

The driving part is in driving connection with at least one of the base body and the first joint section and drives the first joint section to rotate relative to the base body, and the second joint section rotates relative to the first joint section under the action of the connecting rod. title: Binding structure connecting device for wearable robot
abstract: The binding structure connecting device for the wearable robot comprises a clamping groove type sliding rail, and the clamping groove type sliding rail is fixedly connected with a robot body; and the sliding base is connected with the binding structure, the sliding base is matched with the clamping groove type sliding rail, the sliding base slides in or out from one end or the other end of the clamping groove type sliding rail, and the binding structure is separated from or connected with the robot body. Through cooperative use of the clamping groove type sliding rail and the sliding base, quick disassembly and assembly between the binding structure of the wearable robot and the robot body can be achieved, and maintenance and replacement of the binding structure are facilitated; by arranging the clamping groove type sliding rails with different lengths, large-range adjustment of the position of the wearable robot binding structure relative to the robot body can be achieved, and therefore the wearable robot binding structure is better suitable for people of different body types to use; through the locking deflector rod on the sliding base, position locking of the binding structure of the wearable robot relative to the robot body can be achieved, and the advantage of stable and reliable force transmission is achieved.

title: Control method and system based on biped robot door operation and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and system based on biped robot door operation and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of biped robot control. The control method comprises the following steps of: grasping the door handle; acquiring and determining information; generating a first instruction according to the first real-time point cloud information and the first real-time ontology information; a first lower limb balance adjustment step; the information acquisition and determination step comprises the following steps: acquiring environment information in real time based on a preset frequency; body information of the biped robot is collected in real time based on the preset frequency; the first lower limb balance adjustment step comprises the step of generating a first balance instruction according to the first real-time pose information, the first real-time point cloud information and the first real-time body information. According to the control method, upper limb control and lower limb control of the biped robot are decoupled, and the control method is suitable for controlling the biped humanoid robot operation door.

title: Linear electric drive joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical joints, in particular to a humanoid robot linear electric drive joint which comprises a shell, a front end cover and a rear end cover, the front end cover and the rear end cover are fixed to the two ends of the shell respectively, and an execution assembly and a drive control assembly are arranged in the shell; the execution assembly comprises a reverse planetary roller screw and a motor, and the drive control assembly comprises an encoder composed of a coded disc and a magnetic ring, a pull pressure sensor and a driver. Aiming at the technical problem that an existing linear joint has defects, a reverse planetary roller lead screw is adopted as a main transmission component, and the lead screw, a roller and a nut of the reverse planetary roller lead screw are in linear contact, so that high precision, long service life, high integration level and high thrust density can be achieved while high bearing and high speed are achieved; therefore, the method is suitable for use scenes of humanoid robot joints.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot lower limb system, comprising: a crotch portion comprising a rope-driven motor; the thighs are installed at the two ends of the crotch respectively and can rotate along a pitch axis and a roll axis; the shanks are installed at the lower ends of the two thighs respectively, a knee joint motor is installed on the upper portion of each thigh, and the shanks are driven to rotate relative to the thighs through the knee joint motors and the synchronous belts; the ankles are mounted at the lower ends of the two shanks respectively; the rope drive motor drives the shank opposite to the ankle to rotate through the steel wire rope. The synchronous belt has the characteristics of high transmission precision and strong anti-interference capability in a non-severe environment, the rope drive has the characteristic of high sensitivity, and all motors are intensively arranged at the uppermost end of the leg structure, so that the center of gravity is concentrated on the upper part, the inertia of leg movement is reduced, and the movement control is facilitated. Meanwhile, the principle that the left leg and the right leg are designed into blocks is adopted, so that the left leg and the right leg can rotate independently, and walking in multiple terrains is facilitated.

title: Biped robot leg structure
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure of a biped robot, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and solves the problem that the mass distribution of a series connection structure is too close to the tail end of a leg in the leg design on the basis of realizing two-degree-of-freedom rotation, namely left-right movement along an X axis and front-back movement along a Y axis. The movement of a human hip joint can be better simulated; the driver of the thigh part firstly drives the middleware, and then the middleware drives the driven part to move, so that relative sliding of the thighbone and the tibia and bending movement of the knee joint are simulated under the assistance of the middleware; the telescopic driving part of the shank part drives the universal joint to rotate at any angle in the telescopic process, meanwhile, the movable plate can conduct front-back pitching, left-right swinging and plane rotation, three-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved, the parallel structure is adopted, and better distribution of force and torque can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot finger transmission system
abstract: A humanoid robot finger transmission system belongs to the technical field of manipulators and comprises a palm part and finger parts, each finger part is provided with a transmission system, each transmission system comprises a driving mechanism and a connecting rod mechanism, and each driving mechanism is a miniature double-buckle pushing chain device arranged on the side, close to the palm back, of the palm part. A first installation space is formed in the palm part, close to one side of the palm center, of the driving mechanism, the connecting rod mechanism comprises a first connecting rod connected between the middle knuckles and the far-end knuckles and a second connecting rod connected between the near-end knuckles and the middle knuckles, and a driving rod assembly is connected between the second connecting rod and the output end of the miniature double-buckle pushing chain device. And a second mounting space is formed in the finger part on the outer sides of the connecting rod I and the connecting rod II. The miniature double-buckle pushing chain device is used as a driving mechanism of each finger part, so that the cost is reduced, the internal mounting space of the manipulator can be greatly expanded, and the manipulator can realize function upgrading by mounting more sensor parts.
