title: Multi-mode wearable humanoid robot data acquisition and remote operation system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode wearable humanoid robot data acquisition and remote operation system. The system comprises a wearable device which acquires real human body data; the environment sensing equipment collects real environment data; the communication equipment performs multi-mode data transmission; the storage device stores data acquired by the wearable device and the environment sensing device, and performs data writing and data reading; the computing device receives the data collected by the wearable device and the environment sensing device, carries out calculation, maps the human body data into humanoid robot data, and generates a control instruction of the humanoid robot; and the humanoid robot body equipment executes a corresponding action according to the control instruction. Therefore, through the human body posture data, the reasonability of the posture and action of the humanoid robot is improved, the completion rate of similar task learning of the humanoid robot in a complex scene is improved, mature industrial equipment is adopted, the cost is low, the organization and implementation difficulty is small, and the method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of data collection quality and benefits.

title: Low-gravity motion simulation method and system based on spatial orientation perception consistency
abstract: The invention provides a low-gravity motion simulation method and system based on spatial directional perception consistency, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a low-gravity motion curve into an actual low-gravity motion channel and a ground motion simulation channel, and reducing the axial gravity component of a body through the adjustment of a human body posture. Therefore, low-gravity motion input characteristics required by an actual low-gravity channel are equivalently simulated; and further calculating motion sensing data of the two channels by using a motion sensing model, generating a motion control instruction by taking motion sensing error minimization as a target, and further performing motion simulation based on the motion control instruction. By adjusting the static posture of the human body, the motion sensing features under the low-gravity condition are equivalently simulated in a certain motion space, and motion simulation under the low-gravity environment is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot whole-body coordination control method based on mass center dynamic model
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot whole-body coordination control method based on a mass center dynamical model. The method comprises the steps that system modeling is conducted on a humanoid robot according to the mass center dynamical model; establishing a relationship between arm momentum and centroid momentum based on whole-body kinematics and a momentum conservation principle; a whole nonlinear optimization control problem is constructed and solved in real time, and a controller predicts the motion trail of the robot in a future period of time; feedforward torque is obtained through inverse dynamics calculation, and joint torque is issued in combination with a joint PD controller. The invention designs a nonlinear model predictive control problem for whole-body coordination control of the humanoid robot, reasonably plans a system state, an arm tail end state, a foot end state and a reference trajectory of control input, and designs equality constraints and inequality constraints necessary for whole-body coordination movement of the robot; task trajectory constraint and momentum conservation constraint on the tail end of the arm are added, so that the ability of the arm to assist in motion balance is more prominent.

The visual auxiliary assembly is arranged in the modularized forearm assembly, the camera assembly can be moved out of the forearm shell assembly or contained in the forearm shell assembly through opening and closing of the forearm protection shell in the visual auxiliary assembly, and visual auxiliary of the position of the view blind area is achieved through opening and closing of the forearm protection shell in the position of the view blind area; therefore, the humanoid effect is better.

title: Robot for Assisting With and Performing Household Chores
abstract: A folding robot for assisting with and performing household chores includes a head having a screen and a sensor, an elongate neck member, a torso, one or more arms connected to the torso, a riser member connected and rotatable with respect to the torso, one or more legs connected to the riser member by a hip joint, and a controller configured to send and receive data associated with the robot for completion of household tasks. Each arm includes a first arm member, a second arm member, a wrist member, and at least two fingers. Each leg includes a leg member, a first drive wheel disposed at a first end of the leg member coaxial with the hip joint, and a second drive wheel disposed at a second end of the leg member. The first drive wheel and second drive wheel are independently controllable for travel of the robot.

title: Biped robot, walking control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot walking control, and discloses a biped robot, a walking control method and device thereof and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps that the mass center state of the robot in each control period is acquired, and the mass center states comprise the planning mass center state and the measuring mass center state; calculating a capture point error of the robot in each control period based on the planned centroid state and the measured centroid state; accumulating the capture point error of each control period to obtain a total accumulation error of the capture points; when the capture point error or the capture point cumulative total error exceeds a preset threshold range, adjusting the landing point position of the robot swing leg based on the capture point cumulative total error; and the swinging legs are controlled to move, so that the robot lands at the adjusted landing point position. According to the method, it is guaranteed that the biped robot can still walk stably without falling down when being disturbed by thrust.

title: Force feedback exoskeleton and humanoid robot imitation learning method
abstract: The invention discloses a force feedback exoskeleton and a humanoid robot imitation learning method. The number of the arm exoskeleton parts is two, the two arm exoskeleton parts are symmetrically connected to the backpack part, and the number of the data glove parts is two so as to collect position and posture information of the left hand and the right hand respectively. title: Humanoid robot finite time path tracking control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot finite time path tracking control method, and relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot finite time path tracking control realized by adopting an active-disturbance-rejection disturbance observer and a second-order sliding mode, and the specific steps are as follows: establishing a matrix expression model of humanoid robot nonlinear dynamics; designing an angular velocity subsystem control model; designing a humanoid robot displacement subsystem model; designing an active-disturbance-rejection disturbance observer; the control input vector of the second-order sliding mode finite time trajectory tracking is designed, so that the actual displacement of the humanoid robot can accurately track the given displacement, and the control parameters and the control input vector of the second-order sliding mode finite time trajectory tracking are adjusted, so that the tracking error of the humanoid robot completes minimum convergence within the finite time. According to the method, the external environment interference can be estimated within finite time, the system uncertainty caused by parameter perturbation can be effectively compensated, and the stability, robustness and adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Waist and hip assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist and hip assembly and a humanoid robot. The waist and hip assembly comprises a barrel structure, a pitching motor, a supporting piece, a rolling motor and a yawing motor. The cylinder structure is provided with a first wiring channel; the pitching motor is accommodated in the barrel structure; the pitching motor is provided with a first axis inclined relative to the left-right direction and the front-back direction of the humanoid robot. title: Humanoid robot multi-motion switching control method and system based on imitation learning
abstract: According to the humanoid robot multi-motion switching control method and system based on imitation learning, imitation learning is performed on the basis of a generative adversarial network, and the sampling probability of each motion skill is dynamically adjusted according to the performance condition of the humanoid robot for executing each motion skill; according to the method, the humanoid robot can uniformly master different motion skills, the humanoid robot can integrate different motion skill combinations, the severity of the mode collapse problem is effectively relieved, and good flexibility and expandability are achieved.

title: Lower limb mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb mechanism and a humanoid robot. title: Shoulder joint assembly, arm assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shoulder joint assembly, an arm assembly and a humanoid robot, the shoulder joint assembly comprises a shoulder joint shell, a first driving part and a second driving part, the shoulder joint shell comprises a first barrel and a second barrel, the peripheral surface of the second barrel is connected with one end of the first barrel in the axial direction, the first barrel is provided with a first axis, and the second barrel is provided with a second axis; the first cylinder comprises a first axis and a second axis, the first axis and the second axis intersect and are perpendicular, a surface which passes through the first axis and is perpendicular to the second axis is a reference surface, the second cylinder comprises a first surface and a second surface which are opposite in the axial direction, and the distance between the first surface and the reference surface is smaller than that between the second surface and the reference surface; the first driving part is coaxially connected with the first barrel to drive the shoulder joint shell to rotate around the first axis, the second driving part is connected with the second barrel and the large arm assembly to drive the large arm assembly to rotate around the second axis, the middle point of the second driving part in the axial direction is located on the first axis, and the lightweight degree of the shoulder joint assembly is improved.

title: Foot structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a foot structure which comprises two thighs mounted at the lower end of a robot body, shanks mounted at the lower ends of the thighs and soles mounted at the lower ends of the shanks, connecting ports are formed in the middles of the upper surfaces of the soles, and air suction ports are formed in the bottom surfaces of the connecting ports in a penetrating mode. The upper surface of the sole is fixedly connected with a connecting frame, the upper surface of the connecting frame is connected with a flow dividing assembly, the other end of the flow dividing assembly is connected with the side wall of the sole, and a reverse blowing opening penetrates through the side wall of the sole. The humanoid robot comprises a robot body and further comprises the leg structure. According to the leg structure and the humanoid robot, the standing stability can be improved in the walking stage and the static stage of the robot body; when the robot body walks, if leaves and other sundries with large area and light weight are carelessly adhered to and blocked at the air suction ports of the soles, the blocking objects can be blown away before the soles step on the ground, so that the blocking probability is reduced.

title: Robot joint
abstract: The utility model provides a robot joint, which relates to the technical field of robot joints and comprises a palm mechanism, the palm mechanism comprises a shell, an adjuster is arranged at one end of the shell, a butt joint ring is arranged at one end of the adjuster, a thumb knot is arranged on one side of the shell, a butt joint device is arranged on the thumb knot, and the butt joint ring is connected with the butt joint device. And butt joint devices are arranged in the butt joint ring and the butt joint devices. According to the utility model, the arm elbow of the robot is in butt joint with the shell, so that the control equipment of the shell is started to control and manage the regulator and the thumb knot, and when a worker only needs to adjust the robot, the finger mechanism can be controlled and adjusted through the butt joint ring of the regulator and the butt joint device of the thumb knot; in this way, the finger mechanism can be controlled and adjusted through a limiting stopper, an adjusting ring and a transfer device in the finger mechanism, so that joints of the robot are more humanoid, and the practicability of the robot in the actual using process is improved.

title: Sensor mounting device for humanoid mobile machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a sensor mounting device for a human-shaped mobile machine, and relates to the technical field of robot interaction. The robot comprises a robot mechanism, the robot mechanism comprises a base, the bottom of the base is rotationally connected with a lead screw, and a roller assembly is arranged at the end, away from the lead screw, of the lead screw. The rotating force of the rotating rod is matched with assemblies such as the protection plate, the positioning rod and the clamping block A, the protection plate is pushed to make circular motion through the rotating rod so as to be closed with the box body, then the knob is rotated to drive the positioning rod to rotate, the positioning rod drives the clamping block A on the positioning rod to rotate, and the box body is protected from being damaged. And through the mutual contact effect of the clamping block A and the protection plate, the protection plate is limited, so that the dust prevention effect on the sensor in the box body is achieved, the situation that the sensor is exposed outside for a long time is avoided, and the service life is prolonged.

title: Intelligent robot
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent robot which comprises a head mechanism, a neck mechanism and a body mechanism. Wherein the head mechanism comprises a head bracket, a head main body, a head shell, a display screen and a head bottom shell; the head body, the head shell, the display screen and the head bottom shell are all fixed to the head support. Wherein the head shell comprises a mask and a head rear shell; the head body comprises a main control board, a capacitive touch sensor, a head direct current motor and a transmission structure of the head direct current motor. The capacitive touch sensor is fixed in the head shell; the head direct current motor and the transmission structure thereof comprise a head direct current motor, a head motor frame, a head gear set and a bearing; the head direct current motor drives the head gear set to rotate, and the head gear set is connected with the bearing. The bearing is arranged on the head bottom shell; the head direct current motor controls the head mechanism to shake the head and is fixed in the head motor frame; and the head motor frame is fixed on the head bottom shell.

title: Humanoid robot grabbing method based on three-dimensional vision
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot grabbing method based on three-dimensional vision, and the method comprises the following specific steps: S1, environment modeling and perception: carrying out the three-dimensional scanning of a working environment, and constructing a three-dimensional map of the environment; s2, object identification and 6D attitude estimation: identifying a target object, and estimating the position and attitude of the object in a camera coordinate system; s3, coordinate conversion and target positioning, wherein the posture of the object is converted into a robot base coordinate system from a camera coordinate system through TF conversion; and S4, path planning and motion control are conducted, specifically, path planning is conducted through a cumotion algorithm, a grabbing path is generated, and the two arms are driven to move according to the planned track to achieve grabbing. By means of environment modeling and sensing, the robot can update environment information in real time, conduct three-dimensional scanning on the working environment and generate the three-dimensional grid model of the environment in real time, the model is used for obstacle detection and avoidance planning, and the dynamic environment adaptability of the robot to object grabbing is improved.

title: Force impedance dynamic flexibility control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a force impedance dynamic flexibility control method for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: designing a dynamic sliding mode surface as a combination of an inner ring expected contact force and a derivative of the humanoid robot; an inner ring expected contact force input control law is designed, so that the error of the inner ring expected contact force of the humanoid robot is minimum; based on a dynamic sliding mode surface and an inner ring expected contact force input control law, designing an outer ring force impedance control law by enabling a force impedance characteristic to approach a force impedance expected characteristic; the outer loop force impedance control law comprises a bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error number, and the bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error is converged to a bearing capacity compensation parameter identification error threshold value, so that the dynamic flexibility control of the force impedance of the robot is realized. The invention further discloses a force impedance dynamic flexibility control system of the humanoid robot, the dynamic flexibility of posture operation of the humanoid robot can be achieved, force impedance control precision is effectively achieved, and good multi-working-condition adaptability is achieved.

title: Waist and hip integration mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a waist and hip integration mechanism and a humanoid robot. The waist turnover driving piece is arranged on the hip support; the two lateral extension driving pieces are oppositely arranged on the hip support, and the axes of the driving ends of the two lateral extension driving pieces coincide; the two side unfolding supports are connected to the driving ends of the side unfolding driving pieces correspondingly. The two pitching driving parts are respectively arranged on the side extension bracket; the two pitching supports are connected to the driving end of the pitching driving piece. The two hip turnover driving pieces are arranged on the pitching support, and the driving ends of the hip turnover driving pieces are connected with leg mechanisms of the humanoid robot. Nine degrees of freedom at the waist and hip joints of a traditional humanoid robot are optimized into seven degrees of freedom, the number of motors is reduced, the overall weight is reduced, high flexibility and maneuverability are kept, meanwhile, the cruising ability is improved, more space is vacated for the robot, and the lightweight design of the robot is achieved.

title: Lower limb structure and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the lower limb structure and the humanoid robot, the lower limb structure comprises a yaw driving part, a pitching driving part, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, the pitching driving part is connected with the yaw driving part, the yaw driving part is used for driving the pitching driving part to rotate around a yaw shaft, and the thigh assembly comprises a thigh shell and a driving mechanism; the thigh shell comprises a first shell and a second shell, the first shell and the second shell are connected in the first direction, one end of the second shell is connected with the pitching driving piece, the pitching driving piece is used for driving the thigh assembly to rotate around the pitching axis, and the driving mechanism is installed in the end, close to the pitching driving piece, of the thigh shell. The connecting face of the first shell and the second shell is a plane, the yaw axis coincides with the connecting face, the pitch axis intersects and is perpendicular to the yaw axis, the shank assembly is rotationally connected with the end, away from the yaw driving piece, of the thigh shell and connected with the driving mechanism, and the static stability and the dynamic stability of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Lower limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The lower limb assembly comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a supporting piece and a first driving mechanism, and one end of the second connecting piece is rotationally connected with the first connecting piece; the supporting piece is rotationally connected with the other end of the second connecting piece; the first driving mechanism comprises a first driving piece, a first crank and a first connecting rod, the first driving piece is embedded into the second connecting piece and drives the first crank to rotate around a first axis, the first axis extends in the first direction, the first crank comprises a main body and a connecting column which are connected, and the main body is connected with the first driving piece; the length direction of the connecting column intersects with the first axis. title: Humanoid robot leg structure
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot leg structure which comprises thighs, knee joints, shanks, ankle joints and shanks. The thigh part comprises a first joint module motor and a second joint module motor; the knee joint comprises a first pull rod, a second pull rod and a connecting seat; the first joint module motor is connected with the connecting seat through the first pull rod; the shank part comprises a shank pull rod and a third joint module motor; the second joint module motor is connected with the foot through a second pull rod and a shank pull rod; the third joint module motor is connected with the foot through a shank pull rod; the foot part comprises a front support and a rear support which are connected through a foot support rotating shaft. Compared with the prior art, the humanoid robot has the advantages that the second joint module motor and the third joint module motor are located on the thigh portion and the shank portion respectively, symmetrical arrangement is not needed, module motors with larger size and torque can be arranged, and the motion ability of the humanoid robot is enhanced; the foot part comprises a front support and a rear support, and can adapt to different terrains.

abstract: According to the elbow structure of the humanoid robot, the control precision is improved, the impact resistance is high, the service life is long, the installation position error is greatly reduced, self-adaptive angle change can be conducted after stress is conducted, in this way, large deformation generated when an elbow is subjected to overturning moment can be avoided, disassembly and assembly are convenient, the machining precision is higher, the installation precision is better, and the practicability is high. title: Waterproof and dustproof humanoid robot actuator
abstract: The invention provides a waterproof and dustproof humanoid robot actuator, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, the waterproof and dustproof humanoid robot actuator comprises a supporting arm, the supporting arm comprises a supporting base, a rotating base is longitudinally and rotatably mounted at the top of the supporting base, a driving assembly is fixedly mounted between the supporting base and the rotating base, and a hollow dustproof pipe is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the rotating base; the hollow dustproof pipe is nested on the outer wall of the supporting base and is rotatably matched with the supporting base, the bottom of the hollow dustproof pipe is fixedly provided with the thin pipe filter screen formed by arranging thin pipes, and the thin pipe filter screen is provided with liquid drainage holes. Dust and water flow can be effectively isolated in a small occupied space, and the waterproof and dustproof effects of the actuator are improved; the movable arm can be prevented from being out of control in the working process through the auxiliary driving sliding block and the driving screw, and operation accidents are reduced.

title: Lower limb device and humanoid robot
abstract: The lower limb device is used for the humanoid robot and comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly, a first matching ring and a second matching ring, the hip joint assembly comprises a pitching driving part, a transverse rolling driving part, a yaw driving part and a first matching part, the pitching driving part is rotationally connected with the transverse rolling driving part, the transverse rolling driving part is rotationally connected with the yaw driving part, and the first matching part is rotationally connected with the thigh assembly. The first matching part is connected with the yaw driving part, the thigh assembly comprises a second matching part, one of the second matching part and the first matching part is provided with a protrusion, the other one of the second matching part and the first matching part is provided with a groove, and the protrusion is matched with the groove so that the second matching part and the first matching part can be relatively fixed in the circumferential direction of the yaw driving part. The first matching ring and the second matching ring are arranged on the periphery of the second matching piece and the periphery of the first matching piece in a sleeving mode correspondingly, the first matching ring and the second matching ring are detachably connected, so that the second matching piece and the first matching piece are fixedly connected in the axial direction of the yaw driving piece, and the convenience degree of disassembly and assembly of the hip joint assembly and the thigh assembly is improved.

title: Shoulder mechanism, limb structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shoulder mechanism, a limb structure and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The shoulder mechanism comprises a first driving assembly, a first transfer frame, a first transfer block and a second driving assembly; the first adapter frame is connected to the first adapter block, the first adapter block is connected to an output shaft of the first driving assembly, and the first driving assembly is used for driving the first adapter frame to rotate around a first rotating axis; the second driving assembly is rotationally installed on the first adapter frame and used for driving the second driving assembly to rotate around a second rotating axis relative to the first adapter frame, and the second rotating axis is perpendicular to the first rotating axis. According to the shoulder mechanism, the large arm mechanism and the small arm mechanism in the humanoid robot can be conveniently disassembled, assembled and maintained in the later period.

title: Heavy upper limb exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides a heavy upper limb exoskeleton robot which comprises a back assembly, a shoulder assembly, an upper arm assembly and a lower arm assembly, and the back assembly can be fixed to the back of a human body; the shoulder component is connected with the upper end of the back component; the upper arm assembly is connected with the shoulder assembly, the upper arm assembly is bound on a big arm of a human body, and the upper arm assembly can rotate relative to the shoulder assembly; the lower arm assembly is connected with the upper arm assembly, the lower arm assembly is bound on a forearm of a human body, and the lower arm assembly can rotate relative to the upper arm assembly. The exoskeleton robot adopts the three-degree-of-freedom shoulder joint appearance design, and it is ensured that the exoskeleton robot adapts to the scene where operation is narrow. The exoskeleton robot cannot slide down due to the weight of the exoskeleton robot, so that the gyration center of the joint is kept consistent with a human body, and the stability and reliability are kept in a high-load environment by adopting a high-strength aluminum alloy material and a high-power motor.
abstract_en: The invention provides a heavy upper limb exoskeleton robot which comprises a back assembly, a shoulder assembly, an upper arm assembly and a lower arm assembly, and the back assembly can be fixed to the back of a human body; the shoulder component is connected with the upper end of the back component; the upper arm assembly is connected with the shoulder assembly, the upper arm assembly is bound on a big arm of a human body, and the upper arm assembly can rotate relative to the shoulder assembly; the lower arm assembly is connected with the upper arm assembly, the lower arm assembly is bound on a forearm of a human body, and the lower arm assembly can rotate relative to the upper arm assembly. title: Lower limb leg-foot structure with jumping ability and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb leg-foot structure with jumping ability and a biped robot. The lower limb leg-foot structure comprises a thigh assembly, a shank assembly and a foot assembly which are sequentially connected from top to bottom. A thigh body, a knee joint rocker arm and a shank pull rod of the thigh assembly and a shank body of the shank assembly form a four-bar mechanism. The thigh body, the knee joint driving motor and the knee joint rocker arm form a slider-crank mechanism. The four-connecting-rod mechanism and the slider-crank mechanism form a set of combined mechanism through the common knee joint rocker arm so as to drive the knee joint to rotate. According to the combined mechanism, the linear motion speed of the knee joint driving motor is amplified into the rotation angular speed of the knee joint through the variable reduction ratio amplification effect of the four connecting rods, and the lower limb of the knee joint driving motor has the explosive jumping ability under the condition of the conventional output speed.

title: Foot structure for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a foot structure for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The foot structure comprises a sole, a heel, a direct drive motor and a flange bearing. The soles are in contact with the ground to realize left-right rotation; the heel is connected with the shank to realize front-back rotation. The direct-drive motor is installed at the front end of the sole and connected with the heel through a motor rotor to control left-right rotation. The flange bearing is installed at the upper end of the heel and connected with the shank to control front-back rotation. The single-ankle and double-ankle conversion mechanism is fixed or released by screws through the through holes in the side faces of the soles and the threaded holes of the heels. When the sole and the heel are loosened, the motor drives the sole to rotate relative to the heel, and the double-ankle function is achieved; and the screw fixation is in a single-ankle state. By means of the design, complexity of traditional double-ankle design is simplified, production cost and time consumption are reduced, adaptability and flexibility of feet are improved, and the robot can better adapt to complex terrains and diversified environments.

title: Holographic walking digital robot based on large model technology and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a holographic walking digital robot based on a large model technology and a control method thereof, the robot can carry out holographic digital human image display and is provided with a chassis capable of walking, the overall implementation cost is low, the robot can move according to guidance space information, the interaction is vivid and visual, and the robot is convenient to use. According to the holographic walking digital robot based on the large model technology and the control method of the holographic walking digital robot, man-machine interaction and smooth interaction are achieved in the mode that a local large model and a cloud large model are combined, and therefore the holographic walking digital robot based on the large model technology and the control method of the holographic walking digital robot have the advantages of being low in cost, capable of conducting interaction based on space, flexible and natural in display image and smooth in interaction mode.

title: Humanoid robot simulation environment based on Isaac Sim and implementation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot simulation environment based on Isaac Sim and an implementation method thereof, relates to the technical field of robot simulation, is suitable for construction and verification of an industrial inspection and test laboratory scene, and accurately constructs equipment, obstacles and scene layout models by collecting detailed parameters of equipment and obstacles in the industrial scene and utilizing a 3D modeling tool, so as to realize the simulation of the humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that firstly, a humanoid robot model is established, topological optimization and material detail processing are conducted, then the humanoid robot model is deployed in a simulation environment, movement, interaction and experimental operation of the robot in a laboratory are simulated through an integrated control system and a high-precision physical engine, and real-time movement control over the robot in simulation is achieved in combination with ROS2 and MoveIt2. According to the invention, the accuracy and reliability of task execution of the robot in a laboratory environment are improved, and effective verification and support are provided for application of the robot to an actual industrial experiment scene.

title: Heterogeneous exoskeleton multistage synchronous linkage telescopic outer limb and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a heterogeneous exoskeleton multistage synchronous linkage telescopic outer limb and a working method thereof.The outer limb comprises a driving mechanism, an exoskeleton connecting shell, multistage telescopic mechanisms and a spherical foot end component, the driving mechanism and the exoskeleton connecting shell are connected through screws, and the multistage telescopic mechanisms are sequentially connected through guide rails; the spherical foot end part is connected with the three-stage telescopic mechanism through a bolt; according to the method, human body movement is analyzed through the control system, the telescopic state of the outer limbs is controlled, and closed loop control is achieved. The working end can rotate conveniently, the working device can be replaced conveniently, and the working device can adapt to different kinds of work easily.

title: Data acquisition system, terminal and method for end effector of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data acquisition system, terminal and method for an end effector of a humanoid robot. The system comprises at least one data acquisition terminal and a data collection device, wherein the data collection device is respectively connected with each data acquisition terminal; the data acquisition terminal is provided with an actuator corresponding to an end actuator of the humanoid robot; the data acquisition terminal is used for acquiring process data corresponding to a scene task in the process of executing the scene task, and sending the process data to the data collection device; the data collection device is used for collecting process data to obtain scene task data corresponding to at least one scene task, the scene task data corresponding to each scene task is used for training an artificial intelligence (AI) model, and the AI model obtained by training is used for controlling the humanoid robot to execute the scene task. The system can complete data acquisition without depending on a robot body, and is high in adaptability.

title: Lower limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a lower limb assembly and a humanoid robot, the lower limb assembly comprises a machine body, a first turnover side-sway motor, a second turnover side-sway motor, a thigh pitching motor, a thigh connecting piece and a shank pitching motor, and the first turnover side-sway motor is fixedly connected with the machine body; the second turnover side-sway motor is rotatably connected with the first turnover side-sway motor; the thigh pitching motor is rotatably connected with the second turnover side-sway motor; the thigh connecting piece is fixedly connected with the thigh pitching motor, an avoiding part is arranged on the thigh connecting piece, and the avoiding part is used for preventing the thigh connecting piece from interfering with the second turnover side-sway motor; and the shank pitching motor is fixedly connected with the thigh connecting piece. The maneuverability of the robot is improved, and the motion space of the legs of the robot is increased.

title: Inverse kinematics solving method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an inverse kinematics solving method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, the method is applied to a mechanical arm of a humanoid robot, the mechanical arm comprises a plurality of joints, the joints are driven by a rotating motor and a linear motor, and the method comprises the steps that a posture transformation matrix of the mechanical arm is obtained; a forward transfer matrix of the mechanical arm is obtained; obtaining a multivariate nonlinear equation set according to the attitude transformation matrix and the forward transfer matrix; according to the Newton Hessian method, obtaining an approximate matrix of the inverse matrix of the multivariate nonlinear equation set; and according to the tail end pose of the mechanical arm, the angles of the multiple joints of the mechanical arm are inversely solved through the approximate matrix. According to the method, the calculation amount of inverse kinematics solution can be reduced, and the solution speed is improved.

title: Biped robot control method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a biped robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that in response to a received stepping instruction of the biped robot, a stepping track of the biped robot is obtained, the stepping track is used for representing a motion track of a swing foot of the biped robot from a current posture to an expected posture, the biped robot further comprises supporting feet and a robot body, and the supporting feet are used for supporting the robot body to be in a stable state; the fuselage is controlled to move in the first direction based on the current centroid position of the fuselage and the current position of the supporting leg, a first moving position is obtained, and the first direction is used for representing the direction of the supporting leg relative to the swing leg; based on the stepping track and the first moving position, the machine body is controlled to move in the second direction, a second moving position is obtained, and the second direction is used for representing the moving direction of the swing foot in the stepping track. The technical problem that the control effect on the biped robot is poor in the prior art is solved.

title: Smart old-age care data remote transmission method and humanoid old-age care robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent old-age care data remote transmission method and a human-shaped old-age care robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-transmitted heart rate data sequence, a current blood oxygen data sequence, a historical heart rate data sequence and a historical blood oxygen data sequence of an old-age person, obtaining suspected heart rate abnormal data, obtaining comparison heart rate data of each piece of suspected heart rate abnormal data and the initial health reflection degree, obtaining related blood oxygen data of each piece of suspected heart rate abnormal data, obtaining the initial health reflection degree of the related blood oxygen data of each piece of suspected heart rate abnormal data, obtaining the final health reflection degree of each piece of suspected heart rate abnormal data, and obtaining the final health reflection degree of each piece of suspected heart rate abnormal data. And the data transmitted preferentially are obtained. The invention aims to solve the problem that normal heart rate data in a part of movement process can be preferentially transmitted when heart rate data when the body health of a pension has a problem is preferentially transmitted.

title: Leg assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The leg assembly is used for the humanoid robot, the leg assembly comprises a thigh shell, a first driving piece, a shank piece and a first connecting rod, and one end, in the first direction, of the thigh shell is used for being connected with a crotch assembly; at least part of the first driving piece is contained in the thigh shell; the shank part is rotationally connected with one end, far away from the crotch assembly, of the thigh shell in the first direction; the first connecting rod comprises a first end and a second end which are opposite, the first end is connected with the first driving piece, the second end is connected with the shank piece, and the first end is located on the outer side of the second end in the second direction; the first direction is the up-down direction of the humanoid robot, and the second direction is the left-right direction of the humanoid robot. According to the leg assembly, the size of the humanoid robot in the left-right direction can be reduced, the gravity center is not prone to shifting, and the humanoid effect is good.

title: Hip joint mechanism, crotch assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint mechanism, a crotch assembly and a humanoid robot. The hip joint mechanism comprises a first driving part, a mounting bracket, a second driving part and a third driving part, the first driving part is used for driving the lower limb assembly to rotate around a first axis; an inclined included angle is formed between the first axis and the left-right direction of the humanoid robot; the mounting bracket comprises a first plate, a second plate and a third plate which are connected in sequence; the surface, back to the first plate, of the second plate is fixedly connected with a rotor of the first driving part; the second driving piece is used for driving the lower limb assembly to rotate around a second axis; a shell of the second driving piece is fixedly connected with the first plate; the third driving part is used for driving the lower limb assembly to rotate around a third axis, a shell of the third driving part comprises a connecting shell and a containing shell, the connecting shell is rotationally connected with the third plate and fixedly connected with a rotor of the second driving part, and a rotor of the third driving part is used for being fixedly connected with the lower limb assembly. The hip joint mechanism is simple in structural arrangement and high in space utilization rate.

title: Pet feeding method based on humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a pet feeding method based on a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: controlling a humanoid robot to pick up at least part of scattered food and place the scattered food in a food tray of a feeder under the condition that the feeder is detected to feed a pet and the food is scattered; controlling the feeder to weigh the food in the food tray to obtain a first food weight; calculating a food weight difference according to a preset feeding weight and the first food weight; the food weight difference is a difference value between the preset feeding weight and the first food weight; the feeder is controlled to throw food into the food tray again according to the food weight difference; wherein the second food weight of the food put again is equal to the food weight difference. The method not only ensures that the pets eat enough food, but also avoids food waste.

The method comprises the following steps: controlling a humanoid robot to pick up at least part of scattered food and place the scattered food in a food tray of a feeder under the condition that the feeder is detected to feed a pet and the food is scattered; controlling the feeder to weigh the food in the food tray to obtain a first food weight; calculating a food weight difference according to a preset feeding weight and the first food weight; the food weight difference is a difference value between the preset feeding weight and the first food weight; the feeder is controlled to throw food into the food tray again according to the food weight difference; wherein the second food weight of the food put again is equal to the food weight difference. The method not only ensures that the pets eat enough food, but also avoids food waste.

title: Finger assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a finger assembly and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The finger assembly comprises a support, a finger piece, a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly and a third driving assembly. The first driving assembly, the second driving assembly and the third driving assembly are arranged on the support and connected with the finger piece and can drive the finger piece to move in three degrees of freedom. The first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece are located outside the finger piece, so that the space in the finger piece is not occupied, the structure of the finger piece is more compact, and the finger piece moves more flexibly. When the first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece break down and need to be detached and maintained, the first driving piece, the second driving piece and the third driving piece can be conveniently detached from the support, the finger piece does not need to be detached, and the detaching and maintaining difficulty of the finger assembly is reduced.

title: Foot structure, control method and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a foot structure, a control method and a humanoid robot, the foot structure comprises a shell, a foot pad, a sensor component, an inertial measurement unit and a control device, and a cavity is formed in the shell; the foot pad is arranged in the cavity and located at the bottom of the shell. The at least two sensor parts are used for respectively measuring the ground vertical counter-acting force at the two ends of the foot pad in the length direction; the inertial measurement unit measures motion information of the foot structure; the control device is configured to be capable of receiving information of all the sensor components and the inertial measurement unit so as to achieve closed-loop control over motion. Through combination of the sensor component and the inertial measurement unit, multi-dimensional sensor integration and high-level motion parameter monitoring, a finer and more intelligent walking control strategy is provided for the humanoid robot, the motion stability and the adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved, and the humanoid robot is more intelligent. The problem of unstable walking caused by ground condition changes is reduced, and application of the technology in more scenes is promoted.

title: Linear joint with motor-nut-bearing integrated design
abstract: The invention discloses a linear joint with a motor-nut-bearing integrated design. The linear joint adapts to operation requirements and motion precision of a humanoid robot. A motor rotor-reverse lead screw nut-bearing integrated design is adopted, a motor rotor magnet is pasted on the outer circle of a nut of a reverse lead screw and fixed through a symmetrical double-spiral reinforcement structure, and the outer circle of the nut is designed to be an inner ring of an angular contact ball bearing, so that the structure is more compact; and high integration, high performance, high precision, high dynamic response and high power density of the linear joint are further realized. The rotating motion of the nut is converted into the linear motion of the lead screw through the reverse lead screw pair, meanwhile, a mechanical zero point is arranged on the encoder side, and the limiting function is achieved. An absolute value type encoder and a tension and pressure sensor are arranged in the linear joint, and the rotating speed, displacement and tension and pressure in the actual movement process can be monitored in real time.

title: Bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot, which relates to the field of manipulators, and comprises a head device, a trunk device, a tail device, a manipulator device and a linkage device, the head device comprises a driving assembly and two pull wires, and the two pull wires penetrate through the trunk device front and back and then are connected with the tail device; the manipulator device comprises four mechanical claws and at least two reinforcing contact mechanisms, the linkage device comprises two linkage shells and a swing rod, the two sides of the linkage shells are connected with the mechanical claws respectively, the reinforcing contact mechanisms are movably arranged on the two mechanical claws close to the tail device respectively, the trunk device is at least provided with two convex parts, and the convex parts are connected with the linkage shells. The trunk device bends and swings towards the two sides to drive the two protruding parts to push the two ends of the swing rod correspondingly, so that the two ends of the swing rod drive the two reinforcing contact mechanisms to make contact with the ground and release contact with the ground correspondingly. According to the bionic robot, light weight can be achieved, the limb coordination degree is higher, configuration is simple, and the operation and maintenance cost and energy consumption are lower.

title: Verfahren und System zum Planen und Steuern des Gleichgewichts- und der Fortbewegung eines humanoiden zweibeinigen Roboters
abstract: In a method for planning and controlling the balance and locomotion of a humanoid bipedal robot, having at least one control and planning device which performs real-time planning and control of DCM trajectories in 3D by means of a model of the three-dimensional divergent movement component (3D-DCM), it is provided that the model of the divergent movement component (3D-DCM) contains equations of motion for the flight phase.

title: Robot lower limb mechanism and bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot lower limb mechanism and a bionic robot. The robot lower limb mechanism comprises a hip joint support, a leg assembly and a first driving assembly, the leg assembly comprises a thigh support and a shank support, one end of the leg support is rotationally connected to the hip joint support, the other end of the leg support is rotationally connected to the shank support, and the first driving assembly comprises a first telescopic driving part and a second telescopic driving part; one end of the first telescopic driving piece is rotationally connected to the thigh support, the other end is rotationally connected to the hip joint support, one end of the second telescopic driving piece is rotationally connected to the shank support, and the other end is rotationally connected to the hip joint support. The second driving assembly of the robot lower limb mechanism is simple in structure, the overall weight of the driving structure can be effectively reduced, and the driving efficiency of the leg assembly is higher.

title: INTEGRATING HUMANOID ROBOTS WITH AUTONOMOUS VEHICLES IN WORKFLOWS
abstract: A robotic system includes humanoid robots configured to move within a commercial environment that includes totes that hold commercial product; at least one autonomous tugger, autonomous mobile robot, or automated guided vehicle configured to couple to and move carts through the commercial environment; and a control system communicably coupled to the humanoid robots and the autonomous tugger, autonomous mobile robot, or automated guided vehicle. The control system performs operations including commanding the autonomous tugger, autonomous mobile robot, or automated guided vehicle to move the carts to a first location in the commercial environment; commanding the humanoid robots at the first location to perform at least one of: pick at least one tote to leave at the first location or place at least one tote from the first location on the carts; and commanding the autonomous tugger, autonomous mobile robot, or automated guided vehicle to move the from the first location to a second location in the commercial environment.

title: Emotion analysis processing method, system and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an emotion analysis processing method for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first multi-modal data of a user, and carrying out the preprocessing of the first multi-modal data, and obtaining second multi-modal data; performing time sequence synchronization and feature extraction on the second multi-modal data to obtain voice feature data, posture feature data and visual feature data; according to the voice feature data and the posture feature data, performing self-attention feature fusion on the visual feature data to obtain fusion features; inputting the fusion features into an emotion classification model for emotion recognition to obtain emotion state information; and inputting the emotional state information into an emotional interaction generation model for emotional interaction generation to obtain emotional interaction information. According to the method, by improving the accuracy and robustness of emotion recognition in the man-machine intelligent interaction process, the matching degree of the generated interaction content and the user emotion can be improved, and the user experience is improved. The invention relates to the technical field of emotion analysis.

title: Humanoid robot remote control system and method based on virtual reality technology
abstract: The invention relates to a virtual reality technology-based humanoid robot remote control system and method, the system comprises a VR device and a humanoid robot, and the VR device comprises a head-mounted device, a hand device, a visual information sampling unit, a hand device sampling unit and a visual information imaging unit; the humanoid robot comprises a robot system communication unit, a robot system planning control unit, a visual sensor and a joint motor execution unit. The technical problems that existing robot control mainly depends on field teaching operation of workers, so that the mechanical arm control threshold is high, and the field limitation is large are solved, and the beneficial effects of being low in threshold, high in interactivity, low in delay, high in safety, high in flexibility and the like are achieved.

title: Head assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a head assembly and a humanoid robot, the head assembly comprises a first shell, a second shell and a control module, the first shell comprises a mounting table and a first shell, and the mounting table is connected with the first shell and used for being connected with a neck assembly; the second shell is connected with the first shell, the first shell provides support for the second shell, a containing space is defined by the first shell and the second shell, the second shell forms a face part, the first shell and the second shell form an afterbrain part, and the face part and the afterbrain part are arranged in a spaced mode in the first direction; the control module is accommodated in the accommodating space and is fixedly connected with the second shell; the first shell is provided with a first heat dissipation hole, the first heat dissipation hole is located between the mounting table and the face part, the second shell is provided with a second heat dissipation hole, the second heat dissipation hole is located at the afterbrain part, and the first heat dissipation hole and the second heat dissipation hole are both communicated with the containing space; in the orthographic projection of the first direction, the first heat dissipation holes and the second heat dissipation holes are overlapped with the first shell. The head assembly is high in integration degree.

title: Biped robot and linear actuator applied to biped robot
abstract: The biped robot comprises a main body connecting part and leg parts arranged on the two sides of the main body connecting part, and each leg part comprises a thigh part, a shank part, a sole assembly and a connecting rod assembly used for connection which are sequentially connected; the thigh part comprises a thigh rotating joint, a thigh lifting linear joint, a shank bending linear joint and a thigh supporting plate, the thigh lifting linear joint and the shank bending linear joint are linear actuators and are oppositely arranged, and the two ends of the thigh lifting linear joint and the two ends of the shank bending linear joint are rotationally installed; the shank part comprises an ankle linear joint and a shank supporting plate, the upper end of the ankle linear joint is rotatably connected with the shank supporting plate, and the lower end of the ankle linear joint is connected with the sole assembly. The method has the beneficial effects that the load capacity of the biped robot is improved, and the requirements of the biped robot for large load, high response speed and high precision can be met.

title: Modular head assembly and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The invention discloses a modular head assembly, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the modular head assembly comprises a head shell which comprises a top shell, a head shell and a neck shell, and the top shell, the head shell and the neck shell are in butt joint in sequence to form the hollow head shell; the head assembly is fixedly arranged in the head shell; wherein a first butt joint face and a second butt joint face are formed between the top shell and the head shell, and the included angle between the first butt joint face and the second butt joint face is larger than or equal to 90 degrees; a third butt joint face and a fourth butt joint face are formed between the head shell and the neck shell, and the included angle between the first butt joint face and the second butt joint face is larger than or equal to 90 degrees. Two connecting surfaces in different directions are formed between the top shell and the head shell as well as between the head shell and the neck shell, so that the contact area between two adjacent shells is increased, and the problem of poor connection stability caused by connection in a single direction is avoided.

title: Leg structure assembly of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robots, and discloses a leg structure assembly of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and the leg structure assembly comprises a hip joint assembly and a leg structure assembly, the hip joint assembly comprises three driving modules, and three-degree-of-freedom rotation movement similar to human hips is achieved; the knee joint assembly comprises a knee joint structure, a knee joint driving module and a knee joint transmission assembly, the knee joint driving module is installed at the upper end of the thigh structure, and the knee joint transmission assembly drives the shank structure to bend and stretch; the ankle joint assembly comprises an ankle joint structure, an ankle joint driving module and an ankle joint transmission assembly, the ankle joint driving module is installed at the upper end of the thigh structure and located below the knee joint driving module, and the ankle joint transmission assembly drives the foot structure to achieve plantar flexion/dorsiflexion movement and extroversion/adduction movement. The driving modules are moved upwards to the upper ends of the thigh structures, and the humanoid robot has the advantages of being free of driving modules at the tail ends, concentrated in mass and small in rotational inertia, and the movement frequency of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot and knee joint thereof with variable stiffness and variable reduction ratio functions
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and knee joints with variable stiffness and variable reduction ratio functions thereof, and the humanoid robot comprises thighs, push rods, first connecting rods, second connecting rods, first guide rods, second guide rods, variable stiffness mechanisms and shanks, the upper ends of the thighs are rotatably connected with the upper ends of the push rods, and the lower parts of the thighs are rotatably connected with one ends of the two first connecting rods; the thigh lower end is rotationally connected with the shank upper end; the lower end of the push rod is coaxially and rotationally connected with the other ends of the two first connecting rods and one end of a second connecting rod in sequence from inside to outside; the other end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected to shafts in the middles of the outer sides of the first guide rod and the second guide rod; the upper ends of the first guide rod and the second guide rod which are in mirror image are rotationally connected to the inner sides of shafts at the upper ends of the shanks respectively; the first guide rod and the second guide rod are respectively provided with a sliding groove, and the variable stiffness mechanism is provided with a fulcrum sliding in the sliding grooves. And the variable stiffness mechanism is also connected with a plate spring in the shank. The knee joint integrates high outbreak, buffering and energy storage, and long-time high-dynamic movement of the humanoid robot is facilitated.

title: Robot control method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot control method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps of performing instruction decoding on a task file according to a preset dictionary to obtain at least one to-be-executed instruction, and storing each to-be-executed instruction into a to-be-executed instruction queue; each to-be-executed instruction comprises a command name, a command parameter and an execution state; reading a head instruction of the instruction queue to be executed as a current instruction; and judging whether the current instruction has a preorder instruction or not, and if the preorder instruction exists and execution of the preorder instruction is completed, executing the current instruction according to the preset dictionary. Therefore, the robot operation instruction is decoded through the preset dictionary, the decoding process is simple, the expansibility is high, complex robot operation can be programmed, the robot operation threshold is reduced, and the usability of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot and sole structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot equipment, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot and a sole structure of the humanoid robot. The sole structure comprises a rigid connecting piece which comprises a main body plate piece and a connecting part, the connecting part is arranged on the main body plate piece, and the connecting part is used for being connected with the ankle connecting end of the humanoid robot; the first layer plate is fixedly connected with the main body plate, the end part of the first layer plate exceeds the end part of the rigid connecting piece in the first direction, and the part, exceeding the end part of the rigid connecting piece, of the first layer plate can be bent and deformed in the rotating direction; the second layer plate is connected to the side, away from the rigid connecting piece, of the first layer plate, the second layer plate is a part made of a flexible material, the contour shape of the projection of the second layer plate is consistent with the contour shape of the projection of the first layer plate in the second direction, and the projection of the first layer plate is located in the projection of the second layer plate. By applying the technical scheme, the problem that the sole structure of the current humanoid robot does not have the characteristic that the front sole can be bent and deformed is solved.

title: Human-shaped bionic robot trunk based on stepping motor driving
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid bionic robot trunk based on stepping motor driving, which comprises a base, a supporting assembly is arranged on the surface of the base, a first rotating device is arranged above the supporting assembly, a third rotating device is arranged at the top of a fixing frame, and a stepping motor is arranged on the base. The rotating sleeve is arranged above the third gear and the fourth gears, the second rotating device is arranged between the positioning frame and the protective sleeve, the driving device is arranged above the protective sleeve, the arc-shaped sleeve is arranged between the protective sleeve and the driving device, and the arc-shaped sleeve is arranged above the arc-shaped sleeve. And the rotating frame is arranged above the arc-shaped sleeve. According to the humanoid bionic robot trunk based on stepping motor driving, the umbrella-shaped gear set structure is adopted in the movable neck, the service life of the structure is longer than that of an existing robot neck, and due to the fact that the structure is simple, control is more convenient, and manufacturing cost is low.

title: Multi-rigid-body robot and upper limb device thereof
abstract: The utility model provides a multi-rigid-body robot and an upper limb device thereof. The upper limb device comprises a shoulder assembly, a big arm assembly, a wrist assembly and a hand assembly which are arranged in sequence. The wrist assembly is used for realizing the rotating motion of the hand assembly around a first rotating shaft and a second rotating shaft, and the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are intersected; the shoulder assembly, the big arm assembly and the wrist assembly each comprise at least one rotating joint module, and one or more rotating joint modules form axial through holes in the axial direction of the corresponding rotating joint modules so that connecting lines can penetrate through the axial through holes. According to the multi-rigid-body robot and the upper limb device thereof, the upper limb device has the advantages of being light in weight, large in load and high in humanoid degree, connecting lines can be conveniently fixed, and abrasion of the connecting lines and joints can be reduced.

title: Human-shaped bionic baby robot with adjustable breathing and heartbeat
abstract: The utility model provides a breathing and heartbeat adjustable humanoid bionic baby robot which comprises a shell, lifting devices are arranged on the left side and the right side in the shell, each lifting device comprises a push rod motor, the top end of each push rod motor is connected with a push block, and a light sensing switch is arranged on each push rod motor. The rotating device is arranged in the shell and located below one pushing block. Two first movable devices, two second movable devices and a third movable device are arranged at the four corners and one side of the shell correspondingly. According to the breathing and heartbeat adjustable humanoid bionic baby robot, the two push rod motors with the push blocks are arranged in the shell, the rotating device, the two first movable devices, the two second movable devices and the third movable device are used in cooperation, and when baby nursing training is carried out, the first movable devices and the second movable devices can be driven by the rotating device to rotate; after the whole device is electrified, the breathing, heartbeat and limb movement states of the baby can be simulated.

title: Robot control method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a robot control method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that in the process that a robot carries a load, foot trajectory planning is conducted on the robot, and a foot trajectory planning result of the robot is obtained; determining a zero moment point reference trajectory of the robot according to the foot trajectory planning result; determining an equivalent centroid trajectory according to the zero moment point reference trajectory; wherein the equivalent center of mass is the center of mass which takes the robot and the load as a whole; the mass center track of the robot is determined according to the equivalent mass center track; inverse kinematics solution is conducted according to the mass center track of the robot, and the leg joint poses of the robot are obtained; and controlling the robot to move according to the leg joint poses of the robot. According to the method, the influence generated by the load is fully considered, and the walking stability of the robot is effectively improved.

title: IsaacSim-based humanoid robot simulation method for steel inspection and assay laboratory
abstract: The invention discloses an IsaacSim-based humanoid robot simulation method for a steel inspection and test laboratory, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot simulation methods, and the IsaacSim-based humanoid robot simulation method for the steel inspection and test laboratory comprises the following steps: step 1, carrying out refined modeling on environmental elements of the steel inspection and test laboratory; step 2, integrating a humanoid robot model in an IsaacSim simulation environment; 3, configuring workflows of different tasks of the robot in the simulation scene; 4, collecting and analyzing data when the robot executes the task in the virtual environment; and step 5, feeding back an adjustment algorithm or a control parameter based on a simulation result so as to improve the adaptability and the stability of the robot in a complex laboratory environment. Through the method, a user can perform comprehensive algorithm verification in a simulation environment, including a series of key algorithms such as a control algorithm, a visual identification algorithm and a motion planning algorithm of the humanoid robot, so that the stability and effectiveness of the humanoid robot in an actual environment are ensured.

title: Humanoid robot wearable flexible vibration sensing sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a wearable flexible vibration sensing sensor for a humanoid robot and a preparation method of the wearable flexible vibration sensing sensor. The sensor structure comprises an upper packaging layer, a lower packaging layer, a moisture absorption layer, a hydrogel layer, a graphene layer, an electrode layer and a flexible circuit board. Wherein the upper packaging layer and the lower packaging layer protect the internal structure, the moisture absorption layer enhances the moisture absorption capacity in the environment, the hydrogel layer maintains moisture and forms a concentration gradient, the graphene layer enhances the sensitivity of the sensor, the electrode layer collects ion migration to generate voltage, and a signal amplification circuit and a wireless transmission module are embedded in the flexible circuit board. The method is characterized in that a vibration signal is converted into voltage change through ion migration between the hydrogel layer and the graphene layer, and accurate vibration sensing is achieved. The sensor has high sensitivity, quick response and good flexibility, is suitable for being integrated into the humanoid robot, and improves the environmental perception and interaction performance of the humanoid robot.

title: Robot action generation model training method and action generation method
abstract: The invention relates to a robot action generation model training method and an action generation method, and the model training comprises the steps: constructing an automobile wire harness operation data set, and extracting a human body posture; constructing an instruction set based on the data set and the human body posture; pre-training a motion word segmentation device; obtaining a text-action vocabulary; pre-training a language model based on the data set, the instruction set and the text-action vocabulary; and constructing an operation data set, and performing fine tuning on the pre-trained language model based on the operation data set to complete training. According to the generation method, a humanoid action sequence is output through a model trained through a model training method, and the humanoid action sequence is redirected to a robot to complete robot action generation. Compared with the prior art, the generality of the generation model is improved, the robot action more conforming to the automobile wire harness operation can be generated, and the flexibility of the robot for operating the automobile wire harness is improved.

title: Method and device for constructing virtual three-dimensional human body model and central processing unit
abstract: The invention provides a method and device for constructing a virtual three-dimensional human body model and a central processing unit. The method comprises the steps that a skeleton model is constructed according to the structural features of a real target human body, the skeleton model comprises a plurality of virtual joint points, and each virtual joint point corresponds to a posture function used for representing the motion features of the corresponding real joint point in the target human body; adjusting the attitude function according to the three-dimensional surface morphology data of the target human body to obtain an initial three-dimensional model; and splitting the surface morphology data of the initial three-dimensional model according to a preset splitting strategy, and establishing association between the split surface morphology data of each part and the virtual joint points to obtain a target three-dimensional model, the target three-dimensional model being used for following the target human body to act under the driving of the target human body. According to the method and the device, the target three-dimensional model capable of accurately representing the real human body can be constructed, and the target three-dimensional model can accurately follow the real human body to act in real time under the driving of the real human body.

title: Protective anthropomorphic robot joint with lightweight characteristic
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot wrist joints, in particular to a protective anthropomorphic robot joint with a lightweight characteristic, which comprises a joint bracket and an end effector mounted on the joint bracket, and further comprises a driving assembly I and a driving assembly II which are mounted on the joint bracket in parallel, the driving device is used for driving the end effector to perform freedom-degree motion, the axes of the freedom degrees intersect on the plane, and meanwhile the intersection point is arranged on the central axis of the joint support; and the differential gear box is installed on the joint support, the differential gear box is of a closed structure, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the differential gear box, and the transmission mechanism is connected with the first driving assembly, the second driving assembly and the end effector and used for transmitting driving force of the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly to the end effector. The method is personified; the inertia is low; the stability and the precision are high; modular design is adopted; and the power consumption is low.

title: Knee joint assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The knee joint assembly comprises a first thigh web, a knee joint motor is arranged at the upper end of the side wall of the first thigh web in the X direction, and the output end of the knee joint motor is connected with a first flange plate; a knee joint connecting rod is hinged to the eccentric part of one end of the first flange away from the knee joint motor; the lower end of the side wall of the first thigh web is rotationally connected with a shank web in the X direction. The end, away from the first flange plate, of the knee joint connecting rod is hinged to the upper end of the shank web. The hinge point of the knee joint connecting rod and the first flange plate, the rotating shaft point of the first flange plate, the hinge point of the knee joint connecting rod and the shank web and the rotating shaft point of the shank web form a contra-parallelogram structure. The motion angle range of the knee joint connecting rod can be narrowed on the basis that the requirement for large-angle-range motion of the knee joint of the humanoid robot is met.
