title: Humanoid robot, carrying control method and device thereof and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot, a carrying control method and device thereof and a readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: collecting an image containing a to-be-carried object through a camera, so as to obtain a real-time object pose; according to the object pose, the target pose of the tail ends of the two arms of the robot reaching the object grabbing point is calculated in real time; according to the target pose and the actual pose, fed back in real time, of the tail ends of the two arms, the tail ends of the two arms are controlled to stably move to a grabbing point through a closed-loop feedback controller; in the process that the robot makes contact with an object, the tail ends of the two arms are controlled by the flexible controller to flexibly grab the object and place the object at the designated position. According to the method, the precision and the carrying efficiency of the humanoid robot during object carrying can be improved.

title: Obstacle sensing equipment and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses an obstacle sensing device which comprises an obstacle sensing module connected to the front side of the head of a robot body. The humanoid robot further comprises the obstacle sensing equipment. The fixed arc plate and the movable arc plate are arranged on the outer side of the head of the robot body, the movable arc plate can be unfolded to protect the obstacle sensing module, the fixed arc plate protects the rear side of the head, the protection area is enlarged, meanwhile, when the movable arc plate is unfolded, the fixed air bag and the movable air bag are inflated at the same time, impact force is absorbed, and the safety of the robot is improved. The damage degree of the obstacle sensing module is greatly reduced, and the protection effect on the obstacle sensing module is effectively improved; and due to the arrangement of the scraping plate, the lens on the front side of the obstacle sensing module can be cleaned through linkage of the downward moving assembly, and dust attached to the lens during daily use of the robot body and dust attached to the lens after falling down are cleaned away.

title: Actuator, joint module, robot arm, biped robot, quadruped robot, four-wheeled robot, humanoid robot, and robot
abstract: The invention provides an actuator, a joint module, a mechanical arm, a biped robot, a quadruped robot, a quadruped robot, a humanoid robot and a robot. The actuator comprises a shell, a motor assembly and a speed reducer assembly, the shell comprises an outer shell part, a first extension part and an inner cylinder part, and a first containing cavity with an opening is defined; the motor assembly is composed of a rotor, a stator, a rotor adapter and a rotary supporting assembly, the rotor adapter is provided with a rotor connecting part, a second extending part and a first connecting shaft part and is connected with the rotor, the rotor and the stator are arranged in the first containing cavity, and the rotary supporting assembly is arranged between the first connecting shaft part and the inner cylinder part; an input end transmission shaft of the speed reducer assembly is connected with the first connecting shaft part and rotates along with the rotor adapter, the second extension part is close to the speed reducer assembly, and the first extension part is far away from the speed reducer assembly relative to the second extension part. According to the invention, the transmission precision of the actuator and the stability of power output are ensured while the small size and compactness of the actuator are realized.

title: Joint coupling driven humanoid robot leg structure and control method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of legged robots, and aims to provide a joint coupling driven humanoid robot leg structure and a control method thereof. The whole mechanism has three degrees of freedom which are respectively the flexion and extension movement of the hip joint, the knee joint and the ankle joint, and the hip joint, the knee joint and the ankle joint can flexibly rotate and can reach the human body joint rotation angle range, so that the actions such as jumping can be realized. The invention provides the innovative design of the coupling joint, and has the advantages of enhancing the motion coordination, reducing the control complexity and reducing the energy consumption; on the basis of ensuring sufficient motor torque and proper volume, the appearance and the movement are in line with human body characteristics, and the biological performance advantages of a human body are fully exerted; the structural design is small and exquisite, a joint driving motor moves upwards, and overall light weight is achieved; a control strategy based on power limitation is provided, the Jacobian matrix is utilized to optimize the motor output torque, the system power consumption is further reduced, and the method has a wide social application scene.

title: Hand structure convenient to install and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a hand structure convenient to install and a humanoid robot, the hand structure comprises a fixed arm and a connecting arm, one end of the connecting arm is fixedly connected with an inserting rod, the bottom surface of the fixed arm is provided with a connecting groove corresponding to the inserting rod in position, and the outer wall of the inserting rod is fixedly connected with a plurality of clamping plates; a plurality of clamping grooves corresponding to the clamping plates in position are formed in the inner wall of the connecting groove, a limiting assembly is connected into the inserting rod, a conductive plug is fixedly connected to the bottom face of the fixing arm, and a conductive inserting groove is formed in one end of the connecting arm. According to the hand structure convenient to install and the humanoid robot, through mutual cooperation of the limiting assembly and the inserting rod, a worker can quickly replace the connecting arm, so that quick disassembly and assembly of the hand structure are achieved, quick switching of the hand structure is achieved, the hand structure adapts to various different operation tasks, the downtime of the robot is remarkably shortened, and the working efficiency of the robot is improved. The operation efficiency of the robot is improved.

title: Arm structure and bionic robot
abstract: The utility model provides an arm structure and a bionic robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The arm structure comprises a driving part, an upper arm part, a front arm part and a palm part, the upper arm part is rotationally connected with the driving part, the front arm part is rotationally connected with the end, away from the driving part, of the upper arm part, the palm part is rotationally connected with the end, away from the front arm part, of the upper arm part, the driving part is provided with a first limiting part, and the driving part is provided with a second limiting part. The arm structure comprises an upper arm part and a front arm part, the upper arm part is provided with a second limiting part, the front arm part is provided with a third limiting part, the first limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the arm structure, the second limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the upper arm part, and the third limiting part is used for limiting the rotating operation angle of the front arm part. title: Humanoid robot based on pneumatic tendon
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot based on pneumatic tendons, which comprises a skeleton, an abdomen system, a thoracolumbar fascia and trapezius muscle system, a lower limb system, a neck system and a shoulder system, and the neck system, the shoulder system, the abdomen system and the lower limb system are all mounted on the skeleton from top to bottom. The thoracolumbar fascia and trapezius muscle system is mounted on the skeleton. A plurality of groups of pneumatic tendons are used for driving the joint, so that the joint can move in multiple directions at the same time; the pneumatic tendon similar to the human muscle in shape is utilized, and the pneumatic tendon has the advantages of being larger in power/mass ratio, high in adaptability, large in output force and the like. The neck joint, the shoulder joint, the belly joint, the waist joint and the lower limb joint of the product respectively have three degrees of freedom, two degrees of freedom, two degrees of freedom, two degrees of freedom and six degrees of freedom, various actions of human joints can be vividly simulated, and the effect of each muscle in joint movement can be known.

title: Humanoid robot capable of standing with straight leg and starting with straight leg
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a trunk assembly, a thigh assembly, a shank assembly and a foot assembly, the trunk assembly and the thigh assembly are rotatably connected through a hip joint assembly, and the thigh assembly and the shank assembly are rotatably connected through a knee joint assembly. The shank assembly is rotatably connected with the foot assembly through the ankle joint assembly, the thigh assembly and the shank assembly respectively comprise a thigh skeleton and a shank skeleton, and when the thigh skeleton and the shank skeleton are straightened, the pitching rotation axis of the hip joint assembly and the pitching rotation axis of the knee joint assembly are not on the same vertical plane; the pitching rotation axis of the knee joint assembly and the pitching rotation axis of the ankle joint assembly are located on the same vertical plane, it is guaranteed that the transmission angle between the thigh assembly and the shank assembly of the robot is not 0 degree, the degree of freedom in the vertical direction cannot be lost, straight-leg standing and straight-leg starting of the robot are achieved, and the robot is closer to a real person in shape.

title: Length self-sensing artificial muscle
abstract: The invention discloses a length self-sensing artificial muscle, and relates to an inductance type length sensor technology and an artificial muscle technology. A fluid-driven artificial muscle is seamlessly integrated with an inductance type length sensor, the artificial muscle is a fluid-driven elastic telescopic unit, and the inductance type length sensor is a wire winding which is wound outside the artificial muscle and is formed by connecting a plurality of groups of coils in series. The mutual inductance between the wire windings is reduced or increased along with the stretching of the artificial muscle, so that the inductance of the coil is monotonically reduced along with the increase of the length of the artificial muscle. The length of the artificial muscle can be detected in real time by measuring the inductance of the coil, and the resolution is up to the submillimeter level and is not influenced by factors such as load size and deformation speed. The length self-sensing artificial muscle provided by the scheme can be widely applied to various robot systems driven by the artificial muscle, such as an earthworm crawling imitating robot capable of body sensing, a rigid-flexible hybrid bionic arm capable of realizing accurate position control and interactive response, a complex humanoid robot system and the like.

title: Humanoid robot complex terrain balance control method based on state and disturbance observer
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot complex terrain balance control method based on a state and disturbance observer, and belongs to the technical field of robot application. The problem that the humanoid robot is unstable when walking in a complex environment is solved. According to the technical scheme, the method comprises the following steps that 1, a simplified humanoid robot'spring-damping 'inverted pendulum model is established; 2, designing a state and disturbance observer; step 3, based on the step 2, designing a state feedback controller taking a real-time observation object of the state and disturbance observer as input; 4, selecting an appropriate controller pole and an appropriate controller observation point; and 5, simulation verification of attitude balance control of the humanoid robot under the complex terrain is carried out. The method has the beneficial effects that the robustness of the robot to interference and the task execution capability can be improved particularly in disaster rescue and complex environment operation.

title: Dexterous hand finger based on connecting rod transmission, bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dexterous hand finger based on connecting rod transmission, a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problem that a transmission mechanism of an existing dexterous hand is low in response speed, and adopts the technical scheme that the dexterous hand finger mainly comprises a finger base and a finger body, a driver and a transmission mechanism in transmission connection with the driver are arranged on the finger base, the driver drives the finger body to bend and/or swing through the transmission mechanism, the transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block installed on the guide piece in a sliding mode, and the sliding block is in transmission connection with the finger body. A traction rope connected with the sliding block is wound on an output shaft of the driver, the driver controls the output shaft to rotate forwards and backwards so as to drag the sliding block to slide back and forth along the guiding piece through the traction rope, and then the finger body is controlled to bend and/or swing. The finger is mainly used for driving the sliding block to move through the pulling rope so as to control the finger body to bend and swing, and the response efficiency of the finger body can be improved.

title: A BIPEDAL ROBOT FOR DYNAMIC AND ROBUST LOCATION IN DIVERSE ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: A bipedal robot having five degree of freedom leg assemblies is disclosed. At least some of the actuators are positioned near the hip joint to concentrate mass of the leg assembly proximate to the hip joint. A transmission system is configured to transmit force from at least one of the actuators to either the knee joint or the ankle joint of the leg assembly.

title: Multi-language speech recognition and interaction method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-language speech recognition and interaction method of a humanoid robot, particularly relates to the technical field of speech recognition and interaction, and effectively separates background noise and target speech signals through a multi-channel high-sensitivity microphone array in combination with an adaptive noise elimination algorithm, thereby improving the speech signal recognition accuracy in a noisy environment and improving the speech recognition efficiency. abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid double-arm robots, and particularly relates to an intelligent grabbing method of a humanoid double-arm robot, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an RGB image and a depth image of a target object through a global camera, performing alignment processing, detecting the target object by using a coarse positioning model, and determining pre-grabbing positions of double arms; global point cloud data in a working space are obtained in real time through a global camera, and path planning is performed by adopting an improved artificial potential field algorithm, so that two arms respectively reach pre-grabbing positions; acquiring an RGB image and a depth image of a target object through a double-arm tail end camera, performing alignment processing, detecting the RGB image of a target camera by using a fine positioning model, and finding a feasible target grabbing attitude by using a pre-trained 6D grabbing attitude prediction model; and the two arms are controlled to execute the grabbing action according to the target grabbing posture and placed at the preset position. The method can adapt to various complex scenes, and diversified grabbing is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method based on hybrid fuzzy embedded PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) control algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method based on a hybrid fuzzy embedded PID (Proportion Integration Differentiation) control algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: measuring a distance; measuring the distance between the humanoid robot and the forward obstacle, the distance between the humanoid robot and the right obstacle and the distance between the humanoid robot and the left obstacle by using an infrared sensor, defining fuzzy control variables and determining a value range; according to the method, a fuzzy control algorithm and a PID controller are innovatively combined, a fuzzy controller is utilized, a fuzzy control variable is defined as a forward obstacle distance, a right obstacle distance, a left obstacle distance and an optimized turning angle, a value range is determined, and a fuzzy membership function is generated. The forward obstacle distance value, the right obstacle distance value and the left obstacle distance value are input, the unique optimized turning angle is correspondingly obtained, the angle and torque of the robot joints can be adjusted in real time, navigation control over the humanoid robot is achieved, and the navigation precision is improved. The defects that an existing navigation method replacing a GPS is difficult to adapt to dynamic environment changes and low in control precision and calculation efficiency are overcome.

title: Torso protrusion for robotic manipulation of objects and related technology
abstract: A robot in accordance with at least some embodiments of the present technology includes a torso having a superior portion, an inferior portion, and an intermediate portion therebetween. The robot further includes two legs connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso, two arms connected to the torso via the superior portion of the torso, and a protrusion also connected to the torso via the inferior portion of the torso and extending anteriorly from the torso. The robot is configured to move an object toward the torso at least partially via contact between the object and at least one of the arms. The robot is further configured to support a weight of the object at least partially via the protrusion while the robot ambulates via the legs.

title: Multi-modal sensing humanoid robot action self-adaptive control method and multi-modal sensing humanoid robot action self-adaptive control system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal perception humanoid robot action adaptive control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first multi-modal data; the first multi-modal data comprises first image data, first point cloud data and first force sense data; performing data fusion on the first image data and the first point cloud data, and constructing a three-dimensional model of the scene in real time; generating an optimal path according to the real-time environment data of the three-dimensional model, converting the optimal path into a joint instruction of the humanoid robot, and generating an action control strategy; according to the action control strategy, arm movement of the robot is adjusted through visual servo control, and first operation data are obtained; the path and action of the robot are adjusted in a closed-loop control mode, and second operation data are obtained; and reinforcement learning and regular evaluation are carried out through a DDPG algorithm, and an action control strategy is continuously optimized. According to the invention, multi-modal sensing robot motion adaptive control with strong adaptive capability, high operation precision and good robustness can be realized.

title: Natural language control method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a natural language control method for a humanoid robot. By constructing the simple skill library and the complex skill library of the robot, the dependence on a large amount of operation data in a specific field is effectively reduced. According to the method, a large language model is used as a base of a task planner, and the capabilities of scene learning, semantic understanding and common sense reasoning of the task planner are brought into full play. By introducing a visual model in the field of computer vision, high-level semantic information and low-level spatial information of the environment can be obtained, and an accurate scene graph is constructed to serve as environment state representation. According to the voice interaction interface constructed by the invention, the naturalness of man-machine interaction is improved, so that a user can more conveniently communicate with the robot and input instructions, the user experience is effectively improved, and popularization of the humanoid robot in an actual application scene is facilitated.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a wheeled humanoid robot. The wheeled humanoid robot comprises a head assembly, an upper body assembly, leg assemblies, arm assemblies and a movable chassis assembly. The head assembly can rotate in the vertical direction and/or the horizontal direction relative to the upper body assembly; the upper body assembly is movably connected with the leg assembly, so that the upper body assembly is switched between a bent state and a straightened state relative to the leg assembly and/or the upper body assembly ascends and descends relative to the leg assembly; the leg component can be switched between a bent state and a straightened state; the arm assembly can rotate and/or swing relative to the upper body assembly; and all or part of the components can realize multi-angle rotation and/or multi-angle swing. Through an efficient and precise movable connection mechanism, the head assembly, the upper body assembly, the leg assemblies, the arm assemblies and the chassis assembly can achieve multi-degree-of-freedom and multi-angle movement, the operation flexibility of the robot is greatly improved, and the operation range of the robot is greatly widened; and the robot can execute diversified tasks in a complex and changeable environment.

title: Motion track planning and obstacle avoidance method for wheeled two-arm humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a wheel type double-arm humanoid robot motion track planning and obstacle avoidance method. The method comprises the steps that a robot system is started for self-inspection; the first sensor obtains environment information and constructs a real-time three-dimensional point cloud obstacle information graph; the second sensor obtains chassis state information and mechanical arm state information; a target task is set, and a moving path of a chassis and a moving path of a mechanical arm are planned based on the state information of the target task; and the system controls the chassis to move according to the planned moving path through the cooperative control model, and the mechanical arm moves according to the planned moving track. Through construction and real-time updating of the real-time three-dimensional point cloud obstacle information graph, the robot can effectively recognize and avoid obstacles, the risk of collision with the surrounding environment is reduced, meanwhile, the robot can adapt to the dynamically changing environment, path planning is rapidly updated through the D * Lite algorithm, and the path planning efficiency is improved. And the path can be adjusted in time when the obstacle moves or a new obstacle appears.

title: Humanoid robot two-arm cooperation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot double-arm cooperation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target feature vector; the target feature vector comprises surrounding environment information and two-arm joint state information of the humanoid robot; a neural network model is constructed, and then a motion branch model and a track branch model are constructed based on the neural network model; respectively inputting the target feature vector into a motion branch model and a trajectory branch model to obtain a control instruction of the two arms of the humanoid robot output by the motion branch model and predicted trajectory points of the two arms of the humanoid robot output by the trajectory branch model; generating a control strategy according to the control instruction and the prediction track point; and controlling the two arms of the humanoid robot to move according to the control strategy. According to the method, the environment and the states of the two arms are sensed more comprehensively and accurately by fusing the surrounding environment information and the joint state information of the two arms, so that the humanoid robot can better adapt to complex environments and tasks.

title: Agricultural biped robot and pose control algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural biped robot and a pose control algorithm. The pose control algorithm comprises the following steps that basic parameters of a model prediction control algorithm are initialized; establishing a speed model, an angular speed model, an angle change model and a position change model; establishing a spatial state discrete model; building a model predictive control algorithm, wherein the model predictive control algorithm comprises a space state equation, a cost function and constraints; and performing attitude planning through the model prediction control algorithm, wherein the attitude planning algorithm comprises degree of freedom, standing, squatting, stepping, walking attitude, pause, translation and steering. According to the technical scheme, by optimizing the motion model, the spatial state discrete model, attitude planning and other control algorithms, the control efficiency of the agricultural biped robot is improved, the robot is prevented from sensing confusion and adapting to the complexity of the agricultural production environment, and the motion control capacity is improved.

title: Humanoid tea bud picker
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid tea bud picker, which relates to the technical field of tea leaf picking devices and comprises a clamping mechanism, a rotating mechanism, a tea bud collecting box and a motor damping system. The rear end of the clamping mechanism is provided with a 42 stepping motor, the front end of the motor is provided with a pair of gears with the tooth number ratio being 1: 2, the front end of the gear set is provided with a lead screw and a sliding block nut, the most front end of the clamping mechanism is provided with clamping fingers, the middle of the clamping fingers is provided with a picking blade, and the inner sides of the clamping fingers are pasted with flexible material sponges. The picker support is connected with the clamping fingers through the clamping finger arms and the external connecting pieces. The rotating mechanism is located below the clamping mechanism, and the tea bud collecting box is located at the rear end of the rotating mechanism. According to the humanoid tea bud picker, by simulating the action of pinching and rotating the wrist when the tea buds are manually picked, the integrity rate and picking efficiency of the tea buds are improved, and famous and high-quality tea is picked.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot valve tightening method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control, and particularly relates to a humanoid double-arm robot valve tightening method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a valve image data set based on a binocular vision camera; labeling the valve image data set to generate a labeled data set; performing enhancement processing on the annotation data; recognizing and positioning the valve based on a preset binocular vision algorithm and YOLO, and recognizing the position, the frame and the center point of the valve; the two-arm robot is moved to the two sides of the valve, and the positions and poses of the tail ends of the two arms in other directions except the clamping direction are kept consistent; clamping control is carried out based on a self-adaptive variable admittance controller; the valve is driven to rotate through rotation of the joint at the tail end of the double-arm robot, so that the valve is tightened. According to the invention, rapid and accurate valve identification is realized, and the reliability and flexibility of the system in practical application are greatly enhanced.

title: Stator adapter, actuator, joint module, humanoid robot, point-foot robot, quadruped robot, four-wheel-foot robot, mechanical arm and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a stator adapter, an actuator, a joint module, a humanoid robot, a point-foot robot, a quadruped robot, a four-wheel-foot robot, a mechanical arm and a robot. Wherein the actuator comprises a stator, a stator adapter, a gear ring and a fixed disc, the stator adapter is provided with a barrel-shaped part and an extension part which are approximately in a hollow cylindrical shape, the stator is nested outside the barrel-shaped part, the gear ring is nested inside the barrel-shaped part, and the thermal conductivity of the stator adapter is larger than that of the gear ring. By changing the connection mode of the stator and the gear ring, the process of maintaining and replacing parts is simplified, and the maintenance cost is reduced; by innovating the stator heat dissipation structure design, the heat dissipation condition of the stator is effectively improved, especially in a high-power output state, the peak performance of the motor can be greatly improved, and meanwhile the service life of the actuator is prolonged.

title: Miniaturized joint module and robot controller
abstract: The miniaturized joint module comprises a shell, a speed reducer assembly, an encoder assembly, a rear cover shell, a motor and a bearing, the speed reducer assembly and the rear cover shell are arranged at the two ends of the shell correspondingly, the encoder assembly and the motor are both arranged in the shell, the encoder assembly is located outside the motor, and an output shaft of the motor is sleeved with the bearing; the encoder assembly comprises an input rotary encoder and an output rotary encoder, and the output rotary encoder is annularly arranged outside the input rotary encoder, so that the input rotary encoder and the output rotary encoder are located on the same plane. The miniaturized joint module provided by the invention is suitable for the movable joint of the wrist part of the humanoid robot, the output rotary encoder is embedded on the input rotary encoder, so that the encoder assembly has a butt joint plane, the output rotary encoder and the input rotary encoder are positioned on the same plane, the length of the module is reduced, the structure is simpler, and the cost is lower. And meanwhile, the product can be miniaturized.

title: Immersive master-slave teleoperation anthropomorphic robot system with force feedback
abstract: The invention discloses an immersive master-slave teleoperation anthropomorphic robot system with force feedback, a master end assembly comprises a seat, a master end control arm, a force feedback manipulator, a VR visual device, a data sensing glove and a master end controller, and the master end assembly is a master control end; the slave end assembly comprises a movable chassis, a movable trunk, a slave end mechanical arm, a slave end manipulator, a binocular camera and a slave end controller, and the slave end controller is in electric signal connection with the movable chassis, the movable trunk, the slave end mechanical arm, the slave end manipulator, the binocular camera, the six-dimensional torque sensor and the master end controller; the wireless controller is in electric signal connection with the master end controller and the slave end controller, the wireless controller has a slave end control mode and a force feedback teleoperation mode, and in the slave end control mode, the wireless controller controls the movable chassis to move; in the force feedback teleoperation mode, the master end control arm and the force feedback mechanical arm synchronously move with the slave end mechanical arm and the slave end mechanical arm correspondingly.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hybrid humanoid robot waist structure
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom series-parallel hybrid humanoid robot waist structure, and relates to the technical field of robots. The defects that an existing multi-degree-of-freedom waist structure is not compact enough, limited in precision, low in rigidity and poor in stability are overcome. The robot comprises a yaw joint mechanism and a pitching-sidesway joint mechanism which are connected in series, upper limbs and legs of the robot are connected through the yaw joint mechanism and the pitching-sidesway joint mechanism, and the yaw joint mechanism can drive the upper limbs of the robot to do yaw motion; the pitching-sidesway joint mechanism comprises a movable platform, a static platform, a joint universal joint and two joint driving assemblies, the movable platform is fixedly connected with the upper limbs of the robot, the static platform is fixedly connected with the legs of the robot, the joint universal joint is connected with the movable platform and the static platform, and the two joint driving assemblies are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the joint universal joint; and the two joint driving assemblies are connected with the movable platform and the static platform correspondingly, and when the two joint driving assemblies drive the movable platform, the movable platform can do pitching motion and/or side-sway motion around the joint universal joint.

title: Intelligent skeleton control device
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent skeleton control device. Comprising a sensor module, an actuator module, a control module, a processing module and a safety braking module, the sensor module is electrically connected with the processing module, the processing module is electrically connected with the control module, the control module is electrically connected with the actuator module, and the safety braking module is electrically connected with the actuator module. The control module is further electrically connected with the safety braking module. The motion trend of the human body is decomposed in combination with the inclination detected by the gyroscope, so that the motion intention of each pressure sensor can be decomposed into motion information in the X-axis direction, the Y-axis direction and the Z-axis direction, all the pressure sensors are fused, and the fusion processing of the motion information is more accurate. The motion state can be conveniently analyzed and processed through model prediction control, and a motion instruction is generated; and under the condition of abnormity, the movement of the exoskeleton is stopped immediately through the safety braking module.

title: Bionic hip joint and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic hip joint and a humanoid robot, the bionic hip joint comprises a hip bone connecting structure, a hip joint structure and a hip joint muscle structure, the hip bone connecting structure is used for connecting a bionic hip bone; one end of the hip joint structure is movably connected with the hip bone connecting structure; the hip joint muscle structure comprises a plurality of hip joint muscles distributed around the hip joint structure, each hip joint muscle comprises a pressure driving part and a flexible connecting part, the fixed end of the pressure driving part is connected with the hip joint structure, and the flexible connecting part is connected with the pressure driving part and the hip bone; the flexible connecting part is dragged through a hydrodynamic stretching mechanism of the pressure driving part, and the hip joint structure is driven to do joint movement relative to the hip bone; the flexible driving technology of the hydraulic muscles is adopted, the multiple hydraulic muscles can work cooperatively, multi-degree-of-freedom complex movement is achieved, and the design which is compact in space, high in connection reliability, low in power consumption and highly anthropomorphic is achieved.

title: Seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm for a biped robot, and relates to the field of robots, the seven-degree-of-freedom series-parallel structure mechanical arm is installed on a supporting body, and the supporting body is located on an installation fixing base. Comprising a five-degree-of-freedom series arm and a two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist structure which is located at the front end of the series arm and connected with the series arm. According to the mechanical arm with the series-parallel connection structure, the rigidity and the bearing capacity of the mechanical arm are improved, the working space is expanded to adapt to more complex operation tasks, the stability and the reliability of operation are enhanced, error accumulation is reduced, and the accuracy of overall operation is improved.

title: Flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot
abstract: The flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms and legs, and the core structure of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot is a balance movement mechanism composed of the trunk and the legs. The trunk comprises a sliding rail, a flywheel shell, a motor, a ball screw, a storage battery, a power electronic conversion device, a stepping motor, a coupler, a fastening connecting piece, a shock pad, an upper rolling bearing, a rotating shaft, a magnetic induction coil, a flywheel and a lower rolling bearing. The legs comprise hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints, all the mechanisms operate in a coordinated mode to achieve overall operation of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot, and the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a flywheel energy storage structure, a gravity center adjusting structure, a leg movement structure and a balance control structure. The stability is improved; by utilizing the flywheel energy storage principle, mechanical energy is converted into electric energy and stored, so that continuous advancing power is provided; and each leg has four degrees of freedom, so that the mechanical complexity is reduced.

title: Double-arm intelligent robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a double-arm intelligent robot which comprises a mobile machine body, a double-arm base, a multi-degree-of-freedom anthropomorphic arm, a dexterous hand, a holder, a binocular vision device, a control system module and a walking camera module, and the double-arm base is fixed on the mobile machine body; the multi-degree-of-freedom anthropomorphic arm is connected to the double-arm base; the dexterous hand is connected to the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm; the holder is fixed on the double-arm base; the binocular vision device is fixed on the holder; the control system module is arranged in the mobile machine body; the walking camera module is arranged in the mobile machine body, and the binocular vision device is electrically connected to the walking camera module. According to the technical scheme, the strength and precision of the robot are combined with judgment and originality of human beings, and incomparable productivity and safety are achieved in the dangerous, complex and unstructured environment. The double-arm intelligent robot provides a safer and more effective way to simulate the flexible operation capability of human beings under challenging and dangerous conditions.

title: Joint lubricating assembly of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a joint lubricating assembly of a humanoid robot, which comprises a mounting seat, a cavity is arranged in the mounting seat, a rotating block is rotatably arranged in the cavity, a plurality of spherical grooves are uniformly formed in the circumferential wall of the cavity, balls are rotatably arranged in the spherical grooves, one side of each ball is slidably connected with the rotating block, and the other side of each ball is slidably connected with the rotating block. A connecting hole is formed between the annular cavity and the spherical groove; an oil injection channel is formed in the top of the annular cavity; an oil injection mechanism is arranged at the position, located at the oil injection channel, of the upper end of the mounting base; an opening is formed in one side of the cavity, an annular plate is fixedly arranged at the opening, and a mechanical arm is arranged in the annular plate; the two ends of the mechanical arm extend out of the annular plate, and a driving device is fixedly arranged on one side of the mounting base. The lubricating effect of the joint is improved, a worker can be conveniently prompted to add lubricating oil, and the service life of the joint is prolonged.

title: Biped robot leg structure
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot leg structure which comprises a center base, a hip joint flexion and extension motor, a hip joint abduction motor, a hip joint internal and external rotation motor, a knee joint motor and a shank component, the shank component comprises a shank support and a foot, and the shank support is provided with a first ankle joint motor and a second ankle joint motor; a universal joint is arranged between the foot and the shank support, a first crank rocker mechanism is arranged between the first ankle joint motor and the foot, and a second crank rocker mechanism is arranged between the second ankle joint motor and the foot. A driving rod is transversely arranged at the rear part of the foot; the first crank rocker mechanism comprises a first rotating disc, a first eccentric column is arranged on the first rotating disc, a relay rotating disc is rotationally connected to the shank support, a second eccentric column and a third eccentric column are arranged on the relay rotating disc, a connecting rod is arranged between the second eccentric column and the first eccentric column, and a first universal connecting rod is arranged between the third eccentric column and the driving rod. The invention has the advantages of flexibility, small volume and low energy loss.

title: Leg structure of wire-driven biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a line drive type biped robot leg structure which comprises a thigh support, a knee joint motor is arranged at the lower end of the thigh support, a shank support is connected to an output shaft of the knee joint motor, a foot assembly is movably connected to the lower end of the shank support and comprises a foot fixing piece, and a heel is connected to the rear portion of the foot fixing piece. The heel is connected with a line driving structure, the line driving structure comprises a first ankle joint motor, a second ankle joint motor, a first driving line wheel, a second driving line wheel, a first ankle joint line wheel and a second ankle joint line wheel, and a first transmission line is arranged between the first driving line wheel and the first ankle joint line wheel; a second transmission line is arranged between the second driving line wheel and the second ankle joint line wheel, a first crank swing rod structure is arranged between the first ankle joint line wheel and one side of the heel, and a second crank swing rod structure is arranged between the second ankle joint line wheel and the other side of the heel. The device has the advantages of being simple in structure and good in adaptability.

title: Artificial muscle length measuring device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an artificial muscle length measuring device and a humanoid robot. The length measuring device comprises a mounting base, a rotating part, a measuring rope, an elastic part and a rotating angle measuring mechanism, and the mounting base is fixed to the fixed end of an artificial muscle; the rotating piece is rotationally arranged on the mounting base, and a winding part is formed on the rotating piece; the rotation angle measuring mechanism is connected with the rotating member and is used for detecting the rotation angle of the rotating member. The device has the beneficial effects that the rotating part, the measuring rope, the elastic part and other components are matched, the length change of the artificial muscle is converted into the rotating angle change of the rotating part, the rotating angle measuring mechanism records and outputs the value of the rotating angle, and therefore the length change value of the artificial muscle can be calculated; because the rotation angle measurement occupies a small volume, the compactness of the structure is realized, the measurement device can be integrated in the compact structure of the humanoid robot, and the influence on the overall design and motion performance of the robot is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot multi-particle model prediction control method and device
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot multi-particle model prediction control method and device, and the method comprises the steps: simplifying a target humanoid robot into a multi-particle simplified model based on at least one target experiment task and mechanical structure parameters; based on the at least one target experiment task, determining a control task and a control constraint of each particle in the multi-particle simplified model; calculating an optimization variable of the target humanoid robot based on the control task and the control constraint; and taking the optimization variable as a reference trajectory, and carrying out trajectory tracking by utilizing whole body control to solve a torque instruction of each joint of the target humanoid robot, so that the target humanoid robot executes a corresponding target experiment task under the condition of meeting a preset balance condition. Therefore, the technical problems that in the related technology, a simplified model used for model prediction cannot fully utilize the redundant freedom degree of the robot, and it is difficult to adjust the body balance under the condition that the real-time performance and efficiency are met are solved.

title: Biped walking race robot data driving switching gain estimation technology
abstract: The invention relates to a biped walking race robot data driving switching gain estimation technology. According to the technology, the behavior theory of a linear system is utilized, a data interpretation system of an unknown dynamic hybrid system is constructed, a global exponential stability criterion is established in combination with a data-based linear matrix inequality, and the global exponential stability of a biped robot system is ensured under the mild condition; therefore, the biped walking race robot can operate normally without depending on a model. Meanwhile, according to the hybrid estimation scheme based on data driving, a system model identification step is eliminated, and resource consumption is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot control method, device and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method, device and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The method comprises the steps that the spatial position of a working object in a moving state is dynamically obtained; establishing a capture system model according to the spatial position; wherein the capturing system model is used for describing the numerical relationship between the tail end attitude angles of the two arms of the humanoid robot and walking parameters of the two feet and the numerical relationship between the tail end attitude angles and the middle joint angles of the corresponding arms; solving according to the motion decomposition controller and the capture system model to obtain a tail end attitude angle and a middle joint angle; determining control parameters of the humanoid robot according to the tail end attitude angle and the middle joint angle; and controlling the humanoid robot to catch the working object according to the control parameters. The motion decomposition controller is solved and the control parameters are determined on the capturing system model, so that the humanoid robot can be controlled to stably and accurately capture the moving working object.

title: Biped robot complex terrain adaptive gait planning method and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot complex terrain self-adaptive gait planning method and a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robotics.The biped robot complex terrain self-adaptive gait planning method comprises the steps that a fractional order PID controller is constructed, and the fractional order PID controller comprises a multi-sensor network module, a self-adaptive module and a fractional order calculus control module; constructing a reinforcement learning model for biped robot gait planning, setting a state, an action, a decision and a reinforcement learning reward function of reinforcement learning, performing continuous iteration and optimization adjustment on the reinforcement learning model by using a strategy gradient method, updating strategy parameters, and outputting control parameters of the biped robot; and performing decision fusion on control parameters output by the fractional order PID controller and the reinforcement learning model through a comprehensive loss function to obtain globally optimal biped robot control parameters. According to the method, more accurate gait planning can be provided for the biped robot in complex terrains, and better walking flexibility and adaptability are achieved.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device and medium
abstract: The invention provides a control method and device of a humanoid robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the control method of the humanoid robot comprises the steps that the current joint angle of a mechanical arm and the current first position of a target object are obtained; inputting the joint angle and the first position into a pre-trained prediction model for processing to obtain a change value of the joint angle; the joint angle of the mechanical arm is controlled to be adjusted according to the change value, and the current second position of the end effector is obtained; determining whether the distance between the second position and the first position is smaller than a distance threshold; and if yes, an end effector is controlled to grab the target object, and if not, the step of obtaining the current joint angle of the mechanical arm and the current first position of the target object is executed, so that the humanoid robot can be applied to the dynamic environment, and the dynamic object can be accurately grabbed.

title: Modularized combined type human spine simulating device with energy storage and explosive power and control method
abstract: The invention provides a modular combined type energy storage and explosive power humanoid spine device and a control method, and belongs to the field of humanoid spines. The problems that an existing humanoid spine structure is insufficient in load and impact resistance, difficult to simulate the real spine curvature of human, lack of kinetic energy explosion device design and single in function and form are solved. According to the invention, three motions of pitching, lateral deviation and explosive force propulsion can be realized, the three motions are respectively controlled by a network formed by connecting a main control computer and three single-axis or integrated four-axis servo drive and control units through an industrial Ethernet, and S-shaped and random bending motion and forward or upward explosive force propulsion motion of the spine are realized; different combination modes, large load, strong impact resistance, high rigidity and accurate movement capability are realized; in addition, the humanoid spine device based on the structure and a device formed by combining the humanoid spine device in different combination modes can also be used as a trunk spine of a humanoid robot, a flexible arm and a snake-shaped robot.

title: Balance control system of biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a balance control system of a biped robot, which belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots and comprises a signal processing center and electronic skin sensing units surface-mounted on soles of the biped robot. The electronic skin sensing unit is used for collecting plantar pressure data of the biped robot; the signal processing center is used for determining the gait of the biped robot based on the plantar pressure data and carrying out balance adjustment on the biped robot based on the gait; wherein the gaits comprise normal, forward inclination, backward inclination, left inclination and right inclination. According to the invention, low-cost and high-efficiency balance control of the biped robot is realized.

title: SISTEMA ROBOTICO CON AVANZADA INTERACCION SOCIAL
abstract: The invention is mainly a process of developing robotic systems with advanced social interaction that includes software developments and a design proposal for the face of humanoid or semi-humanoid robots. The main technical elements of the invention are: 1. Extension of the logical notion of a robot (ROBOT = RUTAS CORE + RUTAS _NODO): The concept of a robot includes both the specific hardware (which people currently see as a robot) and all the computers that execute the functionalities that allow the robot to interact with human beings, thus expanding its processing and response capabilities. For this, the main hardware of the robot must be running software (RUTAS CORE) that allows connection with all programs and computers that implement the different functionalities (RUTAS NODE). 2. Communication middleware for heterogeneous robotic systems (RUTAS CORE / RUTAS NODE): The RUTAS CORE program implements a finite state machine that articulates the execution of the different functionalities depending on the social interaction needs of the robot, based on what the environment and human beings demand of it. 3. Modeling and storage of semantic knowledge in repositories accessible to several robots (RUTAS REPOSITORIO): The information repository of the robotic system called RUTAS REPOSITORY has been implemented using technology called semantic web (which allows storing not only data but knowledge) and a round-trip translator is implemented to translate semantic information into data structures used in robots and vice versa. 4. Modeling of proxemic zones of people and groups of people using Gaussian functions with 'N' degrees of freedom. A new way of modeling proxemic zones (a concept used to explain the different proximity zones of people and the possibility of entering them) called Gaussian function with 'N' degrees of freedom has been created, which allows modeling the zone with the specific deformities of the dynamics of groups of people. 5. Recognition of people's emotions. A functionality for recognizing people's emotions was developed based on the use of deep learning and RGB cameras. 6. Recognition of emotions of groups of people. A functionality for recognizing group emotions was developed based on the 'average' of the emotions of each person composing the group. 7. Integration of a Chatbot with Chat GPT for robotic interaction. A functionality is implemented that integrates Chat GPT to establish voice conversations with people. 8. Face of a robot based on a flexible screen. Includes the use of a flexible screen as a face, which allows gestural actions similar to those performed by human faces to be carried out.

title: Wearable Robot Ankle Device
abstract: The present invention relates to an ankle device for a wearable robot, which constitutes a wearable robot and has an operator's foot mounted thereon, provides various degrees of movement freedom in response to movement of the operator's ankle joint, minimizes impact when the heel of the foot drags on the ground during a walking process, and enables natural walking.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an ankle device for a wearable robot, which constitutes a wearable robot and has an operator's foot mounted thereon, provides various degrees of movement freedom in response to movement of the operator's ankle joint, minimizes impact when the heel of the foot drags on the ground during a walking process, and enables natural walking.

title: Head and neck assembly for a humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. Said head portion includes: a frontal shell having a rear edge, a rear shell having a frontal edge, and an illumination assembly. The illumination assembly is configured to illuminate a region that: (i) extends between a rear edge of the frontal shell and an extent of the frontal edge of the rear shell, (ii) is positioned adjacent to the extent of the rear edge of the frontal shell, and (iii) is positioned adjacent to the extent of the frontal edge of the rear shell.
abstract_en: A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. Said head portion includes: a frontal shell having a rear edge, a rear shell having a frontal edge, and an illumination assembly. The illumination assembly is configured to illuminate a region that: (i) extends between a rear edge of the frontal shell and an extent of the frontal edge of the rear shell, (ii) is positioned adjacent to the extent of the rear edge of the frontal shell, and (iii) is positioned adjacent to the extent of the frontal edge of the rear shell.

title: Hip and leg connecting structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hip and leg connecting structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The hip and leg connecting structure of the humanoid robot mainly comprises a hip structural part, a first leg connecting part and a second leg connecting part, a first assembling face of the hip structural part abuts against a first matching face of the first leg connecting part, a first clamping structure is clamped with a first butt joint structure, and a second assembling face abuts against a second matching face of the second leg connecting part. The second clamping structure is clamped with the second butt joint structure, and mutual limiting and matching of the hip structural part and the first leg connecting part and mutual limiting and matching of the hip structural part and the second leg connecting part are formed under the arrangement of clamping and abutting, and the clamping position and the abutting position bear acting force firstly; a number of fasteners for connecting the hip structure with the first leg connector and the hip structure with the second leg connector may be protected.

title: Humanoid robot multi-camera feature fusion mode
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-camera feature fusion method for a humanoid robot. A plurality of cameras are included; the method comprises the following steps: calibrating each camera to obtain an internal parameter and an external parameter of the corresponding camera; calculating a horizontal field angle of the corresponding camera according to the internal reference of each camera; according to the horizontal field angle and the external parameter of each camera, the coverage range of the plurality of cameras on a horizontal reference plane with the robot as the center is obtained; a plurality of cameras respectively collect images to obtain a fused projection image; inputting the fused projection image into an image recognition model to obtain the position of the object relative to the robot; according to the technical scheme, the problems that a neural network model is too large and the training and reasoning cost is high due to the fact that high-dimensional image data are directly used are effectively avoided, consumption of computing resources is remarkably reduced, meanwhile, the detection accuracy and efficiency are improved, and the target object in the image is rapidly and accurately positioned.

title: Wheel-leg type humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and discloses a wheel-leg humanoid robot which comprises a robot body, mechanical legs are arranged at the bottom of the robot body, a sliding box is installed at the bottoms of the mechanical legs, a walking assembly capable of adjusting the height in a self-adaptive mode is arranged in the sliding box, and the robot can be driven to walk on various terrains. A protection frame is arranged on the outer wall of the robot body, a starting assembly and a main air bag are arranged in the robot body, the protection frame is in driving connection with the starting assembly, the main air bag is in sealed connection with the interior of the protection frame and is in fluid conduction with the interior of the protection frame, and the starting assembly is used for starting the main air bag to inflate the protection frame when it is detected that the robot topples over. The sliding box can drive the robot to walk on various different terrains, multiple applicability is achieved, the phenomenon of single use is avoided, meanwhile, the protection frame of the device can protect the robot when the robot inclines or falls down, and the phenomenon that the robot is damaged is prevented.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. Wherein the leg structure of the humanoid robot mainly comprises a hip structural part and a leg structure, the hip structural part is connected with a hip pitching joint module, an output flange of the hip pitching joint module is connected with a leg rolling joint module, complex assembly on the hip structural part is avoided through a direct connection mode, the requirement for the structural design of the hip is simpler, assembly is more convenient, and the reliability of the humanoid robot is improved. And the size of the hip can be reduced, and structural bloating of the hip position is avoided. Due to the arrangement direction of a rotating shaft of an output flange of the hip pitching joint module, the leg structure of the humanoid robot is more flexible, the movement range is larger, and the humanoid robot can adapt to more scenes.

title: Humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a control method thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a lower limb part for realizing movement; the upper limb part is used for realizing grabbing and/or instruction operation; the eye part is used for acquiring environment feedback and comprises a depth camera; the general control part is used for controlling the lower limb part, the upper limb part and the eye part according to the instruction and the environment feedback, and is further used for controlling the lower limb part to move and controlling the depth camera to enter a dynamic environment feedback capture mode when entering a moving state; when the operation state aiming at the target object is entered, the upper limb part is controlled to carry out grabbing and/or corresponding instruction operation, and the depth camera is controlled to enter a high-precision environment feedback capture mode. Therefore, according to the control method, when the robot or the mechanical arm enters the moving or grabbing state through the master control part, the same depth camera can be switched to the corresponding operation mode, and different depth data solving requirements under different application scenes are met.

title: Testing equipment and technology for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of structure testing, and discloses a humanoid robot testing device and process, the humanoid robot testing device comprises a to-be-tested workpiece and a base, the top of the base is fixedly connected with the to-be-tested workpiece, the top of the base is fixedly connected with an inner ring, and the top of the base is fixedly connected with an outer ring. The top of the base is provided with a testing mechanism, the testing mechanism comprises an inner ring sliding column, the inner ring sliding column is slidably connected to the outer wall of the inner ring, the top of the inner ring sliding column is fixedly connected with a bearing block, and the inner wall of the bearing block is fixedly connected with one end of a first spring. According to the testing equipment and process of the humanoid robot, the testing mechanism is arranged, the driving motor rotates to circularly perform impact testing on the to-be-tested workpiece in a reciprocating manner, the position of the inner ring sliding column on the inner ring is rotated, and different positions of the to-be-tested workpiece are impacted; different positions of the to-be-tested workpiece can be tested without frequent dismounting and repositioning of the equipment.

title: Biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to complex road surfaces
abstract: According to the biped robot foot structure capable of adapting to the complex road surface, the whole foot structure is designed through modular decomposition, when a user walks on the wet and slippery flat ground, the foot obtains information of foot sole sensors on the front foot sole and the rear foot sole in real time, and the virtual constraint structure is actively controlled through an electric cylinder; stress of a front longitudinal arch sole joint is reduced, meanwhile, the ground pressure transmission direction of a foot structure is improved, the ground pressure is kept in a friction cone as much as possible, and therefore the robot is prevented from slipping; when the robot walks on an uneven road surface, the electric cylinder actively controls the ground contact angle of the front foot sole, and the spring guide rod of the rear foot sole is assisted, so that active and passive self-adaptive adjustment of the foot of the robot to the ground is realized. The electric cylinder is used as a virtual constraint structure for active control, and the spring telescopic rod structure of the rear sole imitating ligament is combined, so that active and passive self-adaption of the feet of the robot to different complex road surfaces is realized, and the adaptability of the biped robot to the complex road surfaces is improved.

title: Intelligent health-care accompanying robot with face tracking function
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent tracking, and particularly discloses an intelligent health-care accompanying robot with a face tracking function, which performs image preprocessing and face feature analysis on a first user face image and a second user face image by using an image analysis and processing technology based on computer vision. In this way, screen pose data is intelligently adjusted according to a fine-grained global semantic compensation representation between the first user facial feature and the second user facial feature. The robot can intelligently adjust the screen posture by collecting the user face image in real time and analyzing the posture of the user face image, it is ensured that the robot is located at the optimal watching position of the user all the time, and the operation difficulty and visual fatigue are greatly reduced. In addition, the face orientation of the user can be tracked and adapted in real time through an intelligent automatic control mode, and more natural and smoother interaction experience is provided.

title: Humanoid robot linear actuator and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot linear actuator and a preparation method thereof, and the humanoid robot linear actuator comprises a fixed cylinder body, and a frameless motor, an execution device and a detection unit which are arranged in the fixed cylinder body; the execution device is arranged in the fixed cylinder body through driving of a frameless motor, and the detection unit is used for controlling the execution device to move; the frameless motor is coaxially arranged outside a curved-surface lead screw of the execution device in a sleeving mode, and the two ends of the curved-surface lead screw are rotationally arranged in the fixed cylinder body. The invention discloses a humanoid robot linear actuator which is compact in structure, excellent in driving performance and capable of achieving high-precision motion control and a preparation method of the humanoid robot linear actuator.

title: Rigidity-variable foot structure of biped robot
abstract: The variable-rigidity foot structure of the biped robot comprises a shank support and a foot fixing piece, the rear portion of the foot fixing piece is fixedly connected with a heel, the left side and the right side of the heel are each provided with a shaft head, and the two shaft heads are each movably connected with an ankle joint driving device; the front portion of the foot fixing piece is fixedly connected with an arch, the front end of the arch is rotationally connected with a sole, the rear end of the sole is rotationally connected with a first connecting rod, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with a second connecting rod and a third connecting rod, the other end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected to the foot fixing piece, and the other end of the third connecting rod is rotationally connected with a damping assembly. The damping assembly comprises a sleeve, a damping spring arranged in the sleeve and a piston which is connected into the sleeve in a sliding mode and can abut against the damping spring, the piston is connected with an adjusting rod, the adjusting rod is fixed relative to the shank support, and a rigidity adjusting device is arranged between the adjusting rod and the piston. The method has the advantages of being more flexible, efficient and higher in adaptability.

title: Hip structural member of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hip structural part of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. Wherein the hip structural part is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the first connecting part and the second connecting part are roughly constructed into isosceles triangle structures with the same size, and one waist edge of the first connecting part and one waist edge of the corresponding second connecting part are connected with one leg structure; and the other waist edge of the first connecting part and the other waist edge of the corresponding second connecting part are connected with the other leg structure. The top edge of the isosceles triangle structure is used for being connected with the waist structure of the humanoid robot, the stability of the triangle is utilized, and the hip is stable in overall structure, high in bearing capacity and not prone to deformation and damage.

title: Hydraulically-driven two-degree-of-freedom coupling bionic jumping robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of jumping robots, in particular to a hydraulically-driven two-degree-of-freedom coupling type humanoid-leg jumping robot and a control method thereof. The overall structure of the robot simulating jumping of the human legs is composed of a driving assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly. The designed jumping robot is simplified into an SLIP model, a PID controller is adopted in the jumping process to achieve control over the flying phase of the jumping robot, and a PD controller is adopted in the landing phase for control. The hydraulic cylinders are far away from the legs, so that the hydraulic cylinders are driven to move to the upper body, and the whole robot has better attractiveness. And meanwhile, the lightweight design of the legs is achieved, the inertia of the legs is reduced, and the robot has more stable dynamic performance. And the vertically placed hydraulic cylinder is designed, so that the driving efficiency is further improved, and finally, more efficient bionic jumping movement is realized.

title: Robot hip joint damping device
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a robot hip joint damping device, which comprises a waist connecting seat, two buffer parts and two leg connecting seats, in the walking process of a biped humanoid robot, the gravity of the head and the upper body is conducted to the ground, and the reverse impact force of the ground is conducted upwards through soles. The two buffer parts deform and are matched with the waist connecting seat and the leg connecting seat, so that the stress of the hip joint of the robot can be buffered. Even if the reverse impact force from the ground is large, the impact force comes from other external directions or the impact force comes from the robot, the robot hip joint damping device can still effectively buffer the stress condition of the hip joint. Therefore, mechanical connection point positions of the hip joint and a power output mechanism are effectively prevented from being damaged, and a normal power output curve is guaranteed.

title: Fixing structure of humanoid robot joint motor
abstract: The utility model discloses a fixing structure of a humanoid robot joint motor, and relates to the technical field of bionics. The device comprises an upper limb and a lower limb movably connected to the bottom end in the upper limb, limiting grooves are evenly formed in the bottom of the end face of the front end of the upper limb at intervals in the circumferential direction, moving grooves are formed in the centers in the limiting grooves, limiting plates are slidably connected into the limiting grooves, and adjusting assemblies are arranged in the moving grooves; a limiting assembly is arranged in the center of the front end face of the limiting plate, and a conveniently-disassembled assembly is arranged on the outer side of the limiting assembly. According to the utility model, through the limiting assembly and the convenient-to-disassemble assembly, the joint motor body can be quickly disassembled and replaced by a worker, time and labor are saved, the working efficiency is high, the adjusting assembly can be used for making corresponding adjustment according to the size and size of the joint motor body and the position of the mounting hole, and the application range is enlarged.

title: Humanoid robot arm structure facilitating wiring and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot arm structure convenient for wiring and a humanoid robot, the arm structure comprises an L-shaped shoulder connecting seat, the L-shaped shoulder connecting seat comprises a first horizontal part and a first vertical part, the first horizontal part is arranged parallel to a first direction and is used for being connected to a trunk shoulder of the humanoid robot; the first vertical part is arranged in parallel to the second direction; a shoulder joint motor is arranged on the first vertical part, and the shoulder joint motor is located under the first horizontal part in the second direction; an upper arm mounting seat driven by the shoulder joint motor to rotate is arranged on the end face, deviating from the shoulder joint motor, of the first vertical part in the first direction; the first vertical part is provided with a shoulder joint driver electrically connected with the shoulder joint motor, and the shoulder joint driver is located under the first horizontal part in the second direction. According to the utility model, the cables electrically connected with the shoulder joint motor and the shoulder joint driver can be arranged conveniently, so that later maintenance personnel can find and repair faults conveniently.

title: ROBOT CONTROL SYSTEM, AND ROBOT CONTROL PROGRAM
abstract: To reduce a control load by performing directly work of a plurality of work kinds including holding of a work target object by a hold part.SOLUTION: A position of a radius r1 of a work site 80 is defined to be a stand-by position for humanoid robots 1 not performing any work, meanwhile a position of a radius r2 (r1>r2) of the work site 80 is defined to be a work position for performing work. When the robot 1 for carrying-in carries in a target object 100, all of the humanoid robots 1 are each arranged at the stand-by position. When the target object 100 is carried into the work site 80, a humanoid robot 1 corresponding to a work-step number, among the humanoid robots 1 for work, moves to the work position. Since this move is based on a work-step program, interference (contact, a collision, etc.) between the humanoid robots 1 does not occur.
