title: Novel humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a novel humanoid robot which comprises a head mechanism, an upper limb mechanism, a waist mechanism, an upper arm mechanism, a forearm mechanism, a hand mechanism, a hip mechanism, a thigh mechanism, a shank mechanism and a foot mechanism. A second swing mechanism is arranged between the forearm mechanism and the upper arm mechanism, a third swing mechanism is arranged between the hand mechanism and the forearm mechanism, a fourth swing mechanism and a second plane rotating mechanism 70 are arranged between the waist mechanism and the upper limb mechanism, and the hip mechanism is fixedly connected with the lower end of the waist mechanism; a fifth swing mechanism and a third plane rotating mechanism are arranged between the thigh mechanism and the hip mechanism, a sixth swing mechanism is arranged between the thigh mechanism and the shank mechanism, and a seventh swing mechanism is arranged between the shank mechanism and the foot mechanism. According to the robot, complex actions of the robot are completed through cooperation of the swing mechanism and the plane rotating mechanism.

According to the robot, complex actions of the robot are completed through cooperation of the swing mechanism and the plane rotating mechanism.

title: Leg structure of robot, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg structure of a robot, the robot and a humanoid robot. The second leg structure connected with the output end is provided with a sleeve shaft section, the second leg structure is arranged on the outer side of the joint module in a sleeving mode through the sleeve shaft section, the first bearing and the second bearing are arranged between the sleeve shaft section and the outer wall of the side, close to the output end, of the joint module, and the joint module is directly supported through the two bearings. A shaft piece of a joint module speed reducer does not need to be used for supporting any more, and abrasion and even damage caused by bias pressure of a main shaft in the joint module are avoided.

title: Thigh structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a thigh structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, solves the problem that two motors of the thigh structure are both mounted at the upper ends of thighs, and adopts the technical scheme that the thigh structure mainly comprises a thigh bracket and two motors, each motor comprises a shell, a driving unit, a control unit and a transmission unit, the driving units, the control units and the transmission units are mounted in the motors, first hinge ends are formed at the bottom ends of the thigh supports, second hinge ends are formed at the top ends of the thigh supports, mounting cavities are formed in the thigh supports, the shells of the motors are strip-shaped, and the two motors are laid in the length direction of the thigh supports. The transmission units are in transmission connection with an output shaft of the driving power source and used for outputting torque, the transmission unit of one motor is fixedly connected with the shank through a first hinge end, and the transmission unit of the other motor is fixedly connected with the crotch through a second hinge end. The invention is mainly used for fully utilizing the internal space of the thigh structure and reducing the width of the top end of the thigh structure.

title: Biped robot control method and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a control method of a biped robot and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps that in response to a received control instruction of the biped robot, the current posture of the biped robot is collected, the control instruction carries posture data of the biped robot, and the posture data is used for determining the expected single-foot point-to-ground posture of the biped robot; the expected single-foot point-to-ground posture is used for representing that the toe area of the corresponding swinging foot of the biped robot is expected to be in contact with the ground under the condition that the sole area of the corresponding supporting foot of the biped robot is in contact with the ground; based on the current posture and the expected single-foot point-to-ground posture, a swing foot moving track of a swing foot and a machine body moving track of a machine body corresponding to the biped robot are determined; and controlling the biped robot to operate based on the swinging foot moving track and the robot body moving track. The technical problem that the single-foot point-to-ground posture of the biped robot cannot be achieved in the prior art is solved.

The technical problem that the single-foot point-to-ground posture of the biped robot cannot be achieved in the prior art is solved.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and solves the problem that the sizes of a motor and a control unit are limited due to the fact that the motor is fixed to the upper ends of a thigh structure and a shank structure, according to the technical scheme, the leg structure mainly comprises a crotch, the thigh structure, the shank structure and a foot end piece; the thigh structure comprises a thigh support, two motors are installed on the thigh support, the shank structure comprises a shank support, a motor is installed on the shank support, a shell of each motor is in a long strip shape, the control unit comprises a plurality of circuit boards, the circuit boards are stacked in the shell in the length direction of the shell, and a first installation cavity is formed in the thigh support. The two motors on the thigh support are both fixed in the first installation cavity, the shank support is provided with a second installation cavity, the motor of the shank support is fixed in the second installation cavity, and a transmission unit of the motor is fixedly connected with the foot end piece. The motor mounting structure is mainly used for enabling the motor to have a larger mounting space.

title: Frame structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The frame structure of the humanoid robot comprises a hip assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, the hip assembly comprises a hip joint Pitch assembly, a hip joint Roll assembly, a hip joint Yaw assembly, a trunk supporting frame and a U-shaped support, and the hip joint Pitch assembly enables a pitch motor to incline by 20 degrees through the trunk supporting frame and then is connected with the U-shaped support; the U-shaped support is rigidly and fixedly connected with the hip joint Yaw assembly through the hip joint Roll assembly, and the thigh assembly is connected with the shank assembly. A crossed roller bearing double-sided fixing structure is arranged at the connecting part of the hip joint Roll assembly and the hip joint Pitch assembly; the hip joint pitch motor and the hip joint roll motor are designed in a coupling mode, the crossed roller bearing is additionally arranged on the output shaft of the hip joint motor, meanwhile, the structural mode that the inner ring and the outer ring are fixed on the four sides is adopted, and the hip joint pitch motor is resistant to impact and overturning moment, easy to install and stable in reliability.
abstract_en: The frame structure of the humanoid robot comprises a hip assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly, the hip assembly comprises a hip joint Pitch assembly, a hip joint Roll assembly, a hip joint Yaw assembly, a trunk supporting frame and a U-shaped support, and the hip joint Pitch assembly enables a pitch motor to incline by 20 degrees through the trunk supporting frame and then is connected with the U-shaped support; the U-shaped support is rigidly and fixedly connected with the hip joint Yaw assembly through the hip joint Roll assembly, and the thigh assembly is connected with the shank assembly. A crossed roller bearing double-sided fixing structure is arranged at the connecting part of the hip joint Roll assembly and the hip joint Pitch assembly; the hip joint pitch motor and the hip joint roll motor are designed in a coupling mode, the crossed roller bearing is additionally arranged on the output shaft of the hip joint motor, meanwhile, the structural mode that the inner ring and the outer ring are fixed on the four sides is adopted, and the hip joint pitch motor is resistant to impact and overturning moment, easy to install and stable in reliability.

title: Lightweight design method and system for mechanical legs of hydraulic biped robot based on topological optimization
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hydraulic biped robot mechanical leg lightweight design method based on topological optimization, and the method comprises the steps: defining a three-dimensional geometric model according to an existing biped robot mechanical leg space; building of a finite element model is completed, definition of topological optimization parameters is completed, and topological optimization and post-processing design are carried out; and through result analysis, the optimal configuration is screened for simulation analysis. A mathematical model of the mechanical leg of the hydraulic biped robot is established based on a topological optimization method, and an initial geometric space and an analysis model are determined according to design requirements. Weight reduction optimization is carried out on the thigh assembly through topological optimization, and finally four topological structures are obtained, and the mass of the four topological structures is 535.4 g, 494.3 g, 423.8 g and 569.2 g respectively. Through simulation verification, the third scheme meets the requirements in the aspects of strength, safety coefficient and service life, the optimization effect is better than that of the original design, and the feasibility and superiority of the optimization design are proved.

title: ESCALATING HAZARD-RESPONSE OF DYNAMICALLY STABLE MOBILE ROBOT IN A COLLABORATIVE ENVIRONMENT AND RELATED TECHNOLOGY
abstract: A method in accordance with at least some embodiments of the present technology includes determining first hazard information about a human in an environment at a first time. The method further includes decelerating a mobile robot in the environment based at least partially on the first hazard information. The method further includes determining second hazard information about the human at a second time after the first time. The method further includes reconfiguring the mobile robot based at least partially on the second hazard information. Reconfiguring the mobile robot includes moving the mobile robot from a standing configuration to a non-standing configuration. The method further includes determining third hazard information about the human at a third time after the second time. Finally, the method includes causing a safe operating stop of the mobile robot based at least partially on the third hazard information.

title: Head and neck assembly for a humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. Said head portion includes: a rear shell, and a frontal shell coupled to the rear shell to define a head volume between the frontal shell and the rear shell, and an electronics assembly with a display located in the head volume between the frontal shell and the rear shell. The frontal shell of the head housing assembly includes: a first arc length at a first location below the display, a second arc length at a second location aligned with a portion of the display, and wherein said second arc length is greater than the first arc length, and a third arc length at a third location above the display, and wherein said third arc length is greater than both the first arc length and the second arc length.

title: ROBOT CONTROL POLICY
abstract: There is provided a method for learning a bipedal robot control policy, the method includes (i) learning, by a processing circuit, an action-related corrective policy that once applied reduces a gap associated with an initial simulation state transition function and with a real world state transition function; and (ii) determining a control policy of the bipedal robot in a simulator, using the action-related corrective policy.

title: Humanoid robot falling control method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot falling control method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The control method comprises the following steps: acquiring state data of the humanoid robot in real time; predicting the current state of the humanoid robot according to the state data; and if the current state is the high-risk tumble state, controlling the humanoid robot to execute tumble protection action. According to the fall control method for the humanoid robot, the accuracy of fall prediction is improved by monitoring the gravity center position, the movement speed and the acceleration in real time. The method can quickly start the protection action under the high-risk condition, reduce the damage risk and protect the safety of surrounding personnel. The adaptability and autonomy of the robot are enhanced, the stability and safety are improved, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the service life is prolonged, so that the practicability and market competitiveness of the robot are enhanced, and the application range is widened.

title: Rescue positioning method and device for humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a rescue positioning method and device for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method comprises the following steps: performing map construction processing according to environment scanning information and a robot moving speed to generate a first grid map; determining at least three first specified positions in the first grid map according to the initial position information of the robot; the robot is controlled to move to each first designated position in sequence; determining a first distance estimation value according to the first rescue request information corresponding to each first specified position, and generating a first measurement circle according to the first specified position and the first distance estimation value; determining first rescue position information of the to-be-rescued object; real-time position information of the robot is obtained, and a first rescue path is generated according to the real-time position information of the robot, the first rescue position information and the first grid map. The method is used for achieving the effects of reducing the inaccurate rescue path caused by the positioning error and improving the rescue efficiency.

title: Autonomous refueling method and system for humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an autonomous refueling method and system for a humanoid robot and a storage medium. The humanoid robot comprises an eye mechanism, a walking mechanism, a first mechanical arm and a first mechanical hand installed at the tail end of the first mechanical arm, and the autonomous refueling system comprises an oil gun recognizing and positioning module used for recognizing an oil gun from the environment through the eye mechanism according to a refueling instruction and positioning the position of the oil gun; the first walking indication module is used for controlling the walking mechanism to move towards the position of the oil gun so that the humanoid robot can advance to the area where the oil gun is located; and the oil gun grabbing module is used for enabling the first manipulator on the first mechanical arm to grab an oil gun so as to carry out oiling operation. According to the technical scheme, the characteristic that the humanoid robot structurally has left and right arms and left and right hands like people is fully utilized, manual refueling of the vehicle is replaced, and unmanned intelligent refueling is achieved.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a humanoid mechanical arm which comprises a shoulder joint, a large arm, a small arm and a mechanical hand which are sequentially connected from front to back, a rope driving mechanism is arranged on the large arm and the small arm, the shoulder joint comprises a shoulder rack and a joint driver installed on the shoulder rack, and the joint driver drives a flexible shaft and a rope to rotate through matched transmission of the flexible shaft and the rope. And the corresponding rope driving mechanisms are driven, so that the large arm, the small arm and the manipulator are controlled to perform corresponding anthropomorphic arm movement. According to the humanoid mechanical arm, all-directional flexible movement can be conducted, complex actions can be effectively completed, the bionic effect of movement of the humanoid mechanical arm is improved, ropes are arranged at all joints, meanwhile, corresponding actuators are arranged for flexible shaft driving and rope driving, and the flexible shaft driving and the rope driving are matched for operation, so that modular layout of a driving system is achieved; the problems of complexity and coupling of a rope driving mechanism are solved.

title: Force-position hybrid control method and device of robot
abstract: The invention provides a force-position hybrid control method and device for a robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: operating expected input of the robot based on a preset control mode, and determining a control target of the robot; and calculating a robot control increment corresponding to the control target through a preset state prediction model so as to determine a control torque of the robot, thereby carrying out driving control on the robot. Wherein the control target at least comprises a mixed mode of one of the following controls: pose control and force or torque control; the state prediction model is constructed based on a moment state equation and a pose state equation of the robot and a Jacobian matrix of the robot, and the Jacobian matrix is constructed based on Jacobian of waist and double arm subsystems of the robot. According to the invention, pose tracking and force/torque tracking of the robot under a unified framework can be realized, force and position hybrid control of high-degree-of-freedom robots such as humanoid robots can be realized, and complex task requirements can be met more comprehensively.

title: Robot joint movement method and system based on muscle bionics
abstract: The invention discloses a robot joint movement method and system based on muscle bionics, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the robot joint movement method comprises the following steps: selecting a bionic driving material as a joint driving unit; a joint connection mode with multiple degrees of freedom is constructed, and state information of joints is monitored in real time; and a control system is established, and the control system receives a movement instruction and controls joint movement in combination with the state information. By simulating contraction and relaxation mechanisms of human muscles and adopting novel intelligent materials or pneumatic muscles or hydraulic muscles and other driving modes, flexible movement of robot joints is achieved, cost is reduced, movement efficiency is improved, the human muscle movement principle is simulated, and a brand new solution is provided for humanoid robot joint movement.

title: Waist and crotch assembly and humanoid robot with waist and crotch assembly
abstract: The invention discloses a waist and hip assembly, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The waist rotation driving device is mounted on the waist platform; the left side leg swinging driving assembly comprises a first rotary support rotationally installed in the waist platform and a left side leg swinging driving device fixedly installed on the waist platform; the left side rotating leg driving assembly comprises a second rotating support rotationally installed on the first rotating support and a left side rotating leg driving device fixedly installed on the first rotating support; the right side leg swinging driving assembly comprises a third rotary support rotationally installed in the waist platform and a right side leg swinging driving device fixedly installed on the waist platform; and the right side rotating leg driving assembly comprises a fourth rotating bracket rotationally mounted on the third rotating bracket and a right side rotating leg driving device fixedly mounted on the third rotating bracket. The waist and crotch structures of the robot are optimized, the leg movement drivers are used for completing movement of the waist, and the number of the drivers is reduced.

title: Non-hose hydraulic robot leg structure and hydraulic humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of hydraulic robots, and discloses a hose-free hydraulic robot leg structure and a hydraulic humanoid robot. Comprising a main oil inlet and outlet block, a thigh shaft, a thigh plate, a shank shaft, a shank plate, a shank shaft, a servo valve block, a first servo valve, a second servo valve, an integrated valve block non-hose hydraulic cylinder, a front-back oil passing non-hose hydraulic cylinder, a first fixing support and a second fixing support. The main oil inlet and outlet block is communicated with the two thigh plates through thigh shafts; the second servo valve is communicated with the thigh plate through a servo valve seat; the first servo valve is communicated with the integrated valve block hoseless hydraulic cylinder, and the integrated valve block hoseless hydraulic cylinder is communicated with the thigh plate through the first fixed support; the front-back oil-passing hoseless hydraulic cylinder is communicated with a thigh plate through a first fixed support and is communicated with a shank plate through a second fixed support; and one shank plate is communicated with the other thigh plate through a shank shaft. According to the invention, the integration level and precision are improved.

title: Compact humanoid robot leg structure and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a compact humanoid robot leg structure and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. In order to solve the problems that an existing humanoid robot leg is complex and redundant in structure, low in structure and form bionic degree and the like, the humanoid robot leg which is small in size, modularized, simple and compact in structure and high in structure bionic degree is provided, and the manufacturing difficulty, cost, size and total structure weight of the robot leg are reduced. The leg structure comprises a hip joint module, a thigh module, a knee joint module, a shank module and an ankle-sole module which are sequentially connected, and three-degree-of-freedom movement of a bionic hip joint, three-degree-of-freedom movement of a knee joint and two-degree-of-freedom movement of an ankle joint can be achieved. The method can be used for humanoid robots and biped robots.

title: Leg device of foot-type robot and foot-type robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg device of a foot type robot and the foot type robot. The leg device of the foot type robot comprises a robot leg and a driving motor arranged in the robot leg, the driving motor comprises a shell internally provided with a power cavity and a power assembly arranged in the power cavity, a first containing cavity is formed in the end face of the tail of the shell, and a motor controller electrically connected with the power assembly is arranged in the first containing cavity; the motor controller comprises a strong current control assembly and a weak current circuit board assembly which are stacked along the rotation axis of the power assembly and electrically connected, and a heat dissipation channel is reserved between the strong current control assembly and the weak current circuit board assembly. The invention further discloses the foot type robot which adopts the leg device of the foot type robot. The leg device of the humanoid robot has the advantages that the overall structure of the leg device of the robot is more compact, the space utilization rate of the legs of the humanoid robot can be improved, all parts can be reasonably arranged in the limited leg space, and the situation that the flexibility and reliability of leg movement are affected by too many external cables and scattered control equipment is avoided.

title: Carrying device for carrying robot
abstract: The carrying device comprises a supporting plate, first containing grooves are formed in the two sides of the lower portion, located on the front face, of the supporting plate, and first sliding blocks are slidably connected to the sides, close to each other, of the inner walls of the tops and the inner walls of the bottoms of the first containing grooves; a first pneumatic clamping device is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the first sliding block, first air cylinders are fixedly installed on the lower portions of the two sides of the supporting plate, a second containing groove is formed in the upper portion, located in the middle of the front face, of the supporting plate, and second sliding blocks are slidably connected to the inner walls of the two sides in the second containing groove; a second pneumatic clamping device is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the second sliding block, and a second air cylinder is arranged under the second sliding block. According to the carrying device for the carrying robot, the pneumatic clamping device, the air cylinder and the supporting plate are arranged, the legs and the waist of the humanoid robot can be clamped, and the purpose of carrying the robot can be achieved through a forklift.

title: Finger push rod, manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a finger push rod, a manipulator and a humanoid robot. The finger push rod comprises a first assembly body and a second assembly body, wherein the first assembly body comprises a shell and a motor outer stator of a brushless motor arranged in the shell; the second assembly body comprises a motor inner rotor which is rotatably arranged in the motor outer stator; the ball screw is provided with a first part located in the shell and a second part extending out of the shell; the first part is arranged in a motor inner rotor of the brushless motor in a penetrating manner and is driven by the motor inner rotor to rotate; and the ball screw nut is sleeved on the second part and is connected with the mechanical finger. A ball screw pair is adopted as a transmission device, and the ball screw pair and a motor can be designed on the same straight line, so that the radial size of the finger push rod at the motor is reduced; the split type brushless motor is adopted, the ball screw is arranged in the rotor in the motor in a penetrating mode, other connecting structures are not needed, the number of parts is reduced, the system integration degree is high, and the axial size of the finger push rod can be reduced.

title: A SEMI AUTONOMOUS HUMANOID ROBOT FOR SECURITY
abstract: The present invention discloses a semi-autonomous humanoid robot for security applications to avoid the accidents/risks using the virtual reality technology. The humanoid robot comprises a plurality of rotary elements and actuators operatively connected with the power source for providing the necessary rotary movement to the hands, legs and other body parts of the robot. The robot head is having a 360-degree camera which is configured to visualize the captured details to the user/operator. The wearable suit is configured to worn by the wearer/user/operator for providing the instruction/communication to the robot using the plurality of sensors/Arduino/actuators positioned in the suit. The VR headset is configured to worn by the wearer/user/operator for viewing the realistic details from one or more remote locations. The control system is operatively coupled with the user handheld devices for instructing/operating/controlling the robot functions/operations from the remote locations using the joysticks or the like. The wireless connectivity module is configured to provide the two-way communication between the user and the robot by means of controlling the robot functionalities through the virtual reality headset and joystick. The present invention will reduce the accidents and risks in the field of security applications.

title: Ankle hinge shaft, ankle hinge structure and shank structure of robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an ankle hinge shaft, an ankle hinge structure and a shank structure of a robot and a humanoid robot. Wherein the ankle hinge shaft comprises a first connecting rod section, a first connecting shaft section, a shaft shoulder section, a second connecting shaft section and a second connecting rod section which are connected in sequence, the first connecting shaft section, the shaft shoulder section and the second connecting shaft section are concentrated in the middle and can be used for installing the ankle hinge shaft, the structural shape of the ankle hinge shaft has high strength, and due to the arrangement of a clamping shoulder, the ankle hinge shaft can be installed conveniently. The connecting strength of the first connecting shaft section, the shaft shoulder section, the second connecting shaft section and the shaft shoulder section is improved, and the structural strength of the connecting shaft is further improved. The first rocker hinge section and the second rocker hinge section are far away from the middle part, and the two ends of the shaft body are not required to be further assembled except for hinge points, so that the length of the shaft body is reduced, materials are saved, the processing is more convenient, and the production cost can be effectively reduced.

title: Humanoid robot predictive control method with redundancy freedom degree constraint and robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot predictive control method based on redundancy degree of freedom constraint and a robot. The method comprises the steps of creating a first dynamic model of a biped lower limb system in the humanoid robot based on product parameters of the humanoid robot; according to the first dynamical model and a reference trajectory planned based on the motion task of the humanoid robot, control parameters of the biped lower limb system walking along the reference trajectory and corresponding control costs are predicted, and the control costs comprise the state cost and the input cost of the biped lower limb system; based on the control parameters, a cost function in a quadratic programming form is created, and the cost function comprises redundant joint constraint terms of the humanoid robot; determining an optimal control parameter of the humanoid robot based on the cost function and a first constraint condition with a priority corresponding to the motion task; and joint motors in the humanoid robot are controlled to operate based on the optimal control parameters. Therefore, the problem that two feet of the humanoid robot are difficult to stably run in a complex environment can be solved.

title: Bionic humanoid robot foot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic humanoid robot foot, and relates to the field of robot design. The problem that an existing humanoid robot is not high in walking efficiency due to the fact that foot pedaling force is insufficient is solved. The invention comprises a front sole, a middle foot, a rear foot and a fascia connecting rod mechanism, the middle foot and the fascia connecting rod mechanism are oppositely arranged up and down and are arranged between the front sole and the rear foot, the front sole and the rear foot are connected through the middle foot and the fascia connecting rod mechanism, and a multi-degree-of-freedom supporting connecting rod structure is defined by the middle foot, the fascia connecting rod mechanism, the front sole and the rear foot; when the feet of the humanoid robot touch the ground, the supporting connecting rod structures are stressed to deform, so that the terrain self-adaptive capacity of the feet of the robot is improved; the fascia connecting rod mechanism is of a bendable rod-shaped structure, a limiting assembly is arranged on the fascia connecting rod mechanism, and the limiting assembly can limit bending of the fascia connecting rod mechanism, so that the degree of freedom of the supporting connecting rod structure is reduced, the supporting connecting rod structure becomes rigid, and the treading force of the robot feet is increased in the treading process of the robot feet. The method is mainly used for robot foot design.

title: Linear joint servo module, driving device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a linear joint servo module, a driving device and a humanoid robot. A stator of a frameless torque motor is fixedly connected with a shell, the frameless torque motor is connected with a motor output shaft through a planetary roller screw rod, and the motor output shaft is provided with a monopole pair of magnets; the encoder plate is arranged opposite to the monopole pair of magnets, the encoder plate generates a position signal of the motor output shaft according to the magnetic field change generated by the rotation of the monopole pair of magnets, and the position signal is sent to the control panel. The control panel controls the servo driving board to generate corresponding current according to the position information and the motor control signal and outputs the current to the frameless torque motor so as to control the state of the frameless torque motor, and the shell is used for fixing the servo driving board, the control panel and the encoder board, so that the weight of the module can be reduced, and the motion performance can be improved; and the purposes of lightweight design and rapid dismounting, replacement and maintenance of the robot can be achieved.

title: Leg movement structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a leg movement structure and a humanoid robot. The leg movement structure is used for the humanoid robot. The leg movement structure comprises a mounting assembly, a cantilever assembly and a legging assembly. The cantilever assembly is rotatably mounted on the mounting assembly. The legging assembly can be arranged on the cantilever assembly in a sliding mode. The leg binding assembly comprises a fixing seat and a supporting plate, and the supporting plate can be rotatably mounted on the fixing seat; the fixing base can be installed on the cantilever assembly in a sliding mode, and the supporting plate is used for fixing the legs of a user. According to the leg movement structure provided by the utility model, users of any age and any body type can comfortably and appropriately fix the legs on the supporting plate, and the legs are moved and recovered under the driving of the humanoid robot, so that the applicability and the practicability of the leg movement structure provided by the utility model are improved.

title: Detachable joint structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a detachable joint structure of a humanoid robot, which is convenient to mount and dismount, improves the convenience, facilitates emergency treatment of tripping, and gives an alarm to remind an operator of overhauling. Comprising a body mechanism; the device comprises a main body mechanism and further comprises two fixing mechanisms, two dismounting mechanisms, a driving mechanism, two emergency mechanisms and two auxiliary mechanisms, the two fixing mechanisms are installed in the main body mechanism, the two dismounting mechanisms are installed on the main body mechanism, the driving mechanism is installed on the main body mechanism, and the two emergency mechanisms are installed on the main body mechanism. The two auxiliary mechanisms are mounted on the emergency mechanism, the main body mechanism is conveniently mounted and dismounted through the fixing mechanism, the main body mechanism is dismounted through the dismounting mechanism, the main body mechanism is driven by the driving mechanism, and the auxiliary mechanisms assist the emergency mechanism to perform emergency treatment when the main body mechanism is tripped.

title: Humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a control method thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a waist support; the two driving assemblies are fixedly connected with the two opposite sides of the waist support and are coaxially arranged. The hip joint assembly comprises a connecting rod structure, a first bearing, a second bearing and a fixing piece, flanges are arranged on the sides, close to each other, of the two driving assemblies, and when the driving assemblies drive the flanges to rotate around the first axis, the connecting rod structure drives the fixing piece to swing in the left-right direction of the humanoid robot through the first bearing and the second bearing; a rotating motor is arranged in the fixing piece, the leg assembly is connected with the rotating motor so that the leg assembly can rotate around a second axis, and the first axis and the second axis are relatively perpendicular to each other. The driving shaft is coaxially arranged, the transmission mode that the flange and the connecting rod structure are combined is adopted, meanwhile, the independent axis design is combined, so that rotation and movement of the joint do not occupy too much transverse space any more, and the movement freedom degree of the hip joint is improved.

title: Humanoid robot assembling process and equipment for automobile core part production
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine tool mechanical arms, in particular to humanoid robot assembling equipment for producing automobile core parts, which comprises a humanoid robot body for producing the automobile core parts. The humanoid robot body comprises a driving base, a mechanical base fixedly mounted on the upper surface of the driving base and a mechanical arm fixedly mounted on the upper surface of the mechanical base and used for conveying materials, and a supporting structure is arranged below the driving base; and a cleaning part for cleaning the joint of the driving base and the mechanical base is slidably mounted on the annular guide base, and the cleaning part is composed of a mounting structure, a walking mechanism, a shell, a cleaning mechanism, dust collection equipment and a scraping structure. By designing the walking mechanism capable of circularly moving around the driving base, dust collection and lubrication functions are linked with rotation of the walking mechanism, that is, dust collection and lubrication work is achieved through inertia and a rotating shaft when the walking mechanism rotates, and cleaning of the outer surface of the rotating position of the base of the mechanical arm is achieved.

title: Intelligent humanoid fire-fighting robot
abstract: The intelligent humanoid fire-fighting robot comprises a robot body, mechanical arms are installed on the two sides of the robot body, mechanical legs are installed at the bottom of the robot body, and a smoke monitoring assembly is arranged in the center of the top of the robot body; a moving assembly is arranged at the bottom of the mechanical leg, a clamping assembly is installed on the moving assembly, and the mechanical leg is fixed to the moving assembly through the clamping assembly. A cavity is formed in the lower portion of the front side of the robot body, and a monitoring assembly is fixedly installed in the cavity. A storage cavity is formed in the upper portion of the cavity, a driving assembly and a cleaning assembly are installed in the storage cavity, the cleaning assembly is controlled by the driving assembly to stretch out and draw back and swing so as to clean the monitoring assembly, and it is guaranteed that an environment picture obtained by the monitoring assembly is clear; a mounting groove is formed in the center of the top of the robot body, a fixing assembly is arranged at the bottom of the mounting groove, and the smoke monitoring assembly is fixed by the fixing assembly after being inserted into the mounting groove. The system can prevent and early warn fire, thereby reducing casualties and property loss.

title: Robot leg yaw joint supporting structure, robot leg structure, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a robot leg yawing joint supporting structure, a robot leg structure, a robot and a humanoid robot, and the robot leg yawing joint supporting structure mainly comprises a leg rolling output connecting piece, a bearing and a leg yawing joint module. A connecting flange on the butt joint portion of the leg rolling output connecting piece is connected with an output flange of the leg yawing joint module in an assembled mode, a bearing playing a supporting role is arranged between the butt joint portion and the output end of the leg yawing joint module, and a supporting system is formed between the butt joint portion and the leg yawing joint module through the arrangement. And a supporting system is also formed at the speed reducer section inside the output flange of the leg yawing joint module, so that the output flange of the leg yawing joint module is prevented from being biased, and the speed reducer of the yawing joint module is protected.

title: Humanoid robot motion efficiency evaluation method and system, storage medium and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion efficiency evaluation method and system, a storage medium and equipment, belongs to the technical field of robot evaluation, and aims to solve the problems of tedious calculation and inaccurate evaluation in existing robot motion efficiency evaluation. According to the method, firstly, the reference dynamic power DPoS index Pd is calculated according to the vector diameter length from the ith joint connecting rod to the DH parameter coordinate origin o, the rotation angular speed of the ith joint connecting rod and the rotational inertia of the ith joint connecting rod relative to a rotating shaft at the coordinate origin, and then the ratio of the reference dynamic power DPoS index Pd to the actual power of the humanoid robot serves as the reference dynamic efficiency; and evaluating the motion efficiency of the humanoid robot according to the reference dynamic efficiency.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid dexterous hand and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the humanoid dexterous hand comprises a humanoid hand structure, the humanoid hand structure comprises a palm-imitating structure and a plurality of finger-imitating structures, and each finger-imitating structure comprises at least one knuckle; the touch system comprises measuring sheets laid on the knuckles of the palm-imitating structure and the finger-imitating structures, signal lines connected with the measuring sheets and an acquisition device, the measuring sheets are arranged to be stretchable and bendable sheet structures, the measuring sheets comprise pressure sensor arrays, and the pressure sensor arrays are connected with the signal lines and the acquisition device. The pixel distance of the pressure sensor array is not larger than 10 mm. The defect that in the prior art, when the humanoid dexterous hand grabs the target, the sensing information of the target is inaccurate is overcome.

title: Control method and device for double-arm cooperation of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device for cooperation of two arms of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that an action image sequence generated in the process that the two arms of the humanoid robot execute a target task is acquired; a first feature vector sequence corresponding to the action image sequence, a mechanical arm joint position vector sequence and a second feature vector sequence corresponding to the target mask image sequence are determined; target style variables corresponding to the first feature vector sequence, the second feature vector sequence, the mechanical arm joint position vector sequence and the action image sequence are coded, and a feature key-value pair sequence is output; the feature key-value pair sequence and the humanoid robot body position vector are jointly used as training samples; and performing supervised imitation learning on the plurality of training samples, and generating a motion control model for double-arm collaboration. Therefore, based on the motion control model, the two arms of the humanoid robot can complete more complex long action sequence tasks, and the success rate of target task execution is effectively improved.

title: Hydraulically-driven large-turning-angle robot joint
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulically-driven large-turning-angle robot joint, and relates to the field of robot joints. The problems that an existing hydraulic robot joint is high in complexity and redundancy and large in size and weight are solved. The device comprises a shell unit and further comprises a torque transmission system and a swing cylinder driving system, the torque transmission system and the swing cylinder driving system are connected and then embedded in the shell unit, and the swing cylinder driving system provides reciprocating linear swing driving power and is in sliding connection with the input end of the torque transmission system. Linear motion of swing driving power is converted into a torque power source for rotation of the torque transmission system, and torque is output by the torque transmission system. The required torque is directly output through the swing cylinder to drive the joint, the transmission structure is simplified, and meanwhile the advantage of hydraulic drive on the power mass ratio is utilized. The overall motion performance of the robot is improved, the size and weight of the robot are reduced, and meanwhile the efficient driving capacity is guaranteed. The invention is applied to the humanoid robot.

title: Biped robot capable of improving weight distribution of legs
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot for improving weight distribution of legs. A hip frame body is fixedly connected to the center of the bottom of a waist frame body; the upper end of the thigh frame body is connected with the hip frame body through a motor direct drive type hip joint assembly, the lower end of the thigh frame body is connected with the upper end of the shank supporting rod through a knee joint assembly, and the lower end of the shank supporting rod is connected with the upper surface of the foot supporting plate through an ankle joint assembly; a leg bending and stretching driving assembly is arranged between the thigh frame body and the shank supporting rod; a foot pitching and deflection driving assembly is arranged between the thigh frame body and the foot supporting plate. Driving motors of knee joints and ankle joints are moved upwards to thighs, the knee joints and the ankle joints are driven by the driving motors in a connecting rod transmission mode, the weight of shanks and rotational inertia of the shanks are reduced, and in the dynamic walking process of the biped robot, the gravity center regulation and control difficulty is reduced, and the walking posture stability of the biped robot is improved; the balance between the movement performance of the shank and the lightweight requirement is realized.

title: Frameless torque motor suitable for humanoid robot and controller
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motor control, in particular to a frameless torque motor and controller suitable for a humanoid robot, which comprises a cylinder part, a stator is arranged in the cylinder part, a rotor is arranged on the inner wall of the stator, a nested connection mechanism is arranged on the surface of the rotor, and a surface heat dissipation assembly is arranged on the surface of the cylinder part. The nested connection mechanism comprises a placement strip plate, a connection arc plate, a magnetic attraction block, a magnet butt joint column piece and a permanent magnet material rotor ring plate, and the placement strip plate is fixedly connected to the top of the rotor. According to the frameless torque motor suitable for the humanoid robot and the controller, multiple layers of permanent magnet material rotor ring plates are sleeved together layer by layer through arrangement of a surface heat dissipation assembly and a nested connection mechanism, and the adjacent permanent magnet material rotor ring plates can be connected together through magnetic attraction after being in contact through magnet butt joint column pieces and magnetic attraction blocks during sleeving; and the magnetic fields of the rotor ring plates in each layer are mutually superposed and cooperated to generate larger torque, so that the practicability is high.

The nested connection mechanism comprises a placement strip plate, a connection arc plate, a magnetic attraction block, a magnet butt joint column piece and a permanent magnet material rotor ring plate, and the placement strip plate is fixedly connected to the top of the rotor. title: Motion synchronization system between human and humanoid robots and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a motion synchronization system and method between a human and a humanoid robot, and an object thereof is to extract various motion data by deep learning from various moving images collected via the internet, generate common motion data for similar motion data from the extracted various motion data, convert the generated common motion data into motion control values of the humanoid robot and store them in a database, and control the motion of the humanoid robot with the motion control values of the motion data matched and synchronized by matching motion data input from an actual user with the motion data stored in the database, thereby enabling the humanoid robot to express motions expressed by a human in a natural and highly completed corrected manner.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a motion synchronization system and method between a human and a humanoid robot, and an object thereof is to extract various motion data by deep learning from various moving images collected via the internet, generate common motion data for similar motion data from the extracted various motion data, convert the generated common motion data into motion control values of the humanoid robot and store them in a database, and control the motion of the humanoid robot with the motion control values of the motion data matched and synchronized by matching motion data input from an actual user with the motion data stored in the database, thereby enabling the humanoid robot to express motions expressed by a human in a natural and highly completed corrected manner.

title: Humanoid robot motion expression system and method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to an motion expression system for a humanoid robot and a method therefor, and an object thereof is to enable natural and highly complete motion expression by extracting various motion data by deep learning from various moving pictures collected through the Internet, generating common motion data for similar motion data from the extracted various motion data, converting each of the generated common motion data into motion control values of the humanoid robot, and then controlling the motion of the humanoid robot with the motion control values.

title: Walkassist Robot with Autonomous Cruise Function
abstract: A walking assistance robot equipped with an autonomous driving function includes a body and a control unit, wherein the body includes: an annular waist support detachably attachable to a waist; two hip joint supports fixed to lower left and right portions of the waist support and having a triangular shape so as to wrap around hips and hip joints; two knee joint supports positioned below the hip joint supports, including rod-shaped supports to wrap around left and right knees, and having an annular shape; and two joint parts connecting the hip joint supports and the knee joint supports. The waist support includes: a waistrest having a pressure sensor attached to an inner rear side; a belly rest having a pressure sensor attached to an inner front side; two cameras on an outer front side; and a microphone capable of recognizing a user's voice, and the joint parts include: a first anchor and a second anchor connecting a lower part of the hip joint support and an upper part of the rod-shaped support of the knee joint support; and a first stepper motor connected to the first anchor, driven by power, and rotating in a front-rear direction, and a second stepper motor connected to the second anchor, driven by power, and rotating in a left-right direction.

title: Humanoid robot based on atmosphere driving
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid robot based on atmosphere driving, which comprises a main driving system for providing negative pressure potential energy required by driving; the tail end execution system is driven by the main driving system to complete specific actions; the switch valve system is arranged on the main driving system and can control fluid to enter the end execution system or come out of the end execution system so as to be matched with execution of actions, and the actions comprise the stretching action and the contracting action; the sensing system is used for acquiring sensing information of each part of the humanoid robot; the power supply management system is used for supplying power to electric components; the control system is connected with the main driving system, the switch valve system, the sensing system and the power management system; and the supporting framework provides a supporting carrier for each system. The series piston cylinders and the parallel piston cylinders are integrated to serve as a main driving system, negative pressure potential energy is released by means of atmospheric pressure, actions of a natural person are simulated, and the practicability of the robot is improved.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, in particular to a human-shaped mechanical arm which comprises a shoulder joint assembly, an elbow joint assembly and a wrist joint assembly. The second shoulder rotating module is connected to the output end of the first shoulder rotating module; the third shoulder rotating module is connected to the output end of the second shoulder rotating module; the elbow joint assembly comprises a large arm rotating connecting piece connected to the output end of the third shoulder rotating module, an elbow connecting piece rotationally connected with the large arm rotating connecting piece and a front arm rotating module installed on the elbow connecting piece. The wrist joint assembly comprises a forearm rotating connecting piece installed at the output end of the forearm rotating module, a wrist connecting piece and a mechanical arm adapting piece rotationally connected with the wrist connecting piece, a mechanical arm driving mechanism for driving the mechanical arm adapting piece to rotate is installed on the wrist connecting piece, and the humanoid mechanical arm is similar to a human body and good in flexibility.
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, in particular to a human-shaped mechanical arm which comprises a shoulder joint assembly, an elbow joint assembly and a wrist joint assembly. title: Humanoid robot test platform
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot test platform which comprises a supporting frame, a hanging bracket is arranged at the top end of the supporting frame, a plurality of hanging rings are installed at the bottom end of the hanging bracket, a sliding rail is arranged in the middle of the supporting frame in the width direction, and a sliding block is installed on the sliding rail in a sliding mode. A pair of waist fixing frames is connected to the outer end of the first sliding block, a supporting connecting piece and a load connecting piece are arranged between the waist fixing frames, the load connecting piece comprises a mounting groove and a transverse rod, the transverse rod is clamped in the mounting groove, loads are arranged at the two ends of the transverse rod, and locking assemblies are arranged between the waist fixing frames and the supporting frame. The waist fixing frame fixes the height of the robot through a locking assembly. The waist fixing frame, the supporting connecting piece and the load connecting piece are arranged in a matched mode, so that the robot is effectively prevented from falling down in the specific motion testing process, and whole-course protection is achieved.

title: Mining humanoid robot for raw material sorting scene
abstract: The invention discloses a mining humanoid robot for a raw material sorting scene, which comprises a robot body, the robot body comprises a moving part and a working part, the moving part is used for moving the position of the robot body and adjusting the posture of the robot body, and the working part is used for grabbing ore raw materials; the sensor system comprises an environment sensor, a visual sensor, a touch sensor and a position sensor, the visual sensor is used for providing a current environment visual field, the touch sensor is used for sensing surface characteristics of ore raw materials, and the position sensor is used for monitoring the position and posture of the robot body; the control system is used for receiving a signal of the sensor system and controlling the robot body to move and operate, the robot can remarkably improve the sorting efficiency of mine raw materials, manual participation is reduced, the labor intensity is reduced, meanwhile, the sorting accuracy is improved, and the product quality is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid double-chain structure mechanical arm
abstract: The humanoid double-chain structure mechanical arm comprises a main body, a main chain and an auxiliary chain, the main body can be regarded as the waist and the legs of a person, double branch chains can be regarded as the left arm and the right arm of the person, and complex work can be completed by replacing the person through cooperation of the main body and the double chains; the mechanical arm integrally adopts 4 + 3 + 4 joint configuration, a main body and a main chain are of a standard series seven-axis mechanical arm configuration, the axes of all joints of the main body and the auxiliary chain intersect on the same straight line, the seven-axis industrial robot configuration is guaranteed, and algorithm switching in the movement process is facilitated; according to the mechanical arm, the joints are convenient to disassemble, single-chain and double-chain conversion can be achieved according to different operation scenes, different motion planning algorithms are selected, and the motion process is simple and efficient. If the auxiliary chain is detached, the robot is of a standard series seven-axis robot configuration, if the main chain is detached and the eighth joint is locked, the robot is of the standard series seven-axis robot configuration, and the third joint and the eighth joint are locked at the same time, the robot is of a standard six-axis industrial robot configuration, so that the practicability of the mechanical arm is enhanced.

title: Vein blood sampling device and system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a vein blood sampling device and system based on a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of medical instruments, the vein blood sampling device comprises an intelligent blood sampling table module, a blood sampling consumable supply module, a humanoid blood sampling puncture robot module, an arm fixing module, a consumable recovery module and a visual detection module; through the humanoid blood sampling puncture robot module, a target point conforming to blood vessel puncture in a space can be accurately found and positioned, the blood sampling consumable supply module can be conveniently integrated with an existing automatic blood sampling processing system, and the blood sampling consumable supply module can be conveniently integrated with the existing automatic blood sampling processing system under the cooperation of other modules. The human-shaped blood sampling puncture robot carries out operations such as pulse pressing, disinfection, puncture blood sampling, pressing hemostasis, blood sampling tube shaking and blood sampling consumable recycling.

title: Humanoid robotic surgical system
abstract: In the humanoid robot operation system provided by the embodiment of the invention, the mechanical arm is assembled on the trunk and is in communication connection with the host, the trunk is assembled on the moving mechanism, the trunk is internally provided with the host accommodating space so as to assemble the host in the host accommodating space, and the man-machine interface is assembled on the trunk and is in communication connection with the host. A generation type operation large model is deployed on the host, and the operation large model executes the following steps that basic medical record information, preoperative examination results and focus image data of a patient are received through a man-machine interface to construct a three-dimensional physiological structure model; performing feature analysis on the three-dimensional physiological structure model to mark a target surgical site and formulate a mechanical arm path according to the target surgical site; establishing a mapping relation between the path of the mechanical arm and the position of the patient to generate an action track sequence of the mechanical arm; according to the action track sequence, the moving mechanism is driven to move towards the position of the patient to reach the designated point position, and the mechanical arm is controlled to drive the surgical instrument to act so as to perform an operation on the target surgical site.

title: Humanoid robot action simulation method and system based on human body linear model
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot action simulation method and system based on a human body linear model, and the method comprises the steps: S1, collecting the video input of human body actions, and extracting the action information frame by frame; s2, carrying out modeling based on the action information, and obtaining SMPL representation and three-dimensional representation of a human body posture; s3, based on the SMPL representation and the three-dimensional representation of the human body posture, generating SMPL sequence data in the time dimension and the three-dimensional representation of the human body action, and constructing a dynamics tree model of the robot; and S4, planning a motion track of the robot through the dynamic tree model, and generating a corresponding control instruction. According to the method, mesh modeling is carried out on human body actions and the SMPL model is extracted, so that human body dynamics are accurately captured. Based on the SMPL sequence of the motion, the power tree model adapted to the motion of the humanoid robot is constructed, real-time simulation of the robot to human actions is realized, and the accuracy and real-time performance of the actions are improved.
abstract_en: The invention provides a humanoid robot action simulation method and system based on a human body linear model, and the method comprises the steps: S1, collecting the video input of human body actions, and extracting the action information frame by frame; s2, carrying out modeling based on the action information, and obtaining SMPL representation and three-dimensional representation of a human body posture; s3, based on the SMPL representation and the three-dimensional representation of the human body posture, generating SMPL sequence data in the time dimension and the three-dimensional representation of the human body action, and constructing a dynamics tree model of the robot; and S4, planning a motion track of the robot through the dynamic tree model, and generating a corresponding control instruction. Based on the SMPL sequence of the motion, the power tree model adapted to the motion of the humanoid robot is constructed, real-time simulation of the robot to human actions is realized, and the accuracy and real-time performance of the actions are improved.

title: Half-humanoid robot teleoperation control method based on VR equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a semi-humanoid robot teleoperation control method based on VR equipment, and relates to the field of VR equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, data stream tracking and connection: developing and compiling a data stream tracking APP, installing the APP on the used VR equipment, and carrying out the real-time collection of the gesture of an operator and the relative pose data of the head through the VR equipment; and step 2, coordinate conversion of the VR data stream: the coordinate systems of the wrist and the head in the VR data stream are in one-to-one correspondence with VR base coordinates. And 3, writing an inverse kinematics solution program based on C + +, and carrying out solution design on the joint angle and the gesture. The visual angle limitation of an existing system is broken through, the head control function of VR equipment is combined, the movement of the head of the robot can be adjusted in real time along with the rotation of the head of an operator, and therefore dynamic first visual angle switching is achieved. The immersion feeling of an operator is enhanced, the operation accuracy is improved, and the operator can better perform task operation in a complex environment.

title: Under-actuated robot finger with rigid-flexible hybrid transmission mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an under-actuated robot finger with a rigid-flexible hybrid transmission mechanism, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. The connecting seat is fixed at the top end of the gear box, a rotating shaft is mounted in the middle of the connecting seat, a worm gear is sleeved on the rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is meshed with the worm; the tail end of the knuckle shell is rotatably connected with the worm gear; the tail end of the swinging arm is hinged to the front side edge of the connecting seat; a limiting groove is formed in the top end of the swinging arm; the tail end of the driving arm is hinged to the rear side edge of the surface of the worm gear, the top end of the driving arm is hinged to the inner side end of the sliding rod, the fingertip assembly comprises a flexible base and a rigid framework and is provided with a spring hinged to the top end of the knuckle shell, and the outer side end of the sliding rod is hinged to a rigid supporting rod embedded into the fingertip assembly. The rigid-flexible hybrid transmission mechanism is combined with the under-actuated design, the method is simple and easy to implement, the requirements of the humanoid prosthetic finger on the aspects of size, weight, integration and grabbing envelope are met, the characteristic of coupling-adaptive movement is achieved, and the flexibility and comfort are improved.

title: Humanoid robot joint impedance control device
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot joint impedance control device, which comprises a loading device, a joint impedance control computer and an interface touch screen for operating man-machine interaction, and is characterized in that the loading device comprises a horizontal test bed and a weight adjusting assembly which are arranged on a workbench; different torque loads are applied to the joints through the loading device, and after the loads are set to the human-computer interface, the joint impedance control computer performs impedance control on the joints according to the set loads and joint feedback information; the device is a testing device for the flexibility of robot joints produced in batches, evaluation and comparison of the humanoid robot joints are convenient and fast through a man-machine interaction interface and device experiments, mechanical and electric control composition is simple and flexible, and parameter index quantification in software is visual. title: Waist joint driving structure of robot, waist driving structure of robot, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a waist joint driving structure of a robot, a waist driving structure of the robot, the robot and a humanoid robot. The waist joint driving structure mainly comprises a crank, a bearing, a supporting piece and a waist joint module, an output flange of the waist joint module is connected with the connecting end of the crank in an assembled mode, the supporting piece is connected to the output end of the waist joint module in an assembled mode, and the bearing with the supporting function is arranged between the supporting piece and the crank. The outer ring of the bearing abuts against the inner ring of the supporting piece, and the inner ring of the bearing abuts against the shaft sleeve on the connecting end. By means of the arrangement, the crank forms bilateral support through the bearing at the output end in the waist joint module and the bearing between the crank and the supporting piece, the problem of bias pressure can be avoided, and damage to the joint module is avoided.

title: Leg and waist structure of robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg and waist structure of a robot and a humanoid robot. The leg and waist structure comprises a knee bending mechanism, a waist bending mechanism and a lifting mechanism. The knee bending mechanism comprises a knee bending driving mechanism, a connecting rod assembly and a self-locking first transmission mechanism, so that the knee bending mechanism is switched between a bending state and a straightening state; the bending mechanism comprises a bending driving mechanism for driving the knee bending mechanism to switch between a bending state and a straightening state relative to the lifting mechanism; the lifting mechanism comprises a self-locking second transmission mechanism so that the lifting mechanism can ascend and descend relative to the bending mechanism. According to the invention, the knee bending mechanism can realize independent bending and straightening; the bending mechanism can drive the knee bending mechanism to bend and unbend relative to the lifting mechanism; the lifting mechanism can ascend and descend relative to the bending mechanism. Self-locking lead screws are respectively arranged in the knee bending mechanism and the lifting mechanism for transmission, so that the safety and the stability of the whole structure are greatly improved, the size of a motor is reduced, the weight of the whole machine is reduced, and the production cost is reduced.

title: Method and device for generating passable area of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid robot passable area generation method and device and a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an original image of a to-be-passed area of the humanoid robot when it is detected that the humanoid robot starts to move after being electrified; defocusing recovery processing is carried out on the original image, and a depth image is generated based on the distance from each pixel point in the image after defocusing recovery to the monocular camera; determining a first region formed by pixel points of which the depth values are greater than a distance threshold in the depth image, and mapping the first region into the original image to obtain a second region; determining an impassable area of the original image; determining a passable area of the humanoid robot based on the impassable area of the original image; and the passing direction angle of the humanoid robot is determined, and the humanoid robot is controlled to pass through the passable area based on the passing direction angle. According to the invention, the passable area of the humanoid robot can be accurately generated in real time, and real-time navigation is carried out.

title: Method for predicting life of battery of humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a method for predicting the service life of a battery of a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out the multi-source data collection of the robot, and the multi-source data collection comprises the steps of battery parameter collection, use environment perception, task load recording and charging behavior analysis; carrying out preprocessing and feature extraction on the collected multi-source data; and outputting a prediction result according to the extracted features through a deep learning model architecture. Multi-source data is combined with a deep learning model to predict the battery life condition of the robot, the precision of a battery life prediction result is improved, and meanwhile, the method can adapt to different types of robots and variable use environments.

title: Dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The dexterous hand comprises a palm and a plurality of finger assemblies. A containing cavity is formed in the palm, and multiple openings are formed in the front side of the palm. A plurality of mounting arms are arranged in the containing cavity and correspond to the openings respectively, and the front ends of the mounting arms penetrate through the openings and protrude out of the front side of the palm; the accommodating cavity is divided into an upper mounting space and a lower mounting space by the plurality of mounting arms; the multiple finger assemblies are connected to the front ends of the multiple mounting arms in a one-to-one correspondence mode. A plurality of driving units are arranged in the upper mounting space and used for driving the finger assemblies to swing up and down relative to the mounting arm. Two circuit boards arranged up and down are arranged in the lower installation space, a wire of the driving unit is connected to the circuit board located on the upper portion, and a control module is arranged on the circuit board located on the lower portion. Moving parts on the driving units can be prevented from interfering with wire harnesses and electronic devices, and the internal layout of the palm is more reasonable.

title: Music-driven humanoid robot control method based on antagonistic imitation learning
abstract: The invention relates to a music-driven humanoid robot control method based on antagonistic imitation learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining original music matched with dance demonstration, and carrying out the feature extraction of the original music; a music encoder is adopted to encode the extracted features to obtain implicit vectors of the music; inputting the implicit vector of the music into a dance generator as a condition, and generating robot dance action control information so as to construct a simulated robot dance action; the dance discriminator is used for distinguishing simulated robot dance actions and dance demonstration; alternately training the dance generator and the dance discriminator until the dance generator generates simulated robot dance actions, so that the dance discriminator cannot accurately distinguish; and obtaining a music sequence, and generating a dance action through the trained dance generator. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of being capable of generating the smooth dance movement well matched with the music, and having flexibility and generalization ability and the like.

title: Humanoid robot patrol task interest point searching method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot patrol task interest point searching method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an environment image by using a camera; detecting a color abnormal area in the environment image, marking the color abnormal area as a point of interest, and carrying out average operation on the pixel area of the environment image to obtain the pixel center coordinate of the point of interest on the environment image; performing mathematical operation by using an internal reference matrix of the camera, converting a pixel center coordinate of the point of interest in a two-dimensional image coordinate system into a coordinate in a camera coordinate system, and performing corresponding matrix transformation and translation transformation on the obtained camera coordinate according to internal and external parameters of the camera to obtain a coordinate of the point of interest; according to the method, after the patroller arrives at the target area, the whole interest target library is divided into a plurality of parts according to the time sequence, so that it is guaranteed that instantaneous errors possibly generated in the operation process of the patroller cannot affect the interest targets found before the errors are generated.
