title: Hierarchical learning framework for whole-body model predictive control of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hierarchical learning framework for whole-body model prediction control of a humanoid robot. The hierarchical learning framework comprises the steps of defining an initial state and a task target of the robot, initializing a control strategy of each layer to construct an initial kinematics model, collecting a motion data set, and identifying model parameters from data. Afterwards, through reinforcement learning based on the model, the dynamic model is continuously updated and optimized so as to reduce the difference between the model and an actual system; finally, a whole-body model prediction control method is used for calculating a control strategy in real time through a dynamic model optimized through reinforcement learning, a hierarchical learning framework is innovatively developed, and it is ensured that the system can achieve real-time control under the condition that the central control system is updated slowly through the multi-layer design; the efficient real-time response capability is still kept, the flexibility and the dynamic performance of the robot are remarkably improved, and the humanoid robot can generate multi-contact and dynamic behaviors even if the low-frequency strategy of whole body model prediction control is updated.

title: Sleeve part dismounting device and assembling method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a sleeve part dismounting device and an assembling method of a humanoid robot. The sleeve part dismounting device comprises a pull-out rod, a pull-out plate and an elastic piece, and the pull-out rod is used for being arranged on a sleeve part in a penetrating mode; a pull-out rod groove is formed in the first end of the pull-out rod; the pull-out plate is rotatably arranged in the pull-out rod groove, and the length of the pull-out plate is larger than the inner diameter of the outer ring; the two ends of the elastic piece abut against the pull-out plate and the pull-out rod groove respectively. The pull-out plate and the pull-out rod have a first state and a second state which are opposite to each other; in the first state, the pull-out plate rotates towards the pull-out rod groove so as to compress the elastic piece, and the pull-out rod can drive the pull-out plate to penetrate through the sleeve part. In the second state, the elastic restoring force of the elastic piece drives the pull-out plate to rotate away from the pull-out rod groove, and the pull-out rod can drive the pull-out plate to abut against the outer ring. By means of the device, the difficulty of dismounting the sleeve parts from the mounting holes can be reduced.

title: Robot walking method and device, storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a robot walking method and device, a storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the steps that the actual space state of the robot at the historical moment is acquired; prediction is carried out according to the actual space state at the historical moment through a preset prediction model, a reference motion track is obtained, and the preset prediction model is obtained by carrying out model training on the human motion track; the actual space state of the robot at the current moment is obtained; target control input is obtained according to the reference motion trail and the actual space state at the current moment, and walking is conducted according to the target control input. Compared with an existing method for generating the reference motion trail through fixed walking data, the method has the advantages that the reference motion trail with the higher integrating degree with the human body dynamic characteristics can be obtained through prediction of the preset prediction model obtained through human motion trail training, and therefore the anthropomorphic effect during walking is improved.

title: Self-adaptive rope-driven joint
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive rope-driven joint which comprises a support, a driving mechanism, a swing assembly, a tensioning mechanism and a movable platform. The driving mechanism is composed of a motor, a driving rope, a pulley and a support, fixedly installed at the bottom of the support and connected with the movable platform through the driving rope, and the length of the driving rope is adjusted through the motor to enable the movable platform to rotate. The swing assembly is rotationally installed on the support and rotationally connected with the movable platform. Each tensioning mechanism is composed of a spring, a fixed pulley, a pulley seat and a tensioning rope, the two tensioning mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the support, and the tail ends of the tensioning ropes are connected with the swing assembly so that the driving rope can be kept tensioned all the time; and the movable platform and the bracket are provided with bolt connection mounting holes, so that the joint is convenient to mount and maintain. The joint has the advantages of being free of gaps, small in rotation inertia, simple and compact in structure, large in load-weight ratio, good in safety performance and the like, a novel joint structure is provided for design of the humanoid mechanical arm, and the joint has wide application scenes.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg structure comprises a foot assembly, a shank assembly and a pair of driving assemblies. The shank assembly and the foot assembly are hinged to form a rotation center. In the pair of driving assemblies, one driving assembly is arranged on the outer side of the shank assembly, and the other driving assembly is arranged on the inner side of the shank assembly; the driving assembly can stretch out and draw back in the extending direction of the driving assembly and is provided with a fixed end and a telescopic end, the fixed end is hinged to the shank assembly, the telescopic end is hinged to the foot assembly, and the hinged position of the telescopic end and the foot assembly and the rotating center are arranged at intervals in the length direction of the foot assembly. The telescopic action of the driving assembly can drive the foot assembly to rotate around the rotating center. According to the leg structure provided by the invention, by improving the leg structure, the weight of the ankle joint can be reduced, the size of the ankle joint is reduced, and the bionic effect of the rotation action between the leg bone and the foot is better.

According to the leg structure provided by the invention, by improving the leg structure, the weight of the ankle joint can be reduced, the size of the ankle joint is reduced, and the bionic effect of the rotation action between the leg bone and the foot is better.

title: Crus structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot

title: Factory environment operation system based on humanoid robot, humanoid robot and method
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a factory environment operation system based on a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot and a method. The system comprises at least one human-shaped robot and a task scheduling device, the task scheduling device is used for performing task allocation according to the task information of the at least one to-be-executed task and the information of each humanoid robot to obtain the humanoid robot corresponding to each to-be-executed task, and sending a respective corresponding task instruction to each humanoid robot; and the humanoid robot is used for determining whether the current position is in a task execution area corresponding to the task instruction according to the task instruction, moving to the task execution area if the current position is not in the corresponding task execution area, and executing an operation corresponding to the task instruction. According to the scheme, the appropriate humanoid robot is arranged to complete the corresponding task through the task scheduling device, the factory operation efficiency is greatly improved, and the humanoid robot can adapt to more and more complex environments and tasks.

title: User presentation data-based task configuration method and related device
abstract: The invention discloses an own task configuration method based on user demonstration data and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: sending a busy/idle query request to a server in response to a first operation of a user; a busy/idle query reply message from the server is received, a task configuration interface is displayed, and the task configuration interface comprises a plurality of task selection controls and a plurality of human-shaped robot selection controls; sending a task configuration message to the server in response to a second operation of the user, wherein the task configuration message carries the target humanoid robot and the target task; a training result message from the server is received, a training result interface is displayed, the training result interface is used for displaying the training score of the target humanoid robot executing the target control scheme, the target control scheme is the content generated by the server according to the user demonstration data, and the user demonstration data is used for representing the action executed by the user for the target task. According to the invention, remote training of the robot can be realized, and the diversity and flexibility of task execution of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Waist assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist assembly and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The waist assembly comprises a base, a top plate, two driving pieces and a braking piece. After the lengths in the driving parts are adjusted respectively, the distances between the multiple connecting parts and the base are different, the top plate can be made to deflect relative to the base, and therefore the top plate can rotate around multiple axes in different directions relative to the base. In this way, the top plate can rotate around multiple axes in different directions relative to the base through the at least two driving pieces. The two ends of the braking part are also rotationally connected with the base and the top plate, so that the braking part can rotate relative to the base and the top plate, the driving part drives the top plate and the base to move relative to each other, the braking part can stretch out and draw back according to increase and decrease of the distance between the top plate and the base, and the braking part can keep a certain length within a preset stretching range; therefore, the top plate connected with the brake part and the base can be kept at a certain position, and the relative position and angle of the top plate and the base can be kept.

title: Hip-lumbar joint motor module architecture applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The hip-lumbar vertebra joint motor module framework comprises a hip joint motor module and a lumbar vertebra joint motor module, the hip joint motor module has three rotational degrees of freedom of lateral swing, leg lifting and turning of thighs, and the three rotational degrees of freedom are realized by lateral swing joint motors, leg lifting joint motors and turning joint motors of the thighs respectively; the lumbar vertebra joint motor module has three torsional degrees of freedom of lateral swing, buckling and torsion of the waist, and the three torsional degrees of freedom are achieved through a lateral swing joint motor, a buckling joint motor and a torsion joint motor of the waist respectively. According to the hip-lumbar vertebra bone freedom degree of the human body, hip joint and lumbar vertebra joint motor modules of the humanoid robot and a framework of the hip joint and lumbar vertebra joint motor modules are designed. The structural layout is compact, and the movement of human joints is simulated more truly.

title: Humanoid robot adaptive control method and system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot self-adaptive control method and system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control. The method comprises the steps that electroencephalogram signals and electromyographic signals of a target object are collected; determining a first time-frequency domain feature of the electroencephalogram signal according to the electroencephalogram signal, and determining a second time-frequency domain feature of a muscle activation state according to the electromyographic signal; fusing the first time-frequency domain feature and the second time-frequency domain feature by adopting a dynamic weighting algorithm to obtain a multi-modal feature; inputting the multi-modal features into an action intention recognition model to obtain a predicted action intention; and determining a robot control instruction according to the predicted action intention and the current state of the robot so as to control the humanoid robot. The precision of self-adaptive control of the humanoid robot can be improved.

abstract: Humanoid robot (1) for being used on an assembly line of a plant, comprising: -a plurality (10) of actuators (11) enabling the humanoid robot to move, -a control unit (20) for controlling the actuators (11), and -means (40) for visualizing the ambient environment of the robot wherein the robot lacks a battery for supplying the actuators (11) with electrical energy and comprises an interface for a wired connexion (60) to an external power supply for said supply.

title: Flexible joint actuator mechanism of lightweight humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a lightweight humanoid robot flexible joint actuator mechanism which comprises a mounting base, a connecting frame is fixedly connected to the mounting base, three first connecting rods are evenly assembled on the top face of the connecting frame, and second connecting rods and third connecting rods are movably connected to the side walls of the first connecting rods correspondingly. The other end of the second connecting rod and the other end of the third connecting rod are movably connected with the same movable rod, the movable rod is arranged in an L shape, the two ends of the movable rod are movably connected with a fourth connecting rod and a fifth connecting rod respectively, the other end of the fourth connecting rod and the other end of the fifth connecting rod are movably connected with a clamping jaw, and a driving assembly is arranged in the center of the top of the mounting base. Each joint of the hand can be controlled to move flexibly by using a single driver, and a driver does not need to be arranged at each joint.

title: Joint structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint structure of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. A groove is formed in one end of the thigh section, a first rotating shaft is rotationally arranged on the opposite side of the inner wall of the groove, a transmission circular gear is fixedly arranged on the first rotating shaft, and a driving part used for driving the first rotating shaft to rotate is arranged on the thigh section; a connecting seat is constructed at one end of the shank joint, a second rotating shaft is fixedly arranged on the connecting seat, a driven circular gear meshed with teeth of the transmission circular gear is fixedly arranged on the second rotating shaft, and a first mounting groove is formed in the thigh joint in a penetrating manner; through the arrangement of the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft, the thigh section and the shank section are each provided with a rotating shaft, the thigh section and the shank section are in transmission connection through meshing of teeth of a transmission circular gear and teeth of a driven circular gear, and it is ensured that the shank section can imitate a human body to rotate; the mounting and dismounting are convenient, so that the practicability is improved.

title: Lower limb structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot lower limb structure which comprises a bearing piece, a mechanical thigh is rotationally connected to an inner cavity in the bottom of the bearing piece, a knee bearing piece is rotationally connected to the bottom of the mechanical thigh, and a mechanical shank is rotationally connected to an inner cavity in the bottom of the knee bearing piece. The bottom of the mechanical shank is rotationally connected with an ankle bearing piece, a mechanical foot is arranged below the mechanical shank, the inner wall of the mechanical foot is fixedly connected with a bearing shaft, and the surface of the bearing shaft is rotationally connected with an inner cavity in the bottom of the ankle bearing piece. The stability of the mechanical thighs, the mechanical shanks and the mechanical feet can be improved, and the purpose that in the operation process of the robot, the knee parts of the robot are prevented from being reversely bent, and consequently the robot is unstable is achieved.

title: Upper limb structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an upper limb structure of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The robot comprises a trunk, a shoulder, a big arm, elbows, a small arm and hands, the shoulder, the big arm, the elbows, the small arm and the hands are sequentially connected, a connecting plate is arranged on the shoulder, a plurality of positioning holes are formed in the connecting plate, and connecting cylinders which are the same as the positioning holes in number and are in one-to-one corresponding insertion fit are arranged on the trunk; and a locking piece which acts on the connecting plate and locks or unlocks the connecting plate is arranged on the connecting cylinder. The mode that the shoulders and the trunk are connected through a plurality of bolts in the prior art is abandoned, during use, the connecting plate is made to be in the vertical direction and abut against and be in lap joint with the trunk, the multiple connecting cylinders penetrate through the multiple positioning holes correspondingly, the multiple locking pieces are driven by the driving piece to operate synchronously, the connecting plate is locked together through the multiple locking pieces, and the connecting plate is locked through the multiple locking pieces; and the connecting plate cannot move and cannot be far away from the trunk, so that the shoulders are connected with the trunk.

title: Push-pull rod joint mechanism used on arm wrist of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a push-pull rod joint mechanism used on a humanoid robot arm wrist, which comprises a joint motor module, a pull rod and a suspension support assembly, one end of the suspension support assembly is annular and is fixedly sleeved on the joint motor module, the other end of the suspension support assembly is a semi-circular plate, and the other end of the suspension support assembly is provided with a push-pull rod. The two ends of the semicircular plate are rotationally connected with the two sides of the other joint motor module, the suspension assembly enables the two joint motor modules to be perpendicular to each other, one end of the pull rod is connected with the output end of the joint motor module fixed in the fixing ring, and the other end of the pull rod is connected with the side wall of the other joint motor module. The two joint motor modules are perpendicular to each other through the suspension support assembly, the output end of one joint motor module drives the other joint motor module to swing front and back through the pull rod, flexibility is improved, the overall structure is compact, and installation is convenient.

title: Humanoid robot based on vision and teleoperation
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot based on vision and teleoperation, which relates to the field of transfer robots and comprises a humanoid robot body and a flexible handle. The humanoid robot body comprises a head part, a trunk part, operation arms and a first wireless receiving and transmitting module; the trunk part is provided with an image acquisition device; the operation arm comprises a plurality of support arms which are rotationally connected in sequence; an independent driving module is arranged in each supporting arm, and the number of the supporting arms is larger than or equal to four; the first wireless transceiver module is in communication connection with the operation arm and the image acquisition device; the dexterous handle comprises a shell, a handle and/or function keys, a display module and a second wireless receiving and transmitting module, the second wireless receiving and transmitting module is in communication connection with the handle and/or the function keys and the display module, and the second wireless receiving and transmitting module is in communication connection with the first wireless receiving and transmitting module. The mechanical arm is high in degree of freedom, large in operation space, good in flexibility and strong in immediacy sense of operators, and labor force is saved.

title: Head and neck structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a head and neck structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and the head and neck structure of the humanoid robot comprises a head support and a neck support which are connected with each other, and a laser radar module with a transmitting/receiving module. An intra-neck space is formed in the neck support, at least part of a transmitting/receiving module of the laser radar module is located in the intra-neck space, and at least part of the field angle of view of the transmitting/receiving module is not shielded by the head support. At least part of the transmitting/receiving module of the laser radar module is located in the neck space, the neck support is used for containing the transmitting/receiving module, and compared with the mode that the transmitting/receiving module is installed on the upper portion of the head support in the prior art, the anthropomorphism of the head and neck structure is guaranteed. Besides, when the humanoid robot is impacted by external force, the neck support can block most impact for the transmitting/receiving module, so that the transmitting/receiving module is difficult to be directly impacted by the external force, and the possibility of damage is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot, and particularly relates to the technical field of robots, the humanoid robot comprises a driving seat and a bottom frame, the top of the driving seat is fixedly connected with a robot main body, the back of the driving seat is provided with a battery mounting port, and the top of the bottom frame is fixedly connected with a charging bin; a first passing opening is formed in the front face of the charging bin, a sliding groove is formed in the top of the charging bin, a sliding plate is slidably connected into the sliding groove, a sliding frame is fixedly connected to the bottom of the sliding plate, two storage batteries are placed in the sliding frame, a connecting base is fixedly connected to the top of the sliding plate, and a first electric push rod is fixedly connected to the top of the charging bin. title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. title: Autonomous operation training system and method for humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous operation training system and method for a humanoid robot dexterous hand, and the system comprises an image collection unit, a pose estimation network unit, a humanoid dexterous hand structure, a micro-control unit, a host, a feature fusion and extraction network unit, an autonomous strategy network unit, and a PD controller. Wherein the host receives a voltage digital signal, and performs binarization processing on the voltage digital signal according to a preset threshold value to obtain pressure sensing information; the feature fusion and extraction network unit receives the attitude information, the pressure sensing information and the joint angle information, and performs feature fusion on the attitude information, the pressure sensing information and the joint angle information to obtain global sensing spatial-temporal features; and the autonomous strategy network unit receives the global perception spatio-temporal characteristics, and obtains an optimal action sequence according to the global perception spatio-temporal characteristics. According to the invention, the problem of dexterous hand robust intelligent control under the condition of lack of key modal information of joint angles and object poses is solved.

title: Robot and robot control method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot and a robot control method, and belongs to the technical field of robot equipment. An existing robot cannot perform complex dancing actions and is simple in function and poor in performance. The robot comprises a robot body and a rotary performance piece. The robot body is provided with arms used for assembling rotary performance pieces and a throwing motor used for throwing performance props. The rotating performance piece is assembled at the tail end of the arm, and the throwing motor can provide throwing power and provide kinetic energy for the performance prop to fly outwards, so that the robot at least can perform dancing actions such as rotation and throwing, the actions are rich, the operation demonstration effect is good, the performance performance is good, innovativeness is high, the posture is attractive, the anthropomorphic effect is good, the function is powerful, and the ornamental value is high. The robot can be popularized and applied conveniently, the blank of the robot performance technology is filled, and the robot can be used for large-scale humanoid robot dancing performance, especially for folk dance performance.

title: Target grabbing point data generation method, device and equipment and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a target grabbing point data generation method, device and equipment and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of target detection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a color image and a depth image of a target object shot by shooting equipment in real time; performing alignment correction processing according to the color image and the depth image to obtain a pseudo-color depth map; inputting the pseudo-color depth map into a pre-training deep learning segmentation model for detection segmentation processing to obtain a target segmentation mask map of the target object; performing centroid extraction processing according to the target segmentation mask pattern, and determining centroid coordinates of a target object; and performing depth correction processing according to the target object mass center coordinate, the pseudo-color depth map and a preset internal reference matrix to obtain a target three-dimensional coordinate, and determining the target three-dimensional coordinate as target grabbing point data. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the accuracy of the captured point data obtained in a complex dynamic scene.
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a target grabbing point data generation method, device and equipment and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of target detection. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the accuracy of the captured point data obtained in a complex dynamic scene.

title: Solid hydrogen energy system and hydrogen-powered humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a solid hydrogen energy system and a hydrogen power humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of heat exchange, the system comprises a solid hydrogen storage device and a hydrogen fuel cell, the solid hydrogen storage device and the hydrogen fuel cell are connected through a circulating device, and the circulating device comprises a circulating pipeline, a circulating pump, a radiator, a cooling plate and a heating device; the cooling plate and the heating device are respectively arranged outside the hydrogen fuel cell and the solid hydrogen storage device, the cooling plate absorbs heat generated by the hydrogen fuel cell, and the heat is transferred to the heating device through the heat-conducting medium flowing out of the circulating pipeline so as to heat the solid hydrogen storage device. The solid hydrogen storage device is heated by using heat generated during power generation of the hydrogen fuel cell, so that the heat dissipation problem of the hydrogen fuel cell is solved, assistance is provided for heating and hydrogen release of the solid hydrogen storage device, and stable hydrogen release of the solid hydrogen storage device is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot wearable intelligent navigation equipment
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot wearable intelligent navigation device which is composed of a navigation module and a wearable body, the navigation module is not limited in installation position, and a user can install the navigation module at the most appropriate position according to task requirements and motion characteristics of a robot; the structure of the wearable body is not specifically limited, and the wearable body can be designed in a customized mode according to the shapes and sizes of different humanoid robots. The wearable navigation equipment has the beneficial effects that the wearable navigation equipment is adopted, the problems that a humanoid robot navigation scheme is long in design period, large in original structure change and high in implementation cost are solved, the compact structure of the humanoid robot is met, the overall attractiveness of the humanoid robot is guaranteed, the wearable navigation equipment can be worn or taken off at any time according to the use scene requirement, and the practicability is high. Multiple humanoid robots share one set of navigation equipment in a time-sharing manner, and the method has the advantages of being short in production period, low in scheme cost and the like.

title: Intelligent accompanying human-type robot based on multi-modal emotion interaction and sensing method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot perception, in particular to an intelligent accompanying human-type robot based on multi-mode emotion interaction and a perception method, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting facial expression and body posture data of a user through a visual perception unit, collecting intonation, speed, volume and keyword data through a voice perception unit, and carrying out the recognition of the speech, speed, volume and keyword data; data preprocessing and feature extraction are carried out; secondly, carrying out time sequence modeling on the extracted visual and voice features based on a recurrent neural network, and generating visual and voice time sequence feature vectors; the method comprises the steps that firstly, time sequence features are extracted, then, a multi-mode fusion model based on an attention mechanism is adopted, the time sequence features are fused into a comprehensive emotion feature vector used for emotion state classification, and finally, personalized interaction content such as voice, expressions and limb actions matched with the emotion state of a user is generated according to an emotion classification result. According to the method, the accuracy of robot emotion perception and the naturalness of man-machine interaction are remarkably improved, and the method is suitable for multi-scene application of education, medical treatment, old-age care and the like.

title: Neodymium-iron-boron magnet and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a neodymium-iron-boron magnet and a preparation method and application thereof.The neodymium-iron-boron magnet is prepared from at least two main phases, heavy rare earth elements are not added into main phase alloy I, and heavy rare earth elements are added into main phase alloy II. According to the method, a traditional single-phase alloy smelting process is replaced with a multi-main-phase processing technology, so that formation of intergranular phases can be inhibited, and the neodymium-iron-boron magnet shows a low temperature coefficient and a high Curie temperature. Meanwhile, through the modes of powder refining, lubricant adding, hydrogen-containing sintering and the like, a new breakthrough on the temperature resistance of the neodymium iron boron permanent magnet material can be achieved, and research, development and preparation of the neodymium iron boron permanent magnet material with low Co, low heavy rare earth elements and high temperature resistance are achieved; the obtained neodymium-iron-boron permanent magnet material can be widely applied to preparation of humanoid robot motors, high-temperature motors, electric driving systems, medical equipment, electrical equipment, high-temperature sensors, monitoring equipment and the like.

title: Multi-humanoid robot distributed collaborative carrying method based on model predictive control
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of automation, and discloses an improved multi-humanoid robot distributed load sharing cooperative carrying control method based on model predictive control, and the method comprises the steps: inputting and torque inverse solution; carrying out MPC modeling and degree-of-freedom setting; optimizing a target and a constraint condition; stable contact between the robot and the object in the carrying process is ensured, and special carrying constraints are defined; a comprehensive cost function is formulated, and optimization of the carrying process is achieved. Through the improved MPC method and the torque distribution strategy, the efficient and accurate humanoid robot cooperative carrying control method is provided, coordination and cooperation among the robots can be achieved, accurate control over the torque and stability of the postures of the robots in the carrying process can be guaranteed, and therefore the overall performance of multi-robot cooperative carrying is improved.

title: Humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot dexterous hand which comprises a palm, a thumb and four grabbing fingers. A steering engine connected with the thumb, a first index finger active joint motor, a first middle finger active joint motor, a first ring finger active joint motor, a first little finger active joint motor and a first thumb active joint motor are installed in the palm, wherein the first index finger active joint motor, the first middle finger active joint motor, the first ring finger active joint motor, the first little finger active joint motor and the first thumb active joint motor correspond to the four grabbing fingers in a one-to-one mode. According to the humanoid robot dexterous hand, due to the fact that the pushing mechanisms between the fingers are mutually independent, the fingers do not interfere with one another in the working process, the situation that wires are wound together like a traditional wire pulling mode is avoided, and reliability is higher.

title: Multifunctional exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional exoskeleton robot. The robot comprises a basic support; the two groups of lower limb units are used for supporting legs; the lower limb units are connected with the basic support through hip driving units, and the hip driving units are used for driving the lower limb units to rotate around a vertical shaft so as to simulate internal and external rotation actions of hip joints. And when the lower limb unit rotates around the vertical shaft, the position of the rotating shaft is always unchanged, and the rotating shaft coincides with the internal and external rotation axis of the hip joint of the human body. The hip driving unit is used for connecting the lower limb unit and driving the lower limb unit to rotate so as to simulate the internal and external rotation action of the hip joint, the hip driving unit can enable the position of a rotating shaft of the lower limb unit to be unchanged all the time when the lower limb unit rotates around a vertical shaft, and the rotating shaft always coincides with the internal and external rotation axis of the hip joint of the human body. The exoskeleton robot can adjust the lower limb postures more naturally, and it is guaranteed that the motion of the human body during steering has better stability.

title: Biped robot body mass center planning method, control method, device and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot body mass center planning method, a biped robot body mass center control method, a biped robot body mass center planning device and a robot, and the biped robot body mass center planning method comprises the steps that the initial body mass center position and motion difference information of the robot are obtained, the initial body mass center position is the mass center position before the robot executes the target action, and the motion difference information is pre-planned motion information when the robot executes the target action; and according to the motion difference information and the initial fuselage mass center position, the target fuselage mass center position is determined, and the target fuselage mass center position is the mass center position after the robot executes the target action. The response speed of the planned mass center position of the robot can be increased, and the speed and action range of whole-body movement of the robot are increased.

title: High-load-ratio rope-driven humanoid agile mechanical arm based on heterogeneous differential joints
abstract: The invention relates to a high-load-ratio rope-driven humanoid agile mechanical arm based on heterogeneous differential joints. Comprising a base, a three-degree-of-freedom differential shoulder joint, a first arm rod, a two-degree-of-freedom differential elbow and a wrist joint which are connected in sequence, wherein the three-degree-of-freedom differential shoulder joint performs first shoulder rotary motion, second shoulder pitching motion and third shoulder rotary motion; the two-degree-of-freedom differential elbow and wrist joint performs elbow pitching motion and first wrist rotary motion; the two-degree-of-freedom differential wrist joint is used for carrying out pitching motion of the second wrist and rotary motion of the third wrist, and the driving source is used for providing power. The loading capacity can be improved, and the seven-degree-of-freedom, large-load-ratio and agile effects of the mechanical arm are achieved.

title: Humanoid robot transportation device
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot conveying device which comprises a base, a groove is formed in the top of the base, a conveying belt is arranged in the groove, a motor is arranged on the surface of one side of the base, a vertical plate is arranged on the surface of the rear side of the base, a handle is arranged on the surface of the rear side of the vertical plate, a plurality of feeding frame assemblies are arranged on the top of the base, and each feeding frame assembly comprises two fixing plates. Lifting plates are slidably inserted into the tops of the fixing plates, supporting grooves are formed in the tops of the lifting plates, blocking mechanisms are arranged at notches of the supporting grooves, first storage grooves are symmetrically formed in the bottoms of the side faces, close to each other, of the two fixing plates, and threaded rods are inserted into the inner bottom walls of the first storage grooves in a threaded mode; the ends, close to each other, of the two threaded rods are rotationally connected with clamping arc-shaped plates, and the ends, away from each other, of the two threaded rods penetrate through the fixing plate and are connected with rotating buttons. According to the device, multiple humanoid robots can be transported, feeding and discharging operation is simple and convenient, the working efficiency is high, the transportation stability is guaranteed by clamping and fixing multiple positions of the humanoid robots, and the practicability is high.

title: Bionic humanoid robot arm
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a bionic humanoid robot arm, which can adjust the length of the arm within a certain range, enhances the use flexibility of a robot, and is convenient for the robot to finish some long-distance work. Comprising a connecting mechanism; the robot further comprises a large arm mechanism, an adjusting mechanism and a small arm mechanism, the large arm mechanism is installed on the connecting mechanism and drives the adjusting mechanism and the small arm mechanism to rotate, the adjusting mechanism is installed on the large arm mechanism and adjusts the length of the small arm mechanism, and the small arm mechanism is installed on the adjusting mechanism and connected with a palm of the robot.

title: Upper arm structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot upper arm structure which comprises a big arm, the surface of the big arm is rotatably connected with a small arm, the surface of the small arm is fixedly provided with a gear, the surface of the big arm is fixedly provided with a cylindrical box, the inner wall of the cylindrical box is slidably connected with a striking rod, the surface of the striking rod is fixedly provided with a circular plate, and the circular plate is fixedly provided with a gear. A pressing switch is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the cylindrical box, a spring is arranged in an inner cavity of the cylindrical box, and a fixing plate is fixedly installed on the surface of the large arm. The striking rod is struck to move through rapid rotation of the gear, so that the striking rod impacts the pressing switch, then the pressing switch controls the motor to be started and drives the supporting plate to rotate, the sliding rod moves and extrudes the gear to stop rotating, and rapid rotation of a small arm in the upper arm structure can be sensed; and the forearm is controlled to stop rotating in time, so that the rotating stability of the forearm in the upper arm structure is improved.

title: Humanoid robot multichannel sudden stop control circuit and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot multi-channel emergency stop control circuit and a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot multi-channel emergency stop control circuit comprises a controller, an emergency stop control channel, a first relay and a state detection circuit, the emergency stop control channel comprises an emergency stop control panel, a remote wired operation panel and a wireless control circuit, the state detection circuit comprises an I/O port of the controller, and the I/O port is connected to the emergency stop control board and used for detecting the state of the emergency stop control channel. When any one of the remote wired operation panel, the wireless control circuit and the emergency stop control panel is in an open circuit state, the I/O port is a first detection signal; and when the remote wired operation panel, the wireless control circuit and the emergency stop control panel are all in the on state, the I/O port provides a second detection signal. Through multi-channel cooperative control, real-time state feedback and a multi-condition logic judgment mechanism, the problems that a traditional sudden stop system is high in single-point fault risk and insufficient in state monitoring are solved.

title: Humanoid chewing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid chewing robot, and belongs to the technical field of biomimetic robots, the humanoid chewing robot comprises six branch chains, the six branch chains are mounted on a base, the six branch chains are divided into three groups, and the three groups of branch chains are respectively arranged corresponding to a masseter group, a temporalis group and a wing muscle group of a lower jaw; the driving ends of the branch chains are in driving connection with a masseter muscle group, a temporomuscle group and a wing muscle group which are correspondingly arranged, and are used for simulating six main open-close muscle groups in chewing; the two restraining assemblies are arranged at the condylar processes on the two sides of the mandible and used for simulating the condylar processes of the mandible to be restrained by the temporomandibular joint. According to the invention, the chewing condition can be truly simulated, and the obtained parameters are more accurate.

title: Humanoid robot control method

title: Mechanical humanoid wrist
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical humanoid wrist, and relates to the technical field of humanoid wrist robots, the mechanical humanoid wrist comprises a static platform, a movable platform, a driving connecting rod assembly, a universal hinge assembly, a connecting rod assembly, a reversing pulley assembly, a reel assembly, a driving rope assembly and a restraint rope assembly; the driving connecting rod assembly comprises a first driving connecting rod and a second driving connecting rod which are connected between the static platform and the movable platform in a series-parallel mode. The universal hinge assembly comprises a first universal hinge connecting fork, a second universal hinge connecting fork and a first universal hinge. The connecting rod assembly comprises seven connecting rod pieces; the reversing pulley assembly comprises nine reversing pulley blocks; the driving rope assembly comprises three pairs of driving ropes which drive the same joint in pairs in a closed-loop mode. The restraint rope assembly comprises a first restraint rope and a second restraint rope which form a closed loop to restrain the same joint. The mechanical humanoid wrist is simple and compact in structure, three-degree-of-freedom rolling is achieved through the three sets of driving ropes, the wrist rolling motion space is large, and the model is simple.

title: Dexterous hand thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a dexterous hand thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. title: Humanoid quadruped robot
abstract: The humanoid quadruped robot is composed of a robot head 1, a robot neck 2, a robot body 16, three robot arms, four robot legs, a waist joint piece 7, a thoracolumbar hip joint piece 22, a plurality of joint motors and auxiliary parts, and compared with an existing robot, the humanoid quadruped robot has the four differences that the robot head 1 is fixed to the robot neck 2, and a shell of the robot head 1 is made of a one-way light-transmitting material; one-way light transmission means that a visual device in the robot head 1 can see external scenes, external human eyes and the visual device cannot see internal parts, two positions are three robot arms, one robot arm is arranged at the chest position of the robot body 16, retracts when not used and stretches out when used, and three positions are that the robot body 16 rotates by 360 degrees at random at the waist joint position. title: Aluminum alloy humanoid robot joint part machining positioning and clamping composite tool
abstract: The invention provides an aluminum alloy humanoid robot joint part machining positioning and clamping composite tool, and relates to the technical field of joint part machining positioning, the aluminum alloy humanoid robot joint part machining positioning and clamping composite tool comprises a fixing frame and a center clamping plate, servo motors are installed in the middles of the tops of the two ends of the fixing frame, and a fixing supporting plate is installed at the included angle position of the edge of the top of the fixing frame; a positioning ring is mounted at the top of the fixed support plate; rotary transmission rods are rotationally mounted in the central clamping plate and the lateral clamping plates; a guide wheel is installed on the rotary transmission rod, and the outer side face of the guide wheel is located on the inner side of the center clamping plate and the inner side of the lateral clamping plate. title: Humanoid robot dexterous hand control method and system based on RGB image and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of dexterous hand control, and discloses a humanoid robot dexterous hand control method and system based on an RGB image and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining continuous action RGB image frames of a human hand; performing cutting and posture detection processing on the continuous action RGB image frame of the human hand to obtain a plurality of hand key points; in a pre-constructed 3D hand model, calculating a preset number of joint point angles of the 3D hand model based on the plurality of hand key points; and the joint point angle is input into a pre-constructed joint angle mapping model of the dexterous hand, the joint angle of the dexterous hand is calculated, and the joint angle of the dexterous hand is sent to a controller of the humanoid robot, so that the controller of the humanoid robot drives the humanoid robot to execute corresponding actions. title: Automatic steering driving humanoid trajectory planning method and system
abstract: The invention provides an automatic steering driving humanoid trajectory planning method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring relative distance information between a vehicle and obstacles on two sides of a road and vehicle kinematics information by acquiring and processing human control data in a curve scene; non-linear features are extracted from the vehicle kinematics information based on a kernel principal component analysis (KPCA) method; the multi-state cycle prediction model is constructed based on an LSTM network, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out weighted attention on key data of long and short term information by cell state information; the model inputs the nonlinear features, the relative distance information between the vehicle and obstacles on the two sides of the road and the kinematics information of the vehicle into a multi-state cycle prediction model, and predicts future driving track points. Therefore, the mapping precision of the network is improved, human manipulation behaviors are well learned, and the stability of the planned trajectory is improved.

title: Variable-rigidity flexible driving joint capable of being used for humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a variable-rigidity flexible driving joint capable of being used for a humanoid mechanical arm. The variable-rigidity flexible driving joint comprises an elastic input module and a variable-rigidity module. The elastic input module comprises a fixing assembly, a guide rail assembly and an elastic assembly; the elastic assembly comprises an optical shaft sleeved with a linear bearing and a spring assembly. The guide rail assembly comprises a guide rail, a first sliding block assembly and a guide rail rotating shaft. One end of the guide rail is connected with the linear bearing through the first sliding block assembly, and the other end is connected through the guide rail rotating shaft; the variable stiffness module comprises a support, a lead screw assembly, a second sliding block assembly and a variable stiffness driver. The guide rail rotating shaft is driven by the fixing assembly, so that the guide rail rotates around the lead screw nut and drives the first sliding block assembly to move, and then the linear bearing elastically moves along the optical axis under the action of the spring. According to the driving joint, flexible variable rigidity adjustment is achieved, a new thought is provided for humanoid joint design, and the driving joint can be used as one of components of a mechanical arm and has a large application prospect.

title: Dynamic robust motion control method and system for wheeled biped robot

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of nursing robots, and particularly relates to a leg flexible supporting device of a humanoid backpack nursing robot. The device comprises a leg wrapping module and a pose adjusting module. The two pose adjusting modules are symmetrically mounted on the left side and the right side of the robot chest rest, and each pose adjusting module is connected with one leg wrapping module; the leg wrapping module comprises a leg support bracket, a tail end wrapping plate, an adjusting air bag, a locking buckle, a connecting bracket, a reset spring and a multi-connecting-rod mechanism; the multiple reset springs are arranged on the connecting support, the rear end of the leg support support is fixedly connected with the free ends of the reset springs, the multi-connecting-rod mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the rear end of the leg support support respectively, the two tail end wrapping plates are connected with the multi-connecting-rod mechanisms on the two sides respectively, and the adjusting air bags are arranged in the middles of the inner sides of the two tail end wrapping plates respectively. The two ends of the locking buckle are connected with the ends of the two tail end wrapping plates respectively. The folding degree of the tail end wrapping plate can be adjusted in a self-adaptive mode according to the body shape and the leg shape of the human body, the fitting degree with the legs is improved, and the use comfort is improved.

title: Heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot head assembly and humanoid robot composed of heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot head assembly
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a large-load anti-explosion humanoid robot head assembly and a humanoid robot comprising the same, the large-load anti-explosion humanoid robot head assembly comprises a head main body assembly, the appearance of the head main body assembly imitates the head of a human body, and an accommodating space is formed in the head main body assembly; the neck moving assembly is provided with three joints and can realize three-degree-of-freedom rotation; the voice control module is used for realizing voice interaction with the outside; the head body assembly is fixed to the top of the neck moving assembly and can rotate in three directions along with the neck moving assembly. The voice control module is installed in the containing space of the head body assembly and moves along with the head body assembly. The multi-degree-of-freedom movement, the man-machine interaction function and the heat dissipation effect of the head assembly can be improved.

title: Wrist force sensor calibration method, device and equipment of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and the technical field of information, and discloses a wrist force sensor calibration method, device, equipment and medium of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the following steps: reading an external force measured by a wrist force sensor in a sensor fixed coordinate system, and reading an external torque measured by the wrist force sensor in the sensor fixed coordinate system; generating a calibrated external force according to the calibration result, the external force measured by the wrist force sensor in the sensor fixed coordinate system and the first calibration model, and selecting the calibrated external force as a real external force; generating a calibrated external torque according to the calibration result, the external torque measured by the wrist force sensor in the sensor fixed coordinate system and a second calibration model, and selecting the calibrated external torque as a real external torque; and when the tail end executor of the mechanical arm makes contact with the object, the target action is executed on the object according to the real external force and the real external torque. The acquisition efficiency of the real external force and the real external torque can be improved.

title: Walking method of biped robot under complex terrain
abstract: The invention discloses a walking method of a biped robot in a complex terrain, which belongs to the technical field of robot walking and comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing a preliminary kinetic model of walking of the biped robot, and optimizing to obtain an improved kinetic model; 2, generating a reference state track of the biped robot according to the input information; step 3, optimizing the reference trajectory; 4, further optimizing and distributing the contact force, calculating the joint torque of the walking of the biped robot, and sending the joint torque to each joint motor; 5, the position, speed and posture of the biped robot are estimated in real time according to the data and fed back to a track planning and whole body control module, and planning and control of the next period are carried out; and 6, the steps 2-5 are continuously repeated, so that the biped robot can walk under the complex terrain. The adaptability and the energy efficiency of the robot under the complex terrain can be improved.

title: Maintainability Autonomous driving Preventive maintenance Humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot for condition-based maintenance autonomous movement-driving for checking condition-based maintenance items, which is a function of checking the driving state of a vehicle while autonomously moving and driving between compartments inside the running vehicle and transmitting and storing the contents in real time, by detecting heat (temperature), sound (mechanical sound, electronic sound, frictional sound, impact sound, and other sounds), vibration, timbre and smell of a moving object, which are items requiring precise maintenance among information appearing while the running vehicle is running, and checking, acquiring, transmitting, and recording and storing the driving state information for each location of the vehicle.

title: 4D printing rigidity variable bionic joint based on humanoid robot application
abstract: The invention designs a 4D printing rigidity-variable bionic joint based on humanoid robot application. The 4D printing rigidity-variable bionic joint comprises a joint ball socket base, a joint upper cover, a high-elasticity hemispherical composite structure, a joint ball head structure, an electromagnetic coil and a pressure sensor. The joint ball socket base is provided with an upper flange and a lower flange, and the high-elasticity hemispherical composite structure is made of high-elasticity silica gel and a magnetic thixotropic material through a composite 4D printing technology. The 4D printing rigidity-variable bionic joint applied to the humanoid robot can be driven by artificial muscles, has the characteristic of quickly responding to joint stress, timely adjusts the rigidity of a stress part, can realize regional automatic change of the rigidity and damping of a high-elasticity composite structure, and has the advantages of simple structure, low cost and the like. The working performance and flexible connection of the robot joint are met, the damping performance of the joint is improved, and abrasion of all components in the relative movement process is avoided.

title: Quick-release connecting mechanism applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a quick-release connecting mechanism applied to a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the quick-release connecting mechanism comprises a spherical bearing, and the spherical bearing is mounted on a robot arm through a bearing seat and a bearing seat cover plate; an inner hole of the spherical bearing is tightly connected with the quick release structure base; a threaded cover plate is mounted at the bottom of an inner hole of the spherical bearing through threads; the quick-release structure further comprises a quick-release structure base. The universal quick-release bionic wrist can serve as a universal quick-release bionic wrist of a humanoid robot, the universal swing function of the wrist is achieved through the spherical bearing, and quick connection and disassembly of a dexterous hand and the wrist are achieved through a conical surface positioning and inclined surface locking structure; meanwhile, the problems of line connection and signal transmission of the dexterous hand or other executing mechanisms are solved; the connecting structure is suitable for the humanoid robot, can also be matched with an industrial robot execution tail end, can be used as other industrial connecting structures, and meets the requirements of different fields for the flexibility, convenience and stability of connecting parts.

title: Task configuration method of humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a task configuration method of a humanoid robot and a related device, which are applied to humanoid robot control system terminal equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: responding to an input operation based on a robot function configuration interface, and obtaining task configuration information; outputting first prompt information, and prompting a user to wear VR wearable equipment to perform task operation demonstration; first information is sent to the VR wearable device, and the VR wearable device is indicated to display a VR environment corresponding to the task type; in response to a selection operation for a target control of the robot function configuration interface, sending second information to the VR wearable device; receiving first posture data and a first video stream of the VR wearable device; and third information carrying the task type, the first video stream and the first attitude data is sent to the server, and the server is indicated to send an association relationship between the task type and the subtask sequence and at least one atomic skill model parameter to the robot. The task execution diversity and flexibility of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom decoupling wrist
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom decoupling wrist, and relates to the technical field of humanoid wrist robots, the three-degree-of-freedom decoupling wrist comprises a static platform base, a pointing motion branch, a middle rotation branch, a movable platform, a guide wheel assembly and a driving rope assembly, the pointing motion branch comprises a pitching supporting seat, a deflection supporting seat, a pitching driving wheel, a deflection driving wheel and a connecting rod assembly; the middle rotary branch is mounted between the static platform base and the movable platform; the guide wheel assembly is installed on the static platform base. The driving rope assembly comprises a first driving rope, a second driving rope and a third driving rope, and the driving rope assembly is suitable for being connected between the guide wheel assembly and the pointing movement branch in a winding mode; the decoupling wrist is suitable for rotating and rotating for a whole circle in the three-degree-of-freedom movement direction by driving the rope assembly. The three-degree-of-freedom decoupling wrist is simple and compact in structure and free of singular shapes and positions in a working space, the axes of all the joints intersect at one point, and rotary motion of the wrist is easier to achieve.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom rotation parallel mechanism, humanoid ankle joint, robot and skeleton thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom rotation parallel mechanism, a humanoid ankle joint, a robot and a framework of the robot. The two-degree-of-freedom rotation parallel mechanism comprises a fixed platform, a movable platform, a passive constraint branch chain containing a passive hooke joint and two same RCU motion branch chains composed of a first rotation pair, a cylindrical pair and a hooke joint, the R pair of the two branch chains is active input, the two branch chains meet the constraint condition that rotation axes coincide in the space structure, and thanks to the structure, the two branch chains can be driven to rotate in the same direction. According to the parallel mechanism, large-range posture adjustment of the tail end can be achieved through small axial displacement of a cylindrical pair, power transmission is achieved through four-rod mechanism cascading, and the humanoid ankle joint which is novel in structure and compact in structure can be further comprehensively obtained. The parallel mechanism provided by the invention has two rotational degrees of freedom, can realize pitching and pitching actions around a fixed rotation center, and can be used for scenes such as robots and posture adjustment platforms.

title: Data processing method and device for sales service based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a data processing method and device for sales service based on a humanoid robot, applied to the humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: detecting an article demand of a target customer, obtaining an article information list, the article information list comprising a first category to which a reference article existing in a current service scene belongs, the reference article does not exist in the current service scene, but can be made through the Internet of Things server, and the second category belongs to the reference article; determining a target category to which a target article indicated by the article demand belongs; determining a target task flow; and interactively executing the target task flow with the Internet of Things server, so that the target customer obtains the target article. Thus, the humanoid robot generates the corresponding target task flow based on the current service scene and the article demand of the target customer, and provides the target article required by the target customer by executing the target task flow, thereby improving the intelligence and flexibility of the humanoid robot to provide the sales service. And compatibility of executing data processing in combination with the current service scene.

title: Interaction method and device for upper limb cooperative control of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an interaction method for upper limb cooperative control of a humanoid robot. The interaction method comprises the following steps: performing task analysis on a received voice request; if the target object needing to be executed exists, target object recognition processing is carried out according to the task analysis result; based on target identification information and target pose information output by identification processing and a task analysis result, performing task planning processing by utilizing a large language model according to a double-arm division cooperation principle, and generating a task sequence and a character instruction corresponding to each task; sequentially executing the following operations on each target task in the task sequence: based on the target pose information and the target identification information, controlling upper limbs of the humanoid robot to execute an operation action corresponding to the target task on the target object; therefore, on the basis of the large language model, the visual module and the voice module are matched, so that a user can communicate with the robot more visually; and the operation capability of the upper limbs of the humanoid robot for executing complex tasks can be improved.

title: Tool-based task implementation method of humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention provides a tool-based task implementation method of a humanoid robot and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an operation instruction; according to the operation instruction, obtaining at least one first workflow corresponding to the operation task and an execution sequence of each first workflow in the at least one first workflow; according to the execution sequence, operation content corresponding to the first workflow is completed in sequence, and when the operation content corresponding to the current first workflow comprises a target tool, under the condition that the target tool is in an unusable state, starting operation on the target tool is executed based on a starting mode of the target tool, and enabling the target tool to be in a usable state, and based on the current first workflow, operating the target object by using the target tool to complete the operation content. The intelligence of the humanoid robot can be improved when the humanoid robot executes tasks needing tools, and the task execution efficiency is improved.

title: Operation method and system of humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning
abstract: The invention discloses an operation method of a humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning, which relates to the related technical field of agricultural robots and comprises the steps of multi-sensor data acquisition, data processing and map generation, map updating, target crop image recognition and positioning, global path planning, local path obstacle avoidance and picking action execution. The invention further discloses an operation system of the humanoid agricultural robot based on path planning. The operation system comprises a humanoid robot body, a visual sensor, a laser radar, a depth camera, an inertial measurement unit, an auxiliary sensor, an actuator module, a control system, a communication module and a power supply system. The inventor-shaped robot can recognize the positions and shapes of the tools in advance by using a sensitive visual perception system of the inventor-shaped robot, can skillfully cross over or bypass the tools by virtue of the flexibility of the inventor-shaped robot, can accurately determine the positions and distribution conditions of crops in a three-dimensional space, and generates a comprehensive picking environment map.

title: Hip joint assembly, lower limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hip joint assembly, a lower limb assembly and a humanoid robot. The hip joint assembly comprises a hip joint, a thigh part and a damper, and the hip joint comprises a joint base; the thigh part is movably connected with the joint base; the damper is arranged between the joint base and the thigh part, the damper comprises a damping main body and a piston rod capable of stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping main body, the damping main body is hinged to the thigh part, and the piston rod is hinged to the joint base and used for stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping main body when the joint base is stressed so as to share the load borne by the joint base. When the humanoid robot encounters passive impact or is in a heavy load working condition, the piston rod of the damper stretches out and draws back relative to the damping main body, the damping characteristic can be automatically adjusted according to changes of loads borne by hip joints so as to absorb and disperse part of impact force, and therefore the loads borne by the hip joints are shared; the locked-rotor condition of the actuator of the hip joint assembly is reduced, and energy loss caused by locked-rotor of the actuator is reduced.

title: Method and equipment for grinding and polishing shaft type rotating body parts
abstract: The invention discloses a method and equipment for grinding and polishing a shaft type rotating body part, belongs to a precision machine manufacturing technology, and solves the problems that the outer surface of the conventional shaft type rotating body part with a complex shape cannot be precisely ground and polished, so that a planetary roller screw in a humanoid robot is large in torque and power consumption, low in precision and short in service life, and the like. The horn mouth is defined by the drainage component, the opening of the horn mouth faces the radial outer side, the inlet facing the part is formed by the inner end of the horn mouth, the grinding agent flows in the direction set by the inlet instead of flowing disorderly in the non-direction, and therefore the relative movement of the grinding agent and the surface of the part can be kept as needed; the relative movement speed and flow between the part and the abrasive are increased, and the pressure impacted on the outer surface of the part is increased. The grinding agent is guided to flow through the inlet, effective impact of the grinding agent on the surface of the part is increased, grinding efficiency is improved, then the part rotates around the axis of the part, and uniform grinding precision of the surface of the part is guaranteed.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The leg structure comprises thighs, shanks, knee joints and dampers, the knee joints are connected with the thighs and the shanks, each damper comprises a damping main body and a piston rod capable of stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping main body, the damping main bodies are hinged to the shanks, and the piston rods are connected with the thighs and the shanks. The piston rod is connected with the thigh part and used for stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping body when the knee joint is stressed so as to share the load borne by the knee joint. When the humanoid robot encounters passive impact or is in a heavy-load working condition, the piston rod of the damper stretches out and draws back relative to the damping main body, the damping characteristic can be automatically adjusted according to the change of the load borne by the hip joint so as to absorb and disperse part of impact force, so that the load borne by the hip joint is shared, the locked-rotor condition of a joint actuator is reduced, and the reliability of the humanoid robot is improved. And therefore, huge energy consumption caused by stalling is reduced, and the energy cost and the maintenance cost of the humanoid robot are reduced.
abstract_en: The leg structure comprises thighs, shanks, knee joints and dampers, the knee joints are connected with the thighs and the shanks, each damper comprises a damping main body and a piston rod capable of stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping main body, the damping main bodies are hinged to the shanks, and the piston rods are connected with the thighs and the shanks. The piston rod is connected with the thigh part and used for stretching out and drawing back relative to the damping body when the knee joint is stressed so as to share the load borne by the knee joint. When the humanoid robot encounters passive impact or is in a heavy-load working condition, the piston rod of the damper stretches out and draws back relative to the damping main body, the damping characteristic can be automatically adjusted according to the change of the load borne by the hip joint so as to absorb and disperse part of impact force, so that the load borne by the hip joint is shared, the locked-rotor condition of a joint actuator is reduced, and the reliability of the humanoid robot is improved. And therefore, huge energy consumption caused by stalling is reduced, and the energy cost and the maintenance cost of the humanoid robot are reduced.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom hip system of novel humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a three-degree-of-freedom hip system of a novel humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of intelligent robots. The system comprises a thigh skeleton, a main base, a transverse rolling joint module, a yawing joint module, a pitching base assembly, a planetary roller screw assembly, a main connecting rod and an auxiliary connecting rod. Pitching motion is achieved through the planetary roller lead screw assembly, transverse rolling motion is achieved through the transverse rolling joint module, and yawing motion is achieved through the yawing joint module. By optimizing the structural design, the problems that in the prior art, the load capacity is low, the weight is large, the size is large, assembling is inconvenient, and walking is unstable are solved, and the robot is suitable for various application scenes such as industrial carrying and rehabilitation training.

title: Robot lower limb and humanoid robot

title: Heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot which comprises modular components and a multi-mode sensing network. title: Mechanical leg and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical leg and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical leg comprises a shank assembly and a foot assembly. title: Wearable human exoskeleton for measuring motion state of waist of human body
abstract: The invention provides a wearable human exoskeleton for measuring the motion state of the waist of a human body. The wearable human exoskeleton comprises an exoskeleton body, a push rod, a sensor, a fixing plate, a sliding block, a sliding rail and a seat. The exoskeleton is of a back belt-shaped structure and is worn by a human body; the three push rods are of telescopic structures and are arranged into a triangle; one end of each push rod is provided with a sensor which measures the telescopic distance of the push rod caused by the motion of the waist of the human body; the ends, provided with the sensors, of the three push rods share one fixing plate, and the sensors are hinged to the fixing plate. The other ends of the connecting rods are respectively hinged to the exoskeleton; the sliding rail is fixed to the seat in the vertical direction. The sliding block is fixed to the bottom of the fixing plate and moves up and down along the sliding rail. According to the invention, human exoskeleton waist joint action data can be collected and mapped to the humanoid robot, so that the difficulty of motion control is reduced; and the accuracy and the flexibility of controlling the waist joint of the humanoid robot can be improved.
