abstract: As a humanoid robot pilot system, it includes an autonomous flight unit that perceives flight situations based on aircraft states or voice commands received from the outside, extracts flight missions corresponding to the flight situations from a flight knowledge base that stores flight missions for each flight situation by learning actual aviation manuals based on natural language processing, and generates operation paths corresponding to the flight missions, and a control unit that operates flight controls of the aircraft based on the operation paths.

title: Robot, control method and device thereof and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot, a control method and device thereof and a storage medium, and the control method comprises the steps: obtaining the motion information of a motor at a parallel joint when the robot moves, inputting the motion information into a pre-trained parallel motion model to obtain sole posture information, performing closed-loop control according to the sole attitude information and the expected attitude information of the robot to obtain a first control torque, performing closed-loop control based on the first control torque and the expected motion information of the parallel joints to obtain a second control torque, and controlling motors at the parallel joints to work according to the second control torque. In the embodiment of the invention, the plantar posture of the robot is estimated through the parallel motion model, and compared with a traditional numerical iterative algorithm, the algorithm process and the data volume are greatly simplified, and the control efficiency of the parallel robot is improved. And moreover, the motion stability and the motion precision of the robot are improved by adopting torque level control on the robot.

title: Foot type walking anti-disturbance navigation method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot foot type walking anti-disturbance navigation method, which is used for solving the problem of disturbance rejection in the aspect of tolerating model uncertainty by adopting the method provided by the invention. The problem of state estimation precision degradation caused by model uncertainty caused by Jacobian matrix perturbation in the first-order linear approximation process is effectively suppressed, and the first-order state estimation precision of the humanoid robot nonlinear system is remarkably improved. According to the method, real state distribution is taken as a center, a Warisstein distance fuzzy set is constructed as an allowable neighborhood, and an EKF algorithm is modeled into a game state estimation problem based on Warisstein distance fuzzy set constraint, so that the navigation and positioning precision of the humanoid robot is remarkably improved, and the method has great significance in wider application of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot transition method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot transition method and device. The method comprises the steps that a server receives a target production task sent by terminal equipment; determining a target transition sequence according to the target production task; determining a plurality of target visual elements according to the target transition sequence, wherein the plurality of target visual elements are used for indicating the humanoid robot to position; determining a target transition configuration file according to the target transition sequence and the plurality of target visual elements; and sending the target transition configuration file to the humanoid robot so as to enable the humanoid robot to transition among the plurality of target production processes. The target transition sequence moving among the multiple target production processes is determined, so that the target transition configuration file is determined according to the target transition sequence and the multiple target visual elements; the humanoid robot configured with the target transition position file can perform transition between processes based on the process execution sequence and the visual elements of the production line, the flexibility and adaptability of robot transition are improved, and the intelligent degree is high.

title: Small RV speed reducer for humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention discloses a small RV speed reducer for humanoid robot joints. The small RV speed reducer comprises an input assembly, a speed reduction assembly and an output flange. The input assembly drives the transmission sun gear through the input shaft and is meshed with the crank planetary gear set to form first-stage speed reduction. The crank planetary gear set drives the small-tooth-difference gear pair assembly (including the upper/lower winding wheel and the pin wheel housing) to perform planetary motion with a certain angle phase difference, and second-stage speed reduction is achieved. And the output flange is in threaded connection with the input end cover to finish power output. Through compact integration of the planetary gear and the cycloidal gear mechanism, the outer diameter of the speed reducer is controlled within 80 mm, the thickness of the speed reducer is smaller than 30 mm, the high reduction ratio is guaranteed, meanwhile, the size and weight are remarkably reduced, the transmission efficiency is greatly improved, and the speed reducer is suitable for humanoid robot joint scenes with limited space.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on motion data analysis
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on motion data analysis, and belongs to the technical field of robot motion control. According to the method, multi-mode motion data in the motion process of the humanoid robot are collected, key motion features are extracted, motion state recognition is carried out on robot motion, key parameter change rules of all the motion states are analyzed, joint motion models in different motion states are constructed, switching between the different states is controlled, and the motion state of the humanoid robot is recognized. In combination with a current motion state and a target state, a robot motion trajectory is generated and optimized, energy consumption conditions of different trajectory schemes are calculated based on an energy consumption estimated value, and the trajectory is optimized by adopting an energy optimal control method, so that the robot can give consideration to both motion stability and energy efficiency when executing a task. Feedback data in the motion execution process of the robot are collected in real time, the motion error deviation is calculated, control signals are dynamically adjusted, and it is ensured that the robot can still keep the accurate motion track in the complex environment.

title: Humanoid robot global automatic valve screwing system and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot valve control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot global automatic valve screwing system and a control method.The humanoid robot global automatic valve screwing system comprises a movable chassis, a lifting module, a waist pitching module, a robot body, a tail end tool, a sensor assembly and a control system; the tail end tools are arranged at the tail ends of the two arms of the human shape. The sensor assembly is used for environment sensing, collection of valve height and posture information and collection of operation torque information. The control system is used for roughly positioning a target valve, automatically planning and controlling the moving chassis to approach the valve according to a rough positioning result, and adjusting the height based on the collected height information of the valve; and on the basis of the recognized valve posture, the two human-shaped arms and the tail end tool are controlled to complete screwing operation. Different types of valves can be automatically recognized and operated through the intelligent control system, and the time and cost of manual operation are reduced.

title: Welding device of frameless motor for humanoid robot joint
abstract: The utility model discloses a welding device of a frameless motor for a humanoid robot joint, which comprises an annular PCB (printed circuit board), a clamping groove is arranged on the side of the PCB, the welding device further comprises a support, the support comprises top rings, a bottom ring, a connecting arm and a reinforcing arm, the top ring positioned above is connected with the top ring positioned below through the connecting arm, and the reinforcing arm is connected with the bottom ring through the connecting arm. title: Deformable wheel-foot robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a deformation wheel foot robot which comprises a robot trunk frame structure and a front chest plate control motor installed at the bottom of the front face of the robot trunk frame structure, and a front chest plate is installed on an output shaft of the front chest plate control motor. title: Waist omni-directional driving assembly for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a waist omni-directional driving assembly for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, the waist omni-directional driving assembly for the humanoid robot comprises a base, a driven shaft, a cross shaft universal joint, two waist omni-directional joint modules and two crank rocker mechanisms; the two waist omni-directional joint modules are rotatably connected with the two ends of the second rotating shaft respectively, the two waist omni-directional joint modules are coaxially arranged and approximately symmetrically distributed on the two sides of the second rotating shaft, motors of the two waist omni-directional joint modules are arranged adjacently, the output ends of speed reducers are arranged oppositely, and the second rotating shaft is parallel to the driven shaft; crank parts of the two crank and rocker mechanisms are fixedly connected with output flanges of the two speed reducers respectively, and rocker parts of the two crank and rocker mechanisms are hinged to the two ends of the driven shaft respectively. title: Hip structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hip structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and the hip structure comprises a waist-hip connecting piece, two joint connecting pieces, two middle connecting pieces and a bottom connecting piece. The waist and hip connecting piece is provided with a waist connecting base and two connecting arms which are arranged on the two opposite sides of the connecting base and extend downwards, and the tail ends of the two connecting arms are provided with connecting ends extending downwards respectively. The two connecting ends are fixedly connected with the upper ends of the two joint connecting pieces correspondingly, the two joint connecting pieces are symmetrically arranged along the sagittal plane of the humanoid robot, and the ends, corresponding to the joint output flanges, of the outer sides of the two joint connecting pieces are obliquely and downwards arranged. The middle connecting piece and the bottom connecting piece further reinforce connection among all the components, it is ensured that under the condition of complex stress, the whole hip structure can work cooperatively, acting force and counter-acting force from top to bottom are effectively dispersed and borne, complex design of the hip is avoided, and the stability of the hip is improved.

title: Waist yaw driving structure of humanoid robot, waist crossing structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a waist yaw driving structure of a humanoid robot, a waist crossing structure of the humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. title: Assembly structure of hip pitching joint and hip structural part of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an assembling structure of a hip pitching joint and a hip structural part of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The assembly structure of the hip pitching joint and the hip structural part of the humanoid robot mainly comprises the hip structural part and two hip pitching joint modules. The hip structural part is provided with an approximately annular joint fixing position, the hip pitching joint module is embedded in the joint fixing position, two first clamping lugs of the hip pitching joint module are clamped with two first clamping openings in the two sides of the upper edge of the joint fixing position respectively, and two second clamping lugs of the hip pitching joint module are clamped with two second clamping openings in the two sides of the lower edge of the joint fixing position respectively. The position of the first bayonet does not exceed the upper edge of the joint fixing position, and the position of the second bayonet does not exceed the lower edge of the joint fixing position, so that the sizes of the upper edge and the lower edge of the hip structural member cannot be increased due to the arrangement of the bayonets, the occupied space of the hip structure is reduced, and the structure is more compact.

title: Low-speed transmission shaft of joint module of humanoid robot, joint module, motion joint of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a low-speed transmission shaft of a joint module of a humanoid robot, the joint module, a motion joint of the humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and the low-speed transmission shaft comprises a first shaft and a second shaft which are coaxially connected through an axial decoupling type torque coupling structure. The low-speed transmission shaft is designed to be of a structure formed by combining the first shaft and the second shaft, and the first shaft and the second shaft are allowed to have relative displacement in the axial direction while keeping synchronous transmission through the axial decoupling type torque coupling structure; a set distance can be always kept between an output code disc and a reading head in the output encoder, so that the influence of axial movement of a low-speed transmission shaft in the prior art on the detection precision of the output encoder is effectively avoided, and high-precision control and immediate feedback can be realized during operation of the joint module; and the accuracy and reliability of the motion joint execution tail end control of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Behavior safety control method for humanoid robot and intelligent robot with humanoid robot body
abstract: The invention provides a behavior safety control method for a humanoid robot and an intelligent robot with a body, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: through a mode of combining global obstacle avoidance and local obstacle avoidance, the path planning efficiency, flexibility and safety of the robot and the cooperative capability of a multi-robot system are remarkably improved. According to the method, the behavior safety control level of the robot can be improved, the performance and response speed of the whole system can be optimized, and it is ensured that the robot can operate efficiently and safely when facing static and dynamic obstacles. Meanwhile, the behavior mode of the robot is judged, if abnormal behaviors including hardware and software faults, running path abnormity, special environment exceeding a set range and the like are found, emergency braking is needed, and all power supplies of the robot are cut off through a built-in safety chip of the robot or a special instruction.

title: Humanoid sole and shank simulating assembly of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot humanoid sole and shank assembly which comprises a sole assembly, a shank assembly and a thigh assembly. The sole assembly comprises a sole, an inertial measurement unit mounted on the sole, a force sensor mounted above an arch of the sole and an adapter plate mounted on the force sensor; the shank assembly comprises a shank, a cross-shaped bearing, an ankle joint support and an ankle joint driving module, the ankle joint support is movably connected to the bottom of the shank through the cross-shaped bearing, the ankle joint support is fixedly installed on the top of the sole assembly, and the ankle joint driving module is installed on the shank and used for driving the ankle joint support to swing along double shafts of the cross-shaped bearing; the thigh assembly comprises a thigh and a knee joint driving module, and the thigh is rotationally connected to the top of the shank through the knee joint driving module. The performance of the humanoid robot in the aspects of movement flexibility, stability, load bearing capacity and complex ground adaptability is remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot imitation learning data acquisition method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot imitation learning data acquisition method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: generating an imitation learning task; splitting the imitation learning task into a plurality of sub-tasks; judging whether each subtask is matched with a primitive task in a primitive library or not, taking the subtask matched with any primitive task as a first type of subtask, and taking the subtasks which cannot be matched with any primitive task as a second type of subtask; obtaining a first type of data corresponding to the first type of subtasks from the primitive library; acquiring a second type of data corresponding to the second type of subtasks; and according to the sequence of the plurality of sub-tasks, fusing the first type of data and the second type of data to serve as learning data corresponding to the imitation learning task. The data collection time can be shortened, and the cost is reduced.

title: Ankle-foot structure of humanoid robot capable of transversely rolling in large range and robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot ankle-foot structure capable of transversely rolling in a large range and a robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The ankle-foot structure comprises two motor connecting rod mechanisms and an ankle-foot structure, one side of a motor base is connected with a thigh, the other side of the motor base is fixedly connected with a motor, and one side of a crank is fixedly connected with an output shaft of the motor; the thigh connecting rod is connected with the shank connecting rod through a trapezoidal rod, and the shank connecting rod is connected with the first base; the lower portion of the first base is fixedly connected with the ankle-foot bottom plate, two first through holes are formed in the upper portion of the first base, linear bearings are placed in the first through holes and connected to the foot shaft in a sleeving mode, and the shank connecting rod is connected to the foot shaft in a sleeving mode through a fisheye bearing. The lower portion of the second base is fixedly connected with an ankle-foot bottom plate, two second through holes are formed in the upper portion of the second base, deep groove ball bearings are placed in the second through holes and connected to the cross in a sleeving mode, and foot rubber is fixedly connected to the ankle-foot bottom plate.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent decoration construction system and method based on multi-modal perception
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot intelligent decoration construction system and method based on multi-modal sensing, and the system obtains the geometric data of a construction surface in real time through multi-modal sensing, obtains the posture data of a robot through an IMU inertial measurement unit, facilitates the data calibration, guarantees the modeling precision of a building model, and improves the construction efficiency. Real-time feedback of construction progress and construction defects is carried out; the intelligent decision-making module is combined to dynamically adjust the movement and construction operation track of the robot; by means of an end effector of the flexible mechanical arm, high-precision multi-mode building construction operation is achieved; and the collaborative operation module can realize multi-robot construction operation task scheduling and progress management, so that the building comprehensive construction efficiency is improved. Compared with a traditional decoration construction mode, the construction efficiency, the construction precision and the robot operation and moving stability are remarkably improved, autonomous operation of a complex curved surface is supported, and the construction consistency and the continuity of multi-mode construction operation are improved.

title: Special electric vehicle for humanoid robot
abstract: The electric vehicle special for the humanoid robot is a vehicle provided for traveling of the humanoid robot, and overcomes the defects that the humanoid robot is short in traveling distance and low in walking speed. The humanoid robot is characterized in that starting and stopping of the electric vehicle, the running speed, turning-on and turning-off of a front lamp 6, turning-on and turning-off of a rear lamp 9, rotation of a steering shaft 102, braking of a front wheel 103, braking of a rear wheel 108, sound production of a horn 4 and supporting of a vehicle support 11 are all controlled by a control signal sent by the humanoid robot to firstly control a master controller 3 on the electric vehicle; the main controller 3 controls according to different control signals, the rearview device 8 plays a role in enabling the humanoid robot to see the scene behind the vehicle without turning back, the inclination angle sensor module plays a role in controlling the inclination angle of the vehicle frame 104, and when the special electric vehicle is used by the humanoid robot, a special intelligent chip must be arranged in the humanoid robot to be matched with the electric vehicle. title: Humanoid robot leg structure
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot leg structure which comprises thighs, knee joints, shanks and feet. title: Lower limb structure of humanoid robot
abstract: A lower limb structure of a humanoid robot comprises a waist assembly, two thigh assemblies, two shank assemblies and two sole assemblies. The two sole assemblies are fixedly installed at the bottoms of the two ankle joint supports respectively. title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, discloses a humanoid robot and solves the problem that the leg distance is too large due to existing coaxial joint layout. In a standing posture, an output flange of the hip pitching joint is obliquely arranged downwards and is fixedly connected with a shell of the leg rolling joint through a rigid connecting piece; the rotating axis of the leg rolling joint is parallel to the advancing direction of the robot; the hip pitching joints and the leg rolling joints are arranged in a staggered manner on a vertical projection plane; on a horizontal projection plane, the projection area of the hip pitching joint at least partially covers the projection area of the leg rolling joint. The positions of the two leg rolling joints are changed, the two leg rolling joints are shifted towards the inner side and the lower side of the body, and the positions, located on the rotating axes of the hip pitching joints, of the rotating shafts of the original leg rolling joints are moved out and moved to the area between the rotating axes of the two hip pitching joints, so that the distance between the two thighs is reduced.

title: Exoskeleton for remote control operation of multi-axis mechanical arm or humanoid robot

title: Actuator, joint module, motion joint of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an actuator, a joint module, a motion joint of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. title: Heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot moving chassis
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a heavy-load anti-explosion humanoid robot moving chassis which comprises a frame assembly. title: Humanoid robot inverse kinematics trajectory planning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot inverse kinematics trajectory planning method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: planning an initial motion trajectory of a robot; according to the initial motion trail, the theoretical joint angle and the theoretical joint speed of the robot are obtained in an inverse kinematics mode; a kinematics mapping relation between the joint space speed and the working space speed of the robot is obtained; according to the kinematics mapping relation, constraint conditions are obtained, and the constraint conditions comprise a joint angle constraint condition, a joint speed constraint condition and a speed-level joint torque constraint condition; according to the constraint conditions, the theoretical joint angle and the theoretical joint speed are optimized, and an optimized joint angle and an optimized joint speed are obtained; and according to the optimized joint angle and the optimized joint speed, an optimized joint movement track is obtained. According to the invention, the joint motion trail is smooth.

title: Leg rolling joint supporting structure of robot, leg structure of robot, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg rolling joint supporting structure of a robot, a leg structure of the robot, the robot and a humanoid robot, and the leg rolling joint supporting structure of the robot mainly comprises a hip pitching supporting piece, a bearing and a hip pitching output connecting piece. The bearing is arranged between the shaft sleeve of the hip pitching supporting piece and the shaft bearing part of the hip pitching output connecting piece for supporting, so that after the hip pitching joint and the leg rolling joint module are obliquely arranged, even if an eccentric phenomenon occurs, the eccentric phenomenon is prevented from being transmitted to the output flange under the supporting of the bearing, and the hip pitching joint and the leg rolling joint module are prevented from being damaged. And therefore, the problems of gear abrasion and the like caused by bias pressure on the speed reducer of the hip pitching joint module are effectively avoided.

title: Humanoid robot wearable whole-body teleoperation method, system and device
abstract: The invention relates to a wearable whole-body teleoperation method, system and device for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining mechanical arm parameter information and mechanical arm coordinate information of a wearable whole-body teleoperation device worn on an operator; based on the mechanical arm parameter information, a motion dimension value and motion parameter information are called; determining a single transformation matrix of the adjacent coordinate system according to the motion parameter information; calculating a product between single transformation matrixes corresponding to the motion dimension value and taking the product as a dimension transformation matrix; and actual control information is determined according to the mechanical arm coordinate information and the dimension transformation matrix, and the actual control information is output to the humanoid robot. title: Humanoid robot composite motion wrist and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot composite motion wrist and a control method thereof.The wrist structure comprises a base, a joint connecting rod, a rotary joint, a non-centering universal joint, a supporting rod and a movable platform, and a first telescopic control assembly, a second telescopic control assembly and a sliding telescopic assembly are fixedly arranged on the base in a three-point distribution mode; the two ends of the joint connecting rod are movably connected with the top telescopic end of the first telescopic control assembly and the top telescopic end of the second telescopic control assembly respectively, one end of the rotary joint fixedly sleeves a middle rod body of the joint connecting rod, the other end of the rotary joint is movably connected with the sliding telescopic assembly through a non-centering universal joint, and the movable platform is connected and installed above the rotary joint through a supporting rod. The two telescopic control assemblies are used for controlling stretching and retracting, then transmission is conducted through the joint connecting rods, meanwhile, the sliding telescopic assemblies are matched, so that the rotary joints incline and rotate by angles, and the movable platform is driven to do side-tipping motion, pitching motion or combined motion of the two. According to the invention, rapid, complex and fine wrist actions can be realized.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent control method and system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent control method and system for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: controlling a robot to move in a preset moving channel, and obtaining indoor positioning data and orientation data at the same time; the robot is provided with a forward camera module and a lateral camera module, and image data of a front channel and side goods shelves are continuously collected in the moving process. The system corrects the moving direction of the robot in real time through comprehensive analysis of indoor positioning data, orientation and azimuth data and front image data, and navigation accuracy is ensured. And processing the acquired side shelf images by using a preset commodity image recognition algorithm, recognizing commodity information, matching the commodity information with corresponding indoor positioning data, and finally generating a commodity shelf database containing space positioning information. The multi-dimensional information fusion method not only realizes the accurate navigation of the robot, but also improves the automation level and efficiency of goods shelf commodity management, and provides convenient commodity position query service for users.

title: Strong fault-tolerant shank type pedestrian inertial autonomous navigation method based on weighted observation function
abstract: The invention provides a strong fault-tolerant shank type pedestrian inertial autonomous navigation method based on a weighted observation function. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, preliminarily identifying a standing middle phase according to a module value of ankle acceleration, wherein the time when a human body walks in the standing middle phase is correction time; constructing an ankle-shank kinematics model; under a Kalman filtering framework, establishing an ankle-shank kinematics/inertial navigation integrated navigation model based on an ankle-shank kinematics model and an inertial navigation error equation; a weighted observation function wk is constructed according to the observation error, the wk is used as a weight to be added in calculation of a gain matrix and a covariance matrix in the Kalman filtering process, and the weakening degree of observation information is controlled so as to suppress the negative influence caused by correction time error detection. Ankle-shank kinematics model information and micro inertial navigation system information are fused by adopting a robust information fusion algorithm added with a weighted observation function, so that the convenience, robustness and adaptability of the whole system are improved.

title: Joint module and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a joint module and a humanoid robot. Through the arrangement of the adapter, the shell does not need to be connected with the speed reducer, and the joint shell is provided with the radial first assembly hole in the side face of the assembly end of the speed reducer, so that the speed reducer can be assembled, and meanwhile, the motor and the speed reducer are assembled.

title: Joint module, assembly structure of transmission part of joint module and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a joint module, an assembly structure of a transmission part of the joint module and a humanoid robot. The assembly structure of the joint module and the transmission part of the joint module comprises the joint module and the transmission part, the joint module comprises a speed reducer output flange, a bearing and a shell; the transmission part comprises a first annular connecting end; one part of an inner ring of the bearing abuts against the speed reducer output flange, an outer ring of the bearing abuts against the shell, and the other part of the inner ring of the bearing abuts against the first annular connecting end. The bearing simultaneously forms a radial bearing interface and an axial positioning reference between the output flange of the speed reducer and the transmission part, and no additional bearing is arranged on the rotating shaft of the first annular connecting end for supporting. The technical problem of rotary supporting of a transmission part connected with an output flange of a joint module in the prior art can be solved.

title: Teaching type video tool service method and related device
abstract: The invention provides a teaching video personal service method and a related device, and the method comprises the steps: receiving an action link configuration data set from a mobile terminal, controlling a humanoid robot to carry out the operation teaching of a first target object, controlling the humanoid robot to obtain a first object state image and a second object state image, and carrying out the operation teaching of the first target object. And determining the robot task completion degree and the user task completion degree according to the relationship between the first object state image, the second object state image and the single frame image, and carrying out operation teaching on the continuous single action task based on the continuous corresponding action link configuration data set according to the action task constraint condition until it is confirmed that the teaching task is completed. Compared with an existing strategy that a robot directly generates a demonstration scheme based on a human demonstration video, the scheme improves the flexibility and intelligence of humanoid robot teaching video service, facilitates the improvement of the individuation degree for different teaching conditions, and improves the user experience.

title: Dexterous hand thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The driving mechanism is arranged on the mounting seat and comprises a first driving part and a second driving part; the inward turning and side swinging mechanism is movably arranged on the mounting seat; the knuckle module is connected to the side, away from the mounting base, of the inward turning and side swinging mechanism; the inward bending mechanism is arranged in the knuckle module and used for driving the knuckle module to bend inwards; the first driving part is used for driving the inward turning and lateral swinging mechanism, so that the knuckle module connected with the inward turning and lateral swinging mechanism performs coupling motion of lateral swinging and inward turning; the second driving piece is used for driving the inward turning side swing mechanism so that the knuckle module can conduct inward turning motion. Through decoupling transmission of the second driving piece and the first driving piece, lateral swinging of the thumb is achieved, and the thumb is allowed to be flexibly adjusted in a complex three-dimensional space. The thumb of the dexterous hand can achieve three-degree-of-freedom movement of inward turning, side swinging and bending, and the grabbing accuracy of the dexterous hand is improved.

title: Active safety protection humanoid robot based on multi-closed-loop mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses an active safety protection humanoid robot based on a multi-closed-loop mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises an upper body and two bionic mechanical legs. The bionic mechanical leg comprises a thigh rack and a shank rack, the thigh rack is hinged to the shank rack through a first hinge shaft, the bionic mechanical leg further comprises a second linear driver, a linear sliding block is hinged to the fixed end of the second linear driver, the linear sliding block slides up and down along the thigh rack, and the movable end of the second linear driver is connected with the shank rack; an active safety module is arranged on the thigh rack; in a normal working mode, the active safety module locks the linear sliding block; when the knee joint is impacted by the outside, the driving safety module loosens the linear sliding block and absorbs and buffers the downward sliding impact force of the linear sliding block. Different from a traditional rigid driving joint, damping and buffering of the human bionic mechanical leg can be achieved, the safety of resisting sudden external force is provided, and therefore the reliability of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot, the dexterous hand comprises a palm and dexterous hand fingers, the dexterous hand fingers comprise pre-tightening seats and pre-tightening assemblies, the pre-tightening seats are arranged on the palm, and the pre-tightening assemblies are arranged on the pre-tightening seats; the finger driving mechanism is movably arranged on the pre-tightening seat and is connected with the pre-tightening assembly; the finger module is rotationally arranged on the palm and is connected with the finger driving mechanism; the pre-tightening assembly is used for providing pre-tightening force towards the finger module for the finger driving mechanism so that the finger driving mechanism can overcome the pre-tightening force when driving the finger module to move, and energy is charged for the pre-tightening assembly. After the finger module tightly holds an object, although the finger module is limited by the grabbed object and cannot continuously do work on the grabbed object, the finger driving mechanism is not completely blocked, and the driving force of the finger driving mechanism can overcome the pre-tightening force to charge the pre-tightening assembly; therefore, the problems of serious system heating, high energy consumption and overheating damage caused by stalling of the finger driving mechanism are avoided.

title: Biped robot ankle joint mechanism based on body intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and discloses a biped robot ankle joint mechanism based on body intelligence, which comprises a base, a similar sliding film, a semicircular silica gel joint head and a base, the sensor comprises an excitation sensor and a suppression sensor, the excitation sensor and the suppression sensor work mutually, and finally, on the premise that the ankle joint of the robot does not depend on a controller, the robot interacts with the pneumatic artificial muscle through the body, the ground and the sensing-driving integrated system, and finally the ankle joint is autonomously driven. Finally, efficient interactive perception of the external environment and the state of the robot is achieved, the adaptability of the robot in the complex environment is improved, and dependence on electric appliance sensing elements is reduced.

title: Robot reinforcement learning model construction method based on optical inertial fusion whole body motion capture
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motion capture data processing, and discloses a robot reinforcement learning model construction method based on optical inertial fusion whole body motion capture, and the method comprises the steps: measuring and recording a plurality of key parameters of a target human body; carrying out primary calibration and recording on all inertial sensors worn on a target human body, and calibrating all cameras arranged around at the same time; in the process that the target human body executes the specified action, synchronously acquiring action sampling data of the target human body; the action sampling data comprises motion data corresponding to the inertial sensor and camera image data corresponding to the camera; the motion data and the camera image data are processed, fused and optimized, and optimized joint posture quaternary data and human body motion sequence data are obtained; and inputting the human body action sequence data into the reinforcement learning model of the humanoid robot, and configuring the preset reward function to perform reinforcement learning training, so that the learning efficiency of the robot and the accuracy of action execution can be improved.

title: Harmonic speed reduction module for humanoid robot dexterous hand joint
abstract: The invention provides a harmonic speed reduction module for a dexterous hand joint of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid finger joints, the harmonic speed reduction module comprises an axial magnetic flux motor and a double-rigid-wheel harmonic speed reducer, and the axial magnetic flux motor comprises a motor shell, an input shaft, a permanent magnet rotor and two PCB stators; the double-rigid-gear harmonic speed reducer comprises a wave generator, a flexible bearing, a flexible gear, a first rigid gear, a second rigid gear and a supporting bearing, the input shaft is fixedly connected with the wave generator, the first rigid gear serves as an inner ring of the supporting bearing and is detachably and fixedly connected with the motor shell, and a connecting plate is arranged between the first rigid gear and the motor shell; the rigid gear II is positioned on one side of the rigid gear I far away from the motor shell as a support bearing outer ring; the flexible bearings comprise two first flexible bearings which are arranged in parallel in the axial direction of the input shaft, and a limiting protrusion located between outer rings of the two first bearings is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the flexible gear; an end cover is arranged on the side, away from the first rigid wheel, of the second rigid wheel. The axial length of the joint module is shortened, and meanwhile the load capacity and the transmission precision of the joint module are improved.

title: Humanoid robot performance measurement method and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot performance measurement method and system, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, the method is applied to a processing device in the humanoid robot performance measurement system, and the humanoid robot performance measurement system further comprises a to-be-measured humanoid robot and at least one collection device. A plurality of mark points are arranged on the humanoid robot; the method comprises the following steps: controlling the humanoid robot to execute corresponding actions according to a preset measurement task; acquiring motion data of the humanoid robot acquired by the acquisition equipment, wherein the motion data is acquired by the acquisition equipment based on the plurality of mark points; and according to the motion data, calculating to obtain performance measurement data of the humanoid robot. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, the performance measurement of the humanoid robot can be realized, and the application value of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Method and system for constructing dense point cloud map of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of point cloud map construction, in particular to a humanoid robot dense point cloud map construction method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a video image collected when a humanoid robot walks in real time; the gait phase of the humanoid robot in the current frame image in the video image is judged; estimating the camera pose of the current frame image based on the gait phase of the humanoid robot of the current frame image; judging whether the current frame image is a key frame or not based on the camera pose of the current frame image; and performing local mapping and loopback detection according to the key frame to obtain a global dense point cloud map. According to the method, the fuzzy and jittering conditions of the acquired data during mapping of the humanoid robot are effectively improved, a more accurate environment map can be obtained, the operation precision during task execution of the robot is improved, and the collision risk in the advancing process of the humanoid robot is reduced.

title: Emotional behavior expression method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an emotional behavior expression method of a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: providing an emotional behavior decision-making method for matching an interaction object voice emotion with a humanoid robot behavior emotion and a humanoid robot emotion self-adaptive expression strategy so as to construct an interaction method for associating a user emotion with a humanoid robot emotion. According to the interactive system, an adopted microphone array is used for collecting and positioning an interactive object sound source, an optimized random forest model is trained to recognize the voice emotion of an interactive object, and the emotion behavior of the humanoid robot is decided, so that the emotion behavior expression of the humanoid robot is realized. According to the method, the matching relationship between the user voice emotion and the humanoid robot behavior emotion is constructed, and the problem that in the prior art, the humanoid robot hardly directly constructs the emotion relationship between the human and the robot is solved. And meanwhile, the advantage that the action behavior elements of the humanoid robot are fully utilized to express emotions is fully displayed, and the man-machine interaction effect is further improved.

title: Bionic interaction humanoid equipment capable of automatically sensing and simulating multi-dimensional physiological feedback
abstract: The invention discloses bionic interaction humanoid equipment capable of automatically sensing and simulating multi-dimensional physiological feedback, and belongs to the technical field of bionic interaction humanoid equipment, the bionic interaction humanoid equipment comprises a main body shell, the main body shell is internally provided with a sensing module, a control module, a lubricating liquid storage and release module, a temperature control module and a vibration module, the control module is used for receiving the interaction signal transmitted by the sensing module, generating a corresponding control instruction based on a preset algorithm, and transmitting the control instruction to the corresponding lubricating liquid storage and release module, the temperature control module and/or the vibration module for execution; the lubricating liquid storage and release module comprises a liquid storage container and a liquid control module, and the lubricating liquid storage and release module is used for opening a control valve according to a control instruction of the control module and releasing lubricating liquid with the preset capacity to a target area. Multi-dimensional induction and real-time adjustment can be achieved, release, temperature and vibration of the lubricating liquid are dynamically regulated and controlled, and the interactive experience feeling with a user is improved.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent data processing method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent data processing method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the analysis and processing of various external sound data based on a data processing terminal, and determining a plurality of groups of sound instructions; and based on the data processing terminal, performing priority analysis on the multiple groups of sound instructions, and determining a priority sound instruction set. According to the method, sound data of the surrounding environment of the humanoid robot is collected through an auditory sensor, then semantic analysis, instruction priority analysis, instruction completion degree analysis, energy demand analysis and instruction recheck processing are performed on the sound data, and whether the humanoid robot executes a first execution sound instruction or not is determined; according to the mode, the problem that the humanoid robot cannot perfectly complete the instruction can be avoided, the problem that the instruction cannot be completely completed due to insufficient energy can also be avoided, in addition, the instruction is rechecked, the problem of energy waste of the humanoid robot caused by mistaken instruction sending can also be avoided, and the cost is indirectly reduced.

title: Double-arm wheel type humanoid intelligent robot with body
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm wheel type humanoid intelligent robot with a body, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, the double-arm wheel type humanoid intelligent robot comprises a movable chassis, a robot body and a folding lifting mechanism, the fixed end of the folding lifting mechanism is arranged at the top of the movable chassis, and the robot body is arranged at the movable end of the folding lifting mechanism; the folding lifting mechanism comprises a first folding part, a second folding part... an Nth folding part which are hinged through a joint rotation driving mechanism, N is an integer larger than or equal to 2, the first folding part is hinged to the movable chassis, and the Nth folding part is hinged to the robot body. The folding lifting mechanism is adopted, the lifting distance of the folding lifting mechanism is the sum of the lengths of N folding parts, and when the folding lifting mechanism is in a folding recovery state, the height of the folding lifting mechanism is only the width of a single folding part, so that the height of the robot in an initial state or a retraction state is greatly reduced; and the purpose of reducing the accommodating space is achieved.

title: Actuator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an actuator and a humanoid robot. The connecting section and the connecting end are mutually supported in the radial direction, the connecting end is rotationally supported through the rotating supporting assembly, the rotating speeds of the connecting end, the connecting section and the input end are the same, the connecting end, the connecting section and the input end are tightly matched and only need to be rotationally supported through the rotating supporting assembly, and the situation that multiple sets of rotating supporting pieces are arranged is avoided. According to the arrangement, the structure is compact, the arrangement of the rotary supporting piece is reduced, and the size of the actuator can be effectively reduced.

title: Leg structure of robot, robot, biped robot and humanoid robot

abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot reinforcement learning training method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a model file of a humanoid robot; analyzing the model file to obtain a position relation of two feet of the humanoid robot and part constraint information of the humanoid robot, and establishing a reference coordinate system according to the position relation of the two feet; according to the reference coordinate system and the component constraint information, a parallel ankle joint mechanism model of the humanoid robot is constructed, and inverse kinematics information is determined according to the parallel ankle joint mechanism model; and training a reinforcement learning strategy of the humanoid robot according to the inverse kinematics information and the component constraint information. According to the method, series-parallel connection conversion in a resolving mode in the training process is avoided, the operation efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the requirement for reinforcement learning parallel sampling efficiency is lowered, the training process is simplified, and the convergence speed of reinforcement learning strategies is increased.

title: Humanoid robot field continuous slope terrain recognition method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot field continuous slope terrain recognition method. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring point cloud data of an environment by using a laser radar; s2, performing RASG rasterization on the point cloud data, and dividing continuous point cloud data into a plurality of region blocks; s3, traversing each region block, and converting the point cloud data in each region block into elevation information to form an elevation grid; s4, calculating a slope grid according to the elevation grid; and S5, clustering the gradient grids, and grouping similar gradient regions, the terrain can be divided into different continuous gradient regions, the features of the terrain are clearer and easier to analyze, the variable-size radial grids are adopted to segment the point cloud data, adaptive processing can be performed according to point cloud densities at different distances, and the accuracy of the point cloud data is improved. And the calculation complexity is greatly reduced.

title: Humanoid robot leg mechanism and robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot leg mechanism and a robot, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, the humanoid robot leg mechanism comprises a shank skeleton, a thigh skeleton and a foot, and is equipped with a first power mechanism and a second power mechanism. The first power mechanism is located in the thigh skeleton, drives the shank skeleton to rotate around the knee joint rotating shaft through a first motor and comprises a first driving wheel, a first driven wheel and a first transmission rope. The two second power mechanisms are arranged on the left side and the right side of the thigh skeleton respectively, drive the feet to move around the naked joint assembly and comprise second motors, second driving wheels, second driven wheels, second transmission ropes and connecting rods, and the connecting rods are connected with the second driving wheels and the feet. The power mechanism is concentrated on the thigh skeleton, so that the inertia of the legs is effectively reduced, and the movement flexibility of the robot is improved. Meanwhile, the space occupied by the leg structure is reduced through the integrated power transmission system, the bloated appearance is avoided, and the attractiveness is improved.

title: Modularized bionic joint and dynamic balance control humanoid robot system
abstract: The invention discloses a modular bionic joint and dynamic balance control humanoid robot system, which relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a sensing module and a decision module, the sensing module comprises a multi-modal sensor, and the decision module comprises a bionic strategy module and an intelligent algorithm module. The bionic strategy module comprises an ankle joint and hip joint cooperation module and a gait planning module, the intelligent algorithm module comprises a real-time dynamic prediction control module and a strategy optimization module, and the execution module comprises a modular bionic joint module and a control system module. title: Intelligent household robot

abstract: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method and device of a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, and the fault diagnosis method of the humanoid robot comprises the steps: obtaining the current fault information of the humanoid robot; according to the current fault information, performing multiple times of event search in a pre-constructed fault tree, after each time of event search, predicting the occurrence probability of the searched fault event under the current fault symptom according to the historical fault information, and obtaining the predicted occurrence probability of the searched fault event, the current fault symptom is determined according to the current fault information; according to the predicted occurrence probability of the searched fault event, fault diagnosis information of the humanoid robot is generated, and the fault diagnosis information is used for assisting fault processing of the humanoid robot; wherein the fault tree is constructed according to fault event information related to the humanoid robot. According to the invention, the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the humanoid robot can be improved.

abstract: The invention provides an RV speed reduction module for a humanoid robot dexterous hand joint, and relates to the technical field of humanoid finger joints, the RV speed reduction module comprises a driving motor and an RV speed reducer which are coaxial, the driving motor comprises a motor shell, an input shaft, a permanent magnet rotor and two PCB stators located on the two sides of the permanent magnet rotor respectively; the RV speed reducer comprises two cycloidal gears, a main bearing and at least two eccentric shafts, and the main bearing is arranged between the two cycloidal gears; two first four-point ball bearings are arranged between the eccentric shaft true circle and the inner ring of the main bearing, and the motor shell is detachably connected with the outer ring of the main bearing; a second four-point ball bearing is arranged between the cam at the two ends of the eccentric shaft and the cycloidal gear; the outer wall of the cycloidal gear is meshed with inner hole teeth of the outer ring of the main bearing; one end of the eccentric shaft is provided with a planet wheel; one end of the input shaft is provided with an input gear meshed with the planet wheel; an end cover detachably connected with the main bearing inner ring is arranged on the side, away from the motor shell, of the main bearing outer ring. title: Pneumatic muscle multi-axis manipulator obstacle avoidance track correction method and control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid soft robot control, and provides a pneumatic muscle multi-axis manipulator obstacle avoidance trajectory correction method and control method.The pneumatic muscle multi-axis manipulator obstacle avoidance trajectory correction method comprises the steps that a target trajectory of a pneumatic muscle multi-axis manipulator is obtained; for the target track, a Mercator projection method is adopted, and the target track is converted into a two-dimensional plane track; the relative position and shape of an obstacle are obtained, external force is obtained through calculation, after the external force is introduced into a track generation equation of a dynamic motion primitive algorithm, based on a two-dimensional plane track, an obstacle avoidance track of the pneumatic muscle multi-axis manipulator is generated through the dynamic motion primitive algorithm, and inverse transformation is conducted through a Mercator projection method. The problem that traditional trajectory planning is lagged in adjustment and insufficient in precision in a complex environment is solved.

title: Biped robot control method and system based on head-mounted display control equipment
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot control method and system based on head-mounted display control equipment, and relates to the technical field of sensors and robots. In addition, the action indication information is input into a robot motion control model based on deep reinforcement learning, so that the robot motion control model outputs an action strategy to the biped robot in combination with the action indication information. According to the invention, more natural, visual and convenient-to-deploy robot standing height control can be realized, so that the robot control accuracy and the user experience are improved.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system based on auditory sense
abstract: The invention discloses an auditory-based humanoid robot control method and system, and relates to the technical field of voice analysis, and the method comprises the steps: analyzing the noise condition of a voice signal and the position information of a starting person, carrying out the denoising of the voice signal according to the noise condition and the position information of the starting person, specifically enhancing the voice signal, and effectively removing the noise. The reliability of voice signal data is improved, and a basis is provided for subsequent voice analysis and recognition. Segmenting the voice signal to obtain a plurality of voice signal segments, analyzing the association degree of the text content segments, and associating the plurality of text content segments to obtain the semantic content. title: Multi-style vehicle automatic driving method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-style vehicle automatic driving method for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-style vehicle automatic driving model by an automatic driving preference alignment module, a humanoid robot admittance control module and a feature extraction module; the feature extraction module processes environment and vehicle state data by using a VAE encoder to obtain state representation. And the automatic driving preference alignment module models the decision problem into a Markov decision process, an action containing an expected front wheel steering angle and an accelerator is generated through a high-level planner, and a strategy is optimized according to a PPO algorithm in combination with a reward value output by a reward model. A humanoid robot admittance control module generates a steering wheel actual turning angle according to the expected front wheel steering angle, a bottom layer controller fuses impedance, fuzzy control and adjusting parameters to obtain speed control input, and finally multi-style vehicle automatic driving is achieved by integrating the steering wheel actual turning angle, an accelerator and the speed control input.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a biped humanoid robot attitude detection method based on time sequence multi-scale feature fusion, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a target biped humanoid robot, and extracting a plurality of feature maps with different scales; iteratively carrying out time sequence multi-scale feature fusion according to the feature map of the current scale of the current frame, the fusion feature map of the previous scale of the current frame and the feature map of the current scale of the previous frame to obtain a plurality of fusion feature maps of the current frame; processing the fusion feature map of the minimum scale and the fusion feature maps of other scales by using a preset attention module and a preset jump connection module according to the plurality of fusion feature maps of the current frame to obtain a coding feature and a plurality of jump connection features of the current frame; and according to the coding feature and the plurality of jump connection features, decoding to obtain an output feature map of the current frame. Through time sequence multi-scale feature fusion, the accuracy and recall rate of posture detection of the biped humanoid robot are improved.

title: Four-limb connecting structure of humanoid robot in exhibition hall
abstract: The utility model provides a four-limb connecting structure of a humanoid robot in an exhibition hall, and relates to the technical field of four-limb connecting structures, the four-limb connecting structure comprises a robot trunk, the side surface of the robot trunk is provided with a mounting groove, the interior of the mounting groove is slidably connected with a mounting block, and the back surface of the mounting block is provided with a rotating groove A. A better use effect is realized, and the service life of the robot trunk is prolonged. After the mechanical arm is used for a long time, when the mechanical arm needs to be maintained, a rotating handle can be rotated by means of a tool, the rotating handle drives a threaded rod to rotate, the threaded rod backwards rotates in the robot body through a rotating groove, and after the threaded rod is completely rotated out of the back face of a mounting block and the back face of the robot body through the rotating groove, the mechanical arm can be maintained; and then the mounting blocks are pulled out from the interior of the robot trunk through the mounting grooves to be maintained, so that the situation that mechanical arms of an existing robot are mostly directly and fixedly mounted on the two sides of the trunk, and after long-time use, the mechanical arms cannot be detached, so that the mechanical arms are inconvenient to maintain when needing to be maintained is avoided.

title: Ankle joint structure and human-shaped toy
abstract: The utility model relates to an ankle joint structure and a humanoid toy, the ankle joint structure comprises a damper, a leg connecting assembly and a foot connecting assembly, the damper is arranged between the leg connecting assembly and the foot connecting assembly, the leg connecting assembly is installed at one end of a shank close to a sole, and the foot connecting assembly is installed at one side of the sole close to the shank. The leg connecting assembly has a first rotational degree of freedom, the damper has a second rotational degree of freedom, the foot connecting assembly has a third rotational degree of freedom, and the first rotational degree of freedom, the second rotational degree of freedom and the third rotational degree of freedom are mutually orthogonal. Three mutually orthogonal rotational degrees of freedom are formed through the leg connecting component, the damper and the foot connecting component, so that the foot sole can rotate at different angles relative to the leg, the human-shaped toy can swing in different postures, the weight of the human-shaped toy is borne through the rotary damper with large torsion, and the human-shaped toy can be put in different postures. And the stability and safety of the ankle joint structure are ensured.

title: Sensing and controlling integrated control system for hand joints of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a sensing and control integrated control system for hand joints of a humanoid robot. The sensing and control integrated control system comprises an industrial personal computer, a programmable multi-axis motion control card, an axis channel expansion interface board, an analog quantity control interface board, an input and output quantity control interface board, a driver, artificial muscles, a control panel, a relay and a contactor. And the industrial personal computer is bidirectionally and electrically connected with a programmable multi-axis motion control card. According to the utility model, monitoring of the driver and the artificial muscle is realized through the analog quantity control interface board and the input and output quantity control interface board. The device has the functions of actively adjusting the position of the hand joint and sensing and inhibiting deformation.

title: Head structure of humanoid robot in exhibition hall
abstract: The utility model discloses an exhibition hall humanoid robot head structure which comprises a robot head body and further comprises a mouth shape adjusting mechanism, the mouth shape adjusting mechanism is arranged on the surface of the robot head body, and the mouth shape adjusting mechanism comprises a mouth portion wrapping sleeve, a rubber strip, a long rubber block, a short rubber block, a micro telescopic motor A and a micro telescopic motor B, an opening wrapping sleeve is arranged on the surface of the robot head body and is composed of an upper lip sleeve and a lower lip sleeve, a micro telescopic motor A pushes and pulls an adhesive tape through a pull rod during operation to control forward movement and retraction of the upper lip sleeve and the lower lip sleeve, and a micro telescopic motor B extrudes or stretches a short adhesive block from the two sides through a pull rod during operation to control forward movement and retraction of the upper lip sleeve and the lower lip sleeve. The angle of the short rubber block is changed around the long rubber block, then the upper lip sleeve and the lower lip sleeve are driven to change, approaching and stretching of the lip side position are simulated, a lower jaw control assembly in the robot head body is matched, mouth shape simulation is conducted on part of pronunciation during generation, and the simulation performance of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Liquid heat dissipation loop of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot liquid heat dissipation loop which comprises a circulation box, a plurality of joint motors and two multi-way connectors, cooling liquid channels in shells of the joint motors are connected with the two multi-way connectors through two-way circulation pipes respectively, and a plurality of cooling fins are fixedly installed on the outer side of the circulation box. A plurality of heat conduction rings are arranged in the circulation box and fixedly connected through two first heat conduction pipes. A multi-way connector, a two-way circulating pipe, a circulating box and a circulating pump are matched in a cooling channel of a plurality of joint motor shells to circulate cooling liquid, each joint motor can be effectively cooled, meanwhile, a plurality of cooling fins are arranged on the outer side of the circulating box, and a plurality of heat conduction rings and two first heat conduction pipes are arranged in the circulating box, so that the heat conduction efficiency is improved. The heat of the cooling liquid in the circulation box can be quickly conducted out, and the heat dissipation motor can be matched with the first flow guide cover and the second flow guide cover to directly conduct heat dissipation treatment on the cooling fins and the second heat conduction pipe.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom waist system and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a three-degree-of-freedom waist system and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the three-degree-of-freedom waist system comprises a waist support frame, a waist support rod, a support plate, a thoracic cavity bracket, a rotary driving unit and more than two linear driving units, the waist support frame comprises a mounting plate and two leg connecting frames which are integrally formed; the two leg connecting frames are located on the two sides of the mounting plate. The mounting plate is connected with the supporting plate through the waist supporting rod and more than two linear driving units; the linear driving unit is used for realizing pitching and side-sway of the thoracic cavity bracket relative to the leg connecting frame; the thoracic cavity support is installed on the supporting plate through the rotary driving unit. The rotation driving unit is used for achieving rotation of the chest support relative to the leg connecting frame. Rotation, pitching and side-sway between the upper limb unit and the lower limb unit of the robot can be achieved, the working range of the robot is widened, meanwhile, the load capacity of a waist system is guaranteed, and then the universality of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot data processing method and system based on parallel computing
abstract: The invention discloses a parallel computing-based humanoid robot data processing method and system. The parallel computing-based humanoid robot data processing method comprises the step of mounting sensors at key movement parts of a humanoid robot. According to the method, sensors are installed at key parts of the humanoid robot, various operation data including motion data, stress data and control data can be monitored and collected in real time, data preprocessing is carried out, the accuracy and integrity of the data are ensured, and the accuracy and integrity of the data are ensured based on calculus principle, Lagrange principle and PID control algorithm calculation. The motion position vector, the generalized force and the control quantity of the humanoid robot can be accurately obtained, the data form an operation data set, a neural network model is adopted for training, optimal operation state information can be generated, the current operation data set is compared with the optimal operation state information, correction information can be generated, and the correction accuracy is improved. This allows the robot to perform adaptive adjustments according to real-time data and historical optimal states, thereby optimizing its performance.

title: Humanoid hip joint and thigh simulating assembly of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid hip joint and thigh assembly of a humanoid robot, which comprises a hip joint assembly and two thigh assemblies, the hip joint assembly comprises a first support and hip joint driving modules installed on the left side and the right side of the first support. The two thigh assemblies are installed on the two hip joint driving modules respectively to achieve front-back swing of the two thigh assemblies, each thigh assembly comprises a rotating module, a twisting module and a thigh support, and the thigh support is movably connected to one hip joint driving module through the rotating module and the twisting module. Therefore, left-right rotation and torsion of the thigh support are achieved respectively. The hip joint and thigh assembly of a humanoid structure is provided by simulating the structural layout of human hip joints and thighs, the hip joint and thigh assembly is more anthropomorphic in appearance and motion function, and the problem that in the prior art, the structural layout of hip joints is unreasonable is solved.

title: Intelligent grabbing control method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent grabbing control method and system based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: taking each finger of a humanoid dexterous hand as an independent agent, generating a control action based on a respective strategy network, and forming a multi-agent system; empirical data generated in the interaction process of each agent and the environment in the multi-agent system is stored by utilizing a playback pool mechanism, the sampling priority of a playback pool of each agent is dynamically adjusted according to the task target, the learning progress and the task importance, and the playback pools share the empirical data; a staged reward mechanism is adopted, and each agent in the multi-agent system is jointly guided to optimize the position, the joint angle and the contact force in different stages of a grabbing task through individual rewards and global rewards; a multi-agent depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm is used for training, and a trained multi-agent system is used for intelligent grabbing control. The precision and stability of the grabbing process are remarkably improved.

title: Workpiece material supplementing information processing method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a workpiece supplementing information processing method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: displaying a first interface when a supplementing confirmation message is received; the first interface comprises first information and a first control, the first information is graphic and text information associated with the missing target workpiece, and the first control is an option for confirming feeding; in response to an operation of triggering the first control by the user, sending an indication message to a server, the indication message being used for indicating the server to send a material supplementing instruction to the target material supplementing robot; and when a confirmation message from the server is received, a second interface is displayed, the second interface comprises second information which is generated according to the confirmation message and used for prompting completion of material supplementing, and the confirmation message is a message generated according to the first image collected by the humanoid robot and the second image collected by the target material supplementing robot. According to the method, the robot is confirmed to supplement materials at the terminal equipment side, and the humanoid robot and the material supplementing robot cooperate to confirm that the material supplementing is completed, so that the material supplementing efficiency is improved.
