title: Dexterous hand finger, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand finger, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot, the dexterous hand finger comprises a flexible connecting structure, and the flexible connecting structure comprises a mounting seat, a guide rod and a reset part; the mounting seat is arranged on the palm structure, and the guide rod is arranged on the mounting seat; the reset piece is arranged on the guide rod; the driving module is arranged on the guide rod in a penetrating mode and located on the side, away from the mounting base, of the reset piece; the finger root module is connected to one side of the driving module so as to move under the driving of the driving module; when the finger root module is subjected to external force, the finger root module drives the driving module to move along the guide rod and extrudes the reset piece, and the reset piece is used for providing reset acting force for the driving module. When the fingers of the dexterous hand are stressed, the driving module moves along the guide rod, so that the impact force is prevented from directly acting on the driving module, the impact is absorbed through the reset piece located between the driving module and the mounting seat, and the driving module is protected to a certain extent.

title: Auto-disturbance rejection control method for linear electrically-driven joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an active-disturbance-rejection control method for a linear electrically-driven joint of a humanoid robot. The active-disturbance-rejection control method comprises the steps that a dynamic model is established for a linear electrically-driven joint system of the humanoid robot; determining an extended state observer according to the kinetic model, estimating the state variable and unknown disturbance of the system in real time, and dynamically compensating the disturbance through the extended state observer; determining a nonlinear feedback control law based on the state observed by the extended state observer and the estimated disturbance information; and analyzing the stability of the extended state observer and the nonlinear feedback control law, and performing parameter adjustment on the extended state observer and the nonlinear feedback control law based on an analysis result. According to the active-disturbance-rejection control method for the linear electrically-driven joint of the humanoid robot, the active-disturbance-rejection control technology is applied, the limitation of traditional PID control in a nonlinear and uncertain system is overcome, efficient control over the linear electrically-driven joint is achieved, and therefore the dynamic performance and robustness of the humanoid robot are enhanced.

title: Quality detection method and equipment for data acquisition of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a quality detection method and device for data acquisition of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that collected data of the humanoid robot are obtained, the collected data comprise an expected value sequence and an actual value sequence of target parameters of the humanoid robot, and according to the expected value sequence and the actual value sequence, a delay evaluation value and a continuity evaluation value of the collected data are determined; and determining a quality inspection result of the collected data according to the delay evaluation value and the continuity evaluation value. According to the quality detection method for data acquisition of the humanoid robot, the expected value sequence, the actual value sequence and the two time sequences are analyzed, the delay and continuity errors of the two sequences are quantified, the delay evaluation value and the continuity evaluation value are obtained, whether the acquired data are qualified or not is determined based on the evaluation values, and the quality detection accuracy of the humanoid robot is improved. Automatic quality inspection can be realized, manual visual inspection is replaced, the cost is reduced, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title: Telescopic and rotatable movable stacking type humanoid robot trunk
abstract: The invention discloses a movable stacking type humanoid robot trunk capable of stretching, retracting and rotating. The trunk top mounting plate is installed on the trunk bottom mounting plate in an up-down moving and swinging mode through an air cylinder, the planetary gear train, the driving unit and the measuring unit are all connected to the trunk top mounting plate, a photoelectric blocking piece is installed on the planetary gear train, and the driving unit is used for driving the planetary gear train and the photoelectric blocking piece to rotate; the measuring unit is used for measuring the telescopic length and the rotating angle of the robot trunk, the swing unit, the driving unit and the measuring unit are all externally connected with a control system, and the control system accurately controls the pose of the robot trunk according to the telescopic length and the rotating angle of the robot trunk. In the stacking process of the mobile robot, after the stacking plane rises gradually, the height of the robot can be increased in a self-adaptive mode, so that goods at the higher position can be stacked more quickly, and the production efficiency is improved.

title: Thigh structure, leg device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a thigh structure and a leg device of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. abstract: The invention provides a humanoid manipulator. Comprising a palm assembly, a thumb, other fingers and a circuit board. The palm assembly is provided with a pitching assembly and a swinging assembly, and two-degree-of-freedom movement can be achieved through a driving part and a connecting rod. The thumb is matched with a driving component through two mutually inclined universal joints, so that multidirectional movement can be realized, and other fingers are driven to bend and stretch through tendon ropes; the circuit board is integrated at the far end of the palm and controls all driving components. The protruding part of the quick-release assembly can be screwed into the groove of the external component to be fixed and is matched with the electric connection structure to synchronously complete separation of mechanical structure connection and electric connection. Therefore, the manipulator provided by the invention has the functions of high-flexibility grasping similar to that of a human hand and quick disassembly, assembly and maintenance.

title: Moment push rod structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot moment push rod structure, and relates to the technical field of robot push rods, the humanoid robot moment push rod structure comprises a push rod main body, the top surface of the push rod main body is fixedly connected with a bottom plate, the top surface of the bottom plate is provided with two grooves which are symmetrical left and right, and an empty groove is arranged in the bottom plate between the two grooves. A plurality of second springs which are evenly distributed are fixedly connected to the bottom of the inner wall of the empty groove, a concave plate is fixedly connected to the top face of each second spring, a first sliding groove is formed in the top face of each concave plate, and two triangular plates which are in bilateral symmetry are slidably inserted into the first sliding grooves; a plurality of evenly-distributed third springs are fixedly connected between the sides, away from each other, of the two triangular plates and the two sides of the inner wall of the empty groove, and a vertical rod is movably connected to the top face, located between the two grooves, of the bottom plate in an inserted mode. And the condition that the rod body of the push rod structure is broken due to overweight goods is avoided.

title: Humanoid robot finger mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot finger mechanism which comprises fingertips, first knuckles and second knuckles, one ends of the second knuckles are provided with the first knuckles in a hinged mode, the end portions of the first knuckles are provided with the fingertips in a hinged mode, and the other ends of the second knuckles are connected with a palm in a hinged mode. The fingertips are arranged at the ends of the first knuckles, the fingertips are hinged to the third ear frames at the ends of the first knuckles through the convex lugs, so that the fingertips are flexible, a connector can be covered through the simulated skin, the first meshing grooves are formed in one ends of the first knuckles, the first ear frames are arranged on the inner sides of the first meshing grooves, and the first knuckles are arranged on the first ear frames. title: Rapid clamping device for humanoid robot test
abstract: The utility model discloses a quick clamping device for humanoid robot testing, which comprises a bottom plate, the surface of the bottom plate is provided with a front moving fixing assembly and a rear moving fixing assembly, the front moving fixing assembly comprises a first stepping motor arranged on the surface of the bottom plate, and the output end of the first stepping motor is rotatably connected with a first guide rail screw rod; the first guide rail lead screw is rotationally connected with a first moving block, a connecting block is fixedly arranged on the surface of the first moving block, an instep fixing arc-shaped plate is fixedly arranged on the surface of the connecting block, and the heel limiting block is of a right-angle structure; the rear moving fixing assembly comprises a second stepping motor, the output end of the second stepping motor is rotationally connected with a second guide rail lead screw, the second guide rail lead screw is rotationally connected with a second moving block, and a heel limiting block is fixedly arranged on the surface of the second moving block. The feet of the humanoid robot are fixed through cooperation of the front moving fixing assembly and the rear moving fixing assembly, and the device is simple in structure and convenient to use.

title: Humanoid robot joint motor bearing press-fitting structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot joint motor bearing press-fitting structure which comprises a base, a supporting frame arranged on the base, a positioning piece arranged on the base and a press-fitting piece arranged above the positioning piece and capable of axially moving, a cylindrical protrusion is arranged on the positioning piece, and a positioning face is arranged on the peripheral side of the cylindrical protrusion. The press fitting part is downwards provided with a pressing ring matched with the circumferential side of the bearing, an outer ring is arranged on the press fitting part located on the outer side of the pressing ring, and a notch is formed in the outer ring. Compared with the prior art, the motor end cover adjusting device has the advantages that the structure is simple, and the first air cylinder can move up and down and adjust the height through the screw rod so as to adapt to various motor end covers; according to the utility model, the positioning piece and the press fitting piece are detachably connected so as to replace and adapt to motor end covers of various different sizes; the utility model has the advantages of simple structure and fast production rhythm, and is suitable for batch production.

title: Wrist joint assembling structure and arm structure of humanoid robot and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a wrist joint assembly structure of a humanoid robot, an arm structure and a robotic.The wrist joint assembly structure of the humanoid robot mainly comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a third connecting piece, a first joint module and a second joint module; the first joint module is assembled with the first connecting piece and the second connecting piece through the two end faces and the first output flange, the second joint module is assembled with the third connecting piece through the end face, and the third connecting piece is assembled and connected with the second connecting piece. title: Four-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a four-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the four-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism comprises a top plate, a bottom plate, a plurality of telescopic driving pieces and a driven piece, one end of each telescopic driving piece and one end of the driven piece are rotationally connected with the top plate, and the other end of each telescopic driving piece is rotationally connected with the bottom plate. The other ends of the telescopic driving parts and the other end of the driven part are both rotationally connected with the bottom plate, the driven part is located in the middle of the telescopic driving parts, the telescopic driving parts and the driven part both comprise spherical hinges, and the spherical hinges are arranged at the two ends of the telescopic driving parts and the two ends of the driven part. And four-degree-of-freedom motion can be realized, and the problem that the understanding and response capabilities of the robot to the surrounding environment are insufficient due to joints with less degrees of freedom is solved.

title: Fusion method of flexible joint mechanism and touch sensor of intelligent accompanying humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a method for fusing a flexible joint mechanism and a touch sensor of an intelligent accompanying human-type robot, by constructing the flexible joint mechanism based on a composite material, robot joints can generate controllable deformation under the action of external force, and higher degree of freedom and smaller motion resistance are provided. The tactile sensor unit is integrated in the flexible joint, can sense the change of contact force between the joint part and an external object in real time, and cooperates with a robot action model through a data fusion algorithm, so that the robot action path is optimized, and tactile feedback is enhanced. In addition, a force control and position control self-adaptive switching mechanism is further introduced, the driving force of robot joints is automatically adjusted, and the stability and high efficiency of the robot in a complex environment are ensured. According to the method, the performance of the robot in a dynamic interaction scene can be remarkably improved, and more accurate and natural tactile interaction capability is provided for the robot.

title: Unstructured environment supervised personal task data processing method and device
abstract: The invention provides an unstructured environment supervised personal task data processing method and device, and the method comprises the steps: determining a target task mode based on a network connection state, and enabling the target task mode to be used for constraining the selection of target equipment, and constraining the source of interaction information executed by a humanoid robot; obtaining visual perception picture information of the external environment, and sending the visual perception picture information to the target equipment; receiving a target object and an operation instruction from the server; and controlling the humanoid robot to reach the target posture based on the operation instruction and initiate target operation to the target object. Compared with the strategy that the robot accompanies the pet according to the preset accompanying route, action and audio sent by the wireless terminal in the prior art, according to the scheme, the interaction between the humanoid robot and the user in the unstructured environment is more coherent, the response speed of the humanoid robot to the user instruction or environment in the body service process is increased, and the user experience is improved. And the intelligence of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Robot interaction method, interaction device and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides an interaction method and device of a robot and electronic equipment. The robot comprises a head and a machine body. The head is rotationally connected with the fuselage; the robot controls the head to rotate in multiple directions to execute various anthropomorphic interaction actions; the robot is used for transporting the distribution goods to the distribution point location; the interaction method comprises the following steps: after a delivery point is reached, detecting a pick-and-place result of a delivered article and controlling a head to execute a personification interaction action corresponding to the pick-and-place result; and/or in the moving process, the surrounding environment is detected, and the head is controlled to execute anthropomorphic interaction actions corresponding to the surrounding environment. Therefore, the problem that the interaction intention of the robot is difficult to understand by the user in the prior art can be solved.

title: Double-steel-wheel harmonic reducer for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of harmonic reducers, and particularly discloses a double-steel-wheel harmonic reducer for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The double-steel-wheel harmonic reducer comprises a steel wheel assembly, a flexible wheel assembly and a wave generator; the steel wheel assembly comprises a first steel wheel and a second steel wheel, the first steel wheel and the second steel wheel are of an annular structure, the flexible wheel assembly is arranged in annular containing cavities of the first steel wheel and the second steel wheel, a first inner tooth structure is formed on the inner side of the first steel wheel, a second inner tooth structure is formed on the inner side of the second steel wheel, and the flexible wheel assembly is of an annular structure. An outer tooth structure meshed with the first inner tooth structure and the second inner tooth structure is formed on the outer side of the flexible gear assembly, tooth number difference exists between the first inner tooth structure and/or the second inner tooth structure and the outer tooth structure, the wave generator is used in cooperation with the flexible gear assembly, and the wave generator drives the first steel wheel and/or the second steel wheel to be in meshed transmission through the flexible gear assembly. By means of the double-steel-wheel structure, miniaturization and light weight are achieved, and meanwhile the performance of the harmonic reducer is kept.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure based on planetary roller screw
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg structure based on a planetary roller screw, and aims to provide a mechanical structure scheme for converting rotational motion into linear motion, so that the adaptability and the motion stability of a robot in complex terrains can be improved. According to the structure, a planetary roller screw is adopted as a main transmission element, a screw nut is driven by a motor, high-precision push-pull motion is achieved, and leg joints of the robot are driven to move. Compared with a traditional gear, hydraulic or linear motor driving mode, the transmission mechanism has the advantages of being high in transmission efficiency, low in reverse clearance, low in energy consumption and excellent in torque transmission characteristic. By means of the structure, humanoid linear joint movement of the legs can be achieved, the robot can more stably complete complex actions such as walking, standing and jumping, meanwhile, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the system reliability is improved. The robot can be widely applied to the fields of humanoid robots, rescue robots, special operation robots and the like.

title: Multi-control Lyapunov function combined biped robot optimization control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot optimization control method based on multi-control Lyapunov function combination. The method comprises the steps that a control Lyapunov function set is acquired according to a motion control task of the biped robot, and then a stability constraint union set of control input is acquired; and constructing a quadratic form optimization control model based on the stability constraint union set, performing online multi-thread parallel solution, and then outputting optimization control output so as to perform optimization control on the biped robot. According to the method and the online parallel solution scheme, the overall performance of motion control of the biped robot can be effectively improved on the basis of not additionally increasing control calculation time, and high-performance motion optimization control of the biped robot is achieved.

title: Physical force sense feedback system for interaction between humanoid robot and environment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of force sense feedback systems, in particular to a humanoid robot and environment interaction physical force sense feedback system which comprises an object stress analysis module, an object deformation analysis module, a control module, a grasping force judgment module and a communication module. The object stress analysis module is used for analyzing and obtaining related information of object stress and transmitting the related information to the control module; the object deformation analysis module is used for analyzing and obtaining related information of object deformation and transmitting the related information to the control module; the control module obtains a grasping index according to the related information of the object stress and the related information of the object stress, and transmits the grasping index to the grasping force judgment module; the grabbing force judgment module obtains information that the force of the robot for grabbing the object is too large or proper according to the grabbing index and transmits the information to the communication module; and the communication module transmits the information that the force of the robot for capturing the object is too large or proper to the robot hand execution module.

title: Hexapod robot for free dancing and dancing welcome
abstract: The hexapod robot can dance and welcome, and entertainment and service can be provided for people. The six-foot robot is secondarily developed on the basis of a common six-foot robot, and the developed content comprises the following steps: 1, new dance actions such as swinging dance, propeller, seal climbing and welcome dance; 2, when no person approaches, the robot performs, randomly selects other dancing actions and dances; and when someone approaches, the robot turns to perform welcome action and shows welcome. After meeting, the robot automatically returns to the performance state.

title: Quality detection method and device for image acquisition of humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a quality detection method and device for image acquisition of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining image acquisition data of the humanoid robot, determining time differences corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames according to timestamps of the multiple image frames, determining similarity values corresponding to the multiple pairs of adjacent frames if the multiple time differences are all smaller than a preset duration, and determining similarity values corresponding to the multiple pairs of adjacent frames if the similarity values are smaller than the preset duration. And according to the plurality of similarity values and a preset condition, determining a quality inspection result of the image acquisition data, the preset condition being related to a preset initial threshold and increment thresholds corresponding to the plurality of pairs of adjacent frames. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention can reduce the cost, improve the efficiency and ensure the accuracy.
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a quality detection method and device for image acquisition of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining image acquisition data of the humanoid robot, determining time differences corresponding to multiple pairs of adjacent frames according to timestamps of the multiple image frames, determining similarity values corresponding to the multiple pairs of adjacent frames if the multiple time differences are all smaller than a preset duration, and determining similarity values corresponding to the multiple pairs of adjacent frames if the similarity values are smaller than the preset duration. And according to the plurality of similarity values and a preset condition, determining a quality inspection result of the image acquisition data, the preset condition being related to a preset initial threshold and increment thresholds corresponding to the plurality of pairs of adjacent frames. The method provided by the embodiment of the invention can reduce the cost, improve the efficiency and ensure the accuracy.

abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a waist assembly structure, a humanoid robot and a robot. title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot which comprises a chest mechanism, a head mechanism, an upper limb mechanism and a lower limb mechanism. Wherein the chest mechanism adopts a supporting framework with a hollow structure, a control module and a power supply module are integrated in the supporting framework, the layout is reasonable, and meanwhile, the working temperature of the power supply module and the control module is prevented from being too high; visual sensors are arranged at the front end of the head mechanism and the front end of the supporting framework and used for detecting the environment and improving the motion precision of the robot. The upper limb mechanism is provided with a shoulder joint assembly and an elbow joint assembly, four-axis movement of robot arms is driven, the working requirement is met, meanwhile, a direct drive structure of a motor and a connecting rod is adopted, and the transmission efficiency is high. The lower limb mechanism is provided with a hip transmission mechanism and a leg transmission mechanism, the hip transmission mechanism is designed in an orthogonalization mode and an oppositely-arranged structure, so that the transmission mechanism is highly integrated and compact in structure, and miniaturization of the robot is achieved.

title: Real-time control system and method for humanoid robot cluster based on mobile ad hoc network
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a humanoid robot cluster real-time control system and method based on a mobile ad hoc network. The system comprises an equipment layer which comprises an operation system and equipment of the humanoid robot; the device comprises an ad hoc network module. The edge layer comprises a server and a humanoid robot; and the platform layer is used for controlling and managing the humanoid robot in real time. The method has the advantages that under the environment that a traditional wireless cellular network cannot be accessed, data sharing of all humanoid robots in the network can be achieved, and therefore tasks of different robots are arranged according to an intelligent scheduling algorithm in combination with the current states, environment information and the like of the robots; based on an efficient communication protocol, robot states and surrounding environment factors can be quickly obtained, after tasks of the robots are arranged, different task instructions are respectively issued to different robots in the network, and the robots at different nodes in the network can respond to the instructions in real time, so that real-time control of the system is realized.

title: Ankle and sole system of humanoid robot
abstract: An ankle and sole system of a humanoid robot comprises a shank skeleton, an ankle and a sole, the tail end of the shank skeleton is movably connected with the sole through the ankle, and the ankle is driven by a driving mechanism; the driving mechanism comprises a driving mechanism A and a driving mechanism B which have the same structure and are mutually independent, and the driving mechanism A and the driving mechanism B are arranged on the two sides of the middle of the shank skeleton respectively. The upper ends of the driving mechanism A and the driving mechanism B are movably connected with the middle part of the shank skeleton, and the lower ends of the driving mechanism A and the driving mechanism B are movably connected with the sole; the relative distance AA between the base end joint ball bearing A and the output end joint ball bearing A and the relative distance BB between the base end joint ball bearing B and the output end joint ball bearing B are regulated and controlled, so that the foot bottom can pitch and roll transversely.

title: Terrain semantic segmentation method for humanoid robot in field environment
abstract: The invention discloses a terrain semantic segmentation method for a humanoid robot in a field environment. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a trafficability data set; performing scanning aggregation; carrying out trafficability mapping; point cloud stacking and ground height estimation; the trafficability is realized; for each point column, a certain threshold value is set for points higher than the local ground to filter out overhanging obstacles, because the points do not collide with the unmanned system, the invention provides a new frame to construct a BEV cost graph, and the method has the following advantages: (1) observed values changing along with time are aggregated; (2) predicting invisible areas in the map; and (3) irrelevant obstacles, such as overhanging branches, which do not affect the traversal are filtered out, a complete three-dimensional semantic point cloud is constructed by using past and future marked laser radar scanning, and a ground real two-dimensional traversal map is constructed. The model of the patent is trained with a ground real BEV map constructed from a fully observed and marked environment.

title: Experimental platform for testing comprehensive performance of linear joint for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an experimental platform for testing comprehensive performance of a linear joint for a humanoid robot. The platform comprises a bed body, a fixing device, a sensing device and a load generating device, wherein the fixing device, the sensing device and the load generating device are arranged on the bed body; the fixing device is used for installing and fixing the to-be-measured linear joint; the fixing devices are detachably installed on the lathe bed, and the linear joints of different specifications and models can be adapted by replacing the fixing devices of different types. The sensing device is used for acquiring the tension and pressure numerical value and displacement data of the to-be-measured linear joint in real time, and is used for carrying out subsequent performance evaluation calculation; and the load generating device is used for simulating different load conditions of the linear joint along the axial movement direction of the to-be-tested linear joint and acting on the to-be-tested linear joint. The linear joint performance test experimental platform can more conveniently and efficiently test the performance of the linear joint under various working conditions, so that the linear joint is tested and evaluated, and the linear joint performance test experimental platform has the characteristics of high loading precision, small load force fluctuation range, high stability and the like.

title: Dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot, the dexterous hand comprises a palm structure and a holding finger structure, the holding finger structure comprises a joint assembly, a first driving assembly, a swing assembly, a fixing frame and an auxiliary assembly, and the fixing frame is connected to the palm structure. The swing assembly is rotationally connected to the palm structure and elastically connected with the fixing frame, the joint assembly is rotationally connected to the swing assembly, and a rotating shaft of the swing assembly is perpendicular to a rotating shaft of the joint assembly. The auxiliary assembly is arranged to be elastically telescopic, in the telescopic direction of the auxiliary assembly, one end of the auxiliary assembly is connected to the joint assembly through a universal structure, the other end of the auxiliary assembly is connected to the first driving assembly through a universal structure, and the first driving assembly is connected to the fixing frame. The first driving assembly is suitable for driving the auxiliary assembly to move so as to drive the joint assembly to rotate relative to the swing assembly. Through the arrangement, the flexible adaptability of the dexterous hand can be improved.

title: Environment sensing system of human-shaped accompanying robot and precision motor control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an environment sensing system of a human-shaped accompanying robot and a precision motor control method, and the system comprises a data collection module, a data processing module, a space analysis module, an environment sensing evaluation module, a task planning module and a control instruction module. The data acquisition module acquires environment data through various sensors, the data processing module processes data from different sensors and generates a comprehensive environment information graph, the space analysis module performs space analysis on the environment information graph and identifies feasible paths, obstacles and potential dangerous areas, and the environment perception evaluation module performs environment perception evaluation according to a space analysis result. The task planning module generates an action plan of the robot according to an adaptability score, and the control instruction module generates a control instruction according to the task plan; the adaptive capacity and execution efficiency of the robot in a dynamic and complex environment are improved, and the method has important application value.

title: Two-arm robot anthropomorphic joint attitude mapping method based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to a two-arm robot anthropomorphic joint attitude mapping method based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, belongs to the field of robot kinematics and trajectory planning, and mainly comprises the step of establishing a unified representation method, namely a spherical coordinate representation method, of a human two-arm joint pose and a robot two-arm joint pose. A large arm, a small arm and a palm joint of a person are equivalent to three vectors which are connected in sequence, a mechanical arm is equivalent to the large arm, the small arm and the palm joint, each joint is regarded as a vector, and the three vectors are connected in sequence; according to the method, spatial positions of a human arm three-joint vector and a mechanical arm three-joint vector are determined by using a spherical coordinate representation method, and polar coordinates and azimuth angle parameters of an equivalent joint vector of the double-arm robot and the human arm joint vector are enabled to be equal through an anthropomorphic joint attitude mapping algorithm; and then the mechanical arm joint angle value meeting the condition is obtained through a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and therefore migration from the human arm joint posture to the humanoid posture of the double-arm robot is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot and dexterous hand thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a dexterous hand thereof. The humanoid robot comprises a palm shell defining a containing cavity; the thumb comprises a first rotary actuator, a second rotary actuator, a transmission assembly and a thumb assembly, the first rotary actuator and the second rotary actuator are fixedly connected to the inner wall of the containing cavity, the transmission assembly is in transmission connection between the first rotary actuator and the second rotary actuator, and at least part of the thumb assembly extends out of the containing cavity; the thumb component is in transmission connection with the transmission component; each finger comprises a finger piece and a linear actuator, the linear actuators are fixedly connected to the cavity wall of the containing cavity, at least part of each finger piece extends out of the palm shell, and each finger piece comprises a connecting base, a finger near knuckle, a finger far knuckle, a finger far knuckle and a finger far knuckle rubber coating; and a connector board electrically connected to the first rotary actuator, the second rotary actuator, and the linear actuator. The dexterous hand is compact in layout, small in occupied space and high in movement precision, and the grabbing force of the dexterous hand is improved.

title: Series-parallel flexible humanoid double-arm robot
abstract: A series-parallel flexible humanoid double-arm robot comprises an arm connecting piece, two mechanical arm modules, a motion control module and a power module. Two arm joint connecting ends are formed on the arm connecting piece. The two mechanical arm modules are connected to the two arm joint connecting ends in parallel, and each mechanical arm module comprises a plurality of flexible joint mechanisms and a dexterous hand module which are sequentially connected in series. The motion control module is installed on the arm connecting piece, and the motion controller is electrically connected with the two mechanical arm modules so as to control the two mechanical arm modules to bend and stretch in multiple directions; the power module is electrically connected with the two mechanical arm modules and the motion control module so as to achieve equipment power supply. The robot accords with the human arm muscle cooperative work rule, the overall performance and reliability of the equipment are high, and the movement process is natural and smooth; each flexible joint mechanism can be independently driven and tested, in addition, the flexible joint mechanism modules of the double-arm robot can be rapidly assembled and replaced, and the maintenance cost is low.

title: Humanoid robot path planning system based on obstacle avoidance algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot path planning system based on an obstacle avoidance algorithm, and the system comprises the steps: S1, obtaining multi-source environment data, and generating a multi-dimensional dynamic environment representation; s2, realizing real-time avoidance of dynamic obstacles through local path re-planning; s3, a path multi-objective optimization module is communicated with a self-adaptive path adjustment module, and an optimal path with global adaptability is generated through a reinforcement learning mechanism and an iterative optimization process; s4, a multi-modal data fusion module which constructs a unified environment feature model through a feature extraction and fusion algorithm; s5, based on an initial path generated by a path multi-objective optimization module, performing dynamic correction on the path by using a nonlinear programming technology, and updating spatial distribution of path points in real time; and S6, quickly searching the global path space through a topological optimization algorithm, and determining a global optimal path. The method has the advantages of strong real-time performance, high adaptability, strong path optimization capability and accurate environment perception.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom parallel driving flexible joint mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a two-degree-of-freedom parallel driving flexible joint mechanism. The two-degree-of-freedom parallel driving flexible joint mechanism comprises a central supporting frame, an output end transmission module and two input end driving modules, wherein the central supporting frame comprises a first connecting end and a fixing head arranged opposite to the first connecting end; the output end transmission module comprises an output shell, a T-shaped main shaft, two input bevel gears and an output bevel gear; the T-shaped main shaft is arranged in the output shell, the T-shaped main shaft comprises a horizontal end and a vertical end vertically connected to the middle of the horizontal end, the two input bevel gears are rotationally connected to the two sides of the horizontal end respectively, the vertical end is sleeved with the output bevel gear, and the two input bevel gears are meshed with the output bevel gear respectively; the two input end driving modules are arranged on the two opposite sides of the central supporting frame correspondingly and used for driving the two input bevel gears to rotate correspondingly so that the second connecting end can rotate around the horizontal end or rotate around the vertical end. The space layout is greatly optimized, and the flexibility and adaptability of the humanoid mechanical arm in practical application are enhanced.

title: Intelligent nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent nursing robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The intelligent nursing robot sequentially comprises a head part, an upper limb part and a lower limb part from top to bottom, shells of the upper limb part and the lower limb part are integrally machined, the lower limb part is used for walking and moving, and the head part is rotationally installed at the top of the upper limb part; bed sheets, quilt covers, pillowcases, hospital dress and the like can be stored in a classified mode, dirty and clean articles can be placed separately, daily cleaning and maintenance of the sickbed and patients are facilitated, manual carrying of medical staff is omitted, and convenience is achieved. Meanwhile, the intelligent functions of intelligent interaction, body temperature detection, blood pressure detection and the like are carried, simple physical sign detection can be carried out on a patient at any time, medical staff do not need to come to detect at regular time, even the patient can operate by himself/herself, different medicines can be stored on the functional arms on the two sides, accurate dispensing can be carried out according to the conditions of the patient, the error rate of manual operation is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved. And the effect of supervising the patient to take medicine can be achieved by matching with the temperature measurement and vision module.

title: Humanoid robot learning method based on frequency domain enhanced wavelet Transform model
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot learning method based on a frequency domain enhanced wavelet Transform model, and the method comprises the steps: collecting an RGB image data set, a driving arm joint information data set, a driven arm joint information data set, a chassis line angular velocity data set, and an IMU line angular velocity data set of a humanoid robot; inputting a driven arm joint information data set, a chassis line angular velocity data set, an IMU line angular velocity data set and a CLS into a Transform encoder module to obtain a re-parameterized sample; according to the scheme, frequency domain enhancement is introduced into an FE-EMA module on the basis of EMA, a wavelet Transform model is responsible for processing one-dimensional time sequence data, abundant frequency domain information in the data is captured, multi-scale information is captured through wavelet transform, richer feature expression is achieved, and meanwhile higher robustness is shown in frequency domain information extraction; and the learning efficiency and the task completion capability of the humanoid robot are obviously improved.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid robot which comprises a thoracolumbar assembly, a first connecting plate and a second connecting plate, the head assembly is arranged on the first connecting plate; the number of the lower limb assemblies is two, the two lower limb assemblies are both arranged on the second connecting plate, the lower limb assemblies and the second connecting plate are connected through hip joint assemblies, and each hip joint assembly comprises a plurality of first diaphragm type clamping air cylinders which are arranged at intervals in the circumferential direction; one end of the first diaphragm type clamping air cylinder is connected with the second connecting plate, and the other end of the first diaphragm type clamping air cylinder is connected with the lower limb assembly. title: Waist joint structure of bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of waist joint structures, in particular to a waist joint structure of a bionic humanoid robot, which improves the flexibility of use and adjustment, the use stability and the use convenience. Comprising a first shell and a connecting piece, the connecting piece is installed at the bottom end of the first shell, and an opening is formed in the top end of the first shell; the device further comprises a supporting device, a driving device, a power device, a U-shaped piece, a first rotating shaft and a connecting arm, the connecting piece is rotationally installed on the inner side wall of the U-shaped piece, the U-shaped piece is installed on the supporting device, the supporting device is used for driving the U-shaped piece to rotate horizontally, and the driving device is arranged at the bottom of the first shell and used for driving the first shell to swing left and right. The first rotating shaft is rotationally installed on the inner side wall of the first shell, the bottom end of the connecting arm is connected with the outer side wall of the first rotating shaft, the top end of the connecting arm penetrates through the opening and extends out of the first shell, and a power device is arranged in the first shell and used for driving the first rotating shaft to rotate.

title: Walking mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a walking mechanism and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The walking mechanism comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly and a shank assembly; the hip joint driving motor and the knee joint driving motor are coaxially arranged; one end of the thigh body is connected with the hip joint driving motor, and the hip joint driving motor is used for driving the thigh body to swing; the first ankle joint rotating motor is arranged at one end of the shank body and connected with the knee joint driving motor through a knee joint pull rod, and the knee joint driving motor is used for driving the shank body to swing. One end of the shank body is connected with the other end of the thigh body through a first ankle joint rotating motor, the first ankle joint rotating motor serves as a knee joint rotating shaft, the first ankle joint rotating motor is connected with the foot through a first pull rod, and the first ankle joint rotating motor is used for driving the foot to swing. According to the utility model, the transmission conversion complexity of the legs of the robot is reduced, the algorithm solution is simplified, and the division boundary of the rod piece is clearer.

One end of the shank body is connected with the other end of the thigh body through a first ankle joint rotating motor, the first ankle joint rotating motor serves as a knee joint rotating shaft, the first ankle joint rotating motor is connected with the foot through a first pull rod, and the first ankle joint rotating motor is used for driving the foot to swing. According to the utility model, the transmission conversion complexity of the legs of the robot is reduced, the algorithm solution is simplified, and the division boundary of the rod piece is clearer.

title: Intelligent robot for restaurant
abstract: The utility model discloses an intelligent robot for a restaurant, which comprises a robot main body, a dinner plate taking and placing unit, a cleaning unit, a self-walking unit and a man-machine interaction unit, various functional modules are integrated on the same platform, so that the robot has an omnibearing service capability, the investment cost of a plurality of robots with single functions is reduced, and the robot is more intelligent. The robot body is of a machine body structure with a base arranged at the bottom and a humanoid machine body arranged at the top, and the dinner plate taking and placing unit is arranged on the arm side of the humanoid machine body and driven by an arm side steering engine to take and place dinner plates. The self-walking unit is used for achieving self-walking of the robot body, and the self-walking unit comprises an environment sensing module arranged on the head and the body of the humanoid machine body and an electric drive roller module arranged on the bottom side of the base. Through integration and optimization of multiple functions such as ground cleaning, man-machine interaction, dinner plate taking and placing and the like, the service efficiency, customer experience and cleaning effect of a restaurant can be remarkably improved.

title: Tendon rope transmission humanoid finger, humanoid hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a tendon rope transmission humanoid finger, a humanoid hand and a humanoid robot, and the tendon rope transmission humanoid finger comprises a fixed support which is provided with a driving device; the first knuckle is rotationally connected with the fixed support through a first rotating shaft, and a first rope wheel is arranged on the first rotating shaft; the second knuckles are rotationally connected with the first knuckles through second rotating shafts, and second rope wheels are arranged on the second rotating shafts; one end of the main tendon rope is connected with the driving device, and the other end of the main tendon rope is sequentially wound on the first rope wheel and the second rope wheel to be fixed on the second knuckle; a first rope disc is arranged at the end, close to the first knuckle, of the fixing support, a second rope disc is arranged at the end, close to the first knuckle, of the second knuckle, and the two auxiliary tendon ropes are wound and fixed between the first rope disc and the second rope disc in a crossed mode. According to the tendon rope transmission humanoid finger, the knuckles of the humanoid finger can swing at the same time, and the situation that the humanoid finger is not controlled to swing is eliminated.

title: Biped robot leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure of a biped robot and a humanoid robot. The biped robot leg structure comprises a hip joint assembly, a thigh assembly, a shank assembly and a foot which are connected in sequence. The hip joint driving motor is connected with the knee joint driving motor through a connecting assembly, and the hip joint driving motor and the knee joint driving motor are coaxially arranged; the shank assembly and the thigh assembly are connected through a first ankle joint rotating motor, and the first ankle joint rotating motor serves as a knee joint rotating shaft. The first ankle joint rotating motor is located at the root of the shank assembly, and the knee joint driving motor is located at the root of the thigh assembly so as to reduce inertia of the tail ends of robot limbs. The leg structure of the biped robot is improved, inertia is made to move upwards by moving the driving motor upwards, and the flexibility and the dynamic performance of the robot are improved; the compactness of the leg structure of the biped humanoid robot is improved, the transmission angle is effectively limited, the transmission stability is improved, and the encoder and the like are convenient to maintain.

title: Finger joint transmission mechanism of humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a finger joint transmission structure of a humanoid manipulator, which is formed by pivoting a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the pivoting part of the first knuckle is provided with an arc-shaped tooth row, the second knuckle is internally provided with a speed reducer and a motor which are connected with each other, the speed reducer is provided with a transmission shaft which convexly extends towards the tooth row, and the transmission shaft is connected with the motor. And a transmission gear meshed with the tooth row is connected to the transmission shaft, so that when the motor drives the transmission shaft to rotate through the speed reducer, the transmission gear is synchronously driven to move along the tooth row, and further the second knuckle is driven to perform up-and-down pivoting motion at a preset angle relative to the first knuckle.

title: Finger joint transmission mechanism of humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention discloses a finger joint transmission mechanism of a humanoid manipulator, which is formed by pivoting a first knuckle and a second knuckle, an arc-shaped tooth row is arranged at the pivoting part of the first knuckle, and a power device and an inclined transmission component are arranged in the second knuckle. The transmission assembly is meshed with the tooth row of the first knuckle, so that when the power device drives the transmission assembly to operate, the power device relatively drives the transmission assembly to move along the tooth row, and then the second knuckle is driven to do up-and-down pivot swing motion at a preset angle relative to the first knuckle.

title: Humanoid robot imitation learning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot imitation learning method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining training data; according to the training data, training an initial model to obtain an imitation learning model; enabling a target humanoid robot to execute an action according to the imitation learning model; wherein the training data is data acquired by taking the simulation robot as a center when the simulation robot simulates an original object, and the training data comprises an actual joint position and an actual tail end force. According to the invention, the simulation learning model can be closer to the action habits of human beings, and the control of the humanoid robot can be more accurate and meticulous.

title: Biped mobile robot
abstract: The invention provides a double-foot mobile robot which comprises a first top platform, a second top platform, a first foot bottom plate, a second foot bottom plate and six independently-controlled telescopic branch chains with driving pairs as moving pairs, and a first telescopic branch chain and a second telescopic branch chain are hinged between one side of the first top platform and one side of the first foot bottom plate respectively. A third telescopic branch chain is connected between the other side of the first foot bottom plate and one side of the second top platform, a fourth telescopic branch chain and a fifth telescopic branch chain are hinged between the other side of the second top platform and one side of the second foot bottom plate, and a sixth telescopic branch chain is connected between the other side of the second foot bottom plate and the other side of the first top platform; through cooperation and telescopic changes of the six telescopic branch chains, the first top platform, the second top platform, the first foot bottom plate and the second foot bottom plate, movement of the biped mobile robot is achieved only through one parallel mechanism, the control difficulty and the control cost are reduced, the overall weight is reduced, and efficient walking is achieved.
abstract_en: The invention provides a double-foot mobile robot which comprises a first top platform, a second top platform, a first foot bottom plate, a second foot bottom plate and six independently-controlled telescopic branch chains with driving pairs as moving pairs, and a first telescopic branch chain and a second telescopic branch chain are hinged between one side of the first top platform and one side of the first foot bottom plate respectively. A third telescopic branch chain is connected between the other side of the first foot bottom plate and one side of the second top platform, a fourth telescopic branch chain and a fifth telescopic branch chain are hinged between the other side of the second top platform and one side of the second foot bottom plate, and a sixth telescopic branch chain is connected between the other side of the second foot bottom plate and the other side of the first top platform; through cooperation and telescopic changes of the six telescopic branch chains, the first top platform, the second top platform, the first foot bottom plate and the second foot bottom plate, movement of the biped mobile robot is achieved only through one parallel mechanism, the control difficulty and the control cost are reduced, the overall weight is reduced, and efficient walking is achieved.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom parallel ankle joint mechanism of humanoid robot and kinematics and mechanics resolving method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a two-degree-of-freedom parallel ankle joint mechanism of a humanoid robot and a kinematics and mechanics resolving method, the two-degree-of-freedom parallel ankle joint mechanism comprises a seven-connecting-rod transmission structure, and two groups of parallel four-connecting-rods form closed chain transmission. The motors I and II are installed at the upper ends of the shanks and rotate to drive the connecting rods IV and III to move through the connecting rods I, II, V and VI, and then the pitching degree of freedom and the transverse degree of freedom of the ankle joints are controlled in a coupling mode. According to the mechanism, dual-motor load balancing is achieved through parallel transmission, the equivalent torque is improved, meanwhile, kinematics and mechanics resolving methods can be combined, accurate control can be achieved only through motor feedback, the sensor cost is reduced, and the mechanism is suitable for the high-stability movement requirement of the biped robot.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a two-degree-of-freedom parallel ankle joint mechanism of a humanoid robot and a kinematics and mechanics resolving method, the two-degree-of-freedom parallel ankle joint mechanism comprises a seven-connecting-rod transmission structure, and two groups of parallel four-connecting-rods form closed chain transmission. title: Control method and device for straight knee walking of humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device for straight-knee walking of a humanoid robot and a storage medium. The control method and device are used for improving the straight-knee walking performance of the humanoid robot in different scenes. Collecting human body gait data; performing action redirection processing on the human body gait data; modeling the walking task, constructing an adversarial network, and generating a maximum expected discount return function; constructing a speed tracking reward function; constructing a soft boundary Wasserstein loss function of the discriminator, and constructing a style reward function according to the output of the discriminator; a PD controller is constructed; physical parameters of the target humanoid robot in straight knee walking training are selected, and prior distribution is set for each physical parameter; performing live-action test motion on the target humanoid robot, and collecting operation data corresponding to the physical parameters; and combining the collected operation data with the prior distribution corresponding to the physical parameters, and feeding back the updated posterior distribution to the simulation learning stage to optimize the control strategy.

title: AED first-aid method based on humanoid robot and related products
abstract: The invention discloses an AED first aid method based on a humanoid robot and a related product, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target monitoring video, and determining a target person to be subjected to first aid according to the target monitoring video; acquiring a personnel position, personnel identity information and an abnormal starting moment of the target personnel to be subjected to emergency treatment; the humanoid robot is controlled to obtain target AED equipment, and attribute information of the target equipment is obtained; acquiring a target position of the humanoid robot at the current moment; generating a target first-aid route between the target position and the personnel position; estimating a target consumed time length according to the target first-aid route; determining a target emergency strategy according to the target equipment attribute information, the personnel identity information and the target consumed duration; and controlling the humanoid robot to go to the personnel position, and controlling the humanoid robot to use the target AED equipment to perform first aid on the target personnel to be subjected to first aid according to the target first aid strategy. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the first-aid efficiency of the AED equipment is improved.

title: Artificial intelligence-based humanoid robot dynamic environment adaptation and behavior optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot dynamic environment adaptation and behavior optimization method based on artificial intelligence, the humanoid robot dynamic environment adaptation and behavior optimization method has excellent environment adaptation capability, the robot can comprehensively and accurately perceive and understand environment change through a multi-modal environment perception and knowledge graph real-time construction and updating mechanism, and the robot can be used for optimizing the environment change. The self behavior strategy is rapidly adjusted, and the strong adaptive capacity far better than that of a traditional technology is shown in a complex dynamic environment; through fusion of reinforcement learning and a planning algorithm and combination of rich information of a knowledge graph, the robot can quickly make scientific and reasonable behavior decisions when facing various uncertainties and emergencies, and decision errors are effectively avoided; the robot has continuous evolution learning ability, and a continuous learning and optimization mechanism enables the robot to continuously accumulate experience in the operation process, continuously improve and optimize a knowledge system and a decision model of the robot, gradually improve the performance and ability, and better adapt to diversified environments and complex task requirements.

title: Facial robot expression cooperative control method and system based on nonlinear mapping
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field related to robot facial expressions, and particularly relates to a robot facial expression anthropomorphic expression method and system based on nonlinear mapping and multi-server cooperative control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a plurality of facial key points of a real face image corresponding to each preset key part of a facial robot, calculating a pixel deviation between the plurality of face key points and a preset reference key point for quantifying the expression amplitude of the key part, and subtracting a preset original state value from the pixel deviation to obtain a pixel deviation representing the key part relative to a preset original state; mapping the pixel deviation into an angular deviation representing each server for driving the key part relative to the original position through nonlinear mapping, and realizing anthropomorphic expression of the facial expression based on each angular deviation; the nonlinear mapping mode of each part depends on the position of each server for driving the part; during mapping, firstly, normalization processing is carried out on pixel deviation based on the size of a human face. The method can improve the expression accuracy.

title: Design method and device for self-thinking robot with human characters
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field related to robots, in particular to a design method and device for a robot with human characters and capable of achieving self thinking. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a five-recognition information matrix; wherein the five-recognition information matrix comprises image recognition information, voice recognition information, taste recognition information, smell recognition information and body touch and limb movement recognition information; the five-recognition information matrix is a partial matrix in the state matrix; determining a stimulation matrix based on the change of the state matrix over time and a predetermined character matrix; wherein the character matrix is used for representing characters of the robot; wherein the stimulation matrix is used for representing the change of the state matrix, and stimulation is obtained under the influence of the character matrix; adjusting a state matrix in combination with the stimulation matrix, the character matrix and a preset memory warehouse; the state matrix is used for representing the current state of the robot; based on the adjusted state matrix, behaviors needing to be carried out by the robot are determined, and a behavior matrix is obtained; and adjusting the character matrix in combination with the state matrix and the stimulation matrix.

title: Walking type humanoid intelligent pesticide applying robot and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a walking type humanoid intelligent pesticide applying robot and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of agriculture. Before operation, a meteorological factor threshold value for starting/pausing/stopping pesticide spraying operation and parameters such as the height and the spraying width of the pesticide spraying operation are set; after the operation is started, according to the real-time monitored meteorological factors, the types and the occurrence amount of target pests in plaques to be applied with pesticides and the crop growth condition, the types and the dosage of applied pesticides are controlled in real time by controlling the flow of electric control valves of different pesticide boxes in real time, and the pesticide application operation is controlled to be started/paused/stopped in real time according to the meteorological factors; and various monitoring and operation data are transmitted back to a background control end in real time in the whole process. The application of the invention greatly improves the technical level of pesticide spraying, greatly reduces the pesticide dosage, and has a very wide application prospect.

title: Humanoid robot motion training method and device based on real scene
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion training method and device based on a real scene. The humanoid robot motion training method and device are used for improving the performance of a humanoid robot running in the real scene. Constructing a world model for training the humanoid robot; generating an initial motion control strategy for the humanoid robot; training an initial motion control strategy of the humanoid robot in the simulated environment; enabling the humanoid robot to enter the real world to execute real world scene motion; real scene motion data of the humanoid robot in the real world scene motion process are collected in real time through a sensor; real scene motion data and real-time motion actions determined by the initial motion control strategy are input into a world model in real time for interactive training, and a robot simulation state at the next moment is generated; performing error analysis on the simulation state of the robot at the next moment and the real state of the robot at the corresponding moment in the real scene motion data to generate a total prediction error; and updating the initial motion control strategy according to the total prediction error.

abstract: The present invention provides a rehabilitation wearable robot performance evaluation system (1) and a control method thereof, characterized by comprising: a humanoid robot dummy (10) to which a rehabilitation wearable robot can be mounted and capable of implementing joint motions; a control unit (20) for controlling driving of the humanoid robot dummy (10) and receiving a signal of the rehabilitation wearable robot to control test execution for performance evaluation of the rehabilitation wearable robot; a storage unit (30) in electrical communication with the control unit (20) and storing preset data of a model simulating a rehabilitation patient; a calculation unit (40) in electrical communication with the control unit (20) and calculating a motion trajectory of the humanoid robot dummy (10) for simulating a rehabilitation patient; a sensing unit (50) for sensing interaction state information between the humanoid robot dummy (10) and the rehabilitation wearable robot; and a test controller (25) including executing test control for performance evaluation of the rehabilitation wearable robot using the interaction state information sensed by the sensing unit (50) and the preset data stored in the storage unit (30).

title: MANAGING ROBOTS IN WORKFLOWS WITH HUMAN INTERVENTION
abstract: A robotic system includes a plurality of humanoid robots configured to move within a commercial environment to autonomously perform one or more tasks; and a control system communicably coupled to the one or more humanoid robots and including a human operator interface. title: Humanoid robot capable of flying for rescue
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot capable of flying for rescue, and relates to the technical field of robots. A camera and a voice device are arranged on the head-shaped frame, adjusting mechanisms are connected to the two sides of the human-shaped frame, each adjusting mechanism comprises a motor arranged in the human-shaped frame, and a first bevel gear is arranged at the driving end of each motor. title: Compact hydraulic drive waist and hip integrated pelvis structure
abstract: The invention relates to a pelvic bone structure, in particular to a compact hydraulic drive waist and hip integrated pelvic bone structure. The problems that an existing humanoid robot driven by hydraulic pressure is complex in system structure, large in part number, large in weight and numerous in oil pipe are solved. A waist joint comprises two waist transmission chains, two waist pitching transmission assemblies and a waist rotation driving part, the two waist transmission chains are vertically installed on a pelvic skeleton, and the waist rotation driving part is installed between the two waist pitching transmission assemblies and engaged with a gear between the two waist pitching transmission assemblies; the two hip joints are mounted on the left side and the right side of the pelvic skeleton; each hip joint comprises a hip yawing transmission chain and a hip side-sway transmission chain, the hip yawing transmission chains are horizontally mounted in the pelvic skeleton, the hip side-sway transmission chains are vertically mounted in the pelvic skeleton, and the hip yawing transmission chains and the hip side-sway transmission chains are connected with one ends of the thigh connecting pieces. The invention is applied to the biped robot.

title: Method and equipment for calibrating upper body of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robot calibration, and discloses a method and equipment for calibrating the upper body of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: (1) respectively collecting calibration data through two closed loops of a binocular camera, a holder, a left mechanical arm and a left tail end target and a binocular camera, a holder, a right mechanical arm and a right tail end target; (2) representing the three-dimensional coordinates of the measured target point by adopting a conversion relation between a visual coordinate system and the target point and a relational expression between the estimated values of the three-dimensional coordinates of the target point, and further forming a multi-dimensional equation set; and (3) constructing a target optimization function according to the Mahalanobis distance between the measured value of the calibration data and the obtained estimated value, and performing iterative backstepping on the unknown coordinate system conversion relation in the multi-dimensional equation set and the three-dimensional coordinate of the target point in the coordinate system at the tail end of the mechanical arm based on the target optimization function until convergence, and the relational expression is determined based on the unknown coordinate system conversion relation obtained through current back-stepping, and then calibration is completed. The calibration precision is improved.

title: Robot anthropomorphic motion control method and system based on skeleton mapping
abstract: The invention discloses a robot anthropomorphic motion control method and system based on skeleton mapping. The method and system are used for enhancing anthropomorphic motion performance and environment adaptability of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a scale proportion and a posture transformation matrix between a human body and the humanoid robot based on initial posture data; according to the motion data, recursively calculating original pose information of each human body joint in a world coordinate system through a forward kinematics algorithm; mapping the original pose information into expected pose information of the humanoid robot on the key coordinate system by applying a scale proportion and a pose transformation matrix; a target joint angle of the humanoid robot is solved according to the expected pose information, and contact state information of legs of the humanoid robot and the ground is calculated according to the target joint angle; and the target joint angle and the contact state information serve as input, a motion control strategy of the humanoid robot is trained through a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and humanoid motion control over the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Shank structure, leg device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a shank structure, a leg device and a humanoid robot. The shank structure comprises a humanoid shank shell, a bearing support and a foot driving mechanism. The human-like shank shell has an external shape similar to a human shank, and a cavity is formed in the human-like shank shell; the bearing support is installed in the cavity in the height direction of the humanoid shank shell. The foot driving mechanism is used for driving the feet to act, and the foot driving mechanism is arranged in the cavity and installed on the bearing support. In this way, the humanoid effect is achieved through the humanoid shank shell, the main supporting effect is achieved through the bearing support, and the stability and attractiveness of the structure are both considered.

title: Human-shaped bionic robot face and eyebrow expression structure based on stepping motor driving
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid bionic robot face and eyebrow expression structure based on stepping motor driving, which comprises four stepping motors, two eyebrow driving blocks and two face driving blocks, the two eyebrow driving blocks are fixedly arranged at the output ends of the two stepping motors respectively, and the two face driving blocks are fixedly arranged at the output ends of the two stepping motors respectively. title: Humanoid robot joint motor rotor yoke
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot joint motor rotor yoke which comprises an annular fixing support, a plurality of division bar protrusions are evenly arranged on the outer wall of the annular fixing support, a containing groove used for containing magnetic steel is formed between every two adjacent division bar protrusions, at least two pieces of magnetic steel are installed in each containing groove, and the magnetic steel is fixed to the annular fixing support. And a limiting structure is arranged between at least one side of the magnetic steel and the placing groove. The magnetic steel is sleeved with the rubber injection ring, and the rubber injection ring makes contact with the outer wall of the magnetic steel. The arrangement of the rubber injection ring can block the outer side of the magnetic steel to prevent the magnetic steel from being thrown out of the placing groove due to centrifugal force. The supporting piece is fixed to the inner ring of the fixing support, and a concentric through hole is formed in the supporting piece. A mounting ring groove is formed in the peripheral side of the concentric through hole, and at least one mounting hole is formed in the mounting ring groove. And a plurality of circular ring through holes are formed in the supporting piece on the peripheral side of the concentric through hole. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, good magnetic steel fixing effect and easy processing.

title: Humanoid robot arm assembly zero positioning structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid robot arm assembly zero positioning structure which is characterized in that a first joint mechanism comprises a plurality of joint motor modules, a joint motor module A and a joint motor module B are connected through a first connecting support, and the joint motor module B and a joint motor module C are connected through a second connecting support; the second joint mechanism comprises a joint motor module D and a joint motor module E; the push-pull rod joint mechanism comprises a joint motor module F, a joint motor module G, a pull rod and a suspension support assembly. The zero-position loss detection device is simple in overall structure, convenient to operate, capable of finding out zero-position loss more quickly and accurately, and low in cost.
