title: Multifunctional intelligent exoskeleton robot
abstract: The invention provides a multifunctional intelligent exoskeleton robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the multifunctional intelligent exoskeleton robot comprises a waistband assembly which is worn on the trunk of a user and is provided with a backpack assembly which is carried on the back of the trunk of the user, and the backpack assembly is fixedly connected with an air water collection assembly and a suspension arm assembly; the two hip and knee joint exoskeleton assemblies are worn on the legs of the user, the two hip and knee joint exoskeleton assemblies are connected with the waistband assembly through the energy storage assembly, floating assemblies and bulletproof assemblies which can be rapidly disassembled are arranged on the hip and knee joint exoskeleton assemblies, and the bulletproof assemblies wrap the knee joints of the legs of the user; the two ankle joint exoskeleton assemblies are worn on the feet of the user. title: Fast distributed humanoid robot state estimation method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a fast distributed humanoid robot state estimation method, system and device and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring IMU sensor data and vision measurement data; non-linear attitude estimation is carried out based on IMU sensor data and visual measurement data, and floating base attitude estimation information at the next moment is obtained; contact information and leg joint information are obtained, after physical constraint is carried out based on the contact information, linear movement window estimation is carried out according to the leg joint information and the attitude estimation information of the floating base at the next moment, and speed and position estimation information of the floating base at the next moment is obtained; and when linear movement window estimation is carried out, speed estimation information and position estimation information are optimized by adopting a marginalization method. According to the method, the calculation complexity can be reduced, and meanwhile, the accuracy of state estimation and the resistance to noise and model uncertainty are improved.

title: Multipurpose humanoid biped robot based on three-point visual identification system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-purpose humanoid biped robot based on a three-point visual recognition system. The multi-purpose humanoid biped robot comprises an upper body unit; the head unit is located at the upper end of the upper body unit; the arm units are located on the left and right sides of the upper body unit; the leg units are integrated on the left side and the right side below the upper body unit through hip joint units; a visual sensor is integrated in the head unit, and the shooting angle of the visual sensor is adjusted through a head movement module integrated in the head unit. The head of the biped robot has two degrees of freedom, so that the head can pitch and rotate, meanwhile, the visual sensor is carried, information of the surrounding environment can be collected in real time, and main information input is provided for the robot.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent scheduling system under multi-task processing
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of scheduling systems, in particular to a humanoid robot intelligent scheduling system under multi-task processing, which comprises an analysis module, a control module, a sorting module and a scheduling module, the analysis module is used for analyzing and obtaining task-related information and transmitting the task-related information to the control module; the control module obtains task factors according to information related to tasks and transmits the task factors to the sorting module; the sorting module sorts the plurality of different task factors according to a numerical sorting mode, and transmits the plurality of sorted task factors to the scheduling module; and the scheduling module carries out scheduling processing on the task corresponding to the task factor with the maximum numerical value after sorting, and transmits scheduling information to the robot.

title: PPS high-strength temperature-resistant composite material, preparation thereof and application of PPS high-strength temperature-resistant composite material in humanoid
abstract: The invention discloses a PPS high-strength temperature-resistant composite material, preparation thereof and application of the PPS high-strength temperature-resistant composite material in a humanoid robot. The composite material comprises the following raw material components: 35-55 parts by mass of polyphenylene sulfide, 20-40 parts by mass of a composite reinforcing agent, 2-8 parts by mass of a flexibilizer, 3-9 parts by mass of a conductive agent, 3-7 parts by mass of potassium titanate whiskers, 0.2-0.5 part by mass of a coupling agent and 0.1-1 part by mass of an antioxidant, and the composite reinforcing agent comprises more than two reinforcing agents with different forms and/or sizes. The obtained PPS high-strength temperature-resistant composite material is subjected to multi-scale enhancement and multifunctional modification on the basis of a PPS material, the performance limitation of an existing PPS material can be broken through, and powerful material support is provided for high-performance and intelligent development of humanoid robots.

title: HUMANOID CHATTING SYSTEM AND METHOD THEREOF
abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid chat system and method thereof, which is a system and method for implementing a humanoid robot that interacts and converses with a person. The humanoid chat method according to an embodiment of the present invention is a humanoid chat method in the HRI server (10) of a humanoid chat system including an HRI server (10) and a humanoid robot (50), the method comprising: receiving robot surrounding data including an image and a voice from the humanoid robot (50); analyzing the robot surrounding data to analyze a situation around the humanoid robot (50) and an emotion of a speaker of the voice; storing the analyzed situation and emotion; determining whether there is a conversation start code in the voice; and if there is the conversation start code, performing a conversation with the speaker based on the stored situation and emotion.

title: ROBOT HUMANOIDE CON MANOS QUE INCLUYEN MODULOS INTERCAMBIABLES PARA ATENCION A DISTANCIA Y TELEMEDICINA
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot for assisted care in patient monitoring and/or telemedicine. This humanoid robot has an articulated head, a torso, a mobile base, and articulated limbs that are arms in which each has a robotic hand with interchangeable modules that fulfill specific functions, such as communication with people, measurement of vital signs, among others. In addition, it has cameras, sensors for visualizing the environment and interacting with patients, and a navigation system that allows the humanoid robot to move.

title: Humanoid robot integrated joint module
abstract: The humanoid robot integrated joint module comprises a joint module body, the right end of the joint module body is fixedly connected with a fixing seat, and the outer surface of the fixing seat is movably connected with a mounting seat. According to the joint module disclosed by the invention, through the arrangement of the fixed seat and the mounting seat, the periphery of the joint module body can be limited while the joint module body and the humanoid robot joint are conveniently spliced by personnel, so that the joint module body is prevented from displacing in the front-back direction and the up-down direction in the use process; through the arrangement of a rotating disc, an annular frame, a guide plate, a clamping rod, a supporting ball, a through hole and a clamping groove, after the joint module body and the humanoid robot joint are spliced, a person can operate the rotating disc to rotate, so that the clamping rod can be inserted into the clamping groove; and the joint module body, the fixed seat, the mounting seat and the humanoid robot joint can be effectively locked and limited.

title: Moving mechanism applied to humanoid robot and control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a moving mechanism applied to a humanoid robot and a control method, a multi-stage lifting mechanism adopts modular hierarchical design and independent driving and sequentially comprises a first-stage lifting unit, a second-stage lifting unit and a third-stage lifting unit from bottom to top, and cylinders of all stages are nested to form a telescopic structure. Lead screw transmission optimization is adopted, a servo motor has a braking function, reinforcing ribs are installed on all levels of lifting units, and pressure sensors are arranged in top connecting pieces of three levels of columns. The bidirectional linear moving mechanism comprises a moving stator, a sliding seat and other components, and based on the coreless linear motor technology, the moving stator adopts a sectional permanent magnet array layout. The working space of the humanoid robot is expanded, the large load and micron-order positioning capacity are both considered, and therefore the problem that the working range of an existing humanoid robot is limited is solved.

title: Biped humanoid refueling robot and automatic refueling method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped humanoid refueling robot and a related refueling method. The biped humanoid refueling robot comprises a trunk, arm parts, a pair of lower limb parts and an executing mechanism used for implementing refueling operation. The executing mechanism is arranged at the tail end of the arm part; the lower limb part comprises a crotch part, a thigh part, a shank part, an ankle part and a foot part; the crotch part is connected with the lower end of the trunk and the upper end of the thigh part, and the crotch part has two degrees of freedom; the lower end of the thigh part is connected with the upper end of the shank part to form a knee part with one degree of freedom; the lower end of the shank part is connected with the foot part through the ankle part, and the ankle part has two degrees of freedom. The biped humanoid refueling robot provided by the invention has the capability of more flexibly adapting to a site, the robot can freely move through the lower limb part, the flexibility of the automatic refueling robot is improved, the requirement on the parking position of a vehicle to be refueled is low, and the refueling operation space is not limited.

title: Joint module of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a joint module of a humanoid robot, which is compact in structure and reduced in size and weight. According to the joint module, the size and the weight are greatly reduced, the installation convenience and applicability are improved, and the joint module is particularly suitable for industrial and humanoid robots with limited space. The absolute time grating encoder has high-precision position detection capability, can feed back joint position information in real time, and lays a foundation for high-precision motion in a complex task. The compactness of the joint module reduces the transmission loss among the components, meanwhile, the electromagnetic power-off brake is powered by the driver, extra power support is not needed, the energy consumption requirement is reduced, and the joint module is suitable for the humanoid robot with the high cruising ability requirement. Therefore, the problem that the control precision of a joint module of an existing humanoid robot is low is solved.

title: Face temperature abnormity early warning method based on human-type health care robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a face temperature abnormity early warning method based on a human-type health care robot and a medium. According to the preset moving speed of the human-type health care robot, the bimodal sensor array is indicated to carry out face image collection on the target user, and a current face collection infrared image is obtained; the environment sensor group is indicated to collect current collection background parameters in real time and input the current collection background parameters into the background parameter dynamic matching parameter model, and a current dynamic threshold value is generated; angular point feature extraction is carried out on the current face acquisition infrared image to obtain a forehead temperature and zygomatic temperature difference value, and the temperature rise rate of the target user in a preset time period is obtained; and according to the forehead temperature difference value and the temperature rising rate, matching with a current dynamic threshold value is carried out, a target grade abnormity early warning is obtained, and early warning operation is carried out. The problem that the health care robot cannot accurately carry out early warning interaction and cannot well guarantee the safety of the user is solved, early warning operation can be carried out in time, the safety of the user is guaranteed, and the user experience is improved.

title: Multi-mode wheel-leg separation type lower limb of humanoid robot and deformation method of multi-mode wheel-leg separation type lower limb
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode wheel-leg separation type humanoid robot lower limb and a deformation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The multi-mode wheel-leg separation type humanoid robot lower limb comprises a leg type mechanism connected with a wheel type mechanism through a connecting piece; the driving deformation assembly is in transmission connection with the leg type mechanism and the wheel type mechanism and used for driving the leg type mechanism and the wheel type mechanism to jointly deform into a leg mode or a wheel mode; when facing different scenes, the leg type mechanism can be flexibly selected to walk vertically or the wheel type mechanism can walk horizontally, the comprehensive moving performance is excellent, the comprehensive moving efficiency is greatly improved, and the application range is greatly widened. The leg type mechanism can be transformed into a clamping state and is matched with the upper limbs of the robot to achieve the functions of common grabbing and the like, and various working requirements can be met.

title: Wheeled chassis humanoid robot positioning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a wheel-type chassis humanoid robot positioning method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, the wheel-type chassis humanoid robot comprises a wheel-type chassis and a robot, the robot is arranged on the wheel-type chassis, the wheel-type chassis is provided with a wheel-type speedometer, and the wheel-type speedometer is provided with a wheel-type speedometer. The head of the robot is provided with a visual acquisition unit. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring pose data of a wheel type chassis through a wheel type odometer; acquiring visual pose data through a visual acquisition unit; and fusing the wheel type chassis pose data and the visual pose data to obtain the pose of the humanoid robot. According to the embodiment of the invention, the humanoid robot can be positioned more accurately.

title: Waist, crotch and leg assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the waist, crotch and leg assembly and the humanoid robot, the requirement for external space can be reduced, the waist, the crotch and the legs of the humanoid robot can all move at a large angle, the flexibility is high, and various action postures of the humanoid robot are completed with the small degree of freedom. The hip joint comprises a hipbone shell, an IMU unit, a hipbone driving assembly, a waist connecting piece, a leg unit and a knee driving unit. The hipbone driving assembly is connected with the leg unit and the waist connecting piece, and a knee driving unit is installed in the leg unit; the hipbone driving assembly is matched with the leg unit and the knee driving unit to control the waist, the crotch and the legs of the humanoid robot to move.

title: Linear actuator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a linear actuator and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of linear actuators. The linear actuator comprises a shell assembly, a driving piece, a torque transmission assembly, a ball screw assembly and an execution rod. The driving piece, the torque transmission assembly and the ball screw assembly are all installed in the shell assembly, and a driving shaft of the driving piece extends into the input end of the torque transmission assembly and is in static friction connection with the torque transmission assembly. The ball screw assembly comprises a screw shaft and a nut, and the output end of the torque transmission assembly is connected with the screw shaft; the nut is in threaded connection with the lead screw shaft and is in sliding fit with the shell assembly. One end of the execution rod extends into the shell assembly and is connected with the nut. According to the linear actuator provided by the invention, the technical problems of high system complexity and cost and low force control response speed caused by the fact that a linear actuator in the prior art cannot realize reverse driving and needs to be provided with a force sensor are solved.

title: Humanoid robot linear electric joint cogging torque compensation and evaluation method based on data driving
abstract: The invention discloses a data-driven linear electric joint cogging torque compensation and evaluation method for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of control of linear electric joints of humanoid robots. The problems that an existing humanoid robot linear joint cogging torque compensation method is long in consumed time, difficult to operate and poor in precision are solved. According to the invention, the motor rotates a circle in the forward direction and the reverse direction respectively, the forward current and the reverse current are sampled, and the position of the motor and the corresponding current at the position are recorded at the same time; determining the number of sampling points in the sampling time according to the rotating speed of the motor, calculating the number of position points of the motor, obtaining a mapping relation between forward and reverse currents and the position of the motor, and representing the position points of the motor by using the forward and reverse currents; based on the relation between the cogging torque and the forward current and the reverse current, the mapping relation between the position, represented by the forward current and the reverse current, of the motor and the corresponding cogging torque is obtained, and then iterative compensation is conducted on the joint cogging torque based on the position, represented by the forward current and the reverse current, of the motor and the corresponding cogging torque mapping relation.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on enhanced contrast learning algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method and device based on an enhanced contrast learning algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a training environment of a humanoid robot; constructing an initial neural network model and an enhanced contrast learning algorithm framework; determining a domain randomization parameter and a reward function of a training environment; based on the reward function and the domain randomization parameter, training the initial neural network model in a training environment through a reinforced contrast learning algorithm framework to obtain a trained neural network model; establishing a virtual test environment, and deploying the trained neural network model to the virtual test environment for model test optimization to obtain a target neural network model; and deploying the target neural network model into the humanoid robot to perform motion control on the humanoid robot. According to the method, the motion control stability of the humanoid robot is improved, meanwhile, the domain randomization parameters are used for simulating the parameters of the real environment, and the generalization and robustness of the model are improved.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot shoulder connecting structure, a robot and the humanoid robot to solve the problem that an existing shoulder connecting piece cannot achieve balance between assembly convenience and machining cost. title: Humanoid robot head

title: BIPEDAL ROBOT WITH INTEGRATED THRUSTER-ASSISTED LOCOMOTION
abstract: A bipedal robot having a legged assembly and an aerial assembly is described. The legged assembly includes two legs, each leg having a hip frontal joint, a hip sagittal joint, and a knee joint. The aerial assembly includes two thrusters mounted on a carbon fiber-aluminum composite mount. Actuators for the joints include 3D printed housings with embedded components. A controller generates walking trajectories and controls the thrusters to assist with stabilization and obstacle traversal. The robot is capable of dynamic multimodal locomotion, combining legged movement with thruster-assisted stabilization and jumping to navigate challenging terrain.

title: MECHANICAL END EFFECTOR
abstract: A mechanical end effector for a humanoid robot includes a plurality of identical finger assemblies. Each of the finger assemblies is removably connected to a frame. Each of the finger assemblies is fully self-contained and operable independently of every other one of the finger assemblies and independently of every other component connected to the frame. Each of the finger assemblies includes a single electric motor and is configured to be fully operable using only the single electric motor.

title: Parallel straight-knee biped robot driven by artificial muscles
abstract: The invention discloses a parallel straight-knee biped robot driven by artificial muscles, and relates to the technical field of bionic biped robots. The problems that an existing biped robot is bloated in structure, large in weight and insufficient in driving force are solved. The robot comprises a hip part (1) driven by a rotational joint motor, a leg part (2) driven by artificial muscles and a foot part (3). And the two rotational joint motors are respectively connected with one leg and the hip. Each leg is composed of two four-branch-chain 2R1T three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanisms sharing the static platform, each 2R1T parallel mechanism is driven by four artificial muscles, and each leg is totally provided with eight artificial muscles serving as driving elements. The two 2R1T parallel mechanism movable platforms are connected with the hip and the feet of the robot respectively. The robot foot is a large rigid flat plate and is used for stabilizing the robot. The size is small, the weight is light, and the robot motion inertia is reduced. The method is used for occasions of man-machine interaction or collaborative operation with human beings.

The robot comprises a hip part (1) driven by a rotational joint motor, a leg part (2) driven by artificial muscles and a foot part (3). And the two rotational joint motors are respectively connected with one leg and the hip. Each leg is composed of two four-branch-chain 2R1T three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanisms sharing the static platform, each 2R1T parallel mechanism is driven by four artificial muscles, and each leg is totally provided with eight artificial muscles serving as driving elements. The two 2R1T parallel mechanism movable platforms are connected with the hip and the feet of the robot respectively. The robot foot is a large rigid flat plate and is used for stabilizing the robot. The size is small, the weight is light, and the robot motion inertia is reduced. The method is used for occasions of man-machine interaction or collaborative operation with human beings.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on sequence feature processing
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on sequence feature processing, and the method comprises the steps: firstly, collecting motion data of a robot in different task scenes, and carrying out the preprocessing, so as to improve the data quality; then, a dynamic updating mechanism is adopted to extract local motion features, and the capturing capacity of short-time motion changes is enhanced; the motion trend of the robot is analyzed through an autoregression method, and the continuity and stability of a control instruction are improved. Based on the processing result, a self-adaptive control strategy is generated, so that the robot can optimize motion parameters in real time according to environment changes. The method shows high gait stability, energy consumption efficiency and motion adaptability in a simulation environment and an actual robot platform, and the motion control level of the humanoid robot in a complex task scene can be effectively improved. The method is suitable for various humanoid robot motion control tasks, and is especially suitable for an intelligent robot system with high stability and real-time performance requirements.

title: Humanoid dance numerical control fountain
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid dance numerical control fountain, and relates to the technical field of bionic robots, the humanoid dance numerical control fountain comprises a cavity on which a head is rotatably arranged; the rotating part is arranged at the bottom of the cavity; the walking assembly is rotationally arranged at the bottom of the rotating part and used for supporting the rotating part and the cavity; an upper gear and a lower gear which are used for driving the head part and the rotating part are rotationally arranged in the cavity respectively, and a motor is arranged in the cavity; the arm parts are rotationally arranged on the two sides of the cavity, and a water spraying module and a fire spraying module are arranged on the arm parts. According to the humanoid dance numerical control fountain, the output shaft of the motor is coupled with the upper gear or the lower gear through the clutch assembly, the head is driven to rotate through the upper gear, the infrared detector is arranged on the head, the surrounding environment is detected through rotation of the head, and the rotating part is driven to rotate through the lower gear; the effect of twisting the upper body of the robot is presented, and the ornamental value and interestingness are improved.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method based on point cloud clustering. Belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring at least two groups of continuous image information about a target object; obtaining target point cloud information corresponding to the image information, and performing clustering processing on the target point cloud information based on a target clustering algorithm to obtain first point cloud information corresponding to the target object; determining the state of the target object according to the image information; the state is static or dynamic; determining position information and direction information of the target object according to the first point cloud information and state corresponding to the target object; determining grabbing control information of the end effector according to the position information and the direction information of the target object; and controlling the end effector to grab the target object according to the grabbing control information. According to the method, the problem that the success rate of object grabbing of a current humanoid robot is low is solved.

title: Humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid welding robot which comprises a main body, a welding limb, an observing limb and a pincer limb, the main body is equivalent to the waist and the legs of a human body, the welding limb and the pincer limb are equivalent to the double arms of the human body, the observing limb is equivalent to the neck and the brain of the human body, a welding gun serves as an end effector of the welding limb, and a double-finger dexterous hand serves as an end effector of the pincer limb. A robot camera is carried at the tail end of the observation limb, and high-quality welding of complex welding seams can be completed through cooperation of the main body and the three branch chains. The whole robot adopts 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 joint configuration; the problems that current manual welding efficiency is low, working time is unstable, and welding quality is difficult to guarantee are solved. Meanwhile, rapid development in the high-end equipment manufacturing industry has vigorous requirements for welding, and the humanoid welding robot is wide in application prospect.

title: Lower limb exoskeleton control method based on upper limb big arm motion state as signal input
abstract: The invention provides a lower limb exoskeleton control method based on an upper limb big arm motion state as signal input, which completes control of a lower limb exoskeleton by taking upper limb big arm motion characteristics as signal input through a natural coordination relationship between upper limb big arm motion and lower limb motion of a human body. Comprising the following steps: S1, acquiring motion data of human big arms relative to a trunk; s2, according to the lower limb exoskeleton control method based on the upper limb and big arm motion state as the signal input in the claim S1, big arm motion data comprises at least one of an angle sensor, an encoder or an IMU acceleration sensor as a hardware basis, and the upper limb and big arm motion state is used as the hardware basis; angle data between the big arms and the trunk of the human body or motion data of any part of the big arms are measured, and the big arm motion state data comprise detection of an angle sensor, an encoder or an IMU acceleration sensor and later calculation between the big arms and the trunk; angle, angular velocity and angular acceleration at each moment; and position, velocity and acceleration degree data of any part of the big arm relative to the trunk. And S3, controlling the motion state of the lower limb exoskeleton by taking the motion data of the upper limbs and the big arms of the human body relative to the trunk obtained in the S2 as an input source. According to the method, the exoskeleton control design difficulty can be greatly reduced, meanwhile, high-precision following and high-speed response of the lower limb exoskeleton are achieved, and therefore the flexibility of the lower limb exoskeleton is improved.

title: Humanoid robot foot control method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot foot control method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, the humanoid robot foot comprises a tiptoe, an ankle and a heel, and the control method comprises the steps that in the off-ground stage of the humanoid robot foot, the angle of the ankle is controlled, so that the heel of the humanoid robot foot is firstly off the ground, and then the angle of the ankle is controlled; the tiptoe is lifted from the ground; and in the landing stage of the feet of the humanoid robot, the angle and the position of the ankle are controlled, so that the heels of the feet of the humanoid robot firstly touch the ground, and the tiptoes of the feet of the humanoid robot then touch the ground. The walking mode of the humanoid robot is closer to that of human beings, and walking is more natural.

title: Heavy-load leg system of humanoid robot
abstract: A large-load leg system of a humanoid robot comprises a thigh skeleton, a shank skeleton, a planetary roller lead screw assembly, a main dowel bar, an auxiliary dowel bar and a driver. The base end of the planetary roller screw assembly is fixed on the thigh skeleton through a base end joint ball bearing, and a planetary roller screw pushes an output end joint ball bearing to do reciprocating rectilinear motion; the other end of the auxiliary dowel bar is limited on the thigh skeleton, the other end of the main dowel bar is fixedly connected with the force sensor, the force sensor is movably connected with the shank skeleton through the main dowel shaft, and the shank skeleton rotates around the rotating shaft; the driver is used for controlling the relative linear motion of the planetary roller screw rod and the planetary roller screw rod, the driver is fixed on the driver heat dissipation plate, and the driver heat dissipation plate is fixed on the thigh skeleton; the shank skeleton is provided with a wiring hole and a wire embedding groove, and the tail end of the shank is provided with a bearing hole site; the hip joint pitching base is connected with the hip through a fastening screw A;

title: Facial action driving method and device, computer readable storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of facial action driving, and particularly relates to a facial action driving method and device, a computer readable storage medium and a robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target sound for driving a facial action; processing the target sound through a preset three-dimensional facial action model to obtain a first facial action corresponding to the target sound; wherein the first facial action is a human three-dimensional facial action based on hybrid deformation expression; performing mapping processing on the first facial action to obtain a second facial action corresponding to the first facial action; wherein the second facial action is a robot three-dimensional facial action based on hybrid deformation expression; and controlling a face motor of the robot to execute the second face action. According to the method and the device, the three-dimensional facial action based on hybrid deformation expression is adopted, and the human three-dimensional facial action is mapped into the robot three-dimensional facial action, so that the method and the device can be better applied to an entity bionic robot.

title: Biped robot gait planning method and device for step terrain
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot gait planning method and device for a step terrain, and belongs to the technical field of robot gait planning, the method comprises the following steps: based on a linear inverted pendulum model, respectively establishing walking modes of an upper step and a lower step of a biped robot; based on a walking mode, mapping the linear inverted pendulum model under the step terrain into a segmented virtual height linear inverted pendulum model under the plane terrain; based on a segmented virtual height linear inverted pendulum model, gait planning of the biped robot under the stepped terrain is achieved through model prediction control. According to the biped robot gait planning method and device for the step terrain, the linear inverted pendulum model with the virtual centroid height is used, the gait mode is established according to the terrain elevation information and the landing point information of the step environment, and the method and device can adapt to the irregular step terrain with the variable height and the variable length; and the gait has good terrain adaptability.

title: Multi-drive bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of multi-drive bionic humanoid robots, in particular to a multi-drive bionic humanoid robot, which is provided with a rotating mechanism and a cushioning mechanism, so that in the use process of the multi-drive bionic humanoid robot, the robot is protected by opening a device when the robot breaks down and is powered off, and the service life of the robot is prolonged. The damage to the robot is reduced; comprising a mounting mechanism; the device further comprises multiple sets of rotating mechanisms, two sets of driving mechanisms and multiple sets of cushioning mechanisms, the multiple sets of rotating mechanisms are rotationally installed on the installation mechanism, the two sets of driving mechanisms are installed on the installation mechanism, and each set of rotating mechanism is provided with one set of cushioning mechanism. The mounting mechanism is used for fixing, the rotating mechanism is used for rotating, the driving mechanism is used for driving, and the cushioning mechanism is used for damping.

title: Novel humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a novel humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a base, an outer covering plastic shell and a metal framework arranged on one side of the base. By starting a first linear motor, a second linear motor and a third linear motor, the first linear motor contracts and drives a motor connecting piece to conduct hinge joint, meanwhile, a first cross connecting rod is linked to conduct hinge joint, knuckles are bent and used for taking objects, and the second linear motor contracts and drives a head connecting piece to conduct hinge joint. During hinging, the position of the fingertip knuckles of the thumb can be adjusted according to the requirement for object taking so as to assist in object taking, meanwhile, a third linear motor is contracted so that a third cross connecting rod and a fourth cross connecting rod can be hinged, meanwhile, the fingertip knuckles of the thumb can be bent, and object taking can be assisted; therefore, the purpose of flexibly adjusting the dexterous hand is achieved, the dexterous hand is suitable for taking objects in different shapes, and meanwhile the dexterous fingers can move independently.

title: Leg structure of robot, robot, biped robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure of a robot, the robot, a biped robot and a humanoid robot, the leg structure of the robot comprises: a shank, the shank comprises an upper hinge end, an extension section and a lower mounting end; the first lower mounting part is detachably connected with the lower mounting end; the second lower mounting part is detachably connected with the lower mounting end, and an outer ring of the first bearing is arranged on the first lower mounting part; the outer ring of the second bearing is arranged on the second lower mounting piece, and the central axis of the first bearing and the central axis of the second bearing are collinear; a foot; the foot connecting shaft is arranged on the foot, the first end of the foot connecting shaft is arranged on the inner ring of the first bearing, and the second end of the foot connecting shaft is arranged on the inner ring of the second bearing. title: Humanoid robot imitating human body structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot simulating a human body structure. The humanoid robot comprises a machine frame, a PLC, two leg assemblies and two arm assemblies, wherein the two leg assemblies drive the machine frame to move spatially, and the two arm assemblies are arranged on the machine frame. Each of the arm component and the leg component comprises at least one joint piece, a rod piece connected with the joint piece and a driving motor for driving the rod piece to relatively deflect; the corresponding output ends of the PLC are in signal connection with the control input ends of the corresponding driving motors respectively, the driving motors are arranged on the machine frame in a centralized mode, the machine frame is further provided with wire wheels, the number of the wire wheels is equal to that of the driving motors, and all the driving motors transmit the corresponding wire wheels, then transmit soft brake wires wound on the wire wheels and then transmit the corresponding rod pieces. The device has the advantages of being relatively simple in structure, low in manufacturing cost, high in anti-overload capacity, finer, more flexible and more natural in action and more convenient to maintain.

abstract: To address such problems that when a figure acting as a person operating a robot toy is placed inside a body of the robot toy, the body itself becomes unnaturally large and it is difficult to secure a space inside the body to place a movable mechanism, and when the figure is placed above the robot toy, the movable range of the robot toy's arms and head is limited.SOLUTION: A bipedal robot toy includes a head, arms, an upper torso to which the head and the arms are connected, two legs, and a lower torso to which the two legs are movably connected and which is movably connected to the upper torso, and a boarding part is connected to a rear of the lower torso.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: CONTROL METHOD FOR SELF-COLLISION AVOIDANCE OF WALKING ROBOT HAVING MANIPULATOR, AND WALKING ROBOT FOR PERFORMING SAME
abstract: The present invention relates to a control method for self-collision avoidance of a walking robot equipped with a manipulator and a walking robot performing the same, the control method including the steps of: modeling a first collision-possible part of a manipulator and a second collision-possible part of a robot body into three-dimensional shapes each having line segments and a circular cross section; calculating the shortest distance between a first line segment with respect to the modeled first collision-possible part and a second line segment with respect to the modeled second collision-possible part; calculating a relative Jacobian between first and second points by applying a Jacobian matrix to the first point of the first line segment and the second point of the second line segment connecting the shortest distance; and calculating a speed for avoiding collision between the manipulator and the robot body by using the size of the three-dimensional shapes, the shortest distance between the first and second line segments, and the relative Jacobian between the first and second points.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control method for self-collision avoidance of a walking robot equipped with a manipulator and a walking robot performing the same, the control method including the steps of: modeling a first collision-possible part of a manipulator and a second collision-possible part of a robot body into three-dimensional shapes each having line segments and a circular cross section; calculating the shortest distance between a first line segment with respect to the modeled first collision-possible part and a second line segment with respect to the modeled second collision-possible part; calculating a relative Jacobian between first and second points by applying a Jacobian matrix to the first point of the first line segment and the second point of the second line segment connecting the shortest distance; and calculating a speed for avoiding collision between the manipulator and the robot body by using the size of the three-dimensional shapes, the shortest distance between the first and second line segments, and the relative Jacobian between the first and second points.

title: Robot head structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a robot head structure and a humanoid robot. The robot head structure comprises a head shell, the head shell is provided with eye areas, and the robot head structure further comprises a visual unit located in the head shell; the visual unit comprises a laser scanning module, the light emitting end of which is correspondingly arranged at the eye region, and the laser scanning module comprises a laser scanning motor and a laser scanning assembly; the laser scanning motor is used for driving the laser scanning assembly to rotate for laser scanning; the number of the first camera modules is N, N is greater than or equal to 1, and the viewing end is correspondingly arranged at the eye region; and the visual control board is connected with the laser scanning module and the first camera module. By means of the layout design, the size of the laser scanning module is reduced, the overall structure is more compact, and the laser scanning module is suitable for being used in a robot head with a narrow internal space. The operation stability and the control precision are improved, and a high-precision visual scheme suitable for the humanoid robot is provided.

title: Humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot situational social behavior expression method, which comprises the following steps of: sensing user behaviors by adopting multiple sensors, constructing a multi-layer interactive situation sensing structure, and establishing association between a human-computer interaction situation and the user behaviors; self-adaptive layered isolated word recognition and voice emotion recognition based on an optimized neural network are adopted, user voice features are fully utilized, a matching relation between user emotion and robot situational social action emotion is constructed, and an emotion-fused robot situational social behavior expression decision is provided. Therefore, the multi-modal social behavior expression of the humanoid robot, which can express emotions while implementing an interaction task, is realized. According to the method, the relationship between the user behavior and the interaction situation and the relationship between the interaction situation and the social behavior of the humanoid robot are constructed, the problem that in the prior art, the emotion interaction is less when the humanoid robot executes the social task is solved, and the environment situation and the user emotion are fully considered; and a multi-situation social expression realization path of the humanoid robot is provided.

title: Upper limb mechanical arm of humanoid industrial robot
abstract: The invention discloses an upper limb mechanical arm of a humanoid industrial robot, and particularly relates to the technical field of manipulator control, the upper limb mechanical arm comprises a mechanical main arm, a mechanical arm seat and a chuck, the mechanical arm seat is used for controlling the mechanical main arm to move, a heat dissipation seat is arranged in the mechanical arm seat, and the heat dissipation seat is used for keeping circulation of air inside and outside the mechanical arm seat; a safety assembly is arranged between the mechanical arm base and the heat dissipation base. The safety assembly is used for keeping a good ventilation environment near the heat dissipation base and the mechanical arm base. Through the arrangement of the safety assembly, the mechanical arm base, the heat dissipation base and the mechanical main arm, dust particle adsorption of a dust screen on the surface of the heat dissipation base can be prevented, impurities accumulated on the dust screen of the heat dissipation base are reduced, and the heat dissipation efficiency of the mechanical arm base and the mechanical main arm is improved; temperature rise of key components in the mechanical main arm and the mechanical arm seat is prevented, and the performance and the service life of the mechanical main arm and the mechanical arm seat are improved.

title: Head and neck assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a head and neck assembly and a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problems that the simulation degree of the head and neck assembly is poor, and the appearance of the humanoid robot is affected. According to the head and neck assembly, the head assembly is provided with the first containing space and the opening, the neck assembly is located on the side, facing the first direction, of the head assembly, and the opening faces the neck assembly, so that the neck assembly can stretch into the first containing space from the opening, and the junction of the head assembly and the neck assembly is more coherent and natural in transition; and the simulation degree of the head and neck assembly is increased. Besides, under the condition that the rotation angle of the head assembly around the first axis relative to the neck assembly is 0 degree, a gap is formed between the edge of the neck assembly and the edge of the opening, avoiding is provided for rotation of the head assembly around the first axis relative to the neck assembly, and the head assembly can smoothly rotate around the first axis relative to the neck assembly.

title: Swing electric cylinder for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robot joints, in particular to a swing electric cylinder for a humanoid robot, a rack is machined on a lead screw shaft, and the tooth height of the rack is distributed in a cubic curve mode in the axial direction in order to eliminate the change of a gap in the gear and rack transmission process. A motor rotor magnetic cylinder made of neodymium iron boron is welded to the outer circle of a nut of the reverse planetary roller lead screw pair, the rotor nut rotates, a lead screw moves front and back, a rack on the lead screw pushes a gear to rotate in a reciprocating mode, and a gear shaft drives a swing rod to swing. The swing angle of the swing rod is accurately positioned according to the front-back telescopic position of the lead screw shaft, and the nut rotates to drive the lead screw to move axially. The encoder detects angular displacement of rotation of the nut and transmits a signal to the controller. The controller controls angular displacement of the nut through the driver according to information fed back by the encoder. The swing electric cylinder can provide larger torque under the condition of the same weight. The problem that the flexibility of the humanoid robot is limited due to the fact that the humanoid robot is affected by the size and weight is solved.

title: Servo motor driving system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a servo motor driving system for a humanoid robot. A servo motor driving system is a core execution mechanism of the humanoid robot and directly affects the movement performance (such as flexibility, explosive power and energy efficiency) of the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot can be better controlled and driven, and more flexible and real actions are achieved. The servo motor driving system for the humanoid robot comprises a main body framework driving module, a joint driving module, a sensing module and a heat dissipation-buffering driving module which are installed on a robot framework. The main body framework driving module is installed at the main body positions of the humanoid robot framework (the hands, the legs, the waist and the like corresponding to the parts, with a large number of muscles, of the human body). The joint driving modules are mounted at the joints of the frameworks; the sensing module and the heat dissipation-buffering driving module are installed between the main body framework driving modules in a penetrating mode. Through the mutual cooperation of the main body skeleton driving module, the joint driving module, the sensing module and the heat dissipation-buffer driving module, the humanoid robot can be better controlled and driven, so that more flexible and real actions are realized.

title: Spatial parallel connection rod hand mechanism and human-shaped hand
abstract: The invention discloses a spatial parallel connection rod hand mechanism, which relates to the technical field of robots, and comprises a palm fixing piece, a thumb module and a four-finger module which are sequentially arranged on the palm fixing piece, and parallel connection rod systems which are respectively arranged on the thumb module and the four-finger module, the multi-degree-of-freedom, multi-fingertip-force and multi-moment grabbing movement of the human-shaped hand is achieved through the parallel connecting rod system. The invention further provides a humanoid hand which is used for a humanoid robot or a human body artificial limb. The robot is compact in structure, close to a human hand, good in dynamic responsiveness, capable of conducting real-time synchronous operation, good in load capacity, flexible in action and capable of executing various finger-to-finger motions.

title: MECHANICAL END EFFECTOR
abstract: The present disclosure provides an underactuated end effector for a humanoid robot. The end effector includes a frame, a plurality of finger assemblies removably connected to the frame, and a thumb assembly removably connected to the frame. Each finger assembly includes a finger motor assembly. The thumb assembly includes a first thumb motor with a first thumb motor shaft configured to rotate about a first motor shaft axis, and a first motor gear connected to the first thumb motor shaft. The thumb assembly also includes a second thumb motor with a second thumb motor shaft configured to rotate about a second motor shaft axis, and a second motor gear connected to the second thumb motor shaft. The first motor shaft axis is substantially parallel to the second motor shaft axis, and the first motor gear axis is substantially parallel to the second motor gear axis.

title: Amphibious humanoid robot underwater movement posture adjusting method
abstract: An amphibious humanoid robot underwater movement posture adjusting method comprises the following steps that a fixed coordinate system is established with the intersection point of the central axis of an amphibious humanoid robot and the connecting line of the gravity center and the buoyancy center as the original point, and a carrier coordinate system is established with the geometric center of the amphibious humanoid robot as the original point; establishing a first coordinate system by taking the geometric center of the thoracic cavity adjusting module as an original point, and establishing a second coordinate system by taking the geometric center of the leg adjusting module as an original point; based on the established coordinate system, a force balance equation and a moment balance equation of the amphibious humanoid robot are obtained through a static balance principle, and motion feedback and real-time adjustment of a control signal are achieved through a calculation execution module; determining the adjustment posture of the amphibious humanoid robot to obtain corresponding adjustment parameters; and the posture of the amphibious humanoid robot is adjusted according to the obtained adjusting parameters, so that the amphibious humanoid robot advances by keeping the optimal incident flow resistance coefficient.

title: Humanoid body intelligent mobile robot providing convenient service
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical rehabilitation wheelchair tools, discloses a humanoid body intelligent mobile robot providing convenient services, and remarkably improves the functionality and practicability of the humanoid body intelligent mobile robot. Comprising a mobile device, an execution device is arranged on the mobile device, and an intelligent brain device is installed on the execution device; the execution device comprises two groups of driving mechanisms with U-shaped structures; wherein one group of driving mechanism is arranged on the moving device and is provided with two executing ends, the two executing ends are respectively connected with one group of first lifting mechanism, the executing ends of the two groups of first lifting mechanisms are jointly connected with a mounting seat, and two groups of haunch supporting mechanisms are arranged on the mounting seat; the other set of driving mechanism is connected with the executing end of a second lifting mechanism arranged on the moving device, the two executing ends of the other set of driving mechanism are each connected with a set of seat plate mechanism, and the two sets of seat plate mechanisms are located below the axilla supporting mechanism and can form a hip supporting face after being unfolded.

title: Humanoid robot and form switching control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a form switching control method, and relates to the technical field of robots. The shank part is hinged to the thigh part; wherein the thigh part and the shank part are each provided with a wheel foot part, each wheel foot part comprises an adjusting assembly and a wheel type walking assembly, and the wheel type walking assemblies are connected with the thigh part and/or the shank part through the adjusting assemblies; the adjusting assembly is used for adjusting the relative position relation between the wheel type walking assembly and the thigh part and the shank part through the adjusting assembly, so that the wheel type walking assembly can replace the thigh part and/or the shank part to bear the weight of the humanoid robot; according to the humanoid robot and the form switching control method, rapid switching of a human foot walking mode, a double-wheel-foot walking mode and a four-wheel-foot walking mode can be achieved.

title: System and method for collaborative operation of humanoid robot and robot dog
abstract: The invention discloses a collaborative operation system and method for a humanoid robot and a robot dog. The system comprises a server, the humanoid robot and the robot dog. The server, the humanoid robot and the robot dog are interconnected through a hybrid communication network; the server receives a task request sent by an external system; creating a task execution instruction of the humanoid robot and a task search instruction of the robot dog; sending a task execution instruction to the humanoid robot, and sending a task search instruction and parameters carried by the task request to the robot dog; the robot dog responds to the task search instruction and carries out traversal search on a target site corresponding to the operation map; sending the searched to-be-processed object information and self operation parameters to the humanoid robot; and the humanoid robot responds to the task execution instruction and performs operation on the target site based on the to-be-processed object information shared by the robot dog. By adopting the embodiment of the invention, the collaborative operation of the humanoid robot and the robot dog can be realized, and the task execution efficiency is improved.

title: Intelligent obstacle avoidance system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent obstacle avoidance system and method for a humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, and solves the technical problem that an existing humanoid robot is insufficient in obstacle avoidance capability in an unstructured environment. Whether the obstacle can be avoided by executing the preset obstacle avoidance action or not is judged firstly, and if not, the non-obstacle contour of the inner side of the obstacle is recognized; judging whether the humanoid robot can pass through the non-obstacle contour or not based on a forward and inverse kinematics model; if yes, extracting a target attitude, and controlling the humanoid robot to pass through the obstacle according to the target attitude; when an obstacle cannot be avoided, whether the humanoid robot can pass through the non-obstacle contour on the inner side of the obstacle by adjusting the posture of each structural unit is analyzed, if yes, the target posture of the humanoid robot is determined based on a forward and inverse kinematics model, and the obstacle passing possibility of the humanoid robot is analyzed on the basis of the flexibility of the humanoid robot; the obstacle avoidance capability of the humanoid robot in an unstructured environment can be improved.

title: Sliding-mode control double-foot joint trajectory tracking optimization method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biped robot joint position control, and particularly relates to a reinforcement learning-based sliding-mode control biped joint trajectory tracking optimization method, which comprises the following steps of: establishing a kinematic model of an n-link mechanism according to a simplified link structure of a leg structure of a foot robot and by connecting adjacent links through joints, angular velocities of all joints and an end effector are obtained; establishing a dynamical model to obtain a relationship between a corresponding moment and a motion parameter; a sliding mode controller is designed with the tracking error of the difference between the ideal track of each joint and the actual track of the corresponding joint as a control target; and parameters of the sliding mode controller are updated in real time based on a reinforcement learning method, and adaptive sliding mode control is realized. According to the method, reinforcement learning and sliding mode control are combined, the reinforcement learning method is used for selecting parameters of the sliding mode controller in the control strategy, the control strategy is flexibly adjusted according to the changeable environment to make the optimal or suboptimal motion behavior, and environment self-adaption is achieved.

title: High-torque-density lightweight harmonic reducer of humanoid robot
abstract: The high-torque-density light-weight humanoid robot harmonic reducer comprises a rigid gear, a flexible gear and a wave generator, the rigid gear is of an annular structure with an inner gear ring, the tooth shape of the inner gear ring is an involute tooth shape, the flexible gear is of a thin-wall cup-shaped structure, an outer gear ring is arranged on the outer wall of the flexible gear, and the wave generator is arranged on the outer wall of the flexible gear. The tooth shape of the outer gear ring is matched with the tooth shape of the inner gear ring of the rigid gear, an installation shaft hole is formed in the center of the cup bottom of the flexible gear, the wave generator comprises an oval flexible bearing and a cam installed on the outer side of the flexible bearing, the cam is in interference fit with the flexible bearing, and the wave generator is installed in the installation shaft hole of the flexible gear. The flexible gear is used for enabling the flexible gear to generate elastic deformation, and a heat dissipation assembly is detachably installed in an installation shaft hole of the flexible gear. By arranging the heat dissipation assembly, the heat dissipation effect of the harmonic reducer is remarkably improved, the internal temperature is reduced, the working stability of the reducer during high-load operation is improved, and the service life of the reducer during high-load operation is prolonged.

title: Humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment
abstract: The invention provides humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problem that an existing super-long lead screw nut is low in machining efficiency when internal threads are machined is solved. The humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment comprises a rack, two sliding seats are arranged on the rack in the transverse direction in a sliding mode, a machining interval exists between the two sliding seats, one sliding seat is provided with a rotating disc capable of rotating, the rotating disc is provided with a chuck, and the rack is further provided with a first driving piece capable of driving the two sliding seats to move synchronously in the same direction and move oppositely. One sliding seat is provided with a chuck, the other sliding seat is provided with a tip, the chuck clamps a columnar cutter, one end of the columnar cutter abuts against the tip, the rack is slidably connected with a feeding seat located between the two sliding seats in the longitudinal direction, a mounting seat capable of clamping a workpiece is fixed to the feeding seat, and the mounting seat is provided with a second driving part capable of driving the workpiece to rotate. According to the humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, the machining efficiency can be further improved.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a humanoid dexterous hand, which comprises a palm part, a thumb and four fingers, the four fingers are respectively an index finger, a middle finger, a ring finger and a little finger, the structures of the index finger, the middle finger, the ring finger and the little finger are the same, the lengths of all knuckles are different, each finger comprises a finger body and a finger mechanical transmission chain, the thumb comprises a thumb body and a thumb mechanical transmission chain, and each finger and the thumb can be independently installed on the palm or detached from the palm. According to the humanoid dexterous hand, all the driving motors can be direct-current servo motors or stepping motors, and when fingers or the thumb stops bending and stretching movement, if the servo motors are adopted, a servo control system has the electric locking capacity due to the fact that the servo motors are in a closed-loop control mode; if a stepping motor is adopted, the stepping motor has a torque holding function, and the holding torque is far higher than the driving torque; all the power assemblies are externally arranged, namely, the power assemblies are not arranged in finger knuckle cavities.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb mechanism and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb mechanism and a working method thereof, solves the problem that a connecting rod force arm is small due to the fact that the position of a robot knee joint motor is too high in the prior art, and has the beneficial effect of enlarging the motion range of knee joints. The first power source is connected with the first rocker arm, the first rocker arm is connected with one end of the knee joint connecting rod, the other end of the knee joint connecting rod is connected with the first connecting rod shaft, the end, close to the thigh part, of the shank part supports the second connecting rod shaft, the thigh part supports the thigh gear shaft, and the shank part supports the shank gear shaft. The gear section of the thigh gear shaft is meshed with the gear section of the shank gear shaft, one end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting rod shaft, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the thigh gear shaft, one end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting rod shaft, and the other end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting rod shaft.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb mechanism and a working method thereof, solves the problem that a connecting rod force arm is small due to the fact that the position of a robot knee joint motor is too high in the prior art, and has the beneficial effect of enlarging the motion range of knee joints. The first power source is connected with the first rocker arm, the first rocker arm is connected with one end of the knee joint connecting rod, the other end of the knee joint connecting rod is connected with the first connecting rod shaft, the end, close to the thigh part, of the shank part supports the second connecting rod shaft, the thigh part supports the thigh gear shaft, and the shank part supports the shank gear shaft. The gear section of the thigh gear shaft is meshed with the gear section of the shank gear shaft, one end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting rod shaft, the other end of the first connecting rod is rotationally connected with the thigh gear shaft, one end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected with the first connecting rod shaft, and the other end of the second connecting rod is rotationally connected with the second connecting rod shaft.

title: Bionic attachment foot structure and humanoid robot with same
abstract: The bionic attachment foot structure comprises a connecting assembly and a self-adaption assembly, the connecting assembly comprises a connecting base, the connecting base is used for being connected with the humanoid robot, the connecting base is provided with a first matching part, the self-adaption assembly comprises a rotating base and an attachment part, the rotating base is provided with a first matching part, and the attachment part is provided with a second matching part. The rotating seat is provided with a second matching part, the first matching part is matched with the second matching part, the second matching part can rotate around the center point of the first matching part, the attachment part is detachably connected with the rotating seat and located on the side, close to the bottom face, of the rotating seat, the attachment part has an attachment state and a release state, and in the release state, a gap is formed between the attachment part and the ground; in the attaching state, at least part of the attaching piece makes contact with the ground. According to the bionic auxiliary foot structure, the balance of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the system complexity and cost of the humanoid robot are reduced.

title: High-density flexible piezoresistive fingertip tactile sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a high-density flexible piezoresistive fingertip tactile sensor and a preparation method thereof.The high-density flexible piezoresistive fingertip tactile sensor comprises a fingertip base, an electrode plate, a conducting layer, a flexible conducting layer and a signal acquisition module, the electrode plate is provided with a plurality of protruding electrode pairs, and the side, close to the electrode plate, of the conducting layer is provided with a plurality of tiny deformable protrusions; the flexible conducting layer is used for transmitting external deformation to the conducting layer, and the signal acquisition module is used for acquiring tactile data and sending the tactile data to the upper computer; the fingertip base is provided with a containing groove used for containing the electrode plate and the conducting layer, the fingertip base is provided with an annular fixing groove in the groove wall of the containing groove, the side, close to the base, of the flexible conducting layer is provided with a protruding part matched with the containing groove in an inserted and embedded mode, and the peripheral wall of the protruding part is fixedly connected with a flange matched with the annular fixing groove in a clamped and embedded mode. The touch perception level of the humanoid robot can be remarkably improved, and the operation precision and adaptability of the humanoid robot in a complex environment are enhanced.

title: Joint module and robot
abstract: The invention provides a joint module and a robot. The joint module comprises a first shell, a first-stage planetary mechanism, a second-stage planetary mechanism and a rotor connecting shaft, wherein the first-stage planetary mechanism and the second-stage planetary mechanism are arranged in the first shell; the first shell is provided with a first shell groove; the first-stage planetary mechanism comprises a first inner gear ring, a first sun gear coaxially connected with the rotor connecting shaft, a first planet carrier arranged between the first inner gear ring and the first sun gear, and a first planet gear arranged on the first planet carrier and meshed with the first inner gear ring and the first sun gear; the second-stage planetary mechanism comprises a second inner gear ring, a second sun gear coaxially connected with the first sun gear, a second planet carrier arranged between the second inner gear ring and the second sun gear, and a second planet gear arranged on the second planet carrier and meshed with the second inner gear ring and the second sun gear. According to the structure, the axial length of the joint module is reduced, the weight is reduced, and the joint module is made to adapt to the narrow space layout of the humanoid robot.

title: Human-shaped machine walking training architecture based on multiple encoders and training method of human-shaped machine walking training architecture
abstract: According to the humanoid machine walking training architecture based on the multiple encoders and the training method thereof, the training architecture comprises the first encoder and the second encoder, the first encoder and the second encoder are optimized through variational auto-encoders, the decoding process of the first encoder is optimized through privileged information of the next frame, and the decoding process of the second encoder is optimized through the privileged information of the next frame. The decoding process of the second encoder is optimized based on observation information of a next frame, the system further comprises a feature fusion module and a near-end strategy optimization module, the output of the first encoder and the output of the second encoder are respectively connected with the feature fusion module, the feature fusion module is connected with the near-end strategy optimization module, and the near-end strategy optimization module is connected with the near-end strategy optimization module. The walking stability and adaptability of the humanoid robot under complex terrains are remarkably improved, so that the robot can stably walk on stairs, slopes, uneven road surfaces and road surfaces with different roughness, and the practicability and reliability of the humanoid robot in practical application are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot joint linear motor control method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot joint linear motor control method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, humanoid robot joints comprise a first linear motor, a second linear motor, a limb pitching joint and a limb rolling joint, and the first linear motor and the second linear motor are connected with the limb pitching joint and the limb rolling joint after being connected in parallel. The control method comprises the following steps: acquiring an expected first angle and an expected second angle; obtaining a theoretical first length and a theoretical second length according to the expected first angle and the expected second angle; the output length of the first linear motor is controlled to be adjusted to a theoretical first length, and the output length of the second linear motor is controlled to be adjusted to a theoretical second length, so that the actual first angle is equal to the expected first angle, and the actual second angle is equal to the expected second angle; the first angle is the angle of a limb pitching joint, and the second angle is the angle of a limb rolling joint. The motion of the humanoid robot is closer to that of human beings, and the loading capacity is large.

title: Locking structure applied to soft magnetic motor
abstract: The invention discloses a locking structure applied to a soft magnetic motor, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot manufacturing. The device is characterized by comprising an outer coil, two rotors, a hole plate, a steering rudder, a positioning cone, two magnetic coils and an inner frame. The clamping pins in the gap of the mover are meshed with the clamping openings in the hole plate, and after the outer coil is powered off, the mover does not move reversely under the condition that the magnetic field driving force disappears. Repulsive force generated by the magnetic coil and the permanent magnet pushes the steering rudder to rotate. The positioning cone top is outside the inner angle, so that the steering rudder is fixed. The problems that a soft magnetic motor is large in power consumption and the motor is prone to heating are solved.

title: Gravity center adjusting device applied to humanoid service robot
abstract: The invention discloses a gravity center adjusting device applied to a humanoid service robot, and belongs to the technical field of service robots. The gravity center adjusting device applied to the humanoid service robot comprises a bottom plate, top plates are connected to the two ends of the top end face of the bottom plate in a threaded mode, a screw is arranged between the two top plates, one end of the screw is connected with one top plate through a bearing, and a motor is connected to the outer wall of the other top plate in a threaded mode; the other end of the other screw penetrates through the top plate and is fixedly connected with the output end of a motor, a balancing weight is installed on the screw through a thread, supporting plates are welded to the two ends of the end face of the bottom of the bottom plate correspondingly, a movable rod is welded between the two supporting plates, and sliding grooves are formed in the top and the bottom of the movable rod correspondingly. A sliding frame is installed on the movable rod in a sliding mode. The invention effectively solves the problem that the service effect is affected by the corresponding dumping phenomenon easily caused by the influence of gravity when the existing design is used and meets the terrains such as climbing and downhill.

title: Humanoid robot bionic skin mold design system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robots, and discloses a humanoid robot bionic skin mold design system and method.The system comprises a skin modeling module, a model partitioning module, a mold cavity injection molding module, a material curing module and a model post-processing module. A three-dimensional model of the bionic skin is generated through scanning data of the humanoid robot, high-precision injection molding is achieved through dynamic optimization of sensor layout and partitioned mold cavity design, material curing is regulated and controlled through partitioned temperature-pressure fields, and finally the real skin touch sense is simulated through a multi-scale surface reconstruction algorithm. The problems that in a traditional bionic skin mold design, the sensor layout is unreasonable, the adaptability of partitioned mold cavities is poor, and material curing is uneven are solved, and the mechanical property and the perceptual authenticity of the humanoid robot skin are remarkably improved.
