title: Adaptive humanoid robot gait optimization system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gait optimization systems, in particular to a self-adaptive humanoid robot gait optimization system based on deep learning, which comprises an analysis module, a control module and a communication module, the analysis module is used for processing related information of the step length, the gradient, the friction force and the load and transmitting the information to the control module; the control module obtains a climbing step length reference index according to related information of the step length, the gradient, the friction force and the load and transmits the climbing step length reference index to the communication module; the communication module transmits the climbing step length reference index to a robot foot control module; and the robot foot control module adjusts the climbing parameters according to the climbing step length reference index. The robot can automatically adjust gaits according to external environment changes such as gradient, friction force and load, the climbing requirement is met, and the self-adaptive capacity is high.

title: Servo motor rotation actuator for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of rotary actuators, in particular to a servo motor rotary actuator for a humanoid robot, which comprises a rotary actuator body, a mounting sleeve is fixedly connected to the bottom of the outer wall of the rotary actuator body, a base is inserted into the bottom of the outer wall of the mounting sleeve, and a clamping mechanism is movably mounted at the bottom of the inner cavity of the base. An ejection mechanism is movably installed in the position, below the clamping mechanism, of an inner cavity of the base. The rotary actuator body is fixed in the inner cavity of the mounting sleeve, the mounting sleeve is inserted into the inner cavity of the base, the insertion rod of the clamping mechanism is matched with the sliding block for clamping, and the first spring abuts against the sliding block and does not move, so that the mounting sleeve can be stably mounted in the base, and the rotary actuator body can be conveniently and stably mounted; the effect of improving installation convenience of the rotary actuator body is achieved, and the problem that installation is not convenient enough due to the fact that the rotary actuator body is fixedly installed through bolts is solved.

title: Robot leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robots, and discloses a robot leg structure and a biped robot, a hip joint module in the leg structure comprises a side extension driving module, a turnover driving module and a pitching driving module, one ends of the three modules are installed on a hip joint installation frame in a series connection mode, and the other ends of the three modules are connected with thighs; the knee joint module is located in the containing cavity of the thigh part, the knee joint module comprises a linear driving module, the fixed end of the linear driving module is rotationally connected with the upper portion of the thigh part, the movable end of the linear driving module is in transmission connection with the top of the shank part, and the linear driving module drives the shank part to do pitching motion through linear telescopic movement; the bottom of the shank part is hinged to the foot bottom part through a cross shaft structure, and the ankle joint module is arranged on the shank part and is in transmission connection with the foot bottom part so as to complete pitching and side stretching movement. The design of hybrid driving of the linear and rotary joint modules gives consideration to the requirements of high robustness and low energy consumption of the foot-type robot in a real scene.

title: Ankle mechanism of continuous carbon fiber bionic robot based on 3D printing
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a 3D printing-based continuous carbon fiber bionic robot ankle mechanism which comprises a carbon fiber bionic talus, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the top end of the carbon fiber bionic talus, and a first supporting frame is rotationally connected to the side, away from the transmission mechanism, of the top of the carbon fiber bionic talus; two ankle flexion and extension rotating discs are rotatably connected to the top of the first supporting frame, a second supporting frame is fixedly connected between the two ankle flexion and extension rotating discs, a sliding groove is formed in the first supporting frame, and a carbon fiber bionic calcaneus is fixedly connected to the top of the carbon fiber bionic talus. Through the synergistic effect of the ankle flexion and extension mechanism, the simulated joint torsion mechanism and the like, the motion mode of human feet can be highly simulated, so that the robot has better mobility and adaptability under the environments of complex terrains such as rugged mountain roads and steps.

title: Healthy old-age care robot system based on bimodal mobile chassis and control method
abstract: According to the healthy old-age care service robot based on the bimodal moving chassis, the operation stability of a mechanical arm is remarkably improved through intelligent switching of a moving form (omnidirectional wheel/crawler driving) and a fixed form (four-corner supporting legs and bionic suction cups). The system integrates a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm, a multi-level sensor and a light-weight AI algorithm, core functions such as tea and water supply, medicine and object feeding and health monitoring are achieved, and the cost of the whole machine is reduced to 30% of that of a traditional scheme. Innovatives include a bimodal chassis control algorithm, a magnetic suction quick-change mechanical arm interface, millimeter wave radar respiration detection and the like, and large-scale mass production feasibility is achieved.

title: Few-difference tooth speed reducer integrated at joint part of robot
abstract: The invention discloses a few-tooth-difference speed reducer integrated on a robot joint part, and belongs to the technical field of robot joint driving. Comprising an input system, an output system and a feedback system, wherein the input system comprises a driving part and a planetary gear, and the driving part drives the planetary gear to rotate; the output system comprises a fixed gear ring box body, an output gear ring and an output flange, the fixed gear ring box body and the output gear ring are both meshed with the planetary gear, the output flange is fixedly connected with the output gear ring, and the number of teeth of the output gear ring is 1-4 smaller than that of the fixed gear ring of the fixed gear ring box body; the feedback system is connected with the output flange, detects rotating speed, torque and rotating angle data in real time and transmits the rotating speed, torque and rotating angle data to a robot main control system. The device is small in size, high in torque density and suitable for humanoid robots and auxiliary medical equipment.

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot. The leg mechanism comprises a thigh structural part, a foot plate structural part, a shank structural part and an ankle steering engine. The upper end of the shank structural member is rotatably connected to the thigh structural member, and the lower end of the shank structural member is rotatably connected to the foot plate structural member. The ankle steering engine is installed on the thigh structural part and located on the upper side of the rotating connecting position of the thigh structural part and the shank structural part, and the output end of the ankle steering engine is connected with the foot plate structural part through the connecting rod assembly. According to the leg mechanism, the gravity center of the ankle steering engine can be lifted to the thigh structural part, particularly to the position above the anterior knee joint, on the basis, the overall gravity center of the leg mechanism can be improved, the rotational inertia of the leg mechanism can be reduced, and therefore the torque requirements of the anterior hip steering engine and the anterior knee steering engine can be reduced; the control response speed of the leg mechanism and the humanoid robot can be increased.

title: Reverse circulation type planetary roller lead screw pair for linear joints of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a reverse circulation type planetary roller lead screw pair for a humanoid robot linear joint, which comprises a long nut, a lead screw, a roller and a retainer, the lead screw is coaxially arranged in the long nut, the part of the lead screw arranged in the long nut is provided with a threaded section, the retainer is sleeved between the lead screw and the long nut, and the roller is arranged in the long nut. An anti-falling mounting groove is formed in the retainer, and the pin roller is rotationally mounted in the anti-falling mounting groove; annular groove teeth are formed in the surface of the roller, one side of the outer wall of the roller is meshed with the internal thread on the inner wall of the long nut, and the other side of the outer wall of the roller is meshed with the threaded section on the lead screw. Circulating reset components are installed at the two ends of the threaded section of the lead screw respectively, and the two ends of the pin roller make contact with the circulating reset components respectively. Compared with a traditional pin roller, the pin roller with the annular groove teeth can reduce the manufacturing difficulty, is convenient to machine, is matched with a retainer of an integrated structure, can simplify the machining steps and reduces the assembly difficulty.

Circulating reset components are installed at the two ends of the threaded section of the lead screw respectively, and the two ends of the pin roller make contact with the circulating reset components respectively. Compared with a traditional pin roller, the pin roller with the annular groove teeth can reduce the manufacturing difficulty, is convenient to machine, is matched with a retainer of an integrated structure, can simplify the machining steps and reduces the assembly difficulty.

title: Humanoid welding robot based on machine vision
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid welding robot based on machine vision. The right arm is configured to drive the first visual device to move to obtain image data; the welding visual processing device is connected with the first visual device and is configured to perform data processing on the image data to obtain welding information; and the robot controller is connected with the welding visual processing device, the left arm and the right arm and is configured to control the left arm and the right arm to move based on the welding information. The humanoid robot is applied to a welding scene, a welding gun is arranged on one mechanical arm of the humanoid robot, a visual device is arranged on the other mechanical arm of the humanoid robot, a welding gun arm and a visual arm are integrated on the same equipment and are of an independent movement structure, and the degree of freedom and the reachable range are greatly improved.

title: AI solar humanoid robot multi-scene adaptive system based on quantum calculation energizing and dynamic control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and discloses an AI solar humanoid robot multi-scene self-adaptive system based on quantum computing energization and a dynamic control method. The system comprises a quantum calculation module used for generating a dynamic path planning and energy optimization strategy, a multi-mode sensing unit, an integrated 3D visual sensor, a touch skin and six-dimensional force sensor, a bionic energy system, a perovskite-silicon laminated photovoltaic panel, a piezoelectric kinetic energy recovery device, a hydrogen fuel cell and a motion control unit. abstract: The invention discloses a bionic humanoid robot knee joint mechanism, a robot and a method, solves the problems that in the prior art, a humanoid robot is difficult to squat and stand up after squatting, and has the beneficial effect that the humanoid robot is convenient to smoothly stand up from squatting down. title: Biped robot task navigation method based on image segmentation and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot task navigation method based on image segmentation and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of feature objects obtained by performing image segmentation on panoramic image information acquired by a sensing module based on a target location; according to the spatial features of the plurality of feature objects, the spatial features of the biped robot and the spatial features of the target location, determining whether a target idle position exists in the target location; detecting that a target idle position exists in the target location, and determining a target behavior strategy according to the character recognition results of the plurality of feature objects; and controlling the biped robot to execute the target behavior strategy. The feature objects obtained after image segmentation is conducted on the collected panoramic image are detected for multiple times, the target behavior strategy of the robot is determined according to the detection result, the elevator taking delivery task is completed according to condition self-service decision, help is not needed to be provided by other elevator passengers, and the intelligence of the robot for executing the elevator taking delivery task is improved.

title: Equipment maintenance control method and device for robot training ground, equipment and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an equipment maintenance control method and device of a robot training ground, equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of industrial manufacturing equipment of a humanoid robot training ground, and the method comprises the steps: collecting visual data, text data and motion data, related to maintenance, of to-be-maintained equipment; training the multi-modal large model; generating an initial maintenance task corresponding to the sensing data through a maintenance control model; adjusting and optimizing the initial maintenance task according to the perception data through a reinforcement learning model to generate a target maintenance task; and performing maintenance control on the to-be-maintained equipment on the humanoid robot based on the target maintenance task. title: Simulation system and method for anti-fatigue design of flexible power cable of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot flexible power cable anti-fatigue design simulation system and method, and relates to the technical field of robots. According to the anti-fatigue design simulation system and method for the flexible power cable of the humanoid robot, through multi-field coupling simulation, cross-scale damage modeling, multi-objective optimization and virtual verification, fatigue damage of the cable in a complex working environment is accurately predicted, and an efficient simulation platform is provided for anti-fatigue design of the cable. The system specifically comprises a multi-field coupling and critical positioning module, a cross-scale damage modeling module, a multi-objective optimization module and a virtual verification and iteration module. Multi-modal data of cable deformation, friction heat generation and resistivity change are dynamically generated through multi-physics field coupling simulation, the evolution process of cable damage is analyzed, and design parameters are optimized to improve the fatigue durability of the cable.

title: Humanoid robot falling recovery control method based on multi-stage course learning
abstract: According to the humanoid robot tumble recovery control method based on multi-stage curriculum learning, robot tumble crawling actions are decomposed into a plurality of key frames, frame-by-frame staged learning is carried out, meanwhile, a mixed internal model and a reinforcement learning framework are introduced, the mixed internal model obtains a current observation value of a robot in real time, and through speed estimation, the robot tumble recovery control method based on multi-stage curriculum learning is realized. According to the method, feature information is obtained, the robustness of a strategy is enhanced, the difference between simulation and reality is reduced, a reinforced semester framework mixing internal optimization and near-end strategy optimization is combined, and through interaction with a simulation environment, robot learning is rapidly and stably transited from one key frame to the next key frame, learning of complex human shape motion behaviors is achieved, and the learning efficiency is improved. According to the application, the man-machine interaction safety performance is optimized, so that the robot can reliably operate in scenes needing close man-machine cooperation, such as medical care and home service, and a technical foundation is laid for constructing a more intelligent and safer next-generation service robot system.

title: Analysis method, system and equipment for cooling capacity of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot cooling capacity analysis method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an environment temperature, a first temperature and a working current of a heating part, and a second temperature of a cooling structure; performing temperature rise hybrid calibration on the first temperature and the second temperature according to the environment temperature and the working current to obtain calibrated temperature rise data; acquiring actual temperature rise data of the heating component, wherein the time window of the actual temperature rise data is the same as the time window of the calibrated temperature rise data; and according to the calibrated temperature rise data, cooling analysis is carried out on the actual temperature rise data, and a cooling capacity analysis result of the humanoid robot is obtained. According to the method, the accuracy of the cooling capacity obtained through analysis can be effectively improved, and the reliability and stability of the humanoid robot in the working process can be improved. title: Shoulder joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a shoulder joint structure and a humanoid robot, and the shoulder joint structure comprises a first supporting assembly, a second supporting assembly, a third supporting shell and an elastic rotating connecting assembly. Wherein the elastic rotating connecting assembly comprises an elastic containing frame, a connecting shaft, a supporting ring and a ball, impact is absorbed through inclined elastic deformation of an elastic supporting part, the ball rolls in an annular rolling groove to achieve low-friction rotation, and the problem that a traditional bearing is prone to damage due to hard connection is solved. Meanwhile, the elastic supporting part adopts pre-tightening installation and limiting design, so that lossless disassembly and assembly are facilitated; and the connecting arms and the ball ring grooves are geometrically optimized, so that stress concentration and ball clamping stagnation are avoided. The shoulder joint structure is applied to the humanoid robot and connected between the trunk and the arms, collision energy can be effectively buffered when the robot falls down, the protection effect is achieved, assemblies can be rapidly disassembled and assembled, the maintenance cost is reduced, the impact resistance and maintainability of the shoulder joint of the robot are remarkably improved, and the service life of the shoulder joint of the robot is remarkably prolonged.

title: Far-end transmission humanoid robot joint module
abstract: The utility model provides a far-end transmission humanoid robot joint module, and mainly relates to the technical field of robot joints. A lead screw is fixedly arranged at the top of the servo motor, the outer ring of the lead screw is in threaded connection with a lead screw sleeve, and the lead screw sleeve is in transmission connection with the chain transmission assembly. abstract: Transport system (1) for internal material transport comprising a tugger train (2) comprising a towing vehicle (3) and at least one tugger train trailer (4a; 4b; 4c; 4d) configured to carry a load carrier (5a; 5b; 5c; 5d), in particular a trolley (15a; 15b; 15c; 15d), characterized in that the transport system (1) comprises a humanoid robot (10) configured to control the towing vehicle (3), wherein the humanoid robot (10) is configured to operate a steering actuation element of a steering drive of the towing vehicle (3), to operate a drive actuation element of a traction drive of the towing vehicle (3), and/or to operate a brake actuation element of a braking device of the towing vehicle (3).

title: Biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network heat dissipation method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network heat dissipation method for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot heat dissipation. The biological blood vessel bionic liquid cooling network heat dissipation method for the humanoid robot comprises the following steps: carrying out embedded near-node heat dissipation with a driving source by utilizing a first heat dissipation unit according to the aorta-level local high-heat-flow heat dissipation requirement of a chip located at the brain of the humanoid robot through biological bionic mapping and global partition cascade thermal control; aiming at the high-dynamic multi-heat-source heat dissipation requirement of a joint motor located at a movable joint part of the humanoid robot, indirect heat dissipation with a driving source is carried out by utilizing a second heat dissipation unit; according to the capillary-level low-heat-flux heat dissipation requirement of a power battery located on the chest of the humanoid robot, self-driven indirect heat dissipation is conducted through the capillary pump effect by means of a third heat dissipation unit; and for vein-level liquid cooling backflow, large-area natural convection air cooling heat dissipation on the skin surface is simulated for global heat discharge, and finally the bionic liquid cooling heat dissipation method for the system-level humanoid robot is formed.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises a plurality of structural parts which are sequentially connected, the adjacent structural parts rotate relatively through driving parts, and the rotating axes of the adjacent driving parts are perpendicular to each other. The driving part comprises a horizontal driving part and a vertical driving part, the rotating axis of the horizontal driving part is perpendicular to the extending direction of the mechanical arm, and the rotating axis of the vertical driving part is parallel to the extending direction of the mechanical arm. An output shaft of the horizontal driving part drives the adjacent structural parts to rotate through the single cantilever, and a first wire harness fixing structure is arranged at the tail end of the horizontal driving part. An output shaft of the vertical driving piece is connected with a first crossed roller bearing through a connecting inner shaft sleeve, and the first crossed roller bearing is installed on an outer ring of the connecting inner shaft sleeve. After being led out from the first wire harness fixing structure, the wire harness extends along the side wall of the vertical driving piece, penetrates through the inner ring connected with the inner shaft sleeve and then extends to the first wire harness fixing structure of the next horizontal driving piece.

title: Compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of force sensors, in particular to a compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor. In order to solve the problems that the overload capacity of a traditional cantilever beam structure is insufficient, a novel I-shaped beam and II-shaped beam structure is difficult to miniaturize and the requirements of a humanoid robot for high overload capacity and a compact structure cannot be met at the same time, the following technical scheme is provided: the six-dimensional force sensor comprises an outer frame; the cross beam is mounted in the outer frame; the vertical beam is vertically arranged at the central position of the cross beam; the connecting block is arranged at one end, far away from the cross-shaped beam, of the vertical beam; the outer frame, the cross-shaped beam, the vertical beam and the connecting block are integrally designed; and the mounting plate is mounted on the connecting block. The mounting requirements of humanoid robot joints and other space-limited scenes are met, multi-time rated load impact can be borne, and the movement safety and the complex task execution capacity of a robot are improved.

title: Humanoid robot field obstacle identification method based on transform feature enhancement
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot field obstacle recognition method based on transform feature enhancement. The method comprises the following steps: S1, firstly, acquiring image data of an environment by using a camera and acquiring point cloud data of the environment by using a laser radar; s2, making the data collected in the desert environment into a three-dimensional data set for subsequent model training detection; s3, constructing a network model; and S4, for a radar point cloud branch, voxel features and voxel coordinates are obtained, a laser radar branch follows a SECOND architecture, point cloud and image data of a 3D obstacle area encountered on a patrol detection path are collected, information of a 3D obstacle target is output through analysis and calculation, a dynamic feature index (DFI) module is introduced, and the 3D obstacle target is obtained. The voxel features of the point cloud are projected to the image coordinate system by using the internal and external parameters obtained through offline calibration, the initial projection coordinates are obtained, and the method is more accurate than the method of directly projecting the voxel features to the image by using the internal and external parameters of the radar.

title: Personalized emotion perception method for autistic children based on tactile interaction
abstract: The invention provides an autism child personalized emotion perception method based on tactile interaction, and the method comprises an identification stage: employing a trained autism child personalized emotion identification model to identify tactile behavior data in a man-machine interaction process of an autism child and a human-shaped accompanying robot, and obtaining an emotion classification result; in the model training stage, the personalized emotion recognition model of the autism children comprises a public feature extractor, a domain independent feature extraction and classifier, a domain general feature extraction and classifier and an aggregation prediction classifier. The training process of the personalized emotion recognition model for children with autism comprises the following steps: acquiring tactile behavior data; dividing the tactile behavior data into source domain data and target domain data; obtaining a source domain feature and a target domain feature through a common feature extractor; obtaining a domain independent classification result through a domain independent feature extraction and classifier, and obtaining a domain general classification result through a domain general feature extraction and classifier; and obtaining a classification result of the emotion category through an aggregation prediction classifier.

title: Rigid-flexible coupling humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention provides a rigid-flexible coupling humanoid manipulator which comprises a humanoid rigid-flexible coupling manipulator mechanical body, a wrist tube connected with a hand body and a driving control system and a hand body driving control system, a thumb and palm connecting piece drives a thumb to do palm-facing movement, and a steering engine module is in transmission connection with fingers and the thumb through a plurality of driving ropes. The fingers and the thumb can do flexion or abduction movement, and the fingers can do lateral deviation abduction movement; and elastic ligaments are connected to joints of the fingers and the thumb. Through the autonomous variable-stiffness metacarpophalangeal joints, the bionic interphalangeal joint system and the hand-simulated hand movement system of the elastic envelope structure, dexterous movement and contact compliance of the manipulator in a complex operation task are achieved, and the dynamic balance requirement of the manipulator between dexterous operation and rigid maintenance is met; the invention has the advantages of excellent movement performance, strong environmental adaptability, low manufacturing cost and the like.

title: Diffusion strategy leapfrog sampling robot control method and system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a robot control method and system for diffusion strategy leapfrog sampling, equipment and a medium, and the method mainly comprises the steps that network parameters and hyper-parameters are initialized, the Q function gradient estimation state sensitivity is calculated based on the current state, and the current state is calculated based on the Q function gradient estimation state sensitivity. Self-adaptively adjusting leapfrogging parameters according to the magnitude of the Q function gradient estimation state sensitivity; executing action and environment interaction, including determining a sampling sequence according to the leapfrogging parameter to execute DDIM sampling, and obtaining an action from a policy network; and sending the action into a simulation environment for interaction to obtain a next state and action reward. According to the method, through an innovative deterministic diffusion process leapfrog sampling technology, the calculation complexity and the sampling time are remarkably reduced, and meanwhile the high quality of strategy generation is kept. The method is particularly suitable for a humanoid robot control system, can efficiently process a complex high-dimensional action space, and realizes a real-time and flexible control strategy.

title: Humanoid robot based on deep reinforcement learning, shooting method and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot based on deep reinforcement learning, a shooting method and a storage medium, and relates to the field of humanoid robots and deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps that the shooting task of the humanoid robot is divided into three sub-tasks including ball approaching, ball taking and shooting, a decision model of each sub-task is obtained through deep reinforcement learning training, and the humanoid robot conducts action decision through the models obtained through training to complete the shooting task. The shooting process of the humanoid robot is divided into a sensing module, a decision-making module and a control module, the sensing module carries out characterization learning through a convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism, the decision-making module carries out action decision-making through an improved SAC algorithm, and action execution is controlled by executing a predefined action group.

title: Method for generating anthropomorphic walking gait of self-balancing lower limb exoskeleton
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic walking gait generation method of a self-balancing lower limb exoskeleton. The method comprises the following steps: initializing a reference zero moment point track, a centroid sagittal plane track and a sole track according to a human body walking motion rule; generating transverse movement of the self-balancing lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton by adopting a previewing control method based on the initialized reference zero moment point track; on the basis of the initialized centroid sagittal plane track and the sole track, sagittal motion is generated through a straight knee optimizer and a stable filter, the straight knee optimizer is used for optimizing hip joint tracks of different heights, and the stable filter is used for generating hip joint tracks meeting dynamic constraints; and solving the inverse kinematics by adopting a Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm to obtain each joint track of the self-balancing lower limb rehabilitation exoskeleton. By utilizing the method, the anthropomorphic walking gait with the characteristics of mass center height change, knee straightening, heel landing and toe off-ground can be generated.

title: Rigid-flexible series-parallel humanoid leg biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a rigid-flexible series-parallel humanoid leg biped robot which comprises a horizontally arranged base. The driving modules are arranged at the two ends of the base; the middle platform is correspondingly arranged below the two ends of the base; the cable-driven parallel mechanism is connected with the output end of the driving module and the middle platform; the foot ends are arranged below the corresponding middle platform; the connecting rod transmission mechanism is connected with the foot ends, the middle platform and the SR connecting rods; according to the robot, under driving of the cable-driven parallel mechanism, the foot ends have six degrees of freedom consistent with the legs, the flexibility is higher, and the requirements of complex scenes are met; an S-R-U branch chain in the robot is consistent with an actual human leg motion mode, a mixed connection mechanism can adopt a series structure kinematics solving method, and the gait planning process is greatly simplified; rope driving is adopted, the inertia is small, the load ratio and the working space are large, and the requirements for light weight and flexibility of the robot are met; the driving part and the transmission part both adopt parallel structure design, and the whole robot has the advantages of high precision and good stability.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: A multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot dexterous hand belongs to the technical field of robot dexterous hands, the dexterous hand is provided with five fingers, the rear side of each finger is provided with an upper-layer driving module and a lower-layer driving module, the upper-layer driving modules are used for driving the fingers to curl up and stretch, the upper-layer driving modules and the fingers form an integral structure, and the lower-layer driving modules are used for driving the fingers to curl up and stretch out. The lower-layer driving module is used for driving the whole structure to swing left and right and rotate in a three-dimensional mode, the bottom of the lower-layer driving module is fixedly connected with the outer wall of a shell at the palm portion of the dexterous hand, and the upper-layer driving module and the lower-layer driving module do not interfere with each other. And the lower-layer driving module is used for controlling finger actions through a connecting rod rotating table structure. According to different action stress states of the fingers, a layered and modularized driving layout scheme is innovatively designed, on the premise that the space layout is effectively saved, two additional degrees of freedom can be added to each finger, and the flexibility and grabbing precision of the dexterous hand are greatly improved.

title: Humanoid robot finger magnetic touch sensor system with bimodal sensing function
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot finger magnetic tactile sensor system with a bimodal sensing function, and relates to the technical field of tactile sensor systems. A magnetic touch sensing module is included, and bimodal force sensing is achieved through a microstructure material; the signal conditioning module optimizes the signal by means of an adaptive neural network; the data acquisition and processing module, a multi-core heterogeneous processor and a deep learning algorithm are used for extracting features and calculating force information; the communication and interface module is used for transmitting data by adopting chaotic encryption and multiple protocols; the mechanical structure module uses a bionic material and a variable rigidity joint; and functional modules of self-calibration, temperature compensation and the like are also arranged. Positive pressure and tangential force are accurately sensed, signal processing is efficient, environmental interference resistance is high, and data transmission is safe and reliable; the mechanical structure flexibly adapts to various tasks, reliability and endurance are improved through fault diagnosis and energy management, and the robot is assisted to complete complex operation.

title: Soft humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a soft humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The soft humanoid robot comprises an inflation mechanism, an adapter plate and two telescopic mechanisms. The air inflation mechanism comprises an air inflation piece and a first air inflation driving piece, the air inflation piece comprises a ball part and two branch parts located on the two sides of the ball part respectively, and the branch parts can be folded in the direction close to the ball part; the bottom of the ball part and the first inflation driving piece are both mounted on the top surface of the adapter plate; the telescopic mechanism comprises a first telescopic air bag assembly and a second telescopic air bag assembly, the first telescopic air bag assembly is rotationally connected with the bottom surface of the adapter plate, the other end of the first telescopic air bag assembly is rotationally connected with the second telescopic air bag assembly, and air bags and second inflation driving parts are arranged in the first telescopic air bag assembly and the second telescopic air bag assembly. The adapter plate plays a role in supporting the inflation mechanism and the two telescopic mechanisms. According to the soft humanoid robot provided by the invention, the technical problems of high cost and low safety of a humanoid robot in the prior art are solved.

title: Motion online generation and control method and system for whole-body coordinated walking of humanoid robot, computer readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot motion control, and discloses an online generation and control method and system for whole-body coordinated walking motion of a humanoid robot, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. According to the method, in walking motion generation, a whole-body walking motion track including upper body joint motion information is generated in real time by adopting a whole-body kinematics-centroid dynamics model; a model predictive control model is adopted to realize organic combination of motion trail generation and real-time tracking control; and solving the model prediction control model, and taking the optimal state x * and the corresponding control input u * as the input of whole body control. According to the method, in the planning stage, namely the whole-body walking motion trail including upper body joint motion information, the whole-body dynamic characteristics of the arms, the waist and the like are comprehensively considered, and a new method of long-time-domain trajectory optimization and online control is combined, so that real whole-body coordinated walking is fundamentally realized.

title: Humanoid robot leg four-bar mechanism design optimization method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of link mechanism design algorithms, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot leg four-link mechanism design optimization method which comprises the following steps: simplifying a leg mechanical structure, and abstracting a mathematical model of a four-link mechanism; establishing a kinematic model of rotation of the four-bar mechanism, and calculating a rotation angle; analyzing kinematic characteristics of the four-bar mechanism in the rotating process; and establishing alternative schemes based on different combinations of the design parameters, and screening an optimal design scheme according to constraint conditions and dynamic characteristics. According to the method, a mathematical model for solving unique design parameters is not established, but a semi-empirical method is adopted, and an optimized design scheme is screened out by traversing possible combinations and analyzing dynamic characteristics one by one. According to the method, the multi-parameter model is established based on the four-connecting-rod mechanism, an optimization scheme is screened in combination with experience, the difficulty of establishing a complex model is reduced, the efficiency is improved through establishment of a unified design process, and the universality of the method is improved through introduction of manual analysis.

title: Rod end knuckle bearing
abstract: The rod end knuckle bearing comprises a rod end body, an inner hole is formed in the rod end body, an inner ring is installed in the inner hole in a matched mode, an annular limiting groove is formed in the outer spherical surface of the inner ring, and a limiting pin used for being matched with the annular limiting groove in a limiting mode so as to limit the swing freedom degree of the inner ring in the designated direction is fixed to the rod end body. The limiting pin is arranged on the rod end body, meanwhile, the annular limiting groove is formed in the outer spherical surface of the inner ring, and therefore the swing freedom degree of the inner ring in the left-right direction can be limited through limiting cooperation of the inner side end of the limiting pin and the annular limiting groove; and the walking stability of the humanoid robot can be effectively improved.

title: Series-parallel multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical lower limb simulating human leg movement
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a series-parallel multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical lower limb simulating human leg movement. The invention aims to provide a series-parallel multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical lower limb simulating human leg movement, so that the pose control of the mechanical lower limb can be flexibly realized, the whole machine body is driven to move to obtain the desired movement and pose, and the balance of a connected robot and the like can be ensured in the movement process. According to the technical scheme, the series-parallel multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical lower limb simulating the leg movement of the human body is characterized in that the series-parallel multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical lower limb comprises a double-leg connecting structure connected with a mechanical upper limb and two mechanical single legs connected with the double-leg connecting structure through a first rotating pair capable of rotating around the horizontal axis; each mechanical single leg comprises a hip joint, a knee joint and an ankle joint which are sequentially connected from top to bottom.

title: Redundant drive parallel waist mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot, in particular to a redundant drive parallel waist mechanism for the humanoid robot. The redundant drive parallel waist mechanism for the humanoid robot has the advantages of being large in working space range, high in precision and large in bearing capacity. According to the technical scheme, the redundant drive parallel waist mechanism for the humanoid robot is characterized by comprising a waist platform connected with upper limbs of the humanoid robot, a pelvic bone base connected with lower limbs of the humanoid robot and six branches connected between the waist platform and the pelvic bone base in parallel; the six branches comprise four first branches and two second branches; or the six branches comprise four third branches and two fourth branches.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot control method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that an expected zero moment point of a humanoid robot is obtained; judging whether the expected zero moment point is in a double-foot supporting domain or not; if the expected zero moment point is not in the double-foot supporting domain, obtaining an adjusting track, an adjusting force and an adjusting moment; and enabling the humanoid robot to move according to the adjusting track, the adjusting force and the adjusting moment so as to enable the expected zero moment point to return to the double-foot supporting domain. Adjustment can be carried out when the expected zero moment point of the humanoid robot exceeds the two-foot supporting domain, and toppling of the humanoid robot is prevented.

The method comprises the steps that an expected zero moment point of a humanoid robot is obtained; judging whether the expected zero moment point is in a double-foot supporting domain or not; if the expected zero moment point is not in the double-foot supporting domain, obtaining an adjusting track, an adjusting force and an adjusting moment; and enabling the humanoid robot to move according to the adjusting track, the adjusting force and the adjusting moment so as to enable the expected zero moment point to return to the double-foot supporting domain. Adjustment can be carried out when the expected zero moment point of the humanoid robot exceeds the two-foot supporting domain, and toppling of the humanoid robot is prevented.

title: Operation and charging all-in-one machine for humanoid robot and using method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a running and charging all-in-one machine for a humanoid robot and a using method of the running and charging all-in-one machine. The chassis structure is connected with the fixing structure through the supporting structure; the chassis structure comprises a movable chassis; a roller mechanism is arranged on the movable chassis; the supporting structure comprises a supporting pile; the fixing structure comprises a fixing support connected to the supporting pile. The movable chassis is connected with the fixed support through the supporting piles. A charging unit is arranged on the supporting pile, and the charging unit comprises a charger connected to the supporting pile; a locking mechanism is arranged on the fixed bracket; the locking mechanism comprises a sliding block which is connected to the fixing support and can move transversely. Product design is carried out according to the gravity center of the humanoid robot, the robot is rapidly fixed in a sliding block mode, then charging or battery replacing is carried out, and the occupied area of equipment is small.

title: Leg and foot structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a leg and foot structure and a humanoid robot, the leg and foot structure comprises a base, and the base is connected with a plurality of leg assemblies; the leg assembly comprises a thigh part and a shank part, and the upper end of the thigh part is matched with the base through a movable connecting assembly and can pitch in the longitudinal direction and swing laterally in the transverse direction; the shank part is connected to the lower end of the thigh part and tilts and deflects in the longitudinal direction; a first driving assembly is arranged on the base and used for driving the thigh part to pitch and laterally swing, and a second driving assembly is arranged at the thigh part and used for driving the shank part to pitch. According to the leg and foot structure and the humanoid robot, the leg and foot structure is improved, the first driving assembly drives the thigh part to achieve pitching adjustment and side-sway adjustment of the thigh part, meanwhile, the second driving assembly drives the shank part to be matched with the leg and foot structure to achieve coordination and stability of actions, and through the improvement, the leg and foot structure is more stable. The leg-foot structure is more flexible to control and adjust, and more coordinated walking actions can be realized.

title: Parallel mechanical joint simulating human ankle movement
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot, in particular to a parallel mechanical joint simulating human ankle movement. The invention relates to a parallel mechanical joint, and aims to provide a parallel mechanical joint simulating human ankle movement so as to realize two degrees of freedom of simulating human ankle movement on the basis of ensuring high rigidity and movement precision, and the parallel mechanical joint is simple in structure, good in supporting performance and capable of ensuring a certain movement space. According to the technical scheme, the parallel mechanical joint simulating human ankle movement is characterized by comprising a vertically-arranged shank, a foot connected to the bottom end of the shank through a composite rotating shaft, an RPR push rod branch connected between the shank and the composite rotating shaft and an SPS push rod branch connected between the shank and the foot.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom spherical joint motor module applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a three-degree-of-freedom spherical joint motor module applied to a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots. The three-degree-of-freedom spherical joint motor module comprises a sphere, a first permanent magnet direct current brushless motor, a second permanent magnet direct current brushless motor and a third permanent magnet direct current brushless motor; wherein the first permanent magnet direct current brushless motor and the second permanent magnet direct current brushless motor are located on the outer surface of the ball body and are arranged at an angle of 90 degrees in space, and the first permanent magnet direct current brushless motor is used for achieving rotation of the ball body around the X axis; the second permanent magnet direct current brushless motor is used for realizing rotation of the sphere around the Y axis; the third permanent magnet brushless direct current motor drives the first permanent magnet brushless direct current motor, the second permanent magnet brushless direct current motor and the sphere to rotate around the Z axis as a whole. The spherical joint motor module realizes 360-degree rotation of each motor around the respective rotating shaft, remarkably expands the movement range of the sphere, and has the advantages of compact structure, high space utilization rate and the like.

title: Four-foot two-arm robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of walking robots, and particularly relates to a four-foot two-arm robot which comprises a robot body, a gravity center balance mechanism and a reinforcing mechanism, the robot body comprises a base with a storage groove in the top, bionic driving feet located at the front end and the rear end of the bottom of the base and mechanical arms movably installed on the two sides of the top of the base; when the bottoms of the bionic driving feet press an obstacle or a slope, and the gravity center of one side of the robot body is unstable, the gravity center balance mechanism is automatically driven to work, and the gravity center of the robot body is automatically balanced; when the gravity center balance mechanism works, the reinforcing mechanism is automatically driven to synchronously work to reinforce the stability of objects in the object containing groove, the four-foot two-arm robot replaces a traditional four-foot two-arm robot, and the situation that when the four-foot two-arm robot walks in a complex road surface environment, due to the fact that the gravity center is not stable, self-balance cannot be corrected in time, toppling is caused, and the service life of the robot is prolonged is avoided. Therefore, the problem of damage to the user and carried articles is solved.

title: Reinforced learning motion control method and system for lower limbs of linear joint humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot control, and discloses a reinforcement learning motion control method and system for lower limbs of a linear joint humanoid robot, and the control method comprises the steps: structurally separating the physical coupling constraint of a linear motor and a rotary joint in a training environment; a reinforcement learning method is adopted, an actor-commentator method and privilege observation variables are supplemented, and multiple agents are trained in parallel; a trained strategy is deployed to a real machine, input and output of the strategy obtained through training are rotating joint information, actual robot control and collected data are linear joint motor side information, and the difference between simulation and reality can be overcome through the mapping relation of force, position and speed. Compared with a traditional position control method, the force control characteristic of the linear joint is used, and the higher adaptability is achieved; and meanwhile, a reinforcement learning method is used for training the linear joint humanoid robot, accurate modeling is not needed, and a global and long-term motility simulation algorithm stage and a deployment algorithm stage can be achieved.

title: Robot, control method and device thereof, joint self-locking structure and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a robot and a control method and device thereof, a joint self-locking structure and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: in response to a received robot standing instruction, controlling the robot to adjust a leg posture to a preset standing posture, and controlling the joint self-locking structure to lock the degree of freedom of a leg joint in at least one direction, and controlling the leg joints not to be enabled; and in response to a received robot walking instruction, the joint self-locking structures are controlled to relieve freedom degree locking of the leg joints, and the leg joints are controlled to enable and execute walking actions. According to the method, the leg joints of the robot can be locked or released through the joint self-locking structure, the posture can be kept without affecting standing of the robot even if the leg joints are not enabled when the leg joints are locked, and therefore the leg joints can be locked and enabled when the robot stands, energy consumption needed for enabling the joints is saved, and the robot can be more conveniently used. And when the robot walks, locking of the leg joints is relieved, so that walking of the robot is prevented from being affected.

title: Human fingertip-simulated touch sensor
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid fingertip tactile sensor, which comprises a humanoid phalanx, a touch sensor and a control module, the bottom permanent magnet is arranged on the anthropomorphic phalanx; the flexible circuit board covers the bottom permanent magnet; the separation fixing layer is arranged on the flexible circuit board and is provided with a mounting hole; the piezoresistive film and the top permanent magnet are mounted in the mounting hole of the separation fixing layer; and the silica gel contact layer is sleeved on the separation fixing layer. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of low sensitivity, low array, serious crosstalk between sensing units, low integration level and the like of a fingertip touch sensor in the existing robot sensing technology. According to the invention, a plurality of sensing units are distributed on the human-simulated fingertip, so that the detection of the magnitude of multi-contact pressure and the action position can be realized. The human fingertip simulating sensor can be installed at the tail end of the mechanical arm, and necessary tactile information is provided for achieving flexible operation.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation. Belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information about a target object; segmenting the image information of the target object based on an instance segmentation algorithm to obtain a target area corresponding to the target object; obtaining point cloud information corresponding to the target area according to the image information; according to coordinate information in the point cloud information, position information of the target object is obtained through calculation; performing principal component analysis on the point cloud information to obtain direction information of the target object; determining grabbing control information of the end effector according to the position information and the direction information of the target object; and controlling the end effector to grab the target object according to the grabbing control information. According to the method, the calculation accuracy of the position information of the target object in a complex scene can be improved, so that the capture success rate in the scene can be improved.

title: Humanized elevator taking method and system based on machine vision and mechanical arm interaction
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanization elevator taking method and system based on machine vision and mechanical arm interaction. The method comprises the steps that S1, the robot recognizes current floor information and calls an elevator; s2, the robot enters the elevator by adopting a humanization method; s3, after the robot enters the elevator, the target floor is pressed down; and S4, the robot intelligently leaves the elevator after judging that the robot arrives at the target floor. The robot has the advantages that the robot can take an elevator like a common person, the requirement of the robot for taking the elevator autonomously can be met, and manpower and economic cost are saved.

title: Humanoid mechanical foot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical foot which comprises an ankle, a main supporting assembly, a heel, an instep, toes, an arch and a force sensor. The ankle capable of axially rotating in multiple directions is connected with the top end of the force sensor, and the bottom end of the force sensor is connected with the first end of the main supporting assembly. A heel main body of the heel is rotationally connected with the second end of the main supporting assembly, and the heel main body is elastically connected with the main supporting assembly; the instep main body of the instep is rotationally connected with the third end of the main supporting assembly, and the instep main body is elastically connected with the main supporting assembly; the instep main body is elastically connected with toes; the arch is of a curved elastic structure, and the two ends of the arch are connected with the heel body and the instep body respectively. The invention further discloses the humanoid robot. The device has the beneficial effects that through coordinated work of a plurality of components, adaptability to different ground types is achieved, impact force is effectively absorbed, and vibration generated when the device falls to the ground is relieved.

title: Human-shaped orthopedic surgery robot and control system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid orthopedic surgical robot and a control system thereof, and relates to the technical field of surgical robots. The humanoid orthopedic surgery robot and the control system thereof comprise a robot upper body and a moving part arranged at the bottom of the robot upper body, a robot head is arranged at the top of the robot upper body, functional arms are arranged on the two sides of the robot upper body, and a moving wheel set is arranged at the bottom of the moving part. An auxiliary supporting assembly is arranged on the moving part and staggered with the moving wheel set. The robot can be flexibly moved and stably supported, meanwhile, the robot is provided with a mechanical arm to assist manual operation, the robot is further integrated with an illuminating lamp, a binocular stereoscopic vision camera, a touch display screen, a voice module and the like, meanwhile, the head turning and pitching functions are provided for the head, free tracking illumination and shooting can be achieved, and the robot is further integrated with a voice interaction system. And a storage space and a tool storage space are additionally arranged, so that medical staff can take and use the tool conveniently.

title: High-sealing-performance bearing structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bearings, and discloses a high-sealing-performance bearing structure for a humanoid robot, which comprises an inner ring, a retainer is arranged on the outer side of the inner ring, a plurality of roller bodies are arranged on the retainer, an outer ring is arranged on the outer sides of the roller bodies, and a lubricating oil injection port is formed in one side of the outer ring; the lubricating oil extrusion assembly is arranged on the outer side of the inner ring, and the lubricating oil extrusion assembly comprises a square groove. The outer side of the inner ring is provided with a second elastic piece and an extrusion plate, and when the inner ring rotates to generate centrifugal force, the second elastic piece and the extrusion plate move towards the inner wall of the retainer, so that lubricating oil staying in a space formed among the inner side of the retainer, the outer side of the roller body and the outer side of the inner ring is extruded towards the inner wall of the retainer; lubricating oil is in contact with the roller body through the flow dividing channels, so that the lubricating oil in the bearing can be in full contact with the roller body, a good lubricating effect is achieved, and waste of the lubricating oil caused by accumulation of the lubricating oil on the inner wall of the retainer is avoided.

title: Crus structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shank structure of a humanoid robot. Comprising a shank support, a foot plate, a six-dimensional force sensor, an ankle assembly, a push rod motor driving assembly, a rotation driving assembly and a buffering and damping assembly, the six-dimensional force sensor is installed on the foot plate, and the ankle assembly is installed on the six-dimensional force sensor; the rotation driving assembly is arranged above the ankle assembly, the push rod motor driving assembly, the buffering and damping assembly and the shank support are arranged between the rotation driving assembly and the ankle assembly, and one end of the ankle assembly and one end of the rotation driving assembly are hinged to the two ends of the push rod motor driving assembly respectively. The lower ends of the shank support and the buffering and damping assembly are hinged to the ankle assembly, the upper end of the shank support is fixedly connected with the rotary driving assembly, and the upper end of the buffering and damping assembly is hinged to the rotary driving assembly. The flexibility and action range of the shank part of the humanoid robot are improved, shank impact in the walking or jumping process of the humanoid robot is relieved, and the service life of the motor and other components is prolonged.

title: Humanoid robot shank structure and leg mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot shank structure and a leg mechanism, solves the problem of deep coupling between pitching motion and swinging of a foot sole of a robot in the prior art, and has the beneficial effect that the foot sole is convenient to control, and the specific scheme is as follows: according to the humanoid robot shank structure, the foot sole is rotatably connected with a shank; a first driving source and a second driving source are arranged on the shank, the first driving source is connected with one end of an ankle joint connecting rod through a first rocker, the other end of the ankle joint connecting rod is rotatably connected with the foot sole of the robot, and the first rocker, the ankle joint connecting rod and the foot sole form a double-crank mechanism so as to drive the foot sole to do pitching motion through the ankle joint connecting rod; the second driving source is connected with one side of the sole through a first transmission part, the second driving source is connected with the other side of the sole through a second transmission part, the first transmission part and the second transmission part are flexible transmission parts, and the second driving source acts to drive the sole to swing through the first transmission part and the second transmission part.

title: Damping leg of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a damping leg of a biped robot. The damping leg comprises an upper body support, hip joint composite driving mechanisms, thighs, knee joint motors, shanks, ankle joint spherical hinges, three layers of composite soles and adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers. The adjustable spring-damping shock absorber and the knee joint motor are connected between the thigh and the shank in parallel. The three-layer composite sole is divided into a bearing layer, a buffer layer and a contact layer below the ankle joint spherical hinge. The structural design that the adjustable spring-damping shock absorber is connected with the knee joint motor in parallel gets rid of the limitation of the installation range of a traditional built-in shock absorber, and efficient cooperation of shock absorption and driving is achieved. When the foot sole falls to the ground, the load is absorbed by the foot sole buffer layer and the adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers together, so that a multi-damping effect is formed.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a damping leg of a biped robot. The damping leg comprises an upper body support, hip joint composite driving mechanisms, thighs, knee joint motors, shanks, ankle joint spherical hinges, three layers of composite soles and adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers. The adjustable spring-damping shock absorber and the knee joint motor are connected between the thigh and the shank in parallel. The three-layer composite sole is divided into a bearing layer, a buffer layer and a contact layer below the ankle joint spherical hinge. The structural design that the adjustable spring-damping shock absorber is connected with the knee joint motor in parallel gets rid of the limitation of the installation range of a traditional built-in shock absorber, and efficient cooperation of shock absorption and driving is achieved. When the foot sole falls to the ground, the load is absorbed by the foot sole buffer layer and the adjustable spring-damping shock absorbers together, so that a multi-damping effect is formed.

title: System for optimizing energy flow and improving balance force of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a system for optimizing energy flow and improving balance force of a humanoid robot, which is characterized in that a new battery system formed by combining a flywheel energy storage battery and a lithium battery is adopted in a joint driving system of the robot, and the flywheel energy storage battery is used for replacing an original brake resistor; the flywheel energy storage battery comprises a first controller, a motor and a flywheel with a rotating shaft arranged in the center, the flywheel energy storage battery can store braking energy through the flywheel and recycle the energy, the energy utilization rate is greatly increased, and larger braking power can be provided within a short time.

title: Variable-sensitivity wide-range nonlinear sensor and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sensors, in particular to a variable-sensitivity wide-range nonlinear sensor and application thereof. According to the technical scheme, the device comprises a connecting assembly, and the connecting assembly comprises an inner rigid block; the outer ring is arranged on the outer side of the inner rigid block, a plurality of groups of connecting cylinders are mounted on the outer ring, and the connecting cylinders are connected with the output end or the operation end of a motor. abstract: The invention discloses a bionic facial structure and a high-fidelity facial expression interaction robot system. title: Humanoid robot welding pose adjusting method and system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot welding pose adjusting method and system, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The humanoid robot welding pose adjusting method comprises the steps that an initial state vector is constructed according to state information of a humanoid robot in the welding process; performing time sequence feature compression processing on the initial state vector to obtain a compressed state vector; inputting the compression state vector into a strategy optimization model to obtain an optimization action strategy output by the strategy optimization model; wherein the strategy optimization model is obtained by training according to a state information sample; according to the optimized action strategy, discretized joint rotation angle values of all joints of the humanoid robot are generated; and according to the discretized joint rotation angle values, the welding pose of the humanoid robot is adjusted. According to the method, a strategy optimization model based on an optimized long-short-term memory network and a multi-head attention mechanism is introduced, and self-adaptive adjustment and accurate control of the humanoid robot on the welding pose in the dynamic welding environment are achieved.

title: Biped robot segmented virtual slope inverted pendulum modeling method suitable for rugged terrain
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot segmented virtual slope inverted pendulum modeling method suitable for rugged terrains. According to the method, a virtual slope is established according to the positions of adjacent landing points of the rugged terrain, the centroid movement height is calculated, and forward and lateral centroid accelerations are obtained; the randomness of the height of the foothold position of the biped robot is considered, and adjacent virtual slopes are connected to establish segmented virtual slopes; introducing a centroid velocity concept before and after segmented virtual slope switching, and establishing an angular momentum relationship of supporting leg positions according to an angular momentum conservation law; establishing a centroid velocity relationship by considering velocity abrupt change at a slope switching junction in the same step period; introducing a state domain of the hybrid system, and respectively performing state representation on the mass center at a segmented virtual slope switching junction and a non-junction; and finally, establishing a dynamic model of the virtual segmented slope inverted pendulum considering the abrupt velocity change. According to the modeling method, the terrain adaptability and the movement stability of the biped robot on the rugged terrain can be effectively improved.

title: ROBOT
abstract: A robot according to an embodiment of the present application comprises: a robot body that can autonomously travel; a detection unit that detects conditions around the robot body; and a control unit that causes the robot body to autonomously travel according to the conditions detected by the detection unit. title: KINEMATICS OF A MECHANICAL END EFFECTOR FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a thumb assembly for an end effector for a humanoid robot. The thumb assembly includes a digit assembly comprising a proximal assembly, a medial assembly, a distal assembly, a proximal interphalangeal joint pivotably coupling the proximal assembly to the medial assembly, and a distal interphalangeal joint pivotably coupling the distal assembly to the medial assembly. The thumb assembly also includes a motor assembly comprising a first motor and a second motor, and a gear assembly. The gear assembly includes a flexion gear configured to be driven by the first motor to cause the digit assembly to move about a second carpometacarpal joint axis, and an interposition gear configured to be driven by the second motor to cause the digit assembly to move about a first carpometacarpal joint axis.

title: 3 The Robot Simulator System based on Data Acquisition of the Non-Rigid Human Motion and Real-Time 3D reconstruction of the Remote Environmental Information which supports Virtual Environment Visualization
abstract: The present invention relates to a real-time remote environment information relay-type robot simulator required for a plurality of remote workers to control a humanoid robot in a poor environment site. title: Shock resistance testing device for knuckle bearing of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint bearing shock resistance testing device, which relates to the field of robot safety testing and comprises a testing machine supporting seat, a limiting mounting frame, a testing table protective cover, a sliding sealing baffle plate, a positioning mounting rod, a timer pressing switch and a bearing limiting piece. The limiting mounting frame is fixedly connected to the rear side of the testing machine supporting seat; the test board protective cover is fixedly connected to the upper end surface of the test machine supporting seat; the sliding sealing baffle is slidably connected to the front side of the test board protective cover. title: Obstacle-avoiding and joint-avoiding extreme motion planning method for humanoid upper limb robot
abstract: An obstacle avoidance and joint avoidance extreme motion planning method for a humanoid upper limb robot belongs to the technical field of robots, and comprises the following steps: establishing a mapping relation between the tail end position posture of the humanoid upper limb robot and the angle of each joint to obtain a speed layer forward kinematics model; introducing an estimation error of a pseudo-inverse matrix corresponding to the Jacobian matrix and an estimation error of a null space basis matrix; establishing a hybrid error model based on the estimation error; constructing a recurrent neural network based on the hybrid error model; and according to a matrix value obtained by the recurrent neural network, a joint angle track of the humanoid upper limb robot is calculated through a control law. The joint limit and the obstacle constraint are considered at the same time, and the tracking precision and the convergence speed of the robot can be improved.

title: Method, system and terminal for aligning multiple sensing timestamps of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot multi-sensing timestamp alignment method, system and terminal, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining image records of images captured by a plurality of preset cameras; determining a main record and a comparison record according to the image record; determining a main timestamp based on the main record, and determining a comparison timestamp according to the main timestamp and the comparison record; determining an accumulated time error according to the main timestamp and the comparison timestamp; determining an optimal timestamp according to the accumulated time error; and synchronizing the comparison timestamps of the plurality of preset cameras according to the optimal timestamp. The method and the device have the effects of improving the data processing efficiency and speed and timely aligning data from different sensors.

title: Humanoid robot knowledge enhancement decision-making system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot knowledge enhancement decision-making system. A dynamic knowledge constraint mechanism is constructed through fusion of an industry knowledge graph and real-time sensor data. The system comprises an industry knowledge graph module for storing structured operation knowledge, an SPARQL query engine for extracting knowledge constraints, sensor data for generating environment vectors through state feature coding, a Q-learning algorithm combined with the knowledge constraints for dynamically adjusting a Q value updating strategy, balancing exploration efficiency and a security boundary, and outputting an optimization action instruction. The action parameter adjusting module converts an instruction into a mechanical arm control signal, an execution result generates feedback data through the effect evaluation module, and the graph increment updating module is driven to achieve knowledge base iterative optimization. According to the architecture, the problem of execution errors caused by semantic deviation in a traditional method is effectively solved, and reliability and operation accuracy of autonomous decision making in a complex dynamic environment are enhanced through knowledge-guided reinforcement learning and closed-loop verification of physical operation.
