title: Joint moment-based humanoid machine action coordination method and system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot action coordination method and system based on joint torque, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the original data of the joint torque of a humanoid robot through a sensor, carrying out the preprocessing of the original data of the torque, outputting stable torque data, constructing an impedance control model through the combination of the angle data of the mechanical arm joint of the humanoid robot, and carrying out the control of the mechanical arm joint. Predicting a moment change trend to obtain a predicted moment sequence; adaptive threshold detection is carried out on the predicted moment sequence, and moment peak values of different amplitudes are identified; analyzing the propagation velocity of the torque peak value, and calculating a velocity vector of peak value propagation by combining the propagation direction of the torque peak value; whether the velocity vector of peak propagation exceeds a preset threshold value or not is judged, and if yes, the response trend of a joint torque controller is predicted to judge whether joint control parameters of the humanoid robot need to be adjusted or not; and if the joint control parameters of the humanoid robot need to be adjusted, optimizing the rigidity and damping parameters of the impedance control model to output a stable control signal.

title: Humanoid robot welding method and device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and provides a humanoid robot welding method and device and a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that in the walking welding process of the humanoid robot, walking parameters of the humanoid robot at the next moment are determined based on the gravity center variation of the humanoid robot at the current moment; in the walking welding process of the humanoid robot, the pose of the welding mechanical arm at the next moment is determined based on the welding track deviation of the welding mechanical arm at the current moment, the walking parameters of the welding mechanical arm at the next moment, the pose of the welding mechanical arm at the current moment and a preset welding track; and based on the pose at the next moment, the welding mechanical arm is controlled to conduct welding. According to the method, the welding track can be accurately controlled, it is guaranteed that the welding arc is always located on the center line of the welding seam, the welding quality is improved, and then the welding precision, continuity and welding quality of the humanoid robot on the long welding seam are guaranteed.

title: Skin type robot facial expression control method and system based on vision and language model
abstract: The invention discloses a skin type robot facial expression control method and system based on a vision and language model. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining an input image; capturing an image corresponding to the target expression through a camera installed at the eyes of the robot; S2, extracting facial key point features of the input image; s3, preliminarily acquiring a parameter instruction of a robot face steering engine; s4, a robot face steering engine is driven; according to the skin type robot facial expression driving method developed by the invention, visual and language information is analyzed in a staged manner, the real-time driving effect of the robot facial expression can be realized, and the driving of the robot facial expression is finely adjusted by utilizing a large language model; the robot can show good distinction degree in some subtle expressions, and the developed skin type robot has vivid facial expressions and can be applied to multiple interaction fields such as text travel, medical treatment and education.

title: Humanoid model POSE action synchronization method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a mannequin POSE action synchronization method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining action instruction data: obtaining the action instruction data containing target positions and motion tracks of a plurality of joints of a mannequin through an input device; s2, the current posture is monitored in real time, wherein the posture and the environment of the mannequin are monitored in real time; s3, joint control is achieved, specifically, based on an intelligent joint controller, a closed-loop control system and a servo motor are used for controlling a plurality of joints of the mannequin; s4, action adjustment: dynamically adjusting action parameters of the joints through a self-adaptive control algorithm according to attitude data and external environment changes which are monitored and fed back in real time; and S5, data processing and feedback: processing feedback data from the multi-sensor system and the joint control module in parallel in real time. title: Geometric inverse solution method for seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm with shoulder joint offset
abstract: The invention discloses a geometric inverse solution method of a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm with shoulder joint offset. The robot is based on a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm, a shoulder joint of the humanoid arm is biased, and three axes of a wrist joint of the humanoid arm are orthogonal at one point; the origin position of the 0 coordinate system of the humanoid arm is the intersection point of the axes of the first joints of the left arm and the right arm, and the inverse solution method of the humanoid arm comprises the following steps that a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm DH coordinate system is established, and DH parameters of the seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm DH coordinate system are calibrated; performing forward kinematics solution of the humanoid arm according to the set DH parameters; according to the joint limit of the humanoid arm, the connecting rod angle theta 2 of the joint of the humanoid arm 2 is preset as a constant in the value interval, so that the degree of freedom is degraded; solving a connecting rod angle theta4 of a joint 4 of the shaft part and a connecting rod angle theta1 of a joint 1 through a geometric method; solving a connecting rod angle theta3 of the joint 3; and solving angles theta5, theta6 and theta7 of three joint connecting rods of the wrist part of the humanoid arm. The method has the advantages of being small in calculation amount, high in efficiency, reliable in calculation precision, easy to implement and the like.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geometric inverse solution method of a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid arm with shoulder joint offset. The method has the advantages of being small in calculation amount, high in efficiency, reliable in calculation precision, easy to implement and the like.

title: Ankle joint mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides an ankle joint mechanism and a humanoid robot, and the ankle joint mechanism comprises a first rotating part, a second rotating part and a driving device. The first rotating piece is configured to be rotatably connected with the shank profiling piece around a first rotating shaft, and the second rotating piece is rotatably connected with the first rotating piece around a second rotating shaft. The second rotating piece is used for being connected with the foot profiling piece. The driving device is configured to be arranged on the shank profiling part, the driving device is in transmission connection with the second rotating part, and the driving device is used for driving the second rotating part to drive the first rotating part to rotate around the first rotating shaft or driving the second rotating part to rotate around the second rotating shaft. The first rotating shaft extends in the width direction of the shank profiling piece, and the second rotating shaft extends in the thickness direction of the shank profiling piece. According to the ankle joint mechanism, the driving device drives the second rotating piece to move so as to adjust the posture of the foot profiling piece, and the ankle joint mechanism is simple in structure, convenient to control and capable of being suitable for various application scenes.

title: Robot voice control system
abstract: The utility model discloses a robot voice control system, which is applied to a humanoid robot and comprises an intelligent mobile terminal, and a microphone, a multi-protocol wireless transmission receiving module, an audio processing and power amplification module, a loudspeaker, a multi-protocol gateway and a voice recognition control mainboard which are arranged on a robot body, the microphone, the multi-protocol wireless transmission receiving module, the audio processing and power amplification module and the multi-protocol gateway are respectively connected with the voice recognition control mainboard, the intelligent mobile terminal is in communication connection with the multi-protocol gateway, the audio processing and power amplification module is further connected with the loudspeaker, the multi-protocol wireless transmission receiving module is further connected with the body control component, and the body control component is connected with the intelligent mobile terminal. And the voice recognition control main board is also connected with the body control part. title: Welding program generation method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of welding, and provides a welding program generation method of a humanoid robot and related equipment.The welding program generation method of the humanoid robot comprises the steps that a first workpiece image of a to-be-welded workpiece is obtained, and segmentation masks of the to-be-welded workpiece and a welding seam are determined based on the first workpiece image; determining three-dimensional contour points of the welding seam according to the three-dimensional point cloud of the workpiece to be welded and the segmentation mask; welding task information is obtained, and welding steps are inferred according to the welding task information and the three-dimensional contour points; according to the welding steps, the segmentation masks, the three-dimensional contour points and the initial operation skill of the humanoid robot, welding process parameters are determined and written into an initial welding program; and the initial welding program is tested in the simulation environment corresponding to the to-be-welded workpiece, and the target welding program of the humanoid robot is obtained. Through the technical scheme provided by the invention, safe and automatic generation of the humanoid robot welding program is realized.

title: Industrial robot data acquisition method based on programming and body intelligent cooperation
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot data acquisition method based on programming and intelligent cooperation, relates to an industrial robot control method, and provides an industrial robot data acquisition system and method based on programming and intelligent cooperation. The system comprises a programming mechanical arm (main arm), a robot demonstrator, five RGBD cameras and a humanoid robot (slave arm). The master mechanical arm and the slave mechanical arm conduct cooperative collection, the master arm executes pre-programming actions, and the slave arm receives the joint angle and the tail end pose of the master arm through the ROS and calculates the track of the slave arm. And efficient data acquisition and processing are realized by applying algorithms such as master-slave mechanical arm cooperation, image acquisition and processing, data conversion standardization, model training optimization and cloud edge cooperation. Meanwhile, an alarm mechanism is arranged, and data are recorded and analyzed. The method is high in expansibility, can be applied to the fields of industrial automation, intelligent manufacturing and the like, and helps to improve the industrial production efficiency and quality.

abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator system assisting in shifting or turning over and a robot, and relates to the technical field of manipulators. title: Industrial robot collaborative optimization system
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial robot collaborative optimization system, which relates to the technical field of humanoid robots and comprises a joint state acquisition module for acquiring joint torque, angular velocity, acceleration and external disturbance data in real time; the joint first constraint analysis module is used for decomposing a motion task into a high-level task and bottom-level joint control, introducing joint limiting and torque saturation constraint, solving joint optimal torque distribution through QP quadratic programming, and obtaining a first joint torque distribution result; the second joint constraint analysis module is used for designing a multi-objective optimization function based on the first joint torque distribution result and a humanoid robot joint real-time state database, carrying out weight self-adaption according to the humanoid robot joint real-time state database, synthesizing the weight of the multi-objective optimization function according to a dynamic weight, and obtaining a second joint torque distribution result; and solving an optimal joint angle, speed and moment sequence to obtain a joint moment optimal distribution result. Joint abrasion can be effectively reduced, and meanwhile task adaptability and energy efficiency optimization are enhanced.

title: Analytic solution method and device for regulation and control of walking period and walking position of biped robot, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an analytical solution method and device for regulation and control of a walking period and a walking position of a biped robot, a terminal and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps that a simplified model is used for simulating motion of the biped robot, and an angular momentum evolution formula is given; based on an angular momentum evolution formula, calculating an x-direction angular momentum predicted value at the end moment of the current stepping period through the state of the biped robot; setting an angular momentum predicted value at the end moment of the current step period in the x direction to be equal to the expected angular momentum, and analyzing and solving the remaining time of the current step period; and based on the remaining time of the current stepping period, the y-direction angular momentum corresponding to the current biped robot state and the expected angular momentum corresponding to the expected forward speed, the forward stepping position is analyzed and solved. The analytic solution method is high in calculation efficiency and low in time consumption, the stepping period and the stepping position of the biped robot can be accurately regulated and controlled according to the terrain lateral constraint and the system state, and the terrain adaptability and the anti-interference robustness of walking of the robot are improved.

title: Humanoid robot uninterrupted work control circuit, control method and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot uninterrupted work control circuit and method and a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot uninterrupted work control circuit comprises an equipment cabin, a first battery assembly, a second battery assembly and a main board. When the first battery assembly and the second battery assembly are both inserted into the equipment compartment, the electric quantity of the second battery assembly is monitored in real time, when the electric quantity of the second battery assembly is larger than a first preset threshold value, the second battery assembly supplies power to the humanoid robot, and when the electric quantity of the second battery assembly is smaller than or equal to the first preset threshold value, the humanoid robot is powered. When the second battery assembly is fully charged, the first battery assembly is switched to supply power to the load of the humanoid robot automatically or through a manual battery replacement button, meanwhile, a battery replacement prompt is given out until the second battery assembly which is fully charged is inserted into the equipment compartment again, and at the moment, it is automatically judged that the second battery assembly supplies power to the load of the humanoid robot and supplies power to the first battery assembly. According to the invention, live-line battery replacement of the humanoid robot is realized, and the influence of shutdown operation on the working efficiency is avoided.

title: Lifting device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a lifting device and a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problems that the overall appearance of the humanoid robot is greatly different from the natural form of human beings, and the user experience is poor. In the lifting device, a driving assembly drives a first-stage moving part to move in the first direction or the second direction, and a second-stage moving part moves in the first direction at the speed twice that of the first-stage moving part under the action of a first pulley and a first driven belt; the lifting device is arranged on the first-stage moving part and moves in the second direction at the speed two times that of the first-stage moving part under the action of a second pulley and a second driven belt, so that the size of the lifting device in the second direction can be changed, and the humanoid robot body can be arranged on the side, facing the second direction, of the second-stage moving part. And the overall appearance of the humanoid robot is closer to the natural form of human beings. In addition, the double-speed movement of the second-stage moving part in the first direction and the second direction can be realized under the pulling of the driven belt, so that the double-speed movement of the second-stage moving part is more stable and reliable.

title: Multi-scene fusion sensing system and method for olfaction sensor of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a multi-scene fusion perception system and method of a humanoid robot olfaction sensor, and relates to the technical field of intelligent sensors, and the system comprises an olfaction perception optimization module which is used for obtaining an olfaction perception optimization network; the first matrix module is used for monitoring a gas pipeline to obtain a first matrix; the second matrix module is used for performing interference compensation according to a real-time environment; the third matrix module is used for correcting according to the state of the sensor; the leakage detection module is used for detecting pipeline leakage; and the suppression verification module is used for carrying out false alarm suppression verification on the pipeline leakage detection result to obtain a pipeline early warning signal. The gas leakage detection method and device can solve the technical problem that the gas leakage detection precision is limited due to the fact that the gas leakage detection device is prone to environmental interference and high in false alarm rate in the prior art, and can adjust the multi-node olfaction sensing network in real time through historical data, conduct multi-level correction on monitoring data and introduce false alarm suppression verification, thereby improving the detection accuracy of gas leakage. The accuracy of gas leakage detection in a multi-scene environment is improved.

title: Buoyancy-adjustable amphibious humanoid robot underwater posture adjusting method
abstract: A buoyancy-adjustable amphibious humanoid robot underwater posture adjusting method comprises the following steps that an amphibious humanoid robot enters water in a cross-medium mode, and the water entering state of the amphibious humanoid robot is judged by conducting data detection through a first depth meter; after the amphibious humanoid robot is completely submerged in water, the underwater posture of the amphibious humanoid robot is adjusted through a buoyancy adjusting device and a posture adjusting propeller; when the amphibious humanoid robot goes out of water, the thrust of the propeller is adjusted to adjust the pitch attitude until the third depth gauge does not display corresponding data, it is indicated that the head of the amphibious humanoid robot goes out of water at the moment, then the buoyancy adjusting cabin is controlled to slide upwards to the topmost end, and the legs of the amphibious humanoid robot are controlled to rotate; and controlling the amphibious humanoid robot to walk out of the water surface until the first depth gauge does not display data, and indicating that the amphibious humanoid robot is completely discharged out of the water as a whole.

title: Self-adaptive humanoid finger device based on connecting rod structure and robot hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of mechanical fingers, and discloses a self-adaptive humanoid finger device based on a connecting rod structure and a robot hand. The humanoid finger device comprises a knuckle assembly, an elastic connecting rod group and a proximal connecting rod, the knuckle assembly comprises a base, a first knuckle, a second knuckle and a third knuckle which are hinged in sequence; the elastic connecting rod set comprises a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod, the first connecting rod is hinged to the base, the second connecting rod is hinged to the second knuckle, the first connecting rod is hinged to the second connecting rod, and a tension spring is arranged between the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod. One end of the proximal connecting rod is hinged to the first knuckle, and the other end of the proximal connecting rod is hinged to the third knuckle. The three-knuckle design is adopted, the finger is endowed with anthropomorphic compliance through the under-actuated connecting rod mechanism and the tension spring, and the anthropomorphic degree and the self-adaptive object enveloping capacity of the mechanical finger are improved.

title: Humanoid robot information input method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot information input method, system and device and a storage medium. According to the invention, the personnel level is determined through the trigger signal, and different input guides are set according to the personnel level for information input. title: Method, system and equipment for testing multi-floor navigation capability of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot multi-floor navigation capability test method, system and device, and the method comprises the steps: selecting a target test environment; selecting a reference point at each floor, instructing the robot to move, recording a positioning coordinate and an actually measured coordinate, and calculating a positioning error; placing the robot on different floors, instructing the robot to recognize the current floor, and calculating floor recognition accuracy and average recognition time; setting a cross-floor stair navigation task and a cross-floor elevator navigation task, and evaluating stair navigation and elevator navigation performance; setting a multi-floor navigation task, and evaluating the comprehensive navigation capability; and constructing a weighted evaluation model according to the positioning error, the floor recognition accuracy, the stair navigation, the elevator navigation performance and the comprehensive navigation capability, calculating a comprehensive score according to each index, and generating a test report. Therefore, the problems of lack of vertical movement capability evaluation, incapability of floor identification, inaccurate floor positioning precision, poor navigation continuity and the like in the prior art are solved.

title: Foot type robot ground reaction force estimation method
abstract: The invention relates to a ground reaction force estimation method for a foot-type robot, which is applied to the foot-type robot, and the foot-type robot is provided with a hip unfolding and folding joint, a hip flexion and extension joint and a knee joint which are sequentially connected in series; wherein the hip unfolding and folding joints rotate around the X axis, the hip flexion and extension joints rotate around the Y axis, and the ground bearing reaction of the foot type robot is calculated by the moment of force of the hip unfolding and folding joints, the hip flexion and extension joints and the knee joints; the torque is obtained by comprehensively calculating the motion state and the driving torque of the foot type robot and the torque of each joint rotating shaft by the gravity center of the leg behind each joint. The ground reaction force estimation method only needs joint torque information and single-leg model parameters, is an ontology sensing estimation method, and does not add additional sensors; the method has the advantages of no additional sensor, no dependence on robot whole machine model parameters, low algorithm complexity, low estimation error and the like. And key technical points are provided.

title: Biped humanoid robot stable walking method based on generalized angular momentum inverted pendulum model
abstract: The invention relates to a biped humanoid robot stable walking method based on a generalized angular momentum inverted pendulum model. According to the method, an angular momentum inverted pendulum model equation is established, a conversion relation and conversion efficiency between centroid angular momentum and speed are introduced, an adjustable generalized speed is generated, a corrected motion divergence component is calculated based on a generalized angular momentum inverted pendulum model, and then stable walking of the biped humanoid robot is planned. According to the method, the generalized angular momentum inverted pendulum model is established, and the conversion rate parameter between the mass center angular momentum and the speed is introduced, so that the mass center speed of the biped humanoid robot can be directly regulated and controlled while the calculation efficiency is ensured, and the movement stability and the anti-interference robustness of the biped humanoid robot in the walking process are improved.

title: Joint module motor and joint module for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a joint module motor for a humanoid robot and a joint module, and belongs to the field of robots. The robot mainly comprises a joint assembly, the joint assembly comprises a joint shell a and a joint shell b, a housing is installed on the joint shell a through a bearing, the joint shell a and the joint shell b are connected with an output shaft of a motor, and a fixing piece used for combining the motor is fixedly installed on the joint shell b. The joint module comprises a motor and a fixing part, a fixing seat is fixedly installed between the motor and the fixing part, and the fixing seat is provided with a lubricating system used for improving the smoothness and lubrication between the motor and the fixing seat. And meanwhile, the fixing base is arranged between the motor and the fixing piece, the motor can be prevented from making direct contact with the joint assembly, and therefore partial abrasion is reduced.

title: Human-eye-movement-imitating parallel robot with three degrees of freedom
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a human eye movement simulating parallel robot with three degrees of freedom, which comprises a base frame module, three series robots and an eyeball module, the base frame module comprises a mounting disc, and a central shaft is arranged in the middle of the mounting disc. The three series robots are the same in structure and are arranged on the mounting disc around the central axis at 120-degree intervals, the control tail ends of the three series robots are all connected to the eyeball module, and the three series robots cooperatively drive and control the eyeball module to rotate. The device is particularly suitable for a bionic robot structure for simulating human eyeball movement, solves the problems of unstable movement center, complex structure and low integration level in the prior art, and has the advantages of compact structure and accurate movement.

title: Four-finger humanoid dexterous hand based on rolling-pitching type degree-of-freedom metacarpophalangeal joints
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a four-finger humanoid dexterous hand based on tumbling-pitching degree-of-freedom metacarpophalangeal joints, which comprises a palm, a thumb, an index finger, a middle finger and a ring finger, the thumb is arranged on the inner side of the palm, and the index finger, the middle finger and the ring finger are arranged on the top of the palm. The four fingers are independently controlled, each finger is provided with three joints, and the movement of the near-end knuckle joint and the movement of the far-end knuckle joint are coupled through a crossed four-bar mechanism. Three fingers except the thumb adopt rolling-pitching type double degrees of freedom different from that of a traditional yawing-pitching type at metacarpophalangeal joints and are driven by different motors respectively, so that bending and stretching of the fingers and rolling rotation around own axes can be realized; the metacarpophalangeal joints of the thumb are connected through a micro servo linear motor, so that the lateral swing degree of freedom is provided for the proximal phalanx. The dexterous hand is reasonable in structure, rich in grabbing posture, high in dexterous performance and capable of achieving various grabbing tasks.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a scanning image of a large storage tank; determining a plurality of first corrosion degradation areas and a corrosion degradation degree distribution diagram of each first corrosion degradation area based on the scanning image of the large storage tank; determining a plurality of first detection point locations of each first corrosion degradation area based on the plurality of first corrosion degradation area scanning images; determining a plurality of second detection point locations of each first corrosion degradation area based on the state detection data of each first detection point location; generating a second corrosion degradation degree distribution diagram of each first corrosion degradation area; determining a plurality of second corrosion degradation regions; and determining the high-risk corrosion and degradation area based on the state detection data of the plurality of first detection points of each second corrosion and degradation area and the state detection data of the plurality of second detection points of the second corrosion and degradation area. According to the method, the high-risk corrosion and degradation area of the large storage tank can be rapidly and accurately determined.

title: Biped humanoid robot leg
abstract: A double-foot humanoid robot leg comprises a waist joint supporting piece, a left leg structure and a right leg structure are installed on the two sides of the waist joint supporting piece through lateral joint components respectively, and each of the left leg structure and the right leg structure comprises a thigh structure, a shank structure and a motion control assembly part. The bottom of the thigh structure is rotationally connected with the top of the shank structure through a knee joint structure, a foot plate structure is rotationally installed at the bottom of the shank structure through an ankle joint structure, and the motion control assembly part is installed at the top of the thigh structure, connected with a tendon-imitating driving pull wire assembly and provided with an installation outer shell. A lateral joint connecting part is arranged on the installation outer shell and used for being connected with a lateral joint component. According to the utility model, the dynamic performance, the naturalness and the flexibility are excellent, the far-end driving is realized, the joint load and the rotational inertia are small, the stability of the joint structure is high, and the required initial driving force is smaller, so that the power consumption is lower.

title: Ankle force sensor mounting structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot ankle force sensor mounting structure which comprises a fixing seat, a top plate mounted at the top of the fixing seat, a bottom plate mounted at the bottom of the fixing seat, a manipulator pin through hole formed in the middle of the fixing seat, and a manipulator mounting table mounted in the middle of the top of the fixing seat. A wrist mounting table is mounted at the bottom of the fixing seat, a strain beam mounting groove is formed in the outer side, close to the manipulator mounting table, of the fixing seat, and a strain beam is mounted in the strain beam mounting groove and is of an L-shaped structure as a whole. According to the humanoid robot ankle force sensor installation structure, the installation process is simple and rapid, the assembly time of a robot is greatly shortened, and the production efficiency is improved. The strain beam can generate obvious deformation under the action of external force, so that the strain beam is accurately captured by the strain gauge and converted into an electric signal, and high-precision measurement of force and torque is realized.

title: Method for controlling anthropomorphic running action of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a control method for anthropomorphic running actions of a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: modeling demonstration actions of human experts into key frame data through contact mode decomposition and gait cycle modeling; through the space-time symmetry processing of the mirror image key frame, the reasonability and the conciseness of simulating a reference track by the robot are ensured, and the robot is prevented from learning bad actions; the anti-interference performance of the running action and the dynamics optimality are achieved through enhanced imitation learning of a layered reward structure, and the method aims at controlling the robot to simulate the human running action and meanwhile conduct human-simulated running actions which are high in anti-interference capacity, high in dynamics rationality and close to the optimal solution in multiple dimensions.

title: Autonomous movement trajectory tracking method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot autonomous movement trajectory tracking method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an environment image of a humanoid robot movement environment by using a robot vision system, and carrying out gray processing and image enhancement processing on the environment image to obtain a target environment image; extracting textural features of the target environment image according to the target environment image, and inputting the textural features into a support vector machine to identify obstacles to obtain positions of the plurality of obstacles in the environment; establishing an environment map of the moving environment of the humanoid robot by adopting a grid method; and constructing an autonomous moving path of the humanoid robot by using the environment map and adopting an ant colony algorithm based on a cosine curve transformation model. The direction of the robot is determined by positioning the target and the obstacle, and meanwhile, the ant colony algorithm based on the cosine curve transformation model is adopted to optimize the moving path, so that the moving path of the humanoid robot is shortest and smooth, the planning efficiency is improved, and the moving time of the humanoid robot is saved.

title: Simulation skin simulating human body temperature and humanoid robot thereof
abstract: The invention discloses simulated skin simulating human body temperature and a humanoid robot thereof, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The simulation skin comprises an outer layer simulation material; the temperature control system is arranged under the outer-layer simulation material and divided into a plurality of independent temperature control areas, the temperature control system comprises a flexible heating element, a temperature sensor, a supporting substrate and a temperature control module, and the temperature control module is used for adjusting the power of the flexible heating element and achieving that the skin surface temperature is within a preset range; and the main control system communicates with the temperature control module and is used for transmitting the predefined scene to the temperature control module. The human body skin texture is simulated through the outer layer material, the temperature is dynamically adjusted in combination with the temperature control system, and the dynamic temperature sensing effect imitating the human body temperature is finally achieved.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method based on fuzzy neural network and adaptive PID hybrid control algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method based on a fuzzy neural network and an adaptive PID hybrid control algorithm, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, measuring distances: measuring the distances between a humanoid robot and a forward obstacle, a right obstacle and a left obstacle by using an infrared sensor; s2, carrying out extended Kalman filtering to remove noise; s3, defining a fuzzy control variable and determining a value range; s4, generating a fuzzy membership function; s5, constructing a fuzzy neural network; according to the method, the extended Kalman filtering technology is creatively used for giving out optimal estimation in the maximum likelihood sense for data obtained through measurement of the infrared sensor, the influence of noise on the system is reduced, the fuzzy neural network is introduced to replace a fuzzy control algorithm, and the fuzzy control algorithm is optimized. The input of the neural network is changed into a fuzzy input signal and a fuzzy weight, and the output of the neural network is defuzzified to obtain a visual effective value.

title: Joint module and robot
abstract: The invention provides a joint module and a robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The joint module comprises a joint assembly and a wire harness assembly, the joint assembly comprises a first joint unit and a second joint unit, the joint assembly is provided with a joint axis, the first joint unit is hinged to the second joint unit, and the first joint unit and the second joint unit can rotate around the joint axis; the wire harness assembly comprises a first connecting unit, a second connecting unit and a conduction unit, the first connecting unit is arranged on the first joint unit, the second connecting unit is arranged on the second joint unit, the conduction unit is spirally wound with the joint axis as the center, one end of the conduction unit is electrically connected with the first connecting unit, and the other end of the conduction unit is electrically connected with the second connecting unit. The other end of the conduction unit is electrically connected with the second connection unit, and the conduction unit is of a flexible structure or an elastic structure. The joint module provided by the invention can realize high-durability and low-loss power and signal transmission in a limited space so as to meet the requirement of long-term high-frequency motion of the humanoid robot.

title: EXTERIOR COVERING SYSTEM FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot comprising a torso portion, an arm assembly extending from the torso portion, a leg assembly extending from the torso portion, and an exterior covering system. The exterior covering system is configured to cover at least a portion of the torso portion, the arm assembly, and the leg assembly. The exterior covering system includes an energy attenuation assembly positioned adjacent to at least one of the torso portion, arm assembly, or leg assembly. The exterior covering system further includes a cover assembly positioned over the energy attenuation assembly, and a coupling means for securing the cover assembly to the humanoid robot.

title: Robot real-time remote control method and system based on motion capture
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and provides a robot real-time remote control method and system based on motion capture, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the joint motion information of an operator; performing rotary offset correction on the difference between a joint action information acquisition coordinate system and a robot coordinate system, setting a fixed offset for an elbow joint, dynamically generating and updating connecting rod and joint information of a virtual human body, updating a topological relation model between the joints, extracting a target angle of each joint, and calculating a target angle of each joint; all joint angles of the robot are updated step by step through smooth processing, and follow-up control over robot actions is achieved. According to the method, coordinate correction, topological modeling and proportional mapping are carried out on human body joint motion information, and smooth function processing is combined, so that efficient conversion from human body actions to robot actions is realized. According to the method, accurate modeling or a large amount of training data is not needed, low delay, high stability and good deployability are achieved, and the practicability and usability of remote control of the humanoid robot are remarkably improved.

title: Whole-body control method and control device of robot, storage medium and robot
abstract: The invention provides a whole-body control method and device of a robot, a storage medium and the robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The method comprises the following steps: training a basic whole body control model by using an AMASS data set; training a sub-control model corresponding to each motion type on the basis of the basic whole body control model by using the plurality of clustering sub-data sets; after the trained sub-control model is deployed to a control module of the robot, an execution track sequence of the robot is collected by controlling the robot to move; utilizing the collected execution track sequence to train an action increment model corresponding to the sub-control model so as to adjust the corresponding sub-control model; and fusing the adjusted sub-control models by using a knowledge distillation technology to obtain an optimized whole-body control model. According to the embodiment of the invention, a'general-expert-general 'training framework is provided and is used for learning a general whole-body control strategy, and the problem of interference among different motion types is effectively relieved.

title: Shoulder joint of hydraulic humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a hydraulic humanoid robot shoulder joint which comprises a pitching motion assembly, a rolling motion assembly, a yawing motion assembly, a trunk supporting plate and a connecting shaft. The pitching motion assembly and the transverse rolling motion assembly are arranged on the trunk supporting plate, and the yawing motion assembly is connected with the transverse rolling motion assembly through a connecting shaft. The pitching motion assembly comprises a pitching gear, a pitching rack, a pitching driving hydraulic cylinder and a pitching sliding block plate; the transverse rolling movement assembly comprises a second sliding block, a third sliding block, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a joint connecting piece and a transverse rolling driving hydraulic cylinder; an output shaft of a transverse rolling driving hydraulic cylinder sequentially penetrates through the trunk supporting plate, a pitching gear and a second sliding block to be fixedly connected with a third sliding block, and a joint connecting piece is movably connected with a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod; the third sliding block moves relative to the second sliding block through the first sliding rail. And the shoulder joint is compact in structure.

title: Fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand
abstract: The invention discloses a fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, and relates to the field of humanoid robots, the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand comprises variable-rigidity flexible fingers, a palm body, a palm cover, an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, and mounting holes in the variable-rigidity flexible fingers are correspondingly mounted in the upper end face and mounting groove holes of the palm body; the electric control unit and the six-way combined fluid valve are arranged in a cavity of the palm body side by side, and the palm cover is fixedly connected with the palm body. According to the fluid-driven multi-section sub-control type variable-rigidity flexible hand, the multi-section sub-control type design is adopted, a plurality of electric control fluid micro-valves are arranged in the flexible finger bodies, and independent control over the flexible finger joints is achieved; a rigidity adjusting layer is arranged, so that the object grasping stability of the flexible hand is further improved; an electromechanical integration mode is adopted, the palm body internally comprises an electric control unit and a six-way combined fluid valve, the constraint of redundant cables is reduced, and the working efficiency is further improved.

title: Humanoid health care robot ethical decision-making method and system based on game theory
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid health care robot ethical decision-making method and system based on the game theory, and particularly relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the physiological, psychological and environmental data of old people and the environment; constructing a game model in which multiple parties participate; calculating an optimal strategy of each party according to the game theory model, and determining an optimal behavior path of the robot; under the condition of multi-party benefit conflicts, various decisions are sorted according to the ethical decision algorithm, and the technical scheme has the beneficial effects that through the ethical decision method and system based on the game theory, and in combination with Nash equilibrium, social welfare maximization and ethical conflict minimization theories, the multi-party benefit conflicts are obtained; the robot can obtain physiological and psychological data of the old people in real time, calculate an optimal nursing strategy according to a multi-party game model, dynamically adjust a decision path, ensure that the nursing requirements of the old people are met, minimize ethical conflicts, improve the nursing effect and improve the overall nursing experience and life quality of the old people.

title: High-performance humanoid robot communication method and system based on DDS and TSN and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a high-performance humanoid robot communication method and system based on a DDS and a TSN and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: environment deployment: deploying FastDDS middleware in an OpenEuler embedded real-time environment, and achieving distributed data distribution; transmission layer optimization: constructing a transmission layer module using a DPDK framework based on a standard FastDDS transmission layer interface; traffic scheduling: optimizing data transmission of the DDS by adopting a QBV scheduling rule of the TSN; according to the network card architecture, a network card is designed based on an FPGA, and message timing scheduling of a TSN QBV rule is achieved. According to the method, the data transmission performance is improved from the two aspects of node communication optimization and global scheduling, low-delay, high-throughput and high-stability data transmission is achieved, and the method is suitable for humanoid robot communication scenes with strict requirements for real-time performance and reliability.

title: Miniature six-dimensional force sensor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature six-dimensional force sensor for a humanoid robot. The miniature six-dimensional force sensor comprises an elastic body which is integrally disc-shaped, and an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate which are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the elastic body; the elastic body comprises an elastic body hub, a stress table and four strain beams, and the cross section of each strain beam is rectangular; the stress table is hollow and is arranged at the central position of the elastomer hub, the four strain beams are uniformly distributed between the stress table and the elastomer hub, one end of each strain beam is connected with the elastomer hub, and the other end of each strain beam is connected with the stress table; the elastomer hub is provided with a cable outlet. A plurality of strain gauges are adhered to the four strain beams to form six Wheatstone bridges for respectively measuring forces and moments in six directions of Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty and Tz. The miniature six-dimensional force sensor has the advantages that the thickness of the sensor is very small, the thickness is only 9.2 mm, the diameter is 45 mm, and the miniature six-dimensional force sensor is suitable for the humanoid robot industry.

title: Intelligent grabbing control method and system based on tactile perception
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent grabbing control method and system based on tactile perception, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a tactile feedback signal through a sensor array of a humanoid robot, carrying out the frequency domain decomposition of the signal through a Fourier transform method, and carrying out the analysis of the pressure and deformation data of each contact point on the surface of a to-be-grabbed object, calculating to obtain frequency characteristic distribution of the tactile feedback signal; if the initial estimation value of the object rigidity gradient exceeds a threshold value, performing finite element analysis on the object rigidity gradient, and combining a time domain processing result of the tactile feedback signal to obtain object rigidity gradient distribution; carrying out probability modeling on the deformation field by adopting a Bayesian inference method according to the gradient distribution of the rigidity of the object, and carrying out iterative optimization on a modeling result to obtain dynamic update parameters mapped by the deformation field; and regenerating an action sequence of the end effector of the humanoid robot based on the optimized strategy according to a trigger condition of grabbing failure detection, and determining a final grabbing control parameter.
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent grabbing control method and system based on tactile perception, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a tactile feedback signal through a sensor array of a humanoid robot, carrying out the frequency domain decomposition of the signal through a Fourier transform method, and carrying out the analysis of the pressure and deformation data of each contact point on the surface of a to-be-grabbed object, calculating to obtain frequency characteristic distribution of the tactile feedback signal; if the initial estimation value of the object rigidity gradient exceeds a threshold value, performing finite element analysis on the object rigidity gradient, and combining a time domain processing result of the tactile feedback signal to obtain object rigidity gradient distribution; carrying out probability modeling on the deformation field by adopting a Bayesian inference method according to the gradient distribution of the rigidity of the object, and carrying out iterative optimization on a modeling result to obtain dynamic update parameters mapped by the deformation field; and regenerating an action sequence of the end effector of the humanoid robot based on the optimized strategy according to a trigger condition of grabbing failure detection, and determining a final grabbing control parameter.

title: Robot joint control method and system and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot joint control method and system and a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: estimating first rotation position information of a first joint motor based on acceleration and angular velocity information measured by a two-degree-of-freedom joint of a robot; second rotation position information of the first joint motor is calculated based on the robot visual signal; actual measurement motor rotation position information measured by a motor encoder of the first joint is obtained; the first rotation position information, the second rotation position information and the actually measured motor rotation position information are compared in pairs, and the health state of a motor encoder of the first joint is diagnosed; if it is diagnosed that the health state of the motor encoder of the first joint is abnormal, safety buffer control over the motor of the first joint is achieved through rotation position information of the first motor, and the safety control problem when the joint motor encoder of the humanoid robot breaks down is solved; the technical effect of remarkably improving the safety and reliability of the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Man-machine synchronous control system and method for self-balancing outer limbs
abstract: The invention discloses a man-machine synchronous control system and method for a self-balancing outer limb, and belongs to the technical field of wearable robots. The system comprises a trunk of an outer limb, a thigh connecting rod, a shank connecting rod, a hub motor, a hip joint and knee joint driving module, an inertial measurement unit (IMU), a guyed displacement sensor and a control processing module, wherein the outer limb is connected with a human body through an elastic coupling device. The control system adopts a model predictive control (MPC) algorithm, takes a man-machine relative speed estimated by a guyed displacement sensor as a feedback dynamic adjustment control target, solves control input in real time in combination with a system state model, and is executed by a motor to realize synchronous following and self-balancing control of human gaits. Through the fusion design of the wheel foot structure and the dynamic optimization algorithm, the method does not depend on traditional human body signal input, can adapt to variable gaits and enhance the system stability, and has the advantages of high man-machine interaction comfort, fast control response, high adaptability and the like.

title: Hydraulic humanoid robot leg structure driven by blade swing cylinder and direct drive valve group
abstract: The invention discloses a hydraulic humanoid robot leg structure driven by a blade swing cylinder and a direct-drive valve bank, which comprises a thigh structure, a shank structure and a foot plate structure, the thigh structure is provided with a direct-drive multi-way valve bank, the end part of the thigh structure is provided with a hip joint blade swing cylinder actuator and a hip joint yaw shaft piston cylinder actuator, and the hip joint yaw shaft piston cylinder actuator is provided with a hip joint blade swing cylinder. A knee joint pitch shaft blade swing cylinder actuator is installed at the end of the shank structure, and a piston cylinder actuator is installed on the shank structure. By adopting the hydraulic driving scheme of combining the precise blade oscillating cylinder and the piston cylinder and concentrating the servo valve group on the outer side of the thigh, the defects of the existing technical schemes of speed reducer motor driving, lead screw electric cylinders, traditional hydraulic piston cylinders and the like in high-load, high-speed movement and long-term use are successfully overcome. The lower limb structure of the humanoid robot has the characteristics of high torque output, high-speed rotation, excellent heat dissipation and durability, low electromagnetic interference and the like, and provides higher flexibility, reliability and adaptability for the lower limb structure of the humanoid robot.

title: Walking power assisting device with differential transmission mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a walking power assisting device with a differential transmission mechanism, which comprises a power module, a waist module and a leg rod module, the power module is horizontally arranged near the lower abdomen in front of a human body, and the rotation axis of the power module is horizontally arranged and is parallel to the coronal plane of the human body; the device comprises a motor module, a speed reducing mechanism, a differential transmission mechanism, a first power output end and a second power output end, the motor module is in transmission connection with the input end of the reducing mechanism, one end of the differential transmission mechanism is in transmission connection with the output end of the reducing mechanism and the first power output end, and the other end is in transmission connection with the second power output end; based on the differential transmission mechanism, rotation of the output end of the speed reducing mechanism can drive the first power output end to rotate in the opposite direction relative to the second power output end. The walking power assisting device has the advantages of being light in weight, small in storage size, small in implementation space, low in complexity, close-fitting, compact and the like.

title: Linear joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot linear joint comprises a planetary roller screw, an angle encoder is mounted on the outer side of the planetary roller screw, a six-dimensional force sensor is fixedly mounted on one side of the planetary roller screw, a mounting seat is fixedly mounted on the outer side of the planetary roller screw, and a reading head is fixedly mounted at the top of the mounting seat; the screw rod can drive six pin rollers in the nut to rotate when rotating, so that the nut linearly moves on the outer side of the screw rod, the linear joints of the humanoid machine operate, and the joints can stretch, retract and the like; the planetary roller lead screw is adopted for carrying out linear motion at the joints, so that the smoothness of the joints can be guaranteed, large axial loads and radial loads can be borne, meanwhile, the advantages of being high in precision and rigidity, long in service life and the like are achieved, in addition, due to multi-line contact among the rollers, the lead screw and the nut, transmission is more stable, and vibration and noise are reduced.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and system, the system comprises a sensor module, a sensing module, a state representation module, a decision module, a motion control module, an actuator module and a feedback module, and the method comprises the following steps: step 1, data acquisition; step 2, environment perception; step 3, state representation; step 4, action selection; step 5, motion control; step 6, performing feedback and adjustment; according to the method, the hybrid model combining the ViT and the CNN is adopted for environment perception, the environment perception precision is improved, the error recognition rate is reduced, motion planning is carried out through reinforcement learning, the robot can autonomously learn the optimal motion strategy, decision making and adjustment can be autonomously carried out according to the environment change and the task target, and the robot experience is improved. The problem that a traditional motion planning algorithm is high in calculation complexity is solved, the robot motion planning efficiency, the autonomous decision-making ability and the environment adaptability are improved, and safe, efficient and autonomous motion of the humanoid robot in a complex dynamic environment is achieved.

title: Robot gait control method and device suitable for walking on slippery road surface and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot gait control method and device suitable for walking on a slippery road surface and a biped robot. A reinforcement learning and MPC combined control mode is adopted, the robot is controlled to carry out normal gait walking, and data of joint motors and foot sensors are collected in real time; the state of the robot is judged, specifically, when the robot possibly overturns, the robot enters a slow gait mode, and the judgment standard that overturning possibly occurs is that the states of n steps in the future are deduced in the simulation deduction environment, and whether the n step presents the overturning trend or not is judged; and when the robot overturns, the robot enters a high-frequency gait mode, and a related gait regulation and control mode is designed. The problem that the biped robot easily slips on a wet and slippery road surface is solved; and when slipping occurs, the problem is difficult to remedy. And the stable walking capability of the robot on a complex road surface is improved.

title: Finger capturing device and method for humanoid robot reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a finger capturing device and method for reinforcement learning of a humanoid robot, and the device comprises finger modules which are disposed on each finger of the humanoid robot, and each finger module comprises an IMU sensor, an LED lamp, a touch sensor, and a processing module; the IMU sensor is used for collecting motion state data of fingers; the LED lamps are used for carrying out ID identification on each finger through a flicker sequence of the LED lamps; the processing module is used for processing data acquired by the IMU sensor and controlling the LED lamp; the touch sensor is used for sensing the contact state of the finger and an external object; the camera is used for acquiring two-dimensional image data of the hand position of the humanoid robot in multiple directions; and the analysis center is used for identifying and obtaining the spatial position coordinates of each finger according to the two-dimensional image data in the multiple directions, and judging the hand posture according to the spatial position coordinates of each finger and the contact state and motion state data of the finger and the external object, so that the anti-interference performance and the accuracy of optical motion capture are improved.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a finger capturing device and method for reinforcement learning of a humanoid robot, and the device comprises finger modules which are disposed on each finger of the humanoid robot, and each finger module comprises an IMU sensor, an LED lamp, a touch sensor, and a processing module; the IMU sensor is used for collecting motion state data of fingers; the LED lamps are used for carrying out ID identification on each finger through a flicker sequence of the LED lamps; the processing module is used for processing data acquired by the IMU sensor and controlling the LED lamp; the touch sensor is used for sensing the contact state of the finger and an external object; the camera is used for acquiring two-dimensional image data of the hand position of the humanoid robot in multiple directions; and the analysis center is used for identifying and obtaining the spatial position coordinates of each finger according to the two-dimensional image data in the multiple directions, and judging the hand posture according to the spatial position coordinates of each finger and the contact state and motion state data of the finger and the external object, so that the anti-interference performance and the accuracy of optical motion capture are improved.

title: Method and device for controlling uninterrupted work of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an uninterrupted work control method and device for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: monitoring the electric quantity of a first battery in real time, and enabling the first battery to supply power to a first load of the humanoid robot when the electric quantity of the first battery is greater than a first preset threshold value; and when the electric quantity of the first battery is smaller than or equal to a first preset threshold value, a second battery supplies power to a second load of the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot is kept in a standing state or operates in a low-power state. According to the invention, live-line battery replacement of the humanoid robot is realized, and the influence of shutdown operation on the working efficiency is avoided.

title: Mechanical knuckles, mechanical fingers, dexterous manipulator and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a mechanical knuckle, a mechanical finger, a dexterous manipulator and a robot, and relates to the technical field of manipulators, the mechanical knuckle comprises a shell assembly and a first driving mechanism, and a first mounting cavity is formed in the shell assembly. The first driving mechanism is arranged in the first mounting cavity, and an included angle is formed between the length direction of the first driving mechanism and the length direction of the shell assembly. According to the mechanical knuckle provided by the embodiment of the invention, the length of the shell assembly can be shortened, and the driving arrangement structure is more compact, so that the mechanical knuckle conforms to the biomechanical characteristics of a human hand.

title: Parallel biped robot with waist structure and walking method
abstract: The parallel biped robot with the waist structure is characterized by comprising a parallel double-leg structure, the waist structure and an upper body structure which are arranged from bottom to top and can move independently; the parallel double-leg structure comprises a leg structure cross beam, the two ends of the leg structure cross beam are downwards connected with leg structures, and the upper portion of the leg structure cross beam is fixedly connected with the waist structure; the waist structure is a six-degree-of-freedom Stewart mechanism, a lower platform of the waist structure is rigidly connected with a cross beam of the leg structure, an upper platform of the waist structure is rigidly connected with the upper body structure, and six telescopic rods are connected between the upper platform and the lower platform; the invention further discloses a walking method of the robot, through introduction of the six-degree-of-freedom waist structure, the robot can adjust the position and posture of the upper body in real time in the walking process, active compensation of mass center deviation is achieved, and compared with a traditional serial connection type waist mass center adjusting range is larger, the corresponding speed is higher, and the robot can walk more stably. And the advancing stability is obviously improved.

title: Double-arm humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm humanoid robot which comprises a head unit. A chest unit; the arm unit is a multi-joint mechanical arm; a hand unit; the chassis part is provided with a plurality of omnidirectional wheels; wherein the head unit, the chest unit and the chassis part are sequentially arranged from top to bottom, and the arm units are connected to the two sides of the chest unit; the hand units and the ends, deviating from the chest unit, of the arm units are assembled, and the mechanical structures of the hand units of the two arm units are different. According to the robot, global movement is achieved through the omni-directional wheel chassis, cooperative operation is achieved in combination with the double-side heterogeneous mechanical arms, the space limitation of a traditional fixed base mechanical arm is broken through, the stability defect of a humanoid biped robot is also broken through, the single machine integrates the movement and multifunctional operation capacity, and the robot has a wider industrial application prospect.

title: Humanoid robot somatosensory control system and method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot somatosensory control system and method based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps that physiological data and environment information of a user are collected through a wearable device and an environment sensor, and full-modal synchronous collection is achieved in combination with audio and visual data. The system carries out noise reduction processing on the collected sound, extracts a voice instruction and recognizes non-language sound features to judge the physiological state of the user; and analyzing the posture and gesture intention of the user through a human body detection and posture recognition algorithm. And multi-modal data is further fused, the intention of a user is accurately judged in combination with scene context and a security verification loop, a multi-dimensional state space and an atomic action library are constructed, and a composite reward function is designed to realize intelligent decision and execution of robot actions. The system comprises a multi-modal data acquisition module, a user intention understanding module, a dynamic action planning module, a safety monitoring and exception handling module and a continuous learning and collaborative optimization module, and can effectively improve the intention recognition precision, environmental adaptability and task execution efficiency of the robot in a complex home scene. And intelligent and personalized family service support is provided for the elderly.

title: Hierarchical disturbed recovery control method for humanoid robot based on motion divergence
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot hierarchical disturbance recovery control method based on motion divergence, and the method comprises the steps: detecting the mass center position and speed of a robot in real time through an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) and a state signal to estimate external force interference, and carrying out the dead-zone filtering and memory attenuation processing of the estimated external force; the method comprises the steps of calculating a current motion divergence # imgabs0 # based on a linear inverted pendulum model, correcting the actual offset direction of the motion divergence # imgabs1 # according to an estimated external force, calculating the offset of the motion divergence # imgabs1 # relative to a zero moment point # imgabs2 #, dividing the disturbance degree into a slight level, a medium level and a serious level by calculating the maximum safety threshold of the offset, and adopting corresponding recovery strategies for different levels. And finally, according to the corrected landing point, planning a real-time swing leg path for the robot to track and control, thereby realizing adaptive disturbance recovery of the robot.

title: Emotion care artificial intelligence robot
abstract: Disclosed is an emotion-care artificial intelligence robot capable of sensing an external stimulus according to a user's touch, and implementing various corresponding emotion expressing actions according to a position or type of the sensed external stimulus. An emotion-care artificial intelligence robot according to the present invention includes: a torso unit; a head unit movably installed on an upper portion of the torso unit; a face unit installed on the head unit and having a movement separate from the head unit; a sensing unit composed of sensing elements installed to sense an external stimulus according to a user's touch; a cover unit having a bulging portion capable of convexly inflating while covering the head unit and the torso unit in a state where the face unit is exposed; and a driving unit that implements a corresponding emotion expressing action according to the external stimulus sensed by the sensing unit, wherein the emotion expressing action implemented by the driving unit according to the external stimulus may include some or all of an action of moving the head unit forward/backward or left/right, an action of moving the face unit up/down or left/right, and an action of inflating the bulging portion.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system based on AI intelligent teaching
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot control method and system based on AI intelligent teaching. A humanoid robot control method based on AI intelligent teaching comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining scheduling related data in a classroom, and carrying out data preprocessing on the scheduling related data to obtain preprocessed scheduling related data; s2, acquiring a personnel spacing value according to the preprocessed scheduling related data, and performing robot path planning and control according to the personnel spacing value; and S3, when the personnel spacing value is greater than or equal to a first preset distance, performing first path planning and control of the robot. By setting a three-stage switching mechanism, the robot can dynamically adjust the service strategy according to the real-time personnel spacing and the help demand degree, so that the autonomous thinking space of students is guaranteed, and effective assistance can be provided for auditing personnel and teachers at a proper time.

title: Humanoid robot body design method, equipment, medium and product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot body design method and device, a medium and a product. For the appearance of the humanoid robot, the internal structure layout is deduced reversely with the human body appearance curved surface as the boundary condition, and skin-skeleton-muscle layered coupling design is adopted; for humanoid robot skeletons, heterogeneous mixed joints are configured according to 23 main joint types of a human body, and a spine adopts a four-degree-of-freedom series link mechanism design; the humanoid robot is driven, driving assemblies are configured in a graded mode based on the gravity center migration model, and shape memory alloy bionic tendons are introduced. Through an appearance constraint design method, the appearance of the robot is highly matched with the human body structure, the appearance is more vivid and natural, and the affinity of man-machine interaction is improved. The technical problem that the humanoid robot is stiff and stiff can be at least solved.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot multi-dimensional dynamic stability cooperative control method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot multi-dimensional dynamic stability cooperative control method and device, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The dynamic model comprises a trunk pitching model, a trunk rolling model, a hip joint swinging model, a knee joint flexion and extension model and an ankle joint rotation model; determining the stability comprehensive evaluation indexes of the humanoid robot under the dimensions of longitudinal sliding, sideslip and heeling; the hip joint swing model and the knee joint flexion and extension model correspond to a lower limb swing dimension, the trunk pitching model and the trunk rolling model correspond to a trunk balance dimension, and the ankle joint rotation model corresponds to a sole contact dimension; dynamic kinetic parameters of all joints of the humanoid robot are obtained, and the expected control quantity is determined in combination with the stability comprehensive evaluation index; and performing cooperative control on an execution mechanism of the humanoid robot according to the expected control quantity. According to the invention, by establishing a multi-dimensional stability cooperative control scheme, full-dimensional stability control in a complex environment can be realized.

title: Motion control method and system for intelligent robot
abstract: The invention provides a motion control method and system for an intelligent robot, and the method comprises the steps: collecting environment and state data through an intelligent sensor group of a humanoid robot, inputting the environment and state data into a pre-training first neural network model, and obtaining motion prediction data and an environment analysis result; constructing a motion planning model, and performing energy consumption-stability multi-objective optimization on the joint motion track by adopting a preset first algorithm; the central controller generates a joint position, speed and torque reference trajectory based on an optimization result; and the local second controller of each joint locally adjusts the reference trajectory within the prediction time domain according to the real-time feedback. According to the invention, multiple sensors are combined with the mixed attention neural network to realize environment and self state intelligent perception, and the problem of multi-sensor data fusion time sequence dependence is solved; through energy consumption-stability multi-objective optimization, the complex environment movement efficiency is remarkably improved; the central controller and the local controller work cooperatively, and in combination with an edge computing architecture, the communication delay is reduced, and the system response speed is improved.
