title: Bionic magnetic integrated flexible driver for flexible joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic magnetic integration flexible driver for a flexible joint of a humanoid robot. The driver comprises a driver shell, a rope driving structure and a magnetic integration structure. The rope driving structure comprises a stepping motor, a rope guide rod and a steel wire rope, the stepping motor is fixedly installed in the driver shell, a driving shaft of the stepping motor is coaxially connected with the rope guide rod through a coupler, and one end of the steel wire rope is wound on the rope guide rod; the magnetic integration structure comprises an upper magnet, a magnet sleeve, a traction structure and a lower magnet, the lower magnet is fixed to the end, away from the rope guide rod, of the stepping motor, the upper magnet is embedded in the magnet sleeve, the magnet sleeve is sleeved with the driver shell, and the traction structure fixed to the steel wire rope is arranged on the magnet sleeve. According to the flexible driver, the rope guide rod and the steel wire rope are arranged, so that the load capacity of the driver is improved, and the movement requirement in a complex environment is met; telescopic movement of joint muscles is achieved through repulsive force simulation between the magnets, and the application prospect is good.

title: High-performance universal humanoid robot
abstract: The high-performance universal humanoid robot comprises a main body trunk provided with a main control system, the main control system is provided with a plurality of standard communication interfaces and standard power supply interfaces, and the main body trunk is connected with an upper limb platform through a first universal flange plate interface; the main body trunk is connected with the lower limb platform through a second universal flange plate interface, and all actuators of the upper limb platform and the lower limb platform are in power supply connection with a standard power supply interface through power supply lines and are in communication connection with a standard communication interface through communication lines. The master control system is provided with an overall coordination control program based on deep reinforcement learning, model prediction control and a multi-modal large model; the method has more flexible hardware architecture and software platform, and task deployment can be quickly adjusted and optimized in a short time according to actual application requirements.

title: Multi-modal collaborative decision-making method and device for humanoid robot in industrial scene
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal collaborative decision-making method and device for a humanoid robot in an industrial scene, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a multi-frame monitoring image, force touch sensor data and equipment operation sensor data of a visual camera of the humanoid robot in the industrial scene; extracting feature vectors of the multi-frame monitoring image, the force touch sensor data and the equipment operation sensor data as multi-modal feature vectors; taking the multi-modal feature vector as a training sample to train a cross-modal model, so that the cross-modal model learns an association relationship among vision, haptic and equipment data; obtaining dynamic industrial scene data, extracting feature vectors, and inputting the feature vectors into the trained cross-modal model to generate scene description information; and outputting an operation decision instruction according to the scene description information so as to control the humanoid robot. Through cross-modal feature fusion and dynamic knowledge reasoning, the task execution precision and environmental adaptability of the humanoid robot in a complex industrial environment can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot head orientation method and system based on audio-visual collaboration
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot head orientation method and system based on audio-visual collaboration, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and solves the problems that in the prior art, shielding of a human face or poor environmental conditions are not considered, the number of available effective features of detection images and voice data is reduced, and the detection efficiency is improved. And the head orientation accuracy and efficiency are low. Time synchronization data is generated according to a detection image and a detection sound source; generating directional data after generating a detection influence coefficient according to the illumination intensity and the detection data; generating a horizontal orientation adjustment error according to the adjusted detection image, then generating an alarm signal, carrying out orientation by adopting the multi-source data at the same time, monitoring the inhibition degree of the environment on the multi-source data in real time, dynamically adjusting the combined weight among the multi-source data according to the correlation among the inhibition degrees, and orienting the horizontal orientation according to the combined weight. And then the orientation vertical direction is adjusted, and implementation is carried out step by step, so that the accuracy and efficiency of final head orientation are improved.

title: Intelligent accompanying system, method and equipment based on humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and discloses an intelligent accompanying system, method and equipment based on a humanoid robot and a medium. The sensing module, the processing module, the execution module, the interaction module and the communication module are arranged in the humanoid robot body. The sensing module is used for acquiring physiological information, behavior information and environment information of an accompanying person; the processing module is used for receiving the information acquired by the sensing module, processing and analyzing the information and generating a corresponding accompanying strategy; the execution module is used for executing the accompanying strategy generated by the processing module; the interaction module is used for interaction among the humanoid robot body, an accompanying person and other persons; and the communication module is used for communication between the humanoid robot body and external equipment. The technical problem that robot accompanying is not flexible can be solved at least.

title: Humanoid robot control system and method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, and provides a humanoid robot control system and method based on reinforcement learning, and the humanoid robot control system comprises a first control subsystem and a second control subsystem. The first control subsystem comprises a strategy reasoning module, a state conversion module and a robot control module; the second control subsystem comprises a data acquisition module and a driving control module; the data acquisition module is used for finishing timestamp alignment and abnormal value filtering of sensor data and transmitting the data to the state conversion module; the state conversion module is used for fusing multi-source sensor data and constructing a time sequence state feature containing a real-time measurement value and historical time sequence information; the strategy reasoning module is used for generating a multi-joint angle target value of the robot according to the time sequence state characteristics provided by the state conversion module; and the robot control module is used for analyzing the multi-joint angle target value output by the strategy reasoning module, selecting a control mode and generating a control command comprising a parameter adjustment instruction.

title: Image recognition-based humanoid robot for supermarket tallying
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot for supermarket tallying based on image recognition, which comprises an image recognition tallying control system, and the image recognition tallying control system is arranged in the humanoid robot and comprises an image recognition module and a clamping force control module. A weight sensor is mounted on an arm of the humanoid robot; the image recognition module is electrically connected with the clamping force control module, the image recognition module is used for conducting image recognition on goods through the humanoid robot, and the clamping force control module is used for controlling the clamping force of the humanoid robot on the goods. The image recognition module comprises an image capture unit, a weight recognition unit, a networking unit and a classification unit, and the device solves the problems that when a current humanoid robot carries out supermarket tallying, goods cannot be recognized through image recognition, the clamping force on the goods is constant, the clamping force on food goods is large, and the goods are damaged.

title: Humanoid robot joint module based on hybrid magnetic flux motor
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint module based on a hybrid magnetic flux motor, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. A plurality of heat dissipation grooves which are distributed in the radial direction of a stator shaft and extend in the axial direction of the stator shaft are formed in the side wall of the stator shaft, a plurality of heat conduction hole sets are formed in the side wall of the stator shaft, the heat conduction hole sets correspond to the heat dissipation grooves in a one-to-one mode, and each heat conduction hole set is distributed in the axial direction of the stator shaft and communicates with the heat dissipation grooves; the side wall of the outer rotor is circumferentially provided with a plurality of heat dissipation holes extending in the axial direction of the outer rotor. Multiple first flow guide holes are formed in the end face of the inner rotor; the end face of the radial motor rotor is provided with a plurality of second flow guide holes which are distributed in the radial direction and extend. According to the invention, a composite air duct structure with the axial air duct, the hollow stator shaft and the end cover for ventilation is constructed, the rotation of the motor is utilized to drive air to flow, an internal and external double-circulation forced cooling path is formed, the volume does not need to be additionally increased, efficient heat dissipation can be realized, overheating demagnetization of the motor is effectively prevented, and the continuous high-load operation capability is improved.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The leg structure of the humanoid robot comprises an upper half leg plate, a lower half leg plate, a lifting assembly and a magnetic induction assembly, and the non-rotating-shaft end of the upper half leg plate is in butt joint with the non-rotating-shaft end of the lower half leg plate. The lifting motor is started to drive the main gear, the auxiliary gear, the main threaded rod and the auxiliary threaded rod to rotate, the main threaded rod and the auxiliary threaded rod enable the lower half leg plate to stretch or retract in a rotating mode according to the positive and negative rotation directions of the lifting motor, and the length of the upper half leg plate and the length of the lower half leg plate are increased or decreased; the magnetic induction sliding rod on the lower half leg plate slides out or slides in the sliding hole of the upper half leg plate, the magnetic induction sliding rod drives the magnetic sliding box and the magnetic column to move, the induction coil induces the position of the magnetic column in the induction coil, the extension or shortening length of the lifting assembly is detected, and the length of the legs of the humanoid robot is adjusted in a self-adaptive mode. The gait of the robot can be flexibly switched between the fluctuating surface, the soft surface or the hard surface, and the walking stability and efficiency are greatly improved.

title: Ankle connecting structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot ankle connecting structure which comprises a fixing base, a front cover plate is installed at the top of the fixing base, a bottom plate is installed at the bottom of the fixing base, the fixing base is of a cylindrical structure, and a mechanical arm fixing table top is arranged in the middle of the top of the fixing base. A plurality of strain beam mounting grooves are formed in the position, close to the outer side of the manipulator fixing table top, of the top of the fixing base, strain beams are mounted in the strain beam mounting grooves, a shaft positioning table top is arranged in the middle of the bottom of the fixing base, and a shaft positioning sleeve is mounted on the shaft positioning table top. Compared with a traditional complex mounting structure, the ankle connecting structure of the humanoid robot has the advantages that the fixing seat of a cylindrical structure is adopted, and the table top, the mounting groove and the through hole are reasonably formed in the fixing seat, so that the structure is simplified and lightened. According to the design, the overall weight of the robot is reduced, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved.

title: Humanoid service robot capable of being transformed into wheelchair and control method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid service robot capable of being transformed into a wheelchair and a control method.The humanoid service robot comprises a headrest part, a backrest part, armrest mechanical arms, a wheelchair seat and a movable base, the wheelchair seat is arranged on the upper side of the movable base, one end of the wheelchair seat is hinged to the upper end of the movable base, and the other end of the wheelchair seat is hinged to the lower end of the backrest part; a wheelchair seat push rod for driving the wheelchair seat to rotate is arranged at the upper end of the movable base, a backrest push rod for driving the backrest part to rotate is arranged on the lower side of the wheelchair seat, a rotatable headrest part is arranged at the upper end of the backrest part, a headrest cushion is arranged on one side of the headrest part, a head screen is arranged on the other side of the headrest part, and a laser radar and a depth camera are arranged at the upper end of the headrest part. title: Gait control method for 12-degree-of-freedom biped humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a gait control method for a 12-degree-of-freedom biped humanoid robot. The gait control method comprises the following steps that S1, structural design of a self-research robot is conducted; s2, modeling the self-developed biped humanoid robot; s3, designing a self-developed biped humanoid robot controller; s4, performing evaluation and experimental analysis; according to the robot, six joint drivers are arranged for each leg at three main parts of a hip joint, a knee joint and an ankle joint, sufficient hardware conditions are provided for flexible movement of a self-developed robot, a humanoid robot model is simplified by adopting a single rigid body model, and a robot movement control method and constraint conditions thereof are designed for 12 degrees of freedom, so that the robot movement control method and constraint conditions are optimized. Although the simplified model ignores leg dynamics, robust stability of a 12-degree-of-freedom system can still be achieved under the multi-body effect, and adaptability and real-time performance of the system are improved.

title: Robot leg mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly discloses a robot leg mechanism which comprises thighs, shanks, feet, adjusting driving parts and transmission parts. Wherein the shank is rotationally connected with the thigh, and a transmission channel is formed in the shank; the feet are rotationally connected to one ends of the shanks away from the thighs; the adjusting driving piece is arranged in the transmission channel; the transmission part penetrates through the transmission channel and extends in the same direction as the shank, one end of the transmission part is in transmission connection with the output end of the adjusting driving part, the other end of the transmission part is rotationally connected with the foot, and the adjusting driving part drives the transmission part to move so as to drive the foot and the shank to rotate relatively. According to the arrangement, the number of parts is greatly reduced, the assembling procedure is saved, and the assembling efficiency is improved; meanwhile, as the robot needs to serve as a supporting structure, the structural strength is large, the transmission part is arranged in the transmission channel, even if the robot falls down, the shanks cannot deform, and the possibility that the transmission part in the robot is bent is effectively reduced.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom finger mechanism of five-finger manipulator
abstract: The two-degree-of-freedom finger mechanism of the five-finger manipulator is suitable for five-finger manipulator equipment of a humanoid robot and serves as a ring finger and little finger module. The robot consists of two parts, namely a finger bending assembly and a finger swinging assembly. The finger bending assembly drives a ball screw nut pair through a driving motor to convert rotary motion into linear motion, and then a ball nut drives an elastic connecting rod and finger joints to achieve bending motion of fingers. The finger swinging assembly drives a bevel gear set through a driving motor, and after the direction of rotating motion is changed, a connecting rod and finger joints are driven through a universal joint to achieve the swinging action of fingers. According to the two-degree-of-freedom mechanical finger, the two assemblies are ingeniously combined to one finger, and the overall size of the mechanical finger is reduced while two-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved. And in combination with the use of the elastic connecting rod, the driving motor is protected, and the action area of the manipulator and the grabbed object is increased.

title: Biped humanoid robot simulating human leg skeletal muscle structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped humanoid robots, in particular to a biped humanoid robot simulating a human leg skeletal muscle structure. Comprising a hip bone plate, two upper rotary actuators, two hip joint rotating parts, two thigh bone simulation rods, two knee joint frames, two lower rotary actuators, two shank bone simulation parts, two foot simulation parts, four upper front linear actuators, two upper rear linear actuators and four lower rear linear actuators, and each hip joint has three degrees of freedom. The knee joint has one degree of freedom. The ankle joint has two degrees of freedom, so that the biped humanoid robot can complete actions such as walking, running, hip twisting and squatting, the flexibility of hip joint motion control is guaranteed, and the use of parts is reduced. By optimizing the structure of the biped humanoid robot, when the biped humanoid robot is in the upright state or the walking state, the consumed electric energy is less, and the cruising ability of the biped humanoid robot is effectively guaranteed.

title: Shock excitation system and method for testing dynamic characteristics of footbridge
abstract: The invention discloses an excitation system and method for testing the dynamic characteristics of a footbridge, and the system comprises a plurality of humanoid robots, one of which is provided with a data collection and analysis module; wherein one or more humanoid robots are provided with balancing weights; the control terminal is in communication connection with the humanoid robots and the data acquisition and analysis module and is used for controlling the stride frequency, stride and moving path of the humanoid robots; the monitoring device comprises a plurality of monitoring units, and the monitoring units are distributed on the foot bridge and used for monitoring the vibration acceleration and vibration displacement of the foot bridge; and each monitoring unit is in communication connection with the data acquisition and analysis module. According to the invention, effective excitation of the foot bridge, especially a large-span foot bridge, can be realized, compared with a traditional mode, pedestrian excitation can be simulated more truly, the safety risk caused by adopting pedestrian excitation is avoided, and the test result is accurate and reliable.

title: Humanoid robot flexible action method, device, medium and product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot flexible action method and device, a medium and a product. Flexible joint modules are arranged at joints of the humanoid robot; establishing a natural action model based on human kinematics and dynamics principles; collecting human natural action data to construct an action database; based on the natural action model and the action database, generating a flexible movement track according to a target action and a current state of the robot; controlling the flexible joint module to perform flexible motion according to the flexible motion track, and collecting flexible motion data in real time; and according to the flexible motion data, the operation state of the flexible joint module is adjusted through a force feedback adaptive algorithm. The technical problem that the humanoid robot moves rigidly can be at least solved.

title: Coiled fiber-driven two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist joint and working method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to a coiled fiber-driven two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist joint and a working method thereof.The coiled fiber-driven two-degree-of-freedom parallel wrist joint comprises a fixed platform and a movable platform, a first branch chain, a second branch chain and a third branch chain are arranged between the fixed platform and the movable platform, and the first branch chain and the third branch chain are the same in structure and each composed of two connecting rods and three rotating pairs; the second branch chain is composed of two universal joints and a telescopic rod, driving of the whole joints is achieved through four sets of coiled fibers, the four sets of coiled fibers are installed on the four end faces of the movable platform and the fixed platform respectively, the temperature of the coiled fibers changes when the coiled fibers are powered on and heated, and then the coiled fibers contract and generate driving force to enable the movable platform to move. The mechanism is compact in structure, good in symmetry and high in rigidity and bearing capacity, meanwhile, flexible redundant drive is achieved through the coiled fibers, and then the mechanism has high rigidity and high flexibility. The mechanism is suitable for industrial robot tail end wrist joints, humanoid arm wrist joints, intelligent artificial limbs and other occasions.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a leg structure and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The leg structure comprises a hip lateral extension assembly, a hip pitching assembly, a hip turnover assembly, a thigh skeleton and a shank skeleton which are connected in sequence, and a knee joint assembly connected with the thigh skeleton and the shank skeleton; the output axis of the hip lateral extension assembly, the output axis of the hip turnover assembly and the output axis of the hip pitching assembly are perpendicular to one another, and the output axis of the hip pitching assembly is parallel to the output axis of the knee joint assembly; the hip lateral extension assembly can drive the thigh skeleton to rotate around the output axis of the hip lateral extension assembly, the hip pitching assembly can drive the thigh skeleton to rotate around the output axis of the hip pitching assembly, the hip turnover assembly can drive the thigh skeleton to rotate around the output axis of the hip turnover assembly, and the knee joint assembly can drive the shank skeleton to rotate relative to the thigh skeleton. According to the leg structure, the tail end mass of the leg structure can be reduced, the rotational inertia is reduced, and therefore the flexibility and cruising ability of the biped robot are improved.

title: Obstacle classification three-dimensional A* map biped robot path optimization method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of walking path planning and motion control of biped robots, and particularly relates to a three-dimensional A * map biped robot path optimization method for classifying obstacles, which improves a traditional A * method, records and processes height characteristics of the obstacles, distinguishes the obstacles according to the passing ability of the robots, and improves the walking path planning and motion control of the biped robots. The obstacles are classified into crossing and bypassing, so that a new map is designed more flexibly. According to the method, two types of obstacles are processed on a map, the obstacles capable of being crossed and marked as passable areas, and the obstacles capable of being bypassed and marked as non-passable areas, so that path planning is performed on an established new map, and finally an optimal path from a starting point to an ending point is obtained. Compared with a path planning algorithm for avoiding obstacles, the method combines the structure and motion characteristics of the biped robot, and an optimized passing path can be obtained.

title: Robot swing arm trajectory optimization method based on dynamic planning
abstract: The invention discloses a robot swing arm trajectory optimization method based on dynamic planning, which comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a central mode generator model, and generating a rhythmic swing arm trajectory; s2, acquiring posture state data of the humanoid robot in a running process; s3, converting the rhythmic swing arm track and attitude state data into attitude disturbance input vectors; s4, evaluating a track stability index, and judging whether the track stability index exceeds a deviation threshold value or not; s5, when a threshold value is deviated, an energy control period orbit adjustment algorithm is called to generate an orbit correction candidate parameter; s6, constructing a dynamic planning model by taking attitude disturbance input as a state variable, and searching and outputting an optimal trajectory correction parameter; and S7, the correction parameters are fed back to the central mode generator, and the swing arm track of the next period is generated. According to the invention, through disturbance modeling and track feedback regulation and control, stability optimization and dynamic adaptive control of swing arm motion are realized.

title: Autonomous navigation path planning method and device for humanoid robot in complex environment
abstract: The invention provides an autonomous navigation path planning method, device and equipment for a humanoid robot in a complex environment. A navigation task is determined by obtaining the current position and path requirement of the robot; constructing a constraint preposition map based on body size constraint, joint motion constraint and dynamic balance constraint, and calculating a feasible motion space of the robot in advance; acquiring environment sensing data for variation trend analysis, and predicting a future movement track of the dynamic obstacle to generate a dynamic environment prediction sequence; establishing a bidirectional planning mechanism, performing forward and reverse path search at the same time, and generating a plurality of candidate path hypotheses through meeting point detection and path fusion; analyzing a human behavior pattern to identify a potential passage conflict area, establishing a social negotiation strategy, and taking an intermediate meeting point as a social key node to adaptively adjust a candidate path; the optimal safety path is determined through multi-dimensional safety evaluation of the falling risk, the collision risk and the energy consumption risk, and intelligent autonomous navigation of the humanoid robot in a complex environment is achieved.

title: Projection interaction method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a projection interaction method and system. The projection interaction method comprises the following steps: acquiring input information of a user; generating instruction information in response to the input information; and in response to the instruction information, adjusting arm parameters of the humanoid robot and adjusting projection parameters of a projection interaction interface. The humanoid robot has the advantages that compared with an existing humanoid robot with projection modules located at the chest and the head, the humanoid robot is better in flexibility and smaller in motion range, the projection interaction interface can be adjusted without moving, steering and the like of the humanoid robot, and the interaction effect is improved.

title: Bionic finger, bionic manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a bionic finger, a bionic manipulator and a humanoid robot. title: Robot teleoperation method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot teleoperation method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, the method is applied to a robot teleoperation system, and the teleoperation system comprises a humanoid robot which comprises a chassis part, a trunk part, a first mechanical arm and a tail end execution mechanism; the teleoperation equipment comprises a supporting piece, a second mechanical arm and a tail end handle, the joint configuration of the second mechanical arm is the same as that of the first mechanical arm, and the tail end handle is arranged at the end, away from the supporting piece, of the second mechanical arm; the method comprises the steps that first operation on the second mechanical arm and second operation on the tail end handle are received; a first control instruction and a second control instruction are generated according to the first operation and the second operation, the first control instruction is used for controlling the first mechanical arm to move, and the second control instruction is used for controlling the tail end executing mechanism to move; according to the first control instruction, the first mechanical arm is controlled to execute the same action as the second mechanical arm; and according to the second control instruction, controlling the end execution mechanism to execute opening/closing operation.
abstract_en: The invention provides a robot teleoperation method and device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, the method is applied to a robot teleoperation system, and the teleoperation system comprises a humanoid robot which comprises a chassis part, a trunk part, a first mechanical arm and a tail end execution mechanism; the teleoperation equipment comprises a supporting piece, a second mechanical arm and a tail end handle, the joint configuration of the second mechanical arm is the same as that of the first mechanical arm, and the tail end handle is arranged at the end, away from the supporting piece, of the second mechanical arm; the method comprises the steps that first operation on the second mechanical arm and second operation on the tail end handle are received; a first control instruction and a second control instruction are generated according to the first operation and the second operation, the first control instruction is used for controlling the first mechanical arm to move, and the second control instruction is used for controlling the tail end executing mechanism to move; according to the first control instruction, the first mechanical arm is controlled to execute the same action as the second mechanical arm; and according to the second control instruction, controlling the end execution mechanism to execute opening/closing operation.

title: Intelligent human-shaped finger structure integrating pressure, temperature sensing and heating
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic manufacturing and robot skin, in particular to an intelligent human-shaped finger structure integrating pressure, temperature sensing and heating. The device comprises a finger-shaped appearance structure, a multifunctional film sensor arranged in the finger-shaped appearance structure and a control system, and the multifunctional film sensor comprises an upper substrate, a lower substrate and an electrode circuit arranged between the upper substrate and the lower substrate. The humanoid finger intelligent skin assembly has the advantages that the double-layer film substrate is designed, functional ink such as a printed silver circuit, FSR, PTC and NTC is printed, 3D buzzing forming is carried out, the humanoid finger intelligent skin assembly with the pressure sensing, temperature sensing and heating integrated function is achieved, and the humanoid finger intelligent skin assembly is suitable for application of humanoid robots.

title: Linear driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of sole of human body
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a linear driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of human soles. According to the linear driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of the human foot sole, on the basis that high rigidity, movement precision and bearing capacity are guaranteed, rotation of bionic movement of the human foot sole is achieved through linear reciprocating movement, and the linear driving mechanical joint is simple in structure, good in supporting performance and high in environment adaptability. According to the technical scheme, the invention discloses a linear driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of a human sole. The top end of the shank is connected with a knee joint, the foot body is connected to the bottom end of the shank through a first hooke joint, and the sole is connected to the front end of the foot body through a first rotating pair. The sole driving branch is connected between the foot main body and the sole; and the two ankle driving branches are positioned on the left side and the right side of the shank and are respectively connected between the shank and the foot main body.

title: Humanoid robot and hip structure thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a hip structure thereof. The hip structure comprises a waist main frame, a supporting frame, a lower limb frame, a first motor module and a second motor; a motor accommodating station is arranged in the opposite front of the waist main frame; the lower limb frame is rotatably mounted on the supporting frame around the Y axis; the first motor of one first motor module is mounted above the motor accommodating station, and the first motor of the other first motor module is mounted below the motor accommodating station; one end of the driving swing arm is connected to the supporting frame, the other end of the driving swing arm is connected to the output end of the first motor, and the first motor is used for driving the supporting frame at the other end of the driving swing arm to rotate around the X axis; the second motor is installed on the lower limb frame, and the output end of the second motor is connected to the supporting frame and used for driving the lower limb frame to rotate around the Y axis relative to the supporting frame. According to the scheme, the problems that the motor connecting structure from the hip to the thigh of the robot on the X-axis, the Y-axis and the Z-axis is complex, large space is occupied, and movement and attractiveness are affected are solved.

title: Humanoid robot foot based on human arch
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot foot based on a human arch, and aims to solve the problems that a foot structure of a biped humanoid robot is insufficient in the aspects of stability, rigidity, flexibility, energy efficiency, diversity, ergonomics and the like. The five toes, the first metal vertical plate and the second metal vertical plate are fixed to the sole metal plate, the hallux toe sleeve is sleeved on the toes and connected with the toes through the first elastic metal driving rod, and the final toe sleeve is sleeved on the toes and connected with the toes through the second elastic metal driving rod. A first C-shaped connecting rod connected with a first elastic metal driving rod and a second elastic metal driving rod is inserted into the front portion of an ankle connecting block, the bottom of the ankle connecting block is connected with a heel metal plate through a plurality of spring columns, and a second C-shaped connecting rod is inserted into the rear portion of the ankle connecting block. And the second C-shaped connecting rod is fixed with the heel metal plate through the heel elastic metal driving rod. According to the scheme, the shoe sole has better adaptability and balance.

title: Humanoid robot capable of sweeping floor and control system thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot capable of sweeping a floor and a control system thereof, and the humanoid robot comprises a cleaning module with a biped walking capability, a multi-degree-of-freedom joint humanoid body, an integrated dust collection device, a rolling brush, a mop and an automatic switching mechanism, a sensing system comprising a laser radar and the like, and a navigation and path planning system based on an SLAM algorithm. And human-computer interaction interfaces such as voice interaction are supported. The control system comprises an embedded processor, a task scheduling unit, a state monitoring unit, a fault processing module and an energy consumption management unit, and can coordinate the work of each module. The robot has the advantages that the problem that an existing sweeping robot is limited in cleaning capacity, and a humanoid robot lacks a cleaning function is solved, organic combination of flexible movement and efficient cleaning is achieved, and the intelligent cleaning requirement under the complex indoor environment is met.

title: Solar energy utilization device and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a solar energy utilization device and a humanoid robot. The device comprises a modular shell, the shell is designed in a modular mode, flexible solar cells are customized according to the curved surface of the modular shell, and the flexible solar cells are installed on the surface of the modular shell in an attached mode; the dynamic angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on the surface of the modular shell and used for automatically adjusting the angle of the surface of the modular shell according to ambient light; and the intelligent energy management system integrates the flexible solar cell and the battery and is used for performing intelligent management on energy. The technical problems that the cruising ability of a humanoid robot is limited by the battery energy density, the movement performance is affected by separation of an energy collection device and a rack, a rigid solar panel is difficult to adapt to a shell curved surface, the solar energy utilization rate is low due to a fixed installation angle, and modular maintenance and updating of a solar system are difficult in the prior art can be at least solved.

title: Biped humanoid robot robust motion control method based on state reconstruction
abstract: The invention discloses a biped humanoid robot robust motion control method based on state reconstruction. The biped humanoid robot robust motion control method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting robot sensor data; step S2, state reconstruction; s3, generating a robust control strategy; s4, closed-loop motion control is conducted, specifically, the motion instruction generated in the S3 is combined with real-time feedback of the robot to conduct closed-loop control, and posture adjustment and gait balance of the robot are ensured; according to the method, sensor data are collected in real time, a state reconstruction module based on an encoder-decoder network and a gating cycle unit (GRU) is used for conducting state reconstruction on original data with noise and partial observation missing, and therefore accurate robot motion state estimation is obtained. An asymmetric actor-commentator reinforcement learning strategy is combined with closed-loop feedback to realize robust gait control of the robot on complex terrains (such as stairs, uneven road surfaces and concave-convex terrains).

title: Interaction action decision optimization method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an interactive action decision optimization method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining current environment state information and target task information, carrying out the feature extraction of the obtained current environment state information, and obtaining corresponding state feature data; encoding the obtained target task information to obtain a corresponding target encoding vector, and performing data splicing according to the state feature data and the target encoding vector to obtain comprehensive state vector data; performing parameter optimization on the trained optimization decision model through a preset experience playback pool to obtain an optimized optimization decision model; and inputting the obtained comprehensive state vector data into the optimized optimization decision model for processing to obtain a target action instruction, and driving the humanoid robot to move according to the target action instruction. According to the embodiment of the invention, the decision-making accuracy and the decision-making efficiency can be improved.

title: Biped humanoid robot path planning method based on improved RRT
abstract: The invention discloses a biped humanoid robot path planning method based on improved RRT. The biped humanoid robot path planning method comprises the following steps: S1, a sampling stage; S2, an expansion stage; a self-adaptive step length extension strategy is adopted, and the configuration of the sampling step length is associated with the number of obstacles and the size of the area occupied by the obstacles in the space; when potential collision with an obstacle is detected, preliminary evaluation is firstly carried out, an estimation function is established to eliminate the safe obstacle which is relatively far away from a new node, and then detailed collision analysis is carried out, and S5, a pruning strategy is carried out; according to the method, a new attraction function and a new adaptive step heuristic function in the extension stage are designed, the attraction function scans the surrounding environment and adaptively adjusts the attraction amplitude, the search efficiency of the random tree is improved, random extension around an obstacle is prevented, and therefore the quality and the adaptive capacity of path planning are ensured.

title: Leg and foot structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The leg and foot structure of the humanoid robot comprises a driving assembly and an ankle joint assembly, and the bottom of the ankle joint assembly is connected with a foot sole; wherein the driving assembly comprises two symmetrically-arranged driving motors, the axes of output shafts of the two driving motors are located on the same straight line, the ankle joint assembly comprises a first rope winding rotating shaft and a second rope winding rotating shaft, and a third rope winding rotating shaft is further arranged on the rotating supporting structural part; the third rope winding rotating shaft is located between the first rope winding rotating shaft and the second rope winding rotating shaft, and each output shaft is provided with at least two first ropes connected with the first rope winding rotating shaft or the second rope winding rotating shaft. Second ropes wound on the third rope winding rotating shaft are further arranged on the upper sides and the lower sides of the first rope winding rotating shaft and the second rope winding rotating shaft. The motion range and the motion precision of the ankle joint are effectively improved, and the motion ability of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot arm
abstract: The humanoid robot arm comprises a shoulder shell, a big arm shell is rotationally arranged on the lower portion of the shoulder shell, a fixing ring is fixedly installed at the top of the big arm shell, an elbow shell is rotationally arranged on the lower portion of the big arm shell, and a small arm shell is rotationally arranged at the bottom of the elbow shell. A servo motor in the linkage heat dissipation assembly rotates to drive a large suction fan blade and a plurality of small suction fan blades to synchronously blow air for heat dissipation, the large suction fan blade conducts heat dissipation on the middle portion of a harmonic reducer, the small suction fan blades conduct heat dissipation on the edge of the harmonic reducer, and the large suction fan blade and the small suction fan blades conduct heat dissipation on the edge of the harmonic reducer. Synchronous heat dissipation of the center and the edge is achieved, the heat dissipation effect is good, in the blowing heat dissipation process, through arrangement of the spiral air inlet pipe in a spiral shape, spiral air inlet is achieved, the air flow speed is increased, the heat dissipation efficiency is improved, and quick mounting and dismounting of the mechanical arm are achieved through the quick dismounting mechanism.

title: Linear execution mechanism applied to humanoid robot
abstract: A linear actuating mechanism applied to a humanoid robot relates to the field of robot parts and comprises a driving structure, a spiral spring structure and an accessory structure, the driving structure comprises a linear motor, a driver is arranged at the bottom of the linear motor, a sensor group is mounted at the end of the linear motor, and the spiral spring structure is connected with the sensor group. One end of the linear motor away from the sensor group is provided with a tension-pressure sensor; the spiral spring structure comprises a spiral spring, a spring supporting seat and a second spring supporting seat are arranged at the two ends of the spiral spring respectively, and a fixing cylinder is arranged on the spring supporting seat. The accessory structure comprises a connecting rod and a second connecting rod. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages that: planetary roller screw transmission parts are reduced, the efficiency is high, the weight is light, and the cost is saved; and the mechanical resistance and noise are reduced, so that the linear actuating mechanism runs more smoothly. The functions of shock absorption, energy storage and limiting are achieved. And active stroke, rigidity and damping adjusting functions are provided.

title: Novel humanoid robot neck structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a novel humanoid robot neck structure which comprises a first base, clamping plates, a rotating plate, a second base, a rotating disc, a first neck arm, a second neck arm and a third neck arm, the clamping plates are symmetrically installed on the first base, the rotating plate is rotatably installed between the two clamping plates, the second base is installed on the top of the rotating plate, and the rotating disc is installed on the second base. A turntable is rotationally mounted on the second base; the first motor works to achieve left-right rotation of the second base and simulate the left-right head shaking action of the humanoid robot, the second motor works to achieve horizontal rotation of the rotating disc with the first rotating shaft as the circle center and simulate the head turning action of the humanoid robot, and the third motor works and meshing transmission of the driving teeth and the driven teeth. Rotation adjustment of multi-stage neck arms is achieved, head raising and head lowering actions of the humanoid robot are simulated, and then multi-angle and multi-direction movement of the neck of the humanoid robot is guaranteed.

title: Novel humanoid robot integrated joint module
abstract: The utility model relates to a novel humanoid robot integrated joint module which comprises fixed covers, first joint arms, a rotating shell and a second joint arm, the fixed covers are provided with the first joint arms, the two first joint arms are detachably installed, the rotating shell is rotatably installed between the two fixed covers, and the second joint arms are detachably installed between the rotating shell and the fixed covers. A rotating groove is formed between the two fixing covers, and a second joint arm penetrating through the rotating groove is installed on the rotating shell. The two fixing covers are detachably installed and can be conveniently assembled with the rotating shell, meanwhile, the multilateral connecting columns of the installation disc are connected with the output shaft of the bevel gear box in an inserted mode, then overall assembly of the joint module is achieved, and follow-up disassembly, assembly and maintenance are facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot motion debugging protection device
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot motion debugging protection device, and relates to the technical field of robots. A first guide rail pulley controller is connected with a first end of a first supporting top beam and a first end of a movable supporting cross beam; the second guide rail pulley controller is connected with the second end of the second supporting top beam and the second end of the movable supporting cross beam. And the third guide rail pulley controller is respectively connected with the movable support cross beam and the safety traction rope restraint device. The first guide rail pulley controller and the second guide rail pulley controller control the safe traction rope to move in the direction of the first supporting top beam, and the third guide rail pulley controller control the safe traction rope to move in the direction of the movable supporting cross beam. Therefore, the safe traction rope can automatically track the movement of the humanoid robot in the debugging process of the humanoid robot. Manual participation is not needed, and the labor cost is reduced. And moreover, the damage probability of the humanoid robot is reduced, the debugging efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved, and the personnel safety is improved.

title: Robot collaborative assembly method based on hand space posture intention perception
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a robot collaborative assembly method based on hand space attitude intention perception, comprising: constructing a customized gesture recognition model for tool holding gestures; recognizing a hand in the target image in real time, and extracting three-dimensional coordinate information of key points of the hand in real time; based on the three-dimensional coordinate information of the key points of the hand, calculating a spatial rotation angle of the hand through an attitude algorithm; mapping the rotation angle data to a motion parameter range required by control of the humanoid wrist joint robot; and integrating the motion parameters with the gesture information, generating a control instruction, and controlling the robot to act based on the control instruction. According to the method, the space rotation angle of the hand is calculated in real time, the robot simulating the hand wrist joint can recognize angle information based on the space rotation angle, the hand posture of an operator is dynamically responded and matched, the continuous hand following function can be achieved, and man-machine cooperative assembly is achieved.

title: Super-flexible cable for humanoid robot and preparation method of super-flexible cable
abstract: The invention provides a super-flexible cable for a humanoid robot and a preparation method thereof, the super-flexible cable for the humanoid robot comprises a core body, an insulating layer and a sheath, the core body comprises copper foil wires and an aramid fiber column, and the plurality of copper foil wires are spirally twisted by taking the aramid fiber column as a center; the insulating layer comprises modified aramid fibers, and the modified aramid fibers are obtained by processing aramid fibers with a LiCl-polyvinylpyrrolidone solution and grafting the aramid fibers with a toluene solution of trimethoxysilane/1, 6-hexamethylene diisocyanate. The cable provided by the invention has excellent flexibility, and is suitable for various complex and narrow installation spaces and frequent bending application scenes; the addition of the modified aramid fiber and the optimized cabling structure significantly improve the tensile strength and bending fatigue resistance of the cable, and prolong the service life.

title: Intelligent humanoid robot system based on somatosensory control and method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control and intelligent interaction, and discloses an intelligent humanoid robot system based on somatosensory control, which comprises a central processing unit, the receiving end of the central processing unit is in signal connection with the transmitting end of a server, and the receiving end of the central processing unit is in signal connection with the transmitting end of a control hardware management unit. According to the intelligent humanoid robot system based on somatosensory control, different from a traditional remote controller mode, the wearable somatosensory device is used for collecting human body limb movement and posture data, synchronous mapping control over movement of the humanoid robot is achieved through wireless transmission, meanwhile, visual feedback of the robot is provided, an operator can achieve the effect that what you see is what you control, and the intelligent humanoid robot system is convenient to use. The robot is provided with a wearable, modularized and low-power-consumption somatosensory device design, is provided with an intelligent learning module, can perform behavior prediction and automatically adjust the motion precision through historical motion data and scene recognition, and can provide motion assistance in a specific scene, so that the control intelligence level is further improved.

title: Preparation and application of lightweight and low-cost humanoid robot skin
abstract: The invention discloses preparation and application of light-weight and low-cost humanoid robot skin, and belongs to the field of application of humanoid robot surface materials. Comprising the following steps that S1, waterborne polyurethane slurry is sprayed to an inner mold body of a mold A and an inner mold body of a mold B correspondingly, and drying is conducted; foaming type polyurethane resin is injected into the mold A, demolding is conducted after the foaming type polyurethane resin is completely foamed and cured at the normal temperature, and a polyurethane foaming body is obtained; s2, a platinum silica gel catalyst is sprayed on the polyurethane foaming body and the mold B; s3, a polyurethane foaming body is fixed into the mold B; injecting the mixed silica gel into a gap of the mold B; curing and demolding; and S4, after demolding, carrying out surface hand feeling treatment by using skin feeling water-based slurry, and drying to obtain the light-weight and low-cost humanoid robot skin. The polyurethane forms a compact polymeric membrane after being dried, so that the problem of oil leakage on the surface of the silica gel is effectively solved, and the surface wear resistance, scratch resistance and light aging resistance are remarkably improved.

title: Deceleration servo motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motors, and discloses a deceleration servo motor for a humanoid robot, which comprises a motor main body, a deceleration mechanism and a transmission shaft, the motor main body is in transmission connection with the transmission shaft through the deceleration mechanism, and the deceleration mechanism comprises a shell, a sun gear, a plurality of planet gears, a planet carrier and a gear ring. A first locking piece and a second locking piece are arranged in the shell in a sliding mode, when the first locking piece is in a first locking state, the first locking piece locks the planet carrier and the transmission block, when the first locking piece is in a second locking state, the first locking piece locks the planet carrier and the shell, and when the second locking piece is in the first locking state, the second locking piece locks the planet carrier and the shell. When the second locking piece is in the first locking state, the gear ring and the transmission block are locked through the second locking piece, and when the second locking piece is in the second locking state, the gear ring and the shell are locked through the second locking piece. The problem that in the prior art, the transmission ratio of a speed reduction servo motor is fixed, and different transmission ratios cannot be adjusted corresponding to different loads is solved.

title: Hollow rotary joint module and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hollow rotary joint module and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. The hollow rotary joint module comprises a harmonic reducer, a motor assembly, an encoder magnetic ring assembly and an output flange. The motor assembly comprises a frameless motor and a motor flange, the rotor is rotationally arranged on the inner side of the stator, the rotor is connected with the motor flange to drive the motor flange to rotate, and the motor flange is connected with the wave generator; a first magnetic ring of the encoder magnetic ring assembly is arranged on a first magnetic ring flange, the first magnetic ring flange is connected with a motor flange and a wave generator, a second magnetic ring is arranged on a second magnetic ring flange, and the first magnetic ring and the second magnetic ring are located on the same plane. The output flange comprises a flange part and a straight barrel part, openings are formed in the two opposite ends of the straight barrel part, the straight barrel part penetrates through the harmonic reducer, the first magnetic ring flange and the second magnetic ring flange, and the flange part is connected with the harmonic reducer. The hollow rotary joint module is compact in structure, the overall length of the hollow rotary joint module is reduced, and the size of the hollow rotary joint module is smaller.

title: Two-connecting-rod driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of sole of human body
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a two-connecting-rod driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of human soles. According to the two-connecting-rod driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of the human foot sole, on the basis that high rigidity, movement precision and bearing capacity are guaranteed, swinging of the human foot sole is simulated by adding one freedom degree, and the two-connecting-rod driving mechanical joint is simple in structure and good in supporting performance. According to the technical scheme, the invention discloses a two-connecting-rod driving mechanical joint simulating rotation of a human sole. The top end of the shank is connected with a knee joint, the foot body is connected to the bottom end of the shank through a first hooke joint, and the sole is connected with the foot body through a first rotating pair. The sole driving branch is connected between the foot main body and the sole; and the two ankle driving branches are positioned on the left side and the right side of the shank and are respectively connected with the shank and the foot main body.

title: Humanoid robot with automatic obstacle avoidance function and use method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot with an automatic obstacle avoidance function and a use method, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, the humanoid robot comprises a main body and an automatic cleaning module, the main body is provided with the automatic cleaning module, and the automatic cleaning module is used for automatically cleaning environment sensing equipment of the humanoid robot; the automatic cleaning module is one of a rotary cleaning mechanism and a movable cleaning mechanism. By installing the automatic cleaning module, the automatic cleaning function when stains appear on the environment sensing equipment is achieved, the problem that the stains on a lens of the environment sensing equipment affect the robot and capture of surrounding environment images is solved, and the accuracy and safety of obstacle avoidance are improved.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a knuckle assembly, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. Wherein the near-end knuckle module (10) is thicker, the far-end knuckle module (20) is thinner, and in a projection plane perpendicular to the output shaft, the projections of the first support (1) and the second support (3) are both within the outer contour range of the projection of the near-end knuckle module (10), and the projection of the far-end knuckle module (20) is within the outer contour range of the projection of the second support (3). By means of the arrangement, driving connection between the near-end knuckle module (10) and the far-end knuckle module (20) can be achieved more easily in a narrow finger space.

title: Novel humanoid robot waist structure
abstract: The utility model relates to a novel humanoid robot waist structure which comprises a base, a rotating seat, bearing seats, a U-shaped seat, a rotating block and a supporting seat, the rotating seat is rotatably installed on the base, the bearing seats are symmetrically installed on the top side of the rotating seat, the U-shaped seat is rotatably installed between the two bearing seats, the rotating block is rotatably installed in the U-shaped seat, and the supporting seat is installed on the rotating block. A supporting seat is installed on the top side of the rotating block, a first lubricating mechanism is installed on the outer side of the bearing seat, and second lubricating mechanisms are installed on the two opposite sides of the U-shaped seat. The waist structure can simulate horizontal rotation work of the waist of the humanoid robot, stoop work of the humanoid robot in the front-back direction and stoop work of the humanoid robot in the left-right direction, and multi-angle adjustment of the waist is achieved.

title: Target pose tiny change estimation method for monocular vision of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a target pose tiny change estimation method for monocular vision of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: S1, firstly, applying tiny and accurate displacement and inclination to an object, and obtaining images before and after the change of the object through a monocular camera; s2, feature point detection is carried out on each grid object image; s3, perspective projection transformation is carried out on known grid point coordinates and unknown grid point coordinates; s4, a multivariate nonlinear optimization problem is introduced into unknown grid point coordinates, high-precision parameters of six-degree-of-freedom change of an object can be obtained, an estimation algorithm is improved, the original point of attitude change is the gravity center of a point cloud, in addition, the convergence speed of iterative calculation is also increased, and the method has the advantages of being high in robustness and high in robustness. Experimental measurement is carried out by using a simple and cheap monocular optical system, and the displacement change of about 0.25 mm and the dip angle change of 0.1 degree can be measured with high precision.

title: Humanoid robot attitude estimation method based on physical information constraint
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot attitude estimation method based on physical information constraint. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, establishing an attitude estimation network model; step 2, constructing a loss function; step 3, training the attitude estimation network model, and then performing attitude estimation by using the attitude estimation network model; step 4, calculating a state prediction value and a covariance matrix thereof; 5, calculating a gain matrix of the attitude estimation network model; step 6, calculating a posteriori estimation value of the state and a covariance matrix of the state; 7, calculating the state estimation result to obtain the joint posture estimation of the humanoid robot at the current moment; and step 8, repeatedly executing the step 4 to the step 7 to obtain attitude estimation results at all moments. The structure driven by the hybrid model can effectively avoid the conditions that the network model has large demand on annotation data and is easy to fall into local optimum and the like, and can provide an accurate attitude estimation result.

title: Differential planetary roller screw test experiment table for dexterous hand of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot dexterous hand differential planetary roller screw test experiment table, which comprises an experiment table base, an experiment table box body I and an experiment table box body II are symmetrically and slidably arranged at two ends of the experiment table base, and a groove is formed in the middle of the experiment table base; a reverse side hollow cup motor support is arranged on one side of the outer portion of a middle groove of the experiment table base, and a reverse side servo hollow cup motor used for testing a reverse differential type planetary roller screw is fixedly arranged on the reverse side hollow cup motor support. A thrust plate is arranged in a middle groove of the experiment table base in a sliding mode, and a reverse side tool plate is fixed to the side, close to the reverse side hollow cup motor support, of the thrust plate. According to the invention, full-dimensional test support can be provided for high and low temperature working conditions, dynamic response and durability of the differential planetary roller screw of the dexterous hand of the humanoid robot, and the comprehensive performance test work of the differential planetary roller screw of the dexterous hand of the humanoid robot can be rapidly and effectively carried out.

title: High-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy direct drive
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of manipulators, and discloses a high-degree-of-freedom humanoid dexterous hand based on shape memory alloy direct drive, which comprises a palm seat and a plurality of fingers arranged on the palm seat side by side, and each finger comprises a plurality of semiconductor refrigeration modules, a plurality of SMA wires, a plurality of bias reset springs and a plurality of knuckles hinged to each other, each knuckle is driven by the corresponding semiconductor refrigeration module and the two corresponding SMA wires to swing, and rapid reset is achieved under the action of the offset reset spring. The dexterous hand has the advantages of being high in degree of freedom, good in flexibility, rapid in response and light in weight, and fine and flexible grabbing actions can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot simulation skin and temperature control system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot simulation skin and a temperature control system thereof. The simulated skin comprises an outer-layer soft material; the internal temperature control layer is arranged on the inner side, and the integrated temperature sensor is used for monitoring the surface temperature in real time; the heating module is a micro electric heating wire; the periphery of the liquid circulation system is filled with the phase change material, a paraffin-based or hydrated salt material is adopted, and the temperature is kept stable through phase change at the temperature of 35-38 DEG C. The temperature control system comprises a temperature sensor for collecting data, a built-in machine learning algorithm optimization strategy and PID closed-loop control and adjustment; the heat exchange system adjusts the heat-conducting liquid to dynamically control the temperature; the intelligent battery management system supplies power and monitors energy consumption. The robot has the advantages that human body temperature simulation is achieved through the composite structure and the intelligent temperature control technology, the problem that an existing robot lacks temperature feedback is solved, and the naturalness and functionality of man-machine interaction are improved.

title: Built-in cycloid speed reducer of humanoid robot joint disc output structure and joint module
abstract: The invention discloses a built-in cycloid speed reducer of a humanoid robot joint disc output structure and a joint module. The problems that an existing robot joint module is large in size, insufficient in transmission precision and bearing capacity and the like are solved. The joint module adopts a compact built-in design, the motor and the cycloid speed reducer are integrated, the cycloid speed reducer adopts a disc output structure, and the joint module has the advantages of high integration level, high transmission precision, large torque, high rigidity, strong impact resistance, long service life and the like, and is particularly suitable for the requirements of humanoid robot joints on compactness and high performance. And the tooth profile of the cycloidal gear adopts a parabola modification method, so that the meshing characteristic is further optimized, the transmission stability is improved, and the transmission error is reduced. Complete self-sealing is achieved, secondary pollution to the operation environment of the robot is avoided, a simple and convenient installation mode is achieved, the two ends of the input crankshaft are supported by the cylindrical roller bearings, and radial force can be directly borne.

title: Rubber material for humanoid robot protection application and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of rubber materials, in particular to a rubber material for humanoid robot protection application and a preparation method thereof.The rubber material takes ethylene propylene diene monomer, hydrogenated nitrile rubber and fluororubber as matrixes, modified nano silicon dioxide, carbon nanotubes and other fillers are compounded, and flame-retardant, antistatic and other functional auxiliaries are added; the uniform performance of the material is ensured through the processes of ultrasonic-assisted dispersion, segmented gradient vulcanization and the like; the protection assembly is of a multi-layer composite structure composed of a base cloth enhancement layer, a buffer layer and a functional surface layer, interlayer chemical bonding is achieved through plasma treatment, and the functional surface layer obtains the self-lubricating and lyophobic characteristics through laser micro-texture treatment. The tensile strength of the material is larger than or equal to 18 MPa, the flame retardance reaches the UL94V-0 level, the surface resistivity is smaller than or equal to 1 * 10 < 9 > ohm, and the material has excellent mechanical performance, environment tolerance and multifunctional integration and can be widely applied to humanoid robot protection in the fields of industry, medical treatment and the like, the reliability of a robot is effectively improved, and the service life of the robot is effectively prolonged.

title: Bionic humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a bionic humanoid mechanical arm which comprises a shoulder joint module, a big arm module, an elbow joint module, a small arm module and a wrist joint module which are connected in sequence. The wrist joint module realizes two-degree-of-freedom flexible movement through a regular octahedron tensegrity structure, and the rotation centers of the wrist joint module naturally intersect at one point and are connected with the rolling shaft in series to form three-degree-of-freedom concurrent rotation; the length-adjustable supporting rod in the flexible structure changes the joint rigidity in real time and dynamically adapts to the load change so as to enhance the man-machine interaction safety; an elbow joint adopts a virtual pitch circle rolling mechanism, all joint-crossing driving rope paths are forced to remain unchanged, and multi-joint motion coupling is eliminated from the mechanical intrinsic level; a driving motor and a rope wheel system are arranged on the large arm module in a centralized mode, the rope tensioning state is continuously optimized in cooperation with a ratchet wheel type self-locking tension mechanism, and the tail end inertia is reduced under the condition that an elbow and wrist joint motor is completely removed.

title: Micro-chain actuator for humanoid robot and dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-chain actuator for a humanoid robot, which comprises a micro-chain actuator main body, the micro-chain actuator main body comprises a driving module, a speed reduction module and a pushing module, the speed reduction module is arranged below the driving module, the pushing module is arranged on one side of the driving module and the speed reduction module, and the speed reduction module is arranged on the other side of the driving module. The driving module is in transmission connection with the pushing module through the speed reduction module. According to the miniature chain actuator for the humanoid robot, the pushing module is arranged on the other side of the driving module and the speed reduction module, the advantage that the longitudinal size of the driving module and the speed reduction module is small is considered through the parallel arrangement mode, the defect that the longitudinal size of the pushing module is large is overcome, and the space size of the device can be reduced as much as possible; meanwhile, the size of actuators such as a hollow cup motor integrated lead screw and an electric cylinder which are commonly used at present is greatly reduced, the problems of large machining difficulty and high manufacturing and maintaining cost are avoided, and the effective extending stroke of the micro chain actuator body is far larger than that of other linear actuators.

title: Built-in cycloid speed reducer of humanoid robot joint crosshead shoe output structure and joint module
abstract: The invention discloses a built-in cycloid speed reducer of a humanoid robot joint crosshead shoe output structure and a joint module. The problems that an existing robot joint module is large in size, complex in structure, insufficient in transmission precision and bearing capacity and the like are solved. According to the invention, the frameless torque motor and the cycloidal-pin wheel speed reducer are designed in an integrated built-in manner, so that the structure is highly compact; the cycloidal speed reducer adopts a cross slide block output structure, planetary motion of the cycloidal gear is efficiently converted into rotary motion of an output flange, and the structure has the advantages of being short in transmission chain, high in rigidity and small in return difference. In addition, a parabola modification method is adopted for the tooth profile of the cycloidal gear, the meshing characteristic of the gear is optimized, the transmission stability is improved, and noise is reduced. The joint module has the advantages of being high in integration level, high in torque density, high in rigidity, high in impact resistance, convenient and fast to install and the like, and is particularly suitable for humanoid robot joints with strict requirements for space and performance.

title: Combined humanoid artificial hand
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid artificial hands, in particular to a combined humanoid artificial hand which comprises a base, an arm bin and an auxiliary connecting assembly. A connecting base is fixedly arranged in the center of the side end of the base, a connecting groove is formed in the center of the end of the arm bin, and the connecting base is sleeved with a protective pad. The two sides of the protective pad are connected with the side face of the base and the end face of the arm bin in a clamped mode respectively. The auxiliary connecting assembly is arranged on the base and the arm bin; the waterproof artificial hand has the advantages that the joint of the base where the artificial hand is installed and the arm bin has the waterproof effect through the auxiliary connecting assembly, water is prevented from permeating into the arm bin to affect normal use of a control circuit of the artificial hand, meanwhile, the auxiliary connecting assembly adopts a combined component to protect the base and the arm bin, damage caused by knocking is avoided, and maintenance is convenient.
