title: Foot damping structure of biped robot
abstract: The foot damping structure of the biped robot comprises a sole body, a first cavity and a second cavity are formed in the sole body, the first cavity is located at the front sole position of the sole body, and the second cavity is located at the heel position of the sole body. Hydraulic oil is injected into the first cavity and the second cavity respectively, the first cavity is communicated with the second cavity, thin channels are formed in the side walls of the first expansion chamber and the second expansion chamber respectively, and the first expansion chamber and the second expansion chamber are communicated with the first cavity and the second cavity through the thin channels respectively. The buffer mechanism can be suitable for various terrain scenes, impact and vibration are greatly absorbed in the process that the robot achieves high-dynamic impact actions such as running and jumping of various lower limbs, the influence of the buffer mechanism on motion control and algorithms is reduced, the stability of the robot is improved, and the service life of the robot is prolonged. And meanwhile, the service life and reliability of robot parts and the whole machine are improved.

title: Linear actuator of humanoid robot
abstract: The linear actuator of the humanoid robot comprises a servo electric cylinder and a limiting ring fixedly connected to the front end of the servo electric cylinder, a supporting ring is connected to the front side of the limiting ring in a sliding mode, a heat dissipation device is installed on the front side of the supporting ring, a through hole is formed in the surface of the heat dissipation device, and a through hole is formed in the surface of the through hole. A fixing assembly is arranged on the surface of the supporting ring, a limiting structure is arranged on the surface of the limiting ring, the semi-column rod is placed in the inner cavity of the round hole, then the semi-column rod is unfolded under the action of the spring piece, the surface of the limiting block is buckled by the inner cavity of the limiting groove, and then the heat dissipation device and the limiting ring are fixed. Therefore, the purpose of cooling the position of the output end of the servo electric cylinder to prolong the overall service life of the servo electric cylinder can be achieved.

title: Multi-modal sensing security humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode sensing security humanoid robot and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of security humanoid robots, and the specific steps are as follows: step 1, integrating sensing devices and control chips of all parts of the robot, configuring scanning frequency parameters, and realizing environment sensing and action control functions; the method comprises a first step of establishing a dangerous sample feature library through multi-source data labeling, a second step of fusing multi-sensor data to realize robot gait control, and performing identification and verification on personnel based on pre-stored data, and a third step of establishing the dangerous sample feature library through multi-source data labeling, and realizing a whole process of danger identification and response by calculating a sample feature matching degree. And a sample equalization coefficient is optimized, and the feature difference learning ability of the model to dangerous actions/scenes and non-dangerous actions/scenes is improved, so that the danger identification precision is improved, and rapid identification and response to dangerous conditions are realized.

title: Full-drive dexterous hand
abstract: The full-drive dexterous hand comprises a palm mechanism, a thumb mechanism and a finger mechanism, the thumb mechanism comprises a metacarpal bone, a thumb near knuckle and a thumb far knuckle which are sequentially distributed, the metacarpal bone obtains bending and rolling freedom degrees through gear transmission, and the thumb near knuckle and the thumb far knuckle both obtain bending freedom degrees through motor direct drive; the finger mechanism comprises a finger near knuckle, a finger middle knuckle and a finger far knuckle which are sequentially distributed, the finger near knuckle obtains bending and side-sway freedom degrees through gear transmission, and the finger middle knuckle and the finger far knuckle obtain bending freedom degrees through motor direct drive. A full-drive humanoid manipulator framework is adopted, high-precision motion mapping is achieved through 20 independent controllable degrees of freedom, the bionic core is that the ball joint design is adopted, the composite motion capacity of human fingers is highly simulated, fine actions such as grabbing, kneading and rotating of a human hand can be accurately reproduced, and the flexibility degree of the human hand is deeply restored.

title: Unmanned deinsectization humanoid robot based on machine intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arm control, in particular to an unmanned deinsectization humanoid robot based on machine intelligence, which comprises a robot camera, a robot head, a robot shell and robot arms. According to the invention, pest data are collected through the camera and the wind power sensor, the collected pest data are input into the control system, the control system analyzes the pest data, and catch-up and deinsectization tasks are carried out on pests according to an analysis result. By chasing and killing the pests, the pest killing efficiency of the robot on the pests in the surrounding environment is improved, meanwhile, the whole task process is autonomously controlled by the robot, and the purpose of unmanned robot intelligent pest killing is achieved.

title: High dynamic response control method and system for linear actuator of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high dynamic response control method and system for a linear actuator of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the pressure and moment data of a contact point, carrying out the data preprocessing and signal calibration processing, and obtaining the calibration pressure and moment data; based on the calibrated pressure and torque data, performing high-frequency signal extraction to obtain dynamic change characteristics, and performing distribution diagram construction in combination with the pressure and torque data to obtain a pressure distribution diagram and a torque distribution diagram; performing data fusion processing according to the pressure distribution diagram and the torque distribution diagram, generating real-time contact area distribution, and performing dynamic prediction model construction based on the pressure and torque data to obtain a dynamic prediction model; according to the dynamic prediction model, actuator output force and joint angle adjustment amount are calculated, output torque and angle compensation amount are generated, torque distribution optimization and force feedback compensation are carried out, and an optimized final control signal is obtained. According to the method, high-dynamic response control of the controller can be realized.

title: Driving wheel mechanism and wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a driving wheel mechanism and a wheeled humanoid robot. The driving wheel mechanism comprises a supporting plate and a slewing bearing. The walking driving assembly and the rotating driving assembly are movably arranged on the supporting plate in a penetrating mode; the wheel assembly is movably arranged below the slewing bearing and is in transmission connection with the walking driving assembly and the rotation driving assembly; the walking driving assembly comprises a walking driving motor, and an output shaft of the walking driving motor movably penetrates through the central axis of the slewing bearing; the first-stage speed reduction transmission mechanism is rotationally arranged on the wheel assembly and is in transmission connection with an output shaft of the walking driving motor; and the second-stage speed reduction transmission mechanism is in transmission connection with the first-stage speed reduction transmission mechanism and the wheel assembly. According to the driving wheel mechanism, the walking driving motor and the rotating driving motor are both arranged on the supporting plate, then the two-stage speed reduction transmission structure drives the wheel assembly to linearly walk, and the problem that a cable of an existing driving wheel mechanism is prone to abrasion is effectively solved.

title: Humanoid emotion accompanying robot based on multi-modal interaction
abstract: The humanoid emotion accompanying robot comprises a robot body, a robot head body is arranged at the upper end of the robot body, a walking mechanism is arranged at the lower end of the robot body, and the robot head body is provided with a non-contact physical sign collecting module. The non-contact physical sign collection module comprises sound pickups located at the ears, monitoring cameras located at the eyes and a millimeter wave radar sensor located at the nose, the non-contact physical sign collection module is electrically connected with the central processing unit through the controller, and the controller and the central processing unit are both located in the robot body. A touch display screen electrically connected with the controller is arranged on the front face of the robot body, and a storage mechanism is arranged below the touch display screen. According to the invention, the physical signs of the user are collected through the non-contact physical sign collection module, and the central processing unit analyzes the physical signs of the user to obtain the emotion of the user, so that a basis is provided for the emotion communication between the accompanying robot and the user.

title: Composite dielectric layer neuromorphic memristor based on IAZO and IGZO and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a composite dielectric layer neuromorphic memristor based on IAZO and IGZO. A dielectric layer comprises an indium aluminum zinc oxide layer and an indium gallium zinc oxide layer. The neural morphological memristor has the advantages that the consistency and stability of an I-V curve of the neural morphological memristor can be remarkably improved, and the neural morphological memristor has a good memristor cycle characteristic, a stable resistance ratio and a relatively small threshold voltage; in addition, the composite dielectric layer memristor also has the'threshold 'characteristic, the'non-adaptation' characteristic and the'sensitization 'characteristic of a pain receptor, and promotes the development of artificial sensory systems for electronic skins, prostheses, humanoid robots and the like.

title: Humanoid robot gait control method and system based on imitation and inverse reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gait control method and system based on simulation and inverse reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the walking data of a human body or a simulation robot to construct a high-quality training data set, and calculating the similarity between the robot and expert data through a graph convolution structure; a multi-dimensional linear reward function is designed based on a task target, four types of indexes including stability, gait periodicity, trajectory similarity and energy efficiency are integrated, and multi-target optimization is achieved through weight distribution. A neural network is adopted to construct a strategy model, training is performed in combination with a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, and a strategy ratio cutting technology is utilized to constrain an update amplitude so as to improve learning stability. And meanwhile, a maximum entropy principle is introduced to dynamically update a reward function, so that the adaptability to expert strategies is enhanced. Finally, simulation verification is conducted through a MuJoCo physical engine, and visual analysis and performance evaluation of the highly-simulated human gait are achieved. According to the method, the problem that the robot gait self-adaptability and robustness are insufficient in a complex dynamic environment is solved.

title: Digestion device and method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a digestion device and method of a humanoid robot, belongs to the technical field of digestion equipment of humanoid robots, and aims to solve the problem that a traditional robot cannot configure food according to preset excrement elements and complete the whole digestion process on the basis of conversion of electric energy, mechanical energy and chemical energy. The robot can simulate the complete digestion function of the human body, including food intake, transportation, digestion, absorption, excretion and other whole processes, solves the problem that a traditional robot lacks a device for simulating the digestion function of the human body, can configure food according to preset excrement elements, meets the specific requirements of different application scenes for excrement element composition, and is high in practicability. By means of the series connection mode, excrement can serve as farmland fertilizer to provide organic fertilizer for agricultural production, cyclic utilization of resources is achieved, and by means of the parallel connection mode, the excrement can serve as in-vitro auxiliary medical equipment to be communicated with injured organs in a natural human body, the workload is shared, the workload of the injured organs is reduced, and the service life of the injured organs is prolonged.

title: Humanoid robot multi-mode instruction analysis system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode instruction analysis system for a humanoid robot. Comprising a voice input module, a visual input module, a voiceprint feature extraction module, an object recognition and pose estimation module, a multi-modal alignment network based on a space-time attention mechanism, a scene semantic tree construction module, an instruction node mapping module, a confidence evaluation module and a decision module. title: Efficient energy management circuit of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a high-efficiency energy management circuit of a humanoid robot. The system comprises a kinetic energy recovery device, an isolation circuit and a power management chip U1. The kinetic energy recovery device comprises a vibration energy collector, a spring energy storage device and a permanent magnet generator M and aims to convert mechanical motion into available electric energy. Energy stored by the spring energy storage device is converted into electric energy through the permanent magnet generator M. Meanwhile, the vibration energy collector is responsible for capturing vibration energy from the surrounding environment and converting the vibration energy into electric power. And after being processed by the isolating circuit, alternating current generated by the two is converted into direct current voltage suitable for working of internal components of the robot by the power management chip U1. In addition, the power management chip U1 ensures stable operation of the circuit and effective distribution of energy through function configuration of different pins of the power management chip U1. According to the circuit design, the energy utilization rate is improved, and the problem that kinetic energy cannot be effectively utilized when the humanoid robot acts is solved.

title: Four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a four-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm structure which is installed on a rotating shaft of a humanoid robot and comprises a forward flexion/backward extension module, an abduction/adduction module, an inward/outward rotation module, an elbow joint module and a small arm module, and the mass center of each module is located on the rotating shaft. The forward bending/backward stretching module is used for achieving the abduction/adduction freedom degree of the mechanical arm, the abduction/adduction module is used for achieving the abduction/adduction freedom degree of the mechanical arm, the inward/outward rotation module is used for achieving the inward/outward rotation freedom degree of the mechanical arm, and the elbow joint module is used for achieving the elbow joint freedom degree of the mechanical arm. The rotation freedom degree of the humanoid robot upper limb has low rotational inertia, the motor load is greatly reduced, the humanoid robot upper limb has high stability under high dynamic impact, and the anthropomorphism and overall coordination of the humanoid robot upper limb are greatly improved.

title: TORSO OF A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a torso assembly for a humanoid robot. title: Humanoid robot multi-mode dynamic jump test system, method, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot test equipment, in particular to a humanoid robot multi-modal dynamic jump test system, method, equipment and medium, and the system comprises a multi-modal sensing module, a dynamic environment simulation platform and a data processing terminal; wherein the multi-mode sensing module comprises a binocular vision camera, a plantar pressure sensor array and a nine-axis IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit); the dynamic environment simulation platform comprises a height-adjustable obstacle, an elastic coefficient-adjustable ground module, an environment mode presetting unit and an AR projection module; the data processing terminal comprises an embedded AI chip, an interactive interface and a data processing module. The data processing module comprises a Kalman filtering module, an LSTM neural network model, an energy consumption evaluation module and an optimization suggestion generation module. Therefore, the problems that in the prior art, the measurement precision is low, dynamic parameters are difficult to record, the system is easily interfered by postures and displacement, the test environment is single, the evaluation dimension is insufficient, and a data fusion method is lacked are solved.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulator structures, in particular to a humanoid robot manipulator assembly which comprises carriers and clamping bodies mounted on the carriers. abstract: The invention relates to an emotion accompanying robot system based on multi-dimensional perception and an interaction method, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots. title: Humanoid robot action generation method based on cognitive feedback mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action generation method based on a cognitive feedback mechanism. The humanoid robot action generation method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring and preprocessing multi-modal sensing data; s2, performing intention recognition and cognitive feedback based on the standardized perception feature vector; s3, retrieving candidate actions according to the intention label and constructing an action parameter space; s4, globally optimizing the action parameters through a beetle antennae search algorithm to obtain an optimal action sequence; s5, the optimal action sequence is issued and executed, and real-time feedback information is collected; and S6, according to the feedback adjustment intention confidence and the cognitive reasoning result, judging whether to re-execute or output a final result. According to the method, intelligent perception, self-adaptive action generation and dynamic optimization of the humanoid robot on a complex environment and a user intention are realized, and the intelligence and safety of man-machine interaction are improved.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot with high stability and large operation range
abstract: The invention discloses a wheeled humanoid robot with high stability and large operation range. title: Humanoid robot joint life monitoring method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint life monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of life monitoring. The method comprises the steps that 1, a multi-mode sensor array is constructed to collect original joint motion data of a target robot; 2, standardizing the original joint movement data according to feature types to obtain standard feature data of all parameter types; 3, establishing a joint degradation model of the target robot based on the standard feature data; 4, inputting real-time motion data of the target robot into the joint degradation model, and outputting a joint residual life index; and 5, when the residual life index of the joint is lower than a preset threshold value, a self-adaptive maintenance strategy is triggered. Through real-time monitoring of joint health, early warning and optimization maintenance, the reliability of the robot is improved.

title: Foot mechanism of flying humanoid robot and flying humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a foot mechanism of a flying humanoid robot and the flying humanoid robot. The foot mechanism comprises a leg connecting structure, an ankle joint structure and a toe structure, and the ankle joint structure is movably connected with the leg connecting structure and the toe structure; the ankle joint structure comprises a supporting component, the driving unit and the thrust mechanism, the toe structure and the leg connecting structure are both movably arranged on the supporting component, and the thrust mechanism is partially embedded in the supporting component. The flying robot aims at overcoming the defect that a flying robot in the prior art cannot give consideration to walking stability and air maneuverability, the thrust mechanism is designed in an embedded mode, and the landing stability and the air maneuverability of the robot can be met at the same time. The central axis of the thrust mechanism is located on the annular plane of the annular outer track, namely, the semi-surrounding design is adopted, the space occupied by full embedding can be reduced, thrust deviation caused by full exposure can be avoided, and the robot can have high landing stability and air maneuverability.

title: Wrist integrated humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention provides a wrist integrated humanoid dexterous hand, and relates to the technical field of robots. The wrist has the advantages of being high in wrist flexibility, good in controllability and simple in structure.

title: Humanoid robot multi-mode environment sensing and self-adaptive chassis control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot intelligent control, in particular to a humanoid robot multi-modal environment sensing and self-adaptive chassis control method, which comprises the following steps: monitoring a contact force vector and a sliding trend in real time through a multi-dimensional touch sensor, mapping pose drift to a chassis coordinate system based on a Lie group constraint space-time synchronization layer, and performing multi-modal environment sensing and self-adaptive chassis control on the basis of a multi-dimensional touch sensor; a compensation vector is generated, a three-level tactile response layer dynamic switching force/bit mixed impedance mode is adopted, reverse translation of an omnidirectional chassis is combined to counteract drift, compensation parameters are optimized through a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and the system ensures control instruction time sequence alignment through a time-space stamp synchronization engine. The attitude oscillation in the compensation process is suppressed by using the inertial measurement unit, the obstacle avoidance interference domain is constructed based on the kinematics chain of the operation arm, and the compensation trajectory is smoothed by using the B-spline curve, so that the precision, stability and safety of the humanoid robot in the complex contact operation are improved, and an efficient and reliable solution is provided for a man-machine cooperation scene.

abstract: The invention relates to a linear joint module for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. abstract: The utility model provides a waist connecting assembly and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. title: Dynamic application data transmission cable for humanoid robot body
abstract: The utility model discloses a dynamic application data transmission cable for a humanoid robot body. The filling strip is located in the center of the cable, the four signal transmission core wires are arranged around the filling strip as the center to form the star-quad cable in a surrounding mode, the cable is coated with an aluminum-plastic composite belt, the aluminum-plastic composite belt is coated with a tinned copper foil wire braid layer, and the tinned copper foil wire braid layer is coated with a PUR outer sheath. According to the utility model, the distribution of the data signal core wires is reasonably arranged, and the FEP insulating material has high tensile strength, excellent wear resistance and fatigue resistance. The first wrist joint driving piece and the second wrist joint driving piece are sequentially arranged in the axial direction of the forearm, the first wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the hand assembly to rotate around a first reference axis, and the second wrist joint driving piece is used for driving the wrist skeleton to rotate around a second reference axis; the first reference axis, the second reference axis and the axis of the small arm are perpendicular to one another. title: HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A humanoid robot includes a torso, a left arm assembly coupled to the torso and having a first reference line, a left wrist coupled to the left arm assembly and including at least a rotational axis, and a left end effector coupled to the left wrist. The left end effector is configured to move about the rotational axis and includes a finger assembly with a second reference line and at least two degrees of freedom, and a thumb assembly with at least three degrees of freedom. A first angle is formed between the first and second reference lines when the left wrist is in a first configuration, and a second angle is formed when the left wrist is in a second configuration. Both the first and second angles are greater than 70 degrees, and the difference between the first and second angles is greater than 150 degrees.

title: Gesture interaction method for amphibious humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a gesture interaction method for an amphibious humanoid robot, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: 1, collecting gesture data of land and underwater operators or divers through a head video sensor of the amphibious humanoid robot, and taking the gesture data as the input of the gesture interaction method; step 2, carrying out diversified enhancement operation on the collected gesture data by using two strategies of mixed enhancement and random mixing, and generating a feature vector after processing; step 3, a mask module with dynamic self-adaptive capability is utilized to effectively filter out weak correlation parts of gesture recognition in the feature vectors, and feature optimization is realized; step 4, improving feature extraction accuracy by using an action recognition network integrated with a dynamic self-adaptive mask module; 5, recognizing the extracted gesture features by using an action recognition head; 6, the amphibious humanoid robot executes gesture processing logic based on the recognition result, and then interaction between the diver and the amphibious humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot scheduling method and device in humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot scheduling method and device in a humanoid robot training ground. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring load resource information and preset task information; determining a load utility function of the corresponding humanoid robot based on the information corresponding to the load resource index of each humanoid robot, and allocating load resources to the corresponding humanoid robot based on the load utility function; and constructing a particle fitness function based on the preset task information and the allocated load resources, and determining a target execution sequence of tasks corresponding to the preset task information executed by the corresponding humanoid robot according to the particle fitness function. The method can be applied to the fields of industrial manufacturing, logistics distribution, home service and the like, and can be used for training resource allocation and task execution sequence of the humanoid robot in a humanoid robot training ground. The humanoid robot is assisted to perform reliable and efficient resource allocation, and task execution in different scenes is efficiently completed by determining the target execution sequence of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot real-time cooperation decision-making method based on multi-modal perception fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot real-time cooperation decision-making method based on multi-mode perception fusion. The method comprises the following steps: dynamically deploying a sensor array, acquiring multi-modal original sensing data of the humanoid robot through the deployed sensor array, and performing physiological signal fusion processing and multi-modal feature enhancement processing on the multi-modal original sensing data to obtain a multi-level feature set; performing cross-modal semantic mapping and intention reasoning on the multi-level feature set by using a cross-modal semantic reasoning system supported by a large model to obtain a cooperative execution instruction containing a target action and a force control parameter; and dynamically updating a behavior decision model of the humanoid robot by using a double-buffer collaborative distributed incremental learning mechanism based on the collaborative execution instruction, and obtaining a real-time collaborative decision of the humanoid robot based on the behavior decision model. The technical problem that the man-machine cooperation efficiency of the humanoid robot in a complex scene is low is solved.

title: Electrical system of heavy-load humanoid manipulator and heavy-load humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, and provides an electrical system of a heavy-load humanoid manipulator and the heavy-load humanoid manipulator, and the electrical system comprises a sensor module, a central processing module, a driving execution module, a power management module and a communication module, the central processing module is used for receiving and processing a sensor signal and generating a control instruction, the driving execution module is used for executing the instruction of the central processing module and driving a manipulator joint to move, the power supply management module is used for providing a stable power supply for each module, and the communication module is used for realizing data interaction between the system and external equipment. High-precision sensing and intelligent control are achieved through cooperation of multiple modules, the sensor module integrates a multi-axis inclination angle sensor, a six-dimensional force sensor and a binocular vision sensor, joint angles, grabbing force and object vision information can be collected in real time, and object recognition, grabbing strategy optimization and motion track planning are achieved.

title: Four-foot double-arm type building decoration robot
abstract: The invention discloses a four-foot double-arm type building decoration robot, and relates to the technical field of building decoration robots, the four-foot double-arm type building decoration robot comprises a robot dog moving seat, a material conveying assembly and a high-place operation assembly, the middle part of the upper surface of the robot dog moving seat is rotatably connected with a tow bar, and the material conveying assembly comprises a guide rail rotatably connected to the end part of the tow bar. And meanwhile, the problem that a small home decoration space cannot accommodate multiple robots for operation is solved.

title: Humanoid welding robot device and method based on cooperation of double mechanical arms
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid welding robot device and method based on cooperation of double mechanical arms. The device comprises arm modules, a head module, a trunk module, a moving module, a control system, a laser centering device and a protective gas device. The device is mainly applied to the autonomous intelligent welding process of double-arm cooperation of the double-mechanical-arm humanoid welding robot and comprises the following steps that firstly, the robot autonomously moves to a preset welding station; secondly, welding working condition detection is completed through an intelligent recognition system, and an initial welding path is planned; then, optimal welding parameters are automatically matched based on the process database; then, the double mechanical arms are cooperatively adjusted to the optimal welding starting posture; and finally, the light beam state is monitored in real time in the welding process, dynamic compensation is conducted through a closed-loop control system, and it is ensured that high-quality welding operation is completed. According to the device, three-dimensional visual inspection, double-mechanical-arm cooperative motion control and an intelligent control system are creatively fused, and real-time accurate recognition and dynamic centering compensation of the welding seam morphology are achieved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism capable of simulating ankle and sole movement of human body
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism capable of simulating ankles and soles of a human body. The invention relates to a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism, and aims to provide a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism capable of simulating human ankle and sole movement, so that the degree of freedom of simulating human sole movement is increased on the basis of ensuring high rigidity, movement precision and bearing capacity, and the three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism is good in supporting performance and better in environmental adaptability. According to the technical scheme, the invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism capable of simulating ankle and sole movement of a human body. The shank is connected with a knee joint, the foot body is connected to the bottom end of the shank through a first hooke joint, the sole is connected with the foot body through a first rotating pair, the sole driving branch is connected between the foot body and the sole, and the two ankle driving branches are located on the left side and the right side of the shank and connected with the shank and the foot body respectively.

title: Humanoid robot inertial navigation and vision fusion positioning method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot inertial navigation and vision fusion positioning method, device and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, pre-evaluating the quality of IMU inertial data and visual SLAM data to generate a data credibility identifier; establishing a causal relationship chain between the data sources through time sequence correlation analysis; constructing a multi-strategy superposition state based on data credibility, and determining an adaptive fusion strategy through collapse judgment; constructing a data evolution path by using a causal relationship, and generating an expected behavior feature and a causal deviation feature; the fusion parameters are optimized according to the deviation characteristics, and a plurality of fusion positioning estimations with different weights are generated; and through space aggregation analysis and confidence weight calculation, selecting optimal positioning estimation and outputting a high-precision fusion positioning result. According to the method, deep understanding of sensor data, intelligent selection of fusion strategies and robust output of positioning results are realized, and the positioning performance of the humanoid robot in a complex environment is improved.

title: Large-inner-hole high-density joint motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a large-bore high-density joint motor for a humanoid robot, which comprises a stator and a rotor, and is characterized in that the rotor comprises a hollow shaft and magnetic steel surface-mounted on the outer wall of the hollow shaft; the stator comprises a stator core outside the magnetic steel, insulating end plates are arranged at the two ends of the stator core, windings are arranged at the outer ends of the insulating end plates, a leading-out wire is arranged at the outer end of one winding, a thermal resistor is arranged on the winding, and a temperature sensor of the thermal resistor is embedded in the winding; by arranging the thermal resistor on the winding, the temperature can be monitored at any time, so that the load of the motor can be adjusted according to the monitored temperature, the influence on normal operation caused by overhigh temperature rise of the motor is prevented, the diameter of the rotor is increased and the crack ratio is increased by arranging the inner cavity of the hollow shaft into a large inner hole structure and matching the pole slots of the stator and the rotor to adopt 18 slots and 20 poles, and the reliability of the motor is improved. The magnetic conduction thickness of the hollow shaft can be reduced by selecting multiple poles, and the purpose of reducing the weight of the hollow shaft is achieved.

title: Multi-expression driving bionic intelligent robot head
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic humanoid robots, in particular to a multi-expression driving bionic intelligent robot head which comprises an eyebrow movable layer, a cheekbone movable layer, an eye movable layer, an upper lip movable layer and a chin movable layer located below the upper lip movable layer, and the eyebrow movable layer, the cheekbone movable layer, the eye movable layer and the upper lip movable layer are spliced and assembled by hexagonal threaded copper columns through reserved hole positions. The robot head is composed of a shell, an aluminum alloy machining plate frame, a CNC metal part, a steering engine, a rail and a pull wire, and a camera module and a voice control module are arranged in the robot head. The shell can be customized according to different figure facial features, the shell is of a high-precision, compact and adjustable structure, 26 steering engines are integrated in a limited space to control opening and closing of the face including left and right eyeballs, upper and lower eyelids, canthus, eyebrows, cheeks, mouth corners and mouth and actions of lips, and the layered design and control mode of the head of the robot enable the robot to be more intelligent. And the mounting, the dismounting and the maintenance are more convenient.

title: Humanoid robot and shank structure thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot and a shank structure thereof. The shank structure comprises a knee frame, a foot plate, a driving assembly and a cam; the foot plate is rotatably connected to the knee frame around the X axis; the knee frame is provided with a rotating seat; the inner shaft is rotationally connected to the rotating seat around the Y axis; the fixing sleeve is rotatably mounted on the inner shaft; the driven planetary gears are meshed with the driving planetary gears on the two sides; one end of the side shaft is limited to the fixing sleeve, and the driven planetary gear is rotationally arranged on the side shaft in a sleeving mode. The upper end of the connecting rod is rotatably connected to the connecting seat, and the lower end of the connecting rod is rotatably connected to the foot plate; when the cams at the left and right positions rotate towards the same direction, the connecting seat drives the foot plate and the knee frame to rotate around the Y axis through the connecting rod; when the cams at the left and right positions rotate in opposite directions, the connecting seat rotates around the side shaft and drives the foot plate to rotate around the X axis relative to the knee frame through the connecting rod. According to the scheme, more flexible gait control can be achieved, and the problem that the weight burden of shanks is too heavy due to a direct drive mode in a traditional system is solved.

title: Humanoid robot integrated joint module
abstract: The humanoid robot integrated joint module comprises a joint module body, the right end of the joint module body is fixedly connected with a fixing seat, and the outer surface of the fixing seat is movably connected with a mounting seat. According to the joint module disclosed by the invention, through the arrangement of the fixed seat and the mounting seat, the periphery of the joint module body can be limited while the joint module body and the humanoid robot joint are conveniently spliced by personnel, so that the joint module body is prevented from displacing in the front-back direction and the up-down direction in the use process; through the arrangement of a rotating disc, an annular frame, a guide plate, a clamping rod, a supporting ball, a through hole and a clamping groove, after the joint module body and the humanoid robot joint are spliced, a person can operate the rotating disc to rotate, so that the clamping rod can be inserted into the clamping groove; and the joint module body, the fixed seat, the mounting seat and the humanoid robot joint can be effectively locked and limited.

title: Man-machine interaction type elderly care humanoid robot system based on wireless transmission of health parameters
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless local area network transmission, in particular to a man-machine interaction type old-age care humanoid robot system based on wireless transmission health parameters, which comprises a health data digital system conversion module, a health data transmission processing system and a health data interaction adaptation engine module, wherein the health data digital conversion module is used for constructing a binary bit group; the health data transmission processing system converts the binary bit group into a plurality of level values through a time window function, and constructs a high-low level signal # imgabs0 #; the high-low level signal # imgabs1 # is output to a doctor terminal through a channel; the health data interaction adaptation engine module is used for distinguishing the basic health data and constructing a binary bit group corresponding to the basic health data again; according to the adjusted time window function, the corresponding binary bit group is constructed into a high-low level signal # imgabs2 # through the adjusted time window function, and when family members need multi-source health data, the high-low level signal # imgabs3 # is output to a family member terminal through a channel.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT WITH ADVANCED KINEMATICS
abstract: The disclosed humanoid robot is designed to perform diverse, human-like tasks in various environments, from industrial assembly and customer service to every day household chores. These robots possess anthropomorphic features including a head, torso, arms, legs, and hands, enabling complex motions with over 60 degrees of freedom. The upper portion houses over 70% of the DoF, allowing dexterous manipulation, while the central and lower portions are optimized for battery storage and efficient movement. More than 30 electric actuators (mostly rotary) power the humanoid robot, with a strategic arrangement that minimizes mechanical singularities and facilitates tasks such as deep squats and precise reaching. This configuration reduces cost, weight, and maintenance while improving performance and capabilities of said humanoid robot.

title: Modularized harmonic reducer for humanoid robot joint and assembly process of modularized harmonic reducer
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of harmonic reducers, and particularly discloses a modular harmonic reducer for humanoid robot joints and an assembly process thereof, and the modular harmonic reducer comprises a mounting shell, a reducer body, a base plate and a first limiting piece; the mounting shell is provided with a containing cavity for containing the speed reducer body, the wall body of the mounting shell is provided with an assembly hole penetrating in the axial direction of the mounting shell, the speed reducer body comprises a flexible gear, a rigid gear and a wave generator, and the first limiting piece is provided with an annular limiting boss used for fixing an external bearing. A motor shaft of an external driving motor is connected with the wave generator of the speed reducer body in a matched mode through a bearing and the annular limiting boss. The speed reducer further comprises a quick-release connecting piece, the speed reducer body is arranged in the mounting shell, the quick-release connecting piece penetrates through the assembly hole and is connected with the base plate to limit the speed reducer body between the mounting shell and the base plate, and the base plate is arranged between an external driving motor and the mounting shell.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of harmonic reducers, and particularly discloses a modular harmonic reducer for humanoid robot joints and an assembly process thereof, and the modular harmonic reducer comprises a mounting shell, a reducer body, a base plate and a first limiting piece; the mounting shell is provided with a containing cavity for containing the speed reducer body, the wall body of the mounting shell is provided with an assembly hole penetrating in the axial direction of the mounting shell, the speed reducer body comprises a flexible gear, a rigid gear and a wave generator, and the first limiting piece is provided with an annular limiting boss used for fixing an external bearing. title: Biped robot nonlinear model predictive controller FPGA heterogeneous acceleration method
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot nonlinear model predictive controller FPGA heterogeneous acceleration method, which comprises the following steps: establishing an NMPC model according to a biped robot dynamic model, iteratively solving a quadratic programming form of the NMPC model, and completing a single iteration process: solving by a primitive-dual interior point method and solving a symmetric linear equation set by a minres algorithm; the process of solving the solution of the linear equation set constructed by using the KKT condition based on the quadratic programming form through the primitive-dual interior point method is configured to be executed by a CPU; the process of solving the symmetric linear equation set by the minres algorithm is configured to be executed by the FPGA. According to different calculation characteristics of a solution operator in a biped robot NMPC model, a logic reusable minres algorithm in the solution process is deployed to an FPGA calculation platform, and nonlinear operation is deployed to a CPU for implementation, so that the calculation power characteristic of a heterogeneous chip is fully utilized. According to the method, robot dynamics modeling, an efficient optimization solution algorithm and appropriate computing power resource allocation are considered, and the acceleration effect and verification of the algorithm can be ensured.

title: Dynamic sparse attention-multi-modal space-time constraint humanoid robot control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots, and discloses a dynamic sparse attention-multi-modal space-time constraint humanoid robot control method, which comprises the following steps: S1, multi-modal information collection: collecting robot surrounding environment information, S2, reasoning engine processing and instruction generation: processing the information, and S3, processing the information. S3, time-space synchronization and force constraint; S4, driving mechanism motion control; and S5, emotion expression unit response. By adopting a dynamic sparse attention mechanism and an optimized calculation method, the calculation efficiency of the system is greatly improved, and the reasoning delay is reduced. The NSA inference engine dynamically adjusts the number of activated heads, and axial partitioning calculation, KV cache compression and 4-b-it integer calculation are combined, so that the inference delay is greatly reduced. Through the optimization, the robot can make a faster response to the environment change, and can quickly complete the reasoning and decision-making process and adjust the action of the robot in time in the face of complex and changeable task scenes.

title: Model-free adaptive control method and device for parallel mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of humanoid robot joint driving control, and discloses a model-free adaptive predictive control method and equipment for a humanoid robot parallel mechanism, and the method comprises the steps: (1) constructing a partial format dynamic linearization data model of the humanoid robot parallel mechanism based on a pseudo block Jacobian matrix phi p, L (k); (2) constructing an autoregression model based on the real-time estimated value of the pseudo-block jacobian matrix phi p, L (k) and the estimated value of the past moment, calculating a coefficient theta (k) in a calculation formula of the pseudo-block jacobian matrix phi p, L (k + j), and predicting phi p, L (k + j) by adopting the autoregression model; and (3) deriving to obtain an N-step forward prediction equation, setting an input cost function based on the N-step forward prediction equation, and obtaining the output of the MFAPC controller at the current moment based on the input cost function, thereby realizing model-free adaptive prediction control of the nonlinear controlled system. According to the invention, the control performance is improved.

title: Humanoid flexible robot wrist joint with variable rigidity
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid flexible robot wrist joint with variable rigidity. The humanoid flexible robot wrist joint is used for solving the problems that an existing flexible robot wrist joint is insufficient in humanoid performance and limited in load capacity. According to the scheme, the device comprises three corrugated pipe actuators and a variable-rigidity module, and the variable-rigidity module is surrounded by the three corrugated pipe actuators; the three corrugated pipe actuators form different length combinations by controlling the air pressure in the three corrugated pipes, bending movement of a non-fixed rotation center is achieved, and the load capacity is adjusted by controlling the negative pressure of the variable rigidity module. The variable-rigidity module comprises a lower fixing end plate and an upper fixing end plate with holes, a silica gel film is bonded between the upper fixing end plate and the lower fixing end plate to form a cavity, vertical fibers are arranged on the inner side of the cavity, one end of each fiber is planted on the upper fixing end plate or the lower fixing end plate, friction is generated between the fibers in the bending movement, and the fibers are fixed to the lower fixing end plate. And rigidity adjustment of the variable-rigidity module is realized.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg structure and a humanoid robot. title: Humanoid robot control method based on neural circuit
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method based on a neural circuit, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: S1, constructing a three-layer pulse neural control architecture comprising spinal cord reflex, brainstem balance and cortex decision, and carrying out the weight adaptive distribution and cooperative operation between layers through the dynamic adjustment of neurotransmitter concentration, organic cooperation of prediction and reflection is realized through a three-stage control system; the cerebellar prediction network executes attitude adjustment in advance through a delay compensation algorithm, and compared with pure feedback, the control energy consumption is reduced; the parallel reflex pathway of the spinal cord layer establishes a nerve bypass mechanism, and the emergency response is realized by bypassing high-level processing in an emergency; the multi-layer safety monitoring improves the triggering accuracy of a protection mechanism through error confidence evaluation and contact stability analysis; a weight transfer mechanism of pulse frequency modulation avoids sudden movement change during control mode switching; by means of the design, the stability retention rate of the robot walking on the inclined plane is remarkably improved compared with a traditional method.

title: Method for assembling joints of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint assembly method, which relates to the technical field of robot joint assembly, and comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out pretreatment work, and carrying out cleaning, drying and surface detection on a to-be-assembled joint part; s2, all the joint assemblies are assembled, and preliminary positioning and mounting are conducted through a positioning tool of an assembling mechanism; s3, placing the bolt coated with the thread glue in the threaded hole position of the connecting piece; s4, the bolts coated with the thread glue are tightened through a bolt mounting mechanism, and then the steering engine rotating ends of all the joint parts and the flange support are subjected to bolt mounting; s5, the waist joints are assembled; and S6, wiring processing is conducted on steering engines and controllers of all the joint parts, all the installed joint modules are debugged and detected, and classified qualified products are selected. title: Multi-modal sensing fusion robot humanoid operation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of service robots, and discloses a multi-modal sensing fusion robot humanoid operation method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting environment perception parameters to construct a dynamic environment model; setting and testing a dynamic model of a robot execution mechanism; integrating the dynamic model into the dynamic environment model; task demand parameters and theoretical control loads are calculated, and a driving unit action instruction is generated; the control quantity is adjusted through a discrete period, so that accurate action control is realized; and finally evaluating the execution effect. The system comprises a dynamic environment model construction module, an execution mechanism dynamic model construction module, a model fusion module, a task parameter calculation module, an action instruction generation module, an action control module and an execution effect evaluation module. According to the method, collaborative optimization of environmental dynamics and actuating mechanism dynamics is realized, and the adaptive capacity and control precision of the robot in a complex scene are remarkably improved.

title: Biped robot gait generation method based on enhanced confrontation motion prior
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait generation method based on enhanced confrontation motion prior, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. Comprising the following steps: constructing an enhanced PPO-AMP network; establishing an action network model, an evaluation network model and an AMP module; establishing a biped robot motion model, and selecting a simulation experiment environment; performing reinforcement learning on the enhanced PPO-AMP network by using a reward function combining task rewards and style rewards and combining an improved PPO-Clip mechanism with KL divergence constraint on the basis of a simulation experiment environment to obtain optimized network parameters; the optimized enhanced PPO-AMP network is used for generating the biped robot gait meeting the actual walking task. According to the control method, the environment perception capability is optimized, the network structure is deepened, and the reward mechanism and the training strategy are improved, so that the biped robot has high robustness and high natural gaits on various complex terrains at the same time.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a speed reducer for a humanoid robot and a manufacturing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of speed reducers. title: Humanoid robot resonance sound shape conduction device, conduction method and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot resonance sound shape conduction device and method and a humanoid robot. The resonance sound shape conduction device comprises a sound receiving module, a driving module, a coil, a magnetic base and a vibration disc, one end of the magnetic base extends into the coil, and the other end of the magnetic base extends out of the coil and is fixedly connected with the vibration disc; the vibration disc is fixedly installed on the outer side or the inner side of a shell of the humanoid robot, and the sound receiving module is used for receiving sound signals sent by the humanoid robot; the driving module receives the sound signals and drives the coil to generate an alternating magnetic field, and the alternating magnetic field drives the magnetic base to regularly move in the axial direction of the coil so that the vibration disc can drive the shell of the humanoid robot to synchronously and regularly vibrate and transmit the sound signals to the periphery. The combination of the resonance sound shape conduction device and the shell structure can reduce the cost to a certain extent, reduces electronic components and wiring required by the loudspeaker system, and reduces the production and maintenance cost.

title: Motion control reinforcement learning method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control reinforcement learning method. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an intelligent agent architecture comprising a sensing module, a reinforcement learning module, a decision-making module and a communication module; hierarchical action control of generating tactical-level sub-targets at a high layer and generating specific action instructions at a bottom layer is realized through a hierarchical reinforcement learning model; in an adversarial environment, adversarial behaviors are predicted through an opponent modeling network, a reward function is embedded, and a shared attention mechanism is adopted to optimize a collaborative strategy; during strategy exploration and parameter updating, strategy entropy regularization items are superposed, and the parameters are updated on the basis of experience playback buffer areas; signals are asynchronously broadcasted through the communication module, and the receiver dynamically adjusts the strategy. According to the method, the universality and adaptability of the humanoid robot system are enhanced, the learning efficiency and strategy optimization capability of the humanoid robot intelligent agent are improved, the performance of the humanoid robot in a non-cooperative environment is improved, the robustness and stability of the system are enhanced, and the method can adapt to a complex dynamic environment.

title: Humanoid robot task scheduling method and device in humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot task scheduling method and device in a humanoid robot training ground. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring task information corresponding to a plurality of tasks and task execution information of the humanoid robot; based on the task information of each task and the task execution information of the humanoid robot, constructing utility functions of each humanoid robot for different tasks; determining a corresponding target task allocated to each humanoid robot based on the utility function of each humanoid robot for different tasks; and determining a target execution sequence among the target tasks allocated by the humanoid robots based on the task information corresponding to the target tasks allocated by the humanoid robots and the task execution information of the corresponding humanoid robots. The method can be used for realizing scheduling training of the humanoid robot for different tasks in a humanoid robot training ground scene, assisting the humanoid robot to complete task scheduling in different operation scenes, and realizing efficient cooperative task completion of the humanoid robot.

title: Method and system for evaluating real-time control performance of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot real-time control performance evaluation method, which comprises the steps of calculating a control output quantity of humanoid robot obstacle crossing gait control in a set standard state; obstacle crossing control is carried out on the humanoid robot under different terrains and different obstacles, so that a control deviation standard value is obtained; setting a plurality of centroid heights when the humanoid robot crosses different obstacles, and taking the centroid heights as standard fluctuation ranges of the centroid heights; and establishing a control comparison table, monitoring the control deviation and the centroid height of the humanoid robot during obstacle crossing in real time, and comparing the control deviation and the centroid height with corresponding standard values in the control comparison table to determine the real-time control performance of the humanoid robot. The control performance of the humanoid robot during obstacle crossing is evaluated, the stability problem of the humanoid robot during obstacle crossing can be known in time, control of the humanoid robot can be adjusted in time, and the gait stability of the humanoid robot during obstacle crossing is guaranteed.

title: Method for interacting objects by humanoid robot guided by diffusion model based on key frame
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot object interaction method guided by a diffusion model based on key frames. Comprising the following steps: S1, generating interaction between a human body and an object based on a diffusion model of a key frame; s2, guiding the humanoid robot to interact with the object based on the contact instruction; and S3, interaction between the humanoid robot and the object based on the action generation guidance. According to the method, in an action generation stage, key frames of a robot and an object within a period of time are predicted according to a current state, a motion sequence is recovered by using interpolation, and then a universal robot and object interaction strategy is finely adjusted based on a generated and simulated closed-loop structure and a fixed diffusion model weight. The interaction strategy is rewarded due to accurate simulation of aligned movement and contact information and successful object control, the gap between the output of the diffusion model and the training data set of the simulation environment is made up, and the reward does not need to be designed for a specific task.

title: Attitude control method for thermal failure of local joints on humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a posture control method for local joint thermal failure on a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The posture control method for local joint thermal failure comprises the steps that when the internal temperature T of any local joint motor on the humanoid robot is larger than or equal to T early warning, the humanoid robot executes in-situ pause execution work task instruction time t; if the time t is over, the internal temperatures of all local joint motors on the humanoid robot are Tlt; t, if early warning is carried out, the humanoid robot continues to execute the work task instruction; and if the internal temperature T of any local joint motor on the humanoid robot meets the condition that T is larger than T early warning and smaller than T safety upper limit after the time t is ended, the humanoid robot stops the work task instruction and enters a humanoid robot cooling posture. According to the control method, by comparing and judging the internal temperature T of each local joint motor on the humanoid robot with the early warning temperature T of each local joint motor, the probability of disability of the humanoid robot after the local joint motors are overheated is reduced.

title: Anthropomorphic two-arm teleoperation and data acquisition exoskeleton type device
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot teleoperation and imitation learning, and particularly relates to an anthropomorphic two-arm teleoperation and data acquisition exoskeleton type device which comprises a trunk wearing mechanism, arm wearing mechanisms arranged on the two opposite sides of the trunk wearing mechanism, and a data acquisition mechanism arranged on the arm wearing mechanisms. The joint of the arm wearing mechanism and the trunk wearing mechanism is located on the upper portion of the trunk wearing mechanism, and the arm wearing mechanism is used for collecting motion information of arm joints; according to the robot, the arm wearing mechanism is provided with seven degrees of freedom, the fitting degree with the arm is higher, the robot can better follow the upper limb of the human body to achieve smooth movement, and the deviation between the movement track of the mechanical arm and human operation is reduced; meanwhile, the mechanism directly collects arm action data and maps the arm action data to anthropomorphic robot joints, complex calculation is not needed, dependence on complex programming is greatly reduced, a control instruction can be accurately and rapidly generated, anthropomorphic two arms of the anthropomorphic robot are driven to complete complex tasks, and the accuracy, smoothness and real-time performance of the teleoperation and data collection process are improved.

title: Head assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The head assembly comprises a head shell, a partition plate, a head driving part, a top cover and an electrical module, a containing space is defined by the head shell, a first opening is formed in the bottom of the head shell, a second opening is formed in the top of the head shell, and in orthographic projection of the humanoid robot in the front-back direction, the contour line of the second opening is in a U shape; the partition plate is contained in the containing space and connected with the head shell, the partition plate divides the containing space into a first space and a second space, the first opening is communicated with the first space, and the second opening is communicated with the second space; the head driving part penetrates through the first opening, is partially accommodated in the first space and is connected with the partition plate; the top cover and the head shell are detachably connected at the second opening; the electrical module is accommodated in the second space and is connected with the top cover. The regular structure of the top cover and the head shell simplifies the structure and installation steps when the top cover and the head shell are disassembled and connected, and the appearance integrity and the installation efficiency of the head assembly are improved.

title: Rotary clamping mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a rotary clamping mechanism and a humanoid robot, the rotary clamping mechanism comprises a bearing piece, a driving assembly fixed on the bearing piece, a first clamping piece and a second clamping piece, one side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the bearing piece, and the other side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the second clamping piece. One side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the first clamping piece, the other side of the first clamping piece is rotatably connected with the second clamping piece, the driving assembly is used for driving the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece to rotate, and the first clamping piece and the second clamping piece can clamp the upper edge structure in an included angle shape; the bearing piece is provided with a second bearing face used for being connected with the first bearing face in an abutting mode. According to the rotary clamping mechanism and the humanoid robot, the upper edge structure of the box body is clamped while the box body is supported, the box body is kept stable in the carrying state, and the rotary clamping mechanism and the humanoid robot can be suitable for box bodies of different specifications.

title: Humanoid robot and sole structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robot equipment, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot and a sole structure of the humanoid robot. The sole structure comprises a rigid connecting piece which comprises a main body plate piece and a connecting part, the connecting part is arranged on the main body plate piece, and the connecting part is used for being connected with the ankle connecting end of the humanoid robot; the first layer plate is fixedly connected with the main body plate, the end part of the first layer plate exceeds the end part of the rigid connecting piece in the first direction, and the part, exceeding the end part of the rigid connecting piece, of the first layer plate can be bent and deformed in the rotating direction; the second layer plate is connected to the side, away from the rigid connecting piece, of the first layer plate, the second layer plate is a part made of a flexible material, the contour shape of the projection of the second layer plate is consistent with the contour shape of the projection of the first layer plate in the second direction, and the projection of the first layer plate is located in the projection of the second layer plate. By applying the technical scheme, the problem that the sole structure of the current humanoid robot does not have the characteristic that the front sole can be bent and deformed is solved.

title: Humanoid manipulator
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of manipulators, and provides a humanoid manipulator which comprises a palm base, a thumb unit and at least one single finger unit. The thumb unit comprises a thumb proximal section, a thumb proximal section component, a thumb middle section and a thumb distal section, the thumb proximal section is hinged to the palm base, the first end of the thumb proximal section component is hinged to the thumb proximal section, the second end of the thumb proximal section component is hinged to the thumb middle section, and the thumb middle section is hinged to the thumb distal section; the single-finger unit comprises a single-finger near joint, a single-finger middle joint and a single-finger far joint, the single-finger near joint is hinged to the palm base, the single-finger middle joint is hinged to the single-finger near joint, and the single-finger far joint is hinged to the single-finger middle joint; a thumb buffering mechanism is arranged between the thumb proximal joint and the thumb proximal joint component, and/or a single finger buffering mechanism is arranged between the single finger proximal joint and the palm base. The humanoid manipulator provided by the utility model is used for overcoming the defect that an object or a finger driving motor is damaged due to excessive grasping possibly caused by a control error of an existing flexible manipulator.

title: Electric drive system on-load positioning precision comprehensive test platform for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of positioning precision test, and discloses an electric drive system on-load positioning precision comprehensive test platform for a humanoid robot, which comprises a test platform. The adjusting bracket slides along the top surface of the test platform; the height of the adjusting bracket is adjustable; the to-be-tested object is connected with the adjusting bracket; the load system is fixedly arranged on the top surface of the test platform; the load system applies a load to the to-be-tested object to realize torque loading; the measurement detection part is arranged between the adjusting bracket and the load system; the measuring and detecting part comprises a high-precision angular displacement sensor and a torque and rotating speed sensor, the high-precision angular displacement sensor is used for detecting the displacement change of an object to be measured, and the torque and rotating speed sensor is used for detecting the torque and rotating speed of the load system. Through the platform, the conventional joint static performance and dynamic performance test items of the electric drive system can be met, and absolute positioning precision test and repeated positioning precision test in the loading test process can be realized at the same time.

title: Humanoid robot target pose acquisition method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot target pose obtaining method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target RGB image of a humanoid robot in a current scene, segmenting the target RGB image, obtaining a feature image, obtaining a target feature point from the feature image, and obtaining a target pose of the humanoid robot; the method comprises the steps of obtaining target feature points of a current scene, obtaining template feature point pairs matched with the target feature points from a template library corresponding to the current scene, filtering abnormal feature point pairs from the template feature point pairs to obtain matched feature point pairs, and obtaining the target pose of the humanoid robot according to the matched feature point pairs. According to the method, the calculation amount can be reduced, the calculation power of the humanoid robot is saved, and the efficiency is improved.

title: Method for combining humanoid robot with robotic dog and switching two modes of humanoid robot and robotic dog
abstract: The inventor-shaped robot and robot dog combination relates to AI control of the inventor-shaped robot and the robot dog. The defects of the humanoid robot in calculation, structure, weight, power consumption, price and application scenes are overcome. title: Humanoid robot upper limb attitude estimation method based on adaptive filtering
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot upper limb attitude estimation method based on adaptive filtering, and the method comprises the steps: taking an end point of a humanoid robot upper limb segment as a key point, simulating the relation between the position and the speed in a local coordinate system, and constructing a prior model of a humanoid robot key joint. By combining the acceleration, the attitude direction and the prior model, a filtering framework is established, and the influence of the transient sensor error on the overall precision is effectively reduced. In addition, actual measurement conditions are reflected by using distribution of prior residual errors, and a self-adaptive measurement noise adjustment strategy is provided. According to the strategy, the prior residual error and the maximum likelihood criterion are combined, and the accuracy and robustness of attitude estimation of the humanoid robot are effectively improved.

title: Unilateral parallel connection rod type ankle structure and robot
abstract: The invention provides a unilateral parallel connecting rod type ankle structure and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problems that due to the fact that an existing humanoid robot ankle mechanism adopts a symmetrical double-connecting-rod or direct-driving structure, the occupied transverse space is large, and the rotational inertia is high are solved. The device comprises a shank part, a long connecting rod, a short connecting rod and a sole plate, a first driver and a second driver are arranged on the shank part, the output end of the first driver is connected with a first output flange connecting rod, the output end of the second driver is connected with a second output flange connecting rod, and the first output flange connecting rod is connected with the long connecting rod. The second output flange connecting rod is connected with a short connecting rod, a sole plate connecting rod is installed on the sole plate and provided with two connecting ends, the two connecting ends are connected with a long connecting rod and a short connecting rod respectively, the long connecting rod and the short connecting rod are both arranged on the outer side of a shank part, and the lower portion of the shank part is connected with the sole plate through a cross bearing.
