title: Remote emotion interaction robot system based on real-time pose projection
abstract: The invention provides a remote emotion interaction robot system based on real-time pose projection, and relates to the technical field of robots. Limb actions, facial micro-expressions and voice information of a user are captured in real time through a multi-sensor fusion technology (a camera, a somatosensory glove, a pressure sensor and the like), 468 facial key points and 33 body joint points are extracted in combination with a MediaPipe model, and low-delay and high-precision action smooth mapping is realized by adopting Kalman filtering and an exponential weighted moving average (EMA) algorithm. Modularized bionic design is adopted for the robot, the bionic arms, the head and the breathing and heartbeat bionic module driven by flexible steering engines are arranged, the action rigidity, speed and contact strength can be dynamically adjusted, and human natural body languages and vital signs are simulated. A real-time communication link is constructed through a TCP/IP protocol, dual-mode interaction of real-time projection and a preset action library is supported, and the system is suitable for scenes such as remote nursing accompanying, parent-child interaction and psychotherapy healing.

title: Humanoid robot joint planetary roller screw multi-dimensional load testing device
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint planetary roller screw multi-dimensional load testing device, which relates to the technical field of testing and comprises a radial force simulation device used for simulating radial force on a humanoid robot joint planetary roller screw; the axial force simulation device is used for simulating the axial force on the joint planetary roller screw of the humanoid robot; and the control device is electrically connected with the radial force simulation device and the axial force simulation device. The device integrates a radial force simulation device and an axial force simulation device, one set of equipment completes a lead screw key dimension load test, splicing of multiple pieces of equipment is not needed, the test process is simplified, core components such as humanoid robot joints which need to verify the stress reliability in multiple directions at the same time are adapted, and the function blank of a single force test device is filled up.

title: Rigid-flexible coupled leg structure of biped robot
abstract: A rigid-flexible coupled leg structure of a biped robot comprises a trunk module, a hip joint module, a thigh module, a shank module and a foot module which are sequentially connected from top to bottom. Shock absorbers are connected between the thigh module and the shank module and between the shank module and the foot module. The compact design of the leg structure is realized through the series layout of the motor and the reasonable integration of key parts; meanwhile, a four-connecting-rod driving mechanism is introduced, so that the joint torque transmission efficiency and the overall movement performance are improved; and on the premise of ensuring the light weight of the system, the stability and response capability of the robot in dynamic actions such as walking and take-off are effectively enhanced.

title: Humanoid robot remote control method, device and equipment based on wireless communication
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot remote control method, device and equipment based on wireless communication, and the method comprises the steps: generating control intention data through multi-modal semantic analysis, and building a bidirectional expectation calibration channel to generate an expectation consistency parameter and a deviation tolerance threshold value; obtaining an expected execution result based on the expected consistency parameter, reversely deducing an optimal control sequence by adopting reverse causal reasoning, and carrying out negative space analysis to identify a forbidden execution action set; constructing a paradox verification scene in combination with the control sequence and the prohibition action to generate control boundary parameters; establishing an interlocking verification condition based on the boundary parameters to generate a safe unlocking sequence; performing parallel monitoring on the control sequence to obtain execution verification data to generate a unified instruction stream; transmitting the instruction stream to a robot end for verification and execution, and obtaining actual execution state data; and convergence analysis is carried out based on the state data, a causal feedback chain is obtained to carry out predictive correction to complete remote control, and intelligent and safe humanoid robot remote control is realized.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure and sole assembly based on rope driving
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot leg structure and sole assembly based on rope driving, which comprises a hip assembly, a thigh assembly, a shank assembly and a sole assembly, the joint of the hip assembly and the thigh assembly is a hip joint, the joint of the thigh assembly and the shank assembly is a knee joint, and the joint of the shank assembly and the sole assembly is an ankle joint. A first driving source is arranged on the upper side of a hip joint and used for driving the hip to roll, a second driving source and a third driving source are arranged on the left side and the right side of the hip joint respectively and used for driving the hip to pitch and yaw, and a fourth driving source and a fifth driving source are arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper portion of a thigh assembly respectively and used for driving the hip to roll. The fourth driving source is used for driving the knee joint to move, the fifth driving source is used for driving the ankle to do pitching motion, and the sixth driving source is arranged at the joint of the shank assembly and the sole assembly and used for driving the ankle to do rolling motion. The dynamic performance of the whole robot can be improved.

title: Fire-fighting inspection method and system for unmanned chemical plant by using fire-fighting humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a fire-fighting inspection method and system for an unmanned plant by a fire-fighting humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of the fire-fighting humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: determining a plurality of fire risk nodes according to the detection of each fire risk region; the sub-risk level of the fire risk area is determined based on the position and temperature data of the plurality of fire risk nodes, and the accuracy of the sub-risk level of the fire risk area is improved. Determining a plurality of fire-fighting inspection areas of the fire-fighting humanoid robot according to the sub-risk level of each fire risk area and the current position of the fire-fighting humanoid robot relative to the unmanned plant; based on the positions of the multiple fire-fighting inspection areas, the inspection sequence of the multiple sub fire-fighting inspection paths is determined, and according to the inspection sequence of the multiple sub fire-fighting inspection paths, the current position of the fire-fighting humanoid robot and the real-time events of the fire-fighting inspection areas, the real-time fire-fighting inspection path of the fire-fighting humanoid robot is determined. And the dynamic effectiveness of the real-time fire-fighting routing inspection path of the fire-fighting humanoid machine is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot arm assembly and joint assembly
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm assembly and a joint assembly, and belongs to the field of robot arms, the humanoid robot arm assembly comprises a circular frame, a rotating frame is rotatably connected in the circular frame, a through arc groove is formed in the front surface of the circular frame, an arc plate is slidably connected in the arc groove, and a stabilizing frame is slidably connected to the top of the circular frame; the front end and the rear end of the arc plate are fixedly connected with the interior of the stabilizing frame, an inner cavity is formed in the upper portion of the interior of the circular frame, a motor is fixed to the rear surface of the circular frame, and the front end of an output shaft of the motor penetrates into the interior of the inner cavity. A single motor can simultaneously realize the swinging (front-back) of a longitudinal shaft of the rotating frame and the sliding (left-right) of a transverse shaft of the stabilizing frame, simulates the multi-dimensional movement capability of human joints, and breaks through the single axial limitation; the joint can complete pitching and side-sway compound actions in a two-dimensional plane.

title: Humanoid robot joint structure based on flexible shaft transmission
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot joint transmission, and discloses a humanoid robot joint structure based on flexible shaft transmission, which comprises a fixed bracket, and the fixed bracket is provided with a first motor group, a second motor group, a first flexible shaft assembly, a second flexible shaft assembly, a turbine assembly and a movable part, wherein the first motor set and the second motor set are fixedly installed on the fixed support, the movable part is hinged to the fixed support, the power output end of the first motor set is fixedly connected with one end of the first flexible shaft assembly, and the other end of the first flexible shaft assembly penetrates through the movable part. The power output end of the second motor set is fixedly connected with one end of the second flexible shaft assembly, and the other end of the second flexible shaft assembly is connected with the movable component in an engaged mode. The joint transmission scheme of the humanoid robot is simple in overall structure, large in torque, low in cost, high in reliability and flexible in driving motor arrangement.

title: Humanoid robot for household service
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot for housekeeping service, which comprises a walking mechanism, a bearing mechanism and two arm mechanisms, and is characterized in that a home controller is mounted in a head mechanism; a taking mechanism is mounted at the front end of the arm mechanism; wherein the taking mechanism comprises a mounting seat mounted with the arm mechanism, a limiting seat mounted at the front end of the mounting seat, clamping jaws mounted on two sides of the limiting seat, and a suction cup mounted at the front end of the limiting seat. When the household service robot takes articles, the arm mechanism drives the taking mechanism to take the articles, the articles are stored in the bearing box according to needs, a user can take the needed articles in time conveniently, and when different types of articles are taken, the clamping mode and the sucking mode are switched through the taking mechanism, so that the clamping mode and the sucking mode are switched, and the clamping mode and the sucking mode are switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched to be switched. title: Virtual debugging method, device and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides a virtual debugging method, device and equipment for a humanoid robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot debugging. The virtual debugging method of the humanoid robot comprises the steps of building a production scene simulation model and a kinematics simulation model of the humanoid robot to be debugged according to process simulation software; generating an action control signal according to a control system of the humanoid robot, the production scene information corresponding to the production scene simulation model and the debugging task information; in the production scene simulation model, performing debugging according to the kinematics simulation model and the action control signal; according to the scheme, the problems of high scene building cost and low debugging efficiency when the humanoid robot is debugged by adopting a real object scene are solved.

title: Battery module combined heat dissipation device for robot joint module
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a battery module combined heat dissipation device for a robot joint module, the battery module combined heat dissipation device comprises a robot shell, a heat dissipation assembly is arranged on the front side surface of the robot shell, and a battery module is limited on the front side surface of the heat dissipation assembly through a mounting assembly. The three-dimensional conformal vapor chamber drives heat to be transported directionally and efficiently, and centralized heat dissipation is achieved; by adopting the design of the foot wrist part, the heat dissipation effect is ensured, meanwhile, the arrangement complexity of the micro-channel cold plate, the battery module and multiple joint modules in the humanoid robot is reduced, the energy consumption of the micro-channel cold plate is reduced, the arrangement flexibility of the micro-channel cold plate in the humanoid robot is greatly improved, and the service life of the humanoid robot is prolonged. And the robot shell is tightly attached to the heat dissipation plate and the micro-channel cold plate, so that the heat dissipation area of the robot shell is greatly increased in the heat dissipation process, and the heat dissipation effect is effectively improved.

title: Neck structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a neck structure and a humanoid robot, and the neck structure comprises a neck main support which comprises a cross shaft first hinge part; the movable platform frame comprises a cross shaft second hinge part; the cross shaft is connected between the neck main support and the movable platform frame, and the cross shaft comprises a cross shaft first shaft part suitable for rotating around a B shaft and a cross shaft second shaft part suitable for rotating around a C shaft; the first universal joint pin hinge part is hinged to the first universal joint pin shaft part, and the second universal joint pin hinge part is hinged to the second universal joint pin shaft part; the driving assembly is connected between the neck main support and the movable platform frame, and the driving assembly is suitable for driving the movable platform frame to rotate around the B axis and/or the C axis relative to the neck main support. According to the neck structure provided by the invention, head pitching with a small amplitude can be realized, and a neck shrinking state can be simulated; the head shaking of the robot in the walking process is reduced, and the head sight of the robot can be kept stable.

title: Foot bearing structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot foot bearing structure which comprises a front foot bottom plate, a rear foot bottom plate, an imitated foot arch piece and an imitated foot sole fascia, the front foot bottom plate, the rear foot bottom plate and the imitated foot arch piece form a triangular arch support capable of being longitudinally deformed, the imitated foot sole fascia elastically deforms along with the imitated foot arch piece, a flexible rotating mechanism is arranged in the front arch section of the imitated foot arch piece, and the front arch section of the imitated foot arch piece is connected with the imitated foot sole fascia. Therefore, the foot arch imitating piece can transversely rotate, human foot tarsal transverse joint movement is simulated, and transverse disturbance is relieved. The device has the advantages that the front arch section and the rear arch section can rotate inwards and outwards around the rigid connecting shaft by utilizing the flexible rotating mechanism, so that the adaptability to complex terrains and the gait stability are improved; the triangular arch structure composed of the foot arch imitating pieces can be dynamically opened, closed and deformed, the impact force generated when the robot walks is dispersed, the vertical rigidity is reduced, and the buffering time is prolonged. The flexible foot sole imitating fascia simulates a human foot sole fascia mechanism, energy is stored when the foot arch imitating piece is compressed, restoring force is generated when the foot is lifted, and the gait efficiency and foot naturalness of the robot are improved.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom waist structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a three-degree-of-freedom waist structure and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The three-degree-of-freedom waist structure of the humanoid robot comprises a first joint mounting piece and a second joint mounting piece. And a waist turnover joint is arranged in the first joint mounting piece. The output end of the waist turnover joint is connected with the robot lower limb structure. And the second joint mounting piece is rotationally connected with the first joint mounting piece. And a waist side-sway joint and a waist pitching joint are arranged in the second joint mounting piece. The waist side-sway joint and the waist pitching joint are sequentially arranged in the direction of the output shaft of the waist pitching joint. And the output end of the waist side sway joint is connected with the first joint mounting piece through a crank connecting rod mechanism. The output end of the waist pitching joint is connected with the robot chest structure. A full series connection mode can be adopted, the whole structure is compact, the structure is prevented from being bloated, good structural rigidity is achieved, kinematics calculation and control of the series connection structure are simple, and the motion control difficulty is reduced.

title: Traveling mechanism and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a walking mechanism which comprises a hip base and a foot support and further comprises four sets of leg assemblies, the leg assemblies are rotationally connected to the hip base, and rotating shafts of the leg assemblies are parallel. One end of each foot assembly is rotationally connected with the corresponding foot support; the two sets of foot assemblies are the first foot assembly and the second foot assembly, the first foot assembly is rotationally connected with the first leg assembly and the second leg assembly, and the second foot assembly is rotationally connected with the fourth leg assembly. The coupling assembly is rotationally connected with the first foot assembly, the second foot assembly and the third foot assembly; and telescopic assemblies are arranged in the three groups of moving assemblies with two connecting points. According to the walking mechanism, the mass is close to the hip base, so that the rotational inertia of the whole walking mechanism is reduced, the system rigidity is improved, the walking mechanism is suitable for occasions with high stability requirements and high precision requirements, the motion precision and the feedback precision can be improved, and the control performance and adaptability of a robot are improved.

title: Conical fan-shaped output joint of robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint with a conical sector-shaped torque at a 120-degree free output angle. According to the principle, a semicircular strip-shaped outer gear sleeve with the roundness of 240 degrees and openings in the center and the interior is arranged, an outer driving gear with the roundness of 120 degrees is installed in the outer gear sleeve, and the outer gear sleeve and the outer driving gear are connected through sliding steel balls and semicircular tracks on the two sides of the outer driving gear through semicircular tracks in the outer gear sleeve. A steel ball rotation track is arranged below an outer driving gear with the roundness of 120 degrees, a set of rotation driving device composed of an outer servo motor and an outer driving worm is additionally arranged at the upper end of an outer gear outer sleeve, the outer servo motor drives the outer driving worm, then the outer driving gear is driven by rotating force generated by the outer driving worm, and the outer driving gear is driven by rotating force generated by the outer driving worm. Therefore, the outer driving gear can move back and forth in the outer gear sleeve within the roundness range of 120 degrees. A group of inner movement gear modules which move back and forth at the roundness of 120 degrees in a manner that the movement trails of the inner movement gear modules are staggered in a crossed manner on the outer driving outer sleeve are additionally arranged in the outer driving outer sleeve, and the inner movement gear modules are smaller than the outer driving gear modules and are positioned right below outer driving gears in the outer driving gear modules in a regular crossed manner; an inner driving outer sleeve of the inner gear module is connected with the inner sides of two forked structures, forked downwards, of an outer driving gear of the outer driving gear module, and the inner driving outer sleeve and the outer driving gear are fixed into a whole through screws in driving gear connecting limiting seats on the two sides of the inner gear outer sleeve.

title: Double-eye structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot double-eye structure which comprises a mounting plate, a double-eye assembly is arranged at the top of the mounting plate, a fixing frame is arranged at the bottom of the mounting plate, two symmetrical clamping grooves are formed in each of the front face and the back face of the fixing frame, and a connecting block is fixedly connected to the bottom of the mounting plate. The front face and the back face of the connecting block are each provided with two symmetrical sliding grooves, and inner cavities of the sliding grooves are slidably connected with clamping blocks. The connecting block is pressed into the inner cavity of the fixing frame, the clamping block is extruded to enter the inner cavity of the sliding groove, the spring is extruded to contract, and when the connecting block enters the inner cavity of the fixing frame, the spring stretches to push the clamping block to enter the inner cavity of the clamping groove, so that the double-eye structure of the humanoid robot can be fixed through the clamping and fixing structure; and it is avoided that much time needs to be consumed for disassembly and assembly of the double-eye structure of the humanoid robot, and the overhaul efficiency of the double-eye structure of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot 3D laser sensor
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot 3D laser sensor, and relates to the technical field of laser sensors, the humanoid robot 3D laser sensor comprises a housing, the surface of the housing is fixedly connected with a fixed plate, the top of the housing is connected with a rotatable upper cover, the surface of the fixed plate is provided with a groove, the fixed plate is communicated with the housing through the groove, and the fixed plate is connected with the housing through the groove. A D laser sensor is arranged in a groove of the shell and a groove of the fixing plate, a supporting rod is fixedly connected to the inner wall of the shell, a circuit board is installed on the supporting rod through a bolt, two fixing rods are fixedly connected to the back face of the fixing plate, and the two fixing rods are located on the two sides of the D laser sensor respectively. The 3D laser sensor dismounting device has the advantages that a 3D laser sensor can be conveniently dismounted, so that the effects of conveniently replacing the 3D laser sensor and reducing resource waste are achieved.

title: Projection screen interaction method based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot-based screen projection interaction method, which comprises the following steps that: a robot projects contents such as images, videos and the like to peripheral equipment such as a smart television and the like in a wireless or wired manner; a user sends an instruction to the robot through touch, voice or gestures of external equipment, and the robot executes actions or adjusts content; the two states are synchronized in real time through a network to ensure consistent display and timely response; and the robot dynamically adjusts the projection content priority or the interface layout according to the user interaction history. The method supports encrypted transmission to guarantee data security, and is suitable for scenes such as smart home control of household appliances, remote medical projection of patient data, support of doctor labeling, education projection of courseware, statistical answering and the like. The method has the advantage that the user can more flexibly and conveniently perform diversified interaction with the robot.

title: Pneumatic artificial muscle biped walking control method and system based on imitation learning
abstract: The invention discloses a pneumatic artificial muscle biped walking control method and system based on imitation learning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly collecting the walking posture data of a human body, and generating an expert track based on a Mujoo simulation platform; then training a strategy model by using an imitation learning algorithm, deploying the strategy model to an embedded controller, sending an action instruction to a PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) based on an action strategy, analyzing the action instruction by the PLC, generating a PWM (Pulse-Width Modulation) signal, and controlling the inflating and deflating time sequence of the lower limb pneumatic artificial muscle group; finally, lower limb joint angle and air pressure data are fed back in real time through a sensor, the PWM duty ratio is adjusted in a closed-loop mode, and the walking posture is optimized. The simulation learning algorithm and pneumatic artificial muscle driving are combined, the human walking mode is mapped, more natural and more stable bionic walking is achieved, and meanwhile the integration level and expandability of the system are improved. A PWM dynamic air pressure distribution mode is adopted, redundant energy loss is reduced, and the response speed and the control precision of the system are improved.

title: Joint mechanism of humanoid robot and mounting method
abstract: The invention discloses a joint mechanism of a humanoid robot and a mounting method thereof, and the joint mechanism comprises a first driving part which is used for driving the robot to rotate around a first shaft; the second driving part is used for driving the robot to rotate around a second shaft; the first shell is provided with at least two wire holes extending in the plane direction; the second shell is provided with an opening for the wire body to penetrate through and at least two vertical linear cavities, the vertical linear cavities extend in the vertical direction, the tops of the vertical linear cavities are communicated through the opening, and the bottoms of the vertical linear cavities can be communicated with the wire hole; the second shell and the first shell are rotationally connected and are provided with mounting positions and initial positions, the vertical linear cavities and the linear holes are staggered at the initial positions, and the openings, the vertical linear cavities and the linear holes form a first three-dimensional wiring path; at the mounting position, the vertical line cavity is opposite to the line hole, and the opening, the vertical line cavity and the line hole form a second three-dimensional wiring path; the length of the first three-dimensional routing path is larger than that of the second three-dimensional routing path. According to the invention, through the cooperation of the vertical line cavity and the line hole, the wiring space is increased.

title: Robot long-life light-weight CQ double-cycloid speed reducer
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot speed reducers, and particularly relates to improvement of Japanese RV speed reducers, in particular to a robot long-life light-weight CQ double-cycloid speed reducer which comprises a hypocycloid gear ring, a planet carrier, a double-eccentric input shaft, cycloidal gears, bearings and other parts, and is characterized in that eccentric sections on the double-eccentric input shaft are connected with the cycloidal gears through the RN bearings; the cycloid gear teeth are meshed with the inner cycloid gear to drive the planet carrier to realize transmission output, so that a single-stage cycloid speed reducing mechanism is formed; and a concave-convex double-cycloid transmission structure is adopted, so that the bearing capacity is improved. The RV speed reducer has the technical effects that (1) the service life is long: the precision service life of the whole machine reaches 13000h, which is more than twice of the 6000h of the existing RV speed reducer; (2) light weight: a planetary stage in an existing RV speed reducer is removed, and light weight is realized; and (3) the adaptability is high, a concave-convex double-cycloid transmission structure is adopted, the reduction ratio is increased, the bearing capacity is improved, and the device is more suitable for a humanoid robot cycloid joint module.

title: Bionic foot structure, control method thereof and bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic foot structure, a control method of the bionic foot structure and a bionic robot. The bionic foot structure comprises an ankle; the foot plate is rotationally connected with the ankle; a planetary gear structure; the planetary gear structure comprises a gear ring, a planetary gear and a sun gear, the planetary gear and the sun gear are both located in the gear ring, and the planetary gear is meshed with the sun gear and the gear ring. The planetary gear is rotationally connected with the foot plate, and the ankle is connected with the sun gear; the first end of the damping structure is rotationally connected with the foot plate, and the second end of the damping structure is rotationally connected with the gear ring. The foot plate rotates by a large angle relative to the ankle, and the damping structure has small activity; the rotation speed of the foot plate relative to the ankle is high, and the movement speed of the damping structure is low. The matching between the damping structure and the foot plate is improved through the planetary gear structure, so that the bionic foot structure can rotate similar to a human foot.

title: Industrial scene humanoid robot task execution method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial scene humanoid robot task execution method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of industrial robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-executed task instruction in response to a task issuing request; extracting a complexity parameter of the task instruction, and determining a target task processing model according to the complexity parameter; decomposing the task instruction into a subtask sequence by utilizing a target task processing model, and generating an execution parameter for each subtask; based on the subtask sequence and the execution parameters, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute the task, and a result is output; wherein the complexity parameter comprises a task step number and a precision requirement level; the target task processing model comprises a multi-modal fusion execution model and a single-process execution model. According to the method, the optimal processing model is dynamically matched by extracting the step number and the precision requirement level of the task instruction, so that the task execution efficiency and precision of multiple human-shaped robots are effectively improved, and the use requirements in an industrial scene are met.

title: Harmonic reducer humanoid robot leg power mechanism and gait optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a harmonic reducer humanoid robot leg power mechanism and a gait optimization method.The harmonic reducer humanoid robot leg power mechanism comprises a mounting frame and a foot bottom plate, and a mounting cylinder is fixedly mounted at the bottom end of the mounting frame; a first driving assembly used for driving the mechanical legs to rotate simply and a second driving assembly used for driving the mechanical legs to bend, stretch and turn are arranged outside the mounting cylinder, and the mounting frame and the foot bottom plate are connected through the first driving assembly. The leg power mechanism has the beneficial effects that by arranging the second driving assembly, harmonic speed reducers are distributed in a concentrated mode, external force interference borne by flexible gears in the harmonic speed reducers is reduced, and therefore the reliability of the leg power mechanism is improved, and the service life of the harmonic speed reducers is prolonged; and due to centralized arrangement, technicians can conveniently check, maintain and replace the flexible gear and related parts, and the maintainability of the robot is improved.

title: Multi-mode self-adaptive clamping system for assembling key parts of humanoid robot and control method of multi-mode self-adaptive clamping system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal self-adaptive clamping system for assembling key components of a humanoid robot and a control method of the multi-modal self-adaptive clamping system, and the system comprises a multi-modal sensing module which is used for collecting assembling parameters; the edge calculation module is used for generating a control instruction by utilizing a multi-mode deep learning model according to the assembly parameters; the cloud service module is used for generating distillation data according to the assembly parameters; the self-adaptive clamping module is used for clamping and moving key components of the humanoid robot; and the programmable logic control module is used for controlling the self-adaptive clamping module to execute component assembling operation according to the control instruction and the distillation data. According to the invention, a multi-mode self-adaptive clamping system is realized, and the efficiency and the clamping stability are improved. The robot can be widely applied to the technical field of industrial robots.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and system, a storage medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the weighted calculation of pressure distribution data, and obtaining a pressure barycentric coordinate of a cooperative contact point; a time window sequence is constructed based on the pressure gravity center coordinates, and the instantaneous speed and acceleration of the pressure gravity center are obtained through differential operation; calculating the magnitude and the direction of resultant force applied by the human operator at the cooperative contact point based on the instantaneous speed and the acceleration; the magnitude and the direction of the resultant force are transmitted along a joint chain of the humanoid robot, and the instantaneous stress state of each joint of the humanoid robot is obtained through conversion; calculating a corresponding joint output torque according to the instantaneous stress state of each joint; and all joints of the humanoid robot are controlled to cooperatively move according to the joint output torque. The method is used for accurately recognizing and predicting the human cooperation intention, precise force matching and natural action synchronization in the man-machine cooperation process are achieved, and therefore the safety and efficiency of the cooperation task are improved.

title: Modularized battery pack of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of battery packs, and discloses a modular battery pack of a humanoid robot, which comprises a shell module, a battery pack module is detachably connected in the shell module, and a gap distance is formed between the battery pack module and any side wall of the shell module; one side of the shell module is detachably connected with an upper cover module, and the upper cover module is detachably connected with the robot body. When the shell module is deformed by external force, the damage probability of the battery pack module can be reduced, and the overall safety and reliability of the battery pack are improved; the shell module, the battery pack module and the upper cover module are detachably connected with one another and are independent detachable modules, when one of the shell module, the battery pack module and the upper cover module is damaged and affects use safety, the shell module, the battery pack module and the upper cover module can be independently detached and replaced, the whole battery pack does not need to be replaced, and the humanoid robot can restart to work with the minimum cost; and the upper cover module is clamped with the robot main body, so that the whole battery pack can be conveniently taken out for replacement.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom co-driven humanoid five-finger dexterous hand and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom co-driven humanoid five-finger dexterous hand and a control method, the multi-degree-of-freedom co-driven humanoid five-finger dexterous hand comprises a palm back plate, a palm front panel and five fingers, the five fingers adopt modular design and have completely same structures, each finger has three active degrees of freedom and one passive degree of freedom, and each active degree of freedom and the corresponding passive degree of freedom are in parallel. Wherein three active degrees of freedom are respectively a base joint bending degree of freedom, a base joint side-sway degree of freedom and a middle joint bending degree of freedom and are cooperatively controlled by three servo motors at the bottom of the finger, and one passive degree of freedom is a far joint bending degree of freedom and is realized by a planetary gear train under-actuated mechanism in the finger. A space wheel train mechanism is introduced, the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand is designed, mutual coupling control over the three active freedom degrees of base joint bending, base joint side swing and middle joint bending is achieved, each active freedom degree is cooperatively controlled by three motors, the finger space is simplified, and the output force is increased.

title: Bearing oil seal for humanoid robot joint and press fitting device of bearing oil seal
abstract: The bearing oil seal is applied to the technical field of humanoid robots, the bearing oil seal comprises a pedestal, the top of the pedestal is in bolted connection with a moving track, and one end of the top of the moving track is provided with a bearing cylinder in bolted connection with the pedestal; and a supporting shell is connected to one side of the pedestal through bolts, a grease injection assembly and a press-fitting assembly are slidably connected to the side, close to the moving track, of the supporting shell, and a driving mechanism and a translation mechanism are installed in the supporting shell and the pedestal correspondingly. The grease injection assembly and the press-fitting assembly are driven to move up and down on one side of the supporting shell, meanwhile, the V-shaped clamp is driven to continuously move among the bearing barrel, the grease injection assembly and the press-fitting assembly, and bearings in the bearing barrel are pushed out one by one and accurately moved to the bottoms of the grease injection assembly and the press-fitting assembly to be subjected to grease injection and press-fitting.

title: Standby station
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a standby station, and solves the problems that a standby station in the related technology needs to be operated by multiple professionals, the labor cost is high, and the safety is poor. The standby station comprises a lifting device and a supporting device. The lifting device drives the supporting device to ascend and descend, and the supporting device supports the hip of the humanoid robot. In actual use, only the supporting device needs to descend firstly, then the humanoid robot walks to a designated area or a user moves a standby station to a corresponding position, in the designated area or the corresponding position, the hip of the humanoid robot is located above the supporting device, then the supporting device ascends, the supporting device bears the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot can be supported by the supporting device. title: Rope-driven humanoid five-finger manipulator with self-adaptive adsorption in palm center
abstract: The utility model discloses a rope-driven humanoid five-finger manipulator with a self-adaptive adsorption function at the palm center, which comprises a hand mechanism comprising a manipulator palm and fingers, a plurality of fingers are assembled with the manipulator palm, and each finger also comprises a plurality of knuckles which are mutually hinged; the grasping mechanism comprises a pull rope penetrating through the palm and the knuckles of the manipulator; according to the unfolding mechanism, torsional springs are arranged at the hinged positions of the adjacent knuckles, and the torsional springs enable the two adjacent knuckles to have elastic potential energy for enlarging the included angle; the artificial muscle material is used for sensing the deformation of the knuckles and transmitting electric signals; wherein the distance from the pull rope to the inner front side of the finger is larger than that from the pull rope to the back side of the finger, and the artificial muscle material is located on the back side of the finger. The grabbing and loosening unfolding mechanism is simple and reliable in principle and low in cost. title: CENTROIDAL RATE ESTIMATION FOR ROBOTIC LOCOMOTION
abstract: A system and method for providing a position and rate of change for a robot that is useful in a robotic control system. The invention uses an inverted pendulum and flywheel model. The model produces a linear momentum parameter and an angular momentum parameter. The inventors have developed a modified velocity measure for the control system that combines both the linear and angular rates of motion for the robot into an equivalent linear rate. This equivalent linear rate captured the same dynamic effects as using both a linear and angular rate does for the prior art systems. The developed equivalent linear rate can be used for a number of purposes, including feedback control during walking, step placement, planning, and measurement of balance conditions.

title: Efficient energy-saving humanoid robot servo driver
abstract: The utility model provides a high-efficiency energy-saving humanoid robot servo driver, which relates to the technical field of servo driving and comprises a positioning base, a sliding chute arranged on one side of the positioning base, a machine base arranged on the top of the positioning base, a driving motor arranged on the top of the machine base, and a connecting shell arranged on one side of the machine base. The connecting blocks are arranged on the two sides of the servo driver respectively, the sliding grooves are formed in the two sides of the inner wall of the positioning base respectively, and the limiting shifting pieces are arranged on the front face of the positioning base for limiting, so that the connecting blocks are prevented from being firmly positioned by being limited by the limiting shifting pieces in the sliding grooves; therefore, accurate positioning of the connecting block can be achieved through the sliding grooves in the two sides of the inner wall of the positioning base and the limiting shifting piece on the front face. In the moving process of a humanoid robot, the position accuracy of a servo driver is crucial, and in the working process of the humanoid robot, especially when a high-intensity task is executed or the humanoid robot moves in a complex environment, the servo driver needs to bear large external force.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model provides a leg structure and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The hip pitching assembly comprises a hip pitching joint and a hip pitching connecting piece in driving connection with the hip pitching joint, and the hip pitching connecting piece is fixedly connected with the thigh skeleton; the knee joint assembly comprises a knee joint and a knee connecting piece in driving connection with the knee joint, the knee joint is connected with the thigh skeleton, the knee connecting piece is in transmission connection with the shank skeleton, and the rotating axis of the knee connecting piece is parallel to the rotating axis of the hip pitching connecting piece. According to the leg structure, the tail end mass of the leg structure can be reduced, so that the movement energy consumption is reduced, and the movement flexibility and cruising ability of the biped robot are improved.

title: Multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of humanoid robot to swing
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of a humanoid robot to swing. The multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure comprises a cylinder body, a cylinder liner, a piston, a cylinder stroke control ring, a stay wire, a stay wire restraining device and a wire collecting pipe. The air cylinder body comprises a shell and cover plates, the cover plates seal the two ends of the shell, the shell is in a hollow cylinder shape, a hollow shaft is sleeved with a line concentration pipe, the two ends of the shell are provided with a plurality of air cylinder holes symmetrical to the center section of the shell, air cylinder inner containers and piston plates are installed in the holes, piston plate faces are fixed to the air cylinder inner containers, and piston rods are fixed to the other faces of the piston plates. When the air cylinder inner container is inflated or deflated, the piston does reciprocating linear motion, the two stay wires fixed on the piston rod turn to enter the wire collecting pipe through the stay wire restraining device at the center position of the shell, then turn to penetrate out of the wire collecting pipe to be connected with the finger joints, and therefore the finger joints are driven to swing, and the function of the multi-cylinder pneumatic machine is achieved. The cylinder stroke control ring is installed at a cylinder port to control the maximum stroke of the cylinder.

abstract: The utility model relates to a multi-source emergency stop control system of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and the system comprises a power management board which is integrated with an MCU controller and an emergency stop relay which are connected with each other, a first interface which is connected with the emergency stop relay and is used for accessing a power module, and a second interface which is connected with the MCU controller and is used for accessing an emergency stop switch; and the edge computer is connected with the MCU controller through a third interface, and a network module which is used for receiving external information remotely or remotely and controlling the on-off of the emergency stop relay through the MCU controller is integrated on the edge computer. When the humanoid robot is abnormal, a user can control sudden stop by pressing the sudden stop switch, can remotely control the network module through the remote control handle to achieve sudden stop control, and can remotely control the network module through electronic equipment such as a mobile phone to achieve sudden stop control. The ability of sudden stop control over the robot in various application scenes is achieved, and the reliability of sudden stop control over the humanoid robot is greatly improved.

According to the utility model, the size, the weight and the cost are obviously reduced, and the installation structure, the wiring and the like are simpler.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of garbage sorting, particularly relates to a humanoid robot flexible grabbing type dynamic garbage sorting workstation, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problem that an existing dynamic garbage sorting workstation cannot quickly treat garbage in collection boxes: the dynamic garbage sorting workstation comprises two symmetrical collection boxes; openings are formed in the exteriors of the two collecting boxes, and the inner walls of the openings are slidably connected with the exteriors of the containing barrels on the same sides; and the conveying belt is located on the same side of the two collecting boxes, a support is fixedly connected to the bottom of the conveying belt, and a sorting robot is arranged on the side, away from the collecting boxes, of the conveying belt. According to the flexible grabbing type dynamic garbage sorting work station of the humanoid robot, empty containing barrels and containing barrels full of garbage can be rapidly replaced by the device in the garbage sorting process, so that the shutdown waiting time of the device is shortened, the garbage sorting rhythm is ensured, and the garbage sorting efficiency of the device is improved.

title: Mechanical arm and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and discloses a mechanical arm and a robot. Through cooperation of the connecting rod mechanism and the first driving mechanism, the connecting rod can swing or move in the height direction of the robot so as to drive the arm body to ascend and descend up and down and simulate the shoulder rising action of human beings, and therefore the motion dimension of the mechanical arm in the vertical direction is expanded, and the mechanical arm can complete complex actions which cannot be achieved through a traditional structure; and the movement flexibility and the operation range of the mechanical arm in a three-dimensional space are obviously improved.

title: Bowden cable assisted flexible lower limb multi-joint exoskeleton robot and control method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of motorized tools, and particularly relates to a Bowden cable power-assisted flexible lower limb multi-joint exoskeleton robot and a control method. The robot can assist the hip and knee joints of the lower limbs when a human body walks; a reversing bevel gear set, a two-way wire spool and an electromagnetic clutch are adopted, so that a single motor assists hip joint extension and knee joint bending in the left leg and the right leg of the lower limb; the prediction of the walking gait position and the gait period is realized through inertial measurement units mounted on the two sides of the left leg and the right leg; in the control system, an upper computer drives a motor through dspace to drive hip and knee joints of lower limbs to move, an inertial measurement unit performs angle feedback, and normalized gait prediction is realized. Through a designed dynamic model, PD iterative control and fuzzy PID control, the tracking of the hip and knee joint expected power-assisted curve is realized.

title: Joint module of humanoid robot

title: Humanoid robot palm support structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot palm support structure which comprises a finger support, a support spring, a support connecting shaft sleeve, a support connecting shaft, a support hinge, a pull wire and a pull wire restraint ring. A middle finger support, a ring finger support and a little finger support are connected through a hinge formed by combining a support connecting shaft and a support connecting shaft sleeve, the five finger supports are connected in a hinged mode to form a palm support, and the palm support can form a palm together with five fingers with joints driven by stay wires to swing. The two ends of the support spring can be fixed to the middles of the tops of the L-shaped contact faces of the two adjacent finger supports respectively, and the support spring is used for shaping the palm support when the palm support is not stressed. The pull wire is fixed on the front and back of the palm of the thumb support and penetrates through the pull wire restraint ring on the index finger support, and the pull wire drives the thumb support to swing. According to the palm support, the stress state of the knuckles at the bottom ends of the fingers can be improved when an object is grabbed.

title: Robot autonomous assembly method and system based on imitation learning, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a robot autonomous assembly method and system based on imitation learning, a storage medium and computer equipment, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a universal expert strategy suitable for polygonal shaft hole assembly through analyzing and summarizing the polygonal shaft hole assembly experience of an expert; according to the strategy, task type images and human assembly demonstration data including assembly force/torque and assembly actions are collected; modeling a human assembly skill into a universal assembly skill model based on shared knowledge and specific knowledge; using a loss function guidance algorithm to train and optimize the general assembly model; and deploying the optimized general assembly model into a control system of the robot so as to drive the robot to execute humanization-like assembly. According to the method, the problems of poor generalization performance, slow convergence of an end-to-end learning mode and high cost of an imitation learning method can be solved, rapid learning of human skills can be realized, and humanoid robot autonomous assembly is realized.

title: Interaction test method and device for gait simulation of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an interaction test method for gait simulation of a humanoid robot, which is applied to a test platform. Comprising the following steps: controlling a current gait simulation model corresponding to a virtual robot to perform a gait simulation test in a virtual test environment in a current preset time period; the virtual test data is sent to the physical robot; controlling the physical robot to execute corresponding gait operation according to the virtual test data in the actual test environment, and sending the actual test data to the virtual robot; updating the current gait simulation model based on the virtual test data and the real test data; and continuing to perform the gait simulation test based on the updated gait simulation model, and ending the updating operation until the gait simulation test is ended, so as to generate a complete gait scheme. Therefore, by constructing a closed-loop interaction mechanism between the virtual robot and the physical robot, dynamic adjustment of the gait simulation model is achieved, the gait of the physical robot is restored, and the stability and precision of the gait of the physical robot are improved.

title: Sensor external parameter determination method and device, robot, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a sensor external parameter determination method and device, a robot, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a first sensor based on a laser radar obtains point cloud data of a manipulator; fingertip point cloud recognition is carried out on the point cloud data by using a fingertip point cloud recognition model to obtain fingertip point cloud features; acquiring image data of the manipulator based on a second sensor of the shooting equipment; performing fingertip image recognition on the image data by using a fingertip image recognition model to obtain fingertip image features; and calculating a target extrinsic parameter between the first sensor and the second sensor based on the fingertip point cloud feature and the fingertip image feature. The determination of the target external parameter of the sensor overcomes the defect problem of a single sensor in environmental perception, so that the determination of the target external parameter is more accurate. Meanwhile, the determination of the target external parameter does not need an external tool, and the efficiency of determining the external parameter of the sensor is improved.

title: robot
abstract: The present invention includes: a robot body accommodating a battery therein; a wheel disposed at a lower portion of the robot body, wherein balance control is performed to rotationally drive in a direction opposite to an inclined direction when a center of gravity of the robot body is inclined; a leg portion including an upper link having one side rotatably coupled to the robot body, and a lower link having one side rotatably coupled to the other side of the upper link and the other side rotatably coupled to the wheel; arms rotatably coupled to both sides of the robot body; a distance detection sensor for detecting a distance between the robot body and a floor surface; a front-rear tilt detection sensor for detecting an angle at which the robot body is tilted in a front-rear direction toward the floor surface; and an included angle detection sensor for detecting an angle between the upper link and the lower link, wherein when the distance detected by the distance detection sensor is equal to or less than a set distance, the angle detected by the tilt detection sensor is equal to or less than a first set angle, and the angle detected by the included angle detection sensor is equal to or less than a second set angle, the balance control is performed.

title: Method for humanoid robot to follow accompanying object
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a method for a humanoid robot to follow an accompanying object, and the method is characterized in that the robot recognizes and tracks the image and position of the accompanying object through a camera or a depth sensor, obtains environment data through a laser radar, an infrared sensor and the like, carries out the path planning of obstacle avoidance through a Dijkstra algorithm, and carries out the tracking of the accompanying object. The speed and direction are adjusted according to object movement to follow in real time, and a proper distance is kept according to steps. The robot integrates vision and environment data to accurately judge the condition, can monitor vital signs of an object, triggers an alarm when finding out abnormity, provides emotional support through voice interaction and the like, gives an alarm, calls rescue and contacts people in emergency, and sends a position when the object leaves a safe area. The system has the advantages that real-time tracking, dynamic path planning, health monitoring and multi-mode interaction of the robot on an accompanying object are achieved through visual identification, sensor fusion and an intelligent algorithm.

title: Polishing device for humanoid robot joint module production
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of workpiece polishing, and discloses a polishing device for humanoid robot joint module production, which comprises a base, a headstock and a polishing mechanism, the polishing mechanism comprises a mounting shaft and a bearing table, the bearing table is provided with an execution group, the execution group comprises two sliding blocks, and the two sliding blocks are arranged on the mounting shaft. Containing grooves are formed in the end faces of the two sliding blocks, the two sliding blocks are jointly connected with a linkage block through hinge plates, and a grinding piece is arranged on the side, away from the hinge plates, of the linkage block. According to the grinding device for producing the humanoid robot joint module, the problems that in the prior art, when workpieces such as a machine shell with the stepped inner circumferential surface are machined, grinding heads of different specifications need to be frequently replaced, the working efficiency is remarkably reduced due to frequent replacement, and meanwhile after the grinding heads are replaced, the grinding efficiency is greatly reduced can be effectively solved. The problems that the continuity and consistency of the whole grinding process are difficult to guarantee, the grinding precision of the inner wall of the machine shell is not uniform, and finally precise assembly of parts is affected are solved.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand based on double-center decoupling metamorphic palm and series-parallel direct-drive mechanical fingers
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid dexterous hand based on a double-center decoupling metamorphic palm and series-parallel direct-drive mechanical fingers, which comprises a metamorphic palm and at least one mechanical finger. Eight connecting rods and eight revolute pairs of the metamorphic palm are alternately arranged and sequentially connected to form a closed loop, the axes of four adjacent revolute pairs intersect at a first sphere center to form a first spherical four-rod mechanism, and the axes of the other four adjacent revolute pairs intersect at a second sphere center to form a second spherical four-rod mechanism. Different metamorphic forks are derived from the eight revolute pairs through coaxial axes and coplanar adjacent axes, and when the eight revolute pairs move to forking points for forking, the eight revolute pairs enter different motion branches so as to form different metamorphic structures. A direct-drive type driving mechanism included in the mechanical finger drives an MCP joint to conduct pitching motion and side-sway motion, and the direct-drive type driving mechanism drives a PIP joint and a DIP joint to conduct synchronous flexion and extension motion. The clothes provided by the invention have stronger dexterity.

title: Humanoid robot

title: Biped robot reinforcement learning control method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot reinforcement learning control method which comprises the following steps: after a model prediction controller receives a walking instruction, outputting expected angle data of each joint of a robot to a reinforcement learning neural network, and meanwhile, returning joint angle data of an actual strategy of the reinforcement learning neural network to the neural network by a sensing system at a bottom layer; a joint angle taking time as a sequence and planned by model prediction is compared with a joint angle actually generated by a neural network, and model prediction control is fused into a reinforcement learning training process by setting a reward function for punishment, so that the reinforcement learning training efficiency is improved, and a stable gait is more quickly achieved. Excellent gaits planned by the MPC are transplanted into reinforcement learning control, and control robustness can be improved under the condition that the excellent gaits of the MPC are reserved; and meanwhile, the joint angle data which is obtained by taking time as a sequence and is obtained by taking MPC as a planner can accelerate the reinforcement learning training process, so that the training speed and the control effect of reinforcement learning are greatly improved.

title: Parallel flexible driving humanoid lower limb mechanism and system
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a parallel flexible driving humanoid lower limb mechanism and system. A parallel flexible driving human lower limb simulating mechanism comprises a thigh assembly, a first driving mechanism, a second driving mechanism, a driving mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein the thigh assembly comprises a first motor and a thigh support connected with the output end of the first motor; the shank assembly comprises a second motor and a shank support connected with the output end of the second motor, the shank support is hinged to the thigh support, and the second motor is arranged at the hinged position of the shank support and the thigh support; the foot assembly comprises a third motor and a foot plate, the foot plate is hinged to the shank support, and the output end of the third motor is hinged to the foot plate. The lower limbs can move through cooperative use of all the components. The peak torque of the second motor is reduced in the movement process by adjusting the spring stiffness, so that a servo motor with smaller peak torque is allowed to be selected, the quality of the humanoid lower limb is reduced, the electric energy efficiency is improved, and the working time is prolonged.

The peak torque of the second motor is reduced in the movement process by adjusting the spring stiffness, so that a servo motor with smaller peak torque is allowed to be selected, the quality of the humanoid lower limb is reduced, the electric energy efficiency is improved, and the working time is prolonged.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot. The connecting piece of the actuator is designed to be of the structure with the containing space between the two ends, the output end and the other end, away from the output end, of each joint actuator are connected with the two ends of the connecting piece correspondingly, so that the two ends of each joint actuator are fixed, stress on the two ends is more balanced in the rotating process of the joint actuators, and the stability of the joint actuators is improved. The stability of the mechanical arm in the moving process is improved, and the structure is simple and compact.

title: Humanoide Armkinematik mit Rollkontaktgelenken und Seilantrieb
abstract: Arm kinematics for a robot, in particular for humanoid robots, comprising: a. an arm swivel joint (1) with one rotational degree of freedom for connection to a base or a torso, b. a serial sequence of three rolling joints (2, 3, 5) or four rolling joints (2, 3, 4, 5) each having two rotational degrees of freedom, c. wherein the rolling joints (2-5) have a movement characteristic with spherical rolling contact, and d. the joints (2-5) are driven exclusively by cable pulls (A), e. wherein all actuators (D) are arranged outside of the arm, and f. the cable pulls (A) are guided in pairs antagonistically through the rolling joints (2-5) in such a way that, due to the geometry of the joint type and the cable routing, the total length of each cable pull pair remains constant during the joint movement.

abstract: A mechanical end effector for a humanoid robot includes a plurality of identical finger assemblies. Each of the finger assemblies is removably connected to a frame. Each of the finger assemblies includes a single electric motor and is configured to be fully operable using only the single electric motor.

title: Control decision-making method, system and equipment of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control decision method, system and device for a humanoid robot and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first graph structure data of the humanoid robot and a multi-modal data set in a current time window; performing dynamic feature fusion on the multi-modal data set to obtain fusion features; according to the fusion feature, performing graph structure updating on the first graph structure data to obtain second graph structure data; and inputting the second graph structure data into a decision network for control decision, and obtaining a control decision result of the humanoid robot. The method can effectively improve the environment perception ability of the humanoid robot to the complex environment, and is beneficial to improving the control decision effect of the humanoid robot. The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning.

title: Humanoid robot with anti-collision and anti-falling structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and provides a humanoid robot with an anti-collision and anti-falling structure, which comprises a humanoid robot main body and a robot waist joint part in the humanoid robot main body, and further comprises four groups of movable supporting parts, and anti-falling supporting mechanisms are arranged in the movable supporting parts; the anti-falling supporting mechanism is used for driving the internal structure to stretch out and draw back to the ground to support the robot. The Y-axis twisting mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the movable supporting piece and used for driving the movable supporting piece to conduct Y-axis angle adjustment, and then the Y-axis twisting mechanism is matched with the inclination angle to complete supporting operation of the next step. The device can be conveniently adapted to the humanoid robot in the experiment stage, and the stability in the experiment stage can be improved, so that the problems that after an existing robot falls and is damaged, tedious debugging and maintenance work needs to be carried out, a large amount of time and labor cost are consumed, and the experiment progress and efficiency are seriously affected are solved.

title: Robot long-life light-weight CQ double-cycloid hollow speed reducer
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot speed reducers, and particularly relates to improvement of Japanese RV speed reducers, in particular to a robot long-service-life light-weight CQ double-cycloid hollow speed reducer which comprises an inner cycloid gear ring, a planet carrier, a double-eccentric hollow shaft, cycloidal gears, bearings and other parts, and is characterized in that eccentric sections on the double-eccentric hollow shaft are connected with the cycloidal gears through the RN bearings; the cycloid gear teeth are meshed with the inner cycloid gear to drive the planet carrier to realize transmission output, so that a single-stage cycloid speed reducing mechanism is formed; and a concave-convex double-cycloid transmission structure is adopted, so that the bearing capacity is improved. The RV speed reducer has the technical effects that (1) the service life is long: the precision service life of the whole machine reaches 13000h, which is more than twice of the 6000h of the existing RV speed reducer; (2) light weight: a planetary stage in an existing RV speed reducer is removed, and light weight is realized; and (3) the adaptability is high, a concave-convex double-cycloid transmission structure is adopted, the reduction ratio is increased, the bearing capacity is improved, and the device is more suitable for a humanoid robot cycloid joint module.

title: Self-adaptive locking mechanism applied to wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive locking mechanism applied to a wheeled humanoid robot. The self-adaptive locking mechanism comprises a supporting sensing assembly. The driving assembly is arranged on the supporting induction assembly and comprises a double-shaft motor and two first magnetic gears; the two locking assemblies are movably arranged on the supporting induction assembly respectively and are in transmission connection with the corresponding first magnetic gears respectively; each locking assembly comprises a lead screw and a second magnetic gear which is fixedly arranged on the lead screw and is in transmission connection with the corresponding first magnetic gear. And the locking block structure is arranged on the screw rod in a transmission manner. The locking torque can be preset through the magnetic gears, when the center position of the swing arm is not on the central axis, one magnetic gear reaches the locking torque, the double-shaft motor continues to work until the other magnetic gear also reaches the locking torque, and then the double-shaft motor stops working; therefore, the two locking blocks are matched to carry out bidirectional locking operation on the swing arm, and the problem that the wheel type humanoid robot is poor in stability is effectively solved.

title: Robot joint module and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a robot joint module and a robot, the robot joint module comprises a first mounting seat, a first motor, a fixed rod, a second mounting seat, a rotating part and a connecting rod, the first motor is fixedly mounted on the first mounting seat, and the first motor is provided with a first output shaft; the fixed part of the fixed rod is fixedly connected to the first mounting seat; the second mounting seat is rotatably mounted on the connecting part of the fixed rod around a rotating axis parallel to the first output shaft; the rotating piece is fixedly sleeved on the first output shaft; the first end of the connecting rod is hinged to the rotating part around a first axis, the second end of the connecting rod is hinged to the second mounting seat around a second axis, and the first axis and the second axis are parallel to the first output shaft; the connecting rod is not overlapped with the rotating piece, the first output shaft and the fixed rod in the axis direction of the first output shaft. According to the technical scheme, the technical problem that the swing angle range of a joint module needing to swing on the humanoid robot is limited due to mutual interference of rod pieces can be solved.

title: Biped robot bionic foot with terrain adaptive capacity and rigidity adjustment
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot bionic foot with terrain adaptive capacity and rigidity adjustability, which comprises a front sole, a rear sole, a locust-imitating sole structure, an arch piece, a six-dimensional force sensor and an ankle joint support, and is characterized in that the arch piece is connected with the sole and is connected with the ankle joint support through the six-dimensional force sensor; the simulated locust sole structure adopts a composite structure of an upper rigid framework, a lower rigid framework and a simulated locust foot pad, the simulated locust sole structure is actively attached to the irregular ground through a liquid bag and a flexible bottom face, multi-point contact is achieved, friction force and ground gripping performance are improved, liquid bag partitions are arranged in the simulated locust foot pad, human sole pressure distribution is simulated, the liquid bag can adjust the liquid volume, and dynamic rigidity adjustment is achieved. The arch piece is of an arch-shaped elastic structure, the arch piece is matched with the liquid bag, the rigidity of the arch is adjusted in a linkage mode so as to adapt to the impact load or the gait stage, the buffering capacity is enhanced, the outer ring liquid bag in the liquid bag is used for buffering initial impact, the center liquid bag bears main supporting force, the elastic deformation of the arch is matched, the impact peak value is reduced, and the gait stability is improved.

title: Model reasoning-based humanoid robot control method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and related equipment based on model reasoning, and the method comprises the steps: dynamically collecting multi-modal data through a target robot end, converting the multi-modal data, and generating multi-modal conversion data; dynamically monitoring the network communication state of the target robot end, reasoning the multi-modal transformation data through a lightweight reasoning service model according to the network communication state and the data sensitivity of the multi-modal transformation data, and outputting a reasoning result; the lightweight reasoning service model is obtained through full-layer parameter transformation and federated learning cooperative training; and performing inverse transformation on the reasoning result through the target robot end to obtain an action control instruction, and controlling the target humanoid robot according to the action control instruction. According to the embodiment of the invention, robot automatic control based on multi-modal data input can be realized, and the robot control efficiency and accuracy are improved. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

title: Ball screw for humanoid robot and manufacturing method thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a ball screw for a humanoid robot and a manufacturing method of the ball screw, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The manufacturing method of the ball screw for the humanoid robot comprises the following steps that S1, titanium alloy TC4 is selected as a screw base material, a bar is manufactured after vacuum melting, solution treatment is carried out, topological optimization design is carried out on a screw shaft based on a finite element analysis result, a screw shaft blank of a hollow structure is prepared in a precision casting mode, and the screw shaft blank of the hollow structure is obtained; the lead screw shaft is filled with light high-strength hollow metal microspheres; and S2, in the environment with the constant temperature of 20 +/-0.5 DEG C, a nano-coating hard alloy cutter is adopted for conducting thread grinding on the lead screw shaft blank, and the thread pitch error is controlled within +/-1 micron/100 mm. Through material optimization, structure optimization and advanced process integration, the precision, the lightweight level, the wear resistance and the dynamic response capability of the ball screw are remarkably improved, and the high-precision motion control requirement of the humanoid robot is better met.
