title: Frameless motor reinforced connecting device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a frameless motor reinforced connection device of a humanoid robot, which is arranged on a stator and a rotor and comprises a first shell, a second shell and an extrusion rod, the stator is sleeved with the first shell, the rotor is sleeved with the second shell, the second shell and the first shell are mutually clamped and extrude the stator and the rotor, and the first shell and the second shell can rotate. The first shell is arranged at one end of the stator and used for being matched with the first shell to extrude the stator towards the rotor, the rotor connecting piece is arranged at one end of the rotor and extrudes the rotor towards the stator, and the rotor connecting piece comprises a compression-resistant spring and is used for relieving hard extrusion on the rotor. According to the frameless motor reinforced connecting device of the humanoid robot, the first shell and the stator connecting piece form double limiting through a precise clamping and inserting structure, circumferential and radial displacement of a stator is effectively limited, the coaxiality of a motor axis and a joint rotating axis is remarkably improved, it is ensured that no relative shake exists between the stator and the shell, and the connecting precision is greatly improved.

title: Humanoid robot bionic foot with autonomous terrain testing capability
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot bionic foot with autonomous terrain testing capability, which comprises a front sole component and a rear sole component which are flexibly connected through a sole fascia, a support connecting frame is hinged with an arch component to form a space transmission structure, and the support connecting frame and the arch component cooperate with the fascia to form an arched composite support. The locust-imitating foot pad has the innovation points that the locust-imitating foot pad realizes segmented flexible and local fitting buffering; the pelma fascia and the arch-shaped arch absorb impact in the initial gait stage, and rigid body transmission is reduced; the dorsal muscle imitating elastic sheet and the achilles tendon imitating elastic sheet store and release energy in the second half of the gait, and the dynamic stability is improved; pressure sensors are arranged at three points of the front/rear sole and the ankle joint, a space stress model is constructed, distribution of the force center and the touchdown point of the sole is analyzed in real time, and the terrain state is judged. Through structure-sensing coupling, the foot can autonomously judge the terrain under the non-driving state, passive foot landing adaptation is achieved, environment dependence is simplified, and the application range is wide. And the walking robustness under the complex terrain is improved.

title: Accurate modeling method for series-parallel connection structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot series-parallel connection structure accurate modeling method, which comprises the following steps: respectively acquiring a first target parameter of a parallel connection type linear joint and a second target parameter of a series connection type linear joint, and calculating to obtain the length of the parallel connection type linear joint and the length of the series connection type linear joint; according to the first target parameter and the second target parameter, Jacobian matrixes of the parallel-connection type linear joint and the series-connection type linear joint are determined respectively, and thrust of a parallel-connection joint linear actuator and thrust of a series-connection joint linear actuator are determined respectively according to the torque of the joints and inversion of transposition of the Jacobian matrixes; and force-position hybrid control is conducted on the parallel joint linear actuator and the series joint linear actuator according to the length and the thrust. According to the invention, the motion of the linear joint of the series-parallel hybrid structure and the precise modeling of the mechanical model are realized, so that the stable force-position hybrid control is carried out on the motor.

title: Humanoid robot bending joint structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a bending joint structure of a humanoid robot. The bending joint structure comprises a power device, a power device dowel bar, a power device fixing rod, a bending component, a swing rod, a sliding device, a hinge A and a hinge B, the power device fixing rod is connected with the swing rod through a hinge A. The swing rod is fixed to the slope of the bending component, and the power device fixing rod fixes the power device. The power device pushes and pulls the power device dowel bar, push-pull force is transmitted to the sliding device through the hinge B, the sliding device rotates with the hinge B as the center and slides along the swing rod, the swing rod and the bending component are forced to rotate with the hinge A as the center, and the bending function of the bending joint is achieved. The one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot is simple in structure, the joint bending center of the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot is located on the outer side of the bending joint, and compared with the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot with the patent number of 2023218600601, the one-way swing structure of the humanoid robot has the advantage that the similarity between the bending joint and human joint movement is improved.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT WITH HANDS THAT INCLUDE INTERCHANGEABLE COMPONENTS FOR PROVIDING REMOTE CARE AND TELEMEDICINE
abstract: The present invention relates to a humanoid robot for providing assisted care in patient monitoring and/or telemedicine. This humanoid robot has a swivel head, a torso, a mobile base and articulated limbs that are arms, each arm having a robotic hand with interchangeable components that fulfil specific functions, such as communicating with people and measuring vital signs, inter alia. The robotic hand or the interchangeable components as such can be detachable. The humanoid robot further comprises cameras, sensors for displaying the environment and interacting with patients, and a navigation system that allows the humanoid robot to move.

title: Humanoid dexterous finger, humanoid dexterous hand adopting same and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid dexterous finger which comprises a single-finger base, a fingertip, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the fingertip, the first knuckle and the second knuckle are sequentially hinged from top to bottom, the bottom end of the second knuckle is rotationally connected with the single-finger base through a swing part, and the rotating plane, relative to the swing part, of the second knuckle is not parallel to the rotating plane, relative to the single-finger base, of the swing part; the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles are respectively connected with at least one group of connecting rod driving mechanisms for driving the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles to independently act; each connecting rod driving mechanism comprises a main connecting rod and a driving assembly driving the main connecting rod to move, each driving assembly comprises a power piece, and the power pieces drive the connecting seats to slide back and forth along the sliding rails through pull ropes. The utility model further discloses the humanoid dexterous hand and the humanoid dexterous finger adopting the scheme. The humanoid robot adopts the humanoid dexterous hand. The four-degree-of-freedom flexible finger is provided with four active degrees of freedom, the response speed is higher, and the hand action closer to a real person is achieved.

title: Bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problem that an existing dexterous hand is slow in response speed, and adopts the technical scheme that the bionic mechanical arm mainly comprises an arm and the dexterous hand, and the dexterous hand comprises a palm and at least two fingers. The finger comprises a finger base, a finger body and a driving mechanism, the driving mechanism comprises a driving motor, a transmission mechanism is arranged on the finger base, the transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block installed on the guide piece in a sliding mode, and an output shaft of the driving motor is connected with two pulling ropes wound in opposite directions. The driving motor is in transmission connection with the sliding block through a traction rope, the sliding block is connected with a cross shaft in transmission connection with the finger body, the driving motor controls the output shaft to rotate forwards and backwards so as to drag the sliding block to slide back and forth along the guiding piece through the traction rope, and then the finger body is driven to bend and/or swing. The finger is mainly used for improving the response speed of the finger body.

title: Method and device for compensating precision of humanoid robot encoder and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an encoder precision compensation method and device for a humanoid robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control precision compensation, and the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the rotation angle of the humanoid robot through an external high-precision sensor and an encoder, and monitoring the joint temperature of the humanoid robot at the same time; analyzing and constructing an initial compensation model of an encoder in the humanoid robot based on the rotation angle; constructing an error compensation model of an encoder in the humanoid robot based on the joint temperature; compensating the precision of an encoder of the humanoid robot through the error compensation model and the initial compensation model; the method is used for solving the problems that according to an existing robot control precision compensation technology, factors influencing errors are not comprehensively considered, an algorithm is too complex, the control precision of a robot is insufficient, and the control duration is too long.

title: Method for fusing inner shell film and simulated skin of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a method for fusing a humanoid robot inner shell film and simulated skin, which comprises the following steps: (1) placing a humanoid robot inner shell in plasma equipment, and carrying out surface activation treatment to obtain an activated humanoid robot inner shell; (2) the surface of the activated humanoid robot inner shell is covered with polyurethane primer, then the surface of the humanoid robot inner shell is covered with a transition layer film, and a humanoid robot inner shell film is obtained; (3) integrating a sensor array on an inner shell film of the humanoid robot in the step (2); (4) coating the humanoid robot inner shell film integrated in the step (3) with a silicone rubber priming coat, then covering the priming coat with simulated skin, and then carrying out vacuum fusion to obtain the fused humanoid robot inner shell film and simulated skin; according to the method provided by the invention, the connection strength is improved, the touch experience is improved, the sensor integration is optimized, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the manufacturing process is simplified.

title: High-stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of flexible electronic sensors, in particular to a high-stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor and a preparation method thereof.The high-stability impedance modulation flexible strain sensor comprises a strain sensitive liquid metal resistor, a capacitor, an inductor, two electrodes, an elastomer packaging layer, two strain isolation fabrics and two signal wires; the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor is connected in series with the inductor, and the series branch is connected in parallel with the capacitor; the two electrodes are respectively connected with two electrical connection ends of the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the two strain isolation fabrics are respectively arranged at the two ends of the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor in the length direction; the strain sensitive liquid metal resistor, the capacitor, the inductor, the two electrodes and the two strain isolation fabrics are packaged by the elastomer packaging layer; the two signal wires are connected with the two electrodes in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the problems that an existing flexible strain sensor is poor in stability and prone to electromagnetic interference in the limited built-in space of the humanoid robot are solved.

title: Robot leg shaking analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot leg shaking analysis method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method comprises the steps that the actually-measured jitter frequency of the legs of the robot is obtained; determining joint resonance frequencies of a plurality of joints of the legs of the robot by adopting a joint test platform which is preset and built for the legs of the robot; a platform simulation model corresponding to a pre-established joint test platform is adopted, and the joint torsional rigidity of the multiple joints is determined according to the joint resonance frequencies of the multiple joints; a pre-established leg simulation model of the robot leg is adopted, and the simulation modal frequency of the leg simulation model is determined according to the set joint torsional rigidity of the multiple joints; and according to the actually measured jitter frequency and the simulation modal frequency, performing jitter analysis on the robot leg, and determining whether the robot leg resonates or not. Resonance characteristics of the legs of the robot are recognized through joint simulation and leg simulation, and reference is provided for control optimization of the legs of the robot.

Resonance characteristics of the legs of the robot are recognized through joint simulation and leg simulation, and reference is provided for control optimization of the legs of the robot.

title: Humanoid machine control method and system based on model prediction
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid machine control method and system based on model prediction, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining joint sensing data (hip joint movement angle sequences and knee joint stress signals) and environment interaction data (depth image flow data and sole contact pressure data) of a humanoid machine, and generating a dynamic state feature set through feature correlation processing; the feature matrix comprises a joint cooperation feature vector and an environment constraint feature matrix; calling a pre-training model to carry out spatio-temporal joint prediction on the feature set, and outputting a future motion control sequence containing gait cycle features; then, a joint synchronous control model is constructed on the basis, and a driving control instruction set containing time coordination constraint is generated; and finally, the driving control instruction set is transmitted to the distributed execution unit, and joint state feedback data is collected for next round of processing, so that the motion control performance of the humanoid machine in a complex environment is improved.

title: Method and system for detecting boundary in humanoid robot relay match
abstract: The invention provides a boundary detection method and system in a humanoid robot relay match, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the gradient rising optimization and dynamic threshold segmentation of a smooth image, and then generating a binary image; processing the binary image by adopting a Canny edge detection algorithm to obtain an edge feature map; performing closed operation morphological processing on the edge feature graph to generate a continuous edge graph; processing the continuous edge graph based on a statistical probability Hough transform algorithm to generate an effective boundary straight line set; the straight lines are classified into left and right boundary lines and a finishing line according to spatial positions, the longest straight line in each category is selected to calculate an included angle with the horizontal direction, and a robot motion control system is obtained to adjust the walking direction in real time. According to the invention, the reliability of the detection result is improved.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The wheeled humanoid robot comprises a chassis, and a plurality of walking wheels are installed on the chassis in the circumferential direction; the power source is arranged on the chassis; the steering mechanism is movably arranged on the chassis and is in transmission connection with the power source, and the steering mechanism is in transmission connection with all the walking wheels; the synchronous rotating mechanism is rotatably arranged on the chassis, and one end of the synchronous rotating mechanism is in transmission connection with the steering mechanism; the sweeping mechanism is rotatably arranged on the chassis, and the sweeping mechanism is in transmission connection with the synchronous rotating mechanism; and in the process that the steering mechanism drives the walking wheels to rotate so that the wheel type humanoid robot can steer, the steering mechanism synchronously drives the sweeping mechanism to rotate through the synchronous rotating mechanism, and therefore the sweeping mechanism can be located in the moving path of the walking wheels all the time.

title: Humanoid robot interaction system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot interaction, and discloses a humanoid robot interaction system. The system comprises an interactive perception module, an intention analysis module, an action generation module and a feedback calibration module. The interactive sensing module collects a first interactive signal within a first preset duration, and the first interactive signal is preprocessed and converted into a sensing feature; the intention analysis module identifies a behavior entity of a to-be-interacted object, takes a semantic set of the behavior entity as a reference label, and combines a reference sample and a perception feature to train and analyze a network model; the action generation module collects a second interaction signal within a second preset duration, extracts an encoder and a decoder for analyzing the network model, generates an instruction based on the encoder, constructs a rule mapping execution unit and reversely optimizes a mapping relation through the decoder; and the feedback calibration module collects third interaction signals within a third preset duration, classifies the third interaction signals into regular signals and irregular signals, and performs calibration through the mapping execution unit or performs generation processing through the encoder.

title: Cooperative control method and system of humanoid robot four-limb joint drivers
abstract: The invention provides a cooperative control method and system for four-limb joint drivers of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of driver control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an equipment state, and generating a cooperative control action according to the equipment state; generating a plurality of cooperative control output signals according to the cooperative control action; determining the output quantity of each driver under the cooperative control action according to a preset rule by taking the cooperative control output signals as respective corresponding standard quantities to obtain a standard output quantity; and generating a standard output signal according to the standard output quantity, and controlling the output state of the corresponding driver. According to the method, the equipment state is obtained through the sub-state flag bit, the standard output quantity of the driver is verified, it is ensured that the output quantity is located in the preset working range, and verification is conducted in the modes of sum value and nominal torque ratio judgment, proportion minimum value judgment and the like. The invention further provides a driver cooperative control system. Cooperative control of a plurality of drivers is realized, and stability and reliability of system operation are improved.

title: Biped robot gait network training method
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait network training method. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a dual-channel deep reinforcement learning architecture; the running states of the X biped robots in the simple terrain of the simulation environment are collected; obtaining a current reward according to the current running state, merging each piece of information into a Markov decision process, and storing the information into an experience playback area; when the number of the Markov decision-making processes in the experience playback area is greater than a preset threshold value n, randomly taking a preset number of Markov decision-making processes from the Markov decision-making processes, and updating parameters of the main network and the opponent network; disturbance is carried out on main network parameters, and a human memory curve is simulated to carry out continuous adjustment on main network hyper-parameters clip; the biped robot with the stable walking duration reaching the preset duration is moved to the terrain with the higher difficulty level, and the network parameter updating process is repeated; and course learning is continuously carried out until the accumulated reward information and the stable walking duration of all the biped robots reach preset values.

title: Biped robot state estimation method based on multi-sensor information
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot state estimation method based on multi-sensor information, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the data of an inertial measurement unit, a joint encoder and a joint sensor on a biped robot; a self-adaptive threshold contact state detection algorithm based on current sensing information is designed, and the contact state of the sole and the environment is judged in real time; determining a supporting phase of the robot according to the contact state, and applying a dynamic reference system conversion mechanism of supporting phase perception; constructing a state estimator based on invariant extended Kalman filter IEKF, defining a state vector including the posture, position and speed of the robot, performing state prediction by using IMU data, and performing state updating in combination with contact state information, kinematics information and the like; and outputting accurately estimated robot state information. According to the method, the adaptive contact detection and the IEKF are introduced, so that the state estimation precision and robustness of the biped robot in the dynamic walking process are effectively improved.

title: Biped heavy-load robot control method and control system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robots, and provides a biped heavy-load robot control method and system, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a biped heavy-load robot model; obtaining a dynamic stride frequency adjustment item according to the terrain adaptation item, the energy optimization item and the stride frequency coordination compensation item, and obtaining a gait phase generation function according to the dynamic stride frequency adjustment item; and according to the gait phase generation function, performing a simulation experiment of the biped heavy-load robot model, and if a simulation result passes verification, controlling the biped heavy-load robot according to the gait phase generation function. According to the method, the gait phase generation function can be obtained through the dynamic stride frequency adjustment item, terrain changes or energy efficiency requirements can be better met based on the gait phase generation function so as to cope with complex scenes such as slopes and soft ground, and the dynamic adaptability of the stride frequency is improved.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand based on double-center coupling metamorphic palm and series-parallel rotation driving type mechanical fingers
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid dexterous hand based on a double-center coupling metamorphic palm and series-parallel rotation driving type mechanical fingers, which comprises a metamorphic palm and at least one mechanical finger arranged on the metamorphic palm, the metamorphic palm comprises eight connecting rods and eight revolute pairs which are alternately arranged and sequentially connected to form a closed loop, the axes of four adjacent revolute pairs intersect at a first sphere center to form a spherical four-rod mechanism, and the axes of the other four adjacent revolute pairs and the axis of the first revolute pair intersect at a second sphere center to form a spherical five-rod mechanism. The two mechanisms share one rotating shaft; different metamorphic forks are derived through coaxial axes and coplanar three or more axes of a revolute pair, and when moving to a forking point to be forked, the revolute pair enters different motion branches to form different metamorphic configurations; the mechanical finger comprises a rotary drive type driving mechanism which drives the MCP joint to conduct pitching motion and side-sway motion, and the rotary drive type driving mechanism drives the PIP joint and the DIP joint to conduct synchronous flexion and extension motion.

title: Mobile Robot providing Reality Capture and Metrology Grade geometric measurement for supporting Surveillance and Metrology Applications
abstract: The invention relates generally to a mobile robot, e.g. a humanoid robot, configured to provide reality capture and metrology grade geometric measurement, e.g. to generally support infrastructure surveillance and/or to support workflows in the field of metrology. Aspects of the mobile robot, inter alia, relate to providing increased accuracy of metrology grade devices to overcome deficiencies in mobile reality capture. On the other hand, benefits of mobility provided by mobile robots are transformed to the field of metrology while maintaining metrology grade accuracy.

title: Intelligent interaction method and device of humanoid robot, medium and product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of intelligent robots, and discloses an intelligent interaction method and device of a humanoid robot, a medium and a product. Collecting multi-modal information through a sensor carried by the humanoid robot; after the multi-modal information is preprocessed, a multi-modal fusion algorithm based on deep learning is adopted to carry out fusion processing on the multi-modal information, and an interaction feature vector is obtained; constructing a knowledge base containing domain knowledge, interaction rules and a user model, and recognizing a user intention by using natural language processing and a machine learning algorithm in combination with the interaction feature vector and the current interaction context information; selecting a corresponding response strategy from a preset response strategy library according to the user intention and the current interaction scene; and controlling the humanoid robot to execute a corresponding interaction behavior according to the response strategy. The technical problem of interaction ability of the humanoid robot can be solved at least.

title: Humanoid robot bionic composite foot equipment
abstract: The invention relates to bionic composite foot equipment of a humanoid robot. According to the technical scheme, the foot sole comprises a foot sole, and a telescopic claw mechanism, a composite arch and a dot matrix heel which are sequentially arranged and connected in the foot sole, wherein the telescopic claw mechanism comprises a plurality of telescopic claws; the plurality of telescopic claws are arranged on the fixed shaft in parallel; a ratchet wheel is arranged on the fixed shaft between every two adjacent telescopic claws, and a driven gear is further arranged on the fixed shaft; a pawl shaft is arranged on the fixing support in a penetrating mode, a pawl matched with the ratchet wheel is arranged on the pawl shaft, a rolling wheel and a driving gear are arranged on a motor shaft of the rotating motor, the rolling wheel is bound to the pawl shaft through a pull rope, the reduction gear is meshed with the driven gear and the driving gear, and springs in the composite arch are transversely installed at the two ends of a spring piece. A dot matrix heel is installed on the rear section of the sole and is made of dot matrix structure materials. The automatic telescopic function of the mechanical claw is achieved through the telescopic claw mechanism, the elastic force increasing function is achieved through the composite arch, and damping and impact resistance are achieved through the dot matrix heel.
abstract_en: The invention relates to bionic composite foot equipment of a humanoid robot. abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint rotation and translation integrated mechanism, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, the humanoid robot joint rotation and translation integrated mechanism comprises a base, a groove is formed in the base, a translation assembly and a gear ring are fixedly mounted in the groove, and a first connecting disc and a second connecting disc are arranged on the two sides of the base respectively; annular grooves are formed in the outer walls of the sides, close to the base, of the first connecting disc and the second connecting disc correspondingly, rotating rings are rotationally arranged in the annular grooves, a motor is fixedly installed on the second connecting disc, a rotating column is arranged on the motor, a gear is arranged on the rotating column, and a through groove is formed in the inner wall of one side of the groove. title: Morality behavior demonstration device and system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot arm control, in particular to a morality behavior demonstration device and system based on a humanoid robot, and the device comprises a robot main body, a robot head, and a camera. title: Bionic robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. title: Control device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and provides a control device and a humanoid robot. On the basis, the first computing power board and the second computing power board can share the heat dissipation assembly, the heat dissipation space of the heat dissipation assembly and the fan for heat dissipation and do not need to be provided with radiators respectively, the structure of the control device can be simplified, redundant parts are reduced, high integration, compactness and simplification are achieved, and space layout, integration and miniaturization of the humanoid robot are facilitated.

title: Medical service system and method based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment, and discloses a medical service system and method based on a humanoid robot. In the application, the service system comprises a control platform and a humanoid robot responding to the control platform; wherein a control system in the control platform is in communication connection with the robot, and sends a ward round instruction and/or a medicine delivery instruction to the humanoid robot; after the control module of the humanoid robot receives the instruction, a preset instruction set is generated, and the preset instruction set at least comprises a moving instruction, a dialogue instruction and a limb action instruction; the execution mechanism is connected with the control module and used for executing the medical service action corresponding to the preset instruction set. Through a cooperative architecture of a control platform and a humanoid robot, conventional medical tasks arranged by medical staff are realized, service experience is improved through humanoid interaction, and a solution with both efficiency and practicability is provided for intelligent medical treatment.

title: Limb balance control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a limb balance control method and system for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a forward path range of the humanoid robot, and recording the forward path range as an alternative path set; transmitting preset first near-infrared light, receiving reflected near-infrared light marked as second near-infrared light, and capturing scattered near-infrared light marked as third near-infrared light; calculating to obtain the reflectivity, the scattering rate and the ground smoothness degree in the alternative path set; searching to obtain a path with the lowest ground smoothness, calculating to obtain the optimal gravity center height of the humanoid robot, and recording the optimal gravity center height as a first height; setting an advancing path of the humanoid robot as an optimal path; and setting the gravity center height average value of the humanoid robot during advancing according to the first height. The path with the lowest ground smoothness degree is searched, and the gravity center height is adjusted according to the ground smoothness degree, so that the probability that the humanoid robot slips on the smooth ground is reduced.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom integrated joint
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, in particular to a three-degree-of-freedom integrated joint which is composed of a power system and a transmission system, three motor bins are arranged in the power system, and the transmission system can be controlled through a nested hollow driving shaft to achieve palm yawing, bending and shaft rotation. According to the three-degree-of-freedom integrated joint disclosed by the invention, the space occupation is greatly reduced through the nested driving shaft, so that the three sets of hollow joint motors can be connected and arranged end to end in an integrated mechanical structure, and the requirement that a manipulator and a humanoid robot have relatively small sizes is met.

title: Arm trajectory planning method and control system for intelligent humanoid robot with body based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a deep learning-based arm trajectory planning method and control system for an intelligent humanoid robot with a body. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a three-dimensional grid map of a multi-modal data construction environment; generating an initial feasible path through a path planning strategy network based on deep reinforcement learning; extracting the collision probability of each path node on the initial feasible path; according to the collision probability of each path node, judging an area in which local re-planning needs to be triggered; and carrying out smoothing processing to obtain a smooth obstacle avoidance path. The initial feasible path is generated through the path planning strategy network based on deep reinforcement learning. According to the collision probability of each node, an area needing local re-planning is screened out, and the path of the area is adjusted through an artificial potential field method, so that the capability of avoiding dynamic obstacles in the path planning process is improved, the collision risk in the path planning is reduced, and the path planning efficiency is improved. And the self-adaptive capability of the arm path planning complex environment of the intelligent humanoid robot with the body is improved.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented interconnection communication system and method based on machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot-oriented interconnection communication system and method based on machine learning, and relates to the field of robot communication. Through collaborative integration of visible light and infrared light communication facilities, the high bandwidth characteristic of visible light communication is reserved, the interference problem in a complex environment is solved by using infrared light, and the communication efficiency is improved. Complementarity communication guarantee is formed; by means of the dual-band design, the anti-electromagnetic interference capacity in an industrial scene is remarkably improved, and time delay can be controlled at the microsecond level; based on correlation analysis of filter parameters of historical task data and damping of a damping bracket, an external cause-success rate mapping model is constructed, so that a robot can dynamically adjust mechanical and communication parameters according to real-time working conditions; traditional fixed threshold value control is upgraded into self-adaptive adjustment, and the method is suitable for a high-precision control scene; through combined adjustment of filter parameters and damping of the damping support, limitation of single module optimization is broken through.

title: Limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a limb assembly and a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problem of poor waist flexibility of the humanoid robot. In the limb assembly, a waist spinning driving assembly and a waist pitching driving assembly achieve spinning and pitching actions of the waist respectively and are both arranged on N folding assemblies, the N folding assemblies are sequentially and rotatably connected, the first folding assembly comprises a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, the first connecting piece can rotate around a third axis through a side driving assembly, and the second connecting piece can rotate around a fourth axis through a side driving assembly. Due to the fact that the rotation movement of the first connecting piece around the third axis can have the branch rotation movement of rotating around the waist side-sway axis, under the cooperation of the side-by-side driving assembly, the waist spinning driving assembly and the waist spinning driving assembly, side-sway of the trunk assembly can be achieved through the limb assemblies; therefore, the limb assemblies can achieve actions such as waist spinning, waist pitching, waist side-sway and lifting of the trunk assembly, and the flexibility of the waist of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot industrial task scene generation method and system based on large language model
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot industrial task scene generation method and system based on a large language model, and belongs to the technical field of industrial automation and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an industrial task database; extracting and converting the task parameters according to an industrial task database to obtain first task prompt information; performing thinking chain task decomposition on the industrial task to obtain subtask sequence information; training the large language model to obtain an initial task execution strategy; performing multi-dimensional evaluation on the initial task execution strategy to obtain an evaluation result; optimizing the first task prompt information according to the evaluation result to obtain second task prompt information; and adjusting the large language model according to the second task prompt information to obtain a target task execution strategy. According to the embodiment of the invention, the task adaptability and strategy reliability of the humanoid robot in a complex industrial scene can be improved, and the flexibility and efficiency of industrial automatic production are remarkably improved.

title: Bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problems that an existing dexterous hand is slow in response speed and short in service life, and adopts the technical scheme that the bionic mechanical arm mainly comprises an arm, the dexterous hand and a driving device, and the driving device comprises a driving motor and a transmission mechanism. The transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block, the sliding block is in transmission connection with fingers of the dexterous hand, the transmission mechanism further comprises two traction ropes wound on the output shaft in opposite directions, at least two rope grooves are formed in the peripheral side surrounding the output shaft, and the two traction ropes are wound in the two rope grooves respectively. The bionic mechanical arm further comprises a guide mechanism arranged between the driving motor and the sliding block, the guide mechanism comprises a guide piece used for enabling the two traction ropes to keep a distance in the axial direction of the output shaft of the driving motor, and the traction ropes are wound around the output shaft after being guided by the guide piece. The finger is mainly used for improving the response speed of the finger body.

title: Dexterous hand finger, bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a dexterous hand finger, a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problem that the motion precision of the finger is reduced due to the fact that the rotation matching of a rotating shaft and a shaft hole is easy to be blocked, and adopts the technical scheme that the dexterous hand finger mainly comprises a finger base, a finger body and a driving motor, a transmission mechanism is arranged on the finger base, the driving motor drives the finger body to bend and/or swing, the finger body comprises a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the first knuckle is rotationally connected with the finger base, and the second knuckle is rotationally connected with the first knuckle. Hinge structures are arranged at the joints of the first knuckles and the finger base and the joints of the second knuckles and the first knuckles, each hinge structure comprises a rotating shaft, a shaft hole and a shaft sleeve, and the rotating shafts penetrate through the shaft sleeves and are in running fit with the shaft sleeves. title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot adopting humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a palm and a thumb rotationally connected to the palm, the thumb comprises a fingertip, a knuckle and a single-finger base which are sequentially connected in a rotating mode from top to bottom, and the lower end of the knuckle is connected to the single-finger base through a rotary connecting piece. The rotation axis of the rotary connecting piece relative to the single-finger base is not parallel to the rotation axis of the knuckles relative to the rotary connecting piece; the thumb further comprises a first driving assembly and two second driving assemblies, the first driving assembly drives the fingertips to rotate relative to the knuckles, and the two second driving assemblies drive the knuckles to bend and swing left and right. A third driving assembly for driving the thumb to rotate relative to the palm is arranged on the palm. The utility model further discloses a humanoid robot which adopts any one of the humanoid dexterous hands. The humanoid robot finger has the advantage that the problem that the flexibility of fingers of an existing humanoid robot is limited is solved. The whole thumb has four degrees of freedom and is closer to a real human thumb movement range.

title: External expansion device for humanoid robot
abstract:
[Problem] To provide an external expansion device for a humanoid robot, which enables the humanoid robot to execute an operation mode other than a normal operation.
[Means for Solving the Problem] An arithmetic processing unit 10 electrically connected to a main body 1 detachably disposed on a torso of a humanoid robot 70, a data and power transmission interface 11, an environment-sensing expansion module 14, a power expansion system 13, and a second operation mode database 12, the arithmetic processing unit including the above-described components being installed on the main body. By mounting the external expansion device on a humanoid robot originally placed in a first application scenario and executing a first operation mode, an AI brain of the humanoid robot can subsequently be made to acquire data stored in the second operation mode via the data and power transmission interface. Furthermore, the environment-sensing expansion module and the power expansion system are simultaneously driven to increase scenarios in which the humanoid robot can be utilized under conditions of shortest time and lowest cost, thereby enhancing versatility.

title: HIP ASSEMBLY AND KINEMATICS OF A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot with an arrangement of components that allows the robot to mimic the movements, functionality and capabilities of a human being. The robot includes a torso coupled to a waist, an arm assembly, and a head assembly. A pelvis is coupled to the waist and has left and right actuator mounts. Left and right hip assemblies are coupled to the respective actuator mounts. Each hip assembly includes a hip pitch actuator assembly, a hip roll actuator assembly, and a leg twist actuator assembly. The hip pitch actuator assembly has a portion positioned within the pelvis and is coupled to the actuator mount. The hip roll actuator assembly is coupled to the hip pitch actuator assembly, with a non-90 degree angle formed between their axes. The leg twist actuator assembly is coupled to the hip roll actuator assembly and positioned below extents of both the hip pitch and hip roll actuator assemblies.

title: Multi-path modeling deformation fitting robot
abstract: The robot comprises a bearing base, a sleeve is fixedly connected to the upper portion of the bearing base, the sleeve is connected with a leg simulation model in an inserted mode, a hip deformation structure is arranged on the leg simulation model and located at the hip position, and a fixing hole is formed in the upper surface of the leg simulation model. A waist fixing plate is connected to the fixing hole in an inserted mode, a waist deformation structure is connected to the waist fixing plate in an inserted mode, an upper half body base is connected to the upper portion of the waist deformation structure in an inserted mode, an upper half body simulation model is connected to the upper surface of the upper half body base in a sliding mode, and arm simulation models are connected to the upper half body simulation model through ball shafts; a back simulation model is fixedly connected to the upper part of the upper half body base; through the hip deformation structure, the waist deformation structure and the chest deformation structure, the three-dimensional data of the model can be changed, the three-dimensional data is consistent with the three-dimensional data of a wearer to the greatest extent, and the fitting condition is met.

title: Humanoid robot falling prediction method based on multi-sensor information fusion
abstract: The invention designs a humanoid robot falling prediction method based on multi-sensor space-time information fusion. The humanoid robot falling prediction method is characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, multi-sensor data acquisition, S2, data preprocessing, S3, multi-sensor space-time information fusion network model construction, S4, model training and S5, model verification and application. According to the method, firstly, multi-sensor data of the humanoid robot are collected, then, multi-source information weighting, multi-scale spatial feature extraction, time feature information extraction and spatial-temporal feature dimension reduction fusion are sequentially carried out through a designed multi-sensor spatial-temporal information fusion neural network, and finally, prediction of the falling state of the humanoid robot is achieved. The method is high in tumble identification precision, low in false positive, good in noise robustness and long in advance prediction time, and can provide enough buffer time for a follow-up controller to customize a tumble solution.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method for ferrous metallurgy scene
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method for a ferrous metallurgy scene, and relates to the technical field of robot navigation, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, loading a pre-constructed two-dimensional map module; s2, generating an optimal path for avoiding a fixed obstacle; s31, acquiring current positioning data and real-time environment information; s32, detecting a dynamic obstacle and updating a map module; s33, carrying out local adjustment on the global path; s4, starting an accurate calibration process; and S5, confirming the completion of the navigation task. According to the ferrous metallurgy scene humanoid robot navigation method based on the SLAM, the laser radar component, two-dimensional code accurate calibration and dynamic obstacle avoidance, efficient and accurate navigation can be realized in a complex industrial environment, initial positioning is performed by utilizing the smtoolbox, global and local path planning is performed in combination with the ThetaStarPlanner and MPPI algorithms, the system can avoid static and dynamic obstacles, and the navigation efficiency is improved. And the robot is ensured to run in the optimal path.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot dexterous hand, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot hands, and solves the problems that in the prior art, a robot hand thumb is narrow in working space, and grabbing is not firm; the key stability of each finger is poor. The robot dexterous hand comprises a thumb assembly, an index finger assembly, a middle finger assembly, a ring finger assembly, a little finger assembly, a thumb base, a palm, a little finger part palm, a hand back and a thumb connecting assembly. According to the robot dexterous hand, three-finger collaborative enveloping can be achieved through one-time positioning, and the grabbing efficiency is improved.

title: Humanoid robot arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot arms, and discloses a humanoid robot arm which comprises a big arm, a small arm and a driving unit, the near end of the small arm is movably connected to the tail end of the large arm; the wrist is movably connected to the far end of the forearm; the driving unit drives the small arm to bend relative to the large arm through the transmission assembly and drives the wrist to bend or rotate relative to the small arm. According to the humanoid robot arm, the driving unit is arranged in the large arm, the small arm and the wrist are driven to act through the transmission assembly, the weight of the tail end of the robot arm is reduced, the motion inertia of the tail end of the arm is reduced, and the motion flexibility and motion precision of the whole arm are improved.

title: PEEK material applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a PEEK material applied to a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of polymer composite materials. The PEEK material is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight: 8.5 to 11 percent of short carbon fiber, 3.7 to 4.4 percent of anti-cracking modifier, 1.5 to 2.1 percent of lubricant, 0.35 to 0.4 percent of antioxidant and the balance of PEEK resin, the anti-cracking modifier is prepared by the following steps: carrying out substitution reaction on active primary amino of 3-bromopropyltrimethoxysilane and N-(3-aminopropyl) diethanol amine to prepare an intermediate, activating 1, 3-adamantanedicarboxylic acid by using thionyl chloride, and esterifying with the intermediate to form a chain polyester compound; the anti-cracking modifier significantly reduces the cracking risk of the humanoid robot material through the rigid gradient transition layer design and the multi-interface anchoring mechanism, and breaks through the application bottleneck of the existing carbon fiber composite PEEK material under the thermal cycle working condition.

title: Preparation method of low-creep surface coating type ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber
abstract: The invention relates to a preparation method of a low-creep surface coating type ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, and belongs to the field of high polymer materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, preparing a mixed emulsion from an ethylene copolymer and white oil, heating and dissolving the mixed emulsion to prepare a spinning melt, preparing gel-spun yarns by utilizing an extruding and cooling device, extracting and drying the gel-spun yarns, and carrying out multiple thermal stretching to obtain a fiber body; and coating the thermoplastic resin material on the surface of the ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber through dip-coating and drying treatment to obtain the low-creep surface coating type ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber. Compared with the conventional ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber, the low-creep surface coating type ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene fiber disclosed by the invention has better dimensional stability and durability. The preparation method is convenient for industrial production, and the prepared fiber is excellent in comprehensive performance and suitable for application in special fields such as humanoid robot dexterous hand tendon ropes and the like.

title: Biped passive walking robot release device
abstract: The invention relates to a biped passive walking robot release device. Positioning holes are machined in the upper surface of a bottom plate of the biped passive walking robot release device. The supporting leg fixing and guiding mechanism is arranged on the bottom plate and provided with a sliding block. The supporting leg angle adjusting mechanism is arranged on the sliding block; the supporting leg magnetic attraction releasing mechanism is connected with the supporting leg angle adjusting mechanism. The swing leg fixing mechanism comprises two stand columns and a beam, two ends of the beam are connected with the top ends of the two stand columns, and the sling mechanism is arranged in the middle of the top end of the bottom plate. The swing leg width adjusting mechanism is arranged on the cross beam; the swinging leg width adjusting mechanism is used for bearing and guiding the rope; the swing leg magnetic attraction releasing mechanism is connected to the rope; according to the device, by controlling the supporting legs and the swinging legs of the robot, the angles of the supporting legs and the swinging legs can be adjusted according to experiment requirements, the initial posture of the passive walking robot during releasing in an experiment can be accurately controlled, the experiment repeatability is good, and it is guaranteed that the robot is accurately, stably and controllably released.

title: Novel humanoid five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of manipulators, and discloses a novel humanoid five-finger dexterous hand which simulates the shape of a human hand and comprises a palm part and five finger parts, a driving part, a sensor and a transmission part are integrated in the palm part, and supporting and power transmission are provided for fingers; the five finger parts comprise a thumb structure and four finger structures, namely a little finger, a ring finger, a middle finger and an index finger, the five finger parts adopt modular design, each finger part is provided with three phalanges which respectively correspond to a proximal phalange, a middle phalange and a distal phalange of a human hand, and the phalanges are connected through joints to realize flexion and extension movement. According to the five-finger dexterous hand, flexion, extension, side-sway and other motions of the fingers are achieved through reasonable transmission mechanism and motor control, the motion range is wide, and the requirement for complex operation can be met. And a single finger can load a heavy object exceeding 500g, and the whole hand can load a heavy object exceeding 2kg, so that the mechanical hand has higher practical value.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: in response to a first electroencephalogram signal of a target user, collecting real-time visual data, real-time tactile data and real-time action data of the humanoid robot; performing data fusion on the first electroencephalogram signal, the real-time visual data, the real-time tactile data and the real-time action data to obtain real-time fusion data; and inputting the real-time fusion data into the trained end-to-end model, and outputting an action instruction to control the humanoid robot to execute actions according to the action instruction. According to the embodiment of the invention, the precision and real-time performance of humanoid robot control can be improved.

title: Method and device for generating posture of humanoid robot, robot, medium and product
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a posture generation method and device of a humanoid robot, the robot, a medium and a product, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining to-be-output first voice data, a first special action mark, Gaussian noise and a time step; according to the first voice data, a first Mel spectrum and a first deep semantic feature are determined, and the first deep semantic feature is the first voice data processed through a self-supervised voice representation learning model; the first Mel spectrum, the first depth semantic feature, the first special action mark, the Gaussian noise and the time step are input into a posture generation model, first action data are determined according to output of the posture generation model, and the posture generation model is a trained diffusion model; and when the first voice data is output, synchronously controlling the humanoid robot to generate a gesture action represented by the first action data. According to the method, more diversified actions can be generated in the distribution, and the naturalness and the closeness of man-machine interaction are improved.

title: Humanoid robot joint module with overload protection structure
abstract: The humanoid robot joint module with the overload protection structure comprises a fixed body and a rotating cover, a connecting boss is arranged on the fixed body, an assembling cavity is formed in the connecting position of the connecting boss and the fixed body, a transmission assembly is arranged in the assembling cavity, a brake assembly and a brake driver are arranged on the connecting boss, and the rotating cover is arranged on the rotating cover. The output end of the brake drive is connected with the brake assembly, the brake drive is further connected with the transmission assembly, and the rotating cover is arranged on the connecting boss in a sleeving mode and connected with the connecting boss through the fixing assembly. According to the principle that helical gears are subjected to axial force when being meshed with each other, a magnetic suspension bearing is adopted to connect a rotating shaft with a fixed part, the state of the rotating shaft is monitored through a detection device, and when the output end of the joint module is overloaded, a transmission helical gear is clamped and does not rotate any more, and a driving gear drives the rotating shaft to axially move along a mounting hole; the detection device can control the brake electromagnet to act to brake the rotating cover, meanwhile, the power source stops outputting, and overload damage is prevented.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot adopting humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a power piece, a pull rope driven by the power piece to move, a sliding rail fixed to a single-finger base and a connecting base arranged on the sliding rail in a sliding mode, the connecting base is movably connected with a connecting rod, the pull rope comprises an upper pull section and a lower pull section, and the pull rope is connected with the upper pull section. The upper pulling section and the lower pulling section are fixedly connected with the connecting base from the two ends of the sliding direction of the connecting base respectively, and the power piece drives the connecting base to slide in a reciprocating mode along the sliding rail through the pull rope. The utility model further discloses a humanoid robot which adopts the humanoid dexterous hand. The human-simulated dexterous hand has the advantage of solving the problem that the current human-simulated dexterous hand is slow in action response. The power transmission device is simple in structure, short in response time, free of influence of materials, free of interference of external environment factors, high in anti-interference capacity and capable of transmitting power to fingers more accurately to control actions of the fingers.

title: Bionic arm skeleton structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of bionic skeleton structures, in particular to a bionic arm skeleton structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a humerus, an ulna, a radius and a palm, the humerus is hinged with the ulna, two ends of the radius are respectively connected with two ends of the ulna through a first universal bearing and a second universal bearing, and the first universal bearing and the second universal bearing are hinged with each other. The radius and the palm are connected through a third universal bearing. The utility model provides a skeleton structure of a bionic arm of a humanoid robot, which is used on the bionic arm of the humanoid robot and is driven by combining artificial muscles to realize high humanoid motion functions of the arm and fingers.

title: Humanoid dexterous finger, humanoid dexterous hand adopting same and humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid dexterous finger comprises a single finger base, a fingertip, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, the fingertip, the first knuckle and the second knuckle are sequentially hinged from top to bottom, the bottom end of the second knuckle is hinged to a swing part, the swing part is rotationally connected with the single finger base, and the rotating plane, relative to the swing part, of the second knuckle is not parallel to the rotating plane, relative to the single finger base, of the swing part; the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles are all connected with connecting rod driving mechanisms independently driving the fingertips, the first knuckles and the second knuckles to act, each connecting rod driving mechanism comprises a main connecting rod with at least one end provided with a fisheye bearing and a driving piece arranged on the single-finger base, and the bottom ends of the main connecting rods are rotationally connected with the driving pieces. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a palm and the humanoid dexterous finger which is arranged on the palm and adopts any scheme. The humanoid robot adopts the humanoid dexterous hand. title: Flat integrated cable for knee joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a flat integrated cable for a knee joint of a humanoid robot. The plurality of power transmission cables and the signal control cables are arranged in the flat linear PUR outer sheath in a linear manner, and the PUR outer sheath wraps and packages the plurality of power transmission cables and the signal control cables; each of the power transmission cable and the signal control cable is composed of an insulating core wire, a filling strip and a braid layer wrapping the insulating core wire and the filling strip. According to the utility model, the structural design is ingenious, the tin-plated alloy copper and ETFE insulating material can provide reliable power and signal transmission, the Kevlar can enhance the tensile strength of the cable, and the PUR sheath enables the cable to be easily bent in the knee joint of the humanoid robot and not to be easily broken or twisted off; the robot knee joint cable has the main advantages of being high in space utilization rate, high in flexibility and adaptability, easy to install and maintain, capable of improving the electrical performance and the like due to the fact that the robot knee joint cable is flat.

title: High-precision bionic mechanical arm capable of adjusting traction rope and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a high-precision bionic mechanical arm capable of adjusting a traction rope and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of mechanical arms, and solves the problem that a driving motor cannot accurately transmit power to a transmission mechanism after the existing traction rope is loosened. According to the technical scheme, the robot mainly comprises an arm, a dexterous hand and a driving device, the driving device comprises a transmission mechanism and a driving motor, the driving motor is arranged on the arm, and the transmission mechanism comprises a guide part, a sliding block installed on the guide part in a sliding mode and a traction rope wound on an output shaft of the driving motor. The sliding block is in transmission connection with fingers of the dexterous hand, the pulling rope drags the sliding block to slide back and forth along with forward and reverse rotation of an output shaft of the driving motor so as to drive the fingers to bend and/or swing, the mechanical arm further comprises an adjusting piece used for adjusting the driving motor to be close to or away from the dexterous hand, and the pulling rope changes tightness along with adjustment of the driving motor. The tensioning device is mainly used for keeping the traction rope in a tensioning state by adjusting the driving motor.

title: Robot remote control system and method based on augmented reality and visual feedback
abstract: The invention discloses a robot remote control system based on augmented reality and visual feedback, and the system comprises a visual collection module of a sensing layer which obtains an environment image in real time through a built-in camera; a rocker control module and a video stream transmission module of the augmented reality control layer realize a rocker control function and a video stream transmission function; a WebSocket client module and a WebSocket server module of the communication relay layer are used for transferring and transmitting instructions and data; and the robot execution control layer comprises a chassis control module and a motion execution module, and the chassis control module is operated and managed by the master control computing platform Intel NUC and is used for completing execution of a motion instruction. The invention further discloses a robot remote control method based on augmented reality and visual feedback. title: Fusion control method and system for mechanical arm flaw detection operation during robot dog climbing
abstract: The invention discloses a fusion control method and system for mechanical arm flaw detection operation during robot dog climbing, and relates to the related field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: building a climbing feature sequence when the position of a robot dog meets a detection working position; performing multi-dimensional injury condition prediction on a to-be-detected target to obtain target injury condition prediction distribution, and performing arm-out operation control analysis on the mechanical arm; performing multiple rounds of propagation evolution optimization on the arm-out operation control space to generate an arm-out control optimization strategy; interference triggering prediction is carried out on the robot dog, optimization compensation is carried out on the robot dog according to an interference triggering prediction result, and an interference compensation strategy is obtained; and performing flaw detection fusion control on the to-be-detected target, and executing flaw detection control closed-loop correction according to the flaw detection process induction data. The technical problems that in existing flaw detection work, climbing and flaw detection are lack of a dynamic cooperation mechanism, the environmental adaptability is poor, and the flaw detection precision is low are solved, and the technical effect that the environmental adaptability and the flaw detection precision are improved through climbing and flaw detection cooperation optimization is achieved.

title: Humanoid manipulator and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a humanoid manipulator and a robot, the humanoid manipulator comprises a palm base body and five fingers connected with the palm base body, and the five fingers sequentially comprise a little finger, a ring finger, a middle finger, an index finger and a thumb; wherein the little finger, the ring finger, the middle finger and the index finger are the same in structure, each five-connecting-rod structure is formed by three knuckles and two connecting rods, and each five-connecting-rod structure is driven by a corresponding first driving mechanism and used for enabling the fingers to conduct bending and stretching actions; and the thumb can realize three actions through the second driving mechanism, the rotary driving mechanism and the third driving mechanism, namely bending and stretching actions as well as up-and-down rotating actions and left-and-right swinging actions relative to the palm base body. By cooperatively controlling the seven driving mechanisms, the five fingers can achieve various purposes of fist clenching, palm stretching or grabbing of different objects and the like, and meanwhile the humanoid manipulator has the advantages of being multiple in freedom degree, small, exquisite, flexible, similar to a human hand in size, easy to control and the like.

title: Anti-explosion humanoid robot with self-adaptive posture adjustment function
abstract: The invention provides an anti-explosion humanoid robot with a self-adaptive posture adjustment function, and belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing, the anti-explosion humanoid robot comprises a chassis frame, a chassis wheel train, a chassis upper assembly and a lifting assembly are mounted on the chassis frame, the lifting assembly vertically ascends and descends through a Z-shaped connecting rod mechanism, and a hip module is mounted at the top end of the lifting assembly; the lifting assembly provides pitching degree of freedom for the hip module, a thoracic cavity assembly is fixed to the output end of the hip module and integrated with a control and power distribution system, humanoid mechanical arms are symmetrically installed on the two sides of the thoracic cavity assembly, tail end assemblies are installed at the tail ends of the humanoid mechanical arms, and force sensors and clamping jaws are integrated with the tail end assemblies. The top of the chest assembly is provided with a head assembly; and the cabin system is used for controlling the explosion-proof humanoid robot. The whole humanoid robot can move in the X1 direction, the X2 direction, the Y1 direction and the Y2 direction through the wheel type chassis, and can move in the Z1 direction and the Z2 direction through the lifting assembly. The explosion-proof humanoid robot has the omni-directional posture adjusting capacity, high load adaptability, modular chassis compatibility and an intelligent sensing system, and the bottleneck in the prior art is broken through.

title: Human-simulated five-finger dexterous hand based on space connecting rod and planetary gear train
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid five-finger dexterous hand based on space connecting rods and planetary gear trains, which comprises a palm, a thumb and four fingers, four groups of space connecting rod mechanisms are arranged on the palm and are correspondingly in driving connection with the four fingers, and the freedom degree of bending and side swaying of the fingers is realized; a transversely-arranged miniature electric cylinder is installed at the bottom of the palm, and the miniature electric cylinder drives the thumb to achieve the freedom degree of palm swing through a gear and rack assembly. According to the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand, a space connecting rod mechanism and a planetary gear train mechanism are introduced, and the humanoid five-finger dexterous hand has the advantages of being high in degree of freedom, small in size, reasonable in structural design, high in coupling precision and stable in coupling force.

title: Multi-joint cooperative motion control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a multi-joint cooperative motion control method and system of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, the gait phase data of the humanoid robot in different motion states are obtained, and the motion states comprise the walking state, the running state and the sudden stop state; according to the gait phase data, generating a gait phase migration matrix so as to determine a motion mode switching point, further determining a hysteresis compensation opportunity of the pneumatic artificial muscle, and performing hysteresis compensation processing on the pneumatic artificial muscle of each lower limb joint of the humanoid robot so as to obtain a joint motion state; analyzing an angle change rate and a motion acceleration parameter in the joint motion state, and generating a biological heuristic electric signal; according to the joint cooperation angle threshold value and the motion triggering moment of the biological heuristic electric signal, all the lower limb joints of the humanoid robot are driven to conduct cooperative motion, so that seamless switching of multi-mode motion is achieved, and the motion flexibility and stability are improved.

title: LOWER ARM ASSEMBLY OF A ROBOT
abstract: The disclosure presents a humanoid robot with an upper region (head, torso, arms with forearm assemblies, end effectors), lower region (legs), and connecting central region. Each end effector features index, middle, ring, little finger, and thumb assemblies attached to a housing of said end effector. The housing includes interior wall extents creating spaces for tendon routing, where the first distance between first and second wall extents is less than 45% of the second distance between third and fourth wall extents. Tendons controlling finger movements pass between these wall extents. The robot incorporates a wrist assembly connecting the housing of the end effector to the forearm, actuators housed in the forearm that control the tendons, and a carpal tunnel-like structure that guides tendons from forearm to base of the housing, enabling precise hand movements without requiring actuators in the hand itself.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method and system, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method and system, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the field of navigation.The method comprises the steps that a first obstacle coordinate set is determined for an initial path located in a standard illumination area; calculating a first correction path according to the first obstacle coordinate set; for the initial path in the weak illumination area, determining a second correction path according to the compensation acceleration; for the initial path in the dark area, calculating a third correction path according to the second obstacle coordinate set; and controlling the humanoid robot to walk in the standard illumination area, the weak illumination area and the dark area according to the first correction path, the second correction path and the third correction path respectively. The method is used for dividing different illumination areas and adopting different sensor data and processing methods, stable navigation of the humanoid robot in each illumination area is achieved, the path tracking precision is improved, and then the material carrying efficiency is improved.
