abstract: The invention discloses a device and a method for maintaining real hair and promoting growth of a robot, belongs to the field of composite technologies of robot technologies and biological growth circulation system characteristics, and aims to solve the problem that the appearance simulation degree and the use effect of an existing humanoid robot are seriously restricted due to the fact that the existing humanoid robot cannot realize biological activity maintenance and natural growth of real hair. By means of the double-layer nutrient solution circulation structure, nutrient solutions with different properties are provided for real hair, different requirements of the real hair in the fixing and growing process are met, the real hair is effectively maintained, growth of the real hair is promoted, the human skin mask and the air holes are formed in the scalp structure, the air permeability of the real hair is guaranteed, a good growth environment is created for the real hair, and the hair quality is improved. And through cooperation of an electric pump and an artificial single-circulation heart in the power driving unit, stable circulation and uniform distribution of the nutrient solution are achieved, the utilization efficiency of the nutrient solution is improved, the service life of the real hair of the robot is prolonged, the appearance fidelity of the real hair of the robot is improved, and good application prospects and market values are achieved.

title: Battery replacement method of humanoid robot and controller
abstract: The invention provides a battery replacement method of a humanoid robot and a controller, and relates to the technical field of robots. The humanoid robot is provided with a main battery and a standby battery, the main battery is detachably installed in a battery bin of a humanoid robot body, the standby battery is installed in the humanoid robot body, and the method comprises the steps that when the main battery supplies power to the humanoid robot, whether the electric quantity of the main battery is smaller than a first electric quantity threshold value or not is judged; if the electric quantity of the main battery is smaller than a first electric quantity threshold, determining a target battery swap station; and the humanoid robot is controlled to move to the target battery replacing station so as to replace the main battery, and in the main battery replacing process, the standby battery supplies power to the humanoid robot. The battery replacement process can be simplified, and the endurance time of the robot is prolonged.

title: Hollow external shock wave harmonic reducer
abstract: The invention discloses a hollow external shock wave harmonic reducer which is composed of an external wave generator, a cap-shaped flexible gear, a rigid gear assembly, a machine base and a crossed roller bearing assembly. The rigid wheel and the external wave generator are both of a hollow structure, a driving profile of the external wave generator is arranged on the inner wall of the external wave generator, the driving profile is a double-eccentric-circle cam curve, and the cam curve is an arc within the short-axis wrap angle range; an inner rotation face of the cap-shaped flexible gear is provided with an inner gear ring meshed with the rigid gear outer gear ring, the tooth profile of the rigid gear outer gear ring and the inner tooth profile of a meshing area of the flexible gear in the meshing state are conjugate involute tooth profiles, and full-tooth conjugation can be achieved. Compared with an internal shock wave harmonic reducer, the reducer has the advantages of being compact in structure, large in output torque, high in overall rigidity and resistant to impact and can meet the requirements of a current humanoid robot joint module for large hollowness, high bearing capacity and large speed ratio performance.

abstract: The invention provides a modular four-foot heavy-load humanoid welding robot. The modular four-foot heavy-load humanoid welding robot comprises a four-foot robot body, a double-mechanical-arm device arranged on the four-foot robot body and a sensor system. One of two mechanical arms of the double-mechanical-arm device is a cutting and welding machine provided with a cutting and welding all-in-one machine, and the other mechanical arm is an auxiliary mechanical arm provided with a clamping jaw; the four-foot robot and the double-mechanical-arm device cooperatively cut and weld, and the method comprises the steps that the sensor system scans the surrounding environment, and an initialized static grid map is established; the quadruped robot walks to the target welding area from the starting node; the auxiliary mechanical arm is used for assisting, and the cutting and welding mechanical arm is used for cutting and welding operation. According to the welding robot, through the integrated innovative design of the quadruped robot and the double mechanical arms and the cooperative control method, accurate execution of a welding task in a complex environment is achieved, and meanwhile the adaptive capacity, efficiency and stability of a robot system are improved.

title: Welding track planning method for four-footed humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention provides a welding track planning method for a four-footed humanoid welding robot. The welding track planning method comprises the steps that the welding robot is navigated to a welding station, and welding seam information is recognized and extracted; motion trail planning is conducted on the double mechanical arms in an interpolation mode, and a mechanical arm tail end trail sequence generated through interpolation is obtained; the inverse kinematics of the double mechanical arms is solved for each pose, multiple sets of joint angular solutions are obtained, and the optimal solution which is coherent in motion and minimum in deviation is screened out; the condition number of the Jacobian matrix of each point of the joint track sequence is calculated, and the potential singular pose of the mechanical arm is analyzed and recognized; needed damping factors are calculated in real time according to the singular degree, and the joint speed of the mechanical arm is smoothly adjusted when a singular point is approached; and collision avoidance analysis is carried out on the tracks of the double mechanical arms. According to the method, by combining inverse kinematics multi-solution optimization selection, trajectory time re-parameterization, a damping least square control strategy and a double-arm space coordination collision avoidance mechanism, the stability, safety and consistency in the welding task execution process are ensured.

abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot battery module, and relates to the technical field of batteries. title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid drive cycloid motor for humanoid robot joint motor
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot driving, and particularly relates to an electro-hydraulic hybrid driving cycloid motor for a humanoid robot joint motor, which comprises a motor rotor, the motor rotor is connected with an inner rotor through a spline, inner needle teeth are uniformly distributed on the circumference of the inner rotor, and an outer rotor is arranged on one side of the inner needle teeth. An oil cavity is formed in the surface of the inner pin tooth and the inner contour of the outer rotor in a surrounding mode, outer pin teeth are arranged on one side of the outer rotor, a middle shell is arranged on one side of the outer pin teeth, and a low-pressure oil cavity is formed in the outer contour of the outer rotor, the surface of the outer pin teeth and the inner diameter of the middle shell in a surrounding mode. Fractional-slot concentrated windings are wound on the upper ends of the motor stator silicon steel sheets. A novel permanent magnet brushless direct current motor topological structure, namely a cycloid pair structure permanent magnet composite motor is adopted, a traditional relative circular motion pair of a stator and a rotor is changed into a cycloid pair, a planetary motion track of the rotor is generated, and integration of hydraulic energy and electromagnetic energy is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot remote control method based on virtual reality technology
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot remote control method based on a virtual reality technology, and relates to the technical field of robot motion control, and the method comprises the steps: extracting the displacement features and rotation variation features of the motion of an arm tail end according to a state information set of the arm tail end in virtual reality, and forming a feature set; the robot simulates arm end actions in the virtual reality environment according to the state information set, obtains a simulation time difference according to the simulation process, marks and trains the feature set according to the simulation time difference to obtain a prediction time difference, obtains the state information set and the prediction time difference in real time, and compares the state information set and the prediction time difference to form action delay; and feedback is carried out to the virtual reality environment, so that a natural person in the virtual reality environment can know the delay amount of the current action at the robot end in real time, the action rhythm of the robot can be accurately controlled, the action of the robot better fits the robot, and the control accuracy is further improved.

title: Hybrid lower limb mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot series-parallel lower limb mechanism which comprises a hip entity, four leg entities, two foot entities, a foot entity and a middle entity. The hip entity is a base for lower limb movement; the four leg entities, the two foot entities, the middle entity and the middle entity all translate in parallel planes; any leg entity is rotationally connected to the corresponding leg entity, and any foot entity is rotationally connected to the corresponding foot entity; a plurality of annular structures formed by multiple connecting rods are formed between the leg entity and the foot entity; a middle entity is also connected between the leg entity and the foot entity; the leg entity, the foot entity and the middle entity are connected in a certain mode. According to the scheme, the humanoid robot lower limb mechanism which is different from the prior art and has the series-parallel connection characteristic is provided. The stability of the legs is enhanced through parallel driving, and the more excellent energy efficiency ratio is also achieved through cooperative driving.

title: Sample plate transfer control method and system for intelligent laboratory and related device
abstract: The invention provides a sample plate transfer control method and system for an intelligent laboratory and a related device. The method comprises the following steps: controlling a humanoid robot to move to a first target position based on initialization task information; determining, from the environmental awareness and navigation system, a capture error compensation value based on the first sensing data; the humanoid robot is controlled to conduct material grabbing operation based on the grabbing error compensation value, and fine adjustment is conducted based on the first feedback signal so that the humanoid robot can complete the material grabbing operation; the material grabbing state is detected, if the grabbing state is completed, the humanoid robot is controlled to move to a second target position, and the state is dynamically adjusted; and when it is detected that the humanoid robot reaches the second target position, the target sample plate is placed based on third feedback information. Thus, through scene compliance control and vision-force sense cooperative control, the efficiency and adaptability of the mechanical arm in laboratory automation are improved, and the sample transfer reliability and efficiency in a high-throughput experiment scene are remarkably improved.

title: Nerve field guided humanoid robot self-adaptive door opening control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a neural field guided humanoid robot self-adaptive door opening control method which comprises the steps that point cloud information of a door opening area is obtained, a neural field is constructed, the position and posture of a door handle are detected, and the neural field is formed through boundary information and normal information of a door body structure; generating a collision-free approach path by using the boundary information, the normal information and the door handle pose, and controlling the robot to approach and grab the door handle by using quadratic programming; applying an initial pulling force through a preset admittance control strategy by using normal information, and estimating the position of the door spindle in combination with modeling optimization; based on the door spindle position, a structure consistency arc path is constructed in combination with boundary information and normal information; and in combination with boundary information, controlling the whole robot to execute actions according to a collision-free approaching path and a structure consistency arc path by adopting weighted quadratic programming. According to the method, a neural field is embedded into a key control link, and task-level dynamic optimization under perception driving is realized.

title: Motor heat dissipation structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a motor heat dissipation structure for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The heat dissipation sleeve is arranged outside the machine shell with the multiple inclined heat exchange fins in a sleeving mode, the two ends of the rotating shaft of the motor extend out of the machine shell and are provided with the first fan blade and the second fan blade which are just opposite in wind angle correspondingly, the clutch assemblies are arranged between the first fan blade and the rotating shaft and between the second fan blade and the rotating shaft correspondingly, and one of the two clutch assemblies is selected to be started; when the rotating shaft rotates, the first fan blades rotate and the second fan blades do not rotate, and when the rotating shaft rotates reversely, the second fan blades rotate and the first fan blades do not rotate, so that the first fan blades or the second fan blades correspondingly rotate to form airflow no matter the motor rotates forwards or backwards, the formed airflow is consistent in direction and can better conform to the inclination direction of the heat exchange fins, and the heat exchange efficiency is improved. The heat exchange area is increased, meanwhile, smoothness of airflow can be maintained, the heat dissipation capacity is improved, and the heat dissipation effect is better.

title: Humanoid robot for operating template machine
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot for operating a template machine. The humanoid robot comprises a chassis; the control cabinet is arranged on the chassis; the waist assembly comprises a waist rotating assembly and a waist pitching assembly connected with the waist rotating assembly; the body part is connected with the pitching driving piece, and a body camera is arranged on the body part; the left movable arm is arranged on the left side of the body part; the right movable arm is arranged on the right side of the body part; the left clamping jaw part is connected with the left movable arm; a left clamping jaw camera and a left clamping jaw force sensor are arranged on the left clamping jaw part; the right clamping jaw part is connected with the right movable arm, and a right clamping jaw camera and a right clamping jaw force sensor are arranged on the right clamping jaw part. The humanoid robot is mainly used for carrying out machine replacement on sewing operation of a large-size template machine. And the humanoid robot can realize the operations of grabbing and placing the cutting pieces, opening and closing the template and starting and stopping the template machine.

title: Six-axis patrol operation mechanical arm control method and system of dexterous hand robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arm control, in particular to a control method and system for a six-axis patrol operation mechanical arm of a dexterous hand robot, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining a high-precision three-dimensional point cloud by using a laser radar, carrying out semantic annotation in combination with a public electric power patrol data set, and converting the semantic annotation into a grid map format; an ant colony optimization algorithm is used to optimize and acquire a patrol operation path, negative effects caused by steering in the patrol operation path are considered, a steering reward item and a frequency reward item are constructed, heuristic information of the ant colony optimization algorithm is reconstructed, and an optimal patrol operation path root is planned; and according to a transformer substation path obtained by using an ant colony optimization algorithm, performing local obstacle avoidance operation between the to-be-detected instruments by using an artificial potential field method, and according to the optimized path, controlling a six-axis patrol operation mechanical arm of the dexterous hand robot to perform transformer substation patrol operation. The patrol operation efficiency of the six-axis patrol operation mechanical arm of the dexterous hand robot is improved.

title: Man-machine mutual teaching system and skill transaction method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a man-machine mutual teaching system, which comprises a humanoid robot, and is characterized in that the humanoid robot is provided with a multi-airbag bionic muscle system and an acupuncture point internal and external sensing network, is provided with a preset basic function module, is provided with a mixed learning framework, and is used for integrating end-to-end learning and multi-modal decomposition learning capabilities; the humanoid robot is further provided with a kappa coefficient library, a skill perception module, a ternary skill characterization module, a skill reproduction module, a skill optimization module, a mixed skill library, an isomorphic skill transfer module, a heterogeneous skill adaptation module, a staged skill transaction platform, a coevolution module and an AI intelligent optimization engine. The advantages of end-to-end learning and multi-mode decomposition learning are integrated through a mixed learning framework, the learning efficiency is improved, and the limitation of a single learning normal form is solved; the kappa coefficient library realizes systematic management of force control parameters, provides optimal kappa value configuration for different skills, and greatly improves motion flexibility and accuracy.

title: Biped structure of bionic robot and bionic robot
abstract: The biped structure comprises a hip module and an upper bionic leg module movably arranged on the hip module, the hip module comprises a forward swing driver, a lateral extension driver, a turnover driver, a lateral extension support and a turnover support, an output shaft of the forward swing driver is connected to the lateral extension support, and an output shaft of the turnover driver is connected to the lateral extension support. The side unfolding driver is arranged on the side unfolding support and rotates in the first direction along with the side unfolding support, an output shaft of the side unfolding driver is connected to the turnover support and used for driving the turnover support to rotate in the second direction, and the turnover driver is arranged on the turnover support and used for driving the turnover support to rotate in the second direction along with the turnover support. An output shaft of the turnover driver is connected to the top of the upper bionic leg module and used for driving the upper bionic leg module to rotate in the third direction, the first direction, the second direction and the third direction are perpendicular to one another in pairs, and the problem that the degree of freedom of movement is limited due to hip swelling is solved; the flexible space rotation of the upper bionic leg module is realized.

title: Load characteristic testing device for frameless torque motor of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motor load testing, in particular to a humanoid robot frameless torque motor load characteristic testing device which comprises a frame body and fixing rods axially, symmetrically and fixedly mounted at the top of the frame body, and further comprises a base detachably mounted at the top of the frame body; the stator is detachably mounted in the base; the limiting seat is arranged in the base; the rotor is arranged in the limiting seat and is movably arranged in the stator; the output motor is mounted at the bottom of the frame body and outputs torque for the rotor; the two ends of the lifting plate movably sleeve the outer sides of the fixed rods; the multiple pressing rods are movably arranged at the bottom of the lifting plate in an annular array mode; the adjusting assembly is arranged in the lifting plate and used for driving the multiple pressing rods to coaxially expand or contract. According to the humanoid robot frameless torque motor load characteristic testing device, the position of the pressing rod can be adjusted through the adjusting assembly, stators of various models and different sizes can be pressed and limited, and the stability in the testing process is guaranteed.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid hand structure for robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid hand structure for a robot, and relates to the technical field of robot dexterous hands. The multi-degree-of-freedom human hand imitating structure for the robot comprises a palm, a servo electric cylinder A is fixedly installed in the palm, a palm center base is arranged on the side face of the servo electric cylinder A, a circuit board installation base is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the palm center base, and the end, away from the circuit board installation base, of the palm center base is fixedly installed in the palm. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid hand structure for the robot, the driving mode that the servo electric cylinder is matched with the PCB circuit is adopted, compared with traditional tendon rope driving and gear driving, the driving mode has the remarkable advantages that the electric cylinder push rod stretches out and draws back to directly control finger movement, the precision attenuation problem caused by elastic deformation in tendon rope driving is avoided, and the loading capacity is higher; meanwhile, a complex transmission structure driven by a gear is abandoned, the weight is reduced, the cost is reduced, and the long-term use reliability is guaranteed.

title: Framework material selection method, system and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a skeleton material selection method, system and device for a humanoid robot and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a process hard constraint condition, a plurality of voxel grid units of a humanoid robot skeleton, and a high-frequency load slice of each voxel grid unit; performing multi-mode semantic vector generation processing according to the process hard constraint condition, all the voxel grid units and the high-frequency load slices to obtain a semantic vector matrix; material matching is carried out on the semantic vector matrix to obtain a grid material table, and a plurality of target candidate materials corresponding to each voxel grid unit are recorded in the grid material table; and performing voxel optimization on all the voxel grid units according to the grid material table to obtain a skeleton material selection result of the humanoid robot. The method can effectively improve the material screening efficiency of skeleton material selection, reduce the material selection time and improve the skeleton material selection effect. The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots.

title: Human-machine cooperation humanoid motion autonomous planning method and system based on motion primitives and double DQNs
abstract: The invention relates to a human-machine cooperation humanoid motion autonomous planning method and system based on motion primitives and double DQNs, and belongs to the technical field of robots. According to the method, through a human-human cooperative motion experiment, human arm action primitive types are extracted, and selection factors of the human arm action primitive types are analyzed; a double-DQN primitive decision-making method based on a long-short-term memory network is adopted, a reward function is designed according to the action primitive frequency, a loss function related to the reward function is constructed, and selection of primitive types is achieved; establishing an autonomous planning method; and through a human-machine cooperation experiment, collaborator feedback data is obtained, double-DQN model parameters are optimized, and finally, the robot humanoid motion autonomous planning ability and the acceptability of the collaborator to robot motion are verified. According to the method, the problem of robot humanoid motion autonomous planning in contact type man-machine cooperation is solved, and the humanoid degree of robot motion and the acceptability of a collaborator to robot motion are remarkably improved.

title: Variable-configuration lunar humanoid robot and wheel and foot switching, folding and unfolding method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the field of lunar exploration, and provides a variable-configuration lunar humanoid robot and a wheel-foot switching, folding and unfolding method thereof.The humanoid robot comprises a main force bearing structure which is in an L shape and composed of a side plate and a bottom plate, the front face of the side plate of the main force bearing structure is symmetrically provided with two protruding bases, and the bottom plate is provided with a mounting connector of a waist assembly; the head assembly is installed between the two protruding bases on the side plate of the main force bearing structure; the trunk assembly is installed above the end, not connected with the side plates, of the bottom plate, and the two vertical ends of the trunk assembly are connected with the two ends of the side plates correspondingly; the backpack assembly is installed on the back face of the main force bearing structure side plate. The waist component is mounted on the bottom surface of the main load-bearing structure bottom plate; the two mechanical arm assemblies can rotate correspondingly and are installed on the two sides of the base protruding out of the side plate of the main force bearing structure; the multifunctional tool is installed on the side face of the backpack assembly; the two sets of combined mechanical legs are installed on the two sides of the waist assembly respectively.

title: Life test platform for lead screw transmission device for humanoid robot joint
abstract: The utility model discloses a life test platform for a lead screw transmission device for humanoid robot joints, which relates to the technical field of robot production and comprises a platform body, the top of the platform body is connected with an oil storage tank, a transmission shaft penetrates through the outer surface of the oil storage tank, a gear is sleeved outside the transmission shaft, and one side of the top of the oil storage tank is provided with an air cylinder. The output end of the cylinder is connected with a linkage block through a piston rod. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the cylinder, the transmission shafts, the gear, the rack, the blocking frame, the linkage block and the blocking brush, the plurality of transmission shafts are arranged so as to conveniently connect a plurality of lead screw main bodies for testing, and the cylinder drives the linkage block to reciprocate left and right, so that the rack reciprocates left and right and is engaged with the gear while reciprocating left and right; the gears synchronously rotate forwards and backwards in a reciprocating manner, so that the transmission shafts drive the lead screw main body to rotate forwards and backwards through the couplings; the multi-station synchronous test is facilitated, the structure is simple, and the service life is long.

title: Dexterous hand finger based on connecting rod transmission, bionic mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a dexterous hand finger based on connecting rod transmission, a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problem that a transmission mechanism of an existing dexterous hand is low in response speed, and adopts the technical scheme that the dexterous hand finger mainly comprises a finger base and a finger body, a driver and a transmission mechanism in transmission connection with the driver are arranged on the finger base, the driver drives the finger body to bend and/or swing through the transmission mechanism, the transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block installed on the guide piece in a sliding mode, and the sliding block is in transmission connection with the finger body. A traction rope connected with the sliding block is wound on an output shaft of the driver, the driver controls the output shaft to rotate forwards and backwards so as to drag the sliding block to slide back and forth along the guiding piece through the traction rope, and then the finger body is controlled to bend and/or swing. The finger is mainly used for driving the sliding block to move through the pulling rope so as to control the finger body to bend and swing, and the response efficiency of the finger body can be improved.
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dexterous hand finger based on connecting rod transmission, a bionic mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of bionic mechanical arms, solves the problem that a transmission mechanism of an existing dexterous hand is low in response speed, and adopts the technical scheme that the dexterous hand finger mainly comprises a finger base and a finger body, a driver and a transmission mechanism in transmission connection with the driver are arranged on the finger base, the driver drives the finger body to bend and/or swing through the transmission mechanism, the transmission mechanism comprises a guide piece and a sliding block installed on the guide piece in a sliding mode, and the sliding block is in transmission connection with the finger body. A traction rope connected with the sliding block is wound on an output shaft of the driver, the driver controls the output shaft to rotate forwards and backwards so as to drag the sliding block to slide back and forth along the guiding piece through the traction rope, and then the finger body is controlled to bend and/or swing. The finger is mainly used for driving the sliding block to move through the pulling rope so as to control the finger body to bend and swing, and the response efficiency of the finger body can be improved.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT HAVING COMMON ACTUATOR COMPONENTS
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot having at least 28 actuators. The humanoid robot comprises a torso, a torso twist actuator coupled to the torso and configured to allow the torso to twist around a torso twist axis, and a knee actuator with a knee axis. An upper portion of the humanoid robot is positioned above the torso twist axis and includes a first actuator with a first momentary peak torque rating and a second actuator with a momentary peak torque rating, wherein one momentary peak torque rating of the two momentary peak torque ratings is below 10 Nm. A lower portion of the humanoid robot is positioned below the knee axis and includes a third actuator having at least one momentary peak torque rating that is above 35 Nm. A central portion extends between the upper portion and the lower portion and includes a fourth actuator having at least one momentary peak torque rating that is above 300 Nm.

title: Biped robot and linear actuator applied to biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot and an applied linear actuator thereof, the biped robot comprises a main body connecting part and leg parts arranged on the two sides of the main body connecting part, the leg parts comprise thigh parts, shank parts, sole components and connecting rod components used for connection which are connected in sequence, and the thigh parts, the shank parts, the sole components and the connecting rod components are arranged on the two sides of the main body connecting part; the thigh part comprises a thigh rotating joint, a thigh lifting linear joint, a shank bending linear joint and a thigh supporting plate, the thigh lifting linear joint and the shank bending linear joint are linear actuators and are oppositely arranged, and the two ends of the thigh lifting linear joint and the two ends of the shank bending linear joint are rotationally installed; the shank part comprises an ankle linear joint and a shank supporting plate, the upper end of the ankle linear joint is rotatably connected with the shank supporting plate, and the lower end of the ankle linear joint is connected with the sole assembly. title: Humanoid robot for fermented tea production line
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid robot for a fermented tea production line in the technical field of tea fermentation processes. The humanoid robot comprises a movable base, a material box translation mechanism, a lifting mechanism, a sensing device, a spraying device and a control system, the material box translation mechanism comprises a first sliding platform, a second sliding platform and a supporting platform; a first servo motor, a synchronous belt and a first sliding rail are arranged on the second sliding platform; a second servo motor, a lead screw and a second sliding rail are arranged on the supporting platform. According to the utility model, the mobile operation robot is adopted to carry out man-like operation, and is matched with an automatic production line system, so that the requirements of the fermented tea processing technology are met, and the intelligent mobile robot which can carry out man-like operation and has the function of integrating the fermented tea technology is realized. The material box translation mechanism adopts a three-layer platform structure design, and through the combination of the first sliding platform and the second sliding platform, the two sliding platforms can slide and extend simultaneously and can also slide and extend independently so as to cope with a more complex working environment.

title: Biped robot real machine deployment method
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot real machine deployment method. The invention relates to the technical field of biped robot deployment, and in Sim2Real deployment, the requirements of a simulation environment and an actual environment on the control frequency reach the same control frequency; when the position q and speed dq information of the robot joints is obtained, a mode of sending batch requests and receiving asynchronous responses in a pseudo-parallel mode is adopted; in the Sim2Real process, the synchronism of the IMU data acquisition frequency and the robot control frequency is controlled; the operation performance of the robot in an actual scene is evaluated, and the ability of the robot to deal with various complex conditions is tested, so that the deployment of the real machine of the biped robot is perfected. The performance of the robot in the actual environment is improved through measures such as control frequency optimization, IMU optimization and simulation alignment.

title: Humanoid robot foot and foot force information detection method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot foot and a foot force information detection method. Strain sensing yarns are embedded into a foot arch ligament layer of the humanoid robot foot, and a six-dimensional force sensor and a flexible piezoresistive film of a sole are combined to construct a three-dimensional force field sensing system; the vertical pressure, the shearing force and the torsional moment are synchronously detected, the limitation that only the vertical force can be measured traditionally is broken through, meanwhile, the motion state self-adaptive dynamic sampling technology is adopted, filtering preprocessing is matched, time delay of leg force information detection is shortened, millisecond-level response is achieved, and a biomechanical conduction path is reconstructed through a graph convolutional network. According to the technical scheme, the pre-stored mechanical fingerprint database is combined to predict the stress change in a certain time in the future, so that the lateral force control error of the robot walking in the complex terrain is lower, and therefore, by adopting the technical scheme, the three-dimensional force field detection precision of the humanoid robot foot is higher, and the data in dynamic motion is more complete.

title: Operation method of bionic operation robot based on digital human
abstract: The invention provides an operation method of a bionic operation robot based on a digital human. The invention discloses a bionic operation robot operation method based on a digital human. The bionic operation robot operation method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a digital twin virtual human system and a bionic operation robot; s2, the digital twin virtual human system interacts with the bionic operation robot; and S3, a control room is constructed, and remote control over the bionic operation robot is achieved. The operation method of the bionic operation robot based on the digital human has the advantages that the calculated amount for establishing a human body digital twinning system can be greatly reduced, the quality of reconstructed twinning bodies is improved, the quality of the bionic robot is improved, and the bionic robot can replace manual work to enter a dangerous environment for work and rescue.

title: Foldable robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a foldable robot which comprises a chassis, a supporting rod, a trunk part, arms and a head, the bottom end of the supporting rod is hinged to the chassis around a first hinge shaft, and the top end of the supporting rod is hinged to the bottom end of the trunk part around a second hinge shaft; the foldable robot has an upright form and a folded form, and when the foldable robot is in the upright form, the supporting rod and the trunk part are both vertically arranged relative to the chassis; in the process that the foldable robot is converted into the folded state from the upright state, the supporting rod rotates around the first hinge shaft to a first position inclining forwards or backwards relative to the chassis, the trunk part rotates around the second hinge shaft to a second position inclining backwards or forwards relative to the supporting rod, and the trunk part located at the second position is roughly parallel to the chassis. The foldable robot can be stored in a common square box body, a special box body does not need to be designed and used, and the packaging size and the transportation cost of the humanoid robot are reduced.

title: Under-actuated dexterous finger and humanoid robot hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field related to robots, and discloses an under-actuated dexterous finger and a humanoid robot hand. The second driving unit is connected with the second connecting rod mechanism and used for driving the fingers to bend. The invention further discloses a robot hand constructed by the finger. By means of the robot dexterous hand, the problem that high flexibility and large output torque of an existing robot dexterous hand are difficult to coexist is solved.

title: Real-time positioning and mapping method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, particularly relates to a real-time positioning and mapping method and system for a humanoid robot, and provides an improved Fast-LIO2 algorithm, which adopts a Kalman filter to fuse kinematics at the front end of a foot end of the humanoid robot with IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) data, and accurately estimates the position, posture and speed of the robot in a world coordinate system. The obtained smooth pose track is used for replacing an IMU backward propagation result of a point cloud distortion removal link in a traditional Fast-LIO2 algorithm, so that the time-space consistency of the point cloud in the whole scanning period is ensured. According to the improved method, the problems that gait characteristics are not considered and external constraints are lacked in the application of traditional Fast-LIO2 to the humanoid robot are effectively solved, the point cloud distortion and ghosting phenomena are remarkably reduced, and the positioning robustness and mapping precision of the humanoid robot in a complex dynamic environment are improved.

title: Intelligent wheeled humanoid robot for home-based care appliance
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent wheeled humanoid robot as a home-based care appliance, and relates to the technical field of robots. The robot specifically comprises a wheel type chassis walking mechanism and a robot upper body structure arranged on the wheel type chassis walking mechanism, and the robot upper body structure comprises a robot trunk structure and at least one robot arm mechanism arranged on the robot trunk structure; the robot further comprises a height adjusting mechanism, and the height adjusting mechanism is arranged between the wheel type chassis walking mechanism and the robot trunk structure and used for adjusting the vertical height of the robot trunk structure. A clamping jaw is installed at the tail end of the robot arm mechanism, a multi-mode touch sensor is integrated on the clamping jaw, and the multi-mode touch sensor is used for detecting physical characteristics of an object when the clamping jaw makes contact with the object. The invention aims to enable the wheeled robot to keep efficient moving ability and to adapt to multi-height operation requirements in a family environment.

title: Robot carbon fiber joint dynamic load cooperative control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a robot carbon fiber joint dynamic load cooperative control method based on reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining joint strain and temperature; calculating medium-term state parameters and long-term baseline parameters of the material; the sensing data and the parameters are used as state input, and torque and rigidity are output to act cooperatively; generating and synchronously executing instruction torque and instruction rigidity; and updating the baseline parameters on line according to the execution history to form closed-loop adaptive control. The system comprises a sensing data acquisition module, a physical state observation module, a reinforcement learning decision module, a cooperative control instruction generation and execution module and a baseline parameter updating module. According to the invention, through cooperative control of torque and rigidity and closed-loop updating of a material state, material performance evolution can be actively compensated, and the service life of the joint is prolonged while the task precision is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot self-supervision state estimation method based on variational auto-encoder
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot self-supervised state estimation method based on a variational auto-encoder, and relates to the technical field of robot perception and control, and the method constructs a state estimation model of an encoder-decoder architecture, and carries out training based on a self-supervised learning method. Historical observation information of a robot is input, a state coding module extracts potential feature representation in an observation sequence, supervised training is carried out in combination with privilege information, and a coded submerged space vector is divided into an explicit variable and an implicit variable. The explicit variable is used for calculating a loss function with privilege information, and the implicit variable is used as the input of the state decoding module to reconstruct original observation data, so that the accurate prediction of the floating base speed, position, posture and foot end contact state of the robot is realized. In the reasoning stage, the model carries out state estimation by using real-time observation information and provides state feedback for a downstream motion control module, so that closed-loop control is realized.

title: Robot dexterous hand grabbing method and robot dexterous hand grabbing control system
abstract: The invention discloses a robot dexterous hand grabbing method and a robot dexterous hand grabbing control system, a dexterous hand firstly grabs and moves a target object, and then the target object is grabbed according to whether the contact surface of the dexterous hand is deformed or not, whether the target object is displaced or not and whether the contact surface of the target object is deformed or not within a specified range or not. Whether the target object is successfully grabbed or not is judged; and if the contact surface, making contact with the target object, on the dexterous hand deforms, the target object displaces, and the contact surface, making contact with the dexterous hand, on the target object deforms within the specified range, it is judged that grabbing succeeds. According to the grabbing method, the displacement of the target object, the deformation of the contact surface of the target object and the dexterous hand and the deformation of the contact surface of the dexterous hand and the target object are adopted to judge whether the target object is grabbed or not; the defect that grabbing of an existing humanoid robot dexterous finger completely depends on the deformation quantity of an image recognition flexible contact body to judge the magnitude of clamping force, and whether grabbing is conducted or not is judged is overcome.

title: Robust walking control method and system for high-gear-ratio humanoid robot based on potential dynamics self-adaption
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a high-gear-ratio humanoid robot robust walking control method and system based on potential dynamics self-adaption, and the method comprises the steps: designing a control strategy training frame based on deep reinforcement learning, and carrying out the optimization through an Actor-Critic structure and a PPO algorithm; constructing a potential dynamic adaptive network LDAN, and extracting environment and ontology dynamic parameters through a variational auto-encoder; designing a multi-dimensional reward function; constructing a periodic gait library by using von Mises distribution and motion capture data; gradually introducing terrain disturbance and dynamic change through curriculum type simulation training; the trained strategy and the LDAN module are deployed on the high-gear-ratio driven humanoid robot, the problems that the high-gear-ratio humanoid robot is poor in motion stability, poor in adaptability and insufficient in action expression in a variable environment are solved, and the high-gear-ratio driven humanoid robot has the advantages of being high in robustness, high in natural expressivity and high in migration ability.

title: Humanoid robot control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a control method, system and device of a humanoid robot and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the session information and working environment information of the current round of the humanoid robot, and a plurality of pieces of first structured information and first summary information; the session information and the working environment information are input into a pre-training language model for structured extraction, second structured information output by the pre-training language model is obtained, and the second structured information is structured information of the current round; according to the working environment information, all the first structured information and the first summary information, performing instruction generation on the second structured information to obtain an action planning instruction; and performing action control on the humanoid robot according to the action planning instruction. According to the method, the task efficiency of the humanoid robot in the man-machine cooperative control process can be improved. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: Rotating assembly, hip joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a rotating assembly, a hip joint structure and a humanoid robot. The rotating unit is rotationally connected with the supporting unit, one of the rotating unit and the supporting unit is connected with a limiting block, the other one of the rotating unit and the supporting unit is provided with a limiting groove, the limiting block is movably arranged in the limiting groove, and flexible pads are arranged on the two end faces of the limiting groove and/or the two end faces of the limiting block in the rotating direction of the rotating unit. The limiting groove is suitable for abutting against the limiting block through the flexible pad so as to form flexible limiting on the rotating angle of the rotating unit. According to the rotating assembly, the limiting block moves in the limiting groove along with rotation of the rotating unit, when the limiting block moves to the end face of the limiting groove, the limiting block abuts against the limiting groove through the flexible pad, and therefore the limiting groove flexibly limits the rotating angle of the rotating unit; and structural damage caused by rigid collision between the limiting block and the limiting groove is avoided.

title: Robot leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a robot leg structure and a humanoid robot, the robot leg structure comprises a hip joint assembly, thighs and shank assemblies, and the hip joint assembly is used for being connected to the lower part of the trunk of the humanoid robot; the thigh part comprises a first thigh web and a second thigh web which are oppositely arranged in the Y direction, the first thigh web and the second thigh web are detachably connected into a whole, and a mounting cavity is defined between the first thigh web and the second thigh web; the hip joint assembly is rotationally connected into the mounting cavity along the lower end of the Z direction; the upper end of the shank assembly is rotationally connected to the end, deviating from the hip joint assembly, in the mounting cavity in the Y direction. A first driving assembly is arranged in the mounting cavity and used for driving the shank assembly to rotate in the Y direction. According to the utility model, the walking stability of the humanoid robot is improved on the premise that the movement flexibility of the humanoid robot is met.

The end, away from the first flange plate, of the knee joint connecting rod is hinged to the upper end of the shank web. The hinge point of the knee joint connecting rod and the first flange plate, the rotating shaft point of the first flange plate, the hinge point of the knee joint connecting rod and the shank web and the rotating shaft point of the shank web form a contra-parallelogram structure. The motion angle range of the knee joint connecting rod can be narrowed on the basis of meeting the requirement for large-angle-range motion of the knee joint of the humanoid robot.

title: Double-outer-ring anti-falling high-speed heavy-load harmonic reducer and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a double-outer-ring anti-disengaging high-speed heavy-load harmonic reducer and a humanoid robot. The harmonic reducer comprises a steel wheel, a flexible wheel and a wave generator; the wave generator comprises a cam and a bearing inner ring arranged on the outer side of the cam in a sleeving mode, and a first outer ring and a second outer ring are sequentially arranged on the outer side of the bearing inner ring in a sleeving mode. A large driving area can be provided for driving the flexible gear, so that the driving purpose under the heavy load condition can be achieved, the overall durability of the flexible gear is greatly improved, in addition, the ball frame is limited in the second outer ring through the second outer ring and the locking piece, the installation stability of the ball frame is improved, meanwhile, the internal balls can be axially stopped, and the service life of the flexible gear is prolonged. And the problem of axial separation of the balls during high-speed rotation is avoided.

title: Cable production stranding device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a cable production stranding device for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of cable production, the cable production stranding device comprises a hollow shaft arranged on a bottom plate, a doubling mold and a wind-up roller, one end of the outer side of the hollow shaft is fixedly provided with a winch provided with a plurality of threading holes, and the cable production stranding device further comprises a tension detection device used for detecting the tension balance degree of a plurality of stranded wire layer wires; and the driving mechanism drives the hollow shaft to rotate. Through the tension detection device, the tension of a plurality of stranded wire layer wires can be detected, and if the tension of any stranded wire layer wire is detected to be reduced, a circuit can be switched on to lighten a warning lamp at a corresponding position, so that a worker can find and adjust the tension of the stranded wire layer wires in time, and the working efficiency is improved. Therefore, the tension of a plurality of stranded wire layer leads can be monitored in real time, the cables can be more uniformly stranded together, the stranding quality of the cables is improved, the overall structure of the cables is more stable, and the mechanical performance of the cables is improved.

title: High-integration-level multi-degree-of-freedom head driving mechanism for small humanoid robot and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a high-integration multi-degree-of-freedom head driving mechanism for a small humanoid robot and a control method, and relates to the technical field of robots. Comprising a base, a rotating support, a motor fixing shell and a motor assembly, the rotating support is rotationally connected to the top end of the base, a first motor is installed on the rotating support, a worm is installed at the output end of the first motor, a worm gear is rotationally connected to the top end of the rotating support, and the worm is meshed with the worm gear; the top end of the worm gear support is provided with a left-right swing rod, and two ends of the bottom of the left-right swing rod are provided with rotating connecting rods. The first motor is started, the first motor drives the worm to rotate, the worm rotates to drive the worm gear to rotate, the worm gear rotates to drive the worm gear support to rotate, the left-right swing rod rotates, then the rotating connecting rod is driven to move, finally left-right rotation of the eyeball is achieved, and the second motor drives the front-back swing rod to rotate by starting the second motor.

title: ADVANCED ARRAY OF SENSOR ASSEMBLIES OF A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A humanoid robot includes an upper region with a torso, a pair of arm assemblies coupled to the torso, and a head and neck assembly. The head and neck assembly includes a neck portion coupled to the torso and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. The head portion has a head housing assembly with a first shell and a second shell defining a head volume. The first shell includes an opening with a cover extending across at least a majority of the opening. A first camera and a second camera are located within the head volume, each having horizontal and vertical fields of view exceeding specified angles. The first and second camera bodies are positioned less than 15 centimeters apart. The robot also includes a lower region with a pair of legs coupled to and spaced apart from the upper region.

title: Welding, polishing and cleaning multifunctional integrated device and four-footed humanoid welding robot
abstract: The invention provides a welding, polishing and cleaning multifunctional integrated device and a four-footed humanoid welding robot. The device comprises a machine shell, a welding gun, a cleaning gun and a grinding assembly. One end of the welding gun and one end of the cleaning gun are arranged in an inner cavity of the machine shell through telescopic moving assemblies so that the other end of the welding gun and the other end of the cleaning gun can stretch out of the machine shell or retract towards the machine shell. The polishing assembly comprises a polishing cutter disc and a polishing transmission mechanism arranged in an inner cavity of the machine shell. The polishing cutter disc is located on the outer side of the machine shell and connected with the polishing transmission mechanism to achieve rotary polishing. The device integrates the three functions of cleaning, polishing and welding, can be applied to the tail end of a mechanical arm of a mobile robot, cleaning, polishing and welding actions can be almost seamlessly and continuously executed at the same position, the waiting time and the idle stroke time between procedures are greatly shortened, and the working efficiency is improved. And the effective working time of the robot and the repair efficiency of various steel structures such as large equipment are remarkably improved.

title: Robot wheel type and foot type composite moving structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot wheel type and foot type composite moving structure and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the robot wheel type and foot type composite moving structure comprises a shank arm, the bottom of the shank arm is connected with a sole through a universal shaft, and the robot further comprises a second linkage assembly; the second linkage assembly drives the foot sole to longitudinally move around the universal shaft in the advancing direction of the robot through a second motor. A special-shaped switching piece is mounted on the shank arm close to the output end of the second motor, and selectively restrains the front-back rotation of the foot sole in the advancing direction of the robot; a power wheel is mounted on the special-shaped switching piece; a steering wheel is mounted at the toe end of the sole; when the robot is in a standing posture state, the special-shaped switching piece does not cut off power transmission of the second motor and does not restrain rotation of the foot sole, the robot moves in a foot mode, when the robot is in a kneeling posture state, the special-shaped switching piece limits front-back rotation of the foot sole in the advancing direction of the robot, the robot moves in a wheel mode, the switching structure is simple, and the robot is convenient to use. And the switching efficiency is higher.

title: Joint module of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a joint module of a humanoid robot. The joint module comprises a shell, a bearing and a planetary reducer, wherein the bearing and the planetary reducer are arranged in the shell; an elastic coating layer with the thickness of 0.8 mm is arranged on the outer side of a gear ring of the planetary reducer, an inner ring and an outer ring of the bearing are connected with the elastic coating layer and a shell respectively, the planetary reducer comprises a first planet carrier and a second planet carrier which are oppositely arranged, the first planet carrier is in a circular ring shape and comprises stress areas and non-stress areas which are alternately arranged, and the stress areas and the non-stress areas are each provided with three sections, a stress area is thickened, a non-stress area is hollowed out, a planet wheel of the planetary reducer is arranged in the stress area, a second planet carrier is fixed in a shell, a center hole of a first planet carrier is arranged to be an inner conical surface, a wedge-shaped lining matched with the center hole of the planet carrier is further arranged in the shell, and the wedge-shaped lining is made of shape memory alloy. And when the temperature reaches a set value, the wedge-shaped lining axially extends towards the side where the second planet carrier is located.

title: Bionic dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The bionic dexterous hand comprises a palm module, a plurality of mechanical fingers and a driving module. The palm module comprises a plurality of detachably connected metacarpal bone assemblies; the mechanical fingers are rotationally connected with the metacarpal bone assemblies correspondingly. The driving module is in transmission connection with the mechanical fingers and drives the mechanical fingers to bend and deflect; a first elastic reset mechanism is embedded in the finger pulp face of each mechanical finger, and a second elastic reset mechanism is embedded in the finger back face of each mechanical finger, so that the mechanical fingers are in a natural loose and bent state when the driving module does not work. The first elastic reset mechanism and the second elastic reset mechanism are embedded. The first elastic reset mechanism tends to bend the fingers, and the second elastic reset mechanism tends to straighten the fingers when the driving module does not apply active force. The mechanical fingers simulate the natural state of the human hand when muscles are relaxed, and the reset function of the fingers is achieved.

title: Full-connecting-rod-driven twenty-one-degree-of-freedom humanoid five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a full-connecting-rod-driven 21-degree-of-freedom humanoid five-finger dexterous hand which comprises a palm base and a five-finger executing mechanism. Each of the four fingers has four active degrees of freedom, so that near knuckle side sway, near knuckle bending and middle and far knuckle coupling bending are realized respectively; the thumb has five active degrees of freedom and can independently complete palm aligning, forward falling, abduction and knuckle bending movement. All motions are converted into linear motions through a motor driving lead screw and then converted into rotary motions of knuckles through a push rod and a connecting rod mechanism, and full-connecting-rod transmission is achieved. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism, the double-fish-eye connecting rods, the universal joints and other structures are adopted to ensure that movement among multiple degrees of freedom does not interfere with one another, the far knuckles have passive self-adaptive bending capacity through the design of the compressible push rods, and the multi-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism has high load, high precision, high bionic performance and grabbing adaptability and is suitable for fine operation of a robot.

title: Gait planning method for biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot gait planning method. The invention relates to the technical field of robot gait planning, and the method comprises the steps: taking a kinetic model of a robot as input, so as to achieve the neural network reasoning of simulation; describing the robot by using a URDF file, and enabling the robot to be equivalent to a kinematic chain formed by connecting rigid bodies in series; through accurate description, a robot consistent with that in reality is established in a simulation environment, the robot is enabled to carry out gait learning in a simulation physical environment, and supervised random divergence trial and error are carried out in a mode of setting initial conditions, termination conditions and reward and punishment conditions so as to realize gait learning. According to the invention, through repeated modification of parameters and structural adjustment of adaptability, a stable, low-energy-consumption and high-robustness control strategy is finally obtained through training.

title: Bionic dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The bionic dexterous hand comprises a metacarpal bone assembly, a plurality of finger assemblies and a driving assembly. Each finger assembly comprises a cross-shaped connecting unit and a phalanx unit, the cross-shaped connecting units are rotationally connected with the metacarpal bone assembly and the phalanx units respectively, and each phalanx unit comprises two phalanx blocks which are detachable in a left-right split mode; the driving assembly is in transmission connection with the finger assembly and drives the finger assembly to bend and laterally swing. The cross-shaped connecting unit allows the fingers to bend and swing laterally. On the other hand, connection support can be provided for the left and right detachable phalanx blocks. The maintainability and repairability of the dexterous hand are improved, and the replacement cost is reduced. And the finger movement is more accurate and controllable, so that the control difficulty is reduced, and the operation stability of the dexterous hand is improved.

title: Industrial humanoid robot teleoperation cooperation system and method based on multi-modal motion capture fusion
abstract: The invention provides an industrial humanoid robot teleoperation cooperation system and method based on multi-modal motion capture fusion, and belongs to the technical field of industrial humanoid robots. According to the invention, an optical motion measurement module is used for collecting whole body position data of an operator in an unshielded scene; the inertial motion capture module is used for collecting joint angle data of an operator in a shielding scene; the mode switching module is used for switching working modes; the environment sensing module is used for collecting environment data, workpiece images and robot tail end contact force information and sending the information to the cooperative control unit. The force feedback device is used for converting the contact force information of the tail end of the robot into tactile vibration and collecting grip strength data of an operator; the cooperative control unit is used for fusing the multi-modal dynamic capture pose data and generating an execution instruction in combination with an obstacle avoidance algorithm and a force control model; the industrial humanoid robot is used for receiving the execution instruction. The operation stability and environmental adaptability of the robot in scenes such as high-precision assembly and heavy carrying can be improved.

title: Modularized thumb mechanical finger imitating human hand motion characteristics
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a modularized thumb mechanical finger simulating human hand movement characteristics, which comprises a base module, a metacarpal bone module, a proximal knuckle and a distal knuckle. The base module provides a connection interface with a palm or arm robot. The metacarpal bone module has three active degrees of freedom and is driven by a lead screw sliding block mechanism, and palm aligning, abduction and toppling motions are accurately achieved. And the proximal knuckles realize bending movement. The far-side knuckles and the near-side knuckles move in a coupling mode through a four-connecting-rod mechanism, decoupling is achieved through a rocker sliding block mechanism, and the passive self-adaptive capacity is achieved. The human thumb movement function is highly simulated, the structure is compact, driving is efficient, fine finger alignment and grabbing operation can be stably completed, meanwhile, integration is facilitated through modular design, and the operability, adaptability and intelligent level of the humanoid dexterous hand are improved.

title: HIP JOINT OF HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A hip joint of a humanoid robot may include: a first actuator including a first rotating part configured to rotate around a first rotation axis; a second actuator connected to the first rotating part, the second actuator including a second rotating part configured to rotate around a second rotation axis inclined with respect to the first rotation axis; and a third actuator connected to the second rotating part, the third actuator including a third rotating part configured to rotate around a third rotation axis inclined with respect to the second rotation axis.

title: Signalisierung der vorhandenen Sicherheitsfunktion humanoider Roboter
abstract: Signaling the presence of sufficient technical safety equipment, characterized by the detectability of a light signal on the humanoid robot, which confirms that this robot is capable of avoiding collisions and that avoidance reactions similar to those of humans are implemented. This signaling is provided by a light signal at an easily visible position. A signaling in the color green is proposed. This signaling can, for example, be present in a figurative sense at the position of the nose in a humanoid robot, alternatively also by green glowing eyes or eye rings or a signal on the forehead. This signaling should be permanently present as long as the robot is in a corresponding action phase or standby phase, but not in the event of a fault.

title: Humanoid robot with flying function
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot with a flying function, which comprises a robot body and at least one engine, the engine is arranged on the robot body and can drive the robot body to realize the flying function, the robot body comprises a trunk part and a plurality of leg components, and the engine is arranged on the trunk part and/or the leg component. title: Central driving type three-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot shoulder joint mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a central driving type three-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot shoulder joint mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The mechanism comprises a shoulder flexion and extension module, a shoulder adduction and abduction module and a shoulder inward and outward rotation module, output shafts of the three modules intersect at the same center point in space, and highly-bionic three-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved. Wherein the shoulder flexion and extension module drives a gear pair to drive a first transmission shaft to rotate through a first driving motor; the shoulder adduction and abduction module drives a gear pair and a bevel gear pair through a second driving motor to drive a circular base rack to move; and the shoulder internal and external rotation module is directly driven by a third driving motor to rotate. The rotary inertia of a moving part is remarkably reduced, the dynamic stability and the moving precision are improved, the problems that a traditional shoulder joint is large in inertia and insufficient in freedom degree are effectively solved, high flexibility and high load capacity are achieved, and the complex action requirements of the humanoid robot are met.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The wheeled humanoid robot relates to the technical field of robots and comprises a movable base, a machine body is rotatably mounted on the movable base, mechanical arms are rotatably mounted on the two sides of the machine body, mechanical clamping jaws are mounted at the ends, away from the machine body, of the mechanical arms, and a gravity center shifting mechanism is mounted on the machine body; when the mechanical clamping jaw on one side of the movable base lifts a heavy object, the gravity center shifting mechanism drives the machine body to incline towards the side opposite to the side where the heavy object is lifted. And a deflection mechanism is mounted on the movable base. According to the wheeled humanoid robot, by arranging the movable base, the robot body, the mechanical arm, the mechanical clamping jaw, the gravity center deflection mechanism and the deflection mechanism, when a heavy object is lifted, the robot body can be adjusted to incline in the opposite direction according to the weight condition of the heavy object, and the gravity center position of the robot for lifting the heavy object is adjusted; therefore, the stability of the robot in the advancing process is ensured, the rollover condition of the robot is reduced, and the robot body can be deflected according to the working scene so as to adapt to the working scene.

title: Demonstration method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot teaching method and system.The method comprises the steps that in response to interactive operation of a user on a simulation action page based on a virtual robot, movement track information of a mouse pointer in a corresponding display picture of a display screen is obtained; analyzing the moving track information to determine virtual coordinate information of each moving point location on the moving track information, and determining displacement information of a corresponding mouse pointer according to the virtual coordinate information of each moving point location; determining a corresponding virtual joint variation according to the displacement information of the mouse pointer, and generating a teaching control instruction of the humanoid robot according to the virtual joint variation; the teaching control instruction is sent to the humanoid robot for action control; and carrying out data storage on the generated teaching control instruction. A user can control the humanoid robot through visual mouse operation, the teaching threshold is lowered, and operation convenience and efficiency are improved.

title: AI-based humanoid robot teaching method and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an AI-based humanoid robot teaching method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a human body teaching image of a teaching person in a current scene through a camera assembly; inputting the continuous frames of human body teaching images into a pre-constructed action recognition model for recognition so as to determine teaching action information of each moving stage and human body key point coordinates of each moving stage, and determining robot joints corresponding to the human body key points, calculating to obtain the joint motion state of each control joint of the corresponding robot; and determining a corresponding intention label according to the teaching action information of each movement stage, and updating the joint motion state of each control joint according to the intention label. According to the AI-based humanoid robot teaching method disclosed by the embodiment of the invention, the corresponding intention label is determined according to the teaching action information of each moving stage, and the joint motion state of each control joint is updated according to the intention label.

title: Humanoid robot control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a control decision model and multi-source environment perception data of a humanoid robot in a task scene, and electroencephalogram data of a target user in the task scene; the multi-source environment perception data and the electroencephalogram data are input into a trained state analysis model for analysis, a state evaluation result output by the trained state analysis model is obtained, and the state evaluation result is used for indicating the current emotion category and fatigue level of the target user; inputting the state evaluation result and the multi-source environment sensing data into the control decision model for decision generation, and obtaining an action control instruction of the humanoid robot; and performing cooperative action control on the humanoid robot according to the action control instruction. The control method can effectively improve the safety and efficiency of man-machine cooperation. The invention relates to the technical field of man-machine cooperation.

title: Virtual human intelligent motion control method for complex maintenance scene
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent identification, in particular to a complex maintenance scene-oriented virtual human intelligent motion control method, which comprises the following steps of: performing virtual human physical modeling, and establishing a virtual human model based on a GB10000 human body size standard and a human-machine ergonomics standard, wherein the kinematics architecture divides a virtual human into an upper body and a lower body, the upper body comprises eight joints including a spine, a neck, left/right shoulders, left/right elbows and left/right wrists, the lower body comprises six joints including left/right thigh roots, left/right knees and left/right ankles, and all the joints are abstracted into spherical hinge, hinge or universal joint kinematics mechanisms respectively. Joint angle constraints are set; the technical problem that a mode of designing animations in advance and combining prefabricated animations is adopted on the basis of action methods such as a state machine and a behavior tree, calculation and analysis generally face conventional maintainability tasks, and special and complex maintenance scenes are difficult to meet is solved.
