title: Integral casting structure of humanoid robot framework
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to an integral casting structure of a humanoid robot framework, the integral casting structure comprises a bearing mechanism, a potential energy storage and release mechanism, a bionic gait mechanism and a dynamic balance mechanism, the bearing mechanism comprises a main shell, a vertical beam, a cross beam and a bottom plate; when the bearing mechanism inclines forwards, the potential energy storage and release mechanism breaks and stores gravitational potential energy and converts the potential energy into initial mechanical power for starting walking; when the potential energy storage and release mechanism starts to release initial mechanical power, the bionic gait mechanism is automatically driven to work, and the two bottom plates are driven to simulate human gaits to walk alternately; when the bionic gait mechanism works and drives the two bottom plates to walk alternately, the dynamic balance mechanism is automatically driven to work, balance recovery is carried out on the whole structure during alternate walking, and the problem that the reliability of continuous walking is insufficient due to the fact that the bionic gait mechanism is high in energy consumption, poor in environmental adaptability and poor in balance performance is solved.

title: Robot foot contact and sliding detection method and device based on fuzzy logic
abstract: The invention provides a robot foot contact and sliding detection method and device based on fuzzy logic, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the foot three-axis acceleration and foot three-axis angular velocity of a humanoid robot through employing a proprioceptive inertial measurement unit installed at the foot of the humanoid robot; performing Kalman filtering on the foot three-axis acceleration and the foot three-axis angular velocity of the humanoid robot to obtain a foot linear acceleration, a foot linear velocity and a foot angular velocity of the humanoid robot under a world coordinate system; a hierarchical fuzzy logic is adopted to detect the foot state of the humanoid robot, a generalized 2-type fuzzy C-mean algorithm is adopted in the first layer, the contact probability of the foot and the outside is calculated according to the foot three-axis acceleration and the foot three-axis angular velocity, and a contact event ensuring that the foot stands is detected; and the second layer adopts an interval type 2 fuzzy inference system, and detects a foot transverse sliding event according to the contact probability of the foot and the outside, the foot linear speed and the foot linear acceleration.

title: Humanoid robot for routing inspection of high-voltage switch cabinet and routing inspection method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot for routing inspection of a high-voltage switch cabinet and a routing inspection method of the humanoid robot. According to the humanoid robot, through ingenious cooperation of multiple connecting rods and driving cylinders in the driving adjusting mechanism, the humanoid robot can flexibly adjust the height and position of the trunk, and the humanoid robot can easily adapt to high-voltage switch cabinets of different models and different placement positions and heights.

title: Control method and system for improving humanoid degree of robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a control method for improving the humanoid degree of a robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a surface electromyogram signal of a corresponding position through an electromyogram detection assembly disposed at a user, and carrying out the preprocessing of the obtained surface electromyogram signal, so as to obtain an electromyogram activity curve; performing feature extraction on the myoelectricity activity curve to obtain myoelectricity time sequence features, and inputting the myoelectricity time sequence features into an action sequence decoding model for recognition to output action categories and action sequences associated with the action categories; and matching with the to-be-executed machine joint state according to the action category and the action sequence associated with the action category, and if the matching is inconsistent, performing updating operation on the to-be-executed machine joint state according to a matching result. According to the scheme, it is ensured that the motion of the robot is highly consistent with the human motion, and the humanoid degree and motion accuracy of the robot are improved.

title: Trunk structure and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a trunk structure and a robot. The trunk structure comprises an arm part; the trunk body is provided with an opening, and a containing space is formed in the trunk body; the first driving part is rotationally arranged in the accommodating space, and the output end of the first driving part is in transmission connection with the arm part through the opening; and the second driving part is fixedly arranged in the accommodating space and is in transmission connection with the first driving part so as to drive the first driving part to rotate in the accommodating space. Compared with limited arm lifting actions of a traditional'desktop-level 'robot, the trunk structure can drive the arm parts to rotate through the first driving parts so as to simulate arm swinging actions of human beings, further, the first driving parts can be driven to rotate in the containing space through the second driving parts so as to drive the arm parts to rotate, and therefore the arm lifting actions of the robot are simulated. The arm lifting action and the arm swinging action can be carried out at the same time, so that the movement space of the arms is increased, and the interactive experience is better.

title: Polyether-ether-ketone material applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a polyether-ether-ketone material applied to humanoid robots, which is prepared by mixing modified polyether-ether-ketone and modified cellulose and then carrying out ultraviolet irradiation reaction under the action of benzophenone, in the polyether-ether-ketone material molecule, the main chain of the polyether-ether-ketone molecule contains disulfide bond, and the main chain of the polyether-ether-ketone molecule contains disulfide bond. An imine structure is contained between polysiloxane of a main chain and a side chain of a polyether-ether-ketone molecule, boric acid ester is contained between a polysiloxane chain segment and a cellulose molecular chain, then a dynamic cross-linked network is formed in the material molecule, under the action of external force, the dynamic cross-linked network preferentially absorbs energy and breaks, and the dynamic cross-linked network is rapidly recombined and recovered after breaking. Stress is redistributed through recombination bonds in the fracture and recovery process, crack propagation caused by stress concentration is avoided, an organic silicon chain segment contains a flexible-Si-O-framework to be matched with cellulose molecules, the distance between polyether-ether-ketone molecular chains can be increased, the glass-transition temperature can be reduced, the activity of a low-temperature chain segment is improved, and the mechanical property of the polyether-ether-ketone is improved. Therefore, the material still has good toughness in a low-temperature environment.

title: Dynamic behavior generation method, system and equipment of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic behavior generation method, system and device for a humanoid robot and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the dynamic modeling processing of the multi-joint dynamic characteristics of the humanoid robot, and obtaining a multi-joint dynamic model; the robot state of the humanoid robot, the operation state of an operator operating the humanoid robot and environment task information are obtained, and a state parameter set is constructed by fusing the multi-joint dynamic model; a multi-dimensional reward function of the humanoid robot is constructed according to the multi-joint kinetic model; performing strategy optimization processing on the humanoid robot according to the multi-joint kinetic model and the multi-dimensional reward function, and outputting to obtain a dynamic game action conforming to a physical rule; and performing motion control on joints of the humanoid robot according to the dynamic game action. title: Hierarchical intention-driven humanoid robot man-machine interaction system and method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a hierarchical intention-driven humanoid robot man-machine interaction system and a method thereof, relates to the field of man-machine interaction, effectively solves the defects of a deep learning method in long-time task planning, overcomes the limitation of a large-scale pre-training model in the aspect of fine-grained control, and improves the working efficiency. title: Protective anthropomorphic robot joint with lightweight characteristic
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robot wrist joints, in particular to a protection type anthropomorphic robot joint with the light weight characteristic, which comprises a joint support and an end effector mounted on the joint support, and further comprises a first driving assembly and a second driving assembly which are mounted on the joint support in parallel, the driving device is used for driving the end effector to perform freedom-degree motion, the axes of the freedom degrees intersect on the plane, and meanwhile the intersection point is arranged on the central axis of the joint support; and the differential gear box is installed on the joint support, the differential gear box is of a closed structure, a transmission mechanism is arranged in the differential gear box, and the transmission mechanism is connected with the first driving assembly, the second driving assembly and the end effector and used for transmitting driving force of the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly to the end effector. The device provided by the utility model is anthropomorphic; the inertia is low; the stability and the precision are high; modular design is adopted; and the power consumption is low.

title: Robot joint assembly
abstract: The utility model discloses a robot joint assembly which comprises a linear actuator, two rod end joint bearings, three nuts and a connecting rod, a left-hand thread and a right-hand thread are arranged at the two ends of the connecting rod respectively, and the end, provided with the right-hand thread, of the connecting rod is connected with one end of the linear actuator through one nut. The end, provided with the left-hand threads, of the connecting rod is connected with one rod end knuckle bearing through a nut, and the end, away from the connecting rod, of the linear actuator is connected with the other rod end knuckle bearing through a nut. When the robot joint is installed, the linear actuator in the middle is rotated, nuts at the two ends of the linear actuator are locked when the robot joint is adjusted to the needed position, and therefore the purpose of stepless distance adjustment is achieved, the two rod end joint bearings do not need to rotate, and it is guaranteed that the end faces of rod end holes of the two rod end joint bearings are located on the same plane. The joint is suitable for connection of arms, legs, ankles and other parts of a humanoid robot, and seamless connection of any part can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot mechanical eye movement driving mechanism and expression control method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot mechanical eye movement driving mechanism and an expression control method, and belongs to the field of humanoid robotics.The humanoid robot mechanical eye movement driving mechanism is structurally composed of an eyeball assembly, a hollowed-out frame body, a double-shaking driving rod set, a hemispherical cavity middle connecting body, a space movement synchronous child-mother block and a three-dimensional control frame; through cooperative cooperation of the sliding block mechanism, the connecting rod and the spherical pair assembly, horizontal/vertical synchronous rotation of eyeballs and multi-dimensional movement such as eyelid opening and closing can be achieved, and compared with an electric control scheme, the multi-dimensional movement control device has the advantages of being simple, rapid in response, stable in control and the like.

title: Wheelchair humanoid robot based on humanoid mechanical arm control
abstract: The invention discloses a wheelchair humanoid robot controlled by humanoid mechanical arms. The wheelchair humanoid robot comprises a chassis, a robot trunk, the two mechanical arms and a control calculation unit. The chassis comprises four independent driving wheels; a wheelchair seat is arranged on the robot trunk; the mechanical arm is a seven-axis mechanical arm and comprises three tail end joints and an operation tail end. The control calculation unit is provided with an operation control moving mode; in the operation control movement mode, the control calculation unit senses the operation intention of a user on the operation tail end by collecting data of the joint position sensor and the force feedback sensor, generates a movement command of the chassis through mapping of the operation intention, and converts the movement command into a wheel speed control command of the independent driving wheels. The tail end joint of the mechanical arm serves as a sensing and input device, the independent driving wheel chassis serves as an execution device, and the whole system has the advantages of being high in freedom degree, natural in interaction, safe, smooth and high in space adaptability through cooperation of the two devices.

title: Humanoid robot fusion system with autonomous navigation function
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot fusion system with an autonomous navigation function. Comprising a man-machine interaction module, a data acquisition module, a data fusion processing module, a navigation module and a motion control module, the man-machine interaction module is used for receiving a user instruction, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring environment data near the humanoid robot, the data fusion processing module is used for fusing and processing the acquired data, and the navigation module is used for navigation. The navigation module is used for acquiring risk indexes of all obstacles in the environment and generating a moving path of the humanoid robot according to the risk indexes and a user instruction, and the motion control module is used for controlling the humanoid robot. According to the invention, by setting the risk indexes, the method is beneficial to the analysis of the risk conditions of all the shot obstacles, and the obstacles with small risks are removed from the obstacle avoidance process, thereby reducing the complexity of obstacle avoidance calculation.

title: Movement structure and lower limb structure of humanoid biped robot simulating human muscle contraction movement
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a motion structure and a lower limb structure of a humanoid biped robot simulating human muscle contraction movement, which comprise a motion joint formed by rotationally connecting two mechanical arms and a driving component. The human body muscle structure simulation device has the characteristic of high simulation, and can simulate the human body muscle structure, so that the movement is more natural. The rope disc driving system is adopted, the motion mode similar to human muscle contraction can be simulated through fine design and control, and the action of the robot is smoother and more natural. The movable pulley device is arranged at the knee joint part, so that the motor load can be effectively reduced, and the exercise efficiency is improved. The introduction of the movable pulley system not only reduces the power consumption of the motor, but also reduces the mechanical wear of the system, thereby improving the overall performance and service life of the robot.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot comprises a head, a neck, shoulders, a waist, a hip and thighs, the shoulders are provided with arm lifting mechanisms and arm swinging mechanisms, the neck is provided with a head rotating mechanism and a head vertical swinging mechanism, and the waist is provided with a waist rotating mechanism, a front-back bending mechanism and a left-right bending mechanism. And the hip part is provided with a leg inner and outer side rotating mechanism, a thigh inner and outer side swinging mechanism and a thigh front and back swinging mechanism. The arm lifting mechanism comprises a first shoulder motor arranged on the shoulder and a shoulder joint hinged to the shoulder, and the first shoulder motor is in transmission connection with the shoulder joint; the arm swinging mechanism comprises a second shoulder motor arranged on the shoulder joint and an arm hinged to the shoulder joint, the second shoulder motor is in transmission connection with the arm, the head rotating mechanism comprises a first neck motor arranged on the neck and a second neck motor arranged on the shoulder, and the first neck motor is in transmission connection with the head; the neck part is connected with the shoulder part through a rotating shaft; a connecting rod is arranged on the rotating shaft and is in transmission connection with the second neck motor.

title: Joint structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a joint structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The motor has the effect that the motor is not prone to being damaged when the force needing to be borne by the bearing rod is too large.

title: TRANSPORT SYSTEM FOR IN-HOUSE MATERIAL TRANSPORT, COMPRISING A TUGGER TRAIN AND AT LEAST ONE TROLLEY CARRIAGE

title: Motion control method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method and device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the current motion state parameters of a robot in response to a motion control instruction for the robot, and enabling the motion state parameters to comprise the body state parameters and the foot end state parameters of the robot; determining a target centroid trajectory of the robot according to the motion control instruction and the motion state parameters; and controlling the robot to run along the target centroid trajectory. The robot motion control precision can be effectively improved.

title: Self-adaptive control method for humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot adaptive control method and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining parameter data related to an industrial scene; the parameter data comprises environment illumination intensity, task types, movement speed and workpiece precision requirements; determining a target industrial scene type based on the parameter data; the target industrial scene type comprises a high-illumination high-precision assembling scene, a low-illumination inspection scene, a high-speed moving scene or a heavy load carrying scene; generating a linkage control instruction according to the target industrial scene type; in response to the linkage control instruction, the sensor is synchronously controlled to be switched to a corresponding working mode, and the actuator is adjusted to a matched operation parameter; the adjustment priority of the working mode and the adjustment amplitude of the operation parameter have a scene association mapping relationship. The working mode of the sensor and the operation parameters of the actuator are adjusted in real time according to the industrial scene type, higher efficiency is achieved, and dynamic balance between energy consumption optimization and operation precision can be achieved.

title: Automatic telescopic mechanism and wheel arm humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an automatic telescopic mechanism and a wheel arm humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of specialized robots. The moving assembly can stretch up and down relative to the fixed assembly; the driving assembly is used for driving the moving assembly to stretch up and down; the fixing assembly comprises a first-stage fixing pipe; the movement assembly comprises a secondary stroke pipe; the second-stage stroke pipe is provided with a first inner space with one open end, and the upper part of the first-stage fixed pipe is arranged in the first inner space; the driving assembly is arranged on the top of the first-stage fixing pipe and drives the second-stage stroke pipe to stretch out and draw back in the length direction of the first-stage fixing pipe. According to the automatic telescopic mechanism and the wheel-arm humanoid robot, the problems that in the prior art, due to a vertical mast and a lifting bracket of a telescopic structure of a wheel-arm robot and a driving structure adopting a belt type or chain type transmission mode, the whole structure is complex, the size is large, and maintenance is not easy can be effectively solved; and transportation and storage of the wheel-arm robot are not convenient.

title: Output feedback robust control method, system and equipment for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an output feedback robust control method, system and device for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a kinetic model of a robot limb end system, and defining a state variable, a control variable and an output variable; determining a first robust control equation based on a state feedback optimal control principle, the kinetic model and an output feedback controller constructed by the output variables; converting the first robust control equation into a second robust control equation based on a mapping relation between a state variable and an output variable in the kinetic model, determining a to-be-estimated parameter vector according to the second robust control equation, and performing online estimation based on a preset adaptive law to obtain a control gain matrix; a second robust control equation is constructed based on the output variables; and based on the control gain matrix and the output variable obtained in real time, generating a corresponding control variable to be applied to the robot acra joint so as to carry out robust control on the robot acra system.

title: Humanoid robot hand system and method for manipulative therapy integrated training gloves
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm system and method for a manual treatment integrated training glove, and belongs to the technical field of medical robots. The system comprises a humanoid robot hand, a training glove and intelligent terminal application software. The human-shaped robot hand is made by covering a hand skeleton plate with hydrogel to have the elastic touch feeling and appearance highly imitating the human hand, and touch force monitoring, heating and three-dimensional vibration function modules are integrated in the hand; the training glove is integrated with a finger joint bending degree and pose sensor, can be connected with or separated from the robot arm, and supports combined training and remote control training of the robot arm; and the intelligent terminal application software manages data and is connected with the cloud server. The method comprises the steps of collecting manipulation data of a trainer, driving a robot arm to reproduce manipulation, and generating expert-level treatment data by fusing a cloud expert database or large model optimization. According to the invention, digitalization of expert manipulation treatment, high-precision robot reproduction and intelligent improvement are realized, and the robot is suitable for scenes such as tumor edema, stroke rehabilitation, massage physiotherapy relaxation and the like.

According to the invention, digitalization of expert manipulation treatment, high-precision robot reproduction and intelligent improvement are realized, and the robot is suitable for scenes such as tumor edema, stroke rehabilitation, massage physiotherapy relaxation and the like.

title: Multi-modal man-machine interaction optimization system integrating multiple large language models
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal man-machine interaction optimization system integrating multiple large language models, and focuses on the man-machine interaction field of intelligent humanoid robots. And by fusing technologies such as prompt engineering, natural language processing and personalized role configuration, the flexibility, adaptability and personalized level of human-computer interaction are remarkably improved. According to the technology, the advantages of various large language models are utilized, complex dialogue logic is processed, personalized voice, emotion and action feedback matched with human settings, emotions and contexts is generated, and therefore real-time human-computer interaction is optimized. According to the specific implementation, the system comprises a voice awakening unit, a voice recognition unit, a function calling unit, an anthropomorphic dialogue unit, a keyword matching unit and a voice synthesis unit, and finally highly natural and immersive man-machine interaction experience is achieved. The method shows excellent performance in the aspects of speech recognition accuracy, response speed, emotion action representation, personalized interaction and the like, and provides more vivid, immersive and personalized user experience.

title: Model training method, joint safety identification method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method, a humanoid robot joint safety identification method and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: training an unsupervised reward model through a first-stage training set, training a difficult case classification model through a second-stage training set, and carrying out the fine adjustment of the difficult case classification model through a key data set, the joint safety identification model of the humanoid robot is constructed based on a three-stage training framework, the problems of data sparsity and imbalance can be solved, high-precision joint fault probability prediction is realized, the classification capability of the model is enhanced, and the joint safety identification efficiency is improved. The current sensor state data of the humanoid robot is identified through the joint safety identification model after three-stage training, a corresponding joint safety identification result is output, and the joint safety identification efficiency and accuracy of the humanoid robot are improved. title: Bio-rhythm-based humanoid robot walking and running unified control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot walking and running unified control method and system based on a biological rhythm, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. Capturing human walking and running action data, and extracting rhythm features from frequency and phase time domains; constructing a rhythm generator based on the rhythm features extracted in the step 1; according to a strategy gradient method based on a constraint reinforcement learning algorithm, a walking and running unified control strategy is constructed, rhythm information generated based on a rhythm generator is adopted in the walking and running unified control strategy, then action-critic is used for training, a bionic motion control system Walk2Run under speed driving is jointly constructed, natural gait transition and frequency adjustment are achieved, and the walking and running unified control strategy is obtained. And meanwhile, the physical capacity limitation of the robot is met, and motion fluency and energy efficiency are improved. The problems that an existing humanoid robot does not achieve energy optimization of human walking during walking, and mobility of an existing data set has high requirements for the motion ability of the robot and is poor in generalization ability are solved.

title: Biped robot motion control method based on human body motion collaborative analysis
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot motion control method based on human body motion collaborative analysis, belongs to the technical field of robot control, and solves the problem that the motion personification degree of an existing robot is low. Comprising the following steps: pre-collecting and processing human body motion data in different motion scenes, calculating motion primitives and weight coefficients in each motion scene, and putting the motion primitives and the weight coefficients into a primitive database; the state data of the biped robot are collected in real time, the current motion scene of the biped robot is recognized, the expected mass center track and the expected foot end motion track of the biped robot are calculated according to the current motion scene and the primitive database, then a whole-body control algorithm is adopted to execute a plurality of control subtasks, and the optimal joint torque is solved. And the optimal joint torque is converted into a control signal of an actuator, and movement of the biped robot is controlled and tracked. And the movement personification degree of the robot is improved.

title: Special humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a special humanoid robot which comprises a base and a fixing frame fixedly mounted above the base, and further comprises a body slidably mounted in the fixing frame; the vertical groove is formed in one side of the fixing frame; the sliding plate is arranged in the vertical groove in a sliding manner; the transverse plate is fixedly mounted on one side of the sliding plate; the L-shaped plate is fixedly mounted at the top of the transverse plate, and a transverse groove is formed in the L-shaped plate; the vertical plate is arranged in the transverse groove in a sliding manner; the fixed frame is fixedly connected with the top of the vertical plate, and a notch is formed in the fixed frame; the wiping pad is movably mounted in the notch; the driving assembly is arranged on one side of the transverse plate and used for driving the wiping pad to transversely reciprocate; the adjusting assembly is arranged on one side of the fixing frame, and the moving speed of the wiping pad is adjusted by controlling the driving assembly. According to the special humanoid robot provided by the invention, the wiping pad can slide back and forth along the surface of the touch screen through cooperation of a plurality of components such as the rotating rod, the cylinder, the curved groove and the limiting rod, and dust attached to the surface can be removed.

title: Gas regulation and control integrated intelligent humanoid robot with body and autonomous service method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent humanoid robot integrating gas regulation and control and provided with a body and an autonomous service method of the intelligent humanoid robot. The intelligent humanoid robot comprises a wheel type chassis walking mechanism, a trunk structure, a double-arm structure and a head structure. A lifting stand column leg mechanism is arranged above the wheel type chassis walking mechanism, and a robot trunk structure simulating the upper body of the human body is installed on the lifting stand column leg mechanism. A robot head structure is arranged at the top end of the robot trunk mechanism, and an air channel pipeline connected with the chest, a camera and a sound box are arranged in the head structure. The robot arm mechanisms are installed on the two sides of the robot trunk mechanism, and the five-finger dexterous hand is installed at the tail end of a mechanical arm of each robot arm mechanism. title: Petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot trajectory planning method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot trajectory planning method, device and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: collecting petrochemical environment gas concentration data, robot joint motion parameters and target position information, carrying out the dangerous region calibration of the gas concentration data, generating a forbidden map, and determining safety nodes and joint motion ranges; constructing an initial path skeleton based on target position information and safety node distribution, identifying a local dangerous section and a major dangerous section, and generating a motion constraint condition and a poison avoidance path; generating a motion primitive library based on the motion constraint condition and the joint motion range, performing stability filtering to generate stable motion primitives, and forming an advancing scheme set; acquiring a joint load peak value to construct a dynamic envelope, and judging execution fitness to form an execution probability field; and constructing a three-dimensional decision space based on the poison avoidance path, the advancing scheme set and the execution probability field, searching an optimal convergence point to generate a final planning trajectory, and providing a safe and efficient trajectory planning scheme for the petrochemical explosion-proof humanoid robot.

abstract: This hip joint of a humanoid robot comprises: a first actuator that includes a first rotating part formed so as to rotate about a first rotation axis; a second actuator that is connected to the first rotating part and includes a second rotating part formed so as to rotate about a second rotation axis inclined with respect to the first rotation axis; and a third actuator that is connected to the second rotating part and includes a third rotating part formed so as to rotate about a third rotation axis inclined with respect to the second rotation axis.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom bionic arm of humanoid robot
abstract: A multi-degree-of-freedom bionic arm of a humanoid robot belongs to the technical field of robots, and seven degrees of freedom of the robot arm are formed by a shoulder swing arm rotating mechanism, a shoulder left-right swing arm rotating mechanism, a big arm axial rotating mechanism, an elbow rotating mechanism, a small arm axial rotating mechanism, a wrist rotating mechanism and a wrist inner drive rotating mechanism. Holes and grooves are formed in the elbow part for laying cables, the cables are not exposed, and the shell size of the elbow joint is reduced. And the cable does not run about when the elbow moves in a large range, so that interference with other parts is avoided. A connecting rod mechanism composed of a first output disc, two connecting rods and a second output disc is arranged on the side face, the load inertia of a forearm joint, a whole arm force arm and the tail end is reduced, and the arm load capacity and motion performance are improved; the wrist drives the front-back and left-right freedom degree axes of the hand to coincide at one point, and the flexibility of the wrist is improved. Due to seven degrees of freedom, the robot is more bionic, the degrees of freedom are also on the same straight line after the arms of a person are straightened laterally, and the movement offset is small.

The other end of the wiring cable is used for being in electric connection and signal connection with the humanoid robot. title: Power management method and device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a power management method. The power management method comprises the following steps: S1, receiving collected detection data; s2, comparing the current data and the voltage data with a normal working threshold range, and marking data exceeding the range; s3, when a preset number of continuous sampling periods detect that the current data is greater than the normal working threshold range, or the preset number of continuous sampling periods detect that the voltage data is lower than the normal working threshold range, generating an abnormal signal; and S4, abnormal detection noise data which are triggered and collected by the abnormal noise detection signal are received, feature recognition is carried out on the abnormal detection noise data, a judgment result is generated, and the judgment result is sent to the main controller, so that the main controller generates a corresponding power control signal after receiving the judgment result. The invention further discloses a power management device and the humanoid robot. Compared with the prior art, efficient, accurate and anti-interference energy management is realized.

title: Butt joint method for humanoid robot and mobile vehicle
abstract: The invention discloses a butt joint method for a humanoid robot and a mobile vehicle. The butt joint method comprises the following steps that S1, the humanoid robot advances to the front of the mobile vehicle; s2, the foot sole is lifted, so that the outer side end extends into the positions below the three elastic pieces and the stopping blocks of the corresponding side plates in a downward inclined mode; s3, the other foot sole is lifted up, the action of the step S2 is repeated, and the two foot soles are preliminarily clamped on the vehicle body; and S4, the outer side ends of the two foot soles tilt upwards by a set angle at the same time, the foot soles are mechanically locked on the vehicle body, and the three elastic pieces are in contact fit with the three electrode pieces on the foot soles correspondingly. According to the passive mobile vehicle, the two processes of mechanical locking and electrical connection are ingeniously combined into a whole through the'probing-upwarping 'type butt joint action, stable carrying, direct power supply and accurate control of the humanoid robot on the passive mobile vehicle are achieved through the simplest structure, and the technical problems of system redundancy, high cost and complex butt joint in the prior art are solved.

title: Easily detached and replaced motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of motor disassembly and assembly, in particular to an easy-to-replace motor for a humanoid robot, and the easy-to-replace motor for the humanoid robot comprises a motor body; the motor body is arranged in the mounting plate, a first mounting hole is formed in the top of the mounting plate, a first mounting groove is formed in the bottom of the mounting plate, a communicating hole is formed in the bottom wall forming the first mounting hole, the two ends of the communicating hole communicate with the first mounting hole and the first mounting groove correspondingly, and the motor body is provided with a rotating shaft; the outer wall of the motor body is also provided with two oppositely arranged first guide blocks; a limiting cover; the pressing assembly is arranged in the first mounting hole, and the limiting cover is matched with the first mounting groove; and the two linkage assemblies are both arranged in the first mounting groove. title: Humanoid robot compliant collaborative carrying method and system based on virtual safety mechanism
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot carrying, and discloses a humanoid robot compliant collaborative carrying method and system based on a virtual safety mechanism, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the automatic recognition of a to-be-carried object, and carrying out the precise positioning of a spatial position; calculating the position of the optimal space contact point of the carrying action executed by the two-arm end executors of the humanoid robot based on the identification and positioning results of the to-be-carried object and the like; performing dynamic posture fine adjustment on the position of the optimal space contact point, generating a motion track of the humanoid robot from an initial state to completion of a carrying task, and constructing a virtual space constraint domain; interaction force feedback information between the humanoid robot and the environment and between the humanoid robot and the object to be carried is continuously sensed, and the motion posture and action force of the two arms of the humanoid robot are dynamically adjusted in real time. Through visual sense and force sense cross-modal perception fusion and high-reliability low-delay communication guarantee, smooth anti-collision control in the carrying process is achieved, and synchronous optimization of safety and operation efficiency is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method based on visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot navigation, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot navigation method based on visual semantic segmentation and radar obstacle detection, which comprises the following steps: synchronously acquiring an RGB image and a depth image of a current environment of a humanoid robot by using a visual sensor, and acquiring point cloud data by using a laser radar; performing semantic segmentation on the preprocessed RGB image; radar point cloud obstacle detection; fusing the semantic segmentation map and the laser point cloud map, introducing a Bayesian decision to judge whether the laser point cloud map is passable or not, and then calculating a fusion cost value to obtain a fusion cost map; adopting an RRT */TEB algorithm to output an optimal path; using a nonlinear optimization solver to generate a foothold sequence accurate to each step; according to the method, a semantic-geometric two-dimensional navigation cost model is constructed; bayesian reasoning is deeply bound with a navigation scene, so that the navigation adaptability of an unstructured environment is improved; the navigation method is suitable for the humanoid robot, and is low in energy consumption, low in navigation deviation and high in safety.

title: Trunk structure and robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a trunk structure and a robot, and the trunk structure comprises a trunk body which is internally provided with a containing space; the arm parts are movably connected with the trunk body; and the driving part is arranged in the accommodating space, is in transmission connection with the arm part, and drives the arm part to rotate relative to the trunk body by taking the first shaft as the axis, and/or drives the arm part to rotate relative to the trunk body by taking the second shaft as the axis. Compared with the limited arm lifting action of a traditional'desktop-level 'robot, the trunk structure can drive the arm parts to rotate with the first shaft as the axis through the driving parts so as to simulate the arm swinging action of human beings, further, the trunk structure can drive the arm parts to rotate with the second shaft as the axis through the driving parts so as to simulate the arm lifting action of human beings, and the robot can be understood; the arm lifting action and the arm swinging action can be carried out at the same time, so that the movement space of the arms is increased, and interaction experience is good.

title: All-humanoid robot motion redirection method and device based on motion capture equipment
abstract: The invention relates to an all-humanoid robot motion redirection method and device based on motion capture equipment, and the method comprises the steps: converting a human body posture quaternion collected by the motion capture equipment into a rotation matrix, and achieving the precise mapping from a Cartesian space to a robot joint space in combination with an Euler angle decomposition strategy; a quaternion-disassembled joint angle is used as an initial solution, various physical constraints are introduced in real time according to the actual supporting state of the robot, and the lower limb joint angle is corrected online by constructing and solving an inverse kinematics problem with various constraints, so that the robot reproduces the action of an operator, and the joint angle of the lower limb can be corrected online. And the requirements of joint limiting, self-collision avoidance, dynamic balance and the like are strictly met, so that the accuracy of motion simulation and the stability of the system are effectively unified.

title: Gear reducer for humanoid robot and use method of gear reducer
abstract: The invention discloses a gear reducer for a humanoid robot and a using method of the gear reducer, and relates to the technical field of transmission instruments. The gear reducer comprises a rear seat assembly, and the rear seat assembly comprises a base mechanism; a sun gear mechanism is arranged at the head end of the base mechanism and comprises a main shaft fixedly connected with the rotating shaft in an inserted mode. A planet wheel mechanism is arranged at the head end of the rear seat assembly and comprises an outer sleeve fixedly connected with the base, and a gear ring is fixedly connected to the middle of the inner side of the outer sleeve; planet wheel assemblies are evenly meshed between the sun wheel mechanism and the gear ring at equal intervals. The spindle is fixedly sleeved with a shaft sleeve, clamping protrusions are evenly and fixedly connected to the outer side of the shaft sleeve at equal intervals, and spring washers are fixedly connected to the two circumferential sides of each clamping protrusion in an embedded mode respectively. The head end of the shaft sleeve is sleeved with a first bevel gear; and the tail end of the shaft sleeve is sleeved with a second bevel gear, second teeth are evenly and fixedly connected to the outer side of the second bevel gear at equal intervals, the gear return difference is reduced, and the rotation precision is improved.

title: Waist structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the waist structure of the humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, the universal joint structure is adopted in the waist structure, so that no matter how the robot tilts back and forth, swings left and right, rotates and the like, the three central axes of the pitching motion, the rolling motion and the side navigation motion intersect at one point all the time; due to the compact waist structure, when the waist of the robot moves, the sweeping space of the movement is small, and the working space occupied by the movement of the waist of the robot can be reduced; furthermore, two-degree-of-freedom movement (pitching movement and rolling movement) of the robot is achieved under the combined action of the two crank and rocker structures and the constraint of a waist universal joint, the waist universal joint is a constraint branch chain, the two crank and rocker structures are main transmission branch chains, and the movement of the branch chains is mutually constrained. The motion errors of all the branch chains are mutually constrained, so that the accumulated error of the motion of all the branch chains is low, and the motion precision of the thoracic cavity bottom plate can be improved.

title: Robot control method and system
abstract: The invention provides a robot control method and system. The method comprises the steps that hand posture information is obtained based on a first positioning device, and body posture information is obtained based on a second positioning device; according to the hand position and posture information and the body position and posture information, whether the relative posture of the hand relative to the body is changed or not is determined; if yes, the active pose transformation amount of the hand relative to the body is calculated according to the hand pose information and the body pose information, and the target chassis pose of the movable chassis is calculated according to the hand pose information and the body pose information; calculating a target mechanical arm pose of the mechanical arm according to the active pose transformation amount; and according to the target mechanical arm pose and the target chassis pose, a first control instruction and a second control instruction are generated correspondingly. Decoupling control over the mechanical arm and the chassis is achieved, and the stability and accuracy of whole-body control of the robot are improved.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a biped robot which comprises a hip joint component and a robot body component. The thigh component is rotationally connected to the hip joint component; the shank component is rotationally connected to the thigh component through a knee joint rotating shaft; the driving part is arranged on the thigh component and used for driving the hip joint to swing and driving the shank component to swing; the transmission part is arranged on the thigh component and used for distributing the torque output by the driving part to the hip joint component and the shank component. Through the arrangement, the power density of the driving part can be improved, enough instantaneous moment and speed can be provided for the hip joint component or the shank component according to the use scene, and the dynamic ability of the biped robot is improved. The size of a motor does not need to be additionally increased, a gear box does not need to provide large driving torque, the overall weight of the biped robot is reduced, inertia loads are reduced, movement flexibility is improved, the overall appearance is light, and the attractiveness degree is improved.

title: Robot control method and system and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot control method and system and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that a speed control instruction and action data of a reference object are obtained, the speed control instruction is used for controlling a moving mode to be adopted in a first moving area of the robot with the preset form, and the first moving area comprises the lower limbs and the waist of the robot with the preset form; the action data is used for determining actions to be executed in a second activity area of the preset form robot, and the second activity area comprises upper limbs of the preset form robot; based on the speed control instruction and the action data, determining a whole-body hybrid control mode of the robot in the preset form; and the robot in the preset form is controlled according to the whole-body mixed control mode. The technical problem that control precision and response flexibility are difficult to consider at the same time when robot control is carried out in the prior art is solved.

title: Mouth shape synchronization method, device and equipment of bionic robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a mouth shape synchronization method and device of a bionic robot, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of man-machine interaction, and the method comprises the steps: after a target dialogue instruction is received, generating reply content for current dialogue content through a preset language large model, and carrying out the analysis, so as to convert the reply content into target audio data, a mouth shape synchronization task is generated for the target audio data; splitting the mouth shape synchronization task into a plurality of corresponding expression tasks and mouth shape tasks according to the total playing duration corresponding to the target audio data, and adding the expression tasks and the mouth shape tasks into a task queue; processing tasks in the task queue based on a preset task execution frequency while playing the target audio data, determining a target expression frame corresponding to the expression task and a target pixel frame corresponding to the mouth shape task based on a preset expression library, and performing fusion processing to determine motor angles corresponding to a plurality of motors, the motors are controlled through the motor angles, and mouth shape synchronization of the bionic robot is carried out.

title: Automatic hand-eye calibration method for humanoid robot
abstract: According to the full-automatic humanoid robot hand-eye calibration method, a mechanical arm moves to multiple visual angles according to a preset track, and nine feature points of a calibration plate completely appear in the visual field of a camera. A depth camera synchronously collects an RGB image and a depth map, two-dimensional coordinates of feature points are extracted through a visual algorithm, and a three-dimensional point cloud is generated in combination with depth information. Based on the two-dimensional-three-dimensional corresponding relation, internal parameters, external parameters and a coordinate transformation matrix of the camera are calculated; and the system automatically evaluates calibration errors, intelligently adjusts the pose of the mechanical arm, repeatedly collects data, and iteratively optimizes parameters until the precision requirement is met. According to the method, a closed-loop calibration system of'motion-acquisition-calculation-evaluation-adjustment 'is innovatively constructed, and unattended high-precision calibration is realized. Compared with a traditional method, the method has the advantages of being high in automation degree, high in adaptability, good in stability and the like, the calibration efficiency and precision are remarkably improved, and reliable technical support is provided for large-scale application of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot frameless torque motor cogging back electromotive force testing device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of counter electromotive force testing, in particular to a humanoid robot frameless torque motor cogging counter electromotive force testing device which comprises a composite protection transmission mechanism arranged between a servo motor and a torque sensor, and the composite protection transmission mechanism is used for transmitting power between the servo motor and the torque sensor. The composite protection transmission mechanism comprises a main transmission disc, a transmission block assembly, an adjustable driven disc assembly and a movement compensation coupling assembly. Double safety protection is achieved through ultraspeed centrifugal breaking and overload shearing breaking of the composite protection transmission mechanism, the abnormal overspeed threshold value is flexibly adjusted by means of the adjustable driven disc assembly so as to adapt to a multi-rotating-speed detection scene, and axial movement is counteracted by means of the movement compensation coupling assembly so that the detection precision of the cogging torque and the counter electromotive force can be ensured.

abstract: The utility model provides a facial expression control device for a humanoid robot. The device comprises a head shell, the head shell is sequentially provided with an eyebrow control device, an eye control device and a mouth control device from top to bottom, and the eyebrow control device, the eye control device and the mouth control device are all driven by independent driving devices. The utility model relates to the field of robots.

title: Humanoid robot safety communication method in industrial scene and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot safety communication method in an industrial scene and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: a robot end generates a corresponding robot private key and a robot public key, and distributes a robot certificate based on the robot public key to a control end through an industrial authentication center; a control end certificate distributed by the industrial authentication center is received through the robot end, and the control end certificate is generated based on the control end public key; presenting a three-dimensional graphic code of first signature information about the certificate of the control end through the robot end, wherein the three-dimensional graphic code is used for being read and verified by the control end; the robot end signs the test data through a robot private key, encrypts a control end certificate to generate test information, and sends the test information to the control end; and generating a session key based on key negotiation of the two parties. Physical layer verification security is enhanced through the three-dimensional graphic code, and in combination with an end-to-end encryption mechanism, the communication security problem of multi-robot cooperation in an industrial scene is solved.

title: Robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot. The robot comprises a moving assembly suitable for enabling the robot to move in multiple directions; a torso assembly coupled to the moving assembly and adjustable in height relative to the moving assembly, the torso assembly including a shoulder joint portion and a neck joint portion; the bionic double arms comprise a left arm and a right arm, the left arm and the right arm are movably coupled to the two sides of the trunk assembly through shoulder joint parts so as to achieve three-degree-of-freedom movement relative to the trunk assembly, and the left arm and the right arm each comprise an elbow joint part and a wrist joint part; a large arm mechanism and a small arm mechanism coupled via the elbow joint portion to rotate relative to each other about an axis of the elbow joint portion; the execution component is coupled to the tail end, away from the large arm mechanism, of the small arm mechanism through the wrist joint part so as to achieve three-freedom-degree movement relative to the small arm mechanism; the head part is coupled to the top end of the trunk assembly through the neck joint part and located between the bionic double arms, and the head part is suitable for carrying out two-degree-of-freedom movement relative to the trunk assembly.

title: Humanoid bionic robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid bionic robot. The humanoid bionic robot comprises a moving assembly suitable for being driven to move on the ground; the trunk assembly is arranged on the side, away from the ground, of the moving assembly and is suitable for ascending and descending in the height direction; the bionic double arms are arranged at the end, away from the moving assembly, of the trunk assembly, comprise a left arm and a right arm which are arranged on the two opposite sides of the trunk assembly respectively and are suitable for executing a preset operation task; the acquisition equipment is suitable for acquiring environment information of a surrounding environment; and the control module is coupled to the acquisition equipment and is suitable for acquiring environment information to control at least one of the moving assembly, the trunk assembly and the bionic double arms to act. Therefore, the accuracy of executing the preset action by the humanoid bionic robot can be improved, and the cruising ability of the humanoid bionic robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot self-adaptive clamping jaw grabbing device based on visual feedback
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial robots, and provides a humanoid robot self-adaptive clamping jaw grabbing device based on visual feedback, the grabbing device comprises a visual feedback module, a clamping jaw control module and a mechanical arm provided with a clamping jaw, and the mechanical arm comprises a plurality of joints; the visual feedback module is used for carrying out fine-grained object classification on the environment information through an improved YOLOv7 model and sending the shape type and the three-dimensional pose of an object to be grabbed to the clamping jaw control module; the clamping jaw control module is used for receiving the shape type and the three-dimensional pose of the to-be-grabbed object sent by the visual feedback module, controlling the mechanical arm to move by adopting a low space occupation configuration strategy, and generating a collision-free track of the clamping jaw from the initial position to the to-be-grabbed object; and when the clamping jaw approaches the object to be grabbed, the clamping jaw is controlled to move within the speed threshold range, and when the clamping jaw makes contact with the object to be grabbed, the clamping force of the clamping jaw is restrained based on the clamping force of the clamping jaw, the shape type of the object and the three-dimensional pose.

title: Humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model training method, prediction method and equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model training method, a humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model prediction method and humanoid robot joint motor driving performance model equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source data; the multi-source data comprises static parameter sample data, dynamic parameter sample data, driving performance sample data and joint motion mode parameter sample data of the joint motor; establishing a multi-dimensional data set associated with the joint movement mode according to the multi-source data; setting a regression model; training the regression model according to the multi-dimensional data set to obtain driving performance prediction data; and adjusting parameters of the regression model according to the driving performance sample data and the driving performance prediction data to obtain a target model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the problems of low joint motor driving performance measurement efficiency, poor dynamic adaptability and high maintenance cost of the humanoid robot can be solved, and accurate performance prediction and optimal control based on data driving are realized.

title: Double-arm wheel train humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a double-arm wheel train humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment, the double-arm wheel train humanoid robot comprises a chassis, the chassis comprises a driving wheel and a steering wheel; the trunk part comprises lower limb sections, upper limb sections and inductors, the upper limb sections are installed on the chassis in a lifting mode through the lower limb sections, and the inductors are arranged at the highest positions of the upper limb sections. Through the arrangement of the chassis, the trunk part and the two execution pieces, full-automatic replenishment is carried out on different kinds of goods on the goods shelf of the supermarket and the supermarket, the mechanical arms of the execution pieces can adapt to clamping for boxed goods, bottled goods and hanging goods, all old goods are taken out of the goods shelf together, and the labor intensity of workers is reduced. The new goods are supplemented to the rear side of the goods shelf through the other execution part, and then the old goods are placed on the front side of the new goods, so that the goods selling period is prevented from being too long.

title: Humanoid robot decision interaction method, system and equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot decision interaction method, system and device and a medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining industrial sensor data; inputting the industrial sensor data into a multi-modal large model for environment evaluation processing to obtain an industrial environment evaluation result; inputting the industrial sensor data into an anomaly recognition model according to the industrial environment evaluation result to obtain an anomaly recognition result; inputting the industrial sensor data and the anomaly recognition result into the multi-modal large model for strategy generation processing to obtain an interaction strategy; and performing interaction control on the humanoid robot according to the interaction strategy. The decision interaction efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: Double-speed-reduction hip module and anti-explosion humanoid robot composed of double-speed-reduction hip module
abstract: The invention provides a double-speed-reduction hip module and an anti-explosion humanoid robot composed of the double-speed-reduction hip module, and belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing. The double-speed-reduction hip module comprises a hip base, a hip driving motor is fixedly installed on the hip base, the output end of the hip driving motor is connected with a synchronous belt transmission assembly, and a synchronous belt is in meshing transmission connection with the double-speed-reduction module; the double-speed-reduction module comprises a harmonic reducer, a middle transmission assembly and a planetary reducer which are sequentially and coaxially connected in series and fixed, the input end of the harmonic reducer is connected with a reducer end synchronizing wheel, and the output end of the harmonic reducer is connected with the input end of the planetary reducer through the middle transmission assembly; the total reduction ratio of the harmonic reducer to the planetary reducer is 1: 600; the harmonic reducer and the planetary reducer are coaxially connected in series, the planetary reducer enhances the torque output stability through meshing of the planetary gear train, the load limit of a traditional single-reducer hip module is broken through, and the requirements for heavy carrying and large-torque pitching control in the anti-explosion environment are met.

title: Suspended adjustable heavy-load omni-directional chassis and anti-explosion humanoid robot composed of suspended adjustable heavy-load omni-directional chassis
abstract: The invention provides a suspension adjustable heavy-load omni-directional chassis and an anti-explosion humanoid robot composed of the suspension adjustable heavy-load omni-directional chassis, and belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing. The omni-directional chassis comprises a chassis frame and a modular mounting frame, four sets of chassis wheel trains are symmetrically distributed at the bottom of the chassis frame, and each chassis wheel train comprises a suspension assembly connected with the chassis frame; the suspension assembly is hinged to a wheel train structure assembly, a steering driving assembly is installed at the top of the wheel train structure assembly, a walking driving assembly is installed at the bottom of the wheel train structure assembly, and the output end of the walking driving assembly is connected with wheels. And an explosion-proof and control module is integrated on the chassis frame. The explosion-proof and control module comprises an explosion-proof battery and an explosion-proof module, and supports a remote cabin and remote controller dual-control mode; through suspension dynamic adjustment, drive chain decoupling design and explosion-proof modular integration, dynamic adjustment of the ground clearance and omni-directional movement can be achieved, and safety and usability of quick release can be guaranteed.

title: Bionic machine monkey
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a bionic robot monkey which comprises a simulation body, a sensing detection assembly, a simulation assembly and a control system. The sensing detection assembly is used for collecting feature information of a natural monkey, and the control system is used for obtaining the feature information, sending the feature information to the terminal device, receiving a posture adjustment instruction from the terminal device, controlling the simulation body to adjust the posture to a target posture, and receiving a simulation stimulation instruction from the terminal device. And controlling the simulation component to output the biological simulation information. The bionic machine monkey disclosed by the invention can simulate a natural monkey to the greatest extent, can be hidden in a natural monkey group, can stimulate the natural monkey and observe the stress response of the natural monkey while acquiring the characteristic information of the natural monkey, and can be used as a limb driven recarving device of an experimenter to realize interaction and behavior guidance with the natural monkey; and the information interaction between experimenters and the natural monkeys is well assisted.

title: Humanoid robot fault analysis method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot fault analysis method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal fault data of a humanoid robot; inputting the multi-modal fault data into a fault analysis model to obtain a fault analysis result output by the fault analysis model; wherein the fault analysis model is jointly constructed on the basis of a feature extraction model, a semantic analysis model and a fusion analysis model. According to the method, fusion analysis is carried out on the multi-modal data through the fault analysis model, automatic fault analysis can be realized, the fault analysis efficiency and accuracy of the humanoid robot are improved, and thus the use requirements of users are effectively met.

title: Humanoid robot structure with balance folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot structure with a balance folding and unfolding parasitic mechanism. The humanoid robot structure comprises a head, arm parts, a trunk, buttocks, legs and feet. The robot is characterized in that the buttocks and the legs are combined through double X-shaped parasitic branch chains, the two X-shaped branch chains are arranged in parallel, electric drive modules are arranged in the centers of the X-shaped branch chains respectively, and the axis is staggered to avoid the singular point problem. The electric drive module drives the branch chains to open and close synchronously, folding and unfolding actions are achieved, and the movement range can reach 360 degrees. A 10-degree inclined included angle is formed between the legs and the horizontal plane, front-back and left-right self-balance is achieved in cooperation with the crotch telescopic capacity, and the motor driving torque and dependence on an algorithm are remarkably reduced. The feet are connected with the soles through the electric drive modules to adapt to complex terrains. The problem that a traditional folding and unfolding mechanism is stuck or out of control at a singular point is solved, the dynamic stability and running capacity of the robot are improved, and the stepping distance can reach four times that of a common design.

title: Angle limiting structure, mechanical ankle mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an angle limiting structure, a mechanical ankle mechanism and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot design, the angle limiting structure comprises a walking assembly comprising a supporting piece and a walking piece; the rotating assembly is rotationally fixed to the supporting piece in the first direction and rotationally fixed to the walking piece in the second direction perpendicular to the first direction; and the driving assembly comprises a pair of driving pieces distributed in the third direction parallel to the first direction, and the pair of driving pieces are movably connected to the walking pieces correspondingly. The mechanical ankle mechanism has the advantages that the mechanical ankle mechanism is applied to the humanoid robot, so that the humanoid robot can simulate gaits of a person in the walking process, and the mechanical ankle mechanism is more balanced and stable compared with a mechanical ankle mechanism; and meanwhile, self-adaptive adjustment can be carried out according to various terrains on the basis that the bearing capacity and rigidity of the structure are stable, the static stable support of the structure is maintained, and the dynamic stable support between the structures is enhanced.

title: Joint motor module and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a joint motor module and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the joint motor module comprises a motor assembly, the motor assembly comprises a motor housing, a motor cover body, a motor stator and a motor rotor shaft, the motor cover body is connected with the motor housing and seals an opening at one side of an accommodating cavity; the harmonic reducer is connected with the motor shell and seals the opening in the other side of the containing cavity. The motor has the advantages that the motor stator can generate a variable magnetic field so that the motor rotor shaft can rotate, power is output by the harmonic output flange through the speed reduction assembly of the harmonic reducer, compared with the prior art, the control precision is high, torque output is large, meanwhile, the harmonic reducer is directly connected with the motor shell, the structure is compact, and cost is low. The length and the size of the joint module are effectively reduced, and the appearance size is further reduced on the premise that the control precision is guaranteed.

title: Rolling-walking module
abstract: The subject of the application is a walk-rolling module intended for a mobile robot, a humanoid robot, or multi-legged tracked systems. The walk-rolling module is characterized in that the foot of the lower limb of the humanoid robot is permanently seated in a tie attached to a base. In this case, the base is rotatably connected to the support frame via a pin inserted into the holes of the support frame and the base. In the front part of the support frame, which has a fork shape, an axis is mounted on which a drive assembly driven by a motor mounted on this axis is rotatably supported. The drive motor housing in the shape of a disc is permanently connected to a three-arm hub rotating at a rotational speed ůs, causing the walk-rolling module to move in the direction v. The three-arm hub is characterized in that it has three arms evenly distributed around the circumference, ending in forks. In the fork holes of the arms of the three-arm hub, axes are mounted on which traveling wheels equipped with a ratchet mechanism are symmetrically mounted on both sides. The gear wheel of the ratchet mechanism is permanently connected to the axis and can be locked by a pawl rotatably mounted on the side surface of the traveling wheel (11).

title: Humanoid robot based on visual identification and working method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on visual recognition and a working method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the humanoid robot comprises a robot chest, a robot head is rotatably arranged at the top of the robot chest, big arm driving parts are rotatably arranged on the two sides of the robot chest, and robot big arms are rotatably arranged at the bottoms of the two big arm driving parts; forearm driving parts are rotatably arranged at the bottoms of the two robot big arms, robot forearms are rotatably arranged at the bottoms of the two forearm driving parts, robot hands are rotatably arranged at the bottoms of the two robot forearms, and a first telescopic rod is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the robot chest. title: Point cloud data processing method, system and equipment of humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a point cloud data processing method, system and device of a humanoid robot and a medium. The method comprises the steps that motion state parameters of the robot and collected initial point cloud data are obtained; performing dynamic sampling processing on the robot according to the motion state parameters and the initial point cloud data to generate a projection image; performing multi-channel feature extraction and dynamic weight fusion processing on the projection image to obtain a coding feature map; performing multi-scale residual error coding processing on the coding feature map according to information theory constraints to obtain coding data; and performing reconstruction processing on the coded data according to the motion state parameters to obtain reconstructed point cloud data. The embodiment of the invention can improve the processing efficiency of the point cloud data, and can be widely applied to the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot motion control method based on footprint planning, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing a strategy network which comprises an input layer, two serial circulation hidden layers, and a linear output layer; designing a reward function; then, based on a reward function, a mujoo simulation platform is used for training the constructed strategy network, the posture and the terrain of the robot are initialized, and different footstep sequences are preset for different terrains; updating the policy network by using a PPO algorithm; and carrying out motion control on the humanoid machine by utilizing the trained strategy network. Under the condition that a target footstep sequence is known, cross-terrain stable walking is realized through a strategy network and a sliding window observation mechanism, and closed-loop control from environmental understanding to action generation is realized; the designed reward function can effectively guide the robot to form stable and natural gait behaviors, and the trained strategy network can be directly migrated to an actual robot platform.
