title: Agricultural machine control method, device and equipment based on humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an agricultural machine control method, device and equipment based on a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: respectively constructing a first optimization function corresponding to a steering wheel and a second optimization function corresponding to a pedal by taking the steering wheel of the agricultural machine as a first base system and the pedal of the agricultural machine as a second base system, solving the first optimization function to obtain a steering wheel control prediction parameter, and solving the second optimization function to obtain a pedal control prediction parameter. Control decoupling is carried out on control of a steering wheel and a pedal of the humanoid robot in an agricultural machinery driving scene, a first optimization function and a second optimization function are established according to the steering wheel and the pedal of the agricultural machinery respectively, mutual interference of the steering wheel and the pedal on control logic is avoided, and the robot can independently optimize control strategies of two key operation components; and the overall control efficiency is improved. In addition, independent optimization can also avoid center-of-gravity shift caused by cooperative action, and it is ensured that the robot is kept stable in the agricultural machinery driving operation process.

title: Humanoid robot three-dimensional complex environment navigation method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot three-dimensional complex environment navigation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of robot navigation. Comprises: obtaining a random path node; constructing a collision detection model according to the gait cycle of the robot; detecting whether the random path node passes collision detection by using a collision detection model; if not, deleting the random path node, and obtaining the random path node again; otherwise, adding the random path nodes into the random tree; for each node added to the random tree, collision detection and plane size detection at the node are carried out, and when the detection is passed, candidate nodes are added to a global path point sequence; screening the sequence according to the complexity of the current plane to obtain complex region path nodes and flat region path nodes; and corresponding motion instructions are generated according to the operation requirements of the robot on the path nodes in the different areas. According to the method, the dynamic envelope space calculation cost is reduced, and the global path planning accuracy is improved.

title: Multipurpose interactive humanoid robot, system and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-purpose interactive humanoid robot, a system and a control method.The multi-purpose interactive humanoid robot comprises a robot body provided with a head, a trunk, bionic arms, a waist and legs from top to bottom, a main control device used for controlling the robot body is arranged in the trunk, wrist parts are arranged at the ends of the bionic arms, and the robot body is connected with the robot body. The wrist part is connected with a clamping jaw, the head part, the wrist part and/or the waist part are/is provided with a visual guidance and mechanical action implementation device which is used for scanning and code reading, visual identification, accurate positioning and cooperative grabbing and is connected with the main control device, and the clamping jaw can selectively hold an auxiliary tool matched with the clamping jaw according to an application scene. The multi-purpose interactive humanoid robot can meet the requirements of various industrial scenes and civil scenes at the same time.

title: Ankle joint system of three-degree-of-freedom line-driven humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom linear drive humanoid robot ankle joint system, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot precision joint driving. The system comprises three torque output units fixed to a shank frame in a concentrated mode, four sets of independent transmission cables, an actively-driven toe joint structure and a dynamic tensioning structure. Through deployment of an overhead driving unit, design of a precision line transmission path and integration of a toe driving framework, three-degree-of-freedom cooperative movement of ankle introversion/extroversion, heel dorsiflexion/plantar flexion and toe dorsiflexion/plantar flexion is realized; according to the invention, the defects of lack of active toe joints, heavy structure and large tail end inertia in the prior art are overcome, the active toe joint has the characteristics of compact structure, light weight and low inertia, the dynamic response performance, the energy efficiency and the terrain adaptability of the robot can be obviously improved, and the active toe joint is suitable for high-dynamic motion scenes.

title: Solid hydrogen energy system and hydrogen-powered humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solid hydrogen energy, in particular to a solid hydrogen energy system and a hydrogen-powered humanoid robot. The solid hydrogen energy system comprises a solid hydrogen storage module, a hydrogen conveying module, a hydrogen fuel cell module, a data acquisition module, a motion control module and an energy management module, the hydrogen flow, the environmental parameters and the motion state of the robot are monitored in real time through the data acquisition module, the follow-up motion state of the robot is generated in combination with the motion control module, and an adjustment instruction is transmitted to the energy management module based on the motion state; the energy management module dynamically adjusts operation parameters of the solid hydrogen storage module, the hydrogen conveying module and the hydrogen fuel cell module based on an adjustment instruction input by the motion control module, so that efficient operation of the solid hydrogen energy system and reasonable distribution of energy are ensured; when the solid hydrogen energy system provided by the technical scheme is used for supplying energy to the hydrogen-powered humanoid robot, the energy conversion efficiency is higher, and the coordination with a robot motion control system is better.

title: Wheel-foot humanoid robot operation control method and system based on maneuverability optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot humanoid robot operation control method and system based on maneuverability optimization, and relates to the technical field of robot intelligent control. According to a mechanical arm tail end trajectory tracking task and mechanical arm joint motion constraints, a weight matrix is calculated in a self-adaptive mode through state vectors of a base and a mechanical arm joint; a robot dynamic model is constructed, and the tail end contact force of the mechanical arm is estimated based on a disturbance observer; the direction of the control force is determined according to an estimation result, and then force maneuverability enhancement is carried out; a speed instruction of an end effector is obtained, the expected base speed and the expected mechanical arm joint speed are obtained through a weight matrix, a hierarchical control frame of a model prediction controller and a whole-body controller is constructed based on an integrated dynamic model, the optimal wheel-leg interaction force spinor and the optimal joint torque are obtained through solving, and the optimal wheel-leg interaction force spinor and the optimal joint torque are obtained. Therefore, the whole-body motion control of the robot is driven. Through organic combination of disturbance compensation and force maneuverability optimization, the motion stability and operation efficiency of the robot are enhanced.

title: Humanoid robot with flying function
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot with a flying function, the humanoid robot comprises a robot body and at least one folding and unfolding device used for driving the robot body to achieve the flying function, the robot body comprises a head part and a trunk part, and the trunk part is provided with a plurality of upper limb assemblies and a plurality of leg assemblies; the folding and unfolding device is arranged on the side face of the trunk part, the folding and unfolding device and the upper limb assemblies are arranged in a staggered mode, and the folding and unfolding device can be folded or unfolded relative to the trunk part. According to the embodiment of the invention, the folding and unfolding device is arranged on the robot body, so that the humanoid robot can fly and work, stably walk on the ground or stably fly in the air and complete complex tasks at the same time, can fly in various postures in the air, and has very high maneuverability and multi-modal motion ability.

title: Head device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a head device, and relates to the technical field of robots. The head device is applied to the humanoid robot, a head shell mechanism in the head device comprises a head shell assembly, the head shell assembly comprises a forebrain shell, and a detection module and a touch voice module are arranged on the inner wall of the forebrain shell. The detection module comprises a binocular camera and a depth camera which are arranged on the forebrain shell at an interval, and a neck shell assembly is arranged below the head shell assembly; the head skeleton mechanism is arranged in the head shell assembly and used for driving the head shell assembly to rotate, and the head skeleton mechanism comprises a radar module located below the head skeleton mechanism; an avoiding part is arranged in the middle of the neck shell assembly, the avoiding part penetrates through the neck shell assembly in the front-back direction, and a laser radar in the radar module is exposed out of the avoiding part. The head device can widen the shooting range, so that the humanoid robot is suitable for a complex environment, and meanwhile, the maintenance convenience of the head device is improved.

title: Humanoid robot reverse long nut hard turning machining equipment and machining method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of long nut machining, and discloses humanoid robot reverse long nut hard turning equipment and a machining method.The humanoid robot reverse long nut hard turning equipment comprises a base, a machine tool body is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the base, and a depth-keeping clamping assembly for clamping and fixing a workpiece is arranged on one side of the machine tool body; a material suction assembly used in cooperation with the depth-keeping clamping assembly to treat machining chippings is arranged on the upper surface of the base and located on one side of the machine tool body, and a driving assembly enabling the depth-keeping clamping assembly to rotate at a high speed is arranged at the top of the machine tool body. And a turning assembly for turning a workpiece is arranged on the machine tool body. The workpiece is machined twice, the overhanging length of the cutter is shortened, the turning length is shortened, the rigidity of the cutter bar is enhanced, the chatter possibility in the cutting process is effectively reduced, and the cutting edge of the cutter is protected against cracking.

title: Sensor signal prediction method, system and equipment for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a sensor signal prediction method, system and equipment for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source sensor training sample of the humanoid robot; training the heterogeneous neural network fusion model according to the multi-source sensor training sample through a signal amplitude loss function, a frequency loss function and a transient characteristic loss function to obtain a signal prediction model; obtaining current sensor signals of the humanoid robot, wherein the current sensor signals comprise at least two of a joint angle signal, a motor current signal or an acceleration signal; and inputting the current sensor signal into the signal prediction model, and outputting a predicted sensor signal which is a force sense signal or a torque signal. Through multi-source sensor signal fusion and multi-domain feature learning, accurate prediction of key sensor signals is realized, the number of deployed sensors is reduced, the cost is reduced, the system reliability is improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Robot motor with damping structure
abstract: The invention provides a robot motor with a damping structure, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent robots. The rotating shaft is arranged to be of the split combined structure comprising the driving end and the driven end, the damping structure is arranged between the driving end and the driven end, the connecting pin of the damping structure is arranged on the driving end, the two ends of the connecting pin are matched with the two telescopic pins to abut against the two telescopic pins, and the two inserting holes corresponding to the two telescopic pins are formed in the driven end. The driving end selects one telescopic pin to push through rotation of the connecting pin, so that the end of the telescopic pin extends into the corresponding inserting hole, power transmission is achieved, a shock pad is arranged in the inserting hole to abut against the extending telescopic pin, energy absorption and shock absorption after the motor stops rotating are achieved, the influence of inertial motion on a rotating shaft of the motor is reduced, and the service life of the motor is prolonged. The motor is protected, and current which influences the control circuit can be prevented from being generated when the rotating shaft rotates reversely, so that the operation time of the humanoid robot using the motor is prolonged, the operation is more stable, and the operation cost is lower.

title: Magnetic code disc material for humanoid robot actuator as well as preparation method and application of magnetic code disc material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic code disc materials, and particularly discloses a magnetic code disc material for a humanoid robot actuator and a preparation method and application of the magnetic code disc material for the humanoid robot actuator, and the magnetic code disc material for the humanoid robot actuator comprises a substrate, a Bi layer, an AlNiFeCo film, an Nb layer and a Ta layer which are sequentially stacked. According to the novel structural design provided by the invention, a Bi layer and Nb layer double-intercalation coating structure is introduced, the Bi layer and Nb layer synergistically act on the AlNiFeCo thin film, the application requirements of a high-precision magnetic encoder code disc material for high coercive force and high residual magnetism are met, meanwhile, element diffusion is dispersed pinning network distribution, and the coercive force and residual magnetism of the high-precision magnetic encoder code disc material are improved. Uniform and consistent high-quality sine wave signal output performance can be obtained during magnetic writing of the coded disc; the prepared magnetic code disc material is suitable for high-performance and high-uniformity magnetic code disc material preparation and high-precision and miniaturized magnetic encoder technology, and has a good application prospect in humanoid robot actuators.

title: Method, application and equipment for generating anthropomorphic foot end track of biped robot based on full-connection network
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of biped robot gait planning, and discloses a method, application and equipment for generating a biped robot anthropomorphic foot end trajectory based on a full-connection network, and the method comprises the steps: (1) grouping the collected foot end trajectory data according to a starting step, an intermediate circulation step and a termination step; (2) mapping each group of foot end track data into foot end track data which can be used by a robot based on a kinematics mapping relation between a human body and the robot, and carrying out conformal interpolation; (3) training a full-connection neural network model by adopting the interpolated foot end trajectory data, further generating a foot end trajectory of each intermediate step by adopting the full-connection neural network model, and mapping the directly generated foot end trajectories of the starting step and the ending step to jointly form an anthropomorphic foot end trajectory; and the main loss of back propagation of the full-connection neural network model is punished by introducing the trajectory smoothness and the prediction precision of the start end and the tail end. According to the method, the anthropomorphism of the foot end track is improved.

title: Special nursing aerosol for robot and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a special nursing aerosol for a robot and a preparation method of the special nursing aerosol. The special nursing aerosol comprises 35%-50% of a fluorine-containing refrigerant, 5%-8% of a lubricant, 15%-25% of an organic solvent, 5%-10% of a nonionic surfactant, 1%-3% of an organic antirust agent, 0.5%-1.5% of an organic antioxidant, 0.5%-2% of a quaternary ammonium salt antistatic agent, 1%-3% of an organic silicon water repellent, 2%-5% of a compatilizer and the balance of an auxiliary propellant. The humanoid robot can be cooled, lubricated, cleaned, protected, antistatic, dustproof and other functions at the same time, the maintenance process of the humanoid robot is simplified, the maintenance efficiency is improved, the service life of the humanoid robot is prolonged, and stable and efficient operation of the humanoid robot is guaranteed.

title: Bilateral force feedback teleoperation method for humanoid robot of force compensation mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The invention provides a humanoid robot bilateral force feedback teleoperation method of a force compensation mechanism. According to the method, a 5G private network is used for deployment, the characteristics of low delay, high reliability and large bandwidth of the 5G private network are utilized, real-time interaction of high-dimensional haptic data in a remote and cross-domain environment is effectively supported, cross-domain teleoperation can be achieved, high-fidelity feedback transmission of environment contact force is effectively achieved, and the real-time interaction of the high-dimensional haptic data in the remote and cross-domain environment is achieved. The precision, the operation efficiency and the overall safety of remote operation of the humanoid robot in complex industrial scenes such as nuclear power maintenance, precise assembly and high-risk environment operation are remarkably improved, the gap between traditional automation and low-efficiency remote operation is filled up, and reliable technical support is provided for advanced industrial application needing man-machine cooperation fine force control.

title: Waist device of humanoid robot
abstract: The waist device of the humanoid robot comprises a waist rotating mechanism and a waist pitching mechanism, the waist rotating mechanism comprises a rotary driving module, a bearing and an output adapter, the bearing is arranged on the periphery of the rotary driving module, the output adapter is correspondingly arranged on the bearing, and the output adapter is connected with an output shaft of the rotary driving module; the waist pitching mechanism comprises a shell, a pitching motor, a bearing frame, a mounting piece and a pitching bearing, the shell is arranged on the output adapter, the pitching motor and the mounting piece are correspondingly arranged on the shell, the pitching bearing is connected with the mounting piece, the pitching motor and the pitching bearing are coaxial, and the two sides of the bearing frame are connected with a rotating shaft of the pitching motor and the pitching bearing respectively. The mechanism is simple in structure, through the design of the positions of the bearing and the pitching bearing, the weight above the waist is loaded to the bearing, the generated torque is also loaded by the bearing, the load of the speed reducer is reduced, the service life of the rotation driving module and the pitching motor is prolonged, and the bearing capacity of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Hip joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a hip joint structure and a humanoid robot. A stator of the first motor is fixedly connected with the first motor base, and a rotor of the first motor is rotationally connected with the first motor base and fixedly connected with the second motor base; a stator of the second motor is fixedly connected with the second motor base, and a rotor of the second motor is rotationally connected with the second motor base and fixedly connected with the third motor base; a rotor of the third motor is fixedly connected with the third motor base and rotationally connected with the thigh assembly, and a stator of the third motor is fixedly connected with the thigh assembly. According to the hip joint structure provided by the utility model, the first motor base and the second motor base, the third motor base and the second motor base, and the thigh assembly and the third motor base transmit interaction force through rotors of all motors, so that relatively large interaction force between the rotors and stators of the motors in the radial direction or the axial direction is avoided; and the damage to the motor is further reduced.

title: Power joint mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a power joint mechanism facing a humanoid robot, and particularly relates to the technical field of robots, the power joint mechanism comprises a first arm body and a second arm body, one end of the first arm body is connected with a connecting seat, the connecting seat is provided with a driving motor, the output end of the driving motor is provided with a rotating seat, and the rotating seat is provided with a rotating shaft. A first driving gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating seat in a sleeving mode, a second driving gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating seat in a sleeving mode, a rotating shaft seat is connected to one end of the second arm body, one end of the rotating shaft seat is rotationally connected with the connecting seat in a limiting mode, and a second driven gear is fixedly connected to the outer side of the rotating shaft seat in a sleeving mode; the outer side of the rotating shaft seat is fixedly connected with a first driven gear in a sleeving mode, through the arrangement of the structure, the driving assembly can generate large force in the small size, torque output is increased in the limited space, and after one driven gear on one side is damaged, normal operation of the joint can be maintained through the other driven gear.

title: Chassis assembly with high stability performance and wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a chassis assembly with high stability performance and a wheeled humanoid robot. The chassis assembly comprises a chassis main body, the four steering wheel mechanisms are symmetrically arranged at four corners of the chassis main body in a penetrating manner; the battery mechanism is fixedly arranged at the middle rear position of the chassis main body; the navigation radar mechanism is fixedly arranged above the chassis main body; the steering wheel mechanism comprises a fixed plate; the rotating motor assembly is fixedly arranged on the fixing plate; the connecting frame is movably arranged below the fixing plate and is in transmission connection with the rotating motor assembly; the driving wheel assembly is rotationally arranged on the connecting frame; a stator assembly, a rotor assembly, a driver and an encoder are integrated in each of the rotating motor assembly and the driving wheel assembly. By adopting the steering wheel mechanism with high integration degree, the occupied space of the chassis main body is reduced, the battery mechanism can be conveniently placed in the chassis main body, and the problem that the stability of the chassis of the existing wheeled humanoid robot is not enough is effectively solved.

title: Leg structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a leg structure and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The leg structure comprises a foot assembly, a shank assembly and a pair of driving assemblies. The shank assembly and the foot assembly are hinged to form a rotation center. In the pair of driving assemblies, one driving assembly is arranged on the outer side of the shank assembly, and the other driving assembly is arranged on the inner side of the shank assembly; the driving assembly can stretch out and draw back in the extending direction of the driving assembly and is provided with a fixed end and a telescopic end, the fixed end is hinged to the shank assembly, the telescopic end is hinged to the foot assembly, and the hinged position of the telescopic end and the foot assembly and the rotating center are arranged at intervals in the length direction of the foot assembly. The telescopic action of the driving assembly can drive the foot assembly to rotate around the rotating center. According to the leg structure provided by the utility model, by improving the leg structure, the weight of the ankle joint can be reduced, the size of the ankle joint is reduced, and the bionic effect of the rotation action between the leg bone and the foot is better.

title: Humanoid robot charging equipment
abstract: A humanoid robot charging device is used for executing an automatic charging program on a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot charging equipment comprises a machine body, a charging base arranged on the machine body, and a control module electrically connected with the charging base to control an automatic charging program. The charging seat comprises a charging module, a sensing module and a position adjusting module. The charging module provides charging power and is provided with a first charging interface. The sensing module senses the position relation between the second charging interface and the first charging interface of the humanoid robot. And the position adjusting module adjusts the first charging interface according to the position relation, so that the first charging interface is correspondingly connected with a second charging interface of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot leg and a humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot leg that may include a shank, an ankle that includes an ankle joint that is configured to perform yaw and pitch rotations, a knee joint, multiple ankle related (AR) rotational motors that are in mechanical communication, via multiple AR transmission mechanisms, with the ankle joint, and a knee related (KR) rotational motor that is in mechanical communication, via a KR transmission mechanism, with the knee joint. title: Digital human action generation method, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a digital human action generation method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target text output by a digital human; performing semantic analysis on the target text, and extracting an action guide word; generating a target action sequence of the digital person based on the action guide word; and controlling the digital human to execute the target action sequence. According to the method, the target text to be spoken by the digital person is paraphrased, so that the connotation meaning of the content to be spoken by the digital person is determined through the meaning of the target text, the corresponding target action can be generated according to the actually expressed meaning, and finally, the action output by the digital person can better fit the connotation of the speech spoken by the digital person; and the action of the digital human is more intelligent. According to the method and the device, the problem that digital human actions are not matched with semantics is solved, and the interaction naturalness is improved.

title: Humanoid robot hand-eye coordination intelligent calibration control system and method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot hand-eye coordination intelligent calibration control system and a humanoid robot hand-eye coordination intelligent calibration control method, and the humanoid robot hand-eye coordination intelligent calibration control system integrates high-precision contour extraction, visual feedback closed-loop control, multi-sensor fusion and dynamic path planning. The robot hand-eye calibration method has the beneficial effects that the calibration efficiency and precision can be remarkably improved, the problem of calibration parameter drift caused by system time-varying characteristics and environmental interference is effectively solved through continuous tracking of a target contour and real-time online compensation of pose deviation, and the calibration accuracy is improved. Therefore, the reliability and the absolute positioning precision of the robot in long-term complex operation tasks are guaranteed, and the self-adaptive capability of a robot system is enhanced.

title: Hollow harmonic speed reducer with built-in motor
abstract: The utility model relates to a hollow type harmonic speed reducer with a built-in motor, which comprises a bottom shell, a first concave platform is arranged on the bottom shell, a plastic harmonic speed reducer flexible gear and an outer rotor motor are embedded on the first concave platform, a boss is arranged between the bottom surface of the first concave platform and the bottom surface of the outer rotor motor, and the outer rotor motor is arranged on the boss. And the output shaft is rotatably connected with the bottom shell, a harmonic speed reducer rigid wheel is embedded in a middle mounting cavity of the output shaft, the harmonic speed reducer rigid wheel is in transmission connection with the plastic harmonic speed reducer flexible wheel, and a gap is formed between the bottom surface of the outer rotor motor and the boss. According to the hollow harmonic speed reducer with the built-in motor, the hollow outer rotor motor is adopted, the motor is embedded in the harmonic flexible gear, and the harmonic speed reducer flexible gear and the harmonic speed reducer rigid gear are made of light plastic materials, so that the weight of the whole speed reducer is effectively reduced, and the hollow harmonic speed reducer with the built-in motor is suitable for being applied to humanoid robots and light six-axis robots. And a collaborative robot.

title: Lower jaw driving device and bionic robot head
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of bionic robots, in particular to a lower jaw driving device and a bionic robot head. The utility model provides a lower jaw driving device which comprises a lower jaw transverse moving driver, a lower jaw rotating driver, a lower jaw linear rotating bearing, a lower jaw support and a lower jaw connecting shaft. The lower jaw transverse movement driver, the lower jaw rotation driver and the lower jaw linear rotation bearing are all arranged on the lower jaw bracket; the lower jaw connecting shaft is arranged in the lower jaw linear rotating bearing and used for being connected with a lower jaw assembly. The lower jaw transverse movement driver is used for driving the lower jaw assembly to transversely move in the axial direction of the lower jaw linear rotating bearing, and the lower jaw rotating driver is used for driving the lower jaw assembly to rotate in the circumferential direction of the lower jaw linear rotating bearing. The lower jaw assembly can not only do opening and closing movement, but also can transversely move, so that expressions generated by the lower jaw assembly due to movement are richer, finer and more concrete, some micro expressions can be achieved, and the lower jaw assembly is more humanoid.

title: Electromagnetic Geo-Fence System for Humanoid Intrusion Deterrence and Neutralization
abstract: A system and method for securing physical property through a geo-fenced electromagnetic perimeter designed to detect, warn, and neutralize unauthorized humanoid robots in any shape, size or form such as land or air. The system integrates AI-driven threat classification, real-time humanoid identification, legal compliance modules, and controlled electromagnetic emission to ensure only unauthorized and non-compliant humanoids are deterred or disabled while protecting the property owner's liability.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The humanoid dexterous hand comprises a palm skeleton, a thumb driving mechanism and a joint mechanism, the palm skeleton comprises a guide rail fixing seat, a skeleton body, a four-finger structure, a thumb and a driving mounting groove; the thumb driving mechanism comprises a side swing driving assembly and a bending driving assembly. One end of the bending driving assembly is embedded into the driving mounting groove, the other end of the bending driving assembly is connected with the joint mechanism through the guide rail fixing seat, and the bending driving assembly is slidably connected with the guide rail fixing seat; and the side swing driving assembly is embedded into the driving mounting groove, is connected with the joint mechanism through the guide rail fixing seat, and is in sliding connection with the guide rail fixing seat. The joint mechanism is controlled through the side swing driving assembly and the bending driving assembly respectively, then the thumb is controlled to move through the joint mechanism, free movement can be conducted in two direction dimensions, and the flexibility of the thumb is greatly improved.

title: Control method and control system for omni-directional sensing type humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a control method and a control system of an omnibearing perception type humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the environment information of the environment where the humanoid robot is located and the motion state of the humanoid robot; obstacle information is recognized in real time according to the environment information, and a plurality of alternative obstacle avoidance paths are planned when the obstacle information is recognized; wherein the obstacle information at least comprises the position, the size and the state of the obstacle; no obstacle corresponding to the obstacle information exists on the alternative obstacle avoidance route; performing energy consumption evaluation on all the alternative obstacle avoidance paths according to the motion state of the humanoid robot, and selecting an optimal obstacle avoidance path from all the alternative obstacle avoidance paths according to an energy consumption evaluation result and current remaining available energy of the humanoid robot; and controlling the humanoid robot to move according to the optimal obstacle avoidance path. The method has the effects of accurately controlling the motion of the humanoid robot, improving the obstacle avoidance stability and reducing the motion energy consumption.

title: Method for estimating endurance data based on humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a method for estimating endurance data based on a humanoid robot and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first historical energy consumption data of the humanoid robot from a current position to a target position; calculating through the first historical energy consumption data and the real-time acquisition data to obtain a first task type influence factor, a first environment influence factor and a first robot state influence factor; calculating the first task type influence factor, the first environment influence factor, the first robot state influence factor and the first historical energy consumption data to obtain a first terrain quality influence factor; and estimating an action track of the humanoid robot according to the first terrain quality influence factor to obtain residual endurance data after the humanoid robot arrives at the target position. The problem that existing endurance estimation neglects terrain influence or is too high in cost can be solved, and estimation accuracy is improved.

title: Humanoid robot leg structure with switchable wheels and feet
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot switchable humanoid robot leg configuration. The humanoid robot leg configuration comprises a left side leg configuration and a right side leg configuration which are symmetrical and have the same structure; wherein the left leg structure comprises a right thigh assembly, a robot right knee hub motor module, a right shank assembly, a right shank driven wheel module and a right foot assembly from top to bottom; the right leg structure comprises a left thigh assembly, a left knee hub motor module, a left shank assembly, a left shank driven wheel module and a left foot assembly from top to bottom. According to the design that the wheel state and the foot state can be switched, the maneuverability of the humanoid robot on a long straight road or a slow slope or other specific road conditions is improved.

title: Virtual-real fusion driven humanoid robot walking training method
abstract: The invention relates to a virtual-real fusion driven humanoid robot walking training method, which comprises the following steps: S1, building a robot walking training scene, and collecting data when a robot walks; s2, constructing a data space containing a robot joint state and a target position according to data collected by a sensor in a physical world; s3, constructing a preliminary observation space according to the data of the physical space, and constructing an observation space after virtual-real fusion in combination with the sensor data of the simulation space; s4, on the basis of the observation space after virtual-real fusion, a reward function is constructed, and a robot walking strategy is corrected; and S5, deploying the corrected robot walking strategy on a real robot to carry out real ground walking adaptation, and feeding back information to a simulation space to carry out control strategy optimization. Compared with the prior art, the walking stability and safety of the humanoid robot are improved in the mode that physical data are fed back to the simulation environment observation space adjustment strategy.

title: Vision-based stable grabbing control method and device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot stable grabbing control method based on vision. The humanoid robot stable grabbing control method comprises the steps that a target image of a workpiece to be grabbed is obtained through an image sensor of a humanoid robot; generating a segmented image of the workpiece based on the target image by using an image segmentation model; generating pose information of the workpiece in a world coordinate system based on the segmented image by using a pose acquisition model; the pose information is converted into a tool coordinate system of the dexterous hand through coordinate transformation, and grabbing information of the workpiece is obtained; and controlling a dexterous hand mounted at the tail end of a mechanical arm of the humanoid robot to grab the workpiece according to the grabbing information. The invention further provides a vision-based stable grabbing control device for the humanoid robot, electronic equipment for realizing stable grabbing control of the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot.

title: Joint motor stator and preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a joint motor stator and a preparation method and application thereof, the joint motor stator comprises a base, a plurality of yoke parts arranged on the base and coil windings wound on the yoke parts, and the plurality of yoke parts are arranged at intervals; the base is prepared from, by mass, 80%-90% of iron-silicon powder and 10%-20% of first iron powder. The preparation material of the yoke part comprises at least two kinds of second iron powder with different particle size ranges; wherein the content of silicon in the iron-silicon powder accounts for 6.5%-10%, and the D50 of the iron-silicon powder is larger than that of the first iron powder. According to the joint motor stator and the preparation method and application thereof provided by the embodiment of the invention, by adopting the soft magnetic composite materials (iron silicon powder and iron powder) and mixing the soft magnetic composite materials with different particle sizes, the mechanical strength and the magnetic conductivity of the joint motor stator are effectively improved, so that the magnetic conduction requirement of the joint motor stator applied to a humanoid robot is met.

title: Wrist structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the wrist structure of the humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, the universal joint structure is adopted for the wrist structure, and on the basis that a pitching rotating shaft and a rolling rotating shaft intersect, the intersection point is located in the structural center of the universal joint, so that no matter how the wrist of the robot tilts up and down, swings left and right and the like, the robot can stably rotate. The two central axes of pitching motion and left-right swing intersect at one point all the time, the structure is more compact, and due to the structure, when the wrist of the robot moves, the sweeping space of the motion is small; the structural design of the cross shaft is a structural form closest to wrist movement, and the wrist movement is in up-down and left-right symmetry, so that subsequent hand control and algorithm analysis are facilitated.

title: Leg mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a leg mechanism and a humanoid robot. The leg mechanism comprises a waist support and two leg units, the independent leg units are designed for the humanoid robot, a hip module, a leg module and a foot module are designed, the hip module comprises a hip support, a fixing support and a first driving part, and the leg module and the foot module are assembled on the hip support. The first driving piece is fixed to the fixing support and is in transmission connection with the hip support, so that when the first driving piece drives the hip support to rotate, the leg module can be driven to rotate relative to the waist support, and the movement capacity of the leg module is guaranteed; the fixing support of the leg unit is detachably connected with the waist support, and the fixing support is detached from the waist support, so that the whole leg unit can be independently detached, the leg detaching difficulty is effectively reduced, and the maintenance convenience is improved.

title: Humanoid robot acquisition, training and evaluation integrated method and system
abstract: The invention provides an acquisition-training-evaluation integrated method and system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring operation data of an operator by using master-slave control teleoperation equipment, and optimizing the operation data; the mechanical arm is controlled to respond, and data collection is conducted in the movement process of the mechanical arm; processing and storing the acquired data; applying the processed required information to a reasoning training process of the robot to form a reasoning model; a reasoning training result is deployed to the robot, so that the robot can start to execute a test task; real data of the robot in the execution process are collected, and the motion effect of robot training is evaluated and judged; a robot training reasoning model which does not conform to an evaluation standard is optimized, a data acquisition process and a training reasoning process are purposefully optimized from an evaluation result, and a'training-adjusting-correcting 'whole-process data active discovery and utilization mechanism is formed, so that the construction of a high-quality and multi-modal universal intelligent data set with a body is accelerated, and the accuracy and the reliability of the system are improved. Dependence on real data acquisition is reduced, and robot perception, understanding, reasoning and general generalization capabilities are enhanced. title: Soft torsion linear actuator and execution method
abstract: The invention discloses a soft torsion linear actuator and an execution method. Wherein the soft torsion linear mechanism comprises an inner soft columnar structure and an outer soft columnar structure, a plurality of layers of soft connecting rods are connected in the inner soft columnar structure and the outer soft columnar structure, each set of soft columnar structure can generate rotation-linear motion conversion, the bottom surface of the inner columnar structure is connected with a motor shaft through a D-shaped shaft hole, and the top surface of the inner columnar structure is connected with the top surface of the outer columnar structure; a user controls a motor shaft to rotate through the microprocessor control system and the motor driving system, the inner-layer columnar structure is driven to rotate and stretch out and draw back, then the outer-layer columnar structure is driven to rotate and stretch out and draw back, and finally the purpose of converting rotary motion into linear motion is achieved. A preset track is achieved through flexible deformation of the columnar structure, in the scene needing a large number of flexible drivers, a traditional rotation-linear transmission mode of a synchronous belt or a lead screw or the like can be replaced, and the flexible driver becomes a choice with higher cost benefits and practicability; the artificial muscle can also be used as an artificial muscle in a bionic robot and a humanoid robot.

title: Side-out humanoid holding and clamping robot
abstract: The invention provides a side-out humanoid clamping robot which comprises a base, a rotating seat is arranged on the base, a main machine is arranged on the rotating seat and comprises a vertical plate, a first double-shaft servo motor is arranged at the upper end of the vertical plate, mechanical arms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the vertical plate, and a second double-shaft servo motor is arranged at the lower end of the vertical plate. One ends of the two symmetrical mechanical arms are fixedly connected with a first double-shaft servo motor, penetrating transverse grooves are formed in the other ends of the two symmetrical mechanical arms, extending arms are rotationally connected into the transverse grooves of the two symmetrical mechanical arms, fixing grooves are formed in the extending arms, and surrounding plates are inserted into the fixing grooves. According to the side-out humanoid holding and clamping robot, the mechanical arms can be folded to the two sides of the vertical plate through the arrangement of the first double-shaft servo motor, meanwhile, components between the mechanical arms on the two sides are folded into the containing groove of the vertical plate, and the containing space is greatly saved; and a double-shaft servo motor II is arranged between the mechanical arms on the two sides, so that the extension arms on the two sides are folded, and the workpiece is clamped.

title: Linear driving device, humanoid robot and working equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a linear driving device, a humanoid robot and operation equipment. The linear driving device comprises a rack, a driving structure, a moving structure and a shielding structure. The rack is provided with a moving groove extending in the first direction, and the moving groove penetrates through the rack. The driving structure is arranged in the rack and comprises a driving piece moving in the first direction. The moving structure is movably connected outside the rack in the first direction, and the driving piece is connected to the moving structure. The shielding structure comprises a shielding piece and a guide assembly, and the shielding piece covers the moving groove in the first direction. A penetrating channel is formed in the moving structure, the penetrating channel is provided with two openings formed in a spaced mode, the connecting position of the driving part and the moving structure is located between the two openings, the shielding part penetrates through the penetrating channel through the two openings, the guiding assembly is connected to the penetrating channel, and the shielding part located in the penetrating channel is movably connected to the guiding assembly. The linear driving device is good in sealing performance, and foreign matter is not prone to entering the device.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises an arm assembly and a shell assembly. The shell assembly comprises a big arm shell, the arm assembly comprises a big arm part, and a big arm reinforcing rib in the big arm shell is pressed against the big arm part, so that the big arm can be reinforced, the purpose of limiting the big arm part can be achieved, and the big arm part can be prevented from shaking in the big arm shell to a certain extent. At least one of the large arm reinforcing ribs is in limiting fit with the first limiting face of the large arm part in the direction, away from the elbow, of the large arm part, and the end, facing the elbow shell, of the large arm shell is in limiting fit with the first driver in the direction, facing the elbow, of the large arm part. And the influence on the structural strength of the big arm shell due to the fact that too many holes are formed in the big arm shell is avoided.

title: Humanoid robot liquid cooling architecture system and cooling method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of thermal management of robots, in particular to a liquid cooling architecture system and method for a humanoid robot, and the system comprises a water tank which is arranged at the high position of the humanoid robot and is provided with a filling port, a water inlet and a water outlet; the liquid pumping mechanism comprises a main water pump and a plurality of micro water pumps, the main water pump is located at the controller and the power supply, and the micro water pumps are correspondingly distributed at joint motors on the humanoid robot; the water path connecting mechanism is used for connecting the water tank, the main water pump, the plurality of micro water pumps and liquid cooling channels of the controller, the power supply and the plurality of joint motors to form a liquid cooling loop; and the main heat dissipation mechanism is arranged on the water path connecting mechanism in a series connection mode and used for taking out heat of the heated cooling liquid after heat transfer in an air cooling mode. The stability and cooling efficiency of the whole machine can be improved, meanwhile, the cooling effect of devices can be adjusted according to needs, and power consumption of the robot in the aspect of heat dissipation can be greatly saved.

title: Miniature finger force three-dimensional force sensor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a miniature finger force three-dimensional force sensor for a humanoid robot, which comprises an elastic body, a stress adapter plate, a signal processing plate, an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate, and is characterized in that the upper cover plate and the lower cover plate respectively cover the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the elastic body, the outer surface of the upper cover plate is a stress surface, and the stress surface is a hemispherical surface; the upper cover plate is made of a soft material, and the stress adapter plate is inserted into the upper cover plate and fixed on the elastic body; the signal processing plate is embedded in the lower cover plate and is connected with the elastic body through a wire, the elastic body comprises an elastic body wheel rim, a central stress table and four strain beams, the four strain beams are uniformly arranged between the central stress table and the elastic body wheel rim, twelve monocrystalline silicon semiconductor strain gauges are arranged on the four strain beams to form three Wheatstone bridges, and the three Wheatstone bridges are connected with the signal processing plate. Forces in the three directions of Fx, Fy and Fz are respectively measured. The three-dimensional force sensor has the advantages of small size, light weight and high measurement resolution.

title: Humanoid robot reinforcement learning gait control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot reinforcement learning gait control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. Comprising the following steps: constructing a model prediction control optimization problem based on a linear inverted pendulum model, and generating a robot mass center track and a foothold sequence; collecting state-action pair data of model prediction control, and training a neural network model by adopting supervised learning; designing a reinforcement learning strategy network, taking the output of the neural network model as a physical guidance reference, calculating a training reward based on the constructed composite reward function, training the strategy network in a high-concurrency simulation environment by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, and outputting a joint action instruction; and verifying the trained strategy and the joint action instruction output by the trained strategy in a plurality of simulation environments, and deploying the trained strategy and the joint action instruction to a real machine for dynamic gait control. According to the method, the stability and adaptability of gait control of the humanoid robot are improved through a method of combining model predictive control and reinforcement learning.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a wheeled humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot comprises a wheel type chassis walking module, a robot upper body structure and a control unit. A lifting stand column leg module is arranged between the wheel type chassis walking module and the robot upper body structure, and the lifting stand column leg module drives the robot upper body structure to linearly ascend and descend in the single vertical direction under the control of the control unit. A bowing driving module is arranged in the trunk of the robot upper body structure and used for driving the robot trunk structure to do pitching motion at a preset angle under the control of the control unit. The control unit cooperatively controls the linear lifting motion of the lifting stand column leg module and the pitching motion of the bending driving module according to a target operation task so as to achieve composite space positioning. On the premise of ensuring the moving efficiency and the control stability, the three-dimensional operation space of the wheeled humanoid robot is effectively expanded.

title: Handheld clamping jaw tool
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a handheld clamping jaw tool. title: Chest shell assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a chest shell assembly and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The chest shell assembly comprises a chest shell body, arm buffering pieces and a neck buffering piece. The front shell body, the rear shell body, the two arm buffering pieces and the neck buffering piece of the chest shell body can be assembled after being independently manufactured, and therefore the manufacturing process difficulty of the chest shell assembly can be lowered. The neck buffering piece and the arm buffering piece are elastic pieces, so that the neck buffering piece and the arm buffering piece have the effects of energy absorption and shock absorption, and therefore when the neck structure rotates to impact the neck buffering piece and the mechanical arm rotates to impact the arm buffering piece, the neck buffering piece and the arm buffering piece can absorb impact force through deformation. Therefore, the neck buffering piece and the arm buffering piece cannot be damaged. The arm buffering piece is provided with a first fracture, and the neck buffering piece is provided with a second fracture, so that the arm buffering piece and the neck buffering piece can be integrally formed when being prepared through a copying process.

title: Two-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot sensing head system
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a two-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot head sensing system which comprises a movement assembly (1) located at the bottom. The sensing assembly (2) is arranged above the motion assembly (1) and comprises a visual module, an auditory module and an olfactory module; and the calculation and interaction assembly (3) is connected with the sensing assembly (2) and is used for performing calculation processing on the external environment information received by the sensing assembly (2) and making feedback to the outside so as to realize communication and interaction between the humanoid robot and human beings. title: Leg rotation limiting structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg rotation limit structure for a humanoid robot, which comprises a foot, a shank structure, a connecting piece and a thigh structure, by arranging the shank structure and the thigh structure, when the humanoid robot moves the legs, the shanks bend towards the right side, and the thigh structure is bent towards the right side. The first connecting rod drives the third connecting rod to move through the second connecting rod, the third connecting rod moves upwards by limiting the sliding block through the guide rod, when the shank bends towards the left side, the lower end face of the sliding block is attached to the trigger switch, and then the feedback control system stops rotation of the shank; the response speed and flexibility of the humanoid robot can be improved through electronic limiting, especially when the movement direction needs to be rapidly changed or complex actions need to be carried out.

title: Tandem type bionic mechanical arm

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom bionic hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a multi-degree-of-freedom bionic hand. A finger assembly comprises a first joint module and a second joint module. The first joint module and the second joint module are connected through a second joint base, a first joint driver is arranged on the first joint module, and the first joint driver is in transmission connection with the second joint module through a bevel gear set; the second joint base is connected with and rotationally supported on the first joint module, and the second joint module is hinged to the second joint base; the first joint module is further provided with a second joint rotating driver, and the second joint rotating driver is in transmission connection with the second joint base through a gear set. The utility model further provides the humanoid robot. The multi-degree-of-freedom bionic hand provided by the utility model can realize multi-degree-of-freedom movement, can complete various complicated hand-shaped actions, and is more suitable for being applied to humanoid robots.

title: Motion capture-based humanoid robot motion migration method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the cross technical field of robot control, computer graphics and motion capture processing, in particular to a humanoid robot motion migration method and system based on motion capture, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting human motion data and converting the human motion data into a general format, specifically, recording the motion trail of a human mark point through a motion capture system, the method comprises the following steps: generating a. Bvh file containing skeleton hierarchy and motion parameters, converting the. Bvh file into an NPZ format file containing translation and posture parameters, and processing the NPZ format file based on an SMPL-X human body model. According to the method, through scale optimization and joint matching, the problem of scale difference between the SMPL human body model and the robot model is solved, the matching precision of the joint positions is improved, through combination of the optimization strategy of the main loss and the regularization item and physical constraints, the robot joint angle is effectively prevented from exceeding the limit, and the physical feasibility of actions is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot active protection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides an active protection method and device for a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of data processing, is applied to a central control unit of an active protection system, and the active protection system further comprises an infrared motion capture unit and a track protection unit. The infrared motion capture unit is a space positioning unit provided with a plurality of infrared cameras and is used for collecting real-time pose data of the humanoid robot and sending the real-time pose data to the central control unit; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time pose data of the humanoid robot; calculating a motion trend of the humanoid robot based on the real-time pose data, and performing active protection judgment based on the motion trend to obtain a judgment result; and under the condition that the judgment result indicates that the humanoid robot is in the falling early warning state, the track protection unit is controlled to execute an active protection strategy. Through the method provided by the invention, the robot can be rapidly hoisted and protected when the robot is about to fall down or the posture is abnormal, manual intervention is avoided, and the experiment efficiency and safety are improved.

title: Energy recovery system based on thermoelectric material
abstract: The invention discloses an energy recovery system based on a thermoelectric material. The energy recovery system comprises a thermoelectric power generation unit, a heat dissipation unit, a piezoelectric power generation layer, an energy management circuit and a temperature monitoring unit. The robot joint module is wrapped with the thermoelectric power generation unit, the thermoelectric power generation unit comprises a plurality of thermoelectric modules, the thermoelectric modules form an annular structure, and the thermoelectric power generation unit generates power through the temperature difference between heat generated when the robot joint operates and the environment. The heat dissipation unit is arranged at the cold end of the thermoelectric power generation unit and used for enhancing heat exchange and maintaining effective temperature difference. The piezoelectric power generation layer is attached to the outer side of the thermoelectric power generation unit or a robot joint shell vibration area. Based on the thermoelectric effect and the piezoelectric effect, waste heat and vibration energy generated at the joints during operation of the biped robot can be recycled, the resource utilization rate can be increased, the cruising ability of the biped robot can be improved, meanwhile, the heat dissipation effect at the joints of the biped robot can be guaranteed, and overheating damage is avoided.

title: Data acquisition method and device for humanoid robot training ground and medium
abstract: The invention provides a data acquisition method and device for a humanoid robot training ground and a medium. According to the method, a welding task corresponding to equipment to be welded is determined, multi-sensing data are obtained, path planning and track generation are conducted according to the multi-sensing data and the welding task, an initial track is obtained, random disturbance is injected in the process of controlling the humanoid robot to execute the welding task according to the initial track, and the initial track is adjusted according to the random disturbance. And based on the adjusted initial track, the welding task continues to be executed, and state data in the execution process of the welding task is recorded. The method can be applied to a welding operation scene in the industrial manufacturing field, and can be used in a humanoid robot training ground to realize track generation based on multi-sensing data and automatic recording of data in a task execution process, so that automatic data acquisition is realized, data acquisition efficiency is improved, data richness is improved by adding perturbation, and the accuracy of data acquisition is improved. And the generalization ability of the humanoid robot under different production conditions can be improved.

title: Motion state estimation method and device of humanoid robot, robot and product
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of autonomous movement, and provides a motion state estimation method and device of a humanoid robot, the robot and a product. title: Indoor humanoid robot navigation method and device based on dynamic environment modeling
abstract: The invention discloses an indoor humanoid robot navigation method and device based on dynamic environment modeling, and the robot method comprises the steps: responding to a navigation request carrying a target position point, and obtaining a current position point and various types of sensing data of an indoor humanoid robot according to a preset period; inputting the multiple types of sensing data into a preset map updating plug-in to generate a dynamically updated four-dimensional space-time cost map; searching an optimal navigation path capable of avoiding static obstacles and dynamic obstacles between the target position point and the current position point in the dynamically updated four-dimensional space-time cost map; the optimal navigation path is adopted, the indoor humanoid robot is controlled to move, and the step of obtaining the current position point and the multiple types of sensing data of the indoor humanoid robot according to the preset period continues to be executed till the indoor humanoid robot moves to the target position point. Therefore, by adopting the embodiment of the invention, the historical data of the map can be refreshed in time, so that the robot can effectively avoid the obstacle, and the collision risk is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot whole-body collaborative voice control system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body collaborative voice control system and method for a humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problems of semantic understanding superficial layer, action planning localization and safety control lagging in existing humanoid robot voice control. Through closed-loop cooperation of the multi-mode intention understanding module, the whole-body action planning module, the dynamic balance security arbiter and the microkernel security scheduler, a unified control architecture is constructed. According to the system, natural language instructions are deeply analyzed into whole-body motion constraints through a semantic-action mapping knowledge base, anthropomorphic collaborative motion trails are generated, pre-security verification is conducted through a boundary model based on Lyapunov stability, and finally hard real-time execution and full-cycle security guarding are achieved through a microkernel security scheduler. According to the method, direct conversion from natural language to safe, stable and anthropomorphic whole-body motion is realized, and the task execution capability and the interaction naturalness of the humanoid robot in a complex scene are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot trajectory enhancement method and system for multi-stage continuous tasks
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot trajectory enhancement method and system oriented to a multi-stage continuous task, and belongs to the field of robot intelligent control and imitation learning modeling, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a splicing trajectory and a real-time image sequence into a pre-trained improved conditional variation auto-encoder model, obtaining a predicted trajectory of a humanoid robot, and obtaining the predicted trajectory of the humanoid robot; wherein the pre-trained improved conditional variation auto-encoder model comprises the following steps: constructing an encoder with an attention mechanism, dividing a potential space of the conditional variation auto-encoder into a plurality of layers, each layer of the hierarchical potential space having a potential variable, the feature of each layer of the hierarchical potential space is described by adopting the mean value and the variance of the image potential variables, the mean value and the variance of the image potential variables of each layer are optimized by adopting the loss function, and for long-time, multi-stage and high-dynamic-change imitation learning, the prediction precision is improved by the method, and the prediction efficiency is improved. The problems of unstable training and missing key detail expression are solved.

title: Humanoid robot calibration path planning method and system based on joint tracking
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot vision, and discloses a humanoid robot calibration path planning method and system based on joint tracking, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first joint strain data and first joint jitter data of a palm of a humanoid robot in a non-disturbance condition time interval, calculating a joint strain data difference factor and a joint jitter data difference factor according to the first joint strain data and the second joint jitter data in the actual disturbance condition time interval and the second joint strain data and the second joint jitter data in the actual disturbance condition time interval, and performing weighted summation to obtain a calibration path comprehensive difference factor of each time interval; a calibration path comprehensive difference factor curve is constructed, a calibration path planning coefficient is determined, a calibration path planning strategy of the humanoid robot palm is set, joint errors and jitter differences under different conditions are comprehensively evaluated, and self-adaptive path planning is achieved through quantitative analysis. And the movement stability and precision of the palm of the humanoid robot in a complex environment are improved.

title: Humanoid robot VLA model task generalization ability mining method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot VLA model task generalization ability mining method and system, and the core of the method comprises the steps: training a model through a meta-learning framework, and improving the rapid adaptability of the model to a new task; a multi-task joint training strategy is adopted, and the learning effect of the model on diversified tasks is enhanced; a task feature self-adaptive module is used for automatically identifying and extracting task related features and dynamically adjusting model parameters to adapt to new tasks; through a cross-modal knowledge migration mechanism, deep fusion of vision, language and audio information and knowledge migration are realized. According to the method, the bottleneck problems that in the prior art, a VLA model is weak in generalization ability and difficult to quickly adapt to new tasks, single training cannot meet the multi-task requirement, and cross-modal information fusion is insufficient are effectively solved. Through the synergistic effect of the four core technologies, the overall generalization ability and the practical application performance of the humanoid robot for executing diversified tasks in an unknown, dynamic and complex environment are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb walking control method and device
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot lower limb walking control method and device, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining state information and environment information of a robot; the state information and the environment information are input into a strategy network based on a self-attention structure, a joint action sequence of multiple steps in the future is output, candidate actions of the output overlapped action sequence at the same future moment are subjected to weighted fusion, and a smooth and coherent control instruction is generated; inputting the state transition segment of the robot into an adversarial prior network, outputting a style score and mapping the style score into a style reward; constructing a comprehensive reward function in combination with the task completion reward and the style reward, and optimizing the strategy network; and deploying the optimized strategy network to a robot controller to realize lower limb walking control. The walking naturalness, stability and environmental adaptability can be effectively improved.

title: AR/VR-based humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: A humanoid robot based on AR/VR relates to the technical field of robots and structurally comprises a humanoid robot body, an AR/VR hybrid interaction terminal and a low-delay communication network. The robot body comprises a chassis, a double-arm mechanism, a main control system, a joint driving system, a multi-mode sensor assembly, a visual system, an edge calculation unit and a body intelligent decision module. And the hybrid interaction terminal identifies a user instruction to control the robot body and performs somatosensory feedback on the user. The control method comprises the following steps: 1, starting the system and establishing communication connection; 2, selecting an operation mode and inputting an instruction; 3, identifying a user instruction, generating an execution instruction and transmitting the execution instruction to the main control system; 4, calculating a risk value; 5, switching modes according to the risk value; and 6, the mixed interaction terminal receives the returned data and carries out somatosensory feedback. According to the invention, the technical problems of low efficiency, lack of autonomous judgment of environmental danger and adoption of emergency means and poor safety caused by single interaction mode of the existing operation mode can be solved.

title: Double-arm body operation method of humanoid robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot double-arm body operation method based on reinforcement learning, belongs to the field of robot cooperative control, and is characterized in that a strategy of trajectory block prediction and time integration fusion is used for double-arm cooperative control, and continuity and stability of double-arm operation are improved; in reinforcement learning control, a three-dimensional pose track generation and correction module is introduced, condition generation and denoising correction of a three-dimensional space are carried out on a track block layer, and geometric consistency and naturalness of a generated track are guaranteed; the invention further provides a reinforcement learning optimization framework and a simulation-reality migration process, and through system integration of reward, value guidance and migration processes, strategy deployability and safety are guaranteed; compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the naturalness, the collaboration and the success rate of double-arm operation can be remarkably improved, the generalization ability is high, and the good simulation-to-reality migration ability is achieved.

title: Leg device of foot-type robot and foot-type robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg device of a foot type robot and the foot type robot. title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, solves the problem that the sizes of a motor and a control unit are limited due to the fact that the motor is fixed at the upper ends of a thigh structure and a shank structure, and adopts the technical scheme that the leg structure mainly comprises a crotch, the thigh structure, the shank structure and a foot end piece, the thigh structure comprises a thigh support, two motors are installed on the thigh support, the shank structure comprises a shank support, a motor is installed on the shank support, a shell of each motor is in a long strip shape, the control unit comprises a plurality of circuit boards, the circuit boards are stacked in the shell in the length direction of the shell, and a first installation cavity is formed in the thigh support. title: Leg device of foot-type robot and foot-type robot
