title: Temperature control system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a temperature control system and method for a humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of robot temperature control, and aims to solve the problems that the current humanoid robot is lack of temperature sensing and processing and is lack of flexible overall basis local temperature control means. The system comprises a central temperature control module arranged at the chest position of the humanoid robot and trunk heating devices arranged at the trunk positions of the humanoid robot, and the central temperature control module is connected with a bionic skin inner layer through a cold and hot pipeline; the central temperature control module is connected with the trunk heating device, the central temperature control module comprises a control module and a sensing assembly connected with the control module, the sensing assembly is connected with distributed sensors distributed at the trunk position, and the control module is connected with a bionic skin outer layer and an environment sensing module. The central temperature control system and the trunk heating device are combined to achieve overall and local temperature control of the humanoid robot, and finally rapid temperature regulation and control of different positions can be achieved.

title: Humanoid robot joint overload protection mechanical clutch
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint overload protection mechanical clutch, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the humanoid robot joint overload protection mechanical clutch comprises a joint component, an action driving assembly, a clutch transmission assembly, an automatic adjusting assembly, an overload locking assembly and a safety buckle component, a second joint part and a first joint part are rotationally connected through a main transmission cavity, and a driving disc is arranged in the main transmission cavity; the transmission disc is in transmission connection with the second joint part, a driven disc which bounces downwards is arranged at the upper end of the driving disc, clutch columns on the same side are inserted into driving sliding holes in a sliding mode, clutch type driving of the driving disc to the transmission disc can be formed, and an automatic adjusting assembly can adjust downward supporting elastic force borne by the driven disc; and after an overload condition occurs, the driven disc moves upwards, so that the driving conical surface and the inner end of the driven push column can form sliding tangent fit, the locking teeth are pushed to clamp and lock the driven locking bevel gear, and the side fixing plate is limited and stopped on one side of the springing sliding column by utilizing the fit formed by the driving inclined surface and the driven inclined surface, so that rapid and safe locking after overload is formed.

title: 一种人形机器人的关节模组
abstract: The present invention discloses a joint module for a humanoid robot, comprising a housing, a first cooling pipeline, and a motor and a speed reducer mechanism coaxially disposed inside the housing respectively; the motor includes a main shaft rotatably disposed inside the housing and a first rotor, a stator, and a second rotor arranged sequentially along the axial direction of the main shaft; an annular base of the stator is fixed in the inner cavity of the housing; the main shaft is coaxially disposed in the inner ring of the annular base, and both ends thereof extend outside the stator and are respectively connected to the dual rotors; stator cores distributed at intervals along the circumferential direction are provided on the annular base; an internal oil circuit is opened on the housing, and the internal oil circuit includes a spiral oil circuit surrounding the outer periphery of the speed reducer mechanism; the first cooling pipeline is annularly fixed in the inner ring of the stator. On the basis of adopting a single-stator dual-rotor motor structure, the present invention effectively cools the joint module by arranging the first cooling pipeline on the stator and arranging the spiral oil circuit around the outer periphery of the speed reducer mechanism, thereby improving the service life of the joint module.

title: Data processing method, device and system
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method, device and system, and relates to the technical field of data processing. In this way, the computing device obtains the navigation data according to the camera and the IMU. Thus, the problems that the time consumption is long and complexity is high when the humanoid robot is pulled by depending on a traction mechanism provided with an odometer and the trajectory pose of the humanoid robot is obtained by measuring the number of turns of rotation of the wheels are solved, and the data processing method provided by the invention does not need to measure the number of turns of rotation of the wheels to obtain specific navigation data; according to the method, the humanoid robot can be carried to the target area without the help of the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot is driven to move in the target area to obtain the body navigation data, so that the time for obtaining the body navigation data is shortened, and the efficiency for obtaining the body navigation data is improved. And body navigation data can be obtained without a humanoid robot, so that the cost is saved, and the use scene is expanded.

title: Robot skin temperature regulation and control system and method based on bionic heat conduction
abstract: The invention discloses a robot skin temperature regulation and control system and method based on bionic heat conduction, relates to the technical field of robot temperature control, and aims to solve the problem that a current humanoid robot cannot realize personalized temperature regulation of different trunk part areas. The system comprises a temperature control device and a plurality of local control devices in communication connection with the temperature control device, the temperature control device and the plurality of local control devices are all connected with a bionic skin inner layer, each local control device comprises a local control module and a flow controller connected with the local control module, the local control module is connected with an AI sensing feedback module, and the flow controller is connected with the AI sensing feedback module. The AI sensing feedback module comprises a feedback unit, and the feedback unit receives the integrated data and transmits feedback information to each local control module. The temperature regulation of the inner layer of the bionic skin in each area is realized by utilizing a plurality of local control devices, and intelligent feedback sensing can be performed by virtue of an AI sensing feedback module, so that the temperature control bionic design of the robot is realized.

title: Humanoid robot leg and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg and a humanoid robot. The robot leg comprises a thigh mechanism, a shank mechanism and a foot mechanism which are rotationally connected in sequence. In the upright state, the thigh mechanism inclines forwards relative to the vertical shank mechanism to form an included angle and is supported and limited by the front side of the shank mechanism. A driving motor and a hinge seat are arranged at the joint of each joint, and a motor body of the driving motor is compactly connected with the gear box through the insertion matching of a radial boss and a connecting groove; the gear box serves as a rotating shaft of the hinge seat, an adapter transmits torque through a buffer pad, and abrasion of the periphery is reduced through a supporting pad. An ankle support of the foot mechanism is rotationally connected with the foot mechanism through an independent rotating shaft mechanism so as to transmit impact force and protect an ankle motor. A tiptoe assembly of the foot mechanism achieves passive buffering and treading assistance through a rotating pair and an elastic device. The invention further discloses a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises the humanoid robot leg. According to the invention, the standing stability, the joint connection reliability and the exercise energy efficiency are improved.

title: Intelligent robot feeding method and system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent robot feeding method and system, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a test rubber product image; determining a plurality of initial stress points of the tested rubber product by using an initial stress point model based on the tested rubber product image; determining three-finger stress points based on the plurality of initial stress points of the tested rubber product; generating a plurality of sets of grabbing schemes based on a plurality of initial stress points and three-finger stress points of the tested rubber product, wherein each set of grabbing scheme comprises five-finger stress points; acquiring a captured video of each set of capturing scheme; target grabbing points of the remaining two fingers are determined based on the grabbing video of each set of grabbing scheme; and based on the force bearing points of the three fingers and the target grabbing points of the remaining two fingers, the five-finger robot is controlled to conduct feeding grabbing on the remaining rubber products. According to the method, the adaptive grabbing points of the rubber products can be efficiently and accurately determined, and stable feeding grabbing of the robot is achieved.

title: Double-arm follow-up cooperative control method for humanoid robot based on self-adaptive force control
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot two-arm follow-up cooperative control method based on self-adaptive force control, which comprises the following steps of: 1, acquiring three-dimensional models of two arms of a humanoid robot, and establishing forward and inverse kinematics models of the two arms of the humanoid robot; 2, the initial positions of the two arms of the humanoid robot and the target position of a control object are determined, the initial positions and the target positions of the joints and the tail end of the two arms of the humanoid robot are determined, and the positions of joint connecting rods of the two mechanical arms under respective target joint angles in a world coordinate system are calculated; step 3, motion planning of human-shaped two-arm coordination control: carrying out motion planning on the target object in a task space, and then converting the motion into motion of human-shaped two arms; 4, a tight coupling or loose coupling dynamic model of the humanoid double arms and the target object is established, 5, a humanoid double arm controller calculates force and torque of contact points of the tail ends of the humanoid robot double arms and the operation object, and self-adaptive bilateral collaborative admittance control is completed; and step 6, completing double-arm adaptive follow-up cooperative control.

title: Voice-driven facial expression control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot voice-driven facial expression control method and system. The extracted voice audio features are subjected to face corresponding key point prediction through an audio emotion key point prediction model, and the audio emotion key point prediction model is a regression model based on a long short-term memory network and is used for learning a nonlinear mapping relation between an audio feature sequence and face key point coordinates; outputting a predicted key point position difference value or a relative distance; the predicted face key points are input into a steering engine angle mapping model, and the steering engine angle mapping model maps the geometrical relationship of the face key points into angle instruction parameters for controlling a robot face micro steering engine based on a pre-trained nonlinear regression model; and according to the predicted angle instruction parameters, driving a robot face mechanism to make human expression simulating motion synchronous with the voice content. The problem that multi-channel interaction of a traditional robot is not coordinated is solved, and the naturalness and emotional expressive force of man-machine interaction are remarkably improved.

title: Knee joint self-adaptive locking device of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot knee joint self-adaptive locking device which comprises a rotary joint module, a sliding locking module and a sensing control module, the sliding locking module comprises an electromagnetic lock, a sliding sleeve, a reset spring, a locking sliding block, a linear guide rail and a connecting block, and the sliding sleeve is connected with the electromagnetic lock; the locking sliding block is installed on the sliding sleeve through the reset spring, the electromagnetic lock and the linear guide rail are fixed to the connecting block through bolts, the sliding sleeve is installed on the linear guide rail, and the sliding sleeve and the linear guide rail form a sliding pair. By means of the ingenious mechanical structure design, in combination with a gait phase recognition control method following a natural biped walking mode, rigid locking of the knee joint in a standing phase and flexible releasing of the knee joint in a swinging phase are achieved in a proper walking stage, and the locking mechanism has the advantages of being light in weight, low in power consumption and rapid in response; compared with an existing hydraulic locking scheme, the hydraulic locking device is simpler in structure, free of complex hydraulic pipelines and driving systems, smaller in overall size and lighter in mass.

title: Data acquisition method and equipment for humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data acquisition method and equipment for a humanoid robot training ground, and belongs to the technical field of industrial manufacturing equipment of the humanoid robot training ground. The method comprises the steps that in response to a received task instruction, a target cleaning position on a to-be-cleaned object is determined, trajectory planning is conducted according to the target cleaning position based on a preset weighting function, a target trajectory is obtained, the preset weighting function is associated with a first distance and an arm angle, the first distance is the distance between the target cleaning position and an end effector, and the arm angle is the distance between the target cleaning position and the end effector. A cleaning task is executed on the target cleaning position according to the target track, target data are collected and uploaded in the task execution process, and the target data comprise at least one of the target cleaning position and the target track. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the acquisition efficiency and data accuracy of the humanoid robot in a training ground can be improved, and the operation efficiency and safety in the industrial manufacturing industry or a characteristic operation scene can be improved.

title: Interactive communication humanoid robot expression simulation method based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention discloses an interactive humanoid robot expression simulation method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of expression simulation, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a brain wave signal of a user, carrying out the preprocessing, and generating a power spectrum density feature; inputting the power spectral density features into a pre-trained emotion classification model, and outputting an emotion category and an emotion intensity value of the user; performing emotional expression mapping on the emotional category and the emotional intensity value, and outputting a bionic muscle contraction instruction; performing facial adjustment on facial muscle fibers of the humanoid robot according to the bionic muscle contraction instruction, dynamically adjusting surface texture details of the humanoid robot, and generating a simulated micro expression; and capturing user face feedback data through camera shooting eyeballs, evaluating the acceptance degree of the user on the simulated micro-expression based on the user face feedback data, and outputting an expression optimization strategy. According to the method, through deformation matching and expression optimization double-closed-loop modeling driven by user feedback, biological simulation of micro-expressions of the humanoid robot is realized.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the three-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism comprises two movable plates, and three telescopic driving pieces, a plurality of universal joints and supporting rods which are arranged between the two movable plates, one end of each universal joint is connected with the corresponding movable plate, and the other end of each universal joint is connected with the corresponding supporting rod. The other end of the universal joint is connected with the telescopic driving pieces, the supporting rod is arranged among the three telescopic driving pieces, one end of the supporting rod is provided with a spherical hinge, the other end of the supporting rod is fixedly connected with one movable plate, the spherical hinge is connected with the other movable plate, and the telescopic driving pieces are connected with the other movable plate in the telescopic process. The spherical hinge assists in transmitting small torque, smooth movement of the whole structure can be guaranteed, and large-range rotation can also be achieved.

title: Crus structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a shank structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, solves the problems that a shank motor is mounted at the upper end of a shank, so that the attractiveness is influenced, and the simulation is reduced, and adopts the technical scheme that the shank structure mainly comprises a shank bracket and a motor fixed on the shank bracket, the motor comprises a shell, a driving unit, a control unit and a transmission unit, the shank support is provided with an installation cavity formed in the length direction of the shank support, the shell of the motor is in a long strip shape and is fixed in the installation cavity, the driving unit comprises an output shaft, the transmission unit comprises a rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is in transmission connection with the output shaft and is used for outputting torque. The rotating axis of the output shaft is perpendicular to the rotating axis of the transmission shaft, the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the foot end piece, and the driving motor is driven by the rotating shaft to achieve relative rotation of the shank support and the foot end piece. The motor fixing device is mainly used for fixing the motor in the shank support, so that the appearance of the shank support is more attractive.

title: Plug-in-free and networking-free wireless mini robot camera
abstract: The utility model discloses a plug-in-free and networking-free wireless mini robot camera which comprises a robot shell, a monitoring camera is fixedly installed on the top of the front face of the robot shell, connecting pieces are fixedly connected to the tops of the two sides of the robot shell, and privacy covers are rotationally connected to the surfaces of the two connecting pieces. A PCB is fixedly installed on the inner wall of the robot shell, a battery is fixedly installed on one side of the front face of the PCB, a 4G module is fixedly installed on the other side of the front face of the PCB, a processor is fixedly installed in the middle of the front face of the PCB, and a back plate is arranged at the top of the back face of the robot shell. title: Knee joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a knee joint structure and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the knee joint structure comprises a driver, a driven part and a middleware, one end of the middleware is connected with the driver, the other end of the middleware is connected with the driven part, the driver drives the middleware, and the driven part is connected with the driver. The middle part drives the driven part; the driver simulates a thigh, the telescopic part of the driver simulates the lower end of a thigh and is used for providing driving force for a knee joint, the driven part simulates the upper end of a tibia, the middle part simulates a ligament, the driver drives the middle part firstly, and then the middle part drives the driven part to move, so that the driven part moves under the assistance of the middle part; relative sliding of the thighbone and the tibia and bending movement of the knee joint are simulated; compared with an existing knee joint structure doing circular motion, the position of the actuator is raised, the middle piece and the driven piece are light in weight, the rotational inertia of the knee joint is reduced, and even load bearing is further achieved.

abstract: According to one aspect, ego-body pose estimation may include imputing a trajectory and a pose for a hand of a human based on an ego-centric input video and an input head tracking signal, generating a whole-body pose for the human based on the trajectory and the pose for the hand and by denoising the trajectory and the pose of the hand, and implementing an action based on the whole-body pose determined for the human via an actuator.

title: Humanoid robot waist structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot waist structure and a humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problem that the waist structure of the existing humanoid robot cannot enable the part above the waist to be always kept in a horizontal posture in the vertical up-down movement process. The humanoid robot waist structure comprises a first parallelogram connecting rod frame, a first driving mechanism, a second parallelogram connecting rod frame and a second driving mechanism, and the first parallelogram connecting rod frame comprises a base, a connecting seat and a first rod set rotationally arranged between the base and the connecting seat, the first driving mechanism is used for driving the first rod group to rotate; the second parallelogram connecting rod frame comprises a connecting base, an upper support opposite to the connecting base and a second rod set rotationally arranged between the connecting base and the upper support, and the second driving mechanism is used for driving the second rod set to rotate. According to the utility model, the part above the waist can be always kept in a horizontal posture in the vertical up-and-down movement process.

title: Humanoid robot joint electric cylinder
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot joint electric cylinder which comprises a rod head joint bearing, a sleeve, a first bearing, a stator sleeve, a lead screw sleeve and a piston rod, the sleeve is fixedly connected with the stator sleeve, one end of the lead screw sleeve is radially supported in the sleeve through the first bearing, and the other end of the lead screw sleeve is fixedly connected with the piston rod. A driving plate is installed in the sleeve, a planetary roller screw rod is installed in the screw rod sleeve, the planetary roller screw rod and the screw rod sleeve are meshed through threads, a frameless motor is installed in the stator sleeve, a rotor of the frameless motor is fixedly connected with the outer circle of the screw rod sleeve, and the rotor of the frameless motor is fixedly connected with the outer circle of the screw rod sleeve. A stator of the frameless motor is fixedly connected with the interior of the stator sleeve, one end of the piston rod is fixedly connected with the planetary roller lead screw, and the other end of the piston rod is supported through an anti-rotation sleeve and connected with the rod head knuckle bearing. According to the humanoid robot joint, the electric cylinder and the linear driver are internally arranged, and the structure is compact.

title: Ankle joint driven by double tendons for humanoid robot
abstract: A double-tendon-driven ankle joint for a humanoid robot comprises a shank support structure, an ankle joint shaft structure and an output driving support structure, the end of the ankle joint shaft structure is rotatably mounted on the shank support structure, and the output driving support structure is provided with an ankle joint shaft mounting part, a foot plate mounting part and two driving reel groove structures. The foot plate mounting part is located at the bottom of the output driving support structure and used for mounting the foot plate structure, the two driving reel groove structures are concentric and located on the two sides of the top of the output driving support structure, and the ankle joint shaft mounting part is located at the concentric shaft position of the two driving reel groove structures and used for mounting the foot plate structure. And the ankle joint shaft mounting part is used for mounting an ankle joint shaft structure. The device is simple in structure, convenient in motion control, low in motion inertia, low in manufacturing cost and stable in operation.

title: Knee joint inflexion assembly and humanoid transfer robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an inflexion knee joint assembly and a humanoid transfer robot. The inflexion knee joint assembly comprises a fixed seat, the first telescopic arm mechanism is rotationally arranged on the fixed seat; the joint driving motor is arranged on the first telescopic arm mechanism; the second telescopic arm mechanism is arranged on the joint driving motor in a transmission manner; one end of the elastic supporting mechanism is fixedly arranged on the first telescopic arm mechanism, the other end of the elastic supporting mechanism is movably arranged on the joint driving motor and connected with the second telescopic arm mechanism, and when the first telescopic arm mechanism and the second telescopic arm mechanism form an acute angle, the elastic supporting mechanism provides supporting force for the second telescopic arm mechanism; therefore, the output torque of the joint driving motor is greatly reduced, and the problem that a knee joint motor of an existing humanoid transfer robot needs large redundant power is effectively solved.

title: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated power cable for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cables, in particular to a cross-linked polyethylene insulated power cable for a humanoid robot, which comprises a plurality of groups of conductors, a heat insulation and heat conduction structure, a sheath, a heat dissipation structure and a power cable, and the insulating layer is arranged on the sheath and is in contact with the heat-insulating heat-conducting structure inside the sheath. The conductors are separated through the partition plates and the partition edge strips on the partition plates, and the situation that heat cannot be dissipated effectively due to the fact that the cable cores are attached together is avoided. By means of the heat conduction strips embedded in the separation edge strips and the heat conduction aluminum foil layers making contact with the heat conduction strips, heat generated by the conductors can be conducted outwards, and heat concentration in the cable is avoided. Through the heat dissipation structure which is arranged on the cable joint and is in contact with the heat-conducting aluminum foil layer, heat in the heat-conducting aluminum foil layer can be rapidly taken away through the cooling channel in the heat dissipation structure, so that the purpose of heat dissipation is achieved.

title: Training method and device for walking control model of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a training method and device for a walking control model of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of sensors and robots. The method comprises the following steps: predicting a predicted footing position at a next moment based on a foot position corresponding to a current training sample and a motion control instruction; determining a plurality of candidate landing positions in a sampling neighborhood of the predicted landing position; respectively acquiring topographic feature data in the coverage area of each candidate landing position, and calculating a flatness index of each candidate landing position according to the topographic feature data; and determining the candidate landing position with the optimal flatness index as a target landing position of the current training sample so as to train a humanoid robot walking control model. According to the method and the device, the humanoid robot can evaluate the topographic relief information in the walking control process, and a more accurate humanoid robot walking control model is trained, so that an accurate target landing position can be output in an uneven area, and the risk of instability of the humanoid robot is reduced.

title: 针对柔性双臂人形机器人的数据驱动增强控制方法
abstract: A data-driven enhanced control method for a flexible dual-arm humanoid robot, belonging to the technical field of robot motion control, comprising the following steps: Step S1, based on motion information of the flexible robot, transforming a system model containing unknown dynamic parameters into a linear discrete-time data model with equivalent characteristics; Step S2, designing an improved projection estimation algorithm to perform real-time estimation on pseudo-partial derivative parameters of the robot system; Step S3, designing a finite-time performance index function, and obtaining a data-driven enhanced controller based on the optimal control principle; Step S4, constructing a data-driven high-order control barrier function based on the linear time-data model, and obtaining a data-driven control law satisfying both stability and preset control performance by solving a quadratic programming problem. The present invention effectively simplifies modeling steps, improves modeling efficiency, and balances finite-time convergence performance and optimal control performance of the flexible dual-arm humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid care robot system based on multi-modal perception and behavior decision
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid care robot system based on multi-modal perception and behavior decision, which comprises the following steps: collecting multi-modal data of a care object, and generating a modal feature sequence; inputting to an improved RT-DETR model, constructing a modal conflict graph, and identifying modal conflict nodes; judging the conflict intensity in the modal conflict graph and a preset conflict threshold value, and interrupting the nursing behavior path according to a judgment result; writing the modal conflict node, the modal channel name and the modal confidence value into a behavior buffer area; constructing a confidence trend graph, identifying modal channels with continuously reduced confidence, and removing corresponding behavior path branches; regenerating a candidate path set, and calculating a behavior score value of each candidate path; and selecting the candidate path with the highest behavior score value, and recovering the nursing task execution process. According to the invention, the task stability and the intelligent response capability of the nursing robot in a multi-modal sensing scene are improved.

title: Humanoid robot behavior marking method, device and system and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot behavior marking method, device and system and a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that current target position information of the humanoid robot is acquired; whether the current humanoid robot is located in a set working area range or not is judged according to the target position information; if the current humanoid robot is located in the set working area range, the current role mode of the humanoid robot is kept; and if the current humanoid robot is not located in the set working area range, the current role mode of the humanoid robot is stopped. According to the method, the target position information of the current humanoid robot is obtained, and whether the current humanoid robot is located in the working area or leaves the working area or not is judged according to the target position information. Through the judgment, the current role mode of the humanoid robot is changed. And therefore, the condition that the humanoid robot is irrelevant due to the change of an application scene is avoided. The invention is mainly applied to the technical field of humanoid robots.

title: Joint transmission mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a joint transmission mechanism and a humanoid robot. The joint transmission mechanism comprises a joint assembly and a flexible traction assembly. The joint assembly comprises a first connecting part, a second connecting part and a third connecting part which are rotationally connected in sequence, the first connecting part is configured to be rotationally connected with the first connecting component, and the third connecting part is configured to be connected with the second connecting component; the flexible traction assembly comprises a first traction assembly, a second traction assembly and a third traction assembly, and the first traction assembly is connected with the first connecting part and is configured to apply an acting force rotating around a first axis to the first connecting part; one end of the second traction assembly is connected with the second connecting component, and the other end of the second traction assembly bypasses the third connecting part to be connected with the second connecting part; compact integration of three degrees of freedom of the hip joint is achieved, and the problems that a traditional series connection structure is large in axial size, concentrated in weight and prone to damage due to rigid transmission collision are effectively solved.

title: 一种基于向量纠缠的人形机器人控制方法、装置及设备
abstract: The present invention proposes a humanoid robot control method, apparatus, and device based on vector entanglement, which extracts core action sequences by performing frequency statistical analysis on control tasks; constructs basic action vectors, and generates a spiral entangled action vector chain by using a partial overlapping entanglement method; constructs an action semantic graph by using dynamic semantic mapping and generates a deviation prediction path; identifies non-integer periodic actions through deviation feature vectors, extracts overlapping nodes from the entangled vector chain for borrow-fusion to generate a complete execution sequence; constructs a deviation propagation network to analyze deviation diffusion paths, identifies deviation amplification nodes and convergence nodes, and extracts usable components to generate action enhancement factors; and cooperatively optimizes the enhancement factors and the entangled vector chain to generate an enhanced control sequence, thereby achieving a transition of deviation from passive elimination to active utilization, and improving the motion continuity and energy efficiency of the humanoid robot.

title: Double-arm robot simulation rehabilitation therapist traction training method for stroke upper limb rehabilitation
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of double-arm/humanoid robot control, and discloses a double-arm robot simulation rehabilitation therapist traction training method for stroke upper limb rehabilitation. From the perspective of training safety, an 8-degree-of-freedom kinematics model of the upper limb complex is established and used for evaluating the reachable working space of the tail ends and the front arms of the arms in the interaction process with the double-arm robot. Based on the characteristics of double-arm rehabilitation, a non-redundant inverse kinematics method is provided to constrain joint angles, and a safety mechanism under double constraints is established. From the perspective of training scientificity and flexibility, a potential field control strategy is introduced, so that the robot can learn traction characteristics of a rehabilitation therapist from single demonstration. In combination with master-slave control, the two-arm robot can reproduce assistance of a rehabilitation therapist and allows compliance interaction. According to the invention, the double-arm/humanoid robot can perform therapist type traction training on to-be-recovered limbs, and safe, scientific and smooth rehabilitation training like therapists is provided in clinical and family environments.

title: Motor for robot, mechanical leg and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motor for a robot, a mechanical leg and a humanoid robot. A motor for a robot comprises a motor body and a gear box, the end portion of the motor body and the end portion of the gear box are provided with a first boss and a second boss which protrude outwards in the radial direction of a motor shaft respectively, and the first boss is in butt joint with the second boss; the motor further comprises a connecting piece, a connecting groove is formed in the connecting piece, the first boss and the second boss are jointly inserted into the connecting groove, and the groove wall of the connecting groove is matched with the first boss and the second boss so as to limit relative displacement of the motor body and the gear box in the butt joint direction. The connecting piece is connected with the motor body and the gearbox. The invention further discloses a mechanical leg which adopts the motor of any scheme. The invention further discloses a humanoid robot which adopts the mechanical leg. The driving unit has the advantages that the connecting flange structure of the motor body and the gear box is very light, thin and compact, and the size minimization and the weight lightest of the whole driving unit are realized on the premise of ensuring ultrahigh reliability.

title: Anthropomorphic robot eyeball interaction system, method, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides an anthropomorphic robot eyeball interaction system, method and device and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: recognizing a basic emotion of a user through an AI model according to a voice signal of the user, and generating a corresponding emotion probability value; based on the emotion probability value of each user basic emotion, the adjustment brightness of the white LED lamp strip, the adjustment brightness of the red LED lamp strip, the current-limiting resistance values of the first power supply circuit and the second power supply circuit, the rotation angle of the pupil layer and the RGB value of the RGB lamp bead array are calculated; and a control signal is generated and sent to the first power supply circuit, the second power supply circuit, the stepping motor and the RGB lamp bead array so as to control the lamp color and brightness of the eye white layer, the rotation angle of the pupil layer and the color of the eyeball layer. Through the emotion recognition technology, the emotion of the user is converted into the specific expression of the simulated eyeball, and therefore more visual and more vivid emotion interaction between the simulated eyeball and the user is achieved.

title: Human production scene labor strategy decoding method and device for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a human production scene labor strategy decoding method and device for a humanoid robot and a medium. The human production scene labor strategy decoding method comprises the steps that electromyographic signals of upper limb parts of a human body are collected in real time; an encoder module based on a series-parallel mixed structure is adopted to encode the collected electromyographic signals to obtain hidden space representation of the electromyographic signals, and meanwhile semi-structured hidden space representation representing the hand motion state is constructed; inputting the implicit space representation of the myoelectricity data into the diffusion model as a condition vector, and analyzing to obtain a semi-structured hand motion state implicit space representation; decoding from the semi-structured hand motion state hidden space representation to obtain real-time angle data of each joint of the hand, and taking the real-time angle data as a finger motion tracking result; a human action strategy is decoded from the finger motion tracking result, and interaction object information is deduced according to the human action strategy; and integrating the finger motion tracking result and the interaction object information to obtain a complete hand labor strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of accuracy, reliability and the like.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises an arm, and the arm comprises a sixth steering engine fixed to a first shoulder joint supporting frame; the second shoulder joint supporting frame is fixed to a sixth output disc of the sixth steering engine; a seventh output disc of the seventh steering engine is fixed to the second shoulder joint supporting frame; the upper end of the big arm support is fixed with the seventh steering engine; the eighth steering engine is fixed at the lower end of the big arm support; the small arm support is provided with a main body part and an extension part, the upper end of the extension part is connected with the side part of the main body part, the lower end of the extension part extends downwards in an inclined mode, and the upper end of the main body part is fixed to an eighth output disc of an eighth steering engine; the ninth steering engine is fixed in the area where the extension part of the small arm support is located; and the thumb support is fixed on a ninth output disc of the ninth steering engine. The forearm and the palm are combined into a whole, an unnecessary wrist structure is omitted, and the structure is simplified. The shoulder joint supporting frame can serve as an auxiliary fixing structure, and the arm supporting structure can be greatly simplified.

title: Humanoid robot instruction understanding method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot instruction understanding method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: receiving industrial operation instruction information, and detecting whether the industrial operation instruction information belongs to an industrial scene; inputting to an industrial scene semantic understanding model, and obtaining an output target operation parameter result; safety verification is carried out based on the industrial safety rule base, and a control instruction is generated by using the target operation parameter result to drive the humanoid robot; wherein the industrial scene semantic understanding model is constructed on the basis of a large language model; the target operation parameter result comprises an operation object identifier, an action type, execution precision and a security boundary value. According to the method, the scene relevance is improved by detecting whether the industrial operation instruction information conforms to the industrial scene or not, the analysis precision of the terminology and the operation parameters is improved by utilizing the industrial scene semantic understanding model, the safety verification is performed by introducing the industrial safety rule base, the threshold exceeding operation risk is reduced, the safety is improved, and the user experience is improved. Therefore, the use experience of the user is effectively improved.

title: Dynamic scene online three-dimensional reconstruction system and method for humanoid robot teleoperation
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic scene online three-dimensional reconstruction system and method for humanoid robot teleoperation. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an RGB-D video data stream collected by a first visual angle camera of a humanoid robot; performing dynamic and static separation processing on the RGB-D video data stream to obtain a mask graph comprising a static background and a dynamic object; constructing a static Gaussian map dictionary and a dynamic Gaussian map dictionary based on the mask graph; carrying out real-time asynchronous updating on the static Gaussian map dictionary and the dynamic Gaussian map dictionary by adopting a dual key frame selection strategy; and performing fusion rendering on the static Gaussian map dictionary and the dynamic Gaussian map dictionary to obtain a three-dimensional scene view for teleoperation, and completing online three-dimensional reconstruction of a dynamic scene. The method can be used for dynamic scenes where the humanoid robot performs teleoperation, such as training data acquisition in life scenes, electric power inspection, dangerous scene inspection and the like, and a real-time and immersive three-dimensional environment view is provided for a teleoperator.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom permanent magnet spherical motor for wrist joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom permanent magnet spherical motor for a wrist joint of a humanoid robot. The multi-degree-of-freedom permanent magnet spherical motor comprises a supporting seat; the spherical rotor comprises a hollow rotor spherical shell, a plurality of permanent magnets and a rotor connecting piece, and the polarities of any two adjacent permanent magnets are opposite; the output shaft is fixed on the rotor connecting piece and is movably connected to the supporting seat; the stator is arranged outside the spherical rotor in a surrounding mode, the stator comprises a plurality of stator connecting pieces, a plurality of stator tooth units and a plurality of winding coil units, each stator tooth unit is connected to two adjacent stator connecting pieces, each stator tooth unit comprises a plurality of stator teeth, and the winding coil units all face the permanent magnets; each winding coil unit comprises a plurality of winding coils, the winding coils are arranged on the stator teeth, and the plurality of stator connecting pieces are fixed on the supporting seat through connecting assemblies. The humanoid robot wrist joint is compact in size and large in output torque, and the self-rotating motion and the pitching motion of the humanoid robot wrist joint can meet the driving requirements of the humanoid robot wrist joint on general occasions.

title: Humanoid robot aviation plug tail end tool
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot aviation plug tail end tool which comprises an aviation plug socket, humanoid robot mechanical arms are arranged on the two sides of the aviation plug socket respectively, a locking piece is arranged on the aviation plug socket, and tail end tools are installed at the tail ends of the humanoid robot mechanical arms respectively. A tail end tool is installed at the tail end of a humanoid robot mechanical arm, a left mechanical arm and a right mechanical arm can clamp, plug and pull out a plug at the same time by controlling a pair of meshed bevel gears and a connecting rod mechanism of the tail end tool, and the tail end tool of the left mechanical arm and the tail end tool of the right mechanical arm are each provided with an electric telescopic rod. The plug locking piece is pushed to complete plugging and locking of the plug on the circuit breaker of the middle-mounted switch cabinet, manual operation can be replaced, the structure is simple, control is easy, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Humanoid robot wrist joint structure driven by parallel motors
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot wrist joint structure driven by parallel motors, and the humanoid robot wrist joint structure comprises a mounting base, and a first driving mechanism, a second driving mechanism and a movable support which are arranged on the mounting base; the first driving mechanism comprises a first driving motor and a first transmission assembly connected with the output end of the first driving motor. The second driving mechanism comprises a second driving motor and a second transmission assembly connected with the output end of the second driving motor. The first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are arranged on the same side of the mounting base side by side in the vertical direction, and the first transmission assembly and the second transmission assembly are distributed on the other side of the mounting base; the movable support is provided with a fixed connecting end and an action output end; the fixed connecting end is connected with the end part of the mounting base; the action output end is connected with the first transmission assembly and the second transmission assembly. The scheme has the advantages of compact structure, low rotational inertia, sensitive dynamic response and the like.

title: Fault analysis method, system and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a fault analysis method, system, equipment and medium for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the multi-modal time sequence data of the humanoid robot in a preset time before and after a fault, and the fault description data of the humanoid robot, the multi-modal time sequence data comprising joint time sequence data and sensing time sequence data; inputting the multi-modal time sequence data into a trained first model for visual conversion to obtain visual representation output by the trained first model; inputting the fault description data into a trained second model for text conversion to obtain text representation output by the trained second model; and performing fault analysis on the visual representation and the text representation to obtain a fault analysis result of the humanoid robot. The method can improve the accuracy of fault analysis of the humanoid robot. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on multi-modal biofeedback and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method based on multi-modal biofeedback and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of collecting original multi-modal data; performing data preprocessing on the original multi-modal data to obtain candidate multi-modal data; performing feature alignment and fusion on the candidate multi-modal data to generate a fusion feature vector; inputting the fusion feature vector into a control model, and outputting a joint control sequence; the joint control sequence is converted into a servo motor PWM drive signal to drive a joint actuator of the humanoid robot to move; and asynchronous control and state adjustment are carried out on actions of the humanoid robot based on the biological feedback signals, and online fine adjustment is carried out on a joint actuator of the humanoid robot according to robot response deviation data. The adaptability and interaction accuracy of the robot to the complex environment can be improved, accurate and flexible control over the robot is achieved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

title: Robot control method and system based on adaptive approximate period control obstacle function
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot approximate period control method and system based on a self-adaptive period control obstacle function. The method comprises the steps that a state space model of approximate periodic walking of the biped robot is established, the measurement instantaneous frequency of a system state is obtained in real time through short-time Fourier transform, and approximate periodic characteristics of an accumulated phase time representation system are introduced; acquiring an estimated instantaneous frequency of a system state in real time by using a self-adaptive extended Kalman filter, adjusting the frequency of a control barrier function, and constructing a self-adaptive periodic discrete time control barrier function to obtain a function-based security set forward invariance guarantee; the accumulated phase time error is analyzed, three reset strategies are used for relieving the accumulated phase time error, and a proper reset strategy is selected according to the actual situation; under a model prediction control framework of single-step prediction, a control obstacle function is used as a constraint, and a walking task of the biped robot is completed by solving an optimization problem. The method adapts to the approximate periodic characteristics of the system by estimating the system period in real time.

title: Humanoid robot whole body motion control method based on model predictive control and reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a control method, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the data of a centroid state and an MPC optimal ground acting force in a plurality of motion states of a robot, designing a full-connection residual network, taking the centroid state information as the input, taking the ground acting force as the output, and designing a loss function based on priority. Upper and lower bounds of a friction cone and a sole reaction force are constrained, and the network is trained offline to fit MPC optimization quantity, so that an efficient mode of online reasoning is realized; the joint angle and the angular velocity are fused with the action at the previous moment, the centroid linear velocity and the angular velocity and the foot-ground acting force fitted through a residual network, a bionic reference trajectory is generated through a human motion public data set, different weights are given to a reward function group according to a dominant function value obtained through calculation, and the control performance is improved; symmetrical loss constraint is added to lower limb movement, and the algorithm convergence speed is increased. And finally, training to obtain a whole-body control strategy based on model priori knowledge and a human motion reference trajectory.

title: Humanoid robot teleoperation method based on multi-modal data fusion and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot teleoperation method based on multi-modal data fusion and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring original multi-modal data of an operator through multi-modal acquisition equipment; performing data preprocessing on the original multi-modal data through the controller to obtain candidate multi-modal data, and performing space-time alignment processing on the candidate multi-modal data through the controller to obtain target multi-modal data; inputting the target multi-modal data into the multi-modal fusion model through the controller, and outputting fusion features; a control instruction for the humanoid robot is generated through the controller based on the fusion features, so that the humanoid robot executes teleoperation according to the control instruction; if the response deviation occurs in the teleoperation, a correction instruction is generated through the controller based on the fusion features, so that the humanoid robot executes the correction instruction to correct the motion track of the teleoperation. The method can improve the accuracy, real-time performance and stability of teleoperation, and can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

title: 人形机器人的腿部组件、腿部结构和人形机器人
abstract: The present invention discloses a leg assembly, a leg structure, and a humanoid robot, belonging to the field of humanoid robots, and solves the problems that the hinge joints of traditional robot leg components are prone to wear and have poor impact resistance. The technical solution for solving the problem mainly comprises a bracket and a motor. The motor is fixed at a bottom end of the bracket, and the motor comprises a motor body, a gearbox, and a connecting member. The gearbox is fixed at a bottom of the motor body, the motor body is provided with a first boss, the gearbox is provided with a second boss, and the connecting member is provided with a connecting slot. The first boss and the second boss are jointly inserted into the connecting slot, a rotating shaft is provided with an adapter, a top end of the bracket forms a hinge seat, the adapter is in transmission connection with the hinge seat, and a buffer pad is disposed between the adapter and the hinge seat. The adapter transmits torque to the hinge seat through the buffer pad, a support pad is installed on the hinge seat, and the support pad forms a sliding support for the gearbox hinged to the hinge seat. The present invention helps to reduce the degree of wear and the service life of the leg assembly.

title: Humanoid robot task scheduling method and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot task scheduling method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a to-be-executed task; identifying a scene type and a task feature of the to-be-executed task; determining an operation stage according to the scene type and the task characteristics; determining a target task scheduling strategy based on the operation stage; and distributing the to-be-executed task to the target robot through the target task scheduling strategy. The task allocation and execution efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the user waiting time is shortened.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on human motion synthetic data
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on human motion synthetic data. The method comprises the steps that an SMPL pose sequence consistent with a preset action requirement is generated through a motion synthesis method, then SMPL pose migration is converted into a humanoid robot pose through a motion redirection method based on limb joint chain decomposition and NPR loss, and finally, under an action-critic reinforcement learning framework constrained by AMP, the SMPL pose sequence is converted into the humanoid robot pose. And applying the redirected pose data to motion control of the humanoid robot in combination with a human body pose style discriminator. According to the method, the effectiveness and generalization of the provided control method are verified by taking walking and running as action cases, and compared with a motion control method based on common reinforcement learning without introducing redirection motion data, the anthropomorphic degree and stability of autonomous motion of the humanoid robot can be obviously improved.

According to the method, the effectiveness and generalization of the provided control method are verified by taking walking and running as action cases, and compared with a motion control method based on common reinforcement learning without introducing redirection motion data, the anthropomorphic degree and stability of autonomous motion of the humanoid robot can be obviously improved.

title: Dielectric elastomer driving-based adjustable diaphragm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot optical systems, and discloses a dielectric elastomer driving-based adjustable diaphragm, which comprises a high-voltage electric signal output module and an adjustable diaphragm structure module, and is characterized in that the high-voltage electric signal output module is electrically connected with the adjustable diaphragm structure module; the adjustable diaphragm structure module comprises a dielectric elastomer driver and a flexible hinge structure; the high-voltage electric signal output module controls and outputs a high-voltage electric signal to the adjustable diaphragm structure module, the dielectric elastomer driver enables the area of the area where the flexible hinge structure is located to be enlarged under the driving of the high-voltage electric signal, and then the flexible hinge structure fixed to the dielectric elastomer driver generates single-axis displacement. Therefore, the clear aperture of the optical system is changed, and the luminous flux of the optical system is adjusted. The flexible hinge structure is driven by the dielectric elastomer, so that the function of the adjustable diaphragm is realized, the adjustment range of the clear aperture in a relatively large range is realized, and the function of completely limiting the luminous flux can be realized in principle.

abstract: Building on and adopting tele driving technologies, here a tele robotic arrangement (20) drives a vehicle via robot (21 ), replacing the dependence on tele controlled technologies and mechanisms installed on a minimum level 2 autonomous vehicle. The regular remote-control cockpit (22), simulating a vehicle cockpit (21) is driven by a remote driver to operate remotely the driving mechanisms and devices inside the actual vehicle via a humanoid robot (21), which consists of multiple cameras (eyes) (28), hands (29), adjustable angle feet (30), microphones (31), speakers (32), control units (33), signal receiver and transmitter units (58), in addition to the vehicle computer vision equipment (34), all are set to transmit remotely a semi-driver and vehicle vision to a remote driver receiver (58) inside a cockpit (22) and receive driving instructions from it. title: Humanoid robot joint structure
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robot joints, and discloses a humanoid robot joint structure. A fixing plate is arranged on the upper surface of the connecting block, a plurality of bolts are arranged on the upper surface of the fixing plate, an oil injection port is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the fixing plate, an oil injection port cover plate is arranged at the upper end of the oil injection port, an oil injection pipeline is arranged at the lower end of the oil injection port, and an oil injection nozzle is arranged at the lower end of the oil injection pipeline. The lubricating oil injection nozzle structure is a detachable lubricating oil injection nozzle structure of a humanoid robot joint structure. During use, a bolt penetrates through the fixing plate to be in threaded connection with the upper end of the connecting block, then the oil injection port cover plate is opened, and lubricating oil is injected into the oil injection port and then discharged from the oil injection nozzle through the oil injection pipeline. In the long-time operation process of numerous parts in a robot joint, abrasion can be caused by mutual friction, and the service life and the movement performance of the joint are affected.

title: Forward and inverse kinematics resolving method for 2-RSS-1U parallel mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a forward and inverse kinematics calculation method for a 2-RSS-1U parallel mechanism of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the inverse kinematics calculation method comprises the following steps: establishing an ankle shaft seat point coordinate system, and obtaining a pitch angle and a roll angle of a sole; calculating coordinates of the bottom coordinate points of the ankle connecting rods relative to the initial coordinate system based on a spatial triangular relation; converting to a driving motor coordinate system by combining the known position relation of the coordinate system; and calculating the angle of the driving motor according to the connecting rod length and vertex coordinates. The forward kinematics resolving method comprises the following steps: determining a fixed translation relationship between a mechanism constant parameter and a coordinate system; constructing a nonlinear equation set by taking the roll angle and the pitch angle as unknown quantities; and solving by combining a two-dimensional residual vector with a Newton iteration method, estimating a Jacobian matrix by using a finite difference method in iteration, judging convergence according to a residual threshold, and outputting an attitude angle. According to the forward and inverse kinematics calculation method, the calculation stability and adaptability can be improved.

title: Disturbance point cloud processing method under humanoid robot and industrial scene and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot, a disturbance point cloud processing method in an industrial scene and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining disturbance point cloud data and industrial object type information in the industrial scene, and calculating the dynamic distortion degree of the disturbance point cloud data; obtaining an operation task type of the humanoid robot, and determining a diffusion time step length through a preset diffusion step length mapping table according to the dynamic distortion degree and the operation task type; according to the diffusion time step length, the disturbance point cloud data are processed through a denoising diffusion model, denoising point cloud data are obtained, and in the training process of the denoising diffusion model, a loss function containing a geometric constraint term, an industrial feature matching term and a robot operation precision constraint term is adopted to calculate a loss value. According to the embodiment of the invention, the point cloud disturbance in an industrial scene can be effectively inhibited, and the processing result of the disturbance point cloud can keep key features and adapt to the operation requirements of the robot. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of industrial automation.

title: Humanoid robot arm rotation angle adjusting mechanism
abstract: According to the humanoid robot arm rotation angle adjusting mechanism, the driving lubrication function and the sealing function are integrated, a cavity composed of a transmission cavity and a driving cavity is symmetrically formed in a joint component, a joint is driven by gears symmetrically arranged on the two sides to rotate, and a rack and a sliding column are synchronously driven to do reciprocating motion; a piston barrel at the bottom of the sliding column forms a micro pump in a suction cavity, and lubricating oil deposited at the bottom of the cavity is continuously pumped to a transmission gear at the top end to realize active circulating lubrication so as to ensure sufficient lubrication and heat dissipation; meanwhile, the top end of the sliding column is linked with a folding inflator to compress the sliding column to generate positive-pressure gas to form a positive-pressure gas source, and the gas source can maintain positive pressure of lubricating oil in the cavity to effectively prevent dust and water and can serve as emergency power to be used for driving a brake locking joint or providing power for other pneumatic elements. According to the design, active lubrication and air pressure storage of joint movement are synchronously completed through single power input, and the reliability integration level and the autonomy capacity of the mechanism are remarkably improved.

title: Conveying device and conveying method
abstract: The invention provides a carrying device and a carrying method. The device is used for carrying the humanoid robot and comprises a base, a lifting mechanism and a hoisting assembly. The base is used for being placed on a supporting base face. A movable assembly is arranged at the bottom of the base. The lifting mechanism is provided with a fixed end and a movable end, the fixed end is fixedly connected with the base, and the movable end can move in the direction close to or away from the supporting base face. title: Forward and inverse kinematics resolving method for 2-SPS-1U parallel mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a forward and inverse kinematics calculation method for a 2-SPS-1U parallel mechanism of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. Inverse kinematics calculation includes the steps that the pitch angle and the roll angle of a wrist, the inherent position of a spherical hinge point at the tail end of an SPS branched chain and the fixed translation vector of a wrist rotating shaft base coordinate system relative to a driving motor coordinate system are obtained; and constructing an attitude rotation matrix to convert the tail end spherical hinge point to a real-time coordinate, converting the real-time coordinate to a driving motor coordinate system by combining a fixed translation vector, and calculating a coordinate vector modulus length to obtain a branched chain telescopic length. The forward kinematics solution comprises the steps of obtaining the actually measured length and constant parameters of the branched chain, and constructing a nonlinear equation set by taking a roll angle and a pitch angle as unknown quantities; and solving by combining a two-dimensional residual vector with a Newton iteration method, estimating a Jacobian matrix by using a finite difference method in iteration, and outputting an attitude angle when the residual is smaller than a threshold value. The method is accurate and stable in calculation and adapts to the robot wrist joint control requirement.

title: Full-size integrated humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a full-size integrated humanoid robot which comprises a trunk mechanism, arm mechanisms arranged on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the trunk mechanism, a hip mechanism arranged at the lower end of the trunk mechanism and leg mechanisms arranged at the left end and the right end of the hip mechanism. The driving modules of the arm mechanisms and the leg mechanisms are mounted in the inner cavities of the corresponding curved-surface metal shells through bolts respectively; the hip mechanism comprises a hip assembly and hip curved surface shells installed on the front side and the rear side of the hip assembly. The hip assembly comprises a hip base connected with an output shaft of a trunk driving module of the trunk mechanism. Hip driving modules are symmetrically arranged at the left end and the right end of an inner cavity of the hip base; a control circuit board of the hip driving module is arranged on the top of the hip base through a fixing plate. On the basis of replacing a traditional shell and a skeleton with the curved metal shell, the size of the hip mechanism is reduced, the assembly steps are simplified, the light weight of the humanoid robot is achieved, and the requirement for structural strength is met.

title: Tension and pressure sensor, linear joint of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sensors, and provides a tension and pressure sensor, a linear joint of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The tension and pressure sensor comprises a strain body, a first connecting piece and a second connecting piece, wherein the first connecting piece is a sleeve; the second connecting piece is a cylinder which is coaxial with the sleeve, and the outer diameter of the cylinder is smaller than the inner diameter of the sleeve; the outer surface of one end of the cylinder is connected to the strain body, and the other end is connected to the first external connecting piece; the inner diameter of the sleeve is connected to the strain body at one end, close to the connection position of the cylinder and the strain body, of the sleeve; the other end of the sleeve is connected to a second external connecting piece; a group of strain gauges are attached to the strain body, and the group of strain gauges generate measurement signals in response to the strain of the strain body. The tension and pressure sensor is hidden in the position of the tested assembly in an embedded structure, the integrity and the force bearing path of the original structure of the tested assembly are not damaged, the appearance of the tested assembly is more integrated, the structure of the sensor is protected, and the influence on other assembly parts is reduced.

title: Modular robot
abstract: The invention provides a modeling block robot which comprises a humanoid upper module, the humanoid upper module comprises an upper control system, a head mechanism, upper limb mechanisms, a waist mechanism, two upper arm mechanisms, forearm mechanisms and hand mechanisms, the head mechanism is arranged on the upper portion of the upper limb mechanism, the two upper arm mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the upper limb mechanism, and the forearm mechanisms are arranged on the lower portion of the humanoid upper module. The modular block robot is a modular robot-shaped upper module and can be combined with different devices to form a new robot.

title: Humanoid robot debugging frame
abstract: The humanoid robot debugging frame comprises a bottom plate, a fixing frame is arranged on the bottom plate, a cantilever is rotationally installed at the top end of the fixing frame, the two ends of an electric cylinder are rotationally connected with the fixing frame and the middle section of the cantilever respectively, and the cantilever is driven to turn over in the vertical plane around the fixing frame through stretching and retracting of an ejector rod of the electric cylinder; a coiling machine is arranged at the connecting end of the cantilever, a pulley mechanism is arranged on the cantilever and comprises a movable pulley located below the free end of the cantilever, the coiling machine drives a wire spool to rotate through a motor, a pull rope is wound around the wire spool, one end of the pull rope is fixed to the wire spool, and the other end of the pull rope is connected with the movable pulley through the pulley mechanism. The bottom of the movable pulley is connected with a connecting rope through a tension sensor, and the other end of the connecting rope is connected with the humanoid robot. Compared with the prior art, the device has the following advantages that the humanoid robot is pulled up to be away from the ground at the moment of unbalance, the humanoid robot is prevented from being collided and damaged, and the personal safety of debugging personnel can be guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot navigation method, device and equipment based on defect complementation
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation method, device and equipment based on defect complementation, and the method comprises the steps: extracting, recognizing and measuring defect points and data cavity regions through multi-sensor defect features, and generating a defect feature map; establishing a confidence decreasing verification mechanism based on defect mutual exclusion analysis, determining sensor weight distribution, and generating a navigation gain parameter from a negative error feature set; performing reverse analysis on the navigation data to extract data back information, reconstructing environment implicit features and constructing a reverse navigation field; analyzing the spatial distribution density of the data void region to generate a void density map, dividing a path phase change region and generating a phase change rule set; and fusing the curve path parameters, the three-dimensional path parameters and the navigation gain parameters to generate a self-adaptive navigation sequence, and driving the humanoid robot to realize intelligent navigation control. According to the method, the sensor defects are converted into navigation resources, and the navigation performance in a complex environment is improved.

title: Model training method, humanoid robot dynamic control method based on multi-modal data fusion and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a model training method, a humanoid robot dynamic control method based on multi-modal data fusion and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the preliminary training of a neural network model through a first-stage training sample set, obtaining an initial motion instruction, and carrying out the dynamic control of a humanoid robot based on the execution feedback information after the humanoid robot executes the initial motion instruction. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

title: Collision detection method and equipment for humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a collision detection method and equipment for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that resultant force, collected by a force sensor, of the tail end of the mechanical arm is obtained, derivation is conducted on the resultant force in time, first force change rate data of the resultant force in a time domain are obtained, low-pass filtering is conducted on the first force change rate data based on a preset frequency threshold value, and second force change rate data of the resultant force in the time domain are obtained; the preset frequency threshold value is determined by converting historical force change rate data into data on a frequency domain, the historical force change rate data is obtained by deriving resultant force obtained in the operation process with collision on time, and a collision detection result is determined according to the second force change rate data and the preset threshold value. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the calculation process is simple and efficient, and the target object screening efficiency and accuracy are improved.
