title: Full-drive joint module humanoid five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of dexterous hand design, and particularly relates to a full-drive joint module humanoid five-finger dexterous hand which comprises a palm, four fingers and a thumb, and the four fingers and the thumb are each provided with a base joint module, a middle joint module and a far joint module which are sequentially connected in series; each joint module is provided with an encoding driving unit, each encoding driving unit is provided with an encoder, a motor and a harmonic reducer, the motors are in driving connection with the harmonic reducers and are in transmission output by the harmonic reducers, so that the joint modules rotate and operate, and the encoders are used for acquiring joint angle positions and motor output shaft rotating speed information; the base joint modules of the four fingers are further provided with electric cylinders, the output ends of the electric cylinders are connected with the middle joint modules of the corresponding fingers through space connecting rod mechanisms, and the output ends of the electric cylinders stretch out and draw back to control the middle joint modules to conduct bending movement. The full-drive dexterous hand has extremely high active degree of freedom, is convenient to maintain, expand and iteratively upgrade, and has extremely high application value in the field of multiple industries.

title: Humanoid robot behavior expression method based on visual and auditory emotion and environmental perception
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot behavior expression method based on visual and auditory emotion and environment perception. The method comprises an interaction object face emotion perception method, an interaction object voice emotion perception method, a cross-modal decision strategy based on visual and auditory emotion and environment perception and a humanoid robot behavior expression strategy. According to the method, through interaction object face emotion perception, voice emotion perception, cross-modal decision and humanoid robot behavior expression, the vulnerability of single channel perception in a complex environment is overcome, the weight of visual perception and auditory perception in decision is dynamically adjusted, dynamic adaptive recognition of interaction object emotion in the complex environment is realized, and the interaction object emotion recognition efficiency is improved. And the emotional interactivity and scene adaptability of man-machine interaction or man-machine cooperation are improved.

title: Humanoid robot capable of switching forms
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot capable of switching forms. The humanoid robot comprises leg assemblies, arm assemblies, a trunk, a head assembly and a crotch assembly. The leg assembly is divided into a right leg assembly and a left leg assembly, and the right leg assembly and the left leg assembly are the same in structure and are bilaterally symmetrical. Hub motors are arranged at the right thigh and the left thigh, knee joint driven wheels and elbow joint driven wheels are arranged at the knee joints and the elbow joints, and rapid maneuverability in the vehicle form is achieved. The quick maneuverability of the humanoid robot can be improved, meanwhile, the loading capacity of the humanoid robot is improved, and the loading and mounting capacity is improved.

title: Method for determining positioning precision of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method for determining the positioning precision of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. According to the method, by obtaining multi-source positioning data from the humanoid robot and adjusting the weight coefficient of the multi-source positioning data, the multi-source positioning data can be combined with the original error value of the multi-source positioning data, and finally the positioning precision of the humanoid robot is determined. By adopting the method for determining the positioning precision, the weight coefficient of the multi-source positioning data can be flexibly adjusted according to different working environments of the humanoid robot, the accuracy of the positioning precision can be improved, and the working reliability of the humanoid robot under complex working conditions is ensured.

title: Battery disassembling and assembling structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of battery installation, in particular to a battery disassembling and assembling structure and a humanoid robot. The battery disassembling and assembling structure comprises a shell, a battery groove is formed in the shell, a battery bin is installed in the battery groove, and a battery body is installed in the battery bin in a clamped mode; the cover plate is rotationally arranged in the battery jar, a limiting assembly is arranged on the cover plate, and the auxiliary assembly is arranged on the shell; a fixing plate is fixedly installed at the end of an output rod of a spring telescopic rod, so that when a cover plate covers a battery bin, a rubber pad on the inner side of an arc-shaped plate is attached to a battery body until a cushion plate is clamped to the side wall of the battery bin and a limiting plate is clamped to the arc-shaped plate, and a limiting column is clamped into a V-shaped shifting plate groove to complete position fixing of the cover plate; and at the moment, the arc-shaped plate limits the battery main body, stable installation of the battery main body is guaranteed, deviation and dislocation of the battery are prevented, normal power supply of the battery is guaranteed, and then normal use of the humanoid robot is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot arm and a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot arm comprises an arm main body, the arm main body comprises at least one functional module, and the at least one functional module comprises a rotating module, a swinging module and a synchronous belt; one end of the synchronous belt is in transmission connection with the rotating module, and the other end of the synchronous belt is in transmission connection with the swinging module, so that when one of the rotating module and the swinging module is used for driving, the other one of the rotating module and the swinging module is driven, and all or part of the functional modules in the arm main body are driven to realize multi-angle rotation and multi-angle swinging. According to the humanoid robot arm, the synchronous belt transmission mode is used in at least one functional module in the humanoid robot arm, so that the robot arm can achieve cooperative proceeding of two actions of rotating and swinging, the flexibility of the robot arm is greatly improved, and the operation range of the robot arm is greatly widened; and the space is effectively saved, the overall size of the robot arm is reduced, and the overall weight of the robot arm is reduced.

title: System and method for intelligent plug-in mounting self-checking of line sequence of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a system and method for intelligent plug-in mounting and line sequence self-checking of a humanoid robot. The system comprises a mechanical arm, an end effector, a laser projection system, a mobile vision system and a six-dimensional force sensor. According to the system, laser guiding and SIFT feature recognition are adopted, and submillimeter-level automatic pre-alignment of a mechanical arm and an actuator is achieved; in the plugging process, process monitoring is carried out through six-dimensional force and torque data in combination with a standard curve and a DTW algorithm, and plugging abnormity is found in real time. After plugging is completed, a sweep frequency signal is injected, a poor contact point is accurately detected through impedance phase shift and amplitude analysis, and a defect position is delayed and positioned through signal reflection. For poor contact points, the system adopts a compensation path based on the Hausdorff distance, and drives the shape memory alloy to automatically repair, so that high-precision line sequence self-inspection and fault repair are realized. According to the system, the assembly accuracy and efficiency are greatly improved, the rework rate and the manufacturing cost are reduced, and the intelligence and reliability of the humanoid robot production process are remarkably enhanced.

title: Environment perception and autonomous navigation method based on humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot positioning, in particular to an environment perception and autonomous navigation method based on a humanoid robot and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring environment information in a preset sensing range through a multi-mode sensor; wherein the environment information comprises dynamic target information and static feature information; constructing an environment grid map according to the static feature information to obtain the environment grid map; calculating the environment grid map to obtain static boundary information; performing arrangement according to historical data of the dynamic target information to obtain historical dynamic data; calculating the dynamic target information and the historical dynamic data to obtain movement trend information of the obstacle; and performing calculation according to the motion trend information and the static boundary information to obtain real-time positioning information and an optimal navigation path. According to the method, the positioning precision, the environmental adaptability and the navigation safety of the humanoid robot in industrial and household complex dynamic scenes can be improved.

title: Self-adaptive power distribution method for heating bionic skin of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot control, particularly relates to a bionic skin heating self-adaptive power distribution method for a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problem that reasonable heating control is difficult to carry out on the humanoid robot when the humanoid robot executes a complex dynamic task in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target data; inputting the target data into a pre-constructed digital twinborn model to predict a thermal state change trend of each skin area in a future preset period, and identifying a key area which is heated preferentially in combination with the predictive motion state; taking the heating power distributed to each skin area as a decision variable, and constructing and solving a multi-objective optimization model; and determining a heating control instruction of each skin area according to the solved power distribution value. According to the method, the digital twinborn model and the predictive motion state are utilized, the thermal state trend caused by future actions and environment changes of the robot is predicted in advance, and the heating control effect of the robot under the complex working condition is effectively improved.

title: Robot multi-mode interaction control method and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a robot multi-mode interaction control method and a related device, and the method comprises the steps that a robot controller obtains user interaction information, and the user interaction information comprises user voice information and/or user action information; analyzing the user interaction information, and determining a shopping guide service type and a target vehicle part; acquiring first component information of the target vehicle component from a preset vehicle knowledge base according to the shopping guide service type; according to the shopping guide service type and the first component information, a target action sequence is determined from a preset action library, the target action sequence comprises joint actions and voice actions, the voice actions are used for outputting voice shopping guide information, and the voice shopping guide information is determined according to the first component information; and sending a first control instruction to the target robot, wherein the first control instruction is used for indicating the target robot to execute the target action sequence. According to the invention, the functionality and intelligence of the humanoid robot as an intelligent shopping guide robot can be improved.

title: Neck structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a neck structure and a humanoid robot, the neck structure is used for driving a robot head to move relative to a robot main body, and the neck structure comprises a first driving unit, a second driving unit and a third driving unit. The first driving unit is used for being arranged in the robot head, and the first driving unit is used for driving the robot head to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the first direction during rotation. The second driving unit is used for driving the first driving unit to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the second direction during rotation so as to drive the robot head to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the second direction. The third driving unit is used for being partially arranged in the robot body, and the third driving unit is used for driving the second driving unit and the first driving unit to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the third direction during rotation so as to drive the robot head to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the third direction. The three-degree-of-freedom motion of the head of the robot can be achieved in a limited space.

title: Humanoid robot indoor action planning and action control method and system and robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot indoor action planning and action control method and system and a robot. The method comprises the steps that an environment image is collected and analyzed; the large model is adopted to convert original text execution input by a user into a structured command; constructing an open set scene graph; after the target description text is received, if the place is a strange place, the no-graph task planning module generates a humanoid robot action instruction according to the target description text and the environment image; if the scene is a long-term activity place, the graph task planning module adopts LLM for processing according to the open set scene graph and the task instruction, and outputs an action instruction sequence which is executed in sequence; according to the robot action instruction or the action instruction sequence, a corresponding action control strategy is called, and physical movement of the humanoid robot is controlled. According to the method, autonomous action planning and control of the humanoid robot in an indoor environment are realized by utilizing strong zero sample target recognition and semantic understanding reasoning capabilities based on image and language basic models.

title: Data processing method and device for explanation task, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a data processing method and device for an explanation task, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining target article information of a target article required by a target user according to interaction information collected by a humanoid robot; a first task flow is determined according to the target article information, initial action information of the humanoid robot at the current time point and an action database, and the first task flow is used for indicating the humanoid robot to transmit the target article to the target user and explaining a physical area corresponding to the target article; if request information which is detected by the humanoid robot and used for requesting to explain a target sub-region in a physical region is received when the humanoid robot executes the first task flow, acquiring action execution information of the humanoid robot and sensor information of the humanoid robot; determining a second task flow according to the sensor information, the action execution information, the request information and an action database; and executing the second task flow. The intelligence of the robot in the explanation process is improved.

title: Bionic knee joint mechanism with multi-stage buffer structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The bionic knee joint mechanism comprises a humanoid robot body and knee joints fixedly installed on the lower half portion of the humanoid robot body, walking feet are rotatably installed at the lower end of the humanoid robot body, the knee joints are internally provided with buffering mechanisms, and the buffering mechanisms are fixedly installed on the lower half portion of the humanoid robot body. A secondary buffering mechanism is arranged on the lower side of the buffering mechanism, a stabilizing mechanism is arranged in the walking foot, the buffering mechanism comprises an arc-shaped rod, a sliding block is arranged at one end of the arc-shaped rod, a guiding inclined groove is formed in the lower surface of the sliding block, and two symmetrically-distributed push rods are fixedly installed on one side of the sliding block. A damping cylinder is arranged at the end, away from the sliding block, of the push rod. The second-stage buffering mechanism comprises a buffering bin. According to the device, by arranging the buffering mechanism, small impact force can be buffered, it can be guaranteed that the situation of repeated shaking cannot occur after buffering, and therefore the effect of being good in buffering effect is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot multi-mode visual calibration system and operation method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot multi-modal visual calibration system and an operation method thereof, and the system is characterized in that a closed-loop control system integrating synchronous collection, data alignment, feature fusion, online correction, hand-eye relationship calculation and quality evaluation feedback is constructed; according to the invention, efficient collaboration of multi-modal visual sensing information and automatic maintenance and optimization of a hand-eye relationship are realized, so that the problem of precision attenuation caused by misalignment of a relationship between sensors in the prior art is effectively solved; and the accuracy, consistency and long-term reliability of the humanoid robot in sensing and operation based on multi-modal vision in a complex and changeable environment are remarkably improved.

title: Trunking communication base station system with humanoid mobile function
abstract: The invention discloses a trunking communication base station system with a humanoid mobile function, and relates to the related field of trunking communication base stations. Six core modules including the main control system, the human-shaped moving module, the sensing module, the communication module, the power supply system and the user interaction system are integrated, autonomous communication deployment in a complex environment is realized, particularly, the power supply system adopts a distributed battery structure, and a plurality of battery units are distributed at different parts of the robot, so that power supply redundancy can be realized, and the service life of the robot is prolonged. The problem that a whole machine is powered off due to a single-point fault during centralized power supply is avoided, the weight distribution of the whole machine can be balanced, the gravity center is optimized, the stability of human-shaped movement is improved, each battery pack is provided with an independent BMS, the main control system can monitor the electric quantity and temperature in real time and intelligently dispatch a power supply path, the system safety and the adaptive capacity in extreme environments such as high temperature and impact are improved, and the service life of the system is prolonged. According to the structure, the operation reliability and persistence of the robot in high-risk scenes such as emergency communication and disaster rescue are effectively enhanced.

title: Navigation positioning method, device and equipment for bionic joint humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic joint humanoid robot navigation positioning method, device and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: monitoring a landing shock wave signal and reflection echo data of a robot, carrying out the time domain expansion of the shock wave signal to form a pulse characteristic spectrum, extracting multipath propagation components, and carrying out the time difference correlation to generate an environment response value. Screening a direct wave component by using an environmental response value, positioning a sound wave propagation trajectory, and detecting impedance mutation to construct an acoustic matrix. A strong reflection zone is identified through node analysis, a sound pressure gradient field is extracted to determine an obstacle boundary, and a landmark feature bit is determined in combination with an environmental response value. And adjusting a dynamic stride frequency interval based on a landmark feature bit, forming an adaptive detection sequence, and performing sparse processing to construct path configuration. The mechanical vibration component of the shock wave signal is used for piezoelectric conversion to generate recycled electric quantity, the recycled electric quantity is matched with path configuration power to determine a sensing period, intermittent sensing is executed to obtain detection data to construct a detection convergence field, and finally an accurate positioning window is determined and converted into position coordinates.

title: Humanoid robot behavior data processing method and related device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot behavior data processing method and related device.The method comprises the steps that in response to a first selection operation of a user for a first control of a first action label in an action interaction interface, a first resource calling instruction of the first action label is generated, the first resource calling instruction is received and transmitted to the cloud server, the cloud server is used for querying a first action resource according to the first resource calling instruction and transmitting the first action resource to the humanoid robot, and the first action resource is used for representing action data needed by the humanoid robot for completing a first action; acquiring an action execution feedback message from the cloud server; and displaying the action execution feedback message. The action library of the humanoid robot in the cloud server is started and called through the terminal equipment, multiple functional components of the humanoid robot are in one-key linkage, complex actions are completed, and the intelligence of behavior data processing of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid agent cognitive behavior integrated system with cooperation of large and small models
abstract: The invention, which relates to the technical field of humanoid agent interaction, discloses a humanoid agent cognitive behavior integrated system with cooperation of large and small models, comprising a data identification unit, an intention understanding unit, a memory storage unit, a question and answer reasoning unit and an expression output unit. The core function of a human-like agent is completed in a large and small model cooperation mode, the small model integrates vertical domain data to endow the agent with functions of intention understanding, visual perception and behavior and emotion deduction in the vertical domain, the large model is responsible for reasoning of complex semantics, and the system constructs each function module in a large and small model mode, so that the system is more intelligent. A human-like agent framework capable of real-time interaction is formed, pre-analysis is performed on an open intention of a user before deep reasoning is performed on an end-to-end voice large model, and the mechanism is specially used for solving field specific instructions or professional knowledge which are difficult to understand in the vertical field of the voice large model.

title: Robot energy recovery system and equipment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot energy recovery, and particularly relates to a robot energy recovery system and equipment, and the robot energy recovery system comprises an energy recovery module, an energy management system and a walking auxiliary control system. The energy recovery module is used for recovering the piezoelectric energy and comprises a current collecting circuit, a rectifier bridge circuit and a storage circuit. The energy management system is used for carrying out storage and output management on piezoelectric energy and comprises an energy storage unit and an import and export control module. The walking auxiliary control system is used for conducting auxiliary control on the walking process of the robot. According to the robot energy recovery system and equipment, mechanical energy of the walking part in the walking process can be converted into electric energy through the piezoelectric effect, so that the biped robot has the energy recovery function, the environmental adaptability and flexibility of the biped robot are remarkably improved, and carbon emission of the biped robot is reduced.

title: Hollow composite structure of bionic neck and net-shaped supporting structure of simulated humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a hollow composite structure of a bionic neck and a net-shaped supporting structure of a simulated humanoid robot, which comprises a cervical vertebra bionic section and a net-shaped supporting structure arranged around the periphery of the cervical vertebra bionic section, and the net-shaped supporting structure comprises a plurality of hollow grids. The densities of the hollow grids are different in different areas of the latticed supporting structure; an annular cavity is formed between the cervical vertebra bionic section and the latticed supporting structure, spiral elastic pieces distributed in the axial direction of the cervical vertebra bionic section are arranged in the annular cavity, and the peripheral shape of the spiral elastic pieces is matched with the curved surface of the inner wall of the latticed supporting structure. By means of the latticed supporting structure and the hollowed-out grid design of the latticed supporting structure, material use is greatly reduced, and meanwhile the structural weight is optimized by means of density changes of different areas; the latticed supporting structure is made of a light-weight high-strength material, and the interior of a rod piece formed by the latticed supporting structure is hollow, so that the overall weight is further reduced.

title: Human leg simulating mechanical lower limb based on parallel and serial mechanisms
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a human leg simulating mechanical lower limb based on parallel and serial mechanisms. The invention aims to provide the human leg-imitating mechanical lower limb based on parallel and serial mechanisms, and the leg-imitating mechanical lower limb can simulate the collaborative movement of the lower limb of the human body at hip, knee and ankle joints, and has the characteristics of large working space and high rigidity. According to the technical scheme, the invention discloses a human leg simulating mechanical lower limb based on parallel and serial mechanisms. The hip joint is characterized by comprising a lower driving shell, a driving assembly arranged on the double-leg connecting shell and used for driving the lower driving shell, a thigh body with the top end hinged to the lower driving shell and a first linear driver installed on the lower driving shell and used for driving the thigh body; the two mechanical single legs are connected with the double-leg connecting shell through the driving assemblies respectively.

title: Humanoid robot monocular pose estimation method based on lightweight HRNet
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot monocular pose estimation method based on a lightweight HRNet. The humanoid robot monocular pose estimation method comprises a target detection network, a key point extraction network and PnP pose calculation. The target detection network is composed of an image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement and a multi-scale FRCNN target detection network branch, the image super-resolution network branch based on edge enhancement belongs to a GAN structure, joint optimization is performed on the image super-resolution network and the FRCNN, and an ROI region of a target is output; a five-layer scale feature detection module is added in the FRCNN, so that the detection capability of a small target can be enhanced. The key point extraction network uses an HRNet as a trunk, and carries out contractility analysis on a depth branch and a width branch of the HRNet to obtain a redundancy-removed HRNet; the two HRnets are connected in series, the second stage and the third stage corresponding to the two HRnets are subjected to feature addition, and finally the key points of the humanoid robot are output; and extracting 2D key points of the target, and performing PnP pose calculation by using a known 3D structure to obtain a pose result of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot skin material pouring forming device
abstract: The invention relates to the related technical field of material pouring forming, in particular to a humanoid robot skin material pouring forming device which is characterized in that the top of a processing box body is movably connected with a lower mold base through a fixed sliding rail, and the top of the processing box body is provided with a staggered mold closing assembly for driving the lower mold base to enter the bottom position of an upper mold base; the staggered die assembly comprises an L-shaped swing arm which drives the lower die base to move horizontally and drives the upper die base to move vertically, and an offcut cleaning assembly which blows air to the lower die base is further arranged at the top of the machining box and comprises a cleaning spray head and a cleaning cylinder. When the L-shaped swing arm turns over, the lower mold base on the fixed sliding rail is made to move horizontally through the fixed rotating shaft and the first sliding groove, the lower mold base and the upper mold base can be opened in a staggered mode in the vertical direction and the horizontal direction, and the lower mold base opened in the staggered mode achieves the effects of convenient demolding and cleaning; a demolding suction cup in the overturning demolding assembly achieves stable overturning demolding material taking and heat dissipation cooling of the product.

title: Electro-hydraulic biped humanoid robot multi-factor coupling mechanism and intelligent sensing decision-making method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic servo control and bionic robots, in particular to an electro-hydraulic biped humanoid robot multi-factor coupling mechanism and intelligent sensing decision-making method, which comprises the following steps of: 1, constructing a servo valve hysteresis compensation model, and eliminating valve control nonlinearity; step 2, establishing a body-hydraulic-ground three-domain coupling kinetic equation to form a coupling matrix; 3, fusing IMU and multi-dimensional sensor data, and estimating a state vector in real time; and step 4, triggering a PPO strategy based on an event, and realizing a 1kHz valve control closed loop through TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol). The problem that a traditional off-line model drifts along with temperature/abrasion is solved.

title: Artificial intelligence identification method and system for abnormal state of production line
abstract: The invention provides a production line abnormal state artificial intelligence identification method and system, and the method comprises the steps: collecting joint torsion moment data and ball track offset data of a humanoid robot joint at different rotation angles, and generating an evaluation result of a bearing installation state; determining the abnormal state of bearing installation according to the evaluation result of the bearing installation state; according to the dynamically adjusted judgment threshold value, the joint torsional moment data collected in real time are compared, and the severity of the abnormal state is determined; according to the severity of the abnormal state, joint rotation resistance is simulated and recognized, and a predicted value of joint fit clearance change is generated; according to the predicted value of the joint fit clearance change, updating the judgment threshold value of the dynamic adjustment; after the dynamically adjusted judgment threshold value is updated, joint assembly control configuration is generated; and generating a joint assembly control strategy according to the joint assembly control configuration.

title: Humanoid robot state monitoring method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot state monitoring method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal information data of a humanoid robot; determining physical examination result information according to the multi-modal information data, wherein the physical examination result information is used for representing the anthropomorphic health state of the humanoid robot; when a state inquiry instruction is detected, a state updating strategy is determined according to the physical examination result information and the state inquiry instruction, and the state updating strategy comprises interaction confirmation operation, state updating operation and health maintenance operation; and executing the state updating strategy to update the current running state of the humanoid robot. Therefore, the physical examination result information representing the anthropomorphic health state of the humanoid robot is determined according to the multi-modal information data, so that when the state inquiry instruction is detected, the state updating strategy is determined according to the physical examination result information to perform interaction with higher anthropomorphic degree and more intelligent updating and maintenance; therefore, the state monitoring of the humanoid robot is more intelligent, and the user experience is improved.

title: Humanoid robot arm
abstract: A humanoid robot arm belongs to the field of humanoid robots and is characterized in that a first driving mechanism is mounted in a first arm fixing part, a second arm fixing part is connected with the output end of the first driving mechanism, and the second driving mechanism and a third driving mechanism are transversely mounted and fixed on the second arm fixing part; the upper end of the U-shaped arm fixing part is fixed with a shell of the third driving mechanism, the second lower end of the U-shaped arm fixing part is hinged with a Y shaft of the hollow cross shaft, the upper part of the manipulator flange is hinged with an X shaft of the hollow cross shaft, and the lower part of the manipulator flange is fixedly connected with the manipulator; the Y axis and the X axis of the mechanical arm intersect at one point, the intersection point is located on the axis, rotating around the Z axis of the arm, of the arm, the three axes intersect at one point, the conveying structure layout is consistent with the human arm movement structure layout, the size is gradually decreased from the elbow joint to the wrist joint, and the characteristic of simulating the human arm is achieved. And the two driving power sources bear driving loads at the same time, and the higher load capacity is achieved.

title: Multi-modal data processing method of humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-modal data processing method and related device for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal data collected by the humanoid robot, determining a target action strategy according to the multi-modal data and a multi-modal large model, and determining a resource list required for executing the target action strategy; generating a first resource calling instruction according to the resource list, and sending the first resource calling instruction to a cloud server; acquiring a first action resource from a cloud server; and calling the target function module to execute the target action strategy according to the first action resource. By recognizing the multi-modal data, generating the action strategy, obtaining the action resource stored in the cloud server and calling the control module of the humanoid robot to execute the action strategy according to the first action resource, complex interaction actions are completed, and the intelligence of multi-modal data processing of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: High-strength sensing fiber for humanoid robot as well as preparation method and application of high-strength sensing fiber
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength sensing fiber for a humanoid robot. The high-strength sensing fiber comprises a high-strength viscose fiber substrate and a conductive sensing layer, wherein the conductive sensing layer grows on the surface of the substrate in an electrostatic in-situ manner; the high-strength viscose fiber substrate is prepared from wood pulp cellulose through alkalization-porosity, low-temperature dissolution, spinning and post-treatment processes; the breaking strength of the high-strength sensing fiber is larger than or equal to 8 cN/dtex, the conductivity is larger than or equal to 50 S/cm, the high-strength sensing fiber can be used for preparing a flexible touch sensor, the sensitivity is larger than or equal to 35 kPa <-1 > in the pressure interval of 0-1.3 kPa, the response time is smaller than or equal to 80 ms, the recovery time is smaller than or equal to 100 ms, and the conductivity retention rate is larger than or equal to 90% after 2000 times of cyclic bending. The high-strength sensing fiber can be integrated into a dexterous hand, a joint and an electronic skin system of a humanoid robot, accurately senses three-dimensional force, deformation and temperature signals, solves the technical problem that mechanical properties and sensing properties of traditional sensing fibers are difficult to consider at the same time, and has a wide industrial application prospect.

title: Humanoid robot for automatically harvesting mushrooms
abstract: The invention provides an automatic mushroom harvesting humanoid robot. The automatic mushroom harvesting humanoid robot comprises a movable operation table, a picking module, a root cutting module and a collecting module, the movable operation table is used for adjusting the picking position; the picking module is used for identifying and picking roots to the root cutting module; the root cutting module comprises a blade fixed to the movable operation table and a conveying belt arranged on the movable operation table. A plurality of mushroom containing grooves are formed in the conveying belt and used for bearing mushroom bodies picked by the picking module, and through holes are formed in the bottoms of the mushroom containing grooves and used for allowing mushroom roots to penetrate through; the mushroom accommodating groove moves along with the conveying belt to cut mushroom roots by the blade; and the collecting module is used for collecting the mushroom bodies after root cutting. According to the mushroom harvesting machine, the whole process of mushroom harvesting is integrated, and the harvesting efficiency is greatly improved. All the mechanical arms can work independently, efficient picking is achieved, and mushroom roots are uniformly and efficiently cut through cooperation of the mushroom containing grooves and the blades; the mushroom containing groove can effectively protect mushroom bodies, and the root cutting success rate is guaranteed.

title: 一种人形机器人自适应步态生成系统
abstract: The present invention relates to the technical field of robots, and in particular, to an adaptive gait generation system for a humanoid robot, comprising a command receiving module, a data collection module, a gait generation module, and an image gait adjustment module. The command receiving module is used to receive work commands, the data collection module is used to collect environmental data near the humanoid robot, the gait generation module is used to generate and adjust the gait, and the image gait adjustment module is used to generate a gait error index according to the data collected by the data collection module, and adjust the gait of the humanoid robot according to the gait error index. The present invention installs a photographing unit on the humanoid robot, and acquires the gait error index through the captured image of the photographing unit itself to adjust the gait of the robot. Based on the existing adjustment method, image data is referenced to perform re-adjustment on the robot, which is beneficial to compensating for errors occurring in the preliminary adjustment and improves robustness.

title: Humanoid robot action library data processing method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action library data processing method and device, and the method comprises the steps: displaying an action editing visual configuration interface in response to a first selection operation of a user for a self-defined action configuration control in an action library management interface; obtaining user-defined action data through the action editing visual configuration interface; sending the user-defined action data to the server, and receiving an action configuration response message from the server; and determining configuration result prompt information according to the action configuration response message, and displaying the configuration result prompt information. Thus, the action library of the humanoid robot can be updated in real time only by configuring the user-defined action on the terminal equipment, operation is easy, the configuration efficiency of the action library is improved, the action library can be updated in the using process, shutdown waiting is not needed, and the configuration flexibility of the action library is improved.

title: Explosion-proof humanoid robot 5G cross-domain low-delay remote control system and method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot remote control, and particularly relates to an anti-explosion humanoid robot 5G cross-domain low-delay remote control system and method. The system comprises a master-end teleoperation intelligent cabin and a slave-end remote anti-explosion humanoid robot which perform information interaction through a 5G network; the system transmits a video stream through H.264 coding and a WebRTC protocol, sensor data are packaged through JSON, and human shape control and chassis control information are independently processed. According to the invention, accurate remote force feedback and control can be realized, the time delay of human shape control is within 100ms, the time delay of chassis control is within 150ms, the problems of stability and time delay of remote cross-domain control are effectively solved, and the personal safety of operators in a dangerous working environment is guaranteed.

title: Robot cooperative carrying control method and device for humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a robot cooperative carrying control method and device for a humanoid robot training ground. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring first pose data and first motion state data of a first collaborator, and acquiring second pose data and second motion state data of a humanoid robot; inputting the four items of data into a motion trail predictor to obtain predicted motion state data of the first collaborator; inputting the predicted motion state data and the data of the robot into a pre-trained action generator to obtain a predicted joint angle of the humanoid robot; and control parameters of the humanoid robot are obtained based on the predicted joint angle, and the humanoid robot is controlled to carry cooperatively based on the control parameters. The method can be applied to the fields of industrial manufacturing, logistics distribution, family service and the like, and can be used for predicting the joint angle of the robot in the collaborative carrying process in a humanoid robot training ground, so that control parameters are determined, and the effect of controlling the humanoid robot to achieve collaborative carrying is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot scheduling method based on group game and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot scheduling method based on group game and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot scheduling. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a task demand and a list of working procedures to be executed, and sending the list of working procedures to be executed to a plurality of personal robots; the to-be-executed process list comprises a plurality of to-be-executed processes; receiving self-description information of the plurality of personal robots; analyzing according to the task requirement, the list of the working procedures needing to be executed and the self-description information of the plurality of humanoid robots, and sequentially selecting the humanoid robots meeting the requirements from the plurality of humanoid robots according to an analysis result and distributing the humanoid robots to each working procedure needing to be executed so as to determine the humanoid robot corresponding to each working procedure needing to be executed; and an execution instruction is sent to the humanoid robot corresponding to each process needing to be executed based on the list of the processes needing to be executed. According to the embodiment of the invention, the overall resource utilization rate of the cooperative group can be improved through a group game mechanism.

The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a task demand and a list of working procedures to be executed, and sending the list of working procedures to be executed to a plurality of personal robots; the to-be-executed process list comprises a plurality of to-be-executed processes; receiving self-description information of the plurality of personal robots; analyzing according to the task requirement, the list of the working procedures needing to be executed and the self-description information of the plurality of humanoid robots, and sequentially selecting the humanoid robots meeting the requirements from the plurality of humanoid robots according to an analysis result and distributing the humanoid robots to each working procedure needing to be executed so as to determine the humanoid robot corresponding to each working procedure needing to be executed; and an execution instruction is sent to the humanoid robot corresponding to each process needing to be executed based on the list of the processes needing to be executed. title: Guidance control method and device of humanoid robot, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a guidance control method and device for a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a user request; identifying a user request, and determining a target position according to the user request when determining that the user request is a guide request; according to the position of the humanoid robot, the target position and a map of the exhibition area where the humanoid robot is located, a guiding path and an action sequence corresponding to the guiding path are generated, the action sequence corresponds to at least one guiding action, and the guiding actions comprise at least one of two-arm actions, hand actions, head actions, voice actions and face actions; and generating a first action execution strategy according to the guiding path and the action sequence corresponding to the guiding path, wherein the first action execution strategy is used for indicating the humanoid robot to execute at least one guiding action according to the action sequence. According to the invention, the accuracy and comprehensiveness of the man-machine interaction capability in a special scene can be improved.

title: Full-closed-loop control method and system for joint module of humanoid robot based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array)
abstract: The invention discloses a full-closed-loop control method for a humanoid robot joint module based on an FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array), which relates to the technical field of robot control and comprises the following steps of: performing second-order active low-pass filtering and programmable gain amplification on analog signals of an encoder, a gyroscope and a force sensor to convert the analog signals into digital signals; a multi-dimensional feature sequence is constructed, temperature signals of a joint driver and an encoder are collected through a temperature sensor interface, a temperature drift model is constructed, and zero drift compensation parameters are obtained; further obtaining a joint elastic deformation error, and applying the joint elastic deformation error to an encoder signal for online offset correction; outputting a reconfiguration region selection signal based on the lightweight neural network; and triggering bit stream local refresh corresponding to the PR Region according to a region selection signal output by the lightweight neural network. The problem that a control loop is difficult to eliminate flexible errors due to the fact that a traditional rigid model or a constant parameter model is difficult to reflect deformation characteristics under the heat-lubrication-load combined action in real time is solved.

title: Robot neck device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a robot neck device and a humanoid robot. The robot neck device comprises a neck movement unit and a control unit. The neck movement unit is used for being connected with the robot head and the robot body and can rotate in the axial direction parallel to the first direction, the second direction and the third direction so as to drive the robot head to rotate in the axial direction parallel to the first direction, the second direction and the third direction. The control unit is used for controlling the rotation angle range of the neck movement unit in the axial direction parallel to the first direction to be a first preset angle range and controlling the rotation angle range of the neck movement unit in the axial direction parallel to the second direction to be a second preset angle range. The rotation angle range of the neck movement unit in the axial direction parallel to the third direction is a third preset angle range. The rotation angle range of at least one degree of freedom of the robot head can be adjusted.

title: Head display device of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot head display device which comprises a front shell and a rear shell, the front shell and the rear shell are detachably and fixedly connected to form a containing cavity, a projection device is arranged in the containing cavity, a display screen is fixedly installed in the middle of the front shell, the display screen is electronic control liquid crystal glass, and the front shell is provided with a display screen. According to the utility model, the electric control liquid crystal glass is used as the display screen, and the conversion of different functions is realized by adjusting the transparency of the display screen, so that the display screen is suitable for different use scenes, and the application range is wider.

title: Miniaturized joint module and robot controller
abstract: The utility model discloses a miniaturized joint module and robot controller, miniaturized joint module includes shell, decelerator subassembly, encoder subassembly, back cover shell and motor, decelerator subassembly and back cover shell are respectively arranged at the both ends of shell, encoder subassembly and motor are both arranged inside shell, encoder subassembly is located outside motor, and the motor is located outside motor. The encoder assembly comprises an input rotary encoder and an output rotary encoder, and the output rotary encoder is annularly arranged outside the input rotary encoder, so that the input rotary encoder and the output rotary encoder are located on the same plane. The miniaturized joint module provided by the utility model is suitable for the movable joint of the wrist part of the humanoid robot, the output rotary encoder is embedded on the input rotary encoder, so that the encoder assembly has a butt joint plane, the output rotary encoder and the input rotary encoder are positioned on the same plane, the length of the module is reduced, the structure is simpler, and the cost is lower. And meanwhile, the product can be miniaturized.

title: Rope-driven elbow structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a rope-driven elbow structure and a humanoid robot, relates to the technical field of robots, and aims to solve the problem that an existing rope-driven elbow structure is fixed in rigidity and cannot meet use requirements under different task scenes. Comprising an elbow joint and a driving mechanism, the elbow joint comprises a first roller, a second roller and a connecting frame, and the first roller and the second roller are arranged in a tangent mode and rotationally installed on the connecting frame; the driving mechanism comprises first driving ropes used for driving the elbow joint to perform lifting action and second driving ropes used for driving the elbow joint to perform laying-down action, the number of the first driving ropes is larger than that of the second driving ropes, and each driving rope is connected with a driving motor used for enabling the driving rope to be wound and unwound. The multi-degree-of-freedom parallel mechanism has different rigidities, so that the use requirements under different task scenes can be met.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent grabbing control system and method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot intelligent grabbing control system and method.The intelligent grabbing control system comprises a myoelectricity induction control device and a humanoid robot device, and the myoelectricity induction control device communicates with the humanoid robot device; the electromyographic induction control device comprises an electromyographic signal induction module, a gesture posture acquisition module, a motion capture module, a capture control module and an AR module. The humanoid robot device comprises a manipulator, a camera mechanism assembly, a mechanical arm, a camera mechanism movement driving module, a target object three-dimensional coordinate and posture calculation module, a target object posture recognition module, a first position calculation module, a second position calculation module, a manipulator position verification module and a manipulator posture acquisition module. According to the intelligent grabbing control system and method for the humanoid robot, the electronic equipment and the storage medium, actions of the humanoid robot can be remotely controlled, and the control precision and the working efficiency are improved.

title: High-mimicry biped humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-mimicry biped humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The damage amount and the damage volume of the clamping structure are calculated in real time through the analysis module, an early warning signal is generated in combination with a preset threshold value, and maintenance delay caused by the fact that damage is not found in time in a traditional post-event maintenance mode is avoided; after the warning module receives the signal, a damage source and a tool list are automatically synchronized, the time for manually checking damage reasons and confirming component models is saved, and compared with a one-by-one disassembling and checking mode in traditional maintenance, the time of single-time maintenance is greatly shortened; two types of signals of early warning and warning are set according to different damage degrees, and corresponding differentiated operation is carried out, namely the early warning stage only prompts the risk without influencing the equipment operation, and the warning stage forcibly limits the high-risk function, so that the shutdown loss caused by excessive intervention is prevented, and the component loosening and falling accidents caused by insufficient intervention are avoided.

title: Rope-driven under-actuated manipulator based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of manipulators, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot-based rope-driven under-actuated manipulator which comprises a mechanical palm and mechanical fingers, the section of the mechanical palm is circular, and the mechanical fingers are distributed on the mechanical palm. A mechanical finger rope traction mechanism is arranged in the middle of the inner side of the mechanical palm and penetrates through the mechanical palm to be connected with the mechanical fingers. According to the rope-driven underactuated manipulator based on the humanoid robot, the mechanical fingers adopt multi-rod linkage combination to form an underactuated structure, three knuckles of the humanoid fingers are simulated, and bending is controlled through a mechanical finger rope traction mechanism, so that the mechanical fingers have excellent grabbing performance; wherein the two mechanical fingers can move horizontally to realize the actions of grabbing and pinching; the manipulator needs less drive, the overall weight of the manipulator is reduced, and the manufacturing cost is reduced.

title: VLA model method of humanoid robot for long-range task
abstract: The invention relates to a long-range task-oriented VLA model method for a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: S01, analyzing a natural language instruction through a space-time semantic analyzer to generate an atomic operation sequence with a space-time dependency relationship; s02, maintaining a task state machine by using a dynamic memory network, and tracking the task execution progress in real time; s03, integrating vision, language and sensor data through a multi-modal perception fusion engine; s04, calling a predefined action primitive based on an adaptive execution system and optimizing a motion track; and S05, performing online updating and optimization on the model through a continuous learning mechanism. According to the method, a natural language instruction is analyzed into a structured task sequence with space-time dependence through a space-time semantic analyzer, an execution sequence and preconditions are defined, the semantic understanding ability and the structuring degree of task planning are improved, and task decomposition and replanning in a dynamic environment are supported; according to the method, the LSTM and the knowledge graph are combined, and the task state is maintained in real time.

title: Humanoid robot control model and method
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot control model and method. The model comprises a long and short term sequence network, a dynamic response estimation network and an actuator network; the long-short-term sequence network is used for generating student codes based on current and historical robot body sensing information, and the student codes represent height information of terrain points around the robot and physical characteristic information of the robot; the dynamic response estimation network is used for generating a dynamic response code and a linear speed based on current and historical robot body sensing information, and the dynamic response code is used for representing external interference information; and the actuator network is used for generating a current expected joint angle based on the current robot body sensing information, the student code, the dynamic response code and the linear speed. The strategy performance and stability corresponding to the model and the method are good, and the adaptability to unstructured terrains such as steps and ramps is high.

title: Power failure control method and system for biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a power-down control method and system for a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The method includes the steps that a controlled down-stop mode is started when the biped robot is in a power-down working condition, the current posture is adjusted to be a preset safe landing posture, and the overturning margin and the power energy value are monitored in real time in the process; and when it is monitored that the overturning margin is insufficient, an external supporting mode is switched, an available supporting plane is actively obtained from the current environment, and the tail end of the mechanical arm is driven to move to a supporting point from the current position for external supporting, so that the overturning moment is counteracted till the overturning margin returns to the safety range. According to the method, the external supporting point is introduced, the safe landing strategy of the biped robot is dynamically adjusted under the complex power failure working condition, and the problems of falling, damage and the like of the robot caused by a single shutdown strategy are solved.

title: Humanoid robot falling prediction method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot falling prediction method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining target state information and a target capture point position corresponding to a target humanoid robot in real time in a task execution process of the target humanoid robot; whether the target humanoid robot can reach the target capture point position or not is judged based on the target state information, if yes, the predicted falling time of the target humanoid robot is determined, and the target motion time of the target humanoid robot reaching the target capture point position is determined; and if the predicted fall-down time is greater than or equal to the target motion time, generating a ZMP sequence of the target humanoid robot through a model prediction control algorithm, and predicting whether the target humanoid robot falls down or not based on the ZMP sequence and the target capture point position so as to perform fall-down protection on the target humanoid robot. According to the method, the dynamicity and timeliness of fall prediction of the humanoid robot can be improved, and safety protection is carried out during fall.

title: Humanoid robot based on hydraulic throttling and pressure relief control and control system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on hydraulic throttling and pressure relief control and a control system of the humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. One end of the main leg frame is rotationally connected with the seat, and the other end is rotationally connected with an auxiliary leg frame; the traction driving mechanism comprises a first driving assembly and a second driving assembly, the first driving assembly and the second driving assembly are assembled on the strand seat and the main leg frame respectively, and the output end of the first driving assembly and the output end of the second driving assembly are connected with the main leg frame and the auxiliary leg frame respectively and used for driving the main leg frame and the auxiliary leg frame to rotate respectively; the output end and the input end of the plunger pump communicate with the traction driving mechanism through an oil supply pipe and an oil return pipe correspondingly, and a throttling valve and a pressure release valve are fixed to the oil supply pipe and the oil return pipe correspondingly; the throttling valve is used for controlling throttling; the pressure release valve is used for controlling oil return; legs are controlled to move in a traction mode, a human leg tendon driving mode is simulated, and the flexibility of humanoid walking is met.

title: Interaction control method and device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an interaction control method and device for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining touch sensing information which is used for representing the continuous physical quantity of the contact operation of a user obtained by the humanoid robot through a touch sensing bionic system; determining target intention information according to the touch sensing information; determining a target interaction strategy according to the target intention information, wherein the target interaction strategy is used for indicating at least one target interaction behavior corresponding to the contact operation; and executing the target interaction strategy to enable the humanoid robot to respond to the contact operation with at least one interaction behavior. Therefore, the target intention information is determined according to the tactile sensing information acquired by the tactile sensing bionic system, and the corresponding target interaction strategy is determined and executed according to the operation intention, so that the humanoid robot can understand the meaning of the contact action of the user in the interaction process and make ideal response; the anthropomorphic degree of the humanoid robot is higher, and the comprehensiveness and intelligence of the humanoid robot for executing the interaction task are improved.

title: Real-time whole-body remote operation control system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time whole-body remote operation control system for a humanoid robot, and the system comprises a motion instruction generation subsystem which is located at an operation end and is used for receiving and analyzing input instructions of various modes, and carrying out the unified conversion and complementation of the input instructions into a whole-body joint motion instruction which is suitable for a skeleton structure of a target humanoid robot; the body motion control subsystem is located at the robot end and used for receiving the whole-body motion instruction, adaptively generating a whole-body motion coordination control signal capable of ensuring the stability of the robot in combination with the state of the robot and environment information, and driving and executing the whole-body motion coordination control signal; through cooperation of the two subsystems, the system provides a dual guarantee path for realizing whole-body teleoperation: a complete whole-body instruction can be generated based on the instruction generation subsystem, and whole-body motion can be adaptively generated by the body motion control system according to a received local instruction; and the robustness, the flexibility and the reliability of the system under different conditions are ensured.

title: Humanoid robot data set quality evaluation method and system based on multi-dimensional evaluation
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot data set quality evaluation method and a humanoid robot data set quality evaluation system based on multi-dimensional evaluation, and provides a systematized and standardized evaluation process aiming at the quality problems of the existing robot multi-modal data set in the aspects of normalization, integrity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, accessibility, availability and the like. According to the method, an automatic tool is combined with manual auditing, the structure, metadata, annotation content, data formats, multi-modal alignment and the like of a data set are comprehensively detected, a deep learning algorithm is introduced to achieve detection of pornographic pictures and sensitive words of visual content, and content safety and compliance are effectively improved. The system can flexibly adjust the weight of each evaluation dimension according to different application scenes, automatically generates a quality evaluation report, and supports continuous monitoring and optimization and improvement. Practical application shows that the method can significantly improve the overall quality of the robot data set, and provides reliable data basis and technical support for intelligent training and application of the robot.

title: Intelligent inspection method, device and equipment for humanoid robot with bionic gaits
abstract: The invention provides a bionic gait humanoid robot intelligent inspection method, device and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining task point distribution data, determining an inevitable node sequence based on a coverage demand, and building an inspection state mapping table; constructing a path probability distribution tree by adopting probability backtracking, identifying a main path family and an alternative path family, and forming a probability inspection chain; decomposing an inspection chain into continuous road sections, extracting a traffic difficulty coefficient and a path complexity index, predicting gait energy consumption distribution, determining an obstacle avoidance beat, and generating a path compensation parameter; performing risk assessment on the road section, forming a risk balance scheme through hedging combination of a high-risk path and a safe path, and formulating a coordination rule; acquiring an inspection efficiency coordination factor based on path crossing and overlapping analysis, and generating a beat navigation parameter; a dynamic inspection unit is generated through matching of beat parameters and a probability inspection chain, the task arrival time is adjusted, an elastic inspection process is constructed, and intelligent autonomous inspection under bionic gait control is achieved.

title: Motion protection control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a motion protection control method and system for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a lava shooting video; determining a plurality of pieces of lava monitoring point information and a plurality of edge standing safety points based on the lava shooting video; determining test information of each edge standing safety point based on the plurality of edge standing safety points; based on the multiple test jump videos of the humanoid robot and the multiple pieces of lava monitoring point information, a lava processing model is used for determining robot monitoring walking path information; acquiring a walking video of the test walking path of the acquisition starting section of the humanoid robot; and based on the information of the multiple risk path segments, the multiple test jump videos of the humanoid robot, and the walking video of the test walking path of the start segment acquired by the humanoid robot, determining the walking frequency and step length of each risk path segment. The method can accurately determine the optimal walking frequency and step length of robot lava environment monitoring.

title: Humanoid robot scheduling method in humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot scheduling, in particular to a humanoid robot scheduling method in a humanoid robot training ground, and the method comprises the steps: collecting global environment data in the training ground in real time through a multi-modal sensor array, and fusing the global environment data with the obtained real-time pose information of a robot; analyzing the obtained training task queue into atomic operation data, and associating the atomic operation data with the constructed training ground resource table; based on the dynamic passage map and the training ground resource table, the resource constraint operation chain is dynamically allocated, and a scheduling path is generated after space-time joint path planning; and the generated allocation task is transmitted to the corresponding humanoid robot, and the dynamic passage map and the training ground resource table are updated based on the obtained execution data, so that the efficient and conflict-free real-time scheduling method capable of adapting to the motion characteristics of the humanoid robot is realized, the task and path conflict between the robots is avoided, and the real-time scheduling efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved. The overall utilization rate and the training efficiency of the training ground are improved.

title: Seven-degree-of-freedom isomorphic exoskeleton force feedback humanoid arm system
abstract: The invention discloses a seven-degree-of-freedom isomorphic exoskeleton force feedback humanoid arm system which comprises a left arm, a right arm and a connecting piece, wherein the left arm and the right arm are in mirror symmetry. A single arm adopts an isomorphic series joint chain with three degrees of freedom of shoulders, one degree of freedom of elbows, two degrees of freedom of forearms and one degree of freedom of wrists, which are completely consistent with the upper limbs of a human body, and the rotation axis of each driving joint is strictly aligned with the motion axis of the human body, so that 1: 1 undistorted motion mapping is realized. And each joint is integrated with a torque motor and a sensor, receives a far-end environment contact torque through a CAN bus, and outputs a proportional feedback torque according to a relational expression to form active closed-loop haptic interaction. The upper arm section is of a carbon fiber truss structure, and the weight is greatly reduced while the rigidity is guaranteed. The system has the characteristics of modularization, high integration and low delay, supports two-hand cooperative operation, effectively solves the technical bottlenecks of poor motion fidelity, lack of real force feedback, bulkiness and system dispersion of the existing exoskeleton, and is suitable for high-precision teleoperation tasks.

title: Bionic driving device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a bionic driving device for a humanoid robot, which comprises a sole mounted below a robot leg, through holes are formed in four corners of the sole in a penetrating manner, and front pipes are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the two through holes in the front end of the sole; rear pipes are fixedly connected to the inner walls of the two through holes in the rear end of the sole, mounting pipes are connected to the inner walls of the lower ends of the two front pipes and the two rear pipes, ball cavities are formed in the bottom surfaces of the mounting pipes of the two rear pipes, and rolling balls are connected to the interiors of the two ball cavities in a rolling mode. According to the bionic driving device for the humanoid robot, sliding plate type rolling movement is achieved on smooth and hard grounds such as tiles and marbles through the combination of the moving wheels and the rolling balls at the four corners of the foot sole, a traditional stepping walking mode is replaced, the moving speed is increased, rubber layers are arranged on the surfaces of the moving wheels, the road holding force and flexibility are considered in cooperation with the universal rolling characteristic of the rolling balls, and the driving effect is good. And the rapid movement requirement of an indoor service scene is met.

title: Human body gait parameter estimation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a human body gait parameter estimation method which comprises the following steps: acquiring specific force data, angular rate data and magnetic signal data measured by a first inertial sensing module and a second inertial sensing module which are mounted on a first foot and a second foot, and a magnet is mounted on the first foot; based on the specific force data and the angular rate data of the first foot and the second foot at the current moment, calculating position, speed and attitude information of the first foot and the second foot at the next moment through an inertial navigation algorithm; constructing a system state model of a Kalman filter based on a navigation state calculated by inertial navigation; constructing a zero-speed updating model of the Kalman filter based on zero-speed detection; based on the estimated value of the step spacing at the biped alignment moment, constructing a multi-state constraint model of the biped alignment moment of the Kalman filter; based on the constructed system state model of the Kalman filter, the zero-speed updating model and the multi-state constraint model of the biped alignment moment, the human body gait parameters are obtained, and accurate estimation of the human body gait parameters can be achieved.
