title: Humanoid robot servo driver with high-precision position control
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot servo driver with high-precision position control, which relates to the technical field of servo driving and comprises a mounting frame, a servo motor arranged at the bottom of the mounting frame, a support arranged at the bottom of the servo motor, connecting frames arranged on two sides of the servo motor, sliding blocks arranged on the surfaces of the two connecting frames, and a servo motor arranged on the support. Two sliding grooves are formed in the surface of the support, movable grooves are formed in the surfaces of the two connecting frames, the support can smoothly move upwards, and when clamping grooves of the sliding grooves in the surface of the support move to the positions of the two clamping blocks, reset springs in the movable grooves push the movable frames and drive the clamping blocks on the movable frames to penetrate out of the sliding blocks again. The clamping blocks are arranged on the connecting frame and installed in the clamping grooves in the sliding grooves in the surface of the support, so that the support is clamped by the clamping blocks so as to be fixed to the connecting frame, installation of the support is completed, and the defects that in the installation process, all parts need to be accurately aligned, then bolts are screwed one by one, and the matching positions of keys are adjusted are overcome.

title: Humanoid robot control method, humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a control method of a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a current state and a speed instruction of the humanoid robot; according to the current state and the speed instruction, a reference motion fragment is retrieved from a preset database, the database comprises a plurality of motion fragments, and the motion fragments are obtained according to the human motion data; inputting the current state, the speed instruction and the reference motion segment into an action generation model to obtain a target state of the humanoid robot at the next moment; inputting the current state into a strategy network to obtain a target action output by the strategy network, and controlling the humanoid robot to execute the target action; and updating the parameters of the strategy network according to the new state and the target state after the humanoid robot executes the target action. By means of the method, actions of the humanoid robot can be more personified, and unnatural actions are avoided.

title: Humanoid robot motion trail recording and playback method and device and medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion trail record playback method and device, a medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: scanning the actual length of each limb segment of a source robot and the length of a corresponding limb segment of a target robot, capturing three-dimensional coordinate point cloud data, and generating a source-target length ratio data table; extracting a proportion mismatching area according to the source target length ratio data table, and determining a joint range limited data list in combination with the current rotatable angle and the limit position of each joint; analyzing the interaction influence between the source target length ratio data table and the joint range limited data list according to the joint range limited data list, and determining an action reachability conflict area; verifying the matching degree of point locations in the initial adaptive track point location set and the range-limited data list, and determining a conflict-free track subset; and generating an adaptive source track according to the conflict-free track subset, inputting the adaptive track into a playback system, and outputting a motion track record playback result of the source robot.

title: Lightweight robot joint with high load-weight ratio
abstract: The invention discloses a light-weight robot joint with a high load-weight ratio. The light-weight robot joint comprises an upper end cover, a frameless inner rotor motor, a harmonic reducer, an output shaft and a hollow fixing shaft. A driving circuit board is arranged in the upper end cover and is integrally cast with the hollow fixed shaft, so that the lightweight design is realized. The rated torque of the frameless inner rotor motor is 0.4 Nm, the torque is amplified and output through the harmonic reducer, the reduction ratio is 1: 100, and the rated torque reaches more than 40 Nm. The harmonic reducer adopts a flexible gear design which is lengthened by 30% in the axial direction, the number of meshing teeth is increased, the load capacity is improved, meanwhile, a harmonic steel wheel and a motor shell are integrally cast, and the weight is reduced. And the joint adopts double encoders (16 bit input end and 19 bit output end) to realize high-precision position control. And the whole structure is compact, the diameter is 70 mm, the height is 75 mm, the weight does not exceed 800 g, the high-load and light-weight characteristics are achieved, and the high-dynamic-performance-requirement scene such as a humanoid robot is met.

title: Floating disc type hollow cycloid joint module with novel structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot joint modules, in particular to a floating disc type hollow cycloid joint module of a novel structure, which comprises an inner rotor motor, the inner rotor motor comprises a motor shell, a rotor of the inner rotor motor drives a rotor seat in a mounting cavity to coaxially rotate, and the rotor seat is connected with an eccentric shaft which coaxially rotates; the eccentric shaft is sequentially sleeved with a fourth bearing and a cycloidal gear, an output flange is further arranged outside the cycloidal gear, a fit clearance is formed between the cycloidal gear and the output flange, a floating disc which creeps in the radial direction is arranged between the cycloidal gear and the output flange, and the upper disc face of the floating disc is attached to the cycloidal gear and the output flange at the same time. Therefore, the output flange is driven to rotate. Torque is transmitted through the rotor base and the eccentric shaft, the floating disc is matched with the cycloidal gear to wriggle outwards to transmit the torque, speed reduction is carried out while power is transmitted outwards, the structural composition of the joint module is simplified, the reliability of the joint module in the working process is guaranteed, and practical flexibility and stability are guaranteed.

title: Training method of humanoid robot language recognition model and language recognition method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot language recognition model training method and a language recognition method.The training method comprises the steps that multi-modal training samples are obtained, and the multi-modal training samples comprise an audio modal sample, a mouth shape modal sample and an environment modal sample; multi-layer cross-modal coding is carried out on the multi-modal training sample, a plurality of cross-modal coding features are obtained, and each cross-modal coding feature comprises an acoustic coding feature, a mouth shape coding feature and an environment coding feature; performing cross-modal fusion on all the cross-modal coding features to obtain a first fusion feature; and according to the environment modal sample and the first fusion feature, performing parameter updating on an initialized humanoid robot language recognition model to obtain a trained humanoid robot language recognition model. The training method provides a humanoid robot language recognition model, which is beneficial to improving the accuracy and robustness of language recognition. The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: Human body multi-cycle gait track prediction method based on small sample space-time decoupling
abstract: The invention relates to a human body multi-cycle gait track prediction method based on small sample space-time decoupling. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining a single-cycle gait sample through kinematics modeling and cycle segmentation, and extracting, expanding and normalizing parameters such as stride and stride frequency; secondly, establishing a gait parameter joint distribution model by using a Gaussian mixture model and Gaussian mixture regression, and predicting gait parameters according to the target speed; and then space and time decoupling reconstruction is carried out, a high-fidelity joint trajectory is generated by adopting an adaptive collaborative attention LSTM network in space, a zoom factor is calculated based on a predicted stride frequency and a target speed in time, a time sequence is adaptively adjusted through a dynamic motion primitive, and finally a multi-period and multi-speed high-fidelity gait trajectory is generated through fusion. The method has high precision, interpretability and strong generalization ability under the small sample condition, the generated gaits are natural and coordinated and accord with the biomechanical law, and the application cost of a humanoid movement device is remarkably reduced.

title: Humanoid robot operation control system and method for recognizing hand postures based on touch sense
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot interaction, in particular to a humanoid robot operation control system and method based on touch recognition of hand postures. The method comprises the following steps that driving motors of all fingers of the humanoid robot are controlled to output basic gripping force, the fingers are driven to move towards an object to be grabbed, and finger pulp touch sensors of the fingers make contact with the object to obtain gripping force signals; the grip strength value of the corresponding finger is monitored in real time through a touch sensor, and whether the finger with the grip strength exceeding a preset threshold value exists or not is judged; when it is monitored that the grip strength of any finger exceeds a threshold value, the touch conduction piece corresponding to the finger moves towards the force dividing piece under the action of the grip strength, and the force dividing piece is pushed to slide in the axial direction. Accurate cooperative control and dynamic balance of multi-finger grip strength are realized, so that the grabbing stability of a complex object is enhanced, and the success completion rate of a grabbing task is improved.

title: Monocular vision positioning method suitable for biped robot
abstract: The invention provides a monocular vision positioning method suitable for a biped robot, and the method comprises the steps: employing an AR Tag code as a visual marker, building a mapping relation between a pixel coordinate (ui, vi) of a central point of the AR Tag code and an actual distance di through nonlinear calibration, estimating the depth information from the central point of the AR Tag code to the robot according to the pixel coordinate, and carrying out the positioning of the robot. Therefore, three-dimensional coordinates of the AR Tag code in a robot camera coordinate system are obtained, and coordinates of the robot in a world coordinate system are obtained through coordinate system transformation. The defect that a monocular vision positioning system cannot acquire depth information is overcome, the positioning precision of the monocular vision positioning system is effectively improved, and the monocular vision positioning system has a wide application prospect in a positioning scene with low cost, low power consumption and low computing power.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a voice reply method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of voice signal processing. By the adoption of the technical scheme, the hallusion appearing in the first language model can be detected in time, meanwhile, the second language model is called, the information is supplemented, the influence of the hallusion on the language models can be reduced on the basis that the structure or parameters of the models are not changed, and the accuracy of language reply is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a mixing device for preparing a humanoid robot skin material, and particularly relates to the technical field of material preparation mixing, the mixing device comprises a mixing tank and an upper arm cover, the outer part of the upper arm cover is respectively provided with a feed inlet and a liquid inlet which are communicated with the inner part of the upper arm cover; a multi-mixing structure for mixing materials in the mixing tank is arranged in the upper arm cover, the multi-mixing structure comprises a plurality of multi-blade stirring rods rotationally connected to the interior of the upper arm cover, and the multi-blade stirring rods rotate and revolve in the mixing tank; through the arrangement of the multi-blade stirring rod, the first gear, the second gear, the mixing tank and the connecting teeth, the first gear and the second gear are in meshing transmission to drive the multi-blade stirring rod to realize autorotation, and the autorotation motion of the multi-blade stirring rod strongly shears and disperses local parts, so that solid particles can be quickly dispersed; and large blocks formed by mutual adhesion or agglomeration are prevented, the circular flow of the solid in the liquid is improved, and the mixing quality of the skin material is improved.

title: Flexible control method and system for actions of biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible control method and system for actions of a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the following steps: setting the movement speed of each movement unit as a preset maximum speed value; acquiring the current position of each motion unit as an initial position; receiving a new target position instruction for at least one target motion unit; for the target motion unit, calculating a target distance between the initial position and the new target position; determining a microstep interval K and a microstep number N; calculating delay time L after execution of each microstep; and circularly executing the control operation and the delay operation for N times. The method has the advantages that on the basis of the motor subdivision control theory and the interpolation algorithm, the joint movement of the robot is no longer the previous mechanical impression, the impression is flexible and rapid, the robot is separated from the previous action image of the robot, and the posture is close to the posture of a real person.

title: Graphene-based tactile sense-grip strength two-in-one sensor and application thereof in humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a graphene-based tactile sense-grip strength two-in-one sensor and application thereof in a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of humanoid robot application, the graphene-based tactile sense-grip strength two-in-one sensor comprises a tactile sense sensing layer, a plurality of graphene sensing sheets are fixed on the tactile sense sensing layer, a grip strength sensing layer is arranged at the bottom of the tactile sense sensing layer, and the graphene sensing sheets are fixed on the grip strength sensing layer. The grip strength sensing layer is composed of graphene strain gauges, and a stress conduction and spacing mechanism is arranged between the grip strength sensing layer and the touch sensing layer. The touch sensing layer and the grip sensing layer are integrated together, and the stress conduction and spacing mechanism is used for supporting the touch sensing layer and the grip sensing layer, so that a single flexible module can realize touch sensing and grip sensing at the same time, the structure of the fingertip sensor is greatly simplified, and the wiring and integration difficulty is greatly reduced; therefore, the tactile signal and the gripping force signal have internal physical relevance, and finer and more intelligent gripping control is achieved for the robot.

title: Humanoid robot joint with protection function
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot joint protection, in particular to a humanoid robot joint with a protection function, which comprises a locking mechanism comprising an upper component, an umbrella-shaped disc coaxially arranged below the upper component and a lower mounting ring coaxially arranged on the outer side of the umbrella-shaped disc; the outer protection mechanism is arranged on the outer side of the locking mechanism in a sleeving manner; the driving shaft is coaxially arranged below the umbrella-shaped disc, and a rectangular column is fixedly arranged at one end of the driving shaft; the upper assembly comprises a fixing disc, a first connecting sleeve, an extension ring and an upper mounting ring which are coaxially arranged from bottom to top, the first connecting sleeve is fixedly connected to the top face of the fixing disc, the extension ring is fixedly connected to the outer side wall of the upper end of the first connecting sleeve, and the upper mounting ring is fixedly connected to the top face of the extension ring through a second connecting sleeve. title: Humanoid finger based on integrated linkage and simulation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an integrated linkage-based human-like finger and a simulation method thereof, a U-shaped fork arm is designed at a metacarpophalangeal joint, the U-shaped fork arm is connected with a phalanx outer frame through a phalanx outer frame bearing, and a driving motor works to drive corresponding screw rods to rotate synchronously and paired rotating rod connecting corner fittings to move up and down; the corresponding concave fisheye seat, fisheye connecting rod, convex fisheye seat and bow-shaped connecting rod are driven to move up and down, the bow-shaped connecting rod moves up and down, the bow-shaped connecting rod on the left side moves up and down to drive a U-shaped fork arm matched with the bow-shaped connecting rod to rotate around a phalanx outer frame bearing, and the U-shaped fork arm rotates at the phalanx outer frame bearing to achieve flexible left-right swing of fingers. title: Driving mechanism and leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a driving mechanism and a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and solves the problems of poor impact resistance and short service life of a transmission driving mechanism. According to the technical scheme, the driving mechanism comprises a motor fixed to the first limb and a hinge base arranged on the second limb, an adapter is arranged at the output end of the motor and provided with a torque output end, the hinge base is provided with a torque input end, and the torque output end is provided with a torque output end. The adapter transmits the torque of the motor to the hinge seat through the concave-convex matching of the torque output end and the torque input end, a buffer pad is arranged on a torque transmission path between the torque output end and the torque input end, and the buffer pad is used for filtering the mutual impact between the adapter and the hinge seat in the torque transmission process. Impact force between the adapter and the hinge seat can be relieved mainly through the buffer pad, and the abrasion degree of the adapter and the hinge seat is reduced.

title: Bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a bionic humanoid robot which comprises a trunk mechanism serving as a robot core and used for combining limbs, the top of the trunk mechanism is provided with a head mechanism serving as a sensing unit, and the left side and the right side of the trunk mechanism are each provided with an upper limb mechanism serving as an operation unit. A lower limb mechanism serving as a moving unit is mounted at the bottom of the trunk mechanism. According to the bionic humanoid robot, the trunk serves as a core, the four limbs and the head are installed on the trunk through the modular design thought, end face butt joint is formed, positioning and fastening are increased, the machining difficulty is lowered, the assembling mode is simplified, and internal components are stacked more flexibly; the wrist transmission mode of the upper limb mechanism adopts shape embedding and bolt fastening connection, the structure is stable and reliable, meanwhile, by means of motor orthogonal arrangement of the wrist joint frame, three-degree-of-freedom orthogonality is achieved, and the movement settlement difficulty is reduced.

title: Interactive object recognition and attitude estimation method and device based on humanoid body perception and medium
abstract: The invention relates to an interactive object recognition and posture estimation method and device based on humanoid body perception and a medium. The method comprises the steps that S1, body perception data of an actuator installed at the tail end of a robot are read in real time; s2, preprocessing the collected body sensing data based on a physical model to recover spatial features of the body sensing data, and encoding a preprocessing result by using a series-parallel connection body sensing data encoding module; s3, analyzing the body sensing data coded by the series-parallel connection body sensing data coding module by using an object recognition and attitude estimation model constructed based on a diffusion model to obtain semi-structured hidden space representation representing an interactive object state; and S4, identifying the interactive object from the semi-structured hidden space representation of the interactive object state and decoding attitude information. Compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention improves the accurate recognition and attitude estimation of interactive objects in visual occlusion and narrow space.

title: Method and device for constructing digital twinning system of five-fingered dexterous hand of humanoid robot
abstract: A digital twin system construction method for a five-fingered dexterous hand of a humanoid robot comprises the steps that an onboard computing unit at a humanoid robot end synchronously collects posture data and pressure data of a mechanical arm and the five-fingered dexterous hand and RGB-D image data of a 3D camera, and a unified timestamp is added to all the data; the attitude data, the pressure data and the optimized RGB-D image data are packaged into data frames, and the data frames are sent to a control end through a network; the control end receives and analyzes the data frame, and drives the three-dimensional models of the humanoid robot and the five-fingered dexterous hand to move in real time through forward kinematics calculation by using posture data; pressure data are mapped into color changes of fingertips of the five-finger dexterous hand model, pressure visualization is achieved, RGB-D image data are converted into three-dimensional point cloud, and the three-dimensional point cloud is fused with the humanoid robot model. According to the method, attitude, pressure and high-fidelity three-dimensional visual information can be efficiently integrated, and low-delay, high-immersion and lightweight deployment is realized.

The two sets of installation semicircles are fixedly connected through bolts, a cavity is machined and formed in one side of the small arm, an end effector aviation plug interface is installed on the other side of the small arm, an IO interface board is arranged in the cavity, a wrist joint driving board is stacked below the IO interface board, the wrist joint driving board and the IO interface board are fixed through hexagonal studs, and a cover plate is fixed to the outer side of the cavity through bolts. According to the wrist joint, the mounting structure, the size and the weight of the arm wrist of the humanoid robot are simplified, meanwhile, a hidden design mode is adopted for wiring, interfaces are expanded, and the using flexibility and convenience of the wrist joint are greatly improved.

title: Method and system for constructing sparse visual angle three-dimensional Gaussian language field for humanoid robot grabbing
abstract: The invention discloses a sparse view angle three-dimensional Gaussian language field construction method and system for humanoid robot grabbing. Comprising the following steps: acquiring an RGB image set and a user natural language instruction under a sparse view angle; reconstructing a three-dimensional point cloud through stereo matching, and initializing a three-dimensional Gaussian primitive field after noise elimination and measurement alignment; two-dimensional semantic features are embedded into the field, joint optimization is carried out through a double-path semantic supervision module, and a three-dimensional Gaussian language field with consistent semantics is constructed; wherein the dual-path semantic supervision comprises an object perception path and a global context path, the local semantic consistency and the overall semantic relationship are constrained respectively, and the final semantic representation of each Gaussian primitive is obtained through weighted fusion; and finally, candidate grabbing postures are generated, semantic reordering is carried out in combination with a language instruction, and the optimal grabbing posture is screened through geometric-semantic joint scoring. Under the sparse image set input condition, the execution accuracy of a robot grabbing task under a complex instruction can be improved.

title: METHOD FOR SECURING A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The invention relates to a method for securing a humanoid robot in a vehicle, in particular in the driver's seat or passenger seat of a vehicle used on the grounds of various enterprises, for example, where the robot acts as a driver or as a passenger if battery charging is required, and also to a method for securing a humanoid robot when used as an adult toy. The technical result of the invention is an increase in safety levels during the use of a robot. The method for securing a humanoid robot in a fixed position includes the following steps: positioning the humanoid robot in the place where it is to be secured; securing the humanoid robot at at least one point on the lower leg to a fixed object. The present method for securing a humanoid robot can be useful in the case that a vehicle is used alternately by humans and humanoid robots.

title: Modularized biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a modular biped robot which comprises biped robot modular monomers. title: Progressive motion interpolation training method for whole-body motion learning of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a progressive motion interpolation training method for whole body motion learning of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a target human motion reference trajectory, and converting the target human motion reference trajectory into a robot reference trajectory meeting the joint constraint of the humanoid robot, and taking the robot reference trajectory as a target motion of the humanoid robot; s2, generating reference trajectories with different difficulty levels through interpolation and alignment between the standard standing posture and the target action; s3, a reinforcement learning environment is constructed based on the reference trajectories of different difficulty levels, a reinforcement learning network is constructed, in the reinforcement learning environment, a tracking strategy is trained through the reinforcement learning network, and in the training process, according to trajectory tracking success rates under different difficulty levels, difficulty is updated according to rules, and gradual training from easy to difficult is achieved; and S4, judging whether an ending condition is met or not, if so, ending training, and if not, returning to the step S2. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of realizing gradual training from easiness to difficulty and the like.

title: Hierarchical planning method for humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot layered planning method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: collecting environment perception data and task target data; constructing a constraint condition and cost function based on the environment perception data and the task target data, obtaining an offline constraint optimal control model of global task planning, and solving to obtain a global reference trajectory; on the basis of the global reference trajectory, constructing a tracking error cost function and an obstacle avoidance constraint condition to obtain an online constraint optimal control model of local dynamic adjustment, and solving to obtain a local dynamic trajectory; and outputting and executing the local dynamic trajectory to complete the task planning demand. According to the method, efficiency and balance stability are guaranteed through global task planning, safety and precision correction are improved through local dynamic adjustment, the performance bottleneck of global efficiency and local safety is effectively broken through, and the balance stability, task execution efficiency and man-machine interaction safety of the humanoid robot in a complex scene are effectively improved.

title: Robot anthropomorphic layered local planning method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot anthropomorphic layered local planning method and a robot. The robot anthropomorphic layered local planning method comprises a decision layer, a channel layer and a control layer, comprising the following steps: a decision-making layer determines indication information of a robot driving path through a unique identifier in a visual identification scene; the channel layer obtains box frames by visually identifying an indication board above a main channel based on indication information of a robot driving path of the decision layer, and constructs a virtual lane by taking a connecting line of two side boundaries of two adjacent box frames in the front and back as a virtual lane boundary; the control layer controls the robot to drive in the virtual lane based on the information of the virtual lane of the channel layer and the indication information of the driving path of the robot, and forms a driving track of humanoid motion; therefore, the robot simulates the flexible thinking and decision-making ability of humans when coping with complex problems, and reliable and continuous autonomous operation of the robot is realized.

title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid driving and driven humanoid robot lower limb
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an electro-hydraulic hybrid driving and driven humanoid robot lower limb and waist assembly which serves as a connection foundation of lower limbs and a robot trunk. The near ends of the thigh assemblies are connected with the waist assembly through hip joints; the near end of the shank assembly is connected with the far end of the thigh assembly through a knee joint; the foot component is connected with the far end of the shank component through an ankle joint; the hip joint is provided with three rotational degrees of freedom, the knee joint is provided with one rotational degree of freedom, and the ankle joint is provided with two rotational degrees of freedom; the rotational degree of freedom of each joint in a sagittal plane is driven by an active hydraulic actuator and a passive hydraulic actuator; the rotational degree of freedom of each joint in a horizontal plane and a coronal plane is driven by a motor joint module; the advantages of electric drive and hydraulic drive are brought into full play, and the problems of high power consumption in the negative work stage, complex traditional hydraulic drive pipelines and the like are solved by adopting an active and passive combined distributed hydraulic drive technology.

title: Ball cage type parallel robot joint

title: Humanoid robot joint base positioning and clamping jig and revolving platform
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint base positioning and clamping jig and a rotary platform. According to the device, the multiple abutting parts are all in sliding connection with the sliding part, the abutting parts cannot move independently, when the multiple abutting parts all abut against the positioning end face of the joint base, positioning is achieved, and due to the fact that the abutting parts can be adjusted within a certain range, the device can adapt to installation of joint bases of different specifications and sizes, and flexible manufacturing is achieved.

title: Track detection device and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a trajectory detection device and method for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot trajectory detection devices.The trajectory detection device comprises a humanoid robot body, the two sides of the humanoid robot body are each provided with a large arm and a small arm, and rotating shafts are installed between the large arms and the small arms; wherein a mounting plate and a guide plate are sequentially arranged on the outer side of one small arm from inside to outside, a laser detection head is slidably connected to the guide plate, a driving assembly is arranged between the mounting plate and the guide plate, and the driving assembly can adjust the included angle between the laser detection head and the small arm in real time according to the posture change of the small arm. Reverse angle compensation is achieved through the driving assembly, it is ensured that the optical axis of the laser detection head is stably aligned with the ground, the S-shaped track is used for dynamically guiding dynamic fine adjustment of the laser detection head, precise displacement and dynamic scanning are both considered, and the integrity of detection data is ensured. The detection efficiency is improved.

title: Damping structure of motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hollow cup motors, in particular to a damping structure of a motor for a humanoid robot, which comprises a sliding shaft, a transmission shaft, a flexible coupling and a torsion overload separation assembly, the sliding shaft is connected with the transmission shaft through the torsion overload separation assembly, and a damping effect is provided by arranging the flexible coupling to increase primary buffering; by arranging the torque overload separation assembly, when the torque load exceeds a preset value, the sliding shaft is separated from the transmission shaft, and overburning of the motor is avoided; the torsion overload separation assembly comprises a clamping block and a torsion shaft changing piece, the transmission shaft is provided with a clamping groove, the torsion shaft changing piece comprises a storage part and an expansion part, the expansion part is arranged in the clamping groove, the storage part is arranged in the containing groove, the clamping block can slide and extends into the clamping groove in the normal state, and when the sliding shaft rotates in the circumferential direction, the transmission shaft rotates in the circumferential direction along with the clamping block. When the torque load of the transmission shaft and the clamping block piece exceeds a preset value, the storage part is extruded, the expansion part is expanded, and the clamping block retreats from the clamping groove.

title: Track control method for biped humanoid robot and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a trajectory control method for a biped humanoid robot and electronic equipment. The trajectory control method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first current position of the robot and a second current position of an object to be contacted; calculating a moving track according to the first current position and the second current position to obtain a third target position of the robot; a run-up track is calculated according to the third target position and the second current position, and a landing point of the robot is obtained; according to the landing point, fitting a swing track based on a Bezier curve; and controlling the robot to move according to the moving track, the run-up track, the landing point and the swinging track so as to contact the to-be-contacted object. According to the method, the characteristics of each stage are integrated to obtain the track which is most suitable for robot movement and can correctly kick the to-be-contacted object, and the problem that the to-be-contacted object is trodden in advance or is too far away from the to-be-contacted object is avoided; and a run-up stage is introduced, so that the speed of kicking the object to be contacted can be obviously improved.

The problems that in the prior art, due to the fact that a single sensor is adopted, obstacle information cannot be accurately reflected by surrounding environment monitoring data, meanwhile, an appropriate mode for adjusting an obstacle avoidance algorithm to cope with different obstacle environments is lacked, and the obstacle avoidance accuracy and safety of a humanoid robot are poor are solved.

title: TIG (Tungsten Inert Gas) welding droplet transfer closed-loop control method for humanoid robot welding
abstract: The invention relates to a TIG welding droplet transfer closed-loop control method for humanoid robot welding, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problems that constant-speed wire feeding of TIG welding of a traditional robot cannot adapt to complex working conditions, double-arm welding coordination of a humanoid robot is difficult, and open-loop control over droplet transfer is unstable are solved. Connecting the two ends of a voltage sensor with the welding wire and a workpiece, and judging the contact state of the welding wire and a molten pool through TIG process pre-experiment calibration based on a contact separation threshold value; high-dynamic vision sensing of a high-temperature-resistant dustproof camera and a molten drop recognition algorithm including gray level conversion, median filtering and the like are arranged, and the transition frequency and size of molten drops are detected in a closed-loop mode; and feeding, stopping or withdrawing of the welding wire is controlled through large-torque constant-speed wire feeding and high-speed high-frequency wire control, and closed-loop feedback is formed with a visual detection result. According to the method, the problem of droplet transition control of humanoid robot single-arm TIG welding is solved, and high-quality controllable TIG welding of the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Flexible cable for humanoid robot and processing device
abstract: The invention provides a flexible cable for a humanoid robot and a processing device, and relates to the technical field of cables, the flexible cable for the humanoid robot comprises a bottom frame, a water tank, a pressurizing aeration pump, a cable main body, a liquid level meter, a wire clamping guide mechanism, a rotary water distribution mechanism and a cooling spraying mechanism, and the two sets of wire clamping guide mechanisms are located on the end faces of the sides, away from each other, of the shaft barrels correspondingly, the water tank is fixedly erected on the upper portion of the interior of the bottom frame, and the water tank is sequentially divided into a low heating cavity, a heating transition cavity and a cooling shaping cavity from right to left. According to the invention, through a mode of combining subarea gradient cooling, vortex stirring and spray cooling, stable and uniform cooling of a cable sheath is realized, thermal residual stress is effectively eliminated, appearance defects are avoided, and the cooling device is especially suitable for flexible cables for humanoid robots which need to be bent frequently.

title: AutoWrap robotics: humanoid AI for autonomous vehicle service centers
abstract: The AutoWrap Robotics Humanoid Service Center System is an innovative AI platform that autonomously manages vehicle service centers using a fleet of humanoid robots. It coordinates customer interaction, advanced diagnostics (including for EVs/SDVs) with Explainable AI, and autonomous vehicle repairs, alongside facility and outdoor maintenance. Integrating cutting-edge humanoid robots with sophisticated AI, machine learning, and multi-modal sensing, the platform provides semantic understanding of complex environments. It boosts service quality, reduces labor demands, and dramatically increases operational efficiency, transforming underperforming properties into highly productive autonomous centers. Key features include augmented reality interfaces, robust cybersecurity for in-vehicle networks and robot operations, predictive maintenance, and real-time, socially adaptive humanoid-mediated customer communication. Delivered as a scalable Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solution, the system provides essential AI intelligence for fully autonomous, comprehensive, and sustainable vehicle servicing.

title: Balancing device for humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention discloses a balancing device for humanoid robot joints, and relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing, the balancing device comprises a main body mechanism, the main body mechanism comprises a large arm and a small arm, the opposite ends of the large arm and the small arm are fixedly connected with a first U-shaped plate and a second U-shaped plate respectively, the inner side of the first U-shaped plate is provided with a power-saving assembly, and the inner side of the second U-shaped plate is provided with a power-saving assembly; and the inner side of the second U-shaped plate is fixedly connected with the surface of the joint motor assembly, a balance mechanism is arranged on the inner side of the first U-shaped plate, and disconnecting mechanisms are arranged on the two sides of the joint motor assembly. title: Robot dexterous hand control method and device based on interference identification and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of dexterous hands of humanoid robots, in particular to a robot dexterous hand control method and device based on interference identification and a medium, and the method comprises the steps that S1, a hand shape sequence is obtained based on task information analysis; s2, generating a corresponding joint state for each hand shape in the hand shape sequence, and obtaining a joint state vector corresponding to each hand shape; s3, all two adjacent hand shapes in the hand shape sequence form a hand shape group; s4, taking the joint state vectors of the two hand shapes of each hand shape group as boundary constraint conditions, and combining interference identification model filtering to generate a plurality of joint transition state vectors; s5, splicing all the joint state vectors and the joint transition state vectors in sequence to obtain a control vector of the dexterous hand; and S6, controlling each joint action of the dexterous hand based on the obtained control vector. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that complex space state calculation is not needed, and the like.

title: Olfaction perception monitoring method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to an olfaction perception monitoring method and system for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: when a preset trigger condition is satisfied, detecting the smell obtained by current olfaction sampling, and outputting a smell detection result; according to the smell detection result, all suspected scenes where the current robot is located are deduced, and the scene where the current robot is located is screened out from all the suspected scenes in combination with detection results obtained through corresponding detection of other detection modules except the smell; the other detection modules at least comprise a visual detection module used for detecting image information of the environment where the robot is located. Determining a smell coverage range according to the smell detection result and the scene where the current robot is located; and according to the real-time state of the robot, determining whether the robot is within the odor coverage range in real time, and if not, considering that a preset triggering condition is met. The method has the advantages that redundant detection behaviors of the robot on the smell in the same environment are reduced, and energy consumption is reduced.

The method has the advantages that redundant detection behaviors of the robot on the smell in the same environment are reduced, and energy consumption is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot whole body motion control method and system based on guide learning and remapping data
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot whole body motion control method and system based on guide learning and remapping data. According to the method, guide learning is adopted as a motion control algorithm framework of the humanoid robot; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring human body weight mapping data, and performing coordinate transformation on the human body weight mapping data to serve as a feedforward action in guide learning; constructing a neural network, inputting an observation vector of the robot into the neural network, carrying out reinforcement learning on the neural network, outputting rotation angle data, needing to be finely adjusted, of each joint of the robot, carrying out exponential smoothing processing on the rotation angle data, and outputting a smoothed signal as a feedback signal; and the feedforward action and the feedback signal are combined through PD control to generate a final rotation angle required by each joint of the robot, and then the rotation angle is converted into an output torque of a motor and output, so that whole-body motion control of the humanoid robot is completed. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the action accuracy and the real-time fine adjustment requirement are both considered, and the control robustness is high.

title: Integrated joint motor of hollow internal wiring speed reducer
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of joint motors, and discloses an integrated joint motor of a hollow internal wiring speed reducer. The inner wiring motor mechanism is arranged in the spliced shell and comprises a hollow transmission assembly movably connected to the interior of the spliced shell and a motor module arranged between the hollow transmission assembly and the spliced shell; the speed reduction output mechanism is arranged in the spliced shell and comprises a power output mechanism movably connected to the spliced shell and a speed reduction mechanism arranged between the power output mechanism and the hollow transmission assembly; high integration of the motor, the planetary reducer, the brake, the driver and the wiring harness is achieved, the axial size is shortened by 15% compared with a traditional outer wiring scheme, the radial size is reduced by 8%, cables are not exposed, the appearance is simple, and the robot can be widely applied to high-integration-degree scenes such as collaborative robots, humanoid robot joints and mechanical arm tail ends.

title: Humanoid robot lower limb, calibration method thereof and motion capture platform
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot lower limb and a calibration method and a motion capture platform thereof, and the calibration method comprises the steps: S1, capturing mark points on each joint of a robot through the motion capture platform, and obtaining the actual position coordinates of each joint; s2, according to the actual position coordinates of all the joints and theoretical position coordinates fed back by a built-in encoder of a motor for controlling all the joints, joint position deviations of all the joints are obtained through inverse kinematics solution; and S3, compensating the joint position deviation to a motor for controlling each joint, judging whether each joint reaches a target position or not by capturing the actual position of each joint after compensation, if so, ending calibration, and if not, returning to S2. According to the invention, automatic and manual intervention-free calibration of the joint position of the robot is realized when the robot works in a static state or a dynamic state.

title: Task dynamic allocation method and system for edge computing server
abstract: The invention discloses a task dynamic allocation method and system for an edge computing server, and belongs to the field of edge computing. According to the method, the pressure distribution data sequence of the pelma of the humanoid robot, the calculation load data of the edge calculation server and the candidate task allocation decision sequence are obtained; and performing integration and time difference processing on the pressure distribution data sequence to generate attitude stable data. And for each task distribution decision, generating a corresponding prediction instruction delay sequence and a prediction attitude stabilization sequence by utilizing the prediction model and combining the attitude stabilization data and the calculation load data. And calculating a task allocation score of each decision based on the prediction sequence through a cost function while ensuring that the time sequence resource occupancy rate and the prediction attitude stability meet a preset threshold condition. And the decision with the minimum score is selected as a target task allocation decision, and a task allocation instruction is generated according to task execution sequence information of the target task allocation decision, so that the physical entities can be effectively controlled in time while the calculation efficiency is guaranteed.

title: Production method of UHMWPE tendon rope for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a production method of a UHMWPE tendon rope for a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps of: forming a single yarn input device by using a middle transmission roller with a convex middle and a pressing upper rubber covered roller and a pressing lower rubber covered roller which are matched with each other and are concave in the middle, and respectively arranging a single yarn feeding device and a single yarn twisting device which have the same structure at two ends of the single yarn input device; therefore, spatial structure input of UHMWPE single yarns in the two single yarn feeding devices under the simultaneous driving of one middle transmission roller is realized, then spatial plying under the twisting effect is realized, spatial arrangement of the single yarns in plied yarns is realized, production of the UHMWPE tendon rope for the humanoid robot with high strength and high wear resistance is realized, and the production efficiency is improved. And meanwhile, the energy consumption during stranding production is effectively reduced.

title: Preparation method of CF-PEEK particles with high strength and high thermal conductivity
abstract: The invention is applied to the technical field of special engineering plastic modification, and discloses a preparation method of high-strength high-thermal-conductivity CF-PEEK particles, which comprises the following steps: S1, carbon fiber surface treatment; s2, chopping the carbon fibers; s3, pretreating the PEEK resin; s4, pretreating the nano material; s5, mixing the nano material with PEEK; s6, mixing the carbon fibers with the resin; and S7, performing granulation. According to the preparation method of the high-strength and high-thermal-conductivity CF-PEEK particles, aiming at the key pain point that an existing chopped CF/PEEK composite material cannot meet high rigidity (low deformation) and high thermal conductivity (heat dissipation) at the same time, through accurate introduction of carbon nanotubes (CNT) and optimization of technological parameters, cooperative improvement of performance is successfully achieved, the problem of heat accumulation in high-speed rotation and friction scenes is effectively solved, and the high-strength and high-thermal-conductivity CF-PEEK particles are obtained. And high-end application requirements of humanoid robot joints, transmission parts and the like are completely met.

title: Humanoid robot interaction control system and method based on communication module
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot interaction control system and method based on a communication module. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, predicting a predicted network score for representing future network quality through a network prediction module, classifying each interaction control instruction by combining the two scores through an instruction interaction module, and finally, carrying out differentiation processing on different types of interaction control instructions through an instruction processing module. According to the method, an instruction classification mechanism of real-time and predictive two-dimensional network scores is combined to ensure that the same instruction obtains a classification result matched with the actual demand of the instruction in different network environments, and a differential processing strategy based on the classification result of a local lightweight model is matched; the problem that the real-time performance under the network quality fluctuation condition cannot be ensured by a humanoid robot cloud control method in the prior art is solved.

title: Linear driver for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a linear driver for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the linear driver comprises a front end cover, a main fixing frame and a rear end cover which are fixedly connected in sequence from the front end to the rear end, and the outer side wall of the main fixing frame is fixedly connected with a driver; a force sensor is arranged, the force sensor is connected with a linear motion joint of the humanoid robot through a fisheye head with a lead screw, meanwhile, a first-stage speed reduction driving assembly and a second-stage speed reduction rotating assembly are arranged, a linear motion lead screw is arranged in the second-stage speed reduction rotating assembly, and the lead screw is connected with the linear motion joint of the humanoid robot through the fisheye head with the lead screw. According to the structure, the adaptive driving force can be controlled according to the current force value to drive the linear motion joints of the two humanoid robots to do linear motion, and two times of speed reduction and two times of torque increase are achieved in the driving process of the driving force; the requirements of the humanoid robot for large load, large torque and small rotation angle on hip joints, knee joints, ankle joints, elbow joints, wrist joints and the like can be met.

title: Humanoid robot hip joint
abstract: The humanoid robot hip joint comprises a hip bone, a leg bone and a connecting assembly, the connecting assembly comprises a rotating motor and a half shaft, the half shaft comprises an inner ball and an outer sleeve, the inner ball and the outer sleeve are arranged in a sleeved mode, the inner ball can freely rotate in any direction in the outer sleeve, the outer sleeve is connected with an output shaft of the rotating motor, and the inner ball is connected with the leg bone. A driving piece is further arranged between the hip bone and the leg bone, and the driving piece is used for limiting the displacement amount of the thigh of the robot. The space occupied by the hip bone part of the robot can be reduced, and meanwhile the robot has the more flexible movement capacity and has the advantages of being flexible in movement and small in occupied space.

title: Method and device for enabling biped robot to wear common sports shoes
abstract: The invention relates to a method and device for a biped robot to wear common sports shoes, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the steps that a pre-planned gait track is initialized and generated; calculating the actual centroid position of the robot at each moment; a Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to fuse multi-source data to update the normal stiffness and the friction coefficient of the sole in real time, and the rate is updated through adaptive gain adjustment parameters; adjusting a zero moment point constraint range, and generating a centroid reference position of a preset step number; establishing a sole characteristic database, training a machine learning model, inputting shoe parameters into the machine learning model, and outputting step length, step frequency and ankle joint rigidity by the machine learning model; an ankle joint target angle and a knee joint target angle are solved through inverse kinematics, and a joint motor is driven in combination with a PD control algorithm and a self-adaptive item; when the vertical acceleration of the IMU sensor is larger than a preset acceleration threshold value, the time period before grounding is judged, and a compliant mode is triggered to control the ankle joint rigidity and the torque borne by the joint.

title: Waist elastic connecting structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomimetic robots, and provides a waist elastic connecting structure of a humanoid simulation robot, which comprises a biomimetic lumbar vertebra and a biomimetic pelvic cavity of the robot, the bottom of the biomimetic lumbar vertebra is connected with the biomimetic pelvic cavity, and an elastic component is arranged around the biomimetic lumbar vertebra; the elastic assembly comprises a round strip spiral elastic unit and a flat strip spiral elastic unit, and the round strip spiral elastic unit and the flat strip spiral elastic unit are coaxially arranged and staggered in the axial direction of the bionic lumbar vertebra. A plurality of connecting rods are arranged on the two sides of the bionic lumbar vertebra, a lantern ring is arranged at the end of each connecting rod, and the lantern rings are connected to the corresponding round strip spiral elastic units and the corresponding flat strip spiral elastic units in a sleeving mode. Through staggered combination of the round-strip spiral elastic units and the flat-strip spiral elastic units and combination of wire size gradient change and up-and-down differentiated connection of the elastic units, the waist action of the robot is more vivid and natural, impact can be buffered, and the robot can cooperate with a driving motor to work.

title: Industrial humanoid inspection robot obstacle encountering calculation task processing method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an obstacle encountering calculation task processing method and system for an industrial humanoid inspection robot. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a target scene when the industrial humanoid inspection robot encounters an obstacle; generating an obstacle-encountering calculation task according to the target scene, and segmenting the obstacle-encountering calculation task to obtain a plurality of sub-tasks; distributing the plurality of subtasks to corresponding equipment in an equipment set associated with the industrial humanoid inspection robot; and receiving calculation information returned by each device, integrating the calculation information, and generating an obstacle avoidance path of the industrial humanoid inspection robot. An associated equipment set in a scene where the industrial humanoid inspection robot is located is called, an obstacle encountering calculation task is divided into sub-tasks and allocated to the equipment set, distributed cooperative calculation is achieved, the computing power bottleneck of the industrial humanoid inspection robot is avoided, the obstacle avoidance decision time is shortened, and the calculation efficiency is improved. Through a task segmentation and dynamic allocation mechanism, the load can be flexibly adjusted and calculated according to the real-time state of the equipment, and the robustness of the system is improved.

title: Humanoid robot chest structure and humanoid robot

The functions of all the parts are mutually independent and do not interfere with each other; mutual supporting is achieved structurally, and the overall rigidity and strength of the chest are improved; all the modules are reasonably arranged and connected, the maintenance convenience of the robot is improved, and later expansion is facilitated.

title: Water conservancy project humanoid robot inspection and hidden danger checking system based on polymorphic fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a water conservancy project humanoid robot inspection and hidden danger checking system based on polymorphic fusion. The system comprises a water conservancy project robot, a water conservancy information architecture unit based on polymorphic fusion and an inspection and hidden danger checking unit. The water conservancy information architecture unit based on polymorphic fusion is used for acquiring sensor data of a water conservancy project and water conservancy hidden danger knowledge graph data, and performing data operation and early warning; the routing inspection and hidden danger checking unit comprises a plurality of routing inspection paths, collects corresponding path information and carries out hidden danger intelligent diagnosis. The method is based on the module setting of the water conservancy project body robot, and combines the model predictive control MPC optimization inspection path algorithm of the hierarchical reinforcement decision framework to optimize the inspection path; structured, semi-structured and unstructured data are integrated to sort potential risk factors and association relationships thereof in the water conservancy project, hidden danger traceability analysis, risk prediction and cross-domain knowledge fusion are realized, and intelligent decision support is provided for water conservancy project full life cycle risk management.

title: Series-parallel connection double-foot mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a series-parallel connection double-foot mechanism of a humanoid robot. The series-parallel double-foot mechanism of the humanoid robot comprises a left leg assembly, a right leg assembly and a hip connecting assembly, the left leg assembly and the right leg assembly are composed of hip joints, knee joints, ankle joints and supporting parts, and the hip joints achieve three-degree-of-freedom movement through two rotary actuators and a linear actuator; the knee joint achieves one-degree-of-freedom movement through a linear actuator, and the ankle joint achieves two-degree-of-freedom movement through parallel control of two linear actuators. title: Emotion recognition method of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an emotion recognition method of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the voice, face image and physiological signal of a user through a multi-mode sensor; analyzing data based on a deep learning model, and extracting multi-modal features; training an emotion classification model according to the historical interaction data, and outputting emotion probability distribution; calculating an emotion recognition value based on probability distribution weighted fusion, wherein the weight is dynamically adjusted according to each modal confidence coefficient; and adjusting a robot dialogue response strategy according to the emotion value. According to the method, high-precision and real-time multi-modal emotion recognition is realized, complex emotion changes can be effectively captured, natural and personalized interaction responses are generated according to the context, and the authenticity and adaptability of man-machine interaction experience are remarkably improved.

title: Data enhancement method based on humanoid robot reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a data enhancement method based on humanoid robot reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: S1, building a parallel training environment; s2, parallel training is carried out; s3, acquiring training data; s4, data enhancement; s5, calculating the loss of the training task; and S6, updating the strategy. The invention provides a data enhancement method for reinforcement learning of a humanoid robot, and the method can remarkably improve the speed of reinforcement learning training, can reduce the training data needed by the robot in reinforcement learning, can enhance the left-right symmetry of robot behaviors, improves the beauty of actions, and improves the training efficiency. The proposed data enhancement method can also be applied to other robot learning methods such as imitation learning.

The proposed data enhancement method can also be applied to other robot learning methods such as imitation learning.

title: Latticed support body and elastic connecting piece integrated hollow waist support structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a hollow waist supporting structure integrating a latticed supporting body and an elastic connecting piece of a simulated humanoid robot, which comprises a bionic chest skeleton and the latticed supporting body sleeved in the bionic chest skeleton; the shape of the latticed support body is matched with the contour of the chest of a human body, the latticed support body comprises a plurality of grid units, and the distribution density and the grid size of the grid units are differentially set according to different areas of the chest; a spiral elastic unit is arranged on the lower portion of the bionic chest skeleton and located at the position of the waist. Through the hollow design of the bionic chest skeleton, the hollow structure of the latticed supporting body and the gradient density distribution of the grid units, materials are removed to the maximum extent in a non-key force bearing area, the light weight of the whole structure is achieved, and the motion inertia and energy consumption of the robot are reduced.

title: Standing type wireless charging method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a standing type wireless charging method and system for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: enabling the humanoid robot to move to the center of a charging region of a charging base station in a natural gait self-positioning manner, and building a communication link with the charging base station; the charging base station receives a charging request of the humanoid robot, starts low-power test to carry out initial coupling detection, determines the optimal charging frequency, and starts charging; the charging state is monitored in real time, the charging power is dynamically adjusted according to the charging state, and the charging strategy is adjusted in combination with the safety protection detection result; and when the residual electric quantity of the battery of the humanoid robot meets a preset threshold value or a leaving signal is triggered, a leaving request is sent to the charging base station, charging is stopped, and the communication link with the charging base station is disconnected.

title: Integrated parallel universal damping wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The integrated parallel universal damping wheeled humanoid robot comprises a machine chassis and a humanoid robot body arranged on the machine chassis, the humanoid robot body is connected with the machine chassis through a parallel mechanism, and a top table is driven to rotate through the parallel mechanism; therefore, the humanoid robot main body mounted on the top table is driven to rotate together, and the posture of the humanoid robot main body is adjusted; a universal wheel mechanism and a damping mechanism are arranged at the bottom of the machine chassis, the universal wheel mechanism comprises two universal wheel assemblies installed on the left side and the right side of the bottom of the machine chassis, and the damping mechanism comprises a plurality of damping assemblies arranged at the bottom of the machine chassis. abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot three-dimensional gesture animation generation method and a humanoid robot three-dimensional gesture animation model deployment device. title: Humanoid robot risk early warning method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot risk early warning method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal sensing data of a humanoid robot; inputting the multi-modal perception data into a risk prediction model to obtain a risk prediction result output by the risk prediction model; determining a current risk early warning state of the humanoid robot based on the risk prediction result; and under the condition that the current risk early warning state of the humanoid robot is that the risk exists, collecting risk early warning information, and uploading the risk early warning information to the cloud platform. According to the invention, the multi-modal sensing data is analyzed through the risk prediction model, so that automatic risk early warning analysis can be realized, risk early warning information can be uploaded to the cloud platform in time, key early warning information loss is avoided, the cloud platform is helped to respond to and execute an emergency strategy in time, and the risk early warning efficiency is improved. And the safety and the reliability of the humanoid robot in a complex environment are effectively improved.

title: Humanoid robot self-collision avoidance method, robot, equipment and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot self-collision avoidance method, a robot, equipment and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: determining a self-collision avoidance control moment and a joint control moment of a corresponding connecting rod based on any connecting rod in a target connecting rod pair, determining a self-collision avoidance control moment and a joint control moment of a front connecting rod which influences the movement of the corresponding connecting rod; respectively projecting the joint control torque of the corresponding connecting rod and the joint control torque of the front connecting rod of the corresponding connecting rod to a null space of a task corresponding to the self-collision avoidance control torque by utilizing the null space projection matrix to obtain the joint control torque of the corresponding connecting rod after projection and the joint control torque of the front connecting rod of the corresponding connecting rod after projection; and according to the first superposition torque and the second superposition torque, the corresponding joint motors are controlled to move.

title: Hollow bionic spine structure of simulated humanoid robot and implementation method of hollow bionic spine structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a hollow bionic spine structure of a simulation humanoid robot and an implementation method thereof.The structure comprises a spine bionic assembly, and the spine bionic assembly comprises a cervical vertebra bionic section, a thoracic vertebra bionic section, a lumbar vertebra bionic section and a caudal vertebra bionic section which are sequentially connected in series; each bionic section is of a hollow structure, and the middle of each bionic section is provided with a through hole allowing the corresponding flexible connecting piece to penetrate through. title: Double-arm wheel type humanoid intelligent robot with body
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of bodywork robots, and discloses a double-arm wheel type humanoid bodywork intelligent robot which adopts a wheel type movable supporting structure, an auxiliary crawler belt is arranged in the middle of the bottom side of a chassis support, and when the robot passes through obstacles such as a doorsill and a low step, the auxiliary crawler belt is arranged on the bottom side of the chassis support; the robot can quickly cross obstacles through driving assistance of the auxiliary crawler belt, the terrain passing capacity of the robot is greatly improved, working transmission of moving wheels is completed through cooperation of a transmission belt wheel and a transmission toothed belt, and the situation that a moving driving motor occupies the lower space of a chassis support and collides with ground protrusions can be avoided; the robot body is installed on the upper portion of the chassis support in a matched and supported mode through the first hinge arm and the second hinge arm, the first hinge arm and the second hinge arm are driven through the hinge servo driving base, and flexible adjustment of the supporting height and the working inclination angle of the robot body can be achieved through overturning supporting. The problems that a traditional wheeled robot is difficult to take articles at high positions, and work limitation is high are solved.

title: Humanoid robot joint module based on two-stage planetary speed reduction and double-encoder feedback
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot joint module based on two-stage planetary speed reduction and double-encoder feedback, and relates to the technical field of robots. The humanoid robot joint module comprises a driving motor, a first-stage planetary reducer, a second-stage planetary reducer, a first inductance encoder, a second inductance encoder and a driving control board which are sequentially arranged from the input end to the output end. A first-stage sun gear of the first-stage planetary reducer is connected with a rotor shaft of the driving motor, a first-stage planet carrier of the first-stage planetary reducer serves as first-stage output to be connected with a second-stage sun gear of the second-stage planetary reducer, and a second-stage planet carrier of the second-stage planetary reducer serves as a joint output flange. The first inductance encoder and the second inductance encoder are connected with the driving control board, the driving control board is used for receiving signals of the double encoders and superior control instructions and driving the motor to operate, and the motor control system has high integration and balanced performance, can directly sense the state of the output end and achieves full-closed-loop control based on double feedback.

title: Humanoid robot active following method and device, humanoid robot, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot active following method and device, a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot active following. title: Biped robot control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot control method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that actual observation data at the current moment are collected through a target sensor of a biped robot body; wherein the target sensor comprises a joint encoder, an inertia measuring instrument and a plantar force sensor; predicting a state prediction value at the current moment by combining the state prediction value at the previous moment and a motion model of the biped robot; predicting predicted observation data at the current moment by using the state predicted value at the current moment based on the relationship between the observation data and the state data; correcting the state prediction value at the current moment based on the deviation between the actual observation data at the current moment and the prediction observation data to obtain a state correction value at the current moment; selecting a control parameter in a current state for the unified reinforcement learning control strategy through the correction function based on the state correction value at the current moment, and correcting the control parameter to obtain a current control parameter; and controlling the current biped robot according to the current control parameters.

title: Thumb mechanism and humanoid manipulator
abstract: The invention provides a thumb mechanism and a humanoid manipulator. The thumb mechanism comprises a wrist-palm driving module, a palm-finger driving module, a near-end knuckle module and a far-end knuckle module which are connected in sequence; the thumb mechanism has at least five rotational degrees of freedom; the wrist and palm driving module is arranged on the palm assembly and used for driving the palm and finger driving module to rotate around a first axis relative to the palm assembly and simulating wrist and palm abduction and adduction movement; the metacarpophalangeal driving module is used for driving the metacarpophalangeal driving module to rotate around a second axis relative to the wrist-palm driving module, simulating metacarpal bone flexion and extension movement, driving the near-end knuckle module to rotate around a third axis relative to the metacarpophalangeal driving module, and simulating near-end knuckle rotation movement; and the near-end knuckle module is used for driving the near-end knuckle module to rotate around a fourth axis relative to the metacarpophalangeal driving module, simulating the bending and stretching movement of the near-end knuckle, driving the far-end knuckle module to rotate around a fifth axis relative to the near-end knuckle module, and simulating the bending and stretching movement of the far-end knuckle.
