title: Humanoid robot joint zero calibration structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint zero calibration structure, and relates to the field of robots. The joint zero calibration structure comprises a first joint, a second joint and a calibration assembly. The first joint is provided with a first positioning hole. The second joint is provided with a second positioning hole, and the center line of the second positioning hole and the center line of the first positioning hole are collinear and parallel to the rotation axis of the second joint and the rotation axis of the first joint. The second positioning hole comprises a linear hole section and a conical hole section which are connected. The conical hole section is located on the side, away from the first positioning hole, of the second positioning hole. The calibration assembly comprises a calibration shaft piece and a locking piece, the calibration shaft piece penetrates through the first positioning hole and the second positioning hole, a conical surface attached to the hole wall of the conical hole section is arranged on the calibration shaft piece, and the locking piece is connected with one end of the calibration shaft piece. According to the zero position calibration structure, the conical surface is tightly attached to the hole wall of the conical hole section, the fit clearance between the positioning pin and the shaft hole in the prior art is reduced, and therefore the zero position calibration precision between the joints is improved.

title: High-energy-density lithium-sulfur battery for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of lithium-sulfur batteries, in particular to a high-energy-density lithium-sulfur battery for a humanoid robot, the high-energy-density lithium-sulfur battery comprises an outer shell and a plurality of battery cell modules arranged in the outer shell, the battery cell modules are connected in series, and each battery cell module comprises a plurality of battery cell monomers; each battery cell monomer comprises a lithium-sulfur battery cell inner shell, a liquid storage cavity is formed between the inner shell and the lithium-sulfur battery cell, the liquid storage cavity is filled with insulating fluid, and an isolation assembly capable of deforming is further arranged between the inner shell and the lithium-sulfur battery cell; the inner shell is further provided with a fluid channel communicating with the liquid storage cavity and a pushing cavity, and a movable pushing component is arranged in the pushing cavity. The positive electrode of the lithium-sulfur battery cell is connected with a movable electric connection part, and the movable electric connection part is configured to move between a first position in electric connection with the positive electrode and a second position disconnected from the positive electrode; according to the lithium-sulfur battery, active and quick power-off can be realized from the battery core level, and the safety and the reliability of the lithium-sulfur battery applied to the humanoid robot are fundamentally improved.

title: Humanoid robot

title: Humanoid robot multi-device cooperative control system and method and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot multi-device cooperative control system and method and a robot. The system comprises a cooperative control module, an external equipment management module, an input interaction management module and a main control module. Wherein the external equipment management module is used for processing connection interaction between the humanoid robot and external equipment; the cooperative control module is used for sharing the data of the master device end device to the slave device end device; the input interaction management module is used for processing a user input instruction and interacting with the humanoid robot and/or external equipment according to the user input instruction; and the main control module is used for cooperatively scheduling the external equipment management module, the cooperative control module and the input interaction management module. According to the method, efficient sharing and dynamic recovery of data are realized by adopting a master-slave equipment model and a reference counting mechanism, and the collaboration precision is improved; in addition, the functions of cross-device instruction response, multi-mode interaction, multi-protocol adaptation, dynamic role configuration and the like are achieved, and the complex requirements of robot movement coordination are met.

According to the method, efficient sharing and dynamic recovery of data are realized by adopting a master-slave equipment model and a reference counting mechanism, and the collaboration precision is improved; in addition, the functions of cross-device instruction response, multi-mode interaction, multi-protocol adaptation, dynamic role configuration and the like are achieved, and the complex requirements of robot movement coordination are met.

title: Multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of humanoid robot to move
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure suitable for driving finger joints of a humanoid robot to move. The multi-cylinder pneumatic machine structure comprises a cylinder body, a cylinder liner, a piston, a cylinder stroke control ring, a stay wire and a stay wire restraining device. The air cylinder body comprises a shell and a cover plate, the cover plate seals two ends of the shell, the shell is in a hollow cylinder shape, a plurality of air cylinder holes symmetrical to the central section of the shell are formed in the two ends of the shell, air cylinder inner containers and pistons are installed in the holes, and piston plate faces are fixed on the air cylinder inner containers. And two stay wires required by swinging of finger joints are respectively connected to the two symmetrically arranged cylinder pistons through the stay wire restraining devices. When the air cylinder inner container on one side is inflated, the piston linearly moves to enable the pull wire connected with the piston to pull the finger joints to bend, at the moment, the other pull wire corresponding to the pull wire pulls the air cylinder piston on the other side to linearly move into the air cylinder, and therefore the function of the multi-cylinder pneumatic machine is achieved. The cylinder stroke control ring is installed at a cylinder port to control the maximum stroke of the cylinder.

title: HUMANOID ROBOT HAVING ADVANCED JOINT ASSEMBLIES
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot comprising an actuator with a rotational axis and a momentary peak torque rating greater than 70 N-m. The robot includes a first assembly and a second assembly coupled to the actuator, each lacking a recess for receiving an extent of the actuator in a fully flexed position. The first assembly has a first interior point and a first exterior point, while the second assembly has a second interior point and a second exterior point. The rotational axis is substantially centered between both the first interior and exterior points and the second interior and exterior points. This configuration allows for efficient joint movement while maintaining structural integrity and minimizing potential pinch points.

title: Robot head and neck structure, robot trunk and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a robot head and neck structure, a robot trunk and a humanoid robot, the head and neck structure comprises a head structure and a neck structure, the neck structure comprises a first driving piece, a second driving piece and a connecting piece, the output end of the first driving piece is connected to the connecting piece, and the second driving piece is fixed to the connecting piece; the output end of the second driving part is connected to the head structure, the output end of the first driving part is used for outputting rotation around the first axis, and the output end of the second driving part is used for outputting rotation around the second axis. A first limiting structure is arranged between the connecting piece and the first driving piece and used for limiting the rotating range of the connecting piece around the first axis, and a second limiting structure is arranged between the head structure and the connecting piece and used for limiting the rotating range of the head structure around the second axis. The head structure has a plurality of movable degrees of freedom, and rotation of the head structure is limited under the condition of power loss, so that the position of the head structure is fixed within a certain range.

title: Connecting structure, manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a connecting structure, a manipulator and a humanoid robot, the connecting structure comprises a connecting shaft, a bearing and a locking structure, the connecting shaft comprises a first connecting part and a second connecting part, the outer wall of the second connecting part is provided with an external thread, and the bearing sleeves the second connecting part. The locking structure comprises a locking nut, a locking pin and a locking pad, the locking pad is arranged on the second connecting part in a sleeving mode, the locking nut is connected to the second connecting part in a threaded mode, and the locking pad is located between the bearing and the locking nut. The second connecting part is provided with an adjusting part, the adjusting part is movably connected to the second connecting part, a first elastic piece is connected between the adjusting part and the second connecting part, the adjusting part and the locking nut are each provided with a connecting position, and the locking pin can be connected to the locking nut and the adjusting part at the same time through the connecting positions. According to the connecting structure, looseness prevention can be achieved, the structure used for being connected with the external part can be pressed at the target locking position, and the connecting reliability is improved.

title: Digital Humanoid Robots with Dynamical Models for Robot Guidance and Control System Design
abstract: This patent discloses a computer system for humanoid robot control system design and implementation, featuring a digital humanoid robot with dynamical models and a set of single-input-single-output (SISO) and multi-input-multi-output (MIMO) controllers. The system comprises a main software program, a generative Al humanoid robot intelligence engine, a robot motion path planner module, and a control system simulation engine. It enables efficient design, testing, validation, and implementation of robot control systems, significantly reducing time to market. The system supports seamless upgrades to accommodate new designs and components, enhancing applications in industrial automation, healthcare, public safety, and more, aligning with the goals of the 4th Industrial Revolution.

title: Humanoid robot body intelligent development platform and method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot body intelligent development platform and method. The robot body control algorithm is developed in a platformization mode, various defects caused by traditional development in a manual deep programming mode are overcome, the body intelligent robot control algorithm and the control model are developed on the basis of the platform, the algorithm and the model are finally deployed on the end side of the robot, and the development efficiency is improved. title: Movement control method and device of humanoid robot, terminal equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a movement control method and device of a humanoid robot, terminal equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: training a movement control model of the humanoid robot through a teacher-student distillation training mode, and carrying out the distillation training in a simulation environment, and constructing a simulation model of the humanoid robot and a plurality of simulation terrain point clouds, and training the teacher network. Further compressing input data input into the student network, and performing distillation training on the student network by adopting the compressed training data set by taking the difference minimization between a second joint driving instruction output by the student network and the first joint driving instruction as a target; the trained student network not only maintains the strong ability of the teacher model to cope with complex terrains, but also meets the real-time requirement of the humanoid robot for the control strategy, and overcomes the problem of poor movement stability of the humanoid robot in the prior art.

title: Humanoid robot unmanned driving control system based on humanoid actions
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot unmanned driving control system based on humanoid actions. The humanoid robot unmanned driving control system comprises a multi-mode sensing module, a humanoid action module, a task planning and decision module and a humanoid robot and vehicle control module. The multi-mode sensing module is responsible for environment sensing, humanoid robot and vehicle body state sensing and state estimation through arranging a sensing module; the humanoid action module is responsible for establishing a robot driving action library and establishing different driving experience actions according to different scenes and different road conditions; the task planning and decision-making module is responsible for planning the next task by combining the action of the human-like action module and the information of the multi-modal sensing module with task information and sending out an execution decision, and comprises a task planning module and a decision-making module; and the humanoid robot and vehicle control module is responsible for executing actions, and controlling the vehicle through a mechanical arm of the robot after receiving the task of the task planning and decision-making module.

title: Method, apparatus, medium and program product for compositing robotic works
abstract: The invention aims at providing a method and device for synthesizing robot works, a medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps that in response to a selection operation executed by a user for a timeline, a robot skill combination selected by the user for at least one time point in the timeline is obtained, the robot skill combination comprises at least one of robot actions, robot sounds and robot skills; and according to the robot skill combination corresponding to the at least one time point, synthesizing a corresponding robot work, so that the humanoid robot deployed with the robot work executes the robot skill combination at the at least one time point.

title: Automatic production equipment and method for humanoid robot filter inductor
abstract: The invention provides automatic production equipment for a humanoid robot filter inductor, the automatic production equipment is used for assembling the inductor, the inductor comprises a bottom plate and two coils adhered to the bottom plate through glue, the two coils are arranged in the direction perpendicular to the extension direction of the single coil, and the assembling machine comprises a rack, a first support and a second support; a turntable assembly; the bottom plate feeding assembly is used for feeding the bottom plate to a clamping jaw located at a bottom plate feeding station; the bottom plate gluing assembly is used for gluing the upper surface of the bottom plate located at the bottom plate gluing station; the first coil feeding assembly is used for feeding one of the two coils to the bottom plate located at the first coil feeding station; the side face gluing assembly is used for gluing the outward side of the coil located on the bottom plate; the top gluing assembly is used for gluing the top of the coil located at the top gluing station; the second coil feeding assembly is used for feeding the other coil of the two coils onto the bottom plate; and the discharging assembly is used for discharging the assembled inductors.

title: Humanoid robot control system and control method based on world knowledge enhancement and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control system and method based on world knowledge enhancement and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The system comprises an execution module, a collection module, a trained coding module, a knowledge enhancement module and a planning module. The acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time scene data around the humanoid robot; the coding module is used for coding the real-time scene data to obtain scene features; the knowledge enhancement module is used for processing the scene features according to preset world knowledge to obtain task description; and the planning module is used for solving the optimization objective function according to the task description, the scene features and the body parameters of the humanoid robot to obtain a motion control instruction. According to the embodiment of the invention, the task execution precision of the robot and the cross-scene adaptive capability of the robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot leg mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot leg structures. A humanoid robot leg mechanism comprises a crotch structure part used for being connected with a trunk of a robot, and joints of the crotch structure part for achieving pitching, rolling and yawing of legs are arranged in a distributed mode; the knee structure part is connected with the crotch structure part, is positioned below the crotch structure part, is used for driving the shanks to realize pitching motion, and is provided with a hollow wiring channel, so that the control cable is orderly twisted when the joints rotate; the shank structural part is connected with the knee structural part and located below the knee structural part, and a parallel connection connecting rod mechanism used for driving the ankle structural part is arranged at the upper end of the shank structural part; the ankle structure part is connected with the shank structure part, driven by the parallel connection link mechanism, located below the shank structure part and used for achieving rolling and pitching movement of the ankle, and the rolling axis and the pitching axis of the ankle structure part are coplanar with the crotch key axis when located at the zero position.

title: Semantic constraint instant distillation humanoid robot control method based on large language model and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a semantic constraint instant distillation humanoid robot control method based on a large language model and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a natural language instruction of a user; performing semantic analysis on the natural language instruction of the user through the large language model to obtain a structured semantic intention tensor; compressing and translating the semantic intention tensor by using a local lightweight model to obtain a control parameter; controlling the humanoid robot to complete a target action according to the control parameters, and acquiring execution state feedback information; semantic offset detection is carried out based on execution state feedback information, online adjustment is carried out on a local lightweight model, and a closed-loop control path is formed. The semantic comprehension ability, the action generation efficiency, the feedback adaptability and the cross-scene generalization ability of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Data mapping method and system based on camera assembly
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a camera component-based data mapping method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring a continuous human body motion image sequence in a current scene through a camera component; extracting spatio-temporal data of a plurality of key points of the human body from the human body motion image sequence; a first mapping strategy is adopted for the first key point set, a second mapping strategy is adopted for the second key point set, and then the spatio-temporal data of the human body key points are converted into robot joint angle data; outputting the robot joint angle data to control the robot to move. According to the method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the key point data of the human body is processed according to strategies, so that collaborative advantages are formed in the aspects of precision, efficiency, adaptability, universality, stability and the like, and the problems of accuracy and stability in mapping from human motion to robot motion are effectively solved.

title: Motor sealing structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of motor sealing, in particular to a motor sealing structure for a humanoid robot, which comprises a motor body, one side of the motor body is provided with a rotating shaft and a connecting sleeve, and the connecting sleeve is provided with a matching cavity with an opening. A second annular mounting groove is further formed in the wall surface which forms the matching cavity and is close to the first insertion part, and a plurality of third annular bulges which are uniformly distributed and are arranged at intervals are arranged on the wall surface which forms the second annular mounting groove; the speed reducing mechanism comprises a mounting shell, the mounting shell is provided with a first inserting part and a first extending part, the mounting shell is provided with a first cavity, and the outer wall of the first inserting part is further provided with a plurality of first annular protrusions which are evenly distributed and arranged at intervals; a first rubber sleeve; a thin sheet sleeve is further arranged between the first rubber sleeve and the second rubber sleeve. According to the invention, the advantages of difficult separation and good sealing performance can be realized by effectively utilizing the self structural configuration.

title: Motherboard assembly control method based on humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a mainboard assembly control method based on a humanoid robot and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an assembly intention map of a target model; controlling the humanoid robot to execute a mainboard assembly task according to the map; wherein the mainboard assembly task execution process comprises the following steps: controlling a humanoid robot to perform mainboard assembly according to a robot assembly action plan on a current task node; assembling process data of the current task node are obtained through a sensor, whether the current task node is abnormal or not is judged according to the assembling process data, and if yes, correction is conducted according to a compensation strategy on the current task node; and an instruction is output according to the equipment type selection information of the next task node, so that the clamp replacement table prepares a corresponding assembly tool for the humanoid robot to replace. According to the method, flexible production and automation can be achieved, the cost problem caused by assembly of different machine types or abnormal assembly is effectively solved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot assembly.

title: Dynamic task allocation method for humanoid robot in industrial scene and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot dynamic task allocation method in an industrial scene and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a task load level of a current industrial scene; the task load level comprises a low load level, a medium load level and a high load level; determining a corresponding task allocation strategy based on the task load level; the task allocation strategy comprises an event trigger allocation strategy, an improved Hungary algorithm allocation strategy and a hybrid heuristic algorithm allocation strategy; carrying out task allocation on the humanoid robot based on the determined task allocation strategy; the humanoid robot task allocation comprises task-robot matching, task sequence planning and cooperation scheme generation. According to the method, the distribution strategies can be dynamically switched in different load scenes, the real-time performance and global optimization are both considered, and the utilization rate of the robot and the industrial scene cooperation efficiency are improved.

title: Humanoid arm and system of anti-explosion humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an anti-explosion humanoid robot humanoid arm and system, and the humanoid arm comprises a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm structure chain which is connected with a supporting structure through a mechanical arm fixing base, is connected with a plurality of mounting parts in series through seven driving joints, and is finally connected to a tail end clamping jaw tool through a six-dimensional force sensor. According to the core improvement, joint covering parts covering the outer sides of the second driving joint, the fourth driving joint and the sixth driving joint are arranged, and the covering parts and the driving joint bodies jointly form an explosion-proof cavity so as to meet the explosion-proof requirement. The explosion-proof cavity adopts a structure of combining a wide spigot with a high-temperature-resistant sealing ring, energy limitation is carried out on an internal circuit through an intrinsic safety isolation fence, and sealing wiring is carried out through hollow shaft wiring and an explosion-proof cable gland. A six-dimensional force sensor and a binocular depth camera are further integrated, and a double-arm system can be formed through symmetrical arrangement. The system has high flexibility and environment perception capability, and ensures the operation safety in the flammable and explosive environment at the same time.
abstract_en: The invention provides an anti-explosion humanoid robot humanoid arm and system, and the humanoid arm comprises a seven-degree-of-freedom humanoid mechanical arm structure chain which is connected with a supporting structure through a mechanical arm fixing base, is connected with a plurality of mounting parts in series through seven driving joints, and is finally connected to a tail end clamping jaw tool through a six-dimensional force sensor. According to the core improvement, joint covering parts covering the outer sides of the second driving joint, the fourth driving joint and the sixth driving joint are arranged, and the covering parts and the driving joint bodies jointly form an explosion-proof cavity so as to meet the explosion-proof requirement. The explosion-proof cavity adopts a structure of combining a wide spigot with a high-temperature-resistant sealing ring, energy limitation is carried out on an internal circuit through an intrinsic safety isolation fence, and sealing wiring is carried out through hollow shaft wiring and an explosion-proof cable gland. A six-dimensional force sensor and a binocular depth camera are further integrated, and a double-arm system can be formed through symmetrical arrangement. The system has high flexibility and environment perception capability, and ensures the operation safety in the flammable and explosive environment at the same time.

title: Production control method and control system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a production control method and system based on a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a task completion score of the humanoid robot; according to the task completion score, distributing and screening the sub-tasks to obtain a task execution queue; predicting the task queue according to a first prediction model to obtain a first score; selecting a task execution queue by maximizing the first score; and obtaining a production control strategy according to the task execution queue, and performing production control on the humanoid robot. Completing evaluation according to historical tasks, and performing primary matching on the stations and the subtasks; the task queue is scored through the first prediction model, the task queue is subjected to secondary screening through the first score, it is ensured that each humanoid robot is in the execution condition of a single subtask, the execution conditions of all humanoid robots in the queue are in the optimal state, and task distribution and execution are planned as a whole.

title: Human-shaped upper limb system and remote operation control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid upper limb system and a teleoperation control method. The humanoid upper limb system comprises at least four-degree-of-freedom machine bodies, two humanoid mechanical arms with at least seven degrees of freedom and two dexterous hands with at least twenty degrees of freedom. A high-degree-of-freedom humanoid upper limb system driven by a unified modular motor is constructed, and a double-arm and double-hand cooperative remote operation control method based on any monocular camera is provided, so that the system structurally realizes high-precision and high-consistency 58-degree-of-freedom configuration, and the action coverage range, flexibility and system reliability are remarkably improved; on the control level, through a mapping strategy combining three-dimensional key point estimation, coordinate alignment, model scaling compensation, forward kinematics and optimization solution and filtering smoothing and self-collision prevention planning, high-precision, continuous, smooth and safe whole-upper-limb action redirection can be achieved through remote operation control without special equipment.

title: Humanoid robot testing method and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot testing method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, the method is applied to a cloud platform, and the method comprises the following steps: receiving historical operation related parameters uploaded by a plurality of robot terminals; calculating according to the historical operation related parameters uploaded by the plurality of robot terminals to obtain a plurality of scene working conditions and working condition information corresponding to each scene working condition, and constructing a scene working condition database; receiving test request information of a test platform; and determining output data based on the test request information and the scene working condition database, and sending the output data to a test platform to test the to-be-tested robot. According to the method, the scene working condition database is constructed based on the robot interconnection data, the test scene working condition can be automatically designed, and the test related data can be output to test the robot, so that the test effectiveness of the humanoid robot is improved.

title: Humanoid robot foot plate side-hung hinge type structural design
abstract: The invention discloses a foot plate side-hung hinge type structural design of a humanoid robot. The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of flexibility and degree of freedom of toe parts of foot plate joints of the humanoid robot and stability and high precision of foot plates of the humanoid robot. The key points of the technical scheme for solving the problem are as follows: the method comprises the steps of material cutting and welding: a plate, a side-hung hinge and a spring component; a foot plate, a foot plate central axis, a foot plate cutting line, a toe part and a sole part; spring parts are symmetrically welded on the front side and the back side of the foot plate. According to the main purposes, symmetric welding is a special technical characteristic and a unique technical scheme, and all the technical schemes have the key points that the symmetric welding is used for generating and having powerful road holding force necessary for the'motion control technology 'of the humanoid robot and the affinity, friction force, bond stress and multi-force combination of the road holding force and the ground, the implementation of the'operation control' technology is guaranteed, and the purpose of the humanoid robot is achieved. title: Training method of humanoid robot task planning model and task planning method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot task planning model training method and a task planning method, and the method comprises the steps: inputting first multi-modal training data into a first neural network for model training, and obtaining a trained first neural network; inputting the second multi-modal training data into a trained first neural network to obtain a first prediction task action; performing parameter optimization on the trained first neural network according to task trajectory data corresponding to the first prediction task action to obtain a second neural network; and inputting the task trajectory data and the third multi-modal training data into a second neural network for model training to obtain a trained humanoid robot task planning model. According to the training method, a humanoid robot task planning model can be provided, the model can well adapt to dynamic changes of task scenes, and the scene adaptability and the work generalization ability of the humanoid robot can be improved. The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots.

title: Dual-motor rope drive structure of humanoid robot dexterous hand and control method
abstract: The dual-motor rope-driven structure comprises a palm seat, a plurality of steering engines, first joint connecting seats, a rope-driven disc mounting seat, second joint connecting seats and finger parts, the steering engines are mounted on the palm seat, each steering engine is connected with one first joint connecting seat, and the rope-driven disc mounting seat is connected with the corresponding second joint connecting seat. The first joint connecting seat is rotationally connected with a rope driving disc mounting seat, the rope driving disc mounting seat is connected with a second joint connecting seat, the second joint connecting seat is rotationally connected with the other rope driving disc mounting seat, and the other rope driving disc mounting seat is connected with a finger part; the steering engine is used for driving the two adjacent first joint connecting seats to move close to or away from each other, the rope driving disc mounting seats are used for being driven by externally-loaded motors to rotate, the externally-loaded motors comprise a motor A and a motor B, rope driving discs are arranged on the two sides of the rope driving disc mounting seats, and the motor A and the motor B are connected with the rope driving discs on one side through tendon ropes and independently drive the rope driving discs to rotate. The problem that a conventional humanoid robot dexterous hand is insufficient in control precision is solved.

title: Thoracic cavity outer skeleton hollowing sleeve shell structure of simulated humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a thoracic cavity outer skeleton hollowing sleeve shell structure of a humanoid simulation robot, which comprises a thoracic cavity-shaped shell (1) matched with the contour of the thoracic cavity of a human body and a net-shaped shell (2) sleeved in the thoracic cavity-shaped shell (1), and the thoracic cavity-shaped shell (1) and the net-shaped shell (2) jointly form a support main body; wherein the chest-shaped shell (1) is provided with a bionic curved surface matched with the contour of the chest of a human body, and the shell wall thickness of the chest-shaped shell (1) is differentially arranged; the net-shaped shell (2) is used for achieving structural weight reduction and strength optimization and comprises a plurality of grid units (21), and the grid shape and the distribution density of the grid units (21) change along with the outline of the chest-shaped shell (1). The appearance simulation degree of the bionic robot is met, the strength requirement of the thoracic cavity exoskeleton is met, and meanwhile the overall weight of the thoracic cavity exoskeleton is greatly reduced.

title: Humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization method and system based on task potential field
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot task space hierarchical optimization method and system based on a task potential field, and relates to the field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an end effector instruction inputted by a user, the end effector instruction comprising a reference Cartesian pose of an end effector of a robot arm under a world coordinate system; constructing a plurality of optimization tasks based on the potential field change rate according to the current state of the robot and the end effector instruction; layering the constructed optimization tasks according to a preset priority, and constructing a quadratic programming problem together with the joint position and speed constraint of the robot; the quadratic programming problem is solved, and the optimal joint position variable quantity is output; based on the joint position variable quantity and the current joint position, a joint position instruction of the next control period is generated and sent to a robot joint to achieve position control; according to the method, the operation range of the humanoid robot is expanded, and the optimal kinematics planning of the maximum operation range of the robot in the static state is achieved.

title: Bionic neck structure of simulated humanoid robot and implementation method of bionic neck structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a hollow bionic neck structure of a simulation humanoid robot and an implementation method thereof.The structure comprises a bionic neck assembly, and the bionic neck assembly is formed by sequentially connecting a plurality of vertebra bionic units in series through flexible connecting pieces; wherein the vertebra bionic unit imitates a human cervical vertebra structure, and the interior of the vertebra bionic unit is of a hollow structure; the outer side of the bionic neck assembly is sleeved with an epidermis bionic layer which is used for providing temperature and pressure touch feedback. A human cervical vertebra is simulated through the segmented vertebra bionic units and the flexible connecting pieces, multi-degree-of-freedom flexible movement is achieved, the rigidity feeling of driving of a traditional robot is overcome, the vertebra bionic units are integrally formed through light-weight materials, the internal hollow structural design is adopted, and the purpose of light-weight design of the bionic neck is achieved; and meanwhile, through temperature feedback and pressure feedback of the bionic neck, the naturalness and the sense of security of man-machine interaction are greatly improved.

title: Multi-sensor fusion identification method for wheel-foot humanoid robot in industrial scene
abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-foot humanoid robot multi-sensor fusion identification method in an industrial scene, particularly relates to the technical field of robots, and realizes time alignment of sensor units by constructing a multi-modal sensing system and establishing a synchronous triggering mechanism. Multi-source data is unified to a basic coordinate system by adopting multi-element external parameter calibration and real-time motion compensation, then data-level, feature-level and decision-level fusion is carried out based on a hierarchical fusion architecture, the fusion weight is dynamically adjusted according to the moving state of the robot and scene features, and finally a navigation path plan, an operation instruction and safety early warning are output in real time. The problems of data time delay and coordinate system deviation are solved through a high-precision time synchronization and motion compensation mechanism, the recognition precision and stability in a complex scene are improved by using a hierarchical fusion and weight adaptive strategy, and challenges such as illumination variation, dust interference and machine body shaking are effectively overcome. And the efficient sensing and intelligent decision-making capability of the wheel-foot humanoid robot in a dynamic industrial task is ensured.

title: Lightweight humanoid robot
abstract: The lightweight humanoid robot comprises a thigh assembly, a shank assembly, a foot assembly, a knee joint pitching motor and an ankle joint pitching motor, the knee joint pitching motor is installed on the thigh assembly and used for driving the shank assembly to rotate relative to the thigh assembly, and the ankle joint pitching motor is installed on the shank assembly and used for driving the shank assembly to rotate relative to the thigh assembly. The foot assembly is used for driving the foot assembly to rotate relative to the shank assembly. According to the robot, the arrangement positions of the knee joint pitching motor and the ankle joint pitching motor are moved upwards, so that the rotational inertia of the knee joint and the ankle joint can be reduced; the torque required by a hip joint pitching motor for driving a robot thigh assembly to rotate, a knee joint pitching motor for driving a robot shank assembly to rotate and an ankle joint pitching motor for driving a robot foot assembly to rotate is reduced; therefore, the size and the mass of the hip joint pitching motor, the knee joint pitching motor and the ankle joint pitching motor are reduced, the overall mass and the cost of the robot are reduced, and the light weight of the robot is achieved.

title: Biped robot leg structure
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure of a biped robot, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and solves the problem that the mass distribution of a series connection structure is too close to the tail end of a leg in the leg design on the basis of realizing two-degree-of-freedom rotation, namely left-right movement along an X axis and front-back movement along a Y axis. The movement of a human hip joint can be better simulated; the driver of the thigh part firstly drives the middleware, and then the middleware drives the driven part to move, so that relative sliding of the thighbone and the tibia and bending movement of the knee joint are simulated under the assistance of the middleware; the telescopic driving part of the shank part drives the universal joint to rotate at any angle in the telescopic process, meanwhile, the movable plate can conduct front-back pitching, left-right swinging and plane rotation, three-degree-of-freedom movement is achieved, the parallel structure is adopted, and better distribution of force and torque can be achieved.

title: TORQUE SENSOR, ACTUATOR, AND HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: This torque sensor comprises a photosensor and a light reception amount variable member. One of the photosensor and the light reception amount variable member is directly or indirectly attached to a shaft at a first position, and the other is directly or indirectly attached to the shaft at a second position set apart from the first position in the axial direction. The light reception amount variable member extends in a direction intersecting the axial direction and is related to the photosensor. This actuator comprises a torque sensor and a rotating body. This humanoid robot comprises an actuator, a first element, and a second element rotatably connected to the first element via the actuator.

title: Magnetoelectric encoder circuit with protection function
abstract: The utility model discloses a magnetoelectric encoder circuit with a protection function, which comprises a power supply and protection module, a signal acquisition and encoding module and a signal conditioning and protection module, and is characterized in that the power supply and protection module is electrically connected with an external direct-current power supply and is used for performing input protection and voltage reduction processing on voltage from the external direct-current power supply; the signal acquisition and coding module is electrically connected with an external permanent magnet, acquires a magnetic field signal of the permanent magnet, codes the magnetic field signal to acquire a coded electric signal, and transmits the coded electric signal to the signal conditioning and protecting module to supply power to the signal conditioning and protecting module; and the encoded electric signal is transmitted to the signal conditioning and protecting module, and the signal conditioning and protecting module carries out differential processing and anti-static processing on the encoded electric signal in sequence. According to the utility model, the technical problem that the existing encoder is too large in size and is difficult to be applied to humanoid robot application scenes can be solved.

title: Humanoid collaborative robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of collaborative robots, and discloses a humanoid collaborative robot which comprises a robot body, and the left side and the right side of the robot body are fixedly connected with connecting rods. According to the human-like collaborative robot, when the robot grabs, connecting arms on the two sides of a robot body rotate and lift up at the top of a connecting column to drive movable arms below the connecting arms, rotating pieces A and arm lifting hydraulic rods which can rotate and lift up are installed in the movable arms, the arms are close to the robot according to the position of an external object needing to be grabbed, and then the robot can grab the external object. title: Positioning abnormity capturing method for intelligent humanoid robot with body
abstract: The invention discloses a method for capturing positioning abnormity of an intelligent humanoid robot with a body. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring visual information of a scene around the robot; the obtained visual information is input into a pre-trained model, a plurality of features in the scene are extracted, a scene semantic map is constructed according to the extracted feature information, and the scene semantic map comprises each feature and the pose of the feature in the map; acquiring a current positioning pose of the robot, and determining a target feature theoretically recognized by the robot at the current position from the scene semantic map; whether the features which are not recognized at the current positioning posture of the robot exist or not is judged, and the features which are not recognized at the moment under the current positioning posture of the robot exist or not; if yes, determining that positioning is abnormal and executing a positioning correction process; and if not, determining that the positioning is normal. The robot can quickly and accurately capture and position abnormity, and can cope with complex and changeable scenes with high dynamic performance.

title: Anti-electromagnetic interference design method for wheel-foot humanoid robot in industrial scene
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-electromagnetic interference design method for a wheel-foot humanoid robot in an industrial scene, and particularly relates to the technical field of robots, comprising: S1, constructing a dynamic following electromagnetic shielding structure; s2, establishing a hybrid drive isomeric map filtering system; s3, implementing cross-level electromagnetic compatibility collaborative design; and S4, whole machine cable wiring and grounding system optimization are carried out, layered bundling and directional wiring strategies are adopted, a hybrid grounding model is applied, a low-frequency circuit is in single-point grounding, a high-frequency circuit is in multi-point grounding, and subsystems are connected to a central grounding point through a low-impedance grounding bus. The electromagnetic leakage is avoided, the overall electromagnetic compatibility of the system is enhanced, and the common-mode interference and the ground loop influence are reduced, so that the control precision and the operation stability are ensured.

title: Humanoid robot automatic shoe changing machine
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of service robot operation and maintenance and intelligent equipment, and discloses a humanoid robot automatic shoe changing machine which comprises a hollow shoe changing seat and a rotating disc bracket, the top of the rotating disc bracket is rotationally connected with a shoe rotation assembly, and a mounting driving part is arranged in the hollow shoe changing seat; a supporting frame is fixedly installed at the center of the top of the rotary disc bracket, a lifting telescopic frame is slidably connected to the left side of the supporting frame in the vertical direction, a transverse pushing piece is arranged on the left side of the lifting telescopic frame, and a longitudinal pushing piece is arranged between the top of the transverse pushing piece and the supporting frame. The output end of a second air cylinder extends, a second rotating roller moves leftwards, meanwhile, a U-shaped bracket moves downwards, a push block is inserted into an embedding groove, and the push block pushes a shoe plate to move into a first containing groove; then the cross-shaped boss is driven to rotate through the installation driving piece, so that the multiple L-shaped buckles are gathered together, and the shoe plate is stably connected to the feet of the humanoid robot; therefore, the purpose of automatically changing shoes by the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on gait planning and reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on gait planning and reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot motion control. According to the method, the problems of low convergence speed in a training process and poor stability and reliability of a trained model of an existing reinforcement learning method are solved. According to the method, a reinforcement learning model runs in parallel under multiple environment instances, in the running process, a target foothold is generated in real time based on feedback state information, the generated reference foothold and a mass center track serve as an action reference or reward target of a controller, and a continuous and dynamically-adjusted foot end track is constructed in combination with gait phase information. And after the reinforcement learning model is trained by utilizing all the collected trajectory data, motion control can be performed on the humanoid robot through the trained reinforcement learning model, so that the robot realizes stable walking similar to human beings under the condition of not depending on a predefined template. The method can be applied to motion control of the humanoid robot.

title: Crus structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The shank structure of the humanoid robot comprises a knee joint module, an ankle joint module and a rack, all the modules are sequentially connected according to the position sequence of human joints and have three degrees of freedom, each joint is driven by a direct-current motor, and mechanical limiting is arranged to guarantee safety. The rack is presented in the form of a thigh shell of a humanoid robot; the knee joint module comprises a first knee joint connecting rod, a second knee joint connecting rod, a gear set and a direct current motor; the ankle joint module comprises a shank connecting rod, an ankle joint left transmission connecting rod, an ankle joint right transmission connecting rod, a first left motor connecting rod, a second left motor connecting rod, a first right motor connecting rod, a second right motor connecting rod, an ankle joint universal joint, a gear set and two direct current motors.

title: Thermal-mechanical coupling optimization method for shank structure of hydraulic robot
abstract: The invention provides a thermal coupling optimization method for a shank structure of a hydraulic robot, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic robots and topological optimizing.The thermal coupling optimization method comprises the steps that a node-based thermal coupling topological optimization algorithm is adopted, a complex structure is discretized through an unstructured tetrahedral mesh, and the discretized complex structure is obtained; and a Helmholtz filtering technology and a Heaviside projection technology are introduced, so that the fairness and manufacturability of an optimization result are ensured. And with the purpose of minimizing the flexibility of the structure, intelligent material distribution of the robot shank structure is achieved under the constraint of the material volume. And the hydraulic humanoid robot with the hydraulic flow channel integrated in the structure is constructed according to the optimization result. The quality of the shank structure of the hydraulic humanoid robot is reduced, and the heat dissipation efficiency is remarkably improved. The traditional defect that light weight and heat dissipation design are carried out independently is effectively overcome, performance collaborative optimization is achieved, and the dynamic response and continuous working capacity of the robot is improved.

title: Method and device for controlling flexible gait motion planning of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a control method and device for flexible gait motion planning of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: in a gait motion period of a target humanoid robot, aiming at each leg part of the target humanoid robot, carrying out the gait motion planning of the target humanoid robot; acquiring preset initial state data and expected state data corresponding to a support phase period of the leg part in the gait motion period; based on the initial state data and the expected state data, respectively determining an amplitude coefficient corresponding to the leg part in the gait motion period and sole landing position data corresponding to the leg part in the support phase period; and based on the amplitude coefficient, determining a foot sole ground contact force value corresponding to each moment of the leg part in the gait motion period, and based on the foot sole landing position data and the foot sole ground contact force value, controlling the target humanoid robot to perform smooth gait motion in the gait motion period. Through the method, the coordination, the stability and the efficiency of the flexible motion planning of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Intelligent manipulator for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent manipulator for a humanoid robot, and aims to provide the intelligent manipulator for the humanoid robot, which is favorable for improving the operation safety, and comprises a mechanical arm, a floating connecting seat is arranged at the tail end of the mechanical arm, the floating connecting seat comprises a fixed disc and a floating disc, and the fixed disc is parallel to the floating disc; one side of the fixed disc is detachably and fixedly connected with the tail end of the mechanical arm, one side of the floating disc is in floating connection with the other corresponding side of the fixed disc to form a gap, the other corresponding side of the fixed disc is detachably connected with a circuit board, and a plurality of Hall chips evenly distributed in the circumferential direction of the circuit board are integrated on the circuit board. A plurality of magnets corresponding to the Hall chips in a one-to-one mode are fixed to one side of the floating disc, and the other side of the floating disc is a tool installation face. The device has the beneficial effect that the purpose of improving the operation safety is achieved.

title: Rigid-flexible coupling pneumatic humanoid dexterous finger and dexterous hand
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field related to medical robots, and discloses a rigid-flexible coupling pneumatic humanoid dexterous finger and a dexterous hand. The dexterous finger comprises a sectional corrugated pipe actuator, a rigid cover plate, a rigid bottom plate, a flexible finger pulp patch and a one-way stretchable fabric; a cooperative structure of rigid supporting, flexible driving and contact adaptation is formed through a preset assembly relation; by designing the wave number of the corrugated pipe at each joint of the pneumatic dexterous finger, the bending proportion of each joint is ensured to accord with the human hand movement rule; the one-way stretchable fabric can restrain ineffective upheaval at the joints, and the energy conversion efficiency is improved. The dexterous hand can integrate five anthropomorphic-size dexterous fingers, and the palm notch angle, the thumb turning direction angle and the flexible palm patch are all engraved with the physiological characteristics and structure of the hand of the human body. According to the pneumatic dexterous hand, personification of the pneumatic dexterous hand in appearance and movement modes is achieved, flexibility and bearing stability are both considered, and the pneumatic dexterous hand can meet the requirements of multiple scenes such as medical care and industrial assembly.

title: Humanoid robot body intelligent cooperative control system based on multi-mode perception fusion
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot cooperative control, in particular to a humanoid robot body intelligent cooperative control system based on multi-modal sensing fusion, and the system comprises a multi-modal sensing fusion module which recognizes a target boundary position, analyzes a pressure change, and combines with a posture to extract audio features to generate an environment sensing graph; the dynamic time sequence adjustment module optimizes an action rhythm adjustment detail generation execution plan, the cross-modal behavior correction module corrects an offset optimization track generation coordination sequence, the task priority distribution module analyzes task distribution to generate an execution list, and the time sequence conflict correction module optimizes a path adjustment conflict generation coordination path. According to the method, an environment perception graph is constructed through matching and fusion of multi-source perception data, the action sequence and interval are dynamically adjusted to optimize an execution chain, trajectory offset is corrected to improve action precision, nearest response and load balancing are achieved through real-time task allocation, conflict blocking is reduced through path rearrangement and time sequence coordination, and a perception decision execution closed loop is formed; and the identification precision and the cooperation efficiency are improved.

title: Shank ankle transmission mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a shank and ankle transmission mechanism and a humanoid robot, the shank and ankle transmission mechanism comprises a leg mounting part, a sole and a transmission assembly, a first fixing shaft is arranged at the bottom end of the leg mounting part, and two driving parts are mounted on the leg mounting part; the sole is provided with a first connecting part and a second connecting part, two first ball shafts are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the first connecting part, and the second connecting part is rotationally connected with the first fixing shaft through a bidirectional connecting piece; the transmission assembly comprises two rotating pieces and two connecting rods, the rotating pieces are provided with second ball shafts, and the two ends of the connecting rods are movably connected with the first ball shafts and the second ball shafts correspondingly. The included angle between the two connecting rods is limited between 10 degrees and 80 degrees when the foot sole is at the lifting limit position, it is guaranteed that the connecting rods can provide an excellent force arm for the driving piece at the position, the driving piece can output torque at the highest efficiency, the transmission efficiency is improved, and explosive power is guaranteed.

title: Brain intention recognition method based on sparse-dense double-branch attention adaptive fusion and brain-humanoid robot interaction system
abstract: The invention provides a brain intention recognition method based on sparse-dense double-branch attention adaptive fusion and a brain-humanoid robot interaction system. The method is tested and verified by adopting a motor imagery public data set BCI IV 2a: firstly, the public data set is preprocessed, and a corresponding training set and a corresponding test set are established; secondly, constructing a sparse-dense double-branch attention adaptive fusion brain intention recognition model; then carrying out model training, and carrying out performance test of the method; and finally, a brain-humanoid robot interaction system is established, and validity verification of the method is carried out. The method has the advantages that a sparse self-attention branch is designed, and redundant noise and interference information of input data are inhibited; a dense self-attention branch is constructed, so that the fine-grained feature extraction capability of the model is enhanced; a double-branch attention adaptive fusion mechanism is established, and dynamic weighting of a sparse-dense mode is realized; a brain-humanoid robot interaction system is built, and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

title: Multi-perception intelligent humanoid five-finger dexterous hand
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control and intelligent algorithms, in particular to a multi-sensing intelligent humanoid five-finger dexterous hand which comprises a multi-mode sensing module, a path generation module, a control module and a response optimization module. The multi-modal sensing module collects object features, generates a fine three-dimensional contour and matches a database to obtain multi-modal data; a path generation module carries out discrete contour screening on candidate contact points, an optimal contact point is solved by embedding sequential quadratic programming, and an initial grabbing path curve is generated in combination with differential geometric path planning; the control module adjusts the joint angle based on a finger motion model and a Newton-Rafson method, and outputs the optimal control torque in cooperation with a reinforcement learning and force-position hybrid control algorithm; and the response optimization module iteratively outputs time compensation of each link through a chaos grey wolf optimization algorithm and optimizes response time. According to the method, the grabbing stability, precision and real-time performance are improved, and the method is suitable for industrial precision assembly or man-machine cooperation or other scenes.

title: Full-dimensional defect detection method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a full-dimensional defect detection method and related equipment for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the posture data of the robot, and carrying out the whole-body joint cooperative control of the humanoid robot according to the posture data of the robot, so as to obtain the thermal imaging data, image data and three-dimensional point cloud data of target equipment; performing abnormal region identification on the thermal imaging data to obtain a middle defect region; performing feature extraction on the image data and the three-dimensional point cloud data according to the middle defect area to obtain image features of the image data and point cloud features of the three-dimensional point cloud data; according to the image features, performing single-dimensional feature fusion on the point cloud features to obtain a single-dimensional fusion result; and according to the robot attitude data, performing full-dimensional updating on the single-dimensional fusion result to obtain a full-dimensional defect detection result of the target equipment. According to the method, the accuracy and robustness of defect detection on the industrial equipment can be improved. The invention relates to the technical field of defect detection.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom humanoid wrist joint and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom humanoid wrist joint and a robot, and aims to solve the problems of large overall circumferential mounting space, poor accuracy and flexibility and the like in a traditional structure. The humanoid wrist joint comprises a motor assembly, a connecting assembly and a palm assembly. The motor assembly is connected with the palm assembly through the connecting assembly and comprises a first motor, a second motor and a third motor, the first motor drives the palm assembly to move on a first axis, the second motor drives the palm assembly to move on a second axis, and the third motor drives the palm assembly to move on a third axis. The first axis, the second axis and the third axis intersect at one point. Through the combination of the first motor, the second motor and the third motor, the palm assembly can move on three axes, meanwhile, the three axes intersect at one point, the coordination and accuracy of movement are guaranteed, the flexibility and accuracy of the human wrist joint simulation are remarkably improved, natural movement of the human wrist can be better simulated, and the requirements of complex tasks are met.

title: Body-equipped robot control method and device, model training method and device and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device for a robot with a body, a model training method and device and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The control method comprises the steps that an instruction text, robot pose information and an environment image collected by the robot are obtained, the environment images comprise a first environment two-dimensional image and a first environment depth image collected by a left arm of the robot, a second environment two-dimensional image and a second environment depth image collected by a right arm of the robot, and a third environment two-dimensional image and a third environment depth image collected by a head of the robot; and processing the instruction text, the robot pose information and the environment image based on the action prediction model to obtain the action of the robot at the next moment so as to control the robot to move based on the action of the robot at the next moment. According to the method, the environment perception capability of the action prediction model is enhanced, and the generalization performance and the action execution stability in a few-sample scene are improved.

title: Collision management method, device and equipment for biped humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a collision management method, device and equipment for a biped humanoid robot and a medium, and the method manages collision risks by processing time sequence visual data including continuous multi-frame images and corresponding depth information. Specifically, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, identifying two-dimensional key points of a robot from image data and tracking the two-dimensional key points in a cross-frame manner, and then converting the key points into a time-sequenced three-dimensional coordinate sequence under a world coordinate system by combining depth information; based on the analysis of the three-dimensional coordinate sequence, the current risk level of the robot is judged, and a corresponding protection strategy is generated according to the current risk level. Through time sequence visual analysis, effective management of the collision risk of the biped humanoid robot is realized, and the judgment accuracy is improved.

title: Bidirectional positive and negative elastic connecting structure of bionic neck and bionic neck formed by bidirectional positive and negative elastic connecting structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a bidirectional positive and negative elastic connecting structure of a bionic neck, which comprises a positive spiral elastic unit and a negative spiral elastic unit, the centers of the positive spiral elastic unit and the negative spiral elastic unit are coaxially arranged, and the positive spiral elastic unit and the negative spiral elastic unit are partially overlapped and staggered in the axial direction; the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit are both in a big-end-down horn shape, the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit are opposite in spiral and identical in screw pitch, the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit are made of different materials, and an interactive linkage assembly is arranged between the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit. The forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit are arranged around the bionic cervical vertebra of the humanoid robot. The two-way elastic connecting structure is not an independent passive element, but forms a cooperative system with a neck driving motor, the motor provides active and accurate driving force, and the two-way positive and negative elastic connecting structure is responsible for managing kinetic energy and potential energy conversion in the movement process.

title: Humanoid robot wrist joint precision motor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot wrist joint precision motor which comprises a stator and a rotor, the rotor comprises a hollow shaft, magnetic steel adheres to the outer wall of the hollow shaft, the stator comprises a stator iron core arranged on the outer wall of the magnetic steel, a stator coil is arranged in the stator iron core, a leading-out wire is connected to the stator coil, and the leading-out wire is connected to the rotor. The stator core adopts a skewed slot lamination mode, the stator core adopts a silicon steel sheet with higher saturation flux density, and the silicon steel sheet is made of a low-loss silicon steel sheet material; according to the invention, the difficulty of the wire embedding process is reduced to a certain extent, the copper loss and iron loss of the motor are reduced, the heating of the motor is reduced, and the overall efficiency of the motor is improved; the motor power is correspondingly improved under the same volume, and high power density is realized; through the design of the skewed slots of the stator core, the cogging torque is inhibited to a great extent, the torque pulsation is reduced, and the motor is more stable in operation.

title: Humanoid robot sitting control method and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot sitting control method and a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot sitting control method is used for enabling the humanoid robot to realize flexible and safe autonomous sitting with basic fault-tolerant capability. The method comprises the steps that when it is detected that the humanoid robot is in a standing posture and meets a sitting-down trigger condition, a sitting-down control program is called, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute a sitting-down action sequence, the humanoid robot is made to be transited to a sitting-down supporting posture from the standing posture, and the sitting-down action sequence comprises multiple stages of sitting-down actions; in the sitting action of each stage, the mass center of the humanoid robot and a plurality of end effectors are controlled by the corresponding sitting control subprogram to move according to respective preset sitting reference tracks; after it is detected that the humanoid robot reaches the sitting-down supporting posture, the humanoid robot is controlled to be adjusted to a preset stable sitting posture from the sitting-down supporting posture, and the preset stable sitting posture comprises the steps that at least one contact point is established between a sitting posture supporting part and the ground, and end actuators of the first lower limb and the second lower limb make contact with the ground.

title: Bidirectional positive and negative spiral elastic assembly between waist and pelvic cavity of humanoid robot and waist and pelvic cavity structure
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a bidirectional positive and negative spiral elastic assembly between a waist and a pelvic cavity of a simulated humanoid robot, the bidirectional positive and negative spiral elastic assembly comprises a positive spiral elastic unit and a negative spiral elastic unit, the spiral directions of the positive spiral elastic unit and the negative spiral elastic unit are opposite, and the spiral parameters of the positive spiral elastic unit and the negative spiral elastic unit are the same; an interactive linkage assembly is arranged between the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit; the forward spiral elastic unit and the reverse spiral elastic unit are symmetrically arranged around the connecting center of the hollow bionic lumbar vertebra and the hollow bionic pelvic cavity of the humanoid simulation robot. title: Light control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a light control method and system for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the steps that S1, the humanoid robot is started, hardware self-inspection is conducted on the environment detection module, and meanwhile initialization setting is conducted on the execution module; s2, the environment detection module collects sensing data in a high-frequency parallel mode and transmits the sensing data to the central processing module (2) in real time; s3, processing the sensing data by the central processing module (2), executing judgment logic according to a preset priority sequence, and generating a control signal; and S4, the central processing module (2) drives the execution module based on the control signal, the execution module executes actions according to scene differentiation, and the execution module comprises a flexible OLED screen, a DLP projection lamp, a plurality of illuminating lamps and a plurality of atmosphere lamp strips. According to the invention, light can be individually adjusted according to different scenes and user requirements, and the performance of the robot in various application scenes is greatly improved.

title: Pin shaft output type cycloid speed reducer joint module under large hollow structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot joint modules, in particular to a hinge pin output type cycloid reducer joint module under a large hollow structure, which comprises an inner rotor motor, an electric control assembly and an output assembly are arranged at two ends of the inner rotor motor, and a hollow fixed shaft extends from the electric control assembly to the output assembly; wherein the rotor is connected with a rotating shaft in a matched mode, the rotating shaft is sleeved with an eccentric shaft sleeve and connected with a fourth bearing and a fifth bearing, a first cycloid disc is arranged outside the fourth bearing in a matched mode, a second cycloid disc is arranged outside the fifth bearing, and the first cycloid disc and the second cycloid disc are coaxially arranged and connected and matched through a lock pin; the lock pin further drives the output flange to rotate. According to the joint module, the structural components in the mounting cavity are improved, the number of the components is reduced, meanwhile, the adjacent components are matched more compactly, the structure of the joint module is integrally simplified, the size of the joint module is reduced, the machining and manufacturing process of the joint module can be simplified, and the overall stability and reliability of the joint module are guaranteed.

title: Power inspection device and method based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an electric power inspection device and method based on a humanoid robot. The device comprises the humanoid robot and a terminal upper computer, wherein the humanoid robot comprises an upper limb module, a lower limb module, a head module and a control module; the upper limb module is provided with a partial discharge sensor, a vibration sensor, a distance measuring sensor and a pressure sensor; the head module at least comprises a binocular camera, a laser radar and a near field communication module; and the control module is configured to obtain data of each sensor and transmit the data to the terminal upper computer in a communication manner, and is configured to receive a control signal from the terminal upper computer and control each module to execute inspection in an optimal path according to the control signal. According to the invention, the humanoid robot is utilized to realize the mobile self-adaptive inspection and prediction inspection capability of the power equipment, and a high-cost fixed monitoring system is replaced.
