title: Electrical communication interface of end execution module of humanoid robot and connection method of electrical communication interface
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot electrical connection, in particular to an electrical communication interface of an end execution module of a humanoid robot and a connection method of the electrical communication interface. The wrist deflection mechanism is arranged on the connecting pipe, and a supporting pipe is connected to the wrist deflection mechanism; the positioning and inserting mechanism is arranged on the supporting pipe, a mechanical palm is connected to the positioning and inserting mechanism, an energy storage rotating mechanism is arranged on the positioning and inserting mechanism, and when the mechanical arm is connected with the mechanical palm, the positioning and inserting mechanism can be controlled to be inserted into the supporting pipe, and the energy storage rotating mechanism is driven to store energy. And after the positioning and inserting mechanism finishes inserting, the energy storage rotating mechanism can release stored energy, and the positioning and inserting mechanism performs multidirectional locking action on the mechanical palm, so that the stability of connection between the mechanical palm and the mechanical arm is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device, computer and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot control method and device, computer equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out consistency calibration on main control equipment and the humanoid robot; under the condition that consistency calibration is completed, a motion instruction of an operator is collected through a sensor on the main control equipment, and the motion instruction is sent to the humanoid robot; under the condition that the humanoid robot executes the motion instruction, tail end stress data collected by a sensor of the humanoid robot is received; superposing the tail end stress data and initial stress data of the main control equipment under the working coordinate system to obtain resultant external force; and torque feedback is performed on an operator based on the resultant external force. By adopting the method, accurate control of the humanoid robot can be realized.

title: Joint assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a joint assembly and a humanoid robot. The joint assembly comprises a rotary actuator, a first structural part, a second structural part, a stop part and a moving part. The rotary actuator comprises a fixed end and a rotary end; the first structural member and the second structural member are respectively connected with the fixed end and the rotating end of the rotating actuator; when the rotating end drives the second structural part to rotate by a circle relative to the first structural part, the stopping part can act on the moving part to move to a set position relative to the first structural part, and the maximum rotating angle of the second structural part relative to the first structural part is larger than 360 degrees. According to the joint assembly, the rotation range exceeding 360 degrees can be achieved, and the movement flexibility of the joint assembly is improved.

title: Emotional interaction decision-making method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an emotional interaction decision-making method and system for a humanoid robot. The emotional interaction decision-making method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal data, acquired by a multi-modal acquisition system, of a user interacting with the humanoid robot; preprocessing the collected multi-modal data to obtain a multi-modal emotion data set; constructing an improved multi-modal fusion network model, and training the improved multi-modal fusion network model by using the multi-modal emotion data set to obtain an emotion-behavior mapping decision model; performing sentiment analysis on the real-time input of the user through the sentiment-behavior mapping decision model, and generating a robot interaction behavior instruction or a service response strategy matched with the sentiment state of the user; the method has the following beneficial effects that the multi-modal emotion of the user can be accurately recognized, and the humanoid robot can be driven to make physical behavior feedback with temperature and emotional quotients in real time, so that the naturalness, affinity and emotion connection experience of man-machine interaction are remarkably improved.

title: Industrial production method and production system based on humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial production method and system based on a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of machine control. The method comprises the steps that a production task and a plurality of subtasks of the production task are obtained; matching a corresponding humanoid robot for at least one subtask; the navigation path of the corresponding station of the subtask is issued to the humanoid robot; controlling the humanoid robot to enter a corresponding station according to the navigation path; the execution strategies of the subtasks are issued to the humanoid robot; after entering a corresponding station, starting a production line; and executing the subtask according to the execution strategy. The humanoid robot is controlled to enter a corresponding station to execute a corresponding subtask so as to complete a production task; the humanoid robot is controlled to enter a station through the navigation path, and the humanoid robot is controlled to execute subtasks through an execution strategy; the humanoid robot can be reused among different production tasks, manual work is replaced for production operation, the reuse rate of the robot is increased, and the design difficulty of a production line is reduced.

title: Operation method of operation robot of humanoid structure and operation robot
abstract: The invention discloses an operation robot of a humanoid structure and a dynamic operation method of the operation robot. The robot comprises a central controller, a rotating part capable of rotating by 360 degrees and at least two wheel arms driven by the rotating part, and the wheel arms carry a plurality of operation modules. The core of the method is that a central controller obtains space pose parameters and type identifiers of all operation modules in real time, and predefined operation direction, cooperation distance and module operation reference distance parameters are combined; real-time data is matched with an expected operation combination template, and an operation module combination set meeting the process requirement is dynamically recognized; optimizing a candidate operation plane and a transmission plane, and finally synthesizing a task space layout diagram marked with a plurality of operation units; the central controller intelligently distributes the operation module or the wheel arm to a specific unit according to the layout, generates a self-adaptive operation instruction sequence to control the robot to execute assembly line operation, and can monitor the efficiency in real time and perform closed-loop adjustment in the process. According to the system, autonomous sensing, intelligent planning and cooperative control of multi-module resources of the robot in a dynamic environment are realized.

title: Visual getting-up control method for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot visual getting-up control method and a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot visual getting-up control method is used for improving the stability and success rate of getting-up actions in a real scene. The method comprises the steps that if a humanoid robot getting-up trigger instruction is received, a humanoid robot getting-up control program is called; according to the humanoid robot getting-up control program, the mass center of the humanoid robot and the preset getting-up reference tracks of the multiple end executors are obtained; the sensing information, recognized by the humanoid robot, of the surrounding environment is called; judging whether the surrounding terrain meets a preset supporting condition or not according to the sensing information of the surrounding environment; and when the ground shape does not meet the preset supporting condition, the mass center of the humanoid robot and the adjusted rising reference tracks of the multiple end executors are obtained according to the sensing information of the surrounding environment, the mass center and the preset rising reference tracks of the multiple end executors, and the humanoid robot is controlled to be transited to the two-foot standing posture from the preset posture.

title: Double-leg active and load passive humanoid robot dynamics control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a two-leg active and load passive humanoid robot dynamics control method and system, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining model structure parameters of a humanoid robot through a sensing module; constructing a double-leg active dynamics model and a load passive dynamics model according to the model structure parameters; the expected output torque of each joint of the humanoid robot is solved based on the double-leg active dynamics model and the load passive dynamics model; generating control instructions of the output torque, the speed and the position of the corresponding joint according to each expected output torque; and controlling the humanoid robot by using the control instruction. According to the method, the double-leg active dynamics model and the load passive dynamics model are constructed, dynamic factors brought by the load can be actively fused into the dynamics models, the influence of the load on a dynamics system is counteracted in the control law design, the humanoid robot can be controlled more accurately and flexibly, and the reliability of the humanoid robot is improved. Therefore, the robustness is improved and the energy consumption is reduced.

title: Five-degree-of-freedom active all-drive humanoid mechanical thumb, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a five-degree-of-freedom active all-wheel-driven humanoid mechanical thumb, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robotic.The humanoid mechanical thumb comprises a polygonal bone base, a metacarpal bone unit, a phalanx unit, four first telescopic units and a second telescopic unit, and the metacarpal bone unit is hinged to the polygonal bone base; the phalanx unit comprises a first rod piece, a second rod piece, a third rod piece and a fourth rod piece; the first rod piece is hinged to the metacarpal bone unit; one end of the first telescopic unit is hinged to the multi-corner bone base, the other end of the first telescopic unit is hinged to the first rod piece, and the first telescopic unit is used for driving the first rod piece to rotate; one end of the second telescopic unit is hinged to the metacarpal bone unit; the other end of the second telescopic unit is hinged to the second rod piece, and the second telescopic unit is used for driving the second rod piece to rotate. The mechanical thumb designed by the invention has the comprehensive advantages of five degrees of freedom, high flexibility, high loading capacity, high precision and compact integration of a human-like thumb.

title: Biped robot reinforcement learning control method and system based on historical action sequence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robot reinforcement, and discloses a historical action sequence-based biped robot reinforcement learning control method and system. The biped robot reinforcement learning control method is applied to reinforcement learning control equipment and specifically comprises the following steps that S101, a floating base frame is adopted to load a biped robot URDF model in an Isaac Gym simulation platform, ten active joint freedom degrees are configured, and a control interface is constructed to output a 10-dimensional motor position command vector; the motion robustness and adaptability of the biped robot in a dynamic environment are remarkably improved by constructing a Transform time sequence modeling architecture fusing a historical state-action sequence, and the historical observation and action sequence is combined with sine-cosine position coding to be input into a multi-layer Transform encoder, so that the motion robustness and adaptability of the biped robot in the dynamic environment are improved. The self-attention mechanism is used for capturing the long time sequence dependence relation of foot-ground contact force change, topographic relief and the like, and the problem of gait instability caused by limited local observation in a traditional method is solved.
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of biped robot reinforcement, and discloses a historical action sequence-based biped robot reinforcement learning control method and system. The biped robot reinforcement learning control method is applied to reinforcement learning control equipment and specifically comprises the following steps that S101, a floating base frame is adopted to load a biped robot URDF model in an Isaac Gym simulation platform, ten active joint freedom degrees are configured, and a control interface is constructed to output a 10-dimensional motor position command vector; the motion robustness and adaptability of the biped robot in a dynamic environment are remarkably improved by constructing a Transform time sequence modeling architecture fusing a historical state-action sequence, and the historical observation and action sequence is combined with sine-cosine position coding to be input into a multi-layer Transform encoder, so that the motion robustness and adaptability of the biped robot in the dynamic environment are improved. The self-attention mechanism is used for capturing the long time sequence dependence relation of foot-ground contact force change, topographic relief and the like, and the problem of gait instability caused by limited local observation in a traditional method is solved.

title: Locking structure of motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of coreless motors, in particular to a locking structure of a motor for a humanoid robot, which comprises a rotating shaft and a locking assembly, the locking assembly comprises a sliding part, an electromagnet and a brake disc combination, the sliding part comprises an end-arranged part and an armature part, the armature part is located on one side of the rotating shaft, and the electromagnet is arranged at one end, close to a first shell, of the armature part. The brake disc assembly comprises a first end disc, a first side disc and a second side disc, the first side disc and the second side disc are located on one side of the rotating shaft, and the first end disc is located at the end of the rotating shaft. And along with further movement of the armature part, the second side disc is in contact with the side wall of the rotating shaft, the first end disc is in contact with the end face of the rotating shaft, and the rotating shaft is braked by resultant force, so that the advantages of staged and regional braking and more uniform braking heat distribution are realized.

title: Biped robot high-dynamic action control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot high-dynamic action control method based on reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: setting reference trajectories of a leg joint pitch angle and a shoulder joint pitch angle of a simulation robot for two processes of running and jumping, and setting a pose reference trajectory of the simulation robot and a reference sequential logic of foot contact; according to the biped robot high-dynamic action control method based on reinforcement learning, simple actions such as running and jumping do not need to depend on complex demonstration data or a fine action template, and by designing a reference track of a pitch angle of each joint and setting a pose reference track of a simulation robot and a reference sequential logic of foot contact, the high-dynamic action control of the biped robot can be realized. Through reinforcement learning, expected values of all degrees of freedom of each joint are learned, control over all degrees of freedom of each joint is achieved, then motion control over the robot is achieved, the learning process can be guided only through simple and visual motion priori, the exploration space of reinforcement learning is reduced, and the learning complexity is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot heat dissipation flexible shell structure
abstract: The invention discloses a radiating flexible shell structure of a humanoid robot, which belongs to the technical field of robot manipulators, and comprises a joint frame, a thermoplastic elastic shell, a support strip and a dynamic self-adjusting assembly, the dynamic self-adjusting assembly comprises a heat dissipation shell, a linkage block, an elastic sleeve strip, a steel rope, a plurality of arc-shaped adjusting plates, a sleeve hole column and a plurality of arc-shaped heat dissipation holes. Through the dynamic self-adjusting assembly, the mechanical arm has the advantages that according to the real-time bending angle of a joint and by means of a joint bending power source, self-adaptive large-area adjustment of gaps of heat dissipation holes is achieved, the heat dissipation efficiency is improved, and dynamic adjustment of the heat dissipation efficiency of the mechanical arm of the robot during execution of complex actions is achieved; therefore, the problems that according to the real-time bending angle of the manipulator joint, it is difficult to use a manipulator joint bending power source, it is difficult to conduct self-adaptive large-area adjustment on gaps of the heat dissipation holes of the flexible shell, and the heat dissipation self-adaptive adjustability is poor are solved.

title: Humanoid robot motion control model training method and device based on imitation learning
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control model training method and device based on imitation learning, and relates to the technical field of sensors and robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an action data set containing a plurality of reference human action sequences, and pre-training a strategy network based on the action data set; on the basis of a pre-trained strategy network, introducing a low-rank adaptive parameter matrix for each linear transformation module in the strategy network, and combining the low-rank adaptive parameter matrix with an original weight matrix for subsequent action output generation; inputting the target action into the strategy network added with the low-rank adaptive parameter matrix, and calculating an attitude tracking reward through the deviation from the reference attitude; and based on the attitude tracking reward, updating the low-rank adaptation parameter matrix to complete strategy fine tuning of the target action. According to the method and the device, the model training cost can be reduced, the model training efficiency is improved on the basis, and meanwhile, the model can still keep stable action output without action tasks.

title: Large-mesopore EtherCAT type integrated ultrathin servo driver and double encoders
abstract: The invention relates to a large-mesopore EtherCAT type integrated ultrathin servo driver and double encoders, and the servo driver comprises an integrated stator module and a double-encoder rotor which comprises a motor end encoder stator and a joint output end encoder stator. The integrated stator module is integrated with a servo driver, a motor end encoder stator and a joint output end encoder stator, the servo driver takes a full-localization microprocessor MCU as a core, an EtherCAT slave station controller is integrated in the MCU, the integrated stator module realizes power supply and communication with the servo driver through in-board wiring, and the servo driver is connected with the motor end encoder stator and the joint output end encoder stator. An external connecting cable is omitted, and the double-encoder rotors are installed on the same side of the joint and located on the same plane. The problems that an existing robot joint is bloated in structure, insufficient in communication performance, poor in safety, difficult in wiring and the like are solved, and the humanoid robot joint module is particularly suitable for humanoid robot joint modules with high power density and high safety requirements.

title: Lock rod, lock catch assembly, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a lock rod, a lock catch assembly, a robot and a humanoid robot, the lock rod comprises a mounting rod and a locking rod, the mounting rod is sleeved with a first roller and can roll in a lock catch cavity, the locking rod is coaxially connected with the mounting rod, and a locking section on the locking rod locks or unlocks a locking target; the lock catch assembly comprises a lock catch body with a lock catch cavity, a lock catch sliding block embedded in the lock catch cavity, an elastic piece and a lock rod connected with the lock catch sliding block and moving along with the lock catch sliding block. The robot comprises a battery bin used for containing a drawer type battery, a lock catch assembly used for locking or unlocking the drawer type battery, and a first elastic assembly which is arranged at the bottom of the battery bin, abuts against the bottom face of the drawer type battery and is compressed. The power supply terminal fixing seat is allowed to move slightly; and the second elastic element is propped against the battery bin and the power supply terminal fixing seat. According to the drawer type battery, the defects generated when the drawer type battery is locked can be overcome, so that the battery bin is always kept to be propped against the lock catch assembly and the terminal and the port are tightly connected.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on time sequence track and impedance control
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method based on a time sequence track and impedance control. The method comprises the following steps: constructing X, Y and Z axis sine and cosine time sequence track baselines associated with a gait cycle; sensing the reaction force and speed of the foot end in real time, and deducing mechanical parameters; constructing an adaptive impedance coefficient Z (t) containing proportional, differential and integral gains, and dynamically adjusting the gains; correcting the track based on Z (t); and through electro-hydraulic servo execution and closed-loop feedback optimization, control input is generated, and stability is evaluated. A double-channel cooperative control framework with the self-adaptive impedance coefficient Z (t) as the core is constructed, the contradiction of insufficient track rigidity and environment adaptability in a traditional humanoid robot control method is solved, the limitation of traditional gain adjustment and track correction splitting is broken through, two adjustment channels can be driven at the same time, and the control precision is improved. The system response speed is adjusted and optimized through dynamic gain, environment impact is avoided through track real-time correction, and the dual control effect of flexible response and active adaptation is achieved.

title: Intelligent obstacle avoidance system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot navigation, in particular to an intelligent obstacle avoidance system and method for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current running path of the humanoid robot, acquiring obstacle data through multiple sensors, and marking danger levels for obstacles on the current running path; dividing a core obstacle, a correlation influence and a non-interference area according to the obstacle information, and generating a local obstacle avoidance sub-path; extracting local obstacle avoidance sub-path key points, and combining the local obstacle avoidance sub-path key points with the current operation path to generate a global update path; the system comprises a current path and obstacle sensing module, a regional path updating module and a multi-regional path merging and updating module. Through the above mode, according to the terrain constraint of the static obstacle and the dynamic obstacle, motion trajectory planning is carried out, and the high-precision obstacle avoidance requirement in a complex environment is met.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device, robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and device, a robot and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly generating an upper body operation instruction and a lower body motion instruction which meet task requirements and are high-level semantics through a pre-trained VLA model, thereby guaranteeing the continuity and consistency of the upper body and lower body motions of the humanoid robot; then control signals of all joints of the lower limbs of the humanoid robot are generated through a pre-trained reinforcement learning model, accurate lower limb joint control over the lower body of the humanoid robot is achieved, and it is ensured that the posture of the humanoid robot is balanced and the action is stable in the instruction execution process; the technical problems that in the prior art, motion and operation of a humanoid robot are separated, the motion is discontinuous, and control is unstable are solved.

title: Balance control algorithm for gravity center trajectory planning and real-time tracking of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a balance control algorithm for gravity center trajectory planning and real-time tracking of a humanoid robot, in particular to the technical field of robot control, and realizes dynamic balance control through a closed-loop process of state sensing, online gravity center trajectory re-planning, hierarchical control law calculation and joint torque output and execution. A layered dynamic modeling and control framework is constructed, a variable-height inverted pendulum model is combined with model prediction control, and a gravity center and zero moment point track feasible in dynamics is generated online; virtual restoring force is generated through a gravity center impedance controller, a task priority inverse dynamics solver is used, multi-task execution is coordinated on the premise that balance tasks are guaranteed to be absolutely preferential through a null-space projection technology, theoretical torque is converted into current instructions to drive joints to move, and through efficient collaboration and real-time updating of dynamic models of all levels, the balance tasks are optimized. According to the invention, deep collaboration of various technical features is realized, and the problems of poor adaptability, slow response and poor balance capability of a traditional method in a dynamic environment are effectively solved.

title: Humanoid robot getting-up control method and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot rising control method and a humanoid robot. The humanoid robot rising control method is used for enabling the humanoid robot to achieve rapid and stable autonomous rising with basic fault-tolerant ability. The method comprises the steps that if a getting-up trigger instruction of the humanoid robot is received, a posture adjustment control instruction is called, the humanoid robot is controlled to be adjusted to a preset posture, and the preset posture comprises that the crotch makes contact with the ground, an end executor of a first lower limb and/or an end executor of a second lower limb makes contact with the ground, the first included angle is alpha, alpha is larger than 45 degrees and smaller than 180 degrees, and the second included angle is beta, beta is more than 45 degrees and less than 180 degrees; a getting-up control program is called, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute a getting-up action sequence, the humanoid robot is made to be transited to a two-foot standing posture from a preset posture, and the getting-up action sequence comprises multiple stages of getting-up actions; in the rising action of each stage, the mass center of the humanoid robot and a plurality of end effectors are controlled by the corresponding rising control subprogram to move according to respective preset rising reference tracks.

title: Humanoid robot body design method and device and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot body design method and device and a medium, and relates to the technical field of kinetic energy control, and the method comprises the steps: constructing an interactive dynamics digital twin of a humanoid robot; the method comprises the following steps: simulating an interactive dynamics digital twin in a virtual environment, and obtaining real-time relative space relation data through a distributed visual sensor network; in the process that the humanoid robot executes the self-adaptive motion trail, environment interaction is monitored through a distributed visual sensor network, and an actual kinetic energy loss value is collected; and inputting the energy consumption deviation value between the expected kinetic energy loss value and the actual kinetic energy loss value into the reinforcement learning model, and iteratively optimizing the prediction precision of the contact event type and the motion planning parameters of the online motion planner. According to the method, the expected kinetic energy loss value serves as a dynamic optimization target and is embedded into the online motion planner to generate the self-adaptive motion track, the motion planning process can be optimized in real time, and therefore it is ensured that task constraint and dynamic limitation are met while the kinetic energy loss is minimized.

title: Humanoid robot joint reducer running-in test system and method

title: Humanoid robot face bionic driving structure with high-degree-of-freedom expression control
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot face bionic driving structure with high-degree-of-freedom expression control, an eyebrow module and an eye module of the humanoid robot face bionic driving structure are both arranged on a fixing frame, a mouth module is arranged below the fixing frame, assembly is more convenient and faster, the space utilization rate is higher, and the maintenance cost is lower. A first movement device, a second movement device and a third movement device in the eye module are vertically and horizontally arranged in a staggered mode. The eyeballs are fixedly connected with the third movement device and can be controlled to rotate up and down and left and right. Eye corner connecting positions on one side of the lower eyelid and one side of the upper eyelid are rotationally connected to the supporting seat, and an eye corner on the other side of the lower eyelid is rotationally connected with an eye corner on the other side of the upper eyelid. The first movement device and the second movement device are matched to drive the upper eyelids and the lower eyelids to move up and down so as to open or close the eyes, so that the structural movement smoothness of the eyes is higher, and the movement of the eyes is more natural and vivid.

title: Waist omni-directional steering mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot waist all-dimensional steering mechanism which comprises a supporting plate, an upper cover plate, a corrugated pipe and a lower surrounding plate are arranged on the upper side of the supporting plate and fixedly connected in sequence from top to bottom, the lower surrounding plate is fixedly connected with the supporting plate, and the corrugated pipe is fixedly connected with the supporting plate. A third connecting block is fixedly connected to the center of the supporting plate, and a second connecting block and a first connecting block are sequentially and rotationally connected to the upper portion of the third connecting block. title: Precise lathe for machining reducer bearing of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of bearing machining, and provides a precision lathe for machining a reducer bearing of a humanoid robot, which comprises a machine tool and an adjusting structure, a dust collecting cavity is arranged inside the top end of the machine tool, a fixing structure is mounted on one side of the top end of the machine tool, and an adjusting structure is mounted on one side of the fixing structure. By arranging the adjusting structure, the cutter is moved to one side of the bearing according to the size of the bearing, so that the bearings with different sizes can be conveniently machined, the accuracy of the cutting depth is ensured, the cutter is driven to rotate through the mounting block, the feeding speed of the cutter reaches 40m/min, the repeated positioning precision reaches 0.003 mm, and the machining efficiency is improved. And therefore, the accuracy of the feeding speed is ensured, the mounting block drives the cutter to carry out precise forming on a complex curved surface of the bearing, and the lathe can machine high-precision sizes and shapes required by the reducer bearing of the humanoid robot.

And therefore, the accuracy of the feeding speed is ensured, the mounting block drives the cutter to carry out precise forming on a complex curved surface of the bearing, and the lathe can machine high-precision sizes and shapes required by the reducer bearing of the humanoid robot.

title: Mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. The mechanical arm comprises a shoulder assembly, a large arm assembly, a small arm assembly, a wrist assembly and a power supply wire harness which are sequentially in transmission connection. The shoulder assembly, the big arm assembly and the small arm assembly are all of a hollow structure. The shoulder assembly, the big arm assembly, the small arm assembly and the wrist assembly are each provided with a joint module, and the joint modules are used for driving corresponding joints to act. The power supply wire harness sequentially penetrates through the shoulder assembly, the large arm assembly and the small arm assembly and extends to the wrist assembly. The power supply wire harness is electrically connected with all the joint modules so as to supply power to the joint modules and/or control the joint modules. And the power supply wire harness is arranged in the mechanical arm, so that the problem that the power supply wire harness is exposed is avoided.

abstract: A head and neck assembly for a humanoid robot, including a head portion having an exterior surface defining an overall shape resembling a human head; a neck portion extending from the head portion; a head housing assembly enclosing the head portion and neck portion; an electronics assembly contained within the head housing assembly; and a head actuator assembly configured to move the head portion relative to a torso of the humanoid robot.

title: ROBOT WITH WHEELED SELF-BALANCING BASE
abstract: A mobile robot includes human-like physical proportions and a wheeled self-balancing base. The base may include an omni-directional mobile platform and an articulated (e.g., two-axis) lower joint to provide dynamic self-balancing capability while also maintaining a high level of stability during failures and when unpowered. The robot may furthermore include a length-adjustable pedestal that couples between the mobile base and an upper body. The upper body may include a pair of robot arms with swappable end effectors. The mobile robot may be employed for a wide variety of robot tasks such as lifting objects, carrying objects, pushing objects, pulling objects, or manipulating objects in settings such as warehouses or factories.

title: Legged Robot with Joint-Augmented Stability Control
abstract: A robot may include a torque generator to generate a torque, and a leg system including one or more legs movably coupled to and supporting the torque generator. Each leg of the one or more legs may include a first leg member, a second leg member, a first joint movably coupling the first leg member and the second leg member, and a first linear elasticity element coupled between the first leg member and the second leg member across the first joint. The first linear elasticity element may be disposed to provide a first force when the first linear elasticity element is actuated that, in combination with the torque, facilitates maintaining an upright position of the bipedal robot.

title: Humanoid robot control method and device and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot control method and device and a humanoid robot. Acquiring upper body operation posture data corresponding to an operator; the upper body operation attitude data comprises pitching data, roll data and yaw data; performing component processing on the upper body operation attitude data to generate upper body target attitude data corresponding to the humanoid robot; obtaining current upper body posture data corresponding to the humanoid robot; and controlling the humanoid robot based on the upper body target attitude data and the upper body current attitude data. A closed loop of collection-processing-feedback-control is formed, posture deviation is dynamically corrected, it is ensured that the robot accurately rewrites the intention of an operator, and meanwhile action stability and running stability are considered.

title: Trunk deflection structure and humanoid inspection robot
abstract: The invention provides a trunk deflection structure and a humanoid inspection robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the trunk deflection structure comprises a deflection driving assembly, a torsion transmission adjusting assembly, a safety locking assembly, a hip assembly and a trunk assembly; the torsion transmission gear transmits power through elastic clamping connection between the sliding column and the fixing sleeve, the clamping force of the torsion transmission gear is accurately and continuously adjusted by the adjusting screw through the compression amount of the passive inclined face on the compression spring, and therefore a variable overload protection threshold value can be set. The safety locking teeth are meshed with the outer fixing teeth on the fixing sleeve to achieve rigid posture locking, the locking action is achieved through linkage of the follow-up column, the spherical column and the steel wire pull rope, locking of the inner clamping teeth on the main rotating gear is automatically relieved, vice versa, and physical interlocking which is in a non-locking state and cannot adjust the torque transmission threshold value is formed. The overload protection device integrates the functions of adjustable overload protection, safe locking and misoperation prevention, is compact in structure, and is particularly suitable for multi-degree-of-freedom modular application of humanoid robot trunks and the like.

title: Head rotation control method and device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a head rotation control method and device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, the head rotation control method is used for controlling head rotation of a bionic humanoid robot, and the control method comprises the steps that a target head posture is obtained; the target head posture comprises a target pitching angle and/or a target deflection angle; obtaining a rotation strategy based on the motion model; the rotation strategy comprises a first rotation angle of rotation of the first flange plate and a second rotation angle of rotation of the second flange plate; and driving the first motor and the second motor to move according to the rotation strategy so as to realize head pitching and/or deflection to the target head posture. According to the head rotation control method provided by the embodiment of the invention, the head rotation process is agile, the process is similar to human head rotation, the humanoid effect is better, and the user experience is improved.

title: Hollow thoracic cavity bionic rib structure of simulated humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, and provides a hollow thoracic cavity bionic rib structure of a simulated humanoid robot, which comprises a bionic rib assembly, the bionic rib assembly comprises a plurality of bionic rib units distributed along the circumferential direction of the thoracic cavity, and the bionic rib units are constructed by imitating the shape of human ribs. A hollow cavity extending in the length direction of the hollow body is formed in the hollow body, and a plurality of axial reinforcing ribs are arranged on the inner wall of the hollow cavity; wherein the setting parameters of the hollow cavity and the axial reinforcing ribs are differentially set according to different positions of the bionic rib units in the thoracic cavity. The bionic rib assembly highly simulates a human body in appearance and movement mechanism, optimal balance of structural rigidity and light weight is achieved through design of parameters of the internal hollow cavity and the axial reinforcing ribs, and the overall weight of the bionic rib assembly is greatly reduced compared with a solid rib structure with the same supporting strength while the strength of the rib unit is guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot instep ball picking reinforcement learning control method based on DCM constraint optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot instep ball picking reinforcement learning control method based on DCM constraint optimization, and the method employs a PPO Lagrangian algorithm, and minimizes the cost generated after the robot picks a ball and falls while guaranteeing the maximization of the total reward, thereby reducing the falling times in the ball picking process of the robot. A motion divergence-external force disturbance-based instability model is designed, a foot falling anti-interference strategy based on DCM dynamic constraint and external force disturbance compensation is developed, and stable foot falling of the humanoid robot after the ball picking action is achieved; based on the principle of multi-rigid-body dynamics, a zero moment point is solved in real time by solving a balance equation of centroid acceleration inertia moment and gravity moment, a reinforcement learning reward function is designed in combination with support domain boundary constraint, the stability of single-foot support of the humanoid robot in a challenging task is enhanced, and finally stable control over the specified challenging position is achieved. Compared with other methods, the method has the advantage that the challenge accuracy can reach 95% or above.

title: Humanoid robot joint position precision detection device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motion precision detection, in particular to a humanoid robot joint position precision detection device which comprises a base, a mounting plate, two first arc-shaped blocks, two second arc-shaped blocks, a magnetic attraction block and the like, a control system of a humanoid robot is arranged in the base, the top of the base is connected with the mounting plate, and the first arc-shaped blocks and the second arc-shaped blocks are connected with the magnetic attraction block. The first arc-shaped block and the second arc-shaped block are both connected with magnetic attraction blocks, and the first arc-shaped block and the second arc-shaped block are connected through the magnetic attraction blocks. The rotating angle of the joint part of the humanoid robot can be detected through the angle sensor, data are displayed on the controller, electromagnetic interference signals can be generated through the electromagnetic interference device to interfere operation of the humanoid robot, and the joint part of the humanoid robot can bear loads by sleeving the connecting rod with the circular weight. The complex environment of the humanoid robot in actual work is simulated, and the accuracy of a detection result is improved.

title: Decoration detection method and system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of decoration detection, in particular to a decoration detection method and system based on a humanoid robot. Full-process autonomous detection of main detection items is realized, objectivity and precision of a detection result are improved, manual subjective judgment is avoided, and the result is traceable and verifiable.

title: Mechanical arm, upper limb structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a mechanical arm, an upper limb structure and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robotics.The mechanical arm comprises a shoulder component, an elbow joint component, a wrist component and a hand component, the shoulder component is provided with a shoulder yaw driving actuator, the elbow joint component is provided with a shoulder elbow connecting piece, and the shoulder elbow connecting piece is provided with a shoulder yaw driving actuator. The elbow joint fixing piece is provided with an elbow joint pitching driving actuator, the wrist component is provided with a wrist pitching fixing piece, and the hand component is connected with the wrist component. The humanoid robot is composed of four main parts, namely a head part, a body part, a left arm part and a right arm part, the four main parts form an upper limb structure of the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot can be used for carrying and assembling in industrial manufacturing, surgical operation in the medical field and rehabilitation assistance. The device has wide application in article grabbing and tool use in family service, and can provide scheduling flexibility and accurate operation capability.

title: Humanoid robot in-situ action control strategy network training method, device and equipment based on deep reinforcement learning, robot and medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot in-situ action control strategy network training method, device and equipment based on deep reinforcement learning, a robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. Comprising the steps that first input used for controlling the body height of the humanoid robot, second input used for controlling the linear speed, third input used for controlling the angular speed and fourth input used for indicating the type of a training task are constructed; setting the first input as a random value, setting the second input and the third input as zero, setting the fourth input as an in-situ task, and executing a first training task; setting the first input, the second input and the third input as fixed values, setting the fourth input as a walking task, and executing a second training task; and updating the in-situ action control strategy network according to the action strategies output in the first training task and the second training task and the corresponding reward function subitems. According to the invention, the problem of action output jitter caused by excessive dependence on inhibitory constraints during training is avoided.

title: Humanoid dexterous hand and humanoid robot adopting humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid dexterous hand and a humanoid robot adopting the humanoid dexterous hand. According to the humanoid dexterous hand, a finger driving mechanism comprises at least one finger driving motor layer, a plurality of finger driving motors are arranged in each finger driving motor layer, each finger driving motor is connected with a finger joint of a corresponding hand assembly through a traction rope, and the number of the finger driving motors in each finger driving motor layer is smaller than or equal to 4; the output shafts of all the finger driving motors are arranged outwards, and the projections of the output shafts in the plane perpendicular to the length direction of the arm assembly do not coincide. The invention further discloses a humanoid robot which adopts the humanoid dexterous hand of any scheme. The robot arm has the advantages that mutual friction, winding and even cutting caused by path crossing and contact of a plurality of traction ropes in a narrow space are avoided, and the overall shape of the robot arm is closer to the thickness of a real human arm.

title: Voice interaction method and system based on humanoid robot, and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a voice interaction method and system based on a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The voice interaction method comprises the following steps: acquiring and judging voice signals in a preset interaction interval, determining a target role position in combination with a preset wake-up keyword, and identifying a target interaction object; extracting voice features of the target interaction object and combining the voice features with an interaction object image to construct a target interaction map; according to the target interaction map, matching a corresponding voice interaction plate from a preset voice interaction template library; analyzing the voice content of the target interaction object, generating a compliance reply text, and outputting a corresponding interaction statement according to the voice interaction section; the interaction naturalness is improved through end-to-end multi-modal modeling, risk output is reduced in combination with a dynamic verification mechanism, dialect and special crowd adaptation is supported at the same time, the overall response delay time is shortened, and the compliance of reply content is improved.

title: Device for collecting twinborn data of actual application scene for teaching humanoid robot and training method
abstract: The invention discloses a device for demonstrating a humanoid robot by collecting twinborn data in an actual application scene and a training method, and the method comprises the steps: firstly demonstrating a person wearing equipment on site through an application task, and enabling a plurality of sensors to synchronously collect data through a synchronous clock trigger; generating an application environment perception and scene task understanding twin mapping data set through multi-modal fusion; processing the collected data, and constructing an application task twin mapping data set and an imitation learning model; the related data set and the model are imported into simulation software for simulation optimization and storage; and driving the humanoid robot to execute tasks in an actual scene, and optimizing the autonomous task planning and decision-making model of the humanoid robot through a reverse reinforcement learning algorithm. The method improves the data acquisition efficiency and accuracy, shortens the training preparation time, accelerates the training speed, enhances the scene adaptability of the robot, and reduces the training cost.

title: Humanoid robot gear motor capable of being quickly disassembled
abstract: The invention discloses a speed reducing motor capable of being quickly disassembled for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot motors. Comprising a motor assembly, a speed reduction cavity assembly is arranged at the top of the motor assembly, a speed reduction assembly is arranged in the speed reduction cavity assembly, the motor assembly comprises a driving motor, connecting parts are arranged at the two ends of the top of the driving motor, a spring bolt is slidably connected to the middle of the side face of each connecting part, and a pushing spring is fixedly installed in the middle of one side of each spring bolt; the speed reduction cavity assembly comprises a cavity shell, mounting parts are arranged at the two ends of the bottom of the cavity shell, limiting sliding grooves are formed in the middles of the mounting parts, locking blocks are slidably connected into the limiting sliding grooves, the locking blocks are arranged at the bottom of the spring bolt, unlocking sliding blocks are fixedly installed on one sides of the locking blocks, and reset springs are fixedly installed at one ends of the locking blocks. According to the invention, the speed reduction cavity assembly can be conveniently disassembled, the speed reduction assembly and the motor assembly can be conveniently disassembled, overhaul and maintenance can be conveniently carried out, and the practical value is high.

title: Bionic humanoid robot shoulder control structure and robot
abstract: According to the bionic humanoid robot shoulder control structure and the robot, the bionic humanoid robot shoulder control structure comprises a control part mounting platform and two shoulder motion control racks, the two shoulder motion control racks are rotationally mounted on the two sides of the control part mounting platform, and a rotating shaft is perpendicular to the control part mounting platform; the two shoulder motion control racks are symmetrically arranged at intervals, each shoulder motion control rack comprises a rotary body rack and a shoulder arm bearing support, the shoulder arm bearing supports are rotationally connected with the rotary body racks through a set of connecting rod supports, the shoulder arm bearing supports are vertically arranged, and a first driving device is installed on the control part installation platform; and a second driving device is connected to the rotary body rack and used for driving the shoulder arm bearing support to move up and down. The shoulder parts have the freedom of motion, so that actions such as shoulder shaking and chest expanding can be completed, and the motion control is simple and stable.

title: JOINT STRUCTURE AND HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: This joint structure comprises: a simulated lower leg; a simulated foot having a sole surface facing a ground surface or a floor surface in a standing position; and a simulated joint that connects the two in a manner allowing the simulated foot to move relative to the simulated lower leg. The simulated foot has a recessed portion that is recessed toward the sole surface from the side opposite to the sole surface, and at least part of the simulated joint is disposed inside the recessed portion. The humanoid robot comprises two joint structures.

title: Whole brain emulation system
abstract: Systems and methods to allow for generating a simulated humanoid. The simulated humanoid operates in a simulation space with simulated humanoid having a whole brain emulation module. The whole brain emulation module includes a virtual stimuli input module that is configured to receive or capture stimuli input data. The whole brain emulation module includes an encoder that is configured to translate the stimuli input data into a simulated functional neurodata frame. The whole brain emulation module also includes a brain state module that maintains a current brain state corresponding to a current functional neurodata frame of the simulated humanoid.

title: Data set generation method and device based on humanoid robot, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots and the technical field of navigation, and discloses a data set generation method and device based on a humanoid robot, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment semantic information from a three-dimensional scene rendering result, and obtaining a task type from a navigation task with a body; processing the environment semantic information and the task type through a task disassembling module to obtain trajectory data and text description, and forming an initial navigation sample by the trajectory data and the text description; inputting a plurality of different initial navigation samples into a quality evaluation interface to obtain an evaluation result returned by the quality evaluation interface, obtaining a quality evaluation score corresponding to each initial navigation sample from the evaluation result, selecting the initial navigation sample with the quality evaluation score higher than a preset score as a preferred navigation sample, and integrating the plurality of different optimal navigation samples to generate a data set of the humanoid robot. The method is beneficial for improving the generation efficiency of the data set of the humanoid robot.

title: Graphene heat dissipation coating with high electrical insulating property, preparation process and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motor heat dissipation structures, and discloses a graphene heat dissipation coating with high electrical insulation, a preparation process and a robot, and the graphene heat dissipation coating comprises a graphene composite coating which is prepared on the surface of a rotor, the surface of a stator and the end face of a winding and comprises an insulation matrix; the preparation process of the graphene heat dissipation coating with the high electrical insulation property comprises the steps of surface activation treatment, graphene composite dispersion liquid preparation, spraying and curing, so that the graphene heat dissipation coating with the high electrical insulation property has efficient heat conduction, heat dissipation and electrical appliance insulativity, the volume and the weight are hardly increased, and no volume punishment exists. According to the motor, the problems that in the prior art, a heat dissipation structure in a humanoid robot motor is complex, cost is high, and good insulativity cannot be achieved at the same time are solved.

title: Humanoid robot action control method and system based on navigation and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot action control method and system based on navigation and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The action control method comprises the following steps: acquiring and fusing point cloud data and a multi-view image of a space environment, and drawing an initial space map; positioning a target article according to the initial space map to obtain the initial position of the article, and generating a first moving path and a second moving path by combining the current robot position and the target position of the article; moving to the initial position of the article according to the first moving path, determining an article grabbing track according to the article image, and generating a grabbing moving instruction; controlling the robot to grab and transfer the target object according to a second moving path according to the grabbing and moving instruction in combination with object point cloud measurement and object distance calculation; accurate movement is achieved through an autonomously drawn and recognized map, by means of the continuously optimized map, an instruction jointly confirmed by a vision scheme and a laser radar scheme is accurately completed, objects are accurately recognized and grabbed, and material transferring is achieved.

title: Thoracic cavity structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a thoracic cavity structure and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. title: Cooperative control method and device for robot and wheeled carrier and computer equipment
abstract: The invention relates to a cooperative control method and device for a robot and a wheeled carrier and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps that the current connection state of the robot and a wheel type carrier, the position information of the two feet of the robot, the carrier connection position information of the wheel type carrier and the current movement task of the robot are obtained, the robot is regulated and controlled to conduct position regulation and control processing, and a new connection state is obtained; a wheel type carrier control instruction corresponding to the current motion task is generated, and the wheel type carrier is controlled to execute the current motion task; and collecting a first connection feedback of the robot and a second connection feedback of the wheeled carrier, and generating a first emergency scheme of the robot and a second emergency scheme of the wheeled carrier based on the first connection feedback and the second connection feedback. By adopting the method, the cooperative effect between the humanoid robot and the wheeled carrier can be improved.

title: Upper body structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an upper body structure and a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The upper body structure comprises a trunk assembly and a head assembly, the neck assembly is connected between the trunk assembly and the head assembly, the neck assembly comprises a rotation driving piece, a pitching driving piece, a linear push rod and a swing driving piece, the rotation driving piece is connected between the trunk assembly and the pitching driving piece, and the rotation driving piece rotates around a first axis; the pitching driving part, the linear push rod, the swinging driving part and the head assembly are driven to rotate; the pitching driving piece is connected between the rotation driving piece and the linear push rod, and the pitching driving piece rotates around a second axis to drive the linear push rod, the swing driving piece and the head assembly to pitch; the linear push rod is connected between the pitching driving piece and the swing driving piece, the swing driving piece is connected to the head assembly, the swing driving piece rotates around the third axis to drive the head assembly to swing around the third axis, and the linear push rod pushes the swing driving piece to swing and adjusts the swing angle of the head assembly.

title: Humanoid robot joint module performance test method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint module performance test method, device and equipment, and relates to the technical field of robots, the humanoid robot joint module performance test method comprises the following steps: obtaining an identity label of a tested joint module, and loading a corresponding standard test procedure and a digital twin model from a cloud based on the identity label; controlling the test platform to execute an automatic test sequence based on a standard test procedure, synchronously acquiring multi-modal performance data of the tested joint module through multiple sensors, and recording corresponding timestamps; operating the lightweight AI model in real time through an edge computing unit, performing preliminary analysis on the multi-modal performance data, and adjusting a test strategy according to a preliminary analysis result; uploading the multi-modal performance data with the identity label and the timestamp to a cloud data lake, and performing deep analysis on the multi-modal performance data through an AI analysis engine of the cloud to generate a test report. According to the invention, intelligent testing is realized by constructing an end-edge-cloud collaborative intelligent testing system.

title: Neck joint structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a neck joint structure and a humanoid robot. The neck joint structure comprises a base; the first shaft is rotatably arranged on the base and limits a first axis; the cross shaft limits a second axis perpendicular to the first axis and a third axis parallel to the first axis, and the cross shaft is configured to be rotatably connected to the base around the second axis; the motion platform is connected to the cross shaft and is configured to rotate around a third axis; the at least two actuating mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the motion platform, each actuating mechanism comprises a first actuating part and a transmission part, one end of each transmission part is connected to the output end of the corresponding first actuating part, and the other end of each transmission part is connected to the first shaft; wherein the transmission part is configured to convert the rotary motion of the first actuating part into a push-pull effect on the first shaft in the direction perpendicular to the first axis.

title: High-performance aluminum alloy cable for humanoid robot based on PVC material modification
abstract: The invention relates to a PVC material-based modified and improved high-performance aluminum alloy cable for a humanoid robot, and the cable comprises a sheath which is internally provided with a fourth wrapping tape and an outer braiding layer from the outside to the inside in sequence. Three groups of outer cores which are distributed in an annular manner are respectively arranged in the wrapping tape IV; and an outer filling layer is arranged between every two adjacent groups of outer cores. An inner braid layer is arranged on the inner sides of the outer filling layer and the outer core; six inner winding core groups which are distributed in an annular manner are arranged in the inner braid layer; each inner winding core group is formed by twisting two inner cores; and an inner filling layer is arranged on the inner side of the inner winding core group. The high-performance aluminum alloy cable provided by the invention is relatively good in flexibility and relatively high in thermal stability and aging resistance. The cable can be effectively guided and transmitted, soaking type and high-pressure water spraying type water cooling is carried out after extrusion molding, the cooling efficiency is relatively high, and the cable can be conveniently and rapidly manufactured and molded.

title: High-simulation humanoid robot lip shape synchronous anthropomorphic control method and high-simulation humanoid robot lip shape synchronous anthropomorphic control system
abstract: The invention discloses a lip shape synchronous anthropomorphic control method and system for a high-simulation anthropomorphic robot. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a lip-shaped visual position mapping database of initial consonant phonemes and vowel phonemes; converting the pronunciation text into a pinyin sequence and identifying a pause symbol in the pinyin sequence; analyzing the pinyin into an initial consonant and vowel sequence, and extracting a corresponding lip action according to the mapping database; performing block processing on the action sequence according to the voice rhythm, and distributing the execution time of each action in combination with the audio duration; and a continuous lip shape control instruction sequence is generated by adopting a high-frequency interpolation mode, and is synchronously output in real time according to a time axis and audio playing. Through phoneme-level lip action driving, time fine distribution and continuous interpolation control, high consistency of voice content and lip actions in space and time dimensions is achieved, the anthropomorphic degree and the interaction reality sense of the humanoid robot in the language output process can be remarkably improved, and the user experience is improved. The lip-shaped driving system is suitable for various types of lip-shaped driving systems of humanoid robots.

title: Shank structure, leg device and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a shank structure, a leg device and a humanoid robot. The shank structure comprises a humanoid shank shell, a bearing support and a foot driving mechanism. The human-like shank shell has an external shape similar to a human shank, and a cavity is formed in the human-like shank shell; the bearing support is installed in the cavity in the height direction of the humanoid shank shell. The foot driving mechanism is used for driving the feet to act, and the foot driving mechanism is arranged in the cavity and installed on the bearing support. In this way, the humanoid effect is achieved through the humanoid shank shell, the main supporting effect is achieved through the bearing support, and the stability and attractiveness of the structure are both considered.

title: Equipment for grinding and polishing shaft type rotating body parts
abstract: The utility model discloses equipment for grinding and polishing shaft type rotating body parts, belongs to the precision machinery manufacturing technology, and solves the problems that the outer surfaces of the conventional shaft type rotating body parts with complex shapes cannot be precisely ground and polished, so that a planetary roller screw in a humanoid robot is large in torque and power consumption, low in precision and short in service life, and the like. The horn mouth is defined by the drainage component, the opening of the horn mouth faces the radial outer side, and the inner end of the horn mouth forms the inlet facing the part, so that the grinding agent flows according to the set direction of the inlet instead of flowing disorderly without directions, and therefore, the relative movement of the grinding agent and the surface of the part can be kept as required; the relative movement speed and flow between the part and the abrasive are increased, and the pressure impacted on the outer surface of the part is increased. The grinding agent is guided to flow through the inlet, effective impact of the grinding agent on the surface of the part is increased, grinding efficiency is improved, then the part rotates around the axis of the part, and uniform grinding precision of the surface of the part is guaranteed.

title: Body-equipped humanoid robot capable of automatically changing electricity and electricity changing method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot with a body capable of automatically changing power and a power changing method thereof, and the humanoid robot with the body comprises a chassis assembly which is used for realizing the walking and steering of the robot and comprises a chassis and a battery arranged on at least one side of the chassis; the stand column is fixedly arranged on the chassis assembly; the arm assembly is arranged on the stand column in an up-down sliding mode and comprises a plurality of joint assemblies which are movably connected; the hand assembly is rotationally arranged at the tail end of the arm assembly and comprises a palm assembly and five finger assemblies movably connected with the palm assembly; and the control unit is in signal connection with the battery, the chassis assembly, the arm assembly and the hand assembly and controls the actions thereof. According to the invention, the robot can realize self-automatic battery replacement without human intervention, the automation degree is improved, and the cost is reduced.

title: Curing degree regulation and control method and system of corona-resistant enameled copper flat wire for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of enameled wire curing process control, and discloses a curing degree regulation and control method and system of a corona-resistant enameled copper flat wire for a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: dynamically identifying a curing non-uniform region and a lag stage by acquiring multi-source data such as paint film thickness, furnace temperature field and solvent evaporation rate in real time. And in combination with the process knowledge base, generating a dynamic temperature compensation and time enhancement regulation and control scheme, and carrying out cooperative redistribution and execution on the heater power and the transmission rate according to the scheme. And synchronously collecting feedback data, comparing the feedback data with an expected track to generate a deviation map, iteratively correcting the regulation and control parameters according to the deviation map until deviation convergence, and outputting a stable process parameter packet. According to the method, online diagnosis and self-adaptive closed-loop optimization of the curing process are realized, uniformity and consistency of paint film curing are improved, and quality fluctuation and manual intervention are reduced.

title: Humanoid apple picking robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid apple picking robot which comprises a first humanoid picking mechanism, the first humanoid picking mechanism is installed on a power chassis through a first supporting stand column, and apple picking operation is conducted through two first end effectors on the first humanoid picking mechanism; the second humanoid picking mechanism is installed on the power chassis through a second supporting stand column, two second end executors are movably connected to the second humanoid picking mechanism, and apple picking operation is conducted through the two second end executors. The robot is composed of the two humanoid picking mechanisms, the advantages of a Cartesian mechanical arm and a joint mechanical arm are fused, a heterogeneous complementary cooperative structure is used for replacing a traditional picking mechanical arm with the single height adjustment function, the robot operation space is expanded, the upper-layer and lower-layer operation coverage range is achieved, and the picking efficiency is improved. The fruit picking device is suitable for automatic picking operation in different orchard environments, convenient to use and practical.

title: Cross-platform humanoid robot non-speech teaching behavior rapid generation system and method
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-platform humanoid robot non-speech teaching behavior rapid generation method and system, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the discretization modeling of non-speech teaching behaviors in a typical teaching scene, decomposing continuous motion parameters in a video image into discrete motion primitives, and constructing a motion dictionary based on the motion primitives; a language synthesizer is used for generating a voice sequence from teaching content texts, a Transform module is used for generating an action sequence from the voice sequence, and the action sequence is mapped into action joint parameters according to the action dictionary; mapping the motion joint parameters to motion parameter spaces supported by different platform robots to generate motion parameters supporting the cross-platform robots; and mapping the robot action parameters into robot kinematics parameters of a teaching scene based on reinforcement learning. According to the scheme, deep fusion between teaching semantics and robot anthropomorphic actions is realized, and non-language teaching behaviors which are accurate and controllable and can be quickly generated are realized.

title: Decoration construction system for autonomous planning and execution of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot autonomous planning and execution decoration construction system, which comprises a flexible sensing humanoid robot, an autonomous planning system, a closed-loop control execution system and a twin data interaction system, and is characterized in that the flexible sensing humanoid robot comprises a multi-modal sensing module, a flexible execution module and an efficient moving module; the autonomous planning system is used for generating a three-dimensional semantic map containing dynamic obstacle prediction, an intelligent process list and a self-adaptive path based on multi-modal sensing data, and the closed-loop control execution system is used for achieving force-vision-displacement multi-dimensional closed-loop control and ensuring construction precision and quality. The twinborn data interaction system is used for storing data and achieving construction visualization and remote interaction, the humanoid robot technology, artificial intelligence, digital twinborn, multi-mode perception and decoration are fused, the traditional construction mode of manpower-based and mechanical-assisted construction is broken through, and autonomy, precision and intelligence of decoration construction are achieved.

title: Method for controlling walking of PPO humanoid robot in complex terrain based on Gaussian mixture strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a PPO humanoid robot complex terrain walking control method based on a Gaussian mixture strategy. The PPO humanoid robot complex terrain walking control method comprises the steps that observation information of a humanoid robot under a complex terrain is collected through the humanoid robot and a simulation environment; inputting the observation information into a strategy neural network, wherein the strategy neural network adopts a multi-layer perceptron structure to output Gaussian mixture model parameters; on the basis of Gaussian mixture model parameters, Gaussian mixture action distribution is constructed, and actions of the humanoid robot are obtained through sampling; the actions are input into a control system or a simulation environment of the humanoid robot, and the control system drives all joints to move through a driving mechanism and obtains environment feedback; optimizing the strategy neural network by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm according to environment feedback; the problem that an existing humanoid robot walking control method is likely to converge to be a conservative gait which is not similar to humanoid gaits under the complex terrain is solved.
