title: Negative pressure cooling device, humanoid robot and aircraft
abstract: The invention relates to a negative pressure cooling device, a humanoid robot and an aircraft, the negative pressure cooling device comprises a cooling chamber, a liquid supply part, a spraying mechanism and a suction part, the cooling chamber is provided with a cooling cavity, the cooling cavity is used for installing a heating element, and the heating surface of the heating element is arranged in the cooling cavity; the liquid supply part can convey a liquid working medium into the cooling cavity through a liquid supply pipe; the spraying mechanism is arranged at the liquid outlet end of the liquid supply part, the liquid working medium can be sprayed to the corresponding heating surface through the spraying mechanism, and the liquid working medium can absorb heat on the heating surface and be gasified into a gaseous working medium; the suction part is installed at one end of the cooling chamber and communicates with the cooling cavity, and the suction part can suck the gaseous working medium in the cooling cavity. According to the negative pressure cooling device, the humanoid robot and the aircraft provided by the invention, the problems that synchronous heat dissipation is difficult to perform on a plurality of heating elements, the liquid level of the cooling liquid is easy to change, the cooling liquid cannot effectively immerse the heating surface of the motor, and then the motor is overheated and damaged are solved.

title: Multifunctional intelligent sensing system and method suitable for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional intelligent sensing system and method suitable for a humanoid robot, the system comprises a flexible sensing sleeve, a sectional sensor array, a control module and a mobile phone real-time display module, and the control module comprises a microprocessor control module and a safety control module; the shape of the flexible sensing sleeve is matched with an irregular curved surface of a multi-joint finger of a robot, the sectional sensor array comprises a pressure sensing unit, a strain sensing unit and a temperature sensing unit, the pressure sensing unit is arranged in a finger pulp area of the flexible sensing sleeve, and the strain sensing unit is arranged in a finger pulp area of the flexible sensing sleeve. The strain sensing unit is arranged in a knuckle bending area of the flexible sensing sleeve, and the temperature sensing unit is distributed on the internal contact surface of the flexible sensing sleeve; the microprocessor control module is connected with the sectional type sensor array, the safety control module is connected with the microprocessor control module, and the system and the method have the advantages of being high in adaptability, capable of conducting safety early warning and high in monitoring intuition.

title: Linear joint servo module, driving device and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a linear joint servo module, a driving device and a humanoid robot. A stator of a frameless torque motor is fixedly connected with a shell, the frameless torque motor is connected with a motor output shaft through a planetary roller screw rod, and the motor output shaft is provided with a monopole pair of magnets; the encoder plate is arranged opposite to the monopole pair of magnets, the encoder plate generates a position signal of the motor output shaft according to the magnetic field change generated by the rotation of the monopole pair of magnets, and the position signal is sent to the control panel. The control panel controls the servo driving board to generate corresponding current according to the position information and the motor control signal and outputs the current to the frameless torque motor so as to control the state of the frameless torque motor, and the shell is used for fixing the servo driving board, the control panel and the encoder board, so that the weight of the module can be reduced, and the motion performance can be improved; and the purposes of lightweight design and rapid dismounting, replacement and maintenance of the robot can be achieved.

title: Motor for leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a motor for a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, belongs to the field of humanoid robots, and solves the problems that a control unit does not have enough assembly space and the heat dissipation effect of the control unit is affected due to the fact that the motor is a disc type motor. A driving unit, a control unit and a transmission unit are arranged in the shell, the driving unit comprises a stator, a rotor and an output shaft, the shell is in a long strip shape, the transmission unit and the control unit are located at the two ends of the driving unit respectively, and the control unit is electrically connected with the driving unit and used for controlling the rotating speed and torque output by the driving unit. The transmission unit is in transmission connection with the output shaft and used for outputting torque to joints of the legs, the end of the output shaft is directly connected with the transmission unit, and the rotating axis of the output shaft is kept perpendicular to the rotating axis of the transmission unit. The heat dissipation device is mainly used for improving the heat dissipation effect of the control unit.

title: Mouth structure of bionic service type humanoid machine
abstract: The utility model discloses a bionic service type humanoid robot mouth structure which comprises a sensory system and a mouth system connected with the sensory system, and the mouth system comprises a jaw structure, a tooth structure, a lip structure and a tongue structure. title: Humanoid quadruped robot
abstract: A humanoid quadruped robot is composed of a robot head 1, a robot neck 2, a robot body 16, three robot arms, four robot legs, a waist joint piece 7, a thoracolumbar hip joint piece 22, a plurality of joint motors and auxiliary parts, and compared with an existing robot, the humanoid quadruped robot has the four differences that the robot head 1 is fixed to the robot neck 2, and a shell of the robot head 1 is made of a one-way light-transmitting material; one-way light transmission means that a visual device in the robot head 1 can see external scenes, external human eyes and the visual device cannot see internal parts, two positions are three robot arms, one robot arm is arranged at the chest position of the robot body 16, retracts when not used and stretches out when used, and three positions are that the robot body 16 rotates by 360 degrees at random at the waist joint position. Four machine legs with the same structure are arranged in four places, two machine legs fall to the ground and the other two machine legs are lifted up in the walking process, and the aim of walking is achieved through sequential circulation, so that walking balance and load bearing are facilitated.

title: Array type sensor wiring structure of device simulating human hand operation
abstract: The utility model provides an array type sensor wiring structure of a simulated hand operation device, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robotics.The simulated hand operation device comprises a simulated hand, a wiring structure and an acquisition device.The simulated hand comprises a simulated palm and a plurality of simulated fingers, each simulated finger comprises at least one knuckle, and the simulated palm is connected with the wiring structure; the wiring structure comprises measuring pieces and signal lines, the measuring pieces are laid on knuckles of the simulated palm and the simulated fingers, the signal lines are connected with the measuring pieces, each measuring piece comprises a sensitive point array with force sensing capacity and/or temperature sensing capacity, and the number of the collecting device is one. All the measuring sheets are connected to the acquisition device through the signal lines, and the acquisition device is used for transmitting information measured by the measuring sheets to an upper computer. The defects that in the prior art, an array type sensor of a simulated hand operation device is complex in wiring structure, long in bus and difficult to lay in a limited space in a simulated hand are overcome.

abstract: A humanoid robot includes an upper region includes a head and neck assembly having a neck portion and a head portion coupled to the neck portion. The electronics assembly includes various components and devices used in the operation of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot neck structure
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot necks. A humanoid robot neck structure comprises a head support. The body support is used for supporting the head support; the structure transmission part is connected with the head support and used for driving the head support to do yawing motion, the structure transmission part comprises a pitch axis assembly, and the pitch axis assembly is used for driving the head support to do pitching motion; one end of the first driving part and one end of the second driving part are connected with the body support, the other end of the first driving part and the other end of the second driving part are connected with the pitch axis assembly, and the first driving part and the second driving part are arranged in a mirror image mode; wherein the first driving part and the second driving part drive the pitching shaft to do pitching motion, and the three-degree-of-freedom motion of the head support is achieved by combining the yawing motion of the structure transmission part. And the shaking of the head is obviously inhibited in the dynamic movement process of the humanoid robot, and the accuracy and reliability of environmental perception are guaranteed.

title: Frequency domain measurement method and system for motion distribution of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a frequency domain measurement method and system for motion distribution of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent and robot control. The method comprises the steps that joint real-time motion data are collected and mapped to a normalized state space, and strategy density distribution is obtained; extracting a frequency domain feature vector by adopting a truncated Fourier basis function; constructing a template mean value and a covariance matrix based on the group samples; and the frequency domain deviation is calculated through the spectrum weighted mahalanobis distance. According to the method, time sequence dependence is eliminated through frequency domain conversion, the robustness is improved in combination with group statistical information and spectrum weighting, the structural difference of strategy distribution is accurately captured, and switching of multiple feature extraction and distance measurement modes is supported. The method solves the problems that an existing method depends on a time domain, is insufficient in structural sensitivity and is weak in anti-noise capability, is suitable for scenes such as motion strategy evaluation and mode diagnosis, and is high in engineering practicability.

title: High-selectivity gas-sensitive coating composition for electronic nose chip of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of coating compositions, and discloses a high-selectivity gas-sensitive coating composition for an electronic nose chip of a humanoid robot, and the high-selectivity gas-sensitive coating composition comprises: 40-60 parts of a film-forming matrix selected from polyvinylidene fluoride or a vinyl fluoride-vinyl ether alternating copolymer; 15 to 25 parts of a gas sensitive filler selected from a metal organic framework ZIF-8; 2 to 5 parts of a conductive agent selected from unmodified multi-walled carbon nanotubes; 1 to 3 parts of a compatibility regulator selected from the group consisting of perfluorooctyltriethoxysilane; the two-component solvent system is composed of a good solvent for dissolving the film-forming substrate and a non-solvent for dispersing the gas-sensitive filler but not dissolving the film-forming substrate, and the two-component solvent system is composed of a good solvent for dissolving the film-forming substrate and a non-solvent for dispersing the gas-sensitive filler, so that the conductive agent is directionally distributed at the phase interface of the gas-sensitive filler and the film-forming substrate by utilizing the volatilization rate difference between the good solvent and the non-solvent and the surface energy difference between components; a heterogeneous conductive network coated with a hydrophobic matrix is constructed, so that the mechanical strength of the coating is maintained, the exponential resistance response to trace gas is realized, and the interference of a high-humidity environment is eliminated.

title: Parallel ankle joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The parallel ankle joint of the humanoid robot comprises a shank structural part, a two-degree-of-freedom ankle part, an ankle base and a double-rocker mechanism, and the bottom of the shank structural part is sequentially hinged to the two-degree-of-freedom ankle part and the ankle base; the double-rocker mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the shank structural part, and the two double-rocker mechanisms are connected to the two sides of the shank structural part in parallel. Each double-rocker mechanism comprises a linear drive, a rocker and a ball bearing connecting rod; one end of the rocker is hinged to the shank structural part, the other end of the rocker is hinged to one end of the ball bearing connecting rod, and the other end of the ball bearing connecting rod is hinged to the two-degree-of-freedom ankle part; the fixed end of the linear driver is hinged to the shank structural part, and the output end of the linear driver is hinged to the middle of the rocker. The parallel ankle joint can solve the similar problems of high cost, high bit error rate, low response speed and the like of the existing ankle joint.

title: Humanoid robot reliability test method and system
abstract: The invention provides a reliability testing method and system for a humanoid robot, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot testing, and aims at solving the problems that an existing testing scene is single, one-sided in dimension, backward in judgment, low in efficiency and lack of life prediction. A high-coverage test case is generated by adopting an orthogonal test method, data is automatically collected through multi-sensor fusion, a failure mode is identified after processing, a performance degradation model is established, and finally reliability quantitative evaluation and residual life prediction of key parts and a whole machine are realized. By constructing a comprehensive test scene library and adopting an orthogonal test method, the comprehensiveness and the high efficiency of the test are realized; automatic data acquisition is realized through multi-sensor fusion, so that automation of testing is realized; and a basis is provided for preventive maintenance, and reliability improvement and large-scale commercial application of the humanoid robot are effectively supported.

title: Thumb movement mechanism of humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model provides a thumb movement mechanism of a humanoid dexterous hand. The thumb movement mechanism comprises a palm, a joint mechanism, a first hinge shaft and a second hinge shaft. One end of the palm is connected with four fingers, the joint mechanism is arranged in the palm, one side of the joint mechanism extends out of the palm, and the palm is connected with a thumb through the joint mechanism. A thumb linear driver is arranged in the palm and used for controlling the joint mechanism to drive the thumb to bend and swing laterally. The coupling connecting rod movement mechanism is adopted in the thumb to achieve bending of the thumb, the structure is simple, maintenance is convenient, the failure rate of the thumb movement mechanism in use is reduced, the layout of the thumb linear drivers is changed, the linear drivers used for driving the thumb to bend are all arranged on the palm, and therefore the flexibility of the thumb movement mechanism is improved. The size of the thumb near knuckles is reduced, and the flexibility of the dexterous hand is improved.

title: SENSOR DE FUERZA Y TORQUE DE MULTIEJES PARA USO EN ROBOTICA HUMANOIDE.
abstract: The successful implementation of a humanoid robot that walks requires complex and expensive hardware, which limits its accessibility for many applications outside the academic research. One of the main problems is the Force and Torque sensor used as feedback in the control algorithms necessary for the humanoid to maintain balance. At present there are no force and torque sensors of low cost for development in humanoid robots. For this reason, the present invention discloses the design, calibration and testing process of a novel multi-axis FT sensor using low-cost materials maintaining adequate accuracy for application in humanoid robots.

title: Humanoid robot collision detection method, system and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot collision detection method, system and device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a simplified dynamic model containing gravity and friction force; an error function used for compensating the inherent error of the model is obtained through experimental calibration; during operation, joint angles and currents are obtained in real time, an external-force-free expected torque is calculated through a model and an error function, and the external-force-free expected torque is compared with an actual torque to obtain external torque estimation; and when the external torque estimation exceeds a preset threshold value calibrated by the force application experiment, judging that collision occurs. According to the method, the collision detection precision and robustness based on the joint current are remarkably improved in a mode of'a theoretical model + experimental calibration error ', an additional force sensor or electronic skin is not needed, the cost and complexity are reduced, and the method has the capability of adapting to parameter change through recalibration.

title: Humanoid robot gait control method and system in ship swaying environment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot gait control method and system in a ship swaying environment. The method comprises the following steps: converting obtained ship swaying data and related data of robot motion from a geodetic coordinate system to a ship coordinate system, and establishing a gait cycle model of a robot under the ship coordinate system; the rotational angular velocity of the center of mass of the robot is adjusted through a PID controller, and yaw deviation of the robot caused by ship swaying is corrected in real time; a motion track of a robot mass center is calculated by using a mass center track solving method based on a ship inverted pendulum model S-LIPM, and a mass center position coordinate set for controlling the robot to walk is obtained according to the obtained motion track of the robot mass center. According to the method, ship motion data are systematically fused, a dynamic closed-loop control framework is established, the inapplicability of a traditional method in a ship environment is fundamentally overcome, and whole-process optimization from data perception to control execution is achieved.

title: Deceleration module for intelligent robot with body and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a speed reduction module for an intelligent robot with a body and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligence with the body, the speed reduction module for the intelligent robot with the body comprises a shell, a stator, a speed reduction wheel set and a rotor, the shell is internally provided with a driving cavity, a first air opening and a second air opening, and the first air opening and the second air opening communicate with the driving cavity; the stator is fixed in the driving cavity; the speed reduction wheel set is installed on the shell. The rotor is installed in the driving cavity and comprises a rotating ring and a connecting frame, the rotating ring is rotatably arranged on the periphery of the stator in a sleeving mode, the connecting frame comprises an inner disc and an outer ring, the inner disc is in transmission connection with the speed reduction wheel set, the outer ring is connected with the rotating ring, a plurality of air guide blades distributed at intervals in the circumferential direction are arranged between the inner disc and the outer ring, and the air guide blades are arranged opposite to the stator in the axial direction. According to the technical scheme, the heat dissipation capacity of the speed reduction module is improved.

abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. title: Distributed battery system and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a distributed battery system and a humanoid robot. The distributed battery system comprises a bus bar, the power supply system comprises a plurality of battery assemblies, the battery assemblies are connected in parallel and electrically connected with the bus bar, each battery assembly comprises one or more battery modules connected in series, and each battery module comprises a plurality of battery units connected in series. Each battery unit comprises a plurality of single battery cells which are connected in parallel. The power supply system is formed by the multiple battery assemblies, and the battery assemblies can be designed into different shapes to be dispersedly arranged on the trunk, the four limbs and other parts of the robot, so that the space utilization rate of the power supply system is increased, and the overall energy reserve is greatly increased; and the risk of paralysis of the whole robot system caused by the fault of a single battery assembly is reduced, so that the reliability and the stability of the whole system are remarkably improved.

title: Procedimiento multisensorial secuencial para estimulación cognitiva y regulación emocional
abstract: The present invention relates to a sequential multisensory method and an associated device for generating cognitive stimulation experiences by means of controlled thematic scenarios. The method comprises the orderly execution of various stages including: a natural immersion phase with reproduction of ambient sounds and visual projections; a haptic interaction phase by means of a humanoid robot capable of generating controlled pressure and thermal stimuli; a humorous audiovisual activation phase; a scenic learning phase based on theatrical representations; a self-reflection phase with backlit mirrors and synchronized messages; an environmental regulation phase by means of circadian lighting and programmable air conditioning; and a final psychological guided feedback phase with digital recording.

title: Motor with good heat dissipation performance for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hollow cup motors, in particular to a motor with good heat dissipation performance for a humanoid robot, which comprises a shell combination, a rotor assembly, a permanent magnet, a sealing part, a first fan blade and a thermal expansion part, and is characterized in that the shell combination is provided with an air hole; the rotor assembly comprises a rotating shaft, a coil panel and a coil cylinder, the rotating shaft is rotatably mounted on the shell assembly, and the coil cylinder is located outside the rotating shaft; the permanent magnet is located between the rotating shaft and the coil barrel, a first channel is formed in the outer side wall of the rotating shaft, a second channel is formed between the end of the permanent magnet and the coil panel, a third channel is formed in the outer side wall of the permanent magnet, and a fourth channel is formed in the outer side wall of the coil barrel and communicates with the air hole; the outlet end of the air inlet chamber is communicated with the first channel; according to the shell assembly, after the temperature rises, the thermal expansion piece expands to drive the sealing piece, and the advantage of active heat dissipation after the temperature in the shell assembly rises is achieved.

title: Sensor data acquisition method
abstract: The invention discloses a sensor data acquisition method, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. Aiming at the problems of difficult wiring, vulnerable wiring harnesses, poor data synchronism, transmission packet loss and the like in the existing multi-sensor wired connection, a wireless architecture of a main node and sub-nodes is adopted: the main node generates and issues a synchronizing signal to calibrate a sub-node clock, the sub-nodes collect sensor data and generate a double-serial-number identifier, and the double-serial-number identifier is wirelessly reported after being packaged; and the main node triggers retransmission through double serial number verification, and calls a corresponding protocol to analyze data according to the sensor type. The core algorithm ensures time synchronization and data reliability, and the modular design adapts to multiple types of sensors. The method thoroughly solves the wiring problem, improves the stability and adaptation flexibility of data acquisition, is easy to implement and maintain, and is suitable for a robot multi-sensor collaborative acquisition scene.

title: Clamping assembly for machining precision rotating part of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of numerical control machining lathes, and provides a clamping assembly for machining a precise rotating part of a humanoid robot, which comprises a working table, moving structures are fixed on two sides of the top end of the working table, adjusting structures are fixed on the top ends of the moving structures, and each adjusting structure comprises a base fixed on the top end of the corresponding moving structure. The middle position of the top end of the base is rotationally connected with a driving shaft, and the outer side wall of the driving shaft is in threaded connection with a connecting sleeve. By arranging the adjusting structure, the connecting sleeve can be driven by the servo motor to move on the outer side of the driving shaft under the action of threaded connection of the driving shaft and the connecting sleeve, the connecting sleeve can move to drive the clamp to move, and the transverse use position of the clamp can be adjusted conveniently; the clamping assembly has the function of conveniently adjusting the transverse use position of the clamp, and the convenience and flexibility of the clamping assembly for machining the precision rotating part of the humanoid robot during use are improved.

title: Crotch structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a humanoid robot crotch structure which comprises a crotch assembly and hip joint assemblies connected to the two sides of the crotch assembly, and the crotch assembly comprises a first shell and a first motor used for driving the hip joint assemblies to pitch front and back. The hip joint assembly comprises a second shell, a second motor used for driving lower limbs to rotate is connected into the second shell, a third motor used for driving the second motor to swing left and right is arranged on the second shell, and the biomechanical characteristics are simulated through the inclined axes. The lower limbs are closer to the natural gaits of the human body when pitching front and back, the pitching amplitude of the lower limbs is enlarged, meanwhile, the backward pedaling power generation efficiency is improved, and a higher kinetic energy conversion rate is provided for actions such as running and jumping.

title: Data transmission method and system of industrial humanoid inspection robot
abstract: The invention discloses a data transmission method and system for an industrial humanoid inspection robot. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring inspection data; performing data classification on the inspection data, determining the priority of each piece of sub-inspection data based on a data classification result, and establishing a transmission queue; when it is determined that the current inspection point in the inspection route is not the preset key inspection point, establishing a linear path between the current inspection point and the control platform; dividing the linear path based on an equidistant principle through a straight line perpendicular to the linear path, and determining equipment corresponding to the minimum distance of the corresponding section of the linear path in each divided area as a relay node; and a communication link is constructed according to the plurality of relay nodes, and the industrial humanoid inspection robot transmits the transmission queue to the control platform through the communication link. The routing inspection data are classified, the priority is determined, the transmission queue is established, the key routing inspection data are transmitted preferentially, the relay node is determined, and the stability and effective coverage range of data transmission are remarkably improved.

title: Compact type humanoid arm robot joint
abstract: The invention relates to a compact type robot joint of a humanoid arm. The compact type robot joint comprises a flexible touch sensor, a joint control cavity, a joint cavity, a joint mechanical transmission part and a joint rotating body. The length of the joint cavity is 116 +/-5 mm, the diameter of the joint cavity is 90 +/-5 mm, and the outer diameter of the whole joint is 85-95 mm and is close to the size of the upper limb of a human body; the joint mechanical transmission part is composed of two parallel transmission chains, each transmission chain comprises a motor and speed reducer module and is composed of an encoder, a direct-current frameless motor, a planetary speed reducer, a bearing and an outer frame, the motor and speed reducer modules are packaged into an overall module with the diameter smaller than 45 mm and the total axial height smaller than 110 mm, and the overall module is fixed in a joint cavity through bolts. The encoder, the direct-current frameless motor and the planetary reducer are sequentially connected together from top to bottom through the bearing, the outer frame packages the encoder, the direct-current frameless motor and the area where the bearing is located, and power is transmitted to the planetary reducer in the motor and reducer module.

title: Humanoid robot based on bionic joints and multi-modal perception
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot based on bionic joints and multi-modal perception, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. Dynamic self-adaptive and multi-target collaborative intelligent energy consumption management is realized through the energy consumption management module. A threshold analysis unit generates a dynamic dormancy threshold in real time by integrating energy, environment, tasks and a system four-dimensional state, so that an energy-saving strategy accurately adapts to variable working conditions; the energy consumption management unit executes intelligent sleep and wake-up scheduling based on the threshold value, and ineffective start-stop loss is avoided by introducing minimum effective time judgment; meanwhile, based on a weight self-optimization mechanism of strategy gradient reinforcement learning, the system can automatically balance multi-target requirements and continuously evolve according to comprehensive feedback of an energy-saving effect, task performance and equipment safety, finally, the cruising ability is remarkably improved on the premise that the motion performance and operation safety of the robot are ensured, and the system is suitable for popularization and application. And the optimization of personalized energy efficiency is improved.

title: Flat part sorting method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a flat part sorting method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of logistics. The method comprises the following steps: splitting a flat part sorting task to obtain a plurality of subtasks; the task state of each subtask is determined, when the task state represents to be executed, the humanoid robot is controlled to run to the task position of the subtask to be executed, and first visual observation data after the humanoid robot runs to the task position are obtained; and generating a sorting action sequence according to the first visual observation data and a task instruction corresponding to a to-be-executed sub-task, and controlling the humanoid robot according to the sorting action sequence. According to the embodiment of the invention, the flat part sorting efficiency can be improved.

title: Dynamic adjustment method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a dynamic adjustment method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of performing multi-modal fusion processing on input data to obtain interaction object features and self-action features corresponding to the humanoid robot; the interaction object features and the robot action features are input into a double-intention prediction neural network for processing, and first output data and second output data are obtained; and according to the first output data, the second output data and the real-time feedback data, motion control parameters and motion planning parameters of the humanoid robot are dynamically adjusted, and the humanoid robot is controlled to execute the adjusted motion according to the adjusted motion control parameters and the adjusted motion planning parameters. According to the embodiment of the invention, the harsh requirement of an industrial environment on accuracy and the core switch of a family environment on safety can be solved, and cross-scene universal adaptability and robustness are realized.

title: Industrial scene-oriented wheel-foot humanoid robot path planning and navigation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot navigation, and discloses an industrial scene-oriented wheel-foot humanoid robot path planning and navigation method, which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring environment information and self state information of a robot; s2, performing time sequence alignment and coordinate transformation on the acquired environment information and self state information; s3, recognizing a dynamic obstacle according to the time sequence to obtain a fusion environment map; s4, performing dynamic obstacle avoidance and path re-planning based on a local dynamic planning algorithm; s5, whether a wheel type mode or a foot type mode is started or not is judged according to the environmental information terrain flatness and the ground gradient parameters; and S6, feeding back according to errors and energy consumption in the navigation execution process. According to the invention, by adopting an optimization strategy combining dynamic path re-planning and reinforcement learning, the flexibility of path planning and the capability of coping with a complex environment are improved, and the energy consumption and the obstacle avoidance distance are effectively reduced, so that the robot can stably operate in a wider scene.

title: Humanoid robot multi-modal sensing fusion method based on dynamic sparse activation
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot multi-modal sensing fusion method based on dynamic sparse activation, and relates to the technical field of multi-modal sensing fusion, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a robot multi-modal data flow, and generating modal availability mapping based on the real-time operation state of a robot; dynamically selecting a to-be-activated sensing mode by adopting a sparse gating strategy, and constructing an activation mode set according to a selection result; performing state evaluation on the activation mode set by adopting a Kalman filtering algorithm to obtain a state evaluation set and identifying a mode switching state; when modal switching is recognized, a state evaluation window is constructed based on task complexity and progress change, and the state space dimension of the robot is dynamically adjusted in the state evaluation window to obtain a multi-modal state set; and a robot task execution instruction is generated based on the multi-modal state set, and the behavior action of the robot is controlled, so that the problem of mismatching of robot state space dimensions caused by mode switching when a sparse gating strategy is adopted to dynamically select and activate a sensing mode is solved.

title: Self-adaptive posture adjustment humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a self-adaptive posture adjustment humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. A self-adaptive posture adjusting humanoid robot comprises a trunk provided with feet, and further comprises the steps that the feet comprise heels, middle palms and toes, side skirt plates are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the middle palms, and the side skirt plates are rotationally connected with the middle palms; the sliding block is arranged on the middle palm and is used for pushing the side apron board to rotate; according to the humanoid robot, the side skirt plates capable of being automatically folded and unfolded are arranged on the two sides of the middle palm, the side skirt plates are automatically unfolded when the feet fall on the ground in the walking process of the humanoid robot, the ground contact area of the middle palm is increased, the pressure intensity of the humanoid robot on the ground is reduced, meanwhile, the projection area of the humanoid robot is increased, and the humanoid robot is more attractive. The stability of the humanoid robot is improved when the middle palm leaves the ground and is about to step out of the next step. And the side apron board automatically resets, so that the side apron board is prevented from interfering with the other leg in the stepping process.

title: Human-shaped explosive ordnance disposal robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a human-shaped explosive ordnance disposal robot which comprises a connecting base, leg modules are rotationally installed on the left side and the right side of the connecting base, a chest module is rotationally installed above the connecting base, arm modules are rotationally installed on the left side and the right side of the upper end of the chest module, and a head module is installed above the chest module. Identification cameras and an X-ray machine are fixedly installed on the outer surface of the front side of the chest module, and the identification cameras are distributed in an array mode. According to the humanoid explosive ordnance disposal robot, a novel structural design is adopted, a walking simulation mode is adopted, the humanoid explosive ordnance disposal robot has better trafficability compared with a vehicle type robot under the condition that many obstacles exist, and the humanoid robot has a better load effect (that is, the humanoid robot can stand and has a higher load effect under the condition that the occupied area is small); and all devices required to be used during explosive ordnance disposal can be carried at one time, so that the complexity of explosive ordnance disposal is simplified.

title: Sealing structure for output end of linear joint of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot joint module structures, in particular to a humanoid robot linear joint output end sealing structure which is arranged at an output rod and comprises a front cover, and a section of rod hole formed in the front cover is in clearance fit with the output rod; the first-section rod hole further communicates with a second-section rod hole provided with a middle sealing layer, and an outer sealing layer is arranged outside the peripheral side of the middle sealing layer. The inner end of the middle sealing layer faces an inner port of the two-section rod hole, the outer end of the middle sealing layer faces an outer port of the two-section rod hole, and the outer port of the two-section rod hole is sealed by an end cover and abuts against the middle sealing layer; the output rod is provided with an inner sealing layer opposite to the middle sealing layer. By forming a stable sealing structure, the lubricating requirement of the output rod can be met, lubricating grease can be prevented from overflowing, accordingly, material waste and external pollution are avoided, frequent maintenance can be avoided, use is more convenient, and the effective use service life is longer.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of control adjustment, and discloses a humanoid robot control method based on image segmentation, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the data cleaning of the original environment image data of a humanoid robot, and obtaining a standard environment data frame; performing pixel semantic segmentation on the standard environment data frame to obtain a semantic segmentation region mask; analyzing and identifying a passable area and an interactive object of the humanoid robot to obtain a two-dimensional path navigation route and interactive object information; performing parameter quantization on the two-dimensional path navigation route, and encoding quantized data into an executable leg instruction of the humanoid robot; performing action sequence instruction conversion on the joint rotation angle and the grabbing force of the humanoid robot to obtain an arm control instruction; performing association fusion on the executable leg instruction and the arm control instruction to obtain a comprehensive control instruction; according to the invention, the efficiency of humanoid robot control based on image segmentation can be improved.

title: Training method, control method and device of humanoid robot controller
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot controller training method, a humanoid robot controller control method and a humanoid robot controller training device. A two-stage training framework is adopted, and in the first stage, a reinforcement learning algorithm is adopted to independently train a plurality of single-behavior controllers which are specially used for different sports skills (such as walking and standing); then, the capabilities of the single-behavior controllers are integrated into a unified multi-behavior controller through a behavior distillation method, so that the unified multi-behavior controller has the capability of autonomously switching skills according to states. And in the second stage, in order to improve the robustness of the multi-behavior controller in a complex environment, a task environment for simulating various use terrains is constructed, and reinforcement learning fine tuning is performed on the controller in parallel in the environment, so that a controller capable of adapting to the complex terrains and realizing multi-skill smooth switching is finally obtained. The adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot controller and the reliability of practical application can be improved. The robot can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Shoulder joint of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a shoulder joint of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The shoulder joint comprises a trunk connecting base, an upper limb connecting base, an actuator, a first wire harness and a second wire harness. The actuator comprises a shell, an output end, a cylindrical shaft and a wiring end. The shell comprises a first end and a second end which are opposite to each other. The trunk connecting seat comprises a connecting disc, a first end wall and a second end wall; the first end is fixed with the first end wall; a gap is formed between the second end and the second end wall; the upper limb connecting seat comprises a base and a first side wall, and the first side wall is fixed to the output end; a threading channel is arranged on the upper limb connecting seat, one end of the threading channel forms an inlet, and the other end forms an outlet; the first wire harness sequentially penetrates through the inlet, the threading channel, the outlet and the cylindrical shaft and then enters the gap, and the second wire harness and the first wire harness are folded in the gap and then are led into the trunk through the through hole of the connecting disc. According to the shoulder joint protection device, the wire harness is prevented from being exposed, the wire harness is well protected, and it is ensured that the shoulder joint can move flexibly.

title: Fault prediction and health management method in humanoid robot training ground
abstract: The invention provides a fault prediction and health management method in a humanoid robot training ground, and relates to the technical field of robot health management, and the method comprises the steps: collecting robot body health data, a controller log, and interaction detection data between robots, and carrying out the preprocessing; then performing health preliminary evaluation; constructing a dynamic interaction health graph, and inferring a health attenuation trend through a time sequence graph neural network; constructing and correcting a health-fault causal graph in combination with the historical fault data and the historical health state data; adjusting the alarm level, and verifying the abnormal relevance; constructing a multi-modal health embedding model, and updating the model; and obtaining a fault root cause and a health influence link, and generating a maintenance suggestion, a health maintenance scheme and a risk assessment report. According to the method, the multi-robot group association characteristics are captured through the dynamic interaction health graph, the time sequence graph neural network and the corrected health-fault causal graph are fused, the accuracy and timeliness of fault probability prediction are greatly improved, and early warning of faults is realized.

title: Clamping jaw device, manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a clamping jaw device, a manipulator and a humanoid robot. The driving piece is arranged on the shell, and a worm is arranged at the driving end of the driving piece; the two clamping assemblies are arranged on the shell correspondingly, and the two clamping assemblies are located on the two sides of the worm; the clamping assembly comprises a worm gear which is rotationally arranged on the shell and engaged with the worm. The connecting rod group is rotationally arranged on the shell and is connected with the worm gear; the claw head is arranged on the connecting rod group; the driving piece drives the worm to rotate and drives the two worm gears meshed with the worm to rotate synchronously, so that the connecting rod set rotates, and the two claw heads are close to each other. The two clamping assemblies are arranged on the two sides of the worm, so that the worm wheels are meshed with the worm, reasonable layout of the driving part is facilitated, one worm is adopted to drive the two worm wheels at the same time, the structural compactness is higher, the occupied space is smaller, and clamping coordination and stability are improved.

title: Flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot
abstract: The flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a head, a trunk, arms and legs, and the core structure of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot is a balance movement mechanism composed of the trunk and the legs. The trunk comprises a sliding rail, a flywheel shell, a motor, a ball screw, a storage battery, a power electronic conversion device, a stepping motor, a coupler, a fastening connecting piece, a shock pad, an upper rolling bearing, a rotating shaft, a magnetic induction coil, a flywheel and a lower rolling bearing. The legs comprise hip joints, knee joints and ankle joints, all the mechanisms operate in a coordinated mode to achieve overall operation of the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot, and the flywheel energy storage type angular momentum balance biped robot comprises a flywheel energy storage structure, a gravity center adjusting structure, a leg movement structure and a balance control structure. The stability is improved; by utilizing the flywheel energy storage principle, mechanical energy is converted into electric energy and stored, so that continuous advancing power is provided; and each leg has four degrees of freedom, so that the mechanical complexity is reduced.

title: Waist and crotch structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The waist and crotch structure of the humanoid robot comprises a waist and crotch shell, the top wall of the waist and crotch shell is rotationally connected with a first rotating shaft through a first bearing, the outer side of the first rotating shaft is movably sleeved with a first hollow shaft, the upper end of the first hollow shaft is provided with an upper trunk connecting base, and the left wall and the right wall of the waist and crotch shell are rotationally connected with second rotating shafts through second bearings; the outer sides of the second rotating shafts are movably sleeved with second hollow shafts, and the opposite ends of the two second hollow shafts are provided with lower limb connecting bases. According to the waist and crotch structure of the humanoid robot, by additionally arranging the reinforcing parts and reasonably selecting materials for the reinforcing parts, auxiliary supporting is carried out on rotation inertia force generated by operation of the waist and crotch of the humanoid robot, and then the operation stability of the waist and crotch of the humanoid robot is improved; meanwhile, the crotch width and span height of the waist and crotch of the humanoid robot can be adjusted according to the use requirements of the actual environment, and use is convenient.

title: Humanoid robot bottom plate
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot bottom plate and relates to the technical field of protective structures, the humanoid robot bottom plate is provided with a first surface and a second surface which are opposite to each other, the first surface is used for being connected with the sole of a robot, and the first surface is provided with at least one limiting structure. The limiting structure is used for being matched and clamped with the sole of a robot, rough textures are formed on the first surface, and an anti-skid structure is arranged on the second surface. According to the technical scheme, the structural design of the bottom plate of the humanoid robot is adjusted, and the assembling and connecting stability and reliability of the bottom plate are improved.

title: Robot lower limb structure lightweight rapid prediction method based on machine learning
abstract: The invention relates to a robot lower limb structure lightweight rapid prediction method based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot lightweight design. According to the method, a reliable training data set is generated through finite element analysis, and training is performed in combination with a machine learning algorithm, so that the structural lightweight degree of the humanoid robot part structure under the condition of ensuring the use intensity is quickly predicted, and the lightweight iteration efficiency of the humanoid robot configuration structure is improved.

title: Temperature control structure of humanoid robot arm and temperature control method thereof
abstract: The temperature control structure of the humanoid robot arm comprises an arm outer sleeve body, and the arm outer sleeve body comprises a rear cylindrical sleeve body part and a round table sleeve body part which is formed at the front end of the rear cylindrical sleeve body part and extends forwards; a cylindrical shell is clamped on the inner side wall of the front end of the rear cylindrical sleeve body part, a plurality of mounting through holes penetrating front and back are formed in the middle of the cylindrical shell, a shell of the hollow cup motor is located in the corresponding mounting through hole, and the outer side wall of the shell is tightly attached to the inner side wall of the corresponding mounting through hole; heat of the hollow cup motor is transmitted to the phase change material through the shell, heat is absorbed through deformation of the phase change material, heat is transmitted to the arm shell through the outer side wall of the cylindrical shell, heat is dissipated through the cooling fan and the tooth-shaped cooling fins, external heat dissipation is adopted, internal space occupation is reduced, internal wiring harnesses and other objects cannot be blown, and the heat dissipation effect is good. And noise is reduced, and the using effect is good.

title: Simulation skin capable of being applied to humanoid robot and preparation method of simulation skin
abstract: The invention discloses simulated skin applicable to a humanoid robot and a preparation method thereof, the simulated skin comprises a substrate layer and a silica gel layer, the surface of the substrate layer is provided with a plurality of convex rib parts, the convex rib parts are arched, the two ends of each convex rib part are adhered to the surface of the substrate layer, and the silica gel layer submerges the convex rib parts and is solidified and formed above the surface of the substrate layer. The invention discloses a simulated skin structure and a manufacturing method of the simulated skin, the simulated skin structure can be directly applied to whole body fitting and covering of a humanoid robot, and the problem that silica gel is difficult to stably and firmly fit with most of other materials when being used as the simulated skin is solved.

title: Dexterous finger driving device, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the utility model provides a dexterous finger driving device, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The dexterous finger driving device comprises a support driving module and a transmission module. The driving module is installed at one end of the support and comprises a plurality of driving pieces, and the driving pieces are used for providing driving force. The transmission module is installed on the support and comprises a plurality of moving parts which do linear motion in the same direction, the moving parts are at least in transmission connection with one driving part, and the driving part is used for driving the moving parts to move. The transmission module further comprises a plurality of guiding parts, the length direction of the guiding parts is arranged in the moving direction of the moving parts, the guiding parts are connected to the support, at least two moving parts are connected to one guiding part, and one guiding part is used for guiding the at least two moving parts. The dexterous finger driving device is compact in structure, small in size and convenient to assemble and disassemble.

title: Supporting structure of leg rolling joint, robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a supporting structure of a leg rolling joint, a robot and a humanoid robot, and the supporting structure of the leg rolling joint mainly comprises a first connecting piece, a second connecting piece, a bearing and a leg rolling joint module. A first connecting seat on the first connecting piece comprises a bearing part which is roughly in a hollow circular ring shape, and a bearing is arranged between the bearing part and a pivoting end, deviating from the output flange, of the leg rolling joint module for supporting. Due to the arrangement, the phenomenon that the main shaft is biased when the leg rolling joint is stressed is avoided, the speed reducer of the leg rolling joint is effectively protected, and the problem that the main shaft is damaged due to the biased pressure is avoided.

title: Task-adaptive whole-body variable impedance control method for wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of wheeled humanoid robot control, in particular to a task adaptive whole-body variable impedance control method for a wheeled humanoid robot, which comprises the steps of multi-source signal fusion estimation, task dependent impedance scheduling, upper body impedance control, chassis virtual force admittance mapping and 1kHz real-time closed-loop execution. The upper body rigidity and the chassis damping can be adjusted in real time based on the slip rate, the contact rigidity and the attitude disturbance, on the premise that the passivity and the stability of the system are guaranteed, unification of the assembling flexibility and the carrying stability is achieved, and the mixed task of moving and operating at the same time is supported.

title: Robot whole body control method and system based on real-time inertia motion capture and reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a robot whole body control method and system based on real-time inertia motion capture and reinforcement learning, and belongs to the field of robot control. The system comprises a motion capture module, a data processing and forward kinematics module, a motion redirection and optimization module, a general motion strategy control module and a real-time control and driving module which are connected in sequence, and an end-to-end closed-loop control assembly line is formed through a shared memory and a high-speed communication protocol. According to the method, human body joint data are collected through inertia motion capture equipment, high-quality mapping from a human body posture to a robot model is achieved through posture calculation, non-uniform scaling and two-stage differential inverse kinematics optimization, and a stable joint instruction is generated in combination with a reinforcement learning strategy trained by a PPO algorithm. The method solves the problems of lack of feedback closed loop, joint deadlock, contradiction between fidelity and stability and the like in the prior art, has the characteristics of high robustness and high expansibility, and can be widely applied to scenes of remote operation, action reproduction and the like.

title: Wheel type biped robot complete machine coupling control system and method
abstract: The invention provides a complete machine coupling control system and method for a wheeled biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The system comprises a wheeled biped robot body, a sensor module, an embedded controller and a control software module; the wheel type biped robot body comprises a robot body, left and right parallel five-connecting-rod leg mechanisms, hub motors and joint motors, the left and right parallel five-connecting-rod leg mechanisms are connected to the two sides of the robot body, and the joint motors and the hub motors are arranged in the left and right parallel five-connecting-rod leg mechanisms; the sensor module comprises an encoder and an inertial measurement unit IMU, and is used for measuring the motion state and attitude information of the robot; the embedded controller executes a control algorithm; the control software module comprises a state estimation module, a balance control module, an attitude control module and a height control module. According to the complete machine coupling control system and method for the wheeled biped robot, the problem that in the prior art, cooperative control over joint motors and hub motors is insufficient is solved.

title: Humanoid robot dynamic formation control method, system, equipment, medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot dynamic formation control method, system and device, a medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the current state quantity of a humanoid robot; encoding the current state quantity by using a liquid neural network, and determining the encoded state quantity; inputting the coded state quantity into a reinforcement learning network, determining a control action instruction at the current moment, executing the control action instruction, and generating a state quantity at the next moment and a corresponding reward; on the basis of a priority experience recovery mechanism, according to the current state quantity, the current moment action, the reward and the state quantity of the next moment, updating network parameters of the reinforcement learning network, and determining the trained reinforcement learning network; and performing dynamic formation control on the humanoid robot according to the trained reinforcement learning network. According to the application, the formation stability in a dynamic environment and the response speed to sudden obstacles can be improved, and the formation change flexibility is improved.

title: Humanoid robot bionic skin heating temperature control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot bionic skin heating temperature control method, and belongs to the technical field of robot automatic control, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining real-time temperature distribution data of a bionic skin surface, carrying out time domain differential processing to generate temperature change rate data, and combining the obtained real-time pressure distribution data to construct a contact surface heat conduction characteristic; and generating a basic heat energy supply strategy based on the steady-state components in the heat conduction characteristics of the contact surface, performing dynamic weighted fusion on the basic heat energy supply strategy and an instantaneous heat flow disturbance compensation amount calculated based on the instantaneous dynamic components in the heat conduction characteristics of the contact surface, generating a control heating instruction, and driving a heating unit in the bionic skin to execute a heating action. The real-time pressure and the temperature change rate are integrated to construct the heat conduction characteristic of the contact surface, and the characteristic is decomposed into a steady-state component and an instantaneous dynamic component for feed-forward compensation control, so that predictive compensation can be performed on external thermal disturbance, and rapid and stable control on the temperature of the bionic skin is realized.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a humanoid robot. title: Variable load working condition oriented humanoid robot hydraulic driver position servo self-adaptive control method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of hydraulic servo control systems, and discloses a humanoid robot hydraulic driver position servo self-adaptive control method and system oriented to variable load working conditions. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a mathematical model of a to-be-controlled object hydraulic driver and converting the mathematical model into a state-space equation; according to the state-space equation of the to-be-controlled object, establishing an extended state observer to observe the state and total disturbance of the to-be-controlled object in real time; according to the state and the total disturbance observed by the expansion state observer in real time, a backstepping controller is designed to control the to-be-controlled object, so that the actual displacement of the to-be-controlled object is close to the expected displacement, when the backstepping controller is designed, an adaptive law is established for the load quality in the backstepping controller, and the actual displacement of the to-be-controlled object is controlled. Therefore, the dynamic change of the load in practical application is met. According to the invention, the problems of low tracking precision and weak robustness of hydraulic driver position control under a variable load working condition are solved.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot based on magnetorheological fluid
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a wheeled humanoid robot based on magnetorheological fluid, comprising an undercarriage and a robot body, a support is fixed on the outer wall of the top of the undercarriage, a floating seat slidably sleeves the outer wall of the support, and the robot body is rotatably connected to the top end of the floating seat through a connecting joint. An electricity storage unit is arranged on the outer wall of the undercarriage, a buffer mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism are arranged on the undercarriage, and the buffer mechanism comprises a cavity formed in the support. By means of the arranged buffering mechanism, when the floating seat moves downwards due to vibration, the floating seat pushes the two supports to stretch towards the two sides of the chassis through the two connecting rods, so that vibration energy is converted into kinetic energy for sliding of the supports, the vibration reduction effect is further improved, the two sides of the chassis can be supported in an auxiliary mode after the supports stretch, and the vibration reduction effect is improved. The stability of the undercarriage is improved during vibration, and the situation that the device turns on one side on a bumpy road surface is avoided.

title: Control method for step-by-step gait strategy fusion of biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, and provides a control method for biped robot step-by-step gait strategy fusion in order to solve the problems that a biped robot is large in training difficulty, unnatural in gait, poor in adaptability and the like. Training various different terrain categories through an imitation learning algorithm and a reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain a gait strategy model; s2, performing pairwise fusion gait strategy switching between the gait strategy models corresponding to various different terrain categories; s3, the terrain category of the current position is recognized in real time according to an information collection unit of the biped robot, a corresponding gait strategy model is obtained through a strategy execution control unit, and the biped robot is controlled to walk in the corresponding motion state; and S4, when the terrain category of the biped robot is changed, smooth transition between the two gait strategy models is achieved through gait strategy switching, and control over gait strategy fusion of the biped robot is completed.

title: Method, system and equipment for positioning humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot positioning method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a building structure map and first precise positioning information in a current moving process of a humanoid robot, and obtaining initial positioning information and an environment feature set of the humanoid robot; according to the building structure map, carrying out building environment matching on the environment feature set to obtain reference positioning information; according to a positioning correction condition, performing first condition verification on the first precise positioning information and the initial positioning information to obtain a first condition verification result; and if the first condition verification result is that the positioning correction condition is met, performing positioning correction on the initial positioning information according to the reference positioning information to obtain second accurate positioning information of the humanoid robot in the current moving process. According to the method, the positioning precision of the humanoid robot in a complex building environment can be effectively improved. The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots.

title: Harmonic speed reduction module for humanoid robot dexterous hand joint
abstract: The utility model provides a harmonic speed reduction module for a dexterous hand joint of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid finger joints, the harmonic speed reduction module comprises an axial magnetic flux motor and a double-rigid-wheel harmonic speed reducer, the axial magnetic flux motor comprises a motor shell, an input shaft, a permanent magnet rotor and two PCB stators; the double-rigid-gear harmonic speed reducer comprises a wave generator, a flexible bearing, a flexible gear, a first rigid gear, a second rigid gear and a supporting bearing, the input shaft is fixedly connected with the wave generator, the first rigid gear serves as an inner ring of the supporting bearing and is detachably and fixedly connected with the motor shell, and a connecting plate is arranged between the first rigid gear and the motor shell; the rigid gear II is positioned on one side of the rigid gear I far away from the motor shell as a support bearing outer ring; the flexible bearings comprise two first flexible bearings which are arranged in parallel in the axial direction of the input shaft, and a limiting protrusion located between outer rings of the two first bearings is arranged in the middle of the inner wall of the flexible gear; an end cover is arranged on the side, away from the first rigid wheel, of the second rigid wheel. The axial length of the joint module is shortened, and meanwhile the load capacity and the transmission precision of the joint module are improved.

title: Humanoid shooting robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid shooting robot, the overall appearance structure of which imitates the ergonomic design, and the humanoid shooting robot comprises legs, a waist, a trunk, big arms, small arms, hands and a head so as to fit the visual perception and viewing habits of a human body. Meanwhile, the robot not only can be competent for basketball training and performance tasks, but also can play a positive role in the field of science popularization education due to rich intelligent interaction functions.

title: Humanoid robot SLAM method based on D435i and RTAB-MAP algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot SLAM method based on D435i and RTAB-MAP algorithms, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: receiving an RGB image, a depth image and IMU data outputted by a D435i depth camera at the head of a humanoid robot, and receiving joint angle data outputted by a joint angle collection device; executing timestamp synchronous alignment operation on the multi-source data; visual features are extracted from the processed RGB image, odometer optimization is completed in combination with an IMU pre-integration result, and initial poses and pre-integration residual errors of adjacent frames are output; the vibration state is judged based on IMU data, key frames are screened, and a pose relation graph is constructed or updated; performing pose optimization in combination with the joint angle data and the pose relation graph, and outputting a key frame pose; and finally, based on the optimized key frame pose and depth image, generating a three-dimensional environment map with a semantic tag. The method adapts to motion characteristics of the humanoid robot, vibration interference is effectively relieved, reliability and precision of pose estimation and map construction are improved, and powerful support is provided for autonomous navigation of the robot.

title: Reinforcement learning biped robot gait control method based on multi-layer self-adaptive exploration mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a reinforcement learning biped robot gait control method based on a multilayer adaptive exploration mechanism, and belongs to the field of biped robot reinforcement learning control. The method aims at solving the problems that in existing gait control based on a near-end strategy optimization (PPO) algorithm, strategy convergence is unstable, and exploration and utilization balance is insufficient. According to the method, a multi-layer adaptive exploration mechanism is introduced on the basis of a standard PPO framework: firstly, a state-dependent standard deviation network is designed to realize adaptive noise adjustment of a space layer for dynamically controlling action disturbance intensity; secondly, constructing an entropy regularization mechanism based on advantage weighting, and realizing exploration intensity adaptive control of a direction layer; thirdly, a dynamic entropy coefficient is designed according to the uncertainty of a value function, and exploration rhythm self-adaptive adjustment of a time layer is achieved. Through the synergistic effect of three layers of mechanisms, the strategy realizes dynamic balance of exploration and convergence in different training stages, so that the stability of the training process and the strategy convergence quality are improved.

title: Intelligent piloting system and method based on humanoid robot and attitude mapping technology
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent piloting system and method based on a humanoid robot and an attitude mapping technology. The system comprises a shore end control center, a 5G communication subsystem and a ship end execution system. The shore end captures the whole body attitude information of the pilot through the multi-view attitude capture subsystem, and the attitude mapping and control subsystem converts the whole body attitude information into a robot control instruction by adopting a layered mapping strategy; a robot control instruction is transmitted to the ship end through a 5G network in a low-delay mode, and piloting operation is executed by the humanoid robot; the first visual angle video of the robot is transmitted back to the shore end VR display subsystem, and hand-eye coordinated closed-loop control is formed. Therefore, by means of the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the safety risk that the pilot climbs and leaves the wheel is thoroughly eliminated, all-weather and uninterrupted piloting operation is achieved, the natural operation experience is kept by means of the layered mapping strategy, and the safety, continuity and efficiency of port piloting are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot steering gait planning method based on nonlinear model predictive control
abstract: The invention relates to a gait planning technology of a humanoid robot, in particular to a humanoid robot steering gait planning method based on nonlinear model predictive control. The method provided by the invention is different from the prior art, not only realizes planning of the gait sequence, but also can plan the robot direction angle track meeting the requirements at the same time. According to the gait planning method, the orientation angle can be autonomously adjusted according to the expected speed of an upper-layer instruction, so that the robot has better trajectory tracking performance during steering. Meanwhile, different from the previous method for conservatively approximating the double-support-period ZMP constraint to the single-support-period constraint, the method disclosed by the invention explicitly processes the double-support-period ZMP support polygon constraint in the model prediction control framework, expands the support domain of the optimization problem, enhances the solving flexibility and success rate of the algorithm in a complex dynamic scene, and improves the optimization performance.

title: Bionic eye movement control device and method and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic eye motion control device and method and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The device comprises a plurality of flexible electric actuators, each flexible electric actuator comprises an electric actuating material which generates active deformation under excitation of an electric field, one end of each flexible electric actuator serves as a fixed end to be connected to a bearing body, and the free end, with driving displacement or driving force, of each flexible electric actuator is directly or indirectly connected with an eye function part. The driving motor is used for driving the eyeball shell to rotate and/or driving eyelids to open and close; and the passive constraint structure is configured to provide anisotropic mechanical constraint for active deformation of the flexible electric actuator, so that the active deformation is guided and converted into driving displacement or driving force in the first preset direction. By means of the scheme, eye cooperative control which is compact in structure, smooth in movement, low in noise and high in bionic performance is achieved, and the method is suitable for the fields of humanoid robots, service robots, man-machine interaction and the like.
