title: Manufacturing method of photoelectric composite cable
abstract: The invention discloses a manufacturing method of a photoelectric composite cable, and relates to the technical field of cables. The method sequentially comprises the steps of raw material selection pretreatment, conductor back-twist stranding, insulation extrusion, optical fiber unit prefabrication, synchronous back-twist cabling, shielding layer application, double-layer sheath extrusion molding and the like. An on-line optical state monitoring mechanism is introduced in the synchronous back-twist cabling process, a'monitoring-judging-adjusting 'closed-loop control system is constructed by collecting optical fiber light attenuation change data in real time, and automatic linkage adjustment is carried out on key parameters such as optical fiber pay-off tension, back-twist ratio and twisting pitch. In addition, the cable core structure adopts a compression-resistant gasket to realize unit physical isolation, and is matched with a reverse double-layer twisting and partition temperature control extrusion process. According to the method, the problems of signal loss fluctuation and structure instability of the humanoid robot cable under a severe dynamic working condition are effectively solved, and the bending resistance life, the torsion resistance and the manufacturing consistency of a finished product are remarkably improved.

title: Cross-modal emotion interaction system based on dynamic self-evolution anthropomorphic calculation
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-modal emotion interaction system based on dynamic self-evolution anthropomorphic calculation. According to the system, the functions of cross-modal perception, self-evolution learning and full-scene emotional interaction are realized through collaborative design of an innovative algorithm architecture and hardware and by taking a robot as a carrier. According to the algorithm, a multi-modal fusion perception system is constructed, an emotion feature vector is generated through a self-attention module, and accurate emotion recognition is realized based on Transform. The self-evolution mechanism adopts federated learning and abnormal optimization dual drive, continuous iteration and rapid adaptation of the model are achieved, and data security is guaranteed. The low-time-delay interactive execution system realizes anthropomorphic actions through kinematics solution, trajectory planning and a control algorithm, and combines a dynamic interactive library and reinforcement learning optimization strategy selection. Hardware adopts a polylactide topological optimization skeleton, has 17 degrees of freedom, and integrates a microphone array, a visual module and the like. The robot can be widely applied to the fields of pension services and the like, and emotion recognition precision, self-evolution ability and interaction naturalness are improved.

title: Heat dissipation structure of cabinet
abstract: The utility model discloses a heat radiation structure of a machine cabinet, comprising a cabinet body, a cabinet door rotatably installed on the cabinet body, a handle fixedly connected on the cabinet door, a cavity arranged in the cabinet body, two groups of heat conduction blocks arranged in the cavity, the two groups of heat conduction blocks fixedly installed on a side plate of the cabinet body, a cavity is formed in the cabinet body, a heat conduction block is arranged in the cavity, heat dissipation fins are fixedly connected to the heat conduction block, heat dissipation grooves are formed in the two sides of the cabinet body, the heat dissipation grooves are communicated with the interior of the cavity, an air inlet pipe is fixedly connected to a back plate of the cabinet body, a heat dissipation fan is fixedly installed in the air inlet pipe, and a liquid cooling mechanism is further arranged in the cavity. According to the utility model, the cabinet body is matched with the cavity, the heat conduction block, the heat dissipation fins and the heat dissipation grooves, so that after heat generated inside the cabinet body during working is transferred to the cavity, the heat dissipation function of the cabinet body is realized, the heat inside the cabinet body during working can be dissipated in time, and the influence of overhigh temperature on the performance and the service life of the humanoid robot during testing is avoided.

title: Foldable storage type inner layer structure of special humanoid aviation case for robot
abstract: The foldable storage type inner layer structure of the special humanoid aviation case for the robot comprises a U-shaped frame used for bearing the trunk of the robot, the two end opening portions of the U-shaped frame are both connected with shells in a sliding mode, and the two shells contain the head and the legs of the robot respectively. Fixing assemblies used for fixing the robot trunk are arranged on the inner walls of the two sides of the U-shaped frame, limiting pieces used for limiting objects stored in the shells are arranged on the inner walls of the opposite sides of the two shells, and the two shells are fixedly connected with the two ends of the U-shaped frame through the fixing pieces correspondingly. Through the arrangement of the fixing assembly, the two-way lead screw drives the nut base, then the connecting plate and the arc-shaped plate move to fix the robot trunk, a robot is effectively fixed, the robot is prevented from shaking in the transportation process, flexible adjustment can be conducted according to the thickness of the robot trunk, and the transportation efficiency is improved. And the fixing requirements of robots of different models are met, and the universality of the transport box is improved.

title: Foot bottom self-adaptive balance array device of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot foot bottom self-adaption balance unit which comprises an upper cover, a lower cover, a foot bottom self-adaption balance unit, a foot bottom self-adaption balance unit and a foot bottom self-adaption balance unit, and the top of the upper cover is provided with an interface connected with a humanoid robot foot; the lower cover is fixedly connected with the upper cover, and an inner cavity is defined by the lower cover and the upper cover; the spherical surface of the smoothening ball body is accommodated in the inner cavity and can freely rotate relative to the cavity, and the top and the bottom of the smoothening ball body are smoothened in the axis direction of the smoothening ball body to form an upper plane and a lower plane which are parallel to each other. A distributed leveling array is formed at the foot bottom of the humanoid robot through a plurality of independent balance units, the smoothing ball in each unit can freely rotate around the center of the smoothing ball when the ground fluctuates, the posture of the smoothing ball is passively and instantly adjusted, support is supplemented to the low point, contact is disengaged from the high point, and the leveling effect is achieved. And the static and dynamic stability of the humanoid robot under the complex unstructured terrain is obviously improved.

title: Humanoid robot path re-planning method and system fused with multi-modal perception
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot path re-planning method and system fused with multi-modal perception, and relates to the technical field of motion control, and the method comprises the steps: uniformly writing a depth camera frame and a laser radar frame into an octree voxel, marking the identification of occupation, normal, main direction and contact type, enumerating candidate contact poses, and carrying out the re-planning of the path of a humanoid robot; outputting a semantic voxel contact field and a reachable lookup table; according to the semantic voxel contact field, extracting a free space connected skeleton and constructing a topological corridor sequence, performing layered mapping on candidate contact poses to form a sustainable contact graph, and outputting a corridor-contact joint planning skeleton; and executing dynamic invasion projection on the corridor-contact combined planning skeleton, and marking unpassable segments and unavailable contact nodes. According to the method, a topological corridor sequence is constructed through a free space connected skeleton, and layered mapping is performed on candidate contact poses to form a sustainable contact diagram, so that cooperative expression of corridor constraint and contact switchability in the same corridor-contact combined planning skeleton is realized.

title: Humanoid robot multi-terrain gait control method and system fused with visual perception
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of robot motion control, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot multi-terrain gait control method and system fused with visual perception. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal sensing data of the humanoid robot, and preprocessing the multi-modal sensing data; the preprocessed multi-modal sensing data are input into a pre-trained world model, and the world model updates and outputs a potential state at the current moment based on a historical recursive state, a historical random posteriori state and an action sequence in a historical updating interval; inputting the potential state at the current moment into a pre-trained strategy network, and outputting an action at the current moment; and based on the action at the current moment, the driving torque of each joint is calculated through a PD controller, and the humanoid robot is driven to move. According to the method, a world model structure is introduced, so that the robot can realize more stable and more efficient gait control and terrain adaptation of the humanoid robot under the condition that the robot only depends on perception information which can be acquired by the robot.

title: Humanoid robot scene operation assisting method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot scenarized operation assisting method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. title: Humanoid robot state estimation method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot state estimation method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the collection information of a measurement sensor on a robot body, and the collection information comprises linear acceleration information, angular velocity information and joint pose information; factor nodes are constructed according to the collected information, the base state and the mass center state serve as state variable nodes, the state variable nodes are connected through a constraint relation to form a factor graph, and a weight coefficient is distributed to each factor node; and performing nonlinear optimization on the factor graph to obtain a base state estimation value and a centroid state estimation value. According to the humanoid robot state estimation method, the accuracy and robustness of the state estimation result are effectively improved.

title: Dynamic parameter testing method and platform for joint module structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot joint module structure dynamic parameter testing method and platform, and belongs to the technical field of robot testing. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a test platform, fixing a joint module stator, connecting an output end with a connecting rod with a load, and installing a high-resolution encoder; performing rigidity test, recording torque and angle change by horizontally placing the connecting rod and increasing and decreasing weights, and fitting to obtain a rigidity curve; carrying out a damping test, vertically placing the on-load connecting rod, applying instantaneous excitation, collecting vibration attenuation data, and calculating a damping coefficient. The test platform is simple in structure and mainly comprises a basic platform, a mounting support, a connecting rod, a weight and an encoder. The system comprises the platform and a data acquisition and processing unit. According to the method, the problem that the rigidity and damping parameters of the joint module cannot be conveniently obtained in the prior art is solved, the method is economical and efficient, the obtained parameters can be directly used for robot dynamics modeling and motion control optimization, and the motion precision and the vibration reduction performance are improved.

title: Humanoid robot group dance control method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot group dance control method and system, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: completing module initialization after a plurality of robot subsystems are started; receiving a dance arrangement instruction, and generating a reference trajectory vector including the motion and the posture of the humanoid robot; environment features are extracted to complete positioning under a world coordinate system, humanoid robot attitude estimation is output, and multi-machine state data interaction is achieved; a trajectory verification method based on a physical constraint threshold value is introduced to verify a robot motion planning trajectory; and outputting a group of multi-machine cooperative trajectory set, so that all humanoid robots synchronously track the instruction and present group dance actions. According to the method, a reference trajectory vector adaptive to 21-degree-of-freedom control requirements of the humanoid robot is arranged, smooth transition of actions is achieved, a full-duplex communication architecture based on a TCP protocol is further arranged, the data transmission quantity is adjusted according to network round-trip delay, dependence of a distributed system on communication quality is reduced, and the communication bottleneck of a centralized system is avoided.

title: Modularized distributed power supply system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of power supply, and discloses a humanoid robot modular distributed power supply system which comprises a power supply battery pack, a power management distribution board and a plurality of power utilization modules. The power utilization module at least comprises a control computing power unit, a sensing system, an upper limb joint module, a lower limb joint module and other joint modules; the power management distribution board is electrically connected with the power supply battery pack and each power utilization module. The power management distribution board comprises an MCU control unit, a DCDC power supply unit, a soft start unit, a high-power output unit and a voltage and current detection unit. Through a modular distributed power-on strategy and in combination with soft start pre-charging, voltage and current real-time detection and a regenerative braking absorption unit, voltage and current peaks generated at the moment of power-on of the capacitive high-power load are remarkably suppressed, the risk that a power device is damaged due to overvoltage and overcurrent impact is fundamentally avoided, and the reliability of the power device is improved. And the system reliability and the service life are greatly improved.

title: Manipulator and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots. The operating mechanism is mounted at the operating end of the shoulder joint component; wherein the operating mechanism comprises a cylindrical base, which is internally provided with a closed accommodating cavity; the three mechanical fingers are arranged in the circumferential direction of one end of the cylindrical base; each mechanical finger comprises a mounting base, a first knuckle and a second knuckle; the mounting base comprises a rotary driving part and a mounting connecting part; according to the mechanical arm, the fixed finger and the two movable fingers capable of synchronously sliding are arranged, and a rotation driving function built in the mounting base is combined, so that the mechanical arm can dynamically reconstruct the grabbing space layout and adjust the clamping posture under the condition that physical parts do not need to be replaced; therefore, various operation requirements of three-point enveloping grabbing of block-shaped workpieces, two-point supporting and one-point pressing grabbing of long-axis workpieces, parallel clamping of plate-shaped workpieces and the like can be intelligently met.

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot force sensor calibration equipment, and relates to a humanoid robot force sensor calibration device which comprises a base, a hood, a lower cross beam plate, a lifting part, a horizontal seat mechanism, a counterweight mechanism, a central stress mechanism, a horizontal force application part, a vertical force application part, a force sensor test assembly and a clamping positioning part. abstract: The invention discloses a hand exoskeleton mechanism and a humanoid robot teleoperation system. title: System and method for testing artificial limbs of bionic lower limb robot
abstract: The invention provides a bionic lower limb robot artificial limb test system and method. The system comprises a humanoid robot test main body, a load module, a support module and a data acquisition module, the humanoid robot testing main body at least comprises human lower limb joints and is used for simulating human lower limb walking; the human body lower limb joint comprises at least one of a knee joint, an ankle joint and a foot modularization, and at least part of the human body lower limb joint can be replaced by an artificial limb to-be-tested unit, so that the humanoid robot test main body can drive the artificial limb to-be-tested unit to carry out a walking test; the load module is arranged on the humanoid robot test main body and is used for providing a target load for the artificial limb to-be-tested unit; the supporting module is used for providing a walking road on which the humanoid robot testing main body can carry out a walking test; the data acquisition module is used for monitoring test parameters when the artificial limb to-be-tested unit is subjected to a walking test. According to the invention, a real use scene can be simulated, and accurate detection of the multi-dimensional performance of the artificial limb can be realized.

title: Humanoid robot joint output torque detection device
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robot detection, in particular to a humanoid robot joint output torque detection device. The invention aims to provide the joint output torque detection device for the humanoid robot, which has the advantages of non-invasive detection, complete machine detection and deep diagnosis and is used for joint performance detection. According to the technical scheme, the humanoid robot joint output torque detection device comprises a mounting cabin, and the left side of the mounting cabin is fixedly connected with a connecting plate. According to the invention, the assembly plate is mounted at the framework connecting piece and the clamping mechanism is used for clamping at the movable arm, so that a rigid measurement link from the joint to the rotation sensor module can be constructed in a complete real machine assembly state of the robot without disassembling core movement and transmission parts in a joint area of the robot; the measured torque, rotating speed and angle data completely reflect the output performance of the joint under real mechanical structure constraint and assembly stress, and the data are real and reliable.

title: Data transmission method, device and system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a data transmission method, device and system of a humanoid robot. A load rate on a first protocol network is determined; the first protocol network is a controller local area network; under the condition that the load rate on the first protocol network is greater than a first threshold value and the node type corresponding to the data flow is a first type of nodes, determining the load rate on a second protocol network and the node type corresponding to the data flow on the second protocol network, and determining a regulation and control instruction based on the load rate and the node type; the second protocol network is Ethernet; the first type of nodes are simultaneously connected with the first protocol network and the second protocol network; the regulation and control instruction is used for indicating to adjust a node currently processed by the second protocol network; and controlling the second protocol network to carry out transmission processing on the data stream of the first type of nodes based on the regulation and control instruction. The data transmission method provided by the invention can effectively improve the reliability and bandwidth of data transmission of the humanoid robot.

title: Human-like definition and core feature construction principle based on artificial intelligence (AI) compatible layer
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid definition and core feature construction method and system based on an AI compatible layer, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid agents. According to the invention, on the basis of cross-domain bidirectional mapping and closed-loop optimization core logic of an AI bidirectional interaction parent patent (named as a cross-domain bidirectional adaptation method and system based on an AI compatible layer), a human-like definition misunderstanding of traditional'function replication 'and'material form binding' is broken through; a general definition principle of ''humanoid = electronic brain to human brain simulation degree + cross-domain signal bidirectional collaboration + personality consistency closed loop'' is innovatively proposed, a 0-1 simulation degree scale (simulation degree belongs to the range of 0, 1) is matched, and humanoid non-human boundary and exemplary hierarchical logic are clarified. The core of the technical scheme comprises three core feature system construction, cross-domain signal collaborative adaptation, personality consistency calibration and humanoid nature definition, and the corresponding system comprises four modules of core feature modeling, AI compatible layer adaptation, personality calibration and humanoid definition. According to the method, specific parameters, equipment and algorithms are not bound, the method is suitable for multiple scenes such as a humanoid electronic brain, a virtual digital human and an intelligent robot, a protection closed loop of'underlying principle + definition standard 'is formed with a parent patent, a unified underlying standard is provided for high-simulation humanoid technology landing, the research and development cost is reduced, and an iteration space is reserved.

title: Self-adaptive walking supporting system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a self-adaptive walking supporting system and method for a humanoid robot. The method is applicable to the technical field of humanoid robots. The self-adaptive walking supporting system for the humanoid robot comprises a movable support, a connecting column and a supporting structure. The moving support is arranged on the outer side of the humanoid robot in a sleeving mode, the moving support is provided with driving wheels with the adjustable rotating speed, and the moving support can move through the driving wheels. The connecting column is arranged on the movable support and extends in the height direction. The supporting structure is arranged on the connecting column, the supporting structure is provided with an output end, and the supporting structure can provide supporting force for the humanoid robot through the output end. Therefore, the effects of being simple in structure and capable of providing reliable and stable supporting can be achieved.

title: Construction method and system of motor-driven dynamic control model
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of motor driving control, in particular to a construction method and system of a dynamic control model driven by a motor. The method comprises the following steps of: acquiring operation data of the non-electrolytic capacitor motor driving system under different control parameters to form a full-power section operation data set; performing multi-scale analysis and high-dimensional compression feature decoupling on the full-power section operation data set to obtain a multi-scale dynamic feature vector; constructing a nonlinear regression model capable of being used for real-time control quantity prediction according to the multi-scale dynamic feature vector; deploying a nonlinear regression model in a controller of the non-electrolytic capacitor motor driving system; and executing motor driving control by utilizing the predictive control quantity output by the nonlinear regression model so as to form an electrolytic capacitor-free motor driving strategy. Through high-dimensional dynamic coupling compression representation learning, an electrolytic capacitor-free motor driving strategy of intelligent voltage stabilization regulation and control is constructed to support efficient and steady operation of the humanoid robot.

title: Wrist joint of manipulator and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a wrist joint of a manipulator and a control method, the wrist joint comprises a hollow base, the upper end of the base is provided with a holder through a first electric telescopic rod, the bottom of the holder is connected with the first electric telescopic rod through a first universal structure, and the first electric telescopic rod is connected to the center of the holder of the base; a second electric telescopic rod is arranged on one side of the first electric telescopic rod in parallel, the upper end of the second electric telescopic rod is connected to the edge of the lower end face of the holder through a flexible rubber ball hinge structure, a tension spring is arranged on the other side of the first electric telescopic rod in parallel, and the two ends of the tension spring are connected between the base and the holder through connecting pieces. And an attitude sensor is mounted on the holder. The control method comprises steps S1 to S5. According to the invention, the driving of a plurality of ball screws and the structural design of the corresponding universal joints are adopted, so that the high-precision movement of the wrist joint in multiple directions is realized, the wrist movement of a person can be accurately simulated, the movement range is wide and flexible, and the requirement of the high-simulation movement of the wrist of the high-simulation humanoid robot can be met.

title: Humanoid robot training system and humanoid robot control system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot training system and a humanoid robot control system.The humanoid robot training system comprises the steps that humanoid robot joint angle information, inertia measurement parameters of a base and foot contact force between feet and the ground are collected; the upper limb command generation module generates an upper limb action instruction according to the application requirement of the robot; the upper limb control module calculates a torque control instruction of upper limb joints based on the upper limb action instruction and drives the upper limbs of the humanoid robot to execute actions; the lower limb command generation module generates lower limb action instructions according to walking task requirements of the humanoid robot and sends the lower limb action instructions to the lower limb control module; the lower limb control module inputs joint angle information, inertia measurement parameters, foot contact force, lower limb action instructions and lower limb joint torque at the last moment into a lower limb control instruction calculation model to be trained; and performing model training according to a preset reward function and input and output of the lower limb control module. The adaptive capacity of the robot to internal disturbance is improved through the system.

title: Lubricating grease as well as preparation method and application thereof
abstract: The invention discloses lubricating grease as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and the lubricating grease comprises the following components in percentage by weight: 1.5-2.5% of an organic friction improver, 0.5-1.0% of an ashless organic friction improver, 0.5-1.0% of an anti-wear agent, 0.8-1.2% of an extreme pressure additive, 7.0-8.0% of C12-C18 hydroxy fatty acid, 2.0-2.5% of C6-C12 dicarboxylic acid, 3.0-3.5% of oil-based lithium hydroxide, 0.1-0.2% of alkaline earth metal hydroxide, 10-20% of V-type base oil and the balance of base oil, and the balance of IV type base oil. According to the invention, the friction coefficient can be effectively reduced, so that the robot lubricating grease has a relatively low friction coefficient, and the problem of precise operation control of humanoid robot joints is solved; the cable has good high and low temperature resistance, can work for a long time in an environment of-40 to 150 DEG C, and can adapt to a wide working environment.

title: Joint driving module and dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model provides a joint driving module and a dexterous hand, a first driver and a third driver in the joint driving module are designed in parallel, and the first driver and the third driver which are designed in parallel and a linear transmission assembly connected with the first driver and the third driver are connected in parallel. The first knuckles of the fingers of the dexterous hand can realize active bending and side-sway movement; the second drivers and the linear transmission assemblies connected with the second drivers enable the second knuckles of the fingers of the dexterous hand to be actively bent, the fingers of the dexterous hand have three degrees of freedom, and the three drivers are arranged in the dexterous hand, so that the fingers of the dexterous hand have three degrees of freedom and are more humanoid.

title: Ankle structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an ankle structure and a humanoid robot. The ankle structure comprises a shank rack, a first joint module, a second joint module and a U-shaped frame with an upward opening. An assembly opening is formed in the lower end of the shank rack; the first joint module extends in the left-right direction, a first shell of the first joint module is fixedly connected with the upper middle portion of the shank rack, and a radial extending part is arranged on the periphery of a first output shaft of the first joint module. The second joint module extends in the front-back direction and is arranged in the assembling opening, and the left side and the right side of a second shell of the second joint module are rotationally connected with the shank rack. The U-shaped frame is arranged below the shank rack, and a foot plate is arranged at the bottom of the U-shaped frame; the second joint module is erected in an opening of the U-shaped frame, a second output shaft at the front end of the second joint module is fixedly connected with the U-shaped frame, and the rear end of a second shell of the second joint module is rotationally connected with the U-shaped frame; and the second shell is in transmission fit with the radial extension part through a connecting rod. The ankle structure is simplified, meanwhile, the integration level of the ankle structure is improved, and maintenance and disassembly are convenient.

title: VEM-robot craniofacial end-to-end emotion bionic system
abstract: The VEM-robot craniofacial end-to-end emotion bionic system disclosed by the invention comprises hardware of bionic eyeballs, bionic skin, a bionic mouth, bionic ears and a bionic neck, and realizes real-time and anthropomorphic direct interaction between a robot and a real person under the management support of the end-to-end emotion bionic system, end-to-end emotional simulation is realized from the input ends of binaural hearing, binocular vision, face touch, lip touch, environmental perception and emergency capture to the output ends of binocular expression, skull flexibility, emotional sound, mandibular flexibility, face expression and mouth expression, and intervention of a third party such as a remote controller or background manual work is not needed. According to the system, methods of expression self-learning, interaction object long-time-sequence interaction, memory personalized emotion adaptation, hyperparallel comparison emotion calculation and the like are adopted, an entity emotion craniofacial capable of recognizing people, simulating human expressions, crossing interaction and personalized emotion interaction is achieved, and a multi-mode emotion bionic head is provided for an existing humanoid robot body.

title: Low-energy-consumption humanoid robot knee axial magnetic flux motor topological structure and optimization method
abstract: The invention relates to a low-energy-consumption humanoid robot knee axial magnetic flux motor topological structure and an optimization method, and relates to the technical field of motor design and robots, and the low-energy-consumption humanoid robot knee axial magnetic flux motor topological structure comprises a stator structure, a rotor structure and an axial gap adjusting mechanism; the stator structure comprises a modularized stator iron core formed by laminating a plurality of fan-shaped silicon steel sheets, a centralized stator winding wound on the stator iron core, and heat dissipation grooves arranged on the stator iron core. The modularized stator iron core is used for forming a magnetic circuit base of the stator and is convenient to manufacture and install. According to the low-energy-consumption knee axial magnetic flux motor topological structure of the humanoid robot and the optimization method, through the unique stator and rotor structural design and the combination of the modular stator iron core and the centralized winding, the power density of the motor is effectively improved, the manufacturing complexity is reduced, the magnetic field intensity is enhanced, and the magnetic circuit loss is reduced; and the overall performance and reliability of the motor are obviously improved.

title: Emotion accompanying humanoid robot system based on multi-modal interaction and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an emotion accompanying humanoid robot system based on multi-modal interaction and a control method thereof, the emotion accompanying humanoid robot system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data processing unit and a control unit: the data acquisition unit is configured to acquire physiological parameters and/or behavior data of a target user; the data processing unit is configured to obtain a user state feature vector through a user state recognition model according to the physiological parameters and/or behavior data; the control unit is configured to respond to a request of the target user and/or monitor that the target user triggers a preset condition, read a real-time user state feature vector, and input the user state feature vector into a generative dialogue model and/or a massage control algorithm to obtain output for the request of the target user. The problem that in the prior art, personalized accompanying and coping based on user emotion are difficult to achieve, and the intelligent accompanying effect of the robot is limited is at least solved.

title: Humanoid robot anthropomorphic walking method fusing human motion redirection and model prediction control
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot anthropomorphic walking method fusing human motion redirection and model prediction control, which belongs to the field of robot control and comprises the following steps of: processing human walking data by adopting a motion redirection method to obtain a joint state sequence and a foot end contact mask matched with physical characteristics of a robot; based on the joint state sequence and the foot end contact mask, a model prediction control method is adopted to conduct rolling optimization on a mass center momentum dynamic model, and a high-level motion instruction containing the joint angle and the contact force is obtained; and a whole-body controller is adopted to process the high-layer motion instruction to obtain a joint torque instruction meeting whole-body dynamics and physical constraints, and the robot is driven to execute humanoid walking based on the joint torque instruction. According to the method, human body action redirection and model prediction control are fused, so that coordination of humanoid walking of the humanoid robot on naturalness and stability is realized.

title: Behavior labeling method based on end-to-end humanoid robot large model and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a behavior labeling method based on an end-to-end humanoid robot large model and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-modal sensing data; extracting the multi-modal sensing data by using an end-to-end humanoid robot large model to obtain multiple groups of query vectors; encoding the prompt word text by adopting a preset text encoder to obtain a text encoding vector; preprocessing the plurality of groups of query vectors to obtain a final query coding vector; splicing the final query coding vector and the text coding vector to obtain a model input vector; and inputting the model input vector into the multi-modal large language model to generate and obtain a labeling result. According to the embodiment of the invention, multiple groups of data can be fused, and three-dimensional and multi-dimensional understanding is formed for the task scene, so that the limitation of single sensor information is avoided. According to the method, the labeling precision and interpretability are improved, and the method is suitable for multiple scenes such as industrial cooperation and household service.

title: Humanoid robot operation control method based on VLA model and adaptive constraint following
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a humanoid robot operation control method based on a VLA model and adaptive constraint following, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring multi-modal data of a humanoid robot through a multi-modal data acquisition module, and converting the acquired multi-modal data into aligned and unified feature vectors through the VLA model; and outputting the feature vectors into kinematics constraints satisfied by the operation of the human-shaped robot through a VLA model, integrating the kinematics constraints into a mathematical constraint set required by a Udwadiia-Kalaaba method, and predicting and outputting a possible uncertainty fuzzy set. According to the robot control system, role reconstruction and targeted pre-training are carried out on an existing VLA model, meanwhile, the constraint following control capability of the Udwadiia-Kalaaba theory is introduced, and the requirements for real-time performance, accuracy and robustness of execution of complex dynamic operation tasks can be met.

title: Automatic OTA upgrading method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot OTA automatic upgrading method and system, and relates to the field of robot software maintenance, and the method comprises the steps: determining a target robot set based on robot state information; issuing batch upgrading tasks to the target robot set, and performing installation and upgrading by using a silent installation method; collecting the current battery electric quantity of the robot; if the current battery electric quantity is lower than the upgrading maintaining threshold value, determining a nearest target charging area according to the current robot position; an idle robot is determined based on the current robot position, the idle robot is controlled to carry the current robot to the target charging area for charging, and meanwhile the silent installation process is completed in the target charging area; and after the installation upgrade is completed, automatically running a self-checking program to verify the core function, and when an upgrade self-checking result accords with a preset self-checking requirement result, marking the upgraded version information as upgrade success and reporting the upgraded version information to the cloud management platform. The method has the effect of improving the upgrading efficiency of the robot.

title: Humanoid robot scene adaptive task planning method based on multi-mode-motion coupling world model and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot scene adaptive task planning method based on a multi-mode-motion coupling world model and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and robots. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a task instruction, collecting multi-modal data, and uniformly encoding the multi-modal data to obtain multi-modal fusion embedded data; performing feature association on the multi-modal fusion embedded data through an improved multi-modal-motion coupling world model to obtain a text action instruction and a multi-modal feature vector; according to the multi-modal feature vector, motion constraint guided feature mapping is executed, and a condition feature vector is obtained; generating a fusion image to obtain the fusion image; and taking the text action instruction as a new task instruction, taking the fusion image as new multi-modal data, and returning to the step of receiving the task instruction, collecting the multi-modal data and then uniformly encoding until the output fusion image meets a preset condition. The motion coordination, scene adaptability and task success rate of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Double-arm follow-up system of humanoid robot guided by binocular vision
abstract: The invention discloses a binocular vision guided humanoid robot two-arm follow-up system which comprises a robot body, the robot body comprises a trunk, a head, mechanical arms symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the trunk and mechanical legs arranged below the trunk, and the tail ends of the mechanical arms are provided with multi-fingered dexterous hands; a touch sensor is arranged at the fingertip part of the multi-fingered dexterous hand; the vision module is fixedly arranged on the head and used for collecting vision information of a target object and the surrounding environment of the target object, and the vision module at least comprises a pair of binocular cameras and used for obtaining stereoscopic vision point cloud data of the target object; the control module is arranged in the trunk and electrically connected with the vision module, the mechanical arms and the mechanical legs; according to the system and the method, through the special concave curvature analysis sub-module and the concave curvature adaptation evaluation function, the robot can actively recognize and preferentially utilize the concave area on the surface of the object to grab.

title: Biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot, the biped robot adopts a support plate and two foot mechanisms, the two foot mechanisms are arranged on the support plate, each foot mechanism comprises a first driving part, a second driving part, a first connecting rod, a second connecting rod, a third connecting rod, a fourth connecting rod and a sliding block, the first driving part and the second driving part are arranged on the support plate, and the first driving part and the second driving part are arranged on the support plate. title: Thoracic cavity structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a thoracic cavity structure and a humanoid robot. The front plate comprises an upper bulge, a main body plate and a lower bulge which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; a lower groove matched with the lower bulge is formed in the top of the bottom plate; the lower protrusion is in bolted connection with the bottom plate, and the bottom face of the main body plate abuts against the bottom plate. The upper end of the main body plate is in bolted connection with the top plate, and the top surface of the main body plate abuts against the bottom surface of the top plate; a weight-reducing notch is formed in the bottom of the top plate; the upper protrusion is arranged in the weight reduction notch, and the top face of the upper protrusion abuts against the top face of the weight reduction notch. The left plate and the right plate are respectively clamped with the main body plate; the upper and lower ends of the rear plate are respectively connected with the top plate and the bottom plate. abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of humanoid robots, and provides a humanoid robot teleoperation method and device and a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the pose information of a VR motion controller, and obtaining VR pose information; according to the VR pose information, pose information of the tail end of an arm of the humanoid robot is determined, and tail end pose information is obtained; and performing cooperative control on the head of the humanoid robot according to the tail end pose information, and/or performing cooperative control on the waist of the humanoid robot according to the tail end pose information. title: Automatic calibration method and system of humanoid robot vision system and medium
abstract: The invention provides an automatic calibration method and system for a humanoid robot vision system and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a CSV configuration file which comprises a plurality of groups of predefined joint angle sequences meeting preset requirements; wherein each group of joint angle sequence corresponds to one calibration posture; s2, carrying out integrity verification on the obtained CSV configuration file; s3, controlling a target mechanical arm to move to a corresponding calibration posture according to a predefined joint angle sequence meeting a preset requirement in the verified CSV configuration file; s4, camera images, end effector poses and joint angle data are synchronously collected at each pose, and full-automatic batch collection of hand-eye calibration data is achieved; and S5, calculating a transformation matrix of the camera and the tail end of the mechanical arm through a hand-eye calibration algorithm on the basis of the camera image collected on each pose and the pose of the tail end executor.

abstract: The invention provides a ubiquitous humanoid robot motion controller capable of being quickly deployed and a deployment method, and aims to solve the problem of quickly realizing a walking function of a humanoid robot, the motion controller comprises controller hardware and control software, the control software comprises a model training system, a motor parameter self-adaptive setting part, a real-time communication part and a control software programming interface, and can be conveniently butted with third-party simulation and training software through the designed interface to perform reinforcement learning training and simulation of a robot decision model; and the acquisition of related control parameters, the tuning of the related control parameters and the adaptation of humanoid robot hardware can be automatically carried out, the rapid deployment basically irrelevant to the robot hardware body is realized, and the software adaptation efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Autonomous navigation flexible operation wheel type humanoid intelligent robot
abstract: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation flexible operation wheel type humanoid intelligent robot, and relates to the technical field of intelligent robots. title: Lower limb assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb assembly and a humanoid robot. The lower limb assembly comprises shanks, thighs and wire harnesses. According to the invention, the wiring harness is prevented from being exposed outside the lower limb assembly, and the wiring harness is well protected.

title: Humanoid robot with wire harness protection and motion mode switching method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot with a wire harness protection function and a motion mode switching method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots. The humanoid robot comprises a robot body, a movable base, a mechanical arm, a multi-mode sensor and a controller; the movable base is arranged at the bottom of the robot body, the mechanical arms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the robot body, the multi-mode sensor is assembled on the movable base, and the controller is in communication connection with the mechanical arms and the multi-mode sensor. A wire harness used for supplying power and transmitting signals is arranged in the mechanical arm, a redundant length is reserved for the wire harness, a bending part is formed, the minimum curvature radius of the bending part is not smaller than the minimum safe bending radius allowed by the wire harness, and the controller is configured to adapt to moving mode switching of the robot so as to maintain the wire harness protection state. Stress damage in the wire harness movement process is reduced, the service life of the wire harness is prolonged, meanwhile, cooperative adaptation of movement mode switching and wire harness protection is achieved, and the movement stability of the mechanical arm and the long-term operation reliability of the robot are improved.

title: Humanoid robot paralysis failure diagnosis method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot falling failure diagnosis method and system, and relates to the field of robot fault diagnosis, and the method comprises the steps: determining a current abnormal motion combination in response to a robot falling signal; searching an abnormal combination number based on the current abnormal combination; accumulating abnormal times; when the abnormal frequency exceeds a reliable abnormal frequency threshold value, determining a suspected abnormal state of the power panel; executing a PCBA test method based on the suspected abnormal state of the power panel, and outputting a verification completion signal; when the verification completion signal does not exist, a current robot action combination is collected in real time; determining a predicted abnormal action combination based on the current robot action combination and the abnormal combination number; determining predicted risk time; when the predicted risk time is smaller than the shortest processing time threshold value, robot action adjusting parameters are determined; and executing a robot action adjusting operation. The method has high diagnosis accuracy and efficiency, and unnecessary diagnosis can be avoided.

title: Tendon-driven intelligent humanoid robot with body and control system
abstract: The invention discloses a tendon-driven intelligent humanoid robot with a body and a control system, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problems that an existing humanoid robot is often stiff during joint movement, and the flexible movement of human muscles is difficult to simulate are solved, and by dynamically adjusting the frequency, the amplitude and the phase of a driving signal and combining a self-adaptive frequency algorithm and a closed-loop control strategy, the flexible movement of the human muscles is simulated. It is ensured that the humanoid robot body can achieve quick response and accurate motion control in different task scenes; a phase synchronization algorithm is adopted to dynamically adjust the phase of a multi-joint driving signal, the execution efficiency of a multi-joint cooperative task is optimized, the fluency and stability of the motion of the humanoid robot body are enhanced, and the humanoid robot body can complete complex motions more efficiently; and the weight coefficient of the control parameter is dynamically adjusted according to the real-time motion state and the environment information, so that the humanoid robot body can flexibly adapt to different task scenes and load conditions.

title: Human-computer interaction virtual fitting method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a human-computer interaction virtual fitting method for a humanoid robot. According to the method, the humanoid robot naturally interacts with a user, firstly, a human body image of the user is obtained under voice prompt, and the user is guided to select target clothes; generating posture key point information of the user and a mask map of a human body irrelevant region by using posture estimation and semantic segmentation; for open coat type clothes, a MaskNet model is constructed to carry out region prediction on the coat, and a combined clothes image is generated based on clothes geometric alignment and a background fusion technology. And further constructing a virtual fitting model, carrying out feature coding and diffusion generation on the input combined clothing image, mask image and human body posture image, and outputting a vivid virtual fitting image by the model. And finally, the humanoid robot displays a fitting result on a display screen of the humanoid robot. According to the method, natural and coherent fitting experience can be realized in an entity interaction scene, and higher adaptability and generation quality are achieved when complex clothing structures such as open jackets are processed.

title: Human-shaped trunk system with automatic battery replacement function
abstract: The invention relates to a human-shaped trunk system with an automatic battery replacement function. The human-shaped trunk system comprises a trunk appearance shell assembly (1), a standby storage battery assembly (2), a battery bin system assembly (3) and a battery recycling mechanism assembly (4) which are matched with one another. The battery compartment system assembly (3) comprises a large battery (32), a battery moving mechanism assembly (33), a door opening transmission mechanism assembly (34), a limiting sliding block assembly (35) and a contact type power supply system (36) which are arranged in a battery compartment shell metal plate (31), and the large battery (32) is connected with a point contact type switch of the contact type power supply system (36) when being put back into a battery compartment to form a closed loop; the door opening transmission mechanism assembly (34) is matched with the cabin door assembly (121), and the cabin door assembly (121) is arranged right opposite to the battery bin system assembly (3). The battery replacement device has the advantages that automatic battery replacement is achieved, the replacement efficiency is improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the cruising ability and sustainability of operation of the humanoid robot are guaranteed.
abstract_en: The invention relates to a human-shaped trunk system with an automatic battery replacement function. The battery compartment system assembly (3) comprises a large battery (32), a battery moving mechanism assembly (33), a door opening transmission mechanism assembly (34), a limiting sliding block assembly (35) and a contact type power supply system (36) which are arranged in a battery compartment shell metal plate (31), and the large battery (32) is connected with a point contact type switch of the contact type power supply system (36) when being put back into a battery compartment to form a closed loop; the door opening transmission mechanism assembly (34) is matched with the cabin door assembly (121), and the cabin door assembly (121) is arranged right opposite to the battery bin system assembly (3). The battery replacement device has the advantages that automatic battery replacement is achieved, the replacement efficiency is improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the cruising ability and sustainability of operation of the humanoid robot are guaranteed.

title: Autonomous battery replacing system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot autonomous battery replacing system and a battery replacing method. Unmanned automatic battery replacing is achieved based on a robot and a mobile battery replacing cabinet. title: Wearable human exoskeleton for measuring motion state of waist of human body
abstract: The utility model provides a wearable human exoskeleton for measuring the motion state of the waist of a human body. The wearable human exoskeleton comprises an exoskeleton body, a push rod, a sensor, a fixing plate, a sliding block, a sliding rail and a seat. The exoskeleton is of a back belt-shaped structure and is worn by a human body; the three push rods are of telescopic structures and are arranged into a triangle; one end of each push rod is provided with a sensor which measures the telescopic distance of the push rod caused by the motion of the waist of the human body; the ends, provided with the sensors, of the three push rods share one fixing plate, and the sensors are hinged to the fixing plate. The other ends of the connecting rods are respectively hinged to the exoskeleton; the sliding rail is fixed to the seat in the vertical direction. The sliding block is fixed to the bottom of the fixing plate and moves up and down along the sliding rail. According to the utility model, human exoskeleton waist joint motion data can be collected and mapped to the humanoid robot, so that the difficulty of motion control is reduced; and the accuracy and the flexibility of controlling the waist joint of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid model toy and shoulder structure thereof
abstract: The utility model relates to a human-shaped model toy and a shoulder structure thereof, and the shoulder structure comprises a trunk joint, a first joint, a second joint and an arm joint; one end of the trunk joint is used for being connected with a trunk of the humanoid model toy, the other end of the trunk joint is hinged to one end of the first joint, the other end of the first joint is hinged to one end of the second joint, the other end of the second joint is hinged to one end of the arm joint, and the other end of the arm joint is used for being connected with an arm of the humanoid model toy; the shoulder structure of the human-shaped model toy has a contraction state and an expansion state; when the shoulder structure of the humanoid model toy is in an unfolded state, the arm joints can rotate relative to the other ends of the second joints so as to drive the arms to be close to the chest of the trunk or away from the chest of the trunk. According to the technical scheme of the utility model, the movable range of the arm joints can be enlarged, so that the arms can realize a natural chest-holding posture.

title: Joint driving assembly, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a joint driving assembly, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. The joint driving assembly comprises a transmission shaft (13), a motor (1) and a bearing (14), wherein the motor (1) and the bearing (14) are located in a shell (21). A coil stator (11) of the motor (1) is coaxially and annularly arranged outside a magnet rotor (12), and the axial front end of the coil stator (11) is higher than the magnet rotor (12), so that an accommodating space is axially formed between the coil stator (11) and the magnet rotor (12). An inner ring of the bearing (14) is connected to the outer wall of the annular step (132) of the transmission shaft (13), and at least part of the inner ring is located within the height range of the coil stator (11) in the axial direction. In this way, the axial size of the joint driving assembly can be shortened, and the structure of the joint driving assembly is more compact.

title: Humanoid model toy and crotch structure thereof
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid model toy and a crotch structure thereof, the crotch structure comprises a crotch, the crotch is provided with a first joint, a second joint and a connecting part, and the connecting part is used for being connected with the upper half body of the humanoid model toy; the first joint is used for being connected with a front skirt of the humanoid model toy; the second joints are used for being connected with legs of the humanoid model toy; the first joint and the second joint can rotate relative to the crotch; wherein the crotch structure of the humanoid model toy has at least two states: in the first state, the first joint and the second joint are both located at initial positions, so that the upper body is in an upright state relative to the legs; in the second state, the first joint drives the front skirt armor to rotate forwards to the first position, and the second joint drives the leg to rotate forwards to the second position, so that the upper half body is in a forward leaning state relative to the leg. According to the technical scheme of the utility model, the mobility of the upper half body is increased, and the stability of the model is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot joint end cover die-casting tool
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of end cover die-casting, and particularly relates to a humanoid robot joint end cover die-casting tool which comprises a die-casting table, a cavity locking mechanism, a die-casting mechanism and a temperature control mechanism, the cavity locking mechanism is arranged on the upper wall of the die-casting table, the die-casting mechanism comprises a driving assembly and a liquid pressing assembly, the driving assembly is arranged on the side wall of one end of the die-casting table, and the liquid pressing assembly is arranged on the side wall of the other end of the die-casting table. The liquid pressing assembly is arranged at the end, away from the die-casting table, of the driving assembly, and the temperature control mechanism comprises a gas collection assembly, a closing assembly and a cooling assembly. According to the humanoid robot joint end cover die-casting tool, the temperature of a casting in a mold cavity in the cooling process can be monitored, the cooling temperature and the cooling speed of the casting can be controlled, severe temperature difference changes are eliminated, and therefore the casting quality is improved.

title: Multi-objective optimization method for motor winding of humanoid robot joint module and application of multi-objective optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization method of a humanoid robot joint module motor winding and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot joint module motor windings. According to the method, a resistance and induced electromotive force model of a PCB winding is established, stator copper loss reduction and phase voltage improvement are taken as targets, an improved NSGA-II algorithm is adopted to solve an optimization variable (an included angle parameter) after constraint conditions are set, and an optimized winding shape is obtained. According to the method, the problem of lack of winding modeling optimization in the prior art is solved, and the optimized PCB winding is high in parameter consistency and stable in processing. The axial magnetic flux permanent magnet motor applying the winding adapts to shoulder, hip and knee joint driving, and the motion flexibility and cruising ability of the robot are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot high-precision map construction method fusing ontology perception and external semantics
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot high-precision map construction method fusing ontology perception and external semantics, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, multi-source data collection and preprocessing; s2, feature extraction and pose estimation; s3, performing multi-source data fusion and semantic association; s4, carrying out space-vision-language fusion; s5, constructing a multi-resolution semantic map; s6, dynamic target elimination and map consistency maintenance; s7, VLM auxiliary verification and false alarm correction are carried out; and S8, incremental map updating and long-term learning. According to the method, full-link enhancement from data acquisition, fusion and understanding to optimization is realized, and finally, the robot can construct and utilize a high-precision and high-reliability semantic map to carry out high-level autonomous navigation and natural interaction.

title: Humanoid double-arm robot imitation method and device based on diffusion strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid double-arm robot imitation method and device based on a diffusion strategy. The method is characterized by comprising the following steps: in response to an imitation learning instruction of a double-arm robot, identifying imitation learning demonstration data and imitation learning tasks corresponding to the imitation learning instruction; performing task analysis on the imitation learning task based on a task demand encoder, and determining task condition parameters; and determining a target imitation learning generation model based on the task condition parameters, performing robot imitation learning based on the task condition parameters and the imitation learning demonstration data through the target imitation learning generation model, and determining a robot action sequence. The diversity and accuracy of robot action generation are enhanced, the robot can better simulate complex actions and interaction of human beings, the overall performance and stability of the robot are guaranteed, and the working capacity of mass production service robots is improved.

title: Self-recovery mechanoluminescence fluorescent powder and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses self-recovery mechanoluminescence fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof, and particularly relates to the technical field of functional materials. The invention discloses self-recovery mechanoluminescence fluorescent powder and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of functional materials. The chemical general formula of the fluorescent powder is (Sc1-aLaa) 1-x-y-z-wBO3: Crx, Yby, Erz and Liw, the ScBO3-LaBO3 composite matrix is constructed, and a quaternary rare earth element synergistic doping system is introduced, so that the problems of single matrix, insufficient doping synergy and poor self-recovery property in the prior art are solved. A sol-gel combined low-temperature step-by-step sintering preparation process is adopted, energy consumption is reduced, uniform distribution of doped ions is ensured, and the fluorescent powder has wide-spectrum near-infrared emission, excellent force-light response linearity and excellent self-recovery cycling stability and is suitable for the fields of humanoid robot touch electronic skin flexible sensing devices and the like.

title: Humanoid robot balance control method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot balance control method, system and device and a medium, and relates to the field of robot balance control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the current operation parameters of a humanoid robot in each target direction, and constructing a kinetic model based on the current operation parameters; for any target direction, determining a prediction parameter of the target direction at the next moment by using a Kalman filter based on the current operation parameter of the target direction; determining a control signal of the target direction based on the operation parameter of the previous moment, the current operation parameter and the prediction parameter of the next moment of the target direction; and realizing balance control on the robot based on the dynamic model and the control signals in each target direction. The technical problem that when the posture of the humanoid robot is rapidly adjusted, the center of gravity shifts and even is unstable is solved.

title: Foot bionic device based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a foot bionic device based on a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the foot bionic device comprises a flange joint piece, a top carbon fiber sheet is integrally arranged at the bottom of the flange joint piece, and the flange joint piece and the top carbon fiber sheet form a connecting piece of a robot leg. Compared with the prior art, the robot has the advantages that the Z-shaped spring buffer structure and the multi-layer composite buffer design are designed, vertical impact force is converted into elastic deformation of components, impact energy is effectively absorbed and reduced, then the robot body structure is protected, the deformation degree can be automatically adjusted according to the ground hardness through the multi-layer buffer structure, the terrain adaptability is improved, and the service life of the robot is prolonged. title: Universal robot cognitive architecture based on world model and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a universal robot cognitive architecture based on a world model and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. Aiming at industry pain points that responsibility boundaries are fuzzy and decision-making processes are difficult to trace in large-scale application of robots, the invention provides a robot cognitive system constructed by taking the world as the center, and the robot cognitive system comprises eight functional modules: a first module is used for storing a physical world knowledge base; the second module is used for storing a robot body model; the third module is used for acquiring multi-modal sensing data; the fourth module is used for storing a life entity cognition model; the fifth module is used for storing a life-physical interaction rule base; the sixth module is used for storing a human exclusive knowledge base; the seventh module is used for storing a behavior specification and ethical constraint engine; and the eighth module is used for behavior execution and interaction control. A function-coupled whole is formed among the modules, a complete closed loop from world understanding to behavior generation is formed, and the seventh module is independent and preferential and performs compliance verification on all actions; the system is equipped with a traceable recording mechanism to ensure that marks are reserved in the whole key decision-making process. According to the method, responsibility is taken as a principal line for through design, so that the robot has explainable, traceable and responsible core capabilities on the basis of understanding the physical world, the life entity and the human society, and a technical guarantee is provided for the humanoid robot to enter home and industrial scenes.

title: Embedded rotor structure and linear actuator with same
abstract: The invention discloses an embedded rotor structure and a linear actuator with the embedded rotor structure. The embedded rotor structure comprises a motor stator, an embedded permanent magnet rotor and a planetary roller screw transmission part. The motor stator comprises a stator iron core and stator three-phase windings arranged in a centralized winding mode, and a high-thermal-conductivity silica gel potting structure is arranged outside the motor stator. The embedded permanent magnet rotor comprises a rotor V-shaped slotted iron core and embedded permanent magnet magnetic steel; the planetary roller lead screw transmission part comprises an outer nut, a thrust lead screw and a planetary roller. The rotor V-shaped slotted iron core is directly attached to the outer nut. Through the design of the embedded V-shaped slotted rotor, a double-flux path is formed, the magnetic circuit impedance is reduced, the flux linkage utilization rate and the reluctance torque are improved, and the thrust density and the output power are enhanced; the permanent magnet embedded structure improves magnetic field distribution and realizes effective field weakening control; the rotor and a transmission part are integrally designed to improve the structural compactness, rigidity and force transmission efficiency, and the robot joint is suitable for humanoid robot joints and other scenes.

title: Mechanical arm tail end suction cup structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a mechanical arm tail end suction cup structure of a humanoid robot. Comprising a rotary driving unit fixedly connected to the tail end of the mechanical arm; the suction cup assembly is connected with the output end of the rotary driving unit and rotates around the axis of the suction cup assembly; and the air source supply unit comprises an air pump and an air pipe. The method for grabbing the parcels through the suction cup structure comprises the following steps that the visual system recognizes the positions and contours of the parcels; a mechanical arm is controlled to move, and a center suction cup is aligned with the center area of the parcel grabbing face; a rotation driving unit is controlled to drive the suction cup assembly to rotate, so that the layout direction of the peripheral suction cup is matched with the outline of the package; the air source supply unit is started, and the package is adsorbed through the flexible suction cup; after the parcels are put, the suction cup assembly resets. The device has the advantages of being rapid in positioning, simplified in algorithm, high in adsorption adaptability, high in adsorption capacity, compact in structure and high in practicability.

abstract: The invention discloses a robot head and neck structure and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots, the robot head and neck structure is connected with a robot head part and a robot body part, and the robot head and neck structure comprises a side swing mechanism, a horizontal rotating mechanism and a pitching mechanism which are sequentially connected from top to bottom; the side-sway mechanism is connected with the robot head and drives the robot head to do side-sway motion; the horizontal rotating mechanism is used for driving the side swinging mechanism and the robot head to horizontally rotate; the pitching mechanism is connected with the robot body part and used for driving the horizontal rotating mechanism, the side swing mechanism and the robot head to do pitching motion. title: Chassis structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a chassis structure and a humanoid robot. title: Hand multi-modal information sensing device and robot humanoid skill learning method
abstract: The invention provides a hand multi-mode information sensing device and a robot humanoid skill learning method, and the device comprises a multi-mode touch sensor module which is used for sensing a hand multi-mode touch signal; the flexible strain sensor module is used for sensing a hand joint bending signal; the multi-modal motion capture module is used for sensing hand motion and posture signals, and the hand motion and posture signals comprise hand motion signals and/or hand posture signals; at least one of the hand multi-mode touch signals, the hand joint bending signals and the hand movement and posture signals forms hand multi-mode information representing gesture actions, hand movement and hand touch. title: AI humanoid robot interaction method and system based on multi-modal biological characteristics
abstract: The invention discloses an AI humanoid robot interaction method and system based on multi-modal biological characteristics, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the specific steps: firstly, collecting the motion posture data of a humanoid robot body, constructing a coordinate system transformation matrix, and calculating the relative space parameters of a user and a collection module; collecting parameters are adjusted in a linkage mode, multi-mode biological characteristic data are synchronously collected, data space-time alignment and low-quality data reconstruction are completed, interaction intention is reasoned after identity authentication and living body verification, finally interaction is executed, and user feedback data are collected. Through the integrated architecture design of a posture linkage acquisition parameter matching formula, a multi-modal mutual supervision enhanced loss function and a ternary joint representation adaptive weight formula, the problems of biological characteristic acquisition mismatch and space-time dislocation in a dynamic scene of the robot are solved; and in combination with living body verification, incremental learning and encryption design, the security and long-term operation stability of the scheme are improved.
