title: Self-locking control method for chassis wheel train of humanoid robot and chassis wheel train structure
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot chassis wheel train self-locking control method and a chassis wheel train structure, and belongs to the technical field of robot intelligent control. The system comprises a plurality of steering wheels, a rear swing bridge, a motion controller and a chassis main controller. The multiple steering wheels are distributed at the corners of the chassis body, the two front steering wheels are fixedly installed, and the two rear steering wheels are connected through the rear swing bridge. Each steering wheel comprises a driving and control integrated joint motor with a band-type brake and a direct-drive hub motor without a band-type brake, the driving and control integrated joint motors are used for steering control and angle locking, and the direct-drive hub motors are used for providing walking torque. The self-locking control method comprises the steps that when the static time of the chassis reaches a preset threshold value, all steering wheel steering motors are controlled to rotate so that extension lines of the axes of walking wheels can intersect in a preset area of the chassis, the steering motors are controlled to brake, the walking motors are enabled, and the chassis enters a dormant state. Mechanical self-locking is achieved through a gear train geometric self-locking mechanism, and the gear train self-locking mechanism has the technical advantages of being compact in structure and reducing energy consumption.

title: Angular displacement sensor magnetic grid material for humanoid robot actuator as well as preparation method and application of angular displacement sensor magnetic grid material
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of magnetic grid materials, and particularly discloses an angular displacement sensor magnetic grid material for a humanoid robot actuator and a preparation method and application of the angular displacement sensor magnetic grid material, and the magnetic grid material comprises a substrate, a first AlNiCo layer, a Zr layer, a second AlNiCo layer and a Ti layer which are sequentially stacked. According to the invention, the Zr element with strong oxygen absorption characteristic is introduced as an intercalation layer, and in the high-temperature annealing process, on one hand, Zr is oxidized to form ZrO2, floating and oxidation of Al atoms are inhibited, grains are refined, and a magnetic phase is isolated; on the other hand, a soft magnetic Zr6Co23 intermetallic compound is formed through reaction with Co, and the magnetic performance is cooperatively regulated and controlled. According to the material, when the thickness of a Zr layer is 20 nm, the coercive force reaches 666 Oe and is improved by 111% compared with that of a sample without Zr introduction, meanwhile, the residual magnetism is kept at the high level of 6568 Gs, and the excellent balance of the high coercive force and the high residual magnetism is achieved. The material disclosed by the invention is simple in preparation process, excellent in performance and particularly suitable for a high-precision and miniaturized flexible sensing and driving integrated actuator of a humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot bionic spine flexible driving structure and control system thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot bionic spine flexible driving structure and a control system thereof. The system comprises a state sensing module which collects dynamic motion signals of a bionic spine structure in real time; the reflection control module receives the dynamic motion signal and generates an emergency coordination signal through a preset bionic reflection rule; the advanced decision-making module receives the emergency coordination signal of the reflection control module and generates a multi-dimensional motion control signal through a motion planning algorithm; the unified strategy library module is respectively connected with the reflection control module and the advanced decision-making module, and provides a strategy configuration signal of a reflection rule for the reflection control module; the dynamic execution module is connected with the advanced decision-making module and the state sensing module, receives the multi-dimensional motion control signal and the dynamic motion signal, and generates a driving unit torque distribution signal. According to the humanoid robot bionic spine flexible driving structure and the control system thereof, the problems that an existing humanoid robot waist structure is rigid in movement, poor in impact resistance, high in energy consumption and complex in control can be solved.

title: Switch cabinet live detection method and system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a switch cabinet live detection method and system based on a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of power grids. The target position and the detection item are automatically obtained by analyzing the detection task instruction, and real-time path planning and obstacle avoidance are performed by fusing multi-sensor data, so that the robot can autonomously move to an operation point in an optimal path, and time consumption of reciprocating walking and positioning of personnel is avoided; by controlling the humanoid mechanical arm to automatically switch probes according to detection types and execute standardized detection actions, tedious operations of manually holding, moving and replacing instruments are thoroughly replaced, and repeated measurement caused by misoperation is avoided; real-time fusion analysis and cross validation are performed on multi-source data through a built-in algorithm, and a detection result containing a fault mode is automatically generated, so that real-time intelligent live detection of the switch cabinet is realized, the technical problem of low efficiency of live detection of the switch cabinet is solved, and the detection efficiency of live detection of the switch cabinet is improved.

title: Pneumatic humanoid dexterous hand collaborative planning and robust control method based on digital twinning
abstract: A pneumatic humanoid dexterous hand collaborative planning and robust control method based on digital twinning belongs to the technical field of robot dexterous hand control and pneumatic driving, and comprises the following steps: establishing a digital twinning model and realizing virtual-real bidirectional mapping; constructing a task target and a constraint set, and obtaining a gesture and a capture intention; generating an initial reference trajectory by adopting a multi-quadratic radial basis function interpolation, and performing constraint optimization by taking the initial reference trajectory as a priori and combining full multiple targeting differential dynamic programming and an augmented Lagrange method to obtain a five-finger collaborative trajectory meeting joint boundary and task constraints; establishing a finger Lagrange dynamics and tendon rope transmission model; designing a nonlinear extended state observer to estimate coupling online; and constructing self-adaptive backstepping super-torsion sliding mode control and introducing disturbance compensation to realize high-precision robust tracking. According to the method, the planning feasibility is improved through assistance of the twin environment, and the precision and robustness of the dexterous hand in the grabbing process are remarkably enhanced.

title: Six-dimensional force measurement matrix system and method for multi-terrain gait analysis of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a six-dimensional force measurement matrix system and method for multi-terrain gait analysis of a humanoid robot. The system comprises a modular terrain simulation platform, a six-dimensional force measurement matrix module, a data acquisition and synchronization module and robot gait performance analysis software. The modular terrain simulation platform comprises a rigid leveling module, a slope module and a step module; the six-dimensional force measurement matrix module comprises a plurality of six-dimensional force measurement plates; the data acquisition and synchronization module acquires synchronous matrix data of each six-dimensional force measurement plate; and the robot gait performance analysis software calculates key kinetic parameters and time-space parameters and generates a comprehensive report. According to the invention, three terrains of a rigid flat ground, a slope and steps can be simulated, force and torque of the humanoid robot walking on the terrains are continuously and synchronously acquired through the measurement matrix, and comprehensive, real and accurate evaluation of gait functions is realized. And high-precision and multi-dimensional quantitative evaluation data are provided for gait control algorithm development, dynamic performance calibration and mechanical foot design of the robot.

title: Humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot dexterous hand which comprises a palm, a thumb and four grabbing fingers. According to the humanoid robot dexterous hand, due to the fact that the pushing mechanisms between the fingers are mutually independent, the fingers do not interfere with one another in the working process, the situation that wires are wound together like a traditional wire pulling mode is avoided, and reliability is higher.

title: Tactile sensing module for end effector of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a touch sensing module for an end effector of a humanoid robot. The touch sensing module comprises a light-transmitting support plate (14), a silica gel pad (19), a light-emitting mechanism and a camera component (17), one side of the silica gel pad (19) is attached to the light-transmitting supporting plate (14), and the silica gel pad (19) is made of an elastic material; light emitted by the light-emitting mechanism enters the light-transmitting supporting plate (14), and the light is parallel to the light-transmitting supporting plate (14); the camera component (17) senses the light change caused by the deformation of the silica gel pad (19); wherein one side of the silica gel pad (19), which is far away from the light-transmitting support plate (14), is provided with a dot-shaped matrix graph. The silica gel pad is arranged on one side of the light-transmitting supporting plate, light is guided into the light-transmitting supporting plate through the cooperation of the light guide part and the lamp strip, the deformation quantity of the silica gel pad can be sensed at any time through the camera part, and therefore compared with other touch schemes, the touch display device is high in anti-interference capacity, low in cost and high in producibility and manufacturability.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. A multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot comprises a trunk provided with arms, the arms comprise an upper arm and a lower arm, sliding blocks are symmetrically arranged on the upper arm, corresponding inserting rods are arranged on the symmetrically-arranged sliding blocks, positioning grooves are further formed in the sliding blocks, an annular rail is arranged on the lower arm, and the annular rail corresponds to the positioning grooves; the elbow joint is arranged to be in a clamping type, the structure of the joint part is simplified, the lower arm can be conveniently and rapidly separated from the upper arm and replaced, meanwhile, the lubricating assembly is in linkage with the interior of the upper arm, lubricating oil is automatically extracted from the oil cylinder when the lower arm is disassembled, and the lubricating oil can be automatically fed into the positioning groove when the lower arm is installed. And the elbow joint is lubricated, friction between the annular rail and the positioning groove is reduced, and the rotation of the lower arm is smoother.

title: Training data acquisition device and humanoid robot training system
abstract: The utility model provides a training data acquisition device and a humanoid robot training system.The training data acquisition device comprises a clamping jaw, a driving module and a sensing module, the driving module is connected with the clamping jaw, and the driving module is used for driving the clamping jaw to be opened or closed; the sensing module is arranged on the driving module and used for collecting clamping data of the clamping jaw; the driving module comprises a driving part and at least two transmission parts, the at least two transmission parts are connected with the driving part, each transmission part comprises a worm wheel and a connecting rod mechanism, and the two ends of each connecting rod mechanism are connected with the worm wheel and the clamping jaw respectively. title: Joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint structure and a robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The joint structure comprises a joint assembly, a first driving part and a second driving part, the joint assembly comprises a base part, a movable part and a connecting part, and the connecting part is rotationally arranged relative to the base part along the axis extending in the first direction; the movable part is rotationally arranged relative to the connecting part along the axis extending in the second direction; the first driving piece is arranged on the base part and provided with a first driving rotating shaft arranged in the first direction, and the first driving rotating shaft is in driving connection with the connecting part; the second driving piece is arranged on the connecting part and provided with a second driving rotating shaft arranged in the first direction, and the second driving rotating shaft is in driving connection with the movable part; the first driving piece and the second driving piece are at least partially overlapped in the first direction. title: Sorting device, mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a sorting device, a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, the sorting device is arranged on the mechanical arm, and the sorting device comprises a shell provided with a sorting cavity; the separation net is arranged in the sorting cavity, and the separation net divides the sorting cavity into a collection cavity and an air suction cavity; the sorting pipe is connected to the shell and communicates with the collecting cavity; the sorting cabin is arranged on the shell and communicates with the collecting cavity; the fan is arranged on the shell and located in the air suction cavity, and the fan is used for sucking air from one side of the separation net so that a sorting air channel can be formed between the sorting pipe and the collecting cavity. When particle materials are sorted, the tail end of the sorting pipe is aligned with the particle materials, the particle materials can be quickly sucked into the collecting cavity, a specified air channel is formed through the fan, the structure is simple, and therefore the manufacturing and maintaining cost is reduced. Sorting is achieved through airflow, the complexity of the robot during operation is reduced, the operation difficulty is lowered, and therefore the sorting efficiency is improved.

title: Robot leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the related technical field of robots, and discloses a robot leg structure and a biped robot, a hip joint module in the leg structure comprises a side expansion driving module, a turnover driving module and a pitching driving module, one ends of the three modules are installed on a hip joint installation frame in a series connection mode, and the other ends of the three modules are installed on a hip joint installation frame. The other end of the connecting rod is connected with the thigh part; the knee joint module is located in the containing cavity of the thigh part, the knee joint module comprises a linear driving module, the fixed end of the linear driving module is rotationally connected with the upper portion of the thigh part, the movable end of the linear driving module is in transmission connection with the top of the shank part, and the linear driving module drives the shank part to do pitching motion through linear telescopic movement; the bottom of the shank part is hinged to the foot bottom part through a cross shaft structure, and the ankle joint module is arranged on the shank part and is in transmission connection with the foot bottom part so as to complete pitching and side stretching movement. The design of hybrid driving of the linear and rotary joint modules gives consideration to the requirements of high robustness and low energy consumption of the foot-type robot in a real scene.

title: Head eyeball driving structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of simulation robots, in particular to a humanoid robot head eyeball driving structure which comprises a base plate, a simulation eyeball, a simulation eyelid and an eyelid bottom plate. A transmission gear meshed with the driving gear is coaxially and fixedly arranged on the rotating shaft, a connecting plate is fixedly arranged between the eyelid bottom plate and the base plate, the connecting plate is rotationally provided with a first-stage gear and a second-stage gear, the first-stage gear is meshed with the second-stage gear, and the second-stage gear is meshed with the first-stage gear. The transmission shaft is coaxially and fixedly connected with a side gear meshed with the first-stage gear, an eyelid shaft is rotatably arranged on the eyelid bottom plate, the simulated eyelid is fixedly arranged on the eyelid shaft, an eyelid shaft gear meshed with the second-stage gear is coaxially and fixedly arranged on the eyelid shaft, the simulated eyeball is arranged on the eyelid bottom plate, and the simulated eyeball is arranged on the eyelid bottom plate. The simulation eyelid turnover device has the effect of prolonging the turnover service life of the simulation eyelid.

title: Full-size humanoid robot loading box
abstract: A full-size humanoid robot loading box comprises a loading box body, the loading box body is composed of a robot loading bottom half box body and a robot cover plate top half box body, and the robot cover plate top half box body is buckled to the upper side of the robot loading bottom half box body. A robot loading cavity is formed in the robot loading bottom half box body and used for bearing a robot, knee bending top piers are arranged at the leg positions of the robot loading cavity and used for bearing bent legs of the robot, and the robot cover plate top half box body is composed of a body cover plate part and leg containing cavity parts. The leg containing cavity part and the knee bending top pier are oppositely arranged, one side of the body cover plate part covers the upper side of the body position of the robot loading cavity, an accessory storage cavity is formed in the other side of the body cover plate part, and a sealing cover structure is further arranged on the accessory storage cavity. The box is simple in structure, the robot can be loaded conveniently, and related corollary equipment can be taken and stored in the box conveniently and efficiently.

title: Thoracic cavity structure with detachable battery and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a thoracic cavity structure with a detachable battery and a humanoid robot. The thoracic cavity structure comprises a thoracic cavity bin and a battery pack. The chest chamber is a hollow cavity with a sealed front end and an open rear end; a shoulder and neck base is mounted at the top of the chest chamber; a locking through hole extending in the first direction is formed in the front end of the chest chamber; the first direction is a direction on a vertical plane; the battery pack comprises a box body with an opening in the rear end and a box cover for sealing the box body; the box body is rectangular and is detachably connected with an inner cavity of the chest chamber in a sliding manner; a locking block is connected to the box cover in a sliding mode, and a spring is arranged between the locking block and the box cover. The locking block is suitable for being detachably connected with the locking through hole under the action of the spring; a holding structure is arranged on the rear side of the locking block and extends backwards out of the box cover. According to the utility model, the thoracic cavity cabin, the battery pack and the locking block are matched, so that the disassembly and assembly steps between the thoracic cavity structure and the battery pack are simplified.

title: High-precision zero-backlash NW planetary reducer
abstract: The invention provides a high-precision zero-backlash NW planetary reducer, belongs to the technical field of reducers, and solves the technical problems that the reduction ratio range of an existing humanoid robot is small and the like. When the speed reducer is used, the bevel gear sun gear is driven by an external power source to obtain power, then the bevel gear sun gear drives the first bevel gear planet gears to rotate synchronously, and the first bevel gear planet gears start to rotate after obtaining power subjected to primary speed reduction; the power after primary speed reduction is synchronously transmitted to each bevel gear planet gear II through a gear connecting shaft, and at the moment, each bevel gear planet gear revolves around a bevel gear sun gear while rotating and drives a planet carrier to rotate, so that secondary planetary transmission speed reduction is realized; according to the speed reducer, two stages of bevel gear planet gears are located on the same shaft during speed reduction, the number of teeth of the first stage is larger than that of teeth of the second stage, the directions of the large ends and the small ends of the two stages are opposite, and the effects of offsetting axial force and achieving zero backlash or small backlash while the transmission ratio is high are achieved.

title: Heat dissipation structure, humanoid robot and heat dissipation arrangement method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a heat dissipation structure, a humanoid robot and a heat dissipation arrangement method.The heat dissipation structure comprises a trunk shell, an air inlet and an air outlet are formed in the trunk shell, and the air inlet and the air outlet are arranged in a staggered mode; the first fan is arranged in the trunk shell and is positioned at the air outlet; the supporting seat is arranged in the trunk shell and connected with the trunk shell, a first heating component is arranged on the supporting seat, the supporting seat, the first heating component and the trunk shell form a direct-current air duct, and the direct-current air duct is communicated with the air inlet; the first heat conduction piece is arranged on the side, away from the supporting base, of the first heating component; and the second fan is arranged in the body shell. According to the invention, the cooling effect can be ensured, and the arrangement is convenient.

title: Robot agent evaluation system for lower limb exoskeleton and gait strategy training method corresponding to agent
abstract: The invention relates to a robot agent evaluation system for a lower limb exoskeleton and a gait strategy training method corresponding to an agent, and belongs to the technical field of rehabilitation medical auxiliary equipment. The device comprises a humanoid robot, an exoskeleton, an auxiliary device and a detection element, the exoskeleton is connected with the humanoid robot through the auxiliary device, a first auxiliary structure is provided with a groove, a second auxiliary structure is provided with a protrusion, the groove is connected with the humanoid robot in a clamped mode, and the protrusion is detachably connected with the humanoid robot; the detection elements are installed on the soles of the humanoid robot. The gait of the humanoid robot is adjusted by using a gait strategy training method, so that the humanoid robot can simulate the walking postures of different healthy people or patients with different hemiplegia levels. By wearing the exoskeleton on the device and deploying different walking aid strategies, related data such as angle, torque and power change of each joint, total energy consumption and gait symmetry of the humanoid robot under different walking conditions are obtained, and an exoskeleton developer is assisted to better test and optimize an exoskeleton product.

title: Electro-hydraulic integrated driving bionic humanoid robot upper limb structure and upper limb component
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an electro-hydraulic integrated driving bionic humanoid robot upper limb structure and an upper limb component, which are characterized by comprising a humanoid skeleton structure, and the configuration of the humanoid skeleton structure is constructed by referring to a human upper limb anatomical structure; the ligament system is arranged at the joint of each skeleton to simulate a biological ligament function; the electro-hydraulic integrated driving system comprises a plurality of hydraulic artificial muscle units and a pressure source device, the pressure source device conveys liquid to the hydraulic artificial muscle units through a soft catheter, so that the hydraulic artificial muscle units expand in the radial direction and contract in the axial direction under the action of the pressure source device, and therefore traction force is generated to drive the skeleton structure to achieve joint movement; according to the tendon system, the hydraulic artificial muscle unit is connected with a target skeleton through an artificial tendon. A bionic structure design and an advanced electro-hydraulic driving scheme are deeply fused, the humanoid robot with physiological structure similarity, control response sensitivity and power distribution reasonability is constructed, and the humanoid robot has high degree of freedom, high flexibility and high dynamic performance.

title: High-precision zero-backlash humanoid robot joint speed reducer
abstract: The invention provides a high-precision zero-backlash humanoid robot joint speed reducer, belongs to the technical field of speed reducers, and solves the technical problems that an existing humanoid robot is low in transmission precision, low in repeatable transmission precision and the like. When the speed reducer is used, the bevel gear sun gear is connected with an external power transmission mechanism, so that power is obtained, the bevel gear sun gear rotates to drive the bevel gear planet gears to rotate and revolve around the bevel gear sun gear at the same time, the bevel gear planet gears rotate to drive the planet carrier to rotate at the same time, and first-stage planetary transmission speed reduction is achieved. A gear of a common planetary reducer is changed into a bevel gear, the transmission efficiency and the bearing capacity of the bevel gear are greatly improved compared with those of a harmonic reducer, meanwhile, an elastic piece is additionally arranged on a shaft of a bevel gear planet wheel or the bevel gear planet wheel is loaded on a planet carrier in an axial positioning and pressing mode, and therefore the backlash is adjusted; the transmission precision and the repeatable transmission precision of the speed reducer can be improved, and in addition, the bevel gears are good in machining manufacturability and low in price.

title: Joint module with multi-circle absolute value encoder and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint module with a multi-circle absolute value encoder and a humanoid robot. The joint module comprises an encoder assembly arranged at the end of a motor assembly and connected with an output shaft. The encoder assembly comprises an encoder stator, a gear set, an inner gear ring and an output end encoder rotor which are sequentially arranged in the axial direction of the encoder assembly. One end of the output shaft sequentially penetrates through the motor assembly, the encoder stator and the inner gear ring and is fixedly connected with the output end encoder rotor; the inner gear ring is fixed on an output end encoder rotor; the encoder stator is fixedly connected with a motor shell of the motor assembly; the gear set is rotatably mounted on the encoder stator, is positioned between the inner gear ring and the output shaft, and is in transmission connection with the inner gear ring; and an output gear of the gear set is provided with a third sensing element matched with the encoder stator. According to the utility model, the gear set and the inner gear ring are arranged in the original idle space between the encoder stator and the output end encoder rotor, so that a multi-ring power-off memory function is realized.

title: Bus cable, humanoid robot bus system thereof and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a bus cable, a humanoid robot bus system thereof and a humanoid robot, the bus cable comprises a power supply cable, a plurality of communication cables, a filler and a cable sleeve; a barrel hole is formed in the cable sleeve, and the power supply cable and the communication cables are all located in the barrel hole; and the filler is filled in the cylinder holes, and the communication cables and the power cables are fixed in the cylinder holes. title: Brushless hollow cup direct current motor unit for humanoid robot dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model discloses a brushless coreless DC motor unit for a humanoid robot dexterous hand, which comprises a motor body, a speed reducer and a driver, the motor body comprises a motor stator, a motor rotor, a front end cover and a rear end cover, the motor stator is sleeved outside the motor rotor, and the speed reducer is sleeved outside the front end cover. The front end cover and the rear end cover are respectively arranged at two end parts of the motor rotor, one end of the motor rotor is bonded with encoder magnetic steel by adopting anaerobic adhesive, the outer part of the rear end cover is bonded with a leading-out wire protection seat by adopting anaerobic adhesive, and a leading-out wire on the motor stator is connected to the leading-out wire protection seat through a buckle connecting assembly; according to the utility model, the outgoing line on the motor stator on the motor body is fixed by adopting the buckle connecting assembly, so that the condition that the outgoing line is wound in the high-speed rotation process of the unit is avoided, and the reliability of the unit is improved; a traditional circuit board and outgoing line leading-out mode is replaced by the FPC flexible flat cable, so that axial space is saved, and space is provided for realization of performance indexes of the motor body.

title: Dexterous hand finger, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a dexterous hand finger, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot, the dexterous hand finger comprises a pre-tightening seat and a pre-tightening assembly, the pre-tightening seat is arranged on a palm, and the pre-tightening assembly is arranged on the pre-tightening seat; the finger driving mechanism is movably arranged on the pre-tightening seat, and the pre-tightening assembly is used for providing pre-tightening force for the finger driving mechanism; the finger module is connected to the finger driving mechanism in the moving direction of the finger driving mechanism and rotationally arranged on the palm. When the finger driving mechanism drives the finger module to move, the finger driving mechanism can overcome the pre-tightening force of the pre-tightening assembly and move on the pre-tightening base so as to charge the pre-tightening assembly. After the finger module tightly holds an object, although the finger module is limited by the grabbed object and cannot continuously do work on the grabbed object, the finger driving mechanism is not completely blocked, and the driving force of the finger driving mechanism can overcome the pre-tightening force to charge the pre-tightening assembly; therefore, the problems of serious system heating, high energy consumption and overheating damage caused by stalling of the finger driving mechanism are avoided.

title: Electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to an electrically-driven humanoid dexterous hand which comprises a palm body, a first finger pulp and a second finger pulp, a bending block is rotatably installed on one side of the palm body, and bending structures are arranged at the upper end of the palm body and one side of the bending block. A first finger pulp is movably installed at the upper end of the palm body and one side of the bent block through a bent structure, a second finger pulp is installed at one end of the first finger pulp through a bent structure, a user pulls a pull rod downwards, the pull rod drives a moving plate to move downwards, the moving plate drives one end of a connecting rod to move, and the connecting rod drives an adjusting rod to move. The adjusting rod drives the pop-up clamping block to move towards the interior of the movable groove, so that the pop-up clamping block is separated from the limiting groove, the assembling head and the connecting strip can be pulled out from the interior of the assembling groove, the rotating frame can be detached from the first finger pulp or the second finger pulp, and the finger pulp is convenient to replace.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR ENABLING A HUMANOID ROBOT TO PERCEIVE A MANUFACTURING SITUATION BASED ON A LASER SENSOR AND PERFORM A WORK PROCESS
abstract: A method for recognizing a manufacturing situation and performing an autonomous process through a humanoid robot according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: (a) generating, by the robot, a sensing value by scanning surrounding manufacturing environments and objects with a sensor of a multimodal sensor system; (b) determining information on objects, situation recognition information, and work contents through a vision-language model based on the sensing value; (c) generating a process plan by inputting the determined information into a reinforcement learning model; and (d) performing autonomous work based on the generated process plan.

title: -- HIERARCHICAL DIFFUSION-BASED TEXT-TO-HUMANOID MOTION AUTOMATIC GENERATION SYSTEM
abstract: A hierarchical diffusion-based text-to-humanoid motion automatic generation system is provided, comprising: a user terminal for inputting text and outputting a humanoid, which is a 3D object performing a motion included in the text; and an integrated control server comprising a receiving unit for receiving text from the user terminal, an action decomposing unit for extracting a verb included in the text, decomposing the verb into at least one action unit, and inferring the order and time of actions of the at least one action unit, a motion generating unit for calling a pre-built conditional diffusion model to generate a motion corresponding to the at least one action unit to generate the motion, and a joining unit for joining section-by-section motions corresponding to the at least one action unit.

title: Data compression and transmission method for electronic skin of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a data compression and transmission method for electronic skin of a humanoid robot, belongs to the field of intelligent humanoid robots with bodies, and is used for solving the problems that when large-area electronic skin is applied to the humanoid robot, the data transmission amount is large, the communication rate is low, and the field environment requirement cannot be met. title: Robot motion control method based on multi-mode reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a robot motion control method based on multi-mode reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot motion control. The problem that an existing humanoid robot motion control method is poor in generalization ability and stability is solved. According to the method, a visual language model is utilized to predict terrain physical attributes from an environment image, multi-modal control features composed of visual features, historical motion data and ontology sensing data are constructed, and the problem of information inconsistency between training and deployment is solved through a privilege observation estimation mechanism. And the perceptibility of the humanoid robot to the motion state and the environment information is enhanced. And meanwhile, the terrain training difficulty is dynamically adjusted through adaptive terrain course learning, the course learning, observation estimation and multi-modal fusion design are combined, the strategy can gradually form the generalization ability in diversified terrains, and stable walking and motion skill generalization of the humanoid robot under the complex unstructured terrains are achieved. The method can be applied to robot motion control.

title: Thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer, polyurethane hot melt adhesive film, and preparation methods and applications of thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer and polyurethane hot melt adhesive film
abstract: The invention discloses a thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer, a polyurethane hot melt adhesive film and a preparation method and application of the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer and the polyurethane hot melt adhesive film, a wide-angle X-ray diffraction pattern of the thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer has a diffraction peak in a range of 2theta = 5-30 degrees in a 300% tensile state, and the grain size D1 is 3-12nm. After unloading recovery, the wide-angle X-ray diffraction peak intensity is attenuated, and the grain size D2 is smaller than 1 nm. The thermoplastic polyurethane elastomer is adopted as a main material, and the polyurethane hot melt adhesive film with remarkable yellowing resistance, high elastic recovery rate and low-temperature processing window can be obtained through cooperation of functional auxiliaries and an extrusion casting process. The material system is particularly suitable for functional layers of humanoid robots and is also suitable for bonding application of flexible substrates. The low-temperature processing characteristic can effectively avoid the thermal damage risk of the high temperature of the traditional hot melt adhesive to the sensitive substrate.

title: Multi-modal fusion reinforcement learning control method for agrochemical operation of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal fusion reinforcement learning control method for humanoid robot agrochemical operation, and relates to the technical field of agricultural robot control. The problems that in the prior art, multi-modal data fusion is poor, crop demand prediction lags behind, and dynamic environment adaptability is weak can be at least partially solved. The method comprises the steps of collecting soil, crop and environment multi-source data and converting the data into uniform feature vectors; based on the dynamic modal weight, attention weighted fusion is carried out on various types of data; carrying out noise filtering by adopting Kalman filtering and abnormal value detection; predicting future crop demands through the improved time sequence prediction model and performing error correction; determining a job execution sequence based on the demand priority function; dynamically optimizing operation parameters according to a real-time environment by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm; and the operation precision, efficiency and environmental protection are balanced through a multi-target reward function. According to the invention, multi-dimensional perception and full-process intelligent control are realized, and the method has dynamic environment adaptation capability and operation strategy self-optimization capability.

title: Big model-based humanoid robot brain decision scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot brain decision scheduling method and system based on a large model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a visual image, a voice instruction and body state data of a humanoid robot; mapping the visual image and the ontology state data to a unified semantic vector space by using a pre-trained multi-mode encoder, and generating a current scene description containing an environment topological relation and a self joint state; inputting the voice instruction and the current scene description into the large model; thinking chain reasoning is triggered through a prompt project, and a natural language instruction is decomposed into an atomic task sequence; the task scheduler receives the structured task list and constructs a dynamic task queue; the scheduler distributes a control instruction to the corresponding execution Agent; each execution Agent converts the semantic-level control instruction into a bottom-layer motor control signal and drives the humanoid robot to execute; meanwhile, the state monitoring module collects intermediate state data in the execution process in real time and writes the intermediate state data back to a context window or an external memory bank of the large model.

title: Solid-state battery material for humanoid robot and manufacturing process of solid-state battery material
abstract: The invention discloses a solid-state battery material for a humanoid robot and a manufacturing process of the solid-state battery material, and belongs to the technical field of solid-state batteries. The solid-state battery material comprises a composite positive electrode material, a sulfide-based composite solid-state electrolyte and a modified negative electrode material, wherein the composite positive electrode material takes a lithium-rich manganese-based material as an active main body, the surface of the composite positive electrode material is coated with a Li2ZrO3 protective layer, and the composite positive electrode material is compounded with Li7P3S11 electrolyte particles; according to the sulfide-based composite solid electrolyte, Li7P3S11 is used as a matrix, and Li3PO4-Al2O3 composite nanoparticles are doped; the modified negative electrode material is a TiN conductive layer sputtered on the surface of Si-C composite particles. The manufacturing process comprises four core links of preparation of the composite positive electrode, sintering of the composite solid electrolyte, preparation of the modified negative electrode and assembly of the whole battery through sol and gel coating, hot pressed sintering and magnetron sputtering. Through the composite positive electrode material, the sulfide-based composite solid electrolyte and the modified negative electrode material, the comprehensive performance of the solid-state battery for the humanoid robot is remarkably improved.

title: Waist and crotch structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot waist and crotch structure which comprises a waist support and a crotch connecting frame and further comprises a first motor and a second motor, the first motor is symmetrically installed on the waist support, and the second motor is installed on the crotch connecting frame. The second motor is used for driving the waist support and the crotch connecting frame to rotate relatively; the waist swinging assembly is arranged between the output ends of the first motors and the output ends of the second motors, when the two first motors synchronously rotate in the same direction, the waist support swings left and right along the crotch connecting frame, and when the two first motors asynchronously or reversely rotate, the waist support swings front and back along the crotch connecting frame; the number of driving units can be reduced, the control coordination difficulty can be reduced, the transmission efficiency loss can be reduced, the motion precision of the robot can be ensured, the weight and cost of the structure can be reduced, and multi-directional fast and smooth switching and combination can be realized.

title: Arm assembly of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an arm assembly of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. A containing space is formed in the bottom of the upper arm, a first flange is arranged on the transverse outer side of the containing space, the first actuator is transversely arranged in the containing space, and a shell of the first actuator is fixed to the first flange. A mounting space is formed in the lower arm, a second flange is arranged at the top of the lower arm, the second actuator is vertically arranged in the mounting space, and a shell of the second actuator is connected with the second flange; the connecting base comprises a vertical connecting arm and a transverse connecting arm, the vertical connecting arm is provided with a first connecting part connected with the output end of the first actuator, and the transverse connecting arm is provided with a second connecting part connected with the output end of the second actuator. A large protruding structure is prevented from being formed on the outer side of the arm assembly, arrangement of cables of the first actuator and the second actuator is facilitated, and the structure of the arm assembly is simplified.

title: Underwater humanoid operation robot design and underwater operation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses an underwater humanoid operation robot design and an underwater operation method thereof. The underwater humanoid robot comprises a head module, a trunk module, upper limb modules and lower limb modules, the upper end of the trunk module is connected with the head module, the two upper limb modules are symmetrically connected to the two sides of the trunk module, the lower end of the trunk module is connected with the lower limb modules, and a gravity center adjusting module is arranged in the trunk module. The upper limb module and the lower limb module are used for adjusting the underwater humanoid operation robot and keeping a target pose, and the upper limb module and the lower limb module are each provided with a butt joint port used for connecting different underwater execution units and anchoring tools; during underwater operation, the robot cruises to an operation target through the propeller and is anchored to the wall face of the target through the anchoring module, and underwater operation tasks such as cutting and drilling are completed through an operation tool. The energy consumption of the propeller of the robot can be reduced, the robot is suitable for carrying out underwater residence operation in a complex environment for a long time, and the operation stability of the robot in the complex underwater environment such as high current is greatly improved.

title: Miniature six-dimensional force sensor for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a miniature six-dimensional force sensor for a humanoid robot. The miniature six-dimensional force sensor comprises an elastic body which is integrally disc-shaped, and an upper cover plate and a lower cover plate which are arranged at the upper end and the lower end of the elastic body, the elastic body comprises an elastic body hub, a stress table and four strain beams, and the cross section of each strain beam is rectangular; the stress table is hollow and is arranged at the central position of the elastomer hub, the four strain beams are uniformly distributed between the stress table and the elastomer hub, one end of each strain beam is connected with the elastomer hub, and the other end of each strain beam is connected with the stress table; the elastomer hub is provided with a cable outlet. A plurality of strain gauges are adhered to the four strain beams to form six Wheatstone bridges for respectively measuring forces and moments in six directions of Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty and Tz. The miniature six-dimensional force sensor has the advantages that the thickness of the miniature six-dimensional force sensor is very small, the thickness is only 9.2 mm, the diameter is 45 mm, and the miniature six-dimensional force sensor is suitable for the humanoid robot industry.

title: Industrial scene-oriented humanoid robot co-simulation control method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial scene-oriented humanoid robot co-simulation control method and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps of: determining a functional module of a humanoid robot; constructing a simulation unit corresponding to the function module; according to a container distribution algorithm, a container is distributed to the virtual module in each simulation unit, and a corresponding container resource is distributed to each container; collecting simulation performance data corresponding to each simulation unit; data transmission is carried out based on a differential transmission channel when the simulation units carry out function simulation, the differential transmission channel comprises a first network and a second network, the first network is used for realizing low-delay communication between the virtual modules in the same simulation unit, and the second network is used for realizing cooperative communication between the virtual modules crossing the simulation units; and according to the simulation performance data, performing feedback optimization operation on the function simulation of each simulation unit. The precision, the stability and the real-time performance of multi-module cooperative control of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title: Humanoid robot control method based on generative model and reinforcement learning and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot control method and related equipment method based on a generative model and reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the unified coding processing of multi-modal data and multi-source heterogeneous data comprising different scenes, obtaining input data, carrying out the prediction processing of the input data through a scene reasoning model, and obtaining a prediction result; future scene information is obtained; performing offline training based on future scene information and preset cross-scene task data to obtain an optimal action strategy network; performing Monte Carlo search according to the optimal action network and the obtained future scene information, and outputting an optimal action sequence; and controlling the robot according to the obtained optimal action sequence. According to the embodiment of the invention, the adaptability to different scenes can be improved, and the control precision of the robot is improved. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

title: Precise nut turning center for driving humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine tools, in particular to a precision nut turning center for driving humanoid robot joints, which comprises a frame, a drilling mechanism, a transfer mechanism and an auxiliary mechanism are arranged on the frame, and the drilling mechanism comprises a sliding seat slidably connected to the outer wall of the frame. By means of the arranged transfer mechanism, the transfer frame drives the bearing groove to rotate to be aligned with the guide groove, the nut blank located at the bottommost part of the guide groove falls into the bearing groove, the transfer frame drives the nut blank to be aligned with the drill bit, drilling machining is conducted, automatic clamping and positioning during feeding are achieved, and meanwhile after the process is completed, the nut blank can be automatically clamped and positioned. Compared with the prior art with a clamp reloading neutral period, the device has the advantages that the time occupied by clamp reloading is utilized, feeding is achieved at a rear station when machining is conducted at a front station, the machining interval is shortened, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Hierarchical control-based humanoid robot gait generation system and real-time movement method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control. A humanoid robot gait generation system based on hierarchical control is characterized by comprising a multi-layer control system operating at different refresh frequencies, and the multi-layer control system comprises a high-layer gait and trajectory planning layer operating at a low frequency and used for generating a macroscopic motion instruction; the middle-layer whole-body motion optimization layer runs at medium frequency, serves as a bridge of high-layer planning and bottom-layer control and is used for converting expected plantar and trunk tracks into reference motion of all joints of the whole body; the bottom joint servo control layer runs at the highest frequency and is responsible for accurately tracking a joint-level instruction output by the whole-body motion optimization layer; the state sensing and feedback closed-loop layer is used for feeding back state information, obtained in real time, of the body state of the robot to all the layers, providing a basis for track re-planning of a high layer and providing a real-time state initial value for optimization of a middle layer; and a feedback signal is provided for servo control of a bottom layer.

title: Method for detecting locked-rotor of knuckle bearing of humanoid robot based on current signals
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot knuckle bearing locked-rotor detection method based on a current signal, and relates to robot fault diagnosis. A piezoelectric sensing array is arranged at a knuckle bearing, multi-modal fusion of the current signal and a piezoelectric signal is combined, and dynamic characteristics in the bearing operation process are collected; and a spiral transformation reconstruction technology and a recursive quantization entropy analysis method are used to accurately identify the locked-rotor state of the bearing. Thus, the accuracy and robustness of locked-rotor detection can be improved, bearing locked-rotor abnormity can be found in real time, an alarm signal is output in time, the influence of locked-rotor faults on the running performance of the humanoid robot is effectively reduced, and the working efficiency and safety of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Planetary lead screw high-precision numerical control thread grinding machine for driving humanoid robot joints
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of thread machining, in particular to a planet lead screw high-precision numerical control thread grinding machine for driving joints of a humanoid robot, which comprises a machine frame, a control system is arranged on the machine frame, a working table is slidably connected to the outer wall of the machine frame, and a headstock and a tailstock are slidably connected to two ends of the working table respectively. Through the arranged carrying mechanism, when a detection value of a second distance measuring instrument is lower than a threshold value, a control system controls an overturning motor to rotate in the forward direction, a lead screw is separated from a loading ring through an avoiding opening, meanwhile, an unloading ring rotates to the position below the lead screw, after machining is completed, the lead screw falls into the unloading ring, and during discharging, the overturning motor is controlled to rotate in the reverse direction; the discharging ring drives the machined lead screw to move to the side close to the collecting groove and slide into the collecting groove through the receding opening, meanwhile, the loading ring drives the lead screw placed in advance to complete the positioning work again, then automatic feeding and discharging are achieved, and the working efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Navigation synchronization method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a navigation synchronization method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the following steps: correcting the system time of the humanoid robot through a double-reference time calibration model according to a time reference signal and a sampling trigger signal to realize time reference synchronization of a satellite navigation system and an inertial navigation system; a positioning observation value prediction strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the motion state and the scene type, and a positioning observation value of the satellite receiver is obtained through prediction through a self-adaptive extrapolation algorithm in combination with a historical motion track and real-time sensor data; and acquiring resolving data of the inertial navigation system, introducing a scene feature weight factor to construct an optimized Kalman filtering model, and inputting the positioning observation value and the inertial navigation resolving data into the optimized Kalman filtering model for fusion resolving to obtain synchronized combined navigation data. According to the embodiment of the invention, reliable space state support can be provided for stable movement and accurate control of the humanoid robot.

abstract: The invention discloses an end-to-end control method, system, device and product of a humanoid robot. title: Attention mechanism-based humanoid robot control method and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control method based on an attention mechanism and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a task instruction of the humanoid robot and current environment sensing data; fusing the dynamic attention codes with the current state information of the humanoid robot to generate state input of a reinforcement learning model; based on the state input, outputting an action strategy of the robot through a pre-trained reinforcement learning model, and controlling the humanoid robot to execute movement or task operation; if it is detected that the humanoid robot is in the task execution process, environment feedback and execution result data are collected in real time, online optimization is conducted on the reinforcement learning model based on the environment feedback and execution result data, and if it is detected that the humanoid robot completes the task, key experience information of task execution is extracted, coded into a gene segment and stored in a group experience gene pool. According to the embodiment of the invention, the humanoid robot can quickly make a robust decision in an unknown environment.

title: Walking control method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a walking control method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a production work order from a manufacturing execution system; acquiring real-time environment data, and according to the real-time environment data, constructing an environment model including a ground state, an obstacle, a robot state and a task target area; based on the environment model and the task nodes allocated to the current humanoid robot, performing multi-objective optimization by using a model prediction control algorithm, and generating an optimal control strategy including a walking path and a gait; the current foot type humanoid robot is controlled to execute the optimal control strategy, and the optimal control strategy is dynamically adjusted through a task execution dynamic adjustment model according to the environment model; and synchronously updating the evolved experience segments to all humanoid robots through a feedback learning model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the humanoid robot can achieve a stable, flexible and intelligent execution effect in a changeable production scene.

title: Biped robot gait control method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot gait control method, device and equipment and a storage medium. Through a reinforcement learning algorithm, according to the current state vector and the joint motion trail of the current gait cycle, the current control parameter is output to adapt to the current gait rhythm, the motion stability of the biped robot is guaranteed, the two processes of gait vector generation and control parameter generation are decoupled, and the motion stability of the biped robot is improved. The problem that a model is difficult to train after the stride frequency is put into a state vector is solved, and meanwhile, autonomous adjustment of the stride frequency of the biped robot, optimization of full-speed-domain energy efficiency, enhancement of robot gait control robustness and generation of humanoid natural gaits are achieved.

title: Reverse planetary roller screw suitable for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a reverse planetary roller screw suitable for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of planetary roller screws. One end of each short nut is provided with an internal thread, the other end of each short nut is provided with an external thread, and the middle of each short nut is provided with a multi-head internal thread with a slightly small diameter. A plurality of short nuts are mutually connected through the internal threads and the external threads at the two ends to form a combined long nut with a large length-diameter ratio. The combined long nut, a lead screw with multiple external threads and a plurality of rollers jointly form the reverse planetary roller lead screw suitable for the humanoid robot. According to the reverse planetary roller screw nut, the machining problem of a traditional single large-length-diameter-ratio nut of a reverse planetary roller screw is solved, only a plurality of short nuts need to be machined, the machining difficulty is greatly reduced, the manufacturing cost is reduced, and the production efficiency is improved. In addition, the connection mode of the combined long nut is more efficient and simpler, and the combined long nut is more suitable for being combined with a frameless torque motor to form a humanoid robot linear joint module.

title: Mechanical leg of humanoid robot

abstract: The utility model provides a workpiece clamping mechanism of humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, and belongs to the technical field of machinery. title: Humanoid robot hand structure

Each finger joint (totally 14 joints) can be controlled by the finger joint bending device of the joint to bend or unbend towards the palm, and the thumb can be controlled by the finger base bending device to bend or unbend towards the palm. The wrist can be controlled by the wrist bending device to bend or unbend towards the palm surface, the thumb, the index finger, the ring finger and the little finger (totally four fingers) can be controlled by respective finger diverging devices 7 to complete finger diverging or folding actions, and the middle finger is fixed with the finger base. title: High-precision dynamic balance finish machining device for joint output flange of automatic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of flange machining, and discloses an automatic humanoid robot joint output flange high-precision dynamic balance finish machining device which comprises a machining device body, an instrument arm is installed at the top of the machining device body, a machining arm is installed at the front end of the instrument arm, and a rotary column is rotationally connected into the machining arm. A machining head is slidably connected into the rotating column, mounting holes are formed in the two ends of the machining head correspondingly, and arc-shaped blocks are fixedly connected to the two ends in the machining arm correspondingly. According to the high-precision dynamic balance finish machining device for the joint output flange of the automatic humanoid robot, a worker inserts a machining head into a rotating column and rotates the rotating column after the machining head is inserted, so that the rotating column drives a push block and an inserting rod to rotate, and the push block gradually makes contact with the thick end of an arc-shaped block; and the arc-shaped block pushes the push block to move and drives the push block to be inserted into the mounting hole, and limited mounting of the machining head is completed.

title: DOCKING STATION FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present disclosure provides a docking station for a humanoid robot having a torso, shoulders, and waist, comprising a base configured to support the humanoid robot and a stand assembly extending upward from the base and including an upper support configured to be positioned under the shoulders of the humanoid robot to at least partially support the weight when the humanoid robot is in a quasi-standing position on the docking station. The upper support comprises a pair of arms extending from a vertical support, each arm having a distal end configured to be positioned underneath a respective shoulder. The stand assembly further comprises a lower support configured to be positioned under the waist to provide additional support. The docking station further comprises a charging system configured to charge a battery.

title: Sign language data processing method based on humanoid robot and related device
abstract: The invention provides a gesture language data processing method based on a humanoid robot and a related device, which are applied to the humanoid robot, and the humanoid robot comprises a dexterous hand module and a data processing module. The method comprises the steps that a data processing module obtains sign language combination data of a target user, wherein the sign language combination data comprises static sign language data and dynamic sign language data; determining first semantic information corresponding to the sign language combination data; generating first reply information according to the first semantic information, wherein the first reply information comprises first sign language interaction information; if a plurality of ambiguous gestures exist in the first semantic information, question information is generated, and the question information is used for inquiring a target user to determine a target gesture in the plurality of ambiguous gestures; obtaining determination information of the target user for the multiple ambiguous gestures; regenerating the first sign language interaction information according to the determination information; and controlling the dexterous hand module to execute a corresponding first sign language action according to the first sign language interaction information.

title: High-strength nylon for humanoid robot and preparation method of high-strength nylon
abstract: The invention discloses high-strength nylon for a humanoid robot and a preparation method of the high-strength nylon. According to the composite material, MXD6 nylon and PA66 nylon are used as a composite matrix, chopped carbon fibers are used as a main reinforcement body, and a flexibilizer, an antioxidant, a lubricant and a nucleating agent are added. The preparation method comprises the following steps: performing vacuum drying on the raw materials, putting the dried raw materials into a double-screw extruder according to a specific ratio, and performing melt blending and granulation at a precisely controlled temperature interval (240-285 DEG C) and a screw rotating speed; and drying the obtained particles, and molding the dried particles into the required structural member through an injection molding machine under specific process parameters. Through synergistic interaction of MXD6 and PA66 and optimization of a processing technology, the composite material with high strength, high rigidity, high fatigue resistance, excellent impact toughness and extremely low water absorption is successfully prepared, and the technical problem that performance of an existing humanoid robot structural part material is unbalanced is perfectly solved; and the motion precision, the load capacity and the long-term reliability of the robot are obviously improved.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm wrist and humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid mechanical arm wrist and a humanoid mechanical arm, and relates to the technical field of humanoid mechanical arms, the humanoid mechanical arm wrist comprises a forearm, a wrist, a back stretching and buckling driving assembly and an ulnar deflection and radial deflection driving assembly; the back stretching and buckling driving assembly and the ulnar deflection and radial deflection driving assembly are arranged between the forearm and the wrist side by side and are both in transmission connection with the forearm and the wrist; the ulnar deflection radial deflection driving assembly and the wrist form rotary connection rotating around a first axis, and the ulnar deflection radial deflection driving assembly can drive the wrist to rotate around a second axis; the back stretching and buckling driving assembly and the wrist form rotary connection rotating around the second axis, and the back stretching and buckling driving assembly can drive the wrist to rotate around the first axis; the first axis is perpendicular to the second axis. title: Robot joint electromagnetic brake
abstract: The invention discloses a robot joint electromagnetic brake, relates to the technical field of robots, and is used for solving the technical problem that an existing electromagnetic brake is thick in axial size and cannot meet the requirement for high integration of humanoid robot joints. On the premise of not sacrificing the strength of a magnetic circuit or a stator, the structure is simplified, and the axial thickness of the whole machine is effectively reduced. According to the robot joint electromagnetic brake, an armature is provided with a step-shaped bent part, the protruding end of the step-shaped bent part is arranged in an inner hole of a stator and forms a positioning guide part, a friction plate and a cover plate are placed at the groove end of the step-shaped bent part, and meanwhile the friction plate and the cover plate are arranged in the stator; a stator coil is arranged on the step outer edge of the step-shaped bending part, and a torque spring is arranged between the stator coil and the armature.

abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid surveying and mapping robot (1) which can carry various surveying and mapping devices and replace manual work to complete surveying and mapping tasks in areas with complex terrains or limited spaces. abstract: The utility model discloses a hollow rotary joint module and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots. The motor assembly comprises a frameless motor and a motor flange, the rotor is rotationally arranged on the inner side of the stator, the rotor is connected with the motor flange to drive the motor flange to rotate, and the motor flange is connected with the wave generator; a first magnetic ring of the encoder magnetic ring assembly is arranged on a first magnetic ring flange, the first magnetic ring flange is connected with a motor flange and a wave generator, a second magnetic ring is arranged on a second magnetic ring flange, and the first magnetic ring and the second magnetic ring are located on the same plane. The output flange comprises a flange part and a straight barrel part, openings are formed in the two opposite ends of the straight barrel part, the straight barrel part penetrates through the harmonic reducer, the first magnetic ring flange and the second magnetic ring flange, and the flange part is connected with the harmonic reducer. The hollow rotary joint module is compact in structure, the overall length of the hollow rotary joint module is reduced, and the size of the hollow rotary joint module is smaller.

abstract: The utility model discloses a system for optimizing energy flow and improving balance force of a humanoid robot, which is characterized in that a new battery system formed by combining a flywheel energy storage battery and a power supply is adopted in a joint driving system of the robot, and the flywheel energy storage battery is used for replacing an original brake resistor; as a traditional braking resistor releases braking energy in a heat mode to consume the energy and can generate a large amount of heat, a humanoid robot system is damaged, a flywheel energy storage battery is adopted to store the braking energy, the energy is recycled, the energy utilization rate is greatly increased, and the energy utilization rate of the humanoid robot system is increased. title: Intelligent control method for single-hand and double-hand grabbing task of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent control method for a single-hand and double-hand grabbing task of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining interlayer connection strength distribution and gap width data of nested objects, and constructing an initial connection strength distribution diagram and a gap width record chart; according to the connection strength distribution diagram and the gap width record chart, the boundary of a continuous reachable area and a discrete isolated area is recognized, and the deviation degree of the gap transformation amplitude and a critical threshold value is evaluated; based on the deviation degree, the priority order of the grabbing hierarchy is adjusted, a target hierarchy is determined, and a finger insertion path is planned; the finger insertion path is combined with real-time contact force distribution to evaluate the contact degree, and the path offset distance is dynamically adjusted to generate a to-be-grabbed path; and a final grabbing level and a grabbing path are determined based on the weak position coordinates, and the humanoid robot is guided to execute the grabbing action.

title: Humanoid robot modeling and gait control method based on data and mechanism dual drive
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot modeling and gait control method based on data and mechanism dual drive. The method comprises the steps that S1, a whole-body kinetic equation is established; s2, uncertainty analysis in the dynamic model is carried out; s3, hybrid dynamics modeling is carried out; s4, feature selection based on SHAP analysis; s5, designing a residual prediction neural network; and S6, designing a model predictive control optimization function of the gait control framework. According to the humanoid robot modeling method based on the combination of the standard model and data driving, variables in the robot state space are selected based on feature importance analysis, the complexity of the model is greatly reduced, and the proposed hybrid modeling method can be generally used for the humanoid robot model and has the advantages of being high in practicability and the like. And the robustness of the robot control system is improved.

title: Gear multi-axis cooperative compensation machining method and device based on spinor error mapping
abstract: The invention discloses a gear multi-axis cooperative compensation machining method and device based on spinor error mapping. The method comprises the following steps: collecting actually measured data, and calculating a dynamic transmission error; establishing a gear contact analysis model and a dynamical model, and obtaining an equivalent tooth profile error including a tooth profile/pitch error through inversion under manufacturing realizable constraints; a machining kinematic chain model consistent with an actual gear grinding machine in structure is established based on the spinor theory, various machine tool errors are represented as spinor/displacement parameter disturbance, a linear mapping relation is established, and an error propagation model is established; calculating a sensitivity matrix, and identifying a key machine tool error source and a corresponding motion axis which have the most obvious influence on the tooth profile error; and the synchronous correction amount of each key shaft is calculated and is executed in real time during machining, so that active compensation is realized. According to the method, active compensation and accurate control over manufacturing errors of the humanoid robot joint speed reducer are achieved, the DTE amplitude of the speed reducer is effectively reduced, the local abrasion risk is reduced, and the positioning accuracy is improved.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented wireless remote control handle hardware pre-binding rapid pairing method
abstract: The invention discloses a wireless remote control handle hardware pre-binding rapid pairing method for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, in a robot production and manufacturing stage, a wireless communication receiver module is fixedly connected to a preset circuit position of a robot mainboard; according to the wireless remote control handle hardware pre-binding rapid pairing method for the humanoid robot, through combination of hardware pre-binding and multiple verification mechanisms, the problem that a wireless remote control handle is prone to mismatching in a multi-robot environment is effectively solved; hardware welding ensures that the receiver and the robot body cannot be separated, and a unique pairing physical foundation is laid. Wired connection automatically triggers a pairing process, so that complex manual operation is avoided; the dual identification code verification mechanism is read back and compared immediately after writing, so that the accurate exchange of identity certificates is ensured; bidirectional authentication in the wireless establishment stage further eliminates the possibility of illegal equipment access.
