title: Motion trajectory planning and evaluation method based on humanoid robot world model and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a motion trajectory planning and evaluation method and related equipment based on a humanoid robot world model, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining multi-modal sensor data of a current operation scene, and generating global visual angle state real-time information; inputting the global visual angle state real-time information into a strategy network to obtain action track anchor points, generating real-time state-action pairs according to the global visual angle state real-time information and the action track anchor points, and respectively inputting the real-time state-action pairs into a humanoid robot world model, prediction state-action pairs corresponding to the real-time state-action pairs are obtained and are scored by a scoring prediction network; and according to an evaluation result, a target action track is executed by the humanoid robot. According to the embodiment of the invention, the global state can be modeled through the multi-modal data, the future action-state can be predicted through the world model, and the optimal trajectory planning in the dynamic environment can be realized through the multi-dimensional evaluation of the scoring network. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of humanoid robots.

title: Hybrid control method and system for biped robot, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a hybrid control method and system for a biped robot, equipment and a medium, and the method mainly comprises the steps: obtaining a state variable of a current robot, and outputting a predicted landing point of a next period through a linear inverted pendulum model; solving a joint expected position and a joint expected speed through a robot geometric model and inverse kinematics based on the predicted landing point of the next period; a neural network model is established, the reference position correction amount of each joint is output through the neural network model based on the gait and control parameters of the robot, and the joint expected position and the joint expected speed are compensated based on the reference position correction amount. According to the method, the simplified dynamic model is used for providing a periodic and stable reference trajectory, the neural network is used for achieving self-adaptive compensation for real hardware differences, and finally smooth and controllable execution joint torque is generated through the PD controller, so that accurate landing point control and stable gait are achieved.

title: Humanoid robot action training method, device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action training method, device and equipment and a medium. Firstly, a wearable data acquisition system is adopted to replace traditional teleoperation hardware, laboratory scene limitation is broken through, and high-efficiency data acquisition of a field environment is achieved; secondly, based on depth estimation and a three-dimensional re-projection technology, converting a human first person view angle image to the height of a robot camera, filling a shielding hole through generative repair, and solving the problem of visual distribution mismatching caused by human body height difference; thirdly, constructing a layered decoupling unified action space, mapping the upper limbs into relative pose increments, mapping the lower limbs into discrete motion primitives, mapping the clamping jaws into a binary state, and avoiding action semantic confusion caused by form differences; and finally, man-machine data fusion is realized through timestamp synchronization, so that the robot can realize zero-sample generalization deployment in an environment without field acquisition, and generalization and reliability of a strategy are remarkably improved.

title: Speed reducer performance comparison test method applied to humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial robots, in particular to a speed reducer performance comparison test method applied to a humanoid robot. According to the method, motion information and task description information of an execution mechanism are obtained, and a multi-working-condition test sequence is constructed based on the motion information and the task description information; based on the multi-working-condition test sequence, the speed reducer to be tested is controlled to perform working condition replay, and multi-source operation data corresponding to the multi-working-condition test sequence is acquired in the working condition replay process; performing time reference alignment and measurement calibration processing on the multi-source operation data to obtain standardized test data; performing data preprocessing and feature calculation based on the standardized test data to obtain a unified index set; and performing normalization processing and statistical comparative analysis on the unified index set to obtain a comparative evaluation result of the speed reducer to be tested.

title: FINGER FOR HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A finger provided in a humanoid robot of the present disclosure and extending along a first axis comprises: a first rotating plate receiving power from a motor and rotating about a second axis perpendicular to the first axis; a first hand bone coupled to the first rotating plate to rotate; a second rotating plate rotating about a third axis perpendicular to the first axis and having an arc hole; a second hand bone coupled to the second rotating plate to rotate; a third rotating plate rotating about a fourth axis perpendicular to the first axis; a third hand bone coupled to the third rotating plate to rotate; a first pivot module, one side of which is coupled to the first rotating plate and the other side of which is coupled to the second rotating plate to connect the first rotating plate and the second rotating plate in a pivot structure; and a second pivot module, one side of which is coupled to the arc hole of the second rotating plate and the other side of which is coupled to the third rotating plate to connect the second rotating plate and the third rotating plate in a pivot structure, wherein the second pivot module is passively driven in accordance with driving of the first pivot module, whereby the first hand bone, the second hand bone, and the third hand bone perform a rotational movement.

title: Humanoid robot indoor path planning method and system based on earth surface trafficability estimation, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and provides a humanoid robot indoor path planning method and system based on earth surface trafficability estimation, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of earth surface type map generation, texture feature extraction, equivalent friction coefficient prediction, flatness index calculation, trafficability probability map prediction, candidate path generation, safety audit screening and comprehensive cost screening, and optimal motion strategy generation. According to the method, the ground surface physical characteristics are introduced into the decision-making process, so that the planning level improvement from geometric obstacle avoidance to physical quality and efficiency is realized; by actively identifying and avoiding specific risks, main accident hidden dangers such as slipping and stumbling are directly eradicated from a decision source, and the reliability is improved.

title: Humanoid sweeping robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a humanoid sweeping robot, and relates to the technical field of sweeping robots. title: Combined cable for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a combined cable for a humanoid robot. The combined cable comprises the following parts: two signal wires which are mutually twisted and connected, two power wires which are arranged outside the two signal wires which are mutually twisted, an insulating layer which wraps the two power wires, a belting layer which wraps the outer periphery of the two power wires which are mutually twisted and connected, and a filling material which wraps the outer periphery of the two power wires which are mutually twisted and connected, the two intertwisted signal wires are filled in gaps among the two power wires, the two intertwisted signal wires and the belting layer in the belting layer, and the sheath is tightly wrapped outside the belting layer. title: Joint module, finger joint assembly, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a joint module, a finger joint assembly, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. Wherein a first bearing (104) is arranged in a first mounting groove of a first shell (101) of the power assembly, a second bearing (106) is arranged in a second shell (102) of the harmonic reducer, and the transmission shaft (107) achieves the function of supporting rotation by means of the first bearing (104) of the power assembly and the second bearing (106) of the harmonic reducer. title: Thigh structure, leg device and humanoid robot

abstract: The utility model provides an RV speed reduction module for a humanoid robot dexterous hand joint, and relates to the technical field of humanoid finger joints, the RV speed reduction module comprises a driving motor and an RV speed reducer which are coaxial, and the driving motor comprises a motor shell, an input shaft, a permanent magnet rotor and two PCB stators located on the two sides of the permanent magnet rotor respectively; the RV speed reducer comprises two cycloidal gears, a main bearing and at least two eccentric shafts, and the main bearing is arranged between the two cycloidal gears; two first four-point ball bearings are arranged between the eccentric shaft true circle and the inner ring of the main bearing, and the motor shell is detachably connected with the outer ring of the main bearing; a second four-point ball bearing is arranged between the cam at the two ends of the eccentric shaft and the cycloidal gear; the outer wall of the cycloidal gear is meshed with inner hole teeth of the outer ring of the main bearing; one end of the eccentric shaft is provided with a planet wheel; one end of the input shaft is provided with an input gear meshed with the planet wheel; an end cover detachably connected with the main bearing inner ring is arranged on the side, away from the motor shell, of the main bearing outer ring. According to the utility model, the axial size of the whole joint module is reduced while the transmission precision is ensured.

title: Humanoid robot end side adaptation method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot end side adaptation method and device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. According to the method, performance parameters of hardware components on the end side of the robot are scanned through a hardware feature sensing algorithm, a three-dimensional reconstruction model of the robot is constructed according to the hardware performance parameters through a digital twin model, and the structure and performance of the robot are truly reflected in a virtual environment. Current task requirements and environment characteristic parameters are obtained, a simulation target and constraint conditions are determined according to the parameters, and the optimization direction and boundary are defined. And the task execution capability and the environment adaptability of the robot in different scenes in the financial and medical fields are enhanced.

title: Flexible methanol fuel cell and humanoid robot power supply system
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible methanol fuel cell and a humanoid robot power supply system, and relates to the technical field of methanol power generation, the flexible methanol fuel cell comprises a flexible bag body, the two ends of the flexible bag body are provided with a liquid inlet and a liquid outlet, and the side surface is provided with a mounting opening; the membrane electrode is sealed in the mounting opening; the anode diffusion layer and the cathode diffusion layer are respectively fixed on the anode side and the cathode side of the membrane electrode, and fine wire meshes are fixed on the anode diffusion layer and the cathode diffusion layer. A humanoid robot power supply system comprises a flexible methanol fuel cell, a DMFC energy management system and an energy storage cell, and the flexible methanol fuel cell serves as a power generation unit and is integrally distributed on the outer surface of a robot. According to the flexible methanol fuel cell disclosed by the invention, the whole cell body has good bending, twisting and tensile elasticity, can adapt to various irregular surfaces and dynamic deformation scenes, and is light in weight and thin in thickness. The flexible methanol fuel cell is used as a power generation skin to be integrated on the robot, the mass energy density is improved, and the endurance working time is prolonged.

title: Automatic zero calibration method and system for humanoid robot based on current characteristic analysis
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot zero position automatic calibration method and system based on current feature analysis, and the method comprises the steps: determining the zero position calibration sequence and zero returning direction of each joint; the offset of each joint moving from the mechanical limiting position to the zero position in the zero returning direction is calibrated as the initial zero returning offset; all the joints are controlled to move towards the mechanical limiting position, active current signals of a joint motor are collected in real time in each sampling period, and if a plurality of continuous active current signals collected in real time exceed the current return-to-zero current threshold value, it is judged that the joints reach the mechanical limiting position; all the joints are controlled to move in the zeroing direction till the initial zeroing offset is reached; and correcting the initial zeroing offset for controlling the joint to return to zero. According to the method, efficient, safe, automatic and rapid calibration of multi-joint zero positions can be realized through self-adaptive analysis and zero returning control of current characteristics of the driving motor of the robot body under the condition that an external sensor is not needed.

title: Humanoid robot real-time limb trajectory optimization method based on centroid dynamics
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot real-time limb trajectory optimization method and device based on centroid dynamics and a robot, and belongs to the field of robot motion control. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a robot take-off state and a next grounding target; based on the conservation of angular momentum in the flying stage, constructing an optimization problem which takes a joint trajectory polynomial coefficient as an optimization variable and takes the minimization of the body direction deviation during grounding as a target and comprises kinematics position and speed constraint; the core of the method is that the key property that a translation coupling term in a centroid angular momentum matrix is zero is utilized and proved, so that body rotation dynamics and centroid translation are completely decoupled, and a complex whole-body trajectory is optimized and simplified into an efficient problem which can be solved in real time at a millisecond level; according to the method, a coordinated limb swinging track can be automatically generated, the body posture is accurately controlled in the running and jumping flying stage, and manual intervention is not needed.

title: Method for determining motion parameters of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot action parameter determination method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the following steps: extracting multi-modal input features; in the aerial view space, to-be-observed features generated by fusing the multi-modal input features are obtained, and static parameters of static objects and dynamic parameters of dynamic objects around the humanoid robot are determined; generating a first motion parameter of the humanoid robot based on the to-be-observed features; and determining a motion correction value by using the motion residual value, and modifying the first motion parameter by using the motion correction value to obtain a second motion parameter. According to the technical scheme, the feature information around the humanoid robot is obtained in real time, the dynamic parameters of the dynamic object and the static parameters of the static object are determined in a decoupling mode, the movable space of the mechanical arm is determined, dependence on positioning data is reduced, the obstacle avoidance success rate of the humanoid robot is increased, and the obstacle avoidance efficiency is improved. And the industrial operation efficiency and the household interaction safety of the humanoid robot are effectively improved.

title: Whole body control method and device of humanoid robot, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a whole body control method and device for a humanoid robot, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robot motion control, and the method comprises the steps: building a humanoid robot single rigid body dynamic model according to the model uncertainty and an external disturbance mechanism; in the operation process of the humanoid robot, the current initial control quantity is obtained through a model adaptive prediction controller based on a humanoid robot single rigid body dynamic model, and the model adaptive prediction controller comprises an adaptive neural network model; based on the current initial control quantity, performing fine adjustment on adjustable parameters in the adaptive neural network model so as to dynamically correct the control quantity output by the humanoid robot single rigid body dynamic model, and obtaining the current corrected control quantity; and performing whole body control optimization calculation according to the current corrected control quantity, and generating a joint control instruction. According to the method, in a complex unstructured environment, the humanoid robot can quickly adapt to unknown disturbance, and the robustness and the dynamic performance of the humanoid robot are improved.

title: Modularized parallel direct-drive dexterous hand
abstract: According to the modularized parallel direct-drive dexterous hand, by designing humanoid fingers of a two-degree-of-freedom connecting rod direct-drive structure in a plane and combining a finger support, a palm and a thumb root rotating joint, the dexterous hand can reach any position in the plane, and by restoring human hand actions and conducting modularized structural design on the humanoid fingers, the requirement for simplifying the structure of the dexterous hand is met; the modularized finger width size optimization can be achieved, and compared with a rope-driven dexterous hand through parallel connection rod combined transmission and a direct-driven mechanism dexterous hand, the loading capacity is improved.

title: Whole body posture linkage method and device when humanoid robot stretches hands to reach objects
abstract: The invention provides a whole body posture linkage method and device when a humanoid robot stretches hands to reach an object, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a swing arm angular velocity, a gait phase angle and an azimuth deviation angle between the tail end of an arm and a target object in a walking state of the humanoid robot, and determining a freezing switching judgment threshold value according to the azimuth deviation angle and the swing arm angular velocity; screening a preliminary candidate point set according to comparison of the freezing switching judgment threshold value and a preset threshold value; updating a correction value of a freezing switching judgment threshold value in a next-step state period according to an evaluation result of a suppression result of the trunk pitching oscillation amplitude, mapping the correction value into a phase deviation compensation value in gait phase synchronization, and determining a hand stretching action starting opportunity; and fusing the hand stretching action starting time and the swing arm freezing time, and evaluating the standard reaching degree of the overall action time shortening amount and a preset time optimization threshold so as to determine whole body posture linkage parameters.

title: Migratable humanoid robot control method based on world model and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a world model-based migratable humanoid robot control method and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the data collection of a real environment, obtaining first multi-sensor data and current multi-sensor data, carrying out the migration training of an initial model through the first multi-sensor data, and obtaining a target control model; the initial model is obtained by training the constructed model according to a simulation environment; and the target control model obtained by inputting the collected current multi-sensor data is processed, a target action instruction is output, and the humanoid robot is controlled according to the output target action instruction. According to the embodiment of the invention, the simulation environment and the real environment are combined to train the model, manual debugging is reduced, the model deployment cost is reduced, migration training is performed on the initial environment based on the data of the real environment, the current scene of the robot is adapted in real time, and the scene adaptability of robot control is improved. The method can be widely applied to the technical field of robot control.

abstract: The invention provides an operator lightweight design method, device and equipment for a humanoid robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of robots. Under the constraint of the modular architecture framework, algorithm redundancy reduction is carried out on each operator function module, and algorithm redundancy is reduced. title: Humanoid robot joint module performance test experiment table
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot joint module performance test experiment table which comprises a driving end mechanism, a middle shaft end mechanism, a tail end mechanism and a mounting table. title: Multi-source data processing method, system, equipment and product of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-source data processing method, system, device and product for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: classifying the multi-source data of the humanoid robot, setting a corresponding priority, and obtaining target data; establishing a storage list and a read list corresponding to the target data; the storage list and the read list respectively correspond to storage unit groups of the humanoid robot; in response to a data storage instruction of the humanoid robot, storing target data to a target storage unit according to a priority scheduling strategy in combination with the storage list; in response to a data reading instruction of the humanoid robot, calling a reading list to position a target reading unit based on a business demand, and obtaining target data; and monitoring the utilization rate and the data timeliness of the storage unit group, and executing an erasing operation on the corresponding data region in the storage unit group according to a monitoring result. The data processing efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the method can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented dialogue arrangement method and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot-oriented dialogue arrangement method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that operation instruction input facing a target robot is obtained, a semantic track is constructed, the semantic track indicates a sequence of actions needing to be executed and execution conditions needing to be met when each action in the sequence of actions needing to be executed is executed, multi-source constraint data of a manufacturing site where the target robot is located are obtained, and a manufacturing state track is constructed; the manufacturing state rail indicates the operation constraint and the safety constraint of the manufacturing site; according to the manufacturing state orbit, performing step-by-step registration on each action in the sequence of actions needing to be executed indicated by the semantic orbit, and generating a candidate executable action sequence; and performing logic rehearsal based on the candidate executable action sequence, and determining an actual execution action sequence of the target robot according to a logic rehearsal result. According to the embodiment of the invention, the security risk caused when semantic reasonability and manufacturing state reasonability cannot be met at the same time during instruction execution can be effectively reduced.

title: Multi-motor power-assisted connecting device and system for guyed humanoid robot
abstract: According to the multi-motor power-assisted connecting device and system for the guyed humanoid robot, the multiple motors are arranged on the trunk in a concentrated mode, the inertia of the execution end is reduced, and the impact resistance is improved. According to the control logic, the assistance motors are dynamically or statically added on the basis of current humanoid robot control, joints needing assistance are called for the joint motors in the idle state, the purpose that torque of 500 Nm or above can be output while the joints and the motors of the common size are kept compact in size is achieved, and the size is greatly reduced. For the dexterous hand, a plurality of small motors and a bus large motor work cooperatively, multiple paths of power are gathered to the same joint, and the grabbing force exceeding hundreds of Nm and the precision operation capacity are achieved. Various mechanical self-locking structures are arranged in the connecting point device, and tensions of ten thousand newtons can still be kept after power failure. The control system adopts a layered distributed architecture, and microsecond-level synchronization precision is achieved. The core contradiction that the humanoid robot is small in joint space and high in torque requirement is thoroughly solved, and the humanoid robot is suitable for being applied to whole-body joints and dexterous hands.

title: Balance and stability control system and method for ship biped robot under complex sea conditions
abstract: The invention discloses a balance and stability control system and method for a ship biped robot under complex sea conditions. The system comprises two magnetic attraction balance devices. The magnetic attraction balance device comprises a control processing module, a foot connecting mechanism, a stable adjusting mechanism, a sole magnetic force mechanism and a power module. According to the balance stability control system and method, the stability adjusting mechanism can be used for correspondingly adjusting the levelness of the foot connecting mechanism according to ship data obtained by the control processing module, so that the biped robot can balance shaking of a ship, and the stability of feet in the walking process is enhanced; magnetic attraction can be carried out when feet step on a deck in the walking process by utilizing the foot bottom magnetic mechanism, so that the stability in the walking process is further enhanced; the foot connecting mechanism can be detachably installed on the foot of the biped robot, and the adaptability is high.

title: Humanoid robot control system and method based on FPGA and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot control system and method based on an FPGA and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The system comprises an FPGA main control unit; the input end of the perception-execution communication bridging unit is connected with a plurality of types of sensors of the humanoid robot, the output end of the perception-execution communication bridging unit is connected with a plurality of types of actuators of the humanoid robot, and the perception-execution communication bridging unit is in bidirectional communication connection with the FPGA main control unit; and the forwarding module is used for realizing forwarding of sensor data between the FPGA main control unit and the sensing-execution communication bridging unit or forwarding of a control instruction between the FPGA main control unit and the sensing-execution communication bridging unit. A traditional MCU is replaced by the FPGA, the problems that the humanoid robot is insufficient in computing power, high in communication delay and poor in scene adaptability under multiple scenes are solved, hardware reconstruction cost is reduced, the real-time performance and reliability of the system are improved, and the system can be widely applied to different application scenes.

title: Visual perception method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a visual perception method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring label-free visual data and label visual data of a target scene; inputting the standardized image block data set into a self-supervised learning model, and training the unlabeled visual data based on the self-supervised learning model to extract a first visual feature of the target image block data; inputting the standardized image block data set into a self-supervised learning model, and extracting a second visual feature from the labeled visual data by using the self-supervised learning model; and based on the first visual feature and the second visual feature, training a multi-task learning model so that the humanoid robot can execute at least two different visual perception tasks at the same time, and generating and executing a corresponding action instruction according to a perception result of the multi-task learning model. According to the embodiment of the invention, the adaptability and operation continuity of the humanoid robot in a cross-task environment can be enhanced.

title: Reconfigurable topological humanoid robot based on morphological resonance and quantum sensing
abstract: The invention provides a reconfigurable topological humanoid robot based on morphological resonance and quantum perception, and the system comprises a reconfigurable topological robot body which is composed of intelligent skeleton units which can be dynamically recombined and connected, and the mechanical structure of the reconfigurable topological robot body is used as a memory medium of a motion skill; the distributed quantum entanglement sensing network is integrated to all the intelligent skeleton units, and instantaneous and zero-delay collaborative sensing of the whole body state of the robot is achieved through the quantum entanglement state; and the morphological resonance track excitation system directly generates a target motion track by exciting a specific mechanical resonance frequency mode of the robot body. According to the invention, a core normal form of a physical form, namely a memory medium, is provided, motion skills are coded in variable mechanical topology and resonance characteristics, global synchronization is realized through quantum entanglement, and motion is excited and induced through resonance, so that natural acquisition, physical storage and adaptive reproduction of the skills are realized; and a traditional hierarchical control architecture of'calculation-control-execution 'is thoroughly subverted.

title: Robot motion control method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a robot motion control method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the robot motion control method comprises the steps that robot motion speed information, robot chassis information, robot foot information and environment sensing information are acquired; inputting a decision model based on the robot motion speed information, the robot chassis information, the robot foot information and the environment perception information to predict corresponding motion correction, joint angle correction and foot end position correction, and determining a motion control instruction, a joint angle control instruction and a foot end position control instruction; the decision model is obtained by correcting the expectation of a corresponding target reward function according to the robot movement speed information, the robot chassis information and the robot foot information; and chassis movement and joint movement of the robot are controlled according to the movement control instruction, the joint angle control instruction and the foot end position control instruction.

title: Robot constraint dexterity feasible region measurement and optimization control method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot constraint dexterity feasible region measurement and optimization control method and system, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a joint angular velocity hyper-polyhedron feasible region based on the analyzed joint and environment joint constraint, obtaining a humanoid robot dexterity feasible region through affine transformation, and obtaining a joint angular velocity hyper-polyhedron feasible region; and the humanoid robot constraint dexterity feasible region measurement based on the speed polyhedron is realized. Then, task direction dexterity is constructed based on the dexterity feasible region, and optimization indexes are constructed; the humanoid robot operation task requirement, the joint constraint and the optimization index are integrated through dynamic planning, the recurrent neural network is used for optimization control analysis, the joint angular velocity control instruction is obtained to control the humanoid robot, and the control precision of the humanoid robot for skillfully operating the control task is effectively improved.

title: Scene backtracking method, system, equipment and product of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a scene backtracking method, system, equipment and product for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: triggering the humanoid robot to carry out multi-source data collection processing according to an operation instruction, carrying out the control processing of a data collection process through the operation state of the humanoid robot, and obtaining a multi-source data set; the multi-source data set comprises positioning data, environment video data and target object state data; performing data preprocessing and sample extraction processing on the environment video data according to the positioning data to obtain a sample image; performing target feature recognition and image screening processing on the sample image to obtain a scene image; and performing visual backtracking processing on the positioning data, the scene image and the target object state data to obtain a scene backtracking result. The working efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved, and the humanoid robot can be widely applied to the technical field of robots.

title: Real-time lip synchronization method and system for humanoid robot based on feedforward delay compensation
abstract: The invention discloses a real-time lip synchronization method for a humanoid robot based on feedforward delay compensation, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises the following steps: constructing an annular audio buffer area containing a current frame and a look-ahead frame, and extracting MFCC spectrum features; inputting the MFCC spectrum features into a lightweight full-connection neural network, and outputting visual phoneme probability distribution; mapping the visual phoneme probability distribution to a target angle vector of a multi-degree-of-freedom mouth motor, and calculating a smooth angle of a current control frame; the optimal instruction sending moment of the current frame of each steering engine is calculated, a scheduling instruction is formed by combining the smooth angle of the current control frame and input into a priority queue, and the action finishing moment of each steering engine is aligned with the streaming audio data playing moment; by detecting the actual motion feedback of the steering engine, the mechanical delay is dynamically updated for calculating the optimal instruction sending time of the look-ahead frame. According to the invention, mechanical delay is counteracted, waiting for complete audio generation is not needed, and end-to-end audio-visual synchronization errors are reduced.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time lip synchronization method for a humanoid robot based on feedforward delay compensation, which belongs to the technical field of robots and comprises the following steps: constructing an annular audio buffer area containing a current frame and a look-ahead frame, and extracting MFCC spectrum features; inputting the MFCC spectrum features into a lightweight full-connection neural network, and outputting visual phoneme probability distribution; mapping the visual phoneme probability distribution to a target angle vector of a multi-degree-of-freedom mouth motor, and calculating a smooth angle of a current control frame; the optimal instruction sending moment of the current frame of each steering engine is calculated, a scheduling instruction is formed by combining the smooth angle of the current control frame and input into a priority queue, and the action finishing moment of each steering engine is aligned with the streaming audio data playing moment; by detecting the actual motion feedback of the steering engine, the mechanical delay is dynamically updated for calculating the optimal instruction sending time of the look-ahead frame. title: Thoracic cavity structure and humanoid robot

According to the thoracic cavity structure, the reliability of the thoracic cavity structure can be improved.

title: Modularized robot joint module with stepless speed change and reduction mechanism
abstract: The utility model discloses a modularized robot joint module with a stepless speed changing and reducing mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot transmission mechanisms. The assembly comprises a machine shell, a stepless speed changing and reducing mechanism is arranged in the machine shell, a ring gear is fixed to the upper surface of the machine shell, a gear ring is fixed to the ring gear, and a driving disc is rotationally installed in the gear ring. The stepless speed changing and reducing mechanism comprises a variable-pitch first bevel gear, a variable-pitch second bevel gear, a driving motor, an H-shaped driving rod, an electric push rod, a traction ring and a planetary gear train composed of driving teeth, a planetary gear and a ring gear, wherein the variable-pitch first bevel gear and the variable-pitch second bevel gear are meshed. Stepless continuous adjustment of the total transmission ratio can be achieved, different working conditions of high-speed light load, low-speed heavy load and the like of the humanoid robot can be flexibly adapted, stability, bearing capacity and transmission precision of power transmission are effectively improved, transmission loss is reduced, and smoothness and reliability of operation of joints of the robot are guaranteed.

title: Connecting piece, joint structure and robot
abstract: The utility model relates to a connecting piece, a joint structure and a robot, the connecting piece is used for connecting a joint actuator and a base body and comprises a first connecting body and a second connecting body, the first connecting body comprises an actuator connecting part and a brake connecting part, the actuator connecting part is used for connecting the joint actuator, and the brake connecting part is used for connecting the joint actuator. The brake connecting part is adjacent to the actuator connecting part and is used for being connected with a brake for braking the joint actuator; the second connecting body is connected with the first connecting body and used for being connected with the base body. According to the technical scheme, the connecting part used for installing the brake is designed on the connecting piece, the joint actuator is braked through the installed brake, the possibility of redundant motion of the joint is reduced, and when the connecting piece is applied to the humanoid robot exemplarily, the posture stability of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Robot joint module driving mechanism
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a robot joint module driving mechanism which comprises a shell, the two ends of the shell are open, a supporting plate is fixedly connected to the interior of the shell and divides the interior of the shell into a first installation area and a second installation area, a stator is fixedly installed in the first installation area, and a motor is fixedly installed in the second installation area. A rotor is rotatably installed on the inner side of the stator, a speed reducer unit is arranged in the second installation area, a rear cover is detachably installed at one end of the shell, a front cover is detachably installed at the other end of the shell, a heat dissipation unit used for conducting active heat dissipation on the interior of the shell is embedded in the rear cover, and the output end of the speed reducer unit rotatably penetrates through the front cover. title: Compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of force sensors, in particular to a compact nonlinear six-dimensional force sensor. title: Bionic skeleton material for humanoid robot and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of high-performance polymer composite materials, and discloses a bionic skeleton material for a humanoid robot and a preparation method thereof.The method comprises the steps that 50-75 wt% of polyether-ether-ketone, 20-50 wt% of modified fibers and 1-3 wt% of an antioxidant are subjected to melt blending, extrusion and granulation, then vibration injection molding is conducted through an injection molding machine, the mold temperature ranges from 160 DEG C to 200 DEG C, and in the injection molding and pressure maintaining stage, the bionic skeleton material for the humanoid robot is obtained. And vibration shearing with the frequency range of 0.05-2 Hz is applied to the melt through reciprocating motion of the piston. According to the preparation method, flowing and crystallization of a polymer composite material melt in a cavity of an injection mold are regulated and controlled, so that internal fibers are promoted to be orderly arranged in the melt flowing direction, a polymer matrix is further induced to form a column crystal structure on the surface of the polymer matrix, a reinforcing structure similar to a natural bone is constructed in a bionic mode on the micro-scale, and the mechanical property of the composite material is remarkably improved.

title: Motion precision control system for four limbs of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot four-limb movement precision control system, and relates to the technical field of robot control. According to the method, the motion planning parameters of the humanoid robot can be inhibited in advance according to the vibration pre-judgment information, and high-precision motion control can be completed without depending on subsequent precision compensation.

title: Thin-wall retainer for humanoid robot knuckle bearing
abstract: The thin-wall retainer for the humanoid robot knuckle bearing comprises a retainer body, the retainer body is provided with a hole beam, a pocket and a pocket with one side open, the hole beam is provided with an arc-shaped R-angle lockrand, and the retainer body is integrally connected with an inner flange in a cambered surface transition mode. The double improved design of local overlock optimization and overall strength strengthening is formed. The three-section overlock structure overcomes the local defects of stress concentration, abrasion, ball scratching and the like at the joint of a lock point and a pocket. The inner flange structure makes up the defects that an existing retainer is insufficient in overall rigidity, prone to torsional deformation and uneven in load transmission, the inner flange structure and the inner flange structure act synergistically, stress distribution, structural strength, failure resistance, assembly convenience, transmission precision and the like of the retainer are remarkably improved, and the problems that in the prior art, bearing capacity is insufficient, and transmission precision is poor are solved. And abrasion is caused by excessive friction, so that the service life of the thin-wall bearing is seriously influenced.

title: Track contact network fault positioning device integrating humanoid robot and multi-source sensor
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a track overhead line system fault positioning device integrating a humanoid robot and a multi-source sensor, and the system comprises an obstacle crossing execution module, a part recognition module, a positioning coupling module, an abnormity tracking module and a target verification module. According to the method, autonomous obstacle crossing in a structure shielding environment is achieved through gait instruction combination, crossing behavior information is recorded, attitude guide alignment control and angle segmentation capture strategies are introduced in an image acquisition link, and structure contour boundary clear extraction and image number output are completed; establishing a position mapping relation between an image line segment direction and a track coordinate system, dynamically constructing a multi-view path segment, carrying out coincidence verification on an image edge fracture area and thermal imaging space point data, extracting a space position coordinate of an abnormal component, carrying out information alignment on a component identification name and a path track file, and obtaining an abnormal component; the execution action index is formed according to the time sequence, and the structure recognition integrity, the path matching accuracy and the fault part response efficiency are improved.

title: Humanoid robot walking stability control method and system based on nonlinear model predictive control and readable medium
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot walking stability control method and system based on nonlinear model predictive control and a readable medium, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out gait planning based on the current parameters of a humanoid robot, the gait planning comprises delimiting a feasible region of a foothold and a ZMP reference value; s2, NMPC optimization is conducted on gait planning, compliance control is added, new walking parameters are output to control the walking track of the humanoid robot, and stable walking of the humanoid robot is achieved; wherein the walking parameters comprise the position of the final foothold and the optimized walking track, speed and/or acceleration. According to the technical scheme, the problem of robust and efficient walking of the humanoid robot is solved, the spring damping model is optimized, and a theoretical basis is provided for flexibility and stability of humanoid walking.

title: Humanoid robot motion test platform
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion test platform, which comprises a base, a belt-type motion mechanism, a height adjusting device and a control system, and is characterized in that the height adjusting device comprises a linear driving mechanism of which the bottom is hinged to the base; the first sliding mechanism is connected with the output end of the linear driving mechanism; the second sliding mechanism is in sliding fit with the first sliding mechanism and is connected with the test platform; and the brake mechanism is used for limiting relative movement of the two. abstract: The invention discloses a three-axis rope-driven wrist joint structure based on a ball cage universal joint and a humanoid robot. The deflection power source is connected with a deflection rope of the rope-driven deflection unit; and the flexion and extension power source is connected with a flexion and extension rope of the rope-driven flexion and deflection unit. The mechanism is designed based on the ball cage universal joint with the short axial size, the structure is compact, rope-driven decoupling is achieved, and the mechanism has the complete three-degree-of-freedom movement function.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom joint linkage control method and device for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot multi-degree-of-freedom joint linkage control method and device.The humanoid robot multi-degree-of-freedom joint linkage control method comprises the steps that the real-time torque value of an ankle joint, the inertia absorption sharing amount of the knee joint, the hip joint and the ankle joint and the front-back acceleration data of the head are obtained, and the real-time torque value of the ankle joint is compared with a preset rated range; judging the degree of the ankle moment approaching the rated range; according to the degree approaching the rated range, the ankle joint torque saturation trend is evaluated, and a saturation interval is determined; adjusting the inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee, hip and ankle joints according to the saturation interval; according to the adjusted inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee, hip and ankle joints, calculating the residual inertia amount, determining the transferred inertia sharing amount, and monitoring the acceleration response on the front-back axis of the head based on the transferred inertia sharing amount so as to obtain the filtered front-back acceleration peak value of the head; and finely adjusting the inertia absorption sharing proportion of the knee, hip and ankle joints according to the degree that the filtered front-back acceleration peak value of the head exceeds a preset threshold value.

title: Self-adaptive grabbing system and method of humanoid robot for mixed-flow assembly of industrial parts
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot self-adaptive grabbing system and method for mixed-flow assembly of industrial parts, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and precise instrument and part assembly logistics. The system comprises a material attribute analysis module, a visual feedback adjustment module, an image acquisition module and a self-adaptive grabbing module, wherein the material attribute analysis module and the visual feedback adjustment module run on a built-in computer of the robot, the image acquisition module is fixed to the head of the robot, the self-adaptive grabbing module is located on the hand of the robot, and the image acquisition module and the self-adaptive grabbing module are both connected with the built-in computer of the robot. Optical images of target parts on an assembly line are obtained, material attribute classification and vulnerability evaluation are carried out on various heterogeneous target parts, and robot hand control parameters matched with the materials are dynamically generated. The problem that when a traditional manipulator faces fragile flexible and rigid mixed industrial parts on an assembly line, the parts are cracked, scratched or deformed due to single control parameters is solved, and low-cost and high-precision flexible self-adaptive grabbing is achieved.

title: Double-wheel omnidirectional humanoid robot and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a double-wheel omni-directional humanoid robot and a control method thereof. The parking safety is ensured. According to the invention, traditional limitation is broken through, omni-directional motion and anthropomorphic operation are fused, and complex scene adaptability, attitude stability and trajectory tracking precision are improved.

title: Humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance method and system based on image segmentation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent obstacle avoidance, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot dynamic obstacle avoidance method and system based on image segmentation, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the pixel-level semantic segmentation of environment original data in the advancing direction of a robot, and obtaining an environment mask image; performing contour centroid tracking on the obstacle in the advancing direction, and mapping the tracked centroid position into a three-dimensional coordinate system to obtain a motion state vector of the obstacle; performing grid terrain analysis on the environment mask graph, and constructing a two-dimensional passable area graph; performing incremental path search on the two-dimensional passable area map to obtain a local obstacle avoidance path, and adjusting a safe distance threshold value between the local obstacle avoidance path and the obstacle in combination with the motion state vector; gait phase planning is carried out on the robot, and a joint space trajectory instruction of the robot is generated; according to the invention, the efficiency of dynamic obstacle avoidance of the humanoid robot based on image segmentation can be improved.

title: Intelligent planning method and system for autonomous getting-up action of humanoid robot
abstract: A humanoid robot autonomous getting-up motion intelligent planning method and a humanoid robot autonomous getting-up motion intelligent planning system belong to the field of robot control, and comprise the following steps: collecting and fusing the internal state and external environment information of a robot in real time, and constructing a mixed state vector; outputting a high-level action sequence according to the mixed state vector by adopting an offline trained deep reinforcement learning strategy network; a real-time optimizer based on model predictive control is adopted to convert the behavior semantic instruction into an optimal state trajectory and an optimal control trajectory; and executing the first control quantity of the optimal control trajectory, continuously monitoring the actual state, comparing the actual state with the prediction state of the real-time optimizer based on model prediction control, calculating the deviation between the actual state and the prediction state, triggering local correction if the deviation is small, and triggering global re-planning if the deviation is large. Through the hierarchical intelligent planning architecture, the robot can adaptively cope with various unknown falling postures, a safe, stable and efficient getting-up track is quickly generated, and the autonomy and robustness of the robot are improved.

title: Material box clamping device, humanoid robot and material conveying system
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, and provides a material box clamping device, a humanoid robot and a material conveying system. The pressing plate is used for being fixed to the material box in a limiting mode so that the limiting protrusion can be prevented from being disengaged from the limiting groove. According to the material box clamping device, the precision requirement during material box carrying is lowered, and the material transferring efficiency is improved.

title: Shank mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a shank mechanism of a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of robots. Comprising shanks, connecting rod assemblies, foot plates and connecting assemblies, the shanks are connected with the foot plates through the connecting assemblies, the connecting assemblies are used for driving the foot plates to rotate in the front-back and left-right directions relative to the shanks, the upper ends of the connecting rod assemblies are connected with the shanks, and the lower ends of the connecting rod assemblies are connected with the connecting assemblies; the connecting rod assembly comprises a first driving motor, a second driving motor, a first connecting rod group and a second connecting rod group, the first driving motor and the second driving motor are both mounted on the shank, the upper end of the first connecting rod group is connected with an output shaft of the first driving motor, and the lower end of the first connecting rod group is rotatably connected with one side of the connecting assembly; the upper end of the second connecting rod set is connected with an output shaft of the second driving motor, and the lower end of the second connecting rod set is rotationally connected with the other side of the connecting assembly. The shank mechanism has the technical effects that the movement response speed and flexibility are improved.

title: Humanoid robot hierarchical skill fusion control method and system based on attention mechanism
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot hierarchical skill fusion control method and system based on an attention mechanism, and relates to the field of humanoid robot control. The problems that an existing SkillBlender method is poor in skill fusion weight adaptability, unstable in control and high in energy consumption are solved, and the method comprises the steps that a plurality of basic skill strategies of the human-shaped robot are obtained through pre-training, and parameters of all basic skills are frozen after training is completed; a high-level controller is constructed, state information and task target information of the humanoid robot at the current moment are collected, feature coding is carried out through a state coding module, and high-level state representation is obtained; a learnable skill embedding vector is generated for each basic skill through a skill embedding module, and an attention fusion weight corresponding to each basic skill is generated through an attention weight calculation module; and generating a corresponding sub-target for each basic skill based on the high-level state representation through a sub-target generation module, inputting the current state and the sub-target into a corresponding basic skill strategy, and obtaining action output of each basic skill.

The problems that an existing SkillBlender method is poor in skill fusion weight adaptability, unstable in control and high in energy consumption are solved, and the method comprises the steps that a plurality of basic skill strategies of the human-shaped robot are obtained through pre-training, and parameters of all basic skills are frozen after training is completed; a high-level controller is constructed, state information and task target information of the humanoid robot at the current moment are collected, feature coding is carried out through a state coding module, and high-level state representation is obtained; a learnable skill embedding vector is generated for each basic skill through a skill embedding module, and an attention fusion weight corresponding to each basic skill is generated through an attention weight calculation module; and generating a corresponding sub-target for each basic skill based on the high-level state representation through a sub-target generation module, inputting the current state and the sub-target into a corresponding basic skill strategy, and obtaining action output of each basic skill.

title: Variable stiffness joint driver based on magnetorheological elastomer
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of variable stiffness drivers, and discloses a variable stiffness joint driver based on a magnetorheological elastomer, which comprises a connecting frame used for being connected to a knee joint of a biped robot; the variable stiffness mechanism comprises an electric push rod and a spring-like assembly, the electric push rod is connected to the bottom of the spring-like assembly, the spring-like assembly comprises a magnetorheological fluid opening bottle and a magnetorheological elastic body arranged in the magnetorheological fluid opening bottle, the magnetorheological fluid opening bottle is arranged at the bottom of the connecting frame, and the magnetorheological elastic body is arranged in the magnetorheological fluid opening bottle. The output end of the electric push rod extends out of the first through hole of the magnetorheological elastic body; the excitation assembly comprises a coil framework and an electromagnetic coil wound outside the coil framework, and the coil framework is arranged at the lower end of the magnetorheological fluid opening bottle; and the pressure sensor is arranged between the electric push rod and the magnetorheological fluid open bottle.

title: High-thrust miniature planetary roller screw rod linear humanoid robot joint
abstract: The utility model relates to the field of humanoid robots, discloses a high-thrust miniature planetary roller screw rod linear humanoid robot joint, is applied to a forearm linear joint in a humanoid robot arm, and aims to solve the problem that the precision and the stability are insufficient when an existing humanoid robot joint bears high thrust. The joint comprises a planetary roller lead screw mechanism, a driving motor and a shell, the planetary roller lead screw mechanism is composed of a center lead screw, a plurality of planetary rollers and an annular nut, high-precision linear motion is achieved through rolling of the planetary rollers, the driving motor is connected with the center lead screw through the nut and provides large thrust output, the shell is made of high-strength materials, and the shell is made of high-strength materials. Through the design of the planetary roller lead screw mechanism, the loading capacity and precision of the joint are remarkably improved, and the universal joint is suitable for the field of humanoid robots and has wide application prospects.

title: Laser detection device for producing high-reliability electrode foil for humanoid robot capacitor
abstract: The invention discloses a laser detection device for producing a high-reliability electrode foil for a humanoid robot capacitor, and relates to the technical field of laser detection of electrode foils, the laser detection device comprises a detection frame, two first fixing plates, a second fixing plate and a third fixing plate, the outer side of the detection frame is provided with a rolling assembly, and the two first fixing plates are fixedly connected to the interior of the detection frame; a plurality of mounting plates are arranged in the first fixing plate, the circulating part drives the mounting plates to move to achieve circulating detection, the circulating part drives the laser detection heads to work circularly, a redundant detection system is formed essentially, after one detection head finishes scanning, the next detection head immediately works, and the detection efficiency is improved. According to the invention, uninterrupted continuous detection is realized, and the design avoids false detection caused by temperature drift, performance fluctuation or instantaneous error possibly generated by long-time work of a single detection head.

title: Humanoid robot whole body interaction control method and system based on physical perception redirection and space-time decoupling strategy
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot whole-body interaction control method and system based on a physical perception redirection and space-time decoupling strategy, and the method comprises the steps: converting large-scale human-human interaction data into a human-humanoid robot interaction track maintaining the contact semantic and physical consistency through a physical perception interaction redirection module; accurate contact maintenance is realized through a multi-constraint objective function and two-stage optimization. Constructing a structured data set with stage annotations; then, a space-time decoupling action reasoning network is utilized, long and short time sequence coding, phase attention and multi-scale space coding are fused, and a high-level action anchor point is generated; and finally, converting the command into an executable command through the whole-body controller. The problems that a traditional method is damaged in contact semantics, insufficient in space-time reasoning, difficult in simulation real machine migration and the like are solved, interaction naturalness, robustness and implementability are remarkably improved, and the method is suitable for various social interaction scenes such as embracing and handshaking.

title: Multi-part expression cooperative control method, device, system, equipment and product of anthropomorphic robot
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic robot multi-part expression cooperative control method, device, system, equipment and product, and relates to the technical field of anthropomorphic humans. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining a target expression control signal, then responding to the signal to obtain one-to-one corresponding and mutually independent silence delay parameters for at least two expression execution mechanisms, then synchronously starting a plurality of silence delays based on the parameters, and finally respectively driving the corresponding execution mechanisms when the delays are finished. Therefore, by introducing independent and adjustable silent delay parameters and synchronously starting, the problems of'programmed sequence sense 'and'mechanical cooperation' caused by asynchronous distribution of multi-part action starting instructions in the prior art are solved, and the biological characteristics of'synchronous response and asynchronous execution 'of human facial neural signals are effectively simulated; therefore, the naturalness and life feeling of robot expressions are remarkably improved, and practical application and popularization are facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot for dispensing medicine in pharmacy and medicine dispensing method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot for dispensing medicine in a pharmacy and a medicine dispensing method. The humanoid robot comprises a walking base, a trunk part, humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms, humanoid manipulator mechanisms and a behavior control unit. The trunk part is connected to the top of the walking base, the two opposite sides of the trunk part are connected with humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms correspondingly, the sides, away from the trunk part, of the humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms are connected with humanoid manipulator mechanisms used for grabbing medicine, and the trunk part is provided with a display screen; the behavior control unit is used for controlling the walking base to move to the medicine shelf area; the humanoid mechanical arm mechanism is controlled to move, the humanoid mechanical arm mechanism is driven to grab the target medicine in the medicine shelf area, and the target medicine is temporarily stored in the storage box; and the walking base is controlled to move to the medicine dispensing window, the humanoid manipulator mechanism is controlled to dispense the medicine at the medicine dispensing window, the medication information of the target medicine is displayed through the display screen, and the working efficiency of medicine dispensing of the pharmacy is improved through the humanoid robot.

title: Power recovery system suitable for humanoid robot or multi-legged robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot kinetic energy recovery, and discloses a power recovery system suitable for a humanoid robot or a multi-legged robot. The leg hydraulic buffering unit, the power generation assembly and the air hydraulic buffering unit are connected in series through a hydraulic pipeline to form a closed loop, and an efficient energy capture and conversion chain is constructed; when the feet of the robot make contact with the ground, impact force forces pistons in the hydraulic buffering units to move, and mechanical energy is directly converted into hydraulic energy of high-pressure oil flow; the oil flow immediately drives an impeller and a rotor of the power generation assembly to rotate at a high speed to generate power, instant and direct conversion from impact kinetic energy to electric energy is achieved, the recovery path is short, efficiency is high, and the energy utilization rate of the robot in the walking, running or jumping process is increased.

title: Facial expression control method, device and equipment for anthropomorphic robot, medium and product
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic robot facial expression control method, device and equipment, a medium and a product, and relates to the technical field of anthropomorphic humans. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, receiving an external expression trigger instruction, then planning a corresponding facial expression action sequence, specifically, when each facial expression action in the sequence is planned, actively inserting a silence delay before executing the action, the duration of the silence delay being the duration from instruction receiving to action execution starting, and the duration of the silence delay being the duration from instruction receiving to action execution starting. The ratio of the stimulation-reaction delay to the execution duration of the corresponding action is controlled within a preset interval, and finally the robot face execution mechanism is driven based on the sequence to complete the expression, so that the mechanical and abrupt feeling caused by transient response in the prior art is overcome by actively introducing and quantitatively controlling the proportion of the stimulation-reaction delay to the action duration, and the safety of the robot is improved. And the natural cognitive processing rhythm of human is simulated, so that the facial organ movement of the robot better conforms to the movement mode and reaction rule of human, and the expression naturalness and life feeling are remarkably improved.

title: Head shell assembly for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a head shell assembly for a humanoid robot, which comprises a head cranial shell, a head face shell, a head shell support ring and side ear covers, the head cranial shell and the head face shell are spliced through an angled connecting edge, and the inner walls are respectively provided with a positioning guide mechanism and a screw connecting mechanism which are matched with each other; the head shell supporting ring is provided with a screw connecting seat and a supporting strip groove, and the side ear covers are sealed with the pins through buckles. A bent splicing seam and a head shell mounting cavity are formed after splicing, and a head shell framework mounting position is arranged on the inner wall of the head face shell. In order to overcome the defects that an existing head shell is prone to loosening due to vibration, low in protection level, high in assembly difficulty, concentrated in stress and prone to damage, the technical effects of stable connection, high protection, easy assembly and long service life are achieved through a multi-dimensional connection structure, precise positioning and guiding and dispersed stress design; the device is suitable for a multi-scene humanoid robot with high requirements on head protection, assembly precision and connection stability.

title: Eyeball structure of bionic robot and bionic robot
abstract: According to the eyeball structure of the biomimetic robot and the biomimetic robot, in the eyeball structure of the biomimetic robot, the eyelids, the eyeballs and the driving motor are tightly arranged around the eyeball support, the overall structure is compact and simple, excessive space in the head of the robot is not occupied, and the safety of the robot is improved. The method is particularly suitable for the bionic robot corresponding to equal-proportion reduction of a human body model, production, assembly and after-sales maintenance are easy, and the overall cost is reduced. In addition, a rotating shaft of the eyelids is coaxial with an output shaft of the driving motor, lagging and noise generated during transmission of the transmission mechanism are reduced to the maximum extent, the transmission efficiency is improved, friction resistance is reduced, and the humanoid effect of the bionic robot is more natural and vivid.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent navigation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of navigation, and particularly discloses a humanoid robot intelligent navigation method which comprises the following steps: step S100, receiving a multi-modal input instruction of a user, the multi-modal input instruction comprising a voice instruction or a text instruction; step S200, the multi-mode input instruction is processed, and a structured navigation instruction is generated; s300, acquiring environment information through an environment sensing module, and constructing a three-dimensional semantic map; step S400, based on the structured navigation instruction and the three-dimensional semantic map, planning a motion path of the humanoid robot through a path planning module, and generating a path trajectory; and S500, according to the path track, motion control is executed through a motion control module, the track is converted into a control signal of a joint motor of the humanoid robot, and the balance of the two feet is maintained in real time.

title: Anthropomorphic wear-free joint system of multi-dimensional magnetic suspension and electromagnetic gradual change force control and telescopic bionic muscle tendon
abstract: The invention discloses an anthropomorphic joint system of multi-dimensional magnetic suspension and electromagnetic gradual change force control and telescopic bionic muscle tendons and a control method, and belongs to the technical field of bionic robots, intelligent mechanical joints and electromagnetic control. The technical problems that an existing robot joint is serious in mechanical abrasion, stiff in movement, poor in stability, low in bionic degree, rough in force control effect and the like are solved. The system comprises a multi-dimensional magnetic suspension normal-state stable supporting module, a telescopic bionic muscle tendon module, a multi-unit vector electromagnetic cooperative driving module, an electromagnetic polarity smooth switching and bidirectional driving module and a bionic self-learning gradual change type force control module. Non-contact and wear-free operation of the joints is achieved through multi-dimensional magnetic suspension, anthropomorphic movement is achieved through telescopic bionic muscle tendons, and precise and flexible control is achieved through vector electromagnetism and gradual change force control. The invention has the advantages of zero wear, long service life, multidimensional stability, high humanoid degree, soft force control, simple structure and the like, and is suitable for the fields of humanoid robots, medical rehabilitation robots, intelligent prostheses, humanoid interaction equipment and the like.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical arms, in particular to a humanoid mechanical arm which comprises a connecting joint, a scapular joint, a shoulder joint, a big arm joint, an upper elbow joint, a lower elbow joint, a wrist joint and a paw joint which are sequentially arranged from the near trunk end to the far trunk end. And the joint module is a planetary joint module. Through a highly humanoid multi-joint series connection structure, the movement flexibility and the environmental adaptability of the mechanical arm are remarkably improved. The bionic joint layout from the trunk to the tail end is adopted, and the planetary joint modules are combined for connection, so that multi-degree-of-freedom coordinated movement close to the arms of the human body is realized, and finer and more flexible operation tasks can be completed in a complex unstructured environment.

title: Rigidity-variable gearbox for humanoid robot double-foot driving
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot driving systems, in particular to a variable-rigidity gear box for humanoid robot double-foot driving, and provides the variable-rigidity gear box for humanoid robot double-foot driving to solve the problems in the prior art, the variable-rigidity gear box for humanoid robot double-foot driving comprises a gear box body, and the lower end of the gear box body is fixedly connected with a mounting plate; walking mechanisms are mounted on the two sides of the mounting plate correspondingly, a connecting plate used for mounting a robot is connected to the upper side of the gearbox, and the walking mechanisms provide power through the gearbox to drive the robot to walk; a transition part is arranged between the gear box and the connecting plate, vertical offset vibration of the walking mechanism can be accurately and actively counteracted through the circumferential movement and vertical offset effect of a Reuleaux triangle block in the transition part during rotation, and the influence of vibration on a robot body is greatly reduced in cooperation with the double damping effect of an elastic supporting part and a buffering part; precise elements are prevented from being damaged due to vibration, and the operation stability and service life of the robot are remarkably improved.
