title: Motion control method, boxing control method and system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a motion control method of a humanoid robot and a boxing control method and system, and belongs to the technical field of motion control of humanoid robots. According to an existing robot action recognition scheme, collected action data are lost, and the existing robot action recognition scheme cannot be applied to action control of a humanoid robot. According to the motion control method of the humanoid robot, sensing topology position information is established based on the motion scene of the humanoid robot, and then one or more sensors can be arranged at multiple positions on motion capture clothes respectively to form a contact type motion capture structure; a contact type motion capture structure is utilized to obtain motion data of an operator, so that the problem of motion data missing caused by shielding or light interference can be effectively avoided; and on the basis of a motion capture control algorithm, a motion control instruction about the humanoid robot is generated, so that the robot can be accurately controlled, effective interaction between an operator and the humanoid robot is realized, and the method is suitable for various scenes.

title: Robot joint module thermal management system based on phase change working medium injection
abstract: The invention discloses a robot joint module thermal management system based on phase change working medium injection, and relates to the field of robots, and the system comprises a central high-pressure storage and supply unit which is used for storing a liquid phase change working medium and stabilizing the pressure of the liquid phase change working medium to a set working pressure; the flexible high-pressure common rail pipe network is connected with the central high-pressure storage and supply unit and is used for conveying the liquid phase change working medium to each joint module of the robot; the joint module cooling injection assemblies are arranged at the joint modules correspondingly, communicate with the flexible high-pressure common rail pipe network and are used for conducting pulse injection, phase change heat absorption and waste cold secondary utilization on the liquid phase change working media; and the hierarchical control subsystem is connected with the central high-pressure storage and supply unit and the joint module cooling injection assembly and used for controlling the injection flow of the liquid phase change working medium. The heat dissipation problem restricting the humanoid/quadruped robot from a test prototype to engineering application can be solved, and the thermal failure risk of the joint module is remarkably reduced.

title: Method for planning cooperative movement of upper limbs and waist of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot upper limb and waist cooperative motion planning method, which comprises the following steps: adjusting an elbow joint solution space range according to an analysis result of a geometric constraint degree and a joint angular velocity variation; positioning potential singular point position distribution in the solution space based on the angular velocity gradient change in the solution space range formed after adjustment; according to the singular point position distribution and the adjusted solution space range, the avoidance capability of candidate path points in the waist forward trajectory is evaluated, and a collaborative planning path is generated; the collaborative planning path is simulated and executed, the avoiding effect of the singular point position is evaluated, and a motion control scheme is output; and iteratively updating the joint angular velocity variable quantity according to the motion control scheme, and confirming that the cooperative motion planning is completed.

title: Lower limb structure of bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a lower limb structure of a bionic humanoid robot, and aims to overcome the defects that the upper part of a leg structure of a robot is bloated, the inertia is large, and a force bearing arm is short. The thigh body and the shank body are hinged together, a thigh turnover seat is hinged to the upper portion of the thigh body, a knee joint assembly is installed on the thigh body and comprises a knee joint pusher and a knee joint connecting rod, the knee joint connecting rod is hinged to the shank body, and a knee joint ejector rod is hinged between the knee joint connecting rod and the thigh body; the knee joint pusher is hinged to the thigh body, and a telescopic rod of the knee joint pusher is hinged to the knee joint connecting rod. According to the bionic humanoid robot lower limb structure, the space utilization rate and mass inertia distribution are optimized, the upper portion is prevented from being bloated, and the bionic humanoid robot lower limb structure has good bionic performance, engineering practicability and expansibility.

title: Joint structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a joint structure of a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robot joint structures, the joint structure of the humanoid robot comprises a shoulder piece, a first support frame is fixed on the inner wall of an opening of the shoulder piece, and the inner wall of the first support frame is rotatably connected with an upper cover arm through a bearing; a plurality of air outlets are formed in the side wall of the upper cover arm side by side at equal intervals; according to the joint structure of the humanoid robot, heat dissipation of the driving motors at the upper joint and the lower joint can be completed through one air inlet fan, the load of the arm structure is reduced, and operation energy consumption is reduced.

title: Part maintenance device for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of part maintenance devices, in particular to a part maintenance device for a humanoid robot, which comprises a shell, a motor is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, a rotating shaft is mounted at the output end of the motor, and a slot connected with a screwdriver blade is formed in the other end of the rotating shaft. A slot is formed in the shell, a magnetic attraction block for attracting the screwdriver blade is arranged on the inner wall of the slot, a storage battery is arranged on the inner wall of the shell, a control panel for controlling the motor is arranged on the shell wall of the shell, and after the screwdriver blade is inserted into a part of the humanoid robot, the motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate; and therefore, the rotating shaft drives the screwdriver head to detach part screws, inserted into the humanoid robot, of the screwdriver head, and the detaching efficiency is improved.

title: Waist and hip component of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot waist and hip component which comprises a rear plate, a waist side turning module and two hip side turning modules. The middle driving fixing piece is detachably connected with the rear plate; the output end of the waist side-turning module is connected with a waist side-turning turnover connecting piece penetrating through the axial direction of the waist side-turning module, and the output ends of the two hip side-turning modules are respectively connected with hip side-turning turnover connecting pieces penetrating through the axial direction of the hip side-turning modules; the front plate is connected with the end, away from the rear plate, of the middle driving fixing piece and forms a sandwich structure together with the rear plate. The double-side supporting structure and the deep groove ball bearing disperse axial loads to the front plate and the rear plate, the overturning moment borne by a motor bearing is reduced, the service life of key components is prolonged, and the assembly is convenient to install and improves coordination and expansibility of upper limbs and lower limbs of the robot.

title: Linear actuator for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a linear actuator for a humanoid robot, which relates to the technical field of linear actuators for robots and comprises a shell, limiting lines are annularly and uniformly distributed on the inner wall of the shell, a moving plate is slidably connected into the shell through the limiting lines, and a universal ball seat is arranged at the top of the moving plate. A plurality of spherical joints which are sequentially connected are arranged at the top of the universal ball seat, the output end of the linear actuator can be bent in any direction in the mode that the universal ball seat is connected with the spherical joints, and the linear actuator can still effectively rotate or stretch out and draw back after being bent. In the rotating and stretching process, the spherical joint can adapt to different bending and transmission angles, a guide ring and a guide plate are arranged on the top and in the shell correspondingly, the spherical joint part which does not stretch out completely is limited, and it is guaranteed that the spherical joint part can automatically reset in the stretching or retracting process; the situation that the spherical lamp joint cannot effectively rotate and stretch out and draw back under the bending state due to the influence of the shape of the spherical lamp joint is avoided.

title: Humanoid robot control method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot control method and system based on reinforcement learning, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the path planning of a humanoid robot through a robot control model according to the current position, stacking task and residual energy of the humanoid robot, and obtaining an optimal path, executing control processing of the humanoid robot in the target stacking area according to the optimal path; the robot control model is obtained by training through a GNN graph neural network, reinforcement learning and a Monte Carlo tree search method. The method has the beneficial effects that the carrying efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved, the energy consumption is reduced, and the flexibility of path planning is enhanced.

title: Compact motor reducer and joint module for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a compact motor reducer and joint module for a humanoid robot. The compact motor reducer comprises a planet magnetic gear composite motor and a secondary planet wheel assembly. The planetary magnetic gear composite motor comprises a stator winding, a magnetic gear ring and a primary planetary magnetic gear transmission mechanism, and the primary planetary magnetic gear transmission mechanism is magnetically coupled with the stator winding and the magnetic gear ring respectively; the second-stage planet wheel assembly comprises a second-stage sun wheel, a second-stage planet wheel, a second-stage inner gear ring and a second-stage planet carrier, the second-stage sun wheel is in transmission connection with the output end of the first-stage planet magnetic gear transmission mechanism, and the second-stage sun wheel, the second-stage planet wheel and the second-stage inner gear ring are sequentially in meshing transmission to form a gear planet transmission pair. The planetary magnetic gear composite motor and the second-stage planetary gear assembly are arranged in series in the axial direction. The motor and a primary planetary transmission mechanism are integrated, and magnetic gear transmission is adopted, so that the axial size is shortened, the weight is reduced, the transmission efficiency is improved, the back clearance is reduced, and the operation noise can be reduced.

title: Biped robot parallel ankle joint design method and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a biped robot parallel ankle joint design method and a biped robot. According to the design method for the parallel ankle joints of the biped robot, two sets of spatial four-bar mechanisms are constructed for parallel ankle joint mechanical structures in the biped robot and all hinge point positions of all parts, and the spatial four-bar mechanisms are converted into equivalent planar motion mechanisms for qualitative motion analysis; the method comprises the steps that firstly, a motion model is constructed according to a motion analysis result, kinematics analysis is carried out, known parameter information, unknown parameter information and limiting condition information are determined, finally, the known parameter information and the limiting condition information are input into the motion model to carry out kinematics equation solving, the unknown parameter information is determined, and therefore design is completed. Therefore, the design method provided by the invention does not need to repeatedly iterate for multiple times, is low in difficulty and high in efficiency, reduces the development cost, and solves the problem of insufficient scheme optimization of the existing empirical trial and error design method.

title: Humanoid robot automatic mounting and charging device and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot automatic mounting charging device and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of robot auxiliary equipment.The humanoid robot automatic mounting charging device comprises a base, a wall-leaning supporting frame, an electric lifting driving assembly and a detection control module, the wall-leaning supporting frame is arranged on the rear side of the top of the base, and the electric lifting driving assembly is arranged on the wall-leaning supporting frame; a sliding seat is arranged at the output end of the electric lifting driving assembly, a through groove is formed in the sliding seat, a transverse rail is installed in the through groove, the two ends of the transverse rail are located on the two sides of the sliding seat, and armpit lifting assemblies are arranged on the transverse rail in a sliding mode; the armpit lifting assemblies are adjustable in distance and have floating compensation, the back attaching assembly and the waist limiting assembly cooperate to form three-point type stable hanging, the height of the magnetic attraction universal contact charging assembly is adjustable, and the butt joint reliability can be improved by combining magnetic attraction alignment and elastic contacts; and the detection control module has limiting and charging linkage interlocking functions, so that the use safety and the charging reliability are effectively improved.
abstract_en: The invention provides a humanoid robot automatic mounting charging device and a control method thereof, and relates to the technical field of robot auxiliary equipment.The humanoid robot automatic mounting charging device comprises a base, a wall-leaning supporting frame, an electric lifting driving assembly and a detection control module, the wall-leaning supporting frame is arranged on the rear side of the top of the base, and the electric lifting driving assembly is arranged on the wall-leaning supporting frame; a sliding seat is arranged at the output end of the electric lifting driving assembly, a through groove is formed in the sliding seat, a transverse rail is installed in the through groove, the two ends of the transverse rail are located on the two sides of the sliding seat, and armpit lifting assemblies are arranged on the transverse rail in a sliding mode; the armpit lifting assemblies are adjustable in distance and have floating compensation, the back attaching assembly and the waist limiting assembly cooperate to form three-point type stable hanging, the height of the magnetic attraction universal contact charging assembly is adjustable, and the butt joint reliability can be improved by combining magnetic attraction alignment and elastic contacts; and the detection control module has limiting and charging linkage interlocking functions, so that the use safety and the charging reliability are effectively improved.

title: Two-arm cooperative control method of wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a two-arm cooperative control method of a wheeled humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring environment, task and robot global data, and establishing a two-arm DH model; decomposing tasks through a hierarchical task network algorithm, and selecting a master arm and slave arm or two-arm cooperation mode in combination with a deep learning algorithm; and corresponding master-slave or parallel cooperative control methods are adopted for different modes. According to the invention, accurate matching of the control strategy and the operation mode is realized, the operation precision, the cooperation efficiency and the scene adaptability are improved, the operation stability and reliability are guaranteed, and the method is suitable for complex operation scenes.

title: Surgical instrument switching system and switching method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a surgical instrument switching system and method for a humanoid robot. The system comprises a plurality of surgical instruments, a robot and an instrument library. The robot comprises a mechanical arm, the mechanical arm comprises a connecting part, the connecting part is used for being detachably connected with the surgical instrument, the connecting part is provided with a touch switch, and the touch switch is used for responding to target operation for the touch switch so that the connecting part can be separated from the surgical instrument. The instrument library is used for storing a plurality of surgical instruments and comprises a first body and a second body, and the first body is sleeved with the second body; the unloading mechanism is arranged on the lower portion, located on the second body, of the first body, the unloading mechanism is provided with a target space for containing the connecting part, and the unloading mechanism is suitable for executing target operation on the touch switch under the condition that the connecting part is located in the target space; the storage mechanism is arranged on the second body, and the storage mechanism is suitable for storing the surgical instruments separated from the connecting part and installing the stored surgical instruments to the connecting part.

title: Humanoid robot action redirection optimization method based on physical constraint
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action redirection optimization method based on physical constraints, and belongs to the field of humanoid robot imitation learning. According to the existing action redirection technology, the problems of non-physical floating, ground penetration and insufficient dynamic stability easily occur when high-dynamic actions are migrated due to the fact that dynamic constraints and physical characteristics of a robot are not fully considered. Human body motion data are obtained through motion capture and converted into parameterized parameters, three types of physical constraint modules of motion stability, fuselage height and joint motion range are introduced in the redirection process, constraint loss and task reconstruction loss are collaboratively optimized by adopting a gradient descent algorithm, and robot joint tracks conforming to physical laws are output. The non-physical motion phenomenon can be eliminated, the dynamic stability and the physical rationality of the motion are improved, guarantee is provided for accurate migration of the high-dynamic motion, and the method is suitable for humanoid robot imitation learning scenes.

title: Humanoid robot arm structure for logistics sorting
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm structure for logistics sorting, and relates to the technical field of logistics sorting equipment, the humanoid robot arm structure comprises a robot arm and a rotating platform, and further comprises a grabbing mechanism, the grabbing mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the rotating platform, and the grabbing mechanism comprises a guide groove formed in the surface of the rotating platform; two movable connecting blocks are slidably connected to the interior of the guide groove, a sorting claw is fixedly connected to the lower surface of each movable connecting block, a plurality of sliding grooves are formed in the surface of each sorting claw, sliding blocks are slidably connected to the interiors of the sliding grooves, and every two sliding blocks form a group; and an abutting frame is fixedly connected between every two vertically-corresponding sliding blocks, a pressurizing air bag is fixedly connected to the interior of each sorting claw, the surface of each pressurizing air bag communicates with an air conveying hose, and an air conveying pump is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the rotating platform, so that the problems that the sorting effect and practicability of various types of packages are poor are solved.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a humanoid robot arm structure for logistics sorting, and relates to the technical field of logistics sorting equipment, the humanoid robot arm structure comprises a robot arm and a rotating platform, and further comprises a grabbing mechanism, the grabbing mechanism is arranged on the lower surface of the rotating platform, and the grabbing mechanism comprises a guide groove formed in the surface of the rotating platform; two movable connecting blocks are slidably connected to the interior of the guide groove, a sorting claw is fixedly connected to the lower surface of each movable connecting block, a plurality of sliding grooves are formed in the surface of each sorting claw, sliding blocks are slidably connected to the interiors of the sliding grooves, and every two sliding blocks form a group; and an abutting frame is fixedly connected between every two vertically-corresponding sliding blocks, a pressurizing air bag is fixedly connected to the interior of each sorting claw, the surface of each pressurizing air bag communicates with an air conveying hose, and an air conveying pump is fixedly connected to the upper surface of the rotating platform, so that the problems that the sorting effect and practicability of various types of packages are poor are solved.

title: Humanoid robot control method, system, device, medium, and program
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and provides a humanoid robot control method, system, device, medium and program, the control method comprises the following steps: controlling an environment sensing unit to scan an operation area and generate first environment point cloud data representing a static map; controlling a visual perception unit to acquire pose data of the target object; a force sense feedback unit integrated at the tail end of the mechanical arm executing mechanism is controlled, and force sense feedback data of the mechanical arm executing mechanism in the process of making contact with the target object is detected; according to the pose data, the first environment point cloud data and a preset operation strategy library, a motion track of a mechanical arm executing mechanism is generated; controlling an environment sensing unit to scan the operation area in real time and generate second environment point cloud data representing dynamic obstacle distribution; and correcting the motion track in real time according to the second environment point cloud data to obtain an obstacle avoidance path. The method is used for solving the problems of safe operation and high-precision operation of the humanoid robot in a dynamic change environment.

title: FeNi soft magnetic composite material for axial flux motor and preparation method of FeNi soft magnetic composite material
abstract: The invention discloses a FeNi soft magnetic composite material for an axial flux motor and a preparation method of the FeNi soft magnetic composite material, KH550 hydrolysis and surface bonding reaction are controlled, a compact SiO2-based composite insulating layer with firm interface bonding is constructed on FeNi alloy powder with D50 of 20-30 [mu] m, and the thickness is as low as about 5 nm. After high-pressure forming and reduction annealing, the obtained composite material has high effective magnetic conductivity, low iron loss and excellent mechanical strength. When being used for preparing the stator core of the axial flux motor, the iron loss and excitation loss of the motor can be remarkably reduced, the efficiency and power density of the motor are improved, and the stator core is particularly suitable for high-requirement application scenes such as humanoid robot driving motors.

title: Method and device for pre-judging distance and planning attitude before grabbing of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a distance pre-judgment and attitude planning method and device before grabbing of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: setting moment monitoring parameters of each joint of two arms based on an initial bearing moment, and carrying out the monitoring, the maximum deviation value between the actual monitoring torque value of the near-center-of-mass side joint and the preset initial bearing torque reference value serves as the torque peak value difference of the near-center-of-mass side joint; adjusting torque distribution according to the torque peak difference so as to reduce a near-center-of-mass side vertical supporting torque and increase a far-center-of-mass side compensation torque, determining target torque values of all joints, and generating a joint torque distribution scheme; and executing the joint torque distribution scheme, verifying the contact state of the near-center-of-mass side contact point, comparing the local deformation quantity of the near-center-of-mass side with a preset slippage instability limit value, and outputting a torque peak value control result containing the current torque balance state of the two arms.

title: Humanoid robot servo constraint robust control method and system based on Stackelberg game
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a humanoid robot servo constraint robust control method and system based on a Stackelberg game, and belongs to the technical field of robot servo control and robust control. The control method comprises the following steps: constructing a two-arm system of the humanoid robot; a humanoid robot dynamic model with uncertainty is constructed according to the humanoid robot two-arm system; determining a servo constraint equation of the kinetic model; constructing a robust controller; constructing a control parameter setting model based on a Stackelberg game, and performing optimization determination under engineering constraint on key control parameters in the robust controller according to the control parameter setting model to obtain an optimal parameter solution; and the optimal parameter solution is input into the humanoid robot double-arm system to obtain the optimal performance. According to the invention, optimization and setting of controller parameters are realized through the Stackelberg game, so that the system has high-precision trajectory tracking capability, high robustness and stable control input in an uncertain environment.

title: Human-machine stiffness mapping-based humanoid variable impedance control method
abstract: A humanoid variable impedance control method based on man-machine stiffness mapping comprises the following steps: constructing an extended DMP framework on a two-dimensional sphere manifold, and uniformly modeling motion trail, tail end stiffness and contact force information in human multi-modal demonstration; a human upper body kinematics model is established based on the spinor theory, a hierarchical task control strategy is adopted, tail end pose tracking is used as a main task, and chassis movement and arm configuration coordination is used as a secondary task; a humanoid variable impedance control law is designed by combining demonstration force and man-machine operation difference, and closed-loop tracking of expected force/torque is achieved; during working, the system learns motion and interaction strategies from human body demonstration, and generates coordinated and smooth arm coordination actions. The robot has the beneficial effects that the direction track is free of singularity, motion-rigidity-force integrated reproduction is achieved, the strong coupling coordination of the vehicle arms is good, interaction is smooth and self-adaptive, and the humanoid performance and the environment adaptability of the robot in tasks such as carrying are remarkably improved.

title: Multi-stage course assisted robot action learning method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-stage course assisted robot action learning method, and belongs to the technical field of robot motion control. The method solves the problems that an existing method is still difficult to achieve accurate control over the jumping distance and the landing point, the real-time performance is poor, and the generalization ability among various types of jumping targets is poor. And in combination with a staged reward shaping and whole body coordination guiding mechanism, the humanoid robot forms a stable angular momentum management and body coordination mode in each key stage, so that not only are the jumping performance and the drop point precision improved, but also the posture recovery capability and the anti-disturbance performance in a high-impact scene are remarkably enhanced. And two core technologies of torque control domain optimization and friction identification compensation are provided, so that the training strategy is subjected to dynamic constraint consistent with that of real hardware in a simulation stage. The real machine feasibility of the strategy is greatly improved by constructing a continuous derivable torque-angular velocity feasible region model and friction parameter identification based on an improved Stribeck model. The method can be applied to robot motion control.

title: Color paste for skin of humanoid robot and preparation method of color paste
abstract: The invention relates to the field of color paste, in particular to color paste for skin of a humanoid robot and a preparation method of the color paste. The invention discloses color paste for the skin of a humanoid robot. The color paste comprises the following raw materials: a carrier base, a coloring agent, a dispersing agent, an anchoring combination agent, a skin feeling regulator, an anti-ultraviolet agent, a gum combination agent and the like. According to the prepared color paste for the skin of the humanoid robot, on the premise that excellent safety is guaranteed, the actual application effect of a coloring layer is remarkably improved, the color paste guarantees harmlessness of contact with the skin of the human body, and in the aspect of the application effect, by strengthening an internal anchoring system, the skin of the humanoid robot is protected; the colored silica gel skin has excellent interface bonding strength and mechanical scrubbing resistance, the original soft touch feeling and fine texture of a silica gel material are kept, the robot skin is highly simulated in appearance and touch feeling, and the comprehensive requirements of humanoid robots for attractiveness, safety and durability are perfectly met.

title: Humanoid robot intelligent interaction method and system based on open source gap
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot intelligent interaction method and system based on an open source gap, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the identity information and sensing parameters of a target object when the target object is sensed to enter a welcome area; identifying the identity of the target object according to the identity information, and playing a corresponding welcome word according to the identified identity; obtaining historical records or preference information of the target object according to the identity information, and analyzing the intention and demand of the target object in combination with the sensing parameters, the historical records or the preference information; and navigating the target object to a corresponding welcome area according to the intention and the demand, and recommending a specified activity or facility to the target object. According to the invention, the welcome efficiency of the humanoid robot is improved, and the humanized interaction and continuous optimization capabilities of the humanoid robot are enhanced.

title: Wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a wheeled humanoid robot. The wheeled humanoid robot comprises a movable chassis, a chest and a mechanical arm. The movable chassis is provided with a battery bin used for containing a battery. And the chest is connected with the movable chassis. The mechanical arm is connected with the chest cavity and can take out the battery from the battery bin and load the battery into the battery bin. When the wheeled humanoid robot is used and the electric quantity of the battery is smaller than a target value, the movable chassis can move to the battery replacing equipment, the battery with the lower electric quantity in the battery bin is taken out through the mechanical arm, and then the fully-charged battery is grabbed and loaded into the battery bin. Therefore, the battery can be automatically replaced, time and labor are saved, and extra large battery replacement equipment is not needed.

title: Foot driving structure for humanoid robot and pitching motion method
abstract: The invention discloses a foot driving structure for a humanoid robot and a pitching motion method, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots, the foot driving structure comprises a sole and a support frame fixed at the top end of the sole, and main bodies of a first motor and a second motor are fixed on two sides of the support frame in an up-down staggered manner; a first connecting line between the main body center point of the first motor and the main body center point of the second motor and a second connecting line between the output shaft center point of the first motor and the output shaft center point of the second motor intersect to form an intersection point, and the intersection point is located on the center line of the rear side of the supporting frame; the output axes of the first motor and the second motor are symmetrically arranged in a non-parallel mode, so that couple moment applied to the supporting frame is symmetrically balanced on the horizontal plane when the two motors are driven. According to the foot driving structure for the humanoid robot and the pitching motion method, through the dual-motor space geometry optimization layout, the integrated radial anti-loosening cover plate design and the directional lightweight groove structure, collaborative improvement of the mechanical property, the transmission reliability and the lightweight is achieved.

title: Intelligent composite robot for patrol inspection
abstract: The utility model provides an intelligent composite robot for patrol inspection, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problems that an existing robot can only provide basic detection functions, such as abnormal activity monitoring through a camera and an infrared sensor and some air quality analysis functions, and does not have the functions of protecting and stopping some abnormal behaviors or dangerous behaviors are solved. The robot comprises a base and a trunk, wherein the trunk is of a human-body-imitating mechanical structure; a plurality of power wheels are arranged on the base, each power wheel comprises a hub motor, steering mechanisms are further arranged on the base and used for driving the power wheels to steer, the steering mechanisms correspond to the power wheels one to one, and the steering mechanisms drive the corresponding power wheels to steer independently. The robot has the advantages that the trunk is of a humanoid structure, the power wheels are installed at the bottom, the robot is driven by the power wheels to advance, the moving speed is higher, in-situ rotation can be achieved through the reversing mechanism, and reversing can also be achieved in a narrow space.

title: Humanoid robot foot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a humanoid robot foot which comprises a leg bone, an adapter, an arch, a rear sole and a front sole. The foot of a traditional humanoid robot is divided into the three modules of the foot arch, the rear sole and the front sole, the real supporting phase, the real swinging phase and the two-phase interconversion process are better simulated, then the gait of a real person can be simulated, and the balance, the stability and the walking speed of the humanoid robot during walking can be improved. Meanwhile, by means of the first rotating shaft, the front-back foot lifting action of the ankle joint of a real person can be simulated. By means of the second rotating shaft, the left-right skimming action of the ankle joint of a real human can be simulated. The third rotating shaft enables the rear sole to rotate relative to the arch. The fourth rotating shaft enables the front sole to rotate relative to the arch. The adaptive capacity of the feet of the humanoid robot to the terrain and the movement flexibility are improved, and the application scene is widened.

title: Finger structure, dexterous hand, mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a finger structure, a dexterous hand, a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots, the finger structure comprises a first finger section, a second finger section and a third finger section which are hinged in sequence, and a first tendon rope and a second tendon rope which respectively penetrate into the finger structure in sequence. One end of the first tendon rope is connected to a first check block arranged in the first finger section, an elastic reset piece for being pressed by the first check block is further arranged in the first finger section, and the other end of the first tendon rope is configured to be used for being fixedly connected to a palm part of the humanoid robot. One end of the second tendon rope is connected with the first finger section, the other end of the second tendon rope is configured to be used for being connected with a winch, the fingers can be converted into a bent state from a straightened state through the pulling effect of the second tendon rope, and meanwhile the elastic reset piece is compressed to accumulate elastic potential energy. And the finger structure can be automatically recovered from the bending state to the finger straightening state by virtue of the elastic resetting effect of the elastic resetting piece.

title: Self-adaptive foot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a self-adaptive foot (100) and a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of robots, the self-adaptive foot (100) is applied to the humanoid robot, and the self-adaptive foot (100) comprises a sole part (1); the middle arch (2) is located on the sole part (1) and used for being connected with a shank part of the humanoid robot; the front arch (3) and the rear arch (4) are located at the front end and the rear end of the sole part (1) respectively, and the two ends are hinged to the sole part (1) and the middle arch (2) respectively; the two ends of the first plate spring (5) and the two ends of the second plate spring (6) are fixedly connected to the foot sole part (1) and the middle arch (2) respectively. Seen from the side face of the self-adaptive foot (100), the foot sole part (1), the middle arch (2), the front arch (3) and the rear arch (4) jointly form a quadrilateral structure.

title: Ankle structure for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to an ankle structure for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The ankle structure comprises: a shank body; the first fixed end of the first joint module is fixedly connected with the shank body; a second fixed end of the second joint module is fixedly connected with the shank body; the first rotating wheel is connected with the first output end of the first joint module; the second rotating wheel is connected with the second output end of the second joint module; the ankle joint assembly comprises a pitching part and a heeling part; the third rotating wheel is fixedly connected with the pitching part, and the third rotating wheel is connected with the first rotating wheel through a first transmission piece; the first rotating reversing piece is fixedly connected with the side inclining part; the second rotating reversing piece is meshed with the first rotating reversing piece; the fourth rotating wheel is fixedly connected with the second rotating reversing piece; and the fourth rotating wheel is connected with the second rotating wheel through a second transmission part.

title: Waist and hip assembly and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a waist and hip assembly and a humanoid robot comprising the same. The waist and hip assembly comprises a first supporting body used for being connected with a chest structure of the humanoid robot; the second supporting body is used for being connected with a leg structure of the humanoid robot; the first support body and the second support body are rotatably connected around a first axis; the first rotary actuator is mounted on the second supporting body and is used for providing rotary motion around a second axis so as to realize relative rotation of the first supporting body and the second supporting body; a second rotary actuator mounted to the second support body for providing a rotational motion about a third axis to drive the leg structure; the output end of the first rotary actuator is connected with the first supporting body through a transmission mechanism; the first axis and the second axis extend in the Z direction and are not collinear in the space. The extending ranges of the first rotary actuator and the second rotary actuator in the Z direction at least partially coincide; and the Z direction is the up-down direction of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented multi-source information fusion device and method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-source information fusion device and method for a humanoid robot. The device comprises a clock synchronization module and a sensor array processing module. The clock synchronization module is used for generating and distributing a global clock according to a clock source signal of the clock device or clock information of the Ethernet interface, so that the global clock is used as a working clock of the humanoid robot-oriented multi-source information fusion device; the sensor array processing module is used for configuring an interface of the sensor array processing module so as to adapt to a plurality of accessed sensors; and the sensor array processing module is also used for transmitting the global clock to the plurality of sensors and receiving multi-source sensor signals obtained by synchronous sampling of the plurality of sensors. According to the invention, the plurality of sensors are flexibly accessed through the configurable sensor array processing module, and the clock synchronization of the plurality of sensors is realized by combining the clock synchronization module, so that the hardware adaptability and the clock synchronization precision of the plurality of sensors are improved.

title: Light bearing for intelligent robot with body, speed reducer and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent robot with a body, a speed reducer and a light bearing for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots and intelligent technologies, and the light bearing for the humanoid robot comprises an inner ring, an outer ring and a roller; the inner ring is rotatably sleeved with the outer ring, the inner ring comprises an inner ring body and an inner raceway, the outer ring comprises an outer ring body and an outer raceway, the inner raceway is arranged on the periphery of the inner ring body, the outer raceway is arranged on the inner periphery of the outer ring body, and a raceway cavity is defined between the inner raceway and the outer raceway; at least one of the inner ring body and the outer ring body is made of a light high-strength material with the density lower than 3 g/cm and the specific strength higher than 100 MPa.cm/g. The rollers are installed in the raceway cavities in a rolling mode. According to the technical scheme, the weight of the bearing is reduced, and the lightweight design requirement is met.

title: Humanoid robot ankle joint integrated driving module based on parallel double motors
abstract: The humanoid robot ankle joint integrated driving module comprises an outer frame and a transmission mechanism arranged in the outer frame, the transmission mechanism comprises a first motor, a second motor, a first speed reducer and a second speed reducer, and the first motor and the second motor are symmetrically and fixedly arranged in the outer frame in the axial direction; output shafts of the first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are respectively connected with a synchronous belt mechanism, the first motor is connected with an input shaft of the first speed reducer through one synchronous belt mechanism, the second motor is in transmission connection with an input shaft of the second speed reducer through the other synchronous belt mechanism, and output shafts of the first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are coaxially aligned. The first speed reducer is located under the first motor, and the second speed reducer is located under the second motor. The two independent transmission mechanisms drive two degrees of freedom, double-degree-of-freedom non-coupling driving is achieved, the complexity of a control system is low, extra gaps are eliminated, and the impact resistance is improved through the synchronous belt mechanism, the monitoring assembly and the tension adjusting assembly.
abstract_en: The humanoid robot ankle joint integrated driving module comprises an outer frame and a transmission mechanism arranged in the outer frame, the transmission mechanism comprises a first motor, a second motor, a first speed reducer and a second speed reducer, and the first motor and the second motor are symmetrically and fixedly arranged in the outer frame in the axial direction; output shafts of the first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are respectively connected with a synchronous belt mechanism, the first motor is connected with an input shaft of the first speed reducer through one synchronous belt mechanism, the second motor is in transmission connection with an input shaft of the second speed reducer through the other synchronous belt mechanism, and output shafts of the first speed reducer and the second speed reducer are coaxially aligned. The two independent transmission mechanisms drive two degrees of freedom, double-degree-of-freedom non-coupling driving is achieved, the complexity of a control system is low, extra gaps are eliminated, and the impact resistance is improved through the synchronous belt mechanism, the monitoring assembly and the tension adjusting assembly.

title: Spliced chest shell structure for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a spliced thoracic cavity shell structure for a humanoid robot, which adopts an integral structure formed by splicing front and back split bodies, and a plurality of functional openings are formed by encircling corresponding grooves of shells on two sides, so that stable and accurate butt joint of a trunk, a neck, shoulders and lower limb parts is guaranteed, and the structure is simple and convenient to use. The overall connection strength of the shell is greatly improved by means of a double splicing and fixing structure, and the deformation problem of the functional opening is effectively avoided; meanwhile, a multi-stage stepped positioning and sealing structure is arranged at the neck butt joint part, an adapting part and a split type protection assembly are matched, the sealing performance and the assembly convenience of the joint part are optimized, a shoulder protection structure, a heat dissipation dustproof structure and a convenient maintenance structure are additionally arranged in a matched mode, the overall structure stability, the operation adaptability and the practical functionality are considered, and the practicability is high. And the use requirements of humanoid robot thoracic cavity core system packaging and multi-component cooperative butt joint can be met.

title: Rigid-flexible coupling transmission type dexterous hand, humanoid robot and grabbing method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot actuators, in particular to a rigid-flexible coupling transmission type dexterous hand, a humanoid robot and a grabbing method. The dexterous hand comprises a palm assembly, a finger assembly and a driving mechanism. The finger assembly at least comprises a near-end knuckle and a far-end knuckle which are hinged in sequence, the near-end knuckle is rotationally installed on the edge of the palm assembly, and a reset spring is arranged between the adjacent knuckles on the back side of the finger assembly. The driving mechanism comprises a chain transmission unit, a gear transmission unit and a flexible transmission unit, the chain transmission unit is connected with the gear transmission unit and used for driving the near-end knuckles to rotate relative to the palm assembly, the flexible transmission unit comprises a tendon rope, one end of the tendon rope is wound around the palm assembly, and the other end of the tendon rope is wound around the gear transmission unit. And the other end is connected with the tail end of the far-end knuckle. According to the invention, deep coupling of two transmission modes is realized, so that the dexterous hand is balanced between high-load grabbing and fine self-adaptive operation.

title: Method for manufacturing motor and joint motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a manufacturing method of a motor and a joint motor for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of motors, in the manufacturing method of the motor provided by the embodiment of the invention, a redundant part is formed on one radial side of an iron core segment, and the redundant part is utilized to realize circumferential splicing of each initial iron core segment structure; therefore, a positioning structure can be prevented from being formed on the iron core segments, the integrity of the iron core segments can be guaranteed, the forming difficulty of the positioning parts can be reduced, and the manufacturing difficulty of the iron core segments can be reduced. Moreover, the iron core segments are spliced after the wires are wound on the iron core segments, so that enough operation space can be provided for winding of the wires, the number of turns of the wires wound on each iron core segment can be increased, the slot fullness rate can be increased, and improvement of the performance of the motor is facilitated.

title: Silica gel production and preparation method for humanoid robot cable and application of silica gel production and preparation method
abstract: The invention relates to a production and preparation method and application of silica gel for a humanoid robot cable, and belongs to the technical field of silica gel materials. According to the preparation method, the reactive flame-retardant plasticizer is prepared, the reactive flame-retardant plasticizer normally plays a role in toughening during mixing, and in a high-temperature vulcanization forming stage, aldehyde groups in the reactive flame-retardant plasticizer can react with amino groups on the surface of modified nano silicon dioxide to form stable chemical bonds; the plasticizer and the flame-retardant component are effectively anchored by using the solid filler nano silicon dioxide, migration of the plasticizer and the flame-retardant component is effectively inhibited, and moreover, after the reaction, a silicone oil long chain in the reactive flame retardant plasticizer can also be used as a flexible chain segment, so that the flame-retardant property is improved. The compatibility and the interface bonding force between the nano silicon dioxide and a silica gel matrix are effectively improved, and the mechanical property and the wear resistance of the finished silica gel are remarkably enhanced.

title: Multilayer material for friction part of humanoid robot and processing method
abstract: The invention discloses a multilayer material for a humanoid robot friction part and a processing method. The multi-layer material comprises TC4 titanium alloy sheets and PEEK sheets, the TC4 titanium alloy sheets and the PEEK sheets are alternately arranged to form the multi-layer material, and an epoxy resin binder is arranged between every two adjacent sheets; the outer surface of the end of the multi-layer material serves as the friction surface of the humanoid robot friction part, and TC4 titanium alloy sheets and PEEK sheets are alternately arranged on the friction surface. The outer surface of the end portion of the multi-layer material further comprises a groove texture or a pit texture. A multi-layer material is obtained through superposition of the titanium alloy thin plate and the PEEK thin plate, the outer surface of the end of the multi-layer material serves as a friction surface, on the basis, a texture structure is conveniently introduced through thin plate edge appearance machining and the height difference relation of the adjacent thin plates, and the tribological performance is further improved; therefore, the multilayer material has low density, high strength and good tribological properties.

title: Face robot for expression generation
abstract: The invention discloses a face robot for expression generation. The robot comprises a face mold installed on one side of a brain shell mold, the face mold comprises a lower jaw mold, a lip part, an eyeball mold and an eyebrow part which are sequentially arranged from bottom to top and a control unit used for controlling all parts of the face mold, and the robot is specifically provided with five control assemblies including the eyebrow part, the eyes, a center structure, the lip corner and the lower jaw. The motion angle of the crank is adjusted through the steering engine, robot facial expression motion control is achieved, the exquisite degree and emotion expressive force of facial expressions of a humanoid robot are remarkably improved, and the technical bottleneck that in the field of traditional bionic robots, the expression simulation degree is insufficient, and the emotion expression mode is single is successfully overcome.

title: Rail sports car for debugging humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a rail sports car for debugging a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of rail sports cars. The problem that an existing debugging device lacks follow-up supporting and freedom degree guiding is solved. The rail sports car comprises a sports car box body and an endless chain, a following outer sleeve is fixedly connected to the sports car box body, and a following sliding block is arranged in the following outer sleeve in a horizontal moving mode; sensing devices are fixedly arranged on the following outer sleeve and the following sliding block respectively; the following sliding block is provided with a chain hole which allows the loop chain to penetrate through and is in clearance fit with the loop chain. When the robot horizontally deviates, the loop chain drives the following sliding block to move, and the sensing device responds to relative movement and sends out a signal to control the track sports car to synchronously move along the track. Automatic follow-up of the sports car in the walking process of the robot is achieved, the vertical lifting freedom degree and the static supporting stability in the initial debugging stage can be guaranteed, horizontal safety protection and motion freedom degree guiding can be provided during dynamic walking debugging, and seamless transition from static debugging to dynamic walking is achieved.

title: Thoracic cavity module for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a thoracic cavity module for a humanoid robot, which comprises a thoracic cavity shell and a thoracic cavity skeleton arranged in an inner cavity of the shell, the thoracic cavity shell is formed by splicing a thoracic cavity front shell and a thoracic cavity back shell, and edge grooves of the thoracic cavity front shell and the thoracic cavity back shell define a thoracic cavity upper opening, a thoracic cavity lower opening, a thoracic cavity left opening and a thoracic cavity right opening; the chest front shell and the back shell are fastened and connected through upper, lower, middle and corresponding studs to improve the structural stability; the thoracic cavity skeleton is installed in cooperation with the skeleton nut seat through the inner wall nut column, an isolation space is formed between the thoracic cavity skeleton and the inner wall of the shell to achieve collision protection, the interior of the skeleton is divided into double installation cavities through the supporting rib plates, and efficient heat dissipation and convenient operation and maintenance are achieved in cooperation with the multi-stage heat dissipation structure and the debugging window. The thoracic cavity module can effectively solve the problems that an existing thoracic cavity module is poor in collision protection, the shell is prone to deformation, heat dissipation is poor and operation and maintenance are tedious, the structural stability, electrical safety and use reliability of the thoracic cavity module are improved, and the thoracic cavity module is suitable for being assembled and used for various humanoid robot trunk modules.

title: Neck mechanism for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a neck mechanism for a humanoid robot, which comprises a neck upper connecting piece, a neck lower connecting piece and a neck middle flexible piece for fixedly connecting the neck upper connecting piece and the neck lower connecting piece, the on-neck connecting piece freely swings relative to the under-neck connecting piece through flexible deformation of the in-neck flexible piece. The on-neck connecting piece is provided with an on-neck head ring connecting part and a flexible piece upper connecting part and is connected with the head shell bottom ring in a matched manner; the under-neck joining piece is provided with a flexible piece lower connecting part and an under-neck chest ring connecting part which are connected with a chest ring in a matched manner; the in-neck flexible part is a flexible polymer elastomer, and the whole in-neck flexible part sleeves and hides the internal head driving module. The problems that a traditional rigid neck is stiff in appearance, unstable in swing, unreliable in connection and tedious in assembly can be effectively solved, high-frequency dynamic posture adjustment of the head is adapted, assembly and maintenance are convenient, and practicability is high.

title: Training method and application of humanoid robot motion control model
abstract: The invention discloses a training method and application of a humanoid robot motion control model, and belongs to the technical field of robot motion control. And reward learning is modeled into a meta-learning problem, and joint optimization of a control strategy and a reward function is realized through alternate iteration of an upper-layer optimization process and a lower-layer optimization process. Wherein in the lower-layer training, a motion control strategy of the robot is learned through a reinforcement learning algorithm, and a strategy network outputs a control action based on part of observation information which can be acquired by the robot and is optimized through a predicted reward value provided by an upper-layer reward model; and meanwhile, the upper layer reward model evaluates the strategy behavior by using the complete state information of the robot, so that the intelligent agent is guided to form a coordinated, stable and physically consistent motion mode on the global level. Through the above process, the reward model can adaptively evolve along with the strategy learning process, so that the humanoid robot is guided to efficiently and stably learn the complex motion control strategy without manual intervention.

title: Large-torque ultrathin permanent magnet brake
abstract: The invention discloses a large-torque ultrathin permanent magnet brake and belongs to the technical field of permanent magnet brake production, the large-torque ultrathin permanent magnet brake comprises an outer groove disc, an inner groove disc, an electromagnetic coil, a retainer and a permanent magnet, the outer groove disc comprises an outer cylinder and an outer disc, the inner wall of the outer disc and the outer wall of one end of the outer cylinder are connected and integrally formed, and the inner groove disc comprises an inner cylinder and an inner disc; the inner wall of the inner disc and the outer wall of one end of the inner cylinder are connected and integrally formed, the part, close to the center position, of the surface of one side of the inner disc is the cavity wall surface of one side of the coil inner cavity, and the permanent magnet and the annular retainer are located between the part, close to the edge position, of the surface of one side of the inner disc and the outer disc. The purposes of remarkably increasing the braking torque and reducing the coil function and temperature rise on the premise that the axial size of the brake is not increased are achieved, finally the purposes of large torque, small power, small temperature rise and ultra-thin (namely extremely-small axial size) functions are achieved, and the application requirements of humanoid robots and other products with extremely-small axial size requirements are met.

title: Humanoid robot and special moving chair thereof
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and a special moving chair thereof, aiming at solving the problem that the humanoid robot is difficult to realize high simulation of a human body. The humanoid robot is characterized in that the humanoid robot is provided with a highly-simulated meat body and has humanoid activity capabilities of four limbs, the head, the neck, the waist and the abdomen in a lying and sitting state and rich facial expressions; the special movable chair is provided with a mechanical arm which can do simple work and is provided with a manipulator. The system has visual and hearing functions, can provide limb emotion accompanying, depends on the Ai technology, and can also provide language communication like a real person. When the humanoid robot is held up by a person and placed in the movable chair, a combined robot which can provide emotion accompanying and can be used for simple labor service is formed. As autonomous walking is not needed, a driving mechanism and a control system in the limbs are remarkably simplified, the weight and the occupied space of mechanical parts are remarkably reduced, and skin and skeleton structures are more easily and highly personified. The method is expected to accelerate and propel humanoid robot products to enter the market on a large scale.

title: Visual anti-shake holder of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot vision anti-shake pan-tilt, which belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots and comprises a main body support, a vision carrying frame is fixed at the top end of the main body support, the main body support comprises a pan-tilt seat, a mounting plate frame is fixed on the bottom surface of the pan-tilt seat, and an inserting pile is fixed at the center of the bottom end of the mounting plate frame. The outer wall of the periphery of the inserting pile is sleeved with a rubber sleeve. The visual anti-shake cradle head is connected with the trunk of the robot through the inserting piles at the bottom end of the mounting plate frame, meanwhile, the rubber sleeves on the outer walls of the inserting piles provide inserting stability and buffering damping performance on the periphery, and the limiting bolts on the periphery penetrate into the two ends of the mounting plate frame and the auxiliary structural beams to be fixed to the trunk part in a threaded mode; the pressure springs matched with the limiting bolts can be used for achieving elastic buffering around the mounting plate frame and matched with the rubber rings to form the damping process, the synchronous buffering effect of the center and the peripheral mounting positions is achieved, and therefore the shaking performance of the hardware part of the whole holder is reduced.

title: Dual-power-supply automatic switching power supply circuit of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a dual power supply automatic switching power supply circuit of a humanoid robot, which comprises a main power supply, an auxiliary power supply, a power supply management circuit and a charging circuit, and the output end of the main power supply and the output end of the auxiliary power supply are in power supply connection with the input end of the power supply management circuit. The output end of the power supply management circuit can be in power supply connection with a main control circuit board of the humanoid robot, the output end of the main power supply is further connected with the input end of the charging circuit, the output end of the charging circuit is in charging connection with the auxiliary power supply, and the power supply management circuit is further in control connection with the charging circuit. The power supply management circuit can be automatically switched to the auxiliary power supply to supply power when the main power supply is insufficient in power, and meanwhile, a main power supply insufficient power prompt is sent to a main control circuit board of the humanoid robot. The beneficial effect of the utility model is that the uninterrupted power supply of the humanoid robot can be realized.

title: Leg structure and biped robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a leg structure and a biped robot, and relates to the technical field of robotics.The leg structure comprises a hip lateral extension assembly fixing base and two hip lateral extension assemblies fixedly installed on the hip lateral extension assembly fixing base respectively, and the two hip lateral extension assemblies are arranged in a front-back staggered mode along the output axis of the hip lateral extension assemblies; the mounting directions of the two hip lateral extension assemblies are opposite. According to the leg structure, by means of the arrangement mode of the hip lateral extension assemblies which are staggered front and back and are opposite in installation direction, the transverse size of the hip is reduced, the movement flexibility in a narrow space is improved, and meanwhile load balanced distribution and rich gait movement are achieved through a reasonable force transmission path; and the limitation of a traditional structure on the joint movement range is broken through to adapt to high-difficulty actions, so that the application adaptability of the biped robot in many fields is enhanced.

title: Humanoid foot plate assembly of biped robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robot equipment, and provides a humanoid foot plate assembly of a biped robot, which comprises a main body assembly, and the main body assembly comprises a foot plate, a heel shell, a front foot sole shell and a gravity sensor; the heel shell is mounted at the rear end of the top of the sole plate, the front sole shell is mounted at the front end of the top of the sole plate, and the gravity sensor is mounted in the heel shell; the maintenance assembly comprises a placement groove, an insertion frame, a rotating gear and a threaded rod; the placing groove is formed in the foot bottom plate, the inserting frame is fixedly connected to the inner bottom wall of the foot bottom plate, and the rotating gear is rotationally connected to the inner side wall of the foot bottom plate. According to the utility model, through the auxiliary cooperation between the tooth block and the insertion frame, the heel shell can be pulled out upwards, and the two groups of screw blocks release the clamping of one end of the gravity sensor at the same time, so that a worker can be assisted to quickly disassemble, assemble and take the gravity sensor, and a more abundant maintenance disassembly and assembly space is provided for the worker.

title: PRESENTATION DEVICE, PRESENTATION METHOD, AND PRESENTATION PROGRAM
abstract: A presentation device (10) comprises: a comprehensive evaluation unit (155) that evaluates an attunement level which is the degree of attunement to a user expressed by a backchannel action of a humanoid agent responding to the user, on the basis of at least a non-verbal emotion which is emotion information of the user appearing in non-verbal information of the user; and an agent backchannel generation unit (156) that controls the backchannel action of the humanoid agent responding to the user, on the basis of at least the attunement level.

title: Underground drilling humanoid robot control algorithm based on imitation learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of coal mine robot control, and discloses an underground drilling humanoid robot control algorithm based on imitation learning, and the algorithm comprises the steps: collecting the whole-flow demonstration data of the drilling operation of a human expert in a 1: 1 simulated underground environment, and carrying out the preprocessing, and generating a reference motion track matched with a robot; then constructing a bimodal perception fusion control model, extracting body motion features and dimensional drilling machine operation features through an encoder, realizing feature deep fusion through a bidirectional cross attention module, then generating an action sequence through a time sequence constraint strategy network, and dynamically optimizing the tracking precision in combination with an adaptive tracking mechanism; and the model robustness is improved by adopting a flow matching normal form and an operation regularization loss function. The invention provides an unmanned solution for underground drilling operations such as coal mine gas control and geological exploration, has the advantages of high action precision, strong environmental adaptability, safety and reliability, and has obvious application value.

title: Double-ankle mechanism for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a double-ankle mechanism for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a shank part, a sole part and an ankle connecting part connecting the shank part and the sole part, the double-ankle mechanism comprises a first driving mechanism and a second driving mechanism, one end of the first driving mechanism is connected with the shank part, and the other end of the first driving mechanism is connected with the ankle connecting part; one end of the second driving mechanism is connected with the shank part, and the other end of the second driving mechanism is connected with the ankle connecting part; the first driving mechanism and the second driving mechanism are arranged on the same side of the shank part in parallel without mutual interference so as to respectively drive the sole part to move through the ankle connecting part. According to the double-ankle mechanism, the two-degree-of-freedom movement of the ankles can be controlled at the same time through the two driving actuators, so that the driving actuators share the impact load caused by the movement of the ankles of the humanoid robot at the same time, and the requirement for the driving actuators is lowered.

title: Preparation method of composite facial skin of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot face composite skin preparation method, which comprises: S1, preparing a flexible substrate, adopting a silica gel injection molding process to prepare the flexible substrate, and reserving a channel penetrating through the inner surface and the outer surface of the flexible substrate in the preset position of the flexible substrate during the molding process; s2, preparing surface skin, namely preparing the surface skin by adopting a silica gel injection molding process for later use; s3, preparing a wire, and printing on the inner surface of the flexible substrate through a 3D printing process to form a conductive circuit; s4, preparing an electrode plate, and forming the electrode plate on the outer surface of the flexible substrate through a hot pressing process or a conductive ink direct writing process; s5, a conductive connecting piece is embedded in the channel in the S1, one end of the conductive connecting piece is electrically connected with the wire, and the other end of the conductive connecting piece is electrically connected with the electrode plate; s6, the flexible substrate and the surface skin are compounded into a whole. The wires and the electrode plates are specially arranged, and it can be ensured that the skin accurately responds to driving signals.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented multi-regulation domain real-time compliance decision-making and data management and control method
abstract: The invention provides a multi-regulation domain real-time compliance decision and data management and control method for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot control and data security. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment perception, an ontology state and a target task instruction in real time; identifying a current regulation domain based on the environmental perception data and calling a corresponding regulation constraint set; calculating a dynamic compliance influence factor according to the ontology state, the task instruction and the regulation constraint set; decomposing and reconstructing the task instruction based on the factor to generate an executable subtask sequence conforming to a regulation constraint set; monitoring interaction data flow in real time during execution, and calculating a regulation domain operation entropy based on a data privacy rule and a dynamic compliance influence factor; judging whether the entropy exceeds a preset safety threshold value or not; if yes, blocking, desensitization or degradation processing is triggered, and a final control instruction is output. According to the method, real-time compliance decision making and dynamic data management and control of multiple regulation domains are realized, cross-domain violation is avoided, privacy security is guaranteed, and decision making precision is continuously optimized through a self-learning mechanism.

title: Predictive control humanoid robot anti-falling method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, in particular to a predictive control humanoid robot anti-falling method and system, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a real-time motion state and an environment perception data set of a robot, and carrying out the inversion with a mass center and a joint angle as initial states, so as to obtain a zero moment point trajectory prediction sequence; coupling terrain gradient, height and friction distribution parameters to generate a pre-contact surface state parameter set; performing combined stability boundary evaluation on the track sequence and the parameter set to generate an anti-drop pre-adjustment instruction; extracting a trajectory deviation point and a prediction moment, reversely deriving a centroid adjustment vector and a trunk attitude compensation amount, generating a collaborative motion and attitude compensation sequence, and correcting an original gait trajectory; a servo motor is driven to execute an anti-falling action, and the foot sole joint angle is adjusted according to the gradient; the anti-falling efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot linear joint beneficial to heat dissipation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot joints, in particular to a humanoid robot linear joint facilitating heat dissipation, which comprises a vapor chamber, a cover plate and a cooling unit, a heat-conducting medium is filled between the vapor chamber and the stator shell; a main groove, a diversion groove and a backflow groove are formed in the vapor chamber, the main groove extends in the length direction of the vapor chamber, one end of the diversion groove communicates with the main groove, the backflow groove is formed in at least one side of the main groove and extends in the length direction of the vapor chamber, and the other end of the diversion groove communicates with the backflow groove; the cover plate is fixed on the outer side of the vapor chamber so as to form a micro-channel with the main groove, the shunting groove and the backflow groove; the cover plate is provided with a first liquid inlet and a first liquid outlet, the first liquid inlet and the first liquid outlet are communicated with the two ends of the main groove respectively, and the cooling unit is communicated with the first liquid inlet and the first liquid outlet to form a first circulating cooling loop. The improved vapor chamber and the cover plate are arranged on the outer side of the stator shell to form the micro-channel for heat dissipation, and the micro-channel and the external cooling unit are combined to form the first cooling circulation loop, so that the temperature rise of the stator is stably reduced on the premise that the joint size and complexity are not remarkably increased.
