title: Automatic training platform and method for reinforcement learning of humanoid robot in real physical environment
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robots, and discloses an automatic training platform and method for reinforcement learning of a humanoid robot in a real physical environment, and the platform comprises a fixed frame, the top end of the fixed frame is provided with an X-axis moving slide rail, and the output end of the X-axis moving slide rail is connected with a Y-axis moving slide rail. The output end of the Y-axis moving sliding rail is connected with a Z-axis moving sliding rail, and a connecting frame is installed at the output end of the Z-axis moving sliding rail and used for being connected with a robot to be trained. When the exceeding amount of the real-time state information of the robot exceeding the preset safety threshold value range is larger than or equal to a first preset threshold value, the Z-axis moving sliding rail is used for lifting the robot upwards, the X-axis moving sliding rail and the Y-axis moving sliding rail are used for applying resistance in the corresponding direction to the robot to achieve toppling prevention, and then the robot is driven to reset to start training again. According to the invention, a full-automatic training closed loop is constructed, the problems of falling risk of the robot and training continuity are solved, and the small sample problem of the robot can be solved.

title: Fan propelling device, driving assembly for robot and robot
abstract: The invention provides a fan propelling device, a driving assembly for a robot and the robot, the fan propelling device comprises a duct shell, the duct shell is of a structure with two open ends and limits an axial airflow channel, and a first fan assembly and a second fan assembly are coaxially and sequentially arranged in the duct shell; a first fairing and a second fairing are arranged between the first fan assembly and the second fan assembly, the first fairing and the second fairing are connected through a supporting structure, and the supporting structure is arranged on the inner wall of the duct shell. The embodiment of the invention realizes high thrust density and low pneumatic loss, and is suitable for flight propulsion requirements of humanoid robots and other various robots. The embodiment of the invention has the advantages of high dynamic response, good stability and excellent terrain adaptability, and is particularly suitable for high-performance flight and positioning tasks of a future robot in a complex air-ground collaborative environment.

title: Alloy/bamboo chip multilayer composite material and preparation process
abstract: The invention discloses an alloy/bamboo chip multi-layer composite material and a preparation process, the structure of the multi-layer composite material is formed by alternately arranging alloy sheets/bamboo chip sheets, and a binder is arranged between every two adjacent sheets; the outer surface of the end part of the multi-layer composite material is used as a friction surface, and the surface of the thin plate is perpendicular to the growth axial direction of the bamboo chip, so that the axial vascular bundle in the bamboo chip is perpendicular to the friction surface at the upper end; and according to the thickness dimension, the ratio of the alloy thin plate to the bamboo sheet thin plate is 1: 9-2: 1. The multi-layer composite material is obtained in a sheet layer stacking and bonding mode, the outer surfaces of the ends of the multi-layer composite material serve as friction surfaces, and the groove texture and bamboo fiber oil storage design is introduced into the outer surfaces of the ends of the multi-layer composite material, so that the tribological performance of the multi-layer composite material is remarkably improved, and the friction performance of the multi-layer composite material is improved. Therefore, a novel material capable of being used for a humanoid robot friction part is obtained, and light weight, high strength, excellent tribological performance and environmental friendliness are achieved.

title: Waist mechanism for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and provides a waist mechanism for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The humanoid robot comprises a body rack part, and the waist mechanism comprises a structure conduction part; the first driving part is arranged on one side of the body rack part and is connected with the structure conduction part; the second driving part is arranged on the other side of the body rack part and connected with the structure conduction part, the first driving part and the second driving part are execution units which work cooperatively in parallel, and pitching and twisting movement of the waist is achieved through the structure conduction part; the third driving part is connected with the structure conduction part and located on the lower side of the structure conduction part, the third driving part is an independent execution unit, and course adjustment of the waist is achieved through the structure conduction part. The first driving part and the second driving part are linked in parallel, and the third driving part independently moves to realize accurate control of the waist; the first driving part, the second driving part and the third driving part are connected with the structure conduction part, so that the problems of waist structure flexibility and size compactness are solved.

title: Modularized quick-change battery structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy supply of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot modular quick-change battery structure which comprises a battery module, shells are fixedly mounted on the front side and the rear side of the battery module correspondingly, and a battery bin is arranged at the bottom of each shell; and concave positioning strips are fixedly connected to the front sides and the rear sides of the two sides of the inner wall of the battery bin. The sliding strips on the two sides of the shell are in guide fit with the concave positioning strips on the inner wall of the battery bin, modular quick-change assembly of the battery module is completed, heat generated during work of the battery module is evenly attached and collected through the elastic insulation heat conduction layer on the inner wall of the shell, multi-path stable conduction is achieved through the first heat conduction sheet and the second heat conduction sheet, and the heat conduction efficiency is improved. Wherein the second heat-conducting fin vertically transfers heat to the dense-tooth radiator at the bottom of the battery compartment, efficient diffusion and dissipation of the heat are completed, the interface contact thermal resistance is greatly reduced, and the heat dissipation efficiency is considered while the convenience of quick-change operation is guaranteed.

title: Modularized joint quick-release structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots and discloses a humanoid robot modular joint quick-release structure which comprises a trunk seat, a steering engine seat is inserted into one end of the trunk seat, the trunk seat comprises a shoulder shell, a butt joint pile is fixed to one end of the interior of the shoulder shell, a butt joint opening is fixed to one end of the butt joint pile, and the butt joint opening is fixed to the other end of the butt joint pile. A pin groove is formed in the bottom end of the inner wall of the butt joint opening, and a telescopic groove is formed in the center of the top end of the butt joint opening. According to the joint quick-release structure, the shoulder shell part is fixed to the trunk part of the robot, the butt-joint pile is carried, the butt-joint port of the butt-joint pile can be connected with a steering engine base in an inserted mode for use, a threaded rod is driven by rotating a rotary cap, a pull ring frame connected to the middle of the threaded rod can be lifted and slide, and an upper limiting pile at the bottom of the threaded rod descends; and the purpose that the upper limiting pile and the lower limiting pile lock the inserted plug pile at the same time is achieved, the rapid mounting and fixing process is achieved, and the convenience in the dismounting and mounting process is improved.

title: Linear actuator of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot linear actuator, which comprises a front end cover, a rear end cover, a first joint bearing, a second joint bearing, a third joint bearing, a fourth joint bearing and a fifth joint bearing, the shell is fixedly mounted on the right side of the front end cover; the bearing seat is fixedly connected to the right side of the shell; the housing is fixedly connected to the right side of the bearing seat; the second joint bearing is mounted on the right side of the housing; the encoder is installed on the right side of the bearing seat and located in the housing, and a code disc is arranged in the encoder; the ball screw is arranged in the shell, the left end of the ball screw penetrates through the front end cover and extends to the left side of the front end cover, the ball screw is fixedly sleeved with the first knuckle bearing, and the right end of the first knuckle bearing extends into the bearing seat. According to the linear actuator, a planetary roller screw rod is changed into the ball screw rod, and the screw rod nut and the motor rotor are fixedly connected into a whole, so that the cost of the linear actuator can be effectively reduced, and the use requirement is met.

title: Upper limb structure of bionic humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses an upper limb structure of a bionic humanoid robot, and aims to overcome the defects that the upper limb of the robot is directly mounted on an output flange of a motor by adopting an L-shaped bracket structure, the structural rigidity is insufficient, mechanical shaking is easily caused in high-speed dynamic motion, and the motion precision and the system stability are further reduced. The device comprises a shoulder turnover seat and an elbow turnover seat, an upper support and an upper opposite side flange are arranged on the shoulder turnover seat, a second motor is installed between the upper support and the upper opposite side flange, and the second motor drives the shoulder turnover seat to rotate; a lower support and a lower opposite side flange are arranged on the elbow turnover seat, a fourth motor is installed between the lower support and the lower opposite side flange, and the fourth motor drives the elbow turnover seat to rotate. A bearing and a connecting structure are arranged on the opposite side of a motor output flange to form a C-shaped supporting structure, the bearing capacity of the motor bearing is effectively shared, the joint rigidity is improved, and the service life is prolonged.
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an upper limb structure of a bionic humanoid robot, and aims to overcome the defects that the upper limb of the robot is directly mounted on an output flange of a motor by adopting an L-shaped bracket structure, the structural rigidity is insufficient, mechanical shaking is easily caused in high-speed dynamic motion, and the motion precision and the system stability are further reduced. The device comprises a shoulder turnover seat and an elbow turnover seat, an upper support and an upper opposite side flange are arranged on the shoulder turnover seat, a second motor is installed between the upper support and the upper opposite side flange, and the second motor drives the shoulder turnover seat to rotate; a lower support and a lower opposite side flange are arranged on the elbow turnover seat, a fourth motor is installed between the lower support and the lower opposite side flange, and the fourth motor drives the elbow turnover seat to rotate. A bearing and a connecting structure are arranged on the opposite side of a motor output flange to form a C-shaped supporting structure, the bearing capacity of the motor bearing is effectively shared, the joint rigidity is improved, and the service life is prolonged.

title: Power line for humanoid robot motor
abstract: The utility model discloses a power line for a humanoid robot motor, which comprises a first insulating core wire and a second insulating core wire, and the first insulating core wire and the second insulating core wire respectively comprise a conductor and an insulating layer wrapping the outer side of the conductor. Each conductor of the first insulating core wire and the second insulating core wire is formed by twisting a plurality of conductor strands, and the first insulating core wire and the second insulating core wire which extend in the length direction are parallel and are arranged at intervals. The insulating layer of the first insulating core wire is connected with the insulating layer of the second insulating core wire through a rib extending along the length directions of the first insulating core wire and the second insulating core wire, and the conductor twisting direction of the first insulating core wire is opposite to the conductor twisting direction of the second insulating core wire. According to the utility model, bad interference caused by mutual friction and displacement among the core wires in a complex dynamic use scene can be avoided, and the condition of cable twisting in the use process can also be avoided.

title: Telescopic limb humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a telescopic limb humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. A telescopic limb humanoid robot comprises a body assembly, the bottom of the body assembly is rotationally connected with a leg assembly through a driving part, the side wall of the body assembly is rotationally connected with an arm assembly through a driving part, and the bottom of the arm assembly is fixedly connected with a telescopic mechanism. The end of the telescopic mechanism is fixedly connected with a grabbing mechanism. The grabbing mechanism comprises a rotating frame which rotates on the surface of the telescopic mechanism through a driving part. The distance of the grabbing mechanism can be adjusted through the telescopic mechanism, goods can be grabbed through the grabbing mechanism under the cooperation of the rotating frame, the rotating plate, the linkage rod and the clamping block, the goods can be grabbed flexibly through the mode, the problem that the goods are not firm and fall off easily when grabbed is solved, and the grabbing efficiency is improved. And the working safety of the humanoid robot is further improved.

title: Humanoid robot grabbing auxiliary device
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot gripping auxiliary device, which belongs to the technical field of robot gripping devices, and comprises a machine body, a synchronous limiting assembly is arranged in the machine body, the synchronous limiting assembly comprises first knuckles, a connecting rod, a limiting plate and a second knuckle, the first knuckles are symmetrically and rotatably connected in the machine body, and the second knuckles are symmetrically and rotatably connected in the machine body. Connecting rods are symmetrically and slidably connected to the interiors of the first knuckles, limiting plates are fixedly connected to one sides of the connecting rods, second knuckles are rotatably connected to the outer sides of the first knuckles, through the synchronous limiting assemblies, the friction force between a clamped object and the surfaces of the first knuckles can be increased, and the grabbing strength of the first knuckles is improved; the bevel gear set is driven by the driving motor to rotate so that the threaded rod can drive the connecting rod and the limiting plate to move, the position of the limiting plate can be adjusted according to the thickness of an object, the front end and the rear end of the object are limited, objects with different thicknesses can be rapidly grabbed in a matched mode, and the clamping stability and flexibility are improved.

title: Humanoid robot quick-change container docking mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot quick-change container docking mechanism which comprises a first mounting plate and a second mounting plate, the surface of the second mounting plate is fixedly connected with an outer container body, and the inner wall of the outer container body is fixedly connected with a transverse spring. A compression ring is directly pushed to compress a transverse spring, the compression ring moves to drive a shielding block on the surface to move, so that a spring pin is not blocked any more, finally, the spring pin is clamped into an embedding groove of a butt joint bolt to achieve butt joint, a magnet on the inner wall of the embedding groove makes contact with the bottom end of the spring pin to generate adsorption force, the fixing effect after butt joint is remarkably enhanced, and the butt joint reliability is improved. Through simple inserting and lifting actions, butt joint and disassembly and assembly can be completed, complex tools or procedures are not needed, the operation time is greatly saved, the working efficiency is improved, the method is suitable for the humanoid robot working scene where a cargo box needs to be frequently replaced, and time-consuming and labor-consuming butt joint operation of personnel is avoided.

title: Foot structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model provides a foot structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a leg connecting rod, the lower end of the leg connecting rod is connected with a connecting seat arranged above a rear foot plate through a cross shaft, two lug plates are arranged at one end above the rear foot plate, and the lug plates are connected with a connecting frame arranged on the rear side of the leg connecting rod through a back motor; a front foot plate is movably connected to one side of the rear foot plate, a rear motor connecting seat is arranged at the other end, opposite to the lug plate, above the rear foot plate, a front motor connecting seat is arranged at one end above the front foot plate, and a front motor is arranged between the front motor connecting seat and the rear motor connecting seat. The rotation freedom degree of the rear foot plate and the front foot plate can be increased, the terrain adaptive capacity of the humanoid robot is improved, and standing and walking of the robot on the uneven ground are better facilitated; and the six-dimensional force sensor can measure forces and moments in X, Y and Z directions in real time, so that control of the humanoid robot is facilitated.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot with waist self-balancing function
abstract: The multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot with the waist self-balancing function comprises a supporting frame and is characterized in that the top of the supporting frame is connected with a mounting plate, the two sides of the mounting plate are connected with first waist mounting bases, a waist pitching joint module is detachably connected between the first waist mounting bases, and a waist pitching joint module is detachably connected between the waist pitching joint module and the first waist mounting bases. Second waist mounting seats are connected to the top of the first waist mounting seat, a waist rolling joint module is detachably connected between the second waist mounting seats on the two sides, a third waist mounting seat is connected to the exterior of the second waist mounting seat on one side, and a transverse machine body seat is connected to the top of the third waist mounting seat. A waist yawing joint module is connected to the top of the transverse machine body seat, first spring seats are arranged on the two sides of the transverse machine body seat, corresponding second spring seats are arranged outside the first waist mounting seats on the two sides of the transverse machine body seat, and self-adaptive springs are connected between the first spring seats and the second spring seats. The device has the characteristic of preventing the waist from turning over due to incapability of keeping balance after power failure.

title: WIRELESS CHARGING SYSTEM AND CHARGING METHOD FOR A HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: The present invention disclosed belongs to the technical field of charging for humanoid robots, and specifically relates to a wireless charging system for humanoid robots and its charging method. Through the integration of a positioning-guidance module with the robot’s motion control, the system is capable of guiding the robot to autonomously move and complete precise pose adjustments, enabling accurate alignment between the power receiving end and the transmitting end, effectively reducing manual intervention, and realizing fully unmanned operation throughout the entire process from “searching for the charging pile” to “leaving with a full charge,” thereby significantly enhancing the continuous autonomous operating capability of humanoid robots.

title: Humanoid robot teleoperation method and system based on digital twinning
abstract: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based humanoid robot teleoperation method and system, and belongs to the technical field of digital twinning and humanoid robots, and the system comprises a physical body, a twinning body, a redirection system, a communication system and a data service system. Human body action data are mapped into robot action data through an unsupervised neural network of a redirection system, the robot action data are transmitted to a physical body through a communication system to be executed, twin bodies synchronously display action states in real time, a data service system completes storage, filtering and format conversion, high-precision, visual and safe man-machine heterogeneous whole-body teleoperation is achieved, and the operation efficiency is improved. Contact judgment and abnormal early warning are supported, and the complex scene operation capacity of the robot is improved.

title: Collaborative navigation method of heterogeneous multi-agent
abstract: The invention discloses a heterogeneous multi-agent cooperative navigation method, which is based on a three-zero path planning TZPP normal form, meets the constraints of zero training, zero priori knowledge and zero simulation, adopts a coordinator-explorer heterogeneous agent architecture, takes a humanoid robot as a coordinator and a quadruped robot as an explorer, and realizes cooperative navigation of multiple agents. Independent exploration and path planning are achieved in an unknown complex environment, dependence of an existing method on training, a priori map and a simulation environment is avoided, the deployment and application cost of a robot system is remarkably reduced, and the robustness of the system in a real dynamic environment is improved; specialized task division of the humanoid robot and the quadruped robot is realized, the humanoid robot is responsible for high-level task coordination and navigation decision, and the quadruped robot undertakes environment exploration and feasible path identification by using the flexible moving capability of the quadruped robot, so that the complementary advantages of different forms of robots are fully exerted; the problems of planning confusion and resource waste of isomorphic multi-agent cooperation are solved.

title: Humanoid robot interconnection control system and method, humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot interconnection control system and method, a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robots. According to the system, an industrial personal computer is used for controlling a wireless communication module to start and completing mobile network registration; the activation first hotspot transceiver module is used for establishing an exclusive hotspot of the humanoid robot; a second hot spot transceiver module of the chassis and a third hot spot transceiver module of the remote controller are respectively used for searching encrypted hot spot signals and accessing an exclusive hot spot according to hot spot configuration information; the remote controller is used for generating a control instruction and transmitting the control instruction to the chassis through an intranet link; and the industrial personal computer is also used for carrying out data interaction with the target equipment through the external network link. Thus, there is no need to deploy a router additionally, three-level interconnection of the remote controller, the robot body and the chassis is realized through the exclusive hotspot of the robot body, hardware connection is simplified, an integrated wireless control scheme is constructed, and deployment cost is reduced.

title: Humanoid robot arm high-load turn-off power MOS structure with enhanced P-GaN cap layer
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of gallium nitride semiconductors, and discloses a humanoid robot arm high-load turn-off power MOS (Metal Oxide Semiconductor) structure with an enhanced P-GaN cap layer, which comprises a substrate, a gallium nitride structure and an MOS structure, the gallium nitride structure comprises a buffer layer, a gallium nitride layer, an aluminum gallium nitride layer, a drain electrode, a gallium nitride grid electrode and a P gallium nitride layer; the MOS structure comprises an N diffusion layer, a P well layer, an N well layer, a P + layer, a source electrode and an MOS grid electrode, the MOS structure is located on the surface of the aluminum gallium nitride layer and located on the left side of the gallium nitride grid electrode, and the N diffusion layer is in direct contact with the aluminum gallium nitride layer. A silicon-based MOS structure is integrated on the surface of a gallium nitride device, direct contact between an MOS grid electrode and a gallium nitride grid electrode is achieved, an enhanced P-GaN cap layer power MOS structure is constructed, the high electron mobility of a gallium nitride material and the low-power-consumption control capacity of the MOS structure are combined, and the high electron mobility of the gallium nitride material and the low-power-consumption control capacity of the MOS structure are combined. And the response speed and the system reliability of the device under a high-load frequent turn-off working condition are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot loading and transporting box capable of standing
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robot packaging, and provides a humanoid robot standing loading and transporting box which comprises an outer box with a cavity and an inner box assembly, the humanoid robot is placed in the cavity at the squatting height during packaging, storage and transportation, and the inner box assembly is movably arranged in the cavity. A cavity is formed in the outer box, the humanoid robot squatting in the cavity is supported or/and clamped in all directions in a surrounding mode, a plurality of moving wheels are arranged on the outward surface of a back plate of the outer box, and after the humanoid robot is packaged, the outer box is turned over by 90 degrees, so that the humanoid robot is changed into a lying state from a squatting state during packaging to move; when the package is unpacked, the upper cover is opened, the inner box assembly is pulled out, and the humanoid robot in a squatting state can stand in the inner cavity; when the front plate is opened, the standing humanoid robot can walk out of the cavity. The height of the humanoid robot in the packaging box and the position change of the packaging box during packaging and moving are greatly reduced, and the influence on the humanoid robot during moving is avoided to the maximum extent.

title: HEAD STRUCTURE AND HUMANOID ROBOT
abstract: A head structure for a humanoid robot includes a head frame, a motor bracket, and a pitch motor. The motor bracket includes a first fixing side plate and a second fixing side plate facing each other, and the first fixing side plate and the second fixing side plate are each configured to be connected to a neck structure. The pitch motor is fixed between the first fixing side plate and the second fixing side plate. The head frame is rotatably connected to the first fixing side plate. An output shaft of the pitch motor penetrates through the second fixing side plate and is connected to the head frame. An axis of the pitch motor is arranged to pass through a center of gravity of the head structure, thereby improving the stability of the head structure.

title: Humanoid robot chassis based on vertical lifting
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of humanoid robot moving equipment, and discloses a humanoid robot chassis based on vertical lifting. The chassis comprises a fixed frame, a liftable wheel set, a fixed wheel set, a lifting driving mechanism and a control module; a lifting driving wheel set and a lifting auxiliary wheel set in the lifting wheel set are supported and connected with the chassis fixing frame through vertical lifting mechanisms in the lifting driving wheel set and the lifting auxiliary wheel set; the lifting driving mechanism is connected with the vertical lifting mechanism; a fixed driving wheel and a fixed auxiliary wheel in the fixed wheel group support and are connected with the chassis fixing frame; the control module sequentially comprises a sensing layer, a control layer and an execution layer and is connected with the lifting driving wheel set, the fixed driving wheel set and the lifting driving mechanism. The control module is integrated with the lifting wheel set and the fixed wheel set to act cooperatively, vertical step climbing and complex terrain self-adaptive movement can be achieved, it is guaranteed that the chassis and the upper half body act synchronously, and the robot has the advantages of being stable in bearing, accurate in control, convenient to operate, safe, reliable and the like.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom line-drive humanoid robot ankle joint and motor thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a three-degree-of-freedom linear drive humanoid robot ankle joint and a motor thereof, and relates to the technical field of robots, the three-degree-of-freedom linear drive humanoid robot ankle joint comprises an upper driving module and a three-degree-of-freedom ankle joint mechanism integrated with the upper driving module; the toe expansion module is arranged on the three-degree-of-freedom ankle joint mechanism; the toe extension device further comprises a pull wire control assembly connected with the toe extension module. According to the multi-degree-of-freedom ankle joint mechanism, the top-mounted driving unit is arranged, the three-degree-of-freedom design of the ankle joint mechanism and the toe expansion module independently driven by the pull wire control assembly are matched, multi-degree-of-freedom cooperative movement of ankle introversion/extroversion, dorsal flexion/plantar flexion and rotation and toe dorsal extension/plantar flexion is achieved, and the multi-degree-of-freedom ankle joint mechanism has the advantages of being compact in structure and low in inertia.

title: Biped robot dynamic walking control method and biped robot
abstract: The invention relates to a biped robot dynamic walking control method and a biped robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot control, and the biped robot dynamic walking control method comprises the steps that 1, an autoregressive cerebellum model neural network is adopted to establish a biped robot kinetic model with disturbance terms, the problem of realizing stability of a multi-input multi-output nonlinear system with bounded uncertain terms is solved by converting biped dynamic robust walking into realization of stability of the multi-input multi-output nonlinear system with bounded uncertain terms; 2, designing an adaptive autoregression cerebellar model neural network error observer, and estimating an error upper bound; step 3, designing an adaptive law of a network weight, realizing real-time updating of a network weight space, and performing parameter adjustment on each learning factor; and 4, compensating an estimation error by adopting a boundary value estimation algorithm, and feeding back to a robot walking system, so that the biped robot achieves asymptotically stable walking. According to the invention, the control system can adapt to the time-varying characteristics of the biped walking system on line, and has continuous learning and adaptive capabilities for unknown dynamic states.

title: Three-branch-chain parallel mechanical device simulating rotation of human neck
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot, in particular to a three-branch-chain parallel mechanical device simulating human neck movement. The three-branch-chain parallel mechanical device imitating rotation of the neck of the human body has the advantages of being large in working space range, high in precision and large in bearing capacity, and three-degree-of-freedom movement of the neck of the robot can be achieved in a limited space. According to the technical scheme, the three-branch-chain parallel mechanical device simulating rotation of the neck of the human body is characterized by comprising a movable platform serving as a head framework of a humanoid robot, a shoulder platform connected with upper limbs of the humanoid robot, and three branches connected between the movable platform and the composite hinge in parallel, wherein the top end of the shoulder platform is provided with a composite hinge; the connecting points of the three branches connected with the movable platform are all located on the surface of the side wall of the movable platform and evenly distributed in the circumferential direction of the movable platform at 120 degrees.

title: Dynamic posture predictive thermal management method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a predictive thermal management method and system for a dynamic posture of a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problem that the thermal load of a joint of the robot changes quickly and the response of a traditional temperature control strategy is lagged under a high-dynamic motion working condition. The objective of the invention is to weaken control delay caused by information isolation between thermal management and motion planning subsystems and improve pertinence of cooling resource allocation. According to the technical scheme, the method comprises the steps of obtaining current state information of the robot and a joint prediction movement track in a future set time domain; calculating a future joint thermal disturbance sequence based on motor parameters in combination with the prediction trajectory; and on this basis, a thermal management control optimization model is constructed, and rolling calculation and output are carried out to adjust the optimal control quantity of the flow of the liquid pump and the proportioning valve. According to the method, temperature overshoot can be effectively eliminated, the adaptive capacity and the overall energy efficiency of the thermal management system under the high-dynamic motion working condition are remarkably improved, and the thermal safety and the operation stability of the humanoid robot are guaranteed.

title: Wheel self-locking device of mobile vehicle, mobile vehicle and hybrid mobile device
abstract: The utility model discloses a wheel self-locking device of a moving vehicle, the moving vehicle and a hybrid moving device.The wheel self-locking device comprises a locking and unlocking piece and an elastic reset piece; the locking and unlocking piece is provided with a braking end and a driving end; when the locking and unlocking piece is in a self-locking state, the braking end is in contact with the electric wheel to lock the electric wheel, and when the locking and unlocking piece is in an unlocking state, the braking end is separated from the electric wheel, and the electric wheel is unlocked; the elastic reset piece is used for enabling the locking and unlocking piece to have an activity trend of keeping a self-locking state; and when the humanoid robot moves to a set position of the vehicle body, the matching part of the humanoid robot pushes the driving end, so that the locking and unlocking piece moves to an unlocking state. The wheel self-locking device is of a pure mechanical structure and is low in cost, stable and durable, no electric control signal or manual intervention is needed in the whole self-locking and unlocking process, and automatic closed loop of the physical level is achieved for interaction of the humanoid robot and the mobile vehicle.

title: Finger joint assembly, dexterous hand and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly relates to a knuckle assembly, a dexterous hand and a humanoid robot. Wherein the near-end knuckle module (10) is thicker, the far-end knuckle module (20) is thinner, and in a projection plane perpendicular to the output shaft, the projections of the first support (1) and the second support (3) are both within the outer contour range of the projection of the near-end knuckle module (10), and the projection of the far-end knuckle module (20) is within the outer contour range of the projection of the second support (3). By means of the arrangement, driving connection between the near-end knuckle module (10) and the far-end knuckle module (20) can be achieved more easily in a narrow finger space.

title: Lightweight simple-to-assemble precise cycloid joint module
abstract: The utility model discloses a lightweight simply-assembled precise cycloid joint module, which relates to the field of robot joints, and comprises a hip joint, a knee joint and an ankle joint, the hip joint and the ankle joint are respectively provided with a group of radial output modules which are perpendicular to each other; the knee joint comprises an axial rotating module arranged on the upper portion and a radial output module arranged on the lower portion, shells of the axial rotating module and the radial output module are carbon fiber composite shells, the axial rotating module is divided into a front portion and a rear portion and rotates and outputs in the axial direction, and the shell of the radial output module rotates and outputs in the radial direction. By means of reasonable weight reduction arrangement and torque transmission, high-power output and flexible driving are achieved, and by means of material-structure-process triple innovation, a joint solution with high torque density and low assembly cost is provided for the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining device, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The problem that an existing super-long lead screw nut is low in machining efficiency when internal threads are machined is solved. The humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment comprises a rack, two sliding seats are arranged on the rack in the transverse direction in a sliding mode, a machining interval exists between the two sliding seats, one sliding seat is provided with a rotating disc capable of rotating, the rotating disc is provided with a chuck, and the rack is further provided with a first driving piece capable of driving the two sliding seats to move synchronously in the same direction and move oppositely. One sliding seat is provided with a chuck, the other sliding seat is provided with a tip, the chuck clamps a columnar cutter, one end of the columnar cutter abuts against the tip, the rack is slidably connected with a feeding seat located between the two sliding seats in the longitudinal direction, a mounting seat capable of clamping a workpiece is fixed to the feeding seat, and the mounting seat is provided with a second driving part capable of driving the workpiece to rotate. According to the humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, the machining efficiency can be further improved.

title: Humanoid robot lower body structure and humanoid robot thereof
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a humanoid robot lower body structure and a humanoid robot thereof, which comprise a first driver, a second driver, a third driver, a fourth driver, a fifth driver, a sixth driver, a waist structure, a thigh structure, a shank structure and a foot structure, the waist structure comprises a first waist support, a second waist support, a third waist support, a waist connecting block and two waist connecting rods. The six drivers are divided into two groups, and each group comprises three drivers, so that the multi-direction flexible movement of the lower body structure is realized, and the lower body structure flexibly simulates the actions of human legs. The adaptive capacity and the stability of the humanoid robot can be remarkably improved through the multi-degree-of-freedom design, and the problem that the flexibility and the reliability are insufficient when the humanoid robot is applied in a complex environment is solved.

title: Moving chassis structure of fully-exposed high-heel humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a fully-exposed high-heeled humanoid robot moving chassis structure, and belongs to the field of humanoid robots, the fully-exposed high-heeled humanoid robot moving chassis structure comprises a shell, a chassis heavy plate is fixedly mounted at the bottom of the shell, universal wheels are fixedly mounted at four corners of the bottom of the chassis heavy plate, and a cantilever is rotatably connected to the chassis heavy plate through a first hinge; driving wheels are arranged on the two sides of the interior of the shell, each driving wheel comprises an annular wheel and a motor arranged in the annular wheel, the driving wheels are driven by the corresponding motors to rotate, the output ends of the motors are fixedly connected with fixing shafts, one ends of the fixing shafts are rotationally connected to cantilevers through bearing seats, and the other ends of the fixing shafts are rotationally connected to the cantilever through bearing seats. Through the arrangement of the shell, the universal wheels and the driving wheels, the stable structural design of shell materials and the structural design of reasonable configuration of the two driving motors and the four 4-inch universal wheels, the chassis can walk in a balanced, free and stable manner when passing through the ridges and going uphill and downhill to do various actions and performances like people.

title: Biped robot walking control method based on model predictive control and foothold optimization
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a biped robot walking control method based on model predictive control and landing point optimization. The method aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, when external disturbance and non-flat terrains are handled, stability is insufficient, and adaptability is poor. The core of the invention lies in that the supporting legs and the swinging legs are respectively subjected to optimization control; the three-dimensional ground reaction force of the supporting legs is optimized in real time by adopting model predictive control (MPC), so that the supporting legs can effectively support the trunk; meanwhile, a gait stability feedback controller is designed, real-time state feedback is provided through a state observer, the track of the swing leg is optimized, the foothold position of the robot is dynamically corrected, and the anti-interference capacity of the system is enhanced.

title: High-precision six-dimensional force sensor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a high-precision six-dimensional force sensor for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of six-dimensional force sensors. The device comprises a shell, a switching inner ring is arranged in the shell, a center body is arranged in the switching inner ring, the switching inner ring is connected with the shell through four sets of circumferentially-distributed elastic beams, the center body is connected with the switching inner ring through four sets of circumferentially-distributed elastic beams, and stress pieces are arranged on the elastic beams. The top of the center body is provided with a force contact plate, the bottom of the center body is provided with a bottom plate, and the bottom of the switching inner ring is provided with a circuit board. Through the arrangement of the two sets of elastic beams, mutual rigid switching among the shell, the center body and the switching inner ring can be achieved through sliding of the supporting rods, then different elastic beams can participate in work, free switching between large force and micro operation can be achieved, and the sensing precision and the sensing range of force of the humanoid robot are greatly improved.

title: Method and system for examining ring enveloping high-performance speed reducer of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an examination method and system for a ring enveloping high-performance speed reducer of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of transmission devices.The method comprises the steps that structural parameters and transmission relations of the built-in ring enveloping high-performance speed reducer of the humanoid robot are analyzed, and a humanoid transmission model is constructed; decomposing a transmission relation by taking the built-in installation positioning as a center, and generating a transmission interaction relation graph containing interaction nodes and interaction relations; arranging detection sensing equipment to collect interactive node monitoring data, performing preset dimension comparative analysis, and generating monitoring sequence data; and mapping the monitoring sequence data to a transmission interaction relation graph, and examining the state of each positioning speed reducer according to the interaction relation to obtain state deviation information. Therefore, the technical effects of comprehensive improvement of examination, enhanced accuracy and reduction of misjudgment and missing judgment rate are achieved.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating human body shoulder and elbow joint movement
abstract: The invention relates to the field of humanoid robots, in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating human shoulder and elbow joint movement. The invention aims to provide the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating the movement of the shoulder and elbow joints of the human body, and the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm has high rigidity, high movement precision and stronger bearing capacity on the overall structure, and can realize multi-degree-of-freedom compound movement in a three-dimensional space. According to the technical scheme, the invention discloses a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm simulating human body shoulder and elbow joint movement. The multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm is characterized in that the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm comprises a base assembly provided with four planetary gears, two hooke joint assemblies arranged below the base assembly in parallel and driven by the two planetary gears respectively, two connecting rods driven by the two hooke joint assemblies respectively, and an output execution piece driven by the two connecting rods together.

title: Humanoid robot for dispensing medicine in pharmacy and walking control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot for dispensing medicines in a pharmacy and a walking control method. The humanoid robot comprises a walking base, a trunk part, humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms, humanoid manipulator mechanisms, a humanoid head and a behavior control unit. The trunk part is connected to the top of the walking base, humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms are connected to the two opposite sides of the trunk part correspondingly, humanoid manipulator mechanisms used for grabbing medicine are connected to the sides, away from the trunk part, of the humanoid mechanical arm mechanisms, and a storage box is arranged at the top of the walking base. The humanoid mechanical arm mechanism can move; the top of the trunk part is connected with a human-shaped head part, and the human-shaped head part is provided with a laser radar for collecting high-altitude environment data; the walking base is provided with environment sensing equipment used for collecting near-ground environment data. The behavior control unit is used for constructing a global environment model according to the high-altitude environment data and the near-surface environment data; acquiring a preset track route according to the global environment model; and the walking base is controlled to move according to the preset track route.

title: Autonomous obstacle avoidance trajectory planning method for humanoid robot mechanical arm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an autonomous obstacle avoidance trajectory planning method for a humanoid robot mechanical arm, which comprises the following steps of: generating an initial virtual three-dimensional lattice network through mapping in a working space by sensing an environment and a pose; and a mechanical arm operation degree matrix is calculated, feature values are extracted, the mapping relation with the negative Poisson's ratio is established, and the anisotropic flexibility tensor of the lattice network is updated. An obstacle is equivalent to a rigid pressure head to invade the lattice network, a comprehensive strain tensor of a pressed area is solved based on a negative Poisson's ratio same sign strain effect, and a continuous low-potential-energy channel coordinate system formed by tangential contraction is extracted. And the mechanical arm is fitted into a continuous elastic spline curve, and the internal smooth strain energy and the external constraint energy are superposed to generate a total strain energy functional. And solving an obstacle avoidance spline track corresponding to the functional minimum based on a variational method, and converting the obstacle avoidance spline track into a driving instruction for execution. According to the method, minimum stagnation points are eliminated, and obstacle avoidance continuity and mechanical stability are guaranteed.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method based on grounding detection
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on ground contact detection, which is applied to a biped humanoid robot with a floating base structure, and comprises the following steps: constructing a model prediction controller based on a mass center dynamic model; constructing a grounding probability model; performing adaptive adjustment on the current gait phase according to a grounding detection result; an inverse dynamics quadratic programming problem including generalized acceleration, foot end contact force and joint driving torque is constructed, and a joint torque instruction is solved under the condition that dynamics constraint, foot end contact non-slip constraint and friction cone constraint are met. According to the method, ground contact detection is introduced into a nonlinear model prediction controller, a reasonable centroid dynamic model is designed, necessary equality constraints and inequality constraints are added, self-adaptive adjustment of the humanoid robot under the scene that the foot end contact state is unknown is achieved, and the humanoid robot is more adaptive to the foot end contact state. And the walking stability and robustness of the humanoid robot under the complex terrain condition are improved.

title: Optical lens and optical communication module for humanoid robot domain control
abstract: The invention discloses an optical lens and an optical communication module for humanoid robot domain control, and relates to the technical field of optical communication, the optical lens is used for collimating emergent light of an edge emitting laser, and the optical lens comprises a first lens part and a second lens part which are of an integrally formed structure, the end, back to the second lens part, of the first lens part is provided with an incident plane, and the end, back to the first lens part, of the second lens part is provided with an emergent cambered surface. Wherein the first lens part is provided with a first step surface opposite to the incident plane, the second lens part is provided with a second step surface, and the second step surface is vertically connected with the first step surface and is connected with the emergent cambered surface; the diameter of a projection circle of the first lens part in the light-emitting direction is larger than that of a projection circle of the second lens part in the light-emitting direction, and the extending direction of the first step face is perpendicular to the light-emitting direction. The problem that in the prior art, when an optical lens is applied to a humanoid robot, the coupling efficiency is low is solved.

title: Waist structure for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a waist structure for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The waist structure comprises a first supporting seat, a first driving device, a second supporting seat, a second driving device and a transfer structure, a first output shaft of the first driving device is separated from a second output shaft of the second driving device, the transfer structure is rotationally connected with the first supporting seat, and the transfer structure is rotationally connected with the second supporting seat. The first output shaft is in transmission connection with the transfer structure and used for driving the transfer structure to drive the second supporting seat to rotate around a first axis, and the second output shaft is in transmission connection with the transfer structure and used for driving the second supporting seat to rotate around a second axis; the first axis intersects the second axis. According to the waist structure, the gap between the waist structure action of the humanoid robot and the waist action of a real person can be reduced, so that the action of the waist structure is closer to the waist action of the real person, and the overall coordination of the humanoid robot is higher.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a waist structure for a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The first output shaft is in transmission connection with the transfer structure and used for driving the transfer structure to drive the second supporting seat to rotate around a first axis, and the second output shaft is in transmission connection with the transfer structure and used for driving the second supporting seat to rotate around a second axis; the first axis intersects the second axis. title: Humanoid robot
abstract: A plurality of inertial measurement units are arranged on a trunk component, a thigh bone component and a lower leg bone component of the humanoid robot, and a sole plate assembly comprises a first grounding component, a second grounding component, a third grounding component and a fourth grounding component which are sequentially connected in series through a pivot component. The first grounding assembly is located in the forward direction of the trunk assembly, the fourth grounding assembly is located in the backward direction of the trunk assembly, the fourth grounding assembly is connected to the lower side of the leg bone assembly through a pivot assembly, and the foot bottom plate assembly is provided with the pivot assembly and a pressure sensing unit. Through detection of a plurality of inertial measurement units and a plurality of pressure sensing assemblies, the humanoid robot can carry out ZMP zero moment point gait control and MPC model prediction control analysis to achieve the purposes of autonomous detection and gravity center balance of the robot.

title: Robot neck structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a neck structure of a robot and a humanoid robot. The second joint actuator assembly is used for driving the neck assembly to rotate around a second axis; the second axis is the axis in the vertical direction; the output end of the second joint actuator assembly is connected with the second end of the neck assembly, and a shell of the second joint actuator assembly is connected with a chest assembly of the humanoid robot. The two degrees of freedom of left-right rotation and up-down nodding of the head of the robot can be achieved through the two joint actuator assemblies, the flexibility of the neck structure is improved, nodding and swinging actions are more natural, the neck structure is simple, and the production cost is low.

title: Humanoid robot convenient to adjust
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot convenient to adjust, which comprises a mechanical trunk, a head is rotatably mounted at the top end of the mechanical trunk, mechanical arms are mounted on two sides of the mechanical trunk in a hinged manner, a moving mechanism is arranged on the mechanical trunk, and the moving mechanism is connected with the head. The moving mechanism comprises a control circuit board, the control circuit board is fixedly installed on the side wall of the mechanical trunk, the control circuit board is sleeved with a rectangular protective cover, and the outer wall of the rectangular protective cover is fixedly installed on the outer wall of the mechanical trunk. title: Joint module and robot

title: Waist and hip mechanism and humanoid robot

title: Battery replacement method, wheeled humanoid robot, readable storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a battery replacing method, a wheeled humanoid robot, a readable storage medium and a program product, and the battery replacing method comprises the steps: obtaining a battery replacing signal, and controlling at least part of a first to-be-replaced battery in a battery compartment of the wheeled humanoid robot to be pushed outwards according to the battery replacing signal; after at least part of the first to-be-replaced battery is pushed out of the battery bin, the first to-be-replaced battery is grabbed and transferred; and after the first to-be-replaced battery is transferred, a second to-be-replaced battery provided by the battery replacing equipment is grabbed, and the second to-be-replaced battery is loaded into the battery bin. According to the battery replacement method, the wheeled humanoid robot, the readable storage medium and the program product, the wheeled humanoid robot can autonomously replace the battery, time and labor are saved, and extra large battery replacement equipment is not needed.

title: Humanoid robot data storage module integrating thermal management and parallel interconnection and preparation process
abstract: The invention provides a thermal management and parallel interconnection integrated humanoid robot data storage module and a preparation process, and relates to the technical field of integration of special electronic modules for humanoid robots. According to the thermal management and parallel interconnection integrated humanoid robot data storage module and the preparation process, based on the comprehensive requirements of the humanoid robot data storage module for high thermal conductivity, structural stability and parallel interconnection compatibility, a metal matrix composite material and a ceramic material are selected and compounded to form a substrate; a high-thermal-conductivity composite substrate is prepared by adopting a laminated sintering process, and a thermal diffusion layer structure is preset in the substrate, so that the overall heat conduction efficiency is improved. By constructing a high-thermal-conductivity composite substrate and presetting a thermal diffusion structure in the high-thermal-conductivity composite substrate, the overall heat conduction efficiency of the substrate is remarkably improved, a foundation is laid for a subsequent heat dissipation channel, a metalized microchannel is formed in the substrate by adopting a laser micromachining and electrochemical deposition combined process, an efficient longitudinal heat dissipation path is established, and the heat dissipation efficiency is improved. And heat generated by the high-power-density chip can be effectively led out.

title: Mechanical arm
abstract: The invention discloses a manipulator, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The manipulator comprises a palm base and at least one finger, wherein the finger comprises a plurality of telescopic power devices; the telescopic power devices are sequentially arranged in series end to end, and each telescopic power device serves as a main body structural part of the corresponding knuckle at the same time, is used for outputting telescopic driving force and bearing external loads and can also have a measuring function to measure the magnitude of output force. The device further comprises a touch sensing skin wrapping the telescopic power device, and the touch sensing skin is used for detecting the stress of external force and the stress uniformity degree of all the knuckles in real time and regulating and controlling the output force of the knuckles in real time. Through fusion of a power device and a structure, distributed tactile feedback and knuckle-level control, the movement flexibility of the manipulator is improved, the structure is simplified, the force control precision is enhanced, fine actions can be completed, and the degree of freedom of a human hand can be achieved. The device is suitable for humanoid robots, artificial limbs and precise automation equipment.

title: Training method and control method of Actor-critic network for humanoid walking and running learning control of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the related technical field of robots, and discloses a control method for humanoid walking and running of a humanoid robot. The method comprises the following steps: pre-processing a preset expected running speed of the robot, inputting pre-processed data as observation data into a strategy network of an Actor-critic network, outputting a joint action for controlling the robot to move, converting the joint action into a joint driving torque for controlling the robot by utilizing a controller, and outputting the joint driving torque. Performing simulation control on the robot by using the joint driving torque; and calculating a total loss function, and adjusting the strategy network to enable the total loss function to be minimum so as to realize training of the Actor-critic network. According to the invention, the problem that the anthropomorphism of the motion form, the rationality of the whole-body dynamics and the continuous evolution characteristics of the gait in different speed intervals are difficult to consider at the same time in the existing control method is solved.

title: Robot chest breathing fluctuation structure and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a robot chest breathing fluctuating structure and a control method, the fluctuating structure realizes the dynamic effect of robot chest bionic breathing fluctuating, fills the technical blank of existing anthropomorphic robot trunk dynamic simulation, and meanwhile, through the hinging and sliding connection mode of connecting rods, the real-time dynamic simulation of the robot chest is realized. The motion trail of the front chest assembly is smooth linear motion changing along with the included angle of the connecting rod, and the natural fluctuation characteristic of the human chest during breathing is met; further, according to the control method, real-time detection data such as the actual fluctuation amplitude of the front chest assembly, the actual rotation angle of the connecting rod and the actual movement speed of the front chest assembly are collected through a displacement/angle sensor, a speed sensor and a pressure sensor; generating a first control strategy, and dynamically adjusting the output of the power mechanism to enable the actual parameters of the chest fluctuation to approach the target parameters; while the anthropomorphic effect is ensured, the problems of structure overload, external contact damage and the like are effectively avoided, and the reliability and the safety of equipment are improved.

title: Low-delay force control action control method of humanoid robot for construction and related device
abstract: The invention relates to a low-delay force control action control method for a humanoid robot for construction and a related device. The method comprises the steps that multi-modal sensor data of the whole body of the humanoid robot are collected; inputting multi-modal sensor data into a high-frequency torque inner ring and a low-frequency planning outer ring respectively; solving the whole-body kinetic model in a low-frequency planning outer ring according to multi-modal sensor data to obtain a reference torque value of each joint; taking the reference torque value as a feedforward quantity in the high-frequency torque inner ring, and superposing a torque compensation quantity calculated according to the data of the multi-modal sensor to generate a target torque instruction of each joint; and outputting the target torque instruction to each joint actuator. According to the method, the control loop is separated into the high-frequency torque inner ring and the low-frequency planning outer ring which are different in control period, so that the updating frequency of torque compensation is separated from the time consumption of whole-body dynamics solution, the correction torque is continuously output at high frequency under the working conditions of sudden load change and external force impact, and the instability risk caused by torque response delay is reduced.

title: Hydraulic biped robot leg device with built-in oil pipe
abstract: The invention provides a hydraulic biped robot leg device with a built-in oil pipe, and relates to the technical field of hydraulic bionic robotics.The hydraulic biped robot leg device comprises a biped connecting plate and two bionic legs connected to the lower portion of the biped connecting plate; a thigh structure; a knee joint; a shank structure; an ankle joint; a foot structure; a built-in oil path system; full-hydraulic driving is adopted, compared with electric driving, better dynamic response and higher driving force are achieved, meanwhile, the full-built-in oil way design is adopted, oil pipe scratching, damage and leakage under the complex working condition are avoided, and the full-hydraulic-drive oil pipe hydraulic drive system can adapt to high-risk and extreme working environments; and on the other hand, the high-pressure oil way and the low-pressure oil way are independently designed, the rotary joint is matched with the rotary oil supply mechanism, the hydraulic oil way machined through a drilling machining method replaces traditional hose oil supply, the problems that oil mixing, leakage, damage and pipeline winding are prone to occurring during hose oil supply are solved, oil way operation is more stable, and the service life is greatly prolonged.

title: Humanoid robot impedance adjusting method and system
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine control, and provides a humanoid robot impedance adjusting method and system, and the method comprises the steps: extracting a joint angle sequence and a joint angular velocity sequence of a contact force change curve, carrying out the extreme point detection of the contact force change curve, and obtaining a contact transient characteristic parameter. Performing forward kinematics analysis based on the joint angle sequence to obtain a displacement variation, determining a real-time contact stiffness value by combining the displacement variation and the contact force change curve, and superposing the real-time contact stiffness value and the contact transient characteristic parameters to obtain a stiffness adjustment amount; the position deviation and the speed deviation of the current control period are collected in real time, the position deviation and the rigidity adjustment amount are linearly mapped to obtain a rigidity compensation torque, the speed deviation and the contact transient characteristic parameter gain are modulated to obtain a damping compensation torque, finally, an original torque instruction is updated according to the two compensation torques, and an optimized torque instruction is generated; the impedance adjusting efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot anthropomorphic face display system and full-screen display humanoid robot comprising same
abstract: The invention provides an anthropomorphic face display system of a humanoid robot and a full-screen display humanoid robot comprising the anthropomorphic face display system. The anthropomorphic face display system of the humanoid robot comprises a display screen covering the face area of the head of the robot, eye display windows are arranged at the eye positions, and the eye display windows are provided with light-transmitting protective layers and are in coupling connection with the display screen; the system further comprises a control system, and the control system comprises a user-defined module and an AI driving module. The user customizing module is used for receiving face feature data input by a user, generating a customizing face image matched with the outline of the display screen and the layout of the eye display window, and outputting the customizing face image to the display screen for displaying; and the AI driving module is in communication connection with a robot voice output unit, and is used for generating matched facial expression data and mouth shape dynamic data based on text content and semantics corresponding to voice when the robot makes a sound, and controlling the display screen to synchronously present the expression and the mouth shape so as to realize anthropomorphic interaction.

title: Storage and calculation collaborative convolutional neural network accelerator
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a storage and calculation cooperative convolutional neural network accelerator which comprises a configuration unit, a control unit, a convolution calculation unit, a vector calculation unit, a unified on-chip storage unit and an arbitration unit, and all the units cooperatively construct a storage and calculation tight coupling architecture. The configuration unit realizes flexible configuration of operation parameters, the control unit adopts a primitive scheduling mechanism to promote parallel streamlined execution of each calculation unit, the convolution calculation unit directly executes convolution operation in a specific data stream mode and improves the data reuse rate, and the vector calculation unit adopts a data-level parallel processing mode to adapt to the storage bandwidth. The unified on-chip storage unit guarantees high-bandwidth storage through a multi-memory bank and multi-port design, and the arbitration unit solves memory access conflicts. According to the method, the data migration overhead can be reduced, the operation efficiency and the resource utilization rate can be improved, various convolutional neural network models can be adapted, and high-throughput and low-power-consumption acceleration is realized.

title: Double-ring self-adaptive suspension continuous refrigeration system of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot double-ring self-adaptive suspension continuous refrigeration system, which belongs to the technical field of robot oil way cooling, and comprises a phase change refrigeration module, an oil heat exchange circulation module and a posture self-adaptive suspension module, the external circular ring is fixedly connected with the robot chest frame, the internal circular ring is rotatably connected with the external circular ring, and the hemispherical weight shell is rotatably connected with the internal circular ring; the connecting pipe, the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are perpendicular to one another, the phase change refrigeration module is installed in the hemispherical weight shell, and the phase change refrigeration module is always kept in a vertical state under the action of gravity; the outer circular ring, the inner circular ring, the connecting pipe, the first rotating shaft and the second rotating shaft are all of hollow circular pipe structures, and the oil liquid pipeline sequentially penetrates through the outer circular ring, the inner circular ring and hollow channels of the rotating shafts. Through the double-ring suspension structure and the balance weight type hemispherical shell, the phase change refrigeration module is always kept vertical in the all-posture of the robot, and continuous and stable output of the refrigeration function is achieved.

title: Body load position estimation and cooperative control method based on robot body sensing
abstract: The invention provides a machine body load position estimation and cooperative control method based on robot body sensing, and relates to the technical field of biped robot control. According to the method, a robot joint sensor and an airborne IMU are utilized, leg self-weight and inertial interference are eliminated through dynamics preprocessing, a momentum observer is adopted to extract load external torque, and the position of a robot body is estimated; estimating the mass, the position and the speed of the non-fixed dynamic load in real time through Jacobian matrix mapping and moment balance resolving; estimation distortion caused by fuselage attitude inclination is corrected and eliminated through rotation matrix projection, and smooth output is achieved in combination with Alpha-Beta filtering. In the control link, a backstepping method is adopted to map load motion into a fuselage attitude instruction, joint torque is output through inverse kinematics, a second-order tracking differentiator and a second-order Super-Twisting sliding mode controller, and robot self-balancing and load cooperative control is achieved. The method can effectively solve the problems that a traditional scheme depends on an external sensor, leg dynamics coupling interference, dynamic load estimation lag, attitude inclination positioning distortion and the like.

title: Linear execution mechanism applied to humanoid robot
abstract: A linear actuating mechanism applied to a humanoid robot relates to the field of robot parts and comprises a driving structure, a spiral spring structure and an accessory structure, the driving structure comprises a linear motor, a driver is arranged at the bottom of the linear motor, a sensor group is mounted at the end of the linear motor, and the spiral spring structure is connected with the sensor group. One end of the linear motor away from the sensor group is provided with a tension-pressure sensor; the spiral spring structure comprises a spiral spring, a spring supporting seat and a second spring supporting seat are arranged at the two ends of the spiral spring respectively, and a fixing cylinder is arranged on the spring supporting seat. The accessory structure comprises a connecting rod and a second connecting rod. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the advantages that the planetary roller screw transmission parts are reduced, the efficiency is high, the weight is light, and the cost is saved; and the mechanical resistance and noise are reduced, so that the linear actuating mechanism runs more smoothly. The functions of shock absorption, energy storage and limiting are achieved. And active stroke, rigidity and damping adjusting functions are provided.

title: Electro-hydraulic hybrid drive cycloid motor for humanoid robot joint motor
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot driving, and particularly relates to an electro-hydraulic hybrid driving cycloid motor for a humanoid robot joint motor, which comprises a motor rotor, the motor rotor is connected with an inner rotor through a spline, inner needle teeth are uniformly distributed on the circumference of the inner rotor, and an outer rotor is arranged on one side of the inner needle teeth. An oil cavity is formed in the surface of the inner pin tooth and the inner contour of the outer rotor in a surrounding mode, outer pin teeth are arranged on one side of the outer rotor, a middle shell is arranged on one side of the outer pin teeth, and a low-pressure oil cavity is formed in the outer contour of the outer rotor, the surface of the outer pin teeth and the inner diameter of the middle shell in a surrounding mode. Fractional-slot concentrated windings are wound on the upper ends of the motor stator silicon steel sheets. Permanent magnets and magnetic isolation bridges are embedded in the outer rotor. A novel permanent magnet brushless direct current motor topological structure, namely a cycloid pair structure permanent magnet composite motor is adopted, a traditional relative circular motion pair of a stator and a rotor is changed into a cycloid pair, a planetary motion track of the rotor is generated, and integration of hydraulic energy and electromagnetic energy is achieved.
