title: Biped robot form optimization method based on metric index identification variable additive grouping
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot form optimization method based on metric index identification variable additive grouping. The method comprises an additive structure grouping stage and a Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition. In the additive structure grouping stage, firstly, the interaction strength between every two variables is calculated through a designed inter-variable interaction measurement index, and the interaction strength is converted into a distance matrix; then, the distance matrix is used, a K-Means clustering algorithm with capacity limitation is adopted to cluster the high-dimensional variables to obtain groups, and therefore an additive grouping structure is obtained; and in a Bayesian optimization stage based on additive decomposition, constructing an additive kernel GP agent model by using the obtained additive grouping structure, obtaining a next evaluation point by maximizing an obtaining function, and taking morphological parameters of the evaluation point as initial morphological parameters of the finally applied biped robot. Compared with an existing method, the method is simpler and more stable, and the optimization efficiency and the grouping recognition precision are balanced by limiting the maximum dimension of each subgroup.

title: High-bearing humanoid robot leg outer skeleton structure and machining method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot equipment, and particularly discloses a high-bearing humanoid robot leg outer skeleton structure and a machining method thereof. Comprising the following steps: S1, early-stage preparation and optimization: taking a titanium alloy cast ingot as a raw material, carrying out topological optimization and lightweight design on the leg outer skeleton structure based on CAE finite element analysis, and generating an optimized processing model; then the titanium alloy cast ingot is forged or rolled, and a titanium alloy blank is obtained; s2, precision machining is conducted, specifically, the titanium alloy blank is clamped, rough machining, semi-finish machining and finish machining are sequentially conducted on the basis of the optimized machining model, and a machined part is obtained; s3, heat treatment and stress control; and S4, post-processing and detecting. The leg outer skeleton structure of the humanoid robot can be used for a high-dynamic and high-load humanoid robot, and has the advantages of being light in structural weight, high in bearing efficiency, fast in dynamic response, long in fatigue life and the like.

title: Control method and device of humanoid form robot
abstract: The invention discloses a control method and device for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the three-dimensional position data of key points of a hand skeleton of a target operator, and the pose data of a palm root skeleton of the target operator; according to the three-dimensional position data, skeleton direction vectors of all finger knuckles of the target operator are determined, and according to the skeleton direction vectors, all target finger joint angles of a dexterous hand on the humanoid robot to be controlled are determined; and generating an upper limb joint angle reference track of each upper limb joint of the to-be-controlled humanoid robot according to the pose data, and generating a joint driving instruction for controlling the movement of the upper limbs and the dexterous hand of the to-be-controlled humanoid robot according to the target finger joint angle and the upper limb joint angle reference track. The grabbing posture reproduction precision of the humanoid robot is improved, and the coordination of the grabbing action and the arm movement is enhanced.

title: Limb coordination planning method and device during obstacle crossing of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a limb coordination planning method and device during obstacle crossing of a humanoid robot. The limb coordination planning method comprises the steps that the trunk roll angle, the load distribution quantity and the holding height of the humanoid robot are obtained to serve as input parameters; according to the load distribution quantity and the trunk roll angle, calculating a load centroid lateral offset distance, and determining a centroid height linkage quantity by combining the holding height and the load centroid lateral offset distance; the load state is judged according to the mass center height linkage amount, and the dynamic torque amplification factor is calculated under the high-position holding working condition; adjusting an allowable range of a roll angle according to the dynamic torque amplification factor, and fusing the load distribution quantity to determine a roll amplitude boundary; constructing constraint conditions according to the roll amplitude boundary, and solving by adopting inverse kinematics to generate a limb joint track meeting constraints; and dynamically simulating and evaluating the coordination of the limb joint track, and generating a limb coordination planning scheme of the humanoid robot according to an evaluation result.

title: Motor drive control system, electric drive joint and control method of electric drive joint
abstract: The invention discloses a motor drive control system, an electric drive joint and a control method of the electric drive joint. The control system comprises a first control module and a second control unit. The first control module comprises a first control unit, a signal gating control unit and a motor unit which are electrically connected in sequence, and the first control unit is configured to generate a first control signal through a vector control algorithm according to an operation feedback signal of the motor unit; the second control unit is electrically connected with the signal gating control unit, and the second control unit is configured to generate a second control signal through a reinforcement learning algorithm according to the operation feedback signal of the motor unit; and the signal gating control unit is configured to select the first control signal or the second control signal as a target control signal to control the motor unit to operate according to the operation feedback signal of the motor unit and the second control signal. The problems that when the electrically-driven joint is applied to different humanoid robots, full-autonomous adaptation cannot be rapidly, safely and reliably conducted, and the self-adaptability is poor can be solved.

title: Motion control model training method, robot motion control method and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention provides a motion control model training method, a robot motion control method and electronic equipment, and the model training method comprises the steps: employing a pre-trained terrain reconstruction model, carrying out the terrain reconstruction according to historical ontology feeling data and continuous multi-frame local depth images, and obtaining a current local terrain geometric feature map, according to the current body feeling data, the current local terrain geometric feature map and a preset control instruction of a driving joint in the simulation robot, obtaining a current observation feature, according to the current observation feature, generating a first action instruction and a second action instruction by adopting a teacher model and a student model respectively, and according to the first action instruction and the second action instruction, generating a second action instruction; and training the student model to obtain a target action strategy model so as to perform motion control on the humanoid robot. The stable self-adaptive motion of the humanoid robot under the complex terrain is realized, the terrain reconstruction error and the sensing delay are reduced, the hardware dependence is reduced, and the training efficiency and the environment generalization ability are improved.

title: Attitude self-adaption method and device for humanoid robot in load-bearing state
abstract: The invention provides a posture self-adaption method and device for a humanoid robot in a load bearing state, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the actual landing center point coordinates of left and right feet, the hip joint side-sway angle and the load eccentric distance as input data, carrying out the filtering processing of the input data, and determining the geometric boundary of a supporting polygon; the comprehensive barycentric coordinates of the robot are calculated according to the obtained current angles of all the joints and the filtered load eccentric distance; according to comparison between the current boundary margin and a preset safety threshold value, evaluating a roll instability risk level, and determining a corresponding two-foot transverse spacing adjustment amount; according to the adjustment amount of the transverse distance between the two feet, calculating the hip joint side-sway angle variation, and based on the hip joint side-sway angle variation, driving legs to act to adjust the transverse distance between the two feet; and the width of the supporting polygon is obtained based on the adjusted transverse distance between the two feet, the gravity center projection point coordinates are contained through the width of the supporting polygon, and a robot posture self-adaptive balance result is output.

title: Hierarchical control method and system for humanoid robot based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot control, and discloses a humanoid robot hierarchical control method and system based on reinforcement learning, and the method achieves the fine adjustment of the motion state of a robot through obtaining the feature information of different ground regions, and matching corresponding control strategy parameters according to the feature information. At the junction of the ground areas, the transition state parameters are determined, the fusion weight is calculated, the control strategy parameters of the different areas are subjected to weighted fusion, and a transition control instruction is generated, so that the motion stability of the robot when the robot crosses the different ground areas is ensured; besides, in combination with a reinforcement learning algorithm, the behavior strategy library and the fusion weight calculation logic are iteratively updated according to the actual performance parameters of the robot, so that the motion stability and energy consumption of the robot are continuously optimized, and the adaptability and robustness of the robot in a complex environment are remarkably improved.

title: High-dynamic humanoid dexterous hand based on rigid-flexible hybrid transmission
abstract: The high-dynamic humanoid dexterous hand based on rigid-flexible hybrid transmission comprises a bionic single-finger module used for grabbing objects; a wrist joint module, wherein a plurality of bionic single finger modules are fixed on the wrist joint module; the arm driving module is used for providing driving force for the bionic single-finger module and the wrist joint module; the rigid rotation and linear transmission assembly is arranged in the wrist joint module and the arm driving module and used for conducting local power transmission on deflection motion of finger roots in the bionic single-finger module and multi-degree-of-freedom motion of the wrist joint module; the rigid rotation and linear transmission assembly comprises a rotation transmission part and a linear transmission part which are connected in sequence. The method has the advantages that the tail end inertia is low, and dynamic response is good; the system-level cross-joint motion decoupling is realized; rigid and flexible mixing provides high transmission rigidity and precision; the space utilization is extreme, the structure is highly modularized, and the perfect external protection and bionic flexible contact are realized.

title: Small arm assembly, mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a forearm assembly, a mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, the forearm assembly comprises a fixing support and a wrist joint assembly, the wrist joint assembly is rotationally connected with one end of the fixing support, and a driving assembly comprises a driving part, a telescopic piece, a connecting piece and a stop piece; the telescopic part is arranged at the end, close to the wrist joint assembly, of the driving part, the telescopic part is movably connected with the wrist joint assembly, and the driving part is used for driving the telescopic part to reciprocate in the direction parallel to the first direction; one end of the connecting piece is connected with one end of the driving part back to the telescopic piece, and the other end of the connecting piece is movably connected with one end of the fixed bracket away from the wrist joint assembly; the two ends, opposite in the second direction, of the connecting piece are each provided with a stopping piece, the stopping pieces abut against the fixing support, the stopping pieces are configured to prevent the connecting piece from rotating around the axis parallel to the first direction, and the first direction is perpendicular to the second direction. According to the embodiment of the invention, the response speed, the anthropomorphic effect and the mute performance of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Multifunctional human-shaped joint motor driving control system and control method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multifunctional humanoid joint motor drive control system and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of robots. In order to solve the problems that in the prior art, a human-shaped joint motor drive control system is low in integration level and insufficient in torque control bandwidth, so that the compliance interaction capacity is poor, and multi-mode sensing fusion is lacked, the human-shaped joint motor drive control system comprises a frameless torque motor module used for generating joint driving torque; the transmission module is arranged between the output end of the frameless torque motor module and the joint load and comprises a precise speed reducer and a controllable damper; the multi-mode sensing fusion module comprises an encoder system used for position feedback; the force/torque sensor is used for directly measuring joint output torque; the temperature sensor is used for monitoring temperature; the power driving module is used for driving the frameless torque motor module; and the embedded intelligent control module is used for executing hierarchical control of a current inner ring, a torque middle ring, a speed outer ring and a position outer ring and running a collision detection and thermal management strategy. The method is used for humanoid robots.

title: Soft tissue collaborative operation control method and system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a soft tissue collaborative operation control method and system based on a humanoid robot. Relates to the technical field of medical robots, computer vision and remote operation. The method comprises the steps that image flow information collected by the humanoid robot for a surgery operation area in real time is displayed through a display terminal, and the surgery operation area comprises the area where a first instrument held by a first robot hand of the humanoid robot is located; obtaining a tissue deformation rate of the grabbed soft tissue in response to the detected grabbing operation representing that the first instrument has grabbed the soft tissue; according to the tissue deformation rate of the grabbed soft tissue, prompt information used for prompting the tissue stretching state on a display terminal is generated; and sending the prompt information to a display terminal for display.

title: Humanoid robot real-time speed estimation method and system based on time sequence feature fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a time sequence feature fusion-based humanoid robot real-time speed estimation method and system, and relates to the technical field of robots, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the body sensory data of the random walking of a robot; constructing an LSTM + MLP series hybrid neural network architecture, and training and optimizing to obtain a hybrid neural network model; collecting an ontology sense original data stream through a sensor to obtain standardized feature data; deploying the hybrid neural network model to an embedded master control platform for reasoning operation, and outputting a three-dimensional linear velocity predicted value; and carrying out trapezoidal numerical integration processing on the three-dimensional linear velocity predicted value, generating displacement odometer information and distributing the displacement odometer information to a robot system bus. According to the invention, an LSTM + MLP serial hybrid neural network architecture is arranged, so that physical characteristics of motion can be quickly captured, and experimental data shows that the model can realize quick reduction of mean square error and achieve stable convergence in a short training period, and the migration cost and data dependence of an algorithm among different robot platforms are reduced.

title: Humanoid robot sound sensing and positioning method
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot sound sensing and positioning method, and relates to the technical field of robots, four microphones are scientifically arranged to construct a basic three-dimensional sampling array, and high-precision omnidirectional condenser microphones are selected to realize undistorted acquisition of environmental sound signals, so that the positioning accuracy of the humanoid robot sound sensing and positioning method is improved. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a point sound source, synchronously outputting original sound signal data, accurate sound pressure amplitude data and related identification information, preprocessing the original sound signal by adopting an A-weighted sound level conforming to human auditory characteristics, filtering direct-current components and high-frequency interference noise, outputting a humanoid sound signal, and then acquiring a point sound source approximation model based on a pulsating ball source radiation sound field theory and the point sound source approximation model. The three-dimensional space coordinates of the sound source are accurately solved by combining the humanoid sound pressure data collected by the microphone arrays and the preset coordinates, and a plurality of sound source coordinate results are calculated through the combination of the microphone arrays, so that the accurate judgment and high-precision positioning of the environment sound source and the sound source position are realized.

title: Dual-scene self-adaptive humanoid robot cooperative control method and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a dual-scene adaptive humanoid robot cooperative control method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot motion cooperative control. The method comprises the steps that a target scene is judged according to environment sensing data and a user instruction, and action requirements and joint load characteristics of a robot in the target scene are obtained; according to the motion complexity required by the motion, the scene weight of the target scene and the joint load characteristics, dynamic computing power is distributed to each edge end joint control unit; on the basis of the dynamic computing power, according to semantic alignment and world model physical constraints, a joint cooperative control instruction matched with the target scene is generated; based on the joint cooperative control instruction, corresponding joints are controlled to execute action tasks, and joint movement data and multi-modal sensing data are obtained; and fusing the joint motion data and the multi-modal sensing data to complete closed-loop optimization of the control instruction. The cross-scene universality, the high-degree-of-freedom collaboration and the data utilization efficiency of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Humanoid robot chassis with high rigidity, low gravity center and capsizing resistance
abstract: The humanoid robot chassis comprises an AGV, a lifting stand column is fixed to the AGV, the AGV and the lifting stand column are combined to form a static platform, a lifting branch chain is arranged on the side wall of the lifting stand column, a front branch chain and a rear branch chain are arranged at the upper end of the AGV, and the movable ends of the lifting branch chain and the front branch chain and the rear branch chain are all movably connected with a movable platform. Through the design of the concave AGV trolley structure and the liftable movable platform, the movable platform can sink to the position extremely low away from the ground, and the overturning risk of a traditional movable chassis during high-load operation is avoided. title: Flexible three-dimensional force capacitance sensor for force feedback scene of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a flexible three-dimensional force capacitance sensor for a force feedback scene of a humanoid robot, mainly relates to a tactile sensing technology, and aims to solve the problems of low sensitivity, nonlinear output and the like of a tactile sensor. The sensor comprises an elastomer bump contact on the top layer, an air cavity layer and an elastomer layer on the middle layer, and a printed circuit board and a unit capacitor on the bottom layer. Through electrode layout and multi-layer elastomer design, detection and decoupling of normal force and shear force are realized. The sensor is manufactured by adopting a 3D printing manufacturing technology and a rapid prototyping technology, has high sensitivity, low lag and good repeatability, and can be applied to a force feedback scene of a robot.

title: Building full-autonomous construction method based on multi-humanoid robot cluster and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides a full-autonomous building construction method based on a multi-humanoid robot cluster and related equipment. According to the method, a control processing unit firstly carries out space comparison on real three-dimensional point cloud data obtained after previous humanoid robot operation is completed and a theoretical installation reference surface, and an actual space deviation vector is obtained; then, the control processing unit divides the three-dimensional data of the component to be installed into rigid entity data and flexible tolerance data; and then, the control processing unit performs overall pose translation and rotation on the rigid entity data based on the spatial deviation vector, and converts a spatial difference value generated after pose adjustment into a target filling size of the flexible tolerance data. And finally, the control processing unit generates an execution instruction according to the adjusted tolerance pose data and the target filling size, and updates the subsequent point cloud according to the completion state. According to the method, the problem of component extrusion interference caused by preorder accumulative errors is relieved, and the construction quality of robot cluster full-autonomous relay construction is improved.

title: Annular guide rail-based parallel mechanical joint capable of simulating rotation of neck of human body
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot, in particular to a human neck rotation simulating parallel mechanical joint based on an annular guide rail. The invention aims to provide the human neck rotation simulating parallel mechanical joint based on the annular guide rail, so that three degrees of freedom of human neck joint movement simulating are realized on the basis of ensuring high rigidity and movement precision, the structure is simplified, the supporting performance is good, and the movement space of the neck joint can be ensured. title: Construction method of VEM-robot emotion right brain model
abstract: According to the construction method of the VEM-robot emotional right brain model, the brain of a robot is decomposed into an emotional right brain, an intelligent left brain and a dynamic cerebellum, a body-shaped or humanoid robot operating system VEM-ROS is formed, emotional communication between the robot and a real person or other robots is achieved, the output of the real person serves as a perception spectrum, and the output of the robot serves as a deductive spectrum. The perception spectrum and the deduction spectrum are segmented, synthesized and aligned in an emotional rhythm mode of emotional multi-modal VEM-Token, logic perception of lexical element is calculated through LLM-Token decomposition of a large language model, micro-expressions of emotional perception of multi-modal emotional components are calculated through VEM-Token decomposition, and the micro-expressions of the emotional perception of the multi-modal emotional components are subjected to emotional sensing. The VEM-ROS further comprises priority and interruption, a VEM memory mechanism, a dialogue relation, a craniofacial and limb sensor, an actuator, an interface, robot cloning and operating system packaging. The right brain model supports emotional micro-expression communication between the robot and a real person, just like a Turing test, and is expected to distinguish whether an emotional tester is a robot or a real person.

title: Robot map asynchronous establishment method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a robot map asynchronous establishment method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of robot map construction.The method comprises the steps that a multi-source data stream is received in an asynchronous mode; an implicit network model is constructed, the implicit network model takes the sampled space coordinates, the view angle direction and the language features as input, and the occupancy probability and the semantic feature vector of the corresponding space coordinates are output to form a three-dimensional implicit occupancy map; and performing cross-modal fusion on the semantic features corresponding to the query points in the three-dimensional implicit placeholder map and the geometric features in the laser radar point cloud map to obtain fusion features, and constructing and maintaining an environment map for the robot. Through a complete asynchronous processing framework, online construction of a three-dimensional implicit placeholder map, cross-modal efficient fusion based on a double sparse strategy and special adaptation oriented to the dynamic characteristics of the biped robot are integrated, and a unified environment model with precise geometry and rich semantics is generated.

title: Harmonic transmission module for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a harmonic transmission module for a humanoid robot, which comprises a shell, a harmonic speed reducer is mounted on the shell, an output flange is connected onto the harmonic speed reducer, the harmonic speed reducer comprises a wave generator, a flexible gear and a rigid gear, the flexible gear is provided with a power transmission end, one end face of the power transmission end is an input end, and the other end face of the power transmission end is a rigid end. One end face of the flexible gear is an input end, the other end face of the flexible gear is an output end, the input end is arranged on the wave generator in a sleeving mode to receive power, the output end is meshed with the rigid gear to transmit power, the rigid gear is fixedly connected with the output flange, and the tooth face of the output end of the flexible gear is obliquely arranged in the axial direction. According to the harmonic transmission module for the humanoid robot, the size of the harmonic transmission module can be reduced, the transmission precision is improved, errors are reduced, and the service life is prolonged.

title: Movement control method and system for double driving wheels of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robot control, solves the problems of sensitive response at a low speed and instability at a high speed due to the fact that a single adjustment strategy is mostly adopted in the prior art, and provides a humanoid robot dual-driving-wheel movement control method and system and a humanoid robot. The method is applied to a humanoid robot chassis comprising two driving wheels, an auxiliary wheel and a suspension structure. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring rotating speed information of the two driving wheels and attitude information output by an attitude sensor; selecting a corresponding driving instruction adjustment strategy according to the relationship between the rotating speeds of the two driving wheels and a preset speed threshold value; and according to the adjusted driving instruction and in combination with the posture information, posture correction is carried out on the driving instruction, so that movement control over the humanoid robot is achieved. The driving instruction is adjusted according to the rotating speed of the driving wheel, quick response is achieved at the low speed, stable operation is kept at the high speed, and therefore the moving posture stability of the robot is improved.

title: Body-equipped intelligent operation robot carrying modularized parallel processing device
abstract: The invention discloses a body-equipped intelligent operation robot carrying a modularized parallel processing device, and belongs to the technical field of robot manufacturing. The humanoid robot comprises a trunk connected with the head, two mechanical arms connected in series and a detachably-connected moving unit. The serial mechanical arm can be any one of multiple degrees of freedom; the moving unit is any one of a leg type moving unit, a wheel type moving unit and a crawler type moving unit; the two connecting parts are detachably and correspondingly connected to the tail ends of the two mechanical arms connected in series; the two connecting parts are detachably and jointly connected with a modular parallel processing device or detachably and respectively connected with a modular parallel processing device; the modular parallel machining device can be one of multiple degrees of freedom. The device is high in integration level, high in collaboration, high in intelligence, good in flexibility, high in operation flexibility, high in machining precision and suitable for machining of large complex structural parts.

title: Humanoid robot motion control method and system based on stability constraint
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion control method and system based on stability constraint, and relates to the field of robot motion control, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the body feeling observation data of a humanoid robot, and constructing an augmented confidence state; inputting the augmented confidence state into a strategy network to generate a joint control instruction, and inputting the augmented confidence state into a neural Lyapunov evaluation network to calculate a Lyapunov energy value of a current state-action pair; calculating the difference between the expected energy and the current energy at the next moment based on an exponential stability condition, and anchoring the current energy as a constant through a gradient separation strategy so as to construct a constraint violation quantity which is not interfered by parameter updating; generating a stability penalty term according to the constraint violation quantity to construct a stability constraint, and jointly constructing a total optimization target to update strategy network parameters and generate an optimal joint control instruction; according to the method, the neural Lyapunov stability control theory and characterization learning are fused, and stable motion control of the humanoid robot is achieved.

title: General action data format construction method for humanoid robot and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot motion control, in particular to a universal motion data format construction method for a humanoid robot and electronic equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, remapping; s2, formatted storage is carried out; s3, carrying out original point alignment; s4, editing and splicing; s5, quality inspection; according to the universal motion data format construction method for the humanoid robot, efficient conversion of motion capture data is realized by establishing a remapping and standardization format from BVH data to robot joints; a space reference system is unified through original point alignment, so that action data management and editing are facilitated; action editing and splicing are supported, and the action asset reuse rate and development efficiency are improved; a joint speed checking mechanism is additionally arranged, overspeed risks are checked in advance, hardware damage is avoided, and operation safety is guaranteed; according to the method, a complete technical link of acquisition, conversion, alignment, editing and verification is formed, and the method has outstanding practical value.

title: Humanoid robot parallel driving shoulder and elbow mechanism based on annular limiting module
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot, in particular to a humanoid robot parallel driving shoulder-elbow mechanism based on an annular limiting module. According to the humanoid robot parallel driving shoulder-elbow mechanism based on the annular limiting module, the advantages of a parallel mechanism and a series mechanism are combined, and the rigidity, the bearing capacity and the movement flexibility of a robot shoulder-elbow joint are improved. According to the technical scheme, the humanoid robot parallel driving shoulder-elbow mechanism based on the annular limiting module is characterized in that the shoulder-elbow mechanism comprises two shoulder mounting frames installed on the left side and the right side of the top of a chest cavity, and each shoulder mounting frame is provided with an annular sliding rail, a shoulder horizontal rotating shaft, a shoulder vertical rotating shaft and two push rod branches.

title: Time division control humanoid robot joint system for driving and braking separation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic and mechanical control, and discloses a driving and braking separation time division control humanoid robot joint system which comprises a low-reduction-ratio mechanical driving module used for providing driving force for movement of humanoid robot joints and connected to a joint output shaft in a direct driving mode or a low-reduction-ratio transmission mechanism; the high-reduction-ratio mechanical braking module is used for maintaining the joint posture of the humanoid robot in a non-driving period; the high-capacity electrolytic capacitor energy storage module is connected in parallel with a battery of the low-reduction-ratio mechanical driving module and is used for instantaneously discharging in a driving period to provide peak driving current; and the time-division hybrid control module is used for realizing decoupling control of the driving function and the braking function in a time domain by adopting a time-division control strategy. By dynamically adjusting the driving output and the braking force, the instantaneous explosive force and the response time of the joint are maximized while the motion smoothness is guaranteed.

title: Robot deep squat jump load performance test device and method
abstract: The invention provides a robot deep squat jump load performance test device and method, and the device comprises an assembly mechanism which comprises a load support and a lifting support; the loading mechanism comprises an adjusting module, a movable carrier plate and a plurality of load sheets; the lifting mechanism comprises a moving assembly and a transmission connecting column, and the moving assembly comprises a guide column, a sliding frame and a robot connecting piece. Compared with the prior art, the device is compact in overall structure and high in integration degree, through mutual cooperation and linkage of the assembling mechanism, the loading mechanism and the lifting mechanism, coherent testing of the deep squat performance and the jumping performance of the humanoid robot load can be synchronously completed in the same device, the number of times of replacement of testing tools is reduced, the overall testing cost is reduced, and the testing efficiency is improved. And the test period is shortened, the real stress state and the motion working condition of the humanoid robot in the actual operation process are better fitted, and the authenticity and the reference value of the test result are effectively improved.

title: Control method and system for heat treatment forming of humanoid robot parts
abstract: The invention relates to a control method and system for heat treatment forming of humanoid robot parts, and relates to the technical field of part heat treatment.The control method comprises the steps that heat treatment parameters, part size parameters and part thermal characteristic parameters of the humanoid robot parts are collected; the heat treatment parameters, the part size parameters and the part thermal characteristic parameters are calculated on the basis of a preset single part heat treatment model, so that a heat treatment influence part gap is generated; calculating the part size parameter and the part thermal characteristic parameter based on a preset part shielding model so as to generate a shielding influence part gap; comparing the heat treatment influence part gap with the shielding influence part gap to determine an optimal heat treatment part gap; and the humanoid robot part is placed on a preset heating tool according to the optimal heat treatment part gap, and the heating tool is conveyed into a preset vacuum furnace for heat treatment. The method has the effect of improving the precision of heat treatment forming of the humanoid robot parts.

title: Monocular video-based humanoid robot whole body motion generation method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot whole body motion generation method and system based on a monocular video, and relates to the technical field of robot control, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the preprocessing and multi-modal feature extraction of the monocular video, fusing all modal features to form a time sequence feature vector, and obtaining a three-dimensional motion sequence; mapping the three-dimensional motion sequence to a target robot kinematic model to obtain an initial robot motion sequence; performing systematic post-processing and stability optimization on the initial robot motion sequence, and outputting an optimized robot motion sequence; and calculating a kinematics quantity and converting the kinematics quantity into a motion data matrix, and generating standardized interface data for simulation verification, reinforcement learning training and real machine control deployment. According to the method, the whole body action sequence can be generated from the monocular video, so that the generated robot action keeps the original human body action characteristics, and meanwhile, the kinematics and dynamics constraints of the robot are met, and therefore, the method can be more stably applied to robot simulation verification and real machine control deployment.

title: Intelligent mobile terminal
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to an intelligent mobile terminal which comprises a head holder, a trunk, a manipulator and a wheel-foot type mobile chassis, the top of the trunk is provided with a head mounting part, the lower end of the trunk is provided with a chassis mounting part, and the trunk is provided with a manipulator mounting position; the lower end of the head holder is connected to the head mounting piece; the manipulator comprises a mechanical arm and a paw, one end of the mechanical arm is connected to the manipulator mounting position, the other end of the mechanical arm is connected with the paw, and the mechanical arm is used for driving the paw to move so that the paw can grab an object; the upper end of the wheel-foot type mobile chassis is connected to the chassis mounting piece, and the wheel-foot type mobile chassis is used for driving the intelligent mobile terminal to walk. According to the intelligent mobile terminal, the wheel-foot type mobile chassis is adopted, so that the intelligent mobile terminal can quickly pass through various indoor and outdoor road obstacles, and the moving speed is high.

title: Multi-mode binocular active light source three-dimensional imaging camera and imaging method
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode binocular active light source three-dimensional imaging camera and an imaging method. The camera comprises a binocular imaging unit, an active light source unit and a control and processing unit, the binocular imaging unit comprises a left color imaging module and a right color imaging module, and the left and right modules both adopt color RGB image sensors; the active light source unit comprises a line laser projection module and a structured light projection module, and the line laser projection module and the structured light projection module can be independently started, alternatively started or jointly started at the same time under the control of the control and processing unit. The camera has three working modes: a binocular laser three-dimensional imaging mode, a binocular structured light three-dimensional imaging mode and a binocular color vision mode; the camera can be applied to a head visual system of a humanoid robot and can also be applied to industrial and consumer-level three-dimensional visual scenes. The camera is high in integration level and flexible in mode, and has high-precision three-dimensional and color texture information.

title: Multi-modal driving model and physical parameter fused robot adaptive control method
abstract: The invention specifically discloses a multi-modal driving model and physical parameter fused robot adaptive control method, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring existing control model parameters, physical parameters of an operation arm and task description data, and constructing a standardized data set; training through a meta-learning framework to obtain a generalization meta-model capable of rapidly adjusting parameters; feature extraction is carried out on physical parameters of an operation arm of the target robot and task description of the target robot, and the features are input into the meta-model to obtain an initial control strategy; and constructing a physical security constraint model based on a control barrier function to obtain a control strategy model adaptive to the new scene, finally verifying the performance of the model, and returning adaptive data with the performance reaching the standard to the data set. According to the method, the problems that a traditional control model is highly bound with specific equipment and tasks and is poor in mobility are solved, the model generalization ability and the historical parameter utilization rate are improved, and continuous learning and evolution of a control system are achieved.

title: Arm structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an arm structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, the arm structure comprises a first structural member, four first arm units are arranged on the first structural member, and two first arm units are symmetrically arranged on each side of the first structural member; each first arm unit comprises a plurality of structural parts which are sequentially connected, and motors are arranged between the first arm units and the first structural parts and between the structural parts in the first arm units respectively. According to the embodiment of the invention, the environment adaptability and the upper body operation potential of the humanoid robot as well as the unique strong operation parallelism, task robustness and coordination flexibility of the multi-arm system can be combined, so that on the premise that the overall complexity and the control energy consumption of the robot are not obviously increased, the reliability of the robot is improved. And meanwhile, the fundamental limitation of a traditional two-arm humanoid robot on the operation capability is overcome.

title: Humanoid robot inquiry method based on large language model
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot inquiry method based on a large language model. The humanoid robot inquiry method can be applied to the technical field of medical treatment and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: converting a complaint text into a medical term text by utilizing a semantic mapping model; a diagnosis input text determined according to the diagnosis prompt word and the medical term text is input into a first diagnosis agent and a second diagnosis agent, a first diagnosis result and a second diagnosis result are obtained, and the first diagnosis agent and the second diagnosis agent are large language models of different types; under the condition that the first diagnosis result is different from the second diagnosis result, updating the first diagnosis result based on the medical knowledge graph, the inquiry cue word and the second diagnosis result by utilizing the first diagnosis agent; and utilizing a second diagnosis agent to update the second diagnosis result based on the medical knowledge graph, the challenge prompt word and the first diagnosis result until the updated first diagnosis result is the same as the updated second diagnosis result, and obtaining a target diagnosis result.

title: Neck structure and robot thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a neck structure and a robot comprising the same. The neck connecting seat is rotationally connected with the first connecting shaft; and the head support comprises a second connecting shaft and a third connecting shaft. According to the robot, the neck stand column is connected with the trunk structure, the head support is connected with the head structure, the neck connecting base is rotationally connected with the neck stand column and the head support, the head support is driven by the two sets of oppositely-arranged first driving pieces, and therefore pitching motion and lateral head swinging motion of the head structure are achieved; and meanwhile, the second driving part is inversely mounted on the head support, so that the outer shell of the second driving part serves as a rotating part to directly drive the head structure to rotate horizontally, interference among all moving parts is effectively avoided, the volume ratio of the neck structure is remarkably reduced, and the design requirement for compactness of the neck structure of the humanoid robot is met.

title: Honeycomb-shaped lightweight industrial humanoid robot arm rod structure
abstract: The invention provides a honeycomb-shaped lightweight industrial humanoid robot arm rod structure, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The honeycomb-shaped lightweight industrial humanoid robot arm rod structure comprises an arm rod body, a hollow groove is formed in the arm rod body, and the hollow groove is of a structure with the wide upper portion and the narrow lower portion. According to the scheme, the upper honeycomb net column serves as an upper end high stress area, the design of small grids and thick side walls is adopted, the torsion resistance and bending resistance are enhanced, and large loads transmitted by joints can be stably borne, the middle honeycomb net column serves as a lightweight core area, the design of large grids and thin side walls is adopted, and extreme weight reduction is achieved on the premise that the overall rigidity is not affected; the lower honeycomb net column serves as a high-precision operation end, medium grids and the side wall thickness are adopted, the positioning precision and the structural stability are both considered, tail end shaking is avoided, and the problems that an existing solid aluminum alloy arm rod is heavy, and a hollow round pipe is prone to being twisted are thoroughly solved.

title: Household cleaning and article homing method based on humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a household cleaning and article homing method based on a humanoid robot and a storage medium, and belongs to the field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a family space three-dimensional model based on family space point cloud data; s2, fixed furniture and movable articles are distinguished according to the shape factors and the volume of the bounding box; s3, performing clustering analysis on the point cloud of the fixed furniture to obtain functional region division; s4, based on a preset article standard storage position database, identifying scattered articles in the movable articles; s5, acquiring an image of the functional area, calculating a gray value deviation, a local height difference and an edge gradient based on the image of the functional area, and identifying a pollution type based on the gray value deviation, the local height difference and the edge gradient; and S6, according to the pollution type, matching the cleaning mode and the cleaning parameters, carrying out object type identification on the scattered objects, and calling a preset homing database and a preset homing rule. The cleaning effect is improved, the pollution recognition precision is improved, and the article homing accuracy is improved.

title: Non-linear elastic beam structure and six-dimensional force sensor adopting same
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of force sensors, in particular to a nonlinear elastic beam structure and a six-dimensional force sensor adopting the same. In order to solve the problems that an existing force sensor sensitively measures force through bending deformation, a thin sheet type flexible hinge is arranged at the root to reduce tension and compression rigidity, but the overload capacity of the sensor is greatly reduced, and the force sensor is difficult to be applied to impact load scenes such as humanoid robots, the following technical scheme is provided: a first cross beam and a connecting beam are arranged in an L shape; the first cross beam and the connecting beam are of uniform-section structures and are integrally formed, the ends, away from each other, of the first cross beam and the connecting beam are a stress end and a connecting end respectively, and a fixed included angle is formed between the first cross beam and the connecting beam. While the bending force measurement sensitivity of the force sensor is ensured, the overload capacity of the force sensor is improved, the force sensor can adapt to impact load scenes such as humanoid robots, the application range is expanded, and the practicability is enhanced.

title: Robot crotch translation mechanism based on AGV driving
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a robot crotch translation mechanism based on AGV (Automatic Guided Vehicle) driving, which is characterized in that the top of a spine is provided with a head of a robot, the spine below the head is provided with a bracket for supporting arms of the robot, the middle of the spine is provided with a linear motor, and the linear motor is connected with a sliding table; the linear motor is connected with the ball bearing force bearing structure through the sliding table, the two ends of the ball bearing force bearing structure are connected with the leg root joint of the robot, and the bottom of the spine is connected with the AGV chassis, the sliding table controlled by the linear stepping motor is additionally arranged at the crotch of the robot to move horizontally, and then the deflection angle of the thigh root joint is controlled; left-right translation of the crotch is achieved, the robot can simulate actions such as human crotch twisting, and therefore the defect that in the prior art, human action simulation is insufficient is overcome.

title: Cutter clamping mechanism of humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment
abstract: The utility model provides a cutter clamping mechanism of humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, and belongs to the technical field of clamping mechanisms. The problem that an existing cutter is difficult to clamp while the installation precision is guaranteed is solved. According to the tool clamping mechanism of the humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, the joint lead screw nut machining equipment comprises a rack, the tool clamping mechanism comprises two sliding bases which are arranged in a transverse sliding mode along the rack, installation bases are fixed to the two sliding bases, a rotary disc is rotationally connected to one installation base, a chuck is arranged on the rotary disc, and the chuck is connected to the other installation base. The tool is cylindrical, one end of the tool is fixedly inserted into the chuck, the center abuts against the other end of the tool, and a driving part capable of driving the two sliding seats to move synchronously in the same direction and move oppositely is further arranged on the rack. According to the cutter clamping mechanism of the humanoid robot joint lead screw nut machining equipment, the moving precision of the cutter can be improved, and the machining precision is improved.

title: Robot teleoperation system
abstract: The utility model provides a robot teleoperation system which comprises the components of a humanoid robot which comprises a chassis part, a trunk part, a first mechanical arm and a tail end executing mechanism; the teleoperation equipment comprises a supporting piece, a second mechanical arm and a tail end handle, and the joint configuration of the second mechanical arm is the same as that of the first mechanical arm; the teleoperation equipment is in communication connection with the humanoid robot and used for receiving first operation on the second mechanical arm and second operation on the tail end handle and generating a first control instruction and a second control instruction according to the first operation and the second operation, the first control instruction is used for controlling the first mechanical arm to move, and the second control instruction is used for controlling the second mechanical arm to move; the second control instruction is used for controlling the tail end executing mechanism to move; and the humanoid robot is used for controlling the first mechanical arm to execute the same action as the second mechanical arm in response to the first control instruction, and controlling the tail end executing mechanism to execute opening/closing operation in response to the second control instruction.

title: Cycloidal speed reducer for humanoid robot joint
abstract: The invention relates to a cycloid speed reducer for a humanoid robot joint, and the cycloid speed reducer comprises a pin wheel housing which is provided with a plurality of gear pins at the inner side; an input shaft; the two cycloidal gears are eccentrically connected to the input shaft and can rotate around the axes of the cycloidal gears relative to the input shaft, the eccentric directions of the two cycloidal gears are opposite, and a plurality of cycloidal teeth are arranged on the outer side edges of the cycloidal gears; a plurality of pin shafts are arranged between the two output frames, the pin shafts penetrate through the pin holes in the cycloidal gear, the two ends of each pin shaft are connected with bolts respectively, the two output frames are located between the two bolts, and the pin shafts are limited by the two bolts to axially move relative to the two output frames; when the input shaft rotates, under the cooperation of the gear pins, the cycloidal gear is driven to revolve around the axis of the input shaft, the cycloidal gear is made to rotate around the axis of the cycloidal gear in the direction opposite to the revolution direction, and the cycloidal gear drives the output frame to rotate synchronously through the pin shaft when rotating. According to the speed reducer, relative movement between the pin shaft and the output frame is limited through the bolt, fretting wear can be avoided, and the service life is prolonged.

title: Table tennis hitting method, system and equipment of humanoid robot and computer program product
abstract: The invention discloses a table tennis hitting method, system and device of a humanoid robot and a computer program product, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining table tennis image data collected by a camera of a humanoid robot body, and carrying out table tennis detection and track prediction to obtain a track prediction result of the table tennis; determining target hitting point information according to the track prediction result of the table tennis; and in combination with the current whole-body joint state information of the robot, the trajectory prediction result, the target ball hitting point information and a pre-constructed ball hitting action data set, a whole-body cooperative control instruction of the robot is generated by utilizing a motion control model, so that the robot is controlled to complete the ball hitting action. Perception and trajectory prediction can be completed only by depending on the robot body camera, and the use flexibility is improved; the whole-body collaborative control model enables the robot to finish precise ball hitting while keeping a stable posture. The ability of the humanoid robot to complete diversified and highly anthropomorphic table tennis hitting tasks in an open environment is improved on the whole.

title: Nursing and rehabilitation integrated robot suitable for disabled/semi-disabled old people
abstract: The invention provides a nursing and rehabilitation integrated robot suitable for disabled/semi-disabled old people, and relates to the technical field of household nursing robots. The robot comprises a bottom moving unit and a humanoid robot body arranged on the bottom moving unit. The bottom moving unit adopts a four-foot wheel leg type lifting multiplexing structure; a wheel type structure is adopted during indoor movement, and a leg type structure is adopted during indoor bedside operation; the humanoid robot body comprises a robot head, a liftable main body and double mechanical arms; the liftable main body meets the requirements of monitoring and control actions at different heights; a binocular vision system and a voice interaction unit are arranged at the head of the robot, the binocular vision system continuously collects environment images and transmits the environment images to a main control system, and the main control unit combines data measured by an inertial measurement unit to achieve robot positioning and map building, identifies facial expressions and limb actions of a patient and judges the requirements and abnormal states of the patient. The voice interaction unit is used for achieving voice interaction between the robot and the patient.

title: Real-time evaluation method and device for coordination of trunk and limb ends of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a real-time evaluation method and device for coordination of a trunk and limb ends of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a lumbar vertebra forerake angle signal and a shoulder joint protraction angle signal, acquiring a lumbar vertebra forward inclination angle starting timestamp, a shoulder joint forward extension angle starting timestamp, a real-time pressure ratio of a front sole to a rear sole and an arm target extension distance set by the current exercise task; a Kalman filtering algorithm is adopted to process the lumbar vertebra forward inclination angle signal and the shoulder joint protraction angle signal, and after denoising, an accurate advance value between the smoothed lumbar vertebra forward inclination starting moment and the smoothed shoulder joint protraction starting moment is obtained; and according to the evaluation result of the anti-falling reflection triggering risk, analyzing the pressure ratio rise and the arm target extension distance when entering the urgent rise interval, and calculating the adjusted lead amount allowable upper limit.

title: Ionic conductive elastomer material for realizing ionic conductive stabilization through chemical anchoring and preparation method of ionic conductive elastomer material
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of flexible electronic materials, soft sensing and humanoid robot bionic skin, and particularly relates to an ionic conductive elastomer material for achieving ionic conductive stabilization through chemical anchoring and a preparation method of the ionic conductive elastomer material. The ionic conductive elastomer material comprises a cross-linked polymer network and a reaction type ionic conductive component, the reaction type ionic conductive component comprises an ionic conductive structure and carries a reaction type functional group, and the reaction type ionic conductive component and the cross-linked polymer network form covalent linkage in the curing process, so that ionic sites are anchored in a network topology; and electrical drift caused by ion migration and exudation is inhibited. The material can present repeatable complex impedance spectrum fingerprints under specified conditions, thereby facilitating establishment of auditable calibration and quality control criteria, and multiplexing of sensing and body phase heating temperature control can be realized in all-medium electronic skin.

title: Humanoid intelligent robot body framework profile bending forming equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a human-shaped intelligent robot body framework profile bending forming device, and relates to the technical field of human-shaped intelligent robot body framework machining, the human-shaped intelligent robot body framework profile bending forming device comprises a base, a bidirectional lead screw and a bending shaping clamp, a plurality of material supporting conveying rods are arranged on the outer side of the base at equal intervals, and an L-shaped supporting plate is arranged at the top end of the base; a servo air cylinder is fixedly installed on the outer side of the L-shaped supporting plate, the air inlet end of the servo air cylinder communicates with the air outlet end of a servo proportional valve, a clamping adjusting mechanism is arranged on the upper surface of the base, and a sliding groove is formed in the surface of the clamping adjusting mechanism through a material plate. The two sets of sliding blocks are connected to the two sides of the two-way lead screw in a threaded transmission mode and are in sliding fit with the sliding grooves, and the bending shaping clamps are fixed to the top ends of the sliding blocks and used for clamping and positioning profiles. According to the device, the clamping adjusting mechanism is arranged, the two sets of bending and shaping clamps are driven by the two-way lead screw to be synchronously opened and closed for adjustment, and the device can adapt to robot framework profiles of different specifications and sizes.

title: Robot head and waist linkage method, teleoperation system and server
abstract: The invention discloses a robot head and waist linkage method, a teleoperation system and a server, and the method comprises the steps: entering a waist control mode under the condition of detecting that an operator makes a predefined waist switching gesture, and responding to a waist control instruction under the condition of detecting that the head and the waist of the operator are relatively static, determining a mapping relation between the head of the operator and the waist of the robot based on the head pose matrix of the operator and a preset mapping coefficient, and controlling the waist of the robot based on the mapping relation; wherein the waist control instruction is generated based on the head action of the operator. The technical problem that linkage control over the waist of the robot is difficult to achieve through an existing humanoid robot teleoperation technology is solved.

title: Harmonic speed reduction joint module of silt-proof sealing type humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-sediment sealing type harmonic speed reduction joint module of a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robot joint transmission. The module comprises a driving part, a transmission part and a central tube, the transmission part and the driving part coaxially sleeve the central tube and are detachably connected, the driving part is fixed with the line tube, and the transmission part and the central tube are rotationally sealed; the transmission part comprises a connecting assembly, an adjusting assembly and an output assembly, the output assembly is rotationally arranged at one end of the connecting assembly, a sealing piece is arranged between the output assembly and the connecting assembly, and the inner end and the outer end of the adjusting assembly are connected with the output assembly and the output end of the driving part respectively. The radial size is compressed through coaxial sleeving layout, and the compact structure of the humanoid robot is adapted; the double-sealing layout is adopted to prevent silt impurities from invading, and the problem that a traditional joint is prone to abrasion and clamping stagnation is solved; the modular detachable design is convenient to assemble, operate and maintain, linkage transmission of the adjusting assemblies guarantees speed reduction precision, sealing protection, transmission efficiency and disassembly and assembly convenience are considered on the whole, and the device is suitable for being used under multiple scene severe working conditions.

title: Humanoid intelligent robot body framework punching and blanking machining equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid intelligent robot body framework punching and blanking machining device, and relates to the technical field of humanoid intelligent robot body framework punching, the humanoid intelligent robot body framework punching and blanking machining device comprises a machining pedestal and a punching and blanking component, and the left end and the right end of the top of the machining pedestal are each provided with a limiting component; and the punching and blanking component is mounted at the top of the driving and adjusting component. According to the punching and blanking machining equipment for the humanoid intelligent robot body framework, the machining pedestal, the limiting component, the driving adjusting component and the punching and blanking component are structurally arranged. The machining pedestal is of an integral cast iron structure and provides a stable supporting platform. An adjustable pneumatic clamp is adopted as the limiting component, machine body framework blanks of different sizes can be rapidly positioned and clamped, and displacement in the machining process is prevented; and the driving adjusting component is matched with the punching and blanking component for precise displacement and angle adjustment in the X-axis direction, the Y-axis direction and the Z-axis direction so as to meet the machining requirements of different parts of the framework.

title: Humanoid robot for template machine operation and operation method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot for template machine operation and an operation method, and the robot comprises a robot base which is used for being arranged among a template machine, a piece cutting table and a finished product table; the robot trunk is rotatably arranged on the robot base; the mechanical arm is arranged on the robot trunk and used for grabbing the cut-parts on the cut-part table and transporting the cut-parts to the template machine and the finished product table; the control system is electrically connected with the robot body and the mechanical arms and used for controlling the moving tracks of the robot body and the mechanical arms. And the information collection assembly is arranged on the robot trunk and the mechanical arms, the information collection assembly is electrically connected with the control system, and the information collection assembly is used for collecting three-dimensional point cloud information of the cut-parts and transmitting the information to the control system. According to the humanoid robot for template machine operation and the operation method, manual work can be replaced, the cut-parts can be moved to the template machine, the cut-parts can be moved to the finished product table after sewing of the template machine is completed, and the production efficiency is improved.

title: Anchoring representation and skill transition-based humanoid robot control method and system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot motion control and intelligent learning, and provides a humanoid robot control method and system based on anchoring representation and skill transition. The coverage capability and robustness of skill learning on actions with different stability degrees are improved; through local coordinate representation with the pelvis as an anchor, yaw decoupling and plane registration, the strategy can still keep relative motion consistency when random disturbance and domain randomization exist, and the influence of global drift on tracking and switching is reduced; an activation code or a transition state motor angle sequence is output through a high-level skill transition strategy network, discontinuity and abrupt change caused by hard switching are avoided, and continuous, smooth and stable transition of multiple skills is achieved.

title: Large-load series-parallel humanoid robot for industrial scene and control method
abstract: The invention discloses a large-load series-parallel humanoid robot for an industrial scene and a control method. The robot comprises a parallel moving chassis, a single-degree-of-freedom rotation waist joint, a humanoid upper limb trunk, two eight-degree-of-freedom series-parallel humanoid rigid mechanical arms, a three-degree-of-freedom neck joint and a humanoid head. The control method comprises the following steps: planning a moving path of the parallel moving chassis based on environment three-dimensional information acquired by the head main vision module; after the robot arrives at an operation area, motion quantities of three groups of motion branch chains of the parallel mobile chassis are obtained through a kinematics inverse solution module of a chassis parallel mechanism motion control unit; the humanoid upper limb trunk is adjusted to an expected posture; based on local high-precision three-dimensional information provided by the wrist auxiliary vision module, the main control calculation unit and the arm level control unit execute output. According to the invention, heavy-load operation, accurate operation and dynamic stability in a complex industrial environment are realized.

title: Humanoid robot motion test method and system
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot motion test method and system. The humanoid robot motion test method comprises the steps of obtaining a preset gradient test parameter and a preset speed test parameter which change along with time and have a unified control period; the brake assembly is controlled to release the sliding limiting mechanism, so that the sliding limiting mechanism has a sliding freedom degree; based on the same control period, the following steps are synchronously executed: a to-be-tested humanoid robot synchronously obtains a preset speed test parameter and moves on a treadmill mechanism; respectively controlling a lifting servo assembly and a treadmill mechanism according to preset gradient and speed test parameters; the sliding limiting mechanism slides passively to compensate displacement deviation; synchronously acquiring state data of the to-be-tested humanoid robot to complete a motion test; slope adjustment, treadmill speed adjustment and synchronous control of motion instruction issuing of the to-be-tested robot are achieved based on a unified control period, continuous dynamic linkage adjustment of the gradient and the speed is achieved, complex dynamic working conditions are covered, and the coverage range of the test working conditions and the authenticity of test data are improved.

title: Humanoid robot balance control method and system based on neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot balance control method and system based on a neural network, particularly relates to the technical field of robot program control, and is used for solving the problem that contradictory characterization and joint torque instruction high-frequency oscillation are generated in a controller due to lack of degeneration response when a visual sensor degenerates. Visual images and inertial data are obtained and input into a visual branch circuit and an inertial branch circuit respectively, whether the visual images are in a degradation state or not is judged based on statistical characteristics of output feature vectors of the tail layer of the visual branch circuit, and the self-oscillation state is identified when degradation is judged. When self-excited oscillation is not recognized, fundamental frequency component energy and overtone component energy are extracted from inertial data, a matching value is calculated, a disturbance area is divided into external instantaneous impact disturbance or continuous swing disturbance, and a visual branch output connection weight is immediately reset for the external instantaneous impact disturbance; the output connection weight of the visual branch is gradually reduced to zero for continuous swing disturbance, and the self-induced instability phenomenon of the controller is inhibited at the perception degradation boundary.

title: Humanoid robot assisted intelligent teaching method and system
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent teaching method and system assisted by a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining teaching data and student state data through the humanoid robot; constructing a target knowledge graph according to the teaching data; constructing a learning knowledge graph according to the student state data; based on the target knowledge graph and the learning knowledge graph, judging whether the learning state of the student meets a teaching target condition or not; if yes, the teaching data and the student state data are obtained again through the humanoid robot; otherwise, according to the target knowledge graph and the learning knowledge graph, matching teaching requirements with a teaching resource library to generate a teaching content set; generating a teaching strategy according to the teaching content set; generating a robot teaching execution path according to the teaching strategy; and executing the robot teaching execution path.

title: Attitude motion control method and system of humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, solves the problem that an existing humanoid robot still depends on key or visual control in posture motion control and is complex in operation, and provides a posture motion control method and system of a humanoid robot and a storage medium. The method is suitable for the fighting robot and comprises the steps that posture data and rocker operation data of all parts of an operator are obtained; carrying out filtering processing, coordinate conversion and attitude calculation on the data, and generating control freedom degree data corresponding to each part and a machine body movement control command; carrying out data fusion and generating an attitude control instruction according to the target action reference and/or the operation intention; and the instruction is sent to the main controller to control the robot to move, and the posture is dynamically adjusted according to feedback data fed back in real time. Through closed-loop control of multi-source data acquisition, data fusion and instruction generation, operation is simple, high-precision control of the robot in complex actions such as walking, running, jumping and fighting is achieved, and operation stability and interaction experience are improved.

And separation of signal acquisition and positioning analysis functions is realized, the problems of data processing delay and insufficient positioning precision are solved, and the fluency and accuracy of man-machine interaction are further improved.

title: Humanoid robot action reproduction method based on digital twinning and point cloud matching
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot action reproduction method based on digital twinning and point cloud matching, and belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining and preprocessing human body action posture point cloud data: collecting and purifying human body action point cloud, and providing a high-quality and structured data basis for subsequent key point extraction; s2, human body key point extraction: regressing human body motion key point coordinates from the point cloud, and establishing digital expression of human body postures. According to the humanoid robot action reproduction method based on digital twinning and point cloud matching, firstly, human body action point cloud is collected through a laser radar, and three-dimensional key points are extracted through preprocessing and PointNet + +; registering the key points to a robot space by using a scale icp algorithm and correcting physical constraints; then motor parameters are reasoned through an off-line trained attitude agent model, finally, space errors and inter-frame parameter changes are minimized through dual-objective optimization, and accurate and smooth reproduction of human body actions by the humanoid robot is achieved in a digital twin platform.
