title: Anthropomorphic finger
abstract: The utility model discloses an anthropomorphic finger. The anthropomorphic finger comprises a plurality of finger knuckles and finger joints. Each finger knuckle comprises a knuckle body, one of the two adjacent finger knuckles further comprises a rotary connecting end connected to one end of the knuckle body, the other one of the two adjacent finger knuckles further comprises a fixed connecting end connected to one end of the knuckle body, and a first containing cavity is formed in the rotary connecting end. The fixed connecting ends are movably connected into the first containing cavities in the adjacent finger knuckles, and second containing cavities are formed in the fixed connecting ends; the finger joints are arranged in the second containing cavities, each finger joint comprises a driving motor and a speed reducer, the speed reducers are connected with the output ends of the driving motors, and the output ends of the speed reducers serve as the output ends of the finger joints to be connected with the rotating connecting ends; the output ends of the finger joints are used for outputting rotation driving force so as to drive the two adjacent finger knuckles to rotate relatively. According to the technical scheme, the size of the anthropomorphic finger is small, the size requirement of the human finger is met, and the dexterous hand can have higher flexibility.

title: Large-inner-hole high-density joint motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The large-bore high-density joint motor for the humanoid robot comprises a stator and a rotor, and the rotor comprises a hollow shaft and magnetic steel surface-mounted on the outer wall of the hollow shaft; the stator comprises a stator core outside the magnetic steel, insulating end plates are arranged at the two ends of the stator core, windings are arranged at the outer ends of the insulating end plates, a leading-out wire is arranged at the outer end of one winding, a thermal resistor is arranged on the winding, and a temperature sensor of the thermal resistor is embedded in the winding; according to the utility model, the thermal resistor is arranged on the winding, so that the temperature can be monitored at any time, the load of the motor can be adjusted according to the monitored temperature, the influence on normal operation caused by over-high temperature rise of the motor is prevented, the inner cavity of the hollow shaft is designed into a large inner hole structure, the pole slots of the stator and the rotor are matched to adopt 18 slots and 20 poles, the diameter of the rotor is increased, and the crack ratio is increased; the magnetic conduction thickness of the hollow shaft can be reduced by selecting multiple poles, and the purpose of reducing the weight of the hollow shaft is achieved.

title: Text and track combined constraint humanoid robot motion control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot motion control method based on text and trajectory joint constraint, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot control, the method comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining text description and motion trajectory corresponding to a preset control action, and generating an SMPL digital human pose sequence conforming to double constraints through motion synthesis based on text and trajectory joint constraint; completing motion redirection by adopting an optimization strategy combining a stochastic gradient descent method and a momentum method to obtain pose data of the adaptive target humanoid robot; constructing a teacher-student model based on a near-end strategy optimization algorithm, taking redirection pose data as prior guidance, completing strategy distillation through a data aggregation algorithm, and training to obtain a motion control model; and finally, deploying the model to a robot, and realizing motion control by taking a joint target angle output by the model as a driving signal. According to the method, high-quality prior guidance is provided through double constraints, the semantic consistency, track precision, anthropomorphic degree and scene robustness of motion of the humanoid robot are effectively improved, the training cost is greatly reduced, and the method has excellent engineering landing value.

title: Hip structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a hip structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, the hip structure comprises two hip pitching joints and a hip structure, and a pair of hoop structures is constructed on a shell of each hip pitching joint; the hip structure comprises a first hip component and a second hip component which are oppositely arranged and form a housing after being folded, the first hip component and the second hip component are encircled to be capable of oppositely clamping and wrapping the two hip pitching joints, and hoop structures matched with the hoop structures in an aligned mode are constructed on the first hip component and the second hip component correspondingly; a joint abutment structure is also configured on the first hip member. The two hip pitching joints are arranged on the first hip components and abut against the joint abutting structures, and after the first hip components and the second hip components are encircled, the two hip pitching joints and the hip structures are limited and fixedly connected. The structure is favorable for considering high structural strength, connection rigidity and assembly and maintenance convenience.

title: Humanoid robot-oriented multi-mode voice interaction method and system
abstract: The invention provides a multi-mode voice interaction method and system for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of voice interaction, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a user voice stream, a user face image sequence and a user gesture image sequence in a target voice interaction scene; respectively extracting facial expression features and gesture motion features from the user facial image sequence and the user gesture image sequence, and determining an intention correction factor of a user non-language mode to voice semantics; performing semantic adjustment on a dialogue reply text generated by the user voice stream by using the intention correction factor, generating an adjusted dialogue reply text, and further generating a reply voice; and according to the voice pause interval determined in the user voice stream, identifying a micro-action triggering time sequence in a voice playing reply period, and carrying out interaction feedback based on the micro-action triggering time sequence. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, cognitive correction of the non-language mode to the language mode can be realized in multi-mode voice interaction of the humanoid robot.

title: Robot head and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a robot head and a robot, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The robot head comprises a head body and a turnover structure driven by a motor, the head body is provided with a mask, and the turnover structure comprises a driven rotating shaft, a rotating disc, a pull rod and a turnover plate; the driven rotating shaft is provided with first and second limiting columns; the turntable is provided with a first limiting groove, a second limiting groove and an extension part; the extension part is provided with a pull rod sliding groove; the pull rod is provided with first and second positioning grooves; the turnover plate is provided with a fixing rod and is connected with the mask; an output shaft of the motor is connected with the driven rotating shaft, the rotating disc is rotatably arranged on the driven rotating shaft in a sleeving mode, the first limiting column is limited in the first limiting groove, the second limiting column is limited in the second limiting groove and fixed in the first positioning groove, and the fixing rod penetrates through the pull rod sliding groove and is fixed in the second positioning groove. title: Humanoid robot rope-driven upper limb system with intensively arranged drivers
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot rope-driven upper limb system with centralized drive arrangement, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The system comprises an upper limb trunk, three-degree-of-freedom parallel posture adjusting rope-driven humanoid shoulder joints, large arms, tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joints, small arms, autorotation decoupling differential rope-driven humanoid wrist joints and humanoid simplified palms, the upper limb trunk is of a double-Y-shaped structure, and an intersection space is formed in the upper limb trunk and used for concentrated arrangement of joint driving modules; the three-degree-of-freedom parallel posture-adjusting rope-driven humanoid shoulder joint is of a three-degree-of-freedom parallel structure, and rope-driven transmission is achieved through a steel wire rope. The tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joint is of a rolling joint structure, and tension amplification and constant-torque output are achieved through a movable pulley block. Three-degree-of-freedom decoupling motion is achieved through the autorotation decoupling differential rope-driven humanoid wrist joint. Electromechanical separation is achieved through rope-driven transmission, the driving modules are arranged on the trunk in a centralized mode, and the mass and inertia of the arms are remarkably reduced.

title: Large-size modular design humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a large-size modular design humanoid robot which comprises a trunk unit, arm assemblies and leg assemblies. Shoulder connecting structures are arranged on the two sides of the upper portion of the trunk unit, a first clamping cavity is formed through a first shoulder component and a second shoulder component which can be fixed in a butt joint mode, arm root joints are clamped and fixed, and butt joint of corresponding electrical interfaces is completed; a hip structural part is arranged on the lower portion of the trunk unit, an independent thigh assembling cavity with a leg connecting window and a butt joint base is formed in the hip structural part, a thigh root joint is inserted into the assembling cavity in the rotating axis direction, the butt joint part and the butt joint base are assembled in an attached mode and locked through a fastener, and butt joint of corresponding electrical interfaces is completed synchronously. According to the scheme, upper and lower limb differentiated quick disassembly design is adopted, upper limb assembly convenience and lower limb bearing reliability are both considered, four-limb modularized quick disassembly and assembly are achieved, and the whole machine assembly efficiency and maintenance convenience are improved.

title: Humanoid robot rope-driven lower limb system with intensively arranged drives
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot rope-driven lower limb system with centralized drive arrangement, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The system comprises a pelvis-imitating structure, hip joints, thighs, knee joints, shanks, ankle joints and soles, joint modules are arranged on the upper portion of a pelvis-imitating base in a centralized mode, driving force is transmitted to the knee joints and the ankle joints through Bowden wire tubes and steel wire ropes, and the hip joints are in three-degree-of-freedom serial connection structures to achieve three-direction posture rotation; the knee joint is a tension-amplified constant-rigidity rope-driven joint, and six-time tension amplification and thirty-six-time rigidity coefficient amplification are realized through a rolling joint configuration and a movable pulley block; the ankle joint is a two-degree-of-freedom rope-driven differential mechanism, and dorsiflexion, plantar flexion and introversion and extroversion movement is achieved through differential drive of a steel wire rope. Electromechanical separation and gravity center upward movement of a lower limb system are achieved, the mass and inertia of a swing section are reduced, and the constant-torque constant-rigidity output and flexible safe interaction characteristics are achieved.

title: Tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joint
abstract: The invention discloses a tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joint, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The elbow joint comprises an elbow joint fixed end and an elbow joint movable end, the fixed end is provided with an upper meshing plate with a quarter arc, the movable end is provided with a lower meshing plate with a quarter arc, the fixed end and the movable end rotate unilaterally through a coupling rope, and a rope driving assembly with amplified tension and constant torque is arranged between the two. Tension amplification is realized in a limited radial space through a movable pulley block mechanism in which a stepped double-layer pulley at a movable end is matched with a multi-stage pulley at a fixed end; the double-layer pulley differential rope winding arrangement enables the rope length change and the joint angle to be in a linear relation, and constant torque output and accurate control are achieved in cooperation with an absolute value encoder. The rope driving structure isolates motor impact, and rolling meshing movement restrained by the coupling rope guarantees man-machine interaction safety. The mechanism is compact in structure, high in flexibility and suitable for the upper limb elbow joint of the humanoid robot.

title: Mechanical thumb, manipulator and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a mechanical thumb, a manipulator and a robot. The mechanical thumb comprises a finger root, a first knuckle and a second knuckle, and the first knuckle is connected between the finger root and the second knuckle. A first support is rotationally arranged on the finger root around a first axis, the first knuckle comprises a first connecting rod and a second connecting rod, the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are hinged between the first support and the second knuckle, and the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod are arranged in a crossed mode. The finger root is further provided with a first driving assembly, the first output end of the first driving assembly comprises a thrust block rotating around the second axis, and the thrust block abuts against at least one of the first connecting rod and the second connecting rod through a convex curved surface. The linkage mechanism is arranged, linkage of the first knuckles and the second knuckles is achieved, the movement flexibility of the mechanical thumb can be guaranteed, meanwhile, the number of distributed drivers is reduced, and therefore the structure is simplified, and the size of the mechanical arm is reduced.

title: Crosslinked polyethylene flexible control cable for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of cables, discloses a cross-linked polyethylene flexible control cable for a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the problem of early breakdown caused by the fact that dynamic strain induces electric tree growth in the bending and twisting movement of an existing cable, the cable comprises a conductor, an inner interface layer, an outer interface layer and an insulating layer, an inner interface layer is an EVA semi-conductive layer containing a bi-component microcapsule, after the microcapsule is broken, a core material is subjected to a Diels-Alder reaction to self-repair interface microcracks, an outer interface layer and an insulating layer are made of the same material but lower in irradiation dose, and a permanent C-C cross-linked skeleton and Diels-Alder dynamic covalent cross-linked network dual-network structure is constructed in the insulating layer. And furan and maleimide hanging groups exposed after Diels-Alder bonds are broken serve as deep electron traps to capture high-energy electrons, so that the bending-torsional fatigue life of the cable is prolonged, the self-repairing efficiency of the cable is improved, the partial discharge initial voltage of the cable is increased, and the cable is suitable for high-dynamic scenes such as humanoid robot joints.

title: Whole-body control method for wheeled body-equipped intelligent body and terminal equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a whole-body control method for a wheeled body-equipped agent and terminal equipment, belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and can solve the problem that the reliability of the body-equipped agent in a precise control task is limited due to the fact that an existing method cannot realize continuous attitude optimization and real-time closed-loop control of the body-equipped agent. The method comprises the following steps: S1, receiving target trajectory data of a body agent, and analyzing target poses of all parts of the body agent from the target trajectory data; s2, receiving a mode switching instruction, and determining a current control mode value of the intelligent body according to the mode switching instruction; s3, according to the current control mode value, determining a current activation constraint of the body-equipped agent; and S4, according to the current state data and the corresponding target pose of the independent control part in the activated state in the body agent, and the current activation constraint, determining a current control strategy of the body agent. The method is used for controlling the humanoid robot.

title: AI humanoid robot motion regulation and control method and system based on digital twinning
abstract: The invention discloses an AI humanoid robot motion regulation and control method and system based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot intelligent control and man-machine interaction. Multi-modal information and environment information of an interaction object are collected through a multi-modal sensing module deployed on a physical humanoid robot, a user emotional state of the interaction object is generated through an emotional calculation and mapping module, and an ethical constraint parameter set is generated through an ethical constraint formalized expression module; and further generating a robot target emotional state and a whole body joint movement track which conform to ethical constraints, and finally executing the corresponding track by the physical humanoid robot. The technical problems that in the prior art, emotion expression and ethical constraint are prone to conflict, man-machine interaction fluency is poor, and ethical constraint is not fused into a motion planning bottom layer are solved, and the method can be widely applied to various social scenes of man-machine high-frequency interaction.

title: Self-adaptive height bionic humanoid robot based on modular split type design
abstract: The invention provides a height-adaptive bionic humanoid robot based on a modular split type design. According to the self-adaptive height bionic humanoid robot based on the modular split type design, when the robot moves and is assembled, low-noise, high-precision and long-service-life operation can be achieved through driving of a servo motor, height adjustment is conducted through a supporting frame, a split type shell and modular arm structure is adopted, and the height of the robot is adjusted. Therefore, the problems that an existing bionic humanoid robot is large in movement noise, short in service life, low in precision and low in whole-body modularization degree, a shell cannot be replaced independently, and the height of an internal frame cannot be adjusted are solved.

title: Lumbosacral hip joint structure of humanoid robot
abstract: A lumbosacral hip joint structure of a humanoid robot comprises a transverse installation cylinder seat, a left hip rotation driving device and a right hip rotation driving device, inner installation supporting assemblies are arranged at the two ends of the transverse installation cylinder seat, and the left hip rotation driving device and the right hip rotation driving device are installed on the inner sides of the inner installation supporting assemblies. The output end of the left hip rotation driving device and the output end of the right hip rotation driving device are connected with a left hip joint difference module and a right hip joint difference module, and the left hip joint difference module is composed of a left hip joint shell assembly, a left hip joint dual-drive assembly, a left hip joint difference bevel gear set transmission suite and an output shaft. The side portion of the left hip joint shell assembly is connected to the output end of the left hip rotation driving device, the left hip joint dual-driving assembly is in transmission connection with the left hip joint differential bevel gear set transmission suite, and the output shaft is connected with the center of an output tooth of the left hip joint differential bevel gear set transmission suite. The robot has higher peak torque and motion explosive power, the joint load capacity is high, and the use and maintenance cost is low.

title: Multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot cooperative motion planning method and system in dynamic environment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent control of humanoid robots, in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot cooperative motion planning method and system in a dynamic environment. According to the method, environment information, robot body parameters and task semantic instructions are obtained, a general kinematics model is constructed, semantic analysis and global path planning are achieved in combination with a visual language action model and a world model, and an initial space-time trajectory is generated; conflict detection and priority re-planning are carried out on the basis, and a conflict-free collaborative trajectory is obtained; and a full-joint movement track is further obtained through optimization solution and converted into a joint control instruction to be executed, meanwhile, local re-planning is triggered in combination with real-time environment information, dynamic track correction is achieved, and the safety and adaptability of multi-robot cooperative movement are improved. According to the invention, efficient, safe and robust cooperative motion control of the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot in a complex dynamic environment is realized.

title: Garment wrinkle detection and posture fine adjustment method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of visual inspection, and discloses a humanoid robot garment wrinkle detection and posture fine adjustment method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-view display image of clothing worn by the humanoid robot and tension data of each body area; extracting visual wrinkle features and tension distribution features of each body area, and performing alignment fusion on the visual wrinkle features and the tension distribution features to obtain wrinkle state vectors of each body area; classifying the body areas into normal overhanging wrinkles, slight accumulation wrinkles, obvious pulling wrinkles and serious skew wrinkles, and determining areas to be adjusted; and calculating the fine adjustment amount of the joint posture of the to-be-adjusted area, executing adjustment, and outputting a shooting ready signal until all the body areas have normal overhanging wrinkles or slight accumulation wrinkles. According to the invention, the technical problem that a single-mode sensing scheme cannot obtain the wrinkle form information and the clothes stress information at the same time is solved, and the dependence on manual repeated intervention in the clothes display preparation process is eliminated.

title: Large-size modular design humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a large-size modular design humanoid robot which comprises a trunk unit, a pair of arm assemblies and a pair of leg assemblies. And the arm root joints and the leg root joints are respectively clamped and fixed in the corresponding clamping cavities and are respectively butted with the corresponding electrical interfaces, so that the detachable connection between the four-limb modules and the trunk unit is realized. According to the scheme, the four-limb assembly efficiency, the connection reliability and the maintenance convenience are improved.

title: Robot obstacle avoidance planning method, humanoid robot, equipment, medium and product
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a robot obstacle avoidance planning method, a humanoid robot, equipment, a medium and a product, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining environment state information; according to the environment state information, the current configuration information and the target state information, processing based on an end-to-end double-arm obstacle avoidance planning model to obtain candidate action planning information; performing first collision detection processing according to the environment state information and the candidate action planning information; when it is determined that the collision risk exists, new candidate action planning information is obtained; and when it is determined that the collision risk does not exist, taking the candidate action planning information as action planning execution information. The end-to-end double-arm obstacle avoidance planning model realizes an end-to-end output mode based on the mapping relationship, can quickly obtain candidate action planning information, adapts to a dynamic scene of environmental obstacle change, enhances the real-time performance of robot obstacle avoidance planning, verifies whether a collision risk exists through first collision detection processing, and improves the safety of robot movement.

title: Large-size modular design humanoid robot

title: Ankle joint assembly of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an ankle joint assembly of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, relates to the field of robot mechanical arms, and solves the problems that when an ankle joint assembly of an existing humanoid robot is used, motor arrangement is limited, the ankle joint adjusting flexibility is affected, and meanwhile the foot vibration reduction effect is not ideal enough. Comprising a shank rod, a foot plate, a connecting frame, a joint mechanism and a buffering mechanism, and the buffering mechanism comprises a toe plate, a heel plate and a connecting piece. When the robot walks, the rotating states of the toe board and the heel board are controlled through the buffering mechanism, force storage buffering is achieved, vibration in the walking process is reduced, damage to a joint mechanism is relieved, preliminary vibration reduction is achieved through preferential rotation force storage of the heel board, the gravity center is gradually moved forwards to the foot board and the toe board in the walking process, force storage of the heel board is relieved, and vibration reduction is achieved through force storage of the toe board. The walking posture of a person is simulated, so that the gait is more natural, and the walking stability is improved.

title: Single-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot joint assembly based on differential rope drive
abstract: The invention discloses a single-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot joint assembly based on differential rope drive, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robots. The invention discloses a single-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot joint assembly based on differential rope drive. The single-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot joint assembly comprises an inverted-U-shaped support, a driving device, a pulley assembly, a self-adaptive tensioning device, a rope and a movable platform. The driving device is connected to the inverted U-shaped bracket; the pulley assembly is arranged in the inverted U-shaped bracket; the rope is wound on the pulley assembly, is also wound with the driving end of the driving device and is arranged on the two sides of the driving end; the movable platform is arranged at the groove bottom of the inverted-U-shaped support. A movable pulley support in the pulley assembly is fixedly connected with the movable platform. The self-adaptive tensioning device is connected into the inverted-U-shaped support and provides tensioning force for the movable platform. Through the innovative pulley differential mechanism and compact rope arrangement design, the rotational inertia and the axial size of the joint are remarkably reduced while high rigidity and force control bandwidth are ensured.

title: All-posture regulation and control method and all-posture regulation and control device for liquid metal magneto-rheological driven humanoid robot
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides an all-attitude control method and an all-attitude control device for a liquid metal magneto-rheological driven humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: collecting an attitude data flow of the humanoid robot in a motion process in real time at a preset frequency, and carrying out the real-time calculation through inverse kinematics to generate an expected joint track in a future time period; judging a current motion scene, determining a total expected support resultant force and a total expected support resultant force moment, and solving to obtain a target support force of each flexible micro-support capsule body by taking the support forces of all the flexible micro-support capsule bodies as optimization variables; inputting the data into an improved BP neural network, outputting a feedforward target magnetic field intensity corresponding to each flexible micro-support capsule, calculating to obtain a feedback magnetic field correction amount, and generating a final target magnetic field intensity; and generating a magnetic field with corresponding intensity based on the final target magnetic field intensity to adjust the actual supporting force generated by the flexible micro-supporting capsule body. The invention provides a high-maneuverability and high-precision motion posture stable control method for the humanoid robot.

title: High-simulation humanoid robot based on wheel-foot hybrid drive
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a high-simulation humanoid robot based on wheel-foot hybrid drive, which comprises a trunk module, a wheel-foot module and a control module, the wheel-foot module comprises a foot-imitating subunit for walking and a sliding wheel which is movably nested on the foot-imitating subunit through a transmission subunit so as to execute sliding; the control module overall plans mode switching and balancing; independent lifting of the sliding wheels is achieved through the transmission mechanism, wheel-foot kinematics interference is thoroughly decoupled at the physical bottom layer, and efficient seamless switching of double modes is guaranteed; besides, the wheel foot torque is finely adjusted by means of a coupling algorithm at the bottom layer, and when facing an overturning critical point, upper limb supporting, sliding wheel reverse rotation and internal balancing weight forward movement can be instantly linked to compulsively complete physical gravity center reconstruction, so that the falling rate of the robot is greatly reduced from the mechanical source; and the unprecedented all-terrain dynamic anti-rollover capability and the safety redundancy of actual combat operation of the whole machine are practically endowed.

title: Radiation-sweating-liquid cooling collaborative cooling system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a radiation-sweating-liquid cooling collaborative cooling system for a humanoid robot, and belongs to the technical field of robot thermal management, the radiation-sweating-liquid cooling collaborative cooling system comprises a liquid storage tank, a circulating pump, a plurality of heat source branches and a radiator which are connected in sequence and form a closed loop, and each heat source branch is provided with a heat source, a regulating valve and a sensor assembly; the radiator comprises bionic skin covering the surface of the robot, the bionic skin comprises a bionic micro-channel network layer located on the inner layer and a radiation sweating skin layer located on the outer layer, the radiation sweating skin layer is made of a flexible porous material with spectral selectivity, and after a cooling medium in the liquid storage tank flows through all heat sources to absorb heat, the radiation sweating skin layer is located on the outer layer. The heat flows into the bionic micro-channel network layer, and the heat dissipation of the environment is realized through the radiation sweating skin layer. According to the scheme, the heat dissipation efficiency of the humanoid robot under the high-load working condition is improved, a passive heat dissipation mechanism is utilized, the heat dissipation energy consumption of the system is reduced, the dependence on the environment temperature is reduced, and daytime sub-environment cooling is achieved.

title: Humanoid robot terrain processing and multi-terrain gait control method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robot adaptive control, and provides a humanoid robot terrain processing and multi-terrain gait control method, which comprises the following steps: planning an inspection route, and segmenting walking segments according to spatial positions and functional areas; acquiring multi-source data by using a multi-source environment sensing unit, performing fusion processing on each walking segment, and extracting topographic features; according to a preset discrimination rule, mapping the topographic features of each walking segment into a topographic label with a pavement type identifier and a safety risk level, and converting the safety risk level into a gait level; according to the gait level, a target gait mode is automatically selected, and gait control parameters matched with the gait mode are issued to each joint controller; the foot sole contact state and the posture change are monitored in real time and compared with the terrain label and the gait level of the corresponding walking segment, the corresponding walking segment and the subsequent gait level of the corresponding walking segment are dynamically adjusted, and gait control parameters are updated.

title: Humanoid robot motion simulation data generation method and device, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and provides a humanoid robot motion simulation data generation method and device, equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: determining a target motion semantic tag from a motion semantic tag set; inputting the target motion semantic tag into a time sequence diffusion generation model to obtain a target motion sequence corresponding to the target motion semantic tag; the time sequence diffusion generation model is used for modeling a human body motion generation process into a Markov noise adding and denoising process; the time sequence diffusion generation model is obtained by constructing and training a diffusion generation model and a time sequence network model; wherein the diffusion generation model is used for learning distribution characteristics of human body motion data so as to generate motion data of different time steps; the time sequence network model is used for extracting motion semantic features in the motion data and time sequence features between adjacent motion frames. According to the invention, a segment of continuous and stable human motion data can be quickly generated, and the cost of acquiring the human motion data is reduced.

title: Forearm deflection joint output connecting structure and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a forearm deflection joint output connecting structure and a humanoid robot. The structure comprises a first shell, a second shell, a forearm deflection joint, a bearing seat, a bearing and an output connecting piece. The small arm deflection joint is fixed in the first shell. The bearing seat is fixedly connected with the first shell and is provided with a bearing position and an axial through wiring hole. The output connecting piece is fixedly connected with the second shell and connected with an output flange of the forearm deflection joint, and the output connecting piece is provided with a bearing abutting part and an axially-through arc-shaped through hole. An inner ring of the bearing is arranged on the bearing abutting part in a sleeving mode, and an outer ring of the bearing is installed in the bearing position so that the second shell can be rotationally supported relative to the first shell. And the connecting wire harness sequentially passes through the wiring hole and the via hole to enter the second shell. Functional integration of stable rotating supporting and internal wiring is achieved in a compact radial space, potential safety hazards of external wiring are avoided, and the joint speed reducer is protected against unbalance loading.

title: Mechanical thumb, manipulator and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, in particular to a mechanical thumb, a manipulator and a robot. The mechanical thumb comprises a thumb body and a carpometacarpal joint mechanism, and the carpometacarpal joint mechanism comprises a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly, a third driving assembly, a first support and a second support. The first driving assembly and the second driving assembly are fixedly arranged relative to the palm part, the first support is rotationally connected to the first driving assembly around a first axis, the second support is rotationally connected to the first support around a second axis, and the thumb body is rotationally connected to the second support around a third axis. The third driving assembly comprises a third motor, and the third motor is fixedly arranged on the thumb body. By means of the design, the thumb body can rotate around the first axis, the second axis and the third axis, and therefore free rotation similar to the wrist-metacarpal joint of the thumb of the human hand is achieved. And meanwhile, the third motor does not need to occupy the space of the palm part, so that the size of the manipulator is obviously reduced.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a humanoid robot, which comprises a movable base, a movable base, a driving mechanism and a driving mechanism, wherein a U-shaped wedge structure is formed on the movable base; the shank is rotationally connected with the movable base in the front-back direction; the thigh is rotationally connected with the shank in the front-back direction; the upper body structure is movably connected with the thighs; the shanks can rotate to the middle position of the U-shaped wedge structure, and the thighs can rotate to the two sides of the U-shaped wedge structure, so that the humanoid robot is in a knee bending posture. When the shanks rotate to the middle positions of the U-shaped wedge structures, the thighs rotate to the two sides of the U-shaped wedge structures, the humanoid robot is in a knee bending posture, the U-shaped wedge structures can support the thighs, and the upper body structure keeps stable and is not prone to inclining or shaking.

title: Humanoid robot driven by 16 steering engines
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a humanoid robot driven by 16 steering engines, which comprises a head mechanism, an upper limb mechanism, a chest mechanism and a leg mechanism, the head mechanism is arranged on the upper side of the chest mechanism and comprises a voice recognition module, an ultrasonic ranging sensor and a gesture recognition sensor; the upper limb mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the left side and the right side of the chest mechanism. Each upper limb mechanism sequentially comprises a shoulder joint assembly, a mechanical arm outer connecting baffle, an elbow joint assembly and a palm. title: Biped robot control system
abstract: The utility model discloses a biped robot control system. The biped robot control system comprises a power battery, a power switch, a power module, an industrial personal computer, a motion control mainboard and a joint module. And the power switch is electrically connected with the power battery. The power supply module is connected with the power battery, and on-off control is carried out through the power supply switch. The industrial personal computer is connected with the power supply module and is connected with an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) through a USB (Universal Serial Bus) interface. The motion control mainboard is connected with the power supply module and is connected with the industrial personal computer through an SPI interface. The joint module is connected with the power battery and the motion control mainboard, and the motion control mainboard is connected with the joint module through a CAN bus. And the rated voltage of the power battery is 48V. The control system of the biped robot can be optimized, the control precision and accuracy can be improved, the speed and the space posture of the robot can be obtained in real time, and it can be guaranteed that follow-up task execution work of the biped robot is smoothly completed.

title: Thigh mechanism and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a thigh mechanism and a humanoid robot, the thigh mechanism comprises a thigh shell, a driving assembly and a connecting assembly, one end of the thigh shell is rotatably connected with a shank mechanism of the humanoid robot, and the driving assembly is arranged on the thigh shell and connected with the shank mechanism; the driving assembly is used for driving the shank mechanism to rotate, the connecting assembly comprises a hip joint connecting piece and a crossed roller bearing, the hip joint connecting piece is arranged at the other end of the thigh shell and connected with the driving end of a hip joint mechanism of the humanoid robot, and the crossed roller bearing is arranged on the hip joint connecting piece in a sleeving mode and embedded in the hip joint mechanism. The design of the crossed roller bearing allows load bearing in multiple directions, by embedding the crossed roller bearing, connection between the hip joint mechanism and the thigh mechanism can effectively balance and absorb external impact force, the possibility that the impact force is directly transmitted to a motor on the hip joint mechanism is reduced, and therefore the risk of mechanical faults and damage is reduced.

title: Direct-driven dexterous finger and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a direct-drive type dexterous finger and a humanoid robot, the direct-drive type dexterous finger comprises a driving motor, a gear assembly, a lead screw nut assembly and a knuckle assembly, the gear assembly can reasonably adjust the rotating speed and the torque of the driving motor, and the knuckle assembly can adjust the rotating speed and the torque of the driving motor. A guide sleeve is arranged on an end cover, the lead screw is connected to a planet carrier, an inner ring of a nut is in transmission connection with the lead screw, an outer ring of the nut is rotationally connected with the guide sleeve, the nut can move in the axis direction of the guide sleeve, a finger root joint is rotationally arranged on the nut, and a finger pulp joint is connected with the finger root joint through a first connecting rod. The fingertip section is connected with the finger root section through a second connecting rod, under the action of the driving motor, the planet wheel and the planet carrier are driven to rotate, the lead screw is driven to rotate, the nut can move in the axis direction of the lead screw, and therefore the finger root section, the finger pulp section and the fingertip section are driven to rotate, and the bending and opening functions of the finger are achieved through the double connecting rods.

title: Bionic flexible touch sensor based on pressure pain and robot active protection method
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic flexible touch sensor based on pressure pain and a robot active protection method, and relates to the field of bionic robot flexible sensing and safety protection. The sensor adopts a DIW integrated printing process, comprises a flexible silica gel substrate, a crisscross row and column conductive grid and a spherical crown-shaped micro-convex piezoresistive sensing unit, is free of layering and fully flexible, and can adapt to a complex curved surface of the whole body of a robot. According to the invention, a three-stage progressive quantitative bionic pain sensing system is constructed by taking the damage critical pressure of a sensor material as a reference, the robot is driven to execute a graded protection action through a pain sensing value, and the structural risk is fundamentally eliminated by expanding the stress area; meanwhile, a whole body partition density bionic skin system is constructed, and walking balance adjustment is achieved by fusing plantar pressure and gyroscope data. The sensing precision and the engineering cost are both considered, the bionic sensing capability and the operation safety of the humanoid robot are greatly improved, and the structural service life of the humanoid robot is greatly prolonged.

title: Tension amplification rope-driven humanoid waist joint
abstract: The tension amplification rope-driven humanoid waist joint comprises a movable platform and a static platform, and a three-branch-chain UCU mechanism for providing active constraint and a rope-driven assembly for achieving tension amplification are arranged between the movable platform and the static platform; the three-branch-chain UCU mechanism comprises three parallel UCU branch chains, each UCU branch chain comprises a first hooke joint, a cylindrical pair and a second hooke joint which are sequentially connected in series, the first hooke joint is connected with the movable platform, and the second hooke joint is connected with the static platform; the cylinder pair is sleeved with a compressed spring, and the compressed spring provides elastic support. The rope drive assembly comprises six movable pulleys arranged at the lower end of the movable platform and six fixed pulleys arranged in the static platform, the movable pulleys and the fixed pulleys are staggered up and down to form six movable pulley sets, and tension amplification is achieved through the six movable pulley sets. The parallel mechanism is introduced, so that the waist joint keeps high joint rigidity, and the flexibility and safety of the joint are improved.

title: Intelligent security check system based on edge calculation and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent security check system based on edge calculation and a humanoid robot, relates to artificial intelligence, and provides a scheme for solving the problem that information of a case robot is independent in the prior art. The humanoid robot of the hardware layer serves as an edge computing node to process a real-time task; the server is used as a non-real-time data center of the system; the sensing layer is used for comprehensively digitizing the environment, personnel and articles; the decision-making layer is deployed in an airborne edge calculation unit of the humanoid robot; the interaction layer serves as a man-machine interface. The method has the advantages that the humanoid robot is used as a mobile edge computing node, and other case sensor data are deeply fused through a heterogeneous network architecture. The method covers an anti-shielding visual perception algorithm based on human body key points, a risk assessment method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a real-time task collaborative scheduling technology based on priority, and solves the problems of equipment information islands and manual operation efficiency bottlenecks in security check of high-pedestrian-flow places such as subways and airports.

title: Robot control system and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to a robot control system and a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of robots, the robot control system comprises a central controller, a plurality of domain controllers, a first domain controller arranged in a first area and/or a second domain controller arranged in a second area, and each domain controller is connected with end equipment arranged in the corresponding area; the first area is the neck of the robot or the area above the neck, and the second area is the waist of the robot or the area below the waist; the central controller is arranged between the first area and the second area, and the central controller is connected with the domain controllers and used for sending first control instructions to the domain controllers and receiving summarized data from the domain controllers; and the domain controller is used for receiving the sensing data acquired by the end equipment connected with the domain controller, uploading the processed sensing data as summarized data to the central controller, generating a second control instruction and issuing the second control instruction to the end equipment connected with the domain controller. The system can reduce the occupied volume of the robot in a narrow trunk space.

title: Motion control precision optimization method, device and equipment based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a motion control precision optimization method, device and equipment based on a humanoid robot, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining target object feature information corresponding to a target task; the target object feature information is input into a parameter optimization model, an optimal joint control parameter combination output by the parameter optimization model is obtained, and the parameter optimization model is obtained through training based on the constructed simulation joint control parameters of the simulation robot and the simulation object feature information of the simulation object; controlling the humanoid robot to execute the target task according to the optimal joint control parameter combination; and optimizing the parameter optimization model according to the grabbing result, the performance parameters, the optimal joint control parameter combination and the environment information. Therefore, the motion control of the humanoid robot can be adaptively optimized based on the angle of the task, so that the motion control of the humanoid robot can adapt to a dynamic environment, and the optimization efficiency and precision are improved.

title: Humanoid robot upper limb teleoperation method based on reinforcement learning and optimization algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot upper limb teleoperation method based on reinforcement learning and an optimization algorithm. The humanoid robot upper limb teleoperation method comprises teleoperation of arms and teleoperation of dexterous hands. During remote operation of the arms, actions of the human motion data set are redirected to the two arms of the humanoid robot, and a redirected robot motion data set is obtained; robot motion learning training is carried out based on the redirected robot motion data set, a robot target joint position is output, and then the robot target joint position is converted into a target joint torque; in the teleoperation of the dexterous hand, the position of a key point at the tail end of each finger is calculated by using a forward kinematics method according to the position of each joint at the current moment, a joint angle difference value between two time steps is minimized, and an optimized finger joint angle is output; and synchronously outputting control instructions of all joints of the upper limbs of the robot by taking the real-time posture as input based on the teleoperation of the arm and the teleoperation of the dexterous hand. The method is low in dependence on hardware and stable in teleoperation control.

abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot model evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The problems of different detection items, different detection sequences and the like of different detection personnel are solved, the detection efficiency is improved, and large-scale detection is realized.

title: Humanoid robot image information analysis method and system
abstract: The invention relates to a humanoid robot image information analysis method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: extracting visual features of a to-be-analyzed material from image information, and obtaining a preliminary material type and confidence based on the visual features; judging whether the visual features deviate from a material category feature region corresponding to the preliminary material type or whether the visual features are closer to material category feature regions of other material types so as to identify a high-confidence abnormal condition; comparing at least one kind of non-visual physical feature information of the analysis material with a preset standard physical feature range, and integrating the preliminary material type, the high-confidence abnormal condition and a non-visual physical feature information comparison result to obtain a final material type; and when the final material type conflicts with the preliminary material type, giving out early warning and carrying out risk intervention. Therefore, according to the method, the material identification accuracy and the system robustness of the humanoid robot in the complex storage environment are remarkably improved, and the method has important practical application value.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, relates to a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and aims to synchronously solve the problems that an existing thigh structure is high in machining cost, and connecting fasteners are prone to shear failure and are exposed to influence the appearance. The robot comprises an integrated rotating joint, a thigh structural part, a shank structural part and a bearing assembly. The arc-shaped first connecting end of the thigh structural part is provided with spaced protruding blocks, a first shell body arranged on the joint shell in a diameter dividing mode is provided with a matched groove, and the protruding blocks are locked by fasteners arranged along the rotating axis of the joint after being embedded into the groove. A bearing assembly is arranged in the shank sleeve part, the shank sleeve part is rotationally supported outside the second joint shell, the flange part is fixedly connected with the joint output flange, and the axial projection of the fastener is located in the sleeve part. According to the scheme, connection strength and appearance concealment are both considered, machining is simplified, and cost is reduced.

title: Tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid knee joint
abstract: The invention discloses a tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid knee joint, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The knee joint comprises a knee joint fixed end and a knee joint movable end, an upper quarter-arc vertical plate is arranged at the lower end of the fixed end, a lower quarter-arc vertical plate is correspondingly arranged at the upper end of the movable end, the fixed end and the movable end form a rotating pair through a double-end connecting piece and make single-side rotating opening and closing contact, and a joint rope driving assembly with amplified tension and constant torque is arranged between the two. Reduction ratio amplification and tension amplification are achieved through a movable pulley block mechanism of a rolling joint, and the requirement for the output torque of a motor is reduced. The unique rope winding arrangement enables the rope length variation and the joint angle variation to be kept in a linear relation, and constant torque and constant output are achieved; and the flexibility and the safety of the joint are improved by adopting a rope driving and rope transmission structure. Lightweight, high integration and flexible safe interaction of the humanoid robot joint are achieved, and the humanoid robot lower limb knee joint is suitable for humanoid robot lower limb knee joints.

title: Design method of humanoid walking stability controller based on model reference self-adaption and robot control device
abstract: The invention discloses a design method of a humanoid walking stability controller based on model reference self-adaption and a control device. The design method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a kinetic equation of a biped robot in a continuous swinging stage and a mapping model of a discrete collision stage; s2, a virtual constraint function y = h (q) is designed, so that motion coupling of driving joints and under-actuated joints of the biped robot is achieved; s3, performing input/output feedback linearization processing on the virtual constraint function; s4, designing a PD tracking controller for the linear subsystem; s5, establishing an adaptive reference model; s6, on the basis of an energy minimization criterion, combining with a Bezier polynomial fitting method to optimize parameters of the expected joint trajectory of the biped robot, and generating an energy-saving periodic expected trajectory; and S7, proving the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system by using a control Lyapunov function and Poincare mapping to ensure stable walking of the system cycle.

title: Fixing structure of high-power frameless motor for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a fixing structure of a high-power frameless motor for a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of frameless motors, the fixing structure comprises a stator assembly, positioning blocks are fixed on two side end faces of the stator assembly, and two positioning blocks are arranged on each side end face; and the rotor assembly is arranged in the stator assembly. According to the invention, a structure that the double disc bodies, the double rotating rings and the connecting seat are matched is adopted, a double alignment design is formed by the positioning blocks and the positioning grooves and the convex blocks and the grooves, and a locking mechanism is combined, so that concentric positioning of the stator assembly and the rotor assembly can be rapidly completed, and radial movement of the rotor assembly is effectively limited; besides, the connecting mechanism adopts an adjustable clamping structure design, can adapt to output shafts of different specifications and dimensions, ensures that the output shafts, the stator assembly and the rotor assembly are kept coaxial, does not need to replace a motor main body or additionally customize an adapter flange, and greatly improves the universality and working condition adaptability of equipment.

title: Motion tracking control method and device for humanoid robot, and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a motion tracking control method for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: building a target optimization problem function according to a high-dynamic motion tracking task reward function and a high-dynamic motion safety recovery task reward function for a high-dynamic motion tracking safety control problem of the humanoid robot; and modeling the target optimization problem function as a Markov decision process. The initial humanoid robot action tracking control model is trained by utilizing a reinforcement learning algorithm based on a departure strategy to solve a Markov decision process, a trained humanoid robot action tracking control model is obtained, and the humanoid robot action tracking control model is used for obtaining a high-dynamic action tracking safety decision of the humanoid robot. The humanoid robot action tracking control model is composed of a strategy network and a value network. In this way, action tracking safety control over the humanoid robot can be effectively achieved.

title: Humanoid robot electrical system and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot electrical system and a humanoid robot. The electrical system comprises a main power supply network, a data sensing module, a plurality of distributed joint driving modules, a power supply intelligent management module and a main control module. Wherein the distributed joint driving modules are deployed at all joints, and built-in domain controllers of the distributed joint driving modules are used for obtaining local sensor data and receiving driving instructions issued by the main control module so as to control the joints; the data sensing module collects environment and joint state data; the power supply intelligent management module obtains circuit data and receives an adjusting instruction issued by the main control module so as to adjust the main power supply network; and the main control module fuses and processes various data and generates a driving instruction and an adjusting instruction. According to the technical scheme, through distributed control and intelligent power supply management, the problems that a traditional centralized architecture is complex in wiring, low in energy efficiency and poor in real-time performance are solved, and the movement performance and reliability of the whole machine are improved.

title: Method for controlling stair climbing motion of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a stair climbing motion control method for a humanoid robot. The stair climbing motion control method comprises the steps that robot front environment sensing data and robot body state information are acquired; constructing local terrain representation and performing treading evaluation to obtain a treading area; carrying out support plane segmentation based on the treading area and constructing a structured safe support surface; generating a trunk reference trajectory, a landing point and a foot end swing trajectory based on the structured safe supporting surface; constructing a supporting foot treading domain constraint and a swinging foot obstacle avoidance constraint, and introducing a nonlinear model for predictive control; an execution instruction is output by further combining whole-body control and joint mixed control, continuous and stable stair climbing movement of the humanoid robot in the stair environment is achieved, and the foot falling safety, the swing obstacle avoidance capacity and the movement stability are improved.

title: High-load task-oriented humanoid robot whole-body coordinated motion control method and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a high-load task-oriented humanoid robot whole-body coordinated motion control method and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a current body state and a task target of a humanoid robot, generating a control instruction through a pre-constructed three-order decoupling control model, driving the humanoid robot to execute corresponding actions, and completing a motion control process. Wherein the task targets comprise an upper limb tail end target pose, a moving speed target and a force application target, and the third-order decoupling control model comprises an increment instruction coordination strategy network, an upper limb strategy network and a lower limb strategy network. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of low coupling, low overall training difficulty, high operation precision and the like.

title: Intelligent evaluation training method and device for gait naturalness of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an intelligent evaluation training method and device for gait naturalness of a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a corresponding reference force application time record from a historical force application time database for a working condition label, and determining a feasible range of the force application time; when the step speed change amplitude exceeds a preset safety threshold value and the friction resistance level is lower than a preset stable level, adjusting the force application time delay amount; updating the initial force application time by adopting the adjusted force application time delay amount, and performing iterative comparison and correction with a feasible range of the force application time to obtain an optimal pedaling force application time; according to the comparison between the optimal pedaling force application moment and the plantar flexion moment peak moment, a dynamic force application moment adjusting scheme is generated; and performing propulsive force and slip risk assessment on the dynamic adjustment scheme of the power generation opportunity, and outputting the verified power generation opportunity scheme after confirming that the requirements are met.

title: Humanoid robot cascade centroid model prediction control method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot cascade centroid model predictive control method, which comprises the following steps of: predicting, controlling and optimizing a foothold position of a subsequent gait of a robot by using a multi-step foothold model, planning a reference track of a robot swinging leg by a swinging leg controller based on the foothold position, and controlling the robot swinging leg to track the reference track; the fixed time disturbance observer estimates external disturbance force and disturbance torque acting on the robot in real time, the contact wrench model predicts, controls and compensates the external disturbance force and disturbance torque estimated by the fixed time disturbance observer, and the contact wrench sequence of the robot supporting legs is optimized. According to the method, the unknown disturbance force and disturbance torque of a robot system are quickly estimated by using the fixed-time disturbance observer, the disturbance estimation result is explicitly compensated to the model prediction of the contact wrench, and the multi-step contact wrench of the robot supporting leg is optimized, so that the robot can still keep stable movement under the condition of unknown disturbance; and reliable walking and balance control are realized.

title: Humanoid robot leg joint connecting structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot leg joint connecting structure and relates to the technical field of joint connection.The middle of the outer wall of a connecting shaft is rotationally connected with a connecting plate, the lower end of the connecting plate is connected with a thigh and shank bearing frame, the lower end of the thigh and shank bearing frame is connected with a connecting plate, and a movable groove is formed in the left side of the upper end of the connecting plate; the multi-functional robot has the advantages that the strength and the weight ratio can be increased through the leg stress rod and the thigh and shank bearing frame, the CNC machining path is optimized, the assembly precision is guaranteed, multi-functional integration is achieved, the leg stress rod and the thigh and shank bearing frame form a box-shaped structure, and the multi-functional robot is convenient to use. title: Humanoid robot gravity center position detection method
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot gravity center position detection method, which comprises the following steps of: respectively arranging foot force sensors on the inner side of a heel area, a front plantar area and the outer side of the front plantar area of each elastic foot plate of two feet to form a triangular arrangement, and respectively arranging no less than one foot force sensor on the periphery of each of the three foot force sensors, and whether the foot force sensors work normally or not and whether the humanoid robot body is in an unstable state or not are judged by analyzing and calculating the stress data relation between the foot force sensors. According to the relative positions of the two feet measured by the device for monitoring the relative positions of the two feet in real time, a humanoid robot control center establishes a plane-coordinate system with unified two feet, an optimal stable area coordinate range is determined through experiment and analysis calculation, and after it is determined that the foot force sensors work normally and the body does not lose stability, the humanoid robot is started. According to the coordinate positions and stress data of the foot force sensors, the gravity center coordinate position of the humanoid robot is calculated, and whether the gravity center is located in the optimal stable area or not is judged according to calculation results.

title: Magnetic adsorption guide type humanoid robot wireless charging docking mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent robot energy management, in particular to a magnetic adsorption guide type humanoid robot wireless charging docking mechanism which comprises a placing plane, a humanoid robot, a moving frame and the like, a plurality of universal wheels are installed at the bottom of the moving frame, and the moving frame is placed on the placing plane through the universal wheels. The top of the moving frame is connected with a supporting plate, the top of the supporting plate is provided with an electric push rod, the back of the humanoid robot is provided with a first magnetic sensor, the end of a piston rod of the electric push rod is connected with a mounting plate, the front side of the mounting plate is provided with a second magnetic sensor, and the rear side of the mounting plate is connected with a cable. A moving assembly for adjusting the position of the moving frame is arranged at the bottom of the moving frame. Through gradient magnetic field coupling of the first magnetic sensor and the second magnetic sensor, the two sensors generate axial self-alignment force to automatically correct the angular deviation of the robot, so that non-contact pose real-time tracking is realized, and the problem of interface deviation of the biped robot is solved.

title: Hollow humanoid robot rotating joint integrated with torque sensor
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robot rotating joints, and discloses a hollow humanoid robot rotating joint integrated with a torque sensor, which comprises a mechanical part and a driving and sensor part, and the mechanical part is a basic structure and comprises a harmonic reducer assembly, an inner rotor motor assembly and a hollow wiring assembly. A standard interface can be provided for connecting a joint and a mechanical arm rod, driving and sensor components cover a joint power supply module, a joint communication module and the like, the joint adopts a compact harmonic reducer and the like, microminiaturization and light weight are achieved, the position of the components is adjusted, the rigidity is improved, the wire passing function is reserved, and the joint is suitable for various application scenes; the joint is automatically locked in emergency or power failure, safety is guaranteed, the joint position is maintained in the static state, meanwhile, the integrated torque sensor measures the joint torque in real time, and the action precision is improved.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and provides a leg structure of a humanoid robot, which comprises a thigh part and a shank part, the thigh part is hinged with the shank part through a rotating shaft, a swing mechanism is arranged at the upper part of the thigh part, and the swing mechanism is in transmission connection with the shank part through a connecting rod and is used for driving the shank part to bend and stretch. One end of the connecting rod is hinged to the swing mechanism, the other end of the connecting rod is hinged to the shank part, the swing assembly is moved upwards to the upper portion of the thigh part, the force transmission path of a leg dynamic chain is reconstructed, mass distribution is closer to the biomechanical characteristics of the human body, the rotational inertia of the far-end limb is reduced, and the acceleration response capacity of the knee joint is improved; and a structural foundation is laid for high-speed movement of the robot.

title: Hybrid moving device
abstract: The utility model discloses a hybrid moving device which comprises a humanoid robot and a moving vehicle, the humanoid robot is provided with a main controller and a power module connected with the main controller, and the moving vehicle is a passive moving vehicle and comprises a vehicle body, electric wheels installed on the vehicle body and a motor driver connected with the electric wheels. title: Linear joint, linear joint system and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of mechanical equipment, and particularly provides a linear joint, a linear joint system and a humanoid robot. In the working process, the first lead screw is fixed, the second lead screw is connected with the target piece, the tail end displacement of the second lead screw is composed of two parts, one part is the axial displacement generated when the movable piece drives the second lead screw, the other part is the axial displacement generated when the second lead screw relative to the movable piece, the tail end displacement of the second lead screw is increased, and the execution efficiency is improved.

title: Host installation device for humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a host machine installation device for a humanoid robot, which comprises a main body, a host machine installation mechanism is arranged in the main body, the host machine installation mechanism comprises an equipment outer frame, and the upper end and the lower end of the equipment outer frame are provided with threading grooves. The host module part is protected by the equipment outer frame carried in the host cavity, the host module part consists of an upper-layer processor board card and a lower-layer power controller which are respectively carried by the equipment boxes capable of sliding and stretching, and the two sides of each group of equipment box can be matched with buckles for positioning. title: Lower limb movement mechanism of wheeled humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a lower limb movement mechanism of a wheeled humanoid robot, which belongs to the field of wheeled humanoid robots and realizes light weight and miniaturization of a lower limb structure, more flexibility and higher degree of freedom of leg movement and improvement of the working range and efficiency of the wheeled humanoid robot through cooperative use of a linear movement module and each rotary joint module. The robot mainly comprises a wheel type walking chassis, a lower limb movement mechanism is arranged on the wheel type walking chassis, the lower limb movement mechanism comprises fixed bases symmetrically installed on the wheel type walking chassis, the tops of the fixed bases are connected with the power output end of a bottom rotating joint module, and the bottom rotating joint module is fixedly installed in a leg connecting rod. Linear motion modules are arranged in the leg connecting rods on the two sides and located at the upper end of the bottom rotary joint module, and the power output ends of the two linear motion modules are connected with the power output end of the leg rotary joint module. The invention is mainly used for the wheeled humanoid robot.

title: Three-degree-of-freedom robot joint assembly based on differential rope-driven parallel mechanism
abstract: The three-degree-of-freedom robot joint assembly based on the differential rope-driven parallel mechanism comprises a driving box and a movable platform, a parallel spring tensioning mechanism is arranged between the driving box and the movable platform, the parallel spring tensioning mechanism comprises a branch chain and an extension spring, and the parallel spring tensioning mechanism provides tension for the movable platform; the movable platform is driven by the rope driven by the driving box to achieve three-degree-of-freedom driving, and the movable platform stably moves under the combined action of the rope for providing tension and the parallel spring tensioning mechanism for providing tension. According to the joint assembly, through the collaborative design of differential rope driving and parallel tensioning, three-degree-of-freedom precise movement under the high load, low inertia and compact structure is achieved, the joint assembly can be widely applied to various joint parts, needing three-degree-of-freedom rotation movement, of shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles, necks and the like of the humanoid robot, and high universality and expandability are achieved.
