title: Rope-driven humanoid wrist joint with autorotation decoupling characteristic
abstract: The invention discloses a rope-driven humanoid wrist joint with an autorotation decoupling characteristic, and belongs to the technical field of robots. Comprising an autorotation decoupling mechanism and a differential mechanism, a fixed wheel in the autorotation decoupling mechanism is fixed to a small arm of the robot, a driving wheel is connected with the differential mechanism, and a rope set flexibly drives a joint module. The autorotation decoupling mechanism adopts a movable pulley block structure, and motion decoupling of two groups of steel wire ropes when the steel wire ropes penetrate through autorotation joints is realized by utilizing the characteristics of movable pulleys, so that the driving units can be intensively arranged on a robot base or a near-end structure; according to the differential mechanism, a differential rotation shaft, a differential rotation shaft outer side fixing base and two sets of differential rotation wheels which are symmetrically arranged form a differential structure, multi-degree-of-freedom composite motion such as pitching and yawing can be achieved in a limited space, the structural compactness is remarkably improved, the structural form that rope driving is combined with rope transmission is adopted, the joint flexibility is enhanced, and the mechanical performance is improved. Impact and vibration of the output end of the motor are effectively isolated.

title: Large-size modular design humanoid robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and relates to a large-size modular design humanoid robot which comprises a trunk unit, arm assemblies and leg assemblies. The upper portion of the trunk unit is provided with a first butt joint part used for being connected with the arm assembly, the first butt joint part comprises a mechanical interface and an electric interface, and arm root joints of the arm assembly are matched with the mechanical interface in an axial insertion mode to achieve mechanical connection and are axially fixed through a fastening structure. Meanwhile, the electrical interface on the arm assembly can be in butt joint with the electrical interface in the first butt joint part, so that electrical connection is achieved. A hip connecting structure is arranged on the lower portion of the trunk unit and comprises a first hip component and a second hip component which can be fixed in a butt joint mode, and after the first hip component and the second hip component are in butt joint, a three-way cavity used for containing the upper ends of the leg assemblies is formed. And a leg root joint of the leg assembly is clamped and fixed in the three-way cavity and is connected with an electrical interface in the hip connecting structure.

title: Humanoid robot multi-modal motion instruction distribution and analysis method based on master-slave architecture
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot multi-modal motion instruction distribution and analysis method based on a master-slave architecture, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining voice, vision, body sensing and other multi-modal input data through a master end control node, constructing a time window index, and completing the preprocessing and time alignment; forming a multi-modal semantic feature to determine a task intention and generate a candidate motion instruction set; the main end control node carries out adaptive evaluation on the candidate motion instruction set by combining the current operation state and the current environment state of the robot, determines a target motion instruction, generates execution stage division information, extracts execution constraints to form a constraint set, and carries out stage binding; packaging to generate a motion instruction distribution packet containing packet identification information, sequence identification information, a time window index, validity period information and an integrity verification field, and sending the motion instruction distribution packet to the slave end execution node; and the slave end execution node checks and analyzes the motion instruction distribution packet to obtain a motion instruction to be executed and execution stage division information.

title: Control method and system for biped robot connection transition period based on MPC-CPG fusion
abstract: The invention provides a biped robot connection transition period control method and system based on MPC-CPG fusion. The method comprises the steps that the corresponding overall gravity center position is calculated in the transition period; four Hopf oscillator CPG networks are initialized, corresponding time-varying weighting functions are started to generate CPG initial states of four foot ends and continuous foot end reference trajectories, and in each control period, ZMP positions, overall center positions and CPG states of the two biped robots are correspondingly updated to construct corresponding MPC prediction models; an objective function is solved through the MPC prediction model to output first-step optimal CPG parameters of the two biped robots, and corresponding joint instructions are generated; and after it is judged that the two biped robots meet the transition ending condition, the two biped robots correspondingly exit from the transition stage, and the two biped robots are synchronously switched to the steady-state four-foot CPG planning. The walking stability can be greatly improved.

title: Hip joint assembly and humanoid robot

According to the hip joint assembly, the hip size of the robot can be reduced.

title: Manufacturing process method applied to dexterous hand worm gear of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of micro mechanical part manufacturing, and discloses a manufacturing process method applied to a dexterous hand worm gear of a humanoid robot, which comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a sacrificial layer template with a three-dimensional negative mold and a microscopic anchoring structure by adopting a photoetching technology; s2, conformally depositing a functional surface shell by adopting an atomic layer deposition process, and forming a corresponding prefabricated physical lock catch on the functional surface shell; s3, depositing an intermediate bonding layer with a material component gradient; s4, melting a metal material by adopting an additive manufacturing process to form a structure body, carrying out atomic diffusion to form metallurgical bonding when the high-temperature molten metal in the S4 is in contact with the middle bonding layer, and meanwhile, filling the metal into the prefabricated physical lock catch to solidify to form micromechanical interlocking, and S5, removing the sacrificial layer template; according to the preparation method, through the synergistic effect of metallurgical bonding and micromechanical interlocking, firm combination of the metal matrix and the ceramic shell is achieved, and the heterogeneous composite worm gear which is hard outside and tough inside and is precisely formed is prepared.

title: Manufacturing process method applied to dexterous hand worm of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of machine manufacturing, and discloses a manufacturing process method applied to a dexterous hand worm of a humanoid robot, which comprises the following specific steps: step 1, material selection and pretreatment; secondly, rough turning and semi-finish turning are conducted; thirdly, thread forming machining is conducted; 4, a heat treatment procedure is conducted, specifically, the worm formed in the step 3 is placed in a vacuum heat treatment furnace to be machined, and 5, accurate grinding and polishing are conducted. And 6, cleaning and rust-proof treatment are conducted. According to the method, the temperature is increased to 820-880 DEG C in a vacuum heat treatment furnace at the speed of 8-12 DEG C/min, heat preservation is conducted for 20-40 min, austenitizing is completed, then high-pressure gas quenching is conducted, the cooling speed is controlled to be 60-100 DEG C/s, it is ensured that the axial temperature difference is smaller than or equal to 15 DEG C through closed-loop regulation and control of an infrared thermometer, and the problem that the temperature field distribution is uneven due to the cross section size difference is effectively solved.

title: Manufacturing process method applied to dexterous hand bevel gear of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic manufacturing, and discloses a manufacturing process method applied to a humanoid robot dexterous hand bevel gear, which comprises the following steps: S1, preparing a near-net forming blank, S2, constructing a cathode-precision forging die, S3, loading and initializing a system, S4, cooperatively executing a self-adaptive mixed pulse closed loop, and S5, obtaining a finished product. An adaptive mixed pulse control closed loop is constructed by monitoring an electrochemical impedance signal between an anode blank and a cathode mold in real time. According to the method, the surface finishing state and the limit gap of mechanical forging and pressing are judged through the change of impedance characteristics, and accurate and automatic switching between electrochemical pulses and mechanical pulses is achieved. It is ensured that the fine trimming activation effect of the electrochemical pulse and the precise shaping compact effect of the mechanical pulse cooperate in the optimal time window, and blindness of fixed time sequence control is avoided.

title: Self-adaptive control method and system for biped walking robot based on memory information
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive control method and system for a biped walking robot based on memory information, and relates to the technical field of robot motion control and reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: sampling task distribution to obtain a training task set; memory information is collected based on the task information interaction process in the training task set, joint training is conducted on the coding network, the strategy network and the value network, and a historical observation sequence and a corresponding action sequence are used for constructing a task context to serve as coding network input; introducing noise filtering and state estimation constraint to construct a joint loss function for updating a coding network, and updating a strategy network and a value network by adopting a near-end strategy optimization algorithm; and the trained biped robot prediction control network is utilized to carry out rapid control parameter prediction on a new task of biped walking of the robot. The method can quickly adapt to load change, kinetic parameter drift and noise disturbance, so that efficient self-adaptive control of the biped walking robot is realized.
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive control method and system for a biped walking robot based on memory information, and relates to the technical field of robot motion control and reinforcement learning. title: Modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid mechanical arm
abstract: The modularized seven-degree-of-freedom rope-driven humanoid mechanical arm comprises a three-degree-of-freedom parallel posture-adjusting rope-driven humanoid shoulder joint, a large arm is connected to the output end of the three-degree-of-freedom parallel posture-adjusting rope-driven humanoid shoulder joint, and a tension-amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joint is installed at the other end of the large arm. A forearm is installed at the output end of the tension amplification constant-torque constant-rigidity rope-driven humanoid elbow joint, an autorotation decoupling differential rope-driven humanoid wrist joint is installed at the other end of the forearm, and a humanoid simplified palm is installed at the output end of the autorotation decoupling differential rope-driven humanoid wrist joint. Compared with a motor direct drive mode, when the robot is accidentally collided or overloaded, part of energy can be absorbed through elastic deformation of the rope, the damage risk to the joint body and the external environment is reduced, and therefore the safety of the humanoid robot in the man-machine interaction process is remarkably improved.

title: Method and device for generating two-arm collaborative carrying action of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot two-arm cooperative carrying action generation method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the phase deviation angle of hands and feet at the same side, the angular velocity peak value of an object around a horizontal axis, and the instantaneous joint moment in a walking period of a humanoid robot; determining a rotational inertia estimated value of the carried object according to the instantaneous joint moment and the angular velocity peak value of the object around the transverse axis; the inertia grade of the carried object is judged by comparing the estimated value of the rotational inertia with a preset threshold value; corresponding phase correction strategies are determined according to the inertia levels of different carried objects; and after the phase correction strategy is adopted to adjust the phase deviation angle of the hands and the feet on the same side, the phase correction strategy is corrected according to the monitoring result of the angular velocity peak value around the transverse axis of the object and the pitching oscillation amplitude of the trunk until the phase deviation angle of the hands and the feet on the same side converges to a preset range.

title: Humanoid robot navigation control method and system for three-dimensional complex environment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot navigation control method and system for a three-dimensional complex environment, and relates to the technical field of humanoid robot autonomous navigation and deep reinforcement learning. The method aims at solving the problems that in the prior art, three-dimensional navigation is difficult to give consideration to global planning and local gait generation, foothold support evaluation is insufficient, decision interpretability is poor, and complex terrain training convergence is difficult. According to the method, a 2.5 D local height map is constructed through a depth camera, an attention mechanism fusing a target orientation, a robot motion state and topographic features is designed to generate weighted topographic codes, a reinforcement learning framework containing attention guidance rewards is constructed, and strategy learning is completed based on a TD3 algorithm and two-stage progressive training. According to the method, the foothold selection precision and the navigation success rate under the complex terrain are remarkably improved, the decision interpretability is enhanced, and the method is suitable for autonomous navigation of the humanoid robot in the unstructured environment.

title: Humanoid robot with bionic buttocks based on gold mass ratio of human body
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot with a bionic hip based on the golden mass ratio of a human body. The humanoid robot comprises a trunk, lower limbs and the bionic hip connected between the trunk and the lower limbs. The bionic hip comprises a pelvis structure frame and a function integration tray arranged in the pelvis structure frame, a mass adjusting module is integrally installed on the tray and comprises a sliding rail system, an adjustable balance weight array capable of moving along the sliding rail system and a driving unit, and the ratio eta of the total mass Mhip of the bionic hip to the total mass Mtorso of the trunk is larger than or equal to 0.15 and smaller than or equal to 0.40. The slide rail system adopts an X-Y bidirectional precision guide rail system to realize independent movement of a balancing weight in a horizontal plane, and further realizes three-dimensional space gravity center adjustment through a vertical lifting assembly. The hip mass ratio is limited in a human body golden proportion interval, a three-dimensional adjustable balance weight structure and a double-layer control strategy of macroscopic gravity center adjustment and microcosmic fluctuation control are combined, knee joint loads are effectively reduced, and dynamic stability and bionic performance are improved.

title: Bionic joint compliance driving system oriented to compliance interaction and control method of bionic joint compliance driving system
abstract: The invention discloses a bionic joint compliance driving system for compliance interaction and a control method thereof. The system comprises a brushless direct current motor, a low-reduction-ratio speed reducer, an encoder, a current sampling circuit and a main controller. A quasi-direct-drive (QDD) framework or a series elastic (SEA) framework is adopted, the external torque is estimated in real time through an external force observer (such as an interference observer) by means of motor current and encoder signals, and an additional torque sensor is not needed. Based on the estimated external force, the impedance control module enables the joint to show adjustable mass-spring-damping characteristics, and smooth movement similar to muscle is achieved. When collision is detected, the system can respond within 2 ms and stop safely; and when continuous external force is detected, a dragging teaching mode is automatically entered. The system is low in cost, fast in response, high in safety and suitable for scenes such as quadruped robots, humanoid robots and cooperative mechanical arms needing man-machine physical interaction.

title: Compact high-rigidity joint module with high-performance torque feedback
abstract: The invention discloses a compact high-rigidity joint module with high-performance torque feedback, and the module comprises a speed reducer unit which comprises a hollow sleeve as an assembly foundation and a connecting flange, and a plurality of rows of high-flexural rigidity rotation supporting structures are arranged between the connecting flange and a torque sensor; a bearing outer ring pressing plate is arranged on the end face of the connecting flange, a sealing stacked ring is arranged between the bearing outer ring pressing plate and the torque sensor, and the sealing stacked ring forms dynamic sealing between the bearing outer ring pressing plate and the torque sensor; and the motor unit comprises a hollow rotating shaft serving as an assembling base, and a braking assembly for braking the hollow rotating shaft is arranged between the hollow rotating shaft and the joint lower shell. The invention discloses a compact and high-rigidity joint module with high-performance torque feedback aiming at core performance requirements of a collaborative robot and a humanoid robot for the joint module in actual use, and the compact and high-rigidity joint module has high-performance torque feedback capability, high joint bending resistance capability and bending rigidity and high integration level.

title: Whole-body multi-level comprehensive thermal management system for intelligent robot with body
abstract: The invention provides a whole-body multi-level comprehensive thermal management system for an intelligent robot with a body, which belongs to the technical field of thermal management and comprises a main loop pump drive liquid cooling subsystem, a branch loop pump drive liquid cooling subsystem and a secondary branch loop air cooling subsystem. The trunk subsystem comprises a liquid supply main pipeline, a cooling liquid driving pump, a cooling liquid storage tank, a centralized heat dissipation assembly and a liquid return main pipeline, shoulder joint motors, hip joint motors, a data processing assembly and a head sensor assembly are cooled, the shoulder joint motors and the hip joint motors are both double-layer heat exchange stepping motors, double-layer cooling liquid flowing annular sleeves are arranged outside the shoulder joint motors and the hip joint motors, and the shoulder joint motors and the hip joint motors are connected with the data processing assembly. The robot data processing assembly and the head sensor assembly are cooled through a cold plate; each branch subsystem cools an elbow joint motor and a knee joint motor, and is a cooling fluid pump integrated stepping motor; the secondary branch subsystem cools ankle joint motors at the ends of the limbs and a micro motor in the dexterous hand. According to the invention, the temperature control consistency and long-time operation reliability of different parts are improved, and the energy consumption of the system is reduced.

title: Automatic flexible bobbin replacement control system based on humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a flexible automatic bobbin replacement control system based on a humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of textile automation, in particular to a multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot, and the tail end of a mechanical arm of the multi-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot is provided with a flexible actuator; the multi-mode sensing system is integrated at the tail end of the mechanical arm and comprises a binocular depth camera, a structured light projector and a force and torque sensor; receiving and fusing data from the multi-mode sensing system, reconstructing the dynamic pose of the target spindle in real time in a vibration environment, and calculating the pose reconstruction frequency through the adaption of the vibration frequency and the sensor sampling frequency; the tail end pose and the contact force of the mechanical arm are dynamically adjusted through an impedance controller, and the rigidity parameter of the impedance controller is calculated and determined through the ratio of the yield strength of a bobbin material to the contact area.

title: Interactive projection guidance control method, interactive mechanical arm and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides an interactive projection guidance control method, an interactive mechanical arm and a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: generating to-be-displayed content and a corresponding explanation script in response to a user voice instruction; the four-wheel intelligent chassis is controlled to move to the target display area, the target projection plane is recognized, and the expected pose of the tail end of the interactive mechanical arm is solved; controlling the interactive mechanical arm to move the projection module to an expected pose, performing geometric correction on the to-be-displayed content, and projecting the to-be-displayed content to a target projection plane; according to the explanation script, the laser guiding module is controlled to dynamically indicate or track a target area in the to-be-displayed content, and according to the environment illumination, the task mode and the user position, the lighting module is controlled to execute supplementary lighting; and after the task is completed, the humanoid robot is controlled to execute standby, following or automatic recharging. According to the invention, an integrated closed-loop service of autonomous movement, precise projection, laser explanation, intelligent light supplement and safe recharging of the robot in a dynamic office environment is realized.

title: High-strength aluminum alloy material suitable for humanoid robot skeleton and preparation method of high-strength aluminum alloy material
abstract: The invention discloses a high-strength aluminum alloy material suitable for humanoid robot skeletons and a preparation method thereof, and relates to the field of humanoid robots. The high-strength aluminum alloy material comprises an aluminum matrix and modified zirconium oxide dispersed in the aluminum matrix. The modified zirconium oxide comprises hollow mesoporous zirconium oxide, cerium oxide loaded in channels of the hollow mesoporous zirconium oxide, and a silicon dioxide hole sealing layer coated on the outer surface of the hollow mesoporous zirconium oxide. The problems that a traditional ceramic/aluminum composite material is poor in interface bonding and low in plasticity are solved, the aluminum alloy with high strength, high toughness and low density is prepared, and the strict requirements of humanoid robot skeletons for high bearing capacity and high maneuverability are perfectly met.

title: Heterogeneous computing core task flow scheduling method of humanoid robot and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a heterogeneous computing core task flow scheduling method of a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. title: Robot joint parameter detection method, robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a joint parameter detection method of a robot, the robot and a storage medium. According to the method, the interference of overall motion of the robot is effectively filtered, high-precision and high-reliability joint parameter detection can be achieved without depending on a vulnerable mechanical counting device or high-cost external calibration, and the method is particularly suitable for various joints of the humanoid robot with the composite motion characteristic.

abstract: The utility model discloses a maintenance-free anti-leakage bearing for humanoid robots and industrial robots, which innovatively adopts plastic oil with a microporous structure as a lubricating medium, realizes dynamic release and recovery of lubricating oil through the capillary action of micropores, forms a lubricating film during working, and stores the oil liquid back when the bearing is static, so that the service life of the bearing is prolonged. title: Joint mechanism of humanoid robot

title: Assembly structure of hip pitching joint and thigh structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an assembling structure of a hip pitching joint and a thigh structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. title: Flexible differential mechanism with double parallel degrees of freedom and robot
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of flexible transmission, and provides a flexible differential mechanism with double parallel degrees of freedom and a robot. The first joint unit and the second joint unit are connected through a traction piece; the two driving modules in the driving structure output the same or different speed vectors, and the traction piece drives the first joint unit and/or the second joint unit in the differential structure to rotate. Therefore, the core defects that an existing scheme is insufficient in light weight, large in rotational inertia, low in force sensing precision, complex in control and the like can be overcome, and therefore the application requirement of the high-performance joint of the humanoid robot is met.

title: Brain-computer interface system for whole-body continuous control of humanoid robot and execution method
abstract: The invention provides a brain-computer interface system for whole-body continuous control of a humanoid robot and an execution method, and belongs to the technical field of brain-computer interface and robot control. The system comprises an electroencephalogram data stream acquisition and online sliding window segmentation module, an electroencephalogram feature extraction and classification module, a double-threshold smoothing module and an instruction space mapping and execution module. Wherein continuous decoding of the streaming electroencephalogram signals is realized through online sliding window segmentation with a fixed step length; through a confidence rejection and residence time confirmation mechanism in the double-threshold smoothing module, unstable original prediction of a decoding model is converted into a safe execution instruction, invalid electroencephalogram signals generated by sight line transfer, blinking and the like are effectively filtered, and instruction jitter is eliminated; and the safety instruction is mapped into an incremental motion primitive, so that whole-body continuous and fine control of the high-degree-of-freedom humanoid robot is realized. According to the method, low delay and high stability of control are both considered, and the interaction safety and control precision of the brain-controlled robot are remarkably improved.

title: Humanoid robot linear module test bench
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of linear module performance test equipment, in particular to a humanoid robot linear module test board which comprises a bottom box, an equipment bottom plate is mounted above the bottom box, a linear moving device is fixedly mounted on the equipment bottom plate, and a motor mounting plate is slidably arranged on the linear moving device. title: Biped robot safe navigation positioning method based on discrete control barrier function and layered architecture
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot safe navigation positioning method based on a discrete control barrier function and a hierarchical architecture, and belongs to the technical field of robot control. An RRT algorithm is adopted to generate a global path, and a linear inverted pendulum model (LIPM) is combined to generate a stable gait; a discrete control barrier function (D-CBF) is adopted to ensure that the robot avoids obstacles in a dynamic environment, and safety control input is solved through an optimization problem; real-time positioning is carried out by adopting a sensor fusion technology, and oscillation errors caused by gaits are eliminated through moving average filtering. By combining a discrete control barrier function (D-CBF) and hybrid zero dynamics (HZD), high-precision navigation and safe obstacle avoidance of the biped robot in a complex environment are realized, and the problems of insufficient stability and poor safety in a traditional method are effectively solved.

abstract: The invention discloses a tail end visual actuator assembly for data acquisition of a humanoid mechanical arm and a calibration parameter binding structure of the tail end visual actuator assembly. The assembly comprises a tail end connecting seat, a tail end actuator, a tail end visual acquisition module, a mechanical positioning structure, an electric connection structure, a module identification unit and a calibration parameter binding structure. The tail end connecting seat is used for being connected with a tail end mounting interface of the humanoid mechanical arm, the tail end executor is used for executing grabbing, contacting, clamping, releasing or operating actions, and the tail end visual collection module is used for collecting local image data between the tail end executor and a target object. The mechanical positioning structure is used for limiting the installation position and the installation posture of the tail end visual actuator assembly relative to the tail end of the mechanical arm, the module recognition unit is used for outputting module recognition information corresponding to the current assembly, and the calibration parameter binding structure is used for obtaining corresponding calibration parameters according to the module recognition information. And binding the calibration parameter with the current data acquisition task. By means of the structure, after the tail end visual actuator assembly is installed or replaced, the coordinate corresponding relation among the tail end visual data, the tail end actuator state data and the mechanical arm state data can be kept, and the consistency, reliability and rechecking performance of data collection of the humanoid mechanical arm are improved.

title: Humanoid robot shielding grabbing method and equipment
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot shielding grabbing method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a target material, selecting a target subarray set and array excitation parameters from a subarray mapping library according to the material and the tail end orientation, and controlling a distributed RFID antenna array disposed at a mechanical arm tail end actuator base and/or a phalanx extension region; jointly determining a sampling pose according to the pose uncertainty reduction amount and the cost of moving from the candidate sampling pose to the preset grabbing approaching pose, and scanning to obtain a micro-scanning frame; monitoring a tactile array, generating a plurality of contact absolute reference events in a grabbing approaching or micro-scanning track and forming a continuous tactile contact point sequence, and calibrating the RF phase offset, the tail end external parameter error and the grabbing pose on line based on the continuous tactile contact point sequence, the corresponding mechanical arm pose and the geometric information of the contact points. The problems that in the shielding environment, the pose precision is low in robot grabbing, and scanning and grabbing actions are disjointed can be solved.

title: Lithium battery module and humanoid robot
abstract: According to the lithium battery module and the humanoid robot provided by the invention, the lithium battery module adopts the locking mechanism composed of the cam, the two locking assemblies and the rotating part, so that the technical defects of blockage, unsmooth resetting and low positioning precision of an existing locking structure are effectively overcome. The rotating piece drives the cam to rotate and drives the two locking assemblies to synchronously move along the through groove of the upper cover, stable and smooth movement of the lock cylinder and accurate and consistent positioning are achieved, firm locking can still be kept under the working conditions of frequent posture change and vibration of the robot, locking loosening and alignment deviation are avoided, and the overall assembly stability of the battery pack is remarkably improved. Large-current electric energy transmission between the battery pack and the external power supply interface is realized by adopting the power butt joint device, so that the assembly process can be greatly simplified, the wiring error rate is reduced, the contact resistance is effectively reduced, and the large-current conduction stability is improved.

title: Humanoid mechanical arm body intelligent data acquisition workstation capable of reproducing calibration benchmark and operation method of humanoid mechanical arm body intelligent data acquisition workstation

title: AI humanoid robot control method suitable for complex terrain
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses an AI humanoid robot control method suitable for complex terrains. The method comprises the following steps: dividing a single-foot step state period of the humanoid robot into three phases, namely a swinging early stage, a swinging later stage and a supporting stage; in the early stage of swinging, a pre-judgment instruction packet is generated according to the plantar pressure distribution data and the local terrain depth map, and the pre-judgment instruction packet comprises an expected ankle joint grounding angle, an expected ground rigidity grade and an expected plantar slippage grade; in the later stage of swinging, parameters in the pre-judgment instruction packet are loaded to an ankle joint controller according to the height from the swinging leg to the ground; in the supporting period, the actual contact data and the pre-judgment instruction packet are compared, a deviation source is recognized, and the pre-judgment model is updated; three phases of the left pin and the right pin are executed asynchronously and parallelly and are coordinated through a phase state mutual exclusion rule and a cross-pin trigger signal; according to the invention, the problem of time mismatch between the control instruction and the physical feedback in the robot motion control under the complex terrain is solved, and the real-time adaptation of the terrain change is realized.

title: Household flexible bionic humanoid emotion accompanying nursing robot
abstract: The invention discloses a household flexible bionic humanoid emotion accompanying nursing robot, and relates to the technical field of smart home and household service robots. The robot comprises a flexible bionic shell body, a walking driving mechanism, a limb driving assembly, a voice interaction module, an offline data interface, a control module, a power module and a smart home wireless control unit. The control module comprises a microprocessor, a storage unit and a motor driving circuit, custom time, storage point positions and reminding data can be imported through an off-line data interface, mandarin and dialect recognition interaction of all places are supported, and the robot can be driven to directionally move forwards, backwards, leftwards and rightwards in a room to complete interaction actions such as arm lifting, leg lifting, bowing, eye opening, mouth opening, nodding and hand waving; flexible grabbing mechanisms are arranged at the tail ends of the arms, so that simple care actions such as water pouring, medicine taking, mobile phone taking and glasses taking can be realized; the smart home wireless control unit can control home equipment such as door opening, air conditioner regulation and control, television turning-on and turning-off and the like. title: Artificial intelligence education-oriented humanoid robot multi-mode control system
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence education, and discloses an artificial intelligence education-oriented humanoid robot multi-mode control system, which is characterized in that a privacy perception module integrates a visual perception unit, a voice perception unit, a touch perception unit and an environment perception unit; learning behaviors of students are accurately captured, knowledge point association screening, teaching semantic noise reduction and juvenile contact force classification perception are completed, and invalid data are filtered; the semantic fusion module completes space-time dual alignment by using a teaching time axis, generates a semantic constraint rule based on a subject cognitive map, realizes multi-modal deep fusion by using an improved Transform model, dynamically outputs a special semantic tag for teaching, and converts multi-modal data into a cognitive state capable of directly supporting a teaching decision; and the closed-loop decision module generates a customized teaching strategy through deep reinforcement learning based on a K12 full-disciplinary cognitive map and a dynamic student cognitive portrait, and automatically converts the customized teaching strategy into full-dimensional instructions such as voice, action and the like.

title: Humanoid robot hand contact state sensing method, system and device based on multi-mode tactile fusion and medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent sensing control, and discloses a humanoid robot hand contact state sensing method, system and device based on multi-mode tactile fusion and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: collecting an array pressure signal through a pressure tactile sensor arranged in a contact area of a humanoid robot dexterous hand; collecting a deformation image sequence of the contact area through the sliding touch sensor; fusing the pressure branch feature and the slip branch feature to obtain a multi-modal tactile fusion feature, and generating a single-moment recognition output result; state merging is carried out on recognition output results of multiple continuous moments, and a continuous contact state segment is obtained; and abnormal contact event judgment is carried out by using the state parameter judgment rule, and a structured contact event output result is generated and sent to a robot control system. According to the method, continuous sensing, stable recognition and structured output of the hand contact state of the robot are achieved, and the sliding trend recognition capacity and the control linkage capacity in a complex operation scene are improved.

title: Mechanical finger, manipulator and robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and discloses a mechanical finger, a manipulator and a robot. The mechanical finger comprises a first driving assembly, a second driving assembly, a support and a finger body; the support rotates around the first axis, and the first output end of the first driving assembly is connected with the support. The finger body comprises a root joint, one end of the root joint is rotationally connected to the support around a second axis, and the second axis is perpendicular to the first axis; the second output end of the second driving assembly comprises a first thrust block which rotates around a third axis, the third axis and the second axis are collinear or parallel, the first thrust block abuts against the root joint in at least one side of the rotation circumferential direction of the first thrust block, and the first thrust block is used for driving the root joint to rotate around the second axis relative to the support; the face, abutting against the root joint, of the first thrust block is an outwards-protruding curved face. By means of the mode, the metacarpophalangeal joint structure design with multiple kinematic pairs connected in parallel can be achieved, and the movement of the mechanical fingers is more anthropomorphic.

title: Multi-mode teleoperation control method and system for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-mode teleoperation control method and system for a humanoid robot, and aims to solve the technical bottlenecks of poor input compatibility, weak environmental adaptability and unsmooth movement in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: S100, performing normalization adaptation and intention reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous input from VR, motion capture, vision and the like to generate a standardized target skeleton sequence; s200, constructing a teacher-student asymmetric deep network, and enabling a student network to have the capability of deducing environmental parameters from ontology feedback through implicit feature distillation; s300, performing dynamic manifold filtering on the intention of the operator to extract a smooth motion component, and designing a composite reward function to realize accurate tracking and whole-body collaboration; and S400, the control strategy is executed online, and a safety fusing mechanism is integrated. According to the method, compatibility of low-cost generalization input equipment is achieved, the self-adaptive robustness of the robot in an unknown environment is improved, and output motion is smooth and stable.

According to the method, compatibility of low-cost generalization input equipment is achieved, the self-adaptive robustness of the robot in an unknown environment is improved, and output motion is smooth and stable.

title: Decision control method, system and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a decision control method, system and device for a humanoid robot and a medium, and a unified strategy model in the method is obtained through training by the following steps: obtaining a plurality of full-dimensional training features of the humanoid robot; according to each full-dimensional training feature, performing model training on the single-dimensional strategy model to obtain a plurality of trained single-dimensional strategy models and original track information corresponding to each trained single-dimensional strategy model; the original track information comprises state behavior data, action behavior data and reward behavior data; performing reward cross-scene unification on all the original trajectory information to obtain a unified trajectory data set; and according to the unified track data set, performing model training on the initialized unified strategy model to obtain a trained unified strategy model. The model provided by the method can effectively improve the scene adaptability of decision control of the humanoid robot. The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence.

title: Humanoid robot waist and hip module based on connecting rod difference and inverted Y-shaped structure
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot waist and hip module based on connecting rod difference and inverted Y-shaped configuration, which comprises a yaw and difference attitude control assembly, the waist driving piece is installed on the first positioning frame along the Z axis, the right side differential driving piece and the left side differential driving piece are fixed in the Y-axis direction, and the transmission assembly is matched with the right side differential driving piece and the left side differential driving piece and used for achieving pitching motion of the waist of the robot. The inverted-Y-shaped hip joint bearing assembly comprises a second positioning frame, a left hip driving piece and a right hip driving piece, wherein the left hip driving piece and the right hip driving piece are installed on the second positioning frame in an inverted-Y shape. According to the waist and hip module of the humanoid robot, a parallel differential mechanism composed of the double direct-drive motors, the rigid connecting rods and the cross universal joints is innovatively introduced, the return clearance of traditional gear differential is thoroughly eliminated, and clear decoupling and accurate control over pitching and side-sway freedom degrees are achieved; meanwhile, through inverted-Y-shaped symmetrical arrangement of bilateral hip driving, a mechanical conduction structure with high bearing rigidity and excellent bending moment resistance is constructed.

title: Humanoid robot full-scene multi-task interaction data generation method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot full-scene multi-task interaction data generation method and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robot data set construction. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-modal data set corresponding to a target operation task of the humanoid robot; segmenting the scene image to generate a robot body mask and an interactive target object mask, and normalizing a robot joint action sequence and kinematics parameters based on the degree-of-freedom adaptation coefficient matrix to obtain normalized motion labels adaptive to robots with different degrees of freedom; inputting a pre-trained conditional diffusion model to generate a new scene image by taking the multi-modal sample pair, the double masks, the normalized motion label, the target scene and the task text description as multi-conditional constraints; and combining the new scene image with the source pose data to obtain full-scene multi-task interaction data. According to the method, interaction data which is adaptive to robots with different degrees of freedom and is provided with a complete multi-modal label can be generated at low cost, and the generalization ability and the full-scene adaptability of a large robot model are improved.

title: Parallel-driven bionic neck mechanism of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a parallel-driven humanoid robot bionic neck mechanism, and relates to the field of robot mechanical structures. Comprising a bottom mounting disc; the head mounting platform is arranged above the bottom mounting disc; the driving branch chain group is arranged between the bottom mounting disc and the head mounting platform in parallel; the driving branch chain set comprises a main supporting branch chain located on the rear side of the neck and two cooperative adjusting branch chains located on the front side of the neck, an asymmetric bionic layout is formed in space, and each driving branch chain set independently comprises a driving motor, a lead screw transmission assembly, a first universal joint and a second universal joint. The driving motor is installed on the bottom installation disc, the output end of the driving motor is connected with the lower end of the lead screw transmission assembly through a first universal joint, and the upper end of the lead screw transmission assembly is connected with the head installation platform through a second universal joint. The multi-degree-of-freedom posture adjustment of the robot head can be achieved in a small space, and the multi-degree-of-freedom posture adjustment mechanism has the advantages of being compact in structure, stable in movement, high in bearing capacity and the like.

title: Motion redirection control method, device and equipment for humanoid robot and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a motion redirection control method for a humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a redirection motion data sequence of the humanoid robot during high-dynamic motion according to a target human body reference motion data sequence, and the redirection motion data comprises redirection motion data corresponding to a plurality of moments; and constructing a target body height function corresponding to the humanoid robot. And according to the redirection motion data sequence and the target body height function, determining a preset high-dynamic motion trajectory of the humanoid robot in the high-dynamic motion, and performing filtering processing on the preset high-dynamic motion trajectory to obtain a target preset high-dynamic motion trajectory. And controlling the humanoid robot to execute a high-dynamic action according to the target preset high-dynamic action trajectory. The method can solve the problems of errors and local jittering when human motion data are mapped to the humanoid robot and the humanoid robot is controlled to execute high-dynamic actions, and realizes effective control of action redirection of the humanoid robot.

title: Humanoid robot and intelligent control method for behavior safety of humanoid robot
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot and an intelligent control method for behavior safety of the humanoid robot, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a dynamic operation domain of visual guidance based on image flow and depth information in combination with a current pose, and obtaining a potential field graph including visual navigation; defining a force sense dominated contact exploration domain based on the torque feedback value and the joint current feedback value in combination with the tail end contact state, and obtaining a contact force constraint envelope surface; based on data of an accelerometer and a gyroscope and in combination with a plantar pressure distribution center, a static security domain of inertial locking is judged, and a stable attitude cone is obtained; performing multi-mode control domain priority decision based on the visual navigation potential field graph, the contact force constraint envelope surface and the stable attitude cone to obtain a dominant control target behavior mode; and generating a hierarchical safety control instruction based on the target behavior pattern, and controlling each joint driver of the humanoid robot to execute the torque instruction based on the hierarchical safety control instruction. According to the method, the behavior safety of the humanoid robot in the dynamic unstructured environment is realized.

title: Single-side supporting non-hollow nested type high-torque force control joint module
abstract: The invention relates to a unilateral support non-hollow nested high-torque force control joint module, which belongs to the technical field of robot joint modules, and comprises a rear end cover, a main circuit board, a motor, a high rotor shaft, a bearing assembly, a harmonic reducer, a hollow shaft and a force control assembly, a high rotor shaft single-side bearing supporting structure is adopted, the requirement for machining coaxiality is lowered, and assembly and maintenance are simplified. A double-coded-disc and double-encoder structure is arranged, rotation angle signals of the motor end and the output end are collected respectively, and the position detection and force control precision is improved. An efficient heat dissipation channel is constructed through cooperation of the heat dissipation paste and the concave-convex table of the rear end cover, labyrinth combination sealing is formed by the hollow shaft and the wave generator, and oil leakage and impurity invasion of the speed reducer are effectively prevented. The built-in band-type brake structure achieves reliable braking, the overall structure is compact, bearing performance is good, operation is stable, the defects that a traditional joint is large in machining difficulty, poor in heat dissipation, ineffective in sealing, low in control precision and the like are effectively overcome, and the joint is suitable for high-end intelligent equipment such as humanoid robots and cooperative mechanical arms.

title: Humanoid robot capable of rotating and lifting
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot capable of rotating and lifting. The humanoid robot comprises a base, a rotating mechanism, a lifting mechanism and a humanoid robot body. The rotating mechanism is mounted on the base and drives the lifting mechanism to rotate integrally; the upper end of the lifting mechanism is connected with the robot body to achieve lifting motion. The robot ascends and descends synchronously along with the lifting mechanism and rotates integrally. The lifting mechanism is driven by the rotating mechanism to integrally rotate, the problems that the in-situ rotating angle of a traditional humanoid robot is limited, and the operation range is small are solved, the humanoid robot can be compatible with multiple lifting structures such as lead screws, chains and racks, can be used in cooperation with a fixed base or an AGV, and is high in structural integration degree, good in stability, flexible in operation and high in practicability. The lifting and rotating working platform is suitable for various humanoid robots.

title: Robot autonomous consciousness implementation system based on external perception mapping and internal state machine
abstract: The invention discloses a robot autonomous consciousness implementation system based on external perception mapping and an internal state machine, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, humanoid consciousness construction and robot autonomous decision control, and the system comprises an external perception module which is configured to collect real-time state data of a robot and an external environment; the mirror image mapping module is connected with the external sensing module and configured to map the collected local environment actually contacted with the robot and the state data of the robot into the corresponding state of an internal state machine in real time; an internal state machine module; the robot autonomous consciousness implementation system based on external perception mapping and an internal state machine is constructed, so that the problems that in the prior art, an internal mirror image cannot be constructed autonomously, deviation processing depends on manpower, process correction is lacked, storage redundancy is achieved, and the system is disjointed with a frame can be solved; and full-autonomous closed-loop consciousness behaviors of the robot from sensing, mapping, detection, deduction and correction to memory purification are realized.

title: Multi-modal bidirectional man-machine interaction system and method for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of human-computer interaction of humanoid robots, in particular to a multimodal bidirectional human-computer interaction system and method for a humanoid robot. The system collects human body, environment and robot state information through the multi-modal sensing unit to form multi-modal original data; the interaction decision control unit performs fusion processing, interaction intention prediction and action planning on the multi-modal original data to generate interaction control information; the multi-mode feedback unit outputs vision, voice and limb movement feedback based on the interaction control information; the communication unit achieves sending of interaction control information and real-time returning of the state of the robot, and therefore efficient, natural and closed-loop interaction control between a man and a machine is achieved. According to the method, high-precision recognition and self-adaptive response of the humanoid robot to the intention of the user are realized, so that the accuracy, real-time performance and naturalness of man-machine interaction are improved.

title: Humanoid robot whole body operation system and method based on active space brain and generalization action cerebellum and robot
abstract: The invention discloses a humanoid robot whole body operation system and method based on an active space brain and a generalization action cerebellum and a robot. The system comprises an active space brain module and a generalization action cerebellum module. The active space brain module is used for receiving a natural language task instruction and RGB-D visual observation, executing active space perception, three-dimensional space understanding and adaptive task planning, and outputting a sub-task target and a space decision instruction; the generalization action cerebellum module is used for receiving the subtask target and the space decision instruction, and generating whole-body executable actions of the humanoid robot meeting kinematics constraints and physical feasibility through cooperation of the lower body space navigation and control unit and the upper body dexterous operation unit; the method does not need real robot data of a specific task, has strong generalization, high robustness and active space perception capability, is suitable for autonomous whole-body operation of the humanoid robot in a complex unstructured environment, and can greatly reduce deployment cost and data dependence.

title: Humanoid robot real-time task scheduling method and related equipment
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a real-time task scheduling method for a humanoid robot and related equipment, and belongs to the technical field of robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of task scheduling tables of the humanoid robot, wherein the task scheduling tables are used for representing motion tasks of a motion association group with the same degree of freedom; binding the task scheduling table with a scheduling thread according to the static priority of the motion task to obtain a task ready table; task time extraction is carried out on different ready tasks of the task ready table based on the reference time of the synchronous clock reference, and time features are obtained; performing dynamic priority calculation on the ready tasks according to the time characteristics and real-time scenes acquired by the humanoid robot to obtain scheduling priorities of the tasks; and performing scheduling execution on the plurality of ready tasks through a scheduling thread according to the scheduling priority. According to the embodiment of the invention, the precision, real-time performance and stability of task execution of the humanoid robot can be improved.

title: Parallel double-connecting-hole type triaxial force sensor
abstract: The invention relates to a parallel double-connecting-hole type triaxial force sensor. The sensor comprises an elastic body and a strain gauge group, the elastic body comprises a square loading platform, a square X-direction frame and an outer square frame; the outer square frame comprises a Y-direction beam on the rear side, a left Z-direction beam, a right Z-direction beam and a fixing platform on the front side. The loading platform is connected with the front side of the X-direction frame; the middle of the rear side of the X-direction frame is connected with the middle of the Y-direction beam; the X-direction frame is provided with vertical double connecting holes A; vertical double connecting holes B are formed in the Y-direction beam; the Z-direction beam is provided with a horizontal double-connecting hole; and strain gauge groups are adhered to the side surfaces of the vertical double-connecting hole A, the vertical double-connecting hole B and the horizontal double-connecting hole, and each group forms a Wheatstone full-bridge circuit. The multi-axial force sensor is simple and compact in structure, synchronous measurement of multi-axial force is achieved through the single elastic body, and coupling crosstalk suppression and signal decoupling in multi-axial force measurement can be completely achieved through the overall structure symmetric design and the patch bridging scheme; and therefore, the high-precision measurement requirements of the fields of humanoid robots, high-end equipment, precision medical treatment and the like on multi-axial force perception can be met.

title: Multi-modal interaction and information processing method suitable for humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal interaction and information processing method suitable for a humanoid robot, and relates to the field of intelligent robots. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-modal information flow collected by a sensor carried by the humanoid robot; segmenting the multi-modal information flow into a plurality of time slices according to the voice pause interval; for each time slice, the modal pair collaboration degree between any two modals is calculated, and the modal pair collaboration degree is obtained through weighted summation of a time coincidence factor, a semantic alignment factor and a spatial pointing factor; calculating the aggregation collaboration degree of each mode based on the mode pair collaboration degree, and performing weighted correction on the aggregation collaboration degree according to historical interaction mode data of the user; determining a user intention according to the corrected collaboration degree of each mode and the global collaboration degree; and controlling the humanoid robot to execute an interaction response corresponding to the user intention. Through time axis alignment and dynamic intention arbitration, the problem of intention conflict in multi-modal interaction is solved, and the accuracy and naturalness of interaction are improved.

title: Training method of motion control strategy network and humanoid robot motion control method
abstract: The invention provides a training method of a motion control strategy network and a humanoid robot motion control method, and relates to the technical field of robot control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a human body motion image sequence of a preset scene; the human body motion image sequence comprises multiple frames of continuous human body motion images; performing multi-modal perception on the human body motion image sequence to obtain an environment geometric reconstruction model and a human body geometric motion model; obtaining an effective contact area in the preset scene from the environmental geometric reconstruction model; constructing a local motion simulation scene with a simulation robot according to the human body geometric motion model and the effective contact area; and carrying out motion control strategy network training by adopting a local motion simulation scene to obtain a target motion control strategy network. By means of the method, the motion control strategy with the terrain perception ability can be trained, the humanoid robot can adjust motion in a self-adaptive mode according to the terrain geometrical characteristics, and the motion stability and the task success rate in the real complex environment are improved.

title: Digital human gait generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a digital human gait generation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining three-dimensional topographic data of a virtual scene; constructing a terrain traction field of the virtual scene by using the three-dimensional terrain data of the virtual scene; wherein the terrain traction field is a data set representing the traction strength of each voxel of the three-dimensional terrain on the feet of the virtual digital human and the suggested posture of the feet; performing gait prediction on a target virtual digital human based on the terrain traction field of the virtual scene to generate an optimal foothold sequence; determining a current target foothold from the optimal foothold sequence; and based on the data at the current target foothold in the terrain traction field of the virtual scene, adjusting the gait data of the target virtual digital person for foothold at the current target foothold, and performing rigid locking when the foot touches the ground to obtain the current gait of the target virtual digital person.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, discloses a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot, and aims at solving the problems that an existing leg structure is limited by industrial technology prejudice and cannot give consideration to high bearing capacity, compactness, low cost and easy maintenance. The structure comprises a leg yawing joint, a knee joint, a bearing and a split type thigh structural part, the thigh structural part is formed by splicing a first leg structural part and a second leg structural part, and the first leg structural part and the second leg structural part define a knee joint installation space; the knee joint is arranged in the mounting space, the output flange is fixed with one end of the thigh, the bearing is connected with the bearing fixing position of the thigh and the knee joint, and the leg yawing joint is perpendicular to the rotation axis of the knee joint. The technical prejudice of an integrated skeleton structure is broken through, the split design greatly reduces the processing cost and simplifies the assembly and maintenance, and meanwhile, the knee joint double-support layout is realized by virtue of the split thighs, so that the bearing rigidity is improved, unbalance loading wear is avoided, the overall compactness of the legs is ensured, and the problem that multiple properties are difficult to consider at the same time is effectively solved.

title: Intelligent interactive humanoid robot
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent interactive humanoid robot, and relates to the technical field of interactive robots, the intelligent interactive humanoid robot comprises a robot cavity, the upper and lower parts of the inner side of the robot cavity are provided with battery pack connecting units, and the left and right ends of the outer side of the robot cavity are provided with cooling units; each battery pack connecting unit comprises a driving motor and a lifting plate, and a battery pack set is arranged on the upper portion of each lifting plate in a carrying mode. According to the independent arrangement structure of the upper battery pack and the lower battery pack in the cavity of the robot, automatic lifting and seamless alternate power supply of the upper battery pack and the lower battery pack can be achieved in cooperation with transmission of a driving motor, a driving gear, a driven gear, a threaded lead screw and a lifting plate in the battery pack connecting unit; the battery pack group can be directly pushed in and pulled out for replacement, the whole machine does not need to be disassembled, the battery can be directly and externally connected for charging without disassembling the battery at night, and the convenience of battery maintenance, replacement and charging is remarkably enhanced while the cruising ability is improved.

title: Layered collaborative reinforcement learning motion control architecture for biped robot
abstract: The invention discloses a hierarchical collaborative reinforcement learning motion control architecture for a biped robot, which is characterized in that robot state and environment data are collected in real time through a sensing unit, rich information is provided for an upper master control unit, the upper master control unit is helped to make reasonable decisions, and the complex terrain adaptability is improved; secondly, gait planning, motion mode decision making and terrain recognition are achieved through an upper-layer main control unit by means of reinforcement learning model reasoning, automatic adjustment can be achieved according to the terrain and tasks, and stability and flexibility are improved; control parameters can be output to realize self-adaptive control, multi-factor dynamic adjustment is comprehensively considered, and complex motion requirements are met; meanwhile, the layered collaborative architecture is clear in division of labor, collaborative, efficient in processing and control problems and capable of improving system performance and response speed; in addition, resolving tasks are dynamically allocated according to the computing power of a heterogeneous chip through a middle-layer resolving unit, the potential of the chip is fully played, the computing efficiency is improved, the computing delay is reduced, the real-time response capability of the robot is enhanced, and the robot can better adapt to complex environments and tasks.

title: Humanoid robot quiet walking control method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention provides a humanoid robot low-impact walking control method based on foot end local angular point modeling and a pre-contact speed modulation mechanism. The humanoid robot low-impact walking control method comprises the steps that 1, a robot foot end foot point contact modeling method is constructed; a multi-point contact model is established at the sole of the robot, so that the description precision of the contact process is improved; 2, designing a reinforcement learning quiet walking reward function; a contact related penalty term is introduced into the reinforcement learning framework to restrain the motion state of the foot end before contact; and step 3, designing a contact damping adjusting mechanism. A contact damping adjustment parameter is introduced for adjusting the strength of a contact speed penalty term, and adjustability of walking behaviors is achieved; and 4, constructing a low-noise walking control method based on reinforcement learning. And the low-impact walking control of the robot is realized by integrating modeling, a reward function and an adjustment mechanism. An angular point level contact motion characterization structure is established at the foot end, the local maximum falling speed is calculated in real time, a height-related speed modulation function is introduced at the stage that the foot end is close to the ground, active speed reduction control before contact occurs is achieved, and meanwhile adjustable contact damping parameters are set; therefore, the robot can walk in different degrees with low impact and low noise in different task scenes.

title: Biped robot semi-passive gait control method and system based on adaptive Hopf-CPG
abstract: The invention discloses a biped robot semi-passive gait control method and system based on adaptive Hopf-CPG, and relates to the field of robots, and the method comprises the following steps: building a biped robot dynamic model with knee joints; on the basis of the kinetic model, key structure parameters of the robot are optimized; a self-adaptive Hopf-CPG network is constructed; a self-adaptive mechanism is introduced, and the self-adaptive mechanism comprises frequency self-adaption, amplitude self-adaption and phase self-adaption; and carrying out fusion control on the self-adaptive Hopf-CPG network and the semi-passive gait, and dynamically adjusting the active adjustment proportion of the CPG network according to the walking environment of the robot so as to realize the balance of passive energy saving and active stability. Compared with the prior art, the motion stability is obviously improved, the anti-disturbance capability is high, the energy consumption is low, the cruising ability is improved, the environment adaptability is high, and parameters do not need to be manually debugged.

title: Walking control method for humanoid robot, humanoid robot and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of robots, in particular to a walking control method for a humanoid robot, the humanoid robot and a storage medium. The walking control method for the humanoid robot comprises the steps that a target task set corresponding to the leg state of the humanoid robot is determined based on a supporting-swinging walking model of the humanoid robot and a layered null-space method of whole body control, and the leg state comprises a supporting state and a swinging state; a first transition state is further included in the process that the legs are switched from the swinging state to the supporting state, the first transition state comprises a landing sub-state and a landing completion sub-state, a second transition state is further included in the process that the legs are switched from the supporting state to the swinging state, and the second transition state comprises an off-ground sub-state. According to the technical scheme, stable walking control of the robot is achieved.

title: Leg structure of humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model aims to provide a leg structure of a humanoid robot and the humanoid robot. The leg structure comprises a first joint motor (1), a hip joint (2), a hip universal joint (3), a thigh fixing structure (4), a plurality of joint shafts and a plurality of angular contact bearings. Wherein a rotor of the first joint motor (1) is connected to the hip joint (2), each of the plurality of joint shafts is embedded in a groove of the hip joint (2) or in a groove of the thigh fixing structure (4), each of the joint shafts is embedded in an inner ring of one of the plurality of angular contact bearings, and the thigh fixing structure (4) is embedded in an outer ring of the other of the plurality of angular contact bearings. And each angular contact bearing is embedded into one groove of the hip universal joint (3), so that the leg structure is compact, the occupied space of the robot is small, the leg structure is symmetrically distributed, and the stability of the gravity center of the robot is facilitated.

title: Humanoid robot joint module driver
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robot drivers, and discloses a humanoid robot joint module driver which comprises a servo motor, a planetary gear reducing mechanism, a harmonic reducer, an output flange and a shell. An output shaft of the servo motor is coaxially connected with an output shaft of the planetary gear reducing mechanism, the output shaft of the planetary gear reducing mechanism is rigidly connected with a wave generator of the harmonic reducer, and a flexible gear of the harmonic reducer is connected with an output flange through a spline; the shell is integrally formed by carbon fiber composite materials, the servo motor is installed on the shell, the output flange is installed on the side, away from the servo motor, of the shell, the shell wraps the planetary gear speed reduction mechanism and the harmonic reducer, the planetary gear speed reduction mechanism adopts two-stage speed reduction design, the first-stage speed reduction ratio is 4: 1, and the second-stage speed reduction ratio is 5: 1. The two-stage speed reduction mechanism is connected in series through a planet carrier. According to the utility model, the compactness of a power transmission path can be realized, the overall weight can be reduced, and the structural rigidity can be improved.

title: Robot leg mechanism
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robots, and particularly discloses a robot leg mechanism which comprises thighs, shanks, feet, adjusting driving parts and transmission parts. Wherein the shank is rotationally connected with the thigh, and a transmission channel is formed in the shank; the feet are rotationally connected to one ends of the shanks away from the thighs; the adjusting driving piece is arranged in the transmission channel; the transmission part penetrates through the transmission channel and extends in the same direction as the shank, one end of the transmission part is in transmission connection with the output end of the adjusting driving part, the other end of the transmission part is rotationally connected with the foot, and the adjusting driving part drives the transmission part to move so as to drive the foot and the shank to rotate relatively. According to the arrangement, the number of parts is greatly reduced, the assembling procedure is saved, and the assembling efficiency is improved; meanwhile, as the robot needs to serve as a supporting structure, the structural strength is large, the transmission part is arranged in the transmission channel, even if the robot falls down, the shanks cannot deform, and the possibility that the transmission part in the robot is bent is effectively reduced.

title: Humanoid robot disposable glove wearing device
abstract: The utility model provides a humanoid robot disposable glove wearing device which comprises a machine box, an upper hot drying fan, a lower hot drying fan and a control circuit, a baking chamber is arranged in the machine box, and two baking windows communicated with the baking chamber are arranged on the front face of the machine box. The upper hot drying fan and the lower hot drying fan are arranged on the upper side and the lower side of the machine box respectively and can blow hot air into the baking chamber, a power switch, a temperature adjusting knob and a work indicating lamp are arranged on one side of the machine box, and the upper hot drying fan, the lower hot drying fan, the power switch, the temperature adjusting knob and the work indicating lamp are all electrically connected with the control circuit. After the hands of the robot are sleeved with heat-shrinkable disposable gloves, the two hands of the robot stretch into the baking chamber through the two baking windows correspondingly, the disposable gloves can be tightened to the hands of the robot through hot air in the baking chamber, the gloves are prevented from loosening, and rapid wearing of the gloves is achieved; and the operability and convenience of wearing the gloves by the humanoid robot are improved.
