title: Foot mechanism for humanoid robot and humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a foot mechanism for a humanoid robot, which comprises a base provided with a mounting part and a sleeve part; the first motor is used for realizing rotation of the foot part in the rolling direction and is connected with the sleeve part; the second motor is used for realizing rotation of the foot in the pitching direction; the support comprises a first support, a second support and a third support which are integrally connected, a cavity is defined by the first support, the second support and the third support, the second motor is arranged in the cavity and connected with the second support, the first support is used for being connected with the first motor, and the third support is connected with the base installation part. The utility model further discloses the humanoid robot. Rotation of the feet in the rolling direction and the pitching direction is achieved through the first motor and the second motor respectively, a connecting rod structure does not need to be arranged, the structure is simplified, layout is more compact, the overall size is not too large, and the installation difficulty is reduced; the support is formed by integrally connecting the first support, the second support and the third support, assembling is easier and more convenient, the number of parts is reduced, and the weight reduction effect is good.

title: Transmission cable of humanoid robot
abstract: The utility model discloses a transmission cable of a humanoid robot, which comprises a data transmission line formed by at least two signal transmission core wires, a power line formed by at least two electric energy transmission core wires, and a sheath layer coated outside the data transmission line and the power line, each of the signal transmission core wires and the electric energy transmission core wires comprises a conductor and an insulating layer wrapping the outer side of the conductor, the outer side of a cable core formed by twisting at least two signal transmission core wires and at least two electric energy transmission core wires is wrapped with a shielding tape, and a metal braid layer and a belting layer are sequentially arranged between the shielding tape and the sheath layer; and the sheath layer is coated on the outer side of the belting layer in a sliding manner. According to the utility model, on the basis of improving the shielding performance, the problems of wire breakage, abrasion and the like caused by relative sliding of the metal braid layer are avoided.

title: Humanoid robot
abstract: The humanoid robot comprises a body rod mechanism, a four-limb mechanism and a head mechanism, the head mechanism comprises a head body and a head cover, a plurality of connecting columns are arranged on the end face of the head cover, connecting grooves matched with the connecting columns in an inserted mode are formed in the head body, containing grooves are formed in the inner side walls of the connecting grooves, and the containing grooves are perpendicular to the connecting grooves; a fastening assembly for fixing the connecting column in the connecting groove is arranged in the containing groove, and a control assembly is arranged on the head body. title: Robot joint module and robot
abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of humanoid robots, and relates to a robot joint module and a robot, the robot joint module comprises a mounting support, a motor, an output part, a supporting bearing, a mounting part and a supporting assembly, the mounting support is provided with an arc-shaped groove surrounding an output shaft of the motor, the two ends of the output shaft are a connecting end and an output end correspondingly, and the connecting end is fixedly connected with the motor; the output part fixedly sleeves the output end, the inner ring of the supporting bearing is fixedly connected to the output part, and the outer ring of the supporting bearing is fixedly mounted on the mounting bracket; the mounting piece is fixedly connected to the output piece; the supporting assembly comprises a connecting piece, one end of the connecting piece is fixedly provided with a fixing part fixedly connected with the installing piece, the other end of the connecting piece is provided with a rotating part rotatably installed on the connecting piece, the rotating part is arranged in the arc-shaped groove, the rotating part makes contact with the inner side wall of the arc-shaped groove, and the rotating part is close to the connecting end in the axis direction of the output shaft. The robot joint module can meet the requirements for overall rigidity and stability on the premise that the structure is compact.

title: Cooling system for robot joint module
abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of humanoid robot heat dissipation, and discloses a heat dissipation system for a robot joint module. The heat dissipation system comprises a VC vapor chamber, wherein the VC vapor chamber surrounds a joint module; the liquid cooling plate is of a semicircular opening structure and surrounds the VC vapor chamber, a water inlet and a water outlet are formed in one opening end of the liquid cooling plate, a positive flow channel and a backflow channel are arranged in the liquid cooling plate, one end of the positive flow channel and one end of the backflow channel communicate with the water inlet and the water outlet correspondingly, and the other ends of the positive flow channel and the backflow channel are connected in series; and the heat dissipation assembly comprises a heat dissipation box arranged on the joint module, a fan is installed on the outer side face of the heat dissipation box, a circulating water pump is arranged above the fan, and the circulating water pump, the heat dissipation box and the liquid cooling plate communicate with one another to form a circulating liquid cooling system. Due to the fact that the heat dissipation system is installed outside the joint module, efficient heat dissipation of the closed joint module structure can be achieved, and stability and reliability of the joint module are improved.

title: ROBOT
abstract: A robot according to the embodiment of the present invention comprises a base, a stretching member, and a robot body. The base serves as a foundation of the robot. The stretching member can stretch from the base in a prescribed stretching direction. The robot body has a humanoid shape, is positioned on the side of the stretching member in the stretching direction, and performs work for constructing wiring or piping at a prescribed extended position.

title: Posture stabilization member for humanoid robot combination
abstract: The present invention relates to a posture stabilizing member for coupling to a humanoid robot, and more particularly, to a posture stabilizing member for coupling to a humanoid robot that stably maintains a posture of the robot when performing work in a suspended state by connecting the humanoid robot to a load-supporting rope fixed to an external structure. According to the present invention, tensile force of the load-supporting rope fixed to the external structure is stably transmitted to the humanoid robot through the posture stabilizing member coupled to the humanoid robot, thereby having an effect of enabling the robot to maintain a posture suitable for work even in a suspended state.

title: Hybrid power system for heterogeneous load response for humanoid robots and control method thereof
abstract: The present invention relates to a power system and a control method thereof for maintaining cognitive system power stability while efficiently handling peak power demand generated during joint driving by dynamically controlling power flow between a plurality of energy storage units and a high-output energy storage unit, considering that power characteristics of a cognitive system load and a joint drive system load of a humanoid robot are different.

title: Torso of a humanoid robot
abstract: The present disclosure provides a humanoid robot with an arrangement of components that allows the robot to mimic the movements, functionality and capabilities of a human being. The robot includes a torso having a side portion and a vent opening positioned near said side portion, and a fan positioned within an extent of the torso that is configured to generate an air flow path through the torso to prevent overheating of internal components. A central processing unit (CPU) is coupled to a first printed circuit board. A first extent of a heat sink is thermally coupled to the CPU and a second extent is positioned within the air flow path. A graphical processing unit (GPU) is coupled to a second printed circuit board. A first extent of a second heat sink is thermally coupled to the GPU and a second extent is positioned within the air flow path.
